bron: Dillmann, Lexicon linguae aethiopicae (1865); digitale editie TraCES / Beta maṣāḥǝft (Hiob-Ludolf-Zentrum, Univ. Hamburg)
opmerking: Alleen de lemma's die in de Ethiopische (Ge'ez) boeken voorkomen (gefilterd uit Dillmann).

woorden.betekenis: nova luna, menses lunares
woorden.definitie: subst. i.q. هِلاَلٌ nova luna; saepius occurrit in Abush., ex. gr. አውራኀ፡ ህላል፡ (i.q. አውራኅ፡ ሠርቃዊት፡ vel ወርኃዊት፡) menses lunares (opp. solares), Abush. 25.

woorden.betekenis: cantus Halleluja, tabula Hallelujarum inde a Joannis festo,
woorden.definitie: subst. abstr.: cantus Halleluja: አንቀጸ፡ ሃሌታ፡ (v. ሃሊታ፡) እምዮሐንስ፡ tabula Hallelujarum inde a Joannis festo, Deg. (vid. Catal. Cod. Aeth. Mus. Brit. p. 37). hālletā G ሃሌታ፡ recueil des divers modes de chant des alléluia pour l’année liturgique (temporal et sanctoral, «de Jean à Jean»). C’est ici la particule enclitique ታ፡ de sens collectif, ajoutée à la première partie du mot alléluia (souvent écrit ሃሌ፡ ሉያ፡), qui donne à ce vocable liturgique ሃሌታ፡ le sens de recueil. Voir infra ሰላም፡ et ሰላምታ፡. 2 L ሃሌታ hālletā the chanting of hallelujah, 2 collection of various modes of singing hallelujah; (አንቀጸ፡ ሃሌታ ʾanqaṣa hālletā index of types of melodies) 217

woorden.betekenis: vertendo, mutando, circumagendo, existendi, stando, oriendi,
woorden.definitie: I,2 (rarius per ሐ et ኀ) Imperf. ይሄሉ፡, Subj. የሀሉ፡, Infin. verb. ሀሊው፡ (Asc. Jes. 2,12), Infin. nom. ሀልዎ፡ et ሀልዎቶ፡; in Perf. sing. pers. 3 masc. praeter formam ሀለወ፡ etiam forma contracta ሀሎ፡ usitatissima est (vid. gramm. p. 142 ann. 2), nec non in pers. 3 fem. ሀሎት፡ efferri et scribi potest (Asc. Jes. 7,20). Sed erravit J. Ludolfus, cum inter formas ሀሎ፡ et ሀለወ፡ significationis discrimen interesse censeret (in lex. col. 1 et 2), nam omnibus fere in locis, ubi ሀለወ፡ vel ሀሎ፡ occurrit, diversi libri mss. utramque formam promiscue usurpatam exhibent. [Radicem ሀለወ፡ comparandam propono cum arab. حَالَ (حَول) et substantivo حَالٌ; eodem modo literae radic. secundae et tertiae ordo permutatus est inter ኀለወ፡ et خال (خَول), ኀለየ፡ et خال (خَيْل), al. Sed quamvis prima radicis significatio in vertendo, mutando, circumagendo sit, tamen miro quodam genii linguae innati lusu verbo notio existendi addicta est, alteri autem verbo ኮነ፡, cujus notio prima a stando petita est, significatio oriendi, fiendi, accidendi contigit. Amh. sonat አለ፡]. Significat: 1 esse, existere. Neque tamen ad praedicatum cum subjecto copulandum adhiberi solet, sed existentiam subjecti nudam ponit, aut absolute, aut tamquam in aliquo loco, statu, tempore, actione versantis: ሀሎ፡ ፩ ብእሲ፡ Job 1,1; Dan. apocr. 1,1. ኢትፍቱ፡ ሀልዎ፡ ምስሌሆሙ፡ Prov. 24,1. ሀሎኩ፡ ውስተ፡ ባቢሎን፡ 4 Esr. 1,1; በአምጣነ፡ ሀለውኩ፡ Ps. 145,1; ኢትፍራህ፤ ሀሎኩ፡ ምስሌከ፡ Jes. 41,10; Jes. 43,2; Jes. 43,5; እግዚኦ፡ ሀሎከ፡ ማእከሌነ፡ Jer. 14,9; ይከውኑ፡ ከመ፡ ዘኢሀለዉ፡ Jes. 41,12; ውስተ፡ እዴሆሙ፡ ሀለወት፡ ሠናይቶሙ፡ Job 21,16; ኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ ሀለዉ፡ ዲበ፡ ምድር፡ Sir. 36,19. a Creberrime ipsum Perf. ሀለወ፡ notionem temporis praesentis suggerit: አንበሳ፡ ሀሎ፡ ውስተ፡ ፍኖት፡ λέων ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς Prov. 26,13; አይቴ፡ ሀሎ፡ ubi est? Job 20,7; Jes. 19,12; Jer. 33,18; Jer. 44,19; አነ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዘሀሎ፡ ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ὤν Ex. 3,14; ሀለወ፡ ወኢሀለወ፡ ἦν καὶ οὐκ ἔστι Apoc. 17,8; sed haud minus frequenter ሀለወ፡ tempore praeterito vertendum est: ጸሐፍ፡ ኵሎ፡ ነገረ፡ ዘሀሎ፡ ውስተ፡ ክርታስ፡ Jer. 43,28; ሀሎኩ፡ አነ፡ ኀበ፡ ፈለግ፡ Dan. 10,4; Gen. 33,18; 2 Thess. 2,5; Judith 14,15; Judith 14,18; Ps. 71,17. Imperfectum tempus futurum significat: ወለዓለምኒ፡ ትሄሉ፡ Sir. 42,21; Jes. 58,11; Hez. 30,13; Job 14,10; Job 23,8; sed etiam de tempore praesenti usurpatur: ዘሀሎ፡ ወይሄሉ፡ ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν Apoc. 1,4; Apoc. 1,8; የኀልፍ፡ ከመ፡ ጽላሎት፡ ወኢይሄሉ፡ እንከ፡ Job 14,2. De enuntiationibus conditionalibus conferre licet exempla Jes. 43,2; Jer. 15,1; Matth. 18,20; ኀበ፡ ሀሎ፡ ደመና፡ ህየ፡ ሀሎ፡ መንፈስ፡ Hez. 1,20; Tob. 4,13 et al. b Construi potest cum Acc. loci: ሀለዉ፡ ሐቅለ፡ erant in agro Gen. 34,5; Gen. 46,31; Ex. 1,5; Num. 30,11; 2 Reg. 13,30; እንዘ፡ ሀሎ፡ ዐጸደ፡ ሞቅሕ፡ Jer. 40,1. Matth. 24,26. c Nonnunquam ope verbi ሀለወ፡ praedicatum subjecto copulatur; quod si fit, praedicatum in Acc. ponere licet (gramm. p. 346): ለዘ፡ ሀለወ፡ ድልወ፡ ei, qui paratus fuerit 1 Petr. 4,5; Hen. 63,1; sed notio existendi huic verbo tam firmiter inhaeret ut praedicatum appositionis instar saepius in Nomt. ponatur: ሀለወ፡ ድፉን፡ Jos. 7,21; Jos. 7,22; ወእሙንቱሂ፡ ሀለዉ፡ ቅዉማን፡ Asc. Jes. 9,35 al. d Aethiopes verbum ሀለወ፡ cum Imperfecto alius verbi componunt, ut durationem actionis denotent, sive in tempus praeteritum incidat: ሀሎኩ፡ እሰክብ፡ dormiebam 4 Esr. 9,29; Asc. Jes. 9,28; Dan. 10,2; Gen. 18,22; Lev. 26,35; 1 Reg. 22,6; 2 Reg. 5,2; 1 Par. 6,32; 2 Par. 33,17; sive in Praesens: ሀሎ፡ ይነብር፡ በየማነ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Rom. 8,34, vel praesens instans: ይመጽእ፡ ሀሎ፡ venturus est Hen. 10,2; ትሠጠም፡ ሀለወት፡ Hen. 83,7; ሀለወት፡ ትወልድ፡ 1 Reg. 4,19; sive in futurum አንተ፡ ሀለወት፡ ትትፌጸም፡ Hen. 106,18; Act. 7,6 Platt; ዘይከውን፡ ሀሎ፡ Hen. 52,2. Simili modo cum alius verbi Infinitivo verbali coniungitur, eodem sensu: ሀሉ፡ ተወኪለከ፡ ἴσθι πεποιθώς Prov. 3,5 et al.; nec non እንዘ፡ c. Imperf. sequi potest: በኵሉ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ሕይወትየ፡ ሀለውኩ፡ እንዘ፡ እዜከሮ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ Kuf. 21. e Opponitur ዘሀሎ፡ id quod esti.e. praesensei quod venturum vel futurum est (ዘይመጽእ፡, ዘይሄሉ፡, ዘይከውን፡) 4 Esr. 5,16; Rom. 8,38 (τὰ ἐνεστῶτα) 1 Cor. 3,22 rom., quamquam aliis in locis ዘሀሎ፡ id, quod factum est τὸ γεγονός, significat, Koh. 1,9. f Theologis et philosophis ሀልዎ፡ et ሀልዎት፡ est existentia, essentia, ut እግዚአብሔር፡ አምጻኤ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዓለም፡ እምኀበ፡ ኢሀልዎ፡ ኀበ፡ ሀልዎ፡ Deus qui totum mundum ἐκ τοῦ μὴ εἶναι εἰς τὸ εἶναι perducitFal. f. 83; እግዚአብሔር፡ ለሰብእ፡ እምሀልዎ፡ አግብኦ፡ ውስተ፡ ሞት፡ Macc. f. 5; Hippocrates et Galenus docent: ነፍስሰ፡ ኢትሄሉ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ዳእሙ፡ በሀልዎተ፡ ሥጋ፡ ወተኀልፍ፡ በኅልፈታ፡ Fal. f. 83. Pl. ሀልዎታት፡ entia(τὰ γεγονότα) saepissime in Chrys., ut Chrys. ho. 2. 2 instare, futurum esse: ክልኤቱ፡ ዓመት፡ ኀለፈ፡ ዘረኃብ፡ ወዓዲ፡ ሀሎ፡ ኀምስቱ፡ ዓመት፡ Gen. 45,6; Gen. 45,11. Construi solet cum pron. suff., seq. Subj. verbi, ut conveniat Graeco μέλλειν c. Infin. (gramm. p. 138): እለ፡ ሀለዎሙ፡ ይእመኑ፡ ቦቱ፡ οἱ μέλλοντες πιστεύειν ἐπ᾽ αὐτῷ 1 Tim. 1,16; 2 Tim. 4,1; Rom. 5,14; Matth. 11,14; Jes. 15,7; Job 3,8; vel simplici Futuro Graeco: Jes. 15,7; Tob. 14,4; Gen. 15,13; Gen. 18,19; Deut. 1,22. Haud raro ሀልዎ፡ post Subj. verbi collocatur; ያእምርዎ፡ ሀለዎሙ፡ Jes. 52,15; 1 Petr. 4,18; Hen. 97,3; Ex. 16,23. Sed multis aliis in locis haec phrasis Graeco δεῖ seq. Infin., Latino oportet, necesse estrespondet, quippe cum ሀለወ፡ cum pron. suff. conjunctum significare possit convenit ei, utvel oportet(vid. infra Nr. 8). Ita legitur: ሀለወክሙ፡ ትትወለዱ፡ δεῖ ὑμᾶς γεννηθῆναι Joh. 3,7; Prov. 22,29; 2 Petr. 3,11; Matth. 16,21; Marc. 8,31. Etiam conj. ከመ፡ subjunctivo praeponere licet: ሀለወኒ፡ ከመ፡ እዜንዎን፡ Luc. 4,43 rom. Rarius libri et mss. et impressi in hac phrasi pro Subj. verbi Imperf. praebent: ሀለዎ፡ ይትሌዐል፡ Joh. 12,34 rom. Caeterum non modo ሀለወ፡ cum pron. suff., sed etiam verbum ሀለወ፡ personaliter flexum, Subjunctivo praepositum, idem significare potest: ዘሀለወ፡ ይኩን፡ Apoc. 1,19; Apoc. 4,1; Dan. 2,28; ሀሎነ፡ ኵልነ፡ ንብጻሕ፡ Rom. 14,10; Rom. 14,12 Polygl., ሀለውነ፡ ንሕምም፡ 1 Thess. 3,14 {1 Thess. 3,4: cfr. Weninger, Verbalsystem p. 271, n. 430}. 3 exstare, reperiri, esse: እስመ፡ ሀሎ፡ ዘያሐምም፡ ἔστι γὰρ ὁ ταπεινῶν Sir. 7,11; ሀለወ፡ ዘይብዕል፡ በብዝኀ፡ ጠዊዕ፡ Sir. 11,18; Sir. 19,23; Sir. 19,25; Sir. 19,26; Sir. 20,1; Sir. 37,22; ልሂቅኒ፡ ወአእሩግኒ፡ በኀቤነ፡ ሀለወ፡ Job 15,10; Gen. 2,11; Gen. 2,12; Gen. 29,26; Ex. 13,7; ኢሀሎኑ፡ ህየ፡ ዐቃቤ፡ ሥራይ፡ Jer. 8,22; ኢሀለወት፡ ኀበ፡ እጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ οὐχ εὑρέθη Job 28,13; Job 28,14; ኵሉ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ኢሀለወ፡ ኀበ፡ ጻድቃን፡ haec omnia apud justos non reperiuntur(accidunt) Sir. 23,12; ሀሎ፡ ኀቤከ፡ πάρεστί σοι, subest tibi, Sap. 12,18. 4 durare, manere, vivere, esse: ዘይሄሉ፡ ለዓለም፡ μένων εἰς αἰῶνα Dan. 6,26; Sir. 42,23; ዘሀለወ፡ ዘልፈ፡ 1 Petr. 1,23; ወአንተሰ፡ ትሄሉ፡ σὺ δὲ διαμένεις Ps. 101,27; አብያተ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ይሄልዉ፡ οἶκοι δικαίων παραμένουσι Prov. 12,7; Sir. 6,10; ሕሊና፡ ልብከ፡ ኢይሄሉ፡ Asc. Jes. 1,13; ኢይሄሉ፡ በመሐላሁ፡ jusjurandum non servat Kuf. 35; ሀልዎትከ፡ በዝ፡ ἀντέχεσθαι ἐν τούτῳ Koh. 7,18; ሀልዉ፡ በመንፈስ፡ ቅዱስ፡ Asc. Jes. 11,40; ኢትሄሉ፡ ለዓለም፡ οὐ κατοικηθήσεται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα Jes. 13,20; Jes. 14,31; Jer. 27,39; perdurare Job 4,20; opponitur ተሀጕለ፡ Koh. 7,15; nonnunquam synonymum est verbo ሐይወ፡ ut ወቦ፡ እለሂ፡ ሀለዉ፡ እስከ፡ ይእዜ፡ 1 Cor. 15,6; እመ፡ ሀሎኩ፡ ትሬኢ፡ ወእመ፡ ሐየውከ፡ ታአምሮ፡ 4 Esr. 2,35, nec non ይሄሉ፡ በተስፋ፡ κατασκηνώσει ἐπ᾽ ἐλπίδι Prov. 1,33. 5 versari in aliqua re: ውስተ፡ መስሎ፡ ነገር፡ ኢይሄልዉ፡ Sir. 38,33; እንዘ፡ ሀለወት፡ ውስተ፡ ማሕምመ፡ ወሊድ፡ Gen. 35,17; ኢሳይያስ፡ ሀሎ፡ በራእየ፡ እግዚእ፡ Asc. Jes. 5,7. 6 se habere(de valetudine, conditione, caet.), quo sensu ኮነ፡ usitatius est: ከመ፡ ይስማዕ፡ ዜናሃ፡ ዘከመ፡ ሀለወት፡ Esth. 2,11; ናአምር፡ ዘከመ፡ ሀለዉ፡ πῶς ἔχουσι Act. 15,36; እፎ፡ ሀሎከ፡ quomodo vales?Lud. 7 adesse, praesentem esse: ኢሀሎ፡ ምትየ፡ ውስተ፡ ቤቱ፡ πάρεστι Prov. 7,19; Prov. 8,27; Jes. 58,9; Jes. 65,25; ለእመ፡ ኢሀሎኩ፡ ἀπὼν Phil. 1,27; Phil. 2,12; ሀልዎ፡ በሥጋ፡ παρουσία τοῦ σώματος 2 Cor. 10,10; Gen. 39,14; Gen. 44,14; Ex. 22,13; Ex. 22,14; በሀልዎተ፡ ሰብእ፡ coram hominibus Jsp. p. 288; ኵልነ፡ እለ፡ ሀሎነ፡ ዝየ፡ omnes qui adsumus Genz. f. 109; ለኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ ሀለዉ፡ omnibus, qui aderant Jsp. p. 331. 8 Ubi pron. suff. subjunctum habet, ሀለወ፡ pariter ac ኮነ፡ significare potest: convenit ei, decet eum, cadit in eum, ut እመቦ፡ ዘስሕተ፡ ውስተ፡ ዘከመዝ፡ ግብር፡ ሀለዎ፡ ንስሓ፡ ፫ ዓመት፡ ፍጹም፡ poenitentia triennii integri ei injungenda est Clem. f. 226, b. Ita saepissime cum Subjunctivo verbi construitur, vid. supra Nr. 2. Etiam sine pronomine subjuncto eundem sensum habet 1 Tim. 5,13 rom.: ዘኢሀሎ፡ τὰ μὴ δέοντα (Platt: ዘኢህልው፡). C vid. also ሀልዎ፡ (TraCES)

woorden.betekenis: existentiam praebere alicui, aliquem alicubi commorari, dege
woorden.definitie: II,2 1 existentiam praebere alicui: ምስለ፡ ብዙኅ፡ ምሕረት፡ ታሄልወነ፡ (διοικεῖς) Sap. 12,18. 2 aliquem alicubi commorari vel degere jubere vel facere Gad. Ad. f.7.

woorden.betekenis: qui est, existens, oriundus a, is qui vere est, verus, duran
woorden.definitie: part., fem. ህሉት፡ 1 qui est, existens: ፈጠረ፡ ፍጥረተ፡ ይኩን፡ ህልወ፡ ἔκτισεν εἰς τὸ εἶναι τὰ πάντα Sap. 2,17; መድኀኒነ፡ ዘህልው፡ እምቅድመ፡ ዓለም፡ Did. 36; አምጣነ፡ ነፍስ፡ ህሉት፡ ውስተ፡ ሥጋ፡ Jsp. p. 381; 1 Petr. 3,4; ዘህልው፡ ἃ εἰσί, Apoc. 1,19. Conjunctum cum እምነ፡ significat oriundus a: ነአምን፡ በመንፈስ፡ ቅዱስ፡ ከመ፡ ኢኮነ፡ ነኪረ፡ እምህላዌ፡ መለኮት፡ እስመ፡ እምአብ፡ ውእቱ፡ ህልው፡ καὶ γάρ ἐστιν ἐκ πατρὸς φυσικῶς Cyr. ad Reg. f. 26. 2 is qui vere est, verus, durans, stabilis: ንርአይ፡ ለእመ፡ ነገሩ፡ ህልው፡ εἰ οἱ λόγοι αὐτοῦ ἀληθεῖς Sap. 2,17; Sap. 1,6; ህልወ፡ ቃለ፡ ἀληθῆ λόγον Prov. 22,21; አማን፡ ህልወ፡ እብለክሙ፡ ἐγὼ τὴν ἀλήθειαν λέγω ὑμῖν Joh. 16,7; ዐስብ፡ ህልው፡ μισθὸς τῆς ἀληθείας Prov. 11,18; Prov. 2,12 πιστόν; ዝንጓጔ፡ ህልው፡ cavillatio perpetua, Jsp. p. 365; ብዕል፡ ህልው፡ ወዕሴት፡ ዘይነብር፡ ለዓለም፡ Jsp. p. 348. Inde ህልወ፡ vel በህልው፡ vere, revera: አኮ፡ በህልው፡ ወአኮ፡ በጽድቅ፡ Kuf. 23et Kuf. 22; ህልወ፡ ኮንኩ፡ ምስሌሆሙ፡ Kuf. 1. 3 qui praesto est: እስመ፡ ዕበየ፡ ክሂሎትከ፡ ህልው፡ ኀቤከ፡ ዘልፈ፡ πάρεστί σοι Sap. 11,22; qui adest: እመሰ፡ ኮንኩ፡ ህልወ፡ እምኢተፈጸመ፡ ሎሙዝ፡ si adfuissem, hoc iis non contigisset Jsp. p. 338. 4 τὸ δέον ዘህልው፡ 1 Tim. 5,13 Platt (vid. ሀለወ፡ Nr. 8). hǝllǝw, fem. hǝllut G ህልው፡ hǝllǝw le vrai, ce qui est exact ከሠተ፡ ለነ፡ ዓቢየ፡ ወመድምመ፡ ወህልወ። 189. በህልው፡ réellement, exactement እኩሌ፡ ፀሩ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ኢየሱስ፡ ክርስቶስ፡ እለ፡ ይመይጥዎሙ፡ በህልው፡ ለእለ፡ አምኑ፡ በአማን፡ ቃል፡ ወበምግባር፡ ዝውእቱ፡ ኢየሱስ፡ ክርስቶስ። 193. ዘበህልው፡ en ce qui concerne la vérité, l’exactitude (m. à m.: le vrai). ናሁኬ፡ ኢተሐከይነ፡ በዘህልው፡ ስምዖ፡ ለእግዚእነ፡ ኢየሱስ፡ ክርስቶስ፡ ወእግዚእነ፡ ዘከመ፡ ገብረ፡ እንዘ፡ ንሬኢ፡ ሀለውነ፡ ወዘከመ፡ ዘለፈ፡ ሕሊናቲነ፡ በኀቤነ። 193. 3 L ህልው hǝllǝw (fem.) ህሉት hǝllut existing, who exists, who lives, that lasts, lasting, constant, that is present, who originates, that is true, that is exact በህልው ba-hǝllǝw, ህልወ hǝllǝwa really, exactly, truly 218a

woorden.betekenis: esse, quod sacerdotium ejus aeternum est, quamdiu sol in una
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem. 1 τὸ εἶναι, esse(i.q. ሀልዎት፡): ህላዌ፡ ክህነቱ፡ ለዓለም፡ quod sacerdotium ejus aeternum est Chrys. ho. 19; ለእግዚአብሔር፡ አልቦ፡ ጥንት፡ ለህላዌሁ፡ ὁ θεὸς ἄναρχος Chrys. ho 22; በአምጣነ፡ ህላዌ፡ ፀሐይ፡ በ፩ ኆኅት፡ እም፲ወ፪ ኀዋኅው፡ quamdiu sol in una duodecim portarum commoratur Abush. 3; narrabo ዕድሜ፡ ህላዌሆሙ፡ ለኵሎሙ፡ በጵጵስናሆሙ፡ quantum temporis singuli Patriarchae fuerint Abush. 50. 2 essentia, existentia, substantia, naturarei vel personae: ማይ፡ ኀብአ፡ ፍጥረተ፡ ህላዌሁ፡ Sap. 19,19. Apud theologos saepissime occurrit: እምአሜሃ፡ ህላዌሁ፡ ለክርስቶስ፡ ሶበ፡ ተወልደ፡ በሥጋ፡ Christi ab eo inde tempore fuit existentia, quo natus est(sicut haeretici docent) Cyr. ad Theod. f. 8; የአምኑ፡ አልቦ፡ ህላዌ፡ ዘእግዚአብሔር፡ ቃል፡ አላ፡ በከመ፡ ቃልነ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ἀνυπόστατον τὸν ἐκ Θεοῦ εἶναι λόγον φασίν Cyr. ad Theod. f. 8; Messias dicitur Christus በእንተ፡ ሢመቱ፡ ወግብሩ፡ አኮ፡ ዘህላዌ፡ አው፡ ዘገጽ፡ εἰς πραγμάτων δήλωσιν, οὐχ ὑποστάσεων οὔτε προσώπων Cyr. c. Pall. f. 72. Saepissime Graecorum φύσει respondet: ኢኮነ፡ (ክርስቶስ፡) እግዚአብሔር፡ በህላዌሁ፡ οὐ φύσει θεὸς ὢν (sed assumptione) Cyr. ad Theod. f. 8; ህላዌ፡ ቃል፡ ἡ τοῦ λόγου φύσις Cyr. ad Theod. f. 10; እም፪ ህላዌ፡ ተደመረ፡ ፩ ክርስቶስ፡ e duabus naturis(φύσεων) Cyr. ad Theod. f. 15; Christus በህላዌሁ፡ አምላክ፡ φύσει ὑπάρχων θεός Cyr. ad Theod. f. 23; ነአምን፡ ከመ፡ ውእቱ፡ ወልደ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ በመንፈስ፡ ወወልደ፡ በሥጋ፡ ወአኮ፡ በ፪ ህላዌ፡ ፩ ወልድ፡ οὐ δύο φύσεις τὸν ἕνα θεόν Cyr. ad Reg. f. 28; ኢኮነኑ፡ ፪ህላዌ፡ ዘሰብእ፡ ወዘአምላክ፡ ἄρ᾽ οὖν δύο φύσεις εἶεν ἂν θεοῦ καὶ ἀνθρώπου; Cyr. c. Pall. f. 77. Essentia, οὐσία est ex. gr. in formula illa tritissima: ኅቡረ፡ ህላዌ፡ ὁμοούσιος consubstantialis, coessentialis Cyr. c. Pall. f. 66; al. 3 praesentia: በህላዌሆሙ፡ ለፍቁራኒሁ፡ praesentibus amicis ejus Jsp. p. 320; በህላዌየ፡ Jsp. p. 336; ርሕቀትየ፡ እምህላዌ፡ ንጉሥ፡ discessus meus e praesentia regis Jsp. p. 338; ህላዌ፡ ኵለሄ፡ omnipraesentia Kebr. Nag. 101. 4 status, conditio: ህላዌ፡ ግፍዕ፡ Hen. 91,5; ገቢረ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ወኵሉ፡ አዝማን፡ ወበኵሉ፡ ህላዌ፡ Phlx. 107; ህላዌ፡ ብፁዓን፡ status beatorum Chrys. Ta. 6; ኀበ፡ ህላዌሁ፡ ተመይጠ፡ ልሳኑ፡ ውቁይ፡ Enc.; ኀበ፡ ህላዌሁ፡ አግብኦ፡ ad priorem status reduxit eum, Sx. Ter 5 Enc. – Voc. Ae: ህላዌ፡ ብ፡ መኖርያ፡ አካልሂ። hǝllawe dwelling, abode ወበሣልሳይ፡ ዓመት፡ ተንሥአት፡ እምሸሜ፡ ከመ፡ ትትራከብ፡ ምስለ፡ ወልዳ፡ መፍቀሬ፡ እሙ፡ ከመ፡ በጥሊሞስ፡ ወአሜሃ፡ ኮነ፡ ህላዌሁ፡ በምድረ፡ ወጅ። ‘E no terceiro anno levantou-se de Xamé, para se encontrar com seu filho, amigo de sua mãe, como Ptolemeu, porque então assistia na provincia de Vaĵ’ 25 l. 12–15 (ed.), 44 l. 3–5 (tr.) G ህላዌ፡ «essentia, substantia, existentia», Pl. ህላዌያት፡ –– አነንዋር፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 1. ህላዌ፡ personne, hypostase. አብ፡ ወወልድ፡ ወመንፈስ፡ ቅዱስ፡ ፩ [አምላክ፡] በባሕርዪሁ፡ በዕበዩ፡ ወበክብሩ፡ ወበሥልጣኑ፡ አላ፡ በህላዌ፡ ፫። 4 4 L ህላዌ hǝllāwe substance, essence, nature, existence, hypostasis, being, state, presence, position, condition, (Lt) dwelling, residence ኢህላዌ ʾihǝllāwe absence ህላውያት hǝllāwǝyāt (Pl. of hǝllāwe) elements 218a

woorden.betekenis: essentia
woorden.definitie: subst. (ab ህልው፡ ductum): essentia: Lit. 172,4; Lit. Jac. Sar.; Athan. de Trin.; Haim. Ab.

woorden.betekenis: locus commorationis, domicilium
woorden.definitie: subst. locus commorationis, domicilium: ነፍስ፡ እመ፡ ተፈልጠት፡ እምሥጋ፡ በሞት፡ ገብአት፡ ኀበ፡ ብርሃን፡ ዘውእቱ፡ ማኅደራ፡ ወምህላዋ፡ ወፍግዓሃ፡ ወተድላሃ፡ Jsp.; (Darius) ነሥአ፡ ሀገረ፡ ባቢሎን፡ ወተወፈየ፡ ምህላወ፡ ብልጣር፡ ወነበረ፡ ዲበ፡ ዐራቱ፡ Jsp. p. 276.

woorden.betekenis: pron. suff. IIIae pers. masc. pl., vid. gramm. § 1
woorden.definitie: pron. suff. IIIae pers. masc. pl., vid. gramm. § 149.

woorden.betekenis: captivos ducere, praedam agere, manubias facere, bello caper
woorden.definitie: quadril. I [Amh. ማረከ፡] (pro Subj. regul. ይማህርክ፡ nonnunquam etiam forma ይምሀርክ፡ reperitur Kuf. p. 122 ann. 4; Kuf. p. 160 ann. 11; et pro Imperat. ማህርከ፡ forma መሀርከ፡ Jes. 8,1; Jes. 8,3 var.) proprie: laqueis vel retibus captos agere i.e. 1 captivos ducere, praedam agere, manubias facere, bello capere, c.c. Acc. αἰχμαλωτεύειν ማህረክዎ፡ Job 1,15; Job 1,17; 2 Par. 28,5; 2 Par. 28,8; 2 Par. 28,11; Ex. 22,9; λαμβάνειν 1 Par. 7,21; σκυλεύειν ይመሀርኩ፡ መራዕየኪ፡ Hez. 26,12; Hez. 38,12; ማህረክዎሙ፡ ምህርካ፡ ብዙኀ፡ 2 Par. 14,13; 2 Par. 20,25; 2 Par. 25,13; προνομεύειν ማህረኩ፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ ፄዋ፡ Num. 21,1; Jes. 33,23; ማህረከ፡ እንስሳሆሙ፡ Judith 2,26; Kuf. 34; etiam abs. ማህርክ፡ Jes. 8,1; Jes. 8,3. 2 despoliare, expilare, diriperec.c. Acc. pers. vel terrae: Jes. 11,14 var.; ይመህርኮሙ፡ ለጽኑዓን፡ 53,12; Jes. 27,10; Kuf. 48. māhraka G ማህረከ፡ māhraka quadrl. I, ይመሀርክ፡, ይማህርክ፡ «faire prisonnier dans la bataille, faire du butin» ― ማረከ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 32v. 72 L ማህረከ māhraka take as booty, plunder, loot, rob, pillage 334b

woorden.betekenis: praeda, manubiae, spolia, mǝhrǝkā, mǝhǝrkā, butin, tout ce q
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., praeda(manubiae, spolia) προνομή, σκῦλα Ps. 67,13; Ps. 118,162; Deut. 7,16; 1 Reg. 30,16; 2 Reg. 3,22; Kuf. 13; Jes. 8,4; Jes. 33,4; Jes. 49,25; Jer. 30,10; Hez. 29,19; Hez. 34,22; Judith 9,4; ፄዋ፡ ወምህርካ፡ Num. 31,11. – De locis Gen. 48,22 et Ps. 59,6 vid. ሰቂማ፡ – Voc. Ae.: ፄዋ፡ ምህርካ፡ ብ፡ ምርኮ። mǝhrǝkā, mǝhǝrkā G ምህርካ፡ mǝhrǝkā «butin, tout ce qu’on a pris dans la bataille (homes, choses)» ― ምርኮ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 32v. 73 L ምህርካ፡ mǝhǝrkā booty, spoils, plunder 334b C vid. also ምህርክና፡

woorden.betekenis: infamare, diffamare, conviciari, mihi conviciantur
woorden.definitie: (ተሀበበ፡) III,1: in ingerendis probris et contumeliis versari, infamare, diffamare, conviciari: ወኵልክሙ፡ ተሀበብዎ፡ ለስሙ፡ πάντες ἔκδοτε ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Jer. 31,17; ይትሀበቡኒ፡ mihi conviciantur Jer. 20,8; ኢትትሀበቦ፡ ለአይትጋነይ፡ μὴ ὀνείδιζε ἄνθρωπον Sir. 8,5; በማእከለ፡ ቢጹ፡ ይትሀበብዎ፡ ለምታ፡ Sir. 25,18 (var.: ይትሀበለይዎ፡). In loco Sir. 8,5 alii libri mss. ኢታህብቦ፡ exhibent, quod stirpi II,1 convenit, sed alibi nusquam አህበበ፡ inveni. –

woorden.betekenis: hab, spirare, flare
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., quae primitus sicut هَبَّ aliaeque radice hab incipientes spirare, flare significavit. Hinc:

woorden.betekenis: ros copiosus, aliud, pruina, bulla aquae, ros, bacca, grando
woorden.definitie: (var. ሀቦ፡) subst.: ros copiosus. Legitur Ex. 16,13 ubi Graecus δρόσος habet. – Voc. Ae.: አውል፡ ህቦ፡ ዘ፡ ጤዛ፡; aliud ህቦ፡ ዘ፡ ጠል፡; ጤዛ፡ autem secundum Isenb. p. 184 pruina est. [Quare nescio an etiam حَبَبٌ bulla aquae, حَبَابٌ bulla aquae et ros, حَبَّ bacca (حَبُّ قَرٍّ grando ) et Aeth. ሕንባብ፡ comparanda sint].

woorden.betekenis: ululavit, , clamavit, canes aurei, milvus, vultur
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., quae componenda videtur cum אָוָה ululavit , clamavit (unde אִיִּים canes aurei إِبْنُ آوَى id., אַיָּה milvus, vultur ). Hinc

woorden.betekenis: ô, b, v, milvus, accipiter, Voc. Ae., simia, Satanas apparui
woorden.definitie: subst. (cujus ô, sequentem literam bex vortam esse, indicat). 1 Pl. ሆባያት፡, avis e genere rapacium: ἴκτινος milvus Lev. 11,14; Deut. 14,13; ἱέραξ accipiter Job 39,26 (masc.) collective: Hen. 89,10; Hen. 90,2; Hen. 90,4; Hen. 90,11; Hen. 90,13. Praeterea 34,11 in eo loco ubi LXX ἴβεις habent, Ae. ሆባይ፡ (v. ሆባያት፡) exhibet. Voc. Ae.inter avium nomina: ሆባይ፡ ዘ፡ አንጭት፡ (quod sec. Ludolfi Gregorium „avem e genere rapacium, aridis arboribus insidentem, mures aviculasque captantem“ significat; Lud. lex. col. 6). 2 simia, Pl. አህቡይ፡ πίθηκοι 2 Par. 9,21; Satanas apparuit በአምሳለ፡ ሆባይ፡ Gad. T.H.; ወይጠለ፡ አስገድከ፡ ወሆባየ፡ አክነስከ፡ ብፁዕ፡ አንተ፡ አባ፡ ዮሐኒ፡ Mavâs. 13. – Voc. Ae.inter ferarum nomina: ሆባይ፡ ዘ፡ ዝንጅሮ፡ (v. ዝንጀሮ፡). Vid. etiam Rüppell Reise I. p. 301 (ubi pro Hewescribendum est Höwêvel Höbê). Et milvus et simia a clamandohoc nomen traxisse videntur (neque est, quod ሆባይ፡ simiamcum कपि קוֹף ܩܽܘܦܳܐ κῆπος κῆβος κεῖβος componamus). hobāy Pl. hobāyāt G ሆባይ፡ singe, guenon (ዝንጀሮ፡) ሶቤሃ፡ መጽአ፡ አቡነ፡ ታዴዎስ፡ ወእንዘ፡ ይትዓጸፍ፡ ጸዳለ፡ መብረቅ፡ ወይቤላ፡ እኪት፡ ብእሲት፡ ለምንት፡ ትገብሪ፡ ከመዝ፡ ወትሰርቂ፡ ንዋየ፡ ቅዱሳን። አንሰ፡ አመስቀልኩ፡ ቍልቍሊተ፡ በማእከለ፡ አየር። ወይእዜኒ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ይወልጥ፡ አርአየኪ። ወሶቤሃ፡ ተወለጠ፡ አርአያሃ፡ ወኮነ፡ መንፈቀ፡ ሥጋሃ፡ በአምሳለ፡ ሆባይ፡ ጸጓር፡ እምላዕለ፡ ሐቌሃ፡ ወእምታሕተ፡ ሐቌሃሰ፡ ከመ፡ ሰብእ። 48. አህባይ፡ ((Pl. brisé)) de ሆባይ፡ singes, guenons. ወቦኡ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ከለባት፡ ውስተ፡ ውሣጤ፡ ከተማ፡ ወአስተጋብኡ፡ ብዙኃነ፡ አዕጽምተ፡ ወወገሩ፡ አውጺኦሙ፡ ኀበ፡ አፍአ፡ ከተማ። ወእሙንቱሰ፡ አዕጽምት፡ ኮኑ፡ ሠራዊተ፡ አህባይ፡ ወኮኑ፡ ወዓርጉ፡ ውስተ፡ ነዋህ፡ ደብር።... ወዓርጉ፡ ውስተ፡ ርእሰ፡ ውእቱ፡ ደብር፡ ዘይቀውሙ፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ሠራዊተ፡ አህበይ፡ ወቀሠፍዎሙ፡ በውእቱ፡ ጥብጣቤ፡ ለእሙንቱ፡ አራዊት፡ ወሰደድዎሙ፡ ርሑቀ። 14–15 5 C a vid. also ህበይ፡ (TraCES) b vid. also አህቡይ፡

woorden.betekenis: prurire, scalpere
woorden.definitie: prurire, scalpere vid. sub ሐከከ፡

woorden.betekenis: strepitus, tumultus, perturbatio, turba, temeritas praeceps,
woorden.definitie: subst. 1 strepitus, tumultus, perturbatio, turba: ሀከከ፡ ቀትል፡ θόρυβος πολέμων Jer. 30,2; θόρυβος Prov. 1,27; Prov. 23,29; πτόησις Prov. 3,25; ሀከክ፡ ዘይከውን፡ τάραχος Job 24,17; ταραχή Jer. 14,19; Hez. 23,46; ዕለተ፡ ሀከክ፡ ἡμέρα ταραχῆς Jes. 22,5; Kuf. 36; ማየ፡ ሀከክ፡ τὸ ὕδωρ τὸ ἀνυπόστατον Ps. 123,4; አኮ፡ በሀከክ፡ ወትዝልፍት፡ μηδὲν προπετὲς πράττειν ( temeritas praeceps ) Act. 19,36; 2 tumultus, turbae, seditio, rixae, discordiae, quibus civitates, respublica, ecclesia, quaelibet hominum societas perturbantur: ταραχαὶ Prov. 6,14; ἀκαταστασίαι Prov. 26,28; እለ፡ ይገብሩ፡ ሀከከ፡ διχοστασίαν ποιοῦντες Rom. 16,17; θόρυβος Matth. 26,5; Act. 20,1; στάσις et συστροφή Marc. 15,7; Act. 19,40; σεισμοὶ Matth. 24,7; በሀከክ፡ ኀደርክሙ፡ ወበሀከክ፡ ይወድቁ፡ ደቂቅከ፡ seditione Kuf. 10et 23. – Voc. Ae.: ጋእዝ፡ ተስናን፡ ባእስ፡ ሀውክ፡ ሀከክ፡ ሒስ፡ ሰቈራር፡ ላኳ፡ ቅስት፡ ዘ፡ እሉ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ጽልእ። hakak, Pl. hakakāt 1 tumulto, strepito 2 perturbazione, sedizione, discordia, spavento, rovina, baruffa, rissa, trambusto G ሀከክ፡, Pl. ሀከካት፡ 1 « émeute, tumulte, dispute, trouble » ― ሞገድ፡, ክርክር፡ BNFabb217, fol. 9v. 2 (sens collectif) désordres, dissensions, collisions. ሀከክ፡ ዘኮነ፡ በሀገረ፡ ቍስጥንጥንያ፡ በእንተ፡ ሥጋ፡ ንጹሕ፡ ዘእግዚእነ፡ ወመድኀኒነ፡ ኢየሱስ፡ ክርስቶስ። 143; በእንተ፡ ሀከክ፡ ዘገብሩ፡ ላዕለ፡ ፎቃ፡ በግብጽ። 144. 3 persécution religiouse (les dix grandes persécutions ordonnées par les empereurs romains contre les premiers chrétiens). አንሥአ፡ [ዱማድዮስ፡] ሀከከ፡ ላዕለ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ ወአውረደ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ኵነኔያት፡ ብዙኃተ፡ በእደ፡ ዳክዮስ፡ ወበእንተ፡ ምክረ፡ መኳንንቲሁ። 184; አዘዘ፡ [ፈርንስጣ፡] ከመ፡ ኢይግበሩ፡ ቦሙ፡ ሀከከ፡ ወኢያስተናሥኡ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ስደተ፡ ወኢይበርብሩ፡ ንዋዮሙ፡ ወኢያሕምምዎሙ፡ ምንተኒ። ወዓዲ፡ አዘዘ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይክልእዎሙ፡ ተቀንዮቶሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ ቅድስት፡ ከመ፡ ይጸልዩ፡ በእንቲአሁ፡ ወበእንተ፡ መንግሥቱ። 190. 6–7 L ሀከክ hakak tumult, sedition, riot, revolt, trouble, turmoil, terror, alarm, uproar, quarrel, discord, dissension, consternation, commotion, chaos, disorder, (6) religious persecution 216b

woorden.betekenis: segnitiae vel desidiae deditum esse, segnem, pigrum, otiosum
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 segnitiae vel desidiae deditum esse; segnem, pigrum, otiosum, tardum esse vel fieri: አፍቀሩ፡ ጽሕ፡ በእገሪሆሙ፡ ወኢይትሀከዩ፡ Jer. 14,10; ኢትትሀከዩ፡ nolite segnes esse Sir. 43,30; ዘይጻሙ፡ በሥጋሁ፡ ወይትሀከይ፡ በነፍሱ፡ qui negotiosus est corpore et otiosus animâ, Org.; ኢናፅርዕ፡ ቅኔ፡ እደዊነ፡ ወኢንትሀከይ፡ Did. 13. C.c. ለ rei: Ps. 35,4; Rom. 12,11; ኢትትሀከዩ፡ ለንስሓ፡ Clem. f. 225; et c. Acc. Infin.: ኢትትሀከዩ፡ ነዲፎታ፡ Jer. 27,14; (episcopus) ኢይትሀከይ፡ ጸዊመ፡ Did. 4. 2 cunctari, haesitare, ὀκνεῖν, c.c. Acc. Infin.: ኢትትሀከይ፡ ሐውጾ፡ ድዉይ፡ μὴ ὄκνει ἐπισκέπτεσθαι ἄρρωστον Sir. 7,35; Tob. 12,6; Judith 12,13; Num. 22,16; Jud. 18,9. 3 languescere, intermittere, cessare, deficerein re peragenda: c.c. Acc.: ኢትትሀከይ፡ ጸሎተ፡ ne intermittas preces Rel. Bar.; et c. Acc. Infin.: ኢትትሀከይ፡ ገቢረ፡ ሠናይ፡ μὴ ἀπόσχῃ εὖ ποιεῖν Prov. 3,27; Gal. 6,9; Thess. 3,13; Luc. 18,1; ኢይትሀከዩ፡ ወሪቀ፡ ውስተ፡ ገጽየ፡ Job 30,10; nec non c. እምነ፡ ut: ኢትትሀከይ፡ እደዊከ፡ እምነ፡ አግብርቲከ፡ Jos. 10,6; { episcopus factus ኢተሀከየ፡ በውስተ፡ ሢመቱ፡ እምገድሉ፡ ቀዳሚ፡ Sx. Pag. 5}. 4 pusillanimem essein re peragenda (cfr. كَهِيَ): ኢትትሀከይ፡ ኰንኖቶ፡ μὴ ὀλιγοψυχήσῳς ἐν τῷ κρίνειν Sir. 4,9. 5 aversari, aspernari: ኢይትሀከይ፡ መዊተ፡ οὐ παραιτοῦμαι τὸ ἀποθανεῖν Act. 25,11; ዘእጽሕፍ፡ ለክሙ፡ ኢይትሀከይ፡ አንሰ፡ vobis scribere me non piget Phil. 3,1; etiam cum እምነ፡ rei: ኢትትሀከይ፡ እመልእክት፡ ministerium ne asperneris Hom. (Lud.); F.N. 10,24. tahakaya III,1; tahakkaya III,2, ወይቤልዎ፡ ኢንትሀከይ፡ ንሕነ፡ ከመ፡ ንሖር፡ ኀበ፡ ሐፄጌ፡ ወኢናመከኒ፡ በመከራ፡ ክረምት። ‘“Nous ne désirons pas cesser d’aller (chez le) Ḥaṣēgē, nous n’allons pas chercher de prétextes dans les ennuis de la saison des pluies”’ 54 l. 24–25 (ed.), 63 l. 36–37 (tr.); in the following ex. the verb takes the indirect object but the construction may be faulty: ዓዲ፡ ይቤሎሙ፡ እስኩ፡ ኢይትሀከይ፡ ለክሙ፡ እስመ፡ እወስደክሙ፡ ኀበ፡ ትረክቡ፡ ረባሐ፡ 158 l. 23–24 (ed.) Again he said to them, please do not be idle because I will take you where you will gain profit G ተሀከየ፡ tahakaya III,1 «aspernatus est, piger fuit» ― ሰነፈ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 1. ተሀከየ፡ tahakkaya III,2 se livrer à la paresse, être négligent, nonchalant. እመ፡ ፈቀደ፡ ኀበ፡ ቍጥዓ፡ ወመዓት፡ ዘተሠርዓ፡ ላዕሌነ፡ ሶበ፡ ሶበ፡ ይትሔከይ፡ ለይኩን፡ ቍጥዓሁ፡ ቱሱሐ፡ በምጣኔ፡ እስመ፡ ቀታልያን፡ ይትጌበሩ፡ ሰይፈ፡ እምነ፡ ኀፂን። Ms. BNFet110, fol. 43rb. ስምዑ፡ ኦኖሎት፡ ቃለ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘንተ፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ናሁ፡ አነ፡ እትኃሠሥ፡ አባግዕየ፡ እምነ፡ ኖሎት፡ ወኢይርእይዎሙ፡ ዳግመ፡ ኖሎት፡ ወአድኅን፡ አባግዕየ፡ እምአፉሆሙ፡ ወኢይከውኑ፡ ካዕበ፡ መብልዓ፡ ሎሙ። ይደሉ፡ ከመ፡ ይለብው፡ እንከ፡ አይ፡ ኵነኔ፡ ይደልዎ፡ ለዘይትሔከይ፡ አስተሐምሞ፡ በእለ፡ ተሠይመ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ። Ms. BNFet110, fol. 38v a-b. 7 L ተሀከየ tahakaya, (7) ተሀከየ tahakkaya be sluggish, be slack, be slothful, be weary, be nonchalant, neglect, be negligent, be lazy, be indolent, be inert, be tranquil, be idle, be remiss, cease, hesitate, delay, decline, disdain 216b

woorden.betekenis: segnitia, socordia, desidia, inertia, pigritia, species culp
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem.: segnitia, socordia, desidia, inertia, pigritia Koh. 10,18; Prov. 29,45; Sir. 22,1; saepissime in aliis libris, ex. gr. in Chrys.; Clem. f. 255; in juris doctrina ሀኬት፡ est species culpaesc. negligentia, desidia, ut: እመ፡ ዘረከባ፡ እምሕሠማት፡ ኮነ፡ በሀኬተ፡ ዚአሁ፡ si malum, quod ei (jumento) accidit, negligentiaejus ortum est F.N. 28; በ፡ ተሀጕለ፡ ንዋየ፡ አመጋቢ፡ በእደ፡ መጋቢ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ድልሑት፡ ወኢሀኬት፡ absque dolo et culpa(negligentia) F.N. 30. haket G ሀኬት፡ «desidia» ― ስንፍና፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 1. 7 L ሀኬት haket weariness, idleness, slothfulness, laziness, apathy, inertia, negligence 216b

woorden.betekenis: perturbatus, obstupefactus, properavit, praeproperus, veheme
woorden.definitie: radix cum ሀከከ፡ et ሀከወ፡ cognata. [Arabice respondent cum هَوَّاكٌ, مُتَهَوِّكٌ perturbatus, obstupefactus, هَيَّك properavit, tum أَهْوَاجُ praeproperus, vehementer currens et هَاجَ (هَيْج) incitatus fuit et concitavit; Amharice አወከ፡].

woorden.betekenis: moveri, agitari, jactari, fluctuare, non potuit se loco move
woorden.definitie: III,1 (ተሀወከ፡ Num. 22,3): 1 moveri, agitari, jactari, fluctuare: ውእቱ፡ ገመል፡ ኢክህለ፡ ተሀውኮ፡ non potuit se loco movere Sx. Tachs. 8; ባሕርሰ፡ ይትሀወክ፡ Joh. 6,18; 4 Esr. 13,1 (Laur.); Jes. 5,30; Jon. 1,11; ተሀውኮ፡ መዋግደ፡ ባሕር፡ ያንቀለቅሎ፡ ለሐመር፡ Chrys. ho. 11; ደመና፡ እንተ፡ ትትሀወክ፡ እምነፋስ፡ Judae 12; ተሀውኩ፡ ከመ፡ ዕፀ፡ ገዳም፡ Jes. 7,2; Thren. 4,14; Ps. 15,8; Jes. 24,19; c.c. እምነ፡ exturbari, propelli ex Hen. 38,1; ultro citro circumferri Ps. 61,6; Ps. 108,9. 2 Usurpatur de variis corporis et animi motibus, affectionibus, perturbationibus: ተሀውከ፡ ከርሡ፡ torminibus affectus est M.M. f. 20; ተሀውኮ፡ ልቡ፡ ላዕሌሃ፡ (amore) Judith 12,16; ይትሀወክ፡ ፍትወት፡ በመለያልዪሆሙ፡ excitatur concupiscentia in eorum membris F.M. 34,8; misericordia Gen. 43,30; timore Gen. 41,8; Ps. 6,2; Sap. 5,2; Matth. 2,3; tristitia Kuf. 35; 4 Esr. 1,3; perturbatum esse mente, commotum animo 4 Esr. 9,29; Jes. 13,8; Dan. 7,28; 2 Thess. 2,2. 3 tumultu, concursu, turbis, confusione excitari Matth. 21,10; Marc. 14,2; Jud. 3,26; 1 Reg. 14,16; Sap. 16,6; Esth. 3,15; 4 Esr. 9,3; Kuf. 31. – (Scholion Voc. Ae. vid. sub ተሐውሰ፡) tahawka, tahawaka G ተሀውከ፡ III,1 se révolter, se rebeller. ከማሁ፡ መርገምኒ፡ ትትመየጥ፡ ላዕለ፡ ዘይረግም፡ እንበለ፡ ድልወት። ወሁከትኒ፡ ላዕለ፡ ዘይትሀወክ፡ ወዘኢድልወት፡ እምኔሁ። BNFet110, fol. 33rb. 8 L ተሀውከ tahawka, ተሀወከ tahawaka, ተሆከ tahoka passive; also move about, quake, rebel 220a

woorden.betekenis: agitatus, commotus, perturbatus, vagus, inconstans
woorden.definitie: (ህውክ፡) part.: agitatus, commotus, perturbatus; vagus, inconstans: Jac. 1,8; ህዉካን፡ ወጽሩዓን፡ እለ፡ አልቦሙ፡ ምግባረ፡ ሠናየ፡ Clem. f. 235.

woorden.betekenis: motus, fluctuatio, perturbatio, commotio, inconstantia, turb
woorden.definitie: subst.: 1 motus, fluctuatio: Hen. 60,4; ሀውከ፡ ሞገድ፡ hom. Acacii. 2 perturbatio, commotio: Hen. 39,2; ταραχὴ Epist. Johannis Ant. (in Cyr. f. 114). 3 inconstantia, turbae: Jac. 3,16. Usitatius est 1 turbolenza, agitazione, sommossa, scompiglio, disordine, perturbazione 2 confusione, mescolanza 3 moto, fluttuazione, volubilità

woorden.betekenis: motus, agitatio, fluctuatio, perturbatio, commotio animi, tu
woorden.definitie: n. act.: 1 motus, agitatio, fluctuatio: Sir. 40,5; Ps. 54,25; Ps. 65,8; Ps. 120,3 (σάλος); Koh. 9,3 (περιφέρεια); Joh. 5,3 (κίνησις); ተሀውኩ፡ ዐቢየ፡ ሁከተ፡ Hen. 60,1. 2 perturbatio, commotio animi, ex. gr. ሁከተ፡ ነፍስ፡ ταραχαὶ ψυχῆς Sap. 17,8; Jes. 52,12. Hebr. 12,1. 3 turbae, tumultus, disturbatio: ቃል፡ ወሁከት፡ φωναὶ καὶ θόρυβος Esth. apocr. 1; ሰይጣን፡ መፍቀሬ፡ ሁከት፡ Clem. f. 222; in republica 4 Esr. 12,21; 4 Esr. 12,35; ἀκαταστασία Tob. 4,13; በሁከት፡ ἀτάκτως 2 Thess. 3,11; σύστασις Gen. 49,6; (noli sero in ecclesiam venire) ከመ፡ በድምፀ፡ ምጽአትከ፡ ኢይኩን፡ ሁከት፡ ለእለ፡ ይጼልዩ፡ Kid. f. 19. hukat G ሁከት፡ révolte, désobéissance, insubordination, agitation (sens plus fort que celui de vid. ሀውክ፡). ባህል፡ ሳብእ፡ በእንተ፡ ተፈልጦ፡ ሁከታት፡ ወተጋእዞታት፡ ወዘሀሎ፡ ማእከሌሆሙ፡ ወበእንተ፡ ዘይትጌበር፡ ወቦ፡ ዘይቤ፡ በእንተ፡ ነጐርጓር፡ ወኑፋቄ፡ በትእዛዘ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አው፡ ዘይትጌበር፡ በከመ፡ ሥርዓተ፡ አበው፡ ቅዱሳን። Ms. BNFet110, fol. 33ra. ሁከተ፡ ልብ፡ agitation de l’âme. መዓትኒ፡ ሁከተ፡ ልብ፡ ወገዓረ፡ ነፍስ፡ ውእቱ፡ ወይሰመይ፡ ከመዝ። Ms. BNFet110, fol. 44vb. vid. ልብ፡ 8 L ሁከት hukat movement, motion, trouble, turmoil, disturbance, tumult, perturbation, commotion, uproar, turbulence, agitation, disorder, riot 220a

woorden.betekenis: ibi, illic, istuc, illuc, eo, hic, huc, in illa – in hac vit
woorden.definitie: adv. loci, a radice pronominali propagatum (gramm. § 62,1,b), in libris antiquioris aetatis et impressis et manuscriptis ሂየ፡ exscriptum (ut Matth. 5,26; Matth. 13,42; Joh. 5,5 rom.): ibi, illic; istuc, illuc, eo(opp. ህየ፡ hic, huc), vid. gramm. § 160,b: ሤሞ፡ ህየ፡ Gen. 2,8; Ps. 138,7; Ps. 138,9; ንሖር፡ ህየ፡ 1 Reg. 9,6; Ps. 121,4; et ita sexcenties in variis libris. Componitur cum praepositionibus: በህየ፡ ibi, illic Gen. 24,4; Gen. 43,25; Gen. 46,3; Ps. 131,18; Jes. 22,18; Jer. 18,2 (unde በህየ፡ – በዝየ፡ in illa – in hac vita { Clem. 238f.}|; Clem. f. 266); እምህየ፡ (እምነ፡ ህየ፡) illinc, indeet loci Jud. 18,11; Jud. 18,13; Jes. 52,11; Jer. 13,6; Am. 9,2; Gen. 2,10; Num. 22,41, et temporis Hen. 38,6; አንተ፡ ህየ፡ per, praeter, trans eum(illum) locum: Luc. 19,4 rom.; Jes. 35,8; Jer. 18,16; Jer. 29,18; Hez. 29,11; Judith 4,7; ኀበ፡ ህየ፡ illuc, Sx. Masc. 7; et cum pronominibus relativis ኀበ፡–ህየ፡ quo(vid. ኀበ፡), ዘ፡–ህየ፡ quo Jer. 25,15; እለ፡–ህየ፡ ad quos Deut. 12,29. Hinc originem duxit: hǝyya, hiyya G ህየ፡ ወህየ፡ ici et là. (Voir infra ዝየ፡ ወዝየ፡.) ሖረ፡ ካዕበ፡ አቡነ፡ ታዴዎስ፡ ኀበ፡ ባሕር፡ ወቆመ፡ ህየ፡ ወህየ። 33. 8

woorden.betekenis: ê, loco, vice, pro, pretio, sicut, pro eo ut, hǝyyanta, à ca
woorden.definitie: , quod primitus sonuit ህየተ፡ et ሂየተ፡ (ut Luc. 11,11; Joh. 1,16, 50 rom.; cf. Octateuchum Aeth. in appar. crit. p. 5) et ህየቴ፡ (Gen. 47,19 F; Gen. 44,33 F). Est 1 praepositio (gramm. p. 316) quae antiquitus etiam ህየቴ፡ sonuerat et pronomina suffixa per vocalem êsibi subjungit (gramm. § 167,3) loco, vice, pro, pretio(ἀντί et ὑπέρ): ዘይትነሣእ፡ ህየንቴሁ፡ Koh. 4,15; Sir. 10,14; Sir. 10,15; Gen. 36,33 seq.; ጋገ፡ ዘዕፅ፡ ቀጥቀጥከ፡ ወእገብር፡ ህየንቴሁ፡ ዘሐፂን፡ ጋገ፡ Jer. 35,13; saepissime usurpata, ubi de permutando, persolvendo, remunerando, compensando agitur: Gen. 47,16; Gen. 47,17; Gen. 47,19; Ex. 21,25; Lev. 24,18–20; Deut. 19,21; Num. 3,12; Jes. 43,4; Jes. 53,9; Jes. 60,17; Jes. 61,3; ዛቲ፡ ትከውኖሙ፡ ህየንተ፡ ጽእለቶሙ፡ Zeph. 2,10; Ps. 89,17; ተቀንየ፡ ያዕቆብ፡ ህየንተ፡ ራሔል፡ Kuf. 28; መጠወ፡ ነፍ፡ ህየንቴከ፡ Sir. 29,15; Joh. 11,50; ምንተ፡ ተዐስዮሙ፡ ህየንተ፡ ዘገብሩ፡ Sir. 7,28; ፈደዩ፡ እኪተ፡ ህየንተ፡ ሠናይት፡ Jer. 18,20; Joel 2,25; Ps. 34,14; Ps. 37,21. Nonnunquam usurpatur pro sicut, ex. gr. ህየንተ፡ ቈጾሊ፡ ዕፅ፡ ከማሁ፡ አነ፡ Org.; aliud exemplum vid. sub አሕመልመለ፡ 2 conjunctio pro eo ut, aut sequente ዘ፡, ex. gr. Kuf. 18; ህየንተዘ፡ ትረድኦ፡ አቅበጽካሁ፡ Clem. f. 233, aut omisso ዘ (gramm. § 170,10): ህየንተ፡ ከብረት፡ ነፍስየ፡ 1 Reg. 26,21 var.; ህየንተ፡ ተቀንዩ፡ Kuf. 48; ህየንተ፡ ጻመወ፡ Sx. Teq. 4; Sx. Teq. 21. hǝyyanta G ህየንተ፡ 1 préposition présentant le sens: à cause de, pour. ህየንተ፡ አቡነ፡ አዳም፡ ተረግመት፡ ምድር። 68–69 (Texte tiré du Qalêmenṭos, fol. 88rb.) 2 conjonction régissant un verbe à un mode personnel et présentant le sens: en récompense de, en échange de. ፈደዮሙ፡ እኪተ፡ ለንጉሠ፡ ነገሥት፡ አዕላፍ፡ ሰገድ፡ ህየንተ፡ ወሀብዎ፡ ብዙኃ፡ ጊዜ፡ አውቃፋተ፡ ወርቅ፡ ለእዴሁ፡ ወጸገውዎ፡ ወለተ፡ እኅወ፡ እሞሙ። ዝኒ፡ ዕበዱ፡ ይመስል፡ ዕበደ፡ አይሁድ፡ እለ፡ ፈደይዎ፡ ቀዲሙ፡ ለወልደ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ሞተ፡ ህየንተ፡ አንሥአ፡ ምውታኒሆሙ፡ ወሕማማተ፡ ህየንተ፡ ፈወሰ፡ ሕሙማኒሆሙ። 50. 8–9 L ህየንተ hǝyyanta instead of, in place of, in return for, in substitution for, by reason of, (8) because of, in compensation, like; the suffix pronouns are attached to the base hǝyyante-; e.g. hǝyyantehu lakrǝstos the vicar of Christ 221b

woorden.betekenis: cervus, Voc. Ae., cervo
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. ሀየላት፡ cervus (i.q. אַיָּל, ܐܰܝܠܳܐ, أُيَّلٌ إِيَّلٌ) ἔλαφος Deut. 12,15; Deut. 14,5; 3 Reg. 3a,16; Ps. 17,36; Ps. 28,8; Ps. 41,1; Ps. 103,19; Job 39,1; Prov. 5,19; Prov. 7,23; Jes. 34,15; Jes. 35,6; Kuf. 37; ወሬዛ፡ ኀየል፡ νεβρὸς ἐλάφων Cant. 2,9; ሀየላት፡ ወለዳ፡ በውስተ፡ ገዳም፡ Jer. 14,5. (Hanc vocem rectius litera ሀ quam litera ኀ scribendam esse, cum ex etymo, de quo vid. Ges. thes. p. 45, tum ex ipsa librorum mss., ut qui saepius ሀ quam ኀ exhibeant, scriptura elucet). – Voc. Ae.: ሀየል፡ ዘ፡ ዋላ፡ cervo

woorden.betekenis: botrus palmae, Vocabulariorum Aeth., dulcis fuit, acetum, om
woorden.definitie: subst. botrus palmae βότρυς Cant. 7,8; አጥባትኪ፡ ከመ፡ ሄላ፡ ዘይውሕዝ፡ እምኔሆን፡ ሐሊብ፡ Org. (at 1 Reg. 25,18; 1 Reg. 30,12 ሄላ፡ est prava lectio pro እኂለ፡ q.v.). Auctores Vocabulariorum Aeth.significationem veram ignorant; interpretantur: ሄላ፡ ዘ፡ ብቋያ፡; vel ሄላ፡ ዘ፡ ምንጭ፡ ብቋያ። [Nescio an rectius scribendum sit ኄላ፡ vel ሔላ፡; referendum enim videtur vel ad ሐየለ፡ i.e. حَلاَ ܚܠܺܝ dulcis fuit(cfr. ሐለየ፡), vel ad ኀለለ፡ i.e. خَلَّ (خَلٌّ acetum, خُلَّة omnis planta dulcis, خُلاَلٌ dactyli maturi, qui inter interstitia ramorum quaeruntur), vocali longa ê(pro î) duplicationem literae lcompensante]. helā, Pl. helāt G ሄላ፡, Pl. ሄላት፡ «grappe; pr. le fruit du sycomore, source d’eau» ― ዘለላ፡ ምንጭ፡ BNFabb217, fol. 9r. ― ሄላ፡ «botrus» ― የወይን፡ ዘለላ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 2. 9 L I ሄላ helā (), ኄላ ḫelā (Lt) spring of water II ሄላ helā date cluster, sycamore fruit vid. እሂል ʾǝḫil 217a

woorden.betekenis: fides qua creditur, fidelitas, in, fidelem eum esse, fidem p
woorden.definitie: (ܗܰܝܡܳܢܽܘܬܐ) peregrinae formationis, ab Aramaeis petitum, ab Aethiopibus frequentissime usitatum, subst., m. et fem.: 1 fides qua creditur; fidelitas (Glaube, Treue): Deut. 32,20; Jes. 5,3; Jes. 7,28; Jer. 15,18; Jer. 39,41; Ps. 32,4; Sir. 40,12; Sir. 45,4; Sir. 46,15; 4 Esr. 4,13; 4 Esr. 4,32; 4 Esr. 9,8; Rom. 1,8; Rom. 4,12; 2 Tim. 4,7; Hebr. 11,3; Hebr. 11,39. (synon. አሚን፡, ተአምኖ፡), Matth. 8,10; Jac. 2,14 seq.; πίστεις Prov. 3,3; ሃይማኖተ፡ ተስፋ፡ πίστις ἐλπίδος Sir. 49,10; c.c. በ in Jac. 2,1; እለ፡ አዕረፉ፡ በሃይማኖት፡ በክርስቶስ፡ Did. 34; ዘይገብር፡ ሃይማኖተ፡ ποιῶν πίστεις Prov. 12,22; Prov. 15,28; Sir. 15,15; ሃይማኖተ፡ ዕቀብ፡ ምስለ፡ ቢጽከ፡ (de amicitia) Sir. 22,23; Hen. 41,5; Hen. 43,2; ያጸንዑ፡ ሃይማኖቶሙ፡ በቀለም፡ ወበማየ፡ ሕመት፡ Hen. 69,10; ብእሲ፡ ዚታአምር፡ ከመ፡ ቦ፡ ሃይማኖተ፡ ( fidelem eum esse ) Sir. 37,12; ሀጕለ፡ ሃይማኖቶ፡ fidem perdidit Sir. 27,16; Luc. 16,11; Luc. 16,12; በሃይማኖቶሙ፡ in bonam fidem 4 Reg. 12,15; 4 Reg. 22,7. 2 fides quae creditur ( religio, confessio ); ሃይማኖት፡ ቅድስት፡ Judae 20; ሃይማኖት፡ ርትዕት፡ fides orthodoxa Lit. 165,1: ርቱዐ፡ ሃይማኖት፡ orthodoxus (saepissime; etiam titulus libri cujusdam dogmatici); ሃይማኖተ፡ አበው፡ fides Patrum (titulus libri celeberrimi); ጸሎተ፡ ሃይማኖት፡ symbolum fidei Lit. 163,3; ሃይማኖተ፡ እስላም፡ Islami religio Abush. 50; ሃይማኖተ፡ ንስጦሮስ፡ confessio Nestorii Enc. hāymānot G ሃይማኖት፡ hāymānot, Pl. ሃይማኖታት፡ hāymānotāt présente des significations très différentes: foi chrétienne (au sens général), foi catholique (diophysite); woorden.betekenis: fidus, fidelis, is qui credit, fideles, omnes fideles utrius
woorden.definitie: (መሀይምን፡) part. (ܡܗܰܝܡܰܢ, مُهَيْمَن مُهَيمِن), fem. መሃይምንት፡ fidus, fidelis (sensu theolog.: is qui credit ) πιστός; Job 12,20; Prov. 11,21; Ps. 100,8; 1 Reg. 3,20. 22,14; (Abraham) መሃይምን፡ ውእቱ፡ በኵሉ፡ Kuf. 17; ስምዕ፡ መሃይምን፡ Apoc. 1,5; Apoc. 3,14; Prov. 14,5; ከናፍር፡ መሃይምንት፡ χείλη πιστά Prov. 17,7; መሃይምናኒሁ፡ οἱ πεποιθότες ἐπ᾽ αὐτῷ Sap. 3,9; መሃይምናን፡ fideles (Christiani) ex. gr. Apoc. 17,14; 1 Tim. 4,10; Asc. Jes. 4,13; ክርስቲያናዊት፡ መሃይምንት፡ Kid. f. 23. – Vicem Pl. fem. መሃይምናት፡ explet መሃይምንት፡, quae forma in libris mss. multo crebrius occurrit, quam መሃይምናት፡ (ut ኵሉ፡ መሃይምናን፡ ወመሃይምንት፡ omnes fideles utriusque sexus ).

woorden.betekenis: sublevare, supersedere facere
woorden.definitie: II,1 sublevare alicujus statum, supersedere facere aliquem re, c.c. Acc. pers.: ኢፈቀደ፡ አምላክ፡ ያርኢከ፡ ሙስናሃ፡ ለሀገር፡ ወአምጽአ፡ ኑዛዜ፡ ላዕሌከ፡ ወአህየየከ፡ (sc. cum te dormientem excidium urbis transire faceret), Rel. Bar.

woorden.betekenis: auferre per vim, adimere, rapere, eripere, diripere, rapina,
woorden.definitie: I,1 [in libris melioris notae per ሀ exscriptum; in caeteris linguis haec eadem radix deest, sed nescio an ejusdem stirpis sint חָטַף חָתַף خَطِفَ et خَاتَ] Subj. ይሂድ፡, Infin. ሀዪድ፡ et ሀይድ፡, ሀይዶ፡, ሀይዶት፡, auferre per vim, adimere, rapere, eripere, diripere: ኢትሂድ፡ Lev. 19,13; Lev. 5,21; Hez. 22,27; ሀይዶ፡ Koh. 5,7; ሀይድ፡ rapina(saepissime, ex. gr. Kuf. 23); c.c. Acc. rei: Job 24,3; Matth. 12,29; λαμβάνειν πόλεις 4 Reg. 13,25; c. Acc. pers.: Jes. 10,2; Jes. 49,24; እነሥእ፡ ወአሀይደከ፡ λήψομαι κραταιῶς 1 Reg. 2,16; c. dupl. Acc.: Gen. 21,25; Gen. 31,31; 1 Reg. 8,14; Kuf. 11; Kuf. 13; Kuf. 35; Job 22,7; Sir. 31,27; Mal. 3,5; Matth. 13,12; Luc. 9,39; Marc. 4,25; transl.: rapere, in se vertere, fascinare: ለብሰ፡ ዳዊት፡ ዘየሀይድ፡ ዐይነ፡ 2 Reg. 6,14; ዕበየ፡ ብርሃኑ፡ የሀይድ፡ አዕይንተ፡ Clem. f. 232; Enc. – Voc. Ae.: ተዐገለ፡ ሄደ፡ ዘ፡ ቀማ፡ heda L hyd, ሄደ heda (yǝhid), ሔደ ḥeda rob, take by force, plunder, spoil, break (the law), carry away by force, wrest, snatch away, confiscate, seize, wrong, outrage, (figurative) ravish, bewitch (for the figurative meaning ‘ravish, bewitch’, cp. Amh. ‘marräkä’ take prisoner in war, capture, captivate, fascinate) 220b

woorden.betekenis: flavit, commotus fuit, volitvait in aëre, percussit, jaculan
woorden.definitie: I,1 [vicina videntur هَبَّ et هَفَّ flavitventus; commotus fuit(vento), cfr. هَبَا, هَفَا, هَفَتَ volitvait in aëre, de rebus vento excitatis; et de sibilo stridentis teli, gladii: هَبَّ percussitgladius vibratus; aeth. ሄጰ፡ significat proprie: telum cum sibilo per aërem volare fecit] jaculando attingere, ferire: ነደፈ፡ ወሄጶ፡ ለንጉሥ፡ ማእከለ፡ ሰንቡኡ፡ 2 Par. 18,33; ሄጶ፡ ውስተ፡ ፍጽሙ፡ 1 Reg. 17,49; ወጸፎ፡ በእብን፡ ወሄጶ፡ ጥቦ፡ Kuf. 38; የሀይጱ፡ ሥዕርተ፡ ወኢይስሕቱ፡ Jud. 20,16; ኢይክህለኒ፡ (nec non vincit) ሀይጶተ፡ ቀስት፡ ወደርብዮ፡ ኰያንው፡ Macc. f. 14. – Imperat. ሂጵ፡ M.M. f. 295. – Voc. Ae.: ሄጰ፡ ዘ፡ ገመሰ፡; aliud ሄጰ፡ ዘ፡ ነደፈ፡ hep̣a, ሔጰ ḥep̣a L hyp̣, ሄጰ hep̣a (yǝhip̣), () ሔጰ ḥep̣a strike, smite, shoot with an arrow, throw, hit with a bow and arrow, brandish a spear, pierce, split (someone’s head), () hit the target by throwing a stone or by shooting an arrow 221b

woorden.betekenis: emissio teli, hip̣at, piqûre, blessure, hep̣a
woorden.definitie: subst. emissio teli: አኮ፡ በዘቀስት፡ ሂጰት፡ οὐ τοξοτῶν εὐστοχίαις Cyr. a. Th. f. 7. hip̣at G ሂጰት፡ hip̣at «piqûre, blessure … » ― መንደፍ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 11r. 13 L ሂጰት hip̣at verbal noun of vid. ሄጰ hep̣a 221b

woorden.betekenis: ivit, abiit, periit, interiit, decidit, perdidit, perire, in
woorden.definitie: I,1 [i.q. הָלַךְ ivit, abiit(et periit), هَلَكَ periit, interiit, decidit; transit. perdidit] Subj. ይሕጐል፡, intransit. perire, interire: ተሀጕል፡ ሀጕለ፡ ዐቢየ፡ Hen. 83,7; ከመ፡ ኢትህጐሉ፡ Kuf. 36; ወናሁ፡ ሀጕሉ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ወዓለምኒ፡ 4 Esr. 9,22. At multo frequentius est hagʷǝla L ሀጕለ hagʷǝla (yǝhgʷal), () ሐጕለ፡ ḥagʷla be lost, be destroyed, perish, be deprived of 215b

woorden.betekenis: perdere, pessumdare, delere, disperdere, defraudare, everter
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 transit. (ad interitum vocare i.e.) perdere(pessumdare, delere) disperdere: ኀጢአት፡ ነፍሙ፡ ታሀጕል፡ Prov. 1,19; Koh. 7,7; Koh. 9,18; ንጉሥ፡ አብድ፡ ያሀጕል፡ አሕዛቢሁ፡ Sir. 10,3; Jer. 34,12; Matth. 10,28; ለምንትኑ፡ መጠነዝ፡ አህጐለት፡ 26,8; ያህጕሎሙ፡ ለረሲዓን፡ Hen. 1,9; Hen. 10,15; ከመ፡ ኣህጕሎሙ፡ እምገጸ፡ ምድር፡ 45,6; Hen. 80,8; Hen. 89,60–62. 2 caus. (facere ut aliquis aliquid perdat i.e.) defraudare, evertere, circumverterealiquem aliqua re, c. dupl. Acc.: አህጐለቶን፡ ጻማሆን፡ ἐστέρησεν αὐτὰς τῶν πόνων αὐτῶν Sir. 28,15; ኢታህጕሎ፡ ዕሴቶ፡ ከመ፡ ታግዕዞ፡ Sir. 7,21. ʾahgʷala L አህጐለ ʾahgʷala destroy, lose, make lose, waste, ruin, defraud, put off 215b

woorden.betekenis: ager cultus, terra inhabitata, regio, provincia, patria, Arm
woorden.definitie: subst. fem. et m. (ex. gr. Gen. 19,14; Jer. 45,17), Pl. አህጉር፡ (etiam አህጕር፡ script.), Pl. Pl. አህጉራት፡ (Matth. 10,23) 1 ager cultus, terra inhabitata, regio, provincia, patria: ውስተ፡ አህጉር፡ ወአዕጻዳት፡ εἰς τοὺς ἀγροὺς καὶ κώμας Marc. 6,36; ሀገረ፡ እስራኤል፡ ἡ κατοικία Ἰσραήλ Jer. 3,8; Jer. 3,12; ዘውስተ፡ ሀገር፡ ὁ αὐλών Jer. 31,8; γῆ 2 Reg. 24,13; መሰሎሙ፡ ለኖትያት፡ ዘርእዩ፡ ሀገረ፡ Act. 27,27 rom. (locus ab auctoribus editionis rom. ipsis versus); patria Hebr. 11,14; Herm. p. 48b; ሀገረ፡ አርማንያ፡ Armenia, ሀገረ፡ ምዕራብ፡ Occidens Jsp. p. 312; Jsp. p. 313al. saepe; ሀገረ፡ ሴዋ፡ provincia Sêwae, 303; ሀገረ፡ ደምብያ፡ provincia Dambeae, Lud. (Sed. hic vocis usus potissimum inferiori aetati convenit). 2 pagus, vicus, villa, ἐπαύλεις Jes. 42,11; Jes. 34,13; Jes. 62,9; Judith 15,7; Ps. 143,17; κῶμαι Judith 4,7; Jes. 32,14; Matth. 21,2; Luc. 10,38; Luc. 17,12; Luc. 24,13; Joh. 11,1. 3 oppidum, urbs, civitas: haec est solemnis vocis notio, innumeris in locis obvia; ex. gr. Koh. 9,14; Koh. 10,16; Sir. 36,31; Sir. 10,3; Jer. 21,10; Jer. 22,8; Jes. 10,14; Jes. 24,10; Jos. 21; ዐሥሩ፡ አህጉር፡ δεκάπολις Matth. 4,25; ሀገር፡ ቅድስት፡ Sir. 24,11; ሀገረ፡ ሳኦል፡ sedes Saul regis Jes. 10,29; Kuf. 38, etiam ሀገረ፡ መንግሥት፡; urbs munita, castellum, arx ሀገር፡ ጽንዕት፡ et ሀገረ፡ ጥቅም፡ vel ቅጽር፡ Jer. 4,6; Kuf. 11,46; Sir. 28,14; Jes. 36,1; Hez. 17,4; Lev. 25, 29–31; Num. 13,19; emporium Jes. 45,14; በሀገር፡ in urbe, oppido(opp. በሐቅል፡ ruri, in agro) Deut. 28,3. Etiam አህጉር፡ nonnumquam pro urbe(Sing.) ponitur, ex. gr. Judith 7; { ደብረ፡ ሀገር፡ metropolis, vid. sub ደብር፡ col. 1102}. – Cum genitivo personae conjunctum significare potest patriam: Judith 8,2; Marc. 6,1; Marc. 6,4. 4 Usurpatur pro incolis urbis vel oppidi, civibus: Am. 4,8; Zach. 14,2; Prov. 11,9–11; 1 Reg. 4,13; 2 Reg. 14,7; Act. 12,22 rom.; alias ሰብአ፡ ሀገር፡ Luc. 19,14 et pro civitate(πολίτευμα) Phil. 3,20. [Cum ሀገር፡ convenit Himjaritarum هَجَرٌ et amh. አገር፡; contigua sunt אִכָּר ܐܰܟܳܪܳܐ أَكَّارٌ agricola, lat. ager, germ. Acker(vid. 347)]. hagar; Pl. ʾahgur, ʾahgʷǝr; Pl.Pl. ʾahgurāt G ሀገረ፡ ቍድስ፡ hagara qʷǝddǝs la Ville Sainte (Jérusalem). ዳዊት፡ አስተዳለወ፡ ኵሎ፡ ምግባረ፡ ሕንፃ፡ ወሰሎሞን፡ ሐነፆ፡ በኢየሩሳሌም፡ ወሰመያ፡ ሀገረ፡ ቍድስ፡ በእንተ፡ ቅዳሴ፡ ወመሥዋዕተ፡ ሕግ፡ ወብዝኀ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ወበእንተ፡ ዘሐመ፡ እግዚእነ፡ ወመድኀኒነ፡ ኢየሱስ፡ ክርስቶስ፡ ውስቴታ። 160. 14 L ሀገር hagar; Pl. አህጉር ʾahgur, አህጉራት ʾahgurāt city, town, village, province, district, country, homeland, inhabited region ሀገረ፡ ጥቅም hagara ṭǝqm walled city, vid. ጥቅም፡ ሀገር፡ ጽንዕት hagar ṣǝnǝʿt strong city, vid. ጽንዕ፡ 216a C a for ርእሰ፡ ሀገር፡ vid. ርእስ፡ (Leslau) b for ሰብአ፡ ሀገር፡ vid. ሰብእ፡ (Leslau) c for ባህለ፡ አገር፡ vid. ባህል፡ (Leslau)

woorden.betekenis: litera alphabeti Aethiopici secunda, quae ለው፡ (sec
woorden.definitie: litera alphabeti Aethiopici secunda, quae ለው፡ (sec. Isenb. in lex. amh. p. 5 ላዊ፡) vocatur.

woorden.betekenis: praepositio, singuli, alimentum in singulos dies, ad singulo
woorden.definitie: sive ለ፡ reduplicatum (cfr. በበ፡ et ዘዘ፡) 1 praepositio, qua Latinorum vox singuli, Graecorum ἀνὰ vel κατὰ c. Acc. exprimitur (gramm. § 159,g et gramm. § 164,2). Neque tantum ibi usurpatur, ubi simplex praepositio ለ፡ ipsa constructione postulatur, ut: ሲሳይ፡ ዘለለ፡ ዕለት፡ alimentum in singulos dies Matth. 6,11; ለለ፩ ἑκάστῳ Matth. 25,15; 4 Esr. 6,49; ምዕረ፡ ለለዓመት፡ Ex. 30,10 (vid. ለ፡ Nr. 6); Zach. 14,16; Ex. 5,19; Ex. 16,4; Tob. 5,15; Jes. 6,2; Esth. 3,12; Gen. 44,1; 1 Petr. 4,10; አዐርግ፡ ለለሰማይ፡ ad singulos coelos Asc. Jes. 7,25; sed etiam alias, et ipsi subjecto enuntiationis ለለ፡ praeponitur: ተኈለቁ፡ ለለ፡ ብእሲ፡ ብእሲ፡ Num. 4,49; Ex. 16,16; ለለዓመት፡ quotannis 2 Esr. 20,35; Hen. 5,2; ለለ፡ በዓል፡ Marc. 15,6; ለለምልአቱ፡ quotiescumque plenus est Kedr f. 88. – Etiam accusativo adverbiali praemittitur: ለለ፡ ነግሀ፡ ወሰርከ፡ Enc. (cfr. እምነ፡ et እስከ፡). – Hic annotare juvat, in libris impressis et mss. pro ለለ፡ reperiri ለእለ፡ sensu distributivo quot, quotcumque, ex gr. ፲ወ፪ መሳፍንት፡ ለእለ፡ ሕዘቢሆሙ፡ 12 principes, quot populi corum Gen. 25,16; (Gen. 42,25; Gen. 47,12; Gen. 49,28; Ex. 12,3 in annot.); አመ፡ ዐሡረ፡ ወርኅ፡ ታስዕ፡ ይበክዩ፡ ለለዓሙ፡ (v. ለእለ፡ ዓሙ፡ quotquot anni redeunt) Machb. Meem. str. 11; Machb. Meem. str. 16; item pro ለእለ፡ editionis Plattianae occurrit ለለ፡ quotcumque Marc. 6,22 rom.: አሥመረቶ፡ ለሄሮድስ፡ ወለለ፡ ይረፍቁ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ 2 conjunctio: quotiescumque, ut: ለለተናገርኩ፡ አዐወዩ፡ በግፍዕ፡ Jer. 20,8 (vers. alt.); ለለተናገርኩ፡ מִדֵּי דְבָרֶיךְ Jer. 31,27 (vers. alt., hebr. 48,27); ለለተናገርክዎ፡ ተዘከርኩ፡ Jer. 38,20 (vers. alt.); ለለወለዳ፡ ተባዕተ፡ ቅትላሁ፡ F.M. 23,2; ወኮኑ፡ ለለ፡ ይሰምዑ፡ ነገሮ፡ ያፈደፍዱ፡ ግዘፈ፡ Jsp. p. 364; ለለይወጽኡ፡ ውስተ፡ ፀብእ፡ Abush. 50. – Etiam cum hoc ለለ፡ in libris mss. permutatur ለእለ፡, ex. gr. in Machb. Meem. str. 4; Machb. Meem. str. 5. አምጣነ፡ ትበልዑ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ ወለለ፡ (v. ወለእለ፡) ትሰትዩ፡ ደሞ። lalla G ለለ፡ lalla «quicumque particula praepositiva, omnibus et singularis» Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 3. 20 L ለለ lalla- (repeated ‘la’) expresses the distributive, (at, for) every, each; e.g. ለለ፡ በዓል lalla baʿāl at every feast with suffix pronouns the base is ለሊ lalli-, ለል lallǝ-; e.g. ለልየ for my part, ለሊሁ he himself, he alone, and so on (see 344, 374) 303a

woorden.betekenis: avide deglutivit, edit, comedit, linxit
woorden.definitie: rad. inus.: cfr. لَهِمَ avide deglutivit (hebr. הִתְלַהֵם), לָחַם edit, comedit, ܠܚܰܡ linxit. Hinc

woorden.betekenis: bos, taurus, vacca, taurus annosus, m., boves, armenta, boum
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. አልህምት፡, Pl. Pl. አልህምታት፡ (Hen. 87,4) 1 bos, et mas et femina, taurus, vacca (لِهْمٌ taurus annosus): βοῦς Job 6,5; Job 24,3; Jes. 1,3; Jes. 11,7; Jes. 65,25; Dan. 4,22; ταῦρος Sir. 6,2; Jes. 11,6; μόσχος et μοσχάριον Jer. 38,18; Gen. 18,7 (ላህም፡ ንኡስ፡); 2 Esr. 15,18; Ex. 29,1; Apoc. 4,7; δάμαλις Gen. 15,9 (sed. m.); ላህም፡ ወለደት፡ Jsp. p. 377. – Pl.: βόες, μόσχοι, βουκόλια, boves, armenta, boum grex: Gen. 18,7; Gen. 41,2; Ex. 10,9; Ex. 29,1; Jer. 5,17; Ps. 21,12; 1 Reg. 11,7; 2 Par. 4,3 seq.; Hen. 85 seq.; vaccae: አልህምት፡ ኢይመክና፡ Job 21,10; δαμάλεις 3 Reg. 12,28. Nonnunquam (cum ኵሉ፡ vel ብዙኅ፡ compositum) ላህም፡ collective usurpatur, ut Gen. 46,32; Ex. 12,38. – Ὀνοκένταυροι Jes. 13,22; Jes. 34,14 እለ፡ ሰኰና፡ ላህም፡ እገሪሆሙ፡ versum est. – አልህምተ፡ ገዳም፡ boves sylvestres(agrestes), distinguuntur a ቶራት፡ F.N. 44,2. lāhm C for መግዝአ፡ ላህም፡ vid. መግዝእ፡

woorden.betekenis: provectiore aetate fuit, senectute debilis fuit, id.,, decre
woorden.definitie: I,1 [كَهَلَ provectiore aetate fuit, قَهَلَ VII senectute debilis fuit, قَحَلَ VII id., قَلْحَمَ decrepitus fuit senex; כָּלַח in כֶּלַח senectus; amh. ላቀ፡ et አላቀ፡] Subj. ይልሀቅ፡, Imperat. ለሀቅ፡, Infin. nom. ልሂቅ፡ (Hebr. 11,24) 1 crescere, adolescere, augescere, de plantis Job 8,11; 4 Esr. 8,49; Kuf. 2; Matth. 6,28; Matth. 13,30; de barba, capillo et unguibus 1 Par. 19,5; Dan. 4,30; de aquis Kuf. 5; de nequitia Kuf. 5; de infantibus, pueris, puellis Gen. 21,8; Gen. 38,11; Luc. 2,40; 1 Petr. 2,2; in specie: in pubertatem ingredi Hez. 16,7 (ልህቂ፡ ወዐበይኪ፡); Sir. 42,9; 4 Esr. 9,46, et adolescentiam transigere Act. 22,3 rom.; አይድዐቶ፡ አስቴር፡ ለንጉሥ፡ ከመ፡ በቤቱ፡ ልህቀት፡ Esth. 8,1. Transl.: adaugescere, augeri multitudine, vi, potentia, divitiis Kuf. 24saepius; ለሀቁ፡ ወብዝኁ፡ Kuf. 6. 2 senescere aetate et viribus, aetate provectum, senem vel senilem esse: እልህቅ፡ ወእረሥእ፡ Job 29,18; Jes. 46,4; Sir. 41,2; Ps. 70,19; Gen. 18,11; Gen. 24,1; Gen. 27,1; 1 Reg. 2,22; 1 Reg. 3,21; 3 Reg. 1,15; Joh. 3,4; ይልህቅ፡ ሕይወቶሙ፡ senescet vita corum Hen. 5,9. 3 comparative: natu majorem esse, ዘይልህቅ፡ natu major vel maximus Job 1,13; እኅትክን፡ እንተ፡ ትልህቅ፡ Hez. 16,46; Gen. 19,31 seq.; c.c. pron. suff. ይልህቅዎ፡ eo natu majores sunt Job 32,4; ወራዙት፡ ተኰነኑ፡ ለእለ፡ ይልህቁክሙ፡ 1 Petr. 5,5; Hez. 16,61. lǝhqa G ልህቀ፡ lǝhqa I,1 «grandir» ― አደገ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 11v. 18 L ልህቀ lǝhqa (yǝlhaq), (KG) ልሕቀ lǝḥqa grow, grow up, reach manhood, grow old ዘይልህቅ za-yǝlǝhǝq elder 309a

woorden.betekenis: crescere facere, incrementum dare, nutrire, alere, educare,
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 crescere facere (incrementum dare), c.c. Acc., de plantis: ዕፅ፡ ዘበዝናም፡ አልሀቀ፡ Jes. 44,14; ቀላይ፡ አልሀቆ፡ (ለዕፅ፡) Hez. 31,4; 1 Cor. 3,7; nutrire, alere, educare, capillos: ሥዕርተከ፡ ኢታልህቅ፡ Exp. F. Nic.; animalia 2 Reg. 12,3; infantes, pueros, puellas Jes. 1,2; Jes. 23,4; Jes. 49,21; Jes. 51,18; Job 31,18; Prov. 23,24; Prov. 29,46; 1 Tim. 5,10 (ὑψοῦν, ἐκτρέφειν, al.). Transl.: aliquem augere opibus Kuf. 15. 2 ad senectutem perducere: Jos. 14,10; vel honores senectutis alicui tribuere: ኪያከ፡ አልሀቀ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ σοὶ δέδωκεν ὁ θεὸς τὸ πρεσβεῖον Dan. apocr. 1,50 (denom. a ሊቅ፡, ልሂቅ፡); nec non ob senioratum majorem portionem alicui tribuere: (in distribuendis decimis et primogenituris) ኢያልህቅ፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ቀዳሚ፡ ካህን፡ እምካህናት፡ ለርእሱ፡ዘእንበለ፡ ለካልኡ፡ አላ፡ ይኩን፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ክልኤሆሙ፡ ዕሩየ፡ III Const. Ap. 2; III Const. Ap. 3 senectutem degere, Lud. ex Enc. ʾalhaqa G አልሀቀ፡ ʾalhaqa II,1 «élever, faire grandir» ― አሳደገ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 11v. 18 L አልሀቀ ʾalhaqa, አልህቀ፡ ʾalhǝqa bring up, rear make grow, make grow old 309a

woorden.betekenis: munere presbyteri, fungi, talǝhqa, être ou devenir vieillard
woorden.definitie: III,1 (denom. a ሊቅ፡ presbyter), vox ecclesiastica: munere presbyteri (sacerdotis) fungi: እለ፡ ይትለሀቁ፡ እምኔክሙ፡ 1 Petr. 5,1; እለ፡ ይትለሀቁ፡ Kid. f. 17. talǝhqa G ተልህቀ፡ talǝhqa III,1 «être ou devenir vieillard (dans le sens de sage, prudent)» ― ሸመገለ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 11v. 18 L ተልህቀ talǝhqa become old, become a presbyter (denominative of ‘lǝhiq’) 309a

woorden.betekenis: aetate provectus, senior, senior dignitate, princeps, presby
woorden.definitie: adj. et subst., fem. ልህቅት፡ (vid. gramm. § 129,a) et ለሀቅት፡ (Herm. p. 6; Herm. p. 17; per archaismum ልሀቅት፡ Herm. p. 4; ልሀቅ፡ Herm. p. 2sine dubio pro ልህቅት፡ errore librarii), Pl. m. ልሂቃን፡, fem. ልሂቃት፡ (de ሊቃውንት፡ vid. sub ሊቅ፡) 1 aetate provectus, senior 1 Reg. 2,32; 2 Reg. 19,32; Koh. 4,13 (πρεσβύτερος); Jes. 9,14 (πρεσβύτης); ልሂቅኒ፡ ወአእሩግኒ፡ በኀቤነ፡ ሀለወ፡ Job 15,10; ንኡስ፡ አነ፡ በመዋዕልየ፡ ወአንትሙ፡ ልሂቃን፡ ወሊቃውንት፡ Job 32,7; Sap. 2,10; ልሂቅ፡ ምስለ፡ አረጋዊ፡ Jer. 6,11 (πρεσβύτερος μετὰ πλήρους ἡμερῶν); ክልኤሆሙ፡ ልሂቃን፡ እሙንቱ፡ Luc. 1,7; Luc. 1,18; ልሂቃት፡ πρεσβύτεραι Zach. 8,4; ልሂቃት፡ መበለታት፡ (opp. ንኡሳት፡ መበለታት፡) Did. 14. 2 senior dignitate, princeps, presbyter, praefectus, quamquam hoc sensu forma contracta ሊቅ፡ crebrius adhibetur: እምውሉደ፡ ልሂቃነ፡ ሀገረ፡ ሮሜ፡ e filiis patriciorum Sx. Masc. 17; Sx. Teq. 3al.; ዘይፈቅድ፡ ልሂቅ፡ ይኩን፡ (πρῶτος) Marc. 9,35; πρεσβύτερος (ecclesiae) 1 Petr. 5,1; πρσβύτιδες ልሂቃት፡ Tit. 2,3 et 1 Tim. 5,2 (Platt); ልሂቃነ፡ መንግሥቱ፡ primores regni, Sx. Masc. 2. lǝhiq, Pl. lǝhiqān; fem. lǝhǝqt, lahaqt, Pl. lǝhiqāt G ልሂቅ፡ lǝhiq, Pl. ልሂቃን፡ lǝhiqān «vieillard» ― ሽማግሌ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 11v. ልሂቅ፡ lǝhiq «adultus, senex» ― ታላቅ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 3. ልህቅት፡ lǝhǝqt, Pl. ልሂቃት፡ lǝhiqāt «vieille, matrone» ― ባልቴት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol.11v. 18 L ልሂቅ lǝhiq (fem. ልሂቅት፡ lǝhiqt, ልህቅት፡ lǝhǝqt) grown-up, adult, old, old man, senior, presbyter 309a

woorden.betekenis: provectus, senior aetate, senior dignitate et munere, primor
woorden.definitie: (forma e ልሂቅ፡ contracta, gramm. § 47) subst. (fem. ሊቅት፡, Sx. Hed. 17), Pl. ሊቃን፡ (fem. ሊቃት፡ Lud. e Jes. 3,17, ubi mei libri mss. ሊቃናት፡ exhibent), et Pl. Pl. ሊቃናት፡, ልሂቃናት፡ (gramm. § 133,a), et ሊቃውንት፡ (a ሊቃን፡ derivatum, gramm. § 140,a) 1 provectus, senior aetate; potissimum in Pl. ሊቃውንት፡ (rarius ሊቃናት፡) haec significatio occurrit Job 12,20; Job 29,8; Job 32,7; Prov. 20,29; Jes. 14,23; Jer. 38,13; Joel 1,2; Joel 3,1; Deut. 32,7 al.; ሊቃናት፡ ወመሐዛት፡ Ps. 148,12. – Vulgaris notio hujus formae contractae est 2 senior dignitate et munere, primoris, princeps, presbyter, magister, unus e magistratu. a frequentissime de senioribus vel magistratu Israelitarum, ut ሊቃነ፡ ሕዝብ፡ Ex. 18,12; Ex. 19,7; Ex. 24,9; Lev. 4,15; plerumque in forma ሊቃናት፡ Num. 11,16; Deut. 21,2; Jos. 20,4; Jud. 11,7-9; Ruth 4,2; Ruth 4,4; Ruth 4,9; 1 Reg. 16,4; 2 Reg. 17,4; 3 Reg. 8,1; Thren. 5,12; Matth. 15,2; Matth. 26,3; Matth. 27,1; sed etiam in forma ሊቃውንት፡ 1 Reg. 4,3; 4 Reg. 6,32; Thren. 4,16; Judith 4,8; Judith 6,16; Ps. 106,32; ትኩን፡ ሊቀ፡ በውስተ፡ ቤተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Jer. 36,26; 1 Esr. 1,8. Pro fem. ἄρχουσαι legitur ሊቃናት፡ Jes. 3,17. b passim graecam vocem πρέσβεις (legatos) interpretes Aeth. ሊቃውንት፡ verterunt, ut Jes. 13,8. c de senioribus i.e. presbyteris aliisque praepositis ecclesiae Christianae 1 Tim. 5,1; Asc. Jes. 3,24; Tit. 2,2; Apoc. 4,4; pro fem. Tit. 2,3; 1 Tim. 5,2 (ልሂቃናት፡ rom.); ሊቃውንተ፡ ቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ primates ecclesiae (archipresbyteri, episcopi et superiores) Clem. d de magistris vel doctoribus Judaeorum Christianorumve Matth. 8,19; Matth. 9,11; Marc. 4,38; Marc. 12,19; ሊቃነ፡ ኦሪት፡ νομοδιδάσκαλοι Luc. 5,17; ሊቃውንት፡ διδάσκαλοι Eph. 4,11; ሊቃናት፡ Herm. 11p.; Herm. p. 28. e de principe seu praeposito in qualibet arte, dignitate vel vitae genere (respondet graecum ἀρχι-) ut ሊቀ፡ ሐመር፡ ναύκληρος Act. 27,11 rom.; ሊቀ፡ ሐራ፡ Sx. Masc. 11; ሊቀ፡ መላእክት፡ archangelus 1 Thess. 4,16, ሊቃነ፡ መላእክት፡ Clem. f. 61; ሊቀ፡ ምኔት፡ (sive አበ፡ ምኔት፡) abbas monasterii Phlx.; ሊቀ፡ መዘርት፡ Kuf. 39et ሊቀ፡ ቀዳሕያን፡ Gen. 40,1 (ἀρχιοινοχόος), ሊቀ፡ ሠራዊት፡ ἀρχιστρατηγός (sive መልአከ፡ ሠራዊት፡) Sx. Masc. 9; ሊቀ፡ መበስላን፡ ἀρχιμάγειρος Dan. 2,14; ሊቀ፡ ኀባዝያን፡ ἀρχισιτοποιός Gen. 40,1; ሊቀ፡ ኅፅዋን፡ ἀρχιευνοῦχος Dan. 1,3; Gen. 40,2; ሊቀ፡ ካህናት፡ ἀρχιερεύς Hebr. 2,17; ሊቀ፡ ኬነት፡ (ἀρχιτέκτων) Ex. 37,21; ሊቀ፡ ዐቀብተ፡ ሞቅሕ፡ Gen. 39,21; Gen. 39,23 (ἀρχιδεσμοφύλαξ); ሊቃነ፡ ገባር፡ (ἐπιστάται τῶν ἔργων) Ex. 1,11; ሊቀ፡ ገዛእት፡ ἀρχιτρίκλινος Joh. 2,8 rom.; Joh. 2,9 rom.; ሊቀ፡ ጳጳሳት፡ patriarcha (ecclesiae); ሊቀ፡ ዲያቆናት፡ archidiaconus. 3 In regno Abyssiniae socii supremi rei publicae consilii et primores regni hoc nomine vocabantur (vid. Isenb. lex. amh. sub ሊቅ፡ et sub አለቃ፡); in ecclesia ሊቅ፡ (amh. አለቃ፡) in specie inspectorem ecclesiasticorum, oeconomum ecclesiae significat (Lud. lex.; Rüppell II. 32; Rüppell II. 52.; Harris II. 167. 263). – Voc. Ae.: ቃውም፡ ሊቅ፡ ብ፡ አለቃ፡ liq, Pl. liqān; fem. liqǝt, Pl. liqāt; Pl.Pl. liqānāt, lǝhiqānāt, liqāwǝnt, liqān X ሊቀ፡ liq subst. st.c., Pl. ሊቃነ፡ liqāna head of, chief of a ሊቀ፡ መራኅት፡ liqa marāḫt (title) probably refers to the ‘leading church cantor’ ሊቀ፡ መራኅት፡ ዘሚካኤል፡ ‘le liqa marāḫt, Zamikāʾēl’ 32 l. 2–3 (ed.), 37 l. 9 (tr.), vid. መራኅት፡ C vid. also ቀኝ፡ ጌታ፡ and ግራ፡ ጌታ፡ under ጌታ፡ b ሊቀ፡ ማኅበር፡ liqa maḫbar (title) community chief ወእንዘ፡ ይነብሩ፡ ህየ፡ ለአኩ፡ ኀበ፡ ሊቀ፡ ማኅበር፡ አኃው፡ እለ፡ አግዓዞሙ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ውስተ፡ ምስኳዐ፡ ምሕያከ፡ መላእክት ‘While they were living there, the brothers whom the king had exiled to mǝskwaʿa mǝḥyakä mälaʾǝkt sent a message to the head of the Community’ 78 (ed.), 56 (tr.); ወሊቀ፡ ማኅበር፡ ሆሴዕ፡ ‘le chef de la communauté, Hosēʿ;’ 28 l. 27 (ed.), 33 l. 5 (tr.), vid. ማኅበር፡ c ሊቀ፡ ምኔት፡ liqa mǝnet (title) ሊቀ፡ ምኔት፡ ደብረ፡ ሊባኖስ፡ እሞን፡ ለምኔታተ፡ ኢትዮጵያ፡ ‘the chief of the monastery of Däbrä Libanos — mother of the monastries of Ethiopia’ 59 § 109 (ed.), 34 § 109 (tr.), vid. ምኔት፡ L ሊቀ፡ ምኔት፡ liqa mǝnet abbot of a monastery 351b d ሊቀ፡ ማእምራን፡ liqa māʾmǝrān (title) head of the learned ወሊቀ፡ ማእምራን፡ መክፈልተ፡ ጊዮርጊስ፡ ‘le chef des docteurs, Makfalta Giyorgis’ 37 l. 9 (ed.), 43 l. 33–34 (tr.); ወአርአዮ፡ ዘውስተ፡ ሕሊናሁ፡ ለ፩፡ ሊቅ፡ ሊቀ፡ ማእምራነ፡ ተዓይኒሁ፡ ዘያፈቅሮ፡ እምኵሎሙ፡ ሊቃውንቲሁ፡ ‘He revealed his internal thought to a learned man, chief of learned men of his court’ 30–31 § 99 (ed.), 54 § 99 (tr.) (‘ሊቀ፡ ማእምራን፡ in some cases they are said to be ካህናተ፡ ደብተራ፡ kahǝnatä däbtära are the priests of the royal church who followed the king in all his movements both in peacetime and in war. They enjoyed privilege in front of the king and acquired many kinds of court provisions. Cf. 249; 302; I, VI (tr.); Getatchew Haile 2005, 27.’), vid. ማእምር፡ e ሊቀ፡ ማእስራ፡ liqa māʾsǝrā (title) meaning unknown ወሞተ፡ ማዕቀበ፡ እግዚእ፤ ወሊቀ፡ ማእስራ፡ ተክለ፡ ሥሉስ፡ ‘Es fielen Māʿqaba-Egziʾ, der Liqa-Māʾsa{sic}rā Takla-Śǝllus’ 15 l. 8–9 (ed.), 14 l. 22–23 (tr.), vid. ማእስራ፡ f ሊቀ፡ መኳስ፡ liqa makʷās, ሊቀ፡ መንኳስ፡ liqa mankʷās (title) ‘officer responsible for testing horses and mules reserved for the personal service to the king’ 102 ወቀይሰ፡ ገበዝ፡ ወሊቀ፡ ዲያቆናት፡ ይቀውሙ፡ ጸዊሮሙ፡ ታቦተ፡ ሕግ፤ ወአውፋሪ፡ ምስለ፡ ፈረስ፡ ወሊቀ፡ ምኳስ፡ ምስለ፡ በቅል። ‘und der Propst und Archidiakon stehen dabei, die Gesetzeslade tragend, und der Aufârî mit dem Pferd, und der Lîqa Makuâs mit dem Maulesel’ 18b l. 2–5 (ed.), 74 l. 18, 75 l. 1–2 (tr.); ወአመ፡ ፳ወ፯፡ ለሚያዝያ፡ ሞቱ፡ ፪ሆሙ፡ ኅቡረ፡ ደጅ፡ አዛዥ፡ ሐዋርያ፡ ክሶስ፡ መደባይ፡ ወሊቀ፡ መኳስ፡ ገብርኤል። ‘Le 27 de miyâzyâ moururent ensemble l’Azâdj Ḥaouâryâ-Kësos … et le Liqa-Makuâsa Gabrëèl’ 45 l. 25–27 (ed.), 153 l. 22–24 (tr.); ሊቀ፡ መንኳስ፡ ኃይሉ፡ ‘le liqa mankuās Ḫāylu’ 53 l. 16–17 (ed.), 64 l. 11 (tr.), vid. መኳስ፡ g ሊቀ፡ መጣኒ፡ liqa maṭṭāni, ሊቀ፡ መጻኒ፡ liqa maṣṣāni ሊቀ፡ መጻኔ፡ liqa maṣṣāne (title) supreme judge who exercises appellate jurisdiction 115a;
