Cf. 255. 45 ሕማመ፡ ልብ፡ ḥǝmāma lǝbb «mélancolie» ወድቀ፡ ውስተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ሕማመ፡ ልብ። 184, vid. ልብ፡ 32 ሕማመ፡ ማሕያዊት፡ ḥǝmāma māḥyāwit Passion du Christ ወፈደዮሙ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ በእንተ፡ ዘኢያክበርዋ፡ ለሕማሙ፡ ማሕያዊት፡ ለእግዜእነ፡... ‘Le Seigneur les paya (ainsi), parce qu’ils n’avaient pas honoré la Passion vivificatrice de Notre Seigneur.’ 326, vid. ማሕይው፡ 447–448 ሕመም፡ ባሕርያዊ፡ ḥǝmam bāḥrǝyāwi mal de mer ... ሕማም፡ ባሕርያዊ፡ ዘኮነ፡ ባቲ፡ ‘Le mal de mer qui est en elle’ Ms. BNFet110, fol. 41va, vid. ባሕራዊ፡ ሕማም፡ ጠባይዓዊ፡ ḥǝmām ṭabāyʿāwi mal de la nature c’est-à-dire les souffrances causées par toutes intempéries; expression corrélative à la précédente. ... ነዋ፡ ተሀውከ፡ ቦቱ፡ ሕማም፡ ጠባይዓዊ፡ Ms. BNFet110, fol. 41va, vid. ጠባይዓዊ፡ ሕማመ፡ ፈንጸንት፡ ḥǝmāma fanṣant dysenterie 1374 mentionne une forme proche: vid. ፈንጻጻ፡ qu’il traduit variole, syphilis. አኀዞ፡ ሕማመ፡ ፈንጸንት፡ ወበኅዳጥ፡ ዘመን። ‘[Ménas] contracta la dysenterie et mourut en peu de temps’ 448, vid. ፈንጸንት፡ 448 L ሕማም ḥǝmām, ሕመም፡ ḥǝmam illness, disease, pain, suffering, grief, distress, affliction, tribulation, passion, Passion (of Christ), Passion Week ሕማማት ḥǝmāmāt Passion (of Christ), Good Friday 233a ሕመም፡ ባሕርያዊ ḥǝmam bāḥrǝyāwi seasickness, vid. ባሕራዊ፡ 91b ሕማመ፡ ፈንጸንት ḥǝmāma fanṣant (448) dysentery, vid. ፈንጸንት፡ 163a C for ግብረ፡ ሕማማት፡ vid. ግብር፡

woorden.betekenis: dolorem, afflictionem afferens, māḥmami
woorden.definitie: part. et adj., dolorem vel afflictionem afferens: ዝብጠት፡ ማሕመሚ፡ F.M. 8,3; F.M. 16,6; Fal. f. 18. māḥmami C vid. also አሕማሚ፡

woorden.betekenis: fuligo, atramentum, ḥǝmmat, soot, charcoal, black liquid, bl
woorden.definitie: subst. 1 fuligo (vid. rad. ሐመመ፡ Nr. 4 ἀσβόλη: ጸሊም፡ እምነ፡ ሕመት፡ ራእዮሙ፡ Thren. 4,8; ጸሊም፡ ከመ፡ ሕመት፡ Herm. p. 74; Herm. p. 80. 2 ማየ፡ ሕመት፡ atramentum (e fuligine factum) 2 Cor. 3,3; inde repetitum in Cyr. de r. fid. f. 36; 2 Joh. 12; 3 Joh. 13; Hen. 69,9; Rel. Bar. – Voc. Ae.: ሕመት፡ ዘጽላት፡ ቀለም። ḥǝmmat G ሐመት፡ ḥǝmmat «fuligo, atramentum» ― ጥቅርሻ፡, ጥላት፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 10. 45 L ሐመት ḥǝmmat soot, charcoal, black liquid, blackness 235a C for ማየ፡ ሕመት፡ vid. ማይ፡

woorden.betekenis: portavit onus, comportavit, collegit, coacervavit, coacervan
woorden.definitie: rad. inus. I. mutatis ረ et ለ cum حَمَلَ portavit onus, ܚܡܰܠ comportavit, collegit, coacervavit (جَمَلَ) convenire videtur; eandem autem notionem coacervandi habent hebr. עָמַר et חָמַר (in עִמֵּר עֹמֶר עָמִיר חֹמֶר) et ከመረ፡. Hinc mihi nomen traxisse videtur ሐመር፡ navigium, dictum a portando. (Pariter nomen asini חֲמוֹר ܚܡܳܪܳܐ حِمَارٌ, quem etymologi a colore subrubro dictum esse asserunt, nescio an rectius ad portandum referatur). II. i.q. حَمَرَ IX XI rubuit, cui vicinum est ኀፈረ፡, q.v. (hinc ሐመር፡ bacca rubra ).

woorden.betekenis: navis, qui naufragium fecit, puppi navis, ḥamar
woorden.definitie: subst. (a rad. Nr. I), fem. (rarius m., ut 2 Par. 9,21; 4 Esr. 9,36 var.; Sap. 14,5) Pl. አሕማር፡, Pl. Pl. አሕማራት፡, navis cujuscumque generis (inde a maxima usque ad scapham) ναῦς, πλοῖον, πλοιάριον: Jes. 2,16; Jes. 11,14; Jes. 18,1 (አሕማር፡ እለ፡ ቦን፡ ክንፈ፡); Jes. 23,1; Jes. 23,10; Jes. 33,21; Jes. 60,9; Hez. 27,9; Jon. 1,3 (ረከበ፡ ሐመረ፡ ዘይነግድ፡); Dan. 11,40; Ps. 103,27; Prov. 24,54; Prov. 29,32; Job 9,26; Job 40,25; Sir. 36,2 (ሐመር፡ እንተ፡ ታንኮልል፡); Sap. 5,10; Sap. 14,1; Kuf. 50(ዘይነግድ፡ በሐመር፡ ባሕረ፡); Matth. 4,21; Matth. 14,13; Marc. 3,9; Jac. 3,4; Apoc. 8,9; አሕማረ፡ ተርሴስ፡ Ps. 47,6; 3 Reg. 10,22; ሐመር፡ ንኡስ፡ Sap. 14,5; ንእስት፡ ሐመር፡ Act. 27,16 rom.; Act. 27,30 rom.; አሕማራት፡ Hez. 27,29 (vers. alt.); ሊቀ፡ ሐመር፡ ναύκληρος Act. 27,11 rom.; ነገሥተ፡ አሕማር፡ Hen. 101,4; ሰብአ፡ ሐመር፡ Act. 27,11 Platt; ተሰብረት፡ ሐመርየ፡ 2 Cor. 11,25 rom.; ዘተሰብረ፡ በባሕር፡ ሐመሩ፡ qui naufragium fecit Kid. f. 17; de puppi navis vid. Act. 27,29; Act. 27,30; Act. 27,40. – Navi comparatur ecclesia Did. 12et Maria: ሰላም፡ ለኪ፡ ሐመር፡ ሐዳስ፡ እንተ፡ ትጸውሪ፡ ብዕለ፡ ዓለም፡ Mavâs. 38. – Voc. Ae.: ተንከተም፡ አርማስ፡ ሐመር፡ ዘ፡ መርከብ። ḥamar C a for ሊቀ፡ ሐመር፡ vid. ሊቅ፡ (TraCES, Leslau) b for ሐዳፍያነ፡ አሕማር፡ vid. ኀዳፍ፡ (TraCES, Grébaut) c for ሰብአ፡ አሕማር፡ vid. ሰብእ (TraCES, Grébaut)

woorden.betekenis: pinguis fuit, evasit
woorden.definitie: (ሐመሰ፡) rad. inus. (de qua vid. Ges. thes. p. 494) pinguis fuit vel evasit.

woorden.betekenis: fel
woorden.definitie: fel vid. sub ሐመወ፡ II

woorden.betekenis: û, socer, gener
woorden.definitie: subst., m., Pl. አሕማው፡; (in F.N. 26 etiam pl. ሐማን፡ occurrit, quae forma videtur minus bona esse) pronomina suffixa ope vocalis û recipit (sec. gramm. § 154,d) 1 socer (πένθερος) ሐሙኪ፡ Gen. 38,13; ሐሙሁ፡ Ex. 3,1; Ex. 18,1 seq.; Tob. 10,8; Jud. 19,4; ሐሙሃ፡ Kuf. 41; ሐመ፡ ሙሴ፡ Ex. 18,12; Acc. ሐማሁ፡ Ex. 18,26. 2 gener νυμφός Jud. 15,6; Jud. 19,5; γαμβρός 1 Reg. 22,14; 2 Esr. 16,18; Jsp. p. 281; Jsp. p. 298; Jsp. p. 272, ubi Pl. legitur: እመሰ፡ ፀባእክሙነ፡ ትፀብኡ፡ ውሉደክሙ፡ ወአሕማወክሙ፡ እለ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ቅሩባን፡ ሰብእ፡ ለክሙ።

woorden.betekenis: vincire
woorden.definitie: vincire vid. sub ኀመየ፡

woorden.betekenis: concrevit, congelata fuit, extinctus fuit ignis; mortuus est
woorden.definitie: I i.q. جَمَدَ et جَمُدَ concrevit, congelata fuit (de omni re fluida). II i.q. هَمَدَ extinctus fuit ignis; mortuus est, خَمَدَ consedit ignis remissa sua flamma; remisit febris; sedatus fuit (رَمَادٌ cinis, aram. רָמָץ carbo cum cinere; ܡܽܘܥܳܐ; cinis fervidus ). Hinc

woorden.betekenis: pruina, nix, aliud
woorden.definitie: subst., (m.) pruina, nix [amh. አመዳይ፡]: πάχνη Job 38,24; Job 38,29; χιών 1 Par. 11,22; በረድ፡ አስሐትያ፡ ሐመዳ፡ Ps. 148,8; Kuf. 23; ቍር፡ ወበረድ፡ ወአስሐትያ፡ ወሐመዳ፡ Hen. 34,2; Hen. 60,18; Hen. 76,11; Hen. 76,12; Hen. 100,13. – Voc. Ae.: ሐመዳ፡ ዘ፡ ዋግ፡; aliud: ሐመዳ፡ ዘ፡ ቅሕ፡ ዋግሂ።

woorden.betekenis: cinis, fuliginem, pulvis, ḥamad
woorden.definitie: subst., (m.) 1 cinis, σποδός Ps. 101,10; Ps. 147,5; Thren. 3,16; Judith 4,15; Judith 9,1; 4 Esr. 9,39; Job 13,12; መሬት፡ ወሐመድ፡ Gen. 18,27; Job 30,19; Job 42,6; Sir. 10,9; Sir. 17,32; ሠቅ፡ ወሐመድ፡ Jes. 58,5; Luc. 10,13; አውዐያ፡ ለሀገር፡ ወኮነት፡ ሐመደ፡ Jos. 8,28; እሬስየከ፡ ሐመደ፡ Hez. 28,18; ጠፍኡ፡ ከመ፡ ሐመደ፡ ሡዕ፡ ὡς λίνον ἐσβεσμένον Jes. 43,17; cinis hostiarum combustarum Lev. 4,12; ሐመድ፡ ልቦሙ፡ σποδὸς ἡ καρδία αὐτῶν Jes. 44,20; τέφρα Dan. apocr. 13,14; ዘሕብረ፡ ሐመድ፡ σποδοειδής (coloris cinerei) Gen. 30,39. In Ex. 9,8 ሐመደ፡ እቶን፡ fuliginem (αἰθάλη καμιναία) significat. 2 nonnumquam pulvis (χοῦς) Ps. 71,9; (γῆ) Job 2,12; Job 7,5; 2 Reg. 1,2. (Lev. 19,36 ሐመድ፡ errore interpretis pro mensura ὁ χοῦς positum est). ḥamad C for ሕብረ፡ ሐመድ፡ vid. ሕብር፡

woorden.betekenis: mala ac prava fuit res; improbus, impurus fuit, turpiter egi
woorden.definitie: I,1 [convenit cum arab. خَبُثَ mala ac prava fuit res; improbus, impurus fuit, IV X turpiter egit, sicut አበሰ፡ cum أَثِمَ crimen commisit, peccavit et אָשֵׁם] foedum, turpem, malum esse, displicere: ቦእለ፡ የሐሥማ፡ ውስተ፡ ሕንጻ፡ quidam ( lapides ) deformes erant in structura Herm. p. 80; አልቦ፡ ኀበ፡ ሐሠመ፡ (v. ሕሡመ፡) እምኔሁ፡ non erat in eo quidquam deforme 2 Reg. 14,25; እስከ፡ ሐሠመ፡ ጺአቱ፡ ሎቱ፡ foetor ejus ei perniciosus erat Jsp. p. 293; etiam c. Acc. pers., ut: ሐሠሞሙ፡ ለሕያዋን፡ ጼና፡ አብድንት፡ Jsp. p. 355; ሶበ፡ ሰምዐ፡ ሐሠሞ፡ ዝንቱ፡ quum hoc audiret, ei displicuit Jsp. p. 296.

woorden.betekenis: turpiter, prave agere, malefacere, maledicere, male habere,
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 turpiter vel prave agere, malefacere: አሠንዩ፡ ወአሕሥሙ፡ εὖ ποιήσατε καὶ κακώσατε Jes. 41,23; ኢያሤኒ፡ ወኢያሐሥም፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Zeph. 1,12; ኢትቅናእ፡ ከመ፡ ታሕሥም፡ Ps. 36,8; Ps. 36,9; አሕሠምከ፡ ዘገበርከ፡ Jer. 45,9; አሕሠሙ፡ ለቀቲሎቱ፡ ἐπονηρεύοντο τοῦ ἀποκτεῖναι αὐτόν Gen. 37,18. 2 creberrime: malefacere vel maledicere alicui, male habere aliquem, vim vel injuriam afferre alicui, insultare in, offendere aliquem: c.c. ለ፡, በ፡, ዲበ፡, ላዕለ፡ pers.: ከመ፡ ኢያሕሥም፡ ለያዕቆብ፡ Kuf. 35; Kuf. 37; Ex. 22,20; Ex. 22,21; Ex. 22,22; Rom. 12,17; ለምንት፡ አሕሠምከ፡ በዝ፡ ሕዝብ፡ Ex. 5,22; Ex. 5,23; ኢታሕሥም፡ ዲበ፡ ነባሪከ፡ μὴ κακώσῃς οἰκέτην Sir. 7,20; Sir. 30,40; Ps. 104,14; ኢታሕሥሙ፡ ላዕለ፡ እሉ፡ Gen. 19,7; ኢይክሉ፡ አሕሥሞ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ Jes. 11,9; Jes. 50,8; Kuf. 29; Judith 11,1; ሀገር፡ ታሐሥም፡ ላዕለ፡ ነገሥት፡ 2 Esr. 4,15; አሕሠሙ፡ ገቢረ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ Mich. 3,4; አሕሠመ፡ ቃለ፡ ላዕለ፡ κακολογεῖν 1 Reg. 3,13; Marc. 7,10; Marc. 9,39; በኵሉ፡ ዘትሁብ፡ ኢታሕሥም፡ ቃለ፡ Sir. 18,15; ያሐሥሙ፡ አፉሆሙ፡ ላዕሌየ፡ φαῦλοι γλώσσῃ Sir. 20,16; Sir. 29,24. 3 aliquid declarare malum, in malam partem accipere: ያሐሥማ፡ ኃጥእ፡ ለንዴቱ፡ በአፉሁ፡ Sir. 13,24; ኢታሕሥሙኒ፡ ne mihi in malam partem imputetis Lud. sine auctor.

woorden.betekenis: malum, foedum censere, declarare
woorden.definitie: IV,1 aliquid malum vel foedum censere vel declarare Kuf. p. 143.

woorden.betekenis: foedus, turpis, malus, deformis, Satanae, pravus, futilis, n
woorden.definitie: part. 1 de rebus physicis: foedus, turpis, malus, deformis: ሕሡም፡ ራእዮሙ፡ Gen. 41,19; Gen. 25,27; Kuf. 19; Prov. 11,22 gloss.; οὐκ εὐσχήμων Prov. 11,25; Satanae ኮነ፡ ሕሡመ፡ ራእዩ፡ ፈድፋደ፡ Clem. f. 6; (አእባን፡) ሕሡማት፡ ἀπρεπεῖς Herm. p. 78; ጼና፡ ሕሡም፡ ወጽዩእ፡ ወፍጉግ፡ Genz. f. 156; እለ፡ ይትሐወሱ፡ ሕሡማን፡ κνώδαλα Sap. 16,1. 2 de animo, dictis, factis: malus, pravus, futilis, nequam, iniquus Job 2,3; አልቦ፡ ዘትገብር፡ ሕሡመ፡ ምንተኒ፡ በሒስከ፡ Sir. 10,6; ምግባሪከ፡ ሕሡም፡ ወኅሱር፡ Hez. 20,44; ምግባራት፡ ሕሡም፡ ወሕሙይ፡ ፍትወት፡ Jsp. p. 381; ἀδικία 1 Reg. 28,10; λοιμός 29,10; ትነቡ፡ ሕሡመ፡ ላዕለ፡ መልአክ፡ Jes. 8,21; ኢታውሥእ፡ ሕሡመ፡ በአፉከ፡ Jes. 58,13; አልቦ፡ ዘአውጽአ፡ ላዕሌሃ፡ ቃለ፡ ሕሡመ፡ Judith 8,8; አውሥእዎ፡ በሕሡም፡ Jsp. p. 364; Tit. 2,8 (φαῦλος); Gen. 31,24; Lev. 19,14; Lev. 20,9; ነገር፡ ሕሡም፡ λόγος σαπρός Eph. 4,29; ሕሡም፡ ዜና፡ infamia II Abtel. Ap. 39; ሕሡመ፡ ኮነ፡ ሎቱ፡ እስመ፡ displicuit ei, quod Kuf. 7. 3 de rebus adversis: malus, noxius: ተአመን፡ ከመ፡ ሕሡም፡ አልቦ፡ ዘይረክበከ፡ Sir. 19,10; ኢይረክባ፡ ምንትኒ፡ ሕሡም፡ quidquam mali ei non accidet F.N. 24,6; በሕሡም፡ እቀትሎሙ፡ (κακῶς) Matth. 21,41. – Voc. Ae.: እኩይ፡ ሕሡም፡ ዘ፡ ቢስ።

woorden.betekenis: ignominia affici
woorden.definitie: ignominia affici vid. sub ኀስረ፡

woorden.betekenis: culmus aridus, stipula, sarmenta, ramalia arida, leviathano
woorden.definitie: (amh. አሠር፡) subst., plerumque m., coll., 1 culmus aridus, stipula, sarmenta vel ramalia arida: leviathano est እብን፡ ከመ፡ ሐሠር፡ (χόρτος) Job 41,19; καλάμη (igne conflagranda) Jes. 5,14; ሐሠር፡ ይቡስ፡ ἄγρωστις ξηρά Jes. 9,18; φρύγανα Jes. 40,24; Jes. 41,2; Jes. 47,14; Jer. 13,24; ከምረ፡ ሐሠር፡ στυππεῖον συνηγμένον Sir. 21,9; Jud. 15,14; κάρφος Matth. 7,3; Matth. 7,4. 2 palea, gluma (ἄχυρον, ἄχυρα): ሐሠር፡ ለገቢረ፡ ግንፋል፡ Ex. 5,7; ከመ፡ የአልዱ፡ ብርዐ፡ ለሐሠር፡ Ex. 5,12; Matth. 3,12; Luc. 3,17; Job 41,18; ከመ፡ ሐሠር፡ ዘቅድመ፡ ገጸ፡ ነፋስ፡ Job 21,18; Sir. 22,18; Jes. 17,13; Jer. 23,28 (opp. ሥርናይ፡); pabulum pecuarium: Gen. 24,32; 3 Reg. 4,21; Jes. 11,7.

woorden.betekenis: laetari, laetitia exultare, alacritate gestire
woorden.definitie: et ተሐሥየ፡ III,1 laetari, laetitia exultare, alacritate gestire: ይትሐሠዩ፡ περιχαρεῖς ἐγένοντο Job 3,22; Job 29,22; እንዘ፡ ትትሐሠይ፡ ἐν εὐφροσύνῃ Sir. 32,11; Jes. 9,3; 1 Par. 29,9; ἀγαλλιᾶσθαι Ps. 2,11; Ps. 9,2; Ps. 125,2; Ps. 15,9; Ps. 66,4; Ps. 96,1; Matth. 5,12; 2 Reg. 1,20; c.c. በ ut ይትሐሠዩ፡ ብከ፡ Kuf. 25; Jes. 14,8; Jes. 25,9; Ps. 149,2; Prov. 2,14; Prov. 23,25; c. በእንተ፡ Hez. 25,6; Herm. p. 63; c. ለ pers. συγχαίρειν τινί Phil. 2,17; Phil. 2,18.

woorden.betekenis: laetitia, alacritas, exultatio
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., laetitia, alacritas, exultatio: χαρμονή Job 3,7; Job 20,5; χαρά Sir. 30,16; Jes. 55,12; Ps. 20,6; εὐφροσύνη Jes. 52,9; Jer. 7,34; Jer. 16,9; 1 Par. 29,17; ἀγαλλίαμα Sir. 15,6; Sir. 30,22; Jes. 16,10; Jes. 51,3; Jes. 65,18; Ps. 50,9; Hen. 5,9. Creberrime usurpatur haec vox, et haud raro cum ፍሥሓ፡ conjuncta.

woorden.betekenis: exercitus
woorden.definitie: exercitus vid. sub II ሐረረ፡

woorden.betekenis: sacrum, idola, delubrum, templum, mǝḥrām, sanctuary, shrine,
woorden.definitie: subst., Pl. ምሕራማት፡ 1 sacrum (septum) communi usui exemtum (cfr. حَرَمٌ), pec. lucus, ubi idolum positum est; በአታተ፡ ምሕራሞሙ፡ τὰ σπήλαια αὐτῶν Hab. 2,15; ἄλση: እገዝም፡ ምሕራማቲከ፡ Mich. 5,13; 4 Reg. 18,4; ሐውልተ፡ ምሕራማቲሆሙ፡ 3 Reg. 14,23; ምሕራመ፡ ዖም፡ 3 Reg. 15,13; 3 Reg. 16,33; 3 Reg. 18,19; 4 Reg. 13,6; etiam Ps. 80,6 Aethiops pro ἄρσεων legisse videtur ἄλσεων; τεμένη Hez. 6,6; κῆποι Jes. 1,29; τὰ δένδρα Jes. 17,8 vers. alt. et אֲשֵׁרִים Jer. 17,2 vers. nov.; etiam Jes. 27,9 ምሕራማተ፡ ጣዖት፡ ተገዝመ፡ (εἴδωλα) arbores sacrae intelligendae videntur. Aethiopes his in locis ምሕራማት፡ idola interpretantur, quare Voc. Ae.: ምሕራማት፡ ዘ፡ ጣዖት፡ 2 delubrum, templum (Deorum idolorumve): ምሕራማት፡ τὰ ἱερά Hez. 27,6; Hen. 99,7; ቤቴል፡ ምሕራመ፡ ነገሥት፡ ይእቲ፡ Am. 7,13 [vid. etiam ምኵራብ፡]. – Voc. Ae.: ምሕራም፡ ብ፡ የጣዖት፡ መስገጅ። mǝḥrām L ምሕራም mǝḥrām sanctuary, shrine, temple, chapel, temple of the pagans 242b

woorden.betekenis: ferbuit, incaluit, aruit, adustus est, aruit, ḥarara, ḥarra,
woorden.definitie: radix, quae etiam ሐለለ፡ pronuntiatur, q.v.; arab. حَرَّ ferbuit, incaluit; הָרַר aruit, adustus est; חֲרַר, חַר id.; ܚܰܪ aruit prae calore. ḥarara, ሐረ ḥarra G ሐረረ፡ ḥarara I,1 የሐርር፡, ይሕርር፡ «se carboniser, se sécher, être brûlé» ― አረረ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 22v (au lieu de 22r). 47 L ḥrr, ሐረ ḥarra, ሐረረ፡ ḥarara (yǝḥrǝr, yǝḥrar) burn (intr.), be ablaze, be hot, be grilled, () be dried up 243a

woorden.betekenis: ardor, fervor, aestus, venti ferventis, horae aestus meridia
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem.: ardor, fervor, aestus, pec. solis et venti ferventis: ጊዜ፡ ሐሩር፡ horae aestus meridiani F.N. 10,6; ሙቀተ፡ ሐሩር፡ Hen. 4; Herm. p. 96; ደብረ፡ ሐሩር፡ πεδίον ἀφανισμοῦ Joel 2,3; καῦμα Jer. 17,8; Job 24,24; Apoc. 7,16; Apoc. 16,8; Apoc. 16,9; καύσων Job 27,21; Judith 8,3; ነፋሰ፡ ሐሩር፡ Hos. 13,15; ነፋስ፡ ሐሩር፡ Jon. 4,8; de aestu cupidinum juvenilium Phlx. 106; { ሰካሪ፡ እምሐሩረ፡ ወይን፡ Phlx. 106 }. ḥarur G ሐሩር፡ ḥarur «ardeur brûlante» ― አሩር፡, ቋያ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 22v. 47 L ሐሩር ḥarur intense heat, ardor, fevor (probably from Ar. ḥarūr) 243a

woorden.betekenis: in puerperio cubare
woorden.definitie: in puerperio cubare vid. sub ኀረሰ፡

woorden.betekenis: incantationis, magiae genus
woorden.definitie: vel ሐርስ፡, nec non ሐራስ፡, subst., incantationis vel magiae genus; accuratius ejus notionem vix definire licet: ሰብአ፡ ሐርሶ፡ (CG: ሐረስ፡) sunt ἐγγαστρίμυθοι Lev. 19,31; idem ሰብአ፡ ሐርስ፡ (CG: ሐረስ፡) Lev. 20,6; ዘሐርስ፡ (C: ዘሐራስ፡, G: ዘሐረስ፡) est ἐπαείδων Deut. 18,11. In Gad. T.H. legi formam: ሰብአ፡ ሐሪስ፡ (juxta ሰብአ፡ ሰገል፡); in Clem. f. 219 ሰብአ፡ ሐራስ፡ ወሥራይ፡ ወሰገል፡ ወጣዖት፡ Etiam in Synodo et aliis libris occurrunt hae voces, sed de notione genuina nihil inde efficere licet.

woorden.betekenis: sus, porcus, aprum, â, phascochoero, ḥarāwyā, wild boar, cin
woorden.definitie: et (in antiquioribus libris mss.) ሐረውያ፡ et ሐረዊያ፡ (ut Lev. 11,7 FH; Jes. 65,4; Jes. 66,3 cod. Laur.) m. et fem., Pl. አሕርው፡ (ሐራውያን፡ in Cod. Tubing. Clem. f. 249videtur esse lectio prava) sus, porcus, sing. Lev. 11,7; Prov. 11,22; ሐራውያ፡ ተኀፂባ፡ ገብአት፡ ዲበ፡ ፀብር፡ 2 Petr. 2,22; ሐራውያ፡ ሐቅል፡ ለዋው፡ 2 Reg. 17,8; ሐራውያ፡ ገዳም፡ Ps. 79,14; እመ፡ ይዌልጥ፡ ሐራውያ፡ ጸጕሮ፡ ከመ፡ ፀምር፡ Kuf. 37; coll. Hen. 89,10; Hen. 89,12; Hen. 89,42; ደመ፡ ሐራውያ፡ αἶμα υἵειον Jes. 66,3; ሥጋ፡ ሐራውያ፡ κρέας υἵειον 65,4; Jsp. p. 287; pl. Matth. 7,6; Matth. 8,30; Matth. 8,31; Marc. 5,11; Luc. 15,15; Clem. f. 104. – In locis allegatis ሐራውያ፡ porcum domesticum significat; aprum autem appellare solent ሐራውያ፡ ሐቅል፡ vel ሐራውያ፡ ገዳም፡ (cui ሐራውያ፡ ቤት፡ opponi asserit Ludolfus). Sed etiam aprum ferum hac voce significari, demonstrant alii loci, ut ኮነ፡ እቡደ፡ ከመ፡ ሐራዌ፡ (sic) Gad. T.H. – De vocali vocis finali â vid. gramm. § 131,1. – Praeterea vid. ሕንዚር፡ et መፍልስ፡. – Voc. Ae.: መፍልስ፡ ወሐራውያ፡ ዘ፡ ሕርያ፡ (v. እርያ፡). De እርያ፡ phascochoero vid. Harris Reise, Anh. S. 50. ḥarāwyā subst. wild boar, ‘ cinghiale ’ ምስለ፡ አራዊተ፡ ገዳም፡ ወምስለ፡ አናብስት፡ ወአናምርት፡ ወአዝዕብት፡ ወግሔያት፡ ወቶራት፡ ወባቡላት፡ ወነጌያት፡ ወአሕርው፡ ወከናዚር፡ ወባቡ<ላ>ሰ፡ ብሂል፡ በነገረ፡ አክሱም፡ አጋዜን፡ ወእቱ፡ ወነጌያት፡ ብሂል፡ ሐርማዝ፡ ሐራውያ፡ ወከናዚር፡ መፍለስ፡ ወሐሰማ፡ ‘ in compagnia delle fiere selvatiche, con leoni, leopardi, iene, iraci, gazzelle, bābulāt, nagēyā, ʾaḥrew, kanāzir: bābulā nella lingua di ʾAksum si dice ʾagāzēn (antilope), nagēyāt si dice ḥarmāz (elefante), e ḥarāwyā e kanāzir si dicono maflas (cinghiale) e ḥasamā (porco) ’ 119-120 § 304 (ed.), 68-69 § 304 (tr.); vid. ከናዚር፡, መፍልስ፡

woorden.betekenis: plexit, palmites vitis, palmes vitis ejusdem anni, vitis, vi
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., hebr. et אָרַג et שָׂרַג, aram. סְרַג plexit, unde שָׂרִגִים palmites vitis, aram. זַרְגִּין id., arab. سَرْعٌ palmes vitis ejusdem anni, سَرَعْرَعٌ id., زَرْجِينَةٌ vitis, زَرَجُونٌ vitis, vitis palmites.Vic. est ሀረከ፡ q.v. Hinc

woorden.betekenis: mas ovium et caprarum, aries et hircus, caper, cornibus infl
woorden.definitie: subst., m., Pl. ሐራጊት፡ (nec non Pl. አሕሩግ፡ legi in Gad. T.H., sed dubito an sit forma bona) mas ovium et caprarum, aries et hircus vel caper. [De etymo nihil certi habeo: nescio an nomen a cornibus inflexis ductum et ad significandum eum caprum arietemve, cujus cornua jam inflecti coeperunt, adhibitum sit; de quo etymo comparere licuerit أَعْقَصُ, fortasse etiam צָפִיר a ضفر ፀፈረ፡] κριός et κριοί ሐርጌ፡ እምውስተ፡ አባግዕ፡ Lev. 5,15 et absol. sine በግዕ፡ Jes. 1,11; Jes. 34,6; Jes. 34,7; Jes. 60,7; Jer. 28,40; Hez. 45,23; 2 Par. 29,32; Ps. 28,1; ሐራጊት፡ ሠናያን፡ Jer. 32,20 (sed in eodem commate etiam አብሓኵ፡); χίμαρος et χίμαροι: ሐርጌ፡ እምውስተ፡ አጣሊ፡ Lev. 4,23; Lev. 4,24; Lev. 9,3; Lev. 16,5; Deut. 14,4; ሐራጊተ፡ ጠሊ፡ 2 Par. 29,21, vel abs. sine ጠሊ፡ Ps. 49,10; 2 Esr. 15,18; ሐራጊት፡ ሥቡሓን፡ Mich. 5,7; τράγοι ሐራጊተ፡ ጠሊ፡ 2 Par. 17,11. – Voc. Ae.: ሐርጌ፡ ዘ፡ ጌደር፡ (v. ገልገሉ፡); de qua voce vid. Vocabulariorum scholia ad እጐልት፡ et ad ናቃት። ḥarge, ሐርጊ፡ ḥargi, Pl. ḥarāgit, ʾaḥrug, ሐርጊያን፡ ḥargiyān G ሐርጊ፡ ḥargi, Pl. ሐርጊያን፡ ḥargiyān «mas gregis» ― ጊደር፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 12. 48 L ሐርጌ ḥarge (Pl. ሐራጊት ḥarāgit, አሕሩግ፡ ʾaḥrug), (48) ሐርጊ ḥargi ram, male of sheep or goats, kid (of goats) 242a

woorden.betekenis: decerpere
woorden.definitie: decerpere vid. sub ኀረፈ፡

woorden.betekenis: absit!, absit a me!
woorden.definitie: et frequentius ሐሰ፡ [de quo vid. gramm. § 163,3 et gramm. § 199,d; i.q. arab. حَاشَ لِلهِ, حَاشَالَكَ حَاشَاكَ aram. ܚܳܣܠܳܟ; significatione convenit hebr. חָלִילָה לִי], formula deprecandi et aversandi: absit! Usurpatur absolute ut ሐሰ፡ μὴ γένοιτο Rom. 3,4; Rom. 3,31; Rom. 9,14; ለ pers., ut: ሐሰ፡ ሊተ፡ absit a me! 1 Reg. 2,30; 1 Reg. 20,9; Act. 10,14; Gen. 44,7; Matth. 16,22; 4 Esr. 8,53. Res vel actio, quam aliquis deprecatur vel aversatur, subjungitur praepositione እምነ፡ ut: ሐሰ፡ ሊተ፡ እምነ፡ ገቢሮቱ፡ 2 Reg. 23,17; ሐሰ፡ ሎቱ፡ ለእግዚእየ፡ እምነ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ርኩስ፡ 1 Reg. 25,31; vel conjunctione እስከ፡ seq. Indic.: ሐሰ፡ ለነ፡ እስከ፡ ነኀድግ፡ Jos. 22,29; Gen. 44,17; Gal. 6,14 rom.; vel ከመ፡ seq. Indic., ut ሐሰ፡ ሊተ፡ ከመኢይገብር፡ ዘንተ፡ 1 Par. 11,19; nec non Imperfecto vel Subjunctivo nudo, ut: ሐሰ፡ ኢትመውት፡ μηδαμῶς σοι. οὐ μὴ ἀποθάνῃς 1 Reg. 20,2; Kuf. 43; ሐሰ፡ ለከ፡ ኢታጥፍአነ፡ Jon. 1,14; Judith 8,14; Gen. 18,25; Matth. 16,22.

woorden.betekenis: capistrare, capistrum, colligavit sarcinas; cingulo cinxit j
woorden.definitie: I,1 [sine dubio i.q. hebr. חָסַם, aram. חֲסַם capistrare, מַחְסוֹם capistrum; arab. حَزَمَ colligavit sarcinas; cingulo cinxit jumentum; حِزَامٌ cingulum jumenti; teniae cunarum; حُزْمَةٌ fascis (lignorum, frugum); syr. ܚܙܺܝܡܳܐ accinctus ] capistro coërcere vel ducere: የሐስሎሙ፡ (var. ያሐስሎሙ፡ II,1; var. ይነድኦሙ፡) ሕፃን፡ παιδίον ἄξει αὐτούς Jes. 11,6. – { ነሥኣ፡ (sumsit eam) ምስሌሁ፡ ወአጽዐና፡ ላዕለ፡ ፈረስ፡ ወውእቱኒ፡ የሐስል፡ ላቲ፡ Sx. Nah. 5} Voc. Ae.:የሐስል፡ ዘ፡ ይስሕብ፡, v. ይለብብ፡

woorden.betekenis: II,1 vid. sub I,1.
woorden.definitie: II,1 vid. sub I,1.

woorden.betekenis: putavit, imputavit, cogitavit, numeravit, putavit, reputavit
woorden.definitie: I,1 [i.q. חָשַׁב putavit, imputavit, cogitavit, ܚܫܰܒ numeravit, putavit, reputavit, حَسَبَ computavit, opinatus est, aestimavit; amh. አሰበ፡; vic. est. aeth. ሐዘበ፡ q.v.] 1 supputare, computare, ad calculos vocare: ወኢሐሰበ፡ ዳዊት፡ ወኢኈለቈ፡ ኍልቆሙ፡ 1 Par. 27,23; አኀዘ፡ ይኈልቍ፡ ወይሕሰብ፡ (modo lectio sana sit) 27,24; ሐሲበከ፡ ሐሳበ፡ (v. ሐስቦ፡) computo a te facto 4 Esr. 9,1; Lev. 25,50; Lev. 25,52; የሐስብ፡ ሎቱ፡ ካህን፡ ወርቆ፡ Lev. 27,18; Lev. 27,23; የሐስብ፡ ፃእፃአ፡ ψηφίζει τὴν δαπάνην Luc. 14,28; ሐሲበከ፡ ፃእፃአ፡ Herm. p. 54; በከመ፡ ሐሰበ፡ ወአስተቀሰመ፡ ለአማስኖቶሙ፡ καθὼς ἔθετο ψήφισμα καὶ κλῆρον ἀφανίσαι αὐτούς Esth. 9,24; ኢየሐስብዎሙ፡ በሐሳበ፡ ዓለም፡ Hen. 82,5; crebro in Abush. de computatione et ratiocinatione arithmetica. 2 imputare, annumerare alicui aliquid: እለ፡ ኢሐሰበ፡ ሎሙ፡ ኀጢአቶሙ፡ Ps. 31,1. 3 putare, aestimare, respicere, rationem habere alicujus: ዘሠናይ፡ አሐስብ፡ Rom. 7,13; ምንት፡ ይእቲ፡ ትዕቢት፡ ይቤ፡ ለእመ፡ የሐስብ፡ ሰብእ፡ ነፍሶ፡ ንጹሐ፡ Phlx. 35; እለ፡ ኢየሐስቦሙ፡ ወኢከመ፡ ከለባተ፡ መራዕይየ፡ ἡγησάμην Job 30,1; ኢሐሰብዎ፡ οὐκ ἐλογίσθη Jes. 53,3; ኢየሐስብዎ፡ 1 Esr. 3,20; Ps. 143,4; እለ፡ ኢነሐስቦሙ፡ ወኢከመ፡ ምንትኒ፡ Gal. 2,5; ኢየሐስባ፡ ለነፍስየ፡ οὐ λόγον ποιοῦμαι τῆς ψυχῆς μου Act. 20,24; ኢተሐስብ፡ መነሂ፡ οὐ μέλει σοι περὶ οὐδενός Matth. 22,16. ḥasaba L ሐሰበ ḥasaba think, believe, impute, consider, estimate, esteem, appreciate, regard, deem worthy, take into consideration, have regard for 244b

woorden.betekenis: supputatio, computus, aestimatio, erravisti in computatione,
woorden.definitie: subst., m., Pl. ሐሳባት፡ 1 supputatio, computus, aestimatio: erravisti in computatione, አግብእ፡ ሐሳበከ፡ repetas computationem, Abush. 11; ሰብአ፡ ሐሳባት፡ arithmeticae et chronologiae periti Abush. 1; Abush. 46; አልቦሙ፡ ኍልቍ፡ ወሐሳብ፡ innumeri et infiniti Hen. 40,1; Hen. 63,3; ዘአልቦ፡ ኍልቈ፡ ወመስፈርተ፡ ወአልቦሙ፡ ሐሳበ፡ እምብዝኅ፡ 2 Par. 5,6; mandavit ከመ፡ ይሢጥዎ፡ (ለሥርናይ፡) ሎሙ፡ በሐሳበ፡ ሤጥ፡ ዘከመ፡ አመ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ጽጋብ፡ Jsp. p. 329; ψῆφος Koh. 7,25; ሐሳበ፡ ሤጡ፡ Act. 19,19; etiam በሐሳብ፡ ዘእምኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ψήφῳ τῇ παρὰ Θεοῦ (Dei arbitrio) Cyr. ad Theod. f. 7. – Creberrime usurpatur de computo temporum, ut ሐሳበ፡ ዓመት፡, ሐሳበ፡ ዓለም፡ Hen. 75,1; Hen. 82,5; በእንተ፡ ሓሳበ፡ ዓለም፡ de chronologia mundi Abush.; ሐሳበ፡ ዘመን፡ calendarium 45; de computo festorum, potissimum cycli paschalis, ut Did. 30; Demetrius Alex. Patr. XII ሠርዐ፡ ሐሳበ፡ አበቅቴ፡ ወሐሳበ፡ ጾም፡ ቅዱስ፡ Sx. Teq. 12; de computo mensium et dierum, ut: አመ፡ ፳ወ፭ ለታስዕ፡ ወርኅ፡ በኍልቈ፡ ሐሳበ፡ ዕብራውያን፡ ወበሐሳበ፡ ግብጻውያን፡ አመ፡ ፳ወ፱ለወርኀ፡ ታኅሣሥ፡ Did. 29; de aeris variis, ut: ሐሳበ፡ ሐዋርያት፡, ቢዘን፡, ሮም፡, ሰማዕታት፡, ዮዲት፡, ጻድቃን፡, ሊቃውንት፡ Cat. Cod. Aeth. Mus. Brit. p. 10. 11; nec non de supputationibus astrologorum et divinationibus, ut: ሐሳበ፡ ልደት፡ genethliologiae ratio Stat. Ap. 16; ዘየሐስብ፡ ሐሳበ፡ ልደት፡ Can. Ancyr. 22; እመ፡ ኮነ፡ ተአማኔ፡ በሐሳበ፡ ኮከብ፡ si astrologiae credit F.N. 5; ዘየሐስብ፡ ሐሳባተ፡ ወልድ፡ ምስለ፡ እም፡ (inter alios magos et divinatores recensetur) F.M. 15; ሐሳበ፡ ፀሓይ፡ ወወርኅ፡ ወከዋክብት፡ Org. 2 quantitas, mensura, pretium: ዘብዙኅ፡ ሐሳቡ፡ πολυτελές 1 Petr. 3,4M በውስተ፡ ኍልቈ፡ ሐሳብ፡ ἐν μέτροις Lev. 19,35; ὁλκή Num. 7,13 seq. 3 ratio, quam aliquis reddit vel reposcit: ያገብኡ፡ ሐሳበ፡ ለ(እግዚአብሔር፡) ἀποδώσουσι λόγον τῷ 1 Petr. 4,5; ታወፍዩ፡ ሐሳበክሙ፡ 2 Petr. 1,10; ፈቀደ፡ ይግበር፡ ሐሳበ፡ ምስለ፡ አግብርቲሁ፡ Matth. 18,23. 4 ratio, proportio (quare በሐሳበ፡ idem fere, quod በአምጣነ፡, በከመ፡): ይትኔበይ፡ በሐሳበ፡ ሃይማኖት፡ κατὰ τὴν ἀναλογίαν τῆς πίστεως Rom. 12,6; በሐሳበ፡ መልበስቱ፡ κατὰ τὸν ῥυθμὸν τῆς ἐπωμίδος Ex. 28,15; በሐሳበ፡ ምሥዋዕከ፡ κατὰ τὴν θυσίαν Ex. 29,41; በሐሳበ፡ ሤጡ፡ κατὰ τὴν τιμὴν αὐτοῦ Lev. 27,17; Lev. 25,27; በከመ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ሐሳበ፡ መዋዕሊሁ፡ 2 Esr. 3,4; 4 Esr. 9,17; medicus ለለ፩ ዘሐመ፡ በሐሳበ፡ ሕማሙ፡ (pro ratione morbi) ይሁብ፡ ፈውሰ፡ hom. Severiani in Cyr. f. 122 አኮ፡ በአምጣነ፡ ጌጋይነ፡ ዘኮነነ፡ ሓሳበ፡ ጸጋሁ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ Rom. 5,15; በሐሳበ፡ seq. Subst. ratione habita rei Cyr. ad Theod. f. 19. 5 existimatio, dignitas, Lud. e Cant. Sam. 6 λογεῖον rationale voce ሐሰብ፡ versum legitur Ex. 28,15; Ex. 28,22. ḥassāb, Pl. ḥassābāt G ሐሳብ፡ ḥassāb, Pl. ሐሳባት፡ ḥassābāt «computation, calcul» ― ቍጥር፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 23r. 49 L ሐሳብ፡ ḥassāb account, accounting, reckoning, evaluation, calculation, computation, chronology, quantity, price, portion, proportion, share በሐሳበ ba-hāssāb-a + noun according to, in proportion to ሐሳበ፡ ከዋክብት ḥassāba kawākǝbt astrology ሐሳበ፡ ዘመን ḥassāba zaman calendar 245a C for ባሕረ፡ ሐሳብ፡ vid. ባሕር፡

woorden.betekenis: velare, obvolvere, sol lucem suam celavit, mentiri, promisso
woorden.definitie: I,1 1 velare, obvolvere [vic. כִּסָּה ܟܣܳܐ كَسَا] ወሐሰወቶ፡ ኵሎ፡ ንዋያ፡ καὶ περιεδίπλωσε πάντα τὰ ἀγγεῖα αὐτῆς Judith 10,5 (var. ወሖሰቶ፡); ፀሓይ፡ ብርሃኖ፡ ሐሰወ፡ sol lucem suam celavit Sx. Tachs. 14Enc. 2 mentiri [apud alias gentes hoc verbum sonat כִּזֵּב, כַּדֵּב ܟܰܕܶܒ, كَذَبَ; sed Arabes in uberrima sua lingua etiam خَاسَ (خَوْسٌ) promisso contrarie egit, decepit per fraudem; خَاسَ (خَيْسٌ) perfidia usus est, violavit pactum habent]. Stirpem I,1 semel tantum reperi: እንዘ፡ የሐስዉ፡ በእንቲአየ፡ Matth. 5,11 Platt et Polygl.; sed rom. ይሑስዉ፡ errore typographi pro ይሔስዉ፡ habet.

woorden.betekenis: mendacii convinci, falsum reperiri
woorden.definitie: III,2 pass. mendacii convinci, falsum reperiri: ኢተሐሰወ፡ ቃለ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ (ἐκεπέπτωκεν) Rom. 9,6; ተስፋከ፡ ዘኢይትሔሰው፡ Genz. f. 27; ወለእመ፡ ኮነ፡ ነገሩ፡ ከመዝ፡ ወኢይትሔሰው፡ Jsp. p. 363.

woorden.betekenis: mendacium, omnia Christianae doctrinae dogmata credo, lapill
woorden.definitie: subst. (de forma vid. gramm. § 106) m. et fem. (ut Job 16,8; Sir. 7,12) mendacium [amh. ሐሰት፡ et አሰት፡]: Jes. 28,15; Jes. 28,17; ኢትሕርስ፡ ሐሰተ፡ ላዕለ፡ ቢጽከ፡ Sir. 7,11; Sir. 7,12; Sir. 31,1; Sir. 31,4; ሐሰት፡ ውእቱ፡ አውግሪነ፡ Jer. 3,23; ኵሎሙ፡ ገብሩ፡ ሐሰተ፡ 6,13; ተወከልኪ፡ በሐሰት፡ 13,25; ሐሰተ፡ ትብል፡ ላዕለ፡ 47,16; ሐሰት፡ ኢይወጽእ፡ እምነ፡ አፉሁ፡ Judith 5,5; omnia Christianae doctrinae dogmata credo ወባሕቱ፡ ትንሣኤ፡ ሙታን፡ ሐሰተ፡ ይመስለኒ፡ Gad. T.H.; መንፈሰ፡ ሐሰት፡ 2 Par. 18,21; 2 Par. 18,22; ስምዐ፡ ሐሰት፡ Sir. 26,5; ሰማዕተ፡ ሐሰት፡ Matth. 26,60; ነገረ፡ ሐሰት፡ Sir. 36,24; Jer. 7,4; ውሉደ፡ ሐሰት፡ Jes. 30,9; ሀገረ፡ ሐሰት፡ Jer. 6,6; ነቢያተ፡ ሐሰት፡ Asc. Jes. 2,15; ከናፍረ፡ ሐሰት፡ Prov. 8,7; እብነ፡ ሐሰት፡ lapillus adulterinus Org.; በሐሰት፡ ἐπὶ ματαίῳ Ex. 20,7; በከ፡ ወሐሰት፡ ገብሩ፡ አበዊነ፡ ጣዖቶሙ፡ Jer. 16,19. De ሐሰት፡ mendacio tractatur F.M. 23. Dolus, fraus Jes. 53,9; 1 Petr. 2,22. ḥassat G ሐሰት፡ ḥassat «mensonge» ― አሰት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 23v. 49 L ሐሰት ḥassat lie, falsehood, error በሐሰት ba-ḥassat falsely 246a መሐለ፡ በሐሰት maḥala ba-ḥassat perjure oneself, swear falsely, vid. መሐለ 335b C a for ሰማዕተ፡ ሐሰት፡ vid. ሰማዒ፡ (Leslau) b for ዜና፡ ሐሰት፡ vid. ዜና፡ (Leslau)

woorden.betekenis: pullus caprini et ovilli pecoris, agnus, agna, capellus, cap
woorden.definitie: et መሐስዕ፡, subst., m. et fem. (ut Tob. 2,13; ዛቲ፡ ማሕስዕ፡), Pl. መሓስዕ፡ (sed sec. gramm. § 48,4 plerumque መሐስዕ፡), { Pl. Pl. መሓስዓት፡ Hen. 90,6 in Abb. LV} pullus caprini et ovilli pecoris, agnus (agna), capellus (capella), hoedus [Convenit גְּדִי, ܓܰܕܝܳܐ, גַדְיָא, جَدْيٌ hoedus, de quibus consulas Ges. in thes. p. 265; praeterea جَذَعٌ juvencus de brutis et hominibus, جَذْعَةٌ hoedus anniculus. Haec nomina traxisse videtur non a carpendo et avellendo pabulum, sed quia vel a matre vel a matris alimento avulsus (ablactatus) est]. Crebro species adjicitur, ut: ማሕስዐ፡ በግዕ፡ Gen. 31,38; መሓስዐ፡ አባግዕ፡ Ps. 113,4; Sir. 47,3; Jer. 27,45; ማሕስዐ፡ ጠሊ፡ 1 Reg. 16,20; Gen. 38,17; Kuf. 6; Kuf. 7; መሓስዐ፡ አጣሊ፡ Sir. 47,3; Cant. 1,8. In loco Ex. 12,5, ubi Graecus habet ἀπὸ τῶν ἀρνῶν καὶ τῶν ἐρίφων λήψεσθε, Aethiops simpliciter posuit: ተኅሥኡ፡ ማሕስዐ፡. Aliis in locis modo ἔριφος, ἐρίφιον Jer. 28,40; Tob. 2,12; Tob. 2,13; Am. 6,4; Gen. 27,9; Lev. 1,10 (opp. አባግዕ፡), modo ἀμνός, ἄρνες Lev. 3,7; Lev. 9,3; Lev. 14,21 hac voce ማሕስዕ፡ redduntur. De aetate pulli variis e locis apparet, non tantum anniculum (ማሕስዐ፡ ዓመት፡ Hez. 46,13) sed etiam lactentem (በመሥዋዕተ፡ መሐስዐ፡ በግዕ፡ ἐν προσφορᾷ ἀρνὸς γαλαθηνοῦ Sir. 46,16; መሐስዐ፡ በግዕ፡ ፩፡ ἄρνα γαλαθηνόν 1 Reg. 7,9) hoc nomine appellari. – Voc. Ae.: መሐስዕ፡ ዘ፡ የበግዕ፡ ገልገል፡; aliud: መሐስዕ፡ ዘ፡ ወጠጤ፡ māḥsǝʾ, maḥasǝʿ, ማሕስእ፡ māḥsǝʾ; Pl. maḥasǝʿ, መሓስእ፡ maḥāsǝʾ; Pl.Pl. maḥāsǝʿāt, መሓስዕት፡ maḥāsǝʿt G ማሕስእ፡ māḥsǝʾ, Pl. መሓስእ፡ maḥāsǝʾ «agneau, chevreau» ― ወጠጤ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 34v. 79 L ማሕስዕ māḥsǝʾ, መሐስዕ maḥasǝʿ (95), (Pl. መሓስዓት maḥāsǝʿāt, መሓስዕት maḥāsǝʿt), ማሕስእ māḥsǝʾ () suckling kid, lamb, young goat ማሕስዕ፡ ጠሊ māḥsǝʾ ṭali young kid, vid. ጠሊ፡ ማሕስዕ፡ በግዕ māḥsǝʾ baggǝʿ suckling lamb, calf, kid, vid. በግዕ፡ 337a

woorden.betekenis: modicum
woorden.definitie: modicum vid. sub ሐቀቀ፡

woorden.betekenis: plantas odoriferas, juniperus, pinus, cupressus, thya, ebenu
woorden.definitie: et ሕቁ፡ (Cant. 1,16; Cant. 1,17) subst. [sine dubio pro ሕቅው፡ vel ሕውቅ፡; nescio an vicinum sit حَبَقٌ plantas odoriferas varias significans] saepius in Bibliis legitur; respondet 1 ἄρκευθος juniperus: ዕፀወ፡ አርዝ፡ ወሕቍ፡ ξύλα κέδρινα καὶ ἀρκεύθινα 2 Par. 2,8 var. 2 πεύκη pinus: ዕፀወ፡ ሕቍ፡ πεύκινα 2 Par. 9,10; 2 Par. 9,11. 3 κυπάρισσος cupressus Cant. 1,16; Cant. 1,17. 4 θυΐα thya: ዕፀ፡ ሕቍ፡ ξύλον θύϊον Apoc. 18,12. – Voc. Ae.: ሕቍ፡ ዘ፡ ዞጲ፡ ( ebenum ); aliud: ሕቍ፡ ዘ፡ ሰኖባር፡ (صَنَوْبَرٌ) ወዓዲ፡ ዞጲ።

woorden.betekenis: ager, terra arboribus ac domibus nuda, bona, consita, arvum
woorden.definitie: subst. [ܚܰܩܠܳܐ חַקְלָא ager, حَقْلٌ terra arboribus ac domibus nuda, bona, consita, حَقْلَةٌ arvum bonum; hebr. הֵלֶק, de quo vid. Ges. thes. p. 484] plerumque m.; Pl. አሕቁል፡ et አሕቃል፡ et አሕቅልት፡, Pl. Pl. አሕቃላት፡ et አሕቁላት፡ 1 ager, campus („in genere, includesn silvas, montes caet., oppositus domibus seu oppidis“ Lud.) ἀγρός 2 Reg. 9,7; 2 Reg. 19,28; አሕቁል፡ ἀγροί Ex. 8,9 et አሕቅልት፡ Jos. 21,12; በሐቅል፡ ἐν ἀγρῷ Jer. 48,8; ኢትፃኡ፡ ሐቅለ፡ 6,25; ሐቅለ፡ ሞአብ፡ Ruth 1,1; Ruth 1,2; Ruth 2,6; መጽአ፡ ዔሳው፡ እምሐቅል፡ ርኂቦ፡ Kuf. 24; Kuf. 26; πεδίον Gen. 4,8; Jes. 63,14; Ps. 77,15; Hez. 26,8; (opp. montes) Judith 15,2; እለ፡ ይነብሩ፡ ሐቅለ፡ οἱ ἐν τῇ πεδεινῇ (opp. ዖመ፡) Jes. 32,19; እምአሕቃላት፡ ወእምአድባር፡ Jer. 17,26; አሕቃላት፡ πεδίον Ob. 19; Judith 1,6; አሕቃላተ፡ በድው፡ τὰ πεδία τῆς ἐρήμου Joel 2,22; አሕቅልት፡ πεδία Jos. 11,17; πεδινὴ 10,40; አሕቁል፡ Asc. Jes. 6,3. Praeterea አሕቃላት፡ περίχωρος Gen. 13,10; προμαχῶνες Jer. 5,10; አብያት፡ እለ፡ ይከውኑ፡ ለንጉሥ፡ በብሔረ፡ ሐቅል፡ ἐν τοῖς ἐποικίοις 1 Par. 27,25. Statui constructo subjunctum nomen ሐቅል፡ adj. agrestis denotare solet, ut ሐራውያ፡ ሐቅል፡, አርዌ፡ ሐቅል፡, ንዋየ፡ ሐቅል፡ q.v., ብእሴ፡ ሐቅል፡ ἄγροικος ἀνήρ Gen. 16,12; Gen. 25,27. – Deinde campus planus est: 2 loca vasta et deserta, eremus (sicut ገዳም፡): እለ፡ ይነብሩ፡ ሐቅለ፡ οἱ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ Jer. 9,26; Jer. 32,10; ἡ ἔρημος, αἱ ἔρημοι Hez. 23,42; Jes. 5,17; Sir. 8,16; ሐቅለ፡ ዮርዳኖስ፡ Jes. 35,2; ሐቅለ፡ ቃዋስ፡ Ps. 28,7; ሐቅለ፡ ዚፋ፡ 1 Reg. 26,2; ሐቅለ፡ ሲና፡ Num. 3,4; Kuf. 3,14; ሐቅል፡ ውእቱ፡ ዝብሔር፡ ἔρημος Marc. 6,35; ኮነ፡ ሐቅለ፡ ἔσονται ἔρημοι Jes. 17,9; ረሰያ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ዓለም፡ ሐቅለ፡ θεὶς ἔρημον Jes. 14,17; አሕጉረ፡ ሐቅል፡ πόλεις ἔρημοι Job 15,28; በሐቅል፡ ἐν ὁδῷ ἀπροςκόπῳ Sir. 35,21; ይበቍል፡ አሕቁሊሃ፡ τὰ ἔρημα αὐτῆς ἀνατελεῖ Jes. 44,26; Jes. 51,3; ማያተ፡ አሕቃላት፡ ὕδατα ἐρήμου Jer. 2,24; አሕቃል፡ ἔρημος Gen. 12,20; Joannes Baptista ኮከበ፡ አሕቁላት፡ ወገዳማት፡ Genz. f. 157. ḥaql, Pl. ʾaḥqul, ʾaḥqāl, ʾaḥqǝlt, ሐቅላት፡ ʾḥaqlāt, Pl.Pl. ʾaḥqālāt, ʾaḥqulāt G ሐቅል፡ ḥaql, Pl. ሐቅላት፡ ʾḥaqlāt, አሕቃል፡ ʾaḥqāl, አሕቃላት፡ ʾaḥqālāt, አሕቅልት፡ ʾaḥqǝlt, አሕቁል፡ ʾaḥqul «désert, bois, pays inhabité» ― ምድረ፡ በዳ፡, ዱር፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 23v. 50 L ሐቅል፡ ḥaql (Pl. አሕቃል፡ ʾaḥqāl, አሕቁል ʾaḥqul, አሕቅልት፡ ʾaḥqǝlt) plain, desert, wilderness, countryside, district 239b C for ንዋየ፡ ሐቅል፡ vid. ንዋይ፡

woorden.betekenis: qui ad agros pertinet, agrestis, rusticus, incultus, ḥaqqalā
woorden.definitie: adj. rel. qui ad agros pertinet, agrestis, rusticus, incultus, ዔሳው፡ ውእቱ፡ ብእሲ፡ ድሩክ፡ ወሐቃላዊ፡ ወጸጓር፡ et ብእሲ፡ ሐቃላዊ፡ ውእቱ፡ ወነዓዊ፡ Kuf. 19 (p. 71). ḥaqqalāwi, ሐቃላዊ፡ ḥaqqālāwi, ሐቃላዌ፡ ḥaqqālāwe, ሐቀላዌ፡ ḥaqqalāwe 1 warlike ወሶበ፡ ጸንዓ፡ ፀብእ፡ እስመ፡ ኃያል፡ ውእቱ፡ ወመስተቃትል፡ ዝኩ፡ ገብር፡ ሐቃላዊ፡ ተኀየለ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ኃያል፡ ወመዋኢ፡ Lorsque la bataille devint plus ardente, car ses esclaves révoltés étaient puissants et guerries, le roi puissant et victorieux prévalut 53 l. 20–22 (ed.), 62 l. 22–24 (tr.) 2 subst. rebel, ‘Rebell’ (see also the comment below) ወኮነ፡ ኃይለ፡ እምንእሱ፡ ወህዉከ፡ በኵሉ፡ ምግባሩ። ወእምብዝኀ፡ ተሀውኮቱ፡ ኮነ፡ ሐቃላዊ። ‘Er war stark von Jugend an und aufrüherisch in all seinem Tun. Sein allzu unruhiges Blut ließ ihn zum räubersischen Rebellen werden’ 5 l. 15–17 (ed.), 5 l. 25–27 (tr.); ወእምብዝኀ፡ ተሀውኮቱ፡ ኮነ፡ ሐቃላዌ። ‘Per la sua grande irrequietezza divenne un masnadiero’ 8 l. 7 (ed); 19 l. 6–7 (tr.) (‘ሐቀላዌ፡ dicesi di ribelli politici, che si dano alla campagna.’ 19 n. 2); ወሠራዊትሂ፡ እለ፡ ዝኩራን፡ ኮኑ፡ ጌዶራውያን፡ ወሐቃላውያን፡ ወተፀወኑ፡ ውስተ፡ ኅፅነ፡ ደብር፡ ልዑል፡ እምአድባረ፡ ኢፋት። ‘The soldiers who are also mentioned became robbers and rebels and they took shelter in a fortress of one of the highest mountains of ʾIfat’ 18 § 25 (ed.), 11 § 25 (tr.) (‘Ḥaqalāwi: Benennung für Esau; vgl. 96–97, bezeichnet somit einen wilden Gesellen, der in der Wildnis lebt; von dort ausgehend Rebell ‘šeftā’.) vgl. 635 n. 2.’ 5 n. 15) L ሐቃላዊ ḥāqqālāwi one of the filed, peasant, rustic, rude, (Lt) rebel 239b C for ዜና፡ ሐቃላውያን፡ vid. ዜና፡ (TraCES)

woorden.betekenis: complicuit manus, amplexus est, amplexus, circumdedit, ample
woorden.definitie: I,1 [amh. አቀፈ፡ hebr. חָבַק complicuit manus, amplexus est, vic. חוּק et חָמַק: syr. ܚܒܳܩܳܐ amplexus; arab. حاق med. u circumdedit, amplexus est, حاق med. i cinxit, circumdedit (vid. supra ሐቀወ፡), حَقَفَ pedibus et capite in unum contractis cubavit (animal), حَقَبٌ cingulum ] Subj. ይሕቀፍ፡ 1 complicare manus ሐቀፈ፡ እዴሁ፡ Koh. 4,5. 2 complicare, amplecti, amplexari: የማኑ፡ ተሐቅፈኒ፡ Cant. 2,6; ሐቀፎ፡ ወሰዐሞ፡ Gen. 29,13; ተሐቅፎ፡ ከመ፡ ብእሲት፡ ድንግል፡ Sir. 15,2; Sir. 30,20; Prov. 4,8; Esth. 5,2; ተሐቅፎ፡ ወታስተማውቆ፡ 3 Reg. 1,2; ሕቀፍዋ፡ Deg.; Ps. 47,11; ንሕቀፋ፡ Mavâs. 5; Kuf. p. 112; ሐቀፈ፡ ክሣዶ፡ Gen. 33,4; Gen. 45,14; Kuf. 43; Kuf. 45; Tob. 11,8; transl.: ለምሕልላነ፡ ሕቀፎ፡ Mus. Brit. LIV, 7, f. 3 incubare vel fovere ova, pullos, alis complecti pullos: ከመ፡ ዖፍ፡ እንተ፡ ተሐቅፍ፡ አንቆቅሆ፡ ወተሐፅን፡ እጐሊሃ፡ እስከ፡ ሶበ፡ ይሰርራ፡ Did. 6(Platt p. 41); ከመ፡ ንስር፡ የሐቅፍ፡ እጐሊሁ፡ በገበዋቲሁ፡ Deut. 32,11; ሐቂፎ፡ እጐሊሁ፡ Job 39,27.

woorden.betekenis: amplexum teneri
woorden.definitie: III,1 amplexum teneri: Christus infans ተሐቅፈ፡ በአብራከ፡ እሙ፡ Athan. de Trin.; ተሐቅፈ፡ በአብራክ፡ M.M. f. 25.

woorden.betekenis: audere
woorden.definitie: , ተሐበለ፡ audere, vid. sub ኀበለ፡

woorden.betekenis: dolus, fraus, pravitas, perversitas, improbitas, ḥǝbl, ḥǝbal
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem. (ut Sap. 4,11; Ps. 49,20) 1 dolus, fraus, δόλος, δόλοι: Prov. 12,5; Prov. 12,17; Prov. 12,20 (ጕሕሉት፡ Prov. 12,6); Prov. 26,23; Ps. 51,2; Sap. 4,11; Sap. 14,25; 1 Petr. 2,1; መጽአ፡ እኁከ፡ በሕብል፡ Kuf. 26; ልሳንከ፡ ፀፈራ፡ ለሕብል፡ Ps. 49,20 (δολιότης); በሕብል፡ δόλῳ Matth. 26,4 Platt. 2 pravitas, perversitas, improbitas: ዘይዘርእ፡ ሕብለ፡ φαῦλα Prov. 22,8; ἀσέβειαι Ps. 5,12. – Hinc formas ሐብል፡ et ሕብል፡ significatione secerni solere apparet; quare quod Matth. 26,4 rom. legitur በሐብል፡ δόλῳ, typographi errore pro በሕብል፡ exscriptum esse videtur. ḥǝbl, Pl. ሕበል፡ ḥǝbal G ሕብል፡, Pl. ሕበል፡ ḥǝbal «tromperie, ruse» ― ተንኰል፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 24v. 51 C vid. also ሐብል፡

woorden.betekenis: conjungi, consentire
woorden.definitie: conjungi, consentire vid. sub ኀበረ፡

woorden.betekenis: color, colores, versicolor, colore splendoris induti, infect
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. ሕበር፡ et ሕብራት፡ 1 color: ሕብሩ፡ እሳተ፡ ይመስል፡ 4 Esr. 14,41; ዘዘ፡ ዚአሁ፡ ሕብረ፡ ጽጌሁ፡ 4,49; Sap. 13,14; Sap. 15,4; ሕብራት፡ colores Chrys. ho. 12; ሕብራት፡ ቀይሓት፡ Fal. f. 16; ሕብራቲሆሙ፡ ይመስል፡ መረግደ፡ Mavâs. 20; ጥበብ፡ እንተ፡ ብዙኅ፡ ሕበሪሃ፡ πολυποίκιλος Eph. 3,10; de colore cutis ሕብረ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ Ex. 4,7; ይገብእ፡ ሕብረ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ 4 Reg. 5,10; ሕብረ፡ ማእሱ፡ Lev. 13,2; Lev. 13,3; Lev. 13,10; ሕብረ፡ ገጹ፡ Ex. 34,29; Ex. 34,30; ሕብር፡ ዘዳኅን፡ Lev. 13,14-16; ሕብረ፡ ለምጽ፡ ἁφὴ λεπρᾶς Lev. 13,2; Lev. 13,3; Lev. 13,9 seq.; ዘሕብረ፡ ሐመድ፡ σποδοειδής Gen. 30,39; Gen. 31,10; Gen. 31,12; ዘሕብረ፡ ዐሥቅ፡ ποικίλος versicolor Gen. 37,3; ሕብረ፡ ሜላት፡ ወሕብረ፡ ለይ፡ 2 Par. 2,7; እብን፡ ዘሕብረ፡ ወርቅ፡ χρυσόλιθος Ex. 28,20; Ex. 36,20; ሕብረ፡ ከብድ፡ vid. sub ከብድ፡; ሕብረ፡ ጸዳል፡ ልቡሳን፡ colore splendoris induti Enc.; በዓለ፡ ሕብር፡ infector F.N. 32. 2 varietas colorum. Quamquam enim varietas colorum nec non Adj. versicolor adjecto ብዙኅ፡ vel ዘዘዚአሁ፡ (vid. sub Nr. 1exempla, vel ዘዘዚአሁ፡ ሕብሩ፡ ποικίλως διηνθισμέναι Esth. 1,6) vel adjecto በበ፡ ut: እብን፡ ክቡራት፡ በበሕበሪሆሙ፡ πολυτελεῖς ποικίλοι 1 Par. 29,2; vel, ubi de vestibus agitur, adjecto ዘዐሥቅ፡ (vid. sub. Nr. 1exemplum) significatur, tamen ሕብር፡ et ሕበር፡ per se positum nonnumquam eandem significationem continet, ut: እብነ፡ ሕብር፡ gemma coloris i.e. versicolor Hen. 18,7; ትወድዩ፡ ላዕሌክሙ፡ ሕብረ፡ ፈድፋደ፡ እምድንግል፡ 98,2; ጥምዐተ፡ ሕበሪሁ፡ βάμματα ποικιλίας Jud. 5,30; የኀድግኑ፡ ነምር፡ ሕበሪሁ፡ τὰ ποικίλματα αὐτῆς maculas חֲבַרְבֻּרוֹת Jer. 13,23; ዘሕብር፡ τὰ ποικίλα Gen. 31,8; ዘሕብር፡ ፍጥረቱ፡ ἔργον ποικιλτοῦ Ex. 28,35 (at Hen. 89,10 ad ኅብር፡ referendum est); እምኵሉ፡ ሕብር፡ varia διάφορα Deut. 22,9. 3 in genere species (esterna), forma εἶδος Ex. 28,29; ὅρασις Apoc. 4,3; ዘሕብረ፡ በረድ፡ ὡς ὅρασις κρυστάλλου Hez. 1,22; ሕሊናየ፡ ወሕብርየ፡ ἡ μορφή μου Dan. 4,33; ኀበ፡ ሕብረ፡ ከይሲ፡ ወለጠ፡ ዘዓሣ፡ ራእየ፡ Enc. ḥǝbr, Pl. ḥǝbar, ḥǝbrāt G ሕብር፡ ḥǝbr, Pl. ሕበር፡ ḥǝbar «couleur, figure, espèce, apparence» ― ቀለም፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 24v. ዘዘሕብር፡ zazzaḥǝbr «de diverses couleurs» ይመጽኡ፡ ኀቤሆሙ፡ ምስለ፡ ኃጢአቶሙ፡ ዘዘኅብር። Hawi Ms. BNFet110, fol. 28rc. 51 ዘዘሕብር፡ zazzaḥǝbr chamarré de toutes les couleurs. Renforce, sous l’action des particlues distributives vid. ዘዘ፡, le sens de ሕብር፡ seul mentionné par . 448 ሕብረ፡ ሰማይ፡ ḥǝbra samāy «sulfate de cuivre» Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 24v, vid. ሰማይ፡ 51 L ሕብር ḥǝbr, (Pl. ሕበር፡ ḥǝbar, ሕብራት፡ ḥǝbrāt) color, ink, complexion, beauty, appearance, kind, spot, scurf (which turn the skin white), skin rash ሕብረ፡ ሐመድ ḥǝbra ḥamad ash-colored, vid. ሐመድ፡ ሕብረ፡ ዐስቅ ḥǝbra ʿasq of diverse colors, vid. ዐስቅ፡ ሕብረ፡ ከብድ ḥǝbra kabd purple, vid. ከብድ፡ ሕብረ፡ ሲራ ḥǝbra sirā (Lt) chess so called because of the colored pawns, vid. ሲራ፡ ሕብረ፡ ሰማይ ḥǝbra samāy (*) vitriol blue, vid. ሰማይ፡ ሕብረ፡ መጽርይ ḥǝbra maṣrǝy () rose, vid. መጽርይ፡ ዘሕብር zaḥǝbr speckled ዘዘሕብር zazzaḥǝbr (51) of diverse colors, multicolored 224b

woorden.betekenis: tutelam, curam, administrationem, suscipere, presbyteros non
woorden.definitie: III,1 et ተሐበየ፡ III,2 refl. 1 tutelam, curam, administrationem rei vel personae suscipere: ዘይትሐበዩ፡ ἡ φυλακὴ αὐτῶν Num. 3,25; Num. 3,31; ክርስቶስ፡ ዘዲበ፡ ኪሩቤል፡ ይነብር፡ ወኵሉ፡ ዓለም፡ ዘይትሐበይ፡ Mavâs. 28; presbyteros non decet ይመግቡ፡ ወኢይትሐበዩ፡ praefecturam aut procurationem suscipere (rerum alienarum) Lud. e Synodo. 2 vadem, praedem, obsidem, sponsorem se dare pro aliquo, fidejubere, c. Acc. pers.: አነ፡ እትሐበዮ፡ ἐγὼ ἐκδέχομαι αὐτόν gen. 43,9; ገብርከ፡ ተሐበዮ፡ ለዝ፡ ሕፃን፡ እምኀበ፡ አቡሁ፡ servus tuus hunc puerum, fide interposita, a patre tuendum accepit Gen. 44,32; Kuf. 43; እመ፡ ተሐበይኮ፡ ለዐርክከ፡ ἐὰν ἐγγυήσῃ σὸν φίλον Prov. 6,1; Prov. 6,3; ዘይትሐበይ፡ ወልደ፡ አብደ፡ Prov. 19,28; ኢትትሀበዮ፡ ለዘይጸንዐከ፡ Sir. 8,13; ብእሲ፡ ኄር፡ ይትሔበዮ፡ ለዐርኩ፡ Sir. 29,14; Sir. 29,15; episcopus ኢይትሔበይ፡ መነሂ፡ Did. 4; c. Acc. rei et ለ pers.: ዘይትሐበይ፡ ሕቢተ፡ ለዐርኩ፡ Prov. 17,18; absol. ተሐብዮ፡ et ተሐብዮት፡ fidejussio F.N. 27; ሠናይ፡ ተሐብዮ፡ Sir. 29,16; ብዙኃነ፡ ኄራነ፡ አሕመሞሙ፡ ተሐብዮ፡ 29,18; seq. ከመ፡, ut ተሐበየኒ፡ እንተ፡ ከመ፡ ኢያብጥል፡ ሕጎሙ፡ fide tua interposita promitte (illis), me sacra eorum non abrogaturum esse Jsp. p. 307. Hinc 3 aut a fidem habere alicui: መኑ፡ ዘይትሐበዮ፡ ለሰራቂ፡ τίς πιστεύσει λῃστῇ Sir. 36,31; ተሀበይኒ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይወጽእ፡ እኩይ፡ እምኔየ፡ Kuf. p. 129. b promittere et spondere, polliceri: ተሐበየ፡ ሎቱ፡ (sicario) ብዙኀ፡ ንዋየ፡ Jsp. p. 334; seq. ከመ፡, ut: ተሐበየ፡ ሎቱ፡ ከመ፡ ዮናናውያን፡ ኢይትመየጡ፡ ዳግመ፡ Jsp. p. 294. 4 Ubi de baptismo agitur, est: baptismo sponsorem (vel testem) interesse: ዘይትሐበዮ፡ baptismi ejus sponsor Const. Ap. 34(vid. ተወከፈ፡); F.N. 24,2. taḥabaya, ተሐበየ፡ taḥabbaya G ተሐበየ፡ taḥabaya III,1 ይትሐበይ፡ «être caution, administrer avec responsabilité, être parrain» ― ተዋሰ፡, ዋስ፡ ሆነ፡; የክርስትና፡ አባት፡ ሆነ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 25r. 51–52 L ተሐበየ taḥabaya, taḥabbaya have charge of, take care of, oversee, administer, assume the position of administrator and surety, sponsor, become surety, pledge oneself, stand as guarantor, vouch for, be a god parent ዘተሐበየ zataḥabaya godchild 225a

woorden.betekenis: nomen literae alphabeti hebraici octavae, Ps. 118,
woorden.definitie: nomen literae alphabeti hebraici octavae, Ps. 118,57; Thren. 1,8; Thren. 2,8; Thren. 3,22; Thren. 4,8. – Ubi de psalmis agitur, siglo ሔት፡ Ps. 118,57–64 notatur.

woorden.betekenis: fractus est, contritus est, juste, recte, accurate fecit, de
woorden.definitie: I,1 [חָתַת fractus est, contritus est, sed ܚܰܬܶܬ juste, recte, accurate fecit, definivit, comprobavit. A conterendo significatio transfertur ad minutatim interrogare, minutius scrutari; cfr. ጥቀ፡, ጠንቀቀ፡. Quod alii proposuerunt mutatis sibilantibus et mutis ሐተተ፡ ad ኀሠሠ፡ referendum, haud probabile videtur] Subj. ይሕትት፡ 1 scrutari, perscutari, explorare, investigare c. Acc.: ἐξιχνιάζειν ሕትቶሙ፡ ለአበው፡ Job 8,8; ከመ፡ ትሕትት፡ ኀጢአትየ፡ Job 10,6; Job 13,9; ἐξετάζειν ኢትሕትት፡ ዘኢይትከሀለከ፡ Sir. 3,21; ኢትሒስ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ትሕትት፡ 11,7; የሐተከ፡ 13,11; የሐትት፡ ምግባሪክሙ፡ Sap. 6,4; Ps. 10,6; ἐρευνᾶν {DiL ἐρευνᾷν}, ἐξερευνᾶν {DiL ἐξερευνᾷν} ኢትሕትቱኒ፡ ዘእገብር፡ Judith 8,34; ውእቱ፡ የሐትቶ፡ ለልብነ፡ Rom. 8,27; ኀሠሡ፡ ወሐተቱ፡ Jud. 6,29; Thren. 3,39 var.; ἐρωτᾶν {DiL ἐρωτᾷν} እስከ፡ ጽዮን፡ የሐትቱ፡ ፍኖቶ፡ Jer. 27,5; አስማቲሆሙ፡ ሐተትናሆሙ፡ 2 Esr. 5,9; ሐቲተ፡ ሕትዎ፡ 2 Reg. 20,18; የሐትት፡ ሕሊና፡ እንዘ፡ ኢይሴአል፡ Lit. Epiph.; c. በእንተ፡ rei: ያነብብ፡ መጻሕፍተ፡ ወየሐትት፡ በእንተ፡ ትርጓሜ፡ ቃላቲሆሙ፡ Sx. Hed. 3; ሐተቱ፡ በእንቲአሁ፡ exploraverunt (populum) de eo Sx. Teq. 2 examinare, inquirere, in spec. (vox forensis) cognoscere, interrogare, ad cognitionem vocare, c.c. Acc. pers. vel rei vel c. dupl. Acc.: ርእሰክሙ፡ ሕትቱ፡ ἑαυτοὺς πειράζετε 2 Cor. 13,5; Lit. 173,2; እግዚአብሔር፡ የሐትቶሙ፡ (ἔτασις) Job 12,6; መኑ፡ ዘየሐትቶ፡ ምግባሮ፡ τίς ἐστιν ὁ ἐξετάζων αὐτοῦ τὰ ἔργα 36,23; Sap. 1,9; ἐξήτασεν τοὺς εὐνούχους Esth. apocr. 1; Esth. 2,23; ሐተትዋ፡ (ἐπηρώτησαν) Judith 10,12; Marc. 14,60; Marc. 15,4 (ἐπερωτᾶν {DiL ἐπερωτᾷν}); ዘእንበለ፡ ትሕትቱ፡ ወትጠይቁ፡ Dan. apocr. 1,48; Dan. apocr. 1,51 (ἀνακρίνειν); 1 Cor. 4,4; 1 Cor. 4,5; Rom. 2,16 (κρίνειν); πυνθάνεσθαι Act. 4,7; c. dupl. Acc. Jsp. p. 272; ይሕትቱ፡ ትዕይንት፡ ማእከለ፡ ቀታሊ፡ ወማእከለ፡ አበ፡ ደም፡ Num. 35,24 (κρίνειν); Deut. 13,15; Deut. 17,4; λόγον τινὸς ποιεῖν Job 14,3. 3 causa cognita adjudicare alicui aliquid: የሐትትዎ፡ ሎቱ፡ ቤተ፡ (sed. var. ያሐትትዎ፡) Lev. 25,30. – Voc. Ae.: ሐተተ፡ ዘ፡ መረመረመ።

woorden.betekenis: se, sibi examinare, examinari, cognosci, interrogari
woorden.definitie: III,1 refl. et pass. se vel sibi examinare, examinari; (vox forensis) cognosci, interrogari: ዘእንበለ፡ ትትኰነን፡ ተሐተት፡ πρὸ κρίσεως ἐξέταζε σεαυτόν Sir. 18,20; Herm. p. 89; ሀለወነ፡ ኵልነ፡ ንትሐተት፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Rom. 14,12; ትትሐተት፡ በእንተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘገበርከ፡ Macc. f. 4; እስከ፡ ይትሐተት፡ Num. 35,12; Jos. 20,6; Jos. 20,9; 1 Cor. 2,14.

woorden.betekenis: exploratio, examen, cognitio, inquisitio
woorden.definitie: subst. exploratio, examen, in spec. cognitio, inquisitio (forensis): ሐተታሆሙ፡ ἐξετασμός Prov. 1,32; ἔρευνα Sap. 6,9; ጽኑዐ፡ ሐተታ፡ የሐትትዎሙ፡ δυνατῶς ἐτασθήσονται Sap. 6,7; አመ፡ ዕለተ፡ ሐተታ፡ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ διαγνώσεως Sap. 3,18; ሐተታ፡ በእንተ፡ (ἐπισκοπή) Sap. 14,11; አመ፡ ገብረ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ሐተታየ፡ ἐὰν ἔτασίν μου ποιῆται ὁ κύριος Job 14,3; Hen. 60,6; ሐቲቶሙ፡ ሐተታ፡ ጽኑዐ፡ F.M. 23,6; ሐተታ፡ ጽኑዕ፡ eorum, qui sacerdoti peccata confitentur, Kedr f. 68; eorum qui ad ordinem monachorum aspirant, Kedr f. 79.

woorden.betekenis: testimonium, testis, testes, literae testimonii mei
woorden.definitie: subst., m., (id quod et is qui interrogatur a judice, i.e.) testimonium et plerumque testis (scil. qui profitetur coram judice; vox generalior est ስምዕ፡ et ሰማዕት፡) et coll. testes: መጽሐፈ፡ ማሕተትየ፡ ዝኩ፡ ኅቱም፡ literae testimonii mei (τὸ βιβλίον τῆς κτήσεως) Jer. 39,11; Jer. 39,12; Jer. 39,16; ማሕተቶሙ፡ ለኃጥኣን፡ ሞት፡ μαρτύριον ἀσεβοῦς θάνατος Job 15,34; ከናፍሪከ፡ ማሕተትከ፡ τὰ χείλη σου καταμαρτυρήσουσί σου 15,6; ስምዕ፡ አሐዱ፡ ኢይከውን፡ ማሕተተ፡ (testis idoneus) ለአቅትሎ፡ መንፈስ፡ Num. 35,30; አነ፡ ማሕተቶሙ፡ ከመ፡ Rom. 10,2; ዘኢዘለፍዎ፡ ማሕተት፡ በገጽ፡ testes, Act. 25,16.

woorden.betekenis: elevavit rem, extulit, res elata; tumor in corpore., umbilic
woorden.definitie: subst. [fortasse e radice نَبَرَ elevavit rem, extulit, unde etiam نَبْرَةٌ res elata; tumor in corpore. ] 1 umbilicus (amh. እንብርት፡) ὀμφαλός Cant. 7,3; ሰላም፡ ለሕንብርትኪ፡ ምስለ፡ ፍሑቅ፡ ማዕከክ፡ I Sal. Mar. str. 29; ሕንብርተ፡ ከርሡ፡ ὀμφαλὸς γαστρός Job 40,11; trasl. ሕንብርተ፡ ምድር፡ Jud. 9,37; Hez. 38,12; Kuf. 8. 2 inguina: ኅቡረ፡ ወፃእነ፡ እምሕንብርትኪ፡ Kuf. 35(p. 128); ከርሲስ፡, quando quieti se dabat, sinistram ላዕለ፡ ሕንብርቱ፡ dextram ላዕለ፡ አፉሁ፡ imponere et dicere solebat: ይደልዎ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ይዕቀብ፡ ልሳኖ፡ ወእስኪቶ፡ Fal. f. 12.

woorden.betekenis: angere
woorden.definitie: inus., sine dubio angere [ut חָנַח, חָנַךְ, חָנַק, vid. 497; 498]; vicinum est ኀነቀ፡, ንህከ፡, ንእከ፡ q.v.

woorden.betekenis: porcus, aper, aliud
woorden.definitie: vel ሕንዚር፡ [i.q. חֲזִיר, ܚܙܺܝܪܳܐ, خِنْزِيرٌ] { Pl. ሐናዚር፡ Hen. 89,19 in Cod. Abb. LV} porcus, aper Hen. 89,10. – Voc. Ae.: ሕንዚር፡ ዘ፡ አነር፡ ዢራትሂ፡ ይ፡ ( aliud, in libro Henoch gentem Amalec intelligendam esse, annotatum habet).

woorden.betekenis: firmus, munitusque fuit, firmavit, muro cinxit, aedificare,
woorden.definitie: I,1 [amh. ሐነጸ፡ et አነጸ፡; etymo convenire videtur cum حَصُنَ firmus, munitusque fuit, II firmavit, muro cinxit, (transpositis literis ነ et ጸ); vic. ሐጸረ፡ et ቈጸረ፡] Subj. ይሕንጽ፡ 1 a aedificare, exstruere, condere: ዘየሐንጽ፡ ቤቶ፡ በንዋየ፡ ልቃሕ፡ Sir. 21,8; ሕንጹ፡ አብያተ፡ Jer. 36,5; Jer. 42,7; ሐኒጸ፡ ሀገር፡ Kuf. 10; Kuf. 11; ሐነጸ፡ ምሥዋዐ፡ Kuf. 31; Ex. 24,4; ንሕንጽ፡ በእብን፡ Jes. 9,10; Prov. 9,1; Koh. 2,4; Koh. 3,3; Sir. 49,7; Jes. 5,2; 3 Reg. 5,5; Hez. 21,22; Hez. 27,5. b superstruere, inaedificare vel obstruere locum aedificio, muro: ኢትሕንጽ፡ ዘንተ፡ መካነ፡ Kuf. 32; ሐነጸ፡ ወዐጸወ፡ ፍኖትየ፡ Thren. 3,9. c restituere, reparare (domum, urbem vastatam): ከመ፡ ይሕንጹ፡ መዝበራ፡ ለጽዮን፡ 2 Esr. 9,9; 4 Reg. 21,3; Job 12,13. d superaedificare Judae 20. 2 domum alicui aedificare c. Acc. pers.: ከመ፡ እሕንጾሙ፡ Jer. 38,28; Jer. 40,7; Jer. 49,10; c. Acc. prolis: ከመ፡ ይሕንጽ፡ ለከ፡ ዘርአ፡ እምኔሃ፡ Kuf. 14; Ruth 4,11. 3 struere, statuere, stabilire: ወሐነጸ፡ ሥጋ፡ ህየንቴሃ፡ Kuf. 3; ለዓለም፡ አሐንጽ፡ ምሕረተ፡ Ps. 88,3; ሐነጸ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ማኅበር፡ regulam conventus statuit (Pachomius) Sx. Masc. 24Enc.; ዐስቦሙ፡ በሰማይ፡ ሐነጹ፡ mercedem suam in coelo stabilierunt Enc.

woorden.betekenis: aedificari jubere, exstruendum, condendum curare, Herodes
woorden.definitie: II,1 aedificari jubere, exstruendum vel condendum curare: Ex. 17,15; 2 Par. 2,3; a Par. 2,5; 2 Par. 6,8; 2 Par. 11,5; 2 Par. 11,6; 2 Par. 16,6; ኵሉ፡ ምኵራበ፡ ጣዖት፡ ዘአሕነጸ፡ አንትያኮስ፡ Jsp. p. 294; Herodes አሕነጸ፡ ውስተ፡ ቤተ፡ መቅደስ፡ ሕንጻ፡ ሠናየ፡ Jsp. p. 328.

woorden.betekenis: aedificari, exstrui, condi, inaedificari, obstrui, restitui,
woorden.definitie: III,1 pass. et refl. 1 a aedificari, exstrui, condi Jes. 10,9; Hez. 11,3; 3 Reg. 6,11; Tob. 1,4; 2 Esr. 4,16; 3 Esr. 16,1; 4 Esr. 9,27; Job 6,10; Joh. 2,20; Kuf. 4; Kuf. 49. b inaedificari, obstrui ተሐንጸ፡ ዐውድየ፡ κύκλῳ περιῳκοδόμημαι Job 19,8. c restitui, instaurari Jes. 44,26; Jes. 44,28; Jes. 58,12; Dan. 9,25; Hez. 26,14. d de hominibus: superaedificari: ተሐነጽክሙ፡ ዲበ፡ መሠረተ፡ ሐዋርያት፡ Eph. 2,20. Col. 2,7. 2 statui, stabiliri, confirmari: ለክሙ፡ ተሠርዐ፡ ወተሐንጸ፡ ትፍሥሕት፡ 4 Esr. 8,62; ሰላም፡ በዘይትሐነጽ፡ ቢጽነ፡ Rom. 14,19; recipr. 1 Thess. 5,11 rom.

woorden.betekenis: aedificatio, aedificium
woorden.definitie: subst. aedificatio, aedificium: ሕንጸ፡ (v. ሕንጻ፡) ጥቅም፡ Jes. 59,12; ኵሉ፡ ሕንጻ፡ Hen. 91,5.

woorden.betekenis: aedificatio, structura, aedificium, aedificia
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. ሕንጻት፡ 1 aedificatio 1 Esr. 4,51; አፅርዕዎሙ፡ ሕንጻ፡ 2 Esr. 4,4; ተፀርዐ፡ ሕንጻ፡ (v. ሕንጸት፡) 4,24. 2 structura, aedificium Hez. 40,5; Hez. 42,5 vers. nov.; ውሉድ፡ ወሕንጻ፡ ሀገር፡ ያዐብዩ፡ ስመ፡ Sir. 40,19; ከመ፡ ንድቀ፡ ክረምት፡ ሕንጻሁ፡ Sir. 21,8; ሕንጻሁ፡ ለምኵራብ፡ Matth. 24,1; Herm. p. 78 seq.; አኮ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ዛቲ፡ ሕንጻ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ 1 Par. 29,1; ሕንጻት፡ aedificia Chrys. Ta. 32; አንትሙ፡ ሕንጻ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አንትሙ፡ 1 Cor. 3,9; Eph. 2,21. – Notandum est, pro ሕንጻ፡ etiam formam ሕንጼ፡ reperiri ut in Gad. Za Mich., potissimum ante pron. suffixa, ut አመ፡ ሕንጼሃ፡ ለኢየሩሳሌም፡ Deg. pluries; Sx. Hed. 26.

woorden.betekenis: mus
woorden.definitie: mus vid. አንጸዋ፡

woorden.betekenis: scabit, fricuit, scabere, fricare, scalpere, scabere, scalpe
woorden.definitie: I,1 [حَكَّ scabit, fricuit rem; chald. חֲכַךְ scabere, fricare, scalpere] Subj. ይሕክክ፡ 1 transit. scabere, scalpere, fricare: ነሥአ፡ ገልዐ፡ ወአኀዘ፡ ይሕክክ፡ ቍስሎ፡ Job 2,8; ኀለቁ፡ እንዘ፡ አሐክክ፡ ጸውበ፡ ወእንጳንጴ፡ ወሐመደ፡ ኮንኩ፡ 7,5. 2 intransit. prurire, formicare: ዘሐከከ፡ አባሉ፡ M.F. ḥakaka G ሐከከ፡ ḥakaka I,1 የሐክክ፡, ይሕክክ፡ «démanger, avoir la gale» ― አከከ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 26v. 54 L ሐከከ ḥakaka (yǝḥkǝk) itch, scratch, rub, scrape, have an itch, (, ) be cut into, be notched 228b

woorden.betekenis: tumultus
woorden.definitie: tumultus vid. sub ሀከከ፡

woorden.betekenis: columna, cippus, lapis quivis, monumentum, ḥawǝlt, ḥawalt, ḥ
woorden.definitie: (nonnumquam ሐወልት፡) subst., plerumque fem. (Plur. ሐውላት፡ Job 41,21 var.), proprie: lapis teres, deinde columna, cippus, lapis quivis in memoriam alicujus erectus vel positus, monumentum (differt ab ዐምድ፡) στήλη Gen. 28,18; Gen. 31,13; Gen. 31,45; Gen. 31,48; Gen. 35,20; Kuf. 27; Kuf. 31; Kuf. 32; ሐውልተ፡ እብን፡ Lev. 26,1; ሐውልተ፡ ጼው፡ Gen. 19,26; Sap. 10,5; አቀሙ፡ ሐውልተ፡ እብን፡ ዐቢይ፡ σωρὸν λίθων ἐστήλωσαν 2 Reg. 18,17; ምስካቡ፡ ሐውልት፡ (v. ሐውላት፡) ዐበይት፡ ἡ στρώμνη αὐτοῦ ὀβελίσκοι ὀξεῖς Job 41,21. – Voc. Ae.: ሐውልት፡ ብ፡ ትክል፡ ደንጋይ። ḥawǝlt, ḥawalt, Pl. ḥawlāt, አሕዋልት፡ ʾaḥwālt G ሐውልት፡ ḥawǝlt, Pl. አሕዋልት፡ ʾaḥwālt «pierre dressée, pyramide, obélisque, colonne» ― ትክል፡, ድንጋይ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 26v. 56 L ሐውልት፡ ḥawǝlt (Pl. ሐውላት፡ ḥawlāt, አሕዋላት፡ ʾaḥwālāt) column, pillar, stele, obelisk, pyramid, (Lt) calendar 249a

woorden.betekenis: profectus fuit, redire, ire, incedere, vadere, proficisci, p
woorden.definitie: I,1 [i.q. سَارَ profectus fuit, vid. §39.b; حَارَ (حَوْرٌ) significat redire] Subj. (potissimum in libris antiquioribus) ይሖር፡ et (in recentioribus plerumque) ይሑር፡ (vid. gramm. p. 147), verbum usu tritissimum 1 ire, incedere, vadere, proficisci: በእንግድዓኪ፡ ሑሪ፡ Gen. 3,13; ዘየሐውር፡ በአርባዕ፡, በእደዊሁ፡ Lev. 11,20; Lev. 11,27; Lev. 11,42; ይንበር፡ ግሙራ፡ ወእምአመ፡ ኮነ፡ ኢሖረ፡ Act. 14,8; የሐውር፡ መልዕልተ፡ ባሕር፡ ከመ፡ ዲበ፡ ምድር፡ (περιπατεῖν) Job 9,8; Koh. 11,9; መኑ፡ ዘየሐውር፡ ዲበ፡ አፍሓመ፡ እሳት፡ Prov. 6,28; ጼናሁ፡ የሐውር፡ ወይበጽሕ፡ ነዊሐ፡ Hen. 32,4; πορεύεσθαι Jes. 18,2; Jes. 52,12; Gen. 11,31; Gen. 12,4; 3 Reg. 22,6 al. a c.c. Acc. loci, qui petitur: Koh. 7,2; Jes. 22,15; Dan. apocr. 13,10; Jer. 33,21; Zach. 6,8; Tob. 9,2; ቤተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ነሐውር፡ Ps. 121,1; Gen. 12,5; Gen. 29,1; ሖረ፡ ርኁቀ፡ ብሔረ፡ Prov. 7,19; c. Acc. loci, qui peragratur et viae, qua itur: የሐውር፡ ዐውደ፡ ሰማይ፡ (διαπορεύεσθαι) Job 22,14; Job 16,22; Jes. 11,15; Jes. 44,3; Hez. 33,28; Num. 1,19; ኢትሖር፡ ፍኖተ፡ በዳ፡ Sir. 35,20; የሐውር፡ እገሪሆሙ፡ ፍኖተ፡ ሰላም፡ Jes. 41,3; Jer. 6,25; Kuf. 16. b c. praepositionibus variis, ut በ vel ውስተ፡ viae { 1 Reg. 3,22}. 1 Reg. 8,5; ተሐውር፡ ውስተ፡ ፍኖት፡ 1 Reg. 28,22 al.; ኀበ፡ vel ውስተ፡ pers. vel loci petiti: Lev. 14,2; Lev. 14,4; Matth. 26,18; 4 Esr. 10,24; እምእኪት፡ ኀበ፡ እኪት፡ የሐውሩ፡ Jer. 9,3; የሐውር፡ ውስተ፡ ተውኔት፡ ወዘፈን፡ Clem. f. 127; ሖሩ፡ ውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዓለም፡ Marc. 16,15; 4 Reg. 7,4; c. ቅድመ፡ praeire, praegredi: የሐውር፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ፍጽመ፡ ቅድሜክሙ፡ Jes. 52,12; Ex. 14,15. 2 in specie: a abire, discedere: በከመ፡ መጽኡ፡ ከማሁ፡ ሖሩ፡ 4 Esr. 10,18; Matth. 26,46; Jac. 2,16; ሑር፡ እምኔነ፡ Gen. 26,16; c. እምኀበ፡ Kuf. 24; ሖር፡ βάδιζε, βάδισον Am. 7,12; Jer. 13,1; Jer. 19,1; Jer. 22,5. b egredi, proficisci in bellum: እለ፡ ሖሩ፡ ፀብአ፡ Num. 31,42; ሖሩ፡ ለፀብእ፡ vel ውስተ፡ ፀብእ፡ 1 Reg. 17,13. c ሖረ፡ ፍኖተ፡ iter facere, peregrinari, ut: ዘኮነ፡ በሐዊረ፡ ፍኖት፡ F.M. 32,1; vel navigare, ubi de itinere maritimo agitur: πλεῖν Chrys. Ta. 34(vid. ህድአት፡). d usurpatur de rebus inanimatis, ut de aqua Jes. 8,6; fluviis ሖሩ፡ አፍላግ፡ ውስተ፡ በድው፡ Ps. 104,39, terminis Kuf. 8; Kuf. 9. 3 metaph. ambulare i.e. vitae rationem aliquam sequi: ዘኢሖረ፡ በምክረ፡ ረሲዓን፡ Ps. 1,1; Ps. 25,11; ዘየሐውር፡ በጽድቅ፡ Jes. 33,15; ዘከመ፡ ሖርኩ፡ ቅድሜከ፡ Jes. 38,3; ኢሖሩ፡ በትእዛዝከ፡ Jer. 39,23; Dan. 9,10; ውስተ፡ ጽልመት፡, ብርሃን፡ 1 Joh. 1,6; 1 Joh. 1,7; et in al. locis innumeris. 4 coire, inire, euphemistice, c. ኀበ፡ ut ኢትሑር፡ ኀበ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ብእሲ፡ Deut. 5,17; ብእሲት፡ ኢትሑር፡ ኀበ፡ እንስሳ፡ Lev. 18,23; c. Acc. ut: ሖረት፡ ካልአ፡ rom. (ሖረ፡ ካልእተ፡ Platt) γαμήσῃ ἄλλην Marc. 10,11, quareadulterare, adulterium plerumque phrasi ሐዊረ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ብእሲ፡ significari solet: Marc. 7,21; Rom. 2,22 rom. 13,9; Jac. 2,11; Jer. 9,2; Asc. Jes. 2,5; creberrime in Canonibus, ut Clem. f. 96; Clem. f. 98; Clem. f. 112; Clem. f. 167; Clem. f. 220. Obscoene de libidinibus naturae repugnantibus, c. Acc. bestiae: ዘየሐውር፡ እንስሳ፡ Ex. 22,18; viri: እለ፡ የሐውርዎሙ፡ ወእለ፡ የሐውሩ፡ μαλακοὶ καὶ ἀρσενοκοῖται 1 Cor. 6,9 rom.; c. ላዕለ፡ ut: ኢትሑር፡ ላዕለ፡ እንስሳ፡ Lev. 18,23; c. ዲበ፡ ut: እለ፡ የሐውሩ፡ ዲበ፡ ብእሲ፡ (ἀρσενοκοῖται) 1 Tim. 1,10. – Voc. Ae.: ሖረ፡ አመልዐ፡ ሔደ፡ ḥora G ሖረ፡ ḥora I,1 የሐውር፡, ይሑር፡ «aller au figuré: coïter, etc.» ― ሔደ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 26v. 56 L ḥwr ሖረ ḥora (yǝḥor, yǝḥur) go, go forth, proceed, depart, follow a way of life, have sexual intercourse ዘይሐውር zayǝḥawwǝr a moving creature 249b

woorden.betekenis: ire, proficisci facere, jubere, ducere, deducere, circumduce
woorden.definitie: II,1 ire vel proficisci facere vel jubere, ducere, deducere, circumducere al.: ወአሖሩ፡ ሰረገላቲሆሙ፡ (ἔζευξαν ἅρμα) 4 Reg. 9,21; አነ፡ ኣንጎግዋ፡ ወኣሐውራ፡ በድወ፡ Hos. 2,16; ታሐውር፡ ለመንገለ፡ ደቡብ፡ φέρουσα πρός Hez. 40,44; ያረትዕ፡ መዝራእተ፡ እድ፡ ይቡሰ። ወያሐውር፡ እግረ፡ ሐንካስ፡ Lit. Joh.; aliud exemplum vid. sub ራግናት፡ ʾaḥora G አሖረ፡ ʾaḥora II,1 ያሐውር፡, ያሑር፡ «faire aller» ― አስሔደ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 26v. 56 L አሖረ ʾaḥora causative {of vid. ሖረ ḥora}; also lead, bring (into) 249b

woorden.betekenis: iri, incedi, ita cum migraretur, ab eo, venit, Hierosolyma
woorden.definitie: III,1 pass. iri, incedi: ወእንዘ፡ ይትሐወር፡ ከመዝ፡ በጽሐ፡ ita cum migraretur ( ab eo ), venit ( Hierosolyma ) Gad. T.H., si quidem lectio bona est.

woorden.betekenis: itio, itus, incessus, gressus, abitus, exitus, profectio, in
woorden.definitie: n. act., m. et fem., Pl. ሑረታት፡ 1 itio, itus, incessus, gressus: ሑረት፡ ወግብአት፡ Zach. 7,14; Ps. 36,24; ሑረተከ፡ በሰላም፡ ያሤኒ፡ Prov. 4,27; እምልብሰቱ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ወእምሑረቱ፡ ወእምሠሐቁ፡ ይትዐወቅ፡ ግዕዙ፡ Sir. 19,30; ጥቀ፡ አዳም፡ ሑረታቲኪ፡ Cant. 7,2. 2 abitus, exitus, profectio: በሑረትነ፡ እምኀቤሆሙ፡ Act. 28,10 Platt; in breve tempus a mortuis separati sumus እስመ፡ እምድኅረ፡ ንስቲት፡ ነሐውር፡ ከመ፡ ሑረቶሙ፡ Genz. f. 84; አበስኩ፡ ላዕለ፡ ነፍስየ፡ በሑረትየ፡ ኀበ፡ ሮም፡ Jsp. p. 338; ሑረቱ፡ ኀበ፡ ግብጽ፡ Jsp. p. 325. 3 ambulatio i.e. sentiendi agendique ratio, vita, mores: Ps. 118,133; መምህር፡ ይኩን፡ ንጹሐ፡ በሑረታቲሁ፡ ወጽሩየ፡ በፍናዋቲሁ፡ F.M. 1,5; ሠናይ፡ ሑረታቲሁ፡ በኵሉ፡ መዋዕል፡ Jsp. p. 321; ምግባራት፡ ወሑረታት፡ Jsp. p. 306; ከመ፡ ኢይንግሥ፡ ወልዱ፡ በሑረታቲሁ፡ Jsp. p. 340; c. ለ erga, በእንተ፡ ሠናይ፡ ሑረታቲሁ፡ ለሕዝብ፡ ob benignitatem ejus erga populum Jsp. p. 301. 4 ሑረተ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ብእሲ፡ adulterium Clem. f. 123.

woorden.betekenis: ambulacrum, porticus
woorden.definitie: subst., Pl. ሕዋራት፡ (nonnumquam ሕወራት፡ in libris mss.) ambulacrum, porticus στοὰ Hez. 40,18; 3 Reg. 6,30; Joh. 5,2; Joh. 10,23; Act. 3,11 Platt; לִשְׁכָּה Jer. 42,2 vers. nov.; Jer. 42,4 vers. nov.; Jer. 43,10; Jer. 43,20; ትኩን፡ እንከ፡ ቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ ኑኃ፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ወክልኤ፡ ሕዋራት፡ ውስተ፡ ገበዋቲሃ፡ በአምሳለ፡ ሐመር፡ Did. 12; ሕዋር፡ ማእከላዊ፡ (ecclesiae) Sx. Mag. 13.

woorden.betekenis: eundi spatium, iter, cursus, canalis, deliquiae, ambitus, ci
woorden.definitie: et ሙሓር፡ (4 Esr. 13,46; vid. gramm. § 115) subst., Pl. ምሕዋራት፡ 1 eundi spatium, iter, cursus: ምሕዋረ፡ ሠሉስ፡ ዕለት፡ Ex. 3,18; Num. 10,33; Judith 2,21; Gen. 30,36; Kuf. 29; Jon. 3,3; ምሕዋረ፡ ዕለት፡ 3,4; ምሕዋረ፡ ሰሙን፡ መዋዕል፡ Gen. 31,23; ወብሔሩሰ፡ ምሕዋረ፡ (ሙሓረ፡) ዓመት፡ ወመንፈቀ፡ ዓመት፡ 4 Esr. 13,46. 2 canalis, deliquiae Sx. Genb. 10(vid. ጽርበት፡); ምሕዋራተ፡ ማያት፡ F.N. 37. 3 ambitus, circuitus, orbis, orbita, cursus: ምሕዋረ፡ ዓመት፡ Koh. 6,6; astrorum Hen. 41,5-7; Hen. 60,19; Hen. 69,20; Hen. 69,21; Hen. 69,25. (In Act. 3,11 editio romana perperam ምሕዋር፡ exhibet pro ሕዋር፡ στοά).

woorden.betekenis: cursor, viator, missus, legatus, nuntius, tabellarius, apost
woorden.definitie: subst. (ut videtur, primitus nom. abstr. et coll., deinde concr.) m., Pl. ሐዋርያት፡ [hinc حَوَارِيٌّ] cursor, viator: ከመ፡ እኩይ፡ ሐዋርያ፡ κακὸς ὁδοιπόρος Prov. 6,11; πρόδρομος Hebr. 6,20. 2 missus, legatus, nuntius, tabellarius: ἀπεσταλμένος Jes. 16,8; Joh. 9,7; ἄγγελοι ሐዋርያ፡ (coll.) Gen. 32,4 (Plur. 32,7); ἄγγελοι ሐዋርያት፡ Jes. 30,4; Jes. 33,7; Jud. 11,14; Jud. 11,15; 1 Reg. 6,21; 1 Reg. 16,19; 2 Esr. 16,3; Judith 1,11; ፈነወ፡ ሐዋርያተ፡ ኀበ፡ vel ውስተ፡ Jes. 37,9; Jer. 29,15; Hez. 17,15; φορολόγος 2 Esr. 4,18; 2 Esr. 5,5; βιβλιοφόροι Esth. 3,13; Esth. 8,10. 3 In specie apostolus (Christi) ut Rom. 1,1; 1 Cor. 1,1; Marc. 6,30; Act. 9,27; Judae 17al.; ለክርስቶስ፡ ስሙ፡ መሲሕ፡ በእንተ፡ ቅብአት፡ በከመ፡ ሐዋርያ፡ በእንተ፡ ሐዊሮቱ፡ ይሰመይ፡ (καθάπερ ἀπόστολος κατὰ τὴν ἀποστολήν) Cyr. c. Pall. f. 72. – Hinc እንተ፡ ሐዋርያት፡ apostolica, (epitheton Ecclesiae) Clem. f. 206; Clem. f. 208al., (et fidei, ut) ርትዕት፡ ወእንተ፡ ሐዋርያት፡ ሃይማኖት፡ Cyr. ad Theod. f. 7. – Praeterea ሐዋርያ፡ (vel መጽሐፈ፡ ሐዋርያ፡) Apostolus significat Epistolas Novi Testamenti exceptis Paulinis, Lit., Lection., al. (ut Sx. Masc. 8). 4 Caeterum non apostoli tantum ሐዋርያት፡ nominantur, sed etiam Jesus Christus ሐዋርያ፡ nomen gerit: Hebr. 3,1 (ἀπόστολος); Hebr. 6,20 (πρόδρομος); በሰማይ፡ ኀበ፡ ቦአ፡ ኢየሱስ፡ ሐዋርያ፡ እምቅድሜነ፡ Mavâs. 67. Nec raro nomine ሐዋርያ፡ alii quoque viri (apostolici) in ecclesia eminentes praedicantur, potissimum in Synaxario, ut ጢሞና፡ ሐዋርያ፡ ወረድእ፡ እምኍልቆሙ፡ ለ፸ወ፪ አርድእት፡ Sx. Teq. 26; ሐዋርያ፡ እስጢፋኖስ፡ ሊቀ፡ ዲያቆናት፡ Sx. Ter 1; et ሐዋርያ፡ nonnumquam pro ሐዋርያዊ፡ usurpatur, ut ሰላም፡ ለከ፡ ፊላታዎስ፡ ሐዋርያ፤ ወሊቀ፡ ጳጳሳት፡ ዘለእስክንድርያ፤ Sx. Hed. 12Enc. for ጉባኤ፡ ሐዋርያት፡, ጉቡኣን፡ ሐዋርያት፡ vid. ጉባኤ፡ (TraCES)

woorden.betekenis: se movere, moveri, commoveri, concuti, agitari, loco moveri,
woorden.definitie: (et ተሐወሰ፡ Num. 14,44 C III,1 refl. et pass. 1 se movere, moveri, commoveri, concuti, agitari Gen. 25,22; ኢይትሐወስ፡ Job 41,14; ዘኢይትሐወስ፡ ἀνίκητος Job 39,26; ἀσάλευτος Deut. 11,18; ይትሐወስ፡ ጽላሎት፡ Cant. 4,6; ዓመታት፡ ይትሐወሱ፡ Kuf. 6; ከመ፡ ኢይትሐወስ፡ Jer. 10,5; Jes. 33,20; Jes. 54,10; ብርዕ፡ ዘበነፋስ፡ ይትሐወስ፡ Matth. 11,7 rom.; ተመንደብነ፡ እንዘ፡ ንትሐወስ፡ እምለፌ፡ ለለፌ፡ Act. 27,15 rom. 2 loco moveri vel se movere, c. እምነ፡ loci Num. 14,44; ኢይትሐወስ፡ እንከ፡ እምንባሩ፡ Jes. 46,7; አሰራ፡ ኢይትሐወስ፡ እመካነ፡ ኀጢአት፡ Prov. 5,5; ዐምደ፡ ምድር፡ ተሐውሰ፡ እመንበሩ፡ Hen. 57,2; Hen. 60,21; ዕለተ፡ ተሐውሶ፡ ἐξόδιον Num. 29,35 (vid. annot. ad locum). 3 Reptilia, τὰ ἑρπετὰ, aethiopice ዘይትሐወስ፡ verti solent Gen. 1,20-24; Gen. 6,19; Kuf. 2-6; ኵሉ፡ ዘይትሐወስ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ τὰ ἑρπετὰ τῶν πετεινῶν Lev. 11,20; Ps. 103,26. – Voc. Ae.: ተሀውከ፡ ተሐውሰ፡ አንቀልቀለ፡ ብ፡ ተናወጸ፡; aliud: ተሀውከ፡ ተሐውሰ፡ ዘ፡ ተነቃነቀ፡ taḥawsa G ተሐውሰ፡ taḥawsa III,1 ይትሐወስ፡ «être ébranlé, être agité, se mouvoir, bouger, ramper, aller çà et là » ― ተነቀነቀ፡, ተላወሰ፡, ተመላለሰ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 26v. 57 L ተሐውሰ፡ taḥawsa, ተሐወሰ፡ taḥawasa, ተሖሰ፡ taḥosa passive {of vid. ሖሰ፡ ḥosa}; also move, creep ዘይትሐወስ zayǝtḥawwas reptile 250a

woorden.betekenis: concupivit, delectatus est
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., ut videtur, mutatis labialibus et assibilata dentali, eadem, quae חָמַד concupivit, delectatus est (حَمَدَ).

woorden.betekenis: ʾahoza, ḥawwaza, ḥawaza
woorden.definitie: II,1, i.q. ሐወዘ፡; legitur: ይገብር፡ ዘከመ፡ ያሐውዞ፡ Herm. p. 59(si quidem lectio bona est). ʾahoza L አሖዘ ʾahoza same as vid. ሐወዘ ḥawwaza; also causative of vid. ሐወዘ ḥawaza 251a

woorden.betekenis: suavis, jucundus, gratus, amoenus, ḥawāz, ḥawiz, ḥawizān, ch
woorden.definitie: adj. (formam ሐዊዝ፡, quam Ludolfus in lexico exhibet, equidem nusquam legi), m. et fem. suavis, jucundus, gratus, amoenus: ሐዋዝ፡ ማሕሌት፡ ወመሰንቆ፡ በቤተ፡ ስታይ፡ Sir. 35,6; ጕማ፡ ቃሎሙ፡ ሐዋዝ፡ ወጥዑም፡ Sir. 47,9; መዝሙር፡ ዘሐዋዝ፡ ቃለ፡ ቃነሁ፡ ἡδύφωνος Hez. 33,32; Ps. 80,2; Ps. 146,1; ምድር፡ ሐዋዝ፡ ወስብሐት፡ Hen. 89,40; ሐዋዝ፡ ውእቱ፡ ሕገ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ውስተ፡ ልብየ፡ (συνήδομαι τῷ νόμῳ) Rom. 7,22. – Acc. pro adverbio usurpatur, ut: ሐዋዘ፡ ትነውም፡ ἡδέως Prov. 3,24; Sx. Hed. 6Enc. – Substantivi ሐውዝ፡ vice fungitur: ንግበር፡ ሐዋዘ፡ ውስተ፡ ፍጥረትነ፡ χρησώμεθα τῇ κτίσει Sap. 2,6. ḥawāz, ḥawiz G ሐዊዝ፡ ḥawiz, Pl. ሐዊዛን፡ ḥawizān «charmant, agréable»; ሐዋዝ፡ ḥawāz, Pl. ሐዋዛት፡ ḥawāzat (même sens) ― ያማረ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 26v. 57 L ሐዊዝ ḥawiz (57) agreable, charming, pleasant ሐዋዝ፡ ḥawāz pleasant, pleasing, delightful, agreeable, suave, sweet; pleasure, delight 251a

woorden.betekenis: colorem rubrum ad nigrum vergentem habuit, arsit, accensus e
woorden.definitie: rad. inus.: Arabibus حَوِيَ (pro حَوِوَ) est colorem rubrum ad nigrum vergentem habuit; Syris ܚܰܒ arsit, accensus est. {Nunc comparare maluerim כָּוָה ܩܘܳܐ كَوَى.}ḥawaya G ሐወየ፡ ḥawaya I,2 ይሔዊ፡, የሐዊ፡ «le soir vient, le crépuscule paraît» ― መሸ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 26v. 57 L ሐወየ፡ ḥawaya (yǝḥway) (, ) become dark (due to sunset), become gloomy, become evening 250b

woorden.betekenis: ignis, pruna, Pantaleon, ḥaw, haw, fire
woorden.definitie: subst. ignis (pruna) poët.: Pantaleon እምብዙኅ፡ ንዋይ፡ ጽድቀ፡ ዘአፍቀርከ፤ ሐወ፡ ዘዐቈርከ፡ በመርወይ፡ Deg. (in Sx. Teq. 6de eo narratur: ቈጸረ፡ ፍሕመ፡ በልብስ፡); ጤገን፡ ዘአፍልሕዎ፡ በሐው፡ Sx. Hed. 7Enc.; አንዲዶሙ፡ ሐወ፡ Sx. Sen. 21Enc. – Voc. Ae.: ሐው፡ ዘ፡ እሳት። ḥaw, ሀው haw G ሐው፡ ḥaw «ignis» ― እሳት፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 15. 54 L ሐው፡ ḥaw, () ሀው haw fire 248b

woorden.betekenis: ḥawi, maṣḥafa ḥawi
woorden.definitie: subst.; መጽሐፈ፡ ሐዊ፡ inscriptus est liber magnae molis, in quo de vitis Sanctorum de aliisque tractatur, vid. Ludolfi comm. ad hist. woorden.betekenis: attendit, cavit, animum, oculos intendit, custodivit, specta
woorden.definitie: I,2 [etiam ሐየጸ፡ q.v.; non tam cum ܚܙܳܐ חָזָה, quam cum حَاطَ attendit, cavit, حَفِظَ (ܚܰܦܶܛ) animum vel oculos intendit, custodivit comparandum videtur.] 1 spectare, speculari, (introspicere, prospicere, despectare, perspicere): ዘይሔውጽ፡ ὁ σκοπός 2 Reg. 18,26; ትሔውጽ፡ እምርሑቅ፡ (κατασκοπεύειν) Ex. 2,4; በሐውጾቱ፡ ἐν ὀπτασίαις αὐτοῦ Sir. 43,16; አብድ፡ እምኆኅት፡ ይሔውጽ፡ ቤተ፡ ባዕድ፡ (παρακύπτει εἰς) Sir. 21,23; Sir. 14,23; እመስኮት፡ ትሔውጽ፡ Prov. 7,6; 4 Reg. 9,30; 4 Reg. 9,32; Ps. 13,3; Gen. 26,8; ይሔውጽ፡ እንተ፡ መስኮት፡ Cant. 2,9; Luc. 24,12; ዘሐወጸ፡ ውስተ፡ ሕግ፡ Jac. 1,25; ሐወጸት፡ እኪት፡ እምነ፡ መስዕ፡ κακὰ ἐκκέκυφεν ἀπὸ βορρᾶ Jer. 6,1; ይሔውጽ፡ ልበ፡ Sap. 1,6. Etiam de sereno coeli vultu usurpatur Ex. 24,10. 2 inspicere, visitare: ኢትትሀከይ፡ ሐውጾ፡ ድዉይ፡ Sir. 7,35; Job 2,11; Jud. 15,1; Matth. 25,36; ወአኀዊከ፡ ሐውጽ፡ ለሰላም፡ 1 Reg. 17,18; presbyteri et diaconi የሐውጽዎሙ፡ ለድውያን፡ Kid. f. 16. In specie usurpatur de Deo: a visitare homines aut benefaciendo aut puniendo et rationi reposcendae (ἐπισκέπτειν, ἐπισκοπή): Gen. 21,1; Ex. 3,16; Ex. 13,19; 1 Reg. 2,21; Prov. 29,13; Ps. 64,9; Job 31,14; አመ፡ ይሔውጾሙ፡ Jer. 6,15; Jer. 10,15; Jer. 28,18; Jer. 36,10; Jer. 51,29; Jes. 23,16; Jes. 24,22; 4 Esr. 9,1; c. ላዕለ፡ Jer. 43,31; et b de Dei providentia: prospicere, providere: ሓውጾትከ፡ ἐπισκοπή Job 10,12; Job 7,17; Ps. 8,5; Job 6,14; Job 29,4. Rarius c recensere, lustrare populum, exercitum Ex. 30,12. – Voc. Ae.: ሐወጸ፡ ዘ፡ ጐበኘ፡ አሻግሮ፡ ሐየሂ፡ ይ። ḥawwaṣa G ሐወጸ፡ ḥawwaṣa I,2 ይሔውጽ፡, የሐውጽ፡ «visiter, viser, regarder fixement, guetter, lorgner, épier, observer» ― ጐበኛ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 27v. 57 L ሐወጸ ḥawwaṣa, () ሐወፀ ḥawwaḍa glance, look on, look after, peep, visit, pay a visit, watch, observe, explore, inspect, oversee, take care of, be solicitous, (, ) spy ዘይሔውጽ zayǝḥewwǝṣ watchman 250

woorden.betekenis: colligere, congregare, populus, conferre, calculum subducere
woorden.definitie: radix et significatione et etymo intime conjuncta cum ሐሰበ፡ (q.v.). Notio prima 1 est colligere, congregare (vid. حَزَبَ II III V; vic. حَشَبَ VIII), unde ሕዝብ፡ populus; 2 colligere, conferre i.e. calculum subducere, putare, vid. ሐሰበ።
