woorden.betekenis: turba, agmen, gens, multitudo, agmen, populus, natio, populi
woorden.definitie: subst. [a radicis significatione prima derivatum, cfr. حِزْبٌ turba, agmen hominum, gens; حَوْشَبٌ multitudo, agmen, amh. ሕዝብ፡] m. et fem., Plur. ሕዘብ፡ et አሕዛብ፡, congregatio hominum: 1 populus, natio ሕዝብ፡ ዐቢይ፡ Gen. 12,2; Ex. 15,16; Num. 11,29; Ps. 27,11; Ps. 27,12; Sir. 10,8 et innumeris aliis in locis; fem. ሕዝብ፡ ጽንዕት፡ Mich. 4,7. a Construitur ut cum singulari ita cum plurali et verbi et adjectivi, ut Rom. 10,21; ሕዝብ፡ ዐላዊያን፡ ἔθνος ἀπειθές Sir. 16,6; ሕዝብ፡ ነኪራን፡ ወእኩያን፡ ξένος Λαὸς καὶ χαλεπός Jes. 18,2; Jes. 18,7; Jes. 26,11; ለእሙንቱ፡ ሕዝብ፡ Jer. 12,17; ለእሉ፡ ሕዝብ፡ Judith 10,19; እሉ፡ ሕዝብ፡ መጽኡ፡ 5,6; Jes. 29,13; Jes. 65,2. b Pluralis populi, gentes plerumque forma አሕዛብ፡ ut Ps. 2,1; Ps. 2,8; Jes. 5,26, rarius forma ሕዝብ፡ significatur. α Sed nonnumquam utraque forma conjunctim usitata legitur, ut አግረረ፡ ለነ፡ አሕዛበ፡ ወሕዘበ፡ ታሕተ፡ እገሪነ፡ λαούς–ἔθνη Ps. 46,3; Ps. 2,1; vel pl. et sing. አሕዛብ፡ ወሕዝብ፡ λαοὶ καὶ ὄχλοι Apoc. 17,15; Apoc. 10,11; Apoc. 5,9; Dan. 3,4; Dan. 6,25. β Pluralis አሕዛብ፡ crebro simpliciter (turbas hominum) populum, gentem significat: አሕዛበከ፡ እለ፡ ተሰምዩ፡ λαὸν κεκλημένον ἐπ᾽ ὀνόματί σου Sir. 36,17; Jes. 40,1; Jes. 60,21, et c. sing. adjectivi vel verbi conjungi potest. γ Ex usu loquendi, qui in Bibliis obtinet, አሕዛብ፡ saepe populos i.e. ethnicos, paganos significat: Jer. 10,3 (አረማውያን፡ 10,2); Rom. 1,13; Rom. 3,29. 2 tribus, gens, stirps (δῆμος, φυλή): ከመ፡ ትፃእ፡ ዮም፡ አሐቲ፡ ሕዝብ፡ እምእስራኤል፡ Jud. 21,3; ፲ወ፪ ሕዝበ፡ ድዮስጶራ፡ Jac. 1,1; Apoc. 7,5 seq.; Matth. 19,28; Rom. 11,1; Tob. 5,12; Ex. 28,21; Ex. 31,6; 1 Reg. 20,29. Haec ubi significatio valet, plurali inservit potissimum forma ሕዘብ፡ ut በበሕዘቢሆሙ፡ Jes. 19,13; Job 8,8; Gen. 25,16; Num. 3,15; Num. 3,18 seq. Num. 24,2; Jos. 7,14 (φυλαί, ነገድ፡ δῆμος). 15,1 (δῆμοι). 17,2; Ps. 73,9, sed altera quoque forma usurpatur; አሕዛብ፡ φυλαί Ps. 121,4; Sir. 48,10. 3 Etiam ad gentes i.e. genera rerum inanimatarum haec vox transfertur, ut astrorum Hen. 72,1; nec non ad sectas philosophorum et theologorum (αἵρεσις) Act. 5,17; Act. 15,5; Act. 24,5; ሕዝበ፡ አርዮስ፡ Ariani Sx. Hed. 13. 4 multitudo hominum quaelibet a homines: ወይመውቱ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ብዙኃን፡ እምደቂቀ፡ እስራኤል፡ Num. 21,6; Gen. 20,4; Asc. Jes. 6,7. b turba, multitudo (et ሕዝብ፡ et አሕዛብ፡) ብዙኃን፡ አሕዛብ፡ πολὺς ὄχλος Joh. 12,12 rom.; Dan. 10,6. c plebs, vulgus: እንግልጋ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ἐκκλησία ὄχλου Sir. 26,5; δῆμος Act. 12,22 Platt; Act. 17,5; Act. 19,30. d concio, coetus ሕዝብ፡ ἐκκλησία Sir. 34,11. e turba militaris, vulgus militum ὄχλος Jer. 39,24; አሕዛብ፡ ብዙኅ፡ Dan. 11,11 seq.; ኵሉ፡ ሕዝብ፡ መስተቃትላን፡ Jos. 10,7; Jos. 8,13; Jud. 8,5; 1 Reg. 26,5; 1 Reg. 17,1. f incolae terrae, urbis, potissimum in pl. አሕዛብ፡ (vid. 4,a): አሕዛብ፡ (በሀገር፡) λαός Am. 3,6; Hez. 26,11; አሕዛበ፡ ምድር፡ λαὸς τῆς γῆς 4 Reg. 15,5; 2 Par. 13,9; 2 Par. 26,21; Ex. 5,5; ኵሉ፡ ሕዝብ፡ Gen. 47,21. g Addito pronomine suffixo populares, ut: እምሕዝብክሙ፡ ἐκ τῶν ἰδίων συμφυλετῶν 1 Thess. 2,14; ተደሙ፡ ሰብኡ፡ ወሕዘቢሁ፡ አንከሩ፡ obstupuerunt propinqui ejus et populares ejus mirati sunt Sx. Tachs. 10Enc. 5 Ubi sacerdotibus et clericis opponitur ሕዝብ፡ significat laicos, gregem: 1 Petr. 5,3; creberrime in Canonibus eccles., ut Clem. f. 92; Clem. f. 128. ḥǝzb, Pl. አሕዛብ፡ ʾaḥzāb, ሕዘብ፡ ḥǝzab ሕዝበ፡ ḥǝzba part of n. pr. (personal name) vid. ሕዝበ፡ አርዓድ፡, ሕዝበ፡ አናኒ፡ G ሕዝብ፡ ḥǝzb, Pl. አሕዛብ፡ ʾaḥzāb et ሕዘብ፡ ḥǝzab «peuple» ― ሕዝብ፡, ወገን፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 28r. 59 L ሕዝብ ḥǝzb (Pl. ሕዘብ ḥǝzab, አሕዛብ፡ ʾaḥzāb) nation, people, tribe, sect, multitude, crowd; partisans, gentiles, pagans, heathens 253a

woorden.betekenis: populi dignitas, ḥǝzbǝnnā, stage or condition of being a gro
woorden.definitie: vel ሕዝበት፡ subst. populi dignitas: እስመ፡ ተኀድገ፡ ሕዝብናከ፡ እስራኤል፡, var. ተረስዐ፡ ሕዝበትከ፡ እስራኤል፡ (כִּי נָטַשְׁתָּ עַמְּךָ בֵּית יַעֲקֹב) Jes. 2,6 vers. nov. ḥǝzbǝnnā L ሕዝብና ḥǝzbǝnnā stage or condition of being a group 253a C vid. also ሕዝበት፡

woorden.betekenis: tristis fuit, asperitate, terra dura ac salebrosa, asperitas
woorden.definitie: , raro ሐዝነ፡ (Matth. 20,24 rom.) I,1 [حَزِنَ tristis fuit; amh. አዘነ፡, sed notio prima videtur esse in asperitate (حَزْنٌ terra dura ac salebrosa, حُزُونَةٌ asperitas ac durities terrae) vid. infra ሐዘዘ፡] Subj. ይሕዝን፡ et ይሕዘን፡ (4 Esr. 10,10 Laur.; Act. 27,22 rom.) 1 asperum, scabrum fieri vel esse: የሐዝነኒ፡ ማእስየ፡ τὸ δέρμα μου ἐσκότωται Job 30,30 (v. ያሐዝዘኒ፡, v. ያዘሐዝሐኒ፡) 2 de animo: asperatum vel acerbatum i.e. aegrum animi, tristem, moestum esse, sive ob dolorem sive ob indignationem: λυπεῖσθαι Joh. 16,22; ለምንት፡ ተሐዝን፡ περίλυπος ἐγένου Gen. 4,6; ሐዘነ፡ መንፈሳ፡ ለርብቃ፡ Kuf. 27; Hen. 92,2; Hen. 102,6; Asc. Jes. 8,28; c. በእንተ፡ Kuf. 34; 4 Esr. 10,11; 4 Esr. 10,13; 4 Esr. 10,54; { seq. እስመ፡ Hen. 89,67; Hen. 102,5}; ኢትሕዘኑ፡ (εὐθυμεῖν) Act. 27,22 rom.; ἀθυμεῖν 1 Reg. 1,6; 1 Reg. 15,11; Col. 3,21 Platt; ἀδημονεῖν Matth. 26,37; Marc. 14,33 (ubi ed. rom. et Platt Subjunctivum I,2 የሐዝን፡ exhibent); ἀγανακτεῖν c. በእንተ፡ Matth. 20,24. ḥazana, ሐዝነ፡ ḥazna, ኀዘነ፡ ḫazana G ሐዘነ፡ ḥazana I,1 የሐዝን፡, ይሕዝን፡ «s’affliger, s’attrister, être chagrin, avoir compassion» ― አዘነ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 28r. 59 L ሐዘነ ḥazana, ሐዝነ ḥazna (yǝḥzǝn, yǝḥzan), () ኀዘነ፡ ḫazana be sad, be sorrowful, be grieved, be in mourning, have compassion, be sorry for, sympathize 253b C vid. also ሐዘነ፡

woorden.betekenis: contristare, moerore, tristitia afficere, aegre facere, pung
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 contristare, moerore vel tristitia afficere aliquem, aegre facere alicui: ኢታሕዝኖ፡ ለአቡከ፡ በሕይወቱ፡ (μὴ λυπήσῃς) Sir. 3,12; ከመ፡ ኢያሕዝንከ፡ 30,10; Prov. 10,1; Tob. 4,3; παρεκρούσατό με Gen. 31,7. Impersonaliter hanc stirpem usurpare amant, ut: ወአሕዘኖ፡ ለቃየን፡ ጥቀ፡ καὶ ἐλυπήθη Κάϊν λίαν (es verdroß ihn sehr) Gen. 4,5; ኢያሕዝንከ፡ ወኢትትሐዘበኒ፡ Job 33,7; etiam ኢያሐዝኖ፡ ለልብየ፡ በእንተ፡ 4 Esr. 6,36 ita explicare licet (quamquam etiam I pers. sing. intelligi potest). 2 pungere, mordere animum (conscientiam): ብፁዕ፡ ዘኢያሐዝን፡ ነፍሶ፡ οὗ οὐ κατέγνω ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτοῦ (cujus animus non pungitur) Sir. 14,1; አሕዘነ፡ ልቦ፡ ዳዊት፡ ἐπάταξε καρδία Δαβὶδ αὐτόν 2 Reg. 24,10. 3 sollicitum redderealiquem, curam afferre vel curae esse alicui: ኢያሐዝኖ፡ ተሞቅሖ፡ ወመንሱት፡ Sir. 13,12; አልቦ፡ ዘያሐዝነከ፡ οὐ μέλει σοι περὶ οὐδενός Marc. 12,14; plerumque impersonaliter: ኢያሐዝኖ፡ በእንተ፡ አባግዕ፡ Joh. 10,13; ኢያሐዝኖ፡ (rom.: ኢያጽሀቆ፡) ለጋልዮስ፡ ወኢምንተኒ፡ በእንቲአሁ፡ Act. 18,17 Platt. 4 misericordiam commovere Lud. ex Enc. ʾaḥzana G አሕዘነ፡ ʾaḥzana II,1 ያሐዝን፡ ያሕዝን፡ «chagriner, affliger, attrister, inspirer de la compassion» ― አሳዘነ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 28r. ያኃዝነኒ፡ ማርያም፡ ዘረከበኪ፡ ድክትምና። አመ፡ ቤተ፡ መቅደስ፡ ቦእኪ፡ እንዘ፡ ትጠብዊ፡ ሐሊበ፡ ሐና። 92 59 L አሕዘነ፡ ʾaḥzana sadden, make sad, afflict, cause sorrow, inspire compassion አሕዘነ፡ ʾaḥzana with indirect object suffix pronouns care for, be saddened for, be sorrowful for 253b

woorden.betekenis: tristitia, moeror, aegritudo, luctus, causa moeroris, luctu
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem. (ut Sir. 30,23; Sir. 38,20), Plur. ሐዘናት፡ 1 tristitia, moeror, aegritudo, luctus: λύπη ብዙኃን፡ እለ፡ ሞቱ፡ እንበይነ፡ ሐዘን፡ ሐዘኑ፡ ለልብ፡ ይሰብሮ፡ ለኀይል፡ Sir. 38,18; Sir. 38,19; Sir. 38,20; Sir. 30,23; Sir. 14,1; Prov. 14,13; Luc. 22,45; Joh. 16,20; በሐዘን፡ ἐν λύπῃ Tob. 2,5; 4 Esr. 7,18; ἄλγημα Koh. 1,18; στεναγμός Jes. 35,10; ἀκηδία Ps. 118,28; ἀθυμία Ps. 118,53; 1 Reg. 1,6; 1 Reg. 1,10; 1 Reg. 1,16. Nonnumquam causa moeroris: ሐዘን፡ ይእቲ፡ ለወላዲሃ፡ Sir. 22,4; Sir. 25,23. Tristitia in bonam partem 2 Cor. 7,10; in malam Herm. p. 38 seq. Etiam de luctu pro mortuis usurpatur, ut: እንተ፡ ኢፈጸመት፡ ዕድሜ፡ ሐዘነ፡ ምታ፡ ዘሞተ፡ quae tempus luctui pro marito mortuo definitum nondum explevit F.N. 24,2; hinc በዜማ፡ ሐዘን፡ modis lugubris (de cantu) Cod. Mus. Brit. XXVI. 2 aerumnae λύπαι ሐዘን፡ Gen. 3,16; Gen. 3,17; Kuf. 3; 1 Petr. 2,19; ሐዘናት፡ ብዙኃት፡ Phlx. 79. 3 solicitudo, cura: ሐዘን፡ ወትካዝ፡ μέριμνα καὶ φροντίς Job 11,18; ዘእንበለ፡ ሐዘን፡ ἀμέριμνοι Matth. 28,14. ḥazan, ḫazan G ሐዘን፡ ḥazan «chagrin, tristesse, affliction» ― አዘን፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 28r. 59 ኀዘነ፡ ልብ፡ ḫazana lǝbb «regret» አዕረፈ፡ እንበለ፡ ኀዘነ፡ ልብ፡ ወሀከክ። 201, vid. ልብ፡ 33 L ሐዘን ḥazan sadness, grief, sorrow, mourning, affliction, melancholy, care 254a

woorden.betekenis: causa moeroris, māḥzan, cause of sadness
woorden.definitie: subst. 1 causa moeroris et māḥzan L ማሕዘን፡ māḥzan cause of sadness 254a

woorden.betekenis: contristans, moerorem afferens, misericordiam commovens, mis
woorden.definitie: part. (II,1) 1 contristans, moerorem afferens (qaue duae formae fere promiscue usurpantur): ነውር፡ ማሕዝን፡ (v. ማሕዝን፡) ለልብ፡ πάθος ἐν σώματι καρδίαν λυπεῖ Prov. 25,20; ቃል፡ ማሕዝን፡ λόγος λυπηρός 15,1; ማሕዘነ፡ ኮኖ፡ ዝቃል፡ በቅድመ፡ አዕይንቲሁ፡ Kuf. p. 66; ሕዳጥ፡ ውእቱ፡ ንበረትነ፡ ወማሕዝን፡ (v. ማሕዘን፡) λυπηρός Sap. 2,1. 2 misericordiam commovens, miserabilis, ut: mendicus በአርአያ፡ ማሕዘን፡ Chrys. Ta. 11(Quod J. Ludolfus sub hoc vocabulo recenset ማሕዘን፡ adulteria, vid. sub መሐዘ፡). māḥzǝn, ማሕዘኒ፡ māḥzani L ማሕዝን māḥzǝn, ማሕዘኒ māḥzani saddening, provoking sadness, who causes sorrow, sorrowful, grievous 254a C vid. also ማሕዘኒ፡

woorden.betekenis: vituperatio, reprehensio, increpatio, objurgatio, opprobrium
woorden.definitie: subst. 1 vituperatio, reprehensio: ሒስ፡ ንስቲት፡ μέμψις ὀλίγη Sap. 13,6; እንተ፡ እንበለ፡ ሒስ፡ ἄμεμπτος Esth. 8,13 apocr.; Ps. 118,112; Kid. f. 6; ዘአልቦ፡ ነውር፡ ወሒስ፡ ἄμεμπτος Sap. 10,15; Hen. 67,1; ንጹሕ፡ አንተ፡ እምዝ፡ ሒስ፡ ዘኀቡኣት፡ Hen. 65,11. 2 increpatio, objurgatio, opprobrium, ὄνειδος Job 19,7; ὕβρις Sir. 10,6. ḥis G ሒስ፡ ḥis «blâme, censure» ― መንቀፍ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 28v. 61 L ሒስ ḥis reproof, reproach, vituperation, blame, scolding 252a

woorden.betekenis: vivere, vitam transigere, vitam sustentare, vivum servari, s
woorden.definitie: I,1 (Marc. 1,42 rom. legitur ሐየወ፡, errore typographi) [חָיָה ܚܝܳܐ حَيَّ; in lingua amh. quaedam derivata conservata sunt] Imperf. የሐዩ፡ (የሐይው፡), Subj. ይሕየው፡; Imperat. ሕየው፡, Infin. ሐዪው፡ et ሐይው፡, ሐይዎ፡ et ሐይዎት፡, 1 vivere Gen. 5,3 seq.; ሐዮክ፡ Sir. 41,4; ንሕነኪ፡ ሕይወተ፡ ነሐዩ፡ Sir. 48,11; ሐይውኒ፡ ወመዊትኒ፡ Sir. 11,14; Sir. 22,11; Ps. 20,4; ሐይው፡ ለነዋኅ፡ መዋዕል፡ Bar. 3,14 (μακροβίωσις); Job 7,16; 4 Esr. 6,57; 4 Esr. 7,18; 4 Esr. 8,9; Hab. 2,4; Joh. 5,25 seq., aliis in locis innumeris; ለዓለም፡ ሕየው፡ (v. ሕያው፡) Dan. 3,9; Dan. 6,21, (vid. ነጋሢ፡); ሐይወት፡ ነፍስከ፡ ζῇ ἡ ψυχή σου! 1 Reg. 1,26. a vitam transigere: ሕየው፡ በፍሥሓ፡ Koh. 7,14; ሠናይ፡ ሐይው፡ በትፍሥሕት፡ Sir. 41,13; ዘረወ፡ ንዋየ፡ አቡሁ፡ እንዘ፡ የሐዩ፡ በምርዐት፡ Did. 10; ኢትኅድግዎሙ፡ (ለውሉድክሙ፡) ዕሩዐ፡ ይሕየው፡ Did. 22. b vitam sustentare re, c. በ: በመጥባሕትከ፡ ሕየው፡ Gen. 27,40; Deut. 8,3; Kuf. 26. c vivum servari, superstitem esse Jer. 45,2; Hez. 3,21; Hez. 18,9. 2 reviviscere, i.e. a de animo: refici, recreari: ሐይወት፡ መንፈሳ፡ Kuf. 31; Kuf. 43; ሐይዎ፡ ልቡ፡ ወነፍሱ፡ Gen. 45,26. b de plantis: germinare 4 Esr. 8,47. c de mortuis: in vitam revocari, resurgere Hez. 37,3; Jes. 26,19 (ἐγερθήσομαι); ይብሉ፡ ኢየሐይዉ፡ ምዉታን፡ λέγουσαν ἀνάστασιν μὴ εἶναι Marc. 12,18 rom.; Marc. 12,23 rom.; Luc. 20,35; Luc. 20,37; 1 Cor. 15,12 seq.; etiam de peccato: ሐይወት፡ ኀጢአት፡ ἀνέζησε Rom. 7,9. d a morbo, vulneribus α revalescere, convalescere, sanari: እመ፡ ደወየ፡ ኢይሴፎ፡ ሐይወ፡ Job 24,23; ሐየውነ፡ ἰάθημεν Jes. 53,5; Jer. 28,9; Hebr. 12,13; Matth. 8,13; Joh. 5,14; c. እምነ፡ morbi vel vulneris: Hez. 16,6; Jes. 38,9; Jes. 38,21; 4 Reg. 1,2; Apoc. 13,12. β consanescere, sanari: ቍስለ፡ ሞቱ፡ ሐይወ፡ Apoc. 13,3; ቅጥቃጤ፡ ዘኢየሐዩ፡ συντριβὴ ἀνίατος Prov. 6,15; Lev. 13,37; Marc. 1,42. e de rebus fractis: reparari, restitui Jer. 19,11. 3 sanum et salvum esse a de valetudine: bene valere 3 Joh. 2; Luc. 7,10. b de salute aeterna: salvum fieri, salvari (σωθῆναι) Luc. 18,26 rom.; Act. 15,1; Rom. 11,26; Sir. 3,1. ḥaywa G ሐይወ፡ ḥaywa I,1 የሐዩ፡, ይሕየው «vivre, guérir (neutre), se rétablir, se porter bien » ― ዳነ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 28v. 62 L ሐይወ ḥaywa (yǝḥyaw, yǝḥyu) live, be alive, come back to life, revive (intr.), be well, be healed, be cured, recover, be restored, be saved ሕይወ፡ እምቀቲል ḥǝywa ʾǝmqatil he escaped death 252a

woorden.betekenis: vivificare, vivere jubere, vivum servare, alimento sustentar
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 vivificare, vivere jubere Koh. 7,12; 4 Esr. 8,16; አውረሶሙ፡ ሕገ፡ ዘያሐይዎሙ፡ νόμον ζωῆς Sir. 17,11; ζωοποιεῖν Rom. 8,11. 2 vivum servare: አሕየውኪ፡ ነፍሰኪ፡ Judith 10,15; አትረፈነ፡ ወአሕየወነ፡ 2 Esr. 9,8. a alimento sustentare (ne pereat) Gen. 47,25; እመቦ፡ ከመ፡ ንርከብ፡ ሣዕረ፡ ወናሐዩ፡ አፍራሲነ፡ 3 Reg. 18,5. b vitam concedere alicui, parcere vitae alicujus Judith 11,9; 1 Reg. 15,9 seq.; 1 Reg. 27,9; Gen. 12,12; Ex. 1,17; Num. 31,15; Jos. 9,19. c reum absolvere in judicio, liberum dimittere ἀπολύειν Dan. apocr. 1,53; Matth. 27,15; Marc. 15,6. 3 revivificare, vitae restituere, in vitam revocare a languidum refocillare, recreare: Ps. 70,22; Ps. 118,37; Ps. 118,40. b mortuos Deut. 32,39; 1 Sam. 2,6. c aegrotos: valetudini reddere, sanare Ps. 106,20; Job 42,10; Hos. 6,2; Matth. 8,7 rom.; ያሐይዎሙ፡ ሕይወተ፡ Jes. 19,22. d res fractas, scissas reparare, reficere: ያሐይዉ፡ አረፋተ፡ 1 Esr. 2,17; አሕየወ፡ ምሥዋዐ፡ ዘመዝበረ፡ 3 Reg. 18,32. 4 sensu theologico: salvum reddere, salvare Rom. 1,16; Joh. 12,47 rom.; 2 Tim. 4,18. ʾaḥyawa G አሕየወ፡ ʾaḥyawa II,1 ያሐዩ፡ «faire vivre, guérir (actif), rétablir en santé» ― አዳነ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 28v. 62 L አሕየወ ʾaḥyawa keep alive, make to live, let live, enliven, vivify, raise up alive, restore to life, cure, heal 252a

woorden.betekenis: vivus, vivens, ignis vivit, superstes, sanus, validus, salvu
woorden.definitie: adj, fem. ሕያውት፡, Pl. ሕያዋን፡ fem. ሕያዋት፡ 1 vivus, vivens Koh. 4,2; Koh. 9,4; Sir. 17,27; ምድረ፡ ሕያዋን፡ Jer. 11,19; ነኀጦ፡ ሕያዎ፡ Prov. 1,12; ሕያውኑ፡ ዓዲሁ፡ አቡነ፡ Gen. 45,3; Gen. 45,26; Thren. 4,17; Ruth 1,19; አምጣነ፡ ሕያው፡ ውእቱ፡ Sir. 23,15; እንዘ፡ ሕያው፡ ውእቱ፡ Sir. 25,7; Sir. 30,5; Sir. 37,27; Tob. 5,3; ኵሉ፡ ሕያዋን፡ Dan. 4,14; ንሕነ፡ ሕያዋን፡ Ps. 113,27; Ps. 54,16; ሕያዋነ፡ ሕይወት፡ ዘለዓለም፡ Hen. 15,4; Hen. 15,6; ኮነ፡ ሕያወ፡ 4 Esr. 1,5; ነፍስ፡ እንተ፡ ሕያውት፡ ውስተ፡ ማይ፡ Lev. 11,10; ደዋርህ፡ ሕያዋት፡ Lev. 14,4; ኵሉ፡ ሕያው፡ Job 12,10; ኵሉ፡ ዘሕያው፡ Sir. 16,30; Job 38,14; እጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ vid. sub እጓል፡. Crebro de Deo: ዘሕያው፡ ለዓለም፡ ὁ ζῶν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα Sir. 18,1; Hen. 5,1; Matth. 16,16. Formula jurandi est: ሕያው፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ከመ፡ Ruth 3,13; Jer. 4,2; Jer. 16,14; ሕያው፡ አነ፡ ከመ፡ Jes. 49,18; Hez. 5,11; ሕያው፡ ነፍስከ፡ ከመ፡ Judith 12,4; 1 Reg. 25,26; et formula salutandi regis ሕያው፡ እግዚእየ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ለዓለም፡ 3 Reg. 1,31; Dan. 2,4 (v. ሕየው፡); Dan. 3,9; Dan. 5,10; Dan. 6,6. De rebus inanimatis: እሳት፡ ሕያው፡ (cfr. Latinorum: ignis vivit) Hen. 71,5; Hen. 71,6. Nonnumquam ሕያው፡ reddi potest superstes, ut 1 Thess. 4,15. 2 sanus, validus, salvus, incolumis, integer: a de hominibus: ὑγιαίνων Luc. 15,27; ሕያውኑ፡ ὑγιαίνει; Tob. 7,4; ሕያው፡ ውእቱ፡ Tob. 10,6. b de verbo: λόγος ὑγιής ሕያው፡ ነገር፡ Tit. 2,8 rom. c de vasis, vestibus aliisque hujus generis rebus: ሕያዉ፡ ለልብስ፡ pars vestis sana Matth. 9,16; ልብስ፡ ሕያው፡ ወዳኅን፡ Herm. p. 104; de ollis: invenit eas ድኂኖን፡ ወሕያዎን፡ incolumes, Gad. Lal. d de cate Lev. 13,10 cfr. 13,14. – (Fem. ሕያዊት፡ pro ሕያውት፡ legitur Sx. Jac. 6). ḥǝyāw, fem. ሕያውት፡ ḥǝyāwt, Pl. ሕያዋን፡ ḥǝyāwān, fem. ሕያዋት፡ ḥǝyāwāt G ሕያው፡ ḥǝyāw, Pl. ሕያዋን፡ ḥǝyāwān «vif, sain et sauf» ― ዳኅና፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 29r. ሕያውት፡ ḥǝyāwt fem., Pl. ሕያዋት፡ ḥǝyāwāt «vive, saine et sauve» ― ዳኅና፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 29r. 62 L ሕያው፡ ḥǝyāw (fem. ሕያውት፡ ḥǝyāwt) alive, living, healed, whole (unharmed), safe and sound; with suffix pronouns: ሕያዋኒሆሙ ḥǝyāwānihomu they (who are) alive ሕያው፡ ንጉሥ ḥǝyāw nǝguś long live the king, vid. ንጉሥ፡ used in oaths, e.g. ሕያው፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ከመ ḥǝyāw ʾǝgziʾabǝḥer kama as God lives; ሕያው፡ አነ፡ ከመ ḥǝyāw ʾana kama as I live 252a C for እጓለ፡ እምሕያው፡ vid. እጓል፡ (Leslau)

woorden.betekenis: vita, quamdiu vivis, immortalitas, aqua fluens, victus, vita
woorden.definitie: (nonnumquam, ut in Liturgiarum ed. rom., ሒወት፡), m. et fem. 1 vita: ይኄይስ፡ መዊት፡ እመራር፡ ሕይወት፡ Sir. 30,17; Hen. 5,9; Ps. 7,5; ዓመተ፡ ሕይወት፡ ἔτη ζωῆς Prov. 3,16; በኵሉ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ሕይወትከ፡ Deut. 4,9; Deut. 6,2; vitae spatium Gen. 23,1; ነፍሰ፡ ሕይወት፡ ψυχὴ ζῶσα Gen. 9,12; Gen. 9,15; መንፈሰ፡ ሕይወት፡ πνεῦμα ζωῆς Hez. 35,5; በሕይወትከ፡ quamdiu vivis Sir. 17,28; Sir. 40,28; Apoc. 3,12; Kuf. 24; Kuf. 25; Ps. 145,1; ሕይወት፡ እንተ፡ አልባቲ፡ ሞተ፡ immortalitas 4 Esr. 5,13; ሕይወት፡ ዘለዓለም፡ ζωὴ αἰώνιος 1 Joh. 5,11; ἀφθαρσία Rom. 2,6; ዕፀ፡ ሕይወት፡ Gen. 2,9; Prov. 3,18; Apoc. 22,2; ማየ፡ ሕይወት፡ Apoc. 22,1; Hen. 17,4; Joh. 4,11; መጽሐፈ፡ ሕይወት፡ Apoc. 3,5; Apoc. 13,8; Mavâs. 22; ሕገ፡ ሕይወት፡ Sir. 45,5; ኅብስተ፡ ሕይወት፡ Joh. 6,35; ዝቃል፡ መንፈስ፡ ውእቱ፡ ወሕይወት፡ ውእቱ፡ 6,63. Formula jurandi: ሕይወተ፡ ፈርዖን፡ ከመ፡ Gen. 42,15; Gen. 42,16. (ማየ፡ ሕይወት፡ Kuf. 24ex Hebraismo est aqua fluens). 2 victus, vitae ratio Gen. 27,39; Prov. 27,25; ሕቱ፡ ሕይወቶ፡ ወዘከመ፡ እፎ፡ ውእቱ፡ ግዕዙ፡ ወልማዱ፡ Did. 10; Did. 14; ሐይወ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ (ለኢየሱስ፡) ሕይወተ፡ ጽብብተ፡ ወወሀበ፡ ነፍሶ፡ ህየንተ፡ ፈቃዱ፡ Phlx. 3; quae ad vivendum sunt necessaria, ut: vidua Evangelii, quae አብአት፡ ፪ጸራይቀ፡, አብአት፡ ኵሎ፡ ሕይወታ፡ F.N. 16. 3 sanatio, medela; sanitas, valetudo bona 4 Esr. 7,28; ἴασις Sir. 38,2; ἴαμα Jes. 26,19; θεραπεία ለሕይወተ፡ አሕዛብ፡ Apoc. 22,2; ὑγίεια Sap. 7,10; ትምህርተ፡ ሕይወት፡ διδασκαλία ὑγιαίνουσα 1 Tim. 1,10. 4 salus, salvatio (tam terrestris quam aeterna et spiritualis): ለሕይወትኪ፡ መጻእኪ፡ ἥκεις εἰς σωτηρίαν Judith 11,3; 1 Reg. 11,13; 1 Reg. 14,45; Jud. 15,18; Luc. 19,9; ዐዘቅተ፡ ሕይወት፡ πηγαὶ τοῦ σωτηρίου Jes. 12,3; Jes. 56,1; σωτηρία Rom. 11,11; Hebr. 2,3. 5 resurrectio: ዛቲ፡ ይእቲ፡ ቀዳሚት፡ ሕይወት፡ Apoc. 20,5 (20,6 ትንሣኤ፡); ሕይወተ፡ ምውታን፡ (Platt ሕይወት፡ እምውታን፡) Act. 17,32. ḥǝywat, ሒወት፡ ḥiwat, Pl. ሕይወታት ḥǝywatāt ሕይወታት ḥǝywatāt Pl. አነአ፡ ወሀብክዎአ፡ ኵሎአ፡ እምሕይወታትአ፡ ‘Io gli ho dato tutto, più di ogni altra creatura’ 69 § 174 (ed.), 44 § 174 (tr.) (‘«di ogni altra creatura»: testo ʾemḥeywatātʾe; il plurale di ḥeywat «vita» non è attestato; il siginficato del passo è oscuro.’ 44 n. 142) G ሕይወት፡ ḥǝywat, Pl. ሕይወታት፡ ḥǝywatāt «vie, âge» ― ድኅነነት፡, ዕድሜ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 29r. 62 L ሕይወት ḥǝywat, ሒወት ḥiwat life, lifetime, healing, good health, salvation, restoration, state, situation used in oaths, e.g. ሕይወተ፡ ፈርዖን፡ ከመ ḥǝywata faraʿon kama by the life of Pharaoh 252b C for ነፍሰ፡ ሕይወት፡ vid. ነፍስ፡ (Leslau)

woorden.betekenis: conditio vivi, sani, salvi, ḥǝyāwǝnnā, ḥǝyǝwǝnnā, vie, vivan
woorden.definitie: subst. conditio vivi, sani, salvi: እንዘ፡ ሀሎከ፡ በሕያውናከ፡ ዝየ፡ Chr. L. Atq. f. 28. ḥǝyāwǝnnā, ሕይውና፡ ḥǝyǝwǝnnā G ሕያውና፡ ḥǝyāwǝnnā «vie» (cette forme abstraite provenant de l’adjectif ሕያው፡ «vivant», manque dans le . Seule la forme ሕያውና፡, où la voyelle ‘ā’ n’a pas été abrégée en ‘ĕ’ devant le suffixe ና d’abstraction, est enregistrée dans le ‘Lexicon’) ከመ፡ ይጽጊ፡ ጽጌ፡ ሕይውና። Ms. BNFabb216, fol. 133ra. 62 L ሕያውና ḥǝyāwǝnnā (62), ሕይውና ḥǝyǝwǝnnā state (condition) of living, of being alive 252b

woorden.betekenis: speculatio, observatio
woorden.definitie: subst., speculatio, observatio Kuf. p. 28(v. ሕዋጼ፡); M.M. f. 287.

woorden.betekenis: novus, recens fuit, polivit, renovare, redintegrare, reficer
woorden.definitie: I,2 [i.q. חִדֵּשׁ, ܚܰܕܶܬ, amh. አደሰ፡; arab. حَدَثَ novus, recens fuit; III IV polivit ensem] 1 renovare, redintegrare, reficere, instaurare, ኵሎ፡ ትሔድስ፡ πάντα καινίζει Sap. 7,27; animam: ይሔድሳ፡ ለነፍሱ፡ ἀνανεώσει Job 33,24; Ps. 50,11; vires: ይሔድሱ፡ ኀይሎሙ፡ Jes. 40,31; vitam: ሐድስ፡ መዋዕሊነ፡ ἀνακαίνισον Thren. 5,21; poenitentiam: የሐድስዋ፡ ለንስሓሆሙ፡ Hebr. 6,6; juventutem Ps. 102,5; regnum 1 Reg. 11,14; festum Kuf. 14; foedus Kuf. 22; lumina coeli Kuf. 19; oppida diruta ይሔድሱ፡ አህጉረ፡ ዘመዝበረ፡ Jes. 61,4. In specie a librum renovare i.e. rescribere, transscribere Kuf. 45. b ἐγκαινίζειν initiare: ወሐደሰ፡ ቤተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ 2 Par. 7,5; 2 Par. 7,9. 2 innovare, novare, nova producere: ሐድሱ፡ ለክሙ፡ ሐዳሳተ፡ νεώσατε ἑαυτοῖς νεώματα Jer. 4,3; ብዙኀ፡ ይሔድሱ፡ 4 Esr. 12,29; ይሔድስ፡ እግዚእ፡ ሐዲሳተ፡ Hen. 106,13. ḥaddasa G ሐደሰ፡ ḥaddasa I,2 ይሔድስ፡, የሐድስ፡ «renouveler, rendre nouveau» ― አደሰ፡ አዲስ፡ አደረገ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 29r. 63 L ሐደሰ ḥaddasa renew, restore, renovate, repair, (*) inaugurate 225b

woorden.betekenis: novum fieri, renovari, innovari, redintegrari, Initiari, taḥ
woorden.definitie: III,2 pass. et refl. novum fieri, renovari, innovari, redintegrari: ተሐደሰኒ፡ ቍስልየ፡ ἀπεκαινίσθη Ps. 38,3; ተሐደሳ፡ (Imperat.) መንገሌየ፡ ደሰያት፡ Jes. 41,1; Jes. 45,16; foedus hebr. 9,18 rom.; ተሐደሱ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ Apoc. 21,5; 2 Cor. 5,17; ተሐደሰት፡ ሕገ፡ መንግሥት፡ Kebr. Nag. 87; ይትሔደሱ፡ ሰማያት፡ Kuf. 1; ደይኖሙ፡ ይትሔደስ፡ Kuf. 36; ተሐደሰት፡ ወሐይወት፡ መንፈሱ፡ Kuf. 43; de vita spirituali 2 Cor. 4,16. Initiari (aedes) 2 Par. 7,9 (var.). taḥaddasa G ተሐደሰ፡ taḥaddasa III,2 ይትሔደስ፡, ይትሐደስ፡ «être renouvelé, redevenir nouveau » ― ታደሰ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 29r. 63 L ተሐደሰ፡ taḥaddasa passive {of vid. ሐደሰ ḥaddasa} 225b

woorden.betekenis: novus, recens, testamentum novum, Christiani, N. et V.T., no
woorden.definitie: adj., fem. ሐዳስ፡, Pl. m. ሐዲሳን፡, fem. ሐዲሳት፡ et ሐዳሳት፡, c. ሐደስት፡ 1 novus, recens: folia Hen. 3; ficus Rel. Bar.; vinum Matth. 9,17; ተክለ፡ ዘይት፡ ሐዲስ፡ Ps. 127,4; frumentum (hornum opp. ከራሚ፡) Lev. 26,10; ገብረት፡ ዳፍንተ፡ ሐዳሰ፡ እምሥርናይ፡ ሐዲስ፡ Kuf. 22; plaustrum 1 Reg. 6,7; vestis 3 Reg. 11,29; 3 Reg. 11,30; funis Jud. 15,13; uter Matth. 9,17; domus Deut. 20,5; በድን፡ ሐዲስ፡ (nondum putridum) Enc.; ጦማረ፡ ክርታስ፡ ሐዲስ፡ Jes. 8,1; እገብር፡ ኵሎ፡ ሐዲሰ፡ Apoc. 21,5; ይከውን፡ ሰማይ፡ ሐዲሰ፡ ወምድርኒ፡ ሐዲሰ፡ Jes. 65,17; Jes. 66,22; Apoc. 21,1; 2 Petr. 3,13; ዐርክ፡ ሐዲስ፡ ወይን፡ ሐዲስ፡ Sir. 9,10; ካልእ፡ ሐዲስ፡ ንጉሥ፡ Kuf. 46; ስብሐት፡ ሐዲስ፡ Ps. 32,3; Ps. 39,4; ስም፡ ሐዲስ፡ Jes. 62,2; ሥርዐት፡ ሐዲስ፡ Jer. 38,31; Matth. 26,27; ሥርዐት፡ ሐዳስ፡ Hebr. 9,15; ልብ፡ ሐዲስ፡ ወመንፈስ፡ ሐዲስ፡ Hez. 36,26; ውስተ፡ ሐዲስ፡ ሕይወት፡ Rom. 6,4 rom.; ሐዳሳት፡ (leg. ሐደስት፡) እሙንቱ፡ በሃይማኖት፡ Herm. p. 12. In specie notanda sunt: a ሕግ፡ ሐዲስ፡ vel ሐዳስ፡ (vel ሥርዐት፡ ሐዲስ፡) testamentum novum F.M. 4,2; ሰብአ፡ ሐዲስ፡ ሕግ፡ (Christiani) Chrys. Ta. 19. b biblia Novi Testamenti ሐዲስ፡ ቀኖና፡ Clem. f. 86; መጻሕፍተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘሐዲስ፡ Clem. f. 86; vel ሐዲስ፡ ወብሉይ፡ N. et V.T. Org.; vel ሐዲሳት፡ (sc. መጻሕፍት፡) ወብሉያት፡ id. c ሐዲሳን፡ እለ፡ ተጠምቁ፡ νεόφυτοι novi, modogeniti Did. 42; item ሐዲስ፡ ሕዝብ፡, ሐዲሳነ፡ ሕዝብ፡ Syn.; sed etiam competentes (baptismum) hoc eodem nomine appellare licet: በእንተ፡ ሐዲስ፡ ሕዝብ፡ እለ፡ ይፈቅዱ፡ ይጠመቁ፡ Syn. (vid. ንኡስ፡). d junior, alter, ut: እንጦንዮስ፡ ሐዲስ፡ Sx. Jac. 25; ማርቆስ፡ ሐዲስ፡ Sx. Mij. 22; Sx. Genb. 12. e ሐደስት፡ primitiae: በአውራኀ፡ ሐደስት፡ Ex. 23,15. 2 novus i.e. inauditus ሐዲስ፡ ዘነገርኩ፡ አነ፡ Jes. 42,9; Jes. 43,19; Jes. 48,6; ሐዲሳት፡ res novae Hen. 106,13; ሐዳሳት፡ ለለ፡ ጽባሑ፡ Thren. 3,23; አፅምኦ፡ ዘሐዲስ፡ Act. 17,21. ḥaddis, fem. ḥaddās, Pl. m. ḥaddisān, fem. ḥaddisāt, ḥaddāsāt G ሐዲስ፡ ḥaddis, Pl. ሐዲሳን፡ ḥaddisān «neuf, nouveau» ― {fem.} ሐዳስ፡ ḥaddās, Pl. ሐዳሳት፡ ḥaddāsāt «neuve, nouvelle» ― አዲስ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 29r. 63 L ሐዲስ ḥaddis (fem. ḥaddās) new, recent, junior, the New Testament ሐዲስ፡ ወብሉይ፡ ḥaddis wabǝluy Old and New Testaments, vid. ብሉይ፡ 225b ሐዲሰ፡ ሃይማኖት፡ ḥāddisa hāymānot neophyte, vid. ሃይማኖት፡ 221b C a for ሐዲስ፡ ሥርዐት፡ vid. ሥርዐት፡ (Leslau) b for ሕግ፡ ሓዲስ vid. ሕግ፡ (Leslau)
