woorden.definitie: perire, perdere vid. sub ሀጕለ፡

woorden.betekenis: subsultim incessit, cohibuit, impedivit, cinxit, claudicavit
woorden.definitie: rad. inus.; حَجَلَ subsultim incessit, more corvi, cornicis vel hominis compedibus vincti; vicina: حَجَرَ cohibuit, impedivit, חָגַר cinxit, ܚܰܓܰܪ claudicavit. Hinc

woorden.betekenis: aestatem transigere, aestivare, ḥagaya, spend the summer, be
woorden.definitie: I,1 (denom. a ሕጋይ፡) aestatem transigere, aestivare (opp. ከረመ፡ vel አክረመ፡) Chr. L. Atq. f. 21. ḥagaya L ሐገየ ḥagaya (yǝḥgi) spend the summer, become summer (denominative) 228a

woorden.betekenis: ver et aestas, festum celebravit, âvi, âi, tempus festi, fes
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., ver et aestas [Dubium est, utrum a verbo ሐገየ፡ (coll. ܚܓܳܐ festum celebravit) an terminatione adjectivorum âvi vel âi a nomine ሐግ፡ (חָג) a verbo חגג derivatum sit. Illud quoque in medio relinquimus, utrum ejus notio prima tempus festi vel festorum solemnium an tempus anni revertentis (coll. حِجَّةٌ annus) fuerit. Sed Geez populum hac voce pariter atque caeteris mensium et anni partium nominibus, prius quam suas in Abyssinia sedes occupavisset, usum ess satis constat]. Primitus መጸው፡ ver et ጸዳይ፡ aestas communi nomine ሐጋይ፡ comprehenduntur, nec nisi ubi (per libros in Geez linguam translatos) tria vel quatuor anni tempora distinguuntur, nomen generis in nomen speciei abiit. a Respondet θέρος aestas በሐጋይ፡ Prov. 6,8; Prov. 26,1; ወሐጋይ፡ ውእቱ፡ Jud. 3,20; 2 Reg. 23,11; ቤተ፡ ሐጋይ፡ ὁ οἶκος ὁ θερινός Am. 3,15; Herm. p. 52(opp. ክረምት፡). b Ubi duo anni tempora distinguuntur ሐጋይ፡ semestre aestivum, ክረምት፡ hibernum significat: ሐጋይ፡ ወክረምት፡ (θέρος καὶ ἔαρ, קַיִץ וָחֹרֶף) Gen. 8,22; Kuf. 6; Hen. 4; Hen. 2,3; Aliis in locis θέρος καὶ ἔαρ (קַיִץ וָחֹרֶף) ክረምት፡ ወሐጋይ፡ redditur Zach. 14,8; Ps. 73,18; Kuf. 29. Ex his locis tempus ሐጋይ፡ tempori ክረምት፡ oppositum esse apparet. c Inveniuntur loci, ubi ሐጋይ፡ a ማእረር፡ (messe) distinctum vel tempus vernum et aestatis initium vel autumnum significet: ኢክረምት፡ ወኢሐጋይ፡ ወኢማእረር፡ 4 Esr. 6,8; ወፈለጠ፡ እምውስቴቶሙ፡ ክረምተ፡ ወማእረረ፡ ወሐጋየ፡ በበኍልቆሙ፡ ወበበ፡ ጊዜሆሙ፡ Sir. 36,9. d Quatuor tempora distinguuntur: ክረምት፡ መጸው፡ ማእረር፡ ሐጋይ፡ Kuf. p. 6; ጸዳይ፡ መፀው፡ ሐጋይ፡ ክረምት፡ Abush. 1; ጸዳይ፡ ሐጋይ፡ መጸው፡ ክረምት፡ Abush. 39; unde መፀው፡ ሐጋይ፡ ጸዳይ፡ ab Aethiopibus (ut qui in sua terra quatuor tempora distinguere non consueverint) promiscue usurpari elucet. At Abush. 4, ubi accuratius de hac re disputatur, ait: ሀለዉ፡ ፬ ዘመናት፤ ቀዳሚሆሙ፡ ዘመነ፡ መጸው፡ ወውእቱ፡ እልሐምል፡ ወልተውር፡ ወልዠውዛ፤ ወዘመነ፡ ሐጋይ፡ እልሰርጣን፡ ውአልሰድ፡ ውሰንብላህ፤ ወዘመነ፡ ጸዳይ፡ እልሚዛን፡ ወአቅረብ፡ ወቀውስ፤ ወዘመነ፡ ክረምት፡ እልዠድይ፡ ወደልው፡ ወልሑት፡, unde ሐጋይ፡ aestatem esse apparet. e Denique notandum est, Job 38,32 Μαζουρώθ ክረምት፡, Ἕσπερος ሐጋይ፡ vertisse Aethiopem. – Videre licet, quae J. Ludolfus in Hist. Aeth. I, 5, 26–33 et Isenbergius in lex. amh. p. 93 sub voce በጋ፡ de temporibus anni, quae in Aethiopia distinguuntur, eorumque initiis annotaverunt. – Voc. Ae.: ሐጋይ፡ ዘ፡ መዋዕለ፡ በጋ፡ ḥagāy G ሐጋይ፡ ḥagāy « deuxième partie de l’année abyssine; commence le 25 du mois de ታኅሳስ፡, 2 janvier, (et va) jusqu’au 24 du mois de መጋቢት፡, (1er avril). Contre Ludolf qui la met après la 3e partie ጸዳይ፡» 65 L ሐጋይ ḥagāy, () ኀጋይ፡ summer, dry season (January-March) 228a

woorden.betekenis: lex, pensum, terminus, tempus statutum, lex, jus, lex divina
woorden.definitie: I,1 [denom. a ሕግ፡ lex; radix חָקַק حَقَّ (unde חֹק pensum, terminus, tempus statutum, lex; حَقٌّ jus, lex divina, officium, veritas) apud Aethiopes in duas partes fissa est, quarum alteri (ሕቅ፡) notio modi justi, alteri (ሕግ፡) notio legis convenit] legem dare, constituere, condere: ሕግ፡ ዘሐገገ፡ ለክሙ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ διαθήκη ἣν ἔθετο Κύριος πρὸς ὑμᾶς Ex. 24,8; ሕግ፡ ወትእዛዝ፡ ዘጸሐፍኩ፡ ትሕግግ፡ ሎሙ፡ 24,12; የሐግጉ፡ ሕገ፡ ወዐመፃ፡ Jes. 10,1 vers. alt.; Rom. 2,14; ሙሴ፡ ሐገገ፡ ሎሙ፡ ሕገ፡ Haim. Ab. 2; Clem. f. 188. ḥagaga, ሐገገ፡ ḥaggaga G ሐገገ፡ ḥaggaga I,2 ይሔግግ፡, የሐግግ፡ «décréter, faire des lois, établir, statuer» ― ሕግ፡ ሰራ፡, ደነገገ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 30r. 65 L ḥgg ሐገገ ḥaggaga lay down laws, write laws, legislate, ordain, decree, institute laws 227b

woorden.betekenis: statutum, lex, summa legum divinarum, summa praeceptorum div
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Plur. ሕገግ፡, Pl. Plur. ሕገጋት፡ 1 statutum, lex a νόμος i.e. summa legum divinarum creberrime, ut Jes. 2,3; Jes. 5,24; Jes. 8,20; Jes. 24,5; Jes. 30,9; Jer. 2,8; Jer. 8,8; Jer. 9,13; Thren. 2,9; Job 34,27; Sir. 2,16; Sir. 9,15; Sir. 17,11; Sir. 19,17; Sir. 35,15, al.; ነሥአ፡ ሕገ፡ 4 Esr. 9,31; ዐቀቡ፡ ሕጎ፡ ዘተውህበ፡ ሎሙ፡ 4 Esr. 6,67; 4 Esr. 9,31; Sir. 15,1; τὰ διακιώματά μου ሕግየ፡ Hez. 5,6; Hez. 20,3 seq. Alterum legis mosaicae nomen est ኦሪት፡ vel ሕገ፡ ኦሪት፡ q.v. b Sed etiam singula divinae legis statuta ሕግ፡ (alias ሥርዐት፡) appellantur, ut πρόσταγμα καὶ δικαίωμα 1 Reg. 30,25; Kuf. 50(ዝሕግ፡); Pl. ሕገግ፡ vel ሕገገ፡ ኦሪት፡, ut Rom. 2,25; በገቢረ፡ ሕገገ፡ ኦሪት፡ ἐξ ἔργων Rom. 3,21; Rom. 3,28; Rom. 4,13; Rom. 4,14; Rom. 4,15; Rom. 5,13; Gal. 2,16; ሕገጊሁ፡ Kuf. 50; Num. 9,23; Prov. 3,1; Prov. 6,20; ሕገጋቲሆን፡ summa praeceptorum divinorum Cyr. f. 1; ሕገጋት፡ Jsp. p. 290; ፪ ሕገጋት፡ (sc. V. et N. Testamenti) F.M. 2,6. c Cujusvis reipublicae et societatis leges et instituta ሕግ፡ appellantur, ut Esth. 1,15; ሰብአ፡ ሕግ፡ legum(Aethiopiae) periti Chron. Ax.; ዘያአምር፡ ሕገጋተ፡ ምኔት፡ qui leges(regulas) coenobii novit F.N. 10; ሕገ፡ ምንኵስና፡ F.N. 10. d Inde በሕግ፡ ex lege, legitime, ut: ብእሲትከ፡ እንተ፡ በሕግ፡ አውሰብከ፡ Mal. 2,14; ቤትኩ፡ ምስሌኪ፡ በሕግ፡ Hez. 16,8; ዘሕግ፡ vel ዘበሕግ፡ legitimus, ut: ሰብሳብ፡ ዘበሕግ፡ Did. 33; ሰብሳብ፡ ዘሕግ፡ Kedr f. 78; Syn.; ዘበሕጉ፡ ἀκολούθως 1 Esr. 7,6, vel በከመ፡ ሕጎሙ፡ 1 Esr. 7,9; ዘበሕጉ፡ νομίμως 2 Tim. 2,5; በከመ፡ ሕግ፡ ወሥርዐት፡ κατὰ τὸ κρίμα 2 Par. 4,20; በከመ፡ ሕጉ፡ ὡς καθήκει Lev. 5,10; ዘእንበለ፡ ሕጉ፡ παρανόμως Act. 23,3; አውስቦ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ሕግ፡ ἀθέμιτοι μίξεις concubitus illegitimi Chrys. Ta. 2. e Denique etiam de lege naturae usurpatur: ሕገ፡ ጠባይዕ፡ ὁ τῆς φύσεως νόμος Chrys. ho. 27(cfr. Rom. 2,15); euphem.: ይፌጽም፡ ሕገ፡ ሥጋ፡ necessitati paret Sx. Nah. 14. f id quod ex lege alicui debetur 1 Reg. 2,13. 2 foedus, testamentum (divinum); διαθήκη (cum voce ሥርዐት፡ tum) voce ሕግ፡ creberrime redditur, ut: ከመ፡ ይኩንከ፡ ሕገ፡ ዘለዓለም፡ Gen. 17,7; Sir. 45,15; መጽሐፈ፡ ሕግ፡ βιβλίον διαθήκης Ex. 24,7; Sir. 24,23; አቀመ፡ ሎቱ፡ ሕገ፡ ዘለዓለም፡ Sir. 45,7; Sir. 14,17; Jer. 11,10; Mal. 2,10; አባእካሁ፡ ውስተ፡ ሕገ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለገብርከ፡ ምስሌከ፡ 1 Reg. 20,8. Inde ሕግ፡ ብሊት፡ Vetus Testamentum F.M. 20,1 (vid. ሐዲስ፡); ሕግ፡ ሐዲስ፡ Hebr. 8,8 seq. – Μαρτύριον Sir. 36,20. 3 regula, norma, ratio, mos, consuetudo: κανών Gal. 6,16; ማእረረ፡ ዘበሕጉ፡ ዐቀበ፡ ለነ፡ Jer. 5,24; ኢትትቃተሎሙ፡ በሕገ፡ ቀትል፡ Judith 7,11; ጠፍአ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሕገ፡ ሥጋ፡ እምኔሁ፡ ei corporis vita a naturae norma prorsus abstracta est Gad. T.H.; እንበይነ፡ ሕግ፡ ob morem i.e. quia moris est Sir. 38,17; በሕገ፡ ፈላሲ፡ ὡς παροίκους 1 Petr. 2,11 rom.; በሕገ፡ እጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡–በሕገ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ κατ᾽ ἀνθρώπους-κατὰ θεόν 1 Petr. 4,6; ኢኮነ፡ ከማሁ፡ ሕጉ፡ οὐχ οὕτως ἔσται Gen. 34,7; ዘኒ፡ እነብብ፡ ሕገ፡ ሰብእ፡ κατὰ ἄνθρωπον λέγω Rom. 3,5 Platt; ሕገ፡ ሰብእ፡ እብለክሙ፡ ἀνθρώπινον λέγω Rom. 6,19; Simon Magus ያግህድ፡ ሕገ፡ ዘስሙ፡ ሲሞናዊ፡ simoniam evulgabit Clem. f. 67; ሕጋ፡ ለቤተ፡ ብለኔ፡ mores balneorum Sx. Ter 22Enc. 4 instituta, ritus, sacra populorum; deinde religio ipsa, quatenus legibus et institutis nititur: τὰ νόμιμα ሕጎሙ፡ Lev. 18,3; ሕገ፡ አሕዛብ፡ Jer. 10,3; ኵሉ፡ ሕገጊሃ፡ πάσας τὰς πανηγύρεις αὐτῆς (conciones populi ad festos peragendos) Hos. 2,13; ሕገ፡ ናእት፡ ἑορτὴ τῶν ἀζύμων solemnitas azymorum Ex. 34,18; በመዋዕሊሁ፡ ያስተርኢ፡ ካልእ፡ ሕግ፡ (sc. Islâm) Clem. f. 75; item in Syn. saepius ሕገ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ religio Christiana memoratur. ḥǝgg, Pl. ḥǝgag, ḥǝgagāt probably a Muslim who has undertaken a pilgrimage to Mecca (based on CR’s explanation, see below) ዘጐለተ፡ ሕግ፡ አሕመድ፡ ነጋድ፡ ራእስ። ‘Celui qui a déterminé la concession du fief a été le ḥeg Aḥmad, le nagād rāʾes’ 29 l. 8–9 (ed.), 33 l. 17–18 (tr.) (‘Probablement حاج {ḥāǧǧ}, musulman qui a accompli le pèlegrinage à la Mecque.’ 33 n. 3) G ሕግ፡ ḥǝgg, Pl. ሕገግ፡ ḥǝgag et ሕገጋት፡ ḥǝgagāt «lois» ― ሕግ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 30r. 65 ሕገጋት፡ ḥǝgagāt code de lois አንበረ፡ ትእዛዛተ፡ ብዙኃተ፡ በርትዕ፡ ወሕገጋተ፡ ዘይሰናአዉ፡ ለጽድቅ። 188. አቀመ፡ ሕገ፡ ʾaqama ḥǝgga «promulguer une loi» ቀንአ፡ ላዕለ፡ ሃይማኖት፡ ኦርቶዶክሳዊት፡ ወአቀመ፡ ሕገ፡ በመዋዕሊሁ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይኅድጉ፡ መነሂ፡ እምሐራ፡ ጥቃ፡ ውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ አህጉራተ፡ ሮም። 219, vid. አቀመ፡ 66 L ሕግ፡ ḥǝgg (Pl. ሕገግ፡ ḥǝgag, ሕገጋት፡ ḥǝgagāt) law, decree, canon, rite, rule, regulation, statute, ordinance, norm, covenant, usage, custom ዘሕግ za-ḥǝgg lawful ዘእንበለ፡ ሕግ zaʾǝnbala ḥǝgg unlawful በሕግ ba-ḥǝgg lawfully, legally ሕገ ḥǝgga (, ) like, like as, just as, according to 227b C a for ሠራዔ፡ ሕግ vid. ሠራዒ፡ (Leslau) b for ታቦተ፡ ሕግ፡ vid. ታቦት፡ (TraCES) c for ጸሓፌ፡ ሕግ፡ vid. ጸሓፊ፡ (Leslau)

woorden.betekenis: sagitta
woorden.definitie: sagitta vid. sub ሐጸየ፡

woorden.betekenis: ascia, securis, dolabra, māḥṣe, māḥḍe, māhḍe, māḥḍeyāt, hach
woorden.definitie: subst. (m.) ascia, securis, dolabra: πλέκυς Ps. 73,7; ἀξίνη Matth. 3,10; σιδήριον 4 Reg. 6,5; 4 Reg. 6,6. – Voc. Ae.: ማሕጼ፡ ዘ፡ ምሳር። māḥṣe, ማሕፄ፡ māḥḍe, ማህፄ፡ māhḍe, Pl. ማሕፄያት፡ māḥḍeyāt G ማሕፄ፡ māḥḍe, Pl. ማሕፄያት፡ māḥḍeyāt «hache» ― መጥረብያ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 35v. 80 L ማሕጼ māḥṣe, () ማሕፄ māḥḍe, () ማህፄ māhḍe axe 337b

woorden.betekenis: minuere, mminuere, deminuere, decurtare, de cibis, sibi, det
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 minuere, mminuere, deminuere, decurtare: ያሐጽጽ፡ ሕዝበ፡ ኀጣይእ፡ Prov. 14,34; ግፍዕ፡ ያሐጽጽ፡ መዋዕለ፡ Fal. f. 39; ሕቀ፡ አሕጸጽኮ፡ እመላእክቲከ፡ Ps. 8,6; ኢያሐጽጹ፡ እምነገራትየ፡ Hen. 104,11; ያሕጽጽ፡ እመባልዕት፡ de cibis(sibi) detrahat F.M. 14,4. 2 justo minus facere vel habere i.e. deficere in re, c.c. Acc. Infin.: ኢያሕጸጽከ፡ አሠንዮ፡ ሎሙ፡ Jsp. p. 333; c. እምነ፡, ut: አሕጸጽኩ፡ እምጽድቅ፡ Job 9,20; ዘአሕጸጽክሙ፡ አንትሙ፡ እመልእክተ፡ ዚአየ፡ τὸ ὑμῶν ὑστέρημα Phil. 2,30; c. Acc.: ዘአንትሙ፡ ዘአሕጸጽክሙ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ፈጸሙ፡ 1 Cor. 16,17; ፸ ዓመተ፡ አሕጸጸ፡ እምዘ፡ ፲፪ ዓመት፡ Kuf. p. 19; abs.: 2 Cor. 8,15; Kuf. p. 84. 3 alicui detrahere a re i.e. a remittere: አልቦ፡ ዘያሐጸክሙ፡ (suff. Dat.) እምጥብዖትክሙ፡ Ex. 5,11; እመቦ፡ ዘኢይክል፡ ቀኖና፡ ኀጢአቱ፡ (poenitentiam statutam) ይደሉ፡ ከመ፡ ያቅልሉ፡ ሎቱ፡ ወያሕጽጹ፡ እምቀኖናቲሁ፡ F.M. 2,11. b jacturam vel detrimentum inferre alicui, detrahere de fama: ለእመ፡ ተአዘዝክሙ፡ (si obtemperaveritis) ኢያሐሥመክሙ፡ ወኢያሐጽጸክሙ፡ ተአዝዞ፡ በከመ፡ ኢሐጾሙ፡ ለእለ፡ ቀደሙክሙ፡ Jsp. p. 360; ኢያነውሮ፡ ለብእሲ፡ ወኢያሐጽጾ፡ ከመ፡ ይትአዘዝ፡ Jsp. p. 360. 4 inferiorem existimare, vilipendere: Aristobulos ተቀጸለ፡ ጌራ፡ ዐቢየ፡ ዲበ፡ ርእሱ፡ አሕጺጾ፡ ጌራ፡ ክህነት፡ ቅዱስ፡ Jsp. p. 301. ʾaḥṣaṣa G አሕጸጸ፡ ʾaḥṣaṣa II,1 ያሐጽጽ፡, ያሕጽጽ፡ «faire diminuer, rendre moindre, petit, manquant» ― አጐደለ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 30v. 67 L አሕጸጸ ʾaḥṣaṣa decrease, detract, subtract, diminish, reduce, lessen, abate, make less, make few, omit, make inferior, slight, belittle አሕጸጸ፡ ርእሶ ʾaḥṣaṣa rǝʾso he humiliated himself, vid. ርእስ፡ 247b

woorden.betekenis: incubavit ova; in ulnas cepit puerum; educavit; removit, imp
woorden.definitie: (etiam per ጸ) I,1 [i.q. حَضَنَ incubavit ova; in ulnas cepit puerum; educavit; removit, impedivit; vicina ሐጸረ፡ q.v. et حَصَنَ (ሐነጸ፡); notio prima est in circumdando et tuendo] Subj. ይሕፅን፡ (rarius ይሕፀን፡ Ex. 2,9), 1 sinu fovere, in manibus gestare, ut: ውስተ፡ ሕፅን፡ ኢሐፀኑኪ፡ (ἐν σπαργάνοις οὐκ ἐσπαργανώθης) Hez. 16,4. 2 nutrire, nutricare, educare parvulos, pueros (τρέφειν ἐκτρέφειν τροφεύειν). a de hominibus, qui nutriunt α infantes lactentes, θηλάζειν (lactare): ተሐፅን፡ ሳራ፡ ሕፃነ፡ Gen. 21,7; Ex. 2,7; Ex. 2,9; 1 Reg. 1,23; Luc. 11,27; እለ፡ የሐፅና፡ αἱ θηλάζουσαι Matth. 24,19; እንተ፡ ተሐፅኖ፡ ወታጠብዎ፡ Kuf. 47; እንተ፡ ሐፀነተኒ፡ (ἡ συλλαβοῦσά με) Cant. 3,4. β pueros in genere: አሐፅኖ፡ እምንእሱ፡ Job 31,18; Tob. 14,10; Zach. 10,9; 4 Esr. 9,45; ወለት፡ እንተ፡ ሐፀና፡ παῖς θρεπτή alumna ejus Esth. 2,7; Eph. 6,4; መፍትው፡ ሕዝበ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ እለ፡ አልቦሙ፡ ውሉድ፡ ይሕፅንዎሙ፡ ለእጓለ፡ ማውታ፡ Did. 18. γ senes: የሐፅኖ፡ ለሢበትኪ፡ Ruth 4,15. δ animalia 2 Reg. 12,3. ε capillum (alere): ለዕደው፡ ኢይደልዎሙ፡ ሐፂኖቱ፡ ወጸፊሮቱ፡ ለሥዕርቶሙ፡ F.N. 51. b de Deo: አምላክ፡ ዘሐፀነክሙ፡ Bar. 4,8; Ps. 22,2; Gen. 48,15. c de animalibus, in spec. de avibus (fovere, incubare, nidulari, nutrire): ተሐፅን፡ ውስተ፡ መሬት፡ (እጐሊሃ፡) ἐπὶ χοῦν θάλψει Job 39,14; ርግብ፡ እለ፡ የሐፅና፡ ውስተ፡ ኰኵሕ፡ νοσσεύουσαι Jer. 31,28; ከመ፡ ዖፍ፡ እንተ፡ ተሐቅፍ፡ አንቆቅሆ፡ ወተሐፅን፡ እጐሊሃ፡ እስከ፡ ሶበ፡ ይሰርራ፡ Did. 6. d de inanimatis: ማይ፡ የሐፅኖ፡ (ለዕፅ፡) Hez. 31,4. ḥaḍana, ḥaṣana G ሐፀነ፡ ḥaḍana የሐፅን፡, ይሕፅን፡ «élever, nourrir, allaiter» ― አሳደገ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 31r. 67 L ሐፀነ ḥaḍana (yǝḥḍǝn) hold in the lap, nurse, nourish, suckle, feed, rear, bring up, train, educate, foster, take care of (one’s young) 226b

woorden.betekenis: nutriri, lactari, educari, Christus, taḥaḍna, être élevé, no
woorden.definitie: III,1 nutriri, (lactari), educari: ተሐፀንኩ፡ በጥብ፡ Job 3,12; ትትሐፀኒ፡ በሐሊበ፡ አሕዛብ፡ Jes. 60,16; Jes. 66,11; ዘከመ፡ ተሐፀንኪ፡ ውስተ፡ እዴየ፡ Esth. 4,8; ደቂቅ፡ እለ፡ ተሐፅኑ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ 2 Par. 10,8; 3 Reg. 12,8; Luc. 4,16; በናዝሬት፡ ኀበ፡ ተሐፅነ፡ (ክርስቶስ፡) Deg.; Christus ተሐፅነ፡ ምስለ፡ ሰብእ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ኀጢአት፡ Did. 33; ተሐፅነ፡ በኵሉ፡ ምግባረ፡ ሠናይ፡ Sx. Teq. 13; de animalibus: ይትሐፀኑ፡ እጐላቲሆሙ፡ ኅቡረ፡ Jes. 11,7. taḥaḍna G ተሐፅነ፡ taḥaḍna III,1 ይትሐፀን፡ «être élevé, nourri» ― አደገ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 31r. 67 L ተሐፅነ taḥaḍna passive {of vid. ሐፀነ ḥaḍana} 226b

woorden.betekenis: nutritio, educatio, ḥǝḍnat, nursing, nourishing, education,
woorden.definitie: n. act. nutritio, educatio: ለዝንቱ፡ ቅዱስ፡ (ቄርሎስ፡) ሐፀኖ፡ ሠናየ፡ ሕፅነተ፡ ቴዎፍሎስ፡ እኅወ፡ እሙ፡ Cyr. f. 2; Org.; ዘያሤኒ፡ ሕፅነተ፡ ደቂቁ፡ F.N. 5. ḥǝḍnat L ሕፅነት ḥǝḍnat nursing, nourishing, education, tutelage, upbringing 226b

woorden.betekenis: infans, parvulus, parvu, la, puer, puella, adolescens, ḥǝḍān
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem. (Marc. 5,39; Marc. 5,40; Matth. 9,24), Pl. ሕፃናት፡ infans, parvulus, parvu la, puer et puella; adolescens (quamdiu nondum sui juris est); infans modo genitus Gen. 21,3; Ruth 4,16; βρέφη 1 Petr. 2,2; θηλάζων Ps. 8,3; Judith 16,4; Ex. 2, seq.; παιδίον Matth. 2,13; Gen. 44,22 seq.; Jes. 9,6; Jes. 9,10; Jes. 9,19; ሕፃን፡ ንስቲት፡ Jes. 11,6; ሕፃን፡ ንኡስ፡ Jes. 11,8; τέκνα Jes. 13,18; νήπιος Job 3,16; Job 24,12; Job 33,25; Jer. 6,11; Jer. 9,21; Jer. 50,6; Thren. 1,5; Thren. 2,19; Ps. 114,6; Rom. 2,20; 1 Cor. 3,1; ሕፃን፡ ውእቱ፡ ወልደ፡ ፲ወ፬ ዓመት፡ Kuf. 11; de Ismaële domo patris expulso Gen. 21,14; Kuf. 17; de Benjamino Gen. 43, 8 seq.; de adolescente septendecim annos nato 2 Par. 34,3; de Salomone ወሬዛ፡ ወሕፃን፡ νέος καὶ ἁπαλός 1 Par. 29,1; de Davide (παιδάριον) 1 Reg. 17,33. ḥǝḍān, Pl. ḥǝḍānāt G ሕፃን፡ ḥǝḍān, Pl. ሕፃናት፡ ḥǝḍānāt «enfant des deux genres» ― ልጅ፡, እጣን፡, ሕፃን፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 31r. 68 L ሕፃን ḥǝḍān (Pl. ሕፃናት፡ ḥǝḍānāt) infant, young child, page 226b

woorden.betekenis: nutritor, altor, tutor, nutrix, nutricula, ḥaḍāni, ḥaḍānit,
woorden.definitie: n. ag., fem. ሐፃኒት፡, Pl. c. ሐፃንያት፡ (gramm. § 133,a) et ሐፀንት፡ a m. nutritor, altor, tutor: መምህር፡ ወሐፃኒ፡ διδάσκαλος καὶ τροφεύς Chrys. ho. 34; ሐፀንተ፡ ደቂቁ፡ τιθηνοί 4 Reg. 10,1; 4 Reg. 10,5; crebrius in F.N. 24; F.N. 32; እስመ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ኮንዎ፡ ሐፃንያተ፡ (σύμβουλοι) 2 Par. 22,4. b fem. nutrix, nutricula ἅβρα Gen. 24,61; Judith 8,10; τροφός Gen. 35,8; 2 Par. 22,11; 1 Thess. 2,7; Bar. 4,8; Ex. 2,7; ሐፃንያቲኪ፡ Jes. 49,23; Kuf. 32; τιτθίς Chrys. Ta. 11; τιθηνός 2 Reg. 4,4; Ruth 4,16; ወልደ፡ ሐፃኒቱ፡ σύντροφος Act. 13,1. ḥaḍāni, fem. ḥaḍānit; Pl. ḥaḍānǝyān, ḥaṣant, fem. ḥaḍānǝyāt G ሐፃኒ፡ ḥaḍāni, Pl. ሐፃንያን፡ ḥaḍānǝyān «nourricier, éleveur» ― አሳዳጊ፡, ሞግዚት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 31r. ሐፃኒት፡ ḥaḍānit fem., Pl. ሐፃንያት፡ ḥaḍānǝyāt «nourrice (balia)» ― ሞግዚት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 31r. 67 L ሐፃኒ ḥaḍāni act. part. of ሐፀነ ḥaḍana; also tutor, guardian of children, educator ሐፃኒት ḥaḍānit (fem. of ሐፃኒ ḥaḍāni) nurse, wet nurse 226b

woorden.betekenis: alvus materna, uterus, matrix, māḥḍan, māḥǝḍan, maḥāḍǝn, māḥ
woorden.definitie: subst., fem. et m., Pl. መሓፅን፡ (Gen. 49,25) et ማሕፀናት፡ (Chrys. ho. 23) alvus materna, uterus, matrix (μήτρα): ማሕፀን፡ መካን፡ Hos. 9,14; Ps. 70,7; Rom. 4,19; Job 3,16; Jer. 20,17; Judith 9,2; 4 Esr. 2,48; 4 Esr. 2,50; 4 Esr. 2,51 (ubi Laur. ማሕፅን፡ exhibet); 4 Esr. 3,59; 4 Esr. 8,12; ዘእንበለ፡ ትፃእ፡ እማሕፀን፡ Jer. 1,5; እንዘ፡ ባ፡ ውስተ፡ ማሕፀና፡ Matth. 1,18; ዐጸዋ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለማሕፀን፡ Gen. 20,18; አርኀወ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ማሕፀነ፡ ልያ፡ Kuf. 28; ፈትሐ፡ ማሕፀና፡ Gen. 29,31; በኵር፡ ዘይፈትሕ፡ ማሕፀነ፡ Num. 3,12; Ex. 34,19; Luc. 2,23; ተሀውከ፡ ማሕፀና፡ በእንተ፡ ወልዳ፡ 3 Reg. 3b,26; አፈ፡ ማሕፀን፡ Hen. 62,4. māḥḍan, māḥǝḍan, Pl. መሓፅን፡ maḥāḍǝn, ማሕፃናት māḥ(ǝ)ḍānāt G ማሕፀን፡ māḥḍan, Pl. መሓፅን፡ maḥāḍǝn «matrice, vulve» ― Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 31r. 68 L ማሕፀን māḥǝḍan (Pl. መሓፅን maḥāḍǝn, ማሕፃናት māḥǝḍānāt) bosom, womb, mother’s lap, uterus 226b

woorden.betekenis: tutelae, custodiae, fidei, committere, commendare, concreder
woorden.definitie: quadril. II tutelae, custodiae, fidei alicujus committere vel commendare, concredere alicui, deponere apud aliquem; c.c. Acc. rei et ኀበ፡ pers.: ብሩር፡ ዘአማሕፀነ፡ ኀበ፡ ራጉኤል፡ (supra አዕቀበ፡) Tob. 4,1; 1 Petr. 4,19; Ps. 58,10; F.N. 29; Org. 2; c. ውስተ፡ እደ፡ pers., ut: Ps. 30,6; Luc. 23,46; c. dupl. Acc.: ናሁ፡ አማሕፀንኩ፡ ወለትየ፡ ማሕፀንተ፡ Tob. 10,12; Ex. 22,7; Lev. 5,21; 1 Tim. 1,18; 2 Tim. 1,12; Luc. 12,48; Rom. 16,1; Herm. p. 85; F.N. 29. ʾamāḥḍana, አማኅፀነ፡ ʾamāḫḍana G አማኅፀነ፡ ʾamāḫḍana, quadrl. II, ያመኀፅን፡, ያማኅፅን፡ «mettre en dépôt, recommander, déposer» ― አደራ፡ ሰጠ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 40r. 96 L mḥḍn አማሕፀነ ʾamāḥḍana, () አማኅፀነ፡ ʾamāḫḍana entrust, give in deposit, commit to someone’s care, hand over into the care of, put under protection, commend, recommend, confide 335a

woorden.betekenis: donum sponsalicium, dos., nec duplicatione accepti mulctetur
woorden.definitie: subst. m. et. fem. 1 a donum sponsalicium, quod sponsus futurae uxori in peculium dat; b dos. c De eo in F.N. 24 praecipitur: እመ፡ ፈቀደ፡ ደኃሪ፡ አው፡ ዘተፍኅረት፡ ምንኵስና፡ እምድኅረ፡ ወሀበ፡ ሕፄ፡ ይደልዎ፡ ለደኃሪ፡ ዘወሀባ፡ ቅድመ፡ ከመ፡ ይንሣእ፡ ወለፍኅርቱኒ፡ ከመ፡ ታግብእ፡ ዘነሥአቶ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ካዕበት፡ (nec duplicatione accepti mulctetur); deinde 24,3, ubi voces ዐረቦን፡ ዘፍኅረት፡ et ሕፄ፡ promiscue usurpantur, haec statuuntur: እምከመ፡ አበየ፡ ነሣኢሁ፡ (ለዐራቦን፡) እምድኅረ፡ ተመጠወ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ወገደፋ፡ ለተሰናእዎ፡ (consensum mutuum dissolvit) ይሚጥ፡ ዘአኀዘ፡ ገቢሮ፡ ካዕበተ፡ (reddat, quod accepit, duplicatum) ወእመ፡ ሞተት፡ ይእቲ፡ ብእሲት፡ ለያግብእ፡ (repetat) ደኃሪሃ፡ እምሰብአ፡ ዚአሃ፡ ዘወሀበ፡ በእንቲአሃ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ መብልዕ፡ ወመስቴ፡ ዘወሀበ። ወለእመ፡ ሞተ፡ ውእቱ፡ ብእሲ፡ ዘሎቱ፡ ሕፄ፡ (a quo donum datum est) ወአልቦቱ፡ ወራሲ፡ ይኅድጉ፡ ላቲ፡ ዘነሥአት፡ እምኀቤሁ፡ ወእመሰ፡ ቦቱ፡ ወራስያን፡ ያግብኡ፡ ሎሙ፡ መንፈቀ፡ ንዋዩ፡ ወመንፈቁ፡ ይትርፍ፡ ላቲ። Ibidem ሕፄ፡ distinguitur ab አምኃ፡ i.e. muneribus variis, quae salutandi causa sponsus sponsae dat. – In Bibliis respondet φέρνη מֹהַר: Gen. 34,12; Ex. 22,16 donum quod parentibus mulieris datur. d Jos. 16,10 dos quae a patre filiae datur; item ይደሉ፡ አውስቦ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ትልወት፡ ወኢሕፄ፡ F.N. 24,3; ዘጸሐፈ፡ ትእዛዘ፡ (i.e. testator) የሀብ፡ ለአዌልዲሁ፡ ለለ፩ መክፈክተ፡ ሕፄሆን፡ F.N. 41,4. 2 donatio sponsalicia, emtio sponsae: F.N. 24,2; F.N. 24,3 ut: ዕድሜ፡ ሐዘን፡ (tempus luctus definitum) ይከልእ፡ እምአውስቦ፡ (nuptias) ወኢይከልእ፡ እምሕፄ፡ ወእምፍኅረት። ḥǝḍe, ሕጼ፡ ḥǝṣe G ሕጼ፡ ḥǝṣe «donation de l’époux à l’épouse ou à ses parents, à l’ocassion des fiançailles» ― እጅ፡ መንሻ፡ ማጫ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 31r. 68 L ሕፄ ḥǝḍe () betrothal, dowry 226b

woorden.betekenis: pernicitate, agilitate, sollertiae, sollertem reddere, docer
woorden.definitie: I,2 et I,1 [prima radicis potestas est in pernicitate et agilitate (vid. מָהַר); hinc ducitur notio sollertiae (מָהִיר, ܡܗܺܝܪܳܐ, مَهَرَ, مَاهِرٌ); denique in Geez stirps I,2 et I,1 significat sollertem reddere i.e. docere; amh. ማረ፡ id.] Imperf. plerumque ይሜህር፡ I,2, sed etiam: ይመህር፡ I,1 (4 Esr. 8,15) vel ይምህር፡ (Jes. 29,13; 4 Esr. 10,53; al.); Subj. ይመህር፡ vel ይምህር፡ I,2 (Luc. 1,1 rom.; Deut. 6,1; pro qua forma etiam ይማህር፡ reperitur, ut Deut. 4,36) et ይምሀር፡ I,1 (Ps. 50,14; Deut. 20,18; 1 Tim. 2,12; al.), Imperat. መህር፡ et ምህር፡ I,2 (Matth. 28,19 rom.; Ps. 118,26; Ps. 118,33; Ps. 141,11 al.; pro qua forma etiam ማህር፡ reperitur, ut Deut. 4,9) et መሀር፡ I,1 (Matth. 28,19 Platt; Prov. 29,17; al.) Infin. ምሂር፡ (1 Tim. 4,13), ምህሮ፡ (Rom. 1,16; 1 Tim. 5,17), ምህሮት፡ (Sir. 42,5; Marc. 11,18) et ምሂሮት፡ (Matth. 7,28 rom.). 1 docere a absol. 1 Tim. 2,12; Matth. 4,23. Matth. 11,1. b c. Acc. pers.: Matth. 5,2; Rom. 2,21; Ps. 70,18; Ps. 118,102; et c. ለ pers.: Rom. 2,21; Hebr. 8,11; Deut. 4,10. c c. Acc. rei: ይምህሩ፡ ትምህርተ፡ ትእዛዛተ፡ ሰብእ፡ Jes. 29,13; ይሜህር፡ ምክረ፡ Job 22,2; Phil. 1,16; Rom. 1,16, et c. በእንተ፡ rei 4 Esr. 10,53; Luc. 1,1. d c. dupl. Acc. Ps. 50,14; Ps. 118,26; Ps. 118,33; Deut. 4,14; Deut. 5,28; Deut. 6,7; 4 Reg. 17,27; 4 Esr. 8,15; Koh. 12,9; መሀሮ፡ አቡሁ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ Kuf. 7; Kuf. 47; Dan. 1,4; Job 33,33; Sir. 45,5; Joh. 14,26; Hebr. 5,12. e verba si subjunguntur, adhibetur Acc. Infin.: ትሜህር፡ እገሪሃ፡ ሐዊረ፡ Deut. 28,56; Deut. 20,18; Hen. 8,1; Kuf. 3, vel ለ፡ c. Infin., ut: ምህረኒ፡ ለገቢር፡ Ps. 142,11, vel Subj., ut: Matth. 28,19; Deut. 6,1. 2 instituere, erudire (παιδεύειν, etiam νουθετεῖν admonere): መሀር፡ ወልደከ፡ Prov. 29,17; ምህረኒ፡ እግዚኦ፡ Jer. 10,24; ገሠጾ፡ ወመሀረ፡ Sir. 7,23; Sir. 18,13; Sir. 30,2; Prov. 5,13; Prov. 9,7; Rom. 15,14; 1 Cor. 4,14; 1 Thess. 5,12. mahara, ምህረ፡ mǝhra G መሀረ፡ mahara I,2 ይሜህር፡, ይመህር፡ «enseigner, instruire» ― አስተማረ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 32r. ምህረ፡ mǝhra I,1 ይምህር፡, ይምሀር፡ «enseigner, instruire» ― አስተማረ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 32r. 71 Subjonctif ይምሀር፡ I,1 de forme stative ወባህለ፡ ዳንኤል፡ ነቢይ፡ ከመ፡ ይምሐሩነ፡ ከመ፡ መንግሥተ፡ ክርስቶስ፡ ለዓለም፡ ወለዓለመ፡ ዓለም፡ ይሄሉ፡ እስመ፡ መንግሥቱኒ፡ ኢኮነ፡ ከመ፡ መንግሥተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ዓለም፡ ሐላፊ፡ ወማሳኒ። 639. 72 L መሀረ፡ mahara (yǝmhǝr), (, Lt) ምህረ፡ mǝhra teach, instruct, educate, train, discipline 334

woorden.betekenis: doceri, institui, condocefieri, discere, addiscere, discendo
woorden.definitie: et ተምህረ፡ III,2; rarissime III,1 (gramm. § 97,2) 1 doceri, institui, condocefieri: Jes. 55,12; Kuf. 3; ከመ፡ ትትመሀር፡ Sir. 6,32; Prov. 29,19; እስከ፡ ይትሜሀሩ፡ ብዙኃን፡ Dan. 12,4; ኀበ፡ ይትመሀሩ፡ (sic) አፍራስ፡ ἱπποδρόμα II Const. Ap. 24; እለ፡ ይትመሀሩ፡ (sic) οἱ κατηχούμενοι Can. Neocaes. 5; c.c. Acc. vel በ፡ rei: ኢይትሜሀሩ፡ እንከ፡ ቀትለ፡ Jes. 2,4; Luc. 1,4; ተምህርኩ፡ በሕገ፡ አበውየ፡ Act. 22,3. 2 discere, addiscere: ተመሀር፡ μάθε Job 34,36; 1 Tim. 2,11; c.c. Acc. rei: እመ፡ ተምህሮ፡ ተምህሩ፡ ፍኖትየ፡ Jer. 12,16; ተምህረ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ vel ፀብአ፡ Kuf. 4; Kuf. 19; Sir. 8,8; Sir. 9,1; ተመሀሩ፡ ጽድቀ፡ δικαιοσύνην μάθετε Jes. 26,9; ተመሀርዋ፡ ለአትሕቶ፡ ርእስክሙ፡ 1 Petr. 5,5; Hen. 83,2; c. Acc. Infin.: ርግብ፡ ዘይትሜሀር፡ ሰሪረ፡ Hez. 7,16; ተምህረ፡ መሢጠ፡ Hez. 19,3; Deut. 4,10; Jes. 28,19; ተመሀሩ፡ ገቢረ፡ ሠናይ፡ Jes. 1,17; በኀበ፡ vel እምነ፡ pers., a qua discitur: እሙንቱሂ፡ በኀበ፡ አበዊሆሙ፡ ተመሀሩ፡ Sir. 8,9; 1 Thess. 1,8; ተምህረ፡ እምኔሁ፡ ኵሎ፡ ትምህርታተ፡ Cyr. f. 2. 3 discendo et meditando versari in re, studere rei (μελετᾶν {DiL μελετᾷν}, quod alias አንበበ፡ verti solet): ኢትትመሀር፡ ነፍስየ፡ ኀጢአተ፡ Job 27,4; Prov. 15,28; Prov. 24,2; διαλέγεσθαι et νοεῖσθαι ἔν τινι Sir. 14,20; Sir. 14,21. tamahara, tamǝhra G ተመሀረ፡ tamahara III,2 ይትሜሀር፡, ይትመሀር፡ «être enseigné, être instruit, apprendre» ― ተማረ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 32r. ተምህረ፡ tamǝhra III,1 ይትመሀር፡ «être enseigné, être instruit, apprendre» ― ተማረ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 32r. 71 L ተመሀረ tamahara, ተምህረ፡ tamǝhra be taught, be instructed, learn, be skilled, be versed in, be disciplined 334a

woorden.betekenis: doctor, magister, praeceptor, Patres ecclesiae, mamhǝr, mamḥ
woorden.definitie: part. (gramm. § 114,a) 1 doctor, magister, praeceptor: መምህረ፡ ሕግ፡ νομοθέτης Ps. 9,21; Ps. 83,7; καθηγητής Matth. 23,8; Matth. 23,10; διδάσκαλος Joh. 3,2; Rom. 2,20; Act. 5,34; 1 Cor. 12,28; Eph. 4,11; Hebr. 5,12; 1 Tim. 2,7; 2 Tim. 1,11; Jac. 3,1; ἐξηγητής Prov. 29,18; ሐዋርያት፡ እሙንቱ፡ መምህራኒክሙ፡ ለትእዛዘ፡ ክርስቶስ፡ II Const. Ap. 4; Did. creberrime; መምህራነ፡ ቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ Patres ecclesiae Sx. Hed. 24; al. Fem. መምህርት፡ Sx. Haml. 25. 2 Titulus honorificus est (tamquam doctor, magister), ex. gr. priorum monasteriis praepositorum, Lud. Pariter መምህርት፡ fem. 1 Reg. 4,14 titulus matronae esse videtur. mamhǝr, መምሕር፡ mamḥǝr, fem. መምህርት፡ mamhǝrt; Pl. መምህራን፡ mamhǝrān, fem. መምህራት፡ mamhǝrāt abbot ወመምህርሂ፡ ዘሃሌ፡ ሉያ፡ ገብረ፡ መርዓዊ፡ ‘le supérieur de Hāllē-Luyā, Gabra Marʿāwi’ 37 l. 19–20 (ed.), 44 l. 8–9 (tr.); ወመምህር፡ ዘለጋሳ፡ አባ፡ አርጋኖን፡ ‘le supérieur de Lagāso, abbā Argānon’ 45 l. 21 (ed.), 54 l. 23 (tr.); ወድኅረ፡ ሶበ፡ ተራከቡ፡ በፍትሕ፡ መነኮሳት፡ ወቶማስ፡ ረትዕዎ፡ መነኮሳት፡ በብዙኅ፡ ምስክር፡ ከመ፡ ኢይሠየሙ፡ ጸሐፍት፡ ወባዕዳን፡ እንበለ፡ መምሕር፡ ዘኃረይዎ፡ መነኮሳተ፡ ደብር፡ ውለውእቱ፡ መምሕር፡ ይሠይሞ፡ ንጉሥ፡ በአክሊል፡ ወውራጅ፡ ‘Ensuite, quand Tomās et les moines comparurent en justice, les moines, triomphèrent en démontrant par des témoins nombreux que ni les ṣaḥaft ni d’autres n’étaient nommés [par le roi], hormis le supérieur [du couvent], que les moines du couvent choisissaient et que le roi nommait en lui donnant la couronne et le warrāǧ’ 45 l. 29, 46 l. 1–4 (ed.), 55 l. 6–10 (tr.); ወሠያጢሁኒ፡ አባ፡ ተክለ፡ መንፈስ፡ ቅዱስ፡ መምሕር፡ ወኵሎሙ፡ መነኮሳት፡ ዘእንዞና። ‘Les vendeurs étaient abbā Takla Manfas Qedus, supérieur, et tous les moines d’Enzonā’ 47 l. 24–25 (ed.), 57 l. 14–15 (tr.); ወውእቶሙሂ፡ መምሕራን፡ ዘተጋብኡ፡ እም፻ወ፶፡ አድባር፡ ምስለ፡ ሊቆሙ፡ አባ፡ አሣዕነ፡ ማርያም፡ ዘደብረ፡ አቡነ፡ ሳሙኤል፡ ‘Les supérieurs, qui s’étaient rassemblés de 150 couvents avec leur chef abba Asāʿena Māryām de Dabra abuna Sāmuʾēl’ 76 l. 4–6 (ed.), 91 l. 19–21 (tr.) (‘a mämhǝr of a monk is, as a rule, the abbot of the monastery who gives monastic habit when a novice becomes a monk. The monk is däqiq {vid. ደቂቅ፡} or “(spiritual) child” or disciple of the abbot from whom he receives the habit and whom he would call “father”.’ 6 n. 29) G መምህር፡ mamhǝr, Pl. መምህራን፡ mamhǝrān «maître d’école, professeur, docteur, chef d’une église monastique» ― መምር፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 32r. 71 መምህርት፡ mamhǝrt fem., Pl. መምህራት፡ mamhǝrāt «maîtresse d’école, abbesse» ― አለቃይቱ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 32r. 71 መምህርና፡ mamhǝrǝnnā titre de docteur Cette formation abstraite, obtenue par le moyen de la désinence ና፡, manque dans le . ― Texte et référence: ይደሉ፡ ሎቱ... ስመ፡ መምህርና። Ms. BNFet110, fol. 78r. 72 L መምህር mamhǝr teacher, instructor, master, superior, abbot, prior of a monastery መምህረ፡ ኦሪት mamhǝra ʾorit doctor of the law that is, the Octateuch, vid. ኦሪት፡ መምህርት mamhǝrt (fem. of መምህር mamhǝr) abbess መምህርና mamhǝrǝnnā (72) title of doctor 334a C for አፈ፡ መምህር፡ vid. አፍ፡

woorden.betekenis: doctrina, disciplina, scientia, literae, ars, Didascaliae, d
woorden.definitie: subst., Pl. ትምህርታት፡ 1 id quod docetur et discitur, i.e. doctrina, disciplina, scientia, (literae, ars) διδασκαλία Matth. 15,9; Sir. 24,33; ትምህርተ፡ ዲድስቅልያ፡ ዘአበው፡ ቅዱሳን፡ ሐዋርያት፡ est titulus Didascaliae Did.; διδαχή Joh. 7,16; Hebr. 6,2; 2 Joh. 9,10; Asc. Jes. 3,13; Asc. Jes. 3,21; περὶ ὧν κατηχήθης λόγων Luc. 1,4; coll. Rom. 7,6; in N.T. εὐαγγέλιον vel κήρυγμα saepius vertitur: ትምህርተ፡ ወንጌል፡ Phil. 2,22 vel ትምህርት፡ 1 Cor. 15,14; Gal. 1,6; Rom. 1,1; Rom. 15,16; Phil. 1,27; Phil. 4,15; 1 Thess. 1,5; τὸ λόγιον (revelatio) Jes. 30,11; ἐπιστήμη Job 12,12; Job 36,3; Koh. 1,17; Koh. 12,11; Ex. 35,31; Kuf. 4; Kuf. 7; Hen. 10,8; μαθήματα Jer. 13,21; ትምህርተ፡ ኤፊቆሮስ፡ disciplina Epicuri Act. 17,18 Platt; Cyrillus illuminavit totum mundum በትምህርታቲሁ፡ Cyr. f. 1. Etiam experientia: ብዙኀ፡ ትምህርት፡ πολυπειρία Sir. 25,6. 2 institutio, eruditio, disciplina (puerorum, discipulorum); ingenii animique cultus; studium: በትምህርተ፡ ዳዊት፡ ἐπὶ χεῖρας Δαβίδ 2 Esr. 3,10; διδασκαλία prov. 2,17; 2 Tim. 3,16; Rom. 12,7; παιδεία Prov. 8,10; Prov. 15,12; Prov. 16,22; Sir. 21,19; Job 20,3; ነፍሳት፡ እለ፡ አልቦን፡ ትምህርት፡ ἀπαίδευτοι ψυχαί Sap. 17,1; ወልድ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ትምህርት፡ Prov. 17,21; ኢትነሥኡኑ፡ ትምህርተ፡ Jer. 42,13; ትምህርተ፡ ሰላምነ፡ Jes. 53,5; νουθεσία Eph. 6,4; ትምህርታት፡ ወተግሣጻት፡ Sx. Masc. 20; Sx. Teq. 23; μελέτη Koh. 12,12. tǝmǝhǝrt, tǝmǝrt; tǝm(h)ǝrtāt G ትምህርት፡ tǝmhǝrt, Pl. ትምህርታት፡ tǝmhǝrtāt «doctrine, science» ― ትምርት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 32r. 72 L ትምህርት፡ tǝm(h)ǝrt teaching, study, learning, education, erudition, doctrine, dogma, method, discipline, science, ability, skill 334a

woorden.betekenis: misereri
woorden.definitie: misereri vid. sub ምሕረ፡

woorden.betekenis: evellere
woorden.definitie: evellere vid. sub መልኀ፡

woorden.betekenis: salli, sale condiri, tamalḥa, tamallǝḥa, être assaisonné, be
woorden.definitie: III,1 et III,2 salli, sale condiri Marc. 9,49; ኵሉ፡ በጼው፡ ይትመላሕ፡ Clem. f. 112; Sx. Haml. 7. tamalḥa, tamallǝḥa G ተመልሐ፡ tamallǝḥa III,2 ይትሜላህ፡, ይትመላሕ፡ «être assaisonné» ― ተጣፈጠ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 33r. 74 L ተመልሐ tamalḥa, tamallǝḥa passive of vid. መልሐ፡; also be salty 343a

woorden.betekenis: pergere
woorden.definitie: pergere vid. sub መልዐ፡

woorden.betekenis: impleri, repleri, expleri, compleri, ad finem perduci, tamal
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 impleri, repleri, expleri c. Acc. Ex. 40,28; Deut. 34,9; 4 Esr. 6,43 var.; Hen. 48,1; c. እምነ፡, ut: ተመልአት፡ አየር፡ እምነ፡ መላእክት፡ Sx. Hed. 27. 2 compleri, ad finem perduci Hen. 74,10. tamalʾa G ተመልአ፡ tamalʾa III,1 ይትመላእ፡ «être rempli (peu usité)» ― ተመላ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 33v. 75 L ተመልአ tamalʾa filled itself, become full, be filled, be completed 342a

woorden.betekenis: plenus, repletus, completus, luna plena, abundans, exuberans
woorden.definitie: part. 1 plenus, repletus, completus Ruth 1,21; Ps. 143,15; Matth. 14,20; Matth. 15,37; c. st. constr. ut ምሉኣነ፡ ጥበብ፡ Sx. Teq. 26vel c. እምነ፡ ut Hen. 28,2; ምልእት፡ እምኵሉ፡ ጸጋ፡ ወጥበብ፡ Sx. Hed. 10; 4 Esr. 5,4; ሣፁን፡ ዘምሉእ፡ እምወርቅ፡ ወእምብሩር፡ Lud. e mss. Colb.; at plerumque c. Acc.: ሀገር፡ እንተ፡ ምልእት፡ ሕዝበ፡ Thren. 1,1; ጽዋዕ፡ ምሉእ፡ ማየ፡ 4 Esr. 14,41; ገዳም፡ ወምሉእ፡ ውእቱ፡ አዕጽምተ፡ ሰብእ፡ Hez. 37,1; ምሉእ፡ አዕይንተ፡ Hez. 1,18; Hez. 10,12; ምሉእ፡ መቅሠፍተ፡ መዐት፡ Job 14,1; Jes. 1,4; Prov. 6,34; Ps. 9,29; Ps. 25,10; Cant. 6,5; Hen. 27,1. De luna: ወርኅ፡ ምልእት፡ luna plena Sir. 50,6 vel ወርኅ፡ ምሉአ፡ ብርሃን፡ Abush. 13; de urbe incolis frequente: ኀልቀት፡ ምልእት፡ Hez. 26,2. 2 abundans, exuberans, copiosus Jes. 31,1; ማይ፡ ብዙኅ፡ ወምሉእ፡ Jes. 28,2; Ex. 5,5; ባሕር፡ ዐቢይ፡ ወርሒብ፡ እንተ፡ ምልእት፡ ውስቴታ፡ አራዊት፡ Chrys. Ta. 34; ምሉእ፡ ውስተ፡ አዕይንቲሆሙ፡ ዝሙት፡ ወኀጢአት፡ 2 Petr. 2,14 (vid. መልአ፡ Nr. 3 completus, integer: አኮ፡ በምልእት፡ ወፍጽምት፡ ልብ፡ 2 Par. 25,2. 4 implens: ደም፡ ምሉእ፡ እደዊክሙ፡ Jes. 59,3; ምሉእ፡ ቤተ፡ (v. ቤት፡) ስብሐቲሁ፡ Jes. 6,1; ምሉእ፡ (v. መልአ፡) ኵሎ፡ ምድረ፡ ስብሐቲከ፡ 6,3. (De Jes. 18,7 vid. sub ምሉኅ፡). mǝluʾ, fem. ምልእት፡ mǝlǝʾt; Pl. ምሉኣን፡ mǝluʾān, fem. ምሉኣት፡ mǝluʾāt G ምሉእ፡ mǝluʾ, Pl. ምሉኣን፡ mǝluʾān «plein» ― የመላ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 33v. 75 ምልእት፡ mǝlǝʾt fem., Pl. ምሉኣት፡ mǝluʾāt «pleine» ― የመላች፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 33v. 76 L ምሉእ፡ mǝluʾ full, filled, abundant, copiuos, replenished, complete 342a C for ምሕላ፡ በጐደሎ vid. ምሕልላ፡

woorden.betekenis: plenitudo, totus, universus, omnes omnino, plenitudine, inte
woorden.definitie: subst. 1 plenitudo i.e. id, quod implet vel quo impletur spatium: ንሥኡ፡ ምልአ፡ እደዊክሙ፡ ሐመደ፡ Ex. 9,8; ምልአ፡ ሕፍኑ፡ Lev. 2,2; ምልአ፡ እድ፡ ሐሪጽ፡ 3 Reg. 17,12; Koh. 4,6; Macc. f. 5; Hez. 13,19; ምልአ፡ ቤት፡ ወርቀ፡ እመ፡ ወሀበኒ፡ Num. 22,18. Conjunctum c. በ፡ et pron. suff. vertere licet totus, universus, omnes omnino: ኵሉ፡ ዓለም፡ በምልኡ፡ Ps. 49,13; Ps. 23,1; Ps. 146,4; Jer. 29,2; 4 Esr. 10,14; Hez. 12,19; Hez. 32,15; 1 Esr. 9,10; Luc. 1,10; Luc. 23,18; Jsp. p. 301; Jsp. p. 313; Jsp. p. 375; Jsp. p. 382; F.M. 10,2; pariter በምልአ፡ ልብክሙ፡ plenitudine vel integritate cordis i.e. toto vel integro corde 1 Petr. 1,22; 1 Petr. 4,8; 1 Petr. 5,2. mǝlʾ G ምልእ፡ mǝlʾ «plénitude» ― ምላት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 33v. 76 L ምልእ mǝlʾ fullness, that which fills; also refers to the mode of singing, vid. ጐደሎ; ምሉእ፡ (Grébaut) በምልእ ba-mǝlʾ- with suffix pronouns fully, completely; e.g. በምልኡ bamǝlʾu he fully, he completely, በምልኦሙ፡ bamǝlʾomu all of them, they together ምልአ፡ ሕፍን mǝlʾa ḥǝfn handful, vid. ሕፍን፡ ምልአ፡ እድ mǝlʾ ʾǝd handful, vid. እድ፡ በምልአ፡ ልብከ bamǝlʾa lǝbbǝka with all your heart, vid. ልብ፡ 342a

woorden.betekenis: impletio, repletio, quotiescumque impletum est, immodice ven
woorden.definitie: n. act. impletio, repletio: ወለለምልአቱ፡ (ለኮራ፡) quotiescumque impletum est Kedr f. 88; ምልአተ፡ ከርሥ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ዐቅም፡ immodice ventrem (cibis) implere Macc. f. 24; Lit. 165,4; Lit. 172,4. mǝlʾat G ምልአት፡ mǝlʾat «remplissage» ― መምላት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 33v. 76 L ምልአት mǝlʾat fullness, filling up (n.) 342a

woorden.betekenis: possedit, regnavit, regnavit, consuluit, possidere, dominio
woorden.definitie: I,1 [مَلَكَ possedit, regnavit; מָלַךְ regnavit, ܡܠܰܟ consuluit] Subj. ይምልክ፡ 1 possidere, dominio tenere, occupare, potiri, c. Acc.: κατέχειν Ex. 32,13; Gen. 48,4; ዘይመልክ፡ ሀገረ፡ καταλαμβανόμενος πόλιν Prov. 16,32; ምልካ፡ ወተዋረሳ፡ ἐνάρχου κληρονομεῖν Deut. 2,24; ዮሐናን፡ ወእሊአሁ፡ ተጸወኑ፡ ኀበ፡ ቍድስ፡ ወመለክዋ፡ operibus praemunierunt templum et occuparunt Jsp. p. 353; ይሁቡ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘይመልኩ፡ ለነዳያን፡ (omnia, quae possident) Chrys. Ta. 13. a ex usu fori መለከ፡ non tantum possidere, jure mancipii tenere significat, sed etiam usu capere, ut F.N. 37. b transl.: animis potiri i. e. animos capere vel sibi conciliare (gewinnen), de oratore: እምድኅረ፡ መለከ፡ አልባቢሆሙ፡ ለሰማውያን፡ በብዙኅ፡ ተግሣጽ፡ Chrys. ho. 3. 2 dominari, sub imperio tenere, regnare, c.c. Acc.: κρατεῖν: ኢያአምር፡ ከመ፡ መሓሪ፡ ይመልኮ፡ Prov. 28,22; እለ፡ ይመልክዋ፡ ለየብስ፡ Hen. 62,9 (aliis in locis ይእኅዝዋ፡); saepissime de Deo: ዘኵሎ፡ ይመልክ፡ ὁ παντοκράτωρ, ut Job 15,25; Job 22,17; Job 27,2; Sir. 42,17; Jer. 3,9; Jer. 5,14; Hagg. 1,5; Mal. 1,4; Mal. 1,8; Zach. 1,3; 2 Reg. 5,10; Judith 4,13; Judith 15,10; Apoc. 15,3; 2 Cor. 6,18 (alias: አኃዜ፡ ኵሉ፡); ἄρχειν Gen. 1,16; ይመልኮ፡ እበድ፡ ἄγεται ἀφροσύνη Prov. 18,2; ከመ፡ ይምልክ፡ ቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ Syn.; c. ለ፡, ut: ኢይመልክ፡ (v. ኢይትመልአክ፡) አንሰ፡ ለክሙ፡ Jud. 8,23; c. ላዕለ፡, ut: መለከ፡ ላዕሌነ፡ ሀኬት፡ Chrys. ho. 24; vel absol., ut: መለከ፡ እምታሕቴሁ፡ ለንጉሥ፡ provex fuit Lud. (sine auct.); Hen. 75,3. malaka G መለከ፡ malaka I,1 ይመልክ፡, ይምልክ፡ «dominer, mâitriser» ― ገዛ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 33v. 76 L መለከ፡ malaka own (property), possess, have dominion, dominate, become master, take possession of, occupy, rule, reign, have authority 343b

woorden.betekenis: possessorem, dominum, regnatorem facere, creare, Deum colere
woorden.definitie: II,1 possessorem, dominum, regnatorem facere vel creare aliquem: ኢያመልክዎሙ፡ Sir. 38,33. (አምለከ፡ Deum colere vid. infra). ʾamlaka L አምለከ ʾamlaka causative of vid. መለከ malaka 343b

woorden.betekenis: possideri, dominio teneri, quod non possidetur, imperio, sub
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 possideri, dominio teneri: ዘኢይትመለክ፡ quod non possidetur F.N. 39,3. 2 imperio alicujus subjectum esse Lud. e praefatione Syn. 3 dominum, regnatorem constitui Lud. sine auct.; Chr. L. Atq. f. 31. tamalka G ተመልከ፡ tamalka III,1 ይትመለክ፡ «être adoré, être constitué seigneur, roi» ― ተመለከ፡, ነገሠ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 33v. 76 L ተመልከ tamalka passive of vid. መለከ malaka; also be subjected to, be made (constituted) master 343b C vid. also ተመልከ፡

woorden.betekenis: dominium, imperium, mǝlkat, domination, dominion, empire
woorden.definitie: n. act. dominium, imperium: ትትነሠት፡ ምልከታ፡ μεγαλειότης αὐτῆς Act. 19,27 rom. mǝlkat L ምልከት mǝlkat domination, dominion, empire 343b C vid. also ምልክና፡, ምልክናዌ፡, ትምልክት፡

woorden.betekenis: possessor, dominus, herus, dominator, regnator, malāki, malā
woorden.definitie: n. ag. 1 possessor, dominus, herus ut aedificii, agri, servi, al. F.N. 24,2; F.N. 31; F.N. 37; Chrys. Ta. 12. 2 dominator, regnator: እግዚአብሔር፡ መላኬ፡ ነፍሳቲነ፡ ወፈጣሪሃ፡ ውስተ፡ ሥጋነ፡ Jsp. p. 352; እግዚአብሔር፡ መላኬ፡ ሰማያት፡ ወምድር፡ Macc. f. 10; ክርስቶስ፡ መላኬ፡ ኵሉ፡ አጽናፍ፡ Sx. Masc. 2Enc. malāki መላኬ፡ አክሱም፡ malāke aksum (title) governor of Aksum 6 l. 14; 15 l. 6; 28 l. 27(ed.), 6 l. 5; 16 l. 13–14; 33 l. 5–6 (tr.), vid. አክሱም G መላኪ፡ malāki, Pl. መላክያን፡ malākǝyān «Seigneur, maître, dominateur» ― ገዢ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 33v. 76 L መላኪ malāki act. part. of መለከ malaka; also master, ruler, heir 343b

woorden.betekenis: Melchita
woorden.definitie: i.q. مَلَكِيٌ Melchita i.e. „regiae religioni in Aegypto addictus“ (opp. Jacobita vel Monophysita) Sx. Teq. 16; F.N. 24,2; F.N. 48; Clem. f. 212; al.

woorden.betekenis: dominium, mancipium, potestas, auctoritas, imperium, majesta
woorden.definitie: subst. 1 dominium, mancipium: ይጸንዕ፡ ምልክናሁ፡ እምድኅረ፡ ፴ ዓመት፡ (sc. usucapione) F.N. 35; ንኤዝዝ፡ ከመ፡ ይኩን፡ ላቲ፡ (ለብእሲት፡) ምልክናሁ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ንዋይ፡ F.N. 24,7; 2 potestas patria, tutoris al.; auctoritas, dominium, imperium, majestas, celsitudo: ዘታሕተ፡ ምልክናሁ፡ qui sub ejus (tutoris) potestate est F.N. 24; አሰስሎተ፡ ምልክናሁ፡ ለዘአመገብዎ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ይኅሥሡ፡ እምፈታሒ፡ F.N. 24,3; ምልክና፡ ላዕለ፡ እለ፡ ተኀየልዎ፡ ἐξουσία τυραννούντων αὐτοῦ Sap. 10,14; c. etiam c. Acc.: ቅንየትከ፡ ወምልክናከ፡ ኵሎ፡ τὸ πάντων σε δεσπόζειν Sap. 12,16; κυριότης Chrys. ho. 1 seq. (saepissime); ፈጠርነ፡ ዓለመ፡ ከመ፡ ይትዐወቅ፡ ምልክናነ፡ ወዕበየ፡ ኀይልነ፡ Clem. f. 48; Lit. 173,1; Org. 2. Abstractum pro concreto: Jes. 9,6 (var. pro መላእክት፡ οἱ ἄρχοντες); Gen. 49,10 (v. ምልእክና፡). 3 praefectura, satrapia, vel concr. satrapae: ለለ፡ ምልክና፡ አሕዛቢሆሙ፡ Esth. 3,12; ጸሐፍነ፡ ኀበ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምልክናነ፡ Jsp. p. 317. mǝlkǝnnā G ምልክና፡ mǝlkǝnnā, ምልከት፡ mǝlkat, ትምልክት፡ tǝmlǝkt «domination, empire, règne, régime, pouvoir» ― ግዛት፡, አገዛዝ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 33v. 76 L ምልክና mǝlkǝnnā ownership, possession, rule, dominion, power, domination, lordship, rulership, authority, sovereignt 343 C vid. also ምልከት፡, ምልክናዌ፡, ትምልክት፡

woorden.betekenis: dominos, dominatores, divini numinis, Deus, Deus meus, deus,
woorden.definitie: subst.; est formâ pl., (vid. gramm. § 131,2) sine dubio a singulari deperdito መልክ፡ [coll. hebr. מֶלֶךְ et arab. مَلِكٌ et أَلْمَلِكُ, quae et ipsa de Deo usurpantur] derivatum est, et dominos, dominatores significat: deinde in notionem divini numinis (sive in pluribus Deis sive in unico Deo contineri putetur) abiit, denique apud Abyssinos ad Christianam religionem conversos (pariter atque אֱלֹהִים apud Hebraeos) singularis significationem accepit. 1 Deus, ὁ θεός. Est generale Dei veri nomen (sicut אֱלֹהִים, ܐܰܠܳܗܳܐ, أَلله): speciale ejus nomen, unâ cum monotheismo ad Abyssinis acceptum, est እግዚአብሔር፡ (יַהֵוֶה, ὁ Κύριος); quae duo nomina saepius componuntur እግዚአብሔር፡ አምላክ፡ ut Gen. 6,13; Gen. 6,22; Gen. 7,5 al. Et statum constructum et accusativum admittit, sicut alia nomina appellativa: አምላክኪ፡ Ruth 1,16; አምላካ፡ ለሕይወትየ፡ Sir. 23,4; አምላከ፡ ዓለም፡ Hen. 1,3; አምላከ፡ ሰማይ፡ 2 Esr. 11,4; Ex. 3,6; Ex. 7,1; c. ኦ፡ Vocativi conjunctum nonnumquam: አምላኮ፡ Num. 16,22; Num. 27,16. Is, cujus vel cui Deus Deus est, praepositione ለ፡ introduci potest, ut አምላክ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ዘሥጋ፡ Jer. 39,27; at multo frequentius ope status contructi vel Genitivi. Pronomina suffixa huic nomini vel tamquam plurali vel tamquam singulari affigere licet ut አምላኪየ፡ et አምላክየ፡ Deus meus (gramm. § 155,3,b): illud tamen annotare juvat, quod si Accusativo አምላከ፡ pronomina secundae personae suffiguntur pro አምላኪከ፡ al. saepius አምላክከ፡ al. occurrit, ut Lev. 25,36; Lev. 25,38; Lev. 26,12; እከውነክሙ፡ አምላክክሙ፡ Jer. 7,23; Jer. 11,4 (v. አምላክክሙ፡). 2 deus quilibet ethnicorum, (deus fictus et commenticius), idolum: Ex. 20,4; Ex. 20,23; Deut. 5,8; Ps. 80,8 al. Hunc significatum si habet, pluralem አማልክት፡ admittit: Gen. 31,19 seq.; Ex. 20,3; Lev. 19,4. Neque tamen θεοί solum አማልክት፡ vertitur, ut Ruth 1,15; Jes. 19,3; Jes. 36,18; Jes. 41,23; Jer. 2,28; Jer. 5,7; Jer. 16,20 al., sed etiam εἴδωλα, ut: Gen. 31,19; Sir. 30,19; 1 Joh. 5,21; Act. 15,20 al., et χειροποίητα Jes. 16,12. Saepius occurrunt phrases: አማልክትነ፡ ነኪር፡ dii alieni vel peregrini Gen. 35,2; Jer. 1,16; Jer. 5,19; Kuf. 1; ባዕድ፡ አማልክት፡ Deut. 11,28; Jer. 39,29 vel አማልክተ፡ ባዕድ፡ Jer. 51,8; Deut. 13,7; Jos. 24,14; et አማልክተ፡ ግብት፡ dii temere inventi 2 Par. 23,17; 2 Par. 24,18 (vid. ግብት፡). Nonnumquam pl. አማልክት፡ reperitur, ubi Graecus singularem praebet, ut Jes. 44,17. – Ab አምላክ፡ derivantur verba ʾamlāk, Pl. አማልክት፡ ʾamālǝkt ʾamlāk part of n. pr. (personal name) vid. e.g. አምላክ፡ ጽናሕ፡ G አምላክ፡ ʾamlāk, Pl. አማልክት፡ ʾamālǝkt «Dieu» ― አምላክ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 33v. 76 L አምላክ፡ ʾamlāk Lord, God አማልክት፡ ʾamālǝkt (Pl. of አምላክ ʾamlāk) idols, false gods 344a C a for ለባሴ፡ አምላክ፡ vid. ለባሲ፡ (Grébaut) b for ለባስያነ፡ አምላክ፡ vid. ለባሲ፡ (Grébaut) c for አምልኮ፡ አማልክት vid. አምልኮ፡

woorden.betekenis: Dei dignitas, conversio in Deum, Satanas, ʾamlākǝnnā, malako
woorden.definitie: subst. Dei dignitas; praemisso ከዊነ፡ conversio in Deum: Satanas አኀለዮ፡ (ለአዳም፡) ከዊነ፡ አምላክና፡ F.M. 3,2. ʾamlākǝnnā G አምላክና፡ ʾamlākǝnnā, መለኮት፡ malakot «divinité» ― መለኮት፡, አምላክነት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 33v. 76 L አምላክና ʾamlākǝnnā divinity, () worship of God አምላክና ʾamlākǝnnā authority of God, (Lt) worship of God 344a C vid. also መለኮት፡

woorden.betekenis: ad Deum pertinens, divinus, divinam vocationem suam, ʾamlākā
woorden.definitie: adj. rel. ad Deum pertinens, divinus: ፈቃድ፡ አምላካዊ፡ F.M. 2,11; ኀደጉ፡ ጽዋዔሆሙ፡ አምላካዊተ፡ (divinam vocationem suam) Phlx. 5; ጳውሎስ፡ አምላካዊ፡ F.M. 10,4; in specie hoc praedicato laudantur Biblia, ut መጽሐፍ፡ አምላካዊ፡ F.M. 18; መጻሕፍት፡ አምላካዊት፡ Genz. f. 85; F.N. 2; al. creberrime. ʾamlākāwi, fem. አምላካዊት፡ ʾamlākāwit; Pl. አምላካውያን፡ ʾamlākāwǝyān G አምላካዊ፡ ʾamlākāwi, Pl. አምላካውያን፡ ʾamlākāwǝyān «divin, déiste»; fem. አምላካዊት፡ ʾamlākāwit «divine, déiste» ― ያምላክ፡ ወገን፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 33v. 76 L አምላካዊ ʾamlākāwi divine 344a

woorden.betekenis: implere
woorden.definitie: implere vid. sub መልአ፡

woorden.betekenis: secum auferre, proripere, secum ducere, portare, nam secum a
woorden.definitie: III,3 secum auferre vel proripere, secum ducere vel portare aliquem vel aliquid; c.c. Acc.: ዲያብሎስ፡ ተማልዖሙ፡ ለአዳም፡ ወለሔዋን፡ ውስተ፡ ስሕተተ፡ ዚአሁ፡ እንዘ፡ የኀይጦሙ፡ Macc. f. 8; Macc. f. 22; Macc. f. 24; እምንሄሆሙ፡ ተዐቀቡ፡ (cavete) ከመ፡ ኢይትማልዑክሙ፡ ምስሌሆሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ገሃነም፡ Clem. f. 186; Clem. f. 187; Clem. f. 129. Ex his locis, in quibus nihil dubii inest, illustrare licet locos quosdam Bibliorum, quorum sensus obscurior (et Ludolfo perperam intellectus) est: እስመ፡ ይትማላዕ፡ ሕያዎ፡ ለልብስ፡ nam secum abripit sanam vestis partem Matth. 9,16 rom.; ፌሎነ፡ ተማላዕ፡ (Platt male: ተመላእ፡, rom. ተማልአ፡ tamquam affixo pronomine III pers. sg. fem.) ምስሌከ፡ አመ፡ ትመጽእ፡ 2 Tim. 4,13; ኀለየ፡ ያውፅአነ፡ እምነ፡ መንግሥትነ፡ ወይትማልዐነ፡ ነፍሰነ፡ ἐπετήδευσε τῆς ἀρχῆς στερῆσαι ἡμᾶς καὶ τοῦ πνεύματος Esth. 8,13 apocr.; ተማልዒ፡ ሊተ፡ ምስሌኪ፡ ፍተ፡ ኅብስት፡ 3 Reg. 7,11. (In libris mss. hoc verbum creberrime cum ተማልአ፡, ተመልአ፡, መልአ፡ confunditur). – De notione hujus stirpis III,3 cfr. ተጻብሐ፡ tamālʿa, tamāllǝʿa G ተማልዐ፡ tamālʿa III,3 ይትማላዕ፡ «se séparer, se hâter dʾaller (loin) l’un de lʾautre» ― ተለያየ፡, ፈጠነ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 34r. 77 L ተማልዐ tamālʿa, () ተማልዐ tamāllǝʿa press on (to), be on oneʾs way, carry away with oneslef, bring with one, tear away, take away, draw along 342b

woorden.betekenis: exsecratus fuit, unus alterum exsecratus fuit, supplex fuit
woorden.definitie: I,1 [etiam መሀለ፡; amh. ማለ፡; arab. بَهَلَ exsecratus fuit; III V VI unus alterum exsecratus fuit; VIII supplex fuit in oratione, supplicavit (at مَحَلَ significat maligna delatione insidias struxit)] Subj. ይምሐል፡ 1 jurare, jusjurandum dare; absolute: Lev. 5,4; ሶበ፡ ትምሕል፡ Sir. 23,9; ኢትምሐሉ፡ ግሙራ፡ Matth. 5,33; c.c. በ፡ jusjurandi: Act. 2,30; በካልእ፡ መሐላ፡ ኢትምሐሉ፡ Jac. 5,12; hinc c. በሐሰት፡ vel በዐመፃ፡ pejerare: መሐልክሙ፡ በዐመፃ፡ Jer. 7,9; ኢትምሐሉ፡ በሐሰት፡ Matth. 5,33; በእንተ፡ እለ፡ ይምሕሉ፡ በጽድቅ፡ አው፡ በሐሰት፡ F.M. 22; vel c. Acc. rei vel jurisjurandi vel foederis: Luc. 1,73; Kuf. 37; ዘብዙኀ፡ ይምሕል፡ πολύορκος Sir. 27,14; Ps. 104,8; 4 Reg. 13,23; c.c. ከመ፡ seq. Subj. Kuf. 6; Jes. 62,8; Zach. 8,14; Gen. 25,33; Marc. 6,23; vel seq. Subj. sine ከመ፡ F.M. 22,9; vel c. ከመ፡ seq. Ind. Jer. 29,14; Act. 2,30 Platt; Hebr. 3,11; Hebr. 3,18; Hebr. 4,3; c. Acc. ejus, per quem (quod) juratur: Ex. 20,7; Matth. 5,34; Clem. f. 88; Clem. f. 160; c. በ፡ ejusdem: መሐልኩ፡ በርእስየ፡ Jer. 22,5; Kuf. 18; Jes. 45,23; እለ፡ ይምሕሉ፡ በስመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Jes. 48,1; Jes. 62,8; Jer. 12,16; Hebr. 6,13; F.M. 22,5; c. ለ፡ personae, cui jurejurando promittitur: Jes. 54,9; Ps. 14,6; Jer. 45,16; Kuf. 24; Gen. 25,33; Gen. 31,53; vel c. ላዕለ፡ ejusdem Hebr. 3,18. 2 jurejurando promittere alicui aliquid, c. Acc. rei et ለ pers.: Gen. 50,24; Num. 32,11; Deut. 31,20 (cfr. Ex. 13,5; Ex. 33,1). maḥala G መሐለ፡ maḥala I,1 ይምሕል፡, ይምሐል፡ «jurer, prêter serment» ― ማለ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 34r 78 L መሐለ፡ maḥala (yǝmḥal) swear, take an oath መሐለ፡ በሐሰት maḥala ba-ḥassat perjure oneself, swear falsely, vid. ሐሰት መሐለ፡ በዐመፃ maḥala ba-ʿamaḍā perjure oneself, swear falsely vid. ዐመፃ 335b

woorden.betekenis: jurejurando obstringere, ad jusjurandum adigere, jusjurandum
woorden.definitie: II,1 jurare facere vel jubere i.e. 1 jurejurando obstringere, ad jusjurandum adigere, jusjurandum exigere ab aliquo vel deferre alicui, c. Acc. pers. jurantis (de reliqua constructione vid. I,1): Gen. 24,3; Gen. 50,16; Gen. 50,25; Kuf. 35; አምሐሎ፡ በደመ፡ አቤል፡ ከመ፡ seq. Subj. Clem. f. 15; Asc. Jes. 11,39; በእንተ፡ rei (de): አምሐሎሙ፡ በእንተ፡ አዕጽምቲሁ፡ Kuf. 46; Num. 5,19; አምሐሎሙ፡ (ከመ፡) ይግበሩ፡ 2 Esr. 10,5; ይከውን፡ ጌጋዩ፡ ላዕለ፡ ዘአምሐሎ፡ culpa (jurisjurandi) in eo est, qui jusjurandum defert F.N. 43,5. 2 adjurare, obsecrare, obtestari, c. Acc. Cant. 2,7; Cant. 3,5; Cant. 5,8; Matth. 26,63; Marc. 5,7; 1 Thess. 5,27. ʿamḥala G አምሐለ፡ ʿamḥala II,1 ያምሕል፡ «faire prêter serment, conjurer» ― አማለ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 34r. 78 L አምሐለ፡ ʿamḥala adjure, compel to swear 335b

woorden.betekenis: tamǝḥla, maḥala
woorden.definitie: III,1 pass.: hujus stirpis exemplum nondum inveni tamǝḥla L ተምሕለ tamǝḥla pass. of vid. መሐለ maḥala 335b

woorden.betekenis: juratio, juramentum, jusjurandum, jurejurando, jurato, verum
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem. 1 juratio: መሀርዎሙ፡ ለሕዝብየ፡ መሐላ፡ በበዓል፡ ἐδίδαξαν ὀμνύειν Jer. 12,16; cfr. Sir. 23,9. 2 juramentum, jusjurandum (ὅρκος) Koh. 8,2; Koh. 9,2; Judith 8,30; Gen. 24,8; Matth. 5,33; Matth. 14,9; Hebr. 6,16; Hebr. 6,17; መሐላ፡ አምሐሎሙ፡ Ex. 13,19; በመሐላ፡ jurejurando, jurato Sir. 44,21; al.; መሐላ፡ ጽድቅ፡ (verum) Kuf. 37; መሐላ፡ በሐሰት፡ (falsum; perjurium) Clem. f. 139; Clem. f. 167; አበስከ፡ እመሐላ፡ (violare) Kuf. 37; ኢይሄሉ፡ በመሐላሁ፡ (non servare, negligere) Kuf. p. 127; ዘዐለወ፡ መሐላሁ፡ Hez. 17,15; ከመ፡ ኣቅም፡ መሐላየ፡ ዘመሐልኩ፡ Jer. 11,5; መሐላ፡ ዘእግዚአብሔር፡ jusjurandum per Deum Ex. 22,10; sed Genitivus etiam refertur ad eum, cui juratum est: መሐላየ፡ jusjurandum mihi praestitum Gen. 24,41; Jos. 2,17; Jos. 2,20. De jurejurando tractatur F.N. 43,5; F.M. 22,5. Nonnumquam መሐላ፡ potius exsecratio quam juramentum est, ut: መጽአ፡ መርገም፡ ላዕሌነ፡ ወመሐላ፡ Dan. 9,11; መሐላ፡ ዘመርገም፡ Num. 5,21; { መሐላ፡ ἐπιορκία pejurium Sap. 14,25}. 3 foedus juramento sancitum (διαθήκη, ὁρκωμοσία al.) Ex. 6,4; Hen. 60,6; ንትማሐል፡ መሐላ፡ 2 Reg. 3,12; ዘየዐሉ፡ መሐላሁ፡ Hos. 6,7; Hez. 17,14-19. Etiam coena foederis (δοχή) Gen. 26,30. maḥallā L መሐላ maḥallā, መሀላ mahallā same {as vid. ምሕልላ}; also intercession, advocacy 336a

woorden.betekenis: suppliciter orare, supplicare, supplicem esse, expiandi caus
woorden.definitie: (etiam ተማህለለ፡) quadril. III,1 suppliciter orare, supplicare, supplicem esse (in specie: expiandi causa): ሰገደ፡ ሎቱ፡ እንዘ፡ ይትመሐለል፡ γονυπετεῖν Matth. 17,14; c. ለ፡ vel በቅድመ፡ vel ኀበ፡ pers. et በእንተ፡ rei, ut: ተማሕለሉ፡ ለገጸ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ (ἐδεήθησαν τοῦ προσώπου) Jer. 33,19; ይትመሐለሉ፡ ለገጸ፡ (v. በገጸ፡) እግዚአብሔር፡ ἐξιλάσασθαι τὸ πρόσωπον Zach. 8,22; ለገጽኪ፡ ይትመሐለሉ፡ λιτανεύειν Ps. 44,14; እንዘ፡ ይትመሐለል፡ በቅድመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ በእንተ፡ አበሳ፡ Kuf. 41; ኀበ፡ መኑ፡ እትመሐለል፡ Org.; Sap. 13,18 (ἱκετεύειν); seq. ከመ፡ et Subj. Dan. 9,13; ይትመሐለል፡ አሮን፡ በዲበ፡ አቅርንቲሁ፡ Ex. 30,10; Kuf. 6. tamāhlala, ተማህለለ፡ tamāhlala G ተማህለለ፡ tamāhlala, quadrl. III,1 ይትመሀለል፡, ይትማህለል፡ «supplier» ― ለመነ፡, ተማለለ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 32r, Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 19. 71 L mḥll ተማሕለለ tamāhlala (ተማህለለ tamāhlala) beseech, supplicate, make supplication, seek earnestly 335b

woorden.betekenis: docere
woorden.definitie: docere vid. sub መሀረ፡

woorden.betekenis: misericordiam commovere, miseratione permovere, ʾamḥara, api
woorden.definitie: II,1 misericordiam commovere alicui, miseratione permovere aliquem., c.c. Acc.: አምሐርዎ፡ Matth. 9,36 rom.; ያምሕሩኒ፡ እሉ፡ አሕዛብ፡ Matth. 15,32; Matth. 20,34; Marc. 8,2. – Voc. Ae.: ad Evang.: አምሐርዎ፡ ዘ፡ አስኀዘንዎ። ʾamḥara G አምሐረ፡ ʾamḥara II,1 ያምሕር፡ «apitoyer, inspirer pitié, faire obtenir miséricorde, faire pardonner, obtenir pardon à un autre, faire donner lʾaumône» ― አሳዘነ፡, አስማረ፡, አስመጸወተ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 34v. 78 L አምሐረ ʾamḥara causative {of መሐረ maḥara} 336b

woorden.betekenis: misericordiam impartiri, misericordiam consequi, invenire, m
woorden.definitie: et ተመሐረ፡ III,1 et III,2 misericordiam impartiri alicui; plerumque: misericordiam consequi vel invenire: ይትመሐር፡ ለኵሉ፡ misericordia impertietur omnibus Kuf. p. 22; ዘይምሕር፡ ይትመሐር፡ Prov. 17,5; at Prov. 12,13 ይትሜሐር፡; ብፁዓን፡ መሓርያን፡ እስመ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ይትመሐሩ፡ Matth. 5,7. at Did. 4(ubi hic idem locus repetitur) ይትሜሐሩ፡ (quamquam Platt in Did. p. 17 ይትመሐሩ፡ habet); በዛቲ፡ ንሰከይ። ወበዛቲ፡ ንትኴነን፡ ወበዛቲ፡ ንትመሐር፡ Lit. 173,2. tamǝḥra, ተመሐረ፡ tamaḥara G ተምሕረ፡ tamǝḥra III,1 ይትመሐር፡ «être objet de compassion, être secouru» ― ተመጸወተ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 34v. L ተምሕረ፡ tamǝḥra, ተመሐረ፡ tamaḥara obtain mercy, be shown mercy or pity 336b

woorden.betekenis: facere ut aliquis misericordiam inveniat, misericordiam prae
woorden.definitie: IV,1 1 facere ut aliquis misericordiam inveniat i.e. a misericordiam praestare, impertire, se misericordem praebere alicui: abs., ut: 1 Cor. 13,4 rom.; c. ለ፡ pers. Herm. p. 58; plerumque c. Acc.: እንዘ፡ ኢታስተምሕር፡ ሰብአ፡ ዘከማከ፡ Sir. 28,4; ኢያስተምሕር፡ (v. ይምሕር፡) ብእሲ፡ { እኁሁ፡} Jes. 9,19; Deut. 28,68; Herm. p. 28; Herm. p. 37; Judith 6,19; አስተምሕረኒ፡ (Imperat.) Tob. 3,15; etiam c. ዲበ፡, ut: አስተምሐረ፡ እግዚእ፡ ዲበ፡ አንብዕነ፡ Rel. Bar. b misericordiam alicujus implorare, commiserationem petere ab aliquo aut sibi aut aliis (intercedere): Clem. f. 68; Marc. 7,34; c. ለ፡ pers.: ኣስተምሕር፡ ሎሙ፡ (var.) Job 19,17; c. Acc. Gen. 42,21; c. ኀበ፡ Hen. 38,6; Lit. 170,2; etiam c. ለ፡ ejus, pro quo interceditur, ut: አስተምሕር፡ ለነ፡ ሚካኤል፡ Mavâs. 16, et alias saepissime in precibus et litaniis. 2 ad misericordiam adducere 1 Cor. 13,7 rom. ʾastamḥara G አስተምሐረ፡ ʾastamḥara IV,1 ያስተምሕር፡ «être enclin à la miséricorde, intercéder pour un autre, obtenir des grâces à un autre» ― አማለደ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 34v. 78 L አስተምሐረ ʾastamḥara implore pity, crave mercy, seek mercy, ask for mercy, be prone to pity, have pity, intercede, be merciful, be compassionate, obtain pardon 336b

woorden.betekenis: misericordia, miseratio, commiseratio, caritas, pietas, visc
woorden.definitie: n. act. et subst., m. et fem., Pl. ምሕረታት፡ 1 misericordia, miseratio, commiseratio (ἔλεος, ἐλέη, οἰκτιρμοί, σπλάγχνα, χρηστότης, ἐπιείκεια) Ruth 3,10; Sir. 2,7; Sir. 18,11-13; Jes. 54,7; Jes. 56,1; Jer. 40,11; Thren. 3,21; Ps. 5,8; Ps. 88,1; Ps. 102,11; Ps. 113,10; Ps. 140,6; Matth. 9,13; Jac. 2,13; Rom. 9,23; Tit. 3,5; Jes. 63,15; Dan. 9,18; 2 Cor. 1,3; Col. 3,12; የዐጹ፡ ምሕረቶ፡ እምኔሁ፡ 1 Joh. 3,17; Tit. 3,4; 2 Cor. 6,6; Rom. 2,4; 2 Cor. 10,1; እለ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ምሕረት፡ ἀνελεήμονες Prov. 5,9; ዘገብረ፡ ምሕረተ፡ Jac. 2,13; ገብረ፡ ምሕረተ፡ c. ለ፡ vel ምስለ፡ vel ላዕለ፡ pers. Ex. 20,6; Ruth 1,8; 2 Reg. 10,2; Luc. 10,37; እግዚአብሔር፡ አበ፡ ምሕረታት፡ I Const. Ap. 21; Kid. f. 6; in specie de misericordia erga pauperes: ምሕረተ፡ ነዳያን፡ F.N. 16; et abs. ምሕረት፡ (i.q. ምጽዋት፡) Chrys. Ta. 32. 2 in specie usurpatur de teneriore amore: caritas vel pietas erga suos: እለ፡ አልቦሙ፡ ምሕረተ፡ ἄστοργοι 2 Tim. 3,3; Rom. 1,31; ተፈሥሐ፡ ምሕረቱ፡ ወልቡ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ Kuf. 22; ምሕረትየ፡ ይባርከከ፡ Kuf. 25; Kuf. 36; አሕዘኑ፡ ምሕረተ፡ አቡሆሙ፡ Kuf. 34. – At Kuf. p. 128lin. 15 interpres τὰ σπλάγχνα viscera male voce ምሕረት፡ interpretatus esse videtur. – 3 De ዓመተ፡ ምሕረት፡ computo secundum annos gratiae consulere licet Scaligeri opus de emendat. temp. Genevae 1629p. 689; Ludolfi Comm. ad Hist. p. 385 ann. d.; Catalogum Codd. Aeth. Musei Brit. 1847, p. 10. 11. Dionysius annum incarnationis annum gratiae appellaverat: Aethiopes autem, cum plerumque aeram Martyrum inde ab anno CCLXXVI (pro CCLXXXIV) adhibeant eamque modo integram, modo per periodos Dionysianas (DXXXII annorum) accipere soleant, hunc ipsum computum secundum periodos Dionysianas computum secundum annos gratiae appellant; quem computum si admittunt, annus Christi et DCCCIXus et MCCCXLIus iis ዓመተ፡ ምሕረት፡ ፩፡ est. Exempla habes in libris modo allegatis, nec non in Th. P. Platt a Catalogue of the Ethiopic Manuscripts 1823p. 20. 21; praeterea Herm. p. 108; Gad. Kar., ubi ዓመተ፡ ፹ወ፩ በኍልቈ፡ ዓመታተ፡ ምሕረት፡, quo Isaac (cognomine Gabra-Masqal) regnaverit, memoratur. Denique alias quoque aeras, ipsamque aeram creationis: ዓምተ፡ ምሕረት፡ inscribunt: exempla videre licet apud Ludolfum l.c. et in Catalogo Mus. Brit. l.c. mǝḥrat G ምሕረት፡ mǝḥrat «miséricorde, pitié, compassion» 79 L ምሕረት፡ mǝḥrat compassion, pardon, mercy, pity, clemency, affection 336b C for ዓመተ፡ ምሕረት vid. ዓመት፡

woorden.betekenis: miserator, misericors, misericordiae amans, studiosus, miser
woorden.definitie: n. ag. et adj. miserator, misericors, misericordiae amans vel studiosus (ἐλεήμων, οἰκτίρμων, nec non ἵλεως, φιλόστοργος, ἐπιεικής) መሓሪየ፡ miserator meus Ps. 143,2; Ex. 34,6; Deut. 4,31; Ps. 77,42; Ps. 102,8; Ps. 111,4; Ps. 111,5; Sir. 2,11; Sir. 48,20; Jer. 3,12; Tob. 6,18; Prov. 11,17; Prov. 20,6; 4 Esr. 7,36; 4 Esr. 8,37; Hen. 27,3; Hebr. 2,17; Matth. 5,7; አንስት፡ መሓርያት፡ Thren. 4,10; ኩን፡ መሓሬ፡ Tob. 14,9; መሓሬ፡ ኩን፡ ላዕለ፡ እከዮሙ፡ Ex. 32,12; መሓርያነ፡ ቢጽክሙ፡ Eph. 4,32; መሓርያን፡ 1 Petr. 2,18; ኩኑ፡ መሓርያነ፡ Rom. 12,10; መሓሪ፡ ለእጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ Sx. Hed. 12; opponitur avaro (ቂቁይ፡) Sx. Masc. 27; መሓሪት፡ ዐይንከ፡ Org.; poët. መሓሬ፡ ብዙኃን፡ እምዕዳ፡ multorum miserator obaeratorum Sx. Teq. 9Enc. maḥāri, fem. መሓሪት፡ maḥārit; Pl. መሓርያን፡ maḥārǝyān, fem. መሓርያት፡ maḥārǝyāt መሓሪ፡ ወመስተሣህል፡ maḥāri wamastaśāhǝl ‘gnädig und barmherzig’ (‘»gnädig und barmherzig«: Übersetzung das arab. ar-raḥmān ar-rahīm, die islamische Eulogie für Gott.’ 2 n. 2), vid. መስተሣህል፡ G መሓሪ፡ maḥāri, Pl. መሓርያን፡ maḥārǝyān; fem. መሓሪት፡ maḥārit, Pl. መሓርያት፡ maḥārǝyāt «miséricordieux, miséricordieuse » ― ማሪ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 34v. 78 L መሓሪ፡ maḥāri merciful, compassionate, gracious, one who has pity 336b

woorden.betekenis: parcere
woorden.definitie: parcere vid. sub መሀከ፡

woorden.betekenis: juvenilem, alacrem, libidinosum esse, maḥaza, devenir jeune
woorden.definitie: rad. inus.; ut videtur: juvenilem, alacrem, libidinosum esse, coll. بَغَزَ et ܦܚܶܙ פָּחַז. maḥaza G መሐዘ፡ maḥaza I,1 ይምሕዝ፡, ይምሐዝ «devenir jeune homme, atteindre la virilité» ― ጐለመሰ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 35r. 80 L መሐዘ maḥaza (, , ), መሀዘ mahaza () become a young man, become a lover, be flirtatious 337b

woorden.betekenis: num? utrum?, quid melius esset creatis: utrum creatos an non
woorden.definitie: adv. pronom. interrogativum, compositum e ሚ፡ et መ፡ (gramm. § 63 et § 161,a et § 198,c). Est nota interrogationis et significat 1 num? utrum? ምንት፡ እምኀየሶሙ፡ ለእለ፡ ተፈጥሩ፤ ሚመ፡ ተፈጥሮ፡ ወሚመ፡ ኢተፈጥሮ፡ quid melius esset creatis: utrum creatos an non creatos esse? Cyr. ad Theod. f. 12; አይኬ፡ ዘወለደት፡ ድንግል፤ ሚመ፡ ትስብእተ፡ ወሚመ፡ መለኮተ፡ Cyr. ad Theod. f. 15. 2 Cum ወ compositum (ወሚመ፡) in interrogationibus disjunctivis alteram disjunctionis partem infert: an? Matth. 17,25; Job 6,12; Jes. 40,19; Jer. 12,9; Jer. 51,28; 1 Cor. 4,21; saepissime adjecto: ኑ፡ (ወሚመ፡ –ኑ፡): እምሰማይኑ፡ ወሚመ፡ እምሰብእኑ፡ Matth. 21,25; Gen. 31,28; Gen. 37,8; Joh. 9,2; Act. 8,34; Rom. 4,10; 4 Esr. 6,49; 4 Esr. 12,50. – Etiam ubi enuntiatio interrogativa proxime non antecedit, ወሚመ፡ disjunctivum an? usurpari potest, ut Jac. 4,5. – Vid. እመ፡ – Voc. Ae.: አው፡ ወሚመ፡ ብ፡ ወይ፡; aliud: ወሚመ፡ ዘ፡ ወይም።

woorden.betekenis: pexuit, abripuit, avellere, decerpere, deripere, discerpere,
woorden.definitie: I,1 [مَشَطَ (discerpsit i.e.) pexuit; نَشَطَ, نَشَظَ abripuit] Subj. ይምሥጥ፡ 1 avellere, decerpere, deripere: ትመሥጥዎሙ፡ አምእስቲሆሙ፡ እምላዕሌሆሙ፡ Mich. 3,2; መሠጥዎሙ፡ ለአማልክተ፡ ነኪር፡ ዘውስተ፡ እዘኒሆሙ፡ Kuf. 31; መሠጡ፡ እጓለ፡ ማውታ፡ እምውስተ፡ ጥብ፡ Job 24,9. 2 discerpere, dilaniare: ከመ፡ ኢይምሥጡካሃ፡ ከመ፡ ላህም፡ ለነፍስከ፡ Sir. 6,2; ተኵላ፡ እንዘ፡ ይመሥጦሙ፡ (ለአባግዕ፡) Clem. f. 131; ይመሥጥ፡ ἐπιλήψεται Jes.5,29; Ps. 7,2; Hen. 90,11; Joh. 10,12; Org. 3 diripere, rapere, abripere: ይመሥጡ፡ ወየሀይዱ፡ Hez. 22,25; እምእደ፡ ዘመሠጠ፡ ወእምእደ፡ ዘሄደ፡ Jer. 21,12; መሠጡ፡ ኖላዌ፡ ምስለ፡ መርዔቱ፡ Job 24,2; Ps. 10,9; Ps. 34,12; Jud. 21,21; Kuf. 30; Matth. 13,19; c. dupl. Acc. Herm. p. 5. 4 c. Acc. pers. rapere i.e. raptim auferre vel deducere aliquem: Job 14,20; Joh. 6,15; Act. 8,39; Act. 23,10; 1 Thess. 4,17 rom.; Hen. 39,3; Hen. 68,2; in specie de homine raptae mentis in coelos deducto 2 Cor. 12,2; 2 Cor. 12,4; ምሥጥዎ፡ ለሕሊናክሙ፡ ኀበ፡ መልዕልት፡ (raptim tollite vel) elevate mentes vestras sursum Lith. Orth. 5 simpliciter: tollere, capere, apprehendere Ex. 30,4; Enc. (Ludolfi). 6 in bonam partem: eripere: ወበርበርዎሙ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘያድኅኖሙ፡ ወይመሥጥዎሙ፡ Jes. 42,22. – Voc. Ae.: መሠጠ፡ ዘ፡ ነተቀ፡ (vid. ነጠቀ፡ apud Isenb.). maśaṭa, መሰጠ፡ masaṭa G መሰጠ፡ masaṭa II,3 ይመስጥ፡, ይምስጥ፡ «ravir, ôter des mains» ― ነጠቀ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 39r. 92 L መሠጠ maśaṭa (yǝmśǝṭ), (92, ) መሰጠ masaṭa tear to pieces, tear away, cut up, dismember, carry off, carry away, grab, seize and carry off by force, snatch away, kidnap, strip, seize violently, ravish, enrapture, entrance 369a

woorden.betekenis: aufugere, se auferre, elabi, evadere, effugere, salvum evade
woorden.definitie: II,1 proprie: avulsionem vel abruptionem facere i.e. 1 aufugere, se auferre ἀποδιδράσκειν Job 9,25; ἀπορρηγνύναι Job 39,4; φεύγειν Jes. 21,14; ወይጠል፡ ዘያመሥጥ፡ Jes. 13,14; አምሠጠ፡ ልቡ፡ ἐξέλιπε σύνεσις αὐτοῦ Sir. 22,11. 2 elabi, evadere, effugere, in spec. salvum evadere; c.c. እምነ፡, ut: ኢያመሥጥ፡ እምጽልመት፡ Job 15,30; Job 20,24; ያመሥጥ፡ ድኩም፡ እምእደ፡ ኀያል፡ Job 5,10; መኑ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዘያመሥጥ፡ እምእዴከ፡ Job 10,7; Dan. 8,4; Prov. 12,13; Ps. 123,4; Ps. 104,17; ከመ፡ ዖፍ፡ እንተ፡ ታመሥጠከ፡ እምእዴከ፡ Sir. 27,19; Sir. 27,20; et c. Acc. (pron.suff. pro Dat.): አልቦ፡ ዘያመሥጠኒ፡ ὃς διαφεύξεταί με Jes. 10,14; ያመሥጦን፡ (ἀφέξεται αὐτῶν) Prov. 22,5; አምሠጠኒ፡ 1 Reg. 19,17; እመቦ፡ ዘአምሠጠክሙ፡ 4 Reg. 10,24; Deut. 2,36; 4 Esr. 6,69; መክፈልተ፡ ሠናይ፡ ኢያምሥጥከ፡ Sir. 14,14; salvum evadere: ዘአምሠጠ፡ እንዘ፡ ይጐይይ፡ φεύγων καὶ σωζόμενος Jes. 31,19; ተኀጥአ፡ ወአምሠጠ፡ 1 Reg. 19,18; አምሠጠ፡ በፈረስ፡ ረዋጺ፡ 3 Reg. 20,20; Jes. 30,16; ኢትክሊ፡ አምሥጦ፡ Jes. 47,11; 1 Reg. 27,1; 4 Esr. 9,8; c.c. praepos. loci, ut: አምሥጡ፡ ውስተ፡ ጽዮን፡ φεύγετε εἰς Jer. 4,6; ኢያመሥጥ፡ ጽኑዕ፡ መንገለ፡ ደቡብ፡ Jer. 26,6; Ps. 141,6. Nonnumquam se subtrahere alicui i.e. eum deserere: ኢያምሥጥከ፡ ዐርክከ፡ አመ፡ ትፍሥሕትከ፡ Sir. 12,8. 3 eripere i.e. liberare Sx. Ter 12Enc. ʾamśaṭa, አምሰጠ፡ ʾamsaṭa G አምሰጠ፡ ʾamsaṭa II,1 ያመስጥ፡, ያምስጥ፡ «échapper, s’évader» ― አመለጠ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 39r. 92 L አምሠጠ ʾamśaṭa, () አምሰጠ፡ ʾamsaṭa escape, flee, free onself 369a

woorden.betekenis: sibi, rapere, diripere, rapi, diripi, raptim auferri, auferr
woorden.definitie: et ተመሠጠ፡ (Jud. 21,23) III,1 1 refl. sibi rapere vel diripere aliquid Jud. 21,23. 2 pass. rapi, diripi, raptim auferri, auferri: ዘተመሥጠ፡ διηρπασμένος Jer. 22,3 (var.); Judith 4,12; Kuf. 34; ἁρπάζεσθαι Sap. 4,11; ኢትትመሠጥ፡ በቅራንብቲሃ፡ Prov. 6,25; ἀφαιρεῖσθαι ተመሥጠ፡ ንዋም፡ እምአዕይንቲሆሙ፡ Prov. 4,16; Did. 4; Sap. 14,15; ተመሠጥኩ፡ በነኰርኳረ፡ ነፋስ፡ Hen. 52,1; 1 Thess. 4,17 Platt; de raptu mentis ተመሢጥየ፡ Act. 11,5 rom.; Org. 1. tamaśṭa, ተመሠጠ፡ tamaśaṭa, ተመስጠ፡ tamasṭa G ተመስጠ፡ tamasṭa III,1 ይትመሰጥ፡ «être ravi» ― ተነጠቀ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 39r. 92 L ተመሥጠ፡ tamaśṭa, ተመሠጠ፡ tamaśaṭa pass of vid. መሠጠ maśaṭa; also withdraw oneself 369a

woorden.betekenis: mysterium
woorden.definitie: mysterium vid. sub ምስጢር፡

woorden.betekenis: monstrare, via, viam monstrare, ducere, praeire, ducem esse,
woorden.definitie: (v. መርሀ፡) I,1 [amh. መራ፡; in caeteris linguis haec eadem radix non exstat; sed quaeritur, annon הוֹרָה monstrare et אֹרַח ܐܽܘܪܚܳܐ via illustrando etymo comparanda sint?] Subj. ይምራሕ፡ 1 viam monstrare, ducere c. Acc. pers.: መልአክ፡ ዘይመርሐኒ፡ Asc. Jes. 7,16; Asc. Jes. 7,21; Hen. 21,5; ὁδηγεῖν, καθοδηγεῖν: ወረደ፡ መንፈስ፡ እምእግዚአብሔር፡ ወመርሖሙ፡ Jes. 63,14; መራሕኮሙ፡ በዐምደ፡ ደመና፡ 2 Esr. 19,12; Koh. 2,3; Job 12,23; Ps. 42,3; Ps. 138,9; Deut. 1,33; Luc. 6,39; Matth. 15,14; ἄγειν መሪሐ፡ ይመርሖሙ፡ 4 Reg. 9,20 (alias ἄγειν ወሰደ፡ verti solet); c. በ፡ vel ውስተ፡ loci, per quem pergitur: Ps. 142,12; Ps. 5,9; ዘመርሐነ፡ ውስተ፡ ብሔረ፡ በድው፡ Jer. 2,6; c. Acc. viae: Ps. 22,3; Ps. 85,10; Ps. 138,23; Sap. 10,17; vel c. ውስተ፡ viae Sap. 10,10; c. ውስተ፡ vel ኀበ፡ vel Acc. loci, ad quem tenditur: Apoc. 7,17; Joh. 16,13; አምላክ፡ ይምራሕከ፡ እንተ፡ ላዕሉ፡ ሀገረ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፡ Rel. Bar.; መርሐ፡ ካልእነ፡ ኀበ፡ አሚን፡ Chrys. ho. 26. 2 praeire, ducem esse, προάγειν እለ፡ ይመርሑ፡ ወእለ፡ ይተልዉ፡ Marc. 11,9; ይመርሑ፡ ቅድመ፡ ሰረገላ፡ ἦγαν τὴν ἅμαξαν 2 Reg. 6,3; ἡγεῖσθαι ይመርሖሙ፡ Ex. 13,21; Kuf. 37; Hen. 72,3; Hen. 89,45; Hen. 89,48. 3 monstrare, demonstrare aliquid, c.c. ኀበ፡ rei (in libris e sermone Arabico translatis): ወይመርሕ፡ ኀበ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ቃሉ፡ ለልዑል፡ (hoc demonstratur Verbo Altissimi) F.N. 24,1; ተወክፎተ፡ ሠያጢ፡ ዐረቦነ፡ እምእደ፡ ተሣያጢ፡ ይመርሕ፡ ኀበ፡ ፍጻሜ፡ ሠይጥ፡ ወተሣይጦ፡ F.N. 33. Sed etiam: testimonii causa producere aliquid, c. Acc. Ex. 22,12. marḥa G መርሐ፡ marḥa I,1 ይመርሕ፡, ይምራሕ፡ «guider» ― መራ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 36r. 82 L መርሐ marḥa (yǝmrāḥ) lead, guide, show (the way), prove 358b

woorden.betekenis: duci, deduci, ducem sequi, tamarḥa, être guidé, conduit, be
woorden.definitie: III,1 pass. et refl. duci, deduci, ducem sequi Hen. 72,5; ተመራሕነ፡ ውስተ፡ ዛቲ፡ ጸጋሁ፡ προσαγωγὴν ἔχομεν Rom. 5,2; ተመሪሐነኬ፡ ውስተ፡ ጽድቅ፡ እምኵለንታሁ፡ πανταχόθεν οὖν συνωθούμενοι εἰς Cyr. ad Theod. f. 25; (አበዊነ፡) ዘይደልወነ፡ ከመ፡ ንትመራሕ፡ በምግባራቲሆሙ፡ ወንትመሰል፡ ቦሙ፡ Jsp. p. 359; ከመ፡ ንትመራሕ፡ በትእዛዙ፡ Phlx. f. 242. tamarḥa G ተመርሐ፡ tamarḥa III,1 ይትመራሕ፡ «être guidé, conduit» ― ተመራ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 36r. 82 L ተመርሐ tamarḥa be guided, be led; also reflexive 358b

woorden.betekenis: ductor, dux, perductor, leno, lena, Satanas, marāḥi, marāḥit
woorden.definitie: n. ag. f. መራሒት፡, Pl. መራሕያን፡ fem. መራሕያት፡, ductor, dux: ከመ፡ ትኩን፡ መራሔ፡ ἡγούμενος 1 Par. 17,7; Hen. 72,1; Hen. 74,1; Hen. 75,1; Hen. 82,11 seq.; Org.; c.c. ለ፡ vel ኀበ፡, ut: መራሒ፡ ለዝሙት፡ perductor (leno) II Const. Ap. 17; ብእሲት፡ መራሒት፡ ኀበ፡ ዝሙት፡ lena I Const. Ap. 62(63); nec non per st. constr., ut: (ዛቲ፡ መጽሐፍ፡) መራሒተ፡ ልቡና፡ ይእቲ፡ Fal.; Satanas መራሔ፡ ኵሉ፡ እኩይ፡ Clem. f. 221; እግዚአብሔር፡ መራሔ፡ ሕይወት፡ Prec. Mat.; Kid. f. 12; መራሕያነ፡ ብርሃን፡ epitheton angelorum Lit. Joh.; epitheton Abrehae et Assbehae Chron. Ax. marāḥi, fem. marāḥit; Pl. marāḥǝyān, fem. marāḥǝyāt G መራሒ፡ marāḥi, Pl. መራሕያን፡ marāḥǝyān; መርሕ፡ marḥ, Pl. አምርሕት፡ ʾamrǝḥt «guide» ― መሪ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. L መራሒ marāḥi (Pl. መራሕያን marāḥǝyān) who leads, guide,leader, catechist, leader of a choir 358b C vid. also መርሕ፡

woorden.betekenis: amarescere, amarum esse, malis dulcia sunt opera peccati, ex
woorden.definitie: et መረ፡ I,1 [amh. id.; מָרַר, ܡܰܪ, مَرَّ] Subj. ይምረር፡ (ይምርር፡ 4 Esr. 8,40 Laur.) 1 amarescere, amarum esse: ይመርር፡ ጣዕሙ፡ ለመዓር፡ በዕጕሥታር፡ Herm. p. 30; ዘይመርር፡ እምሐሞት፡ Prov. 5,4; c. pron. suff. pro Dat.: ይመርረኪ፡ ኀዲገ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Jer. 2,19; (malis dulcia sunt opera peccati) ወይመርሮሙ፡ ምግባራ፡ ለጽድቅ፡ Clem. f. 83; ለትምረራ፡ ለከርሥከ፡ Apoc. 10,9. 2 exacerbari dolore et ira; tristem, moestum esse vel fieri (πικραίνεσθαι) መረርኩ፡ Ruth 1,20; መረረተኒ፡ ነፍስየ፡ እምኔክን፡ Ruth 1,13; መረት፡ (v. መረረት፡) Jes. 14,9; መሪረ፡ መረርኩ፡ Thren. 1,20; c. በእንተ፡ 4 Esr. 8,40 (Laur.). marara G መረረ፡ marara I,1 ይመርር፡, ይምርር፡ «être amer (saveur et humeur) » ― መረረ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 36r. 83 L mrr, መረረ marara, መረ marra (yǝmrǝr, yǝmrar) be bitter, be embittered, be grieved, be provoked 360a

woorden.betekenis: amarus, acerbus, amaritudo, exacerbatio, exacerbatus, moestu
woorden.definitie: adj. fem. መራር፡ 1 amarus, acerbus: ማይ፡ መሪር፡ Jac. 3,11; Jac. 3,12; Ex. 15,23; τὸ πικρόν Jes. 5,20; Prov. 27,7; መሪረ፡ ኮነ፡ ሜስ፡ Jes. 24,9. Translate a de iis, quae dolorem et moerorem efficiunt vel animum vulnerant (pungunt): ኦሞት፡ እፎ፡ መሪር፡ ዝክርከ፡ Sir. 41,1; መራር፡ እሞት፡ ብእሲት፡ Koh. 7,26; ለገቢረ፡ መሪር፡ Ps. 63,3; መሪር፡ አፉሆሙ፡ Rom. 3,14; Ps. 13,6; መራረ፡ ያወሥኡከ፡ Sir. 29,25; Jac. 3,14; adv.: እንዘ፡ ይጠወቅ፡ ነፍስየ፡ መሪረ፡ Job 10,1; መሪር፡ πικρία amaritudo i.e. exacerbatio Eph. 4,31. b de fletu, clamore, luctu (acerbus, vehemens): ጸራኅከ፡ ጽራኀ፡ መሪረ፡ Hen. 65,5; በቃል፡ መሪር፡ Hen. 65,2; መሪር፡ ሐዘን፡ Sir. 25,18; adv.: የዐወይዉ፡ መሪረ፡ Hez. 27,30; መሪረ፡ ይበክዩ፡ Jes. 33,7; Jes. 22,4; Matth. 26,75. 2 exacerbatus a moestus, tristis Ruth 1,20; ይኄይስ፡ መዊት፡ እመራር፡ ሕይወት፡ Sir. 30,17. b immitis, crudelis: ሕዝብ፡ መሪራን፡ Hab. 1,6; መሪራነ፡ ነፍስ፡ Jud. 18,25. c refractarius, contumax (παραπικραίνων) Ps. 77,10; ቤተ፡ መሪራን፡ Hez. 2,5 seq. (בֵּית מְרִי). marir, fem. መራር፡ marrār; Pl. መሪራን፡ marirān, fem. መራራት፡ marārāt G መሪር፡ marir, Pl. መሪራን፡ marirān «amer»; fem. መራር፡ marrār, Pl. መራራት፡ marārāt «amère» ― መራራ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 36r. 83 L መሪር፡ marir ( fem. መራር፡ marrār) bitter, something bitter, embittered, ferocious, provoking, sorrowful, grevious መሪረ፡ marira bitterly 360a C for ቤተ፡ መሪራን፡ vid. ቤት፡ (Leslau)

woorden.betekenis: mǝrrat, bitterness, anger, rancor, rebellion
woorden.definitie: n. act. et subst., i.q. ምረር፡, ut Deut. 29,17; Num. 33,9; Sap. 8,16; ምረተ፡ ሕምዝየ፡ Thren. 3,20; በምረተ፡ ነፍሱ፡ Sir. 4,6; contumacia Kuf. 1. mǝrrat L ምረት mǝrrat bitterness, anger, rancor, rebellion 360a

woorden.betekenis: portus
woorden.definitie: portus vid. sub ረሰወ፡

woorden.betekenis: myrtus, mǝrsǝne, mǝrsāni, mirsǝns, mirasins, mersens, mǝrsǝn
woorden.definitie: , መርሳኒ፡; ሚርስንስ፡, ሚረሲንስ፡, ሜርሴንስ፡, ምርስኔን፡, መርሲኔን፡ (مرسين) n. peregr. μυρσίνη (Gen. μυρσίνης, Acc. μυρσίνη) myrtus Kuf. 21; Jes. 41,19 (et Jes. 55,13 vers. nov.); 2 Esr. 18,15. mǝrsǝne, mǝrsāni, mirsǝns, mirasins, mersens, mǝrsǝnen, marsinen, ሚርሰንስ mirsans, መርሶንም marsonǝm G ምርስኔ፡ mǝrsǝne myrte, remplacé parfois par ብርስኖት፡ bǝrsǝnot, ወእምዝ፡ ያልብሶሙ፡ ለእለ፡ ይጠመቁ፡ አልባሰ፡ ጸዐዳ፡ ወአክሊል፡ ዲበ፡ ርእሶሙ፡ ብርስኖተ። 19, n. 2 L ምርስኔ mǝrsǝne, መርሳኒ mǝrsāni, ሚርሰንስ mirsans, ሚረሲንስ mirasins, ሜርሴንስ mersens, ምርስኔን mǝrsǝnen, መርሲኔን marsinen, (OT) መርሶንም marsonǝm myrtle, (6–14) jasmine 360b

woorden.betekenis: jus, jusculum
woorden.definitie: subst. jus, jusculum [amh. መረቅ፡, መርቅ፡; hebr. מָרָק et פָּרָק; arab. مَرَقَ; de etymo vid. Ges. thes. p. 820 et Ges. thes. p. 1131] M.F.
