woorden.definitie: calor gravis vid. sub ረቀየ፡

woorden.betekenis: vid. sub ማሪ፡ col. 169
woorden.definitie: vid. sub ማሪ፡ col. 169

woorden.betekenis: pulvis terrae, humus, lutum, argilla, creta figularis, calx
woorden.definitie: subst. (sine dubio pro መሪት፡ vel መራት፡), [amh. id.], m. et fem.: „terra omnis generis, quae artefacta in pulverem et madefacta in lutum seu coenum resolvitur“ (Lud.), 1 pulvis terrae, humus, γῆ Gen. 3,19; አንተ፡ መሬት፡ 4 Esr. 5,15; ታገብአኒ፡ ውስተ፡ መሬት፡ Job 10,9; Job 34,15; ከመ፡ እኩን፡ መሬተ፡ Tob. 3,6; መሬት፡ ወሐመድ፡ Job 42,6; Sir. 10,9; ኰኵሕ፡ ኀበ፡ አልቦ፡ መሬተ፡ Matth. 13,5; Jes. 47,1; Gen. 26,15; Kuf. 24; 4 Esr. 1,5; 4 Esr. 5,33; 4 Esr. 8,4; χοῦς Koh. 3,20; Koh. 12,7; Ps. 1,5; Deut. 28,24; ወደዩ፡ መሬተ፡ ውስተ፡ ርእሶሙ፡ Thren. 2,10; Hez. 26,4; Hez. 26,12; ከመ፡ መሬት፡ ንሕነ፡ Ps. 102,14; Act. 18,19; χῶμα መሬተ፡ ምድር፡ Ex. 8,13; ረሰይኮን፡ ለአህጉር፡ መሬተ፡ Jes. 25,2; እለ፡ ይነውሙ፡ ውስተ፡ መሬተ፡ ምድር፡ Dan. 12,2. – Est unum e quatuor elementis vid. ጠባይዕ፡ 2 lutum, argilla, creta figularis, calx praeparata, (mortarium) πηλός: አብያተ፡ መሬት፡ Job 4,19; ሥጋክሙ፡ መሬት፡ Job 13,12 (alias ጽቡር፡); κονία መሬት፡ ጸዐዳ፡ Deut. 27,2; Deut. 27,4; χοῦς, qui in aedificiis exstruendis adhibetur Lev. 14,42; Gad. Lal. (saepius). 3 ramenta, rudus, ut lapidum caesorum Gad. Lal. (vid. ምጽራብ፡); aedificiorum dirutorum Jes. 25,2. 4 coenum, stercus, κοπρία Luc. 13,8; 4 Reg. 9,35; Job 2,8; Ps. 82,9; Jes. 5,25; Thren. 4,5. maret, Pl. መሬታት፡ maretāt G መሬት፡ maret, Pl. መሬታት፡ maretāt «terrain, champ, poussière, terre, terreau» ― መሬት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 36v. 85 L መሬት፡ maret earth, dust of the ground, dirt, soil, clay, plaster, dung መሬት፡ ጸዓዳ maret ṣaʿādā plaster, clay 361a

woorden.betekenis: terrenus, maretāwi, maretāwit, maretāwǝyān, maretāwǝyāt, ter
woorden.definitie: adj. rel. terrenus 1 Cor. 15,47; 1 Cor. 15,48; መሬታዊ፡ አንተ፡ ወኀላፊ፡ Clem. f. 238; Clem. f. 122; መሬታዊ፡ ሰብእ፡ Kedr f. 7; Gad. Ad. f. 77; መሬታውያን፡ opponuntur coelestibus (ሰማያውያን፡) Genz. f. 46; Org.; et multis aliis in locis (vid. etiam ጠባይዕ፡). maretāwi, fem. መሬታዊት፡ maretāwit; Pl. መሬታውያን፡ maretāwǝyān, fem. መሬታውያት፡ maretāwǝyāt fem. መሬታዊት፡ maretāwit Kebr. Nag. 11,3 G መሬታዊ፡ maretāwi, Pl. መሬታውያን፡ maretāwǝyān «terrestre, mortel»; fem. መሬታዊት፡ maretāwit, Pl. መሬታውያት፡ maretāwǝyāt «terrestre, mortelle» ― የመሬት፡ ወገን፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 37r. 85 L መሬታዊ፡ maretāwi creature of the earth or of dust, earthly, being of dust (n.) 361a

woorden.betekenis: luxuria, lascivia, libido, impudicitia
woorden.definitie: vel ምርዓት፡ subst. (n. act.) luxuria, lascivia, libido, impudicitia: ἀσέλγεια Marc. 7,22 Platt; 2 Cor. 11,21; Gal. 5,19; ἀσωτία Eph. 5,18; Tit. 1,6; Luc. 15,13; ἀσυνθεσία Jer. 3,7; χρεμετισμός Jer. 13,27; ዝሙት፡ ወምርዐት፡ Kuf. 25; ገብረ፡ ዝሙተ፡ ወምርዐተ፡ F.M. 6,15; ስካር። ሥሥዕት። ፈቲው። ምርዐት። ዝሙት፡ Kid. f. 4; እምስካር፡ ይትወለድ፡ ምርዐት፡ ወዝሙት፡ ወሥሥዕት፡ Clem. f. 139; ናወግዝ፡ እንተ፡ አርያኖስ፡ ምርዐተ፡ ወዕልወተ፡ Exp. Fid. Nic. (f. 282).

woorden.betekenis: i.q. ምርዐት፡ – Voc. Ae.: ምርዓ፡ ዘ፡ ጕልሻ፡ (v. ጉለሻ፡).
woorden.definitie: i.q. ምርዐት፡ – Voc. Ae.: ምርዓ፡ ዘ፡ ጕልሻ፡ (v. ጉለሻ፡).

woorden.betekenis: hariolari, divinare, augurari, tamarraya, tamāraya, exercer
woorden.definitie: III,2 et ተማረየ፡ III,3 hariolari, divinare, augurari: ዘይትሜረይ፡ በከዋክብት፡ ወበአእባን፡ ወበዕፀው፡ Clem. f. 245; Clem. f. 224; ዘያሰገል፡ ወዘይትሜረይ፡ Clem. f. 128; Clem. f. 178; ለተመርዮ፡ ወለተሰግሎ፡ Kuf. 11; ዘይትሜረይ፡ በሰገል፡ Kedr f. 65; ዘይትማረይ፡ ወዘያበውኦሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ቤቱ፡ ለመሠርያን፡ F.N. 11; F.N. 3; ኵሉ፡ ተማርዮ፡ እምኀይለ፡ አጋንንት፡ ወኵሉ፡ ተነብዮ፡ እምኀይለ፡ መንፈስ፡ ቅዱስ፡ M.M. f. 314. tamarraya, tamāraya G ተማረየ፡ tamāraya III,3 ይትማረይ፡ «exercer la sorcellerie» ― ጠነቈለ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 37r. 86 L mry ተመረየ tamarraya, ተማረየ tamāraya act as a soothsayer, divine, practice divination, perform magic 362a

woorden.betekenis: permutavit, commutavit
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., quae mihi cum מוּר et יָמַר permutavit, commutavit convenire videtur.

woorden.betekenis: smaragdus, maragd, émeraude, emerald
woorden.definitie: et ዘመረግድ፡ n. peregr. σμάραγδος, μάραγδος smaragdus gemma (hebr. בָּרֶקֶת, sanscr. मरक्त et मसार vel मसारक, pers. زَمَرَّد et زَمرَد, arab. زُمُرُّذٌ; ejus species est pers. زَبَرجَد, arab. زَبَرْجَدٌ; aram. זְמַרְגַּד, ܙܡܰܪܓܕܳܐ) መረግድ፡ Apoc. 4,3; Apoc. 21,19; Sir. 35,6; Hez. 28,13; Jes. 54,11 (ubi Gr. σάπφειρος habet); Tob. 13,16; Judith 10,21; እብን፡ ዘሕብረ፡ መረግድ፡ λίθος σμαραγδίτης Esth. 1,6; Ex. 28,9; Ex. 28,17; ዘመረግድ፡ Ex. 36,17; dubium utrum መመረግድ፡ an ዘመረግድ፡ Ex. 35,12; Ex. 36,13. – Voc. Ae.: መረግድ፡ በኦሪት፡ ወበቀለምሲስ፡ (in Pentateucho et Apocalypsi) በርዠድ፡ በቅብጢ፤ ዘምሩድ፡ በዐረቢ፤ ሕብሩ፡ ሐመልሚል። maragd G መረግድ፡ maragd «émeraude» ― መረግድ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 37v. 87 L መረግድ፡ maragd emerald (56 quoting Tayyä translates it ‘ornamento di marmo fatto a ombrello,’ but this meaning does not occur in Tayyä) 358a C for እብነ፡ መረግድ፡ vid. እብን፡

woorden.betekenis: similem esse, fieri, speciem habere, et alia hujusmodi, vide
woorden.definitie: et መስለ፡ I,1 [מָשַׁל ܡܬܰܠ مَثَلَ; amh. i.q. aeth.] Subj. ይምሰል፡ 1 similem esse vel fieri, (speciem habere alicujus rei), c.c. Acc.: ይመስሎ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ወልድ፡ ለጦቢት፡ Tob. 7,2; Kuf. 31; አልቦ፡ ዘይመስሎ፡ Sir. 25,11; ምንተ፡ ይመስሉ፡ Jes. 23,2; ምንተ፡ ይመስል፡ ብእሲ፡ 4 Reg. 1,7; ሕብሩ፡ ይመስል፡ እሳተ፡ 4 Esr. 14,41; አርዌ፡ ዘይመስል፡ ድበ፡ Dan. 7,5; Hez. 32,2; Gen. 30,8; Luc. 13,18; Matth. 18,23; Matth. 25,1; Apoc. 13,2; vel c. ከመ፡ ut: ከመ፡ ገሞራ፡ እመሰልነ፡ Jes. 1,9; Rom. 9,29; 4 Esr. 4,64; ከመ፡ ወልደ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ይመስል፡ Dan. 3,25; ይመስሉ፡ ሕዝብየ፡ ከመ፡ ዘአልቦ፡ ልበ፡ Hos. 4,6; Apoc. 4,7; ወዘይመስሎ፡ et alia hujusmodi Syn. 2 videri vel putari, c.c. Acc. (raro c. ለ፡) pers., cui videtur, et c. Acc. vel ከመ፡ rei: ነገርየ፡ ይመስል፡ ሐሰተ፡ verba mea videntur falsa esse Job 6,3; Job 6,25; Hebr. 12,11; ለእመኒ፡ ኅዳጠ፡ ወሀበከ፡ ብዙኀ፡ ይመስሎ፡ ለልቡ፡ ዘጸገበከ፡ id quod tibi dedit, ei multum videtur Sir. 20,14; Job 24,17; ብርዐ፡ ይመስሎ፡ መፍጽሕ፡ Job 41,20; ቦፍናው፡ ዘይመስላሁ፡ ለብእሲ፡ ርቱዓተ፡ Prov. 16,25; Hen. 80,7; ከመ፡ ኢይምሰሎ፡ ጠቢበ፡ ለርእሱ፡ Hen. 26,5; Marc. 6,49; አኀዙ፡ ይውግርዎ፡ በእብን፡ እንዘ፡ ይመስሎሙ፡ ኤርምያስሃ፡ cum iis Jeremias esse viderentur Rel. Bar.; ከመ፡ አድግ፡ ይመስለኒ፡ Job 11,12; Gen. 19,14; 2 Petr. 1,13; rarius c. በኀበ፡ pers., ut: ፍኖት፡ እንተ፡ ትመስል፡ ርትዕተ፡ በኀበ፡ ሰብእ፡ Prov. 14,12. Nonnumquam id, quod alicui videtur, verbo finito exprimitur, ut: መሰሎ፡ ይሰክብ፡ videbatur ei dormire (putavit eum dormire) Judith 14,14; በብዝኀ፡ ነገርከኑ፡ ትጸድቅ፡ (v. ትጽደቅ፡) ትመስል፡ Job 11,2; etiam praemisso ከመ፡, ut: ለአዕይንተ፡ አብዳን፡ መሰሉ፡ ከመ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ዘሞቱ፡ Sap. 3,2. 3 impers. videtur (es scheint), c. Acc. pers. et c. ከመ፡ seq. Indic.: Jac. 1,7; ብዙኃን፡ እለ፡ ይመስሎሙ፡ ከመ፡ Sir. 29,4; vel seq. ዘ፡ et Indic.: መሰለኒ፡ ዘ፡ 4 Reg. 5,11; Gen. 31,31; Gen. 31,35; Dan. apocr. 13,6; Matth. 5,17; Jac. 4,5; vel seq. enuntiatione integra sine particula praemissa Jes. 57,8; Phil. 3,13. Multis in locis hoc verbum Nr. 2et 3 latinis verbis putare, existimare apte interpretaberis. 4 rarissime transit.: id q. መሰለ፡ I,2 q.v., ut Jud. 14,13. masala G መሰለ፡ masala I,1 ይሜስል፡, ይምስል፡ «sembler, ressembler, paraître» ― መሰለ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 37v. 87 L መሰለ masala መስለ masla (yǝmsal) be like, look like, be likened to, resemble, appear, seem; with object suffix pronouns it means it seems to someone (‘kama’ that), think, suppose 365a

woorden.betekenis: similem facere, speciem praebere, imaginem, figuram dare rei
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 similem facere aliquem alicui, speciem praebere alicujus alicui, c. dupl. Acc.: ብዕልክሙ፡ ዘያመስለክሙ፡ ጻድቃነ፡ Hen. 96,4. (E Libr. Myst. Ludolfus affert notionem: imaginem, figuram dare rei). 2 inducere aliquem ut putet (propr. verisimile facere aliquid cui), c. ለ pers.: ያመስል፡ ለሰብእ፡ ከመ፡ ውእቱ፡ ያፈቅረኒ፡ hominibus suum mei amorem persuadet Jsp. p. 338. 3 plerumque: similem putare aliquem vel aliquid alicui, habere aliquem vel aliquid pro aliquo, vel existimare, putare seq. Acc. c. Infin.; c.c. dupl. Acc.: ዐርከ፡ አምሰልዎ፡ φίλον ἡγησάμενοι αὐτόν Sap. 1,16; Sap. 13,2; እንዘ፡ ታመስሉኒ፡ ኤርምያስሃ፡ Rel. Bar.; Asc. Jes. 8,21; vel cum Acc. et praep. ከመ፡, ut: ከመ፡ ዘእምካልእ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ያመስሉኒ፡ Job 19,15; vel seq. enuntiatione integra: አምሳለ፡ ስክርት፡ ይእቲ፡ (putavit eam: ebria est i.e. ebriam esse) 1 Reg. 1,13 var.; etiam praemissa ዘ፡ vel ከመ፡ conj., ut: አምሰላ፡ ያዕቆብ፡ ዘራሔል፡ ይእቲ፡ Kuf. p. 101; 1 Reg. 1,13. 4 absol. putare, existimare, opinari seq. ዘ፡ vel ከመ፡ vel እስመ፡, ut: አልቦ፡ ዘያመስል፡ ከመ፡ Job 25,3; Asc. Jes. 6,14; Hen. 98,7. ʾamsala G አምሰለ፡ ʾamsala II,1 ያመስል፡, ያምስል፡ «rendre semblable» ― አስመሰለ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 37v. 87 L አምሰለ ʾamsala declare similar, declare alike, make believe, regard as, hold as equivalent, consider someone so and so, think, compare, believe 365b

woorden.betekenis: tamasla
woorden.definitie: III,1 raro usitatum (ut Rel. Bar.; 4 Esr. 6,37 var.), plerumque tamasla vid. ተመሰለ፡

woorden.betekenis: simulatione uti, praetexere, comparare, ʾastamasala, use a p
woorden.definitie: IV,1 1 simulatione uti, praetexere seq. ከመ፡ Act. 27,30 rom.2) comparare (i.q. IV,3) c. በ፡, Luc. 13,18 rom.; Luc. 20 rom.; 3 i.q. IV,3 Nr. a; 4 Esr. 8,50 (Laur.). ʾastamasala L አስተመሰለ ʾastamasala use a pretense, compare 365b

woorden.betekenis: similitudo, simile, et omnia quae, similitudo ejus, ei simil
woorden.definitie: m. et fem., est formâ Plur. (a ምስል፡), sed significatione Sing. simplicem aequat (gramm. § 131,2) et frequentius usurpatur quam ምስል፡; ejus Plur. est አምሳላት፡ 1 similitudo Gen. 1,11; Gen. 1,26; Gen. 1,27; በአምሳለ፡ ዚአሁ፡ ገብሮሙ፡ Sir. 17,3; Kuf. 3; ከመ፡ አምሳለ፡ ፬ እንስሳ፡ Hez. 1,5 seq.; Rom. 8,3; Apoc. 9,7; ተመስለ፡ በአምሳለ፡ ንስር፡ Rel. Bar.; 4 Esr. 8,50. Latine saepius ope adjectivi simile explicari potest: ወኵሉ፡ ዘአምሳሉ፡ et omnia quae (similitudo ejusi.e.) ei similia sunt Lev. 11,14 seq.; Marc. 7,13; Herm. p. 46. Praeterea Acc. idemque st. constr. አምሳለ፡ potissimum a poëtis usurpatur a pro praepositione: instar, ceu, tamquam, Tab. Tab. 100; አምሳለ፡ ሠናይ፡ ፍሬ፡ instar boni fructus Enc. b pro conjunctione: quasi, tamquam: አምሳለ፡ ይፈቅድ፡ ንዒወ፡ Enc. 2 imago, effigies, (et typus, exemplar, et imitatio), simulacrum: አምሳላተ፡ እንስሳ፡ ἀπεικάσματα ζῴων Sap. 13,10; Asc. Jes. 7,10; በአምሳለ፡ ዐይነ፡ ማኅተም፡ Sir. 45,12; ይገብሮ፡ አምሳለ፡ ሰብእ፡ Jes. 44,13; አምሳለ፡ መብዐል፡ Sir. 38,28; Ps. 105,21; ያቀውም፡ አምሳሎ፡ Asc. Jes. 4,11; Act. 7,43; አምሳል፡ ለንስሓ፡ ዚአኪ፡ Org. 1; ዮሴፍ፡ አምሳሉ፡ ለጦቢት፡ Josephus Tobiae typus Enc.; Hebr. 9,9; Christus ፈጻሜ፡ አምሳል፡ ወዜና፡ impletor typorum et praedictionum Enc. 3 simile, parabola, proverbium, dicterium, aenigma 4 Esr. 8,3; Matth. 24,32; Matth. 21,45 Platt; ትምህርተ፡ አምሳል፡ παραβολὴ ἐπιστήμης Sir. 1,25; ልበ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ይፌክር፡ አምሳለ፡ Sir. 3,29; Sir. 20,20; 1 Reg. 10,12; 1 Reg. 24,14; Ps. 43,16; Jud. 14,12; Jud. 14,18. 4 analogia, exemplum (quae sequuntur judices in dirimendis litibus, ubi leges scriptae non sufficiunt) F.N. ʾamsāl, Pl. ʾamsālāt G አምሳል፡ ʾamsāl et መምስል፡ mamsǝl, Pl. መምስላት፡ mamsǝlāt «image, simulacre, figure, parabole, ressemblance, similitude» ― የሚመስል፡, ምሳያ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 38r. አምሳለ፡ ʾamsāla (adverbe) «semblablement, comme» ― እንደ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 38r. 88 L አምሳል፡ ʾamsāl (Pl. of vid. ምስል mǝsl, but having also the meaning of a singular) aspect, form, figure, effigy, image, likeness, like thing, similarity, similitude, model, symbol, analogy, imitation, description, parable, proverb አምሳለ ʾamsāla, በአምሳለ ba-ʾamsala like, in the manner of, in the guise of, by way of, kind of 365b C a vid. also መምስል፡ b for ሤጠ፡ አምሳሊሁ፡ vid. ሤጥ፡

woorden.betekenis: instar, sicut, cum, pariter atque, sume tecum fel, per, misi
woorden.definitie: praep. (cujus forma antiquior ምስሌ፡ Gal. 2,9 Polygl.; c. pron. suff. ምስሌየ፡ ምስሌከ፡ caet.; gramm. § 167,3), propr. instar, sicut (cfr. مِثَلٌ), deinde exuta notione primaria: cum (pro quo nonnumquam pariter atque dixeris, ut ኢታማስን፡ ጻድቃነ፡ ምስለ፡ ኃጥኣን፡ Gen. 18,23; Ps. 72,5; Matth. 26,35). 1 cum a copulative: ኣፈልሰከ፡ ምስለ፡ ኵሉ፡ አኀዊከ፡ σέ σὺν πᾷσι τοῖς φίλοις σου Jer. 20,4; Jer. 47,9 (ubi Gr. καί habet); Judith 10,17; Koh. 2,16; Gen. 32,12; Lev. 6,8; Eph. 6,23. b de societate et comitatu: Gen. 13,1; Gen. 18,16; Marc. 2,26; Luc. 5,9; Luc. 7,12; Luc. 8,1; Luc. 23,32; Luc. 24,28; Luc. 24,29; Matth. 16,27; Matth. 26,58; Matth. 12,30; Luc. 11,23; 1 Joh. 2,19. α in specie conjungitur cum verbis sumendi et ferendi: ንሣእ፡ ምስሌከ፡ ሐሞተ፡ sume tecum fel Tob. 11,3; Matth. 25,3; Ps. 49,17; 1 Reg. 21,8. β cum verbis mittendi, ubi significat per: ፈነወ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ misit epistolam cum eo i.e. per eum 2 Esr. 16,5; Gen. 38,20; 4 Reg. 17,13. γ praemittitur iis, quae quis secum fert (alias: በ፡): ሰረረ፡ ንስር፡ ምስለ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ avolavit aquila cum epistola (eam secum ferens) Rel. Bar.; ተለውዋ፡ ዕደው፡ ምስለ፡ ንዋየ፡ ሐቅሎሙ፡ Judith 15,13; Hebr. 9,7; Matth. 24,31; Matth. 25,3; Matth. 26,47; 2 Esr. 3,10. δ rarius ad significandas actiones secundarias cum principali conjunctas (μετά): ትትካየድ፡ ኪዳነ፡ ምስለ፡ መሐላ፡ jungas foedus (cum jurejurando i.e.) jurejurando sanciens Kuf. p. 25; 1 Tim. 4,14. c de conjunctione: vid. verbamiscendi et conjungendi, consentiendi, cognationis, foederandi, conciliandi, concordandi, vicinitatis, al.; praeterea nota constructiones quasdam praegnantes (ubi notionem conjunctus supplere licet), ut Matth. 27,66; ናእተ፡ ምስለ፡ ሐምለ፡ ብሒእ፡ ትበልዑ፡ Ex. 12,8; በልዑ፡ ምስለ፡ ደም፡ 1 Reg. 14,32; 1 Reg. 14,33; ሥጋ፡ ዘምስለ፡ መንፈስ፡ ምስለ፡ ደም፡ Kuf. 6; unâ cum 4 Esr. 1,22; Gen. 18,23; Marc. 15,27. d de auxilio: እስመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ምስሌነ፡ Jes. 8,8; Jes. 8,10; Jes. 45,14; Ruth 2,4; Gen. 21,22; Ex. 23,5; Matth. 28,20; Act. 7,9; vid. ተራድአ፡ e de aequalitate, vid. ዐረየ፡, ተዐረየ፡, ዕሩይ፡, ተማሰለ፡; de aequalitate temporis: በጽባሕ፡ ምስለ፡ ትንሣኤ፡ ፀሓይ፡ Kuf. 3; Ps. 71,5; vid. aliud exemplum sub ሕስት፡ f praecipuum locum tenet ምስለ፡ ubi de actionibus reciprocis tractatur; post verba dimicandi, litigandi, disputandi, consultandi, aemulandi, paciscendi, concumbendi, cohabitandi, scortandi (ሰከበ፡, ኀደረ፡, ዘመወ፡) et post varia alia verba stirpis III,3 ut ተጻልአ፡, ተዓመፀ፡, ተናጸረ፡, ተሳመዐ፡ Gen. 11,7, etiam post verbae mutuae diremtionis, ubi Latini a substituunt ut ተሌለዩ፡ ፩ ምስለ፡ ካልኡ፡ Gen. 13,11; Gen. 31,49; 1 Cor. 7,10; ሀለወ፡ ባእስ፡ ወጽልእ፡ ምስሌከ፡ ወምስሌሆሙ፡ inimicitia inter te et illos mutua Jsp. p. 304. g de commercio vel communione, nec non de eo, quod cum aliquo versans (boni malive) agis erga eum: ምንተ፡ ብየ፡ ምስሌክን፡ (quid habeo i.e.) quid mihi vobiscum? Joel 4,4; ምንተ፡ ብከ፡ ምስለ፡ ሰላም፡ (quae communio est tibi cum pace?) 4Reg. 9,18; አንከሩ፡ ፩፩ ምስለ፡ ካልኡ፡ (alius cum alio) Gen. 43,33; Hen. 41,5; Jes. 6,3; Jer. 22,8; Jer. 23,35; ይግበር፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ምስሌክን፡ ምሕረተ፡ erga vos, Ruth 1,8; Ruth 2,20; Jos. 2,12; አኮ፡ ከመ፡ ትካት፡ ገጹ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ πρὸς αὐτόν Gen. 31,2; Gen. 31,5; ከመዝ፡ ኀልዩ፡ ምስለ፡ ቢጽክሙ፡ (εἰς ἀλλήλους) Rom. 12,16; 1 Thess. 3,12; 1 Thess. 4,10. h de ratione possessionis: ኢኮኑ፡ ምስለ፡ ውሉድ፡ liberos non habebant Kuf. 3. 2 eodem loco cum aliquo i.e. apud, ad, iuxta Ps. 49,19; Ps. 119,6; Koh. 1,11; Koh. 2,16; ረከብነ፡ ብእሴ፡ ምስሌኪ፡ Dan. apocr. 1,21; አጽዐኖ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ ውስተ፡ ሰረገላሁ፡ 4 Reg. 10,16 (ኀቤሁ፡ 4 Reg. 10,15); Gen. 49,29; ምስሌሁ፡ ἐχόμενα αὐτοῦ 2 Esr. 18,4; vel penes Hen. 9,5; ልብየ፡ ኢሀለወ፡ ምስሌየ፡ 4 Esr. 10,44; 4 Esr. 10,45; vel inter: ዘኢኮነ፡ ምስለ፡ ሰብእ፡ ንብረቱ፡ 4 Esr. 3,50; Marc. 1,13; Luc. 24,5; in spec. post ኈለቈ፡, ተኈለቈ፡, ተፈቅደ፡ 3 de accessione rei ad rem, unde societas utriusque oritur: ad, praeter: Lev. 18,18 (ἐπί c. Dat.); Gen. 28,9 (πρός c. Dat.); Hen. 82,20; ምስለ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ኵሉ፡ σύν πᾶσι τούτοις praeter vel super haec omnia Luc. 24,21; ἐπὶ τούτοις Sir. 35,13; Sir. 37,15; ምስለ፡ ዝኒ፡ πρὸς τούτοις 2 Esr. 16,7; 4 Esr. 5,23. 4 cum aliqua re i.e. ea non obstante (bei, trotz, ut مَعَ, עִם, በ፡ בְּ): Ps. 77,36; ምስለ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ኵሉ፡ Jes. 9,12; (በዝ፡ Jes. 9,17); Jes. 5,25; Sir. 29,25; Sir. 48,15; Jer. 3,10; Kuf. 25; ምስለ፡ ከመዝ፡ οὐδ᾽ ὥς Am. 4,9; Marc. 14,59. mǝsla G ምስለ፡ mǝsla «avec, ensemble» ― ጋራ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 38r. 88 L ምስለ፡ mǝsla with, in the company of, in addition to; also used with verbs expressing reciprocity; according to the context it also has the meanings of other prepositions; e.g. ተሌለዩ፡ አሐዱ፡ ምስለ፡ ካልኡ tatelayu ʾaḥadu mǝsla kālǝʾu they were separated each from his brother (friend, another), አኮ፡ ከመ፡ ትካት፡ ገጹ፡ ምስሌሁ ʾakko kama tǝkāt gaṣṣu mǝslehu his countenance was not toward him as before; ምስለ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ኵሉ mǝsle zǝntu kʷǝllu besides all this, for all this, nonetheless with suffix pronouns the base is ምስሌ- mǝsle- 365b

woorden.betekenis: parabola, similitudo, proverbium, aenigma, sententiose dictu
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. ምሳልያት፡ et ምሳሌያት፡ (at ምሳለያት፡ Asc. Jes. 4,21 errori librarii debetur), assimilatio, comparatio i.e. 1 parabola, similitudo, proverbium, aenigma, sententiose dictum, dicterium παραβολή Koh. 1,17; Koh. 12,9; Matth. 13,3; Matth. 13,24; Matth. 21,45 rom.; Matth. 22,1; Hen. 37,5 seq.; Hen. 68,1; Asc. Jes. 4,20; Ps. 48,4; παροιμία Joh. 10,6; Joh. 16,25; Prov. 1,6; ምሳልያተ፡ ሰሎሞን፡ Prov. in tit.; Asc. Jes. 4,21; πρόβλημα Hab. 2,6; Dan. 8,23; παραβολή ዝንቱ፡ ምሳሌ፡ et ዛቲ፡ ምሳሌ፡ Hez. 18,2; Hez. 18,3; זַעֲוָה Jer. 15,4 et Jer. 24,9 vers. alt.; similitudo, simile Chrys. ho. 7. 2 typus, exemplum 1 Cor. 10,11 Platt; ናመጽእ፡ ምሳሌ፡ ላዕለ፡ ዝንቱ፡ afferemus exemplum hujus rei Chrys. Ta. 22; ምሳሌ፡ ዝንቱ፡ (i.q. exempli gratia) Chrys. ho. 21. mǝssāle, Pl. mǝssālǝyāt, mǝssāleyāt G ምሳሌ፡ mǝssāle, Pl. ምሳልያት፡ mǝssālǝyāt «parabole, figure» ― ምሳሌ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 38r. 88 L ምሳሌ mǝssāle (Pl. ምሳልያት፡ mǝssālǝyāt) similitude, comparison, parable, proverb, example ምሳልያተ፡ ሰሎሞን mǝssālǝyāta salomon The Book of Proverbs, 1–24 365b–366a

woorden.betekenis: id quod, simile, par est, similitudo, typus, incomparabilis,
woorden.definitie: et መምሰል፡ subst. id quod alicui simile vel par est, similitudo, typus: ዝኒ፡ ናሁ፡ መምስሉ፡ (v. መምሰሉ፡) ለዝ፡ ውእቱ፡ (συμφώνως) Koh. 7,14; ሀገር፡ እንተ፡ አልባቲ፡ መምስል፡ incomparabilis Mavâs. 10; አልባቲ፡ መምሰል፡ እምአንስት፡ nulla ex mulieribus ejus similis est Jsp. p. 327; Kuf. 38; መምስለ፡ ሞት፡ ተሰምየ፡ ሕማመ፡ ክርስቶስ፡ ὁμοίωμα θανάτου Cyr. c. Pall. f. 92; τύπος ut: Christus non est መምሰል፡ sed impletor sacrificiorum Cyr. c. Pall. f. 91. mamsǝl, mamsal, Pl. መምስላት፡ mamsǝlāt G አምሳል፡ ʾamsāl et መምስል፡ mamsǝl, Pl. መምስላት፡ mamsǝlāt «image, simulacre, figure, parabole, ressemblance, similitude» ― የሚመስል፡, ምሳያ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 38r. 88 L መምስል mamsǝl, መምሰል mamsal that which is similar, similitude, likeness, type 366a C vid. also አምሳል፡

woorden.betekenis: i.e. مُسْلِمٌ vid. sub ሰለመ፡
woorden.definitie: i.e. مُسْلِمٌ vid. sub ሰለመ፡

woorden.betekenis: stringendo, manum ducendo super rem, unguendo, unguentum, ol
woorden.definitie: I,1 [propria vis radicis est in stringendo, manum ducendo super rem et unguendo מָשַׁח ܡܫܰܚ مَسَحَ, unde ܡܶܫܚܳܐ unguentum, oleum; مَسُوحٌ quod illinitur; unguentum] Subj. ይምሳሕ፡ 1 ungere (vid. መሲሕ፡) 2 oleo, adipe, butyro cibum praeparare, cibum iis conditum edere i.e. a epulari, convivari (potissimum de epulis lautis): φάγετε λιπάσματα καὶ πίετε γλυκάσματα interpres uno verbo ምስሑ፡ vertit 1 Esr. 9,51; ወቦአ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ወሐማ፡ ይምስሑ፡ ምስለ፡ ንግሥት፡ Esth. 7,1; Gen. 43,16; አኅለቁ፡ መሲሐ፡ 3 Reg. 1,41; 1 Reg. 9,19. b in genere: cibum meridianum capere, prandere (opp. ተደረ፡ coenare), coenare (vid. ምሳሕ፡ Nr. 2): ምስካብ፡ ዘዲቤሁ፡ ትረፍቅ፡ ሶበ፡ ትመስሕ፡ (ἐσθίειν) Judith 12,15; እንዘ፡ ይመስሑ፡ Jsp. p. 298; 1 Reg. 16,11; Marc. 2,15; ἀριστᾶν {DiL ἀριστᾷν} 1 Reg. 14,24; Luc. 11,38. masḥa, መስሐ massǝḥa, መሥሐ፡ maśḥa, መሥሐ፡ maśśǝḥa G መሥሐ፡ maśśǝḥa I,2 ይሜሥሕ፡, ይመሥሕ፡ «oindre» ― ቀባ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 35v. 81 መስሐ፡ masḥa I,1 ይመስሕ፡, ይምሳሕ፡ «dîner» ― ምሳ፡ በላ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 38r. 88 L መስሐ masḥa (yǝmsāḥ) I, () መስሐ massǝḥa, (KG) መሥሐ፡ maśḥa anoint 363b መስሐ masḥa (yǝmsāḥ) II feast, eat a midday meal or dinner 364a

woorden.betekenis: unctus, Messias, Christus, pseudomessias, antichristus, masi
woorden.definitie: (adj. verb., deinde) subst., Pl. መሲሓን፡ [nom. peregr., sc. מָשִׁיַח ܡܫܺܝܚܳܐ مَسِيحٌ] χριστός unctus 1 est epitethon honorificum regum Israeliticorum aliorumve unguendo consecratorum: 1 Reg. 2,10; 1 Reg. 2,35; 1 Reg. 12,5; 1 Reg. 24,7 al.; 2 Par. 6,42; 2 Par. 22,7; Am. 6,14; Sir. 46,19; Ps. 17,54; Ps. 19,6; Ps. 27,11; Ps. 83,9; Ps. 88,37; Ps. 88,50; Ps. 131,10; Thren. 4,20; de Cyro መሲሕየ፡ ቂሮስ፡ Jes. 45,1; Pl. መሲሓንየ፡ Ps. 104,14; 1 Par. 16,22; epitheton regis Aethiopiae Sx. Teq. 9Enc. et Catalog. Cod. Bibl. Bodl. Aeth. p. 77. 2 Messias, Christus (Ps. 2,2) 4 Esr. 5,29; 4 Esr. 5,30; Hen. 48,10; Hen. 52,4; et saepissime in libris christianis, ut: Matth. 16,16; Matth. 24,5; Luc. 2,26; Luc. 9,20; Act. 2,36; 1 Joh. 2,22; 1 Joh. 5,1; Apoc. 11,15; ሐሳዌ፡ መሲሕ፡ pseudomessias { vel antichristus } 1 Joh. 2,18; ሐሳውያነ፡ መሲሕ፡ 1 Joh. 2,18; 1 Joh. 2,22; Matth. 24,24 al. masiḥ, መሢሕ፡ maśiḥ, መሢሕ፡ maśśiḥ, Pl. መሢሓን፡ maśśiḥān G መሢሕ፡ maśśiḥ, Pl. መሢሓን፡ maśśiḥān «oint, roi, Christ, Messie» ― የተቀባ፡, ቅቡዕ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 35v. 81 L መሲሕ masiḥ, () መሢሕ፡ maśiḥ anointed one, Messiah, Christ 363b C for ሐሳዌ፡ መሲሕ፡ vid. ሐሳዊ፡

woorden.betekenis: lens, lentes
woorden.definitie: subst. lens, lentes M.F. Vox est amharica; aethiopica est ብርስን፡ q.v.

woorden.betekenis: fundamentum
woorden.definitie: fundamentum, ተመስረተ፡ al. vid. sub ሣረረ፡

woorden.betekenis: seruit, ordine disposuit., mamāsǝq
woorden.definitie: rad. inus.; نَسَقَ seruit, ordine disposuit. መማስቅ፡ mamāsǝq Pl. Kebr. Nag. 17,14 xxiiia (ed.): ‘መሰቀ፡ - መማስቅ፡ 9b 21 s.u. S.8, N.14’. Bezold wrote the following note to the preceding word (ወመማሥጠ፡): ‘ወመማስቅ, das hier im Text folgt, ist wahrscheinlich aus einer Dittographie von ወመማስጠ entstanden (G.)’ (8 n.14 (transl.)). As nothing is stated in the apparatus, one must assume that the word ወመማስቅ፡ is written in all the used text witnesses. Proposal for a conjecture (suggested by Hiruie Ermias): መሳውቅ፡ vid. መስወቅ፡

woorden.betekenis: infestatio, infestator, Satanae, mastemā, māstemā, masteme,
woorden.definitie: n. peregr. sc. מַשְׂטֵמָה infestatio vel concr. infestator (si non מַשְׂטִימָא) a rad. שָׂטַם vel שָׂטַן: est nomen Satanae, in Kuf. 10; Kuf. 17; Kuf. 18; Kuf. 19; Kuf. 48usitatum, unde etiam alios in libros Aeth., ut Org.; Sx. Sen. 12 Enc.; Sx. Nah. 30Enc. transmigravit (in libris Graecis Μαστιφάτ sonat). mastemā, ማስቴማ፡ māstemā, መስቴሜ፡ masteme n. pr. m. (personal name) Satan’s name ወለለኒ፡ ለደቂቁ፡ ታድኅነነ፡ እምክረ፡ መስቴማ፡ ‘e anche a noi suoi figli ci preservi dal consiglio del Mästema’ 138 (218) l. 5 (ed.); 139 (219) l. 4–5 (tr.); አ፡ አጋንንት፡ ብሂል፡ ሰ፡ ሰይጣን፡ ብሂል። መ፡ ማስቴማ፡ ብሂል፡ ‘አ veut dire አጋንንት (démons); ሰ veut dire ሰይጣን (Satan); መ veut dire ማስቴማ (persécuteur)’ 406 G መስቴማ፡ mastemā «diable, démon, Satan» ― ሰይጣን፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 38r. 89 L መስቴማ፡ mastemā, መስቴሜ፡ masteme name of Satan 367b

woorden.betekenis: vetus, vetustescere, corrumpi, corruptioni obnoxium esse, pu
woorden.definitie: quadril. I [amh. id.; formatum est e rad. أَسَنَ أَسِنَ وَسِنَ يَسِنَ (hebr. יָשָׁן vetus), cujus prima vis vetustescere et corrumpi est. Quamquam haud infitiandum est, verbo Ae. etiam quasdam significationes verborum יָשַׁן, שָׁמֵם convenire.] Imperf. et Subj. ይማስን፡, corruptioni obnoxium esse et corrumpi φθείρεσθαι 1 opp. vigore et qualitate recentis, putrescere, fracescere, marcere, vetustate corrumpi, deformari, de segete 4 Esr. 8,49; ሥጋሁ፡ ይማስን፡ Job 14,22; Sap. 9,15; φθαρτός 1 Cor. 9,25; 1 Cor. 15,53; Hen. 16,1; ከመ፡ ይቀስሞሙ፡ በፄው፡ ለእለ፡ ማሰኑ፡ Hom. Jac.; de oculorum acie Deut. 34,7; ዘማሰነ፡ ልቡ፡ cujus mens corrupta vel laesa est (senio, morbo, al.) F.N. 32; deformari Act. 13,41 Platt. 2 dilabi, interire, evanescere: ማሰነ፡ እምድር፡ ዝክርከ፡ Job 2,9; ዘይማስን፡ et ዘኢይማስን፡ corruptibilis et incorruptibilis 4 Esr. 2,22; ወርቅ፡ ዘይማስን፡ 1 Petr. 1,7; 1 Petr. 1,18; በአሕማር፡ ማሰኑ፡ Apoc. 8,9; 4 Esr. 9,37; Jac. 4,14; ማሲና፡ ወመዊታ፡ (Infin. verb.) Cyr. f. 124; ማሕፀንት፡ ዘማሰነት፡ ማስኖ፡ ፍጥረታዌ፡ depositum (animal, vestis, al.) quod causa naturali interiit F.N. 29. 3 in specie: everti, exstingui, vastari, desolari (φθείρεσθαι, ἀφανίζεσθαι, ἐρημοῦσθαι): ይማስን፡ ረሲዕ፡ Prov. 10,25; ለይማስን፡ እምሕዝቡ፡ Ex. 30,38; ለማስኖ፡ 3 Reg. 13,34; saepius de terris, regnis, aedificiis: Jes. 5,6; Jes. 24,3 (ሙስና፡ ትማስን፡ ምድር፡); Jer. 7,34; Jer. 12,11; Jer. 25,11; Hez. 12,19; Hez. 36,34; Gen. 47,19; Ex. 8,20; Hen. 10,8; ይማስን፡ ቤቶሙ፡ ለዕቡያን፡ Sir. 21,4; Jer. 22,5; ትማስን፡ ዛሀገር፡ Jer. 33,9; Dan. 8,11; ዘኢይማስን፡ መንግሥቱ፡ Dan. 6,26; Matth. 12,25. 4 sensu ethico: depravari Gen. 6,11; Gen. 6,12; Kuf. 5; Rom. 14,14; Hen. 12,4; 2 Cor. 11,3; Eph. 4,22. māsana G ማሰነ፡ māsana, quadrl. I, ይማስን፡ «se corrompre, se gâter» ― ጠፋ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 38r. 90 L ማሰነ māsana decay, be spoiled, be corrupt, deteriorate, become rotten, be made desolate, be laid waste, be ruined, be abolished, be destroyed, perish ዘይማስን za-yǝmāssǝn corruptible, destructible, perishable ዘኢይማስን za-iyyǝmāssǝn incorruptible, indestructible, imperishable 366a

woorden.betekenis: putrefascere, corrumpere, vitiare, deformare, imbecillum fac
woorden.definitie: II 1 sensu physico: (putrefascere) corrumpere, vitiare, deformare: ጽንጽንያ፡ ምውት፡ ያማስን፡ አፈወ፡ ቅብእ፡ Koh. 10,1; Luc. 12,33; Matth. 6,19; ለእመ፡ አማሰነ፡ አንጼዋ፡ ልብሰ፡ F.N. 36; ያማስና፡ ሦክ፡ Jes. 7,25; Hen. 69,5; ኢይደልዎ፡ ለመኑሂ፡ ከመ፡ ያማስን፡ መርሕበ፡ ሀገር፡ ወጽጐጓቲሃ፡ F.N. 37; imbecillum factum est ejus ingenium በአማስኖ፡ ናላሁ፡ F.N. 32; virginem Syn.; Sx. Nah. 5; deformare faciem Matth. 6,16. 2 perdere, delere, conficere, consumere Jud. 6,4; Jud. 16,24; 1 Reg. 2,25; 4 Esr. 8,17; Ps. 139,12; Gen. 8,21; Gen. 18,23 seq.; Gen. 19,13; ሞት፡ ዘኵሎ፡ ያማስን፡ Hen. 69,11; 4 Reg. 8,19; Ex. 9,25; Koh. 5,5; prodigere, disperdere pecuniam Luc. 15,13; disturbare temporum computum Kuf. 6; in specie: e conspectu tollere, exstinguere, exstirpare (ἀφανίζειν) Ex. 21,19; c. Acc. rei et እምነ፡ loci: Ex. 12,15; 4 Reg. 10,28; Hen. 69,27; 1 Reg. 24,22. 3 vastare, desolare agros, urbes al. Jes. 14,16; Jes. 24,1; Jes. 37,18; Jes. 49,17; Jer. 2,15; Jer. 10,22; Jer. 12,10; Jer. 25,9; Mal. 1,3; Sir. 21,4; Ps. 78,7; Dan. 9,26; Kuf. 6. 4 sensu ethico: corrumpere, depravare 1 Cor. 15,33; (Hen. 10,7); Gen. 6,12; Kuf. 5. ʾamāsana G አማሰነ፡ ʾamāsana, II, ያማስን፡ «corrompre, gâter» ― አጠፋ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 38r. 90 L አማሰነ፡ ʾamāsana spoil, ruin, corrupt, pervert, subvert, deteriorate, demolish, destroy, lay waste, devastate, make desolate, wipe out 366a

woorden.betekenis: corrumpi, perdi, vastari, tamāsana, être corrumpu ou gâté pa
woorden.definitie: III,1 corrumpi, perdi, vastari Lev. 26,43; ለተሠርዎ፡ ወለተማስኖ፡ (v. ወለማስኖ፡) 3 Reg. 13,34. tamāsana G ተማሰነ፡ tamāsana, III,ይትማሰን፡ «être corrumpu ou gâté par l’action d’un otre» ― ጠፋ፡, ተበላሸ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 38r. 90 L ተማሰነ፡ tamāsana be corrupted, be laid waste 366a

woorden.betekenis: corruptio, putrefactio, perditio, pernicies, interitus, exit
woorden.definitie: subst. (gramm. § 122,e,β) fem. et m., Pl. ሙስናት፡ 1 corruptio, putrefactio: ተዘከሮ፡ ለሞት፡ ወለሙስና፡ (καταφθορά) Sir. 28,6; ዕፄ፡ ወሙስና፡ σῆτες καὶ σκώληκες Sir. 19,3; Lit. Chrys.; διαφθορά Ps. 15,10; Ps. 29,11; Act. 2,27; Act. 13,34; Job 33,28; Ps. 102,4; Prov. 28,10; ኢሙስና፡ ἀφθαρσία Cyr. ad Theod. f. 14; እንበለ፡ ሙስና፡ ἐν ἀφθαρσίᾳ Sap. 2,23. 2 perditio, pernicies, interitus, exitium 4 Esr. 8,64; 4 Esr. 8,68; 4 Esr. 10,14; φθορά 2 Petr. 2,12; ἀπώλεια Apoc. 17,8; Apoc. 17,11; ኮነ፡ ለሙስና፡ ወለሀጕል፡ Jer. 12,11; ሙስናሃ፡ ለነነዌ፡ Tob. 14,15; διαφθορά Jer. 13,14; ἀφανισμός Hez. 12,19; Dan. 9,18; Hebr. 8,13; ወተጋብኡ፡ ፬ሙስናት፡ ዘውእቶሙ፡ ቀትል፡ ወዋዕይ፡ ወፀብእ፡ ወረኃብ፡ Jsp. p. 356. 3 vastatio, desolatio ἐρήμωσις Matth. 24,15; Marc. 13,14; Dan. 9,2; Dan. 9,27; 4 Esr. 1,2; 4 Esr. 12,55; Ps. 72,19. 4 sensu ethico: corruptio, pravitas 2 Petr. 1,4; Kuf. 7; Kuf. 15; Kuf. 23; Eph. 4,17 rom.; Col. 2,22; in specie: vita dissoluta (perditio opum) ἀσωτία Prov. 28,7. musǝnnā, ሙሱና፡ musunnā, Pl. musǝnnāt G ሙስና፡ musǝnnā «corruption, perte, dégâts» ― ጥፋት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 38v. 90 L ሙስና musǝnnā, ሙሱና፡ musunnā spoiling (n), rotting (n), corruption, perdition, ruin, desolation, devastation, destruction, depravity, perversion 366a–b

woorden.betekenis: muscus, moschus
woorden.definitie: subst. [i.q. pers. مُشك, arab. مِسْكٌ, aram. ܡܽܘܫܳܟ, talm. מושׁק, amh. ምስክ፡] odoramenti nomen sc. μόχος muscus ( moschus ) Jsp. p. 340; ምስክ፡ ዘውስተ፡ ቢረሌ፡ F.N. 33,4; Chron. Ax.

woorden.betekenis: pauper
woorden.definitie: pauper, ተመስከነ፡ al. vid. sub ሰከነ፡

woorden.betekenis: liquefieri, liquescere, dilabi, diffluere, dissolvi, tabesce
woorden.definitie: III,1 (rare ተመሰወ፡ ut Dan. 10,16 var.) 1 liquefieri, liquescere, dilabi Job 6,17 (de glacie); Ps. 21,15 (de cera); Jer. 6,29 et Hez. 24,11 (de metallo); ከመ፡ ይትመሰው፡ መዓረ፡ ግራ፡ እምገጸ፡ እሳት፡ Jes. 64,2; Judith 16,15; 4 Esr. 13,5; Sap. 16,27; Mich. 1,4; Hen. 1,6. 2 diffluere, dissolvi, dilabi, tabescere: ይትመሰው፡ አሥራውየ፡ Job 30,17; ይትመሰወከ፡ አምዑትከ፡ Sir. 30,7; Jes. 24,23; Zach. 14,12; Hen. 60,3; Hen. 71,11; ይትመሰዋ፡ ኀጣውኢከ፡ Sir. 3,15; ይትመሶ፡ ኀይሎሙ፡ Job 5,5; ተመሲዎ፡ 2 Petr. 3,11; ትትመሰው፡ ነፍሶሙ፡ በንእሶሙ፡ (ἀποθάνοι) Job 36,14. Transfertur a ad oculos tabescentes: ይትመሰዋ፡ አዕይንተ፡ ረሲዓን፡ Job 11,20; Job 17,5. b ad manus remissas: ተመስወ፡ እደዊሆሙ፡ Jer. 27,43. c ad animum demissum vel pavore Lev. 26,16; Jos. 5,1; Jos. 2,9; Dan. 10,16; Ps. 74,3; Jer. 30,13; Job 42,6 vel moerore Jes. 19,10 (λυπηθήσονται) vel pudore 4 Esr. 6,62; vel amore Sx. Hed. 16. d ad animum dissolutum libidinibus 1 Thess. 4,5 rom. tamaswa, tamasawa G ተመስወ፡ tamaswa III,1 ይትመሰው፡ «être liquéfié, fondu, détruit, ruiné» ― ቀለጠ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 39r. 91 L ተመሰወ tamasawa be melted, be liquefied, be dissolved, waste away, dwindle, fail, pine away, be enfeebled, be consumed 368a

woorden.betekenis: aquilo, boreas, septemtrio, plaga septemtrionalis, masʿ, Nor
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., [amh. ምሥእ፡; arab. نَسْعٌ, نِسْعٌ, مِسْعٌ] 1 aquilo, boreas Hen. 77,3; ነፋሰ፡ መስዕ፡ τυφωνικός Act. 27,14. 2 septemtrio, plaga septemtrionalis (βοῤῥᾶς, βορέας): ሰፍሖ፡ ለመስዕ፡ ዲበ፡ ወኢምንት፡ Job 26,7; Job 37,21; Job 38,39; እብሎ፡ ለመስዕ፡ Jes. 43,5; Jer. 6,1; Dan. 11,6; Ps. 47,2; Ps. 88,12; Ps. 106,3; Judith 16,3; Gen. 13,14; Ex. 40,20; Lev. 1,11; Num. 2,25; Num. 34,7; Jos. 15,5; Jos. 15,10; Hen. 32,1. – (Ps. 77,30 ab Aethiopibus መስዕ፡ ventus contra auctoritatem Graeci intrusus est). Memorabilis est versio loci ἐκτρέπων εἰς τὸ πρωΐ σκιάν ዘይመይጦ፡ ለብርሃን፡ መንገለ፡ መስዕ፡ Am. 5,8. – De confusione vocis መስዕ፡ cum አዜብ፡ et ሰሜን፡ vid. ann. ad Gen. 20,1 et s.v. ሰሜን፡ masʿ G መስዕ፡ masʿ «Nord» ― ሰሜን፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 39r. 92 L መስዕ masʿ north, north wind, southwest wind, southeast 362b

woorden.betekenis: vespertinus fuit, vesperi fecit, vesperam factam esse, vespe
woorden.definitie: I,1 [amh. መሸ፡; arab. مَسَا vespertinus fuit, vesperi fecit; cfr. hebr. אֶמֶשׁ] Subj. ይምሰይ፡ vesperam factam esse, vesperascere; c. aut impers., ut እስከ፡ መስየ፡ 2 Par. 18,34; Ruth 2,17; እስከ፡ ይመሲ፡ Macc. f. 3; Ps. 103,24; እምከመ፡ መስየ፡ Matth. 16,2; Matth. 20,8; Luc. 24,29; Gen. 29,23; Ex. 16,13; Jud. 19,9; Judith 13,1; Tob. 2,2; Tob. 7,9; እፎ፡ እንጋ፡ ይመሲ፡ Deut. 28,67; Job 7,4; መሲዮ፡ vel መስዮ፡ cum vesperasceret Matth. 27,57; Kuf. 27; ዘኀበ፡ መስዮ፡ ይበይት፡ Sir. 36,31; aut nominibus temporis et loci tamquam praedicatum attribuitur: መስየሂ፡ ወድአ፡ ሰዓት፡ Marc. 6,35; መሲዮ፡ ዐርብ፡ Marc. 15,42; እስመ፡ መስየነ፡ ብሔር፡, etiam መስየ፡ ብሔር፡ Gad. T.H. (vid. ብሔር፡). masya G መስየ፡ masya I,1 ይመሲ፡, ይምሲ፡ «faire soir» ― መሸ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 39r. 92 L መስየ masya (yǝmsay, yǝmsi) become evening 368b

woorden.betekenis: vespera, crepusculum vespertinum, vespera quintae feriae, pl
woorden.definitie: vel ምስየት፡ (Kuf. 49), subst., Plur. ምሴታት፡ (et ምስያታት፡ Kuf. 49) vespera (crepusculum vespertinum): ምሴተ፡ ከዊኖ፡ Matth. 8,16; Matth. 26,20; በምሴት፡ Koh. 11,6; ምሴተ፡ ἑσπέρας Tob. 6,2; ደመና፡ ምሴት፡ νέφος ὄψιμον Prov. 16,15; በዐሡሩ፡ ወሰቡዑ፡ ምሴት፡ Kuf. p. 23; ምሴተ፡ ኀሙስ፡ vespera quintae feriae Lit. – (Kuf. p. 28ab interprete voci ምሴት፡ significatio plagae occidentalis sicut voci ቀትር፡ plagae meridionalis indita videtur). mǝset, mǝsyat G ምሴት፡ mǝset «soir» ― ምሸት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 39r. 92 L ምሴት mǝset, ምስየት mǝsyat evening, twilight 368b

woorden.betekenis: vincire, in vincula conjicere
woorden.definitie: vincire, in vincula conjicere vid. sub ወቅሐ፡

woorden.betekenis: dominari, potestatem habere, mabbala, avoir autorité, maîtri
woorden.definitie: I,2 [denom. a nomine e rad. በዐለ፡ בָּעַל ܒܥܰܠ بَعَلَ et بَلِلَ derivato] dominium obtinere et exercere, dominari, potestatem habere, c.c. ላዕለ፡, ut: በሐኵ፡ እንዘ፡ ይሜብል፡ ላዕለ፡ መርዔት፡ Prov. 24,66; 1 Tim. 2,12; 1 Cor. 6,12 rom.; Kuf. 10; Kuf. 19; c. ዲበ፡ Kuf. 43; በ፡ Kuf. 10; c. ውስተ፡ terrae Kuf. 22; Kuf. 40; Kuf. 43; c. Acc.: ገብር፡ ጠቢብ፡ ይሜብል፡ አጋእዝተ፡ አብዳነ፡ Prov. 17,2. – Voc. Ae.: መበለ፡ ዘ፡ ተዠሐረ፡ (v. ተዠረ፡). mabbala G መበለ፡ mabbala I,2 ይሜብል፡, ይመብል፡ «avoir autorité, maîtriser, prendre le dessus, inspirer respect et crainte» ― ሰለጠነ፡, ተፈራ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 39v. 93 L መበለ mabbala rule, domineer, exercise authority, wield power, (Sw. in 183) behave arrogantly 328b

woorden.betekenis: extendit
woorden.definitie: rad. inus.; arab. مَتَّ extendit funem, vic. مَتَأَ, et مَتَا, nec non مَدَّ. Hinc

woorden.betekenis: vir adultus, extendendo, maritus, vir, mǝt, ʾamtāt, mari, hu
woorden.definitie: subst., m., Pl. አምታት፡ [proprie: vir adultus, ab extendendo dictus, sicut hebr. מְתִים viri a rad. מָתָה; deinde aethiopice:] maritus, vir (etiam vir futurus vel desponsatus) Luc. 2,36; Marc. 10,12; Job 4,16; Job 4,18; Rom. 7,2; Rom. 7,3; 1 Cor. 7,2; 1 Cor. 7,3; Gen. 2,23; Hos. 2,9; Judith 8,2; 4 Esr. 10,24; Ruth 1,3; Deut. 25,5–7; Sir. 22,4; Sir. 40,23; ምትኪ፡ ዘንእስኪ፡ Jer. 3,4; እንተ፡ ባቲ፡ ምተ፡ Jes. 54,1; Kuf. 33; vir sponsae 2 Reg. 17,3; Matth. 1,19 rom.; Apoc. 21,2; Plur. Ruth 1,9; Esth. 1,18; Tob. 3,8; Sir. 24,15; Hez. 16,45; 1 Petr. 3,1; 1 Petr. 3,5; Tit. 2,4; Tit. 2,5; Eph. 5,22. mǝt, Pl. አምታት፡ ʾamtāt G ምት፡ mǝt, Pl. አምታት፡ ʾamtāt «mari» ― ባል፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 39v. 94 L ምት mǝt, (Pl. አምታት፡ ʾamtāt) husband ምተ፡ እኅት mǝta ʿǝḫǝt brother-in-law, vid. እኅት፡ 371a

woorden.betekenis: secuit, amputavit, desecare, resecare, praecidere, succidere
woorden.definitie: I,1 [i.q. مَتَرَ et بَتَرَ secuit, amputavit, בָּתַר] Subj. ይምትር፡ 1 desecare, resecare, praecidere, succidere, abscidere, amputare: ይመትሩ፡ (v. ይገምዱ፡) አስካለ፡, ይመትሩ፡ ሠርጸ፡ Jes. 18,5; ἀπέκνισε Hez. 17,4; Lev. 1,15; Lev. 4,31; funem Act. 27,32; ungues: ኢይምትር፡ ጽፍሮ፡ Clem. f. 21; laciniam vestis 1 Reg. 27,5; ዕጡፈ፡ ፀምር፡ Jes. 38,12; aurem Matth. 26,51; caput Matth. 14,10; 4 Reg. 10,6; Gen. 40,19; 1 Par. 10,9; Judith 13,8; nervos pedum Gen. 49,6; Jos. 11,6; Jos. 11,9; manus Deut. 25,12; Jos. 11,6; collum decidere (decollare) Hen. 98,12; መተረ፡ ክሣዳ፡ Jsp. p. 346; seq. እምነ፡ ut: እመትር፡ ርእሰከ፡ እምኔከ፡ 1 Reg. 17,46; ምትራ፡ እምኔከ፡ Sir. 25,26; መተረ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ እምእስራኤል፡ ርእሰ፡ ወዘነበ፡ Jes. 9,14. 2 exsecare, excidere, exscindere: ከመ፡ ይምትሩ፡ ብእሴ፡ እማእከለ፡ ይሁዳ፡ Jer. 51,7; መተርናሃ፡ እምውስተ፡ አሕዛብ፡ Jer. 31,2; transl. መተርነ፡ ዘንተ፡ ልማደ፡ እኩየ፡ II Can. Nic. 79. 3 dissecare, discindere: ἀποτέμνειν Tob. 6,5; διαιρεῖν Gen. 15,10; Lev. 9,15; መተራ፡ ፲ወ፪ክፍለ፡ ἐμέλισεν Jud. 19,29; 1 Reg. 11,7; መቲረ፡ ሥርው፡ Hen. 7,1; መተሮ፡ (ለመጽሐፍ፡) በመጥባሕተ፡ ጸሓፊ፡ Jer. 43,23; διακόπτειν Ps. 28,7. 4 concidere Ps. 88,23; Job 3,8; concidendo et cudendo transformare: ይመትሩ፡ መጣብሒሆሙ፡ ለምሳር፡ Jes. 2,4 (vid. I,2). 5 Transfertur a abscidere aliquem tamquam membrum ecclesiae putridum i.e. excommunicare Lud., et abscidere aliquem a munere i.e. deponere vel removere: ይመትርዎ፡ እመዓርጊሃ፡ ለቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ Clem. f. 147(vid. III,1). b abscindere vel intercidere i.e. α intermittere et interrumpere: ቦኑ፡ ለግሙራ፡ ይመትር፡ ምሕረቶ፡ Ps. 76,8; Satanas studet ከመ፡ ይምትር፡ ኅሊናሁ፡ (ለዘይጼሊ፡) Phlx. 100; ክልአታት፡ ወመቲሮታት፡ እምነ፡ impedimenta et interpellationes (quae distinent) a Phlx. 55. β intercludere: Vespasianus መተረ፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ ውኂዘ፡ ማይ፡ Jsp. p. 349; intercludere aliquem a peccato F.M. 2,11. c discindere i.e. dirimere, decernere: si quis agit in aliquem, ይምትሩ፡ ጉቡኣን፡ ነገሮ፡ Can. Ant. 18(20); ለእመ፡ መተረ፡ በኅሊናሁ፡ ከመ፡ ይዕቀብ፡ ድንግልናሁ፡ F.N. 24,1; { መቲረ፡ ጋእዛት፡ F.N. 4}. d praecidere, spem: ኢትምትር፡ ተስፋሁ፡ Sx. Pag. 4. – Voc. Ae.: በተከ፡ መተረ፡ ገዘመ፡ ገመደ፡ ወቀየ፡ ብ፡ ቈረጸ። matara G መተረ፡ matara I,1 ይመትር፡, ይምትር፡ «couper» ― ቈረጠ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 40r. 94 L መተረ፡ matara yǝmtǝr cut, cut off, cut up, cut asunder, break up, interrupt, shut off, depose, remove (from office), excommunicate, decree, decide, determine 372a C vid. also መተረ፡

woorden.betekenis: segmentum, sectio, mamtart, cleft, segment, piece
woorden.definitie: subst. segmentum, sectio Asc. Jes. 4,21; Hen. 21,7. mamtart L መምተርት mamtart cleft, segment, piece 372a

woorden.betekenis: extendit, firmus, robustus fuit.
woorden.definitie: rad. inus.; arab. مَتَنَ extendit, مَتُنَ firmus, robustus fuit.

woorden.definitie: vid. sub ኀብረ፡

woorden.betekenis: vid. sub ኀፈደ፡
woorden.definitie: vid. sub ኀፈደ፡

woorden.betekenis: quis, quae, qui, quae?, uter, utra?, quis eorum?, qualis?, q
woorden.definitie: pron. subst. pers. interrog. (gramm. § 63; gramm. § 147,b; gramm. § 198,c). Nonnisi ad personas refertur, rarissime ad res, ut መኑ፡ የዐቢ፡ መንግሥተ፡ ሰማያትኑ፡ ወሚመ፡ ገነት፡ Clem. f. 62(aliter se habet phrasis መኑ፡ ስምከ፡ quam vid. infra). Est gen. masc. et fem., num. sing. et pl.; quamquam pl. nonnumquam praemisso እለ፡ a singulari distinguitur: እለ፡ መኑ፡ እሙንቱ፡ አኀውየ፡ Matth. 12,48; Hebr. 3,16; እለ፡ መኑ፡ እሙንቱ፡ τίνες εἰσίν; Chrys. ho. 27. Accusativus est መነ፡, rarius መነሃ፡ Jes. 51,12 var.; Matth. 27,21 rom.; መነሃ፡ እጼውዕ፡ Org.; sed passim etiam መኑ፡ ut Jes. 6,8 var.; Sir. 18,4 var. 1 est interrogativum: quis, quae, qui, quae? መኑ፡ ዝንቱ፡ Jes. 63,1; Gen. 24,65; 1 Reg. 25,10; Ps. 38,11; Matth. 3,7; Matth. 21,10; Marc. 10,26; መኑ፡ ይእቲ፡ ዛቲ፡ Cant. 8,5; Ruth 2,9; አንቲ፡ መኑ፡ አንቲ፡ Judith 10,12; Matth. 12,48; መኑ፡ ውእቶሙ፡ እሉ፡ Hen. 40,8; መኑ፡ ወመኑ፡ አንትሙ፡ Ex. 10,8; Acc. መነ፡ Esth. 6,6; Gen. 37,15; 1 Reg. 28,11; Thren. 2,20; Gen. notatur aut praemisso nominis statu constr.: ወልደ፡ መኑ፡ ዝንቱ፡ 1 Reg. 17,56; በርስተ፡ መኑ፡ እንከ፡ አኀድር፡ Sir. 24,7; Gen. 24,23; Matth. 21,23; Matth. 22,42; aut nota Gen. ዘ፡, እንተ፡, እለ፡, ut: ዘመኑ፡ ዝአልባስ፡ Asc. Jes. 9,25; Matth. 22,20; Jes. 51,28; Hen. 22,6; Ruth 2,5; እለ፡ መኑ፡ አንትሙ፡ Jsp. p. 377; praepositiones praemissas admittit: ለመኑ፡ Jer. 6,10; Prov. 23,29; Sir. 10,29; Sir. 31,29; Jes. 50,1; Jes. 53,1; በመኑ፡ Jes. 36,4; Jes. 40,18; 4 Esr. 3,69; ኀበ፡ መኑ፡ Jes. 10,3; Jes. 66,2; እምነ፡ መኑ፡ Hez. 32,12; እምኀበ፡ መኑ፡ Matth. 17,25; በእንተ፡ መኑ፡ Hen. 21,5; al. a uter, utra? Matth. 21,31; Luc. 7,42; Luc. 22,27; Sir. 31,29; Jer. 51,28. b ad res refertur, ubi in his personarum notio inest: መኑ፡ ስምከ፡ Gen. 32,28; Jud. 13,17; Asc. Jes. 7,3; Marc. 5,9; Prov. 24,27; Clem. f. 221. c in interrogationibus obliquis: Jer. 51,28; Asc. Jes. 9,14; Asc. Jes. 9,15; Gen. 43,22; 3 Reg. 1,20; Matth. 10,11; Marc. 14,65. d መኑ፡ እምነ፡ quis eorum? Jud. 21,8; Matth. 21,31. e nomen sibi appositum cum መኑ፡ haud toleret, lat. qui, qualis? (vel pronomine adjectivo አይ፡ vel) phrasi መኑ፡–ዘ፡ circumscribitur: መኑ፡ (ውእቱ፡) ብእሲ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ዘይሌብዎ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ Jer. 9,12; Job 9,4; መኑ፡ ባዕድ፡ ዘ፡ Jes. 44,25; Deut. 4,7; Deut. 4,8. f intenditur interrogatio formulâ መኑ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዘ፡ quis tandem? quisnam? ubi est qui? መኑ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዘኢይስሕት፡ በአፉሁ፡ Sir. 19,16; Sir. 36,31; Jes. 40,12; Jes. 50,8; Rom. 8,33; Rom. 8,34; Hen. 93,11; Matth. 10,11. 2 optative usurpatur, vel seq. Imperf.: መኑ፡ ይሁበኒ፡ አእምሮ፡ Job 23,3; Jer. 9,1; Ps. 4,7; መኑ፡ ይሠይም፡ ዐቃቤ፡ ላዕለ፡ አፉየ፡ Sir. 22,27; Sir. 23,2; vel seq. እም፡ (እመ፡) c. Perf., ut: መኑ፡ እምአስተየኒ፡ 1 Par. 11,17; 2 Reg. 23,15; Num. 11,29; Deut. 5,26; Deut. 30,13; Jud. 9,29; Rom. 7,24; vel seq. simplice Perf. Hen. 63,5. 3 indefinitum fit adjecto ሂ፡, quare dicas: መኑሂ፡ aliquis, aliqua ( ullus, quisquam ): ዘይዘብጥ፡ መነሂ፡ F.N. 6,5; Matth. 12,29; potissimum usitatur in sententiis negativis: ኢ፡–መኑሂ፡, አልቦ፡–መኑሂ፡ nemo ut Matth. 8,28; Ex. 34,24; Sir. 15,20; Sir. 18,4; Lev. 27,26; Prov. 26,2; Jes. 11,9; ዘትጸልእ፡ ለሊከ፡ ኢትግበር፡ ለመኑሂ፡ Tob. 4,15; et praemisso ወ፡ usurpatur ወኢመኑሂ፡ vel ወኢመኑ፡ et ne unus quidem, nemo omnino, ut Matth. 17,8; Lev. 16,17; Jac. 1,13. Memorabilis est locutio: ወለእመኒ፡ መኑ፡ ኮነ፡ ὅστις ἂν ᾖ Gal. 5,10 rom. (Platt: መኑሂ፡ ዘኮነ፡ ከዊነ፡).

woorden.betekenis: quid?, utrum?, qualis, quale?, quae est arbor, sub qua … ?,
woorden.definitie: pron. interrog., ad res relatum (neutr.) quid? (gramm. § 63; gramm. § 147,b; gramm. § 198,e). Plurali caret; Acc. ምንተ፡, et in interrogatione recta et in obliqua usurpatur. 1 interrogativum: ምንት፡ ውእቱ፡ እጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ ወምንት፡ ባቍዑ፡ ወምንትኑ፡ ሠናይቱ፡ ወምንትኑ፡ እኪቱ፡ Sir. 18,8; ምንት፡ እንከ፡ ረባሖሙ፡ ለክልኤሆሙ፡ Sir. 20,30; Jud. 8,1; ምንትኑ፡ ዛቲ፡ አበሳ፡ Jos. 22,16; Ps. 38,6; ምንትኑ፡ እላ፡ አህጉር፡ 3 Reg. 9,13; Hen. 52,3; utrum? Matth. 9,5; Acc. Gen. 4,10; 4 Reg. 4,13; Marc. 14,64; Apoc. 2,29; ምንተ፡ ይመስል፡ ብእሲሁ፡ 4 Reg. 1,7; Joh. 6,9; statui constr. subjunctum: አሰረ፡ ምንትኑ፡ ዝንቱ፡ Dan. apocr. 13,19. a Creberrime annexa particula interrogativa ኑ፡ intenditur: ምንትኑ፡ Rom. 3,1; Jac. 4,12; Gen. 44,15; ምንትኑ፡ ዝንቱ፡ Zach. 4,4; Zach. 4,5; al. b saepe de qualitate rerum interrogat: qualis, quale? ምንት፡ ሕዝብከ፡ ἐκ ποίου καοῦ εἶ σύ Jon. 1,8; Jer. 8,9; Sir. 34,27; Marc. 1,27; Marc. 6,2; Luc. 7,39; Luc. 24,17; Joh. 7,36; Eph. 1,18; Eph. 1,19 (vid. etiam d). c crebro de personis praeciatur, sive quia cujusnam generis et rationis sint interrogans nescit: ምንትኑ፡ እሉ፡ Zach. 1,9; Luc. 7,39; sive quia contemtim loquitur: ምንትኑ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ይብልዎ፡ τίς οὖτος; Sir. 13,23; ምንትኑ፡ አንትሙ፡ እለ፡ τίνες ἔστε ὑμεῖς οἵ Judith 8,12; አነ፡ ምንት፡ አነ፡ Job 9,24; 2 Reg. 7,18; Ex. 16,7; Ps. 8,5; Hebr. 2,6; Rom. 14,4; Rom. 14,10. d quamvis ምንት፡ plurimis in locis substantivi vim teneat (unde ex. gr. locutionem: ምንት፡ ዕፁ፡ በኀበ፡ ረከብክሙ፡ ὑπὸ τί δένδρον; quae est arbor, sub qua … ? Dan. apocr. 1,58 explicabis), tamen (secus ac መኑ፡) nomen vel adj. rel. subst. sibi appositum haud aspernatur: Matth. 5,46; Matth. 27,23; Hen. 60,5; ምንተ፡ ብነ፡ ክፍለ፡ ምስለ፡ ዳዊት፡ 3 Reg. 12,16; ምንተ፡ ረከብከ፡ ላዕለ፡ ገብርከ፡ አበሳ፡ 1 Reg. 29,8; Kuf. 12. e pronomen pers. suffixum, cui sensus Dativi inest, assumit: ምንትከ፡ እሙንቱ፡ እሉ፡ Gen. 33,5; Gen. 33,8; Gen. 48,8. f cum aliis vocibus interrogativis omisso ወ፡ copulari potest: እፎ፡ ምንተ፡ πῶς ἢ τί; Matth. 10,19. g nota locutionem: ምንተ፡ ኮንከ፡ quid factus es i.e. quid est tibi? Jud. 1,14; Gen. 21,17; Ps. 113,5; 1 Reg. 1,8; Jes. 22,1; et ምንት፡ ብኪ፡ ከመ፡ ትሰተዪ፡ Jer. 2,17. h nota locutionem: quid tibi est mecum sc. negotii? ምንት፡ ብከ፡ ምስሌየ፡ Jud. 11,12; Jos. 22,24; Joel 4,4; Matth. 8,29; Marc. 5,7; vel ምንት፡ ብየ፡ ምስሌኪ፡ Joh. 2,4. i de ምንት፡ et ምንተ፡ quare? cur? et de ምንት፡ cum praepp. vid. infra. 2 indefinitum fit addito ኒ፡, rarius ሂ፡ (rarissime sine ኒ et ሂ፡, ut Sx. Tachs. 5 Enc.); potissimum in enuntiationibus negativis usitatur: aliquid, aliquod; quod; quidquam, ullum; substantive usurpatur: Jac. 1,7; Ps. 38,7; Gal. 2,6; Phil. 1,28; al.; et adjective: ኢታንሥኡ፡ ምንተኒ፡ ጾረ፡ Jer. 17,21: ኢይትቃወማ፡ ምንትኒ፡ እኩይ፡ Prov. 3,15; ምንትኒ፡ ሐሰት፡ ኢ፡ Prov. 24,23; 4 Esr. 13,10; Gen. 19,8; Hen. 14,13; Hen. 78,17, et ipsis personarum nominibus attribuitur, ut: ምንተኒ፡ አንስተ፡ ኢያአምር፡ Kuf. 25; ከመ፡ ኢይንሣእ፡ ምንተኒ፡ ብእሲተ፡ Kuf. 25. Praefixo ወ፡, ut: ወኢምንትኒ፡ significat: ne ullum quidem ut Cant. 4,7; Matth. 27,12; Hen. 14,7; ወአልቦ፡ ወኢምንትኒ፡ Jer. 4,23; al.; praeterea ወኢምንት፡ vel ወኢምንትኒ፡ est nihil, nihil omnino: Ex. 10,26; ሰፍሖ፡ ለመስዕ፡ ዲበ፡ ወኢምንት፡ Job 26,7; ከመ፡ ወኢምንትኒ፡ ክዒወ፡ ደም፡ በኀቤሁ፡ Sir. 8,16; ከመ፡ ወኢምንት፡ እሙንቱ፡ Jes. 40,15; Jes. 40,17; Jes. 40,23; 4 Esr. 4,64; relatum ad tempus: ከመ፡ ወኢምንትኒ፡ ἐν στιγμῇ χρόνου Luc. 4,5. Nonnumquam ኢምንተኒ፡ adverbialiter usurpatur: nullo modo Sx. Mag. 5 Enc.; Sx. Tachs. 5 Enc. – Adverbialiter usurpantur a ምንትኑ፡ vel ምንት፡ quid? quomodo? cur? Gen. 40,7; Sir. 38,25; Hen. 83,6; ምንትኑመ፡ Matth. 11,8; Matth. 11,9 Platt. b ምንተ፡ vel ምንተኑ፡ quid? quomodo? cur? Gen. 26,27; ምንተ፡ ወለድከኒ፡ Jes. 45,10; Jes. 22,16; 1 Reg. 21,1; 4 Esr. 5,15; እምውስተ፡ ርኩስ፡ ምንተ፡ ይወጽእ፡ ንጹሕ፡ Sir. 31,4; Num. 22,9; Num. 23,8; 3 Reg. 19,9; Matth. 7,3; Matth. 11,7; Matth. 11,8; Matth. 11,9 rom. Praeterea nota, in locutionibus, quales sunt ምንት፡ አሥሐቃ፡, ምንት፡ አቀመክሙ፡ quid eam ridere, vos stare fecit? i.e. cur risit? cur statis? frequentissimis, pro nominativo ምንት፡ crebro acc. ምንተ፡ reperiri: cur ridere eam fecit? (imperson.), ut 2 Reg. 24,21; Herm. 26ap. c ለምንት፡, ለምንትኑ፡ α quare? cur? qua de causa? Matth. 8,26; 1 Cor. 4,7; Gen. 31,30; Ex. 14,15; Ex. 32,11; Ps. 41,15; Ps. 49,17; Jes. 3,15; Jes. 55,2; Jes. 58,4; Jer. 14,19; Job 3,11; Job 3,12; Job 9,29. β cui rei? quem in finem? Gen. 25,22; Gen. 27,46; Ruth 1,11; ለምንትኑ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ወለምንትኑ፡ ዝክቱ፡ Sir. 39,16; 4 Esr. 3,45; Matth. 9,14; Matth. 26,8. d በምንት፡, በምንትኑ፡ qua in re? Jud. 16,5; qua cum re? 1 Reg. 6,2; qua in re i.e. unde? በምንት፡ ኣአምር፡ Gen. 15,8; qua re ( womit, wodurch ?) Matth. 5,13; 1 Reg. 29,4; qua ratione? Ps. 118,9; al. pro vario praepositionis በ፡ usu. Nonnumquam በምንት፡ est ob quid? cur? Matth. 14,31; Kuf. 12; τοιγαροῦν (በምንትኑመ፡) Job 22,10. e በእንተ፡ ምንት፡ vel ምንትኑ፡ vel በበይነ፡ ምንት፡ quam ob rem? cur? quare? Jer. 5,19; Jer. 13,22; Judith 11,3; 4 Esr. 3,24; 4 Esr. 13,53; Matth. 17,19. f እስከ፡ ምንት፡ vel ምንትኑ፡ quousque? quamdiu? Job 19,2; Ex. 10,3.

woorden.betekenis: i.q. መሀና፡ q.v.
woorden.definitie: i.q. መሀና፡ q.v.

woorden.betekenis: tentatio
woorden.definitie: tentatio, መንሰወ፡, al. vid. sub ነሰወ፡

woorden.betekenis: reprobare, repudiare, rejicere, abjicere, aspernari, sperner
woorden.definitie: I,2 [amh. id.; vic. sunt מֵאֵן ܡܶܐܢ, מָנַע مَنَعَ, nec non مَنَّ in quibusdam derivatis, et amh. መነመነ፡] c.c. Acc. 1 reprobare, repudiare, rejicere: ይሜንን፡ እኩየ፡ (opp. የኀሪ፡ ሠናየ፡) Jes. 7,15; ἀποδοκιμάζειν: እግዚአብሔር፡ መነኖሙ፡ Jer. 6,30; Jer. 7,29; Jer. 8,9; Jer. 14,19; Jer. 38,37; ኢትመንነኒ፡ Sap. 9,4; Matth. 21,42; Marc. 12,10; Ps. 117,21; ἀπωθεῖν መንኖ፡ መነንከነ፡ Thren. 5,22. 2 repudiare, abjicere, aspernari: ቅዱሳን፡ ፈለሱ፡ ገዳመ፤ መነኑ፡ ዓለመ፡ et መኒኖሙ፡ ፍትወታተዝ፡ ዓለም፡ Clem. f. 153; Clem. f. 202; በምክንያተ፡ መንኖ፡ ዓለም፡ F.M. 12,1; Hen. 48,7; Mavâs. 18; ἀποποιεῖσθαι ኢትመንን፡ ግብረ፡ እደዊከ፡ Job 14,15; ἐξουδενοῦν Ps. 105,24; Prov. 1,7; Marc. 9,12; προσοχθίζειν ብእሲ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ኢይሜንኖ፡ Sir. 38,4; መነነት፡ ነፍስየ፡ ወጸልአቶሙ፡ Sir. 25,2; ዔሳው፡ መነነ፡ ቀዲመ፡ ተወልዶ፡ Kuf. 24; Hen. 99,14. 3 spernere, nihili aestimare, despicere: ἐξουδενεῖν Job 30,1; Am. 6,1; 1 Reg. 8,7; 2 Reg. 6,16; Rom. 14,3; ἀτιμάζειν Prov. 14,21; καταφρονεῖν Judith 10,19. – Voc. Ae.: ገደፈ፡ መነነ፡ ዘ፡ ጠሐለ፡ mannana G መነነ፡ mannana I,2 ይሜንን፡, ይመንን፡ «mépriser, rejeter» ― ናቀ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 41r. 97 L መነነ mannana despise, disdain, reject, repudiate, renounce, repel, cast aside, hold in contempt, belittle 350b

woorden.betekenis: repudiare facere, prohibere, festum, quod non admittit vinum
woorden.definitie: II,2 1 repudiare facere i.e. prohibere: festum ዘያሜንን፡ ወይነ፡ quod non admittit vinum (bibere) Sx. Ter 11Enc. 2 detrahere alicui (einen verkleinern) Lud. e V.S. ʾamannana G አመነነ፡ ʾamannana II,2 ያሜንን፡, ያመንን፡ «faire mépriser, faire rejeter, exclure» ― አስናቀ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 41r. 97 L አመነነ ʾamannana causative {of vid. መነነ mannana}; also render contemptible 350b

woorden.betekenis: rejectus, reprobatus, rejiciendus, reprobandus, de connubiis
woorden.definitie: part. 1 rejectus, reprobatus et rejiciendus, reprobandus: ብሩር፡ ምኑን፡ ἀποδεδοκιμασμένον Jer. 6,30; 1 Petr. 2,4; ἀδόκιμος Tit. 1,16; 1 Cor. 9,27; 2 Cor. 13,5-7; Kuf. 6; Kuf. 30; Kuf. 33; በእንተ፡ ተዋስቦ፡ ምንንት፡ de connubiis reprobandis (illegitimis) F.M. 5,14; Hen. 16,3; adulterinus ምኑናነ፡ ኮነ፡ በኀቤሁ፡ Sap. 2,16 (εἰς κίβδηλον); Hen. 10,9. 2 repudiatus, spretus, abominabilis: ምኑነ፡ ረሰይክሙ፡ ትእዛዝየ፡ Prov. 1,25; Mal. 1,7; Ps. 14,5; Ps. 89,5; βδέλυγμα: ምኑን፡ ብእሲ፡ ጻድቅ፡ ለብእሲ፡ ገፋዒ፡ Prov. 29,27; Prov. 12,22; Prov. 15,26. 3 vilis, futilis, nequam (inanis): ἄτιμος Sap. 5,4; ራእዩ፡ ምኑን፡ Jes. 53,3; ἄχρηστος Sap. 2,11; ἀχρεῖος 2 Reg. 6,22; μάταιος Prov. 29,48; ἐξουδενωμένος Ps. 72,21. mǝnnun, fem. ምንንት፡ mǝnnǝnt; Pl. ምኑናን፡ mǝnnunān, fem. ምኑናት፡ mǝnnunāt G ምኑን፡ mǝnnun, Pl. ምኑናን፡ mǝnnunān «méprisé, rejeté, méprisable, vil, abject» ― የተናቀ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 41r. ምንንት፡ mǝnnǝnt fem., Pl. ምኑናት፡ mǝnnunāt «méprisée, vile, abjecte» ― የተናቀች፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 41r. 98 L ምኑን mǝnnun rejected, despised, reprobate, renounced, repudiated, despicable, abominable, ignoble, contemptible, repulsed, vile, worthless, useless 350b

woorden.betekenis: repdudiatio, aspernatio, rejectio, vilitas, nequitia, mǝnnān
woorden.definitie: subst. 1 repdudiatio, aspernatio act.: እመ፡ ሖረ፡ በትምይንት፡ ወምናኔ፡ በከመ፡ ገብረ፡ ለአጋግ፡ Did. 4(Platt p. 24). 2 rejectio pass., vilitas, nequitia: ὄνειδος (probrum) Prov. 18,13; ርኵስ፡ ወምናኔ፡ Kuf. 11; Kuf. 21. mǝnnāne, ምናን፡ mǝnnān G ምናኔ፡ mǝnnāne «mépris, abjection, avilissement, chose méprisable» ― ማናቅ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 41r. 98 L ምናኔ mǝnnāne, (Lt) ምናን mǝnnān rejection, disdain, vileness, repudiation, renunciation, worthlessness, wickedness 350b

woorden.betekenis: ê, discessum, distantiam, separationem, a, de, ex, e longinq
woorden.definitie: praep. separ., cujus forma abbreviata et inseparabilis est እም፡ (gramm. § 164,3). In libris mss. antiquioribus: እምነ፡, in recentioribus እም፡ frequentius occurrit. Pro እምነ፡ antiquitus usitatum erat እምኔ፡ ut Lev. 20,5 F. Pronomina suffixa ope vocalis ê sibi subjungit, ut እምኔየ፡, እምኔከ፡ al. (gramm. § 167,3), rarissime sine ê, ut እምኖሙ፡ Ex. 1,7. Forma እም፡ si verbo a litera መ፡ incipienti praefigitur, ም non bis sed semel tantum exscribitur, ut እምነ፡ ሞቱ፡ vel እሞቱ፡ 1 significat discessum, distantiam, separationem ab aliquo: a, de, ex: የኀልቁ፡ ኃጥኣን፡ እምድር፡ Ps. 9,40; Ps. 103,36; Gen. 17,14; Num. 27,4; Ex. 12,15; ተዘርዉ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሕዝብ፡ እምኔሁ፡ 1 Reg. 13,8; 1 Reg. 13,11; አይቴ፡ አሐውር፡ እመንፈስከ፡ Ps. 138,6; በዐሡር፡ መዋዕል፡ እምኮሬብ፡ Deut. 1,2; ኢኮኑ፡ ርሑቃነ፡ እምድር፡ Joh. 21,8; Ps. 37,22. Frequentissimus est hic praepositionis usus post verba absentiae, distantiae, separandi, recedendi, fugiendi, mittendi, removendi, rapiendi, revertendi, mutandi, prohibendi, deficiendi et aberrandi, desistendi, cessandi, exinaniendi, quiescendi, occultandi; huic usui vicinus est usus post verba timendi, cavendi, nec non expergiscendi, convalescendi et medendi, purgandi. a praemittitur nominibus loci et spatii, ut significet non tantum directionem, unde aliquid veniat vel fiat, ut እምርሑቅ፡ e longinquo Job 2,11; Jes. 10,3; እለ፡ እምቅሩብ፡ οἱ ἐγγίζοντες Jes. 33,13; እምላዕሉ፡ Matth. 27,51; እምሥራቅ፡ ፀሐይ፡ ወእስከነ፡ ዐረብ፡ Ps. 112,3 al., sed etiam partem vel regionem, a qua vel versus quam aliquid sit: Gen. 7,16; Ex. 14,29; እምፀጋሙ፡ 2 Esr. 18,4; Apoc. 4,6; Ex. 25,11; Ex. 25,20; Ex. 38,2; Joh. 19,18; Apoc. 22,2; vid. etiam praepositiones compositas: እምቅድመ፡, እምድኅረ፡, እምታሕተ፡; nec non terminum, trans quem sit vel a quo incipiat aliquid: ላዕሉ፡ እምኔሁ፡ Ex. 39,3; አፍአ፡ እምጥቅም፡ ἔξωθεν τοῦ τείχους Jer. 21,4; ውስጠ፡ እምነ፡ መንጦላዕት፡ Lev. 16,12; እምነ፡ – እስከ፡ inde a – usque ad Gen. 6,7; Gen. 8,17; Ex. 12,12; Deut. 4,32. b nota locutionem adverbialem: መካን፡ እመካን፡ e loco in locum, ut: ዘይትፋለስ፡ ሀገር፡ እምሀገር፡ Sir. 36,31 (vid. infra Nr. 5, a): sed etiam እመካን፡ መካነ፡ e loco in locum, ut: መልአ፡ ምድረ፡ ስብሐቲሁ፡ እምወሰን፡ ወሰነ፡ implevit terram gloria tua a finibus ad fines Sx. Tachs. 24Enc. c nonnumquam, omisso verbo removendi vel prohibendi, in structuris praegnantibus እምነ፡ eundem significatum habet, qui ei post verba prohibendi convenit; dixeris eum negativum et sejunctivum: ተፈጽመ፡ አፈ፡ አራዊት፡ እምነቢብ፡ obturatum est os bestiarum (prohibitus) a loquendo i.e. ute ne loquerentur Kuf. p. 15; 1 Reg. 25,17; ተገመንኩ፡ እምኔከ፡ polluta sum tibi (interdicta) Kuf. p. 119 seq.; vid. etiam ሐሰ፡; ኀደረ፡ ህየ፡ እምዔሳው፡ ወልዱ፡ habitavit ibi, procul a filio suo Kuf. p. 107; Hen. 72,5; Gen. 8,2; { Genz. 120; Genz. 121(vid. sub በሃም፡); Sap. 15,15 (vid. sub ፅሩዕ፡); F.N. 10,8 (vid. sub የዋሂ፡). d post verba carendi, ut Macc. f. 23 vid. sub አጽምአ፡; M.M. f. 36 vid. sub ጽሙእ፡; nec non varia exempla sub ጾመ፡ et ጾም፡}. 2 significat egressum e loco, persona, re: ex, ab: ፃእ፡ እምነ፡ ምድርከ፡ Gen. 12,1; Gen. 4,10; Gen. 22,15; Ps. 16,13; Ps. 17,19; Ps. 39,2; Ps. 41,1; Ps. 79,9; Joh. 6,23; Matth. 8,28; Matth. 12,34; Matth. 12,42; Matth. 18,34. Frequentissimus est hic usus, potissimum post verba egrediendi, surgendi, germinandi, expellendi, extrahendi, eripiendi, al. Deinde adhibetur denotandis a origini rei vel personae: Jud. 13,2; Asc. Jes. 3,1; Tob. 5,14; ዘርእ፡ እምዛቲ፡ ብእሲት፡ 1 Reg. 2,20; Joh. 1,13; Joh. 3,6; Matth. 5,37; Matth. 21,16; Matth. 21,25; Asc. Jes. 6,15; Lev. 18,9; Deut. 13,7; Sir. 46,1; Joh. 3,31; Joh. 8,44; Joh. 8,47; Joh. 15,19; Joh. 17,14. b materiae, ex qua aliquid fit vel componitur: Matth. 3,9; Rom. 9,21; Gen. 2,7; Gen. 2,19; Cant. 3,9; Hen. 26,5. c initio, a quo aliquid exorditur: 1 Petr. 4,17 Platt; Num. 14,19; Hen. 60,8; Judae 14. d auctori, a quo aliquid factum est: Gen. 19,36; 1 Cor. 8,6; 1 Thess. 2,14; Matth. 1,20; c. verbo passivo: እምኔሁ፡ ተቀጽዑ፡ ዐናብርት፡ Job 9,13; Koh. 12,11; Asc. Jes. 2,13. Memorabile est compistum በእምነ፡, quod in Cyr. satis frequenter occurrit, alias a me quidem nusquam repertum est: ኵሉ፡ በእምኔሁ፡ ወቦቱ፡ ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ δι᾽ αὐτοῦ Cyr. f. 18; ኵሉ፡ ቦቱ፡ ወበእምኔሁ፡ ተፈጥረ፡ πάντα δι᾽ αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰς αὐτὸν ἔκτισται Cyr. f. 22; ኵሉ፡ በእምኔሁ፡ ቆመ፡ πάντα ἐν αὐτῷ συνέστηκε Cyr. f. 22; አብ፡ ይሁብ፡ በረከቶ፡ በእምኔሁ፡ ለወልድ፡ διανέμει ὁ πατὴρ δι᾽ υἱοῦ τὰ ἀγαθά Cyr. f. 46; al. e causae efficienti: Ex. 8,20; Gen. 49,12; Apoc. 8,11; 4 Esr. 9,15; Job 14,19; post verba passiva: Job 13,25; Job 13,28; Sap. 5,15; Prov. 24,23; Ps. 6,7; Matth. 8,24; Judae 12; Hen. 61,5. f causae remotiori: propter, ob, prae: Gen. 16,10; Gen. 27,46; Gen. 41,31; Ex. 6,9; Ex. 15,23; Ps. 37,8; Ruth 1,13; እምዐቢይ፡ ረኃብ፡ Job 30,4; እምግርማከ፡ Job 38,17; እምፍርሀት፡ ጐዩ፡ Dan. 10,7; Hen. 13,5; Asc. Jes. 3,13; Matth. 13,44; Matth. 14,26; Matth. 18,7; potissimum post verba, quae affectum animi significant, ut: ኀፈረ፡, አንከረ፡, ተፈሥሐ፡ al. g rarius causae instrumentali ut Luc. 16,9; Gen. 27,39. h normae vel causae, e qua judicatur, cognoscitur: Matth. 12,37; Matth. 7,20; Matth. 12,33; Jud. 7,17; Sir. 27,7. i fonti, unde aliquid petitur Matth. 7,16; Ex. 12,12; Hen. 63,1; Ps. 2,8; Jud. 8,24; Deut. 10,12; 1 Reg. 10,4; 1 Par. 11,18. k conditioni, in qua tamquam in fundamento nitens aliquis agit: 2 Cor. 2,4; Ex. 2,23. 3 significat partem ex toto exemtam: ፩ እምኔሆሙ፡ Dan. 6,2; መኑ፡ እምክልኤሆሙ፡ Matth. 21,31; ክልኤቱ፡ እምኔክሙ፡ Matth. 18,19; Marc. 6,15; Luc. 11,1; Ruth 4,2. a omisso vocabulo numerum definienti, significat: aliquid, aliquid, aliqua pars, ut: ሰይጣን፡ ይወዲ፡ እምኔክሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ሞቅሕ፡ e vobis sc. aliquot Apoc. 2,10; 2 Joh. 4; Gen. 6,19; ዘይጸውር፡ እምኵሉ፡ በረከተ፡ ግብጽ፡ gestans aliquid e bonis Aegypti Gen. 45,23; Lev. 7,19; Lev. 12,4; Lev. 19,23; Num. 16,26. b partitive satis frequentatum est post verba ነሥአ፡, ወሀበ፡, ኀርየ፡, በልዐ፡, ሰትየ፡, ተርፈ፡, አትረፈ፡, መልአ፡, ጸግበ፡ et ea quae similem habent significatum. c hoc እምነ፡ partitivum etiam aliam praepositionem sibi praemissam tolerat, ut: ይቤ፡ አረጋዊ፡ ለእምጠቢባን፡ uni e sapientibus Fal. f. 60. 4 usurpatur comparative: prae; quam; et comparativo et superlativo denotando adhibetur; et cum adjectivis participiisque et cum verbis conjungitur: ዐቢይ፡ እምነ፡ major quam Jos. 19,9; Gen. 38,26; Num. 12,3; ሠናይት፡ እምአንስት፡ pulcherrima mulierum Cant. 1,8; Luc. 1,28; ትጠብብ፡ እምኵሉ፡ አርዌ፡ Gen. 3,1; Gen. 34,19; Marc. 4,31; ያፈቅሮ፡ እምነ፡ diligebat cum magis quam Gen. 37,3; እምኵሉ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ትመውእ፡ ὑπὲρ πάντα νικᾷ ἡ ἀλήθεια 1 Esr. 3,12; ለከ፡ ይበጽሐከ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሰብእ፡ Tob. 6,13; Prov. 8,10; Sir. 41,12; Koh. 7,19 (20); እምነ፡ ክልኤሆሙ፡ ብእሲት፡ እንተ፡ ሠናይ፡ ልባ፡ Sir. 40,19-27. a post እምነ፡ comparativum alias praepositiones et genitivi notam (ዘ፡), quae secundum enuntiationis structuram rei comparatae praemittendae erant, omittere licet: Matth. 5,20; Matth. 18,13, quamquam etiam retineri possunt: ይኄይስ፡ ነቢር፡ ውስተ፡ ገዳም፡ እምስለ፡ ብእሲት፡ መግእዝት፡ Prov. 21,19; Prov. 25,24; Gen. 29,19. b hoc eodem እምነ፡ vel እም፡ duae enuntiationes integrae inter se comparari possunt; quod ubi fit, እምነ፡ conjunctionem potius quam praepositionem dixeris (quae idem valet quod እምነ፡ ዘ፡): ንደቅ፡ ውስተ፡ እደ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ እምንደቅ፡ ውስተ፡ እደ፡ እጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ Sir. 2,18; Sir. 6,1; Sir. 12,7; Sir. 19,24; Sir. 20,2; Sir. 22,15; Sir. 25,16; Sir. 29,10; 4 Esr. 2,23; 4 Esr. 6,39; Prov. 25,7; Ps. 51,8; Ps. 83,11; 1 Petr. 3,17; 2 Petr. 2,21; Rom. 2,29; Matth. 5,29; Matth. 5,30, al. 5 Transfertur ad tempus: inde a, ex, abhinc: Marc. 10,6; Rom. 15,23; Gen. 48,15; Zach. 7,5; Jud. 16,17; እምትካት፡ Matth. 13,25; እምዓለም፡ Jer. 2,20; እምይእዜ፡ Matth. 23,39; እምቅድመ፡ ዓለም፡ inde ab initio mundi Matth. 24,21; Hen. 41,4; እምኔሁ፡ deinde Jac. 4,14 rom.; Hen. 83,5; እምዝ፡ post haec, deinde, deinceps, tunc, tum Matth. 2,7; Matth. 4,1; Matth. 4,5; Matth. 4,10; Matth. 4,11 al. (vid. ዝ; vid. አሜሃ፡, ሶቤሃ፡); እምዘ፡ et እምአመ፡ ex quo (tempore) Luc. 8,27; Matth. 11,1; Gen. 24,22; Ex. 19,1 al. (vid. ዘ፡); Job 31,18; Jes. 44,7 (vid. አመ፡); እምነ፡ statim post Lev. 27,17; እምሰሚዐ፡ ቃሉ፡ audita ejus voce Sx. Mij. 25 Enc. In specie nota a ትውልድ፡ እምትውልድ፡ generatio alia post etiam Hen. 107,1; Num. 28,14; ዕለተ፡ እምዕለት፡ Hen. 103,10; et indecl. ዕለት፡ እምዕለት፡ diem alium post alium Kuf. 49; ዓም፡ እምዓም፡ Kuf. 32 (vid. supra Nr. 1, b; et gramm. § 163,2). b etiam locutionibus adverbialibus in Accusativo positis, ut: ይእተ፡ አሚረ፡, ይእተ፡ ዕለተ፡ haec praepositio praefigitur: እምይእተ፡ ዕለተ፡ (v. ዕለቲ፡ ዕለት፡) Dan. apocr. 1,64; እምይእተ፡ አሚረ፡ (v. እምይእቲ፡ አሚር፡) 1 Reg. 16,13 ann. 30, 25; 4 Reg. 2,22 (cfr. እስከ፡; et እምድኅረ፡ ሕቀ፡ Herm. p. 80; et ለለ፡) – Praep. እምነ፡ pronomino relativo ዘ፡ postponere licet, ut: ዘእምነ፡ Hen. 33,3; Gen. 4,13. – Praep. እምነ፡ aliis praepositionibus praefigitur, ut: ላዕለ፡, መልዕልተ፡, መንገለ፡, ማእከለ፡, መትሕተ፡, ቅድመ፡, በይነ፡, ኀበ፡, ታሕተ፡, ውስተ፡, ዐውደ፡, ዲበ፡, ድኅረ፡ q.v.; et conjunctionibus, ut: ቅድመ፡, አመ፡, , ዘ፡, ድኅረ፡ q.v.

woorden.betekenis: optare, exoptare, in votis habere, desiderio, teneri, optare
woorden.definitie: III,2 optare, exoptare, in votis habere, desiderio rei teneri, absol. Joh. 8,56 rom.; c. Acc. rei: ἱμείρεσθαι Job 3,21; δέεσθαι, ἐνδέεσθαι: ኀይለ፡ ዚአክሙ፡ ተመነይኩ፡ Job 6,22; እትሜነዮ፡ ለመቃብርየ፡ Job 17,1; εὔχεσθαι: ብሔር፡ እንተ፡ ትትሜነይ፡ ነፍስክሙ፡ Jer. 22,27; እለ፡ ይትሜነይዋ፡ ለዕለት፡ እኪት፡ Am. 6,3; Hen. 63,6; አብጻሕክዎ፡ ኀበ፡ ዘተመነየ፡ Jsp. p. 338; ጸልኡ፡ ሕይወተ፡ ወተመነዩ፡ መዊተ፡ Jsp. p. 356; optare ab aliquo, c. እምነ፡ pers., ut: ከመ፡ ይትመነይ፡ እምኔሁ፡ ዘፈቀደ፡ Sx. Tachs. 5vel c. ላዕለ፡ pers. Sx. Tachs. 6. – (In libris Mss. ተመነየ፡ saepius cum ተመየነ፡ confunditur, q.v.). tamannaya G ተመነየ፡ tamannaya, III,2, ይትሜነይ፡, ይትመነይ፡ «souhaiter, désirer ardemment» ― ተመኘ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 41v. 99 L mny, ተመነየ tamannaya wish, desire, be eager for 352b

woorden.betekenis: optatio, optatum, votum, desiderium, tamnet, désir ardent, c
