woorden.betekenis: hirundinis, clamosus, garrulus, turtur, palumbes
woorden.definitie: (v. መንጤጥ፡) subst. nomen avis [mihi, inserta litera ን formatum videtur e rad. መጠጠ፡ i.e. وَطَّ, وَطْوَطَ, unde وَطْوَاطٌ hirundinis species; clamosus vir; وَطْوَاطِيٌ garrulus ] turtur, palumbes, Kuf. 6; Kuf. 14; ዖፈ፡ መንጢጥ፡ ዘኢነባቢ፡ ይትገሐሥ፡ እምአውስቦ፡ ዳግማዊ፡ F.N. 24,1 (e Can. Basil.). – Pl. መንጢጣነት፡ (legas: መንጢጣት፡) Sx. Sen. 12.

woorden.betekenis: fricuit cutem, fricuit corium, cutis, pellis, pellis detract
woorden.definitie: et ማዕስ፡ subst., m. et fem., Pl. አምእስት፡ vel አምዕስት፡ [cfr. مَئَسَ fricuit cutem, مَعَتَ, مَعَسَ, مَعَشَ fricuit corium] 1 cutis, pellis, hominis δέρμα Job 2,4; Job 10,11; Job 19,20; Job 30,30; Thren. 3,4; Thren. 4,8; Asc. Jes. 5,10; Lev. 13; ትመሥጥዎሙ፡ አምእስቲሆሙ፡ እምላዕሌሆሙ፡ Mich. 3,2; Hez. 37,6; Hez. 37,8; βύρσα Job 16,15; bestiae ማእሰ፡ ዘባኑ፡ Job 40,25; Lev. 7,8; Gen. 27,16; Kuf. 26. 2 pellis detracta, pellis fricta, corium: ዘማእስ፡ δερματινός Gen. 3,21; ማእሰ፡ በግዕ፡ ሕሱይ፡ Ex. 25,5; Ex. 35,7; Lev. 13,48; Ex. 49,15; Ex. 49,17; Num. 31,20; ኢይቅንቱ፡ ማእሰ፡ Hez. 44,18; (famelici) በልዑ፡ አምእስተ፡ ሰረገላቲሆሙ፡ ወማእሰ፡ ቀቀበ፡ አስይፍቲሆሙ፡ Jsp. p. 368. – Voc. Ae.: አዕዳል፡ ወማእስ፡ ዘ፡ ቍርበት፡ māʾs, māʿs Pl. ʾamāʾǝst, ʾamāʿǝst G ማእስ፡ māʾs, Pl. አማእስት፡ ʾamāʾǝst «peau, cuir» ― ቈርበት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 42r. 100 L ማእስ፡ māʾs, ማዕስ፡ māʿs (Pl. አማእስት ʾamāʾǝst) skin, hide, leather, headcover, (6–14 Add.) = Amh. ዳባ daba monks mantel of yellow leather 324b

woorden.betekenis: centum, centuria, Mille, mille, mǝʾt, mǝʿǝt, mǝʾǝt, ʾamʾāt,
woorden.definitie: n. numerale [מֵאָה ܡܳܐܐ مِأَيَةٌ, amh. መቶ፡] Pl. አምኣት፡ (pro quo male nonnumquam አእማት፡ scriptum reperitur) centum; centuria. Ejus character est ፻. Quamvis primitus substantivi vis habeat, tamen ምእት፡ rem numeratam plerumque non per st. constr. c. sibi subjungit, sed adjectivorum instar appositione sibi conjungit: ምእት፡ ክረምት፡ Sir. 18,9; ኀረዩ፡ ምእተ፡ ብእሴ፡ Judith 10,17; Gen. 33,19; Gen. 17,17. Numeri centenarii compositi praepositis numeralium unionum plerumque formis masc. formantur: በስድስቱ፡ ምእት፡ ዲናረ፡ ብሩር፡ 2 Par. 1,17; Gen. 15,13; 1 Reg. 13,15; 1 Reg. 22,2; Ex. 39,3; Ex. 39,6. Num. 17,14; ክልኤ፡ ምእት፡ Gen. 32,15. Mille et numeros millenarios compositos Aethiopes numeris denariis voci ምእት፡ praepositis denotare solent: ዐሠርቱ፡ ምእት፡ χίλιοι mille Sir. 16,3; Sir. 39,11; Jes. 30,17; Ps. 90,7; ዐሠርቱ፡ ምእት፡ ዓመት፡ Ps. 89,4; Ps. 104,7; Sir. 39,15; Sir. 41,4; Jes. 7,23; Cant. 4,4; 2 Petr. 3,8; አርብዓ፡ ምእት፡ 4000 Matth. 15,38; ኀምሳ፡ ምእት፡ 5000 Matth. 14,21; 1 Reg. 4,2; 1 Reg. 13,2; 1 Reg. 25,2. Res numerata plerumque in sing., rarius in pl. ponitur, ut Gen. 33,19; Asc. Jes. 9,16. – Pl. አምኣት፡ subst. est: Matth. 13,8 rom.; ይገብር፡ ሣህለ፡ ለአምኣት፡ ወለአእላፍ፡ Kuf. 23; መላእክተ፡ አምኣት፡ ἑκατόνταρχοι 1 Par. 28,1; ፲ወ፪ አምኣት፡ Enc. mǝʾt, ምዕት፡ mǝʿǝt G ምእት፡ mǝʾǝt, Pl. አምኣት፡ ʾamʾāt «cent, ፻, 100 » ― መቶ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 42r. 100 አሠርቱ ፡ ምእት፡ ʾaśartu mǝʾǝt «mille» ― ሽሕ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 42r., vid. ዐሠርቱ፡ 101 L ምእት mǝʾǝt, (Pl. አምኣት ʾamʾāt), ምዕት፡ mǝʿǝt hundred, century 324b C for ሐቤ፡ ምእት፡ vid. ሐቢ፡

woorden.betekenis: cum singultu spiritum emisit, vehemens fuit ira, irae, minar
woorden.definitie: et መዐከ፡ rad. inus., cui مَئِقَ cum singultu spiritum emisit IV ob iram, VIII vehemens fuit ira (potius quam مَعَكَ عَكَّ) comparandum videtur (de vicina irae et minarum vid. መዐት፡). maʾaka, maʿaka, ምዕከ mǝʿka L መአከ maʾaka, መዐከ maʿaka, () ምዕከ mǝʿka get angry, take offence, scold, scold, (, ) threaten, be hostile, be ill-disposed 324a

woorden.betekenis: minari, comminari, minis terrere, praeterea minis eum terrui
woorden.definitie: vel ተመአከ፡ III,2 1 (succensere) minari, comminari, minis terrere: ወዓዲ፡ አፍርሆ፡ እንዘ፡ ይትሜአክ፡ praeterea minis eum terruit Jsp. p. 290; ተመክኦት፡ (pro ተምእኮት፡) comminatio, Jsp. p. 308; c. Acc. pers. Kuf. p. 98; መከረ፡ ከመ፡ ይትመአኪ፡ (v. ይትመዓዕኪ፡) τοῦ ἆραί σε Jes. 51,13; ኢኮነ፡ ከመ፡ ሰብእ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘይትሜአክ፡ ወኢኮነ፡ ከመ፡ እጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ ዘይትቄየም፡ Judith 8,16 ubi e parallelo ዘይትቄየም፡ elucet, Abyssinos ዘይትሜአክ፡ sensu refl. intelligere; at 2 Num. 23,19 incertum videtur, utrum Aethiops ዘይትሜአክ፡ et ዘይትዬዋህ፡ refl. an passive (minis terreri) intelligi voluerit; Graecus enim in utroque loco: ἀπειληθῆναι exhibet. tamǝʾka, tamaʾaka G ተምእከ፡ tamǝʾka III,2 ይትሜአክ፡, ይትመአክ፡ «craindre, être épouvanté» ― ፈራ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 42r. 101 L ተምእከ tamǝʾka, ተመአከ tamaʾaka be threatened, be frightened; also threaten, frighten 324a

woorden.betekenis: extendendi, tabula extensa, mensa, stravit, exstruxit mensam
woorden.definitie: subst. [i.q. مَائِدَةٌ vel مَيْدَةٌ; a rad. መአደ፡, ماد, quae sicut מָדַד vim extendendi habuisse videntur; quare ማእድ፡ tabula extensa; amh. ማእድ፡ et ማድ፡] m. et fem., Pl. ማእዳት፡ 1 mensa, argentariorum (mensariorum) Matth. 21,12; Matth. 25,27; dissecandis hostiis inserviens Hez. 40,40; pec. in qua cibi apponuntur: 2 Reg. 9,7; ነበርከ፡ ትደረር፡ ውስተ፡ ማእደ፡ መኳንንት፡ Prov. 23,1; Dan. 1,5; Dan. 11,27; ትወርድ፡ ማእድከ፡ እንዘ፡ ምሉእ፡ ወጥሉል፡ Job 36,16; Ps. 127,4; Matth. 15,27; ሠርዐ፡ ማእደ፡ stravit vel exstruxit mensam Hez. 23,41; Sir. 29,26; Jes. 21,5; Jes. 65,11; Dan. apocr. 13,11, vel አስተዳለወት፡ ዘዚአሃ፡ ማእደ፡ Prov. 9,2M ብዙኀ፡ ሠርዑ፡ ውስቴቱ፡ (ለማእድ፡) Sir. 34,12; in specie: mensa cum cibis appositis: ቦዐርከ፡ ዘበእንተ፡ ማእድከ፡ ይትዓረከከ፡ Sir. 6,10; Sir. 40,29; ኢበልዐት፡ አመትከ፡ ማእደ፡ ሐማ፡ Esth. 4,17 apocr. De mensa sacra in tabernaculo foederis: Ex. 25,23 seq.; Ex. 38,9 seq.; ማእዳት፡ ዘምሥያም፡ 1 Par. 28,16; de altari Kuf. 31; Mal. 1,7; item de altari vel mensa eucharistiae in ecclesiis: Lit. Jac. Sar., al.; cfr. Act. 20,7. 2 cibus, coena, epulae: ገብረ፡ ማእደ፡ ዐቢየ፡ δοχὴν μεγάλην Gen. 21,8 (Gen. 26,30 var.; Gen. 40,20 var.); ባርኮ፡ ማእድ፡ κλάσις ἄρτων Act. 20,7; ጸሎተ፡ ማእድ፡ preces ad coenam Reg. Pach.; Sx. Hed. 16. māʾǝdd, ማዕድ፡ māʿǝdd, መዓድ፡ maʿādd, Pl. māʾǝddāt G ማእድ፡ māʾǝdd, Pl. ማእዳት፡ māʾǝddāt «table chargée de mets» ― ሰደቃ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 42v. 101 ማዕድ፡ māʿǝdd «table» ― ሰደቃ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 45r. 108 L ማእድ māʾǝdd, () ማዕድ፡ māʿǝdd, (Lt) መዓድ፡ maʿādd table, food, banquet, meal, dish (food), Eucharistic offering 323b

woorden.betekenis: gloriatio, jactatio, gloria, causa gloriationis, tǝmkǝḥt, gl
woorden.definitie: subst. gloriatio, jactatio, gloria, causa gloriationis: ተኀፈርክሙ፡ በትምክሕትክሙ፡ Jer. 12,13; Kuf. 19; Prov. 11,7; Prov. 19,11; Judith 15,9; Deut. 10,21; Rom. 15,17; Jac. 4,16; Lit. 167,4. tǝmkǝḥt, G ትምክሕት፡ tǝmkǝḥt «glorification (vantazione)» ― መመክያ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 42v. 102 L ትምክሕት tǝmkǝḥt glory, vainglory, glorification, boasting, insolence, impudence ትምክሕታት፡ tǝmkǝḥtāt (Pl. of ትምክሕት tǝmkǝḥt) honors 339b

woorden.betekenis: elegit, examinavit, exploravit, examinavit, scrutatus est, p
woorden.definitie: I,1 [respondent: בָּחַר elegit, examinavit, exploravit (בָּחַן), ܒܚܰܪ examinavit, scrutatus est, probavit (ܒܰܚܶܢ), arab. (praeter مَخَرَ VIII) in malam partem مَكَرَ dolum struxit et مَحَنَ tentavit; amh. መከረ፡ et ሞከረ፡] Subj. ይምክር፡ 1 exquirere, explorare, tentare: ምክር፡ እምውስተ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ዕደወ፡ ጻድቃነ፡ σκέψαι Ex. 18,21; κατασκέψασθαι Koh. 2,3; እምክርከ፡ (v. ኣመክርከ፡) በፍሥሓ፡ πειράσω σε ἐν εὐφροσύνῃ Koh. 2,1; እለ፡ ይመክሩ፡ ኰስየ፡ ἀναιρεῖ πειρώμενοι Cyr. c. Pall. f. 70. 2 exploratum approbare i.e. consulere a consilium capere, decernere, nonnumquam: sibi proponere, in animo habere, moliri (βουελεύεσθαι et βούλεσθαι), c.c. Acc. rei: ምንተ፡ መከረ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ላዕለ፡ ግብጽ፡ Jes. 19,12; Mich. 4,12; Mich. 6,5; ይመክሩ፡ ዕሙቀ፡ ምክረ፡ Jes. 29,15; መከሩ፡ ምክረ፡ እኩየ፡ ላዕለ፡ ርእሶሙ፡ Jes. 3,9; Jes. 8,10; መከሩ፡ ኀጢአተ፡ ወገብሩ፡ እኩየ፡ Mich. 2,1; ንጹሐ፡ ይመክር፡ መንፈስየ፡ καθαρὰ νοήσει Job 33,3; c. Subj. verbi Matth. 1,19; Marc. 15,15; በመካን፡ ኀበ፡ አንትሙ፡ መከርክሙ፡ ትባኡ፡ Jer. 49,22; ዘመከርኩ፡ እግበር፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ Jer. 18,8; Sir. 12,16; እግዚአብሔር፡ መከረ፡ ይጽደቅ፡ Jes. 42,21, vel c. ከመ፡ seq. Subj., ut: Act. 15,2; Kuf. 32; Zach. 8,15; vel c. Acc. Infin., ut: ዘቀተለ፡ በኢያእምሮቱ፡ ወኢመከረ፡ ቀቲሎቶ፡ F.M. 4,2. b consilium dare, suadere, c. Acc. pers. Ex. 18,19 var.; Job 26,3 var. (vid. II,1). c consultare, deliberare: መከሩ፡ ምስለ፡ ሊቃውንት፡ Matth. 28,12. d exquirere consilium alicujus c. dupl. Acc.: ውስተ፡ እንግልጋ፡ ኢይመክርዎሙ፡ ምክረ፡ Sir. 38,33 var. makara G መከረ፡ makara I,1 ይመክር፡, ይምክር፡ «prendre conseil, prendre son propre conseil» ― መከረ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 42v. 102 L መከረ makara (yǝmkar, yǝmkǝr) advice, exhort, recommend, devise, form a plan, take counsel, determine, propose, make a decision, plot, conspire 340b

woorden.betekenis: consilium dare, suadere, consilio habito alicui aliquid dece
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 consilium dare, suadere, c. Acc. rei: 1 Cor. 13,5 rom.; ኵሉ፡ መምክር፡ ያመክር፡ ምክረ፡ Sir. 37,7; መኑ፡ ከመዝ፡ አምከረ፡ ላዕለ፡ ጢሮስ፡ Jes. 23,8; c. ለ፡ pers.: ለመኑ፡ ታመክር፡ (v. ትመክር፡) Job 26,3; plerumque c. Acc. pers.: Kuf. 14; ዘያመክረከ፡ Sir. 37,8; መኑ፡ መማክርቲሁ፡ ዘአምከሮ፡ Jes. 40,13; Jer. 45,15; Ex. 18,19; 2 Reg. 17,15; c. dupl. Acc.: ኣምክርኪ፡ ምክረ፡ 3 Reg. 1,12. 2 consilio habito alicui aliquid decernere: pastores Christo infanti munera attulerunt, እንዘ፡ ያመክርዎ፡ በግዐ፡ ካህን፡ ወሐሊበ፡ ከመ፡ ሕፃን፡ ወዕጣነ፡ ከመ፡ ንጉሥ፡ Lud. ex hom. Jac. Sarug.) – In libris Mss. II,1 et II,2 saepius confunduntur. ʾamkara G አምከረ፡ ʾamkara II,1 ያመክር፡, ያምክር፡ «conseiller, persuader» ― አማከረ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 42v. 102 L አምከረ ʾamkara advice, counsel, give a plan, ask for counsel, ask for advice, devise a plan, persuade 340b

woorden.betekenis: secum deliberare, tamakara, tamakra, être conseillé, écouter
woorden.definitie: III,1 secum deliberare: ተመከረት፡ በልባ፡ Lud. e V.S. tamakara, ተመክረ፡ tamakra G ተመክረ፡ tamakra III,1 ይትመከር፡ «être conseillé, écouter les conseils des autres» ― ተመከረ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 42v. 102 L ተመከረ tamakara take counsel 340b

woorden.betekenis: consilia conferre, communicare, consultare, deliberare, cons
woorden.definitie: III,3 1 consilia conferre vel communicare, consultare; deliberare cum aliquo: ኢትትማከር፡ ምስለ፡ አብድ፡ Sir. 8,17; Sir. 9,14; Sir. 37,10; Sir. 37,11 (c. እንበይነ፡ rei); መኑ፡ ዘተማከረ፡ ወአምከሮ፡ Jes. 40,14; ተማከሩ፡ ኅቡረ፡ Jes. 45,20; Jer. 43,16; Dan. 6,7; 1 Par. 13,1; Matth. 26,4; Matth. 27,7 (ተማኪሮሙ፡); c. Acc. pers.: መኑ፡ ተማከሮ፡ τίς ὁ σύμβουλος αὐτοῦ Rom. 11,34. 2 consilium inire, communi consensu decernere, c. Acc. consilii: ተማከሩ፡ ምክረ፡ እኩየ፡ ላዕሌከ፡ Jes. 7,5; Jer. 11,19; 4 Esr. 2,24; 4 Esr. 2,25; seq. Subj.: እሙንቱ፡ ተማከሩ፡ እኩየ፡ ይግበሩ፡ 2 Esr. 16,2; Ps. 30,17; Matth. 27,1. tamākara G ተማከረ፡ tamākara III,3 ይትማከር፡ «se conseiller l’un l’autre, prendre conseil en commun, se concerter» ― ተመካከረ፡ (forme concurrente de ተማከረ፡) Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 42v. 102 L ተማከረ tamākara advise one another, take counsel together, consult, deliberate, devise a plan, conspire, plot 340b

woorden.betekenis: consilium, consilia, deliberatio, consideratio, intelligenti
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem.; in libris serioris aetatis occurrit Pl. ምክራት፡ 1 consilium et consilia, βουλή, βουλαί, βούλημα al. a quod quis vel dat vel petit ab aliquo: ያረምሙ፡ በምክረ፡ ዚአየ፡ Job 29,21; ዘዚአየ፡ ምክር፡ Prov. 1,30; 2 Reg. 15,31; 2 Reg. 15,34; 3 Reg. 1,12; Sir. 37,7; Jes. 19,11; Ps. 1,1; Ps. 118,24. b quod quis capit: ምክሩ፡ ዘመከረ፡ ላዕለ፡ ἐπιβουλή Esth. 2,22; Judith 2,2; Judith 2,4; Job 5,12; Job 10,3; Job 12,13; Job 18,7; Jes. 7,7; Jes. 14,26; Jer. 29,8; Jer. 27,45; Ps. 32,10; Ps. 32,11; Prov. 15,22; ኢኮነ፡ ምክርየ፡ ከመ፡ ምክርክሙ፡ Jes. 55,8; ምክረ፡ ሰላም፡ Zach. 6,13; በምክረ፡ ሕሊናሆሙ፡ ἐν τοῖς διαβουλίοις αὐτῶν Sap. 1,9; ምክረ፡ ፈቃዱ፡ Eph. 1,11; Hebr. 6,17; de arcano alicujus consilio (μυστήριον) Sir. 27,16; Sir. 27,21; ዘያወጽእ፡ ምክረ፡ ቢጹ፡ Sir. 13,12; Rom. 11,25. 2 deliberatio, consideratio, intelligentia, prudentia, sapientia: ኵሉ፡ ምክሩ፡ ዘከመ፡ ያጠነቅቅ፡ ኀሪወ፡ ማኅተም፡ Sir. 38,27; አልቦ፡ ዘትገብር፡ እንበለ፡ ምክር፡ ἄνευ κρίσεως Sir. 30,38; ἄνευ βουλῆς Sir. 35,18; Sir. 35,19; μετὰ ἀβουλίας Prov. 14,17; በምክር፡ ፍጹም፡ (re rite perpensa) F.N. 24,2; ጠቢበ፡ ምክር፡ ውእቱ፡ σοφὸς διανοίᾳ Job 9,4; σύνεσις ምክር፡ ወጥበብ፡ Job 22,2; ምክሮሙ፡ ለሊቃውንት፡ Job 12,20; Job 28,20; Dan. 2,20; Ps. 48,3; Jes. 10,13; φρόνησις Jer. 10,12; γνῶσις Sir. 21,18; ለስሐ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምክረ፡ እጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ Jer. 10,14; Mal. 2,7; ἐπιστήμη Dan. 1,20; βουλή መንፈሰ፡ ምክር፡ Jes. 11,2. 3 sententia, judicium, sentiendi et cogitandi ratio: γνώμη Sir. 6,23; 1 Cor. 1,10; በምክርየ፡ 1 Cor. 7,25; ἐννοιαί hebr. 4,12; βουλή Luc. 23,51; Kuf. 10; de hac doctrina Christiani discedunt ኀበ፡ ፪ምክራት፡ in duas sententias (opiniones) F.N. 24,2. 4 voluntas: βούλημα θεοῦ Rom. 9,19; Leonis papae ሃይማኖት፡ እኪት፡ ዘረሰዮ፡ ለክርስቶስ፡ ፪ጠባይዓት፡ (naturas) ወ፪ምክረ፡ (voluntates) እምድኅረ፡ ተዋሕዶ፡ Sx. Masc. 7. mǝkr L ምክር mǝkr plan, design, counsel, advice, consideration, deliberation, consultation, device, opinion, purpose, point of view, decision, understanding, judgement, conspiracy, intrigue, plot በምክር ba-mǝkr insidiously 340b C for ህጉላነ፡ ምክር፡ vid. ህጉል፡ (Grébaut)

woorden.betekenis: exploratio, probatio, examinatio, experimentum, tentatio, ma
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. መከራት፡ 1 exploratio, probatio, examinatio, δοκιμή, δοκίμιον, δοκιμασία: መከራሆሙ፡ ለወርቅ፡ ወለብሩር፡ ርስነት፡ Prov. 27,21; እብነ፡ መከራ፡ Sir. 6,21; Jer. 6,27; 2 Cor. 9,13; Rom. 5,4; Jac. 1,3; 1 Petr. 1,7. 2 experimentum, πεῖρα መከራ፡ ሞት፡ Sap. 18,20 coll. Hebr. 11,29. 3 tentatio, πειρασμός Kuf. 19; Koh. 5,2; 1 Cor. 10,13; 1 Petr. 1,6; 1 Petr. 4,12; Hen. 94,5; መናስው፡ ወመከራት፡ ብዙኅ፡ Chrys. Ta. 2; Chrys. ho. 25; ኢትክል፡ ትትዐገሥ፡ ለመከራተ፡ ሰይጣናት፡ Phlx. 26. makarā G መከራ፡ makarā «tentation, question, affliction, tribulation, torture» ― ፈተና፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 43r. 103 L መከራ makarā trial, testing, examination, temptation, tribulation, distress, ordeal 341a

woorden.betekenis: inhiberi, subsistere, stetit, sterilem, nfoecundum esse, fie
woorden.definitie: I,1 [amh. id.; proprie, ut videtur, inhiberi, subsistere, a כּוּן (ኮነ፡) stetit propagatum; Arabes frequentant عَقَمَ عَقِمَ et عَقَرَ vel عَقُرَ] Subj. ይምክን፡ 1 sterilem, infoecundum esse vel fieri, de hominibus, brutis et terra: ከመ፡ ኢትምክን፡ μήποτε στειρώσῃ Sir. 42,9; Kuf. 28; አንስት፡ ይመክና፡ 4 Reg. 2,19 (ἀτεκνοῦσθαι); ትመክን፡ ብሔረ፡ ሃይማኖት፡ 4 Esr. 3,2; abortum pati: አልህምቲሆሙ፡ ኢይመክና፡ (ὠμοτόκησε) Job 21,10. 2 orbum fieri, liberis orbari 1 Reg. 15,33; ከመ፡ ኢይምክኑ፡ ሕዝብኪ፡ Hez. 36,14; Hez. 36,15; c. እምነ፡ filii Kuf. 27. makana, makkana G መከነ፡ makkana I,2 ይሜክን፡, ይመክን፡ «devenir stérile» ― መከነ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 43r. 103 L መከነ makana (yǝmkǝn), (103) መከነ makkana be barren, be unfruitful, be sterile, be childless, be bereaved 339b

woorden.betekenis: orbum facere, liberis privare, ʾamkana, ʾamakkana, rendre st
woorden.definitie: II,1 orbum facere, liberis privare: አምከነተኪ፡ መጥባሕት፡ Thren. 1,20; 1 Reg. 15,33. ʾamkana, ʾamakkana G አመከነ፡ ʾamakkana II,2 ያሜክን፡, ያመክን፡ «rendre stérile» ― አመከነ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 43r. 103 L አምከነ ʾamkana, (103) አመከነ፡ ʾamakkana causative of vid. መከነ makana; also deprive of children 339b

woorden.betekenis: sterilem fieri, esse, tamakna, become sterile, become barren
woorden.definitie: III,1 sterilem fieri vel esse Kuf. p. 103 ann. 10. tamakna L ተመክነ tamakna become sterile, become barren 339b

woorden.betekenis: sterilitas, infoecunditas, orbitas, mǝknat, barrenness, ster
woorden.definitie: n. act. 1 sterilitas, infoecunditas Hen. 98,5. 2 orbitas: ኢትኩኑ፡ ለምክነት፡ ዳግመ፡ Hez. 36,12. mǝknat L ምክነት mǝknat barrenness, sterility, bereavement, childlessness 340a C vid. also ምካኔ፡

woorden.betekenis: sterilis, infoecunda, orba, liberis privata, makkān, makkānā
woorden.definitie: adj. fem., Pl. መካናት፡ 1 sterilis, infoecunda στεῖρα Gen. 11,30; Gen. 25,21; Gen. 29,31; Deut. 7,14; Job 24,21; Jes. 54,1; Jes. 66,9; Ps. 112,8; Luc. 1,7; Luc. 1,36; Luc. 23,29; Gal. 4,27; 4 Esr. 9,42; 4 Esr. 10,58 (ubi pro መከን፡ corrigendum est መካን፡); ከርሠ፡ መካን፡ γαστέρες ἀργαί Tit. 1,12. 2 orba, liberis privata, ἄτεκνος Jer. 18,21; Jes. 49,21. makkān, Pl. makkānāt G መካን፡ makkān, Pl. መካናት፡ makkānāt «stérile» ― መካን፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 43r. 103 L መካን makkān barren, unfruitful, sterile, childless (man or woman) 339b

woorden.betekenis: , { አመክነየ፡ vid. sub ከነየ፡ }
woorden.definitie: , { አመክነየ፡ vid. sub ከነየ፡ }

woorden.betekenis: vehemens fuit calor, fervidus fuit, calere, calescere, incal
woorden.definitie: I,1 [amh. id.; vic. sunt وَعَكَ vehemens fuit calor أَكَّ fervidus fuit dies, عَكَّ id.] calere, calescere, incalescere, calefieri, de hominis corpore: ሐወዘኒ፡ እስመ፡ ሞቁ፡ Jes. 44,16; ትትከደኑ፡ ወኢትመውቁ፡ Hagg. 1,6; እምፀምረ፡ አባግዕየ፡ ሞቀ፡ መታክፍቲሆሙ፡ Job 31,20; 3 Reg. 1,2; 4 Reg. 4,34; de sole: ሶበ፡ ሞቀ፡ ፀሓይ፡ 1 Reg. 11,9; Ex. 16,21; de glacie: ተመስወ፡ መዊቆ፡ Job 6,17; de rebus sole calefactis Sap. 16,27; de corde hominis Ps. 38,4. moqa G ሞቀ፡ moqa I,1 ይመውቅ፡, ይሙቅ፡ «s’échauffer» ― ሞቀ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 43v. 104 L mwq ሞቀ moqa (yǝmuq) grow hot, be warm, become intense (heat) 375a

woorden.betekenis: se invicem calefacere, fovere, calore ignis calefieri, tamāw
woorden.definitie: III,3 1 se invicem calefacere vel fovere Koh. 4,11. 2 calore ignis calefieri: ተማወቀ፡ θερμανθείς Jes. 44,16. tamāwaqa G ተማወቀ፡ tamāwaqa III,3 ይትማወቅ፡ «s’échauffer l’un l’autre» ― ተሟሟቀ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 43v. 104 L ተማወቀ፡ tamāwaqa warm oneself, warm one another 375a

woorden.betekenis: calidus, fervidus, ardens, Stephanus erat, fotus, mǝwwuq, mǝ
woorden.definitie: vel ምውቅ፡ part. 1 calidus (fervidus): ምውቅ፡ ከመ፡ እሳት፡ Hen. 14,13; ለከሰ፡ ምዉቅ፡ አልባሲከ፡ ውእቱ፡ Job 37,16; ζεστός Apoc. 3,15; ኅብስት፡ ምውቅ፡ 1 Reg. 21,6; Jos. 9,10; ማይ፡ ምዉቅ፡ Sx. Jac. 11; subst. Kuf. p. 38. 2 ardens, fervidus, de animo: Stephanus erat ዐዚዝ፡ ወምዉቅ፡ በመንፈስ፡ ቅዱስ፡ Clem. f. 158; Kid. f. 33; ምውቅት፡ Kid. f. 34. { 3 fotus, de ave: ማዕነቅ፡ በርእሰ፡ ደብር፡ (monasterii) ምዉቅ፡ Sx. Hed. 15 Enc.}. mǝwwuq, mǝwwǝq, fem. ምውቅት፡ mǝwwǝqt; Pl. ምውቃን፡ mǝwwǝqān, fem. ምውቃት፡ mǝwwǝqāt G ምውቅ፡ mǝwwǝq, Pl. ምውቃን፡ mǝwwǝqān «échaffé, chaud» ― የሞቀ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 43v. ምውቅት፡ mǝwwǝqt fem., Pl. ምውቃት፡ mǝwwǝqāt «échaffée, chaude» ― የሞቀች፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 43v. 104 L ምውቅ mǝwwǝq, ምዉቅ፡ mǝwwuq warm, hot, burning, ardent, fervent 375a

woorden.betekenis: calor, moq, chaleur, warmth, heat
woorden.definitie: subst. calor, soli Hen. 75,4; Hen. 75,7; Hen. 76,5; Hen. 82,16; ነፋሰ፡ ሞቅ፡ Hen. 76,7. moq G ሞቅ፡ moq «chaleur» ― ሙቀት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 43v. 104 L ሞቅ moq warmth, heat 375a

woorden.betekenis: calescere, calor, muqat, échauffement, chaleur, heat, warmth
woorden.definitie: n. act. calescere, calor: እስከ፡ ሙቀተ፡ ፀሓይ፡ (עַד־חֹם הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ) 2 Esr. 17,3 vers. nov.; ሙቀተ፡ ሐሩር፡ Hen. 4; አስሐትያ፡ ዘአልቦ፡ ሙቀት፡ Clem. f. 244. muqat G ሙቀት፡ muqat «échauffement, chaleur» ― ሙቀት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 43v. 104 L ሙቀት muqat heat, warmth, fervor ሙቀተ፡ ኅሊና፡ muqata ḫǝllinā enthusiasm 262a, vid. ኅሊና፡

woorden.betekenis: mori, mortui, Immortalitas, immortalis, mota, mourir, mwt, d
woorden.definitie: I,1 [i.q. מוּת ܡܺܝܬ مَاتَ; amh. ሞተ፡] Subj. ይሙት፡ 1 mori, de hominibus sexcenties, ut Matth. 9,24; Marc. 15,44; Joh. 11,39; እስመ፡ ጌሠመ፡ ንመውት፡ Jes. 22,13; እምድኅረ፡ ሞተ፡ Sir. 39,11; እለ፡ ሞቱ፡ mortui Ruth 1,8; Ruth 4,5; ሙት፡ Job 2,9; መዊቶሂ፡ ተነበየ፡ በድኑ፡ Sir. 48,13; ሐይውኒ፡ ወመዊትኒ፡ Sir. 11,14; ሞተ፡ ትመውቱ፡ Gen. 2,17; 1 Reg. 22,16; Jer. 33,8; ሞተ፡ እመዊት፡ ይሙት፡ Kuf. 2; በሞት፡ ለይሙት፡ Ex. 19,12; de bestiis Matth. 8,32; Ex. 11,5; neque solum de iis qui morte naturali sed etiam de iis, qui morte violenta moriuntur: Deut. 19,11; Luc. 23,15; θανατούσθω ይሙት፡ Ex. 21,12; Ex. 31,14; ἀπολοῦνται Jes. 60,12; πίπτειν Jud. 20,32; 3 Reg. 20,25; c.c. በ፡ causae vel instrumenti 4 Reg. 13,14; Hez. 34,29; ሞተ፡ በቍር፡ Job 31,18; Jos. 10,11; Num. 35,23; Jer. 11,22; ትመውት፡ አንተ፡ በእበደ፡ ዚአሁ፡ Sir. 8,15; c. እንበይነ፡, ut: እለ፡ ሞቱ፡ እንበይነ፡ ሐዘን፡ Sir. 38,18. Immortalitas est ኢመዊት፡ Sap. 4,1; immortalis ዘኢይመውት፡ 4 Esr. 7,12; 4 Esr. 14,12; 1 Cor. 15,53; 1 Cor. 15,54; Rom. 1,23; 1 Tim. 1,17; ሕይወት፡ ዘኢይመውት፡ Hen. 15,6. 2 transl. dicitur a de plantis: እመ፡ ሞተ፡ አዕጹቂሁ፡ Job 14,8; Jon. 4,10; Joh. 12,24; Judae 12. b de sole (eclipsi obscurato) Luc. 23,44. c de animi facultatibus et affectionibus: 1 Reg. 25,37; ሞተት፡ ኅሊና፡ እምኔሁ፡ Kedr f. 73. d de hominibus, qui vires vel consuetudines ex se enecant, c.c. እምነ፡ consuetudinis: ሞትነ፡ እምኀጢአት፡ Rom. 6,2 Platt; Rom. 7,4; Col. 2,20; ሙት፡ እምነ፡ ፍትወታቲሁ፡ ለዝ፡ ዓለም፡ Phlx. 3. mota G ሞተ፡ mota I,1 ይመውት፡, ይሙት፡ «mourir» ― ሞተ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 43v. 104 L mwt ሞተ mota (yǝmut) die ዘይመውት zayǝmawwǝt mortal ዘኢይመውት zaʾiyyǝmawwǝt immortal 375b

woorden.betekenis: mortem concedere, mori jubere, mortem afferre, interficere,
woorden.definitie: et አመተ፡ (Job 7,15 var.) II,1 1 mortem concedere, mori jubere, mortem afferre, interficere, occidere: አሙተኒ፡ mortem mihi concede Jsp. p. 279; ኢታሙቶ፡ noli eum occidere Jsp. p. 367; ይረግዞ፡ በመጥባሕት፡ ዘያመውቶ፡ Jsp. p. 343; ለአሞቶቱ፡ ወለቀቲሎቱ፡ Kuf. p. 120. 2 transl. enecare, mortificare: አመቶን፡ (v. አሞቶን፡) ለአዕይንትየ፡ Job 7,15; c. Acc. et እምነ፡ Col. 3,5 rom.; አሙትዋ፡ ለነፍስክሙ፡ እምኵሉ፡ ምግባረ፡ እኩይ፡ Clem. f. 150; እለ፡ አሞቱ፡ አባለ፡ ሥጋሆሙ፡ እምዝሙት፡ Cyr. ad Theod. f. 17. ʾamota G አሞተ፡ ʾamota II,1 ያመውት፡, ያሙት፡ «mortifier, tuer» ― ገደለ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 43v. 104 L አሞተ ʾamota, አመተ ʾamata let die, put to death, kill, have killed 375b

woorden.betekenis: mortuus, morticinum, emortuus, praemortuus, enecatus, mǝwwut
woorden.definitie: et ምውት፡, part., fem. ምውት፡, Pl. m. ምዉታን፡, ምውታን፡ et ሙታን፡ 1 mortuus Koh. 9,3; Ruth 2,20; Jes. 26,14; ምውታን፡ በረኃብ፡ Jer. 14,18; ምውተ፡ ትካት፡ Thren. 3,6; Ps. 141,4; ዘአንሥአ፡ በድነ፡ እምነ፡ ምውታን፡ Sir. 48,5; Rom. 1,4; Rom. 14,9; Apoc. 20,12; Apoc. 20,13; 1 Tim. 5,6; Luc. 9,60; Hen. 22,5; በእንተ፡ ሙታን፡ agitur F.N. 22; transl.: ምውታን፡ በኀጢአት፡ Eph. 2,1; Col. 2,13; Apoc. 3,1 al. In specie: τὸ θνησιμαῖον morticinum: Lev. 17,15; Lev. 22,8; Deut. 14,21. 2 emortuus, praemortuus, enecatus: de facultatibus animi et consuetudinibus Rom. 7,8; Jac. 2,17; Hebr. 6,1; Hebr. 9,14; de utero Rom. 4,19; de homine, qui consuetudines suas mortificavit ምዉታን፡ ለኀጢአት፡ Rom. 6,11. – Nota etiam ባሕር፡ ምዉት፡ Sx. Nah. 14. mǝwwut, mǝwwǝt, fem. mǝwwǝtt, Pl. mǝwwutān, mǝwwǝtān, mutān, fem. ምውታት፡ mǝwwǝtāt G ምውት፡ mǝwwǝt, Pl. ምውታን፡ mǝwwǝtān et ሙታን፡ mutān «mort» ― የሞተ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 43v. ምውት፡ mǝwwǝtt fem., Pl. ምውታት፡ mǝwwǝtāt «morte» ― የሞተች፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 43v. 105 L ምውት mǝwwǝt, ምዉት mǝwwut (fem. ምውት mǝwwǝtt, Pl. m. ምውታን፡ mǝwwǝtān, ሙታን፡ mutān) dead, deceased 375b C a for ባሕር፡ ምውት vid. ባሕር፡ (Leslau) b for ሣጹነ፡ ምውት፡ vid. ሣጹን (Leslau)

woorden.betekenis: mors, nex, mors repentina, naturalis, voluntaria, morbus let
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., raro fem. (ut Jac. 1,15 Platt; Sir. 36,14; Rel. Bar.; Macc. f. 19). 1 mors, tam naturalis quam violenta, nex: Rom. 5,17; Hebr. 11,5; Ruth 1,17; Job 30,23; ተዘከሮ፡ ለሞት፡ Sir. 28,6; Sir. 41,1; Sir. 41,2; Jes. 25,8; ἀπώλεια Job 20,28; Job 27,7; Jes.47,11; እኩይ፡ ሞት፡ ሞታ፡ Sir. 28,21; በሞት፡ እኩይ፡ ይመውቱ፡ Jer. 14,15; Jer. 16,4; ሞት፡ ኵነኔሁ፡ Jer. 33,11; ኵነኔ፡ ሞት፡ Kuf. 33; ወልደ፡ ሞት፡ ውእቱ፡ 1 Reg. 20,31; 1 Reg. 26,16; 2 Reg. 19,28; አበሳ፡ ዘኢኮነ፡ ለሞት፡ 1 Joh. 5,16; ዝንቱ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዳግም፡ ሞት፡ Apoc. 21,8; ኢጥዕምዎ፡ ለሞት፡ 4 Esr. 4,30; በእንተ፡ ስቅለትከ፡ ወሞትከ፡ ማሕየዊት፡ Genz. f. 26; መልአከ፡ ሞት፡ Asc. Jes. 9,16; ሞተ፡ ግብት፡ mors repentina F.N. 50; ሞት፡ ጠባይዓዊ፡ naturalis, ሞተ፡ ፈቃድ፡ voluntaria Fal. f. 23. Pro domicilio mortuorum: Prov. 15,11; Job 28,22; Ps. 9,14; ᾅδης Jes. 5,14. 2 morbus letalis, pestis: Jer. saepius, ut Jer. 41,17 (alias in eodem libro θάνατος ብድብድ፡ vertitur); በሞት፡ ዐቢይ፡ Jer. 21,6; 2 Reg. 24,13; Ex. 9,13 seq.; Apoc. 6,8. mot G ሞት፡ mot «mort (substantif)» ― ሞት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 43v. 105 L ሞት mot death, distruction 375b C for ጻዕረ፡ ሞት፡ vid. ጻዕር፡

woorden.betekenis: morticinum, cadaver, mortui, orbus, pupillus, pupilla, māwtā
woorden.definitie: subst. (gramm. § 127,1,b) 1 morticinum, cadaver (τὸ θνησιμαῖον) Lev. 11,40 (Lev. 22,8 CG; Lev. 17,15 G); Hez. 4,14; Act. 15,20 Platt; ማውታ፡ ወደም፡ ወብትክ፡ Clem. f. 96; Clem. f. 118; Clem. f. 141; ዘረኵሰ፡ በበሊዐ፡ ማውታ፡ F.M. 6,14; ጽዩእ፡ ሥጋ፡ ማውታ፡ Did. 6(ed. Platt p. 38); Did. 33. 2 mortui (quasi sit مَوْتَى Pl. a مَيْتٌ; vid. gramm. § 138,3 ann.); nonnisi statui constructo እጓለ፡ subjunctum reperitur: እጓለ፡ ማውታ፡ parvulus vel parvuli defunctorum i.e. orbus, pupillus, pupilla, et m. et fem., et sing. et coll.; Ex. 22,21; Job 6,26; Job 22,9; Job 24,3; Job 24,9; Job 29,12; Ps. 9,38; Ps. 9,42; Ps. 108,8; Ps. 108,11; Prov. 23,10; Jes. 9,17; Jer. 5,28; Jer. 7,6; Jer. 22,3; Thren. 5,3; Sir. 4,10; እጓለ፡ ማውታ፡ ኀደገኒ፡ አቡየ፡ Tob. 1,8; Joh. 14,18; Jac. 1,27. – Did. ed. Platt p. 108legitur mira forma: እጓለ፡ ማዊት፡ – Voc. Ae.: እጓለ፡ ማውታ፡ ዘ፡ ድኻ፡ (v. ድሐ፡, v. ደኻ፡). māwtā G ማውታ፡ māwtā «bête morte sans être égorgée ou tuée selon les règles» ― ሙቶ፡ ያደረ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 43v. 105 L ማውታ māwtā corpse, carcass, dead body 376a C for እጓለ፡ ማውታ፡ vid. እጓል፡

woorden.betekenis: orbitas, māwtǝnnā, ʾǝgʷāla māwtǝnnā, orphanhood
woorden.definitie: subst., praemisso እጓለ፡ significat: orbitas, ut: በእንተ፡ እጓለ፡ መውትናሆሙ፡ ወድክትምናሆሙ፡ Jsp. p. 335. māwtǝnnā L ማውትና māwtǝnnā in እጓለ፡ ማውትና ʾǝgʷāla māwtǝnnā orphanhood, vid. እጓል፡ 376a

woorden.betekenis: superare, praepollere, vincere, moʾa, moʿa, vaincre, mwʾ, co
woorden.definitie: I,1 [rad. in ceteris linguis haud usitata; an بَآ huc referre licet?] Subj. ይማእ፡, raro ይሙእ፡, superare, praepollere, vincere; abs. መዊእ፡ νίκη 1 Par. 29,11; Matth. 12,20 Platt; ይመውኡ፡ ἔσονται ἰσχυρότεροι Jes. 37,21; ሞአ፡ ፀር፡ ἐκραταιώθη ὁ ἐχθρός Thren. 1,16; ዕሴተ፡ ዘሞአ፡ ἐπινίκιον 1 Esr. 3,5; ትእምርተ፡ መዊእ፡ τὸ τρόπαιον Chrys. Ta. 5; ወይን፡ ይመውእ፡, አንስት፡ ይመውኣ፡ ὑπερισχύειν 1 Esr. 3,10 seq.; Apoc. 2,7; Apoc. 3,12; Apoc. 6,2; ወሀበነ፡ ንማእ፡ 1 Cor. 15,57; c.c. እምነ፡, ut: 2 Reg. 24,4; 1 Reg. 17,50 E; c. ላዕለ፡, ut: ሀበኒ፡ መዊአ፡ ላዕለ፡ ሰይጣን፡ Kedr f. 5; c. ለ፡, ut: ይመውእ፡ ለኵሉ፡ Dan. 2,40 var.; at plerumque c. Acc., ut: ስእኑ፡ መዊኦቶ፡ 4 Reg. 16,5; Judith 1,13; Kuf. 46; Ps. 12,4; al. Usurpatur de quovis certamine, ut: ከመ፡ ኢይማእከ፡ በብዕሉ፡ Sir. 8,2; Esth. 6,13 (ἀμύνασθαι); ኢይማእከ፡ ሥነ፡ ፍትወታ፡ Prov. 6,25; ከመ፡ ኢይማኡኒ፡ Sir. 23,2; Sir. 12,5; ሞእክምዎ፡ ለእኩይ፡ 1 Joh. 2,13; 1 Joh. 4,4; Rom. 8,37; Rom. 12,21; in controversiis Jes. 54,17; Rom. 3,4; in judicio Ps. 50,5; Act. 25,7 rom. – Forma Subjunctivi: ይሙእዎሙ፡ legitur Jsp. p. 353(sed alias in eodem libro ይማኡ፡); ሙኢዮሙ፡ ለጸላእትኪ፡ Deg. At forma ይምእዎ፡ 4 Esr. 6,56 Laur. lapsu calami pro ይማእዎ፡ exscripta est. – Voc. Ae.: ሞአ፡ ዘ፡ አሸነፈ፡ moʾa, ሞዐ moʿa G ሞአ፡ moʾa I,1 ይመውእ፡, ይማእ፡ «vaincre» ― አቸነፈ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 43v. 105 L mwʾ ሞአ moʾa (yǝmāʾ, yǝmuʾ), () ሞዐ moʿa conquer, vanquish, overcome, prevail, defeat, subdue, surpass in power 3754b

woorden.betekenis: superiorem, victorem reddere, victoriam praebere, ut victori
woorden.definitie: , rarius አምአ፡ (ut Jsp. p. 285) II,1 superiorem vel victorem reddere, victoriam praebere, c.c. Acc. et ላዕለ፡ vel በ፡, ut: ዘአሞኦ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ላዕለ፡ ካልኡ፡ Jsp. p. 283; Jsp. p. 280; ከመ፡ ታሙኦ፡ ለዘፈቀድከ፡ ut victoriam praebeas, cui volueris Jsp. p. 292; ከመ፡ ያሙአነ፡ ቦሙ፡ Jsp. p. 308; ውእቱ፡ ያመውአከ፡ በዳራ፡ ወበመንግሥቱ፡ Jsp. p. 281; Infin. ለአሙኦተ፡ ሕዝቡ፡ Jsp. p. 291; አሙኦተ፡ ሃይማኖት፡ facere ut fides vincat Jsp. p. 348. – Praeter Subjunctivi formam ያሙእ፡ in Jsp. nonnumquam ያመውእ፡ vel ያሞእ፡ formae haud probandae occurrunt, ut: ከመ፡ ኣመውእከ፡ ላዕለ፡ ነገሥት፡ Jsp. p. 280; ከመ፡ ያሞኦሙ፡ Jsp. p. 355. – Nonnumquam aliquem ab aliquo vinci pati reddi potest, ut: Christus ኢያመውኦ፡ ሶበ፡ ይትዋቀሶ፡ (illum eum vincere non sinet i.e.) eum vinci non sinet Org. 1. ʾamoʾa, ʾamǝʾa G አሞአ፡ ʾamoʾa II,1 ያመውእ፡, ያሙእ፡ «faire vaincre» ― አስቸነፈ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 43v. 105 L አሞአ ʾamoʾa, አምአ ʾamǝʾa causative of {vid. ሞአ moʾa}; also give victory, let gain victory 374b

woorden.betekenis: momentum, ictus temporis, in momento, subito, repente, paulu
woorden.definitie: subst., Pl. ምዕራት፡, Pl. Pl. ምዕራታት፡ 1 transitus i.e. momentum vel ictus temporis a ለእንተ፡ ምዕር፡ ἐν ἀτόμῳ (in momento) 1 Cor. 15,52 ant.; ኵሉ፡ ፍጡን፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለእንተ፡ ምዕር፡ Sir. 18,26. b ኵሉ፡ ለምዕር፡ ወግብተ፡ (διὰ τάχους καὶ ἐξάπινα) subito, repente Sir. 11,21; 4 Esr. 6,78; ለምዕር፡ πρὸς ὀλίγον Jac. 4,14; ወይከውን፡ በጊዜሃ፡ ለምዕር፡ ὡς στιγμὴ παραχρῆμα Jes. 29,5. c ምዕረ፡ ኅዳጠ፡ χρόνον paululum temporis Prov. 7,12; ተኀባእ፡ ኅዳጠ፡ ምዕረ፡ Jes. 26,20; Clem. f. 156. d ምዕረ፡ cum Imperativo et Cohortativo conjungere amant: jam, modo, parumper, paulisper, prius: ተፈሣሕ፡ ምዕረ፡ τὸ νῦν ἔχον ἡδέως γίνου Tob. 7,11; ብላዕ፡ ወስተይ፡ ምዕረ፡ ወተፈሣሕ፡ Tob. 7,10; ንጠይቅ፡ ምዕረ፡ Judith 5,20; 1 Reg. 2,16; 1 Reg. 14,19; Marc. 7,27; Marc. 14,41. 2 vicis (in locutionibus adverbialibus, ut una vice, tertia vice al.) a ምዕረ፡ semel ἅπαξ Ps. 88,35; Hebr. 9,27; Hebr. 9,28; 2 Cor. 11,25; Judae 5; ἐφάπαξ Rom. 6,10; ምዕረ፡ ለለዓመት፡ Ex. 30,10; Kuf. 5; Kuf. 49; ምዕረ፡–ወዳግመሰ፡ Job 33,14; Job 39,35; ምዕረ፡ ወካዕበ፡ ἅπαξ καὶ δίς 2 Esr. 23,20; Tit. 3,10; 1 Reg. 17,39; Deut. 9,13; ምዕረ፡ አሐተ፡ una vice Chrys. ho. 17; ዓዲ፡ ምዕረ፡ ἔτι ἅπαξ Hagg. 2,6; Hebr. 12,26; Hebr. 12,27; ዛተ፡ ምዕረ፡ hac vice vel nunc Phlx. 4; ምዕረ፡ ዳግም፡ secundo, F.M. 5,7; ዕፁፍ፡ ፫ ምዕራተ፡ τρὶς δίς Hez. 41,6 vers. alt.; ምዕራተ፡ ብዙኃተ፡ pluries, saepius F.M. 14,10; ምዕራተ፡ F.M. 14,10; Gad. Kar.; Jsp. p. 325; Jsp. p. 369; ምዕራታተ፡ iterum ac saepius Phlx. 85. α ምዕረ፡ – ምዕረ፡ modo – modo Jer. 18,7; Jer. 18,9 vers. alt. β nota pron. suff. per ê affigi: ምዕሬሃ፡ ለይእቲ፡ መስፈርት፡ illam mensuram semel (impletam) 4 Reg. 7,18. b በምዕር፡ semel, uno ictu, uno eodemque tempore Num. 16,21; 2 Reg. 23,8; 1 Reg. 26,8; 1 Par. 11,11; Dan. 2,35; 4 Esr. 3,54; 4 Esr. 3,56; በምዕር፡ በበ ፫፡ ዓመት፡ 2 Par. 9,21; Cant. 4,9; Hebr. 7,27; Hebr. 9,12; c በበምዕር፡ singulis vicibus Jos. 6,3. d እምዕር፡ ለምዕር፡ aliam vicem super aliam i.e. identidem, iterum iterumque Phlx. 100. mǝʿr, Pl. mǝʿrāt, mǝʿrātāt G ምዕር፡ mǝʿr «une fois, una vices (nominatif)» ― አንደ፡ ጊዜ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 44r. 105 ምዕረ፡ mǝʿra «une fois, semel (adverbe)» ― አንደ፡ ጊዜ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 44r. 105 L ምዕር፡ mǝʿr (Pl. ምዕራት mǝʿrāt, ምዕራታት mǝʿrātāt) moment, time ምዕረ mǝʿra once, at once, at one time, a while, for the present, just now, presently 327a

woorden.betekenis: mel, favus, si quis ex ecclesia furatur, maʿār, miel, maʿar,
woorden.definitie: (መዐር፡) subst. [יַעַר, amh. ማር፡] plerumque m., mel μέλι Gen. 43,11; Ex. 16,31 (ἐγκρίς Num. 11,8); Jud. 14,8; Jud. 14,9; 1 Reg. 14,26; Jes. 7,15; Prov. 5,3; Prov. 24,13; መዓር፡ ብዙኅ፡ Prov. 25,27; መዐር፡ ቅድው፡ πρῶτον μέλι Hen. 27,17; Sir. 24,20; Sir. 39,26; Sir. 49,1; Apoc. 10,9; Ex. 3,8; Ex. 3,17; Ex. 13,5 al.; መዓረ፡ ገዳም፡ μέλι ἄγριον Matth. 3,4; መዓረ፡ ጸደና፡ Matth. 3,4; Marc. 1,6. 2 favus κηρίον Ps. 117,12, at saepius: መዓረ፡ ግራ፡ κηρός Jes. 64,2; Judith 16,15; Hen. 1,6 (vid. ግራ፡); si quis ex ecclesia furatur መዓረ፡ ግራ፡ (κηρόν) II Can. Ap. 66(alias in Syn. ሠምዕ፡). – Voc. Ae.: መዓረ፡ ግራ፡ ብ፡ ሰም፡ ሙጫሂ፡ ይ። maʿār G መዓር፡ maʿār «miel» ― ማር፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 44r. 106 L መዓር፡ maʿār, መዐር፡ maʿar honey, honeycomb መዓረ፡ ገዳም፡ maʿāra gadām, መዓረ፡ ጸደና maʿāra ṣadanā wild honey, vid. ገዳም፡, ጸደና፡ መዓረ፡ ግራ maʿāra gǝrā wax lit. ‘sweetness of the honeycomb’, vid. ግራ፡ 326b C for ሐያቤ፡ መዓር፡ vid. ሐያቢ፡ (Leslau)

woorden.betekenis: mellitus, dulcis, maʿarʿir, maʿārʿir, maʿarʿār, maʿārʿirt, m
woorden.definitie: adj. quinquel. (gramm. § 110,b), pro quo መዓሪር፡ Lit. 175,3, mellitus, dulcis: መር፡ ወመዐርዒር፡ Hen. 69,8; ማየ፡ ሰርቅ፡ መዐርዒረ፡ ስተይ፡ Prov. 9,17; Prov. 16,24; ጕርዔሁ፡ መዐርዒር፡ Cant. 5,16; saepius de voce et loquela: በቃል፡ መዐርዒር፡ Kedr f. 22; ቃለ፡ (sic) መዐርዒር፡ ዘሱራፌል፡ Rel. Bar.; ነገረ፡ ገድሉ፡ መዐርዒር፡ ለተናግሮ፡ Deg. maʿarʿir, መዓርዒር፡ maʿārʿir, fem. መዐርዓር፡ maʿarʿār, መዓርዒርት፡ maʿārʿirt; Pl. መዓርዒራን፡ maʿārʿirān, fem. መዓርዒራት፡ maʿārʿirāt G መዓርዒር፡ maʿārʿir, Pl. መዓርዒራን፡ maʿārʿirān «doux comme le miel» ― ጣፈጠ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 44r. መዓርዒርት፡ maʿārʿirt fem., Pl. መዓርዒራት፡ maʿārʿirāt «douce comme le miel» ― ጣፈጠ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 44r. 106 L መዐርዒር maʿarʿir (fem. መዐርዓር maʿarʿār) sweet, sweet-tasting, honey-sweet 327a

woorden.betekenis: intestina
woorden.definitie: subst., forma Pl. a sing. deperdito (vid. gramm. § 140,3,c); forma: አምዑት፡ Sir. 30,7 in uno libro Mss. occurrit; [respondent מֵעִים ܡܥܰܝ̈ܳܐ, مَعْيٌ v. مِعىً, Pl. أَمْعَاءٌ] Pl. አማዕዋት፡ intestina Gen. 43,30; እስከ፡ ይወፅእ፡ አማዑቲከ፡ 2 Par. 21,15; እምብካዮሙ፡ ይትመሰው፡ አማዑትከ፡ (v. አምዑትከ፡) Sir. 30,7; አማዑቲሁ፡ (v. አማዑቱ፡) አራዊት፡ ዘብርት፡ Job 41,6; Ps. 108,17; Ps. 16,10 (ubi Gr. τὸ στέαρ habet); ሥብሕ፡ ዘውስተ፡ አማዑቱ፡ Lev. 4,8; Lev. 7,3; Act. 1,18; 2 Cor. 6,12; I Sal. Mar. 28; Jsp. p. 369; ሕማመ፡ አማዑት፡ δυσεντερία Act. 28,8 Platt. – Voc. Ae.: አማዑት፡ ዘ፡ ሐንዠት፡ v. አንዠት፡

woorden.betekenis: ad iram concitare, provocare, irritare, ʾamǝʿǝʿa, ʾamǝʿa, ir
woorden.definitie: II,1 ad iram concitare vel provocare, irritare (παροξύνειν, παροργίζειν); Imperf. et Subj. ያምዕዕ፡ (gramm. § 96,1); c.c. Acc.: Deut. 4,25; Deut. 31,29; Ps. 73,11; Ps. 73,19; Job 12,6; Sir. 3,16; Sir. 4,2; Jes. 1,4; Jes. 5,24; Jes. 7,13 (አምዕዖ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Infin.); Jes. 60,14; Jes. 63,10; Jes. 65,3; Jer. 7,18; Jer. 7,19; Mich. 2,7; Judith 11,11; Hen. 84,6; Matth. 5,22; Rom. 10,19. Pro አምዕዐ፡ nonnumquam occurrit አምዐዐ፡, ut: እንተ፡ አምዐዐቶሙ፡ (v. አምዕዐቶሙ፡) Jes. 23,11; አምዓዕዎ፡ Herm. p. 12; pro II et I pers. Perf. አምዓዕከ፡, አምዓዕነ፡ passim reperiuntur formae contractae, ut አማዕዕከኒ፡ Hez. 16,54; አማዕናሁ፡ Mal. 2,17. ʾamǝʿǝʿa, አምዐ፡ ʾamǝʿa G አምዕዐ፡ ʾamǝʿǝʿa II,1 ያምዕዕ፡ «irriter, provoquer, fâcher» ― አስቈጠ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 44v. 107 አምዐ፡ ʾamǝʿa II,1 ያምዕ፡ (mêmes sens) 107 L አምዕዐ ʾamǝʿǝʿa, ( 107) አምዐ ʾamǝʿa irritate, provoke to anger, provoke, inspire anger, enrage 325a

woorden.betekenis: irasci, ira ardere, succensere, irasci iram, tamǝʿǝʿa, tammǝ
woorden.definitie: III,1 irasci, ira ardere, succensere (ὀργίζεσθαι, θυμοῦσθαι, θυμοῦσθαι ὀργῇ, μηνίειν); c. absol., ut: ሶበ፡ ትትመዓዕ፡ ተዘከር፡ ዕለተ፡ ሞትከ፡ Sir. 18,24; Ex. 15,14; Ps. 4,5; Ps. 26,14; Marc. 3,5; Matth. 18,34; Matth. 22,7; c. ላዕለ፡ pers. Num. 25,3; Ps. 73,1; Zach. 1,15; Koh. 5,5; Jes. 5,25; Judith 1,12; c. ዲበ፡ pers. ut Ex. 4,14; Kuf. 5; c. Acc. pers.: Ps. 84,5; Gen. 44,18; በእንተ፡ vel በበይነ፡ rei vel pers.: ኢይትመዓዕኑ፡ በበይነ፡ ዝንቱ፡ Jes. 57,6; 4 Esr. 8,33; Kuf. 30; { seq. እስመ፡ Lud. 13,14 }; c. Acc. መዐተ፡ irasci iram, frequentissime: Ex. 4,14; Ex. 32,12; Num. 25,3; Jes. 37,29; ተምዕዐ፡ መዐተ፡ ዐቢየ፡ Jes. 5,25; ተምዐ፡ መዐተ፡ ጥቀ፡ Judith 5,2. – De flexione hujus verbi vid. gramm. § 97,1. Ejus formae sunt: a Perf. ተምዕዐ፡ (vel ተምዐዐ፡ Jos. 7,1 ann.) et ተምዐ፡ Ex. 4,14; Kuf. 3; Kuf. 28; Kuf. 30; Ps. 17,9; II et I pers. sing. et pl.: ተምዓዕኩ፡ (sive ተምዐዕኩ፡) Zach. 1,15; Thren. 5,22; Jes. 12,1; vel ተመዐዕከ፡ sive ተመዓዕከ፡ Thren. 5,22; Ps. 73,1; vel ተምዕዕከ፡ Ex. 32,12; Jes. 37,29; vel ተማዕከ፡ Zach. 1,15; Ps. 73,1 var. b Imperf. et Subj. ይትመዐዕ፡ sive ይትመዓዕ፡ (semel legi ይትሜዓዕ፡ III,2 Marc. 3,5 rom.), c. pron. suff. ትትመዐዖሙ፡ 4 Esr. 8,35; Gen. 44,18; Ps. 84,5; Jes. 28,28; Jes. 64,9; ይትመዓዓከ፡ Koh. 7,22; Kuf. 26; nec non ትትማዕዖ፡ 4 Esr. 8,39; Pl. ይትመዓዑ፡ እምወይን፡ Hos. 7,5. c Imperat. ተምዑ፡, v. ተምዕዑ፡ Ps. 4,5; ተመዐዒ፡ Hez. 21,9. d Infin. verb. ተምዒዐከ፡ Ps. 26,14; Ex. 32,10; ተምዒዖ፡ Job 16,9. e Infin. nom. ተምዕዖ፡ et ተምዖ፡ Koh. 7,9. tamǝʿǝʿa, ተምዐ፡ tammǝʿa, ተምአ፡ tammǝʾa G ተምዕዐ፡ tamǝʿǝʿa III,1 ይትመዓዕ፡ «être irrité, être provoqué à l’indignation» ― ተቈጠ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 44v. ተምዐ፡ tammǝʿa III,1 ይትምዕ፡ ((sic) mêmes sens) 107 L mʿʿ, ተምዕዐ፡ tamǝʿǝʿa, ተምዐ፡ tammǝʿa, () ተምአ፡ tammǝʾa be angry, rage, be enraged, be indignant, be irritated 325a

woorden.betekenis: sugendi, dulcis, suavis saporis, bene olere, suavem odorem s
woorden.definitie: I,1 [etymon obscurum est; cum مَزَّ enim (מָצַץ et מָצָה), quod primitus sugendi vim habuit, deinde in significationem dulcis et suavis saporis abiit, vix componi potest.] Imperf. ይምዕዝ፡ bene olere, suavem odorem spirare: Hen. 24,4; Org. 1; ጽጌ፡ ዘሠናየ፡ መዐዛ፡ ይምዕዝ፡ Laud. Mar. mǝʿza, መዐዘ፡ maʿaza G ምዕዘ፡ mǝʿza I,1 ይምዕዝ፡, ይምዐዝ፡ «avoir bonne odeur, sentir bon» ― ሸተተ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 44v. 107 L ምዕዘ mǝʿza, መዐዘ maʿaza smell sweet, smell, be fragrant, emit a good odor 328a

woorden.betekenis: olfacere
woorden.definitie: { III,1 (ut videtur) olfacere: ወኢአንፎሙ፡ ለተማዕዞ፡ (sic) ደመና፡ Sap. 15,15 in Abb. LV (pro ለአጼንዎ፡ caeterorum librorum).}

woorden.betekenis: odor, bonus, suavis, Esther, sapor, maʿazā, maʿāzā, bonne od
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., Pl. መዐዛት፡ (raro) 1 odor bonus vel suavis, nonnumquam odor in genere (ὀσμή, εὐωδία): Cant. 1,3; Cant. 1,12; Koh. 7,1; Asc. Jes. 6,17 (ubi መዐዛ፡ legendum videtur); ጥዕመ፡ መዐዛየ፡ ከመ፡ ቀናንሞስ፡ Sir. 24,15; Sir. 32,8; Sir. 39,14; Jer. 25,10; ዕፀወ፡ መዐዛ፡ Hen. 24,3; Hen. 29,2; Hen. 30,3; Kuf. 21; 2 Cor. 2,14-16; መዐዛ፡ ሠናይ፡ Lev. 1,9; Lev. 1,13; Lev. 1,17; Lev. 2,9 seq.; Kuf. 2; Kuf. 6; Kuf. 7; Esther ኢተቀብአት፡ መዐዛተ፡ Macc. f. 11; odor in genere: መዐዛ፡ ማይ፡ Job 14,9; Jer. 31,11; 2 Cor. 2,16; መዐዛ፡ እኩይ፡ M.M. f. 278. 2 ut videtur, etiam: sapor suavis: ወይን፡ ዘሠናይ፡ መዐዛሁ፡ οἶνος ἡδύς Esth. 1,7. maʿazā መዓዛ፡ maʿāzā G መዓዛ፡ maʿāzā «bonne odeur (dans toutes ses acceptions)» ― ሽታ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 44v. 108 L መዐዛ፡ maʿazā scent, savor, sweet odor, perfume, smell, fragrance 328a

woorden.betekenis: exhortatio, paraenesis, mǝʿdat, mǝʿdān, exhortation, conseil
woorden.definitie: n. act. exhortatio, paraenesis Lud. sine auct. mǝʿdat G ምዕደት፡ mǝʿdat et ምዕዳን፡ mǝʿdān «exhortation, conseil» ― ምክር፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 45r. Textes et références: ወይቤ፡ መኰንን፡... ሡዑ፡ ለአማልክት፡ ከመ፡ ኢትሙቱ። ወይቤ፡ ቅዱስ፡ ሕፃን፡ ዝምዕደትሰ፡ ሕይወት፡ እንተ፡ ትምዕደነ፡ ሞት፡ ይእቲ። Ms. BAVet86, fol. 9va–b; ወይቤ፡ መኰንን፡... ሡዑ፡ ከመ፡ ኢትሙቱ። ወይቤሎ፡ ቅዱስ፡ ሕፃን፡ ዝምዕደት፡ ሕይወት፡ እንተ፡ ትምዕደኒ፡ ሞት፡ ይእቲ። Ms. BNFet134, fol. 32vb. 108–109 ምዕደት፡ mǝʿdat Les sens exhortation et conseil sont donnés sans références par Dillmann et d’Urbin. Textes et références: ወይቤ፡ መኰንን፡... ሡዑ፡ ለአማልክት፡ ከመ፡ ኢትሙቱ። ወይቤ፡ ቅዱስ፡ ሕፃን፡ ዝምዕደትሰ፡ ሕይወት፡ እንተ፡ ትምዕደነ፡ ሞት፡ ይእቲ። Le juge dit: «Sacrifiez aux dieux, afin de ne pas mourir». Le saint enfant dit: «L’exhortation que tu nous présents (comme étant) la vie, c’est la mort». Ms. BAVet86, fol. 9va–b; ወይቤ፡ መኰንን፡... ሡዑ፡ ከመ፡ ኢትሙቱ። ወይቤሎ፡ ቅዱስ፡ ሕፃን፡ ዝምዕደት፡ ሕይወት፡ እንተ፡ ትምዕደኒ፡ ሞት፡ ይእቲ። Ms. BNFet134, fol. 32vb. 449 L ምዕደት mǝʿdat exhortation, admonition, advice 325b C vid. also ምዕዳን፡

woorden.betekenis: signa zodiaci
woorden.definitie: n. peregr. sc. μαζουρώθ (מַזָּרוֹת) signa zodiaci 4 Reg. 23,5. – In Voc. Ae. inter nomina siderum (ከዋክብት፡) recensetur.

woorden.betekenis: dirui, vastari
woorden.definitie: dirui, vastari vid. sub ዘበረ፡

woorden.betekenis: pendere, ponderare, mazana, mazzana, peser, weigh, measure
woorden.definitie: I (dubium, utrum I,1 an I,2) potissimum in libris serioris Geez et in lingua amh. usitatum [i.q. وَزَنَ אִזֵּן] pendere, ponderare, መዝኖት፡ F.N. 32. mazana, mazzana G መዘነ፡ mazzana I,2 ይሜዝን፡, ይመዝን፡ «peser (code civil vulgaire)» ― መዘነ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 45r. 110 L መዘነ mazzana weigh, measure 379a
