woorden.betekenis: diffluendi, aqua, aqua dulcis, aqua diluvii, liquoribus, atr
woorden.definitie: subst. [e rad. מוֹא, quae cum ምህወ፡, መሰወ፡ al. cognata notionem diffluendi habuit; respondent מַיִם ܡܰܝ̈ܳܐ مَاءٌ, sed amharice ወሀ፡, ወኻ፡, ውኃ፡ sicut مَاهٌ] plerumque m., passim fem. (ut Sir. 43,20; Sap. 19,7), Pl. ማያት፡ 1 aqua Gen. 1,9; ማይ፡ ብዙኅ፡ Jes. 11,9; Job 40,18; ማየ፡ ብሔሩ፡ እኩይ፡ 4 Reg. 2,19; ማይ፡ ዕሙቅ፡ Prov. 18,4; ማይ፡ ቈሪር፡ Prov. 25,25; ማየ፡ ባሕር፡ Sir. 18,10; ለእሳት፡ ያጠፍኣ፡ ማይ፡ Sir. 3,30; ኢትስተይ፡ ማየ፡ ዕራቆ፡ 1 Tim. 5,23; ማይ፡ ጥዑም፡ vel ማየ፡ ጥዑም፡ aqua dulcis ut Gen. 21,19; Lev. 14,5; Lev. 14,50; Lev. 14,52; ማይ፡ መሪር፡ ወማይ፡ ጥዑም፡ Jac. 3,11; ዘአልቦ፡ ማየ፡ ἄνυδρος Zeph. 2,13; ማየ፡ አይኅ፡ aqua diluvii Sir. 21,13; Ps. 28,9; ማየ፡ ሕይወት፡ Sir. 21,13; Apoc. 22,1; አንቅዕተ፡ ማያቲሆሙ፡ Judith 7,12; ማያቲሆሙ፡ ወአንቅዕቲሆሙ፡ Judith 7,17; in bibliis frequentissimus est Pl. ὕδατα ማያት፡ ut Ps. 147,7; c.c. Pl. verbi m. ut Ps. 17,13; Ps. 76,15; Ps. 76,16; Prov. 8,29; Hez. 47,1, et fem. Prov. 5,16, vel c. Sing. verbi m. ut Kuf. 5; de aquis salubribus 4 Reg. 5,12, coll. Joh. 5,3; Joh. 5,4. 2 usurpatur de variis liquoribus 4 Esr. 14,41; ማየ፡ ሕመት፡ atramentum vid. ሕመት፡; ማየ፡ ልብን፡ stacte vid. ልብን፡; de resina e plantis profluente Hen. 31,1; de succis e plantis et fructibus expressis: ማያ፡ አስካል፡ vinum Syn. f. 290; ማየ፡ ሎሚ፡ M.F.; de liquore albo ovorum: ማየ፡ አንቆቅሆ፡ M.F.; ማየ፡ ሐሊብ፡ aqua lactis i.e. serum Th. Petr. – Etiam de lotio dicitur: ወሶበ፡ ነሐውር፡ ቤተ፡ ማይ፡ ርሱያኒነ፡ ነሐውር፡ 2 Esr. 14,23 (i.e. hebr. Neh. 4,17); Kedr f. 86. – Voc. Ae.: ማይ፡ ብ፡ ወሀ፡ ወንዝሂ፡ ይ፡ māy, Pl. māyāt ከዐወ፡ ማይ፡ ዘሥርዐተ፡ ሥጋ፡ urinate, answer a call of nature ሶበ፡ ጽሕውኩ፡ እምንዋምየ፡ ረከብኩ፡ ኵሎ፡ አባልየ፡ ቅጥቁጠ፡ ወስእንኩ፡ አንሳሕስሖ፡ እስከ፡ ለክዒወ፡ ማይ፡ ዘሥርዐተ፡ ሥጋ። ‘when I woke up from my sleep I found all my body parts battered and could not move even to pour the water of the law of the flesh’ 66 (362) l. 29–31 (ed.), 67 (363) l. 29–31 (tr.) (‘The expression is a polite way to say “to urinate”.’ 67 (363) n. 106) G ማይ፡ māy, Pl. ማያት፡ māyāt «eau» ― ውኃ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 45v. ማየ፡ አይሕ፡ māya ʾayḥ «déluge» Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 45v., vid. አይኅ፡ ማየ፡ ሕመት፡ māya hǝmmat «encre» ― ጥቁር፡ ቀለም፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 45v., vid. ሕመት፡ 111 L ማይ māy (Pl. ማያት māyāt) water, liquid ማየ፡ አስካል፡ māya ʾaskāl wine, vid. አስካል፡ ማየ፡ አይኅ፡ māya ʾayḫ deluge, vid. አይኅ፡ ማየ፡ ሐሊብ፡ māya ḥalib whey, vid. ሐሊብ፡ ማየ፡ ሕመት፡ māya ḥǝmmat ink, vid. ሕመት፡ ማየ፡ ልብን፡ māya lǝbn stacte, vid. ልብን፡ ማየ፡ ጸሎት፡ māya ṣalot holy water, vid. ጸሎት፡ 376a ማየ፡ ሕመት māya hǝmmat lit. ‘liquid of soot’ ink, vid. ሕመት፡ 235a C a for ሕንባበ፡ ማይ፡ vid. ሕንባብ፡ b for ሐዋሬ፡ ማይ፡ vid. ሐዋሪ፡ c for ምሕያበ፡ ማይ፡ vid. ምሕያብ፡ (Grébaut)

woorden.betekenis: commiscuit, maceravit dissolvitque
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., sine dubio e.q. مَاثَ commiscuit, maceravit dissolvitque rem in aqua et مَاسَ (مَوْسٌ) id. Hinc

woorden.betekenis: vinum mulsum, temetum conficere, fecit mulsum, ʾamesa, mayya
woorden.definitie: II,1 vinum mulsum vel temetum conficere. Hanc quidem formam d’Abbadie e suo cod. XCI excerptam mihi communicavit; aut Lud. in lex. asserit: መየሰ፡ fecit mulsum. ʾamesa L አሜሰ ʾamesa same as vid. መየሰ mayyasa; (*) also causative of vid. ሜሰ mesa 377a

woorden.betekenis: qui vinum mulsum, temetum, siceram conficit, vendit, caupo,
woorden.definitie: n. ag., Pl. መያስያን፡ qui vinum mulsum, temetum, siceram conficit vel vendit, deinde in genere caupo, tabernarius, κάπηλος Sir. 26,29; መያስያንኪ፡ Jes. 1,22; Did. ed Platt p. 125; ለብሰ፡ ልብሰ፡ መያስያን፡ Jsp. p. 282; መያስያን፡ እለ፡ ይቶስሑ፡ በወይን፡ ከመ፡ ይሢጥዎ፡ F.M. 26,2; ቤተ፡ መያሲ፡ caupona Jes. 5,11; ይበውእ፡ ቤተ፡ መያሲ፡ Clem. f. 127; καπηλεῖον II Can. Ap. 49. mayāsi, mayyāsi; Pl. mayāsǝyān G መያሲ፡ mayāsi, Pl. መያስያን፡ mayāsǝyān «qui fait ou vend de l’hydromel» ― የጠጅ፡ መልከኛ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 45v. መያሲ፡ mayāsi, Pl. መያስያን፡ mayāsǝyān «échanson» ― አሳላፊ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 45v. 111 L መያሲ፡ mayyāsi one who prepares mead, one who sells mead 377a

woorden.betekenis: callidus, subdolus, malis artibus utens
woorden.definitie: part. callidus, subdolus, malis artibus utens: ምይንት፡ ነፍስ፡ ψυχὴ κακότεχνος Sap. 1,4.

woorden.betekenis: astutia, versutia, calliditas, fraus, insidiae, tǝmǝyyǝnt, m
woorden.definitie: subst. astutia, versutia, calliditas, fraus, insidiae, πανουργία 1 Cor. 3,19; 2 Cor. 4,2; Luc. 20,23; δόλος Job 13,16; Jer. 9,6; Dan. 8,25; Dan. apocr. 13,18; እለ፡ የሐውሩ፡ በትምይንት፡ ἀτάκτως περιπατοῦντες 2 Thess. 3,6; ἐπιβουλαί Chrys. ho. 26; እንተ፡ ቃላ፡ ትምይንት፡ (אֲמָרֶיהָ הֶחֱלִיקָה) Prov. 2,16 vers. nov., et Prov. 7,5 vers. nov. tǝmǝyyǝnt G ሚን፡ min, ተምያን፡ tamyān ትምይንት፡ tǝmǝyyǝnt et ምያኔ፡ mǝyyāne «ruse, tromperie, duplicité, déception, astuce» ― ተንኰል፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 46r. 112 L ትምይንት tǝmǝyyǝnt craftiness, ruse, trick, fraud, treachery, deceit, guile, cunning, cheating, malice, wickedness, stratagem 376b

woorden.betekenis: fluxit leniter, liquefactus est
woorden.definitie: rad. inus.; مَاعَ (مَيْعٌ) fluxit leniter, liquefactus est (cfr. ምህወ፡). Hinc

woorden.betekenis: nomen mensis Abyssinorum octavi, qui XXVII° Martii
woorden.definitie: nomen mensis Abyssinorum octavi, qui XXVII° Martii sec. Cal. Julian., VIII° Aprilis sec. Cal. Greg. incipit, et mensi Coptorum ⲡⲁⲣⲙⲟⲩⲑⲉ, ⲫⲁⲣⲙⲟⲑⲓ በርሙዳ፡ respondet. Fere convenit cum primo Hebraeorum mense: በቀዳሚ፡ ወርኅ፡ ብሩህ፡ ዘውእቱ፡ ሚያዝያ፡ Did. 29; በወርኀ፡ ሚያዝያ፡ (μὴν τῶν νέων) Ex. 34,18.

woorden.betekenis: deflexit, declinavit, recessit, repulit, vertere, avertere,
woorden.definitie: I,1 [مَاطَ (مَيْطٌ) deflexit, declinavit, recessit, repulit, nec non מוּט, נוּט, נָטָה, ܡܛܳܐ huc referenda sunt] Subj. ይሚጥ፡ 1 vertere (circumagere, flectere) Hen. 18,4; Jac. 3,3; Jac. 3,4; 1 Reg. 14,13. a avertere, (declinare, deflectere) Ex. 3,6; ይመይጥ፡ ዐይኖ፡ Sir. 27,1; Jes. 35,13; ሜጣከ፡ አንስት፡ ሕሊናከ፡ Sir. 47,19; c. Acc. rei et እምነ፡, ut: ሜጠ፡ አዕይንቲሁ፡ እምነ፡ Sir. 4,1; Sir. 9,8; Cant. 6,5; ኢትሚጥ፡ እዝነከ፡ እምነ፡ ስእለትየ፡ Thren. 3,55; 2 Tim. 4,4; ኢትሚጥ፡ ገጸከ፡ እምኔየ፡ Tob. 3,6; Jes. 54,8; Jes. 57,17; Ps. 12,1; Ps. 84,4; Sir. 4,4; c. Acc. pers. et እምነ፡ (avertere, avocare, abalienare): ሜጥዎሙ፡ ለድኩማን፡ እምፍኖተ፡ ጽድቅ፡ Job 24,4; ይመይጦ፡ ለሰብእ፡ እምኀጢአት፡ Job 33,17. b advertere, convertere (obvertere, admovere): ሜጡ፡ ዘባኖሙ፡ ኀቤየ፡ Jer. 2,27; ሜጥኩ፡ ገጽየ፡ ኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Dan. 9,3; ሚጥ፡ ሎቱ፡ ካልእታሂ፡ Matth. 5,39; እመይጦሙ፡ መንገሌየ፡ Jer. 37,21; ሚጠነ፡ ኀቤከ፡ ወንትመየጥ፡ Thren. 5,21; episcopi ይሚጥዎሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ንስሓ፡ ለእለ፡ አበሱ፡ Did. 6; ሚጥ፡ ልበ፡ ነገሥት፡ ለአሠንዮ፡ Lit. 164,4. 2 revertere a reducere: Ex. 23,4; ይመይጥ፡ ፄዋ፡ ሕዝብየ፡ Jes. 45,13; Jes. 51,11; Jer. 25,18; Jer. 37,18; Ps. 79,4; Ps. 79,8; Ps. 84,1; Ps. 84,4; Ps. 125,1; ሜጠኒ፡ ውስተ፡ ዛቲ፡ ምድር፡ በሰላም፡ Kuf. 31; እመይጥዎሙ፡ ውስተ፡ አሕዛብ፡ Kuf. 1; Lit. 164,3; ለመይጦ፡ ነፍስ፡ Thren. 1,11; Thren. 1,19; እግዚአብሔር፡ ይገብር፡ ሚጦተ፡ ክረምት፡ Clem. f. 171; sensu ethico: Luc. 1,16; Luc. 1,17; Jac. 5,19; Jac. 5,20. b reflectere, repellere (in fugam convertere) Ps. 89,3; Ex. 17,13; 4 Reg. 18,24. c reddere, retribuere: ሚጥ፡ ሎሙ፡ ጽእለቶሙ፡ ላዕለ፡ ርእሶሙ፡ 2 Esr. 14,5. 3 convertere, transformare, transmutare: ዘሜጦ፡ ለማይ፡ ወረሰዮ፡ ጼዋ፡ Sir. 39,23; ሥሓቀክሙ፡ ሚጥዎ፡ ውስተ፡ ላሕ፡ Jac. 4,9; Zeph. 3,9; c. ኀበ፡ in rem M.M. f. 61; ሚጦ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኅብስት፡ ከመ፡ ይኩን፡ ሥጋከ፡ Lit. 160,2. a mutare: ይመይጥ፡ ልቦ፡ Sir. 21,6; (1 Reg. 21,13); Hen. 2,1. b pervertere, in deterius mutare 2 Petr. 3,16; ሰይጣን፡ ሜጠ፡ ሕሊናሁ፡ Lud. e Vit. Dan. c revocare, irritum facere consilium, mandatum aut suum aut alius: ከመ፡ እሚጥ፡ ኪዳንየ፡ Zach. 11,10 (διασκεδάσαι); Hebr. 6,17 (μετατιθέναι); ኢትሚጥ፡ ብፅዐቲከ፡ (δευτεροῦν) Sir. 7,14; እመሂ፡ መከርክሙ፡ ምክረ፡ ይመይጥ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Jes. 8,10; Jes. 14,27; διαλλάσσειν Job 5,12; Job 12,20; Job 12,24; ሜጥከ፡ መቅሠፍተከ፡ Jes. 12,1; Hen. 6,4; ሜጡ፡ ቃለ፡ ንጉሥ፡ (ἀλλοιοῦν i.e. migrare) Dan. 3,28. 4 flectere jus (ἐκκλίνειν); ኢትሚጥ፡ ፍትሐ፡ Ex. 23,6; Thren. 3,34; Jes. 10,2; ሜጡ፡ ፍትሐ፡ የዋሓን፡ Job 36,15. meṭa G ሜጠ፡ meṭa I,1 ይመይጥ፡, ይሚጥ፡ «tourner, retourner (actif), faire revenir, convertir» ― መለሰ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 46r. 112 L myṭ ሜጠ፡ meṭa (yǝmiṭ) turn, turn aside (tr., intr.), turn away, turn back, divert, avert, convert, transform, alter, change, restore, return, repel, frustrate, revoke, refute, pervert, deliver up, recall 377a

woorden.betekenis: se vertere, verti, versari, averti, deflecti, declinari, se
woorden.definitie: III,1 refl. et pass. 1 se vertere, verti: ተመየጡ፡ ወርእዩ፡ Thren. 1,12; Koh. 4,1; Koh. 9,11; Matth. 9,22; Joh. 21,20; ከመ፡ ኢትትመየጥ፡ በገቦከ፡ እምገቦከ፡ Hez. 4,8; ይትመየጡ፡ ለፌ፡ ወለፌ፡ 3 Reg. 18,45; 3 Reg. 20,40; Job 41,16; እስከ፡ ትትመየጥ፡ Sir. 12,15; ተመየጥ፡ ድኅሬከ፡ Clem. f. 54; ሰይፍ፡ ዘይትመየጥ፡ Gen. 3,24; Prov. 8,20; pass. Jac. 3,4. a versari in re: ይትመየጥ፡ በምግባሮሙ፡ Sir. 38,25. b averti (deflecti, declinari), se avertere Jos. 23,12; Kuf. 1; c. እምነ፡ Job 9,13; ተመየጥ፡ እምዐመፃከ፡ Sir. 17,26; Job 36,10 (vide plura exempla sub reverti Nr. 2, d). c se advertere vel convertere ad aliquem, converti: abs. ተመየጥ፡ እምሰማይ፡ Jes. 63,15; 4 Esr. 9,40; Hen. 50,1; ተመየጥ፡ ኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Sir. 17,25; ተመየጡ፡ ኀቤየ፡ ወእትመየጥ፡ ኀቤክሙ፡ Zach. 1,3 (plura exempla vid. sub reverti Nr. 2, d). In specie c.c. Acc. pers. (reconciliatum esse alicui): ተመየጠነ፡ ἐπίβλεψον Sir. 33,2; እትመየጣ፡ ለኢየሩሳሌም፡ በምሕረት፡ Zach. 1,16; Zach. 8,3; Asc. Jes. 9,3; Asc. Jes. 9,5; እትመየጦሙ፡ ወእሣሀሎሙ፡ Jer. 12,25; 1 Reg. 25,14; በከመ፡ ተመይጦትከ፡ κατὰ τὴν ἐπίκειάν σου Or. Az. (Dan.3) 18. 2 reverti a redire Koh. 1,7; Gen. 32,1; ይትመየጡ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድሮሙ፡ Jer. 44,7; እስከ፡ ማእዜ፡ ትትመየጥ፡ 2 Esr. 12,6; Kuf. 27; Ruth 1,6; Luc. 2,20; Luc. 4,14; ኢይትመየጥ፡ ድኅሬሁ፡ Matth. 24,18; Hebr. 10,39 Platt. b reflecti, de rebus inanimatis, ut de finium tractu: Jos. 19,12; Kuf. 8. c seq. alio verbo denotat iterum: ተመይጦሙ፡ ከረዩ፡ Kuf. 24; ይትመየጥ፡ ለግቢእ፡ Koh. 5,14. d sensu ethico: resipiscere, converti: ሕዝብ፡ ኢተመይጡ፡ Jes. 9,13; Joh. 12,40; Matth. 13,15; ኢተመይጠ፡ እምኀጢአቱ፡ Hez. 3,19; Hez. 33,18; Hez. 33,19; Kuf. 5; Kuf. 41; ተመየጡ፡ ኀቤየ፡ Jes. 44,22; Jer. 3,12; 1 Thess. 1,9; Act. 11,21. e et vice versa: recidere, redire ad pristinos mores (pravos): ተመይጡ፡ ውስተ፡ ኀጢአተ፡ አበዊሆሙ፡ Jer. 11,10; እመ፡ ተመይጠ፡ ጻድቅ፡ እምጽድቁ፡ Hez. 3,20; F.M. 6,6. f recedere, defervescere, de ira: እስከ፡ ይትመየጥ፡ መዐተ፡ እኁከ፡ Kuf. 27; Jes. 9,12; Jes. 9,17; Jes. 9,21. 3 converti, transformari, transmutari, mutari, et refl. se convertere: ይትመየጥ፡ ቈላቲሃ፡ ወይከውን፡ ፒሳ፡ Jes. 34,9; ለኃጥኣን፡ ይትመየጦሙ፡ (ταῦτα πάντα) በእኩይ፡ Sir. 39,27; ኅብስት፡ ይትመየጥ፡ ለከዊነ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ እምከዊነ፡ ኅብስት፡ ዘልማድ፡ M.M. f. 3; Hen. 5,2; ዘኢይትመየጥ፡ ἄτρεπτος inconvertibilis Cyr. ad Reg. f. 29; ተስፋ፡ ዘኢይትመየጥ፡ Lit. 168,2; ይመስሎሙ፡ ከመ፡ ህላዌ፡ ቃል፡ ተመይጠ፡ ውስተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ሥጋ፡ ወሚጠተ፡ የአምኑ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ዘኢያአምር፡ ሚጠተ፡ (μεταστοιχευοῦσθαι) Cyr. ad Theod. f. 10; de animo: ተመይጠ፡ ልቡ፡ ለፈርዖን፡ (μετεστράφη) Ex. 14,5; ተመይጦሙ፡ ሤጥዎ፡ Kuf. 34. – (Quod Lud. in lex. col. 97 affert: „active accipitur Can. Clem. 66, ut: fideles ይትመየጥዎሙ፡ ለአግብርቲሆሙ፡ convertant (ad Christianismum) servos suos, et sic in Saal. Req. et Vit. Sanct.“ vereor ne ad Nr. 1, e referendum sit). – Voc. Ae.: ተሠውጠ፡ ተመይጠ፡ ነስሐ፡ ዘ፡ ተመለሰ። tamayṭa, ተሜጠ፡ tameṭa G ተመይጠ፡ tamayṭa III,1 ይትመየጥ፡ «retourner (neutre), être converti» ― ተመለሰ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 46r. 112 L ተመይጠ tamayṭa, ተሜጠ tameṭa passive, reflexive {of vid. ሜጠ meṭa}; also face about, return (intr), go back, turn to, turn back, turn away (intr) ዘኢይትመየጥ zaʾiyyǝtmayyaṭ immutable, unwavering 377a

woorden.betekenis: versus, adversus, conversus, aversus, mǝyuṭ, mǝyyuṭ, mǝyuṭān
woorden.definitie: part. versus a adversus, conversus ad aliquem Hebr. 10,39 rom.; item in Chrys. ad locum; ሰብእ፡ ምዩጣን፡ ኀቤከ፡ (i.e. tibi addicti, devoti) Jsp. p. 307. b aversus: እስመ፡ ምዩጣን፡ ገጾሙ፡ Herm. p. 17; ምዩጠ፡ ገጽ፡ እምስእለትየ፡ Org. 3; sensu ethico: (defectores) Hen. 81,8. mǝyuṭ, mǝyyuṭ, Pl. ምዩጣን፡ mǝyuṭān G ምዩጥ፡ mǝyuṭ, Pl. ምዩጣን፡ mǝyuṭān et ተመያጢ፡ tamayāṭi, Pl. ተመያጥያን፡ tamayāṭǝyān «retourné, converti, revenu, revenant» ― የተመለሰ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 46r. 112 L ምዩጥ mǝyyuṭ pass. part. of vid. ሜጠ meṭa; also apostate 377a

woorden.betekenis: conversio, directio, fatum, aversio, reditus, ad officium vo
woorden.definitie: n. act., Pl. ሚጠታት፡ 1 conversio a astrorum Hen. 43,2; Hen. 72,1; ሚጠታት፡ Lit. Diosc. b directio rerum (fatum) Kuf. p. 96(סִבָּה). c sensu ethico: peccatoris ad poenitentiam Ssal. Req. 2 aversio: በሚጠተ፡ ገጸ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ እምኔነ፡ Jsp. p. 379. 3 reversio a reditus: እጼውዐክሙ፡ ለሚጠት፡ ኀበ፡ ተአዝዞትነ፡ ad officium vos revoco Jsp. p. 372. b reductio: እሬስያ፡ ኅቡረ፡ ለሚጠቶሙ፡ (ἀποστροφήν) Mich. 2,12. c responsum, rescriptum: ሰድ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ኀበ፡ ንጉሠ፡ ምዕራብ፡ ወለእመ፡ ነሣእከ፡ ሚጠተ፡ እምኔሁ፡ ተመየጥ፡ ኀቤየ፡ Jsp. p. 321; Jsp. p. 344. 4 conversio, mutatio, immutatio Hen. 50,1; τροπή Cyr. ad Theod. f. 10; ἀλλοίωσις Cyr. ad Theod. f. 10; ዘእንበለ፡ ሚጠት፡ ἄτρεπτος et ἀναλλοίωτος Cyr. ad Theod. f. 10. miṭat, Pl. miṭatāt G ሚጠት፡ miṭat, Pl. ሚጠታት፡ miṭatāt «retour, conversion» ― ምላሽ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 46r. 112 L ሚጠት miṭat (Pl. ሚጠታት miṭatāt) turning (n), turning away, returning, return, answer, change, transformation, conversion, revolution (going around) 377a

woorden.betekenis: conversio, mutatio, permutatio, vicissitudo, inconvertibilis
woorden.definitie: et ሙያጤ፡, subst. 1 conversio, astrorum Hen. 41,8. 2 mutatio, permutatio, vicissitudo: ዘእንበለ፡ ሙያጤ፡ inconvertibilis (ὁ λόγος) M.M. f. 2; ሙያጤ፡ ልደት፡ γενέσεως ἐναλλαγή Sap. 14,26; ሙያጤ፡ መዋዕል፡ ወተፋልሶ፡ ጊዜያት፡ τροπῶν ἀλλαγαί Sap. 7,18. mǝyāṭe, mǝyyāṭe, muyāṭe L ምያጤ mǝyyāṭe, ሙያጤ muyāṭe alternation, transformation, confusion, change changing, revolution (of stars) 377a

woorden.betekenis: conversio, mutatio, miṭān, returning, conversion, alternatio
woorden.definitie: subst. conversio, mutatio: ጽዱቅ፡ ወክቡር፡ ነገረ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወአልቦ፡ ወኢምንተኒ፡ ሚጣነ፡ በኀበ፡ እለ፡ ቦሙ፡ አእምሮ፡ Macc. f. 10. miṭān L ሚጣን miṭān returning (n), conversion, alternation, answer 377a

woorden.betekenis: extensionem, extensus est, magno distentoque ventre fuit, ma
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., quae extensionem significasse videtur (coll. ܐܶܬܡܰܕܰܪ extensus est, مَدِرَ magno distentoque ventre fuit). Hinc madara L መደረ፡ maddara (*) be wide, be long, (Lt) be stretched out, be extended, be expanded (denominative) 330a

woorden.betekenis: terra, orbis terrarum, omnes homines, continens, regio, prov
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. አምዳር፡ et ምድራት፡, Pl. Pl. አምዳራት፡ 1 terra i.e. a orbis terrarum Gen. 1,1; Gen. 1,2; Gen. 2,1; Gen. 9,19; Gen. 19,31; Jes. 24,4; Jes. 65,17; Jes. 66,1; Jer. 4,28; Hen. 1,7; Hen. 2,3; Deut. 32,1; Matth. 5,18; Matth. 24,35; Hebr. 12,26; Eph. 1,10; ኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ omnes homines, Judith 11,16; Deut. 32,26; Matth. 5,13. b continens (opp. mari et fluviis): Gen. 1,10-12; Gen. 1,28; Marc. 4,1; Luc. 5,11; Hebr. 11,29; Jon. 2,11. c regio (provincia, patria): Gen. 12,1; Gen. 13,9; Gen. 17,8; Matth. 2,20; Matth. 4,15; Matth. 9,26; Jer. 12,14; Jer. 22,29; ውስተዝ፡ ምድር፡ Gen. 49,10; ኵሉ፡ ምድረ፡ ግብጽ፡ Ex. 7,21; Jos. 8,1; 1 Reg. 9,4; ምድረ፡ በድው፡ ἡ ἄνυδρος γῆ Jes. 41,19; ውስተ፡ ምድረ፡ ፄው፡ ἐν ἁλίμοις Jer. 17,6; ምድረ፡ ሕያዋን፡ Jer. 11,19; ምድረ፡ ገነት፡ (paradisi) Clem. f. 171; አምዳር፡ et አምዳራት፡ Dan. 11,40; Dan. 11,42 var.; ምድር፡ ἐπαρχία vel provincia Metropolitae Can. Ant. 7(9). d ager, agri Matth. 27,7; Jes. 23,10; Jes. 28,24; Gen. 47,18; Gen. 47,19; Lev. 25,24; Lev. 25,25; ተገብረ፡ ምድረ፡ 2 Reg. 9,10; ምድራት፡ ርሒባት፡ 1 Par. 4,10; አድባር፡ ወአምዳር፡ (ὀρεινή et πεδεινή) Deut. 11,11. e humus, solum terrae: ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ χαμαί Judith 12,15; Judith 14,18; Thren. 2,10; Jes. 47,1; ἔδαφος Job 9,8; Sir. 11,5; Jes. 26,5; ምድረ፡ ኮነ፡ Judith 5,18; Matth. 10,29; Matth. 15,35; Joh. 8,6; humus, quatenus plantarum ferax est: Matth. 13,8 rom.; Hebr. 6,7; Jac. 5,18; 4 Esr. 9,35. f terrae elementum vel materia, (pulvis, lutum) Sir. 17,1; እለ፡ እምድር፡ γηγενεῖς Prov. 2,18; ዘውስተ፡ ምድር፡ τὰ ἐπίγεια Phil. 3,19. 2 transl. solum, pavimentum, fundus: ἔδαφος tabernaculi Num. 5,17; aedificii 3 Reg. 6,15; Dan. apocr. 13,19; Hez. 41,16; Hen. 14,10; Hen. 14,17; ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ἐπὶ τῆς χελωνίδος Judith 14,15; ἐσχάρα altaris Ex. 6,13; ምድረ፡ ግብ፡ ἔδαφος λάκκου Dan. 6,24; ምድረ፡ ባሕር፡ Job 38,16; hinc እምድሩ፡ funditus, ut: እመ፡ እምድሩ፡ ትኰሲ፡ ሕማማተ፡ εἰ παντελῶς ἀναιρεῖς τὸ πάθος hom. Theodoti Anc. in Cyr. f. 102(de quo loco Voc. Ae.: እምድሩ፡ ዘ፡ ሐንድ፡ ዘንዱን፡ አካቶሂ፡ ይ፡). – [In linguis cognatis: amh. ምድር፡ terra ; arab. مَدَرٌ lutum siccum; pagi, oppida; syr. ܡܶܕܪܳܐ gleba, cespes, terra.] mǝdr, Pl. ʾamdār, mǝdrāt, Pl.Pl. ʾamdārat በጌ፡ ምድር፡ bage mǝdr (role name) vid. በጌምድር፡, በጊ፡ G ምድር፡ mǝdr, Pl. አምዳር፡ ʾamdār «terre, la Terre» ― ምድር፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 46v. 112 L ምድር mǝdr, (Pl. ምድራት mǝdrāt, አምዳር ʾamdār, አምዳራት ʾamdārat) earth, ground, soil, field, country, land, territory, district, region, floor (of a house), bottom (of a pit) 330a

woorden.betekenis: terrenus, terrester, mǝdrāwi, mǝdrāwit, mǝdrāwǝyān, mǝdrāwǝy
woorden.definitie: adj. rel. terrenus, terrester: ወልደ፡ ምድራዊ፡ γηγενοῦς ἀπόγονος Sap. 7,1; Lit. 171,1; ሥጋ፡ መሬት፡ ምድራዊ፡ Jsp. p. 381; ንጉሥ፡ ምድራዊ፡ (opp. Deus) Phlx. 192; ሕይወት፡ ኀላፊት፡ ምድራዊት፡ Macc. f. 19; Chrys. saepissime; al. mǝdrāwi, fem. ምድራዊት፡ mǝdrāwit; Pl. ምድራውያን፡ mǝdrāwǝyān, fem. ምድራውያት፡ mǝdrāwǝyāt G ምድራዊ፡ mǝdrāwi, Pl. ምድራውያን፡ mǝdrāwǝyān «terrestre, terrenus» et fem. ምድራዊት፡ mǝdrāwit, Pl. ምድራውያት፡ mǝdrāwǝyāt ― ዘምድር፡ ወገን፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 46v. 112 L ምድራዊ mǝdrāwi earthly, wordly, of earth, terrestial being 330a

woorden.betekenis: desertum, madbarā, madbǝrā, désert, wilderness
woorden.definitie: et መድብራ፡ n. peregr., sc. מִדְבָּר desertum Jos. 5,6; Hen. 28,1; Hen. 29,1; Hen. 77,7. madbarā, መድብራ madbǝrā G መድብራ፡ madbǝrā «désert ()» Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 46v. 113 L መድበራ madbarā, መድብራ madbǝrā wilderness 329a

woorden.betekenis: sedes principis
woorden.definitie: sedes principis vid. sub ደየነ፡

woorden.betekenis: herba agris noxia
woorden.definitie: herba agris noxia vid. sub ጕሕየ፡.

woorden.betekenis: circumdare, cingere, tuendi, defendendi, adjuvandi, tueri, a
woorden.definitie: I,2 [deest in caeteris linguis, excepta amharica, formatum est e simpliciore radice גַּב جَابَ, de qua vid. Ges. thes. p. 255]. 1 circumdare, cingere: ወአምሳለ፡ አልህምት፡ መትሕቴሃ፡ ዐውዳ፡ ወይሜግብዋ፡ ወየዐውድዋ፡ 2 Par. 4,3; in spec. tuendi, defendendi, adjuvandi causa: Ps. 31,13; Ps. 124,2; Deut. 32,10; አሐለይክዮሙ፡ ይምጽኡ፡ ኀቤኪ፡ ወይመግቡኪ፡ በዝሙትኪ፡ Hez. 16,33; ይሜግቡ፡ በጽድቅ፡ መንበሮ፡ Prov. 28,30; Chrys. Ta. 5; assistendi causa Gad. T.H. 2 tueri, administrare, dispensare: ነፍስ፡ እስርት፡ በሥጋ፡ ከመ፡ ትመግቦ፡ ወትሥራዕ፡ ንብረቶ፡ Jsp. p. 381; ኢይክል፡ ሠሪዐ፡ መንግሥት፡ ወመግቦታ፡ Jsp. p. 309; ይሜግባ፡ ለሐመር፡ gubernator navis est Org. Est vox forensis: procurare, mandatarium vel procuratorem esse, c. vel absol.: Luc. 16,2; non decet presbyteros ይመግቡ፡ ወኢይትሐበዩ፡ Syn., vel c. Acc. rei, ut: ዘይሜግብ፡ ንዋያ፡ ለድክትምት፡ F.N. 24,3. maggaba G መገበ፡ maggaba I,2 ይሜግብ፡, ይመግብ፡ «administrer, avoir l’administration de …, dispenser, être ministre» ― ሹም፡ ሆነ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 47r. 114 L መገበ maggaba steer, be a steward, direct, manage, administer, be in charge of, maintain, surround to protect, protect, (*) feed 331b

woorden.betekenis: praeficere rebus gerendis, curam mandare, administratorem, c
woorden.definitie: II,2 (passim in libris mss. አምገበ፡ II,1 ut Sx.; Imperf. ያመግብ፡ Luc. 12,44 rom.) praeficere rebus gerendis aliquem, curam mandare alicui; administratorem, curatorem, procuratorem constituere aliquem; c.c. Acc. pers.: መጋቢ፡ ዘአመገብዎ፡ F.M. 5,14; et c. ላዕለ፡ rei vel pers.: ኢታመግብ፡ ነኪረ፡ ላዕለ፡ ቤትከ፡ Sir. 30,28; Luc. 12,44; ዘአመገብዎ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ quem curatorem eorum (pupillorum) constituerunt F.N. 24,3, vel c. ዲበ፡, ut: እግዚአብሔር፡ አመገበከ፡ ዲቤሆሙ፡ ትቅትል፡ ወታሕይው፡ Macc. f. 3; vel c. ለ፡ ut Act. 7,10 rom.; vel c. በ፡ rei, ut: ለእመ፡ አመገቦ፡ ለብእሲ፡ በሠይጥ፡ F.N. 30, et c. በ፡ muneris 1 Cor. 9,17; c.c. dupl. Acc. (personae et muneris): ኣሜግቦ፡ ምግበከ፡ Jes. 22,21. – (In Catal. Codd. Aeth. Bibl. Bodl. p. 28 በእንተ፡ አመግቦ፡ de mandato (non: de feudo) vertendum est). ʾamaggaba G አመገበ፡ ʾamaggaba II,2 ያሜግብ፡, ያመግብ፡ «préposer, créer administrateur» ― ሾመ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 47r. 114 L አመገበ ʾamaggaba appoint a guardian, appoint an administrator or an overseer, place in charge of 331b

woorden.betekenis: administratio, dispensatio, munus, procuratio, tutela, mala
woorden.definitie: subst. administratio, dispensatio, munus, procuratio, tutela, οἰκονομία: ትሰዐር፡ እምግብከ፡ Jes. 22,19; Jes. 22,21; Luc. 16,2-4: 1 Cor. 9,17; መገቦሙ፡ ምግበ፡ እኩየ፡ mala procuratione eos curavit (κακῶς ᾠκονόμησε τὴν ἀρχὴν ἑαυτοῦ) Chrys. ho. 34; ምግብ፡ ዘአመገበከ፡ Macc. f. 4; ከመ፡ ይፈጽም፡ ምግቦ፡ Rel. Bar.; በምግቡ፡ ለቈስጠንጢኖስ፡ sub administratione Constantini Sx. Masc. 21Enc.; ዘሀለወት፡ ታሕተ፡ ምግቡ፡ F.N. 24,3. mǝgb, magb G መግብ፡ magb et መግብና፡ magbǝnnā «administration» ― ሹመት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 47r. 114 L ምግብ mǝgb, (114) መግብ magb guardianship, stewardship, tutelage, management, ministry, administration, office, function, duty 331b C vid. also ምግብና፡

woorden.betekenis: pharetra
woorden.definitie: pharetra vid. sub ገነጰ፡

woorden.betekenis: rad. propagata e simplicori מָדַר extendit, mensus
woorden.definitie: rad. propagata e simplicori מָדַר extendit, mensus est, arab. مَدَّ, مَدَى, cujus variationes sunt مَتَّ, مَتَا, مَتَنَ, مَطَّ, مَطَلَ, مَطَا; nec non وَطَنَ in aliquot derivatis.

woorden.betekenis: mensurari, immensurabile, tamaṭṭana, être proportionné, maṭṭ
woorden.definitie: III,2 mensurari, ut: ዘይትሜጠን፡ በእመት፡ F.N. 33; ክበደ፡ ብዕሉ፡ ዘኢይትሜጠን፡ M.M. f. 84. (Formam III,1 ዘኢይትመጠን፡ immensurabile Lud. affert sine auct.). tamaṭṭana G ተመጠነ፡ tamaṭṭana III,2 ይትሜጠን፡, ይትመጠን፡ «être proportionné» ― ተለካ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 47v. 116 L ተመጠነ tamaṭṭana passive {of vid. መጠነ maṭṭana} 372b

woorden.betekenis: quantus? quantum?, quantum gratiae?, quot?, quantopere, quam
woorden.definitie: i.e. መጠን፡ praefixo ሚ፡ interrogativo, 1 usurpatur vice pronominis interrogativi et substantivi et adjectivi; statum constructum plerumque aspernatur; etiam ubi adjective sumitur, caeterorum adjectivorum instar suo substantivo apponi solet; a quantus? quantum? ንግረኒ፡ ሚመጠን፡ ውእቱ፡ Job 38,18; ሚመጠነ፡ ትረክቢ፡ ዐስበኪ፡ πόσον μισθόν Hez. 27,33; ሚመጠን፡ ኑኃ፡ ወሚመጠን፡ ርሕባ፡ Zach. 2,2; Matth. 26,15; exemplum nominis per st. constr. subjuncti est: ሚመጠነ፡ ጸጋ፡ quantum gratiae? Org. 1. b quot? Ps. 118,84; Gen. 30,29; Gen. 47,8; Matth. 15,34; 4 Esr. 2,11-13; ሚመጠን፡ (v. ሚመጠነ፡) እማንቱ፡ ኀጣውእየ፡ Job 13,23. 2 sumitur adverbialiter, plerumque in Acc. (ሚመጠነ፡) positum quamquam etiam ሚመጠን፡ indecl. eodem modo usurpari potest (ut Job 35,5); a quantopere, quam? ሚመጠነ፡ በጥንቃቄ፡ ትኴንን፡ Sap. 12,21; አእምር፡ ሚመጠን፡ ልዑል፡ እምኔከ፡ ደመና፡ Job 35,5. b quamdiu? 4 Esr. 6,47. c quoties? Ps. 77,45; Deut. 9,7; Matth. 23,37. d nota: ወእመ፡ ሚመጠነ፡ ኀሠሠ፡ ὅσα ἂν μοχθήσῃ τοῦ ζητῆσαι quantumvis quaesierit Koh. 8,17. mimaṭan, ሚመጠነ፡ mimaṭana G ሚመጠን፡ mimaṭan «à quelle proportion?, c’est-à-dire combien» ― ምን፡ ያህል፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 47v. 116 L ሚመጠን mi-maṭan, ሚመጠነ፡ mi-maṭana how much?, how much more?, how great?, how large?, how long?, how many?, how often?, how much!, how great! እመ፡ ሚመጠነ ʾemma mi-maṭana however much 373a

woorden.betekenis: quantus, quantusvis, quot, quotquot, centies tot quot sunt,
woorden.definitie: (Pl. a መጠን፡), in st. constr. positum 1 nonnumquam (sicut መጠነ፡) vicem pronominis relativi quantitatis explet (subjuncta integra enunciatione): quantus, quantusvis, quot, quotquot: Num. 32,2; በአምጣነ፡ ሀለዉ፡ ፻ ምክዕቢተ፡ centies tot quot sunt 2 Reg. 24,3; Hen. 61,13; በአምጣነ፡ tanto quanto (pretio) Lev. 25,28; አምጣነ፡ ዐርብ፡ እምሠርቅ፡ quantum occasus ab ortu sc. distat Enc. 2 usurpatur tamquam praepositio: secundum, pro a rarius አምጣነ፡ nudum (Acc. et st. constr.), ut አምጣነ፡ ኀልዮትየ፡ secundum meam opinionem F.M. 11,1. b crebrius praemissa praep. በ፡ (ad verbum: in modo vel proportione): Rom. 5,15; Rom. 5,16; Num. 7,7; Num. 7,8; በአምጣነ፡ ኀይልየ፡ pro viribus Sir. 29,20; 1 Par. 29,2; 1 Par. 29,16; 4 Esr. 2,51; 4 Esr. 9,16; ኢኮነ፡ ዝነገር፡ በአምጣንከ፡ μεγάλως ὑπερβαλλόντως λελάληκας Job 15,11; Jer. 31,30; በአምጣነ፡ ዕበዩ፡ Sir. 43,31; በአምጣነ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ሰማይ፡ Sir. 45,15; Sir. 50,23. c in enuntiationibus correlativis hoc በአምጣነ፡ passim quo magis – eo magis, vel qualis – talis vertere licet, potissimum ubi ከማሁ፡ subjunctum sequitur: በአምጣነ፡ ዕፁ፡ ለእሳት፡ የዐቢ፡ ነዱ፡ quo plura sunt ligna igni, eo major fit flamma Sir. 28,10; በአምጣነ፡ ዕበይከ፡ ከማሁ፡ አትሕት፡ ርእሰከ፡ ὅσῳ μέγας εἶ τοσούτῳ ταπεινοῦ σεαυτόν Sir. 3,18; በአምጣነ፡ ብዝኀ፡ ምሕረቱ፡ ከማሁ፡ ተግሣጹ፡ Sir. 16,12; Sir. 28,10; Sir. 28,11; quales tenebrae, talis lux Ps. 138,11. 3 usurpatur tamquam conjunctio; crebrius አምጣነ፡ nudum, rarius በአምጣነ፡; significat a quantum, quoad, quatenus: በአምጣነ፡ ትክል፡ Tob. 4,8; Sir. 3,13; Sir. 9,14; Sir. 14,11; ἐφ᾽ ὅσον Rom. 11,13; 4 Esr. 10,70. b quamdiu, donec አምጣነ፡ Matth. 9,15; Gal. 4,1; Rom. 7,1; Sir. 23,15; 4 Esr. 8,29; 4 Esr. 8,30; Job 24,13; በአምጣነ፡ Ps. 103,34; Ps. 145,1. c in enuntiationibus correlativis: prout, et አምጣነ፡–ከማሁ፡ vel በአምጣነ፡ – ከማሁ፡ ut – ita, quo magis – eo magis: Rom. 2,5; አምጣነ፡ አብዛኅከ፡ እከየ፡ ኣበዝኅ፡ ለከ፡ ረባሐ፡ (pollicetur Satanas) Clem. f. 221; arbores በአምጣነ፡ ይነፍሕ፡ ነፋስ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ከማሁ፡ ይፈደፍድ፡ ጽንዖሙ፡ ወይነውኁ፡ Chrys. Ta. 19; Ex. 1,12; 4 Esr. 14,16 var.; vel አምጣነ፡–ፈድፋደ፡ Marc. 7,36 Platt. ʾamṭana, አምጣን፡ ʾamṭan G አምጣን፡ ʾamṭan et አምጣነ፡ ʾamṭana «à proportion, comme, car, puisque» ― ስለ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 47v. L አምጣነ ʾamṭana, በአምጣነ ba-ʾamṭana as long as, as large es, as often es, as many as, as much as, in accordance with, according to, in proportion to, to the extent of, in regard to, like, since 373a

woorden.betekenis: dedit, porrigere, praebere, ministrare, nemo tibi porrigit m
woorden.definitie: I,2 [vicina sunt נָתַן et ܢܬܰܠ; نَطَا IV in dialecto Jemanica i.q. أَعْطَا dedit]; 1 porrigere, praebere, ministrare c. Acc. et ለ፡ vel c. dupl. Acc.: አልቦ፡ ዘይሜጥወኪ፡ እዴሁ፡ nemo tibi porrigit manum Jes. 51,18; መጥወኒ፡ እዴከ፡ (promissi confirmandi causa) 4 Reg. 10,15; Gal. 2,9; መጠውኩ፡ ዘባንየ፡ ለመቅሠፍት፡ Jes. 50,6; Apoc. 11,1; Sir. 32,11; alicui ministrare (aliquid) c. Acc. pers. Gen. 18,8; Gen. 40,11; 1 Reg. 14,13; διακονεῖν Luc. 12,37 rom., ὑπηρετεῖν Herm. p. 85; saepissime: praebere panem et calicem, ministrare corpus et sanguinem Christi: ጽዋዐ፡ ይመጡ፡ ዲያቆን፡ Lit. 167,1; Const. Ap. 52; መጠዎ፡ ቍርባነ፡ Clem. f. 179; መጠዎ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ ወደሞ፡ ለክርስቶስ፡ Clem. f. 180. 2 tradere, reddere, c. dupl. Acc. (alicui aliquid) Jer. 39,16; Tob. 9,5; Jes. 25,7; Asc. Jes. 1,5; 1 Thess. 2,8; in specie: in potestatem alicujus tradere vel reddere, c.c. Acc. et ለ፡ ut Ps. 139,9; እለ፡ ሎሙ፡ መጠውከነ፡ Jes. 25,5; ለነፍስ፡ እኪት፡ ኢትመጥወኒ፡ Sir. 23,6; Hez. 16,27; አነ፡ እሜጥወክሙ፡ ለኵናት፡ Jes. 65,12; Matth. 24,9; vel c. dupl. Acc.: ኢትመጥዋ፡ ለብእሲት፡ ነፍሰከ፡ Sir. 9,2; Kuf. 39; vel c. Acc. et ውስተ፡ ut: መጠዎሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ጽልመት፡ Job 24,14; ከመ፡ ይመጥዎሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ኵናት፡ Jes. 34,2; ከመ፡ ይመጥውዋ፡ ውስተ፡ እደ፡ ዘይረግዝ፡ Hez. 21,11; Hez. 30,12; Job 1,12; Job 16,11; Kuf. 1, vel c. simpl. Acc.: መጠዎ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ በእንተ፡ ኀጣውኢነ፡ Jes. 53,6; Rom. 8,32; Ps. 43,14. In specie: tradere animam i.e. aut reddere (Deo) vel exspirare Marc. 15,37; Sx. Ter 11Enc.; aut profundere: ዘይሜጡ፡ ነፍሶ፡ በእንቲአከ፡ Sir. 7,20; መጠወ፡ ነፍሶ፡ ህየንቴከ፡ Sir. 29,15; 1 Reg. 28,21; 4 Reg. 9,15; 1 Joh. 3,16; item: መጠወ፡ ርእሶ፡ በእንቲአነ፡ Tit. 2,14. maṭṭawa G መጠወ፡ maṭṭawa I,2 ይሜጡ፡, ይመጡ፡ «consigner, donner» ― ሰጠ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 47v. 116 L መጠወ maṭṭawa hand over, deliver, give over, grant, surrender, consign, present, transmit 374a

woorden.betekenis: tradi, reddi, accipere, capere, sumere, comprehendere, susci
woorden.definitie: III,2 1 passiva significatione in rem datam relata: tradi, reddi Hen. 95,7; fortasse etiam Hen. 60,8. 2 pass. significatione ad personam, cui datur, relata a accipere, ut: donum Job 8,20; እመ፡ ተመጦኩ፡ ሕልያነ፡ በእዴየ፡ Job 31,7; 1 Reg. 25,27; Gen. 33,10; ኢይትሜጠዎ፡ እምእዴክሙ፡ Mal. 1,13; quidquid porrigitur vel praebetur Apoc. 5,7; ተመጠወ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ በኀበ፡ ሐዋርያት፡ Jes. 37,14; እምኀቤሁ፡ ተመጠወ፡ ስምናስ፡ 1 Esr. 2,11; 4 Esr. 9,34; Hen. 61,1; Hen. 68,5; ministratum corpus et sanguinem Domini accipere (ei communicare): ኢይትመጠዉ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ ወደሞ፡ Clem. f. 248; Lit. 167,1; Const. Ap. 52; ዘይትሜጦ፡ ቍርባነ፡ ምዕረ፡ በበዓመት፡ Chrys. Ta. 17. b capere, sumere, comprehendere: ተመጠውኩ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ Jer. 39,11; Jer. 43,32; እትሜጠዋ፡ በእዴየ፡ Jes. 10,14; ይፈቅድ፡ የኀጣ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ይትመጠዋ፡ በእደዊሃ፡ Jes. 28,4; እምዐቢይ፡ ኀይል፡ እትሜጦ፡ ልብስየ፡ Job 30,18; traditum capere aliquem: Luc. 22,22; Hen. 54,5; Hen. 62,11; sic etiam ὑπολαμβάνειν vertit Aethiops Ps. 16,12. c suscipere, sublevare ἀντιλαμβάνεσθαι: ዘተመጠውኩ፡ Jes. 41,9; Hen. 48,10. d adsciscere, repetere: እትሜጠዋ፡ ለትምህርትየ፡ እምርሑቅ፡ Job 36,3. e excipere benigne aliquem, accipere vel admittere sententiam (hoc sensu frequentius occurrit ተወከፈ፡): ለእመ፡ ይትሜጠወከ፡ προσδέχεσθαι Mal. 1,8; p. 505 n. 52. – Voc. Ae.: ተወክፈ፡ ተወፈየ፡ ተመጠወ፡ ብ፡ ተቀበለ። tamaṭṭawa G ተመጠወ፡ tamaṭṭawa III,2 ይትሜጠው፡, ይትመጠው፡ «recevoir» ― ተቀጠለ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 47v. 116 L ተመጠወ tamaṭṭawa passive {of vid. መጠወ maṭṭawa}; also receive, accept, partake of, take, take hold of 374a

woorden.betekenis: { vid. sub ጸለለ፡}
woorden.definitie: { vid. sub ጸለለ፡}

woorden.betekenis: manducavit, emulsit, sugendi, suxit, mandit, mandere, manduc
woorden.definitie: (et መፀረ፡) I,1 et I,2 [arab. مَضَعَ manducavit (at مَصَرَ emulsit lac); vicinae sunt radd. מָצַץ, מָצָה al., quae notionem sugendi habent; cfr. مَصَدَ suxit, mandit] mandere, manducare, masticare; abs. ut: ኢትልሳሕ፡ እንዘ፡ ትመጽር፡ Sir. 34,16; et c. Acc.: እለ፡ ሥርወ፡ ዕፅ፡ ይመጽሩ፡ (v. ይሜጽሩ፡) እምዐቢይ፡ ረኃብ፡ Job 30,4; እስከ፡ ይመጽሩ፡ (ይሜጽሩ፡ Platt) ልሳናቲሆሙ፡ ሰብእ፡ Apoc. 16,10. – Voc. Ae.: ይመጽሩ፡ (v. ይሜጽሩ፡) ዘ፡ ይድኅኩ፡ maṣṣara G መጸረ፡ maṣṣara I,2 ይሜጽር፡, ይመጽር፡ «gratter, égratigner» ― ፎከተ፡, አከከ፡, ሟጨረ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 48r. 117 L መጸረ፡ maṣṣara, መፀረ፡ maḍḍara masticate, chew, (117) scratch; (Note that Amh. allammäṭä [translation of maṣṣara] means chew and not smileas given in 230) 370b

woorden.betekenis: venire, super, contra, venturus, futurus, venire cum re, pro
woorden.definitie: I,1 [i.q. מָצָא, ܡܛܳܐ, vid. Ges. thes. p. 813; amh. መጣ፡] Subj. ይምጻእ፡ 1 venire (ἥκειν, ἔρχεσθαι, παραγίνεσθαι): Gen. 27,35; Matth. 2,8; Matth. 3,13; Matth. 3,14; Matth. 8,11; Luc. 13,35; Luc. 14,20; Luc. 19,16; Joh. 5,43; Joh. 10,8; Joh. 8,42; al. sexcenties; c.c. እምነ፡ loci, unde quis venit: Gen. 16,8; Gen. 34,7; Matth. 8,11; Luc. 13,29; Luc. 22,52; Joh. 4,47; c. ውስተ፡ loci, ad vel in quem venit: ኀበ፡ pers.: Joh. 3,23; Joh. 6,37; Rom. 1,13; Gen. 34,6; Num. 22,16; 2 Esr. 9,1; Jes. 38,1; Jes. 39,3; Matth. 21,5; c. ላዕለ፡ super (supervenire alicui) Jes. 47,9; Jes. 47,11; Sir. 41,1; Apoc. 3,3; Ex. 30,12; contra Kuf. 37; c. Acc. loci Gen. 24,5; Jer. 47,4; Dan. 1,1; c. Acc. pers. (supervenire alicui, invadere aliquem, venire alicui): Job 3,5; Job 3,6; Jes. 47,11; Jer. 5,12; 1 Reg. 3,17; መጽአኒ፡ መንፈስ፡ ἦλθέ μοι Sap. 7,7. – Neque de personis tantum sed etiam de rebus inanimatis usurpatur: እምከመ፡ መጽአ፡ ነፋስ፡ Sir. 22,18; መጽኡ፡ ወሓይዝት፡ Matth. 7,27; ሕልም፡ Koh. 5,2; Hen. 13,8; ምንዳቤ፡ Jes. 10,3; መቅሠፍት፡ Hen. 60,25; መጥባሕት፡ Jer. 5,12; ጽራኅ፡ Gen. 18,21 al. a in specie dicitur de tempore: 2 Petr. 3,10; ይመጽእ፡ መዋዕል፡ Jer. 7,32; Jer. 16,14; Am. 8,11; ዘይመጽእ፡ venturus i.e. futurus Koh. 11,8; Sir. 42,19 (opp. ዘኀለፈ፡); ዘይመጽእ፡ ወዘይከውን፡ Jes. 41,23; Jes. 44,7; Jes. 45,11; Judith 9,5; 4 Esr. 5,16; 4 Esr. 7,12; 4 Esr. 8,22; Rom. 8,38; 1 Tim. 4,8; Hebr. 2,5; Eph. 1,21. b መጽአ፡ seq. በ፡ venire cum re (ea praeditum vel eam apportantem): 1 Joh. 4,2; 1 Joh. 5,6; 3 Reg. 13,1; Ps. 70,17. c c. በልብ፡ in mentem venire: ኢይመጽኦሙ፡ በልቦሙ፡ Jes. 65,17, vel sine በልብ፡ ut: ይመጽአነ፡ ካልእ፡ ኅሊና፡ Chrys. Ta. 3; cfr. Herm. p. 27a. 2 nonnumquam provenire, nasci, oriri: መጽአ፡ ረኃብ፡ ἐγένετο Ruth 1,1; 1 Reg. 19,8; ትውልድ፡ ይመጽእ፡ Koh. 1,4; Koh. 1,4; Koh. 5,14 (v. ወፅአ፡); Joh. 1,9; Hen. 3; አእምሩ፡ ከመ፡ ፍርሀተ፡ ገጽ፡ ይመጽእ፡ እምነሢአ፡ አምኃ፡ F.N. 43,3. 3 ad exitum venire, evenire, impleri, de propositis, desideriis, vaticiniis: ትምጻእ፡ ምክረ፡ ቅዱሰ፡ እስራኤል፡ Jes. 5,19; Jes. 42,9; Job 6,8; Kuf. 1(alias: በጽሐ፡, ኮነ፡). maṣʾa G መጽአ፡ maṣʾa I,1 ይመጽእ፡, ይምጻእ፡ «venir» ― መጣ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 48r. 118 L መጽአ maṣʾa (yǝmṣāʾ) come, happen to, occur to, come upon, arise; (with the acc) overtake ዘይመጽእ zayǝmaṣṣǝʾ future 369b

woorden.betekenis: venire facere, jubere, afferre, adducere, secum ferre, defer
woorden.definitie: II,1 venire facere vel jubere i.e. a afferre, adducere, secum ferre c. Acc. pers. et rei: Ruth 3,15; Kuf. 3; Gen. 2,19; Gen. 24,33; Gen. 27,25; Gen. 37,2; Gen. 43,2; Lev. 4,5; 2 Reg. 17,28; Luc. 12,51; Luc. 14,21; Matth. 21,2; Hen. 90,21; Hen. 90,26; ኢያምጻእኩ፡ ምስሌየ፡ 1 Reg. 21,8; Judith 12,3; 1 Tim. 6,17; አምጽአት፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ 1 Reg. 28,25; ኣመጽእ፡ እኪተ፡ እመደቡብ፡ Jer. 4,6; ውስተ፡ ትፍሥሕት፡ ኢታምጽእ፡ ሐዘነ፡ Sir. 18,15; deferre marito dotem: ትሎት፡ ዘአምጽአት፡ ኀቤሁ፡ F.N. 24,7. b offerre munera, sacrificia Gen. 4,3; Gen. 4,4; Lev. 2,11; Lev. 22,18; Am. 5,25; Ps. 71,10; Hen. 53,1. c adducere super aliquem aliquid, c. Acc. rei et ላዕለ፡ vel ዲበ፡ pers., ut: ኀጢአተ፡ Gen. 26,10; Ex. 32,21; መርገመ፡ Kuf. 26; ማየ፡ አይኅ፡ Gen. 6,17; Kuf. 4; እኩየ፡ Jer. 39,42; Jer. 51,2; እዴየ፡ Zach. 2,9; መዋዕለ፡ Jes. 7,17; Jes. 27,1; መቅሠፍተ፡ Sir. 47,20; c. ለ pers. Rom. 13,2. d evenire jubere, eventum dare: አነ፡ ኣመጽእ፡ ነገርየ፡ ለዛ፡ ሀገር፡ Jer. 46,16; ነበብኩ፡ ወአምጻእኩ፡ Jes. 46,11; Hen. 74,11. e nasci vel oriri facere vel jubere, i.e. excitare, procreare: ἐξεγείρειν 2 Reg. 12,11; አምጽአ፡ ነፋሰ፡ Jon. 1,4; ታመጽእ፡ ጽልመተ፡ Ps. 103,21; አዝልፎ፡ ስካር፡ ያመጽእ፡ ኮብሰ፡ ወሞተ፡ ግብት፡ ወፈጸንተ፡ F.N. 50. f afferre, proponere, in medium proferre sermonem, argumentum, exemplum: Matth. 13,24; Matth. 13,31; አምጽአ፡ ጥያቄ፡ Chrys., creberrime; አኀዘ፡ ጳውሎስ፡ ያምጽእ፡ ትእምርተ፡ እምሥርዐተ፡ ደብተራ፡ Chrys. ho. 15. ʾamṣǝʾa G አምጽአ፡ ʾamṣǝʾa II,1 ያመጽእ፡, ያምጽእ፡ «faire venir, apporter» ― አመጣ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 48r. 118 L አምጽአ ʾamṣǝʾa bring, offer, cause to happen, bring about, raise up, convey (a thing to a place), put forth 369b

woorden.betekenis: ventio, adventus, mǝṣʾat, venue, arrivée, Avent, coming, arr
woorden.definitie: n. act. ventio, adventus: በምጽአተ፡ ዚአየ፡ ካዕበ፡ ኀቤክሙ፡ Phil. 1,26; ምጽአትከ፡ ኀቤነ፡ Jsp. p. 284; አሐቲ፡ ይእቲ፡ ምጽአቱ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ውስተ፡ ዓለም፡ Sap. 7,5; ዕለተ፡ ምጽአቱ፡ Mal. 3,2; ሠናይ፡ ምጽአትከ፡ (exoptatus ades!) ብእሴ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Gad. T.H.; de adventu Christi priore et de futuro (parusia): Rel. Bar., Asc. Jes. 3,13; Asc. Jes. 4,13; Matth. 24,3; Matth. 24,27; Jac. 5,8; 1 Tim. 6,14; 1 Thess. 2,19; 1 Thess. 3,13. mǝṣʾat G ምጽአት፡ mǝṣʾat «venue, arrivée, Avent» ― መምጣት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 48r. 118 L ምጽአት፡ mǝṣʾat coming, arrival, advent 370a

woorden.betekenis: echo
woorden.definitie: echo vid. sub ጸአመ፡

woorden.betekenis: praecepta, mandata legis, opera bona, eleemosynas, eleemosyn
woorden.definitie: subst. [si quid video, nomen a Judaeis petitum, sc. מִצְוָתָא (Pl. a sing. מִצְוָה), quod proprie praecepta, mandata legis, deinde opera bona, eleemosynas et singulariter eleemosynam significat. Ergo radix est צוה, sed cum nomen peregrinum sit, sub litera መ፡ recensendum est. Ludolfo hoc nomne a phrasi Judaeorum בְּמָטוּ מִנָּךְ quaeso, obsecro petitum visum est] plerumque fem.; usurpatur singulariter et collective; Pl. ምጽዋታት፡ rarissime occurrit (ut Sx. Hed. 12). 1 opus justitiae, opus bonum, eleemosyna: ግበሩ፡ ምጽዋተ፡ ላዕለ፡ ነፍስክሙ፡ በደፊኖቱ፡ Kuf. 7; እንበይነ፡ ምጽዋት፡ χάριν ἐντολῆς Sir. 29,9; ይግበሩ፡ ምጽዋተ፡ ወፍትሐ፡ δικαιοσύνην καὶ κρίσιν Gen. 18,19 quamquam in hoc loco δικαιοσύνην secundum rabbinicum loquendi usum etiam eleemosynam interpretari licet (vid. sub ጽድቃት፡) sicut Matth. 6,1; plerumque ἐλεημοσύνη vel ἐλεημοσύναι Matth. 6,2; ምጽዋት፡ ታኀድግ፡ ኀጢአተ፡ Sir. 3,30; Tob. 4,10; ኢታስትት፡ ገቢረ፡ ምጽዋት፡ Sir. 7,10; Sir. 12,3; Sir. 16,14; Sir. 29,12; ምጽዋተ፡ ብዙኀ፡ ገበርኩ፡ ለአኀውየ፡ Tob. 1,3; Tob. 1,16; Tob. 4,8; ውሂበ፡ ምጽዋት፡ Sir. 37,11; Tob. 12,8; ስኢለ፡ ምጽዋት፡ Sir. 31,25; Act. 3,2; Act. 3,3; ኵሉ፡ ምጽዋት፡ ሣህለ፡ ያመጽእ፡ Sir. 16,14; Sir. 29,12; Prov. 3,3; Deut. 24,13; Jes. 1,27; Dan. 4,24; subjuncto Genitivo objectivo: ምጽዋቱ፡ ለአቡከ፡ Sir. 3,14; Sir. 17,22; ἀποστολαί: ፈንዊ፡ ምጽዋተ፡ ለእለ፡ አልቦሙ፡ 1 Esr. 9,51; 1 Esr. 9,54; ሙዳየ፡ ምጽዋት፡ area eleemosynae vel stipis sacrae 2 Esr. 10,6; Joh. 8,20; ሙዳየ፡ ምጽዋት፡ ይኩን፡ በገቦ፡ ቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ Kid. f. 6 (vid. ሙዳይ፡); de ምጽዋት፡ agitur F.N. 16. 2 beneficentia, misericordia, pietas, bonitas ἔλεος Sir. 29,1; Ps. 83,12; Hos. 6,6; Mich. 6,8; በምጽዋት፡ μετ᾽ ἐλέους Jes. 16,5; ምሕረቶሙ፡ ለረሲዓን፡ ኢምጽዋት፡ Prov. 12,10; ኢረከበተኒ፡ ምጽዋትከ፡ Luc. 15,29; χρηστότης Gal. 5,22; εὐσέβεια Tit. 1,1 rom. mǝṣwāt G ምጽዋት፡ mǝṣwāt «aumône» ― ምጽዋት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 48v. 118 L ምጽዋት mǝṣwāt almsgiving, alms, charity 371a C for ሙዳየ፡ ምጽዋት፡ vid. ሙዳይ፡

woorden.betekenis: micuit, splenduit, flos, floruit, maḍawa, maṣawa, pass the s
woorden.definitie: (vel መጸወ፡) rad. inus., sine dubio נוּץ נָצַץ ناض (مَصَعَ) micuit, splenduit, unde נֵץ flos, הֵנֵצ floruit. (Hoc etymon vocis መፀው፡ mihi quidem magis probatum videtur, quam si quis መ praefixum et radicem זָהָה ܙܗܳܐ زَهَا esse statuerit; זהָה enim Aethiopes habent sub ጸገየ፡). Hinc maḍawa, መጸወ maṣawa L መፀወ maḍawa, መጸወ maṣawa (, ) pass the season of maḍaw vid. መፀው 331a

woorden.betekenis: tempus florum, ver, pluvia verna, aliud, maḍaw, season of fl
woorden.definitie: subst., tempus florum, ver. In Aethiopia ver a fine Septembris mensis incipit, vid. Sx. Masc. 25Enc. (qui locus Lud. lex. col. 104 impressus est). In Bibliis ὑετὸς ὄψιμος (pluvia verna) ዝናመ፡ መፀው፡ versus est Jer. 5,24; Zach. 10,1; ያዘንም፡ ለክሙ፡ ጸዳየ፡ ወመፀወ፡ Joel 2,23. Auctumnus et ver ጸዳይ፡ ወመፀው፡ Clem. f. 171; ክረምት፡ መፀው፡ ማእረር፡ ሐጋይ፡ Kuf. 2. – Praeterea videas, quae sub ሐጋይ፡ disputavimus. – Voc. Ae.: መፀው፡ ዘ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ጽጌያት፡; aliud: ዘ፡ ዘመነ፡ በልግ፡; aliud: ዘመነ፡ ማእረር። maḍaw G መፀው፡ maḍaw «printemps abyssin, première partie de l’année abyssine; commence le 25 መስከረም፡ (4 Octobre) et va jusqu’au 25 ታኅሳስ፡ (1er Janvier)» ― ዘመነ፡ ጽጌ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 48v. 118 L መፀው maḍaw season of flowers, spring, season after the rains (September–December) 331a

woorden.betekenis: planus, facilis, lenis fuit, lenis fuit erga, leniter et ben
woorden.definitie: inus.; respondet سَهُلَ planus, facilis, lenis fuit, III lenis fuit erga aliquem, VI leniter et benigne egit. Hinc

woorden.betekenis: { III,1 i.q. III,3; ሶበ፡ ተሥህሎሙ፡ 4 Esr. 7,37 in Abb.
woorden.definitie: { III,1 i.q. III,3; ሶበ፡ ተሥህሎሙ፡ 4 Esr. 7,37 in Abb. LV.}

woorden.betekenis: clementem, propitium se praebere, ignoscere, veniam dare, co
woorden.definitie: III,3 (saepissime ተሠሃለ፡ scriptum) clementem vel propitium se praebere; ignoscere, veniam dare, condonare; abs., ut: ተሣሀል፡ ἵλεως γενοῦ Am. 7,2; ይክል፡ ተሣህሎ፡ δυνάστης ἐξιλασμῶν Sir. 16,11; οἰκτειρήσει Thren. 3,31; Job 5,18; c. Acc. pers.: Rom. 9,15; Rom. 11,30-32 (ἐλεεῖν); Rom. 5,10 (κατηλλάγημεν); Sir. 16,9; Sir. 36,17; Sir. 36,18; Ps. 50,1; Ps. 84,1 (εὐδοκεῖν); 4 Esr. 7,37; 4 Esr. 10,37; Jes. 12,1; Jes. 14,1; Jes. 27,11; Jes. 49,10; Jes. 49,13; Jes. 52,8; Jer. 5,1; Jer. 13,14 (ἐπιποθήσω); et c. እምነ፡ vel ዲበ፡ rei: ተሣሀላ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ እምነ፡ እኪት፡ 2 Reg. 24,16; እሣሀል፡ ዲበ፡ ኀጢአቶሙ፡ Jer. 43,3. taśāhala, taśahala, ተሠሃለ፡ taśahāla G ተሣሀለ፡ taśāhala III,3 ይሣሀል፡ «avoir pitié, être clément, pardnonner» ― ይቅር፡ አለ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 49r. 121 L śhl, ተሣሀለ፡ taśāhala, ተሠሀለ፡ taśahala, () ተሠሃለ፡ taśahāla be gracious, have mercy, show oneself merciful, be compassionate, show oneself propitious, be lenient, show compassion, forgive, pardon, have pity, be forgiving 528a

woorden.betekenis: clementia, lenitas, benignitas, causa veniae, śāhl, clémence
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., Pl. ሣህላት፡ Ss. Req. 1 clementia, lenitas, benignitas ἔλεος Sir. 16,11; Ps. 24,6; Ps. 24,11; Ps. 50,1; Ps. 84,11; Prov. 14,22; Jes. 63,15; 2 Tim. 1,2; ἐλεημοσύνη Jes. 28,17; οἰκτιρμοί Dan. 2,18; Thren. 3,22; Rom. 12,1; c. Gen. obj. ሣህልኪ፡ ኢየኀልቅ፡ ዘእምኀቤየ፡ Jes. 54,10; Dan. 9,18; Dan. 9,20; ኢይከውን፡ ሣህል፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ Hen. 1,8; Hen. 5,5; ፈድፋደ፡ ሣህልነ፡ እምኵሉ፡ ሰብእ፡ (ἐλεεινότεροι) 1 Cor. 15,19; አልቦ፡ ሣህል፡ ዘ፡ ἀνελεήμων ὁ Sir. 13,12; ረከብነ፡ ሣህሎ፡ καταλλαγὴν ἐλάβομεν Rom. 5,11; 2 Cor. 5,17. 2 causa veniae, ἀντάλλαγμα: ኮነ፡ ውእቱ፡ (ኖኅ፡) ሣህለ፡ ለዓለም፡ Sir. 44,17. śāhl G ሣህል፡ śāhl «clémence, pardon, indulgence» ― ይቅርታ፡, ቸርነት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 49r. 121 L ሣህል፡ śāhl grace, compassion, clemency, favor, mercy, pardon, kindness, gentleness 528a

woorden.betekenis: venia facilis, clemens, lenis, mastaśāhl, maḥāri wamastaśāhl
woorden.definitie: part. (IV,3) venia facilis, clemens, lenis (ἐλεήμων) Ex. 34,6; Joel 2,13; Jon. 4,2; Sir. 2,11; 4 Esr. 7,37; Ps. 85,4; Ps. 110,4; Ps. 111,4; Ps. 111,5 al.; epitheton Michaëlis archangeli Sx. Pag. 3. mastaśāhl መሓሪ፡ ወመስተሣህል፡ maḥāri wamastaśāhl ‘gnädig und barmherzig’ (‘»gnädig und barmherzig«: Übersetzung das arab. ar-raḥmān ar-rahīm, die islamische Eulogie für Gott.’ 2 n. 2), vid. መሓሪ፡ G ተሠሃሊ፡ taśahāli, Pl. ተሠሃልያን፡ taśahālǝyān et መስተሣህል፡ mastaśāhl, Pl. መስተሣህላን፡ mastaśāhǝlān «clément, indulgent» ― ይቅር፡ ባይ፡, ቸር፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 49r. 121 L መስተሣህል mastaśāhl compassionate, merciful, gracious, lenient, easy to be entreated, forbearing 528a C vid. also ተሠሃሊ፡

woorden.betekenis: tertiae, ter, tertio facere, postquam ter jejunavit, tertias
woorden.definitie: I,2 (denom. a ሠላስ፡) 1 tertiae, ter vel tertio facere aliquid: ይቤሎሙ፡ ሠልሱ፡ ወሠለሱ፡ 3 Reg. 18,34; { 4 Reg. 1,13 var.;} ሠሊሶ፡ ጾመ፡ postquam ter jejunavit Kid. f. 7; ሶበ፡ ሠለሰ፡ ብሂሎታ፡ ዘንተ፡ Athan. de Trin.; ንሤልስ፡ ለከ፡ ዘንተ፡ ስብሐተ፡ tertias has tibi laudes dicimus, Prec. Mat.; Kid. f. 11et Kid. f. 12; p. 501. 2 triplicare: አመክዕባ፡ ለኲናት፡ ወሠልሳ፡ ለኲናት፡ Hez. 21,14 var.; trinum dicere vel credere Deum: ለዋሕድ፡ አምላክ፡ እንዘ፡ ይሤልሶ፡ Sx. Genb. 27Enc. 3 tertium locum tenere vel tertium esse 1 Reg. 20,20 (quamquam hoc comma corruptum et obscurum est). 4 in tres partes dividere Ex. 14,7. śallasa G ሠለሰ፡ śallasa I,2 ይሤልስ፡, ይሠልስ፡ «tripler, faire trois» ― ሶስት፡ አደረገ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 49r. 121 L ሠለሰ śallasa triple, treble, do for the third time, act thrice (denominative) 529b

woorden.betekenis: tres, śalās, trois, three
woorden.definitie: nom. num., femininis junctum [שָׁלֹשׁ ثَلَاثٌ ܬܠܳܬ] tres; ejus character ፫፡; Gen. 29,2; Gen. 40,12; Gen. 40,13; Deut. 19,2; Deut. 19,7; Deut. 19,9; Jos. 21,6; Jos. 21,19; Prov. 24,50; Am. 1,3 seq.; Job 1,4; 4 Esr. 2,4; Matth. 20,3. Perraro masculinis junctum legitur, ut: ሠላስ፡ አርዳኢሁ፡ Sx. Teq. 21Enc. Nominis ordinalis vice: አመ፡ ሠላስ፡ ዓመት፡ እምዘወድቀት፡ ሀገሪቱ፡ Org. śalās G ሠላስ፡ śalās fem. «trois» ― ሶስት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 49r. 122 L ሠላስ śalās three (with fem. noun) 529b

woorden.betekenis: u, tres, haec tria, in his tribus, ter, tres illi, śalastu,
woorden.definitie: (i.e. ሠለስት፡ c. suff. u, vid. gramm. § 158) nom. num., masculinis, rarius femininis junctum, Acc. ሠለስተ፡, tres: Gen. 40,12; Hez. 14,14; Zach. 11,8; ሠለስቱ፡ አቅርንት፡ Dan. 7,8; እንተ፡ ሠለስቱ፡ ክረምታ፡ τριέτης Jes. 15,5; ሠለስተ፡ ዓመተ፡ Judith 8,4; Matth. 13,33; 1 Joh. 5,8; ዘ፡ ሠለስተ፡ haec tria Ex. 21,11; በእላ፡ ሠለስቱ፡ in his tribus (rebus) Sir. 25,1; በእሉ፡ ሠለስቱ፡ Sir. 26,28; ሠለስተ፡ ጊዜ፡ ter Did. 29. – Cum pron. suffixis ሠለስቲሆሙ፡ tres illi Kuf. 34; ሠለስቲሆን፡ αἱ τρεῖς αὗται Prov. 24,50; ሠለስቲሆሙ፡ ዕደው፡ οἱ τρεῖς ἄνδρες Job 32,5; ሠለስቲሆሙ፡ (v. ሠለስቲሁ፡) ከንቶ፡ መነነት፡ ነፍስየ፡ Sir. 25,2. – Exemplum formae absol. ሠለስት፡ exstat in 99 śalastu G ሠለስቱ፡ śalastu «trois (le plus usité)» ― ሶስት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 49r. 122 L ሠለስቱ śalastu three (with masc. noun); used with suffix pronouns e.g. ሠለስቲሆሙ śalastihomu the three of them 529b

woorden.betekenis: tertius, tertia, tertium, tertio, jam tertiâ vice, tertia vi
woorden.definitie: adj. num. (ordinale), fem. ሣልስት፡ tertius Gen. 1,13; Ex. 19,1; Ex. 19,11; Ex. 19,16; Luc. 20,12; Apoc. 6,5; Asc. Jes. 7,24; a c. pron. suff. ሣልሱ፡ tertius 1 Reg. 17,13; Marc. 12,21; ሣልስታ፡ tertia (earum) Job 42,14; ሣልሶሙ፡ tertium (eorum) Sir. 23,16; Sir. 50,25; ይከውኖሙ፡ እስራኤል፡ ሣልሶሙ፡ ለግብጽ፡ ወለፋርስ፡ Jes. 19,24; ናሁ፡ ሣልሶሙ፡ ዮም፡ እንዘ፡ ይጸንሑኒ፡ Marc. 8,2. Etiam ubi plures actiones ejusdem personae enumerantur, ሣልስ፡ c. pron. suff. ad personam relato usurpatur, ut: ሣልስታ፡ ሰረቀት፡ በዝሙታ፡ τὸ τρίτον tertio, Sir. 23,23. b nota locutionem: ሣልስከ፡ ዝንቱ፡ tertium tuum hoc est i.e. jam tertiâ vice (facis id) Num. 22,28; Num. 22,32; Joh. 21,14, et sine pron. suff. ሣልስ፡ ዝንቱ፡ Jud. 16,15. c በሣልስ፡ tertium, tertia vice 1 Reg. 3,8; Matth. 26,44; Marc. 14,41; Luc. 23,22 (sed. Num. 2,24 tertio loco). d fem. ሣልስት፡ nonnumquam est α tertia pars τὸ τρίτον 2 Par. 23,4; 2 Par. 23,5 (v. ሣልስተ፡ እድ፡) β tertia dies (subintellecto ዕለት፡) Asc. Jes. 9,16; በሣልስታ፡ Luc. 2,46; ሣልስተ፡ tertia i.e. perendie Luc. 13,32; et nudius tertius: ትማልመኒ፡ ወሣልስተኒ፡ 1 Par. 11,2; Ex. 21,29. γ tertia vicis: ሣልስተ፡ tertium Num. 10,6. śālǝs, fem. śālǝst G ሣልስ፡ śālǝs «troisième m.» ― ሶስተኛ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 49r. ሣልስት፡ śālǝst «troisième fem. » ― ሶስተናይት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 49r. 122 L ሣልስ śālǝs m., ሣልስት śālǝst fem. third ሣልስተ śālǝsta on the third day, in the third place ሣልስተ፡ እድ śālǝsta ʾǝd a third, vid. እድ፡ 529b

woorden.betekenis: tres, tertius, feria tertia, śalusa, the day after tomorrow,
woorden.definitie: nom. temporale, 1 tres (dies) et tertius (dies): ሠሉሰ፡ ዕለተ፡ Ex. 10,22; Ex. 10,23; 1 Reg. 30,12; Jon. 2,1; Matth. 12,40; ሠሉሰ፡ መዋዕለ፡ Judith 12,7; 4 Esr. 13,64; 2 Esr. 8,15; ምሕዋረ፡ ሠሉስ፡ ዕለት፡ Judith 2,21; እስከ፡ ሠሉስ፡ መዋዕል፡ Esth. 4,16; በሠሉስ፡ ዕለት፡ Joh. 2,19; Marc. 14,58 (omisso ዕለት፡ in ed. rom.); አመ፡ ሠሉሱ፡ ለሠርቀ፡ ወርኅ፡ 2 Esr. 6,15; pron. suff. admittit: ደወይኩ፡ ሠሉስየ፡ ዮም፡ 1 Reg. 30,13; 1 Reg. 21,5. 2 feria tertia hebdomadis, ut: በሠሉስ፡ ዕለት፡ Did. 29; ሠሉስ፡ ዘፋሲካ፡ Cod. Mus. Brit. XXIX, 44 vel ሠሉስ፡ ፋሲካ፡ Mavâs. 44. śalusa the day after tomorrow ውእቱሰ፡ አስተጐናደየ፡ ነገረ፡ እንዘ፡ ይብል፤ ጌሰመ፡ ወሠሉሰ፡ ይኩን። ‘Il essaya de différer la chose en disant: “On fera cela demain, après-demain!”’ 47 l. 34–35 (ed.), 55 l. 36–37 (tr.) G śalus ሠሉስ፡ śalus «trois (mascl.), mardi» ― ሶስት፡, ማክሰኞ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 49r. 121 L ሠሉስ śalus after tomorrow, three (days), the third day of the week or month, Tuesday ሠሉሰ śalusa (Lt) after tomorrow 529b

woorden.betekenis: triginta, tricesimus, śalāsā, trente, thirty, ba-śalāsā, thi
woorden.definitie: nom. num. triginta (tricesimus); ejus character est ፴፡; Gen. 41,46; Gen. 47,9; 4 Esr. 9,42; 4 Esr. 9,43; Jer. 45,10; Judith 15,11; አመ፡ ሠላሳ፡ ክረምት፡ Hez. 1,1. śalāsā G ሠላሳ፡ śalāsā «trente» ― ሠላሳ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 49r. 529b L ሠላሳ śalāsā thirty በሠላሳ ba-śalāsā thirtyfold 529b

woorden.betekenis: triplum, triplex ordo, numerus, ternarius, trinitas, tǝślǝst
woorden.definitie: subst. 1 triplum, triplex ordo: ትሥልስት፡ ገጾሙ፡ ὄψις τρισσή Hez. 23,15; ኵሎሙ፡ በትሥልስት፡ πάντες τρισσοί Hez. 23,23; ትሥልስተ፡ τρισσῶς Prov. 22,20; ዘሞኪ፡ ትሥልስተ፡ (v. ትሥልስተኪ፡) Hez. 16,30. 2 numerus ternarius, in specie trinitas (de Deo) Org. 2; ሀሎ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ በመንግሥቱ፤ እግዚአብሔር፡ በትሥልስተ። እግዚአብሔር፡ በመለኮቱ፡ Lit. Diosc.; እመቦ፡ ዘይፈልጦ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ እምትሥልስቱ፡ ውጉዝ፡ ውእቱ፡ Fid. Jac. Bar.; ትሥልስተ፡ መለኮት፡ M.M. f. 8. tǝślǝst G ትሥልስት፡ tǝślǝst «le nombre trois, tiers abyssin» ― ሲሶ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 49v. L ትሥልስት tǝślǝst Trinity, threefold, three times as many ትሥልስት፡ እድ tǝślǝst ʾǝd third part, vid. እድ፡ ትሥልስታት፡ tǝślǝstāt triad 530a

woorden.betekenis: dominatus est, durus, validus, vehemens fuit, dominum praefe
woorden.definitie: I,2 etiam per ሰ, [i.q. שָׁלִט ܫܠܰܛ dominatus est, سَلَطَ سَلُطَ durus, validus, vehemens fuit II dominum praefecit; vid. ሰለጠ፡] vim exercere, potestatem habere (ἐξουσιάζειν), c.c. ላዕለ፡ Matth. 20,25 Platt; c. በላዕለ፡ 1 Cor. 6,12 Platt; c. ዲበ፡ Hen. 103,11. śallaṭa G ሠለጠ፡ śallaṭa I,2 ይሤልጥ፡, ይሠልጥ፡ «être au pouvoir, avoir puissance, achever, accomplir» ― ገዛ፡, ተበየነ፡, ጨረሰ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 49v. 122 L ሠለጠ śallaṭa, () ሠለጠ፡ śalaṭa gain dominion, have power, have authority, exercise authority, become master, reign, rule 530a

woorden.betekenis: potentem, pollentem fieri, potestatem nancisci, habere, domi
woorden.definitie: III,1 et ተሠለጠ፡ III,2 potentem vel pollentem fieri, potestatem nancisci et habere, dominari: ዘይሤለጥ፡ ἐξουσιάζων Koh. 10,4; Koh. 10,5; እለ፡ ይሠለጡ፡ Kuf. p. 50; c.c. በ፡ Koh. 2,19; ተሠለጥከ፡ በሥጋከ፡ Sir. 47,19; ዘይሤለጥ፡ በመንፈሱ፡ ὁ κρατῶν πνεύματος Prov. 16,32; c. ዲበ፡ Hen. 103,12; c. ላዕለ፡ Matth. 20,25 rom.; አግብርት፡ ተሠልጡ፡ ላዕሌነ፡ ἐκυρίευσαν ἡμῶν Thren. 5,8; Dan. 11,43; 2 Esr. 15,15; ሶበ፡ ርእዩ፡ ከመ፡ ዛቲ፡ ኀጢአት፡ ተሠልጠት፡ ላዕለ፡ ብዙኃን፡ ሰብእ፡ F.M. 13; c. ለ፡ et Infin., Koh. 8,8; Koh. 8,9. taśalṭa, taśallaṭa G ተሠለጠ፡ taśallaṭa III,2 ይሤለጥ፡, ይሠለጥ፡ «être autorisé, être accompli» ― ተበየነ፡, ተጨረሰ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 49v. 122 L ተሠልጠ taśalṭa, ተሠለጠ taśallaṭa make oneself master, acquire power, exercise authority, have authority, gain mastery (over), rule (over), dominate, become powerful, prevail 530a

woorden.betekenis: facultate, potestate, auctoritate praeditus, episcopi, śǝllu
woorden.definitie: part. facultate, potestate, auctoritate praeditus: ንጉሥ፡ ሥሉጥ፡ Koh. 8,4; 1 Petr. 3,22 rom. ἐξουσίαι; c.c. በ፡, ut: ሥሉጥ፡ ውእቱ፡ በዘፈቀደ፡ Judith 8,15; (Job 7,15); c. ላዕለ፡ Apoc. 11,6; Apoc. 14,18; አንትሙ፡ (episcopi) ሥሉጣን፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ አሕዛብ፡ Did. 7; c. ከመ፡ et Subj. Apoc. 11,6; Can. Ant. 21; seq. Subj. sine ከመ፡ Matth. 9,6 rom.; ርእዩ፡ ከመ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሥሉጥ፡ ይሕየውሂ፡ ወይእመንሂ፡ Kid. f. 40. śǝlluṭ, Pl. ሥሉጣን፡ śǝlluṭān G ሥሉጥ፡ śǝlluṭ, Pl. ሥሉጣን፡ śǝlluṭān «autorisé, achevé, accompli» ― የሠለጠነ፡, የተፈጸመ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 49v. 123 L ሥሉጥ śǝlluṭ who has power, who has dominion, powerful 530r.

woorden.betekenis: potestas, facultas, auctoritas, potentia, qui in officiis, a
woorden.definitie: subst., Pl. ሥልጣናት፡ 1 potestas, facultas, auctoritas, potentia, ἐξουσία Matth. 7,29; Matth. 9,8; Judae 25; Apoc. 9,19; Apoc. 13,12; ኢይክል፡ ገቢረ፡ ሥልጣነ፡ ፈቃድየ፡ Kuf. 10; ይእኅዝ፡ ሥልጣነ፡ κρατήσει εὐχερῶς Prov. 12,24; c.c. ለ፡, ut: ለሕይወት፡ ወለሞት፡ ሥልጣን፡ ብከ፡ Sap. 16,13; c. ላዕለ፡ Apoc. 20,6; c. ዲበ፡ Matth. 10,1; seq. Subj. verbi Apoc. 9,3; Joh. 1,12; c.c. ከመ፡ seq. Subj. Hen. 25,4; c. Infin., ut: ሥልጣን፡ ብነ፡ (ከመ፡ ለ)ገቢረ፡ ኵሉ፡ ርኵስ፡ Jer. 7,10. Magistratus nominatur እለ፡ በሥልጣናት፡ qui in officiis (sc. constituti sunt) Lit. 168,2; Kid. f. 18. 2 potestas (ሥልጣናት፡) nonnumquam vocantur ii, qui potestatibus praesunt, ut: ሥልጣናተ፡ ሰማይ፡ Hen. 82,8; in specie angeli cujusdam ordinis 1 Petr. 3,22 Platt; Asc. Jes. 1,3; Clem. f. 61; Org. 3. śǝlṭān, Pl. ሥልጣናት፡ śǝlṭānāt person in power ? ሥልጣንሂ፡ ፍጎ፡ ገብረ፡ መድኅን፡ ካህሱ፡ ክንፉ፡ ወለተ፡ ጊዮርጊስ፡ ወለተ፡ ጐብለል፡ ‘Le selṭān était Fego Gabra Madḫen, Kāhsu, Kenfu, Walatta Giyorgis fille de Guablal’ 51 l. 26–27 (ed.), 62 l. 11–12 (tr.); ናሁ፡ ጸሐፍነ፡ ካህናተ፡ ጽዮን፡ ታሪከ፡ ሥልጣኑ፡ ወኃይሉ፡ ለመስፍነ፡ መሳፍንት፡ ደጅ፡ አዝማች፡ ወልደ፡ ሥላሴ፡ ዘሥሉጥ፡ ዲበ፡ ሥልጣናት፡ ወእግዚእ፡ ዲበ፡ አጋእዝት፡ ‘voici que nous, les prêtres de Ṣyon, nous allons écrire l’histoire de le puissance et de la force du prince des princes, le daǧ azmāč Walda Sellāsē, puissant sur les puissances, maître sur les maîtres’ 80 l. 12–15 (ed.), 96 l. 24–26 (tr.) G ሥልጣን፡ śǝlṭān, Pl. ሥልጣናት፡ śǝlṭānāt «pouvoir, autorité, un des ordres angéliques: potestates, Sultan» ― Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 49v. 123 L ሥልጣን śǝlṭān dominion, authority, jurisdiction, power 530a

woorden.betekenis: ridere, ridere alicui, arridere, ridere aliquem, aliquid, de
woorden.definitie: et ሥሕቀ፡ I,1, etiam per ሰ [i.q. צָחַק et שָׂחַק, ضَحِكَ, amh. ሳቀ፡] Subj. ይሥሐቅ፡ ridere Gen. 9,22; Gen. 17,17; Gen. 18,12; Gen. 18,15; Kuf. 16; Dan. apocr. 13,7; Job 22,19; Sir. 21,20; Luc. 6,21; Luc. 6,25; ሥሒቅ፡ Koh. 7,4 var. a ridere alicui, arridere, c. Acc. vel ለ፡ pers., ut: ይሥሕቀከ፡ προσγελάσεταί σοι Sir. 13,6; ኢትሥሐቅ፡ ሎን፡ ወኢትትየውሆን፡ Sir. 7,24. b ridere aliquem vel aliquid, deridere, irridere, c. Acc. pers.: Job 5,22; Job 9,23; Job 21,3; Job 30,1; Job 39,7; ዐይን፡ ዘይሥሕቅ፡ አባሁ፡ Prov. 24,52; Ps. 2,4; Ps. 34,19; Ps. 36,13; Thren. 1,7; Matth. 9,24; c. ላዕለ፡ Hez. 22,5; Job 41,20; Gen. 28,23; Sir. 7,11; Sir. 13,7; c. ዲበ፡ Job 6,26; c. በእንተ፡ Kuf. 35. c ridere vel jocari cum aliquo, c. ምስለ፡ Sir. 13,11, vel c. ለ፡, ut: ኢትሥሐቅ፡ ሎቱ፡ μὴ συγγελάσῃς αὐτῷ Sir. 30,10. śaḥaqa, śǝḥqa, ሰሐቀ፡ saḥaqa G ሠሐቀ፡ śaḥaqa I,1 ይሥሕቅ፡, ይሥሐቅ፡ «rire» ― ሣቀ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 49v. 123 L ሠሐቀ śaḥaqa, ሥሕቀ śǝḥqa (yǝśḥaq), (), ሰሐቀ saḥaqa laugh, laugh at, mock, scoff at, jest, smile at 528a

woorden.betekenis: proventu abundare
woorden.definitie: proventu abundare vid. sub ሰምረ፡

woorden.betekenis: facere ut gratum habeat, delectetur, placere, probari, gratu
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 facere ut gratum habeat aliquis aliquid, delectetur re, c. dupl. Acc. Ps. 103,35, vel c. Acc. pers. et በ፡ rei Ps. 103,35. 2 placere, probari, gratum et acceptum esse alicui (εὐαρεστεῖν, ἀρέσκειν), c.c. Acc. pers.: አሥመሮ፡ ሄኖክ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ Gen. 5,24; Sir. 44,16; Tit. 2,9; Hebr. 12,28; Ps. 114,9; Ps. 26,8 (τὴν τερπνότητα αὐτοῦ); ርእዮሙ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወኢያሥመርዎ፡ Sir. 45,19; ርእየ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወኢያሥመሮ፡ ሰብእ፡ እስመ፡ አልቦ፡ ጻድቀ፡ Jes. 59,15; ያሥምርከ፡ ምክርየ፡ Dan. 4,24; ኢያሠምሮ፡ ለጻድቅ፡ እኩይ፡ ምንትኒ፡ Prov. 12,21; አሥመሮሙ፡ ቅድሜሆሙ፡ 2 Reg. 3,36; Marc. 6,22; vel c. ለ፡ pers. ut: ያሠምር፡ ለዐይን፡ Kuf. p. 14, vel c. ቅድመ፡ pers.; Gen. 17,1; Kuf. 15; hinc Infin. አሥምሮ፡ ἀρέσκειαι Prov. 29,48. ʾaśmara G አሥመረ፡ ʾaśmara II,1 ያሠምር፡, ያሥምር፡ «plaire, faire plaisir» ― አስወደደ፡, አበጀ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 50r. 124 L አሥመረ ʾaśmara delight, give pleasure, like, make content, be pleased, be pleasant, please, be acceptable, be agreeable ኢአሥመረ ʾiʾaśmara displease 530b

woorden.betekenis: gratus, acceptus, probatus, jucundus, bonus, pulcher, libens
woorden.definitie: part. 1 gratus, acceptus, probatus alicui (δεκτός, προσδεκτός, εὐάρεστος) Sap. 9,12; Ps. 5,15; Ps. 18,15; Prov. 10,24; Prov. 14,9; ሥሙር፡ ወኅሩይ፡ Rom. 12,1; c. ለ፡ pers. ሥሙር፡ ለንጉሥ፡ Prov. 14,35; c. በኀበ፡ pers. Prov. 12,22; Phil. 4,18; Rom. 14,18; Jsp. p. 351; c. በቅድመ፡ pers. Hen. 71,12; Did. 4; ምድር፡ ሥምርት፡ γῆ θελητή Mal. 3,12. 2 jucundus, bonus, pulcher εὐπρεπής Zach. 10,3; ዐጽቀ፡ በለስ፡ ሥሙር፡ ጥቀ፡ χρηστός (opp. ሙሱን፡) Jer. 24,2. 3 libens, promtus, liberalis: በነፍስ፡ ሥምርት፡ ἐν ψυχῇ θελούσῃ 1 Par. 28,9. śǝmur, fem. ሥምርት፡ śǝmǝrt; Pl. ሥሙራን፡ śǝmurān, fem. ሥሙራት፡ śǝmurāt G ሥሙር፡ śǝmur, Pl. ሥሙራን፡ śǝmurān «chéri, bien aimé, complaisant» ― የተወደደ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 50r. ሥምርት፡ śǝmǝrt fem., Pl. ሥሙራት፡ śǝmurāt «chérie, bien aimée, complaisante» ― የተወደደች፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 50r. 124 L ሥሙር śǝmur pleasant, pleasing, plaesed, accepted, acceptable, approved, willing, granted, delightful, beautiful, nice, munificent 530b

woorden.betekenis: beneplacitum, voluntas, sǝmr, consent, approval, good will
woorden.definitie: subst. beneplacitum, voluntas: በሥምረ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Gad. Kar. (modo lectio bona sit); usitatius est. sǝmr L ሥምር sǝmr consent, approval, good will 530b

woorden.betekenis: benevolentia, gratia, favor, id quod placet, causa delectati
woorden.definitie: subst. εὐδοκία (das Wohlgefallen) 1 benevolentia, gratia, favor Luc. 2,14; Ps. 142,13 (ἔλεος). 2 id quod placet; causa delectationis (studium, desiderium) Ps. 1,2; Cant. 6,4; τὰ ἀρεστά ገበርኩ፡ ቅድሜከ፡ ሥምረተከ፡ Jes. 38,3; ሥምረቱ፡ ለአምላክነ፡ Bar. 4,4. 3 beneplacitum, voluntas, arbitrium: ሥምረቱ፡ (ለእግዚአብሔር፡) ከመ፡ ትትገሐሥ፡ እምዐመፃ፡ Sir. 32,5; Matth. 11,26 Platt; θελήματα Ps. 102,7; βουλή Ps. 19,4; Kuf. 35; በሥምረተ፡ ፈቃዱ፡ Eph. 1,11 rom.; በሥምረቱ፡ sponte, lebenter Lit. 158,4; ዘእንበለ፡ ፈቃዳ፡ አው፡ በሥምረታ፡ Kedr f. 72. 4 inclinatio voluntatis, assensus: እመቦ፡ ብእሲ፡ ዘአስተዋሰበ፡ ወለቶ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ፈቃዳ፡ አው፡ በሥምረተ፡ ልባ፡ F.M. 5,13; ከመ፡ ይኩን፡ ሥምረት፡ ቦቱ፡ (sc. በተዋስቦ፡) በምክር፡ ፍጹም፡ assensus re diligenter deliberata F.N. 24,2. śǝmrat G ሥምረት፡ śǝmrat «bienveillance, bon plaisir, volonté» ― ፈቃድ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 50r. 124 L ሥምረት śǝmrat will (of God), good will, benevolence, pleasure, delight, favor, assent, consent, approval, acquiescence, agreement 530b

woorden.betekenis: findendo, aperire, ampliare, explicare, illuscere, oriri, fi
woorden.definitie: I,2 [cognatum cum ሠርኀ፡ et ሠረቀ፡ q.v.; prima radicis vis est in findendo شَرَقَ; hinc nascuntur a) aperire, ampliare, explicare شَرَحَ b) de germinibus erumpentibus crescere شَرَخَ זָרַח; de lumine vel sole prorumpente illuscere, oriri شَرَقَ ሠረቀ፡ זָרַח ሠረኀ፡. Praeterea e notione findendi etiam notionem perveniendi ad finem vel bene succedendi excrescere posse, verbis צָלַח ܨܠܰܚ صَلَحَ, amh. ሰላ፡ probatur] 1 prosperum successum dare, prosperare, secundare (plerumque εὐοδοῦν), c.c. Acc. viae, operis, al.: ይሤርሕ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ፍናዊሁ፡ Kuf. 27; Kuf. 31; Tob. 5,17; Jes. 55,11; ውእቱ፡ ሠርሐ፡ ምግባሮሙ፡ በእደ፡ ነቢይ፡ Sap. 11,1; Ps. 89,19; Lit. 175,2; vel c. Acc. pers.: ይሤርሐከ፡ 2 Par. 18,14; ይሤርሐከ፡ በኵሉ፡ ግብርከ፡ Tob. 4,19; 1 Esr. 8,6; vel c. dupl. Acc. (secundare alicui aliquid) Gen. 24,51; Gen. 24,56; Gen. 39,3; Jes. 46,11; Kuf. 39; seq. Subj. verbi: Rom. 1,10. 2 Singularem significatum, de quo haud satis constat, habet in his locis: (nemo a communione mysterii celebranda discedat) ዘእንበለ፡ ይትፈጸም፡ ዕርገተ፡ ቍርባን፡ ወበረከተ፡ ካህን፡ ወሠርሖት፡ F.N. 12 (p. 98); (nemo accepto corpore et sanguine Christi quidquam edat vel bibat) እምቅድመ፡ ሠርሖቱ፡ F.N. 13 (p. 103); conjicio: successum deprecari vel imprecari(cfr. Num. 6,24; Num. 6,25). śarrǝḥa G ሠርሐ፡ śarrǝḥa ይሤርሕ፡, ይሠርሕ፡ «illustrer, illuminer, faire prospérer» ― አበራ፡, አቀናና፡ (አቀናነ፡) Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 50v. 125 L ሠርሐ śarrǝḥa prosper, make prosper, bring success, make successful 533b

woorden.betekenis: volare
woorden.definitie: volare vid. sub ሰረረ፡

woorden.betekenis: altitudo, longitudo, latitudo, śǝrr, śarr, hauteur, parties
woorden.definitie: vel ሠር፡ subst., altitudo, ὕψος Gen. 6,15; ut videtur, etiam longitudo: ecclesiarum quidem, quas Lalibela aedificavit, distinguitur ኑኅ፡ (altitudo vel longitudo), ግድም፡ (latitudo), ሥር፡ (longitudo vel altitudo); alio loco: ቆም፡ (altitudo) et ሥር፡ (longitudo) Gad. Lal. śǝrr, śarr G ሥር፡ śǝrr «hauteur, parties hautes» ― ላይኝነት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 50v. 126

woorden.betekenis: i.q. ሥር፡; Lud. e Mss. Colb.
woorden.definitie: i.q. ሥር፡; Lud. e Mss. Colb.

woorden.betekenis: fundamentum, fundamen, fundamentum jecit, ex imo corde suo,
woorden.definitie: subst., Pl. መሠረታት፡ fundamentum, fundamen: Job 9,6; Job 18,4; Job 22,16; Sir. 16,19; Sir. 50,15; Jes. 13,5; Jes. 14,15; Jes. 24,18; Jes. 28,16; Jes. 44,23; Jes. 58,12; Am. 1,4; Am. 1,7; Ps. 17,9; Ps. 17,17; Ps. 86,1; Judith 1,2; Judith 1,3; Judith 16,15; Job 28,9 (ῥίζαι); Luc. 6,49; Apoc. 21,14; 4 Esr. 10,41; 4 Esr. 10,67; አስተናደፈ፡ መሠረተ፡ fundamentum jecit 1 Cor. 3,10; ሣረረ፡ መሠረተ፡ 1 Cor. 3,11; Luc. 6,48; Hez. 40,5 (τὸ προτείχισμα). Transl.: 1 Tim. 6,19; 2 Tim. 2,19; Hebr. 6,1; Hen. 15,9; fundamentum calculorum vel rationis ineundae, Abush.; (dilexit eum) እመሠረተ፡ ልቡ፡ ex imo corde suo Org. – Voc. Ae.: መሠረት፡ ብ፡ ታቹ፡ maśarat, መሰረት፡ masarat, Pl. መሰረታት፡ masaratāt G መሰረት፡ masarat, Pl. መሰረታት፡ masaratāt «fondement (dans toutes ses acceptions)» ― መሰረት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 38r. 89 L መሠረት maśarat, () መሰረት፡ masarat foundation 396a

woorden.betekenis: fundare, ʾamaśrata, ʾamasrata, faire poser les fondements, f
woorden.definitie: quadril. II (denom. a መሠረት፡) fundare: አመሥርተኒ፡ ዲበ፡ መሠረተ፡ ወርቅ፡ Org. ʾamaśrata, አመስረተ፡ ʾamasrata G አመስረተ፡ ʾamasrata,II, ያመሰርት፡, ያመስርት፡ «faire poser les fondements, faire creuser les fondements» ― አስበገረ፡ አስመሰረተ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 38r. 89 L አመሥረተ ʾamaśrata causative {of vid. መሥረተ maśrata} 369a

woorden.betekenis: furari
woorden.definitie: furari vid. sub ሰረቀ፡

woorden.betekenis: exoriri facere, ortum creare, illucescere facere, effulgere,
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 exoriri facere, ortum creare, illucescere facere, c. Acc. solis Sir. 43,2; Matth. 5,45; Did. 1; Macc. f. 3, aliusve luminis: ከማሁ፡ ይሠርቅ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ጽድቀ፡ ወሐሤተ፡ Jes. 61,11; in genere: effulgere vel resplendere facere: (Deus) አሥረቀ፡ መለኮቶ፡ Lit. Orth. 2 ut videtur, prima luce sacra celebrare, hymnos matutinos canere, saepius in Deg., ex. gr.: በአጽዋም፡ ለእመ፡ ሀሎ፡ አሥርቆት፡, vel አርያም፡ (genus cantus) ዘአሥርቆት፡; vid. etiam Catal. Cod. Ae. Mus. Brit. p. 38. ʾaśraqa G አሥረቀ፡ ʾaśraqa ያሠርቅ፡, ያሥርቅ፡ «faire lever (astres)» ― አስወጣ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 50v. 126 L አሥረቀ ʾaśraqa make shine, make rise, celebrate the new moon by special hymns 534a

woorden.betekenis: ortus, apparitio, oriens, luna nova, novilunium, dies novilu
woorden.definitie: subst., Pl. አሥራቅ፡ 1 ortus vel apparitio sideris Jud. 5,31. 2 oriens i.e. coeli plaga orientalis: መንገለ፡ ሠርቀ፡ ፀሓይ፡ Gen. 25,6; መንገለ፡ ሠርቅ፡ Gen. 13,11; Ps. 102,12; Clem. f. 187; ደብረ፡ ዘይት፡ ዘሀለወት፡ በሠርቀ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፡ Jsp. p. 356. 3 in specie: luna nova, novilunium: ጌሠም፡ ሠርቀ፡ ወርኅ፡ 1 Reg. 20,5; ሠርቀ፡ ወርኅክሙ፡ Jes. 1,14; በሠርቀ፡ አውራኅ፡ Hez. 45,17; አሥራቀ፡ ወርኅ፡ Num. 28,11; 1 Esr. 5,51; ዕለተ፡ ሠርቅ፡ dies novilunii Ps. 80,3, vel ሠርቅ፡ Hen. 78,12; አመ፡ ርእሰ፡ ሠርቅ፡ Ex. 40,2; እንተ፡ ቅድመ፡ ሠርቅ፡ προνουμηνία Judith 8,6. Deinde ubi mensium initia a noviluniis fiunt, ሠርቅ፡ est calendae, initium mensis, ut: አመ፡ ሠርቀ፡ ወርኅ፡ ራብዕ፡ Kuf. 3,6 seq.; Hagg. 1,1; et inde a ሠርቅ፡ mensium dies quatuordecim primi numernatur, ut: በዐሡር፡ ሠርቅ፡ δεκάτῃ τοῦ μηνός Jer. 52,4; Bar. 1,2; Hez. 20,1, vel በኀሙሰ፡ ሠርቅ፡ Hez. 1,1, vel በኃምስ፡ ሠርቅ፡ πέμπτῃ τοῦ μηνός Hez. 1,2; Hez. 8,1; Jer. 46,2, vel አመ፡ ረቡዑ፡ ለሠርቀ፡ ታስዕ፡ ወርኅ፡ Zach. 7,1; Hez. 33,21; Esth. 3,7; Esth. 3,12 seqq. (opp. ጽልመት፡ q.v.). Denique ut diei ita noctis quoque ሠርቅ፡ initium praedicatur Lit. f. 161,1; Herm. p. 108in subscr. (populorum enim alii mensium annique dies ab imminentibus noctibus, alii ab illucescentibus diebus incipiebant, quare ሠርቀ፡ ሌሊት፡ et ሠርቀ፡ መዓልት፡ distinguuntur). śarq, ሰርቅ፡ sarq G ሠርቅ፡ śarq «levée des astres, nouvelle lune, orient, est» ― መውጣት፡, የጸሐይ፡ መውጣት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 50v. ሠርቀ፡ ሌሊት፡ śarqa lelit âge de la lune, vid. ሌሊት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 50v. ሠርቀ፡ መዓልት፡ śarqa maʿalt âge ou jours du mois መዓልት፡, vid. ሞዐልት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 50v. 126 L ሠርቅ śarq, () ሰርቅ፡ sarq rising (of stars, sun, new moon), day of a new moon, beginning of a month, (Lt) the Orient ሠርቀ፡ ወርኅ፡ śarqa warḫ new moon, vid. ወርኅ፡ 534a

woorden.betekenis: oriens, regio orientalis, regiones, partes orientales, mǝśrā
woorden.definitie: subst., Pl. ምሥራቃት፡ oriens, regio orientalis, et ምሥራቅ፡ et ምሥራቀ፡ ፀሓይ፡ Matth. 2,2; Jos. 1,15; Ps. 112,3; Mal. 1,10; Jes. 9,12; Jes. 11,11; Jes. 41,25; Jes. 45,6; Jes. 59,19; Hen. 35; Apoc. 16,12 al.; ምሥራቃት፡ regiones vel partes orientales Abush. 47. mǝśrāq G ምሥራቅ፡ mǝśrāq «orient, est» ― Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 50v. 126 L ምሥራቅ mǝśrāq east, the Orient 534b

woorden.betekenis: sorbere, imbibere, bibere, śaraba, saraba, absorpsit, hausit
woorden.definitie: I,1 [i.q. شَرِبَ, ܣܪܰܦ, سَرِفَ; cfr. etiam ሰረበ፡] sorbere, imbibere, bibere: ይሠርብ፡ ደምየ፡ Job 6,4; ይሠርባ፡ ለኀጢአት፡ ከመ፡ ስታይ፡ Job 15,16; Cod. Mus. Brit. LIV, 7; Apoc. 12,16; ሠሪቦ፡ ብሒአ፡ ይቤ፡ Joh. 19,30; Rel. Bar.; Hen. 28,3. – Voc. Ae.: ሠረበ፡ ብ፡ ማገ። śaraba, ሰረበ፡ saraba G ሰረበ፡ saraba I,1 ይሰርብ፡, ይስርብ፡ absorpsit, hausit, absorber, boire avidement, avaler d’un trait ― ማገ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 44. Ant. d’Abbadie dans son 113 traduit ainsi le verbe ማገ፡ ‘but à petits traits, buvotta, sirota’. 165–166 L ሠረበ፡ śaraba (yǝśrab), (, ) ሰረበ፡ saraba drink, drink up, (L*, , ) absorb, sip 533a

woorden.betekenis: rad. inus., cognata cum ሠረቀ፡ et ሠርሐ፡ q.v.

woorden.definitie: triticum vid. sub ሠዐረ፡

woorden.betekenis: corrigia; linea, ductus, Strich, Streifen, disponere ad line
woorden.definitie: vel ሲራክ፡, subst., n. peregr., Pl. ሢራካት፡ [sine dubio i.q. شِرَاكٌ corrigia; linea, ductus, Strich sive Streifen; coll. שְׂרַג vel סְרַג disponere ad lineam; סֵרַג interstinguere, intersecare, סִרְגֵּל lineare, sulcare, quae omnia ad שָׂרַג vel שָׂרַךְ nexuit, plexit referenda sunt] linea, lineae ductus, stria, ut: (non avertit plantam pedis) እምፍና፡ ሢራኩ፡ Lud. e Mss. Colb. a series vel pars tabulae lineis in varias partes divisae (Fach); rubrica; nec non tabella ipsa lineis tabulatim divisa: ወለለ፡ ኍልቈ፡ አሐዙ፡ ቦቱ፡ አሐዝ፡ ዘበሢራኩ፡ ዘይኤምር፡ ውስተ፡ አይ፡ καθ᾽ ἕκαστον ἀριθμὸν ὑποσημείωσις διὰ κινναβάρεως πρόκειται δηλοῦσα ἐν ποίῳ Epist. Euseb. ad Carp. in N.T. rom., et አእሚረከ፡ አሐዘ፡ ኈልቁ፡ ዘበሢራኩ፡ ὅν ἡ διὰ τοῦ κινναβάρεως ὑποσημείωσις ὑποβέβληκεν Epist. Euseb. ad Carp. in N.T. rom.; M.M. f. 96; M.M. f. 246. b membrum vel incisio orationis, quatenus linearum intervallis distinguuntur (Abschnitt, Absatz). Herm. p. 110(coll. Isenb. lex. p. 54: ሲራክ፡ „a blank horizontal space on a written page between two divisions“). sirāk ሲራክ፡ sirāk G tabella concordnatiarum, tabele de concordances Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 45. 166 L ሲራክ፡ sirāk, ሢራክ፡ śirāk line, column, table, division of a table, segment, section, paragraph, (166) tabel of concordance, (*) lace, shoelace, strap of sandal 513b

woorden.betekenis: rad. inus., propagata e ሠረረ፡ (שָׁרַר), de qua vid.
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., propagata e ሠረረ፡ (שָׁרַר), de qua vid. supra col. 238 et Ges. thes. p. 1482 seq. Hinc

woorden.betekenis: nervus, musculus, commissura, radix, radices agere, capere,
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. ሥረው፡ et አሥራው፡, rarius ሥርዋት፡ (Hen. 8,3; Sx. Ter 27) 1 [i.q. שׁוֹר, ܫܶܪܝܳܢ, amh. ሥር፡] nervus, musculus, νεῦρον (synon. መትን፡): Job 10,11; Job 30,17; Job 40,12; ዘኀጺን፡ሥርወ፡ ክሣድከ፡ Jes. 48,4; Prov. 24,23; Hez. 37,5; Hez. 37,8; ሥርወ፡ ሕሩም፡ Gen. 32,26; Gen. 32,33; ሥርወ፡ መዝራእተ፡ እደዊሆሙ፡ Gen. 49,24; Gen. 49,6; Deut. 21,4; Jos. 11,6; commissura Hebr. 4,12; Eph. 4,16 Platt; Col. 2,19 Platt; ሥርወ፡ ልብየ፡ τὰ αἰσθητήρια τῆς καρδίας Jer. 4,19; አዕጽምት፡ ወአሥራው፡ Cyr. f. 117; ደዌ፡ አደግደገ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ ወተዐውቀ፡ አሥራወ፡ እንግድዓሁ፡ Jsp. p. 302. 2 (i.q. שֹׁרֶשׁ ܫܶܪܝܳܐ, amh. ሥር፡, arab. سِرٌّ) radix plantarum eorumque quae cum iis comparantur: Gen. 41,5; Deut. 29,17; Job 5,3; Deut. 15,30; Sap. 7,20; Jes. 53,2; Luc. 17,6; Matth. 13,6; Matth. 13,21; Rom. 11,16 seq.; Hebr. 12,15; ይሠርጽ፡ ሥርዎሙ፡ Jes. 37,31; ኢበቈለ፡ ሥርዎሙ፡ Jes. 40,24; Hez. 31,7; ይየብስ፡ ሥረዊሁ፡ Job 18,16; Hos. 9,16; መልኀ፡ ሥርዎሙ፡ Sir. 10,15; ይጸንዕ፡ ሥርዉ፡ Jer. 17,8; እምሥርው፡ አጥፍአ፡ Job 31,12; ሥርው፡ ወጕንድ፡ Dan. 4,12; ዘእንበለ፡ ሥርው፡ ἄρριζος Job 31,8; ሀለወ፡ ውስተ፡ ሥርው፡ ἔτι ὂν ἐπὶ ῥίζης Job 8,12; radices agere vel capere: ወደየ፡ ሥርወ፡ { 4 Esr. 8,47}; Macc. f. 5; ገብረ፡ ሥርወ፡ Sir. 3,28; አብቈልኩ፡ ሥርወ፡ Sir. 24,12; አኀዘ፡ ሥርወ፡ Kuf. 37; Herm. p. 64; Herm. p. 65. Transl.: ሥርዎሙ፡ ለርኩሳን፡ Sir. 40,15; ሥርወ፡ ዐመፃ፡ Hen. 91,5; Hen. 91,8; Hen. 91,11; 4 Esr. 1,22; 4 Esr. 3,36. In specie est a principium, fundamentum, origo: ሥርዋ፡ ለጥበብ፡ ፈሪሀ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Sir. 1,20; Sap. 15,3; 1 Tim. 6,10. b stirps, genus Jes. 11,1; Jes. 11,10; Apoc. 5,5; ሥርውኪ፡ ወዘመድኪ፡ እምድረ፡ ከናአን፡ Hez. 16,3; Tob. 5,14. c causa Job 19,28. d exemplar libri originarium (أَصْلٌ): መጽሐፈ፡ ሥርው፡ Jsp. (In Voc. Ae.: ሥርወ፡ ሕሩም፡ ዘ፡ ሽሉዳ፡). śǝrw, ሡር፡ śur, ሥር፡ śǝr, Pl. śǝraw, ʾaśrāw, śǝrwāt G ሥርው፡ śǝrw, Pl. ሥረው፡ śǝraw, ሥርዋት፡ śǝrwāt, አሥራው፡ ʾaśrāw «racine, nerf» ― ሥር፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 51r. 126 L ሥርው śǝrw (Pl. ሥረው śǝraw, አሥራው ʾaśrāw), () ሡር፡ śur, ሥር፡ śǝr sinew, tendon, nerve, muscle, basis, root, origin, stock, tribe, () belief (that is, the basis) ሥርው፡ ሕሩም śǝrw ḥǝrum sinew of the thigh, lit. ‘the forbidden muscle’; it reflects the Heb. ‘gīḏ hannāše̮’ ‘the sinew of the thigh-vein’ which people are forbidden to eat, according to Gen. 32:32, vid. ሕሩም፡ 535b

woorden.betekenis: exstirpator, śarrāwi, śarrāwǝyān, extirpateur, qui déracine,
woorden.definitie: n. ag. exstirpator Lud. sine auct. śarrāwi, Pl. ሠራውያን፡ śarrāwǝyān G ሠራዊ፡ śarrāwi, Pl. ሠራውያን፡ śarrāwǝyān «extirpateur, qui déracine» ― ነቃይ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 51r. 126 L ሠራዊ፡ śarrāwi act. part. of vid. ሠረወ śarrawa 535b

woorden.betekenis: protendere, ad lineam disponere, ordinare, disponere, struer
woorden.definitie: I,1 [amh. ሠራ፡, i.q. شَرَعَ; primitus significare videtur protendere, deinde ad lineam disponere, ordinare] Subj. ይሥራዕ፡ 1 disponere, struere, instruere, ordinare, ornare: laqueos ዘሠርዐ፡ መሥገርተ፡ Sir. 27,26; Prov. 29,5; Jer. 5,26; aciem ሠርዐ፡ ሰራዊቶ፡ (Titus) Jsp. p. 356; ትሠርዕ፡ አሕፃ፡ ዐውዳ፡ τάξεις τὰς βελοστάσεις κύκλῳ Hez. 4,2; populos ይሠርዖሙ፡ ለአሕዛብ፡ Job 12,23; mensam (sternere), cibos ሥርዑ፡ ማእደ፡ Ex. 26,35; Jes. 21,5; Jes. 65,11; Dan. apocr. 13,11; Dan. apocr. 13,14; Sir. 29,26; Ps. 22,6; Ps. 77,22; Ps. 77,24; Lev. 24,6; Lev. 24,8; Luc. 6,4; ብዙኀ፡ ሠርዑ፡ ውስቴቱ፡ (ለማእድ፡) Sir. 34,12; Sir. 34,16; lucernas Ex. 25,37; καταρτίζειν Matth. 4,21; ordinare domum i.e. curare rem domesticam (de moribundo): ሥራዕ፡ ቤተከ፡ Jes. 38,1; 4 Esr. 14,10; 4 Reg. 20,1; librum (disponere): ስንክሳር፡ ዘሠርዑ፡ አበዊነ፡ Sx. Mag. in proleg.; ያሬድ፡ ሠርዐ፡ ማሕሌተ፡ ለለዘመኑ፡ Sx. Genb. 11. 2 instituere, statuere, constituere, condere, sancire, praefinire, praecipere: ሠራዕኩ፡ ኆፃ፡ ወሰነ፡ ለባሕር፡ Jer. 5,22; መኑ፡ ሠርዐ፡ አምጣኒሃ፡ Job 38,5; ሠርዖሙ፡ ፍናዊሆሙ፡ Sir. 36,11; Hen. 5,2; ለኵነኔ፡ ሠራዕካሁ፡ Hab. 1,12; ዐቅመ፡ ሠርዐት፡ ለልሳና፡ Prov. 29,43; ሥራዕ፡ ሊተ፡ ዘይትፈቀድ፡ σύνταξόν μοι τὰ δέοντα Prov. 24,31; (c. Acc. pers. pro Dat. Rom. 16,2); ሠርዐ፡ ጸባሕተ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ Kuf. 34; አርዑተ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ Kuf. 38; ምክያደ፡ Kuf. 40; ውስተ፡ ዐቢይ፡ ሕዝብ፡ እሠርዐከ፡ አነ፡ Kuf. 44; in specie: leges, instituta, ritus, foedera: Kuf. 6; Kuf. 13; ሕግ፡ ዘሠራዕኩ፡ ለአበዊሆሙ፡ Jer. 11,10; Rom. 3,31; Hebr. 8,8; Hebr. 8,9; እሠርዕ፡ ለቤተ፡ እስራኤል፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ሐዲሰ፡ διαθήσομαι δαιθήκην Jer. 38,31; Hez. 34,25; Hez. 37,26; እሠርዖሙ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ዘለዓለም፡ Jes. 61,8; 2 Par. 23,16; Marc. 7,5; praedestinare Rom. 8,29; institutis ornare: ነበርነ፡ አሐተኔ፡ ወሠራዕነ፡ ቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ Clem. f. 103. 3 administrare, dispensare, διοικεῖν Sap. 8,1; Sap. 15,1; 1 Tim. 3,5; 1 Tim. 3,15. śarʿa G ሠርዐ፡ śarʿa I,1 ይሠርዕ፡, ይሥራዕ፡ «ordonner, décréter, statuer, établir, régler, faire des lois, des ordonnances, disposer, préparer la table, travailler, réglementer» ― ሠራ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 51r. 127 L ሠርዐ śarʿa (yǝśrāʿ) set, set forth, set in order, set (the table), establish, establish order, arrange, institute, enact, prepare, ordain, decree, stipulate, legislate, promulgate, prescribe, make regulations, regulate, make a covenant, make a testament, administer (the Eucharist) 532b

woorden.betekenis: disponi, institui, constitui, praecipi, praefiniri, sibi, in
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 pass. disponi, institui, constitui, praecipi, praefiniri: በላዕሌከኑ፡ ተሠርዐ፡ ጎሐ፡ ጽባሕ፡ Job 38,12; ለዐሠርቱ፡ ክፍል፡ ተሠርዐ፡ ዓለም፡ 4 Esr. 14,9; ተሠርዐ፡ በእንቲአሁ፡ Luc. 22,22; 4 Esr. 8,62; Kuf. 3; Kuf. 4; Kuf. 30; ሕግ፡ ተሠርዐ፡ 1 Tim. 1,9; sterni mensam ተሠርዐ፡ ማእድ፡ Sx. Enc. 2 refl. sibi vel inter se pactionem facere; convenit de re: ተሠራዕክሙ፡ ἐποιήσατε συνθήκας Jes. 30,1. taśarʿa G ተሠርዐ፡ taśarʿa III,1 ይሠራዕ፡ «être fait, ordonné, établi par la loi, être décrété, être disposé, être prépare, etc.» ― ተሠርዐ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 51r. 127 L ተሠርዐ taśarʿa passive {of vid. ሠርዐ śarʿa}; also submit, yield 533a

woorden.betekenis: dispositus, instructus, ordinatus, statutus, divinitus insti
woorden.definitie: part. dispositus, instructus, ordinatus, statutus: Esth. 1,6; Hen. 2,1; 1 Cor. 14,40 Platt; Ps. 88,36; in specie de mensa: ሥሩዕ፡ ማእድ፡ ቅድሜሆን፡ Hez. 23,41 et de cibis appositis Joh. 21,9; Lev. 24,7; Mal. 1,7; Sir. 30,18. Nec non ho vocabulo vertitur θεσπέσιος, divinitus institutus, ut: ሥሩዕ፡ ጳውሎስ፡ Cyr. c. Pall. f. 85; ሥሩዕ፡ ጴጥሮስ፡ Cyr. c. Pall. f. 93(vid. ሠራዒ፡). śǝruʿ, Pl. ሥሩዓን፡ śǝruʿān G ሥሩዕ፡ śǝruʿ, Pl. ሥሩዓን፡ śǝruʿān «fait, établi, arrangé, statué, décrété, etc.» ― የተሠራ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 51r. 127 L ሥሩዕ፡ śǝruʿ pass. part. of vid. ሠርዐ śarʿa 533አ C for ኅብስት፡ ሥሩዕ፡ vid. ኅብስት፡ (TraCES)

woorden.betekenis: dispositio, ordinatio, ordo, classis, substructio, apparatus
woorden.definitie: n. act. et subst., m. et fem., Pl. ሥርዐታት፡ 1 dispositio, ordinatio, ordo, classis: መኰንን፡ ለባዊ፡ ይገብር፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ἡγεμονία συνετοῦ τεταγμένη ἐστί Sir. 16,26; Cant. 6,10 (aciei); τάγμα Num. 2,2; ῥυθμός 4 Reg. 16,10; Ex. 25,38 (ὑπόθεμα substructio); Ex. 39,22 ἀποσκευή apparatus; በበሥርዐቶሙ፡ secundum ordines suos Lit.; ሥርዐት፡ nominantur classes harmonicae, in quibus concordantiae Evangelistarum reperiuntur Nov. Test. rom.; ሥርዐታት፡ τάξεις Hen. 82,10; Hen. 82,11. 2 institutio, ut: በእንተ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ምስጢር፡ Matth. 26,26 in tit.; et plerumque institutum a praeceptum, mandatum, edictum, decretum: πρόσταγμα vel προστάγματα Ps. 7,7; Jes. 24,5; Jer. 5,22; Sir. 39,16; δόγμα vel δόγματα Dan. 6,8 seq.; Eph. 2,15; Eph. 3,9; Col. 2,14; ሥርዐተ፡ ሠናይ፡ አምልኮ፡ τὰ δόγματα τῆς εὐσεβείας II Can. Ap. 35; ዐቃቤ፡ ሥርዐት፡ ὑπομνηματογράφος 1 Par. 18,15. b lex, statutum: ሥርዐትየ፡ τὰ νόμιμά μου Hez. 5,6; ሥርዐተ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡ δικαιώματα λατρείας Hebr. 9,1; ሥርዐተ፡ ቀኖና፡ vel ሥርዐታ፡ ለቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ Clem. (saepissime); ሥርዐተ፡ ዲያቆን፡ ዐቀበ፡ ወኢተዐደወ፡ Mavâs. 12; παράδοσις, statutum traditum (traditio) 2 Thess. 3,6; Tit. 1,14; Col. 2,8; Matth. 15,3; Matth. 15,9; de legibus naturae rerum innatis vel praescriptis: Sir. 16,26; Sir. 43,2; Sir. 43,10; ሥርዐተ፡ አውራኅ፡ Kuf. 4; 4 Esr. 4,52; በከመ፡ ሥርዐት፡ ሀሎ፡ Asc. Jes. 11,17; (concubitus) በሥርዐተ፡ ተባዕት፡ ወአንስት፡ Tob. 3,8. c foedus, pactum, testamentum (vid. ሕግ፡), διαθήκη: Gen. 17,20 seq.; Kuf. 1; Kuf. 15; Job 31,1; Jes. 42,6; Jes. 49,8; Jes. 55,3; Jer. 38,31; Mal. 2,4; Mal. 2,5; Prov. 2,17; Sir. 44,11; ሐዲስ፡ ሥርዐት፡ Matth. 26,28; Hebr. 12,24; Rom. 9,4. d regula: ሥርዐተ፡ አባ፡ ጳኵሚስ፡ regula monastica Reg. Pach.; ሥርዐተ፡ ማኅበር፡ regula conventus(coenobitarum) Sx. Enc. e ritus, institutum, usus, consuetudo, mos; de institutis rei publicae: ወነበሩ፡ (Romani) በዝንቱ፡ ሥርዐት፡ እስከ፡ ኀየሎሙ፡ ቄሳር፡ Jsp. p. 274; κρίμα Jer. 37,18; de instituto matrimonii: ንስተተ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ሰብሳብ፡ γάμων ἀταξία Sap. 14,26; በሥርዐተ፡ ሕግ፡ νομοθέσμως Prov. 29,45; πρόσταγμα Gen. 47,26; λατρεία Ex. 12,25; Ex. 12,26; ኅቡረ፡ ሥርዐት፡ eodem vitae instituto utens Sx. Enc.; ሥርዐተ፡ አይሁድ፡ Judaismus Sx. Enc.; in specie de iis ritibus sacrism, qui f sacramenta, mysteria appellantur: ሥርዐተ፡ ጥምቀት፡ F.M. 27; Const. Ap. 20; ሥርዐተ፡ ቍርባን፡ Const. Ap. 52; Lit. Orth.; μυστήρια 1 Cor. 4,1. In genere g ratio, modus, conditio: በሥርዐቱ፡ pro more suo Org.; በዝ፡ ሥርዐት፡ ብዙኀ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ተሐዩ፡ τούτῳ τῷ τρόπῳ Prov. 9,11; በከመ፡ ይከውን፡ ሥርዐቱ፡ ለአውታረ፡ መሰንቆ፡ ከማሁ፡ qualis ratio fidium est, talis Chrys. Ta. 29; ንሕነ፡ ወለጥነ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ nos rationem ({das Verhältniß}) permutavimus Chrys. Ta. 8; ተመሰልኪ፡ በሥርዐተ፡ ንጽሕኪ፡ ምስሌሆሙ፡ ratione castitatis iis similis facta es Org. h status, sors, conditio vitae Apoc. 21,4; Hebr. 3,14; ቦብዙኃን፡ እለ፡ ያስተካብዱ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ንዴት፡ Chrys. Ta. 18; Phlx. 1; ድንግልና፡ ዕቁብ፡ በሥርዐቱ፡ Org. 3 administratio, dispensatio Tob. 1,21; Tit. 2,5; 1 Tim. 3,4. – (Memorabilis est versio ἐπιστήμη ሥርዐት፡ Hez. 28,7; Hez. 28,17). śǝrʿat, Pl. śǝrʿatāt G ሥርዐት፡ śǝrʿat, Pl. ሥርዐታት፡ śǝrʿatāt «sanction, statut, ordonnance, décret, rite, coutume, consuétude, us, manière, état, ordre, testament, etc.» ― ሥራት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 51r. 127 L ሥርዐት፡ śǝrʿat ordinance, ordering, order, arrangement, ordered rank, procession, ceremony, rite, ritual, rule, regulation, manner, precept, prescription, charge, disposition, service, assignement, constitution, provision, administration, institution, testament, pact, custom, habit, tradition, covenant, decree, edict, statute, law, canon ሥርዐተ፡ ቅዳሴ śǝrʾata qǝddāse liturgy, vid. ቅዳሴ፡ ሐዲስ፡ ሥርዐት ḥaddis śǝrʾat New Testament, vid. ሐዲስ፡ 533a

woorden.betekenis: velum navis, artemon
woorden.definitie: subst., Pl. ሥራዓት፡ i.e. شِرَاعٌ (amh. ሽራዓ፡) velum navis: አውረዱ፡ ሥራዓ፡ χαλάσαντες τὸ σκεῦος Act. 27,17 Platt; ሰቀሉ፡ ሥራዐ፡ ዘይንእስ፡ ἀρτέμων artemon Act. 27,40 Platt; አልዐሉ፡ ሥራዓተ፡ Act. 27,13 Platt.

woorden.betekenis: fila ducere, nere
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., quae fila ducere, nere significasse videtur, coll. amh. ሸረረ፡ Hinc

woorden.betekenis: pullulare, germinare, gemmas, folia agere, procedere, śaraṣa
woorden.definitie: et ሠርጸ፡ I,1 [amh. id.; vicinum est ሥርው፡ radix; nec non שָׁרַץ, vid. Ges. thes. p. 1482; Ges. thes. p. 1483] Subj. ይሥርጽ፡ et ይሥረጽ፡ 1 pullulare, germinare, gemmas et folia agere, de plantis: ይሠርጽ፡ ሥርዎሙ፡ Jes. 37,31; (ዘርእ፡) ሠረጸ፡ Matth. 13,5; ዕፀው፡ ሠርጹ፡ Luc. 21,30 rom.; በትር፡ ትሠርጽ፡ Num. 17,20; Num. 17,23; Hez. 7,10; Hebr. 9,4; ከመ፡ ይሥረጹ፡ Rel. Bar.; ከመ፡ ትሥርጽ፡, var. ትሥረጽ፡ Hez. 17,8; Hez. 19,10; ሠረጸ፡ ፍሬሃ፡ ከመ፡ ቆዐ፡ ቀምሕ፡ Sir. 51,15; ቈጽል፡ ዘይሠርጽ፡ Sir. 14,18; Kuf. 2; Kuf. 48; transl. de aliis rebus: lepra ሠርጸ፡ ለምጽ፡ ውስተ፡ ፍጽሙ፡ 2 Par. 26,19; corpore Ps. 27,10; ossibus Sir. 49,10; veritate Ps. 84,12; fide 4 Esr. 4,32; hominibus Sir. 39,12; 2 Reg. 23,5; c.c. Acc. rei: ሠረጽኩ፡ ሞገሰ፡ βλαστήσασα χάριν Sir. 24,17. 2 in specie procedere, de processione Spiritus S. a Patre: ሠረጻ፡ እምአብ፡ Lit. 163,4; ከመ፡ መንፈስ፡ ቅዱስ፡ ሠረጸ፡ እምአብ፡ ወነሥአ፡ እምወልድ፡ Fid. Jac. Bar. (vid. . III, 5 n. 29 c. Comm.). śaraṣa, śarṣa, ሠረፀ፡ saraḍa G ሠረጸ፡ śaraṣa I,1 ይሠርጽ፡, ይሥርጽ፡ «germer, sortir, procéder» ― ወጣ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 51v. 129 L ሠረጸ śaraṣa, ሠርጸ śarṣa (yǝsraṣ), ሠረፀ፡ saraḍa germinate, blossom, shoot forth, sprout, burgeon, bud, proceed (Holy Ghost from the Father), arise, (Lt) conceive, think out 535a

woorden.betekenis: cilicium, pannus hirtus e pilis textus, tegumentum hirtum, c
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. ሠቃት፡ et አሥቃት፡, Pl. Pl. አሥቃቃት፡ שַׂק, ܣܰܩܳܐ, ⲥⲟⲕ cilicium, pannus hirtus e pilis textus, plerumque δέρρις, ቍሰሊሆሙ፡ መዝመዙ፡ በሠቅ፡ Sx. Hed. 1Enc.; ጠብለልዎ፡ በሠቅ፡ Sx. Masc. 1Enc.; 1 tegumentum hirtum vel cilicinum, ἐπιβόλαιον Jud. 4,18; 2 Reg. 21,10; እግዚአብሔር፡ ረበቦ፡ ከመ፡ ሠቅ፡ ለተባዕታይ፡ ማይ፡ Macc. f. 25, in specie de tegumentis tentorii: Ex. 26,7-12; Num. 4,25; Ex. 35,10 C; 1 Par. 17,1; Ps. 103,3; 3 Reg. 20,12 ({ ሠቀት፡} var. pro ደብተራ፡). 2 vestis species, qua induuntur lugentes, poenitentes, ascetae: Ps. 29,14; Ps. 68,14; Job 16,15; Jes. 58,5; Asc. Jes. 2,10; ለብሰ፡ ሠቀ፡ Esth. 4,1; 2 Esr. 19,1; አልበሱ፡ ምሥዋዐ፡ ሠቀ፡ Judith 4,10; Jes. 50,3; ቅንቲ፡ ሠቀ፡ Jes. 3,24; Jes. 15,3; Jer. 4,8; Jer. 6,26; Jes. 30,3; Jes. 31,37; Thren. 2,10; Hebr. 11,37; ሠቅ፡ ዘጸጕር፡ Zach. 13,4. 3 saccus (frumentarius): ገብረ፡ ሠቃተ፡ ምሉአ፡ ኆጻ፡ Sx. Mag. 8Enc. – Voc. Ae.: ሠቅ፡ ብ፡ ማቅ፡; ሠቅ፡ ዘ፡ አምሳለ፡ መሐቅ። śaqq, Pl. śaqqāt, ʾaśqāt, አስቀቅ ʾaśqaq, Pl.Pl. ʾaśqāqāt ፩፡ አስቃቀ፡ ደብተራ፡ ‘8 tele per il tabernacolo,’ 43 VI l. 30 (ed.), 36 l. 29 (tr.); ወአስቀቀ፡ ደብተራ፡ ፯፡ ‘7 tele da sacco per il tabernacolo,’ 64 l. 15 (ed.), 53 l. 22 (tr.) G ሠቅ፡ śaqq, Pl. አሥቃቅ፡ ʾaśqāq, አሥቃቃት፡ ʾaśqāqāt, ሠቃቅ፡ śaqqāt «haire, drap de poil très grossier, cilicium» ― ማቅ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 51v. 129 L ሠቅ śaqq, Pl. ሠቃቅ śaqqāt, አሥቃቅ ʾaśqāq, አሥቃቃት ʾaśqāqāt sackcloth, covering of goat’s hair 532a

woorden.betekenis: pectinavit, miser, infelix fuit, miserum reddidit
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., cujus notio prima e שָׁקַק ܫܰܩ شَقَّ fidit, laceravit et شَقَأَ pectinavit (vid. መሥቄ፡), derivata e شَقِيَ miser, infelix fuit, شَقَا miserum reddidit apparet.

woorden.betekenis: taśāqaya, être tourmenté, śāqaya, suffer pain
woorden.definitie: III,3 pass. Jud. 10,9; Hebr. 13,3; ውስተ፡ ኵነኔ፡ ደይን፡ ተሣቀዩ፡ ለዓለም፡ Macc. f. 22. taśāqaya G ተሣቀየ፡ taśāqaya III,3 ይሣቀይ፡ «être tourmenté» ― መከራ፡ ተቀበለ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 52v. 129 L ተሣቀየ፡ taśāqaya passive {of vid. ሣቀየ śāqaya}; also suffer pain 532b

woorden.definitie: praedicare vid. sub ሰብሐ፡
