Am. 80 vid. ደዋሮ፡ б ሥዩመ፡ ገርዓልታ፡ śǝyuma garʿāltā (title) chief of Garʿāltā ወሥዩመ፡ ገርዓልታ፡ ወኅዱግ... አሕረምነ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይባኡ። ‘au chef du Garʿāltā at au vicaire, …, nous avons défendu d’[y] entrer [dans les fiefs susdits]’ 40 l. 10, l. 11 (ed.), 47 l. 21, l. 23 (tr.), vid. ገርዓልታ፡ в ሥዩመ፡ ጽምብላ፡ śǝyuma ṣembǝlā (title) chief of Ṣǝmbǝlā እመቦ፡ ዘሄደ፡ ወዘተዓገለ፡ እመሂ፡ ሥዩመ፡ ሲሬ፡ ወእመሂ፡ ሥዩመ፡ ጽምብላ፡ ወእመሂ፡ ኅዱግ፡ ውጉዝ፡ ለይኩን፡ ‘S’il se trouve quelqu’un qui viole ou transgresse [cet acte], chef du Sirē, ou chef du Ṣembelā, ou vicaire, maudit soit-il’ 47 l. 8–9 (ed.), 56 l. 23–24 (tr.), vid. ጽምብላ፡ г ሥዩመ፡ ጽራዕ፡ śǝyuma ṣǝrāʿ (title) chief of Ṣǝrāʿ እሎንተ፡ ፯፡ አህጉራተ፡ እመቦ፡ ዘሄደ፡ ወዘተዓገለ፡ እመሂ፡ ሥዩመ፡ አጽቢ፧ ወእመሂ፡ ሥዩመ፡ ጽራዕ፡ ወእመሂ፡ ሥዩመ፡ እንደርታ፧ አው፡ ስዩመ፡ ሰሐርት፧ ወሥዩመ፡ ዋጅራት፧ ውጉዝ፡ ለይኩን፡ ‘S’il se trouve quelqu’un qui viole ou opprime ces 7 pays, qu’il s’agisse du chef d’Aṣbi, ou du chef de Ṣerāʿ, ou du chef de l’Endartā, ou du chef du Saḥart, ou du chef du Wāǧerāt, maudit soit-il’ 50 l. 16–19 (ed.), 60 l. 18–21 (tr.), vid. ጽራዕ፡ д ሥዩመ፡ ጸድያ፡ śǝyuma ṣadyā (title) chief of Ṣadyā ወሥዩመ፡ ጸድያ፡ ወሥዩመ፡ ዘንጒ፡ ዘላዕል፡ ወዘታሕት፡... አሕረምነ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይባኡ። ‘au chef de Ṣadyā, au chef du haut et du bas Zongui, …, nous avons défendu d’[y] entrer [dans les fiefs susdits]’ 40 l. 7–8, l. 11 (ed.), 47 l. 18–20, l. 23 (tr.), vid. ጸድያ፡ G ሥዩም፡ śǝyum, Pl. ሥዩማን፡ śǝyumān «prépose, préfet, administrateur, employé, quiconque est en charge» ― ሹም፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 53v. ሥይምት፡ śǝyǝmt fem., Pl. ሥዩማት፡ śǝyumāt «(idem au féminin)» ― ሴት፡ ሹም፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 54r. 135 L ሥዩም፡ śǝyyum (Pl. ሥዩማን፡ śǝyyumān, ሠየምት፡ śayyamt) pass. part. of vid. ሤመ śema; also appointee, official, governor, prefect, one who is on charge (of) 540a

woorden.betekenis: tinctura, śǝryat, śeryat, teinte, action de teindre, teintur
woorden.definitie: n. act. tinctura Ex. 25,5; Ex. 35,23 c. śǝryat, ሤርየት፡ śeryat G ሤርየት፡ śeryat «teinte, action de teindre, teinture» ― ማለል፡, መታለል፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 51v. 128 L ሥርየት śǝryat, (128) ሤርየት śeryat dyeing (n), (, *) soiling 536b

woorden.betekenis: vendere, negotiatio, emporium, mercari, iter longum fecit, ś
woorden.definitie: I,1 [amh. ሼጠ፡ et ሸጠ፡ vendere; copt. ϣⲱⲧ negotiatio, emporium; ⲉϣⲱⲧ mercari; Ges. in thes. p. 1378 hoc verbum cum شَوَّطَ iter longum fecit et שׁוּט conjungendum proposuit.] Subj. ይሢጥ፡ (mercaturam facere), vendere: ዘይሠይጥ፡ ὁ πολῶν Hez. 7,12; Jes. 24,2; ሠይጥ፡ ወተሣይጦ፡ Apoc. 13,17; Kuf. 50; c. Acc. mercis Gen. 31,15; Gen. 42,1; Kuf. 11; Jes. 48,10; Jes. 50,1; Zach. 11,5; Tob. 1,7; Matth. 13,46; Matth. 18,25; c. በ፡ pretii Hebr. 12,16; Act. 5,8; Am. 2,6; Joel 4,3; Nah. 3,4; c. ኀበ፡ emtoris: Lev. 25,14; Joel 4,6; Gen. 37,27; Gen. 37,28; Gen. 37,36; vel c. ለ፡ emtoris Gen. 41,56; Lev. 25,15; F.N. 33,4; Jsp. p. 329; vel c. dupl. Acc. (aliquid alicui) Lev. 25,25. – Ex hebraismo: vendere aliquem in potestatem alicujus: 1 Reg. 23,7 (alias: አግብአ፡). – Sir. 20,12 habet Graecus ἀγοράζων πολλὰ ὀλίγου, Aethiops ቦ፡ ዘይሠይጥ፡ ብዙኀ፡ በኅዳጥ፡, sed vereor, ne ይሣየጥ፡ legendum sit. śeṭa G ሤጠ፡ śeṭa I,1 ይሠይጥ፡, ይሢጥ፡ «vendre» ― ሸጠ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 54r. 136 L śyṭ, ሤጠ śeṭa (yǝśiṭ) sell 540b

woorden.betekenis: vendi, Tradi in potestatem, taśayṭa, tasayṭa, être vendu, be
woorden.definitie: III,1 vendi Ps. 104,16; Hez. 48,14; Ex. 22,2; Lev. 25,23; Lev. 25,34; 4 Reg. 17,17 (ubi Perf. ተሠየጠ፡ in cod. S); Infin. ተሠይጥ፡ Lev. 25,33; c. በ፡ pretii: Matth. 10,29; 4 Reg. 7,16; Thren. 4,2; ጥበብ፡ ኢትሠየጥ፡ በወርቀ፡ ኦፌር፡ Job 28,16; Job 28,19; c. ለ፡ vel ኀበ፡ emtoris ዕብራዊ፡ ዘተሠይጠ፡ ለከ፡ Jes. 41,14; Lev. 25,39; Deut. 15,12. Tradi in potestatem alicujus: ተሠየጥነ፡ ለሞት፡ ወለተበርብሮ፡ ἐπράθημεν εἰς ἀπώλειαν Esth. 7,4. taśayṭa, ተሰይጠ tasayṭa G ተሠይጠ፡ taśayṭa III,1 ይሠየጥ፡ «être vendu» ― ተሸጠ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 54r. 136 L ተሠይጠ taśayṭa, () ተሰይጠ tasayṭa be sold, be valued 540b

woorden.betekenis: mercari, emere, redimere, mercaturam facere, mercabor a te,
woorden.definitie: III,3 1 mercari, emere aliquid ab aliquo: ዘይሠይጥ፡ ከመ፡ ዘይሣየጥ፡ Jes. 24,2; Jes. 55,1; ዘተሣየጠ፡ ὁ κτώμενος Hez. 7,12; በእንተ፡ ተሣይጦ፡ ወሠይጥ፡ F.N. 33; c. Acc. mercis: Gen. 23,4; Gen. 39,1; Gen. 42,3; Gen. 43,2; Jer. 39,7; Jer. 39,44; Prov. 29,34; Matth. 13,46; c. ለ፡ ejus, cui emitur: Apoc. 5,9; Matth. 14,15; Gen. 42,2; Jer. 13,1; Jer. 19,1; ኢተሣየጥከ፡ ሊተ፡ በወርቅ፡ ዕጣነ፡ Jes. 43,24; Hez. 5,1; c. በ፡ pretii Gen. 17,12; Gen. 17,23; Jes. 43,24; c. እምነ፡ vel በኀበ፡ (እምኀበ፡) ejus a quo emitur: Gen. 23,9; Gen. 23,19; Gen. 25,10; Lev. 25,14; 2 Reg. 24,21. Nonnumquam: redimere 2 Esr. 15,8; Prov. 24,11. 2 mercaturam facere (in genere), sive emendo sive vendendo, c. dupl. Acc.: ይሁዳ፡ ወእስራኤል፡ ሠየጥኪ፡ ወይሣየጡኪ፡ (v. ይሠይጡ፡ ለኪ፡) ሥርናየ፡ ἔμποροί σου ἐν πράσει σίτου Hez. 27,17; በዘ፡ ይሣየጡኪ፡ ተግባረኪ፡ ἐν οἷς ἐμπορεύονταί σε Hez. 27,21; በሤጥ፡ ብዙኅ፡ እሣየጠከ፡ (mercabor a te) 1 Par. 21,24; በከንቱ፡ ተሣየጥኩክሙ፡ non vendidi (quamquam hic de lectione dubitare licet) Jes. 52,3. taśāyaṭa, ተሳየጠ፡ tasāyaṭa G ተሣየጠ፡ taśāyaṭa III,3 ይሣየጥ፡ «acheter» ― ገዛ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 54r. 136 L ተሣየጠ taśāyaṭa, () ተሳየጠ tasāyaṭa buy back, sell among themselves, trade, practice trade 540b

woorden.betekenis: renditus, id quod venditum est, śǝyuṭ, śǝyyuṭ, śǝyyǝṭ, śǝyuṭ
woorden.definitie: part. renditus, ut: ዮሴፍ፡ ሥዩጥ፡ Cod. Mus. Brit. LIV, 7; ሥዩጥ፡ id quod venditum est F.N. 33,6; አንሰ፡ ሥዩጥ፡ ለኀጢአት፡ Rom. 7,14. ሥዩጥ፡ śǝyuṭ, śǝyyuṭ, ሥይጥ፡ śǝyyǝṭ, fem. ሥዩጥ፡ śǝyuṭṭ; Pl. ሥዩጣን፡ śǝyuṭān, fem. ሥዩጣት፡ śǝyuṭāt G ሥዩጥ፡ śǝyuṭ, Pl. ሥዩጣን፡ śǝyuṭān «vendu» ― የተሸጠ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 54v. ሥዩጥ፡ śǝyuṭṭ fem., Pl. ሥዩጣት፡ śǝyuṭāt «vendu» ― የተሸጠች፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 54v. 136 L ሥዩጥ śǝyyuṭ, (KG) ሥይጥ፡ śǝyyǝṭ sold 540b

woorden.betekenis: mercatura, emtio et venditio, merx, pretium, pretiosus, pret
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., 1 mercatura, emtio et venditio; nonnumquam etiam id quod emitur vel venditur, merx: ማእከለ፡ ሤጥ፡ ወተግባር፡ ἀνὰ μέσον πράσεως καὶ ἀγορασμοῦ Sir. 27,2; ὁδοιπόρων Sir. 42,3; Jsp. p. 342; πρᾶσις 2 Esr. 20,31; 2 Esr. 23,20; (ego sum) ሤጠ፡ ደመ፡ ኢየሱስ፡ ክርስቶስ፡ Org. 4. Sed imprimis: id quo emitur vel venditur i.e. 2 pretium Gen. 31,15; Lev. 5,15; 1 Reg. 13,21; ወሀቦ፡ ሤጦ፡ ለውእቱ፡ መካን፡ 1 Par. 21,25; Jsp. p. 312,c; (si quis pignus perdidit, restituat) ሤጠ፡ ዚአሁ፡ F.N. 27; ወርቀ፡ ሤጥ፡ ἀργύριον πράσεως Lev. 25,50; Lev. 25,51; Lev. 27,3-8; πολυτελής pretiosus: ዘብዙኅ፡ ሤጡ፡ Job 31,24; Prov. 3,15; Jes. 28,16; Judith 10,21; Matth. 13,46; Marc. 14,3; በሤጥ፡ pretio (soluto) Gen. 23,9; Thren. 5,4; ዘበሤጥ፡ ἀργυρώνητος Ex. 12,44; Judith 4,10; ዘእንበለ፡ ሤጥ፡ ἄνευ τιμῆς (pretio non soluto, gratis) Ps. 43,14; Job 31,39; Sir. 51,25; Clem. f. 225. Nonnumquam: sumtus, impensae, ut: ሤጠ፡ ግንዘት፡ arbitria funeris F.N. 42. śeṭ G ሤጥ፡ śeṭ «prix» ― ዋጋ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 54v. 136 L ሤጥ śeṭ sale, value, evaluation, price, cost, purchase ሤጠ śeṭ-a in return for ሤጠ፡ አምሳሊሁ śeṭa ʾamsālihu its equivalent price, vid. አምሳል ዘብዙኅ፡ ሤጡ za-bǝzuḫ śeṭ-u precious lit. ‘whose price is high’ 540b

woorden.betekenis: emporium, forum, qui in foro versantur, mercatus, nundinae,
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem.; Pl. ምሥያጣት፡ 1 emporium, forum: ረሰዩኪ፡ ምሥያጠ፡ Hez. 27,16; ወሀቡ፡ ውስተ፡ ምሥያጥኪ፡ Hez. 27,12; አብቅለ፡ አምጽኡ፡ ውስተ፡ ምሥያጥኪ፡ Hez. 27,14; Hez. 27,22; ውስተ፡ ምሥያጥ፡ Tob. 2,3; Matth. 11,16 Platt; Matth. 20,3; ምሥያጣት፡ Koh. 12,4; Cant. 3,2; 1 Esr. 2,17; Marc. 6,56; Matth. 23,7; ሰብአ፡ ምሥያጥ፡ οἱ ἀγοραῖοι (qui in foro versantur) Chrys. ho. 1; ዘተሣየጠ፡ መብልዐ፡ እምሥያጥ፡ F.M. 32,1; ዛቲ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ ይመስል፡ ምሥያጠ፡ ወኵሎ፡ ዘኀለይከ፡ ትረክብ፡ በኀቤሃ፡ Phlx. in Epilogo. 2 mercatus, nundinae: ተጸርዐ፡ ሤጥ፡ ወምሥያጥ፡ Jsp. p. 342; ህየ፡ ይገብሩ፡ ምሥያጠ፡ (πρᾶσιν) 2 Esr. 23,20. 3 munusculum in nundinis dari solitum: (peto a te) ምሥያጠ፡ በከመ፡ ይስእል፡ ወልድ፡ ኀበ፡ አቡሁ፡ Lud. ex Org. Edz. – Voc. Ae.: ምሥያጥ፡ ዘ፡ ገበያ። mǝśyāṭ, ምስያጥ፡ mǝsyāṭ,Pl. mǝśyāṭāt G ምሥያጥ፡ mǝśyāṭ, Pl. ምሥያጣት፡ mǝśyāṭāt «marché (place)» ― ገበያ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 54v. 137 L ምሥያጥ፡ mǝśyāṭ, () ምስያጥ፡ mǝsyāṭ market, marketplace 540b

woorden.betekenis: intercalare, Judaei, ʾaśgara, ʾaśaggara, faire courir, faire
woorden.definitie: II,1 et አሠገረ፡ II,2 intercalare, c. Acc. diei vel mensis, Abush. crebro, ut: Judaei ለለ፫ዓም፡ ያሠግሩ፡ ፩ወርኀ፡ ወትከውኖሙ፡ ይእቲ፡ ዓመት፡ ፲ወ፫ ወርኀ፡ Abush. 3. ʾaśgara, አሠገረ፡ ʾaśaggara G አሠገረ፡ ʾaśaggara II,2 ያሤግር፡, ያሠግር፡ «faire courir, faire accélérer le pas» ― አራመደ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 54v. 137 L አሥገረ ʾaśgara, አሠገረ ʾaśaggara causative of vid. ሠገረ śaggara; also insert by skipping a day or a month in the count of years or holidays 526b

woorden.betekenis: gressus, passus, mǝśgār, maśāgǝr, step, means of crossing ov
woorden.definitie: subst. gressus, passus: (stadiodromus) ዘይረውጽ፡ ኢይኔጽር፡ ኀበ፡ ምሥጋሪሁ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ዳእሙ፡ ኀበ፡ ዕሤቱ፡ Chrys. ho. 7; ዘኢይክል፡ ይትሐወስ፡ ወኢየሐውር፡ አሐተ፡ ምሥጋረ፡ Sap. 13,18. Est nomen mensurae sive spatii, vel ምሥጋረ፡ እግር፡ vel ምሥጋር፡ per se passus F.N. 37; Herm. p. 20; Act. 7,5 rom.; Deut. 2,5; Chrys. ho. 25. mǝśgār, Pl. መሣግር፡ maśāgǝr L ምሥጋር፡ mǝśgār (Pl. መሣግር፡ maśāgǝr) step, means of crossing over, means of taking a step 526b

woorden.betekenis: laqueus, tendicula, plaga, rete, sagena, hamus, insidiis, vi
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. መሣግር፡, raro መሣግርት፡ (ut Chrys. Ta. 34) et መሥገርታት፡ (ut Phlx. 152) 1 laqueus, tendicula, plaga, rete, sagena, hamus: παγίς መሥገርት፡ ጽኑዕ፡ Prov. 6,2; Prov. 22,5; Koh. 9,12; ትወርድ፡ እግሩ፡ ውስተ፡ መሥገርት፡ Job 18,8; Sir. 27,26; Sir. 27,29; Ps. 9,16; Ps. 9,33; Ps. 30,5; Ps. 34,9; Ps. 90,3; Ps. 123,5; Ps. 139,5; Ps. 139,6; Jes. 8,14; Jes. 24,17; Jes. 42,22; ሠርዑ፡ መሣግረ፡ ይቅትሉ፡ ሰብአ፡ Jer. 5,26; Jer. 31,43; Jer. 31,44; Hos. 5,1; እወዲ፡ መሥገርተ፡ ውስተ፡ መላትሒኪ፡ Hez. 29,4; θήρευμα Koh. 7,26; δίκτυον Ex. 27,4; Thren. 1,13; Hos. 5,1; Hos. 7,12; መሥገርት፡ ለአዕዋፍ፡ Prov. 1,17; Matth. 4,20; Marc. 1,18; Joh. 21,6; ἀμφίβληστρον Hab. 1,17; Marc. 1,16; σαγήνη ይረብቡ፡ መሣግሪሆሙ፡ ማእከለ፡ ባሕር፡ Hez. 26,5; Hez. 47,10; Hab. 1,15; βρόχοι Prov. 22,25; ἄγκιστρον 4 Reg. 19,28; Job 40,20; Jes. 19,8; Hab. 1,15; መሥገርተ፡ ገሪፍ፡ Org. 3. Nonnumquam tropice pro insidiis: ዐገተከ፡ መሣግር፡ (παγίδες) Job 22,10; ከመ፡ ኢትደቅ፡ ውስተ፡ መሥገርታ፡ Sir. 9,3; Sir. 9,13. 2 raro: vinculum, catena, ut Hen. 56,1. 3 vox architectonica: opus reticulatum 2 Par. 4,12; Jer. 52,22 (שְׂבָכָה). – Voc. Ae.: መሥገርት፡ ዘ፡ መጽመጃ። maśgart, መስገርት masgart, Pl. maśāgǝr, maśāgǝrt, maśgartāt G መሥገርት፡ maśgart, Pl. መሣግር፡ maśāgǝr «filet, lacs, trappe, souririère, piêge, embûche» ― ወጥመድ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 54v. 137 L መሥገርት maśgart, Pl. መሣግር maśāgǝr, መሣግርት maśāgǝrt, () መስገርት masgart snare, trap, fishhook, net, network, trellis, fetters, ambush 527a ረበበ፡ መርበብተ rababa marbabta or ረበበ፡ መሥገርተ rababa maśgarta cast a net, vid. ረበበ፡, መርበብት፡ 460b

woorden.betekenis: caro, carneus, verbum, caro factum est, consanguineos, puden
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., Pl. (signif. 2) ሥጋት፡ (ሥግዋት፡ habet Joh. 19,31 editio rom. 1 caro, α vivi corporis σάρξ, σάρκες: Gen. 41,2; Gen. 41,19; Lev. 13,10; ሥጋ፡ ነፍስትከ፡ Prov. 5,11; Job 41,14; አልበሰክሙ፡ ሥጋ፡ Hez. 37,5; የኀልቅ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ Job 33,21; Job 33,25; ሥጋየ፡ ወማእስየ፡ Thren. 3,4; ሥጋ፡ ወዐጽም፡ Luc. 24,39; ሥጋ፡ ወደም፡ Matth. 16,17; Hebr. 2,14; Joh. 6,51; Joh. 6,52; ይበልዑ፡ ሥጋ፡ አዋልዲሆሙ፡ σάρκας Jer. 19,9; Mich. 3,3; Apoc. 19,18. β pecudis, quae comeditur, κρέας, κρέατα: Jes. 22,13; Jes. 44,16; Jes. 44,19; Jer. 7,21; Dan. 7,5; Dan. 10,3; ይበልዑ፡ ሥጋ፡ ሐራውያ፡ Jes. 65,4; Ex. 16,12; Lev. 7,15 seq.; Rom. 14,21; 1 Cor. 8,13. Nota a carneus: ዘሥጋ፡, ut: ልብ፡ ዘሥጋ፡ Hez. 11,19; 2 Par. 32,8 እለ፡ ሥጋ፡ 2 Cor. 3,3. b opponitur numini divino, et homines cunctaque animantia complectitur respectu debilitatis et fragilitatis: እስመ፡ ሥጋ፡ እሙንቱ፡ Kuf. 5; Ps. 77,44; ወልደ፡ ሥጋ፡ Asc. Jes. 11,34; hoc sensu fere ubique: ዘሥጋ፡ carneus adhibitum invenies: ኵሉ፡ ዘሥጋ፡ πᾶσα σάρξ Gen. 6,17; Gen. 7,15; Gen. 7,21; Kuf. 3; Job 34,15; Jes. 40,6; Jes. 66,24; አምላክ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ዘሥጋ፡ Jer. 39,27; Num. 18,15; ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘሥጋ፡ Joel 3,1; Ps. 64,2; Ps. 144,22; ፈረስ፡ ዘሥጋ፡ Jes. 31,3; ዘሥጋ፡ ወደም፡ Sir. 17,31; 1 Cor. 15,50; at: ሥጋ፡ ኮነ፡ (verbum) caro factum est Joh. 1,14. c opponitur animo et spiritui, et naturam hominis significat corpoream, in specie quatenus in ea peccatum nititur: Koh. 2,3; Col. 2,1; 1 Petr. 4,2; Eph. 6,5; Hebr. 5,7; Hebr. 12,9; Matth. 26,41; Joh. 1,13; Joh. 8,15; Rom. 8,1 seq.; Gal. 3,3. d opponitur mortuis: እለ፡ ይረክቦሙ፡ በሥጋ፡ Asc. Jes. 4,15; Asc. Jes. 4,16; Hebr. 5,7. e ubi pron. suff. subjuncta habet, nonnumquam consanguineos significat: ሰብኡ፡ ወሥጋሁ፡ Lev. 18,6; Lev. 25,49; Gen. 29,14; Jud. 9,2 coll. Eph. 5,29 et Matth. 19,5; Matth. 19,6. f verecundiae causa usurpatur pro pudendis: Gen. 17,23; Gen. 17,25; Gen. 34,24 (quamquam ነፍስት፡ magis usitatum est); ተንሥአ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ (libidine exarsit) Lud. sine auct.; { Kedr f. 63 vid. sub አንሳሕስሐ፡ col. 328}. 2 corpus σῶμα a vivum: Gen. 47,18; Lev. 6,3; Lev. 14,9; Ps. 39,9; Job 20,25; Dan. 3,27; Dan. 4,30; Matth. 6,22; Matth. 10,28; 1 Cor. 6,18; 1 Cor. 7,34; 1 Cor. 15,40; 1 Cor. 15,44; Jac. 3,3; Hebr. 13,11; ዐቃቤ፡ ሥጋ፡ custos corporis 1 Reg. 28,2; በሥጋ፡ መዋቲ፡ 4 Esr. 1,5; ሥጋ፡ መዋቲት፡ Lit. Chrys.; ሥጋት፡ corpora Chrys. ho. 6. Translate: ፩ሥጋ፡ ንሕነ፡ በክርስቶስ፡ Rom. 12,5; 1 Cor. 6,16; 1 Cor. 10,17; 1 Cor. 12,27; Eph. 1,23; Eph. 4,4. Singularis videtur usus vocis Kuf. p. 29 ሥጋ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡ corpus altaris. b mortuum, cadaver Deut. 21,23; Joh. 19,31; Judae 9; ግድፍ፡ ሥጋየ፡ ላዕለ፡ ሥጋቲሆሙ፡ Jsp. p. 367; in resurrectione ይትጋብኡ፡ ሥጋት፡ እለ፡ ኮኑ፡ ከመ፡ ጸበል፡ Clem. f. 157; truncus decollati Sx. Mij. 18 Enc. śǝgā, Pl. ሥጋት፡ śǝgāt G ሥጋ፡ śǝgā, Pl. ሥጋት፡ śǝgāt «chair, viande, corps» ― ሥጋ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 55r. 138 L ሥጋ śǝgā flesh, meat, the flesh as opposed to the spirit, body, corps ዘሥጋ za-śǝgā of flesh, carnal, sensual ሥጋሁ፡ ወደሙ śǝgā-hu wa-damu Eucharist, lit. ‘his flesh and his blood’, vid. ደም፡ 526a C a for ባሕርየ፡ ሥጋ፡ vid. ባሕርይ፡ (Leslau) b for ኅፍረተ፡ ሥጋ፡ vid. ኀፍረት፡ (Leslau)

woorden.betekenis: separandi, disgregandi, scindere, discindere, divellere, dir
woorden.definitie: I,1 [vic. ሠጠቀ፡ q.v. et شَظِيَ; arab. شَثَّ, شَذَّ, شَظَّ separandi et disgregandi significatum habent] Subj. ይሥጥጥ፡ 1 scindere, discindere, divellere, dirumpere, vestem Gen. 37,29; Lev. 10,6; Lev. 21,10; Job 1,20; Job 2,12; Koh. 3,7; Esth. 4,1; Judith 14,16; Jes. 37,1; Jer. 43,24; Joel 2,13; Hez. 44,21; 2 Esr. 9,3; Matth. 26,65; Joh. 19,24; ኢትሥጥጥ፡ ልብሰተ፡ ሥጋዌሁ፡ Cyr. f. 121; litteras Job 31,37; እሠጥጥ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ኀጣውኢከ፡ Sx. Haml. 8; aquam maris Ex. 14,21; ventrem alicujus: ሠጠጡ፡ ከርሦ፡ Jsp. p. 370. 2 abscindere, avellere 1 Reg. 15,28; 1 Reg. 28,17; Hez. 13,20. – Voc. Ae.: ሠጠጠ፡ ዘ፡ ቀጠጠ፡ v. ቀደደ፡

woorden.betekenis: scindi, dsicindi, dirumpi
woorden.definitie: III,1 pass. et refl. scindi, dsicindi, dirumpi, de veste 1 Reg. 15,27; velo Matth. 27,51; Marc. 15,38; Clem. f. 218; nube: ኢይሠጠጥ፡ ደመናሁ፡ በታሕቴሁ፡ Job 26,8; terra Num. 16,31 (v. ተሠጥቀ፡); utre vini Jos. 9,11; fontibus abyssi Gen. 7,11 (v. ተሠጥቀ፡); aqua lacus Hen. 89,24; stellis 4 Esr. 3,10.

woorden.betekenis: scissus, ruptus, lacer
woorden.definitie: part. scissus, ruptus, lacer: ሥጡጥ፡ አልባሲሁ፡ 1 Reg. 4,12; 2 Reg. 1,2; Jes. 36,22; Jer. 48,5; 4 Esr. 9,39; ዝቅ፡ ሥጡጥ፡ Jos. 9,2; ሥጡጥ፡ መታክፉ፡ በሰይፍ፡ Sx. Ter 2Enc.; ይለብስ፡ ሥጡጠ፡ ወአጽርቅተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ነዋሚ፡ Prov. 23,21.

woorden.betekenis: litera alphabeti Aethiopici sexta, quae ርእስ፡ appel
woorden.definitie: litera alphabeti Aethiopici sexta, quae ርእስ፡ appellatur.

woorden.betekenis: i.q. ረሐነ፡ q.v.
woorden.definitie: i.q. ረሐነ፡ q.v.

woorden.betekenis: procul abesse, remotum esse, distare, longinquum esse, spati
woorden.definitie: I,1 [i.q. רָחַק ܪܚܶܩ; amh. ራቀ፡] Subj. ይርሐቅ፡, Imperat. ረሐቅ፡ 1 procul abesse, remotum esse, distare, c.c. እምነ፡ Gen. 44,4; Jos. 8,4; Jud. 18,22; Ps. 102,12; Jes. 55,9; ርሕቀ፡ እምኔየ፡ ረድኤቱ፡ Job 6,13; ርሕቀ፡ ጽድቅ፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ Jes. 59,9; Ps. 17,25; ነዋኀ፡ ይርሕቁ፡ እምኔየ፡ Jes. 29,13; ርሕቀ፡ አምላክ፡ እምኔየ፡ Jes. 40,27; Ps. 70,13; Thren. 1,16; ቅብዕ፡ እምርእስከ፡ ኢይርሐቅ፡ Koh. 9,8; de tempore: longinquum esse: ኢይርሕቅ፡ ኵሉ፡ ቃልየ፡ οὐ μὴ μηκύνωσι Hez. 12,28. Nota: ርሕቀ፡ ምሕዋረ፡ ሠሉስ፡ ማእከሌሆሙ፡ spatium tridui inter eos interjectum Gen. 30,36. 2 longe recedere, discedere, desistere: ረሐቁ፡ ረሐቁ፡ ወፃኡ፡ እምህየ፡ Jes. 52,11; ረሐቅ፡ እምኔየ፡ πόρρω ἀπ᾽ ἐμοῦ Jes. 65,5; Job 21,14; Hen. 14,23; Hen. 94,2; ይርሕቁ፡ እምኔየ፡ Job 30,10; Ps. 21,11; Prov. 9,18; Sir. 9,13; Sir. 22,13; Luc. 13,27. Nonnumquam pron. suff. huic verbo subjunctum invenies, ut: ኢይርሐቀ፡ ne tibi i.e. a te discedat Prov. 3,3; ኢትጐንዲ፡ ርሒቆቶ፡ Sir. 13,10. a recedere ab aliquo i.e. eum missum facere: ረሐቅ፡ እምኔሁ፡ Job 14,6. b deficere ab aliquo: 2 Par. 21,8; እምእግዚአብሔር፡ ይርሕቅ፡ ልቡ፡ Jer. 17,5; Jer. 39,40; Ps. 118,150. c abstinere, desistere a consuetudine: 1 Thess. 4,3; Hen. 104,6; ረሐቂ፡ እምዐመፃ፡ Jes. 54,14. rǝḥqa G ርሕቀ፡ rǝḥqa I,1 ይርሕቅ፡, ይርሐቅ፡ «s’éloigner» ― ራቀ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 55v. 142 L ርሕቀ rǝḥqa (yǝrḥaq) be far off, be distant, go some distance (from), go far, keep away, be remote, depart, abstain, desist (from), withdraw, recoil 467a

woorden.betekenis: remotus, longinquus, distans, alienus a, alienus irae, tardu
woorden.definitie: part. et adj. remotus, longinquus, distans: ርሑቅ፡ ብሔር፡ Jes. 13,5; Jes. 43,6; ርሑቅ፡ ፍኖት፡ 1 Reg. 26,13; Num. 9,10; Deut. 14,24; Deut. 29,21; Ps. 64,6; Luc. 15,13; Luc. 19,12; Joh. 21,8; ርሑቀ፡ ቆመ፡ እምኔነ፡ Jes. 59,11; ርሑቃን፡ ወቅሩባን፡ Jes. 57,19; Eph. 2,13; Eph. 2,17; Act. 22,21 Platt; c.c. እምነ፡ Jos. 9,20; Koh. 7,23; Sir. 15,8; Deut. 13,8; Ps. 21,1; Ps. 118,155; et per st. constr., ut: ዘቅሩብኪ፡ ወዘርሑቅኪ፡ Hez. 22,5. a rarius de tempore, ut Hen. 1,2; ሳዐ፡ ሞቱ፡ ርሑቅ፡ Sx. Hed. 3Enc.; (alias ነዋኅ፡). b de gradibus cognationis et affinitatis: ርሑቃን፡ አዝማድ፡ (opp. ቅሩባን፡) F.N. 42,2. c alienus a re: ርሑቅ፡ እምፍትወተ፡ ሥጋ፡ Sx. Mij. 28 Enc.; ርሑቀ፡ መዐት፡ alienus irae, tardus ad iram μακρόθυμος Ex. 34,6; Joel 2,13; Ps. 85,14. d ርሑቀ፡ longe, procul Ex. 20,18; Ex. 20,21; እኍ፡ ዘርሑቀ፡ የኀድር፡ Prov. 27,10; Matth. 8,30. e እምርሑቅ፡ e longinquo, procul, eminus Kuf. 18; Job 2,11; Job 36,3; Job 39,29; ይትዐወቅ፡ እምርሑቅ፡ Sir. 21,7; Jes. 10,3; Jes. 33,13; Jes. 49,12; Jes. 60,4; Ps. 9,22; Ps. 137,7; Marc. 5,6; Marc. 8,3; Marc. 11,13; Marc. 14,54; Apoc. 18,15. f እስከ፡ ርሑቅ፡ usque in longinquum vel በርሑቅ፡ in longinquo 2 Esr. 22,43. rǝḥuq, fem. ርሕቅት፡ rǝḥǝqt; Pl. ርሑቃን፡ rǝḥuqān, fem. ርሑቃት፡ rǝḥuqāt G ርሑቅ፡ rǝḥuq, Pl. ርሑቃን፡ rǝḥuqān «éloigné» ― ሩቅ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 55v. 142 ርሕቅት፡ rǝḥǝqt fem., Pl. ርሑቃት፡ rǝḥuqāt «éloignée» ― ሩቅ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 55v. 142 L ርሑቅ፡ rǝḥuq far, far away, distant, remote, one who keeps away እምርሑቅ ʾǝmrǝḥuq from a distance, from afar እስከ፡ ርሑቅ ʾǝska rǝḥuq to a distance ርሑቀ፡ መዐት rǝḥuqa maʿat long-suffering, slow to anger, vid. መዐት፡ ርሑቀ rǝḥuqa adv. far, far off, at a distance 467a C for ርሑቀ፡ መዐት፡ vid. መዐት፡

woorden.betekenis: amplum, latum, spatiosum esse, fieri, dilatari, rǝḥba, s’éla
woorden.definitie: I,1 [רָחַב رَحِبَ رَحُبَ] Subj. ይርሐብ፡ amplum, latum, spatiosum esse vel fieri, dilatari: ርሕበት፡ አረፍተ፡ ባቢሎን፡ Jer. 28,58; ከመ፡ ይርሐብ፡ እምላዕሉ፡ Hez. 41,7; 1 Reg. 2,1; Org. 1; transl. de Israele: Deut. 32,15. rǝḥba G ርሕበ፡ rǝḥba I,1 ይርሕብ፡, ይርሐብ፡ «s’élargir, s’amplifier» ― ሰፋ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 55v. 142 L ርሕበ rǝḥba (yǝrḥab), () ርኅበ፡ rǝḫba be wide, be large, be broad, be ample, be spacious, be extensive 466a

woorden.betekenis: locus amplus, spatium amplum, planities, platea, vicus, marḥ
woorden.definitie: subst., Pl. መራሕብት፡ 1 locus amplus, spatium amplum, planities πλατυσμός Ps. 17,20; 2 Reg. 22,37; Sir. 48,12; Herm. p. 1; εὐρυχωρία Gen. 26,22; 4 Esr. 5,3; 4 Esr. 5,18; 4 Esr. 5,19 (opp. መጽብብ፡). 2 platea, vicus πλατεῖα Gen. 19,2; Jud. 19,15; Jud. 19,17; Esth. 4,1; Esth. 6,9; Esth. 6,11; Tob. 13,17; Koh. 12,4; Koh. 12,5; Jes. 15,3; Jer. 5,1; Jer. 9,21; Jer. 27,30; Jer. 30,15; Jer. 31,38; Thren. 2,12; Hez. 26,11; Hez. 28,23; Am. 5,11; Zach. 8,4; Zach. 8,5; Job 29,7; Matth. 6,5; Jsp. p. 343; Jsp. p. 379. marḥǝb, marāḥǝbt G መርሕብ፡ marḥǝb, Pl. መራሕብት፡ marāḥǝbt «place publique, lieu large» ― አደባባይ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 56r. 143 L መርሕብ marḥǝb (Pl. መራሕብት marāḥǝbt), () መርህብ marhǝb large plot of land, plain, wide place, public place, forum, square, market place, street, quarter, arena 466a

woorden.betekenis: lavit, sudavit, sudore manare, copiosius sudare, rǝḥḍa, rǝhḍ
woorden.definitie: vel ረሐፀ፡ I,1 [arab. رَخَضَ lavit; pass. sudavit copiosius sub finem febris; רָחַץ lavit; vic. ርሕሰ፡ q.v. et رَشَحَ] sudore manare, copiosius sudare: ይርሕፁ፡ አፍራስ፡ (quibus ille vehi solebat) እምጽንዐ፡ ኀይሉ፡ Gad. T.H.; ወረሐፀት፡ (v. ወርሕፀት፡) ነፍሱ፡ ለንጉሠ፡ ሶርያ፡ ἐξεκινήθη (de sudore anxietatis) 4 Reg. 6,11. rǝḥḍa, ርህፀ፡ rǝhḍa G ርሕፀ፡ rǝḥḍa I,1 ይርሕፅ፡, ይርሐፅ፡ «asperger, arroser, suer» ― ረጨ፡, አለበወ፡, (= ርሕፀ፡), ወዛ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 56r. 143 L ርሕፀ rǝḥḍa, ረሐፀ raḥaḍa (yǝrḥaḍ), () ርህፀ፡ rǝhḍa sweat, perspire, (*) wash, soak; (note that ‘raḥaḍat’ or ‘raḥḍat nafsu’ of 4 Kings 6:11 is connected by 274 with this root, but it is perhaps to be derived from vid. ርኅጸ rǝḫṣa, rǝḥṣa ‘be disturbed’ 466b

woorden.betekenis: tacere, conticescere, silere, silentium, tacite exspectare,
woorden.definitie: II,1 A intransit. 1 tacere, conticescere, silere, { σιωπᾶν} Job 16,6; Job 18,3; Thren. 2,10; ሀሎ፡ ዘያረምም፡ እንዘ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ውእቱ፡ Sir. 20,1; Sir. 20,5; Sir. 20,6; Jes. 36,21; Jes. 42,14; Jes. 62,1; Jes. 64,12; እንበለ፡ አርምሞትኪ፡ Cant. 4,1; 4 Reg. 7,9; Matth. 20,31; { σιγᾶν} ባዕል፡ ለእመ፡ ነበበ፡ ኵሉ፡ ያረምም፡ Sir. 13,23; Sir. 20,7; Ps. 82,1; Koh. 3,7; አርምሚ፡ Tob. 10,6; አርመመ፡ ኵሉ፡ σιγὴ ἐγένετο Apoc. 8,1; 1 Cor. 14,34; Luc. 9,36; Luc. 20,26; praeterea: አርመመ፡ ስብሐቲነ፡ 4 Esr. 10,29; ከመ፡ እጸመም፡ ወኣርምም፡ Job 13,19; አፉሁ፡ ያረምም፡ Asc. Jes. 6,11; παύεσθαι Job 18,2; አርምም፡ Kuf. 12; Job 21,3; ይሴብሑከ፡ መላእክት፡ በኢያርምሞ፡ Kid. f. 16; de fluctibus: አርመመ፡ ማዕበል፡ Ps. 106,29; አርምሞ፡ silentium Lit. 173,4. a c.c. እምነ፡, ut: አርመመት፡ እንከ፡ እምባርኮ፡ Kuf. 25; አርምሞ፡ እምጋእዝ፡ Prov. 20,3 var.; አርመመ፡ ጦቢት፡ እምኀበ፡ ይጼሊ፡ Tob. 14,1. b c. እንዘ፡, ut: ኢታረምም፡ እንዘ፡ ትበክዮ፡ Tob. 10,7. c c. ለ፡ i.e. vel tacite exspectare: ታረምም፡ ለመድኀኒተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Thren. 3,26; vel tacite ferre aliquem, non obstare ei: Ps. 49,21; Apoc. 2,20. d cum silentio praeterire παρόψεται Job 11,11. 2 silere, quiescere, quietum et tranquillum se tenere, ἡσυχάζειν Job 3,26; Job 32,1; Job 32,7; ኢያረምም፡ ወኢያዐርፍ፡ Ruth 3,18; Jes. 7,4; Jer. 29,6; ኵላ፡ ምድር፡ ትነብር፡ ወታረምም፡ Zach. 1,11; 1 Reg. 23,9; ዕሩፋን፡ እለ፡ ያረሙ፡ ἡσυχάζοντες ἐν ἡσυχίᾳ Hez. 38,11; አርመመ፡ ባሕር፡ Jon. 1,15. B transit. 1 tacere facere, ad silentium redigere: አርምም፡ አፉከ፡ Sir. 35,8; አርመሞሙ፡ ለሰብእ፡ Jsp. p. 344; ኦአፍ፡ አመ፡ ያረምመኪ፡ ሞት፡ እፎ፡ ትከውኒ፡ Genz. f. 27; ያርምም፡ ልሳኖ፡ እምእኪት፡ 1 Petr. 3,10. 2 tranquillare, sedare: ዘያረምማ፡ ለባሕር፡ Jer. 38,35 var.; Ps. 88,10. ʾarmama G አረመመ፡ ʾarmama II,1 ያረምም፡, ያርምም፡ «se taire» ― ዝም፡ አለ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 56v. 145 L rmm III, አረመመ፡ ʾarmama keep silence, keep silent, be tranquil, be quiet, be at rest, make silent, reduce to silence, astound 471a

woorden.betekenis: ratis, aliud, rams, ramas, ʾarmās, bateau, raft
woorden.definitie: subst., Pl. አርማስ፡ [i.q. رَمَثٌ; vid. etiam Ges. thes. p. 1304] ratis Sap. 14,5; 3 Reg. 5,9; ናመጽኦሙ፡ ወንገብሮሙ፡ ከመ፡ አርማስ፡ እንተ፡ ባሕር፡ 2 Par. 2,16; Sx. Masc. 18. – Voc. Ae.: ተንከተም፡ አርማስ፡ ሐመር፡ ዘ፡ መርከብ፡; aliud: አርማስ፡ ዘ፡ የባሕር፡ ሳንሳ፡ መርከብሂ፡; aliud: አርማስ፡ ጌልያ፡ ብ፡ መርከብ። rams, ረመስ፡ ramas, Pl. ʾarmās G ረምስ፡ rams, Pl. አርማስ፡ ʾarmās «bateau» ― ታንኳ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 56v. 145 L ረምስ rams (Pl. አርማስ ʾarmās), (Lt) ረመስ ramas raft 471b

woorden.betekenis: malus punica, malum punicum, romān, romānāt, grenade et gren
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., coll. et sing., Pl. ሮማናት፡ [רִמּוֹן ܪܽܘܡܳܢܳܐ رُمَّانٌ, vid. Ges. thes. p. 1291; amh. ሩማን፡] malus punica et malum punicum 1 Reg. 14,2; Joel 1,12; Hagg. 2,19; Cant. 6,11; Cant. 7,13; Kuf. 13; ሮማን፡ ፈረዩ፡ Sx. Sen. 23Enc.; Num. 13,23; Num. 20,5; Deut. 8,8; Cant. 4,3; ስቴ፡ ሮማን፡ Cant. 8,2; ጽጌ፡ ሮማን፡ Hen. 19,10; de flore vel fructu mali punicae arte facto Ex. 28,29; Ex. 36,32; Ex. 36,33; Jer. 52,22 seq. romān, Pl. romānāt G ሮማን፡ romān, Pl. ሮማናት፡ romānāt «grenade et grenadier» ― ሮማን፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 56v. 145 L ሮማን romān pomegranate 471b

woorden.betekenis: extenuatus, enervatus fuit, deminuit rem, senescere, senem e
woorden.definitie: I,1 [contiguae videntur radices רָזָה رَذِيَ extenuatus, enervatus fuit; رَزَحَ id.; رَزَأَ et رَزِئَ deminuit rem ] Subj. ይርሣእ፡, 1 senescere, senem esse: እስከ፡ ይረሥኡ፡ Jes. 46,3; Jes. 65,22; Jes. 65,23; ፈድፋደ፡ ረሥአ፡ Tob. 14,3; Job 21,7; እልህቅ፡ ወእረሥእ፡ Job 29,18; Sir. 8,6; ርሣእ፡ በተግባርከ፡ Sir. 11,20; Kuf. 21; Kuf. 27; ለረሢእ፡ ፍጡነ፡ Kuf. 23; ረሢኦ፡ ጥቀ፡ Gen. 25,8; Gen. 27,2; 1 Reg. 8,1; Ps. 36,26; Judith 16,23; Hebr. 11,11; ረሣእኩ፡ እምአውስቦ፡ Ruth 1,12; ዘይረሥእ፡ እምአቡከ፡ Job 15,10. 2 rarius de rebus: senescere, aetate confici: እመ፡ ረሥአ፡ ሥርዉ፡ በምድር፡ Job 14,8; Hebr. 8,13; ኀለፈ፡ ውርዙቱ፡ ወረሥአ፡ መዋዕሊሁ፡ 4 Esr. 14,8. – Voc. Ae.: ረሥአ፡ ዘ፡ አረጀ፡ ዘንግዐሂ።

woorden.betekenis: rās, pendant que le beḥt wadad était le rās Walda Krestos;,
woorden.definitie: subst. amhar., i.q. aeth. ርእስ፡ q.v. Titulus est principium atque proregum Aethiopiae, qui principali dignitate praefulgent. rās እንዘ፡ ብሕትወደድ፡ ራስ፡ ወልደ፡ ክርስቶስ፡ ‘pendant que le beḥt wadad était le rās Walda Krestos;’ 47 l. 3 (ed.), 56 l. 17–18 (tr.); ጕልተ፡ ለራስ፡ ወልደ፡ ሥላሴ፡ ‘en fief au rās Walda Sellāsē’ 50 l. 24 (ed.), 61 l. 3 (tr.); እንዘ፡ ጳጳስነ፡ ቄርሎስ፡ ወራስ፡ ብሕት፡ ወደድ፡ ኢማም፡ ‘tandis que notre métropolite était Qērlos; le rās beḥt wadad, Imām,’ 58 l. 13–14 (ed.), 70 l. 1–2 (tr.) G ራስ፡ rās «général en chef (vulgaire)» ― ራስ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 57r. 147 L ራስ rās title below ‘king’ 473b C for ሕዱግ፡ ራስ፡ vid. ኅዱግ፡ (TraCES)

woorden.betekenis: nomen XXae alphabeti Hebraici literae Ps. 118,153;
woorden.definitie: nomen XXae alphabeti Hebraici literae Ps. 118,153; Thren. 1,20; Thren. 2,20; Thren. 3,57; Thren. 4,20. Ubi de psalmis agitur, siglo ሬስ፡ Ps. 118,153-160 notatur.

woorden.betekenis: squalere, sordidum, pollutum esse, reum, sontem esse, fieri,
woorden.definitie: I,1 [vic. est ረኵሰ፡ q.v., nec non ረስዐ፡] 1 squalere, sordidum, pollutum esse, de vestibus: ልብሱ፡ ለእመ፡ ረስሐ፡ ኢየኀፅብ፡ Fal. f. 44; ልብስ፡ ዘኢረስሐ፡ Genz. f. 130; Org. 2; de homine polluto: ለእመ፡ ረስሐ፡ በሩካቤ፡ ምስለ፡ ብእሲቱ፡ F.M. 14,9; F.M. 14,10; sensu ethico ῥυπαρός Apoc. 22,11. – Locum Deut. 8,4 vid. sub ረሥሐ፡ – 2 reum vel sontem essevel fieri [cfr. רָשַׁע]: ረስሐ፡ ውእቱ፡ ለኵነኔ፡ Matth. 5,21; Matth. 5,22; Clem. f. 179; Clem. f. 180(ይረስሕ፡). – Voc. Ae.: ረስሐ፡ ገመነ፡ ረኵሰ፡ ደመነ፡ ተደነሰ፡ ብ፡ አደፈ፡ rasḥa, ረሥሐ raśḥa G ረስሐ፡ rasḥa I,1 ይረስሕ፡, ይርሳሕ፡ «se salir, se souiller, être impur» ― አደፈ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 57r. 147 L ረስሐ rasḥa (yǝrsāḥ), () ረሥሐ raśḥa be unclean, be dirty, be filthy, be polluted, be impure, be defiled, be contaminated, (Lt) be dull, be lusterless, rust, be liable (to), be subjected (to), be doomed, be accused, be guilty 474a

woorden.betekenis: squalidus, sordidus, impurus, reus, noxius, sons, rǝsuḥ, rǝs
woorden.definitie: part. 1 squalidus, sordidus, impurus, de vestibus ῥυπαρός Jac. 2,2; Zach. 3,3; Zach. 3,4; de argento (scoriis non purgato): ብሩር፡ ርሱሕ፡ (opp. ጽሩይ፡) F.N. 32; de agro: ያንጽሑ፡ ገራህተ፡ ልብየ፡ ርሱሐ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይፍረይ፡ አሜካላ፡ Sx. Sen. 1Enc.; sensu ethico, ἀκάθαρτος Koh. 9,2; ርኩስ፡ ወርሱሕ፡ Job 15,16; እለ፡ ገብርዎ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ምግባር፡ ርሱሕ፡ Clem. f. 82; Clem. f. 85; Org. 2 reus, noxius, sons: ርሱሕ፡ በቀትል፡ ὁ ἐν αἰτίᾳ φόνου Prov. 28,17; ርሱሓነ፡ ኮኑ፡ ለእለ፡ ይዘልፍዎሙ፡ Prov. 1,23 (ርስሕት፡ passim pro ርሕስት፡ q.v.). rǝsuḥ, fem. ርስሕት፡ rǝsǝḥt; Pl. ርሱሓን፡ rǝsuḥān, ርሱሓት፡ rǝsuḥāt G ርሱሕ፡ rǝsuḥ, Pl. ርሱሓን፡ rǝsuḥān «sale, impur, condamnable» ― እድፍ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 57r. ርስሕት፡ rǝsǝḥt fem., Pl. ርሱሓት፡ rǝsuḥāt «sale, impur, condamnable» ― እድፍ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 57r. 147 L ርሱሕ rǝsuḥ defiled, dirty, filthy, impure, accused, charged (with), guilty, (Gr) dull, lusterless 474a

woorden.betekenis: pollutio, sordes, squalor, macula, immaculatus, culpa, crime
woorden.definitie: n. act. et subst., m. et fem., Pl. ርስሐታት፡ 1 pollutio, sordes, squalor, macula, (sensu physico et ethico) Job 9,31; Job 11,15; Jes. 4,4; 1 Petr. 3,21; ῥυπαρία Jac. 1,21; σπῖλος Eph. 5,27; ዘእንበለ፡ ርስሐት፡ ἄσπιλος immaculatus 2 Petr. 3,14; ዘአልቦ፡ ርስሐት፡ ἀμόλυντος Sap. 7,22; σκύβαλα እምኅሊናሁ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ተረክበት፡ ርስሐቱ፡ Sir. 27,4; ርስሐት፡ ርኩስ፡ Kuf. 22; ርስሐተዝ፡ ዓለም፡ Herm. p. 57; ርስሐተ፡ ሥጋ፡ ወመንፈስ፡ Did. 39; ይኩን፡ ንጹሐ፡ እምኵሉ፡ ነውራት፡ ወርስሐታት፡ F.M. 21,3; ጌጋያት፡ ወርስሐታት፡ F.M. I,1; ርስሐታተ፡ ኅሊናተ፡ እኪት፡ Phlx. 103. 2 culpa, crimen Lit. Joh.; ከመ፡ ኢይኩን፡ (nobis communicatio corporis et sanguinis Christi) ለርስሐት፡ ወለኵነኔ፡ Lit. Apost. rǝsḥat G ረስሕ፡ rasḥ et ርስሐት፡ rǝsḥat «impureté, soillure, saleté» ― እድፍ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 57r. 147 L ርስሐት rǝsḥat defilement, impurity, pollution, dirt, uncleanness, filth, crime, guilt, accusation 474a C vid. also ረስሕ፡

woorden.betekenis: firmus, stabilis fuit, ad ancoram stetit, composuit, appulit
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., cui contigua est ረሰየ፡ q.v.; رَسَا firmus et stabilis fuit (رَسَخَ id.); ad ancoram stetit navis; composuit res; IV appulit in portum.

woorden.betekenis: sordibus oblitum, obscuratum esse, corruptis palpebris, ut u
woorden.definitie: I,1 [amh. ረሳ፡; vicina sunt ረስሐ፡ et ረኵሰ፡; prima verbi notio videtur sordibus oblitum, obscuratum esse, de oculis, mente; coll. رَسِعَ corruptis palpebris, ut una alteri agglutinaretur, laboravit] Subj. ይርሳዕ፡ 1 oblivisci, c.c. Acc. Gen. 41,51; Deut. 25,19; Ps. 12,1; Ps. 102,2; Kuf. 1; Kuf. 6; Kuf. 27; ትረስዓ፡ ለሕማምከ፡ Job 11,16; Job 19,14; ኢትርስዓኒ፡ Jes. 44,21; ረስዐኒ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Jes. 49,14; Jes. 49,15; Jes. 65,11; Jes. 65,16; ትረስዕኑ፡ መርዓት፡ ሰርጓ፡ Jer. 2,32; Dan. 2,1; Phil. 3,13; Hen. 98,15; c. Acc. Infin.: ረስዑ፡ ኅብስተ፡ ነሢአ፡ Matth. 16,5; seq. እስመ፡ 2 Petr. 3,8; seq. ዘከመ፡ Jac. 1,24; absol.: አመ፡ ረስዐ፡ ዳእሙ፡ Sir. 14,7. a dediscere Herm. p. 34. b ignoscere: ይረስዕ፡ ሊተ፡ ኀጢአትየ፡ οὐ μνησθήσεται Sir. 23,18; Job 14,16. c non curare, negligere, deserere, in specie: Deum, Dei mandata, ይረስዕዎ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ Job 8,13; Deut. 26,13; Kuf. 23; Jer. 18,15; ἀπειθεῖν: ኢይረስዑ፡ ቃሎ፡ Sir. 2,15; ኢትርሳዕ፡ ፈሪሀ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Sir. 28,23. 2 errorem committere, delinquere per imprudentiam: Lev. 5,15 (ἐὰν λάθῃ λήθῃ) et Lev. 5,18 (ἀγνοίας ἧς ἠγνόησε); እመኒ፡ ረስዐ፡ ἐὰν πλημμελήσῃ Sir. 23,11. 3 impium esse adversum Deum, injustum vel scelestum esse (divinam legem violare), ἀσεβεῖν et ἀνομεῖν [hoc sensu tritissimum est רָשַׁע et ܐܰܪܫܰܥ c. deriv.] Hen. 99,10; sine dubio etiam Hen. 99,9; Hen. 104,9; እለ፡ ግብረ፡ ረሳዕክሙ፡ qui impie egistis Hen. 100,9; ረሲዕ፡ Hen. 5,8; Hen. 10,20; Jes. 9,18 (ἀνομία, var. ኀጢአት፡); ኢይርሳዕ፡ M.M. f. 213. rasʿa, ረስአ፡ rasʾa, ረሥዐ፡ raśʿa G ረስዐ፡ rasʿa I,1 ይረስዕ፡, ይርሳዕ፡ «oublier, vieillir, oublier ses devoirs, être impie, irréligieus» ― ረሳ፡, አረጀ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 57r. 148 L ረስዐ rasʿa (yǝrsāʿ), () ረስአ፡ rasʾa, () ረሥዐ፡ raśʿa forget, overlook, be negligent, neglect, err, act impiously, become godless, be wicked (the meaning ‘become old’ given by 148 belongs to vid. ረሥአ raśʾa) 473b

woorden.betekenis: impius, injustus, scelestus, rasiʿ, rasiʿān, étourdi, irréli
woorden.definitie: adj. [ut ܪܰܫܺܝܥܳܐ] Pl. ረሲዓን፡ impius, injustus, scelestus (ἀσεβής, ἄνομος, παράνομος) Prov. 1,7; Prov. 9,7; Prov. 28,1; Koh. 3,16; Koh. 7,15; Koh. 7,25; Koh. 9,2; Job 8,19; Sir. 9,12; Sir. 41,5; Sap. 14,9; Sap. 16,16; Ps. 1,1; Ps. 11,9; Judae 4; Job 20,5; Hen. 1,1; Hen. 1,9; Hen. 16,1; Hen. 38,3; Hen. 81,9; Hen. 98,15; al.; nota definitionem: ረሲዕ፡ ዘረስዐ፡ ቃለ፡ መለኮት፡ ዘተምህረ፡ Clem. f. 201. rasiʿ, Pl. ረሲዓን፡ rasiʿān G ረሲዕ፡ rasiʿ, Pl. ረሲዓን፡ rasiʿān «étourdi, irréligieux impie» ― ዝንጉዕ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 57v. 148 L ረሲዕ rasiʿ godless, ungodly, impious, wicked, wrongful, sinful 474a

woorden.betekenis: impietas, rǝsʿān, rǝsʿǝnnat, rǝsʿǝnnāt, rǝsʿat
woorden.definitie: subst., impietas: ረሲዕኒ፡ ወርስዓኑ፡ (v. ወረሲዓኑ፡) ὁ ἀσεβῶν καὶ ἡ ἀσέβεια αὐτοῦ Sap. 14,9; Hen. 104,9; M.M. f. 104; Sx. Teq. 9. rǝsʿān, ርስዕነት፡ rǝsʿǝnnat L ርስዓን rǝsʿān, ርስዕነት rǝsʿǝnnat {it could be that Leslau meant vid. ርስዕናት rǝsʿǝnnāt} same as vid. ርስዐት rǝsʿat 474a

woorden.betekenis: et ርስዕና፡ subst., i.q. ርስዓን፡, Hen. 99,1; Hen. 104,9
woorden.definitie: et ርስዕና፡ subst., i.q. ርስዓን፡, Hen. 99,1; Hen. 104,9 var. (gramm. § 122,β).

woorden.betekenis: ponere, injicere, indere, admovere, transponere, transferre,
woorden.definitie: I,2 [contiguum est ረሰወ፡ q.v.] 1 ponere τιθέναι, a injicere, indere, admovere, ut: ረሰዩ፡ አሕባለ፡ ውስተ፡ ክሣዱ፡ Sx. Mij. 30; ረሰዩ፡ ውስተ፡ ገበዋቲሁ፡ ቅንዋተ፡ ኀጺን፡ Sx. Mij. 27; ረሰዩ፡ መኃትወ፡ እሳት፡ ውስተ፡ ገበዋቲሁ፡ (martyris) Sx. Jac. 9; Sx. Jac. 25; ረሰይዎ፡ (martyrem) ውስተ፡ ላህም፡ ዘብርት፡ Sx. Mij. 16. b transponere, transferre: እሬስዮሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ብርሃን፡ እምጽልመት፡ Jes. 42,16. c constituere, praeponere, praeficere Matth. 23,9; ነቢየ፡ ረሰይኩከ፡ Jer. 1,5; Hez. 33,7; (regno in tres partes diviso) ረሰዩ፡ ለለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ክፍል፡ ብእሴ፡ ዘእሙር፡ በኀይል፡ Jsp. p. 347; coll. Eph. 1,22. d c. ታሕተ፡ subdere, subjicere: ረሰየኒ፡ ታሕተ፡ እዴሁ፡ Kuf. 37. e vestes applicare, induere Lud. ex. Enc., vid. ተረስየ፡ f parare, praeparare (sicut הֵכִין): ረሰይከ፡ ሰብአ፡ (v. ፈጠርከ፡) κατεσκεύασας ἄνθρωπον Sap. 9,2; ትሬስይዎ፡ ለገሃነም፡ Matth. 23,15; hinc ረሰየ፡ ርእሶ፡ ለ፡ aptum vel dignum se fecit vel censuit re Act. 13,46. g imputare, c. ላዕለ፡ vel ለ፡ pers., Philem. 18; 2 Reg. 19,19; Org. 1; Num. 12,11; etiam: excusationis causam alicui imputare, excusare aliquem, c. ለ፡ pers. Luc. 14,18; Luc. 14,19. 2 ponere vel habere aliquem pro aliquo i.e. a aestimare, censere, putare, aequiparare, c. dupl. Acc. vel c. Acc. et ከመ፡, Phil. 3,8; 1 Tim. 1,12; Luc. 20,6 rom.; Rom. 6,11; 4 Esr. 8,58; 1 Reg. 1,16; Sx. Mag. 7. b habere vel tractare aliquem pro vel tamquam, c. Acc. et ከመ፡, Gen. 34,31; 4 Esr. 8,52; ረስዮ፡ ከመ፡ እኁከ፡ Sir. 30,39; ወረሰይዎ፡ ከመ፡ አብድ፡ Jsp. p. 377. c declarare: ረሰይዎ፡ ከመ፡ ዘኃጥእ፡ ἔθεντο αὐτὸν εἶναι ἀσεβῆ Job 32,3. d simulare, ut: ረሰየ፡ ርእሶ፡ አብደ፡ se fuere simulavit Sx. Nah. 14; al. 3 facere vel reddere aliquem talem, convertere rem in rem, c. dupl. Acc.: Rom. 8,10; ረሰይኩክሙ፡ ኅሱራነ፡ Mal. 2,9; ትሬስየከ፡ ጥቡዐ፡ ለጸላኢከ፡ Sir. 18,31; Hen. 99,2; Jes. 14,17; ረሰይኮን፡ ለአህጉር፡ መሬተ፡ Jes. 25,2; Jes. 28,15; Jes. 41,19; Jer. 19,7; ምኑነ፡ ኢትረሲ፡ ንባበ፡ ዚአየ፡ Prov. 5,7; Prov. 5,8; Ps. 17,13; Hez. 37,17; እሬስዮ፡ ላሐ፡ ለበዓላቲክሙ፡ Am. 8,10; Joh. 4,46; Num. 13,32; vel c. ውስተ፡ praedicati, ut: Ex. 32,10; Num. 14,12; Kuf. 12; Apoc. 1,6; vel ለ፡, ut: ሠጠጠ፡ አልባሲሁ፡ ወረሰዮሙ፡ ለክልኤ፡ 4 Reg. 2,12; vel c. ከመ፡, ut Ruth 4,11; Kuf. 13; Jes. 41,15; Jes. 49,2; Jes. 50,7; vel seq. verbi Subjunctivo vel ከመ፡ c. Subj., ut: ይሬስዮሙ፡ ለመካርያን፡ ይፄወዉ፡ Job 12,17; Matth. 4,19; Matth. 5,32; እሬስየክሙ፡ ከመ፡ ትሑሩ፡ Hez. 36,27; Jes. 42,24; ረስዮ፡ ለቃልየ፡ ከመ፡ ያስሕቶሙ፡ Judith 9,13; Gen. 17,6; 4 Esr. 10,43. 4 facere, perpetrare, instituere: Hen. 1,9; ምንተ፡ ትሬስዩ፡ τί ποιήσετε Sir. 2,14; Jes. 10,3; Jer. 4,30; Job 31,14; Job 35,2. 5 facere alicui aliquid, in specie: mali quid inferre alicui, afficere aliquem re; c. dupl. Acc.: ከመዝ፡ ለይረስየኒ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Ruth 1,17; ምንተ፡ ይሬስየነ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Job 22,17; Jes. 5,5; Jes. 10,11; Jes. 48,11; Jer. 3,6; አልቦ፡ ዘይሬስዮ፡ ረምሕ፡ Job 41,17; Ps. 55,11; Ps. 117,6; Hen. 9,11; Luc. 2,48. (Passim in libris Mss. ረሰየ፡ cum ሰረየ፡ confunditur, ut Job 42,9; Kuf. p. 54). rassaya G ረሰየ፡ rassaya I,2 ይሬሲ፡, ይረሲ፡ «agir, faire, render beau, considérer, orner» ― አደረገ፡, ሸለመ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 57v. 148 L ረሰየ rassaya put, place, set, set up, establish, institute, constitute, do, make, convert (into), arrange, treat, bestow, appoint, prepare, esteem, consider, declare, impute, regard something as, clothe, arm, equip, (148) decorate, adorn ረሰየ፡ ርእሶ rassaya rǝʾǝso he valued himself, he esteemed himself, vid. ርእስ፡ 474b

woorden.betekenis: appellare in portum, ponere, jacere ancoram, ʾarsaya, rsy, d
woorden.definitie: II,1 stabilire i.e. appellare in portum navem (vid. አርሰወ፡): Marc. 6,53; Act. 21,3 rom.; Act. 27,29 rom.; vel: ponere, jacere ancoram: Chrys. ho. 11(vid. መርሶ፡ sub ረሰወ፡). ʾarsaya L rsy, አርሰየ ʾarsaya (, , ) drop anchor, bring to rest 475a C vid. also አርሰወ፡

woorden.betekenis: sibi induere, amictum esse, accingi, se ornare, armis instru
woorden.definitie: et ተረሰየ፡ III,1 et III,2; (ተራሰየ፡ III,3 Jer. 28,3 var.) 1 sibi induere vestem, arma, amictum esse, accingi, c. Acc., ut: ተረሰይኩ፡ ርትዐ፡ ከመ፡ ዐጽፍ፡ Job 29,14; Jes. 49,18; c. በ፡ Deut. 22,5; ዘይትረሰይ፡ በሰርጐ፡ አንስት፡ Clem. f. 163; ተረሰይ፡ በክብር፡ ወበስብሐት፡ Job 40,5; ይትረሰይ፡ (var. ይትራሰይ፡) በንዋየ፡ ሐቅሉ፡ Jer. 28,3; Jes. 21,5; 1 Tim. 2,9. a nonnumquam: se ornare re, ostentationis vel glriationis causa: Act. 25,23; ትትሬሰዩ፡ በብዕሎሙ፡ Jes. 61,6; ዐይን፡ እንተ፡ ርእየተኒ፡ ትትሬሰየኒ፡ Job 29,11. b armis instrui; accinctum, armatum esse: እለ፡ ተረሰዩ፡ (v. ተረስዩ፡) ለቀትል፡ Num. 31,5; 1 Cor. 14,8 et in genere 2 sese parare vel expedire ad aliquid, paratum esse (נָכוֹן): ተረሰዩ፡ ላዕሌሃ፡ ለቀትል፡ παρασκευάσασθε ἐπ᾽ αὐτὴν εἰς πόλεμον Jer. 6,4; ሶበ፡ ይትሬሰዩ፡ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ἑτοιμασίας Nah. 2,4; ተረስየነ፡ Num. 32,27; ብእሲ፡ ዘተረስየ፡ ἕτοιμος Lev. 16,21. – Voc. Ae.: ተረሰየ፡ ብ፡ ተሸለመ። tarasya, tarassaya G ተረሰየ፡ tarassaya III,2 ይትሬሰይ፡, ይትረሰይ፡ «être fait, être préparé, armé, prompt à se battre» ― ተደረገ፡, ተሸለመ፡, ተሰለፈ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 57v. 148 L ተረስየ tarasya, ተረሰየ tarassaya adorn oneself, clothe oneself, array onself, be armed, prepare oneself, be equipped, () wrap oneself in a blanket 475a

woorden.betekenis: amicire, instruere armis, armare, parare, ornare, orna collu
woorden.definitie: et አስተረሰየ፡ IV,1 et IV,2 (አስተራሰየ፡ IV,3 Jer. 26,9 var.) 1 amicire, instruere armis, armare, parare, ornare: አስተረሰይኮኑ፡ ለቀትል፡ በንዋየ፡ ሐቅል፡ περιέθηκας αὐτῷ πανοπλίαν Job 39,20; ἐξοπλίσατε Num. 31,3; ለምንት፡ ታስተሬሲ፡ አፍራሰ፡ (παρασκευάσῃ) Jer. 12,5; አስተረስዩ፡ (v. አስተራስዩ፡) ሰረገላተ፡ Jer. 26,9; መኑ፡ ያስተሬሲ፡ ሀገረ፡ κοσμήσει Mich. 6,9; አስተረሲ፡ ለክሣድየ፡ ባዝግና፡ ወቃማ፡ orna collum meum torque et monili Sx. Nah. 30Enc.; { 2 parare, facere, ignem: መኑ፡ ያስተሬሲ፡ (v. ያስተረሲ፡) እሳተ፡ Mich. 6,9 var.}. ʾastarsaya, ʾastarassaya G አስተረሰየ፡ ʾastarassaya IV,2 ያስተሬሲ፡, ያስተረሲ፡ «armer, orner, habiller» ― አጌጠ፡, አሸለመ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 57v. 148 L አስተርሰየ ʾastarsaya, አስተረሰየ ʾastarassaya clothe, array, prepare, adorn, equip, arm 475a

woorden.betekenis: apparatus, adoptio, amictus, habitus, paratus, ornatus, mund
woorden.definitie: subst. 1 dispositio, apparatus Hebr. 9,2; Hebr. 9,6; תְּכוּנָה Hez. 43,11 vers. nov. 2 factio i.e. adoptio filii: ትርሲተ፡ ወልድ፡ ὑιοθεσία Rom. 8,15; Rom. 8,23; Rom. 9,4; Eph. 1,5; Gal. 4,5. 3 plerumque: amictus, habitus, paratus, ornatus, mundus (muliebris): σκευή Deut. 22,5; ትርሲተ፡ መርዓዊ፡ Jes. 61,10; እንተ፡ ባቲ፡ ትርሲተ፡ ዝሙት፡ εἶδος ἔχουσα πορνικόν Prov. 7,10; δόξα ልበሲ፡ ትርሲተኪ፡ Jes. 52,1; Hez. 27,7; Job 19,9; Sir. 50,13; εὐπρέπεια ሰለብዋ፡ ኵሎ፡ ትርሲታ፡ Thren. 1,6; κόσμος በውስተ፡ ትርሲተ፡ ቤታ፡ Sir. 26,16; Lit. Orth.; Lit. Joh. 4 in genere: quidquid pompae, magnificentiae, ornatui, decori est, δόξα Jes. 10,3; Jes. 10,16; Jes. 17,4; Jes. 28,1; Jes. 53,2; Hagg. 2,3; Hagg. 2,7; Hagg. 2,9; πάντα ἔνδοξα ἡμῶν ኵሉ፡ ትርሲትነ፡ Jes. 64,11; ἡ αἴνεσίς μου Jes. 12,2; εἰς τιμὴν τῆς δόξης μου ለትርሲተ፡ ክብርየ፡ Dan. 4,27; ትርሲተ፡ አብያቲሆሙ፡ οἰκίαι τρυφῆς αὐτῶν Mich. 2,9; ትርሲተ፡ ጽጌ፡ Org. 3. – Voc. Ae.: ትርሲት፡ ዘ፡ ሽልመት። tǝrsit G ትርሲት፡ tǝrsit «ornament, habillement» ― ጌት፡, ሸለማት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 57v. 149 L ትርሲት tǝrsit apparel, ornament, adornment, attire, equipment, glory, pomp, prepartaion, constitution, occupation 475a

woorden.betekenis: acu pingere, figuris pingere, striatum fecit pannum; scripsi
woorden.definitie: I,1 acu pingere, figuris pingere vestem [hebr. רָקַם id., رَقَمَ striatum fecit pannum; scripsit]: እስከ፡ ሰብአ፡ አዝማና፡ ይረቅሙ፡ ሥዕላ፡ (mulieris) ዲበ፡ አልባሲሆሙ፡ Jsp. p. 273. – Voc. Ae.: ረቀመ፡ ዘ፡ ሳለ፡ raqama G ረቀመ፡ raqama I,1 ይረቅም፡, ይርቅም፡ «broder, barbouiller, trapuntare, peindre» ― ጠለፈ፡, ጣፈ፡, ደረተ፡, ሳለ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 57v. 149 L ረቀመ raqama embroider, paint figures on parchment, (, , ) make incisions, write (222 wrongly renders Amh. salä (translation of raqama) as ‘be sharp’ instead of ‘paint, design’) 473a

woorden.betekenis: gigas, gigantes, aliud
woorden.definitie: , rarius የርባሕ፡ (Num. 13,33 FH), plerumque ያርብሕ፡, subst. (gramm. § 113), sing. et coll., Pl. እለ፡ ያርብሕ፡ (gramm. § 140 s. f.), gigas, gigantes: γίγας Ps. 18,6; Ps. 32,16; Jes. 3,2; Jes. 49,24; Hez. 39,20; γίγαντες ሥጋ፡ ያርብሕ፡ ትብልዑ፡ Hez. 39,18; Kuf. 7; in Acc. vel ያርብሐ፡ ut Gen. 10,8 (G); Sir. 47,4 var., vel ይርባሕ፡ sive ያርብሕ፡ (tanquam n. pr. indeclinabile) Gen. 10,8 FH; በንእሱ፡ ቀተለ፡ ይርባሕ፡ Sir. 47,4; እለ፡ ያርብሕ፡ vel ይርባሕ፡ Gen. 6,4; Gen. 14,5; Num. 13,33; Deut. 1,28; Jos. 12,4; 2 Reg. 21,22; Jes. 13,3; Jes. 14,9; Hez. 32,12; Hez. 32,17 seq.; Job 26,5; Judith 16,6; Sir. 16,7; Hen. 106,17. – Voc. Ae.: ያርብሕ፡ ብ፡ አርበኛ፡; aliud: ያርብሕ፡ ዘ፡ ኀይለኛ፡ አዛልሂ፡ ውእቱ።

woorden.betekenis: multus fuit, magnus, dominus fuit; auxit, magnus, major, in
woorden.definitie: I,1 [רָבַב multus fuit; رَبَّ magnus, dominus fuit; auxit; ܪܰܘܪܒܳܐ magnus, major; amh. ረበረበ፡ in struem cumulare] pandere, expandere, extendere: ክዳነ፡ 2 Reg. 17,19; ክነፈ፡ Ex. 25,20; ሰማየ፡ ከመ፡ ሠቅ፡ Ps. 103,3; Hen. 18,3; rete, sagenam Jes. 19,8; Hab. 1,17; Hez. 26,5; ይረቡ፡ መሣግረ፡ Hez. 26,14; Hez. 47,10; Prov. 1,17; etiam dispergendo pandere: አዘዘ፡ ያምጽእ፡ ሐመደ፡ ወረበቦ፡ ውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ቤት፡ Dan. apocr. 13,14. – Voc. Ae.: ረበበ፡ ዘ፡ ነሰነሰ፡ አሰፋሂ፡ ይ፡ rababa, ረበ፡ rabba G ረበበ፡ rababa I,1 ይረብብ፡, ይርብብ፡ «étendre, déployer, détendre, dilater» ― ዘረጋ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 58v. 151 L rbb, ረበ rabba, ረበበ rababa (yǝrbǝb) stretch, stretch out, expand, extend, spread out, scatter, (, , ) hover (that is, ‘fly with spread wings’) ረበበ፡ መርበብተ rababa marbabta or ረበበ፡ መሥገርተ rababa maśgarta cast a net, vid. መርበብት፡, መሥገርት፡ 460b

woorden.betekenis: rete, piscatorium, majus, sagena, verriculum, vinculis, marb
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. መራብብት፡ (Ssal. Req.) rete (piscatorium) majus, sagena, verriculum, σαγήνη Koh. 7,26; ἀμφίβληστρον Koh. 9,12; Jes. 19,8; Hab. 1,15; Hab. 1,16; Matth. 4,18; ተከለ፡ መርበብተ፡ ከመ፡ ያሥግር፡ ባቲ፡ አራዊተ፡ Sx. Mij. 28; coll. መርበብት፡ Sx. Teq. 30; transl. መርበብተ፡ ሕይወት፡ Lit. Joh.; usurpatur de vinculis, quibus quis irretitus est Hen. 103,8. marbabt, መርብብት፡ marbǝbt, Pl. marābǝbt G መርበብት፡ marbabt, Pl. መራብብት፡ marābǝbt «filet, hameçon» ― ማያዣ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 58v. 151 L መርበብት፡ marbabt, መርብብት፡ marbǝbt (Pl. መራብብት marābǝbt) net, fisherman’s net, trap, snare, (151) fishhook መርበብተ፡ ሰሎሞን marbabta salomon Solomon’s Net, a book of magic containing incantations for conjuring up demons 258; 461a ረበበ፡ መርበብተ rababa marbabta or ረበበ፡ መሥገርተ rababa maśgarta cast a net, vid. ረበበ፡, መሥገርት፡ 460b

woorden.betekenis: quatuor conficere, quadruplicare, quadrifariam dividere, qui
woorden.definitie: I,2 (denom.) quatuor conficere, quadruplicare, quadrifariam dividere: እለ፡ ይሬብዑ፡ qui quatuor (divinitatis personas) faciunt Lud. sine auct.; (Paulus Samosatenus) ዘያማስን፡ ሥላሴ፡ ወይሬብዕ፡ ጥምቀተ፡ Cyr in append. f. 133; (Deus) ዘይሬብዖን፡ ለከንትሮሳተ፡ ዓመታት፡ ከመ፡ ይኩና፡ ለሐጋይ፡ ወለክረምት፤ ለመጸው፡ ወለተወን፡ qui quadrantes annorum conficit M.M. f. 347. rabbǝʿa G ረብዐ፡ rabbǝʿa I,2 ይሬብዕ፡ ይረብዕ፡ «quadrupler, faire quatre» ― አራት፡ አደረገ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 58v. 151 L ረብዐ rabbǝʿa make four, form four (denominative) 460a

woorden.betekenis: quatuor, ʾarbāʿ, four
woorden.definitie: n. numerale, femininis junctum; quatuor; ejus character ፬፡; አርባዕ፡ አህጉር፡ Jos. 21,18; Jes. 17,6; Herm. p. 76; ጽብነ፡ አርባዕ፡ Ex. 25,12; Ex. 25,14; ዘየሐውር፡ በአርባዕ፡ Lev. 11,20; Lev. 11,21; በእንተ፡ ሠላስ፡ ኀጢአቶሙ፡ ወበእንተ፡ አርባዕ፡ Am. 1,3 seq. ʾarbāʿ L አርባዕ፡ ʾarbāʿ four (with a feminine noun) 460a

woorden.betekenis: u, quatuor, ʾarbāʿǝttu, quatre, ʾarbāʿǝt, four, kind of chan
woorden.definitie: (i.e. አርባዕት፡ c. suff. u, vid. gramm. § 158) n. num., plerumque masculinis junctum: quatuor Gen. 2,10; Gen. 14,9; Jud. 9,34; ርኢኩ፡ አርባዕተ፡ አቅርንተ፡ Zach. 1,18; Zach. 1,20; Dan. 7,6; አንበበ፡ ሠለስተ፡ ሳሌዳ፡ ወአርባዕተ፡ Jer. 43,23; አርባዕቱ፡ እንስሳ፡ 4 Esr. 11,43; Matth. 24,31; Marc. 2,3; አርባዕቱ፡ ምእት፡ Gen. 23,16. – Pronomina suff. admittit, ut: አርባዕቲሆሙ፡ Hez. 1,8. – Exemplum formae absolutae አርባዕት፡ exstat in Abbad. Cat. p. 99. ʾarbāʿǝttu G አርባዕቱ፡ ʾarbāʿǝttu «quatre (le plus usité)» ― አራት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 59r. 152 L አርባዕት፡ʾarbāʿǝt four, kind of chant (233–6) አርባዕቱ ʾarbāʿǝttu four (with a masculine noun) 460a

woorden.betekenis: quatuor, magnates, quater, quater et vicies, rǝbʿ, four, rǝb
woorden.definitie: n. num. 1 quatuor (potissimum ante nomina mensurarum usitatum): ጽፍሓ፡ ርብዕ፡ በእመት፡ Ex. 26,8; Ex. 37,2; Deut. 3,11; 3 Reg. 7,3; መኳንንት፡ ርብዕ፡ magnates quatuor Sx. Sen. 6 Enc. 2 adv. ርብዕ፡ vel ርብዐ፡ quater: ርብዕ፡ ለዓመት፡ Kuf. 29; ዘይጠወም፡ ርብዕ፡ Hez. 41,21 vers. ant.; ዕሥራ፡ ወርብዐ፡ quater et vicies Sx. Nah. 30. rǝbʿ L ርብዕ rǝbʿ four (with a feminine noun) ርብዐ rǝbʿa four times 460a

woorden.betekenis: quartus, quarta pars, quadrans, quarta vice, quartum, rābǝʿ,
woorden.definitie: adj. num. (ordinale), fem. ራብዕት፡ quartus Gen. 1,19; Gen. 2,14; Gen. 15,16; Jer. 25,1; Gen. 35,1; Gen. 43,1; Dan. 7,7; Sir. 26,5; Judith 12,10; 4 Esr. 4,52; 4 Esr. 12,16; Matth. 14,25; Marc. 6,48. a admittit pron. suff.: 2 Reg. 3,4; ብእሉ፡ ሠለስቱ፡ … ወራብዖሙሰ፡ Sir. 26,28 (at: ወራብዕሰ፡ Sir. 26,5); ራብዖሙ፡ Dan. 11,2; ራብዕቶን፡ ἡ τετάρτη Prov. 24,50. b ራብዕተ፡ እድ፡ vel ራብዕት፡ quarta pars, quadrans: ራብዕተ፡ እዴሃ፡ ታውዒ፡ Hez. 5,2; Lev. 23,13; Num. 15,5; ራብዕታ፡ ለኢን፡ Ex. 29,40; ራብዕትኪ፡ τὸ τέταρτόν σου Hez. 5,12. c ራብዕተ፡ quarta vice, quartum Num. 10,6. rābǝʿ, fem. rābǝʿt G ራብዕ፡ rābǝʿ m. «quatrième» et ራብዕት፡ rābǝʿt fem. «quatrième» ― አራተኛ፡, አራት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 59r. 151 L ራብዕ፡ rābǝʿ (fem. ራብዕት፡ rābǝʿt) fourth ራብዕተ፡ እድ፡ rābǝʿta ʾǝd fourth part, vid. እድ፡ ራብዕተ፡ rābǝʿta for the fourth time 460b

woorden.betekenis: quatuor, quartus, feria quarta, rabuʿ, quatrième jour, mercr
woorden.definitie: nom. temporale 1 { quatuor} (dies) et { quartus} (dies): አመ፡ ዕለተ፡ ዐሡሩ፡ ወረቡዑ፡ Lev. 23,5; ረቡዐ፡ መዋዕለ፡ Jud. 11,40; ጾመ፡ ረቡዕ፡ Zach. 8,19; Act. 27,27; Act. 27,33; pron. suff. admittit: ረቡዑ፡ ዮም፡ Joh. 11,39. 2 feria quarta hebdomadis, ut: ዘረቡዕ፡ (v. ዘረቡዐ፡) ፋሲካ፡ Mavâs. 45. rabuʿ G ረቡዕ፡ rabuʿ «quatrième jour, mercredi» ― ፬ኛ፡ ቀን፡, ረቡ፡, ሮብ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 59r. 151 L ረቡዕ rabuʿ four (days), the fourth day of the week, Wednesday 460a

woorden.betekenis: quadraginta, quadragesimus, festi Ascensionis, Purificationi
woorden.definitie: n. num. 1 quadraginta (quadragesimus); ejus character est ፵፡; Gen. 7,4; Ps. 94,10; Am. 5,25; Hez. 4,6; Hez. 29,11; 4 Esr. 14,25; Marc. 1,13; Matth. 4,2; አርብዓ፡ ምእት፡ Matth. 15,38. 2 a nomen festi Ascensionis Christi (ἡ τεσσαρακοστή), ut: ዘበዓለ፡ ፵፡ Cod. Mus. Brit. XXX, 53. b nomen fasti Purificationis: በዓለ፡ አርብዓ፡ festum quadraginta (dierum a festo Nativitatis Christi), alias በዓለ፡ ነጺሕ፡ Lud. ʾarbǝʿā G አርብዓ፡ ʾarbǝʿā «quarante» ― አርባ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 59r. 152 L አርብዓ ʾarbǝʿā forty, (Lt) funeral rites forty days after the death of a person 460a C a for በዓለ፡ አርብዓ፡ vid. በዓል፡ b for ጾመ፡ አርብዓ፡ vid. ጾም፡

woorden.betekenis: quadrum, quadruplum, quatuor partes quadri, quarta pars, qua
woorden.definitie: subst. 1 quadrum, quadruplum, quatuor partes quadri: እንተ፡ መርብዕት፡ 3 Reg. 6,30; መርብዕተ፡ ማኅፈድ፡ Kuf. 38; መርብዕተ፡ መኣዝኒሃ፡ ለዓለም፡ ያንቀለቅል፡ Kid. f. 39; መርብዕተ፡ ያስተርኢ፡ ለእመኒ፡ ለሐዘን፡ ወለእመኒ፡ τέσσαρα μέρη Sir. 37,18. 2 quarta pars, quadrans Abush. 23.

woorden.betekenis: rectum, directum, erectum esse, fieri, restitui, recte dispo
woorden.definitie: I,1 [amh. ረታ፡; respondet syr. ܬܪܰܨ (تَرُصَ) vid. 74; Scaliger p. 689] Subj. ይርታዕ፡ 1 rectum, directum, erectum esse vel fieri, sensu physico: ጠዋይ፡ ኢይትከሀል፡ ረቲዐ፡ Koh. 1,15; Luc. 13,13; Ps. 19,9; de via Ps. 118,5; ከመ፡ ይርታዕ፡ ፍናዊከ፡ Prov. 3,6 var.; ከመ፡ እምኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ይርታዕ፡ አሰሩ፡ Prov. 16,9 (1); de sede (erigi vel stabiliri): ይረትዕ፡ በጽድቅ፡ መንበሩ፡ Prov. 25,5; Jes. 16,5. 2 restitui, recte dispositum, compositum esse: ይረትዕ፡ ልሳነ፡ በሃም፡ Jes. 35,6; ተበትከ፡ አሕባልኪ፡ እስመ፡ ኢረትዐ፡ Jes. 33,23; ረትዐ፡ መንግሥቱ፡ ለፈርዖን፡ Kuf. 40; በእንተ፡ ጸሎቱ፡ ይረትዕ፡ ዓለም፡ (mundus) Sx. Jac. 2. 3 prospere agere de personis, bene succedere vel provenire de rebus: { ውእቱ፡} ረትዐ፡ αὐτὸς κατευθύνθη Sir. 49,2; ይርታዕ፡ ኵሉ፡ ተክልክሙ፡ Kuf. 7. 4 rectum i.e. verum esse, nec non: recte dicere, verum dicere: ይረትዕ፡ ስምዖሙ፡ በቅድመ፡ ገጽየ፡ Jer. 37,20; ረታዕከ፡ εὖ ἔφης recte ais Cyr. c. Pall. f. 68; ረታዕከ፡ ኦካልእየ፡ ὀρθῶς ὦ ἑταῖρε Cyr. c. Pall. f. 95. 5 justum esse, justam causam habere Deut. 25,1; hinc a imperson. justum, aequum esse, seq. Subj. Ps. 118,5; Jac. 3.10; vel seq. Infin., ut: ይደሉ፡ ወይረትዕ፡ ሰጊድ፡ Sx. Enc. (vid. ርቱዕ፡). b c. pron. suff. pers. rectum, justum, aequum videri alicui: ረስዩኒ፡ ዘፈቀድክሙ፡ ወዘይረትዐክሙ፡ Jer. 33,14; ዘረትዖ፡ በቅድመ፡ አዕይንቲሁ፡ 1 Par. 21,23; Matth. 20,7; seq. Subj. vel ከመ፡, ut Luc. 1,3; 1 Reg. 18,23. ratʿa G ረትዐ፡ ratʿa I,1 ይረትዕ፡, ይርታዕ፡ «être droit, juste, équitable, être debout, être favorable» ― ቀና፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 59r. 152 L ረትዐ ratʿa (yǝrtāʿ) be (become) straight, be straightened, be right, be righteous, be just, be truthful, be sincere, become established, be restored, be well-ordered, be successful, prosper, be proper; also used with indirect object suffix pronouns; e.g. ረትዐኒ ratʿanni it seemed right to me 475b

woorden.betekenis: erigere, stabilire, rectum facere, dirigere, ad rectum revoc
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 erigere, stabilire: አርትዐ፡ እገሪሁ፡ (sc. Adamus, postquam creatus est) Clem. f. 4; ኣርትዕ፡ መንበረ፡ መንግሥቱ፡ 1 Par. 22,10; እግዚአብሔር፡ አርትዐ፡ ዓለመ፡ በጥበቡ፡ Jer. 10,12; Jer. 40,2. 2 rectum facere, dirigere, ad rectum revocare: አርትዕ፡ ኵሎ፡ ጠዋየ፡ Jes. 58,6; Hebr. 12,12; ያረትዕ፡ ሎቱ፡ ምክረ፡ ወጥበበ፡ Sir. 39,7; 2 Thess. 3,5; saepissime de via: Ps. 5,9; Sir. 2,6; ለእመ፡ አርታዕክሙ፡ ፍናዊክሙ፡ ርቱዐ፡ Jer. 7,5; አርትዑ፡ ፍናዊክሙ፡ ወምግባሪክሙ፡ Jer. 7,3; Prov. 11,5; እመ፡ አርታዕከ፡ ፍናዊከ፡ Job 22,3; Luc. 1,79; 1 Thess. 3,11; viam alicujus r. f. vel ei successum dare Kuf. 12; Sir. 37,15. a recta via tendere, sive seq. ሐዊረ፡ 1 Reg. 6,12; Kuf. 21; sive absolute, ut: አርቲዖ፡ የሐውር፡ Prov. 15,21; Ps. 118,128. b prospere agere, successum habere Dan. 8,24; Dan. 11,27; Ps. 100,9; Ps. 139,12. 3 sensu ethico: rectum, justum, probum, sincerum facere: አርትዖ፡ ፍትሕ፡ Prov. 1,3; አርትዕ፡ ልበከ፡ Sir. 2,2; አርታዕኩ፡ ነፍስየ፡ Sir. 51,20; አርትዕ፡ እዴከ፡ Sir. 38,10, vel corrigere, emendare, ut: አርትዖ፡ ጸዋግ፡ ልብ፡ Clem. f. 182; vel recte agere, honeste facere: ከመ፡ ታርትዕ፡ በኵሉ፡ ግብርከ፡ Kuf. 21; Mich. 7,2. 4 verum dicere, ut: አርታዕከ፡ ነገረ፡ ἄριστα ἔφης Cyr. c. Pall. f. 96; vel verum aliquem dixisse declarare: እመ፡ ነበበ፡ ቃሎ፡ ያረትዑ፡ ሎቱ፡ Sir. 13,22; vel justum declarare aliquem, sensu forensi, c. ለ፡ pers. Deut. 25,1; vel verificare ratum facere aliquid 2 Reg. 7,24. 5 recte componere, ordinare, ut: ecclesiam, Syn. ʾartǝʿa G አርትዐ፡ ʾartǝʿa II,1 ያረትዕ፡, ያርትዕ፡ «redresser, diriger, justifier, corriger, rendre favorable» ― አቀና፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 59r. 152 L አርትዐ ʾartǝʿa straighten, make right, render straight, set up, stabilize, redress, justify, recitify, convince, correct, establish, direct, succeed, declare right or true, declare in someone’s favour አርትዐ፡ ፍኖቶ ʾartǝʿa fǝnoto he went toward, vid. ፍኖት፡ 475b

woorden.betekenis: corrigi, in melius reparari, tarātǝʿa, be reformed, be corre
woorden.definitie: III,3 ad rectiorem conditionem tandere i.e. corrigi, in melius reparari, de ratione rerum mutua: እስከ፡ አመ፡ ይትራታዕ፡ μέχρι καιροῦ διορθώσεως Hebr. 9,10. tarātǝʿa L ተራትዐ tarātǝʿa be reformed, be corrected 476a

woorden.betekenis: erectus, rectus, planus, probus, sincerus, integer, verus, f
woorden.definitie: part. A Adj. 1 erectus, rectus, planus, sensu physico: 3 Reg. 20,11 (opp. ዘሰናም፡); ርቱዕ፡ እገሪሆሙ፡ Hez. 1,7; (ሰኰት፡) ርትዕት፡ Act. 9,11; Matth. 3,3; Hebr. 12,13; ፍናው፡ ርቱዓት፡ Prov. 2,13; ርቱዕ፡ ኵሉ፡ ፍኖቱ፡ Jes. 45,13; Jes. 26,7; Hez. 33,17 seq.; Hen. 76,11; በርቱዕ፡ Ps. 25,12. 2 sensu ethico: probus, sincerus, integer; εὐθύς ርቱዓነ፡ ልብ፡ Ps. 31,14; Ps. 10,2; Act. 8,21; ὀρθός Prov. 11,6; በልብ፡ ርቱዕ፡ ἐν εὐθύτητι Ps. 118,7; δίκαιος (opp. ኃጥኣን፡) Job 17,8. 3 ubi de ordine et ratione et veritate agitur, rectus, verus, fidus Hen. 72,3; Prov. 8,9; Jes. 38,3; ርቱዕ፡ ፍካሬ፡ Dan. 2,45; Deut. 5,25; Ex. 18,7; ርቱዐ፡ ይቤላ፡ Num. 27,7; Ps. 18,9; ሃይማኖት፡ ርትዕት፡ fides recta et ርቱዐ፡ ሃይማኖት፡ orthodoxus creberrime; ርቱዕ፡ ጽሕፈቱ፡ de literis recte (orthographice) scriptis, Lud. auct. Gregor. 4 justus, aequus; inde saepissime impers.: decet, convenit, par est, oportet sive seq. Infin., ut: አክብሮ፡ ርቱዕ፡ ቃለ፡ ስቡሐ፡ χρῆ τιμᾶν Prov. 25,27; አኮ፡ ርቱዕ፡ ለገቢሮቱ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ Kuf. 28; sive seq. Subj.: δεῖ Ruth 4,5; Tob. 12,1; ለከ፡ ርቱዕ፡ ይስግዱ፡ Ep. Jer. 5; Luc. 15,32; Hebr. 2,1; Tit. 1,11; ἄξιος ርቱዕ፡ ይትወከፍዎ፡ 1 Tim. 4,9; κρίσις አንተ፡ ርቱዕ፡ ታጥርያ፡ Jer. 39,7; δίκαιον አኮ፡ ርቱዕ፡ ያስተአክይዎ፡ Sir. 10,23; συμφέρει ኢኮነ፡ ርቱዐ፡ ይኅድጎሙ፡ ንጉሥ፡ Esth. 3,8; ὀφείλειν Rom. 15,1; 2 Thess. 1,3; Hebr. 2,17; ὄφελον ርቱዕ፡ ይሖር፡ 4 Reg. 5,3; Gal. 5,12 Platt; alia 4 Esr. 10,15; ርቱዕ፡ ትብክዮ፡ ለዘሞተ፡ Sir. 22,11; Did. 4al. (synonima sunt ይደሉ፡, መፍትው፡). B Adv. ርቱዐ፡, raro ርቱዕ፡ (ut 2 Reg. 12,5), vel በርቱዕ፡ (ut 4 Esr. 10,13) 1 recte sensu physico: ዘርቱዐ፡ የዐርግ፡ እምነ፡ ምድር፡ (ὄρθιος) 1 Reg. 28,14; ቀዊም፡ ርቱዐ፡ Luc. 13,11; Act. 14,10; አቀመኒ፡ በእገርየ፡ ርቱዐ፡ 4 Esr. 10,44. a recta (via), in rectum: አንሥኢ፡ አዕይንቲኪ፡ ርቱዐ፡ Prov. 14,2; Kuf. 8; ሐጽ፡ ዘየሐውር፡ ርቱዐ፡ Rel. Bar. b e regione, exadversum Hen. 72,8. 2 de eo, quod rationi, naturae, usui consentaneum est: recte, bene, vere Marc. 7,35; Luc. 20,21; በርቱዕ፡ re vera Joh. 4,23. 3 jure, merito: ርቱዕ፡ ይመውት፡ (sensu convenit cum ርቱዕ፡ ይሙት፡ vid. A Nr. 4 2 Reg. 12,5; ርቱዕ፡ ይትኀፈሩ፡ Job 6,20 (quamquam hunc locum etiam ad A Nr. 4referre licet); በርቱዕሰ፡ (v. ወርቱዕሰ፡) ላቲ፡ ይደልዋ፡ ትሕዝን፡ 4 Esr. 10,13. – Voc. Ae.: ርቱዕ፡ ዘ፡ ቅን። rǝtuʿ, fem. rǝtǝʿt, ራትዕት፡ ratǝʿt; Pl. ርቱዓን፡ rǝtuʿān, fem. ርትዓት፡ rǝtǝʿāt, ራትዓት፡ rǝtǝʿāt G ርቱዕ፡ rǝtuʿ, Pl. ርቱዓን፡ rǝtuʿān (choses) «droit» ― ቅን፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 59r. 152 ራትዕት፡ ratǝʿt fem., Pl. ራትዓት፡ rǝtǝʿāt et ርትዕት፡ rǝtǝʿt, Pl. ርትዓት፡ rǝtǝʿāt «droite, juste, équitable etc.» ― ቅን፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 59r. 152 L ርቱዕ rǝtuʿ (fem. ርትዕት rǝtǝʿt) upright, straight, just, right, righteous, honest, true, correct, proper, level, even, orthodox; followed by the subjunctif it means it is seemly (proper, appropriate) ርቱዐ፡ ሃይማኖት፡ rǝtuʿa hāymānot orthodox, vid.ሃይማኖት፡ ርቱዓነ፡ ሃይማኖት rǝtuʿāna hāymānot Orthodox Fathers, vid. ሃይማኖት፡ ርቱዐ rǝtuʿa, በርቱዕ ba-rǝtuʿ uprightly, straightforward, rightly, correctly, truly, in truth, with uprightness, straightway 476a ርቱዐ፡ ሃይማኖት፡ rǝtuʿa hāymānot orthodox, vid. ሃይማኖት፡ 221b C for ሃይማኖት፡ ርትዕት፡ vid. ሃይማኖት፡ (Grébaut, Leslau)

woorden.betekenis: probus, sincerus, integer, candidus, verus, verax, rātǝʿ, rā
woorden.definitie: part. act., rectus i.e. probus, sincerus, integer, candidus; verus, verax, de personis: εὐθύς Prov. 29,10; Ps. 32,1; Ps. 106,42; Ps. 139,14; Koh. 7,29; κατορθοῦντες ራትዓን፡ Prov. 2,7; ἀληθής ብእሲ፡ ራትዕ፡ 2 Esr. 17,2; Matth. 22,16; ἀληθινός Job 1,1; Job 8,21; Job 27,17; Num. 24,3; ὅσιος Apoc. 16,5; εὐσεβεῖς ራትዓን፡ Jes. 26,7; de Jacobo Kuf. 19; de Lea Kuf. 36; de judice Org. rātǝʿ, Pl. ራትዓን፡ rātǝʿān G ራትዕ፡ rātǝʿ, Pl. ራትዓን፡ rātǝʿān (personnes) «droit, juste, équitable, sincère, véritable» ― ቅን፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 59r. 152 L ራትዕ rātǝʿ upright, straight, straightforward, just, honest, righteous, fair, truthful, sincere 476a

woorden.betekenis: rectitudo, statura recta, temperies, probitas, integritas, c
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem. 1 rectitudo, ut: statura recta κατόρθωσις 2 Par. 3,17; temperies Hen. 76,6. 2 a probitas, integritas, candor, εὐθύτης Ps. 10,8; 1 Reg. 9,4. b rectum, jus fasque, nec non justitia, aequitas (saepissime conjunctum cum ጽድቅ፡ et ፍትሕ፡), κρίμα, εὐθύτης, διακιοσύνη Job 29,14; ኢገብሩ፡ ርትዐ፡ Jes. 5,7; Jes. 5,16; ከመ፡ ይግበሩ፡ ፍትሐ፡ ወርትዐ፡ Kuf. 4; ዘይነብብ፡ ርትዐ፡ Jes. 33,15; በፍትሕ፡ ወጽድቅ፡ ወርትዕ፡ Jer. 4,2; Jer. 23,5; Jos. 24,14; Ps. 110,7; Koh. 12,10; τὰ ὀεθά Mich. 3,9; በርትዕ፡ jure Enc. c verum, veritas (τὸ ἀληθές, τὰ ἀληθῆ, ἀλήθεια) Job 5,12; Job 17,10; ኢነበብክሙ፡ ርትዐ፡ Job 42,8; Phil. 4,8; Gen. 24,27; Jes. 11,5; Jes. 26,2; Jes. 59,15; Ps. 84,11; Ps. 84,12; Ps. 95,13; Eph. 5,9; 1 Joh. 1,6; ሎግዮ፡ ዘበነገረ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ወርትዕ፡ Sir. 45,10. rǝtʿ G ርትዕ፡ rǝtʿ «justice, vérite, droiture, équité, sincérité» ― ቅንነት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 59v. 152 L ርትዕ rǝtʿ uprightness, rectitude, righteousness, justice, integrity, equity (in judgement), honesty, truth, truthfulness በርትዕ ba-rǝtʿ justly 476a

woorden.betekenis: rectitudo, facile est rectum fieri, probitas, rǝtʿat, rectit
woorden.definitie: n. act. rectitudo; et sensu physico, ut: ἕως ἂν χωλεία τὸ πρᾶγμα, εὔκολον γενέσθαι ὀρθόν ይቀልል፡ ርትዐቱ፡ facile est rectum fieri Chrys. ho. 31; et tehico, ut: ርትዐተ፡ ልብ፡ (opp. ጥውየተ፡ ልብ፡) probitas F.N. 10,6. rǝtʿat L ርትዐት rǝtʿat rectitude, probity 476a

woorden.betekenis: amplum esse
woorden.definitie: amplum esse vid. sub ርሕበ፡

woorden.betekenis: esuriens, famelicus, fame enectus, rǝḫub, rǝḫǝbt, rǝḫubān, r
woorden.definitie: part. esuriens, famelicus, fame enectus: Ps. 106,9; Ps. 106,36; Ps. 145,5; Job 22,7; Job 24,10; ነፍስ፡ ርኅብት፡ Jes. 32,6; Jes. 58,10; Prov. 27,7; ርኁባን፡ Jes. 40,29; Jes. 58,7; Tob. 1,17; ርኁባኒሆሙ፡ Marc. 8,3; Matth. 25,44; እስመ፡ ርኁብ፡ ሀገር፡ 4 Reg. 7,4. rǝḫub, fem. ርኅብት፡ rǝḫǝbt; Pl. ርኁባን፡ rǝḫubān, fem. ርኁባት፡ rǝḫubāt G ርኁብ፡ rǝḫub, Pl. ርኁባን፡ rǝḫubān et ርኅብት፡ rǝḫǝbt, Pl. ርኁባት፡ rǝḫubāt «affamé et affamée, qui a faim, pauvre» ― የተራበ፡, የተራበች፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 59v. 153 L ርኁብ rǝḫub hungry, starving, famished 468a

woorden.betekenis: patefacere, aperire, reserare, expugnare, ʾarḫawa, ouvrir, r
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 patefacere, aperire, reserare, c. Acc., ut: አርኀወት፡ ኆኅተ፡ Tob. 8,13; ኣርኁ፡ አናቅጸ፡ Jes. 45,1; አርኁ፡ ሊተ፡ አብያተ፡ ዘዕፅዋን፡ 4 Esr. 3,49; 1 Reg. 3,15; 1 Par. 9,27; Ps. 23,7; Ps. 23,9; Job 38,32; Job 41,5; እመ፡ አርኀውከ፡ ሰማየ፡ Jes. 64,1; አፈወ፡ አንቅዕት፡ Kuf. 5; መስኮተ፡ Gen. 8,6; 4 Reg. 13,17; አርኀዋ፡ ለታቦት፡ Kuf. 5; ማሕፀነ፡ Kuf. 28; መቃብረ፡ Hez. 37,13; መዝገበ፡ Jer. 27,25; Hen. 60,21; Matth. 2,11; አፉሃ፡ Apoc. 12,16; ጕርዔ፡ Sir. 34,12; እደ፡ Deut. 15,8; Deut. 15,11; etiam omisso objecto: ለእመ፡ አርኀወ፡ ውእቱ፡ መኑ፡ ዘየዐፁ፡ Jes. 22,22; Job 12,14; Apoc. 3,7; c. pron. suff. vice Dativi: አርኅወኒ፡ ἄνοιξόν μοι Cant. 5,2; Cant. 5,5; Deut. 20,11; Matth. 25,11; Apoc. 3,20; Jud. 3,25. 2 expugnare (in libris ex Arabico translatis), urbem, terram: አርኀወ፡ ሀገረ፡ Jsp. p. 296; Jsp. p. 299; Jsp. p. 313; Jsp. p. 347; Abush. 48; Sx. Sen. 26. ʾarḫawa G አርኀወ፡ ʾarḫawa II,1 ያርኁ፡ «ouvrir» ― ከፈተ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 59v. 153 L rḫw, አርኀወ ʾarḫawa open, unlock, take by assault (a city); with object suffix pronouns it also serves for the expression of an indirect object: e.g. አርኀወኒ ʾarḫawanni he opened for me 468b

woorden.betekenis: se aperire, aperiri, patere, expugnari, tarǝḫwa, être ouvert
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 refl. et pass. se aperire, aperiri, patere; de janua Hez. 46,1; Ps. 23,7; Ps. 23,9; Nah. 2,6; በኵሉ፡ ጊዜ፡ ይትረኀዉ፡ አናቅጽኪ፡ Jes. 60,11; ይትረኀውኑ፡ ለከ፡ አንቀጸ፡ ሞት፡ Job 38,17; ተርኅወ፡ አስራበ፡ ሰማይ፡ Gen. 7,11; አፈወ፡ አንቅዕት፡ Kuf. 5; ሰማይ፡ Job 14,12; Hez. 1,1; Matth. 3,16; Joh. 1,52; መዛግብት፡ Hen. 54,7; መሳክው፡ Hen. 72,7; በአርኅዎተ፡ ምድር፡ Num. 16,30; ብሔር፡ Zach. 13,1; ገነት፡ 4 Esr. 8,62; አዕይንት፡ Kuf. 3; እዝን፡ Marc. 7,34 (ubi ed. rom. ተረኀይ፡ pro ተረኀው፡ praebet); transl.: ትትረኀው፡ እኪት፡ (תִּפָּתַח) Jer. 1,14. 2 expugnari (vid. II,1 Nr. 2): ወኮነዝ፡ ምክንያተ፡ ተርኅዎታ፡ ለሀገር፡ Jsp. p. 365. – Voc. Ae.: ተርኅወ፡ ዘ፡ ተከፈተ፡ tarǝḫwa G ተርኅወ፡ tarǝḫwa III,1 ይትረኀው፡ «être ouvert» ― ተከፈተ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 59v. 153 L ተርኅወ tarǝḫwa be opened, open (intr), be taken by assault (a city) 468b

woorden.betekenis: apertus, patens, rǝḫǝw, rǝḫut, rǝḫǝwān, rǝḫǝwāt, ouvert, ouv
woorden.definitie: part., fem. ርኁት፡, apertus, patens: ርኅው፡ ኆኅትየ፡ Job 31,32; ይረክብዎ፡ (ለአንቀጽ፡) ርኅወ፡ Jsp. p. 377; ኆኅት፡ ርኁት፡ Apoc. 3,8; Apoc. 4,1; Act. 16,27 Platt; 1 Cor. 16,9; ኀዋኅው፡ ርኅዋት፡ Hen. 32,2; Hen. 36,1 seq.; መሳክው፡ ርኅዋት፡ Hen. 72,7; ርእየ፡ ሰማየ፡ ርኅወ፡ Act. 10,11; ርኅው፡ ሎሙ፡ መካነ፡ ትዕግሥትየ፡ 4 Esr. 9,12. rǝḫǝw, fem. rǝḫut; Pl. ርኅዋን፡ rǝḫǝwān, fem. ርኅዋት፡ rǝḫǝwāt G ርኅው፡ rǝḫǝw, Pl. ርኅዋን፡ rǝḫǝwān «ouvert» ― የተከፈተ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 59v. ርኁት፡ rǝḫut fem., Pl. ርኅዋት፡ rǝḫǝwāt «ouverte» ― የተከፈተች፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 59v. 153 L ርኅው፡ rǝḫǝw (fem. ርኁት rǝḫut) open, obvious ርኅወ፡ ሰማይ rǝḫwa samāy day on which heaven is open to receive prayer (Getatchew), vid. ሰማይ፡ 468b

woorden.betekenis: clavis, marḫo, marāḫut, marāḫǝw, marāḫutāt, clef, instrument
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. መራኁት፡, clavis Jud. 3,25; እሙንቱ፡ እለ፡ ይእኅዙ፡ መራኁተ፡ ቤተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ 1 Par. 9,27; Jes. 22,22; ዝንቱ፡ መራኁት፡ Rel. Bar.; Matth. 16,19; Clem. f. 86; Apoc. 1,18; nonnumquam መራኁት፡ pro ἡ κλείς ut Apoc. 9,1; Apoc. 20,1; Sx. Sen. 12; { Pl. Pl. መራኁታት፡ M.M. f. 59, vid. sub ግወት፡}. – Voc. Ae.: መርኆ፡ ዘ፡ መክፈቻ። marḫo, Pl. marāḫut, መራኅው፡ marāḫǝw, Pl.Pl. marāḫutāt G መርኆ፡ marḫo, Pl. መራኁት፡ marāḫut «clef, instrument pour ouvrir» ― መክፈቻ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 59v. 153 መራኅው፡ pluriel brisé de መርኆ፡, ne mentionne que le pluriel መራኁት፡ (‘clefs’). 451 L መርኆ marḫo (Pl. መራኁት marāḫut, መራኁታት marāḫutāt, መራኅው marāḫǝw) key 468b C for ዓቃቤ፡ መርኆ፡ vid. ዐቃቢ፡

woorden.betekenis: caput, principem esse, praeesse, rǝʾsa, raʾasa, être ou deve
woorden.definitie: vel ረአሰ፡ I,1 denom. [i.q. رَأَسَ] caput vel principem esse, praeesse: ረአሰ፡ ውእቱ፡ ለቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ Col. 1,18 Polygl.; ተለአኮ፡ ለነግድ፡ ለመ፡ አብርሃም፡ ወተተሐት፡ ለዘትርእስ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ከመ፡ ዳዊት፡ Phlx. 1; Org. 1. rǝʾsa, raʾasa G ርእሰ፡ rǝʾsa I,1 ይርእስ፡, ይርአስ፡ «être ou devenir chef» ― አለቃ፡ ሆነ፡, ራስ፡ ሆነ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 59v. 153 L ርእሰ፡ rǝʾsa, ረአሰ raʾasa become (be) chief, rise above (denominative) 458a

woorden.betekenis: caput, capillo, corpore, vita, ipse, me ipsum, sua sponte, s
woorden.definitie: subst. [רוֹשׁ ܪܺܝܫܳܐ رَأَسَ, amh. ራስ፡] m., rarius fem. (ut Apoc. 13,3; M.M. f. 231 de capite corporis), Pl. አርእስት፡ (semel, sc. 1 Par. 12,20 in Cod. Abb. CXLI reperi ርእሳን፡, sed alii habent ርኡሳን፡), Pl. Pl. አርእስታት፡ 1 caput corporis hominum et animalium Matth. 5,36; Matth. 6,17; Matth. 8,20; Gen. 3,15; Gen. 40,16; Gen. 40,19; Gen. 48,14; Gen. 48,17; 4 Reg. 4,19; Ps. 3,3; Ps. 109,6; Ps. 109,7; Apoc. 9,17; Apoc. 9,19; Apoc. 12,3; Apoc. 13,3; ርእስ፡ ወዘነብ፡ Jes. 9,14; አልቦ፡ ርእስ፡ ዘየአኪ፡ እምርእሰ፡ አርዌ፡ ምድር፡ Sir. 25,15; 4 Esr. 11,1 seq.; 2 Reg. 3,8; et aliis in locis innumeris; መካን፡ ዘይመትሩ፡ ውስቴቱ፡ አርእስታተ፡ Sx. Haml. 5. a synecdochice pro capillo, non tantum in locutione: ተላጸየ፡ ርእሶ፡ ut Num. 6,19; sed etiam ፀፈረት፡ ርእሳ፡ Judith 16,8. b pro corpore vel vita: ዐቀብተ፡ ርእሱ፡ οἱ φυλάσσοντες τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ 1 Esr. 3,4; Dan. 1,10. { c caput metallicum clavae, Sx. Ter 1 Enc. (vid. sub ዝቡጥ፡; in Actis Sx.
