woorden.betekenis: videre, visus, vidit eum venientem, venire, si, num, an, vis
woorden.definitie: I,1 [רָאָה رَأَى] Imperf. ይሬኢ፡ (raro ይርኢ፡ ut Ps. 118,74; 4 Esr. 9,9), Subj. ይርአይ፡, Imperat. ርኢ፡, rarius ረአይ፡ (ut Jos. 2,1 ann.; Luc. 9,38 Platt), Infin. ርኢይ፡ vel ርእይ፡ (gramm. § 92), et ርእዮት፡ (ut Hen. 14,19; Hen. 85,4). 1 videre, absol., ut: ርእይ፡ visus (sensus) Clem. f. 237al.; ይርአዩ፡ ዕዉራን፡ Jes. 61,1; Ps. 9,34; Ps. 44,12; Matth. 13,14; Joh. 9,39; Rom. 11,10; c.c. Acc. Ps. 49,20; Matth. 2,2; Matth. 4,16; Matth. 5,1; Matth. 5,16; Matth. 9,36; Matth. 11,9; Gen. 33,5; Gen. 42,7; Ex. 3,7; Ex. 3,9; መኑ፡ ይጸግብ፡ እምርእየ፡ ሠናይቱ፡ Sir. 42,24 (innumeris in locis); c. dupl. Acc. objecti et praedicati: ዘርኢከ፡ እምውስቴቶሙ፡ ጠቢበ፡ ትልዎ፡ Sir. 6,34; Gen. 32,2; Matth. 25,37; vel c. Acc. et ከመ፡, ut: ርእዮ፡ ለብርሃን፡ ከመ፡ ሠናይ፡ Gen. 1,4; Gen. 1,8; Hebr. 11,23; Ps. 105,42; ርኢኩኪ፡ ከመ፡ በጽሐ፡ ጊዜኪ፡ Hez. 16,8; Marc. 9,25; vel c. Acc. et ዘ፡ c. verb. fin., ut Act. 8,23 Platt; vel c. Acc. et እንዘ፡, ut: ርእየቶ፡ እንዘ፡ ይመጽእ፡ vidit eum venientem (venire) Tob. 11,5; Matth. 3,7; Matth. 3,16; Matth. 24,30; vel c. Acc. seq. verbo finito, ut: ርኢክዎ፡ መጽአ፡ 1 Reg. 22,9; ርኢኩ፡ ብእሴ፡ ይጼዐን፡ Zach. 1,8; ርኢኩኪ፡ ትሰክቢ፡ ውስተ፡ ደምኪ፡ Hez. 16,6; Hez. 33,3; vel seq. enuntiatione integra, ut: ርኢኩ፡ መንፈስ፡ መጽአ፡ Hez. 1,4; ርኢኩ፡ ክልኤቲ፡ አንስት፡ የሐውራ፡ Zach. 5,9; Ex. 2,6; vel seq. ከመ፡ c. verbo finito: Gen. 16,5; Gen. 30,1; Ex. 3,4; Num. 24,1; Jes. 56,10; vel seq. እመ፡ vel ለእመ፡ si, num, an, ut: ርእዩ፡ እመ፡ ኮነ፡ ከመዝ፡ Jer. 2,10; Gen. 37,14; 1 Reg. 21,8; Matth. 27,49; vel aliis particulis relat. vel interrog. ut Hen. 5,3; Hen. 9,6; 1 Joh. 3,1. a visum recuperare Matth. 11,5; Luc. 7,21; Luc. 18,41; Joh. 9,15. b videre visiones: ርእየ፡ ሕልመ፡ Gen. 41,1; ነቢያትኪ፡ ርእዩ፡ ለኪ፡ ከንቶ፡ Thren. 2,14; ራእየ፡ ይሬእዩ፡ Joel 3,1; Hen. 39,4; ዘይሬኢ፡ (Seher) 1 Par. 29,29; Infin. ርእይ፡ visio Dan. 7,1; Dan. 7,15 (v. ራእይ፡); እለ፡ ይሬእዩ፡ በከርሥ፡ ἐγγαστριμύθοι 2 Par. 35,19. 2 spectare, adspicere, intueri c. Acc.: ኢትርአያኒ፡ Cant. 1,6; Ps. 8,4; Gen. 11,5; Gen. 24,21; Gen. 34,1; Lev. 13,3; Lev. 13,5; Lev. 13,17; 1 Reg. 16,7; Hen. 2,3; Hen. 14,21; Hen. 38,4; Matth. 5,28; Matth. 6,28; Matth. 28,1; Marc. 12,41; Luc. 9,38; Joh. 19,37; Apoc. 1,12; rarius c. ኀበ፡, ut: ርእዩ፡ ኀበ፡ ዝንቱ፡ እኅው፡ Genz. f. 120; c. በ፡, ut: ትሬእዩ፡ ወኮከበ፡ ሰማይ፡ ὁρῶντες τοὺς ἀστέρας Jes. 47,13; Cant. 7,1; omisso objecto, ut: ርኢ፡ እምቤተ፡ መቅደስከ፡ Jes. 63,15. a speculari: ዘይሬኢ፡ ὂ σκοπός 2 Reg. 18,24; 2 Reg. 18,25; c. Acc., ut Gen. 42,9; Num. 13,2. b spectare, spectatorem adesse (zusehen): ቆሙ፡ እንዘ፡ ይሬእዩ፡ Asc. Jes. 5,12; ኢይከውን፡ ንርአይ፡ እንዘ፡ ያስተሐቅሩ፡ ንጉሠ፡ 2 Esr. 4,14; Matth. 27,55; Luc. 23,35; Marc. 15,47; Gen. 21,16. c oculis inhaerere alicui (ut ex adspectu gaudium percipiat) c. በ፡ Ps. 53,7; Ps. 91,11; Ps. 111,7; Koh. 7,15; c. Acc. Ps. 117,7. d respicere Luc. 1,48; Act. 4,29; Ps. 24,19; Ps. 30,9; Gen. 29,32; c. ለ፡ Ex. 5,21. e sibi vel alii providere vel eligere aliquid, c. Acc. et ለ፡ pers., Gen. 22,8; Kuf. p. 68; Num. 10,33; Num. 27,16; 1 Reg. 16,1; 1 Reg. 16,17; ርኢ፡ ሎቱ፡ ዐስቦ፡ ለዝኩ፡ ወልድ፡ Tob. 12,1. f habere aliquid pro aliquo (ansehen für etwas) seq. Acc. et ከመ፡, ut Jud. 9,36; Marc. 11,32; Matth. 14,5. g visere, visitare 4 Reg. 8,29; 2 Reg. 13,5; Luc. 8,20; Rom. 1,11; 1 Thess. 3,6. 3 animadvertere, cognoscere, intelligere: ልብየ፡ ርእየት፡ ብዙኀ፡ ጥበበ፡ Koh. 1,17; Koh. 2,12; 1 Reg. 24,12; Jes. 40,5; Joh. 4,19; Act. 17,22 Platt; Rom. 11,22; Hebr. 2,8; Hebr. 7,4; Jac. 2,24; 1 Joh. 3,1; rarius: considerare, ut Act. 15,6 Platt; Lit. Greg. 4 videre a casus futuros (erleben, iis interesse; vivum et superstitem esse, usque dum accidant) Gen. 44,34; Num. 11,15; Hen. 12,7; Luc. 2,26; Joh. 8,56. b res adversas vel secundas (experiri, sentire, gustare, vel voluptatem vel dolorem inde percipere): ያፈቅር፡ ይርአይ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ሠናያተ፡ Ps. 33,13; 1 Petr. 3,10; ሠናይተ፡ ኢርእየ፡ Koh. 6,6; Koh. 7,16; Koh. 8,16; Koh. 9,9; Ps. 88,47; Ps. 15,10; Apoc. 18,7. – Voc. Ae.: ነጸረ፡ ወርእየ፡ ዘ፡ ሐየ። rǝʾya G ርእየ፡ rǝʾya I,1 ይሬኢ፡, ይርአይ፡ (impératif 2e pers. ርኢ፡), «voir» ― አየ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 60r. 154 L ርእየ rǝʾya (yǝrʾay) see, observe, look, look at, look on, regard, contemplate, consider, watch, have a vision, take notice of, behold, perceive, explore ዘይሬኢ zayǝreʾi seer 458b

woorden.betekenis: videre facere, monstrare, ostendere, visibilem reddere, visi
woorden.definitie: II,1 Imperf. ያሬኢ፡ (ut in quibusdam codicibus 4 Esr. 13,52; Koh. 2,24) et plerumque ያርኢ፡, Subj. ያርኢ፡, videre facere i.e. 1 monstrare, ostendere: c. dupl. Acc.: ያርእዩነ፡ ፍኖቶ፡ Mich. 4,2; Gen. 12,1; Kuf. 4; Jes. 39,2; Jes. 40,14; Jes. 48,17; Jes. 53,11; Judith 13,15; Hen. 1,2; አርአዮሙ፡ እኪተኒ፡ ወሠናይተኒ፡ Sir. 17,7; Sir. 25,25; እለ፡ አርአዮሙ፡ ርእሶ፡ ሕያወ፡ Act. 1,3 Platt; Joh. 14,8; Joh. 20,20; Matth. 4,8; Jac. 2,18; Apoc. 21,9; Apoc. 21,10; vel c. Acc. rei et ለ፡ pers., ut Hen. 13,2; Hen. 69,1; Hen. 105,1; Lev. 13,49; Matth. 8,4; vel c. Acc. rei: Jac. 3,13; ኣርኢ፡ ኀይልየ፡ ላዕሌከ፡ Rom. 9,17; አርአየ፡ ኀይሎ፡ በውስተ፡ ብርሃን፡ Job 28,11; ይደግም፡ አርእዮ፡ እዴሁ፡ Jes. 11,11; ያርኢ፡ ትእምርተ፡ ἀρεῖ σημεῖον Jes. 11,12; Jes. 30,30; እግዚአብሔር፡ ያርኢ፡ ገጾ፡ ላዕሌከ፡ Num. 6,26; Ps. 66,1; Ps. 97,3; vel seq. enuntiatione integra vel conj. ከመ፡, ut: አርአየኒሁ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለካህን፡ ዐቢይ፡ ይቀውም፡ Zach. 3,1; Rom. 1,4; 4 Reg. 8,10. a visibilem reddere Hen. 89,3. b visionem videre facere: ያርእየከ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ራእየ፡ በሕልም፡ 4 Esr. 10,73; Am. 7,4; Am. 7,7. c manifestum facere, revelare: አርአየት፡ ሠቀ፡ ἐγύμνωσε σάκκον Judith 9,1; ነገር፡ ዘአርአይኩከ፡ λόγοι οὓς ἐχρημάτισα πρὸς σέ Jer. 37,2. d notum facere, certiorem reddere: Gen. 2,9; አርእየኒ፡ ወኣእምር፡ γνώρισόν μοι καὶ γνώσομαι Jer. 11,17; etiam cum በእንተ፡ rei Hen. 22,12. e cum voluptate videre facere aliquem aliquid, c. በ፡ rei Ps. 58,11. f videre facere i.e. afficere aliquem re (erzeigen, vid. ርእየ፡ Nr. 4,b) c. dupl. Acc.: ያሬእያ፡ ሠናየ፡ ለነፍሱ፡ Koh. 2,24; Gen. 50,15; Gen. 50,17; Ps. 59,3; Ps. 70,22; Ps. 84,7; Ps. 90,16. 2 lumen perfundere (ut videre possis), lucere (scheinen): ፀሓይ፡ ያበርህ፡ ወያርኢ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ Sir. 42,16; Joh. 1,5; Ex. 25,37. ʾarʾaya G አርአየ፡ ʾarʾaya II,1 ያርኢ፡ «montrer, faire voir» ― አሳየ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 60r. 154 L አርአየ ʾarʾaya show, make manifest, make visible, reveal, display 458b

woorden.betekenis: videri, conspiciendum se praebere, comparere, adparere, invi
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 refl. et pass. ad I,1: videri, conspiciendum se praebere, comparere, adparere Hen. 75,3; Act. 27,20 rom.; Ex. 16,10; Hen. 69,29; c. Dat. pers. Hen. 38,4; c. Acc. vel Nom. praed., ut: ተርእየት፡ ማይ፡ ርግዕተ፡ Sap. 19,7; Ex. 23,15; Ex. 25,8; መፍትው፡ ለአንስት፡ ይትረአያ፡ በአርአያ፡ ህድአት፡ ወበትሕትና፡ ፍድፉድ፡ F.M. 34,8; ዘኢይትረአይ፡ invisibilis Sap. 17,18. 2 pass. ad II,1: monstrari, ostendi, c. ለ፡ pers. Hen. 36,3; Hen. 59,3. tarǝʾya G ተርእየ tarǝʾya III,1 ይትረአይ፡ «être vu, apparaître, comparaître» ― ታየ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 60r. 154 L ተርእየ tarǝʾya be seen, be shown, appear, seem ዘይትረአይ zayǝtraʾay visible ዘኢይትረአይ zaʾiyyǝtraʾay invisible 458b

woorden.betekenis: se conspiciendum praebere, se aperire, apparere, comparare,
woorden.definitie: IV,1 Imperf. ያስተርኢ፡, rarius ያስተሬኢ፡ (ut 4 Esr. 13,37 Laur.; 4 Esr. 13,40 Laur.) 1 facere, ut (agens) ipse videatur i.e. a se conspiciendum praebere, se aperire, apparere, comparare, de rebus et personis (quae antea occultae, invisibiles, incognitae fuerant; etiam de iis, quae antea non exstiterant), potissimum de apparitionibus spirituum et visionum: Gen. 1,9; Gen. 8,5; ያስተርኢ፡ ሢበትኪ፡ Jes. 47,2; ኀሳርኪ፡ Jes. 47,3; Jer. 13,26; ወርኅ፡ Asc. Jes. 4,5; መብረቅ፡ Matth. 24,27; ያስተርኢ፡ ከመ፡ ሕልመ፡ ሌሊት፡ Job 20,8; 4 Esr. 8,64; Hen. 38,1; Hen. 38,2; Matth. 9,33; ያስተርኢ፡ ስብሐተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Jes. 40,5; አስተርአየ፡ ላዕሌኪ፡ Jes. 60,2; c.c. ለ፡ ejus, cui quis se conspiciendum praebet: 4 Esr. 9,29; Jes. 66,14; plerumque c. Acc. Gen. 12,7; Kuf. 16; Hen. 14,4; Hen. 14,8; Jer. 38,3; አንሰ፡ አስተርአይኩክሙ፡ Tob. 12,19; 4 Esr. 12,16; 4 Esr. 14,3; አስተርአየኒ፡ ራእይ፡ Dan. 8,1; Matth. 1,20; Matth. 2,13; Matth. 17,3; Marc. 9,4; Marc. 16,11; Marc. 16,12; Luc. 1,11; Luc. 1,22; Luc. 9,8; Joh. 21,1; Joh. 21,14; Act. 1,3; Act. 2,3; Act. 26,19. b cognoscendum se praebere, manifestari, revelari, innotescere Hen. 59,2; ኣስተርኢ፡ በቅድመ፡ አሕዛብ፡ γνωσθήσομαι Hez. 38,23; Jes. 66,14; ἐγνωρίσθην Hez. 20,5; πεφανέρωται Rom. 3,21; Rom. 16,25; Joh. 3,21; ἀποκαλύπτεσθαι 1 Petr. 1,7; 1 Petr. 1,13; Rom. 1,17; ἐμφανὴς ἐγενόμην Rom. 10,20; Jes. 65,1; Jer. 36,14; ዘአስተርእዮ፡ i.q. ኤጲፋንያ፡ epiphania Cod. Mus. Brit. XXIX, 32. c in conspectum alicujus prodire: ኢታስተርእዩኒ፡ Jes. 1,12; 1 Petr. 4,18. d visibilem, manifestum, conspicuum esse 2 Cor. 4,18; Col. 1,16; ዘኢያስተርኢ፡ invisibilis Gen. 1,2; 1 Tim. 1,17; Hebr. 11,1; Hebr. 11,3; Jes. 45,3; መዝገብ፡ ዘኢያስተርኢ፡ θησαυρὸς ἀφανής Sir. 41,14; ብዙኅ፡ ዘኢያስተርኢ፡ πολλὰ ἀπόκρυφα Sir. 43,22; ያስተርኢ፡ ἐμφανὴς ἔσται Mich. 4,1; ዘያስተርኢ፡ περίβλεπτος Prov. 29,41; ዕለት፡ ዐባይ፡ እንተ፡ ታስተርኢ፡ μεγάλη καὶ ἐπιφανής Joel 3,4; Mal. 3,22; ኀበ፡ ኢያስተርኢ፡ አእምሮ፡ οὗ οὐκ ἐπισκοπεῖται γνῶσις Prov. 19,23; ኣአምር፡ ከመ፡ ታስተርኢ፡ ጽድቅየ፡ Job 13,18; በላዕለ፡ ውሉዱ፡ ያስተርኢ፡ ንብረቱ፡ ለሰብእ፡ Sir. 11,28. e videri (φαίνεσθαι) c. Acc. praed.: ኵሉ፡ ብእሲ፡ ያስተርኢ፡ ለርእሱ፡ ጻድቀ፡ Prov. 21,2; Prov. 26,16; ለነፍስ፡ ርኅብት፡ መሪርኒ፡ ጥዑመ፡ ያስተርእያ፡ Prov. 27,7; Matth. 23,27; 4 Esr. 4,25; seq. conj. ከመ፡ Matth. 6,16; Matth. 6,18; impers., ut: እፎ፡ አንትሙ፡ ትፈቅዱ፡ ወእፎ፡ ያስተርእየክሙ፡ ከመ፡ ኣውሥኦሙ፡ 2 Par. 10,6. f speciem praebere, similem esse, speciem induere vel prae se ferre: Hen. 3; መኑ፡ ያስተርኢ፡ ንጹሐ፡ ከዊኖ፡ እምኀጢአት፡ Prov. 20,9; ያስተርኢ፡ ከመ፡ ዘያደሉ፡ ለቢጹ፡ ወከመ፡ ዘያረትዕ፡ ፍትሖ፡ ለማኅፈሩ፡ Sir. 19,25; Hen. 17,1; አስተርእዮ፡ species (ἀνθέμιον) Koh. 12,6. g lucere (vid. II,1 Nr. 2), de astris Hez. 32,8; Apoc. 1,16; Phil. 2,15; (monachus corpus suum ita emaceravit) እስከኔ፡ ኮነት፡ ፀሓይ፡ ያስተርኢ፡ እማእከለ፡ አዕጽምተ፡ ገበዋቲሁ፡ Phlx. 16. 2 facere ut quis vel quid videatur i.e. a ostendere, manifestum vel conspicuum facere Matth. 6,5 (c. ለ፡ pers.); ኢያስተርኢ፡ ኀፍረቶ፡ (Platt: ኀፍረቱ፡) Apoc. 16,15; አስተርአዮሙ፡ ኀበ፡ ተረግዘ፡ ገቦ፡ (Christus discipulis) Sx. Mij. 6 Enc.; እስመ፡ ፪ ወልደ፡ ያስተርእዩ፡ ለነ፡ δυὰς γὰρ ἡμῖν υἱῶν ἀναφαίνεται (a Nestorianis) Cyr. c. Pall. f. 77; facere ut in conspectum prodeat Hen. 53,6. b revelare Herm. p. 7; ἀποκαλύπτειν Dan. 2,47; አስተርአዮሙ፡ (revelavit iis) በሌሊት፡ ከመ፡ ኢይግብኡ፡ Lud. e Vit. Sanct.; አስተርአየ፡ ሊተ፡ ምስጢራተ፡ ብዙኃተ፡ Sx. Tachs. 19. – (አስተርአየ፡ in libris mss. passim cum አስተስረየ፡ confusum reperitur, ut Lev. 23,27 et Lev. 23,28 (F. H); Lev. 25,9). ʾastarʾaya L አስተርአየ ʾastarʾaya manifest (tr.), become visible, show oneself, reveal oneself, be manifested, be seen, be made visible, become conspicuous, seem, show ዘያስተርኢ zayāstarʾi visible ዘኢያስተርኢ zaʾiyyāsterʾi invisible 459a

woorden.betekenis: videns visiones, vates, rāʾǝy
woorden.definitie: part. videns visiones (vates) 1 Reg. 9,9; 1 Reg. 9,11; 1 Reg. 9,18; 1 Reg. 16,4; 2 Reg. 24,11. rāʾǝy

woorden.betekenis: visus, intuitus, acies oculorum, adspectus, facies, species,
woorden.definitie: n. act. et subst. 1 visus, intuitus: እፎ፡ እክል፡ ርእየተ፡ እኪቶሙ፡ (ἰδεῖν) Esth. 8,6; { visus i.e. acies oculorum Chrys. Ta. 14(vid. sub ከፍአ፡}. 2 adspectus, facies, species Ex. 24,10; Ex. 34,30; Lev. 13,3; Lev. 13,4; Lev. 13,30; ተወለጠ፡ ርእየተ፡ ገጹ፡ Dan. 3,19; ከመ፡ ርእየተ፡ እለ፡ ቄጥሩ፡ Hez. 1,4; Hez. 1,26; ይገብሮ፡ ከመ፡ ርእየተ፡ እጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ Jes. 44,13; ከመ፡ ርእየተ፡ ድብ፡ Sir. 25,17; 4 Esr. 10,38; *Asc. Jes.|10,22 seq. ; *Hen. 32,5; Hen. 46,1; Luc. 3,22; Rom. 1,23. 3 visio, adparitio, revelatio: ሕዝቅኤል፡ ዘርእየ፡ ርእየተ፡ ስብሐቲሁ፡ Sir. 49,8; ርእየተ፡ መላእክት፡ Luc. 24,23; እሳተ፡ ርእየቱ፡ Mal. 3,2; 2 Thess. 2,8 Polygl. rǝʾyat G ራእይ፡ rāʾǝy, ርእይ፡ rǝʾǝy, ርእየት፡ rǝʾǝyat «vision, apparition, vue, aspect» ― ማየት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 60r. 154 L ርእየት rǝʾyat appearance, appearing (n.), vision, shape, image, countenance, looks, sight, spectacle 459a

woorden.betekenis: imago, similitudo, species, effigies, imago picta, sculpta,
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m. 1 imago, similitudo, species (ὁμοιότης, εἰκών) Gen. 1,12; Gen. 1,26; Jac. 3,9; 4 Reg. 16,10; ገብሮ፡ በአርአያ፡ ዚአሁ፡ Sap. 2,23; Sap. 7,26 (εἰκών); Sap. 17,20; ከመዝ፡ አርአያ፡ አምሳለ፡ ስብሐቲሁ፡ Hez. 2,1; Christus አርአያሁ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ 2 Cor. 4,4; አርአያ፡ ገጹ፡ χαρακτὴρ τῆς ὑποστάσεως αὐτοῦ Hebr. 1,3 rom.; መልክዐ፡ አርአያሁ፡ ለዘወለዶ፡ χαρακτὴρ τῆς ὑποστάσεως τοῦ γεννήσαντος αὐτόν Cyr. c. Pall. f. 67. a effigies, imago picta Hez. 23,14; sculpta Ex. 28,32. b passim usurpatur praepositionis et conjunctionis instar α በአርአያሆን፡ secundum similitudinem earum (ἐπί c. Acc.) Gen. 30,38; Gen. 30,39. β አርአያ፡ ceu, tamquam, instar, quasi Sx. Tachs. 27 Enc.; አርአያ፡ ብዙኅ፡ ዝናም፡ magnae pluviae instar Sx. Teq. 25 Enc.; አርአያ፡ ይነውም፡ ዘልፈ፡ tamquam semper dormiret Sx. Ter 21 Enc.; አርአያ፡ ዘ፡ eodem modo quo p. 502 n. 39. 2 norma; forma vel species rei ab artifice imitandae, παράδειγμα Ex. 25,9; 1 Par. 28,11 seq.; አርአያ፡ ምስለ፡ ቀዳሚ፡ አርአያሁ፡ ይዔሪ፡ ἡ εἰκὼν ὡς τὸ ἀρχέτυπον Cyr. ad Theod. f. 12; etiam norma doctrinae Rom. 6,17. 3 exemplum, exemplar a ad imitandum propositum (παράδειγμα, τύπος) Joh. 13,15; ኮነ፡ አርአያ፡ ለዓለም፡ ከመ፡ ይነስሑ፡ Sir. 44,16; Jac. 5,10; 1 Thess. 1,7; 2 Thess. 3,9; Tit. 2,7; 1 Tim. 4,12; 1 Petr. 5,3; Cyr. f. 102; ኩኖሙ፡ አርአያ፡ Clem. f. 118; Kid. 3. b ad terrendos et admonendos alios, spectaculum: Hen. 27,3; Hen. 62,12; Judae 7; ይከውኑ፡ አርአያ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ዘሥጋ፡ εἰς ὅρασιν Jes. 66,24. c libri (transcriptum), apographum: ወሀቦ፡ አርአያሃ፡ (ለመጽሐፍ፡) ያርእያሃ፡ ለአስቴር፡ Esth. 4,8; አርአያ፡ መጽሐፉ፡ ለኤርምያስ፡ ἀντίγραφον ἐπιστολῆς Ep. Jer. 1. 4 typus aliam rem significans, ὑπόδειγμα Hebr. 8,5; አርአያ፡ ወጽላሎት፡ (rerum futurarum) Clem. f. 206; Clem. f. 208; et antitypus 1 Petr. 3,21 (coll. Hebr. 9,24). 5 passim i.q. ርእየት፡ facies, species, ut: ታሤኒ፡ ገጻ፡ ወታሰረጕ፡ አርአያሃ፡ Sx. Mag. 5. ʾarʾayā G አርአያ፡ ʾarʾayā «exemple, modèle, image, figure, aspect, type; (adverbe) comme, semblablement, à l’instar de» ― አምሳያ፡, አብነት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 60v. 154 L አርአያ ʾarʾayā exemplar, similitude, likeness, example, appearance, spectacle, figure, form, shape, type, image, aspect, norm, pattern, model, standard, copy, transcription; just as, like, as አርአያ፡ ዘ ʾarʾayā za + imperfect the same way as + verb 459a

woorden.betekenis: subst. i.q. ርኳም፡, ut: (cadaver imposuerunt) በሣፁን፡
woorden.definitie: subst. i.q. ርኳም፡, ut: (cadaver imposuerunt) በሣፁን፡ ዘእብነ፡ ሩካም፡ Chrys. f. 3.

woorden.betekenis: sordes, crimen, idololatria, poena, impurus ac spurcus fuit,
woorden.definitie: I,1 [amh. ረከሰ፡; contiguum est ረስሐ፡; coll. رِكْسٌ et رِجْسٌ sordes (et crimen), رِجْزٌ رُجْزٌ sordes (idololatria, poena), نَجِسَ impurus ac spurcus fuit] Subj. ይርኰስ፡, rarius ይርኵስ፡ (vid. Lev. 19,26 ann.), immundum vel impurum esse vel fieri, se polluere, contaminari, plerumque sensu levitico et ethico, c.c. በ፡ rei, qua quis contaminatur Lev. 5,3; Lev. 18,23; Lev. 18,24; Lev. 19,26; Lev. 21,1 seq.; Num. 6,7; Num. 19,20; Deut. 24,4; Hez. 14,11; Hez. 20,7; Hez. 20,30; Hez. 23,17; Jer. 2,23; Jer. 3,1; Jer. 23,11; Thren. 4,14; Hagg. 2,13; Kuf. 4; Joh. 18,28; 1 Cor. 8,7; Rom. 1,21; ዘኢይረኵስ፡ ἀμίαντος 1 Petr. 1,4. a profanari: መቅደስየ፡ ረኵሰ፡ Hez. 25,3; 4 Esr. 10,31. b vitiari: ይረኵሳ፡ አንስት፡ Zach. 14,2. rǝkʷǝsa G ርኵሰ፡ rǝkʷǝsa I,1 ይረኵስ፡, ይርኵስ፡ «être impur, profane, souillé, pollué» ― ረከሰ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 60v. 154 L ረኵሰ rakʷǝsa (yǝrkʷas, yǝrkʷǝs) be unclean, be impure, be polluted, be contaminated, be defiled, be profaned ዘኢይረኵስ zaʾiyyǝrakʷǝs undefiled 470a

woorden.betekenis: contaminare, polluere, inquinare, profanare, ignominia affic
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 contaminare, polluere, inquinare, profanare Gen. 49,4; Lev. 11,43; Lev. 18,21; ኢታርኵሱ፡ ርእሰክሙ፡ በኵሉ፡ ዝንቱ፡ Lev. 18,24; Deut. 24,4; Kuf. 2; Kuf. 30; መቅደሰ፡ Jes. 43,28; Hez. 5,11; Hez. 24,21; ስምየ፡ Jes. 48,11; Mal. 1,12; ἔθεσθε εἰς βδέλυγμα Jer. 2,7; ምድረ፡ Jer. 3,2; Jer. 12,10; Jer. 16,18; ሰንበተ፡ Jes. 56,2; Hez. 20,13; አርኰሰ፡ መንግሥታ፡ Thren. 2,2; Ps. 73,8; Matth. 12,5; Matth. 15,11; Act. 24,6; Rom. 1,24; plerumque c. በ፡ rei, qua contaminant, sed etiam c. እምነ፡, ut: ኢታርኵስ፡ እዴከ፡ እምዝንቱ፡ Koh. 7,18. a φαυλίζειν ignominia afficere: አርኰስክሙ፡ ስምየ፡ Mal. 1,6. b polluere, vitiare mulierem Gen. 34,5; Kuf. 30; አርኵሶ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ብእሲ፡ Job 31,11; አርኰሱ፡ ድንግለ፡ Judith 9,2. 2 immundum censere vel pronuntiare (vid. IV,3) Lev. 13,3; Lev. 13,11 seq.; Hebr. 10,29; p. 240 n. 11. 3 impuri vel turpe quid committere: ኢያርኰስኩ፡ Lud. e Vit. Sanct. ʾarkʷasa G አርኰሰ፡ ʾarkʷasa II,1 ያረኵስ፡, ያርኵስ፡ «profaner, polluer, souiller, déclarer ou rendre impur» ― አረከሰ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 60v. 154 L አርኰሰ ʾarkʷasa defile, contaminate, pollute, defame, profane, declare unclean 470a

woorden.betekenis: immundus, impurus, profanus, contaminatus, pollutus, res imm
woorden.definitie: part. (passim ርኵስ፡), fem. ርኵስት፡ (passim ርኩስት፡, ut Hen. 5,4) immundus, impurus, profanus, contaminatus, pollutus, plerumque sensu levitico et ethico: Lev. 5,2; Lev. 5,3; Lev. 11,4 seq.; Lev. 11,43; Lev. 12,2; Lev. 14,57; Lev. 15,2 seq.; Lev. 22,5; Lev. 22,6; Num. 19,11; Deut. 14,3 seq.; Deut. 22,5; Deut. 24,4; ርኩስ፡ ወርሱሕ፡ Job 15,16; ርኩስ፡ ከናፍርየ፡ Jes. 6,5; Jes. 35,8; ቈላፍ፡ ወርኩስ፡ Jes. 52,1; Jes. 64,6; Thren. 4,15; ኅብስት፡ ርኩስ፡ Mal. 1,7; Prov. 3,32; 2 Esr. 9,11; መዋዕል፡ ርኩሳት፡ (opp. ቅዱሳት፡) Kuf. 6; መዓትኒ፡ ወቍጥዓ፡ ርኩሳን፡ እሙንቱ፡ Sir. 27,30; Apoc. 21,27 (κοινός); Act. 10,14; Act. 10,28; Eph. 5,5; 1 Tim. 1,9; Matth. 10,1; Marc. 1,26 rom. Etiam substantive usurpatur: res immunda, detestabilis, βδέλυγμα Jes. 44,19; Deut. 7,26; Sir. 15,13; κατάθεμα Apoc. 22,3. rǝkus, rǝkʷs, fem. rǝkʷǝst, rǝkust; Pl. ርኩሳን፡ rǝkusān, fem. ርኩሳት፡ rǝkusāt G ርኩስ፡ rǝkus, Pl. ርኩሳን፡ rǝkusān «impur, profané, abominable» ― ርኩስ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 60v. ርኵስት፡ rǝkʷǝst fem., Pl. ርኩሳት፡ rǝkusāt «impure, profanée, etc.» ― ርኩስ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 60v. 155 L ርኩስ rǝkus, (ርኵስ rǝkʷs) unclean, polluted, impure, defiled, profane, abominable, corrupt, foul ርኩሳት rǝkusāt (Pl. fem.) impourity 470a

woorden.betekenis: impuritas, pollutio, res immunda, detestabilis, turpis, rǝkʷ
woorden.definitie: subst. (passim ርኩስ፡), impuritas, pollutio; res immunda, detestabilis, turpis Lev. 7,18; Lev. 7,20; Lev. 7,21; Lev. 15,31; Lev. 16,16; Lev. 22,3 seq.; Num. 9,7 seq.; Deut. 18,9; 4 Reg. 16,3; 4 Reg. 21,2; Kuf. 3; Kuf. 16; Kuf. 20; Jes. 66,3; Jer. 4,1; Jer. 7,10; Jer. 7,30; Jer. 13,27; Jer. 16,18; Hez. 20,7 seq.; Hez. 36,25 seq.; Hen. 10,11; Matth. 23,27; Gal. 5,19; Col. 3,5; 1 Thess. 4,7; Apoc. 17,4. rǝkʷǝs, rǝkus L ርኵስ rǝkʷǝs (ርኩስ rǝkus) filth, impurity, defilement, uncleanness, pollution, abomination, anything unclean or vile 470a

woorden.betekenis: impuritas, rǝkʷsat, impurity, uncleanness, contamination
woorden.definitie: n. act. impuritas Ssal. Req. rǝkʷsat L ርኵሰት rǝkʷsat impurity, uncleanness, contamination 470a

woorden.betekenis: applicando, immittendo, componendo, insidere, conscendere, e
woorden.definitie: I,1 [potestas radicis prima in applicando, immittendo, componendo (fügen) esse videtur, vid. IV,1, nec non ركب II V VI et ܪܰܟܶܒ ܐܰܪܟܶܒ; hinc propagatur a) insidere, conscendere, equitare, vehi רָכַב ܪܟܶܒ رَكِبَ, coll. መርከብ፡, አርኩባት፡ b) potiri, assequi, invenire ረከበ፡ I,1; II,1; III,1] Subj. ይርከብ፡ et ይርክብ፡ 1 adipisci, nancisci, assequi, obtinere, potiri c.c. Acc.: ለእመ፡ ዴገንካ፡ ለጽድቅ፡ ትረክባ፡ καταλήψῃ Sir. 27,8; Sir. 15,17; Jud. 7,24; Gen. 31,23; Ps. 7,5; Rom. 9,30; ἐκλάβοι Job 3,5; ἐπιτυχεῖν Jac. 4,2; τυγχάνειν Job 3,21; ትረክብ፡ ተስፋከ፡ Job 11,18; ደቂቆሙ፡ ኢይረክቡ፡ ንዋዮሙ፡ Job 21,19; 4 Esr. 8,66; 1 Reg. 28,22; Ps. 20,8; Ruth 1,9; Matth. 11,29; Luc. 18,18; Gal. 3,22; Hebr. 9,12; ረኪበ፡ ዘርእ፡ ፈቀደ፡ prolem nancisci cupivit Sx. Jac. 8Enc.; de ረከበ፡ ሞገሰ፡ ቅድመ፡ ut Gen. 33,8 vid. ሞገስ፡ a acquirere et possidere, habere Act. 22,18; Gal. 2,4; Marc. 9,50; Marc. 11,22; Marc. 14,7; Lev. 25,28; Lev. 25,47; Sir. 32,12; ዘኢይረክብ፡ ሲሳዮ፡ ὁ ἀπορῶν ἄρτων Sir. 10,27. b capere, occupare urbem, terram Jos. 1,11; Jos. 6,20; Jos. 8,19; Jos. 8,21. c ferire jaculando (treffen): ሄጶ፡ ውስተ፡ ፍጽሙ፡ ወረከቦ፡ ናላሁ፡ Sir. 47,4. d assequi mente rem arduam; Koh. 3,11; Koh. 8,17; Lit. Joh.; aenigma (recte solvere) Jud. 14,12; Jud. 14,18. 2 invenire, reperire, deprehendere sive quaesita, sive amissa, sive alia; rem Gen. 11,2; Gen. 26,32; Gen. 31,32 seq.; Ex. 15,22; Ex. 16,27; Lev. 5,22; Lev. 5,23; 1 Reg. 9,4; Sir. 6,14; ረኪበ፡ መድፍን፡ Sir. 40,18; ዘበዲበ፡ ምድር፡ ረከብከ፡ εὕρεμα Sir. 29,4; Sir. 29,6; Koh. 12,10; Matth. 7,8; Matth. 13,44; Luc. 4,17; Luc. 6,7; Luc. 15,4; hominem Gen. 16,7; Gen. 36,24; Gen. 38,20; Gen. 38,23; Deut. 22,27; Deut. 24,1; 1 Reg. 9,13; 1 Reg. 10,2; Ruth 2,22; Sir. 12,27; Dan. apocr. 1,21; Dan. apocr. 1,38; Matth. 2,8; Matth. 18,28; nonnumquam recipere, recuperare ut Koh. 11,1; 4 Esr. 10,22; c.c. Acc. praedicati, ut: ረከብዎ፡ ውዱቀ፡ 1 Reg. 5,3; 1 Reg. 28,21; ከመዝ፡ ረከብኩ፡ ጽሑፈ፡ ውስተ፡ መጻሕፍት፡ Kuf. 21; 2 Esr. 18,14; vel seq. እንዘ፡ c. verbo fin., ut Jes. 37,8; Matth. 20,6; Matth. 24,46; Matth. 26,40; vel seq. enuntiatione integra (sine conjunctione praemissa): ረከብናሆሙ፡ ይሰክቡ፡ ኅቡረ፡ Dan. apocr. 1,38; ረከባሆሙ፡ ይቀውሙ፡ ህየ፡ ለሊቃውንት፡ Judith 10,6; Tob. 8,13; Rom. 7,21. a videre, percipere, ut Marc. 5,38, quare saepissime ἰδού hoc verbo vertitur, vid. annot. ad 1 Reg. 4,13; ረከብኩ፡ ስቍረተ፡ ውስተ፡ አረፍት፡ ἰδοὺ ὀπή Hez. 8,7; Hez. 8,14; Ruth 3,8; ወረከብክዎ፡ ይገብር፡ ግብሮ፡ Jer. 18,3. b censere, existimare; Rom. 3,28; vel እመሰ፡ ትረክብ፡ ሠናየ፡ wenn du es für gut findest Lud. e Vit. Sam. c incidere alicui vel in aliquem, improviso (supervenire) 1 Thess. 5,4; casu, fortuito, ut: ኢታብእ፡ ኵሎ፡ ሰብአ፡ ዘረከብከ፡ ውስተ፡ ቤትከ፡ Sir. 11,29; Matth. 22,9; ዘረከብከ፡ cuicumque incideris i.e. quicumque fuerit vel qui primus se obtulerit, ut: ኢትሢሙ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘረከብክሙ፡ ne praeficiatis obvium quemcumque Clem. f. 130; በከመ፡ ረከበ፡ quocumque moo invenerit i.e. temere, ut: አብድ፡ ወዝሉፍ፡ በከመ፡ ረከባ፡ ይነብብ፡ Sir. 20,7; Sir. 20,19; Sir. 22,6 (ἄκαιρος); ኢትጠበብ፡ በከመ፡ ረከብከ፡ ἀκαίρως Sir. 35,4. d de eventis et casibus, potissimum adversis, α contigere, accidere, obvenire alicui, invadere aliquem, c. Acc. ut: ኢይረክቦ፡ እኩይ፡ (ἀπαντήσει) Sir. 36,1; Job 1,22; Job 2,10; Job 2,11; Job 9,20; Job 11,6 (συμβαίνειν, ἀποβαίνειν); በእንተ፡ ምንት፡ ረከበኒ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ኵሉ፡ Jer. 13,22; 4 Esr. 10,9; 4 Esr. 10,21; Jon. 1,7; Jer. 5,12; Gen. 49,1; Ps. 39,16; Ps. 114,4; 2 Tim. 3,11; etiam de praedictis: ረከቦ፡ ዝኩ፡ ኵሉ፡ ተኣምር፡ 1 Reg. 10,9; ረከበነ፡ ዝመርገም፡ እኩይ፡ Bar. 1,20; de sorte Joh. 19,24; et impersonaliter: accidit alicui: በይእቲ፡ ዕለት፡ ረከባ፡ ለወለተ፡ ራጉኤል፡ συνέβη τῇ Tob. 3,7. β incidere in casum i.e. eo attingi, c. Acc., ut: Num. 20,14; ብዙኀ፡ ሕማመ፡ ረከበት፡ ብከ፡ Tob. 4,4; በከመ፡ እከየ፡ ምግባሩ፡ ይረክብ፡ (v. ይረክቦ፡) Jes. 3,11; ትሬኢ፡ እመ፡ ትረክቦ፡ ለቃልየ፡ εἰ ἐπικαταλήθεταί σε ὁ λόγος μου Num. 11,23; Gen. 41,13; Gen. 49,10. e cadere in aliquem, ei convenire: ዘይረክበከ፡ τὸ σόν (quod tibi convenit) Matth. 20,14; ይርከቦ፡ ei conveniat Joh. 19,24 (nisi secundum 1,a exponere malueris: is possideat ema tunicam). – Voc. Ae.: አድምዐ፡ ረከበ፡ ዘ፡ አገኘ። rakaba G ረከበ፡ rakaba ይረክብ፡, ይርከብ፡ «trouver, retrouver» ― አገኘ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 60v. 155 L ረከበ rakaba (yǝrkab) find, get, acquire, obtain, attain, attain, receive, gain, reach, take possession of, possess, overtake, apprehend, invent, find out, discover, perceive, suppose; with indirect object suffixes come upon, fall upon, befall, occur, come to pass, happen, be coming to, be proper 469a

woorden.betekenis: facere ut aliquis adipiscatur, inveniat, ʾarkaba, faire trou
woorden.definitie: II,1 facere ut aliquis adipiscatur vel inveniat, c. dupl. Acc., ut: ታረክቦሙ፡ ሕይወተ፡ ለውእቱ፡ ሰብእ፡ Herm. p. 59; vel (omisso Acc. invenientis): ብዙኀ፡ ሰትይ፡ ኢያረክብ፡ ኀይለ፡ ወኢያኀጥእ፡ ቍስለ፡ Sir. 34,30; Ex. 14,3. ʾarkaba G አርከበ፡ ʾarkaba II,1 ያረክብ፡, ያርክብ፡ «faire trouver, retrouver» ― አስገኘ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 60v. 155 L አርከበ ʾarkaba causative {of vid. ረከበ rakaba} 469a

woorden.betekenis: acquiri, comparari, se assequendum praebere, me assequendum
woorden.definitie: III,1 (ተረከበ፡ Asc. Jes. 3,4; an errore typographi?) 1 acquiri, comparari, se assequendum praebere: እምአይቴ፡ ተረክበት፡ ጥበብ፡ Job 28,12; ተኀሥሡኒ፡ ወእትረከበክሙ፡ (me assequendum praebebo vobis) Jer. 36,13; 2 Par. 15,2. a acquisitum possideri, haberi: ወተረክበ፡ ለሰሎሞን፡ ፬፼አፍራስ፡ ἦσαν αὐτῷ 2 Par. 9,25; Deut. 21,17. b mente attingi: እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘኢይትረከብ፡ በልቡና፡ Cod. Mus. Brit. XI; Lud. e V.S. 2 inveniri, reperiri, deprehendi Gen. 2,20; Gen. 41,38; Gen. 44,16; Gen. 44,17; Kuf. 43; Jos. 10,17; 1 Reg. 9,20; 1 Reg. 13,15; 4 Reg. 23,2; ተረክቡ፡ ውስተ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ዐማፅያን፡ Jer. 5,26; ኢተረክበ፡ እኩይ፡ ምግባር፡ ላዕሌሃ፡ Dan. apocr. 1,63; እስከ፡ አመ፡ ተረክበ፡ ጌጋይ፡ በላዕሌከ፡ Hez. 28,15; ኢተረክባ፡ ሠናያት፡ ዘከመ፡ አዋልደ፡ ኢዮብ፡ Job 42,15; Dan. 1,19; Jer. 2,34; Jer. 48,3; Ps. 16,4; 1 Petr. 2,22. a deprehendi (delinquentem) in re Joh. 8,3; ለእመ፡ ተረክበ፡ ካህን፡ በሰሪቅ፡ Kedr f. 67; Deut. 24,7. b inveniri vel deprehendi (i.e. percipi, videri) c.c. Acc. vel Nom. praedicati: Kuf. 19; ኖኅ፡ ተረክበ፡ ፍጹመ፡ ጻድቀ፡ Sir. 44,17; Sir. 44,20; 4 Esr. 3,13; ተረክበት፡ ሕጽጽተ፡ Dan. 5,27; Org. 4; ኵሉ፡ ዘኢይትረከብ፡ ጽሑፍ፡ Apoc. 20,15; ትትረከብ፡ ፅንስታ፡ Asc. Jes. 11,3; Luc. 9,36; vel seq. እንዘ፡ Matth. 1,18; Asc. Jes. 3,4. c inveniri vel reperiri i.e. exstare, exsistere 1 Reg. 13,22; Kuf. 30; አልቦ፡ ዘተረክበ፡ ዘከማሃ፡ Job 28,15; ክልኤሆሙ፡ በኀበ፡ ብእሲ፡ ጻድቅ፡ ይትረከቡ፡ Sir. 18,17; በውስተ፡ ሐሰት፡ ዘአይቴ፡ ይትረከብ፡ ጽድቅ፡ Sir. 31,4; οὐκ ἔσται ኢይትረከብ፡ Jes. 15,6; 2 Par. 12,12; Gen. 18,19 seq. d ዘይትረከብ፡ fortuitus, in casu positus, accidens M.M. f. 318 (vid. ረከበ፡ Nr. 2,c). 3 vacare rei (vid. IV,1): በተውኔት፡ ዘይትረከብ፡ κύβοις σχολάζων II Can. Ap. 40. tarakba G ተረክበ፡ tarakba III,1 ይትረከብ፡ «être trouvé, retrouvé» ― ተገኘ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 60v. 155 L ተረክበ tarakba passive of ረከበ rakaba; also exist, be available, give an audience ዘይትረከብ zayǝtrakkab accidental ዘኢይትረከብ zaʾiyyǝtrakkab inaccessible, incomprehensible 469a

woorden.betekenis: acquisitio, inventio, facultas, accidens, casus, rǝkbat, dis
woorden.definitie: n. act., Pl. ርክበታት፡, 1 acquisitio, ut: ርክበተ፡ ንዋይ፡ F.N. 42,5. 2 inventio: ርክበተ፡ ወልዶሙ፡ (amissi) Sx. Hed. 24; ርክበተ፡ አዕጽምት፡ (ossium sancti) Sx. Ter 19; ዘአስተፋጠነ፡ ፈውሶተ፡ ሕማሙ፡ እምቅድመ፡ ይስአን፡ ርክበታተ፡ መድኀኒታቲሁ፡ Genz. f. 89. 3 ut videtur: facultas (an: accidens, casus?): ሕሊናቲሁ፡ ወኀይላቲሁ፡ ወርክበታቲሁ፡ ዘውስጥ፡ (internae) F.N. 45. rǝkbat L ርክበት rǝkbat discovery, finding, acquisition, existence 469b

woorden.betekenis: pertinens ad res acquisitas, existentes, rǝkubāwi, pertainin
woorden.definitie: adj. rel. (a ርኩብ፡), proprie: pertinens ad res acquisitas (an: existentes? مَوْجُودٌ): ግዕዛት፡ ርኩባዊያት፡ F.N. 43,12; sensus haud satis liquet. rǝkubāwi L ርኩባዊ rǝkubāwi pertaining to acquired things 469a

woorden.betekenis: cameli, rākub, rākubāt, rākobāt, rākʷǝbāt, rākǝbāt, rakabāt,
woorden.definitie: v. እርኩባት፡ et ርኩባት፡ (Lud. in lex.: ራኩባት፡) subst. Pl. cameli foeminae quibus vehuntur 1 Reg. 30,17 رَكُوبَةٌ (نَاقَةٌ). – Voc. Ae.: ርኩባት፡ (v. እርኩባት፡) ዘ፡ የሐማሴን፡ ፈረስ፡ rākub, ራኩባት፡ rākubāt, ራኮባት፡ rākobāt, ራኵባት፡ rākʷǝbāt, ራክባት፡ rākǝbāt, ረከባት፡ rakabāt subst. Kamel Kebr. Nag. 24, 31 16b l. 23 (ed.) Kamele (رَكوبات) xxiva; ራኩባት፡ rākubāt Kebr. Nag. 23,20 15a l. 5; 26a l. 20; 45 n. 50 (ed.) ራኵባት፡ rākwǝbāt 15 n. 6; 26 n. 26; 45b l. 7; 57a l. 11 (ed.) ራኮባት፡ rākobāt 26 n. 26 (ed.) ራክባት፡ rākǝbāt 26 n. 26 (ed.) ረከባት፡ rakabāt 57 n. 18 (ed.) ወእምዘ፡ አእተዉ፡ ምስለ፡ መርዓት፡ ፲፻አእማተ፡ ደናግለ፡ ምስለ፡ ፲፻፡ መስተጽዕናነ፡ ራኩብ፡ ‘gli condussero in casa mille ancelle vergini con mille uomini montati su cammello’ 10 § 20 (ed.), 8 § 20 (tr.) (‘«cammelli»: testo rākub {...} è ammesso dubbiosamente da 305 «Lud. in lex. rākubāt», e accolto da 469 «female camels».’ 8 n. 31) G ርኩባት፡ rǝkubāt cameli foeminae, chamelles Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 40. 155 L ራኩብ rākub, ራኩባት rākubāt, ራኮባት rākobāt, ራኵባት rākʷǝbāt, ራክባት rākǝbāt (, Lt) female camels 469b

woorden.betekenis: mas, masculus, ros, rosā, proles mascula, mâle, male, child
woorden.definitie: subst. [coll. رُوسٌ] mas, masculus, sing. et collect.: ሮስ፡ ወወለት፡ M.M. f. 3; ኵሉ፡ ሮስ፡ Kuf. 15; Kuf. 47; ሮስ፡ ወአዋልድ፡ Ex. 21,4; ውሉድ፡ ሮስ፡ ወአዋልድ፡ Ex. 21,31. ros, ሮሳ rosā G ሮስ፡ ros proles mascula, mâle Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 40. 156 L ሮስ ros, (, ) ሮሳ፡ rosā male, child 477b

woorden.betekenis: fricare, perfricare, defricare, fricuit, tritus, vetustus fu
woorden.definitie: I,1 fricare, perfricare, defricare: በጼው፡ ኢሮቱኪ፡ οὐδὲ ἁλὶ ἡλίσθης Hez. 16,4; M.M. f. 89 [coll. عَرَثَ عَرَتَ fricuit manu rem; at رَثَّ significat tritus, vetustus fuit]. – Voc. Ae.: ሮተ፡ ወፎዘ፡ ዘ፡ ሐሸ። rota G ሮተ፡ rota I,1 ይረውት፡, ይሩት፡ fricare, frictionner, frotter, étriller ― አሸ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 40. 156 L rwt, ሮተ rota (yǝrut) rub, rub off, rub down, scrape, polish 478a

woorden.betekenis: potu sitire, sitim, explere, inebriare, rigare, irrigare, po
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 potu sitire, sitim alicujus explere, inebriare: absol. Ps. 22,7; c. Acc. pers.: ኣረውያ፡ ለነፍሶሙ፡ Jer. 38,14; Jer. 38,25; አርዊ፡ ጽሙኣነ፡ Syn. f. 287; አልቦሙ፡ ዘይሰትዩ፡ ማየ፡ ዘያረውዮሙ፡ (ὕδωρ εἰς πλησμονήν) Judith 7,21; c. dupl. Acc.: አርወየኒ፡ ሐሞተ፡ Thren. 3,15; c. Acc. et እምነ፡, ut: ኣረውዮሙ፡ እምደምከ፡ Hez. 32,5; transl.: ሞገሰ፡ ፍቅራ፡ ያረውየከ፡ Prov. 5,19; ያረዊ፡ ነፍሶ፡ እምቃለ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Sx. Haml. 8. 2 rigare, irrigare, potare facere: ኣርውዮ፡ ለዐጸደ፡ ሐምልየ፡ Sir. 24,31; እስከ፡ ሶበ፡ ያረዊያ፡ ለምድር፡ Jes. 55,10; Ps. 64,9; Ps. 64,11; ፈትለ፡ ኣርዊ፡ ellychnium ut potare faciam (oleum) Sx. Teq. 16 Enc. ʾarwaya G አርወየ፡ ʾarwaya II,1 inebriavit, enivrer Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 60. 156 L አርወየ ʾarwaya give to drink, make drink, quench thirst, saturate, inebriate, water, irrigate 478a

woorden.betekenis: potus praebitio, propinatio, rǝwyat, invitation à boire, abu
woorden.definitie: n. act. potus praebitio, propinatio. – Voc. Ae.: ርውየት፡ ዘ፡ ውግዐት፡ rǝwyat G ርውየት፡ rǝwyat invitation à boire, abus de boisson. Le 307: «ርውየት፡ n. act. potus praebitio, propinatio. Voc. Ae.: ርውየት፡ ዘ፡ ውግዐት፡», mais ne donne ni texte, ni référence. ― Voici texte et référence: ምንዳቤ፡ ለጽሙእ፡ በእንተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ይትኆለቍ፡ (sic) ሎቱ፡ ርውየት። Ms. BAVet61, fol. 19v. 156 L ርውየት rǝwyat drinking one’s fill, providing with drink 478a

woorden.betekenis: ultro citroque discurrit, libere vagatus est, currendo, peti
woorden.definitie: I,1 [رَادَ רוּד ultro citroque discurrit, libere vagatus est, (currendo) petiit; vicinum est ሮጸ፡; vid. etiam መረደ፡] Subj. ይሩድ፡ 1 incurrere, incursare, invadere, oppugnare, incursionem vel impetum facere, expeditione bellica petere: ሮዱ፡ ወቀተሉ፡ በይሁዳ፡ ἐπέθεντο καὶ ἐπάταξαν 2 Par. 28,17; ይረውጹ፡ ላዕሌኪ፡ እንዘ፡ ይረውዱ፡ Jer. 28,14 var.; ወይረውዱ፡ καὶ παρατάξονται Zach. 10,5; c. Acc.: ኢሎፍሊ፡ ሮዱ፡ አህጉረ፡ 2 Par. 28,18; ይሩዶሙ፡ προκαταλαβέσθαι αὐτούς 2 Par. 32,1; Jud. 9,33; Kuf. 37; ሮዱኒ፡ κατέδραμον ἐπ᾽ ἐμοί Job 16,10; ሮዱኒ፡ ወሮጹ፡ ላዕሌየ፡ Job 16,14; ሮደከ፡ ፀባኢት፡ ኀያል፡ Job 29,10; 4 Esr. 13,10; 4 Esr. 13,15; ከመ፡ ይሩዱነ፡ 4 Reg. 7,6; ሮድዎሙ፡ μονόζωνοι ἦλθον 4 Reg. 13,20; 4 Reg. 13,21; ዕደው፡ እለ፡ ኢሮዱ፡ አጋርያን፡ ἄνδρες οἳ ἦσαν πεζοί (opp. equites expediti) Judith 7,2. 2 insurgere contra aliquem, impugnare, insectari, premere (impugnatione): ሮድዎ፡ ወሰሐብዎ፡ ἐπιστάντες Act. 6,12; Num. 16,19; Num. 17,7; Ps. 26,6; ይረውዱከ፡ παροιστρήσουσι Hez. 2,6; እለ፡ ይረውድዎ፡ θλίβοντες Thren. 1,17; Ps. 105,12; Jes. 19,20; Jes. 29,7. 3 persequi, insequi, διώκειν: አፍራስ፡ ዘይረውድ፡ Nah. 3,2; አልቦ፡ ዘይረውድ፡ Jes. 17,2; Ps. 43,18; c. Acc. Ps. 7,1; Ps. 30,19; Ps. 141,9; Ps. 142,3; Jer. 15,15; Jes. 16,4; Thren. 1,6. – Rad. Abb.: ሮደ፡ ዘ፡ ከበበ፡ (i.e. circumvenire). roda G ሮደ፡ roda I,1 ይረውድ፡, ይሩድ፡ persecutus est, poursuivre avec haine, faire acte d’hostilité contre quelqu’un, persécuter ― ከበበ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 60. 156 L rwd, ሮደ roda (yǝrud) pursue, go after, persecute, rush upon, press upon, capture by assult, attack, assail, make an incursion, invade, rise against, (, ) surround 476b

woorden.betekenis: insectatio, persecutio, rudat, rudatāt, persécution, persecu
woorden.definitie: n. act. insectatio, persecutio Org. 6. rudat, Pl. ሩደታት፡ rudatāt G ሩደት፡ rudat, Pl. ሩደታት፡ rudatāt persecutio, persécution ― መክበብ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 60. 156 L ሩደት rudat verbal noun of vid. ሮደ; also persecution, incursion 476b

woorden.betekenis: currere, viam celerare, volare, currendo discedere, se aufer
woorden.definitie: I,1 [רוּץ ܪܗܶܛ; amh. ሮጠ፡; vicina sunt ረየፀ፡ et ሮደ፡] Subj. ይሩጽ፡ currere (viam celerare, volare): Prov. 4,12; 2 Reg. 18,19-25; Num. 11,27; ሩጽ፡ Kuf. 43; ረዊጽ፡ ὁ δρόμος Koh. 9,11; Job 9,25; ፍጡነ፡ ይመጽኡ፡ እንዘ፡ ይረውጹ፡ Jes. 5,26; ይረውጹ፡ ከመ፡ ሀየል፡ ሐንካሳን፡ Jes. 35,6; Jes. 40,31; Matth. 27,48; Matth. 28,8; Rom. 9,16; Joel 2,7; Joel 2,9; ὁρμᾶν Matth. 8,32 {DiL ὁρμᾷν}; de avibus Job 39,30; curru ሰረገላት፡ ዘይረውጽ፡ Nah. 3,2; vento Jes. 5,28; igne Hen. 23,2; fulgure ከመ፡ ይረውጽ፡ መብረቅ፡ ቅድመ፡ ነጐድጓድ፡ Sir. 35,10; Ex. 9,23; Nah. 2,5; sole: ፍጡነ፡ ይረውጽ፡ ፀሓይ፡ 1 Esr. 4,34; Hen. 72,37; verbo Ps. 147,4; 2 Thess. 3,1; de navigantibus Act. 21,1; σπεύδειν እንዘ፡ ይረውጹ፡ μετὰ σπουδῆς Dan. apocr. 1,50; ሩጹ፡ ወኢትቁሙ፡ Jer. 4,6; ሩጽ፡ ጼውው፡ ὀξέως Jes. 8,3; c. Acc. viae Ps. 118,32. a currendo discedere, se auferre: ሩጽ፡ ἀπότρεχε Jer. 47,5. b praetercurrere, cito praeterire: ከመ፡ ኅልፈተ፡ ዜና፡ ዘይረውጽ፡ Sap. 5,9. c circumcurrere, discurrere: ሩጹ፡ ውስተ፡ ፍናዊሃ፡ ለኢየሩሳሌም፡ Jer. 5,1; ይረውጽ፡ ኀበ፡ አባግዕ፡ Herm. p. 56. d praecurrere c. ቅድመ፡, ut: 1 Reg. 8,11; 2 Reg. 15,1. e cursu tedenre aliquo, acurrere, currendo petere, Marc. 9,15; Gen. 18,2; Gen. 33,4; c. ኀበ፡ Hebr. 12,1; Gen. 18,6; ሮጹ፡ ኀቤሃ፡ Dan. apocr. 1,19; Luc. 24,12; ዘርእየ፡ በለሰ፡ ወይረውጽ፡ ኀቤሃ፡ Jes. 28,4; እጐሊሁ፡ ይረውጹ፡ ኀበ፡ ደም፡ Job 39,30; vel c. ለ፡, ut: ለኀጢአት፡ ይረውጻ፡ እገሪሆሙ፡ Jes. 59,7. f currendo sequi: ሮጸ፡ ድኅሬሆሙ፡ Kuf. 43. g incursare, incurrere: ሮጸ፡ ኀቤሁ፡ በኀይል፡ Dan. apocr. 8,6; ሮዱኒ፡ ወሮጹ፡ ላዕሌየ፡ Job 16,14. roṣa G ሮጸ፡ roṣa I,1 ይረውጽ፡, ይሩጽ፡ cucurrit, courir ― ሮጠ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 40. 157 L rwṣ, ሮጸ roṣa (yǝruṣ) run, run about 477b

woorden.betekenis: currens, citatus, praeceps, cursim, citatim, propere, rǝwwǝṣ
woorden.definitie: vel ርውጽ፡ part. currens, citatus, praeceps Sx. Enc.; ለነሰ፡ ህላዌነ፡ ርውጽ፡ ውስተ፡ ሚጠት፡ በሕቁ፡ ἡμεῖς τὴν φύσιν παράφορον κομιδῇ πρὸς ἀλλοίωσιν ἔχοντες Cyr. ad Theod. f. 10. Acc. ርዉጸ፡ adv.: cursim, citatim, propere: ርዉጸ፡ ፄውው፡ Jes. 8,3 var.; Hez. 30,9. rǝwwǝṣ, rǝwwuṣ L ርዉጽ rǝwwǝṣ, ርውጽ rǝwwuṣ who runs, running ርውጸ rǝwwuṣa speedily 477b

woorden.betekenis: cursus, motus rapidus, vitae cursus, certamen, ruṣat, ruṣatā
woorden.definitie: n. act. 1 cursus, motus rapidus: 2 Reg. 18,27; ሩጸተ፡ አፍራስ፡ Jer. 8,16; Org. 1; ሩጸተ፡ እንስሳ፡ ዘኢይትረአይ፡ Sap. 17,18; astrorum Hen. 8,3; Hen. 14,8; Macc. f. 22; Org. 2; ignis Hen. 23,2; navis Sap. 5,10; ኢመጠነ፡ ሩጸተ፡ መባርቅት፡ (i.e. ne momentum quidem temporis) M.M. f. 20. 2 vitae cursus vel certamen: እለ፡ ተጋደሉ፡ ሠናየ፡ ገድለ፡ ወፈጸሙ፡ ሩጸቶሙ፡ ወሞቱ፡ Did. 26; ሠናያነ፡ ሩጸት፡ Org. 1. ruṣat, Pl. ሩጸታት፡ ruṣatāt G ሩጸት፡ ruṣat, Pl. ሩጸታት፡ ruṣatāt cursio, action de courir, course ― ሩጫ፡, መሮጫ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 40. 157 L ሩጸት ruṣat running, run, track, pathway, course, contest 477b

woorden.betekenis: magister cursus, marwaṣi, who causes horses to run
woorden.definitie: part. (II,1) c. term. adj., magister cursus: መርወጼ፡ አፍራስ፡ Const. Ap. 27; Kid. f. 23. marwaṣi L መርወጺ marwaṣi who causes horses to run 477b

woorden.betekenis: tonuit
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., sc. רָעַם ܪܥܶܡ tonuit.

woorden.betekenis: tonitrus, vox tonans, strepitus, fremitus, tonantem et submi
woorden.definitie: subst. 1 { tonitrus } Hen. 20,2. 2 vox tonans, strepitus, fremitus: (Deus) ዘረዓም፡ ወዘለሖሳስ፡ ይሰምዕ፡ tonantem et submissam vocem audit Ssal. Req.; ረዓመ፡ መላእክት፡ (de vocibus angelorum) Lud. ex auct. Gregorii.

woorden.betekenis: jugum, collare, copula
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m. (gramm. § 113) 1 jugum (quod jumentis imponitur): አርዑተ፡ ብዕራ፡ Jes. 5,18; Sir. 26,7; አርዑተ፡ ክሣድ፡ Dan. 8,25; Lev. 19,19; ሐረሰ፡ በአርዑታ፡ Sir. 28,19; ዐሚደ፡ አርዑት፡ Sir. 30,35; እንተ፡ ሰሐበት፡ አርዑተ፡ Deut. 21,3; ትወዲ፡ አርዑተ፡ ዲበ፡ ክሣዱ፡ Job 39,10; crebro translate: አርዑት፡ ዘሠርዑ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ Kuf. 38; ይነሥእ፡ አርዑቶ፡ Thren. 3,27; Matth. 11,29; Matth. 11,30; Jes. 9,4; Jes. 14,5; Jes. 14,25; Jes. 47,6; Jer. 2,20; Jer. 5,5; Jer. 35,4; አርዑተ፡ ግብጽ፡ Kuf. 49; ከመ፡ ይትቀነዩ፡ በአሐዱ፡ አርዑት፡ Zeph. 3,9. 2 collare, copula in genere: ውስተ፡ ክሣዱ፡ አርዑት፡ ዘዕፅ፡ ከመ፡ ከልብ፡ Lud. e V.S.; ቅኑይ፡ በአርዑተ፡ ዐመፃ፡ σύνδεσμος Act. 8,23 rom.; ሰብእ፡ እገሪከ፡ ውስተ፡ አርዑታ፡ εἰς τὰς πέδας αὐτῆς (compedes) Sir. 6,24. – Voc. Ae.: አርዑት፡ ዘ፡ ቀምበር።

woorden.betekenis: nuptiae, solemnia nuptiarum, convivium nuptiale, cubiculum n
woorden.definitie: subst. (m. Esth. 2,18), 1 nuptiae, solemnia nuptiarum, convivium nuptiale (γάμος, γάμοι), ሶበ፡ ተፈጸመ፡ መዋዕለ፡ መርዓ፡ Esth. 1,5; አዕበዮ፡ ለመርዓ፡ አስቴር፡ Esth. 2,18; νύμφευσις Cant. 3,11; በዓል፡ ዘመርዓ፡ Tob. 8,20; Apoc. 19,7; Apoc. 19,9; መጋቤ፡ መርዓ፡ νυμφαγωγός Jud. 14,20; ልብሰ፡ መርዓ፡ Matth. 22,11; ቤተ፡ መርዓ፡ νυμφών cubiculum nuptiale Herm. p. 21; vel domus nuptialis F.M. 32,7; Sx. Teq. 14; ቤተ፡ መርዓ፡ ወከብካብ፡ F.M. 34,2; ከብካበ፡ መርዓ፡ Org. 2 Transfertur ad alia solemnia vel festa laeta, ut: መርዓ፡ መንግሥት፡ festum inaugurationis regis Gad. Lal.; opp. ላሕ፡ Org.; ለመርዓ፡ ስምከ፡ (v. ስምዕከ፡) ይትገበር፡ ከብካብ፡ solemnibus nominis (martyrii) tui apparantur epulae Sx. Mag. 3Enc. marʿā G መርዓ፡ marʿā «noces» ― ሰርግ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 37r. 86 L መርዓ marʿā wedding, marriage, marriage feast 356b

woorden.betekenis: pascere, pastum ducere, gubernare, moderari, regere, pasci,
woorden.definitie: et rarius ርዐየ፡ I,1 [רָעָה ܪܥܳܐ رَعَى] Imperf. ይርዒ፡ et ይሬዒ፡ (gramm. § 92), Subj. ይርዐይ፡, Imperat. ረዐይ፡ 1 pascere, pastum ducere, c. Acc. gregis: Gen. 30,31; Gen. 30,36; Gen. 37,2; Gen. 37,12; Ex. 3,1; 1 Reg. 17,15; Kuf. 28; Kuf. 34; Cant. 1,8; Jes. 61,5; Jer. 38,10; Judith 8,16; አነ፡ ረዐይኩከ፡ በውስተ፡ በድው፡ Hos. 13,5; እርዕዮሙ፡ ውስተ፡ አድባረ፡ እስራኤል፡ Hez. 34,13; Hez. 34,14; ረዐዩ፡ ርእሶሙ፡ ወኢረዐዩ፡ አባግዕየ፡ Hez. 34,8; Hez. 34,10; Luc. 15,15; c. ውስተ፡ gregis 1 Reg. 16,11; 1 Reg. 17,34; absol. Cant. 1,7; Hen. 89,65; Hen. 89,72; Matth. 8,33 rom. Transl.: pascere populum sicut gregem i.e. gubernare, moderari, regere Ps. 2,9; Ps. 22,1; Ps. 36,3; Ps. 47,13; Ps. 77,77; Ps. 79,1; Jer. 3,15; Hos. 4,16; Mich. 5,3; Hen. 90,1; Joh. 21,15; Joh. 21,17. 2 pasci (i.q. ተርዕየ፡): ወይሬዒ፡ (v. ወይትረዐይ፡) ላህም፡ ወድብ፡ ኅቡረ፡ Jes. 11,7; ረዐይክሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ሠናይ፡ ጺኦት፡ Hez. 34,18. – In locis: ዘይሬዕያ፡ ወይዛወጋ፡ ለሙስና፡ ያጼእል፡ አባሁ፡ Prov. 28,7; ዘይርዒ፡ ዘማተ፡ Prov. 29,3 dubium est, utrum Aethiopes verbum transit. vel intransit. intelligant; Graecus habet ποιμαίνει (hebr. רָעָה delectari re ). – Voc. Ae.: ዐቀበ፡ ረዐየ፡ ኖለወ፡ ብ፡ ጠበቀ፡

woorden.betekenis: pascendum curare
woorden.definitie: II,1 pascendum curare: ኣርዕዮሙ፡ (v. ኣሬዕዮሙ፡) ለአባግዐ፡ ቀትል፡ ውስተ፡ ከናአን፡ Zach. 11,7.

woorden.betekenis: pasci, pastum ire, depasci
woorden.definitie: (Ps. 79,14; Dan. 4,30; Jes. 34,17; ተረዐየ፡ Lud.) III,1 pasci, pastum ire, depasci, absol.: Job 1,14; የዐይል፡ ውስተ፡ ገዳም፡ ይትረዐይ፡ Job 39,8; ይትረዐዩ፡ ከመ፡ አስዋር፡ Jes. 5,17; Jes. 11,6; Jes. 14,30; Jes. 49,9; ይትረዐዩ፡ ኅቡረ፡ Jes. 65,25; Zeph. 2,14; Hez. 34,14; Cant. 4,5; Gen. 41,2; Hen. 86,1; Hen. 86,3; c. Acc. pabuli vel pascui: Ps. 105,21; ተርዕየ፡ ሣዕረ፡ Dan. 4,30; Job 40,10 (ἐσθίουσι); Jes. 5,17 (φάγονται); ይትረዐይ፡ ብሔረ፡ ሥዑረ፡ Jes. 30,23; አብሓኵ፡ እለ፡ ኀጥኡ፡ ዘይትረዐዩ፡ Thren. 1,6.

woorden.betekenis: jumenta, armenta, pecus pastum ducta, grex, pastus, pascuum
woorden.definitie: (Matth. 8,31 rom.; Matth. 8,30-32 Platt), at plerumque መርዔት፡ subst., m. et fem., Pl. መራዕይ፡, rarius መርዔታት፡ (ἀγέλαι Cyr. hom. f. 103) 1 jumenta et armenta et pecus pastum ducta, grex (ἀγέλη, ποίμνιον, ποίμνη, νομάδες, κτήνη, βόσκημα, βουκόλιον al.) Cant. 4,1; Cant. 4,2; Jer. 10,21; Jer. 10,22; Jer. 28,23; Jes. 30,23; Judith 3,3; Joel 1,18; 1 Reg. 8,16; 1 Reg. 25,2; Luc. 2,8; Lev. 22,19; Lev. 22,21; Lev. 23,18; Deut. 28,4; መራዕየ፡ አልህምት፡ ወመራዕየ፡ አባግዕ፡ Kuf. 20; Kuf. 30; Kuf. 34; መራዕየ፡ አባግዕ፡ Koh. 2,7; 2 Par. 7,5; መራዕየ፡ አግማል፡ Jes. 60,6; መራዕየ፡ አሕርው፡ Marc. 5,11; ከለባተ፡ መራዕይየ፡ Job 30,1; አዕጻዳተ፡ መራዕይ፡ Jes. 65,10; ከመ፡ ኖላዊ፡ መርዔቶ፡ Sir. 18,13; c. suff. III pers.: መራዕይሁ፡ Job 20,17; ውስተ፡ መራዕይሁ፡ Mal. 1,14; መራዕዮሙ፡ Kuf. 30; Jer. 32,22; መራዕይሆሙ፡ et መራዕዪሆሙ፡ Jer. 6,3; መራዕይሆሙ፡ Kuf. 34. Transl.: መርዔተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Jer. 13,17; Luc. 12,32; 1 Petr. 5,2; 1 Petr. 5,3. 2 pastus, pascuum (νομή): አባግዐ፡ መርዔትየ፡ Jer. 23,1 (at Hez. 34,31 πρόβατα ποιμνίου μου); Ps. 73,1; Ps. 78,14; Joel 1,18. – (Aliud መራዕይ፡ vid. sub መርዓት፡ sub ረዐወ፡). – Voc. Ae.: መርዔት፡ ዘ፡ መጋ፡ (v. መንጋ፡).

woorden.betekenis: gigantes, gigas
woorden.definitie: subst. (Plur. a Sing. ረዓዪ፡) gigantes Sap. 14,6; Prov. 21,16; Kuf. 5; Kuf. 20; Kuf. 29; Hen. 7,2; Hen. 7,4; Hen. 9,9; Hen. 15,3; Hen. 15,8; Hen. 16,1; etiam singulariter: gigas ዝንቱ፡ ቀደመ፡ ይኩን፡ ረዐይተ፡ ወነዓዌ፡ ዲበ፡ ምድር፡ 1 Par. 1,10.

woorden.betekenis: tremere, contremiscere
woorden.definitie: I,1 [רָעַד رعد VIII] Subj. ይርዐድ፡, tremere, contremiscere: እንዘ፡ ይርዕድ፡ Job 38,34; ይርዕዱ፡ ወያድለቀልቁ፡ Sir. 16,19; Ps. 17,9; Ps. 76,18; Ps. 103,33; Hen. 86,6; ረዐድ፡ Hab. 2,16; Marc. 5,33; c. እምነ፡ vel እምቅድመ፡ vel በእንተ፡ causae: ይርዕዱ፡ አድባር፡ እምኔከ፡ Jes. 64,1; Dan. 5,19; Hen. 69,14; Gen. 9,2; Org. 1; እምቅድመ፡ Dan. 6,26; ይርዕዱ፡ በእንተ፡ ቍር፡ 1 Esr. 9,6; 2 Esr. 10,9; c. suff. Dat. ርዕደኒ፡ መንፈስየ፡ Dan. 7,15.

woorden.betekenis: tremor, raʿād

(personal name) vid. e.g. ሸዋ፡ ረዓድ

woorden.betekenis: oryza
woorden.definitie: (ራዝ፡ Lud.) subst. [رُنْزٌ رُزٌّ أَرُزٌّ ܪܽܘܙܳܐ אוֹרֶז; بِرَنج व्रीहि] oryza Kuf. 37(p. 135); ተኀፂቦ፡ ይጸዐዱ፡ እምራዛ፡ Sx. Hed. 29Enc. (homoeoteleuton carminis est ዛ፡).

woorden.betekenis: excelsa, sublimia, coelum excelsum, coelo summo, hymnorum ge
woorden.definitie: subst. Plur. (gramm. § 131,2), Pl. (Pl.) አርያማት፡ 1 (loca) excelsa, sublimia (ὕψος, ὑψηλόν, ὑψηλά, ὕψιστον, ὕψιστα) Ps. 77,75; እለ፡ ይነብሩ፡ ውስተ፡ አርያም፡ Jes. 26,4; ከመ፡ ያስርር፡ ውስተ፡ አርያም፡ እጐሊሁ፡ Hab. 2,9; in specie: coelum excelsum Ps. 7,8; Ps. 67,19; Ps. 72,8; Ps. 72,11; Ps. 92,6; Job 16,19; Job 25,2; Job 31,2; ልበስ፡ ኀይለ፡ አርያም፡ Job 40,5; Jes. 7,11; Jes. 32,15; Jes. 33,5; Jes. 37,23; Jes. 57,15; Jer. 32,16; Thren. 1,13; 1 Par. 15,16; Sap. 9,17; 4 Esr. 4,10; 4 Esr. 8,24; Matth. 21,9; Marc. 11,10; አርያማት፡ Lit. Orth. („In specie accipiunt Aethiopes de coelo summo, quod habent pro throno Dei et sede beatorum“ Lud.). 2 Est nomen hymnorum generis cujusdam in Deg. saepissime obvium; vid. Catal. Cod. Aeth. Mus. Brit. p. 36et locum e Sx. Genb. 11, quem ibidem ann. d laudavimus; d’Abbadie Catal. p. 99. ʾaryām, ʾaryāmāt G አርያም፡ ʾaryām chants appelés ‘ʾAryâm’. Ils font partie de la liturgie éthiopienne, notamment de la septième section du Meʿerāf (ምዕራፍ፡ ‘Directoire du chœur’), et comprennent versets de Psaumes, louanges pour les fêtes du Christ, de la Vierge Marie, des Anges, des Vingt-quatre prêtres du ciel, des Quatre animaux, des prophètes, des apôtres, des martyrs, des justes, etc. 95 158 L አርያም ʾaryām (Pl. አርያማት ʾaryāmāt) heights, the high, the highest, highest heaven, seventh heaven, (158) kind of zemā-chant 41a

[وَرْدٌ ܘܰܪܕܳܐ ܪܽܘܕܳܐ וַרְדָּא] rosa, ῥόδον: ጽጌ፡ ረዳ፡ Sir. 24,14 (Org. 6); Sir. 50,8; Esth. 1,6; Sap. 2,8; κρίνον (lilium rubens) Sir. 39,14; praeterea Gen. 25,25; Hen. 82,16; Hen. 106,2; Hen. 106,10; Const. Ap. 39. – Voc. Ae.: ቀንሞስ፡ ናርዶስ፡ ርዴ፡ (sic) መጽርይ፡ ቀጺመታት፡ ብ፡ ሽታው፡ የሚያምር፡ ዕፀዋት። radā G ረዳ፡ radā rosa frutex, rosier Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 40. 159 L ረዳ radā rosebush, rose 462a C for ጽጌ፡ ረዳ፡ vid. ጽጌ፡

woorden.betekenis: fulcivit parietem, adjuvit, juvare, adjuvare, auxiliari, aux
woorden.definitie: I,1 [amh. ረዳ፡, arab. رَدَأَ fulcivit parietem, adjuvit; Syri et Hebraei frequentant ܥܕܰܪ עָזַר] Subj. ይርዳእ፡ 1 juvare, adjuvare, auxiliari: Marc. 16,20; c.c. Ac. pers. vel rei: Kuf. 3; Kuf. 22; Ps. 43,28; Ps. 45,5; Ps. 53,4; Ps. 78,9; ረዲኦትየ፡ Ps. 21,20; Ps. 37,22; Ps. 39,18; Ps. 69,1; Koh. 7,19; ረዲእ፡ Job 4,20; መነ፡ ትፈቅድ፡ ትርዳእ፡ Job 26,2; Job 29,12; መጽአ፡ ይርድአኒ፡ Dan. 10,13; ዘከመ፡ ረድአኒ፡ እዴሁ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ 2 Esr. 12,18; (in bello) 1 Par. 18,5; Jes. 31,1; Jes. 41,14; 4 Esr. 9,11; Sir. 15,10; Sir. 29,4; ከመ፡ ይርድኦሙ፡ ἵνα εὐοδώσῃ αὐτούς Sir. 38,14; Phil. 2,13; Matth. 15,25; Marc. 9,22; እለ፡ ይረድእዋ፡ ለኀጢአት፡ Hen. 100,4; Marc. 9,24; seq. Subj. verbi: ዘረድአኪ፡ ትምትሪ፡ ርእሶ፡ Judith 13,18. 2 auxilio tutari, defendere: እረድኣ፡ ለዛቲ፡ ሀገር፡ ὑπερασπιῶ Jes. 37,35; c. እምነ፡ ab: ይረድአከ፡ እምፀርከ፡ Job 22,25; ይረድአከ፡ እምድቀት፡ Sir. 31,19; ረድአ፡ እምሕማም፡ Lit. Apost. radʾa G ረድአ፡ radʾa I,1 ይረድእ፡, ይርዳእ፡ adjuvit, aider ― ረዳ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 40. 159 L ረድአ radʾa I (yǝrdāʾ) give help, aid, come to rescue, assist, protect, (Lt) become a disciple 462a

woorden.betekenis: adjuvari, auxilium nancisci, auxilio uti, taradʾa, adjutus f
woorden.definitie: III,1 adjuvari, auxilium nancisci, auxilio uti: ከመ፡ ትትረድኡ፡ በረድኤተ፡ ፈርዖን፡ Jes. 30,2 var.; ዘይትረዳእ፡ በመኳንንተ፡ ዝዓለም፡ Syn. in p. 311. taradʾa G ተረድአ፡ taradʾa III,1 ይትረዳእ፡ adjutus fuit, être aidé ― ተረዳ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 40. 159 L ተረድአ taradʾa passive of vid. ረድአ radʾa 462a

woorden.betekenis: adjutor, auxiliator, radāʾi, radāʾit, radāʾǝyān, celui qui a
woorden.definitie: n. ag., fem. ረዳኢት፡, Pl. ረዳእያን፡, adjutor, auxiliator Ps. 9,9; Ps. 39,24; Ps. 61,2; ረዳእያን፡ በቀትል፡ 1 Par. 12,1; ኖባ፡ ወኢትዮጵያ፡ ይከውንዎ፡ ረዳእያነ፡ ሎቱ፡ Dan. 11,43; Jes. 8,13; Jes. 25,4; Jes. 50,7; Jer. 16,19; ዘአልቦ፡ ረዳኢ፡ Job 29,12; እስመ፡ ረዳኢቱ፡ ወዐምደ፡ ምስማኩ፡ ይእቲ፡ Sir. 36,29; Sir. 51,2; Judith 9,11; c. suff. II fem. sing.: እግዚአብሔር፡ ረዳእኪ፡ (ኦነፍስ፡) Sx. Jac. 5(gramm. § 153). Forma fem. ረዳኢት፡ (gramm. § 120,a) nonnumquam collective et abstracte usurpatur (sicut ረድኤት፡) 2 Reg. 18,3; 2 Reg. 10,11 var. radāʾi, fem. radāʾit; Pl. radāʾǝyān G ረዳኢ፡ radāʾi, Pl. ረዳእያን፡ radāʾǝyān adjutor, celui qui aide ― የረዳ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 41. 159 L ረዳኢ radāʾi (Pl. ረዳእያን radāʾǝyān) helper, assistant 462a

woorden.betekenis: auxilium, adjumentum, socius operis, adjutor, adjutores, rad
woorden.definitie: , nonnumquam ረዲኤት፡ (in libris antiquioribus, ut Jes. 8,20 Cod. Laur.) vel ረዳኤት፡ (2 Reg. 10,11 var.) subst., m. et fem. 1 auxilium, adjumentum Ps. 48,15; Ps. 120,1; Ps. 120,2; Ps. 123,8; Job 6,13; Prov. 21,31; Prov. 28,12; Jes. 8,20; Jes. 30,5; Jes. 30,6; Jes. 31,3; Jes. 47,15; Jer. 29,4; Judith 7,31; Kuf. 12; 2 Reg. 10,11; Hen. 90,13; Hen. 90,14; እለ፡ ወፅኡ፡ ለረድኤትክሙ፡ Jer. 44,7; እለ፡ መጽኡ፡ ረድኤተ፡ ምስለ፡ ዳዊት፡ 1 Par. 12,33; c. Gen. obj. በረድኤተ፡ ሰብእ፡ መዋቲ፡ Act. 4,9; ἐνέργεια Col. 2,12; Eph. 3,7. 2 concr. socius operis, adjutor, adjutores (συνεργός, συνεργοί) 1 Thess. 3,2 Platt; Col. 4,11; 1 Cor. 3,9 rom.; 2 Cor. 1,24 rom.; βοηθός Gen. 2,20. radʾet, radiʾet, ረዴት፡ radet, ረዳኤት፡ radāʾet G ረድኤት፡ radʾet et ረዴት፡ radet auxilium, aide, secours ― ረዳት፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 95. 408 L ረድኤት radʾet, ረዲኤት radiʾet, ረዳኤት፡ radāʾet help, aid, assistance; helper, assistant, fellow worker ረዴት radet (408) help, assistance 462a

woorden.definitie: I,1 [רָגַם ܪܓܰܡ lapidavit; رَجَمَ lapidibus jecit; calumniis petiit; exsecratus est ] Subj. ይርግም፡, male precari, maledicere, exsecrari, diris devovere, abs. Rom. 12,14; (Hen. 22,11); (sacerdos) ዘይዘብጥ፡ ወይረግም፡ Syn. in p. 311; c. Acc. Gen. 8,21; Gen. 12,3; Lev. 24,11; Lev. 24,14; Lev. 24,15; Num. 23,7 seq.; Job 3,1; Job 3,8; Prov. 24,34; Koh. 7,21; Koh. 10,20; Sir. 4,5; Sir. 4,6; Sir. 13,22 (προσεπιτιμᾶν DiL προσεπιτιμᾷν); Sir. 21,27; Sir. 23,14; 2 Esr. 23,2; Hen. 5,5; Hen. 5,6; Matth. 5,44; Marc. 11,21; Jac. 3,9; c. በ፡ nominis divini, per quod maledicitur Ps. 151,6; 1 Reg. 17,43; ረጊም፡ dirae (opp. በረከት፡) Hen. 59,2.

woorden.betekenis: diras imprecari, diris devoveri
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 reflex. diras imprecari vel sibi vel aliis Matth. 26,74; Marc. 14,71; ረገምኩ፡ ወተረገምኩ፡ Form. Conf.; አፍቅሮ፡ ወኢትትረገም፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይትመዓዕከ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Clem. f. 113. 2 pass. diris devoveri: ተረግመ፡ ቤተ፡ መቅደስከ፡ ἐγενήθη εἰς κατάραν Jes. 64,10; Org. 1.

woorden.betekenis: diris devotus, maledictus
woorden.definitie: part. diris devotus, maledictus Gen. 3,14; Gen. 3,17; Ps. 118,21; ርጉመ፡ ለይኩን፡ Mal. 1,14; Jer. 11,3; Jer. 17,5; Jer. 20,15; Jer. 31,10; Job 3,5; ርግምተ፡ ትኩን፡ ዕለት፡ Jer. 20,14; Matth. 25,41; ዘርጉም፡ τὸ ἀνάθεμα Jos. 7,12.

woorden.betekenis: imprecatio, exsecratio, rǝgmat, exécration, malédiction, exe
woorden.definitie: n. act. imprecatio, exsecratio Hen. 5,6; Hen. 5,7. rǝgmat G ርግመት፡ rǝgmat exécration, malédiction, mentionne dans sans texte. Texte et référence: ይሬስዮ፡ ጊዜ፡ ሞቱ፡ ይርግምዎ፡ ርግመተ። 452 L ርግመት፡ rǝgmat execration, malediction, curse 465a

woorden.betekenis: imprecatio, maledictio, exsecratio, dirae
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem. (Ps. 108,16; Ps. 108,17), Pl. መርገማት፡ (Cyr. f. 105; F.N. 9,4) imprecatio, maledictio, exsecratio, dirae, δυσφημία 2 Cor. 6,8; ἀρά, κατάρα Rom. 3,14; Gal. 3,10; Gal. 3,13; Hebr. 6,8; Jac. 3,10; 2 Petr. 2,14; Num. 5,23; መሐላ፡ ዘመርገም፡ Num. 5,21; 2 Esr. 23,2; መርገመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Prov. 3,33; Prov. 26,2; Ps. 9,29; Jes. 65,23; Jer. 29,14; Jer. 51,8; Bar. 1,20; መጽአ፡ መርገም፡ ላዕሌነ፡ ወመሐላ፡ Dan. 9,11; Sir. 3,9; Sir. 29,6; Hen. 5,5; ኢይፃእ፡ እምአፉሁ፡ ቃለ፡ መርገም፡ Did. 17.

woorden.betekenis: perterritus timuit, puduit
woorden.definitie: rad. inus.; رَجَبَ perterritus timuit, puduit.

woorden.betekenis: columba, pulli columbarum, pipiones, ʾargāba marṭul, ‘colomb
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque fem., coll. et sing., Pl. አርጋብ፡ [ut videtur, proprie: avis pavida, trepida, vid. 555] columba, περιστερά, collect. Matth. 10,16; Jes. 60,8; ኮኑ፡ ከመ፡ ርግብ፡ እለ፡ የሐፅና፡ ውስተ፡ ኰኵሕ፡ Jer. 31,28; ርግብ፡ ዘይትሜሀር፡ ሰሪረ፡ Hez. 7,16; Lev. 1,14; እጕለ፡ ርግብ፡ pulli columbarum, pipiones Lev. 5,7; Lev. 12,6; Lev. 12,8; Luc. 2,24; sing. Gen. 8,8; Ps. 54,6; Jes. 38,14; Jes. 59,11; Zeph. 3,1; Cant. 1,15; Matth. 3,16; Clem. f. 25; Rel. Bar.; masc. 4 Esr. 3,33 Laur.; ርግበ፡ ገዳም፡ χελιδὼν ἀγροῦ Jer. 8,7; transl. ad blandam mulieris compellationem Cant. 2,10; ርግብየ፡ ኅሪት፡ III Sal. Mar. 16; Pl. Matth. 21,12 rom.; Joh. 2,14; Reg. Pach.; Sx. Ter 22. አርጋበ፡ መርጡል ʾargāba marṭul ‘colombe della testimonianzaʼ (‘L’agiografo us መርጡል፡ un calco del greco martyrion, «testimonianza», 171. Il termine più ovvio sarebbe stato {vid.} ስምዕ፡. Secondo il linguaggio della «Terza Regola» di Pacomio, «la colomba» (cf. Mt. 10,16) è una metafora che simboleggia i monaci, cf. 63-69.ʼ 45 (125) n. 48, vid. መርጡል፡

woorden.betekenis: inniti baculo, niti, inniti, confidere, Judaei, tamargʷaza,
woorden.definitie: quadril. III,1 1 inniti baculo: ተመርጐዘ፡ ባቲ፡ (ለበትር፡) 4 Reg. 18,21; (ambulat) ዘእንበለ፡ በትር፡ ወተመርጒዞ፡ Clem. f. 131. 2 in genere: niti, inniti re (etiam transl.: confidere re); c.c. በ፡ Cant. 8,5; Sir. 15,4; Hen. 48,3; Hen. 61,3; Hen. 61,5; እለ፡ ይትመረጐዙ፡ ባቲ፡ (sc. ecclesia) Clem. f. 108; ይትመረጐዙ፡ በትእምርተ፡ መስቀል፡ Deg.; c. ዲበ፡ Hen. 61,5 var.; c. ውስተ፡, ut: ተመርጒዝየ፡ ውስተ፡ Deg.; c. Acc., ut: እለ፡ ይትመረጐዝዋ፡ τοῖς ἐπερειδομένοις ἐπ᾽ αὐτήν Prov. 3,18; Clem. f. 194; Judaei ይትመረጐዙ፡ ሕገ፡ ኦሪት፡ ዘሙሴ፡ Cyr. de Melch. f. 129. tamargʷaza G ተመርጐዘ፡ tamargʷaza, quadrl., III,1, ይትመረጐዝ፡, ይትመርጐዝ «s’appuyer sur la canne ou sur le bâton» ― ተመረጐዘ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 37v. 87 L ተመርጐዘ፡ tamargʷaza lean upon a staff, lean on (a person), rely 358a

woorden.betekenis: succus, rǝṭb, sap
woorden.definitie: subst. succus: ይቡስ፡ ዕፅ፡ ዘአልቦ፡ ርጥበ፡ Macc. f. 10. rǝṭb L ርጥብ rǝṭb sap 476b

woorden.betekenis: humiditas, rǝṭbat, rǝṭbǝnnā, viriditas, humidité, verdure, f
woorden.definitie: { etiam formam ርጥብና፡ exhibet Lud. sine auct.} n. act. humiditas (succus, humor, mador), plantae virentis: በከመ፡ እሳት፡ ያየብስ፡ ርጥበተ፡ ዕፅ፡ Phlx. 16; aëris (opp. ሐሩር፡) Phlx. 90. rǝṭbat, ርጥብና፡ rǝṭbǝnnā G ርጥበት፡ rǝṭbat et ርጥብና፡ rǝṭbǝnnā humiditas, viriditas, humidité, verdure, fraîcheur ― እርጥብነት፡, ርጥብነት፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 41. 160 L ርጥበት rǝṭbat dampness, humidity, freshness (of tree) ርጥብና፡ rǝṭbǝnnā (, 160) same 476b

woorden.betekenis: integer, incolumis, salvus, completus, perfectus, fuit
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., e.q. ܫܠܶܡ שָׁלֵם سَلِمَ, cujus potestas prima est integer ( incolumis, salvus; completus, perfectus ) fuit.

woorden.betekenis: Islamum profiteri
woorden.definitie: II,1 i.e. أَسْلَمَ Islamum profiteri: እመቦ፡ ዘአስለመ፡ በፈቃዱ፡ ቀኖናሁ፡ ፫ ዓመት፡ Kedr f. 70.

woorden.betekenis: incolumitas, salus, ut cognosceret, quomodo valerent, pax, c
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem. (ut Rom. 14,19; 1 Petr. 3,11; Hen. 5,4), [ܫܠܳܡ שָׁלוֹם سَلَامٌ]1 incolumitas, salus Hen. 76,8; Hen. 76,13; ሑር፡ በሰላም፡ Kuf. 18; በሰላም፡ የሐውር፡ ወበሰላም፡ ይትመየጥ፡ Kuf. 27; 2 Reg. 3,23; 2 reg. 3,24; ይዜንዎ፡ በእንተ፡ ሰላም፡ 2 Reg. 8,10; 1 Reg. 30,21; ከመ፡ ያእምር፡ ሰላሞሙ፡ ut cognosceret, quomodo valerent Kuf. 34. 2 pax (εἰρήνη), quatenus est cum concordia et securitas, tum salus et felicitas, omnis generis bona ad bene et beate vivendum necessaria complectens, secundum usum loquendi biblicum. a sensu proprio: ገብረ፡ ምስሌሆሙ፡ ሰላመ፡ Jos. 9,13; Kuf. 34; Kuf. 37; Judith 15,8; ንግበር፡ ሎቱ፡ ሰላመ፡ Jes. 27,5; ፈነዉ፡ መልእክተ፡ በቃለ፡ ሰላም፡ Judith 3,1; ይኩን፡ ሰላም፡ ማእከሌነ፡ Gen. 31,44; Jud. 4,17; 1 Reg. 7,14; ትጼውዕዎሙ፡ በሰላም፡ Deut. 20,10; Deut. 20,11; ለሰላም፡ Jud. 21,13; ፈነዉ፡ ኀበ፡ ጢጦስ፡ ይኅሥሡ፡ ሰላመ፡ እምኔሁ፡ Jsp. p. 377; ሰብአ፡ ሰላም፡ pacis amatores Jsp. p. 345; ዕደወ፡ ሰላምከ፡ ἄνδρες εἰρηνικοί σου Jer. 45,22; Ps. 36,39; ሰላመ፡ ይትናገሩኒ፡ Ps. 34,23; Jes. 32,4; ምክረ፡ ሰላም፡ βουλὴ εἰρηνική Zach. 6,13; ይጸልኡ፡ ሰላመ፡ Ps. 119,6; Matth. 10,34; Apoc. 6,4; ገባርያነ፡ ሰላም፡ εἰρηνοποιοί pacifici Matth. 5,9. b sensu biblico: Jes. 26,12; Jes. 45,7; Jes. 48,18; ብዙኅ፡ ሰላመ፡ ደቂቅኪ፡ Jes. 54,13; ሰላም፡ በዲበ፡ ሰላም፡ Jes. 57,19; Jes. 66,12; Jer. 6,14; Jer. 14,19; Jer. 36,7; Jer. 40,9; Ps. 4,9; Ps. 121,7; Hen. 1,8; Hen. 5,4; ንርከብ፡ ሰላመ፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Rom. 5,1; Rom. 8,6; Rom. 14,17; Joh. 16,33; Joh. 20,19; Joh. 20,21; Joh. 20,26; Phil. 4,7; 1 Cor. 1,3. 3 salus i.e. salutatio: ሰላም፡ ለከ፡ salus tibi! salve! creberrime, ut in singulis Encomiorum Synaxarii strophis; ላዕሌሁ፡ ሰላም፡ (in commemoratione nominum Sanctorum) Jsp. p. 274al.; ሰላመ፡ ገብርኤል፡ salutatio Gabrielis (Ave Luc. 1,28) 33. 203; (ritu ordinationis absoluto) ያቅርቡ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሰላመ፡ ሎቱ፡ (ለጳጳስ፡) Kid. f. 7; አትልዎ፡ ሰላም፡ sequi facere salutem Lud. ex Sx. Hed. 18 Enc. salām G ሰላም፡ salām pax, salus, prosperitas, paix, salut Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 42. ሰላም፡ salām poésie religieuse commençant par ce mot et ajoutée à la fin de chaque légende du Synaxaire. 161 L ሰላም salām peace, salutation, safety በሰላም ba-salām in peace, safely ላዕሌሁ፡ ሰላም lāʿlehu salām may peace be upon him! 499b

woorden.betekenis: apium, anetho, foeniculum, sǝlan, silan, silān, anethum, ane
woorden.definitie: n. peregr. sc. σέλινον apium; ponitur pro anetho (ἄνηθον) Matth. 23,23. Aethiops Ludolfi foeniculum esse putabat. – Voc. Ae.: ሲለን፡ ዘ፡ አብዓሽ። sǝlan, ሲለን፡ silan, ሲላን፡ silān G ስለን፡ sǝlan anethum (ἄνηθον), aneth Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 42. 162 L ስለን sǝlan, () ሲለን silan, ሲላን silān dill 500a

woorden.betekenis: cassia, salikā, salik, salak, laurier casse
woorden.definitie: et ሰሊካ፡ subst., sine dubio i.q. ሰሊኆት፡ (quamquam Ludolfi Aethiops utrumque inter se differre ait) cassia: ገነተ፡ ሜዓ፡ ወሰሊክ፡ Sx. Teq. 21Enc.; ከርቤ፡ ሰሊክ፡ ሚዓ፡ Gad. Ad. f. 118; ከርቤ፡ ወሚዓ፡ ወሰሊካ፡ Ssal. Req. salikā, salik, ሰለክ፡ salak G ሰለክ፡ salak cassia, laurier casse, vid. ሰሊኆት፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 42. 162 L ሰሊካ salikā, ሰሊክ salik cassia 499b

woorden.betekenis: potestatem habere
woorden.definitie: potestatem habere vid. sub ሠለጠ፡

woorden.betekenis: complere, absolvere, consummare, perficere, efficere, profic
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 nonnumquam i.q. ሰለጠ፡ transit., sc. complere, absolvere, consummare, perficere: ኣሰልጥ፡ መዐትየ፡ (v. እሰልጥ፡) Hez. 6,12; Hez. 20,8; Rom. 12,8 Platt; አመ፡ ይፈጥሮ፡ ለእጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ ይእተ፡ አሚረ፡ ይኤዝዞሙ፡ ወአመ፡ ያሰልጦ፡ ይእተ፡ አሚረ፡ ያዐርፎ፡ Sir. 18,7. 2 facere ut quis vel quid ad finem propositum perveniat i.e. efficere, proficere, peragere (ausrichten, vollbringen), efficacem esse, prodesse, c. Acc. pers.: መብልዕ፡ ኢያሰልጠነ፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ 1 Cor. 8,8; መሀሮ፡ ለወልድከ፡ ወያሰልጠከ፡ Sir. 30,13; c. ለ፡ pers.: ብእሲ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ያሰልጥ፡ ለመኳንንቲሁ፡ Sir. 20,27; Rom. 16,2; vel absol.: ነፍስ፡ እንተ፡ ታሰልጥ፡ ψυχὴ ἐνεργοῦσα Sap. 15,11; ትክል፡ ወታሰልጥ፡ Jac. 5,16; ኢያሰልጥ፡ οὐκ ἐργῶνται Jes. 5,10; ὠφελεῖν Ps. 29,11; 1 Tim. 4,8; ኢያስለጠት፡ ወኢምንተኒ፡ οὐδὲν ἐτελείωσε Hebr. 7,19; ግዝረት፡ ኢትበቍዕ፡ ወኢታሠልጥ፡ F.M. 33,5; እስመ፡ ጸሎተ፡ ጻድቅ፡ ትበቍዕ፡ ወታሰልጥ፡ Mavâs. f. 1. ʾaslaṭa L አስለጠ ʾaslaṭa accomplish, make perfect, consummate, make efficient 501a

woorden.betekenis: trahi, adduci, captivum trahi, deduci, attrahi, induci, adst
woorden.definitie: III,1 trahi, cum compositis: ተስሕበ፡ በሐብለ፡ ሃይማኖት፡ Sx. Hed. 20Enc.; adduci Hen. 70,3; captivum trahi, deduci Jes. 13,16 var.; 4 Esr. 10,34; እለ፡ ይሰሐቡ፡ ውስተ፡ ሞት፡ Prov. 24,11; attrahi, induci: በአሐዱ፡ ፍቁር፡ ይሰሐብ፡ ካልእ፡ Prov. Aeth. secundum Lud.; ተስሕበ፡ ሰብእ፡ በሥነ፡ ላሕየ፡ ምግባር፡ Sap. 14,20; ወይሰሐብ፡ እንከ፡ በልቡ፡ (sc. ad vitium) Phlx. 48; ጠቢብ፡ ኢይትአኀዝ፡ በአፍቅሮቱ፡ ለሐሳዊ፡ ወኢይሰሐብ፡ ሎቱ፡ (ad eum) Fal. f. 21; adstringi, intendi, de chordis Chrys. Ta. 29(vid. sub ልኅሉኅ፡). tasǝḥba L ተስሕበ tasǝḥba passive {of vid. ሰሐበ saḥaba} 492b

woorden.betekenis: sedatum esse
woorden.definitie: sedatum esse vid. sub ሥኅተ፡

woorden.betekenis: errare, oberrare facere, in errorem inducere, seducere, deci
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 errare vel oberrare facere (a recta via abducere): አስሐቶሙ፡ ውስተ፡ በድው፡ Ps. 106,40; አስሐቶሙ፡ ἀπῴκισεν αὐτούς Sir. 29,18; c. dupl. Acc.: ዘያስሕቶ፡ ፍኖተ፡ ለዕዉር፡ Deut. 27,18; Clem. f. 160; c. Acc. et እምነ፡ viae: Jes. 63,17. 2 in errorem inducere, seducere, decipere, in specie: in peccatum inducere, scandalizare: πλανᾶν Jes. 34,7; ኢያስሕትከ፡ ንጉሥ፡ Dan. apocr. 13,7; Hez. 14,9; ad peccatum: Kuf. 10; Hen. 19,1; Hen. 19,2; Hen. 54,6; Hen. 69,4; ለብዙኃን፡ አስሐቶሙ፡ ትዝህርቶሙ፡ Sir. 3,24; ኢትበል፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አስሐተኒ፡ Sir. 15,12; Jes. 9,16; Sir. 41,10; Prov. 7,21; Jac. 1,16; 1 Joh. 3,7; Apoc. 13,14; 2 Thess. 2,11; ኢታስሕት፡ ርእሰከ፡ μὴ ἁμαρτύνε Sir. 7,7; Ps. 35,1; ἀπατᾶν እመቦ፡ ዘአስሐቶ፡ በልብየ፡ በጽሚት፡ Job 31,27; ተሠነየት፡ ጥቀ፡ እስከ፡ ታስሕት፡ ዐይኖሙ፡ ለዕደው፡ Judith 10,4; Judith 16,8; Jes. 36,14; Jes. 37,10; virginem Ex. 22,15; ኢያስሕትከ፡ μή σε ἐκκλινάτω Job 36,19;ታምጽእ፡ ሊተ፡ ዘያስሕታ፡ ለዐይንየ፡ Sir. 23,4 (μετεωρισμοί); ኢያስሕቱክሙ፡ ሐሳውያነ፡ ነቢያት፡ ἀναπείθειν Jer. 36,8; σκανδαλίζειν Matth. 5,29; Matth. 18,8. 3 in lapsum vel infortunium inducere: እመ፡ አስሐተከ፡ Sir. 12,16; 4 Esr. 6,65; παγιδεύειν Matth. 22,15. ʾasḥata G አስሐተ፡ ʾasḥata II,1 in errorem induxit, scandalisavit, induire en erreur, scandaliser ― አሳተ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 43. 164 L አስሐተ ʾasḥata lead astray, lead into sin, induce into error, tempt to evil, corrupt, seduce, mislead, deceive, delude 494a

woorden.betekenis: errore accidit, erratum, delictum est
woorden.definitie: III,1 impers.: errore accidit alicui aliquid, erratum vel delictum est, c.c. Acc. pers.: 1 Reg. 20,26 (σύμπτωμα), Lev. 4,13; 2 Reg. 14,19; ለእመቦ፡ አበስከ፡ ወተስሕተከ፡ (var. ወስሕትከ፡) Sir. 21,1; personaliter 1 Reg. 6,9.

woorden.betekenis: aberratio, error, errores, vitium, peccatum, sine errore, se
woorden.definitie: n. act., m. et fem., Pl. ስሕተታት፡ aberratio, error, errores, (vitium, peccatum): ስሕተት፡ ጸዋግ፡ περιφέρεια πονηρά Koh. 10,13; Koh. 7,25 (var. ስሕታት፡); πλάνη ፍኖተ፡ ስሕተት፡ Sap. 12,24; ስሕተቶሙ፡ እምአእምሮ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Sap. 14,22; ስሕተተ፡ ልቦሙ፡ Kuf. 1; Kuf. 12; ስሕተተ፡ አሕዛብ፡ Kuf. 6; Asc. Jes. 2,10; ዘእንበለ፡ ስሕተት፡ sine errore . 314 Nr. 46; error Quartodecimanorum Sx. Mag. 4; seductio (passive) Sx. Enc. sǝḥtat G ስሕተት፡ sǝḥtat seductio, error, aberratio, séduction, égarement, aberration ― ማሳት፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 164 ስሕተተ፡ ልብ፡ sǝḥtata lǝbb «folie» ተወለጠ፡ ልቡናሁ፡ ወኮነ፡ የዐውድ፡ ውስተ፡ አብያተ፡ ዘቅጽር፡ በስሕተተ፡ ልብ። 287, vid. ልብ፡ 33 L ስሕተት፡ sǝḥtat error, transgression, going astray, mistake, seduction 494b

woorden.betekenis: in errorem inducens, impostor, seductor, planeta, fallax, mo
woorden.definitie: part. (II,1), Pl. መስሕታን፡, fem. መስሕታት፡ 1 in errorem inducens, impostor, seductor: ጋኔን፡ መስሕት፡ πνεῦμα πλανήσεως Jes. 19,14; Jer. 4,11; ኀይል፡ መስሕት፡ ἐνέργεια πλάνης 2 Thess. 2,11; አጋንንት፡ መስሕታን፡ 1 Tim. 4,1; πλάνοι 2 Joh. 7; ἐπίβουλος 2 Reg. 19,22; ἐμπαῖκται Judae 18; φρεναπάται Tit. 1,10; Clem. f. 186; ሰይጣን፡ መስሕት፡ Macc. f. 10; fem. መስሕታት፡ ለካልኣን፡ Did. 14; ኮከብ፡ መስሕት፡ πλανήτης planeta Judae 13. 2 fallax: እስመ፡ ኮነ፡ መስሕተ፡ በልቡ፡ ወያስሕት፡ ልበ፡ ካልኣኒሆሙ፡ Clem. f. 179; መኰንን፡ መስሕት፡ Lud. ex Sx. Enc. 3 ደብር፡ መስሕት፡ mons offensionis (הַר הַמַּשְׁחִית) 4 Reg. 23,13. masḥǝt G መስሕት፡ masḥǝt impostor, seductus, errans, imposteur, égaré, induit en erreur Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 43. 164 L መስሕት masḥǝt seducer, deceiver, erring, fallacious, impostor 494b

woorden.betekenis: id quod perniciosum, noxium est, nix, pruina, grando, gelici
woorden.definitie: et አስሐቲያ፡ subst., m. et fem. [num ab አስሐተ፡ i.e. הִשְׁחִית vel ሰሐጠ፡ repetendum et id quod perniciosum vel noxium est exponendum? an سَقِيطٌ comparandum videtaur?] nix, pruina, grando, gelicidium, gelu, glacies: χιών Prov. 25,13; Jer. 18,14; πάχνη ይዘርዎ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ለጊሜሁ፡ ወእምከመ፡ ረግዐ፡ አስሐትያ፡ ይትፈለጽ፡ ከመ፡ ስባራተ፡ ማህው፡ Sir. 43,19; Ps. 77,52; Ps. 118,83; አስሐትያ፡ ቀጢን፡ (v. ቀጣን፡) Sap. 5,15; አስሐትያ፡ ክረምት፡ Sap. 16,29; πάγος Job 37,9; Ex. 16,14; ቍር፡ ወአስሐትያ፡ πάγος καὶ ψῦχος Dan. apocr. 3,48; አስሐትያ፡ ይረግዕ፡ ዲበ፡ ማይ፡ Sir. 43,20; Job 15,7; χάλαζα Job 38,22; እብነ፡ አስሐትያ፡ Hen. 71,5; κρύσταλλος Apoc. 21,11 Platt; praeterea in locis aliis, ubi quae voc Graeca respondeat haud satis liquet: Ps. 148,8; Job 6,16; Sap. 16,22; 4 Esr. 6,10; Hen. 14,18; Hen. 60,17; Hen. 69,23; Kuf. 2; Kuf. 23; ዝናም፡ ወአስሐትያ፡ አጥፍኡ፡ እሳተ፡ Sx. Mij. 30Enc.; ከመ፡ አስሐትያ፡ ዘተሰደ፡ በነፋስ፡ ቀጢን፡ Sx. Tachs. 12Enc.; ማይ፡ ርግዕት፡ እምአስሐትያ፡ (gelu) Sx. Mag. 13. – Voc. Ae.: አስሐትያ፡ ዘ፡ ውርጭ።

woorden.betekenis: regio, tractus, patuit, apertum fuit os, nubes, expandi, dil
woorden.definitie: I,1 [conferendum est سَحَاةٌ regio, tractus; شَحَا patuit, apertum fuit os; contiguum videtur ሰሐበ፡ سَحَابَةٌ nubes ] expandi, dilatari: እምቅድመ፡ ይስሐው፡ ግዘፈ፡ ደመናት፡ Lit. Chrys. – Voc. Ae.: ስሕወ፡ ብ፡ ተሳበ።

woorden.betekenis: nomen
woorden.definitie: nomen vid. sub ሰመየ፡

woorden.betekenis: proventus uberior
woorden.definitie: et ሰመር፡ subst., Pl. ሰምራት፡ et አስማር፡, proventus uberior: በሰመረ፡ (v. በሰምረ፡) ገራህቱ፡ et በሰመረ፡ ዐጸደ፡ ወይን፡ ይፈዲ፡ Ex. 22,4; Org. 5; አስማሮ፡ ይፈዲ፡ Ex. 22,4.

woorden.betekenis: felis
woorden.definitie: felis vid. sub ድመት፡

woorden.betekenis: octo facere, octies facere, sammana, octo confecit, faire hu
woorden.definitie: octo facere, octies facere Lud. sine auct. sammana G ሰመነ፡ sammana I,2 ይሴምን፡, ይሰምን፡ octo confecit, faire huit ― ሰምንት፡ አደረገ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 43. 164 L ሰመነ sammana make eight, make eight times (denominative) 502b

woorden.betekenis: octo
woorden.definitie: nom. num., plerumque masculinis junctum, Acc. ሰማኒተ፡, octo; በ፴ ወሰማኒቱ፡ ዓመተ፡ መንግሥቱ፡ 2 Par. 16,1; ወለደ፡ ፳ ወሰማኒተ፡ አትቡዐ፡ 2 Par. 11,21; ዐሠርቱ፡ ወሰማኒቱ፡ ነፍስ፡ Gen. 46,22; 1 Petr. 3,20; 2 Petr. 2,5; Sx. Ter 27Enc.; አትረፈ፡ ሰማኒተ፡ ነፍሰ፡ Lit. Orth.

woorden.betekenis: octavus
woorden.definitie: adj. num. (ordinale), fem. ሳምንት፡ octavus: 1 Par. 12,12; በሳምን፡ ወርኅ፡ Zach. 1,1; በሳምንት፡ ዓመት፡ 1 Esr. 1,41; አመ፡ ሳምንት፡ ዕለት፡ 2 Esr. 18,18; Lev. 9,1; Lev. 15,14; Luc. 9,28; በዓመት፡ ሳምንቱ፡ Jer. 43,9; ሳምኖሙ፡ ውእቱ፡ Apoc. 17,11. Apud poëtam usurpatum est pro ordinali: ሰላም፡ ለክሙ፡ ውስተ፡ አሐተኔ፡ ጉቡኣን፤ ኤጲስ፡ ቆጶስ፡ ዓሥር፡ ወቀሳውስቲክሙ፡ ሳምን፡ (i.e. 18 episcopi et presbyteri) Sx. Mag. 4Enc.

woorden.betekenis: octo, octavus, hebdomas, septimana, septimana passionis, jej
woorden.definitie: nom. temporale 1 octo (dies) et octavus (dies) Gen. 31,23; Hen. 74,6; Hen. 74,7; Luc. 1,59; Luc. 2,21; Joh. 20,26. 2 octo dies i.e. hebdomas integra vel septimana: በሰሙነ፡ ሕማማት፡ septimana passionis F.M. 10,3; Did. 30; Cod. Mus. Brit. XXIX, 2, 17; ሰሙነ፡ ሕማማት፡ ወሰሙነ፡ ፍሥሕ፡ Abush. 1 seq.; ኀሙሰ፡ መዋዕለ፡ በበሰሙን፡ Syn. Nonnumquam ii tantum septimanae dies, quibus labor rusticus fieri solet, i.e. quinque dies (exc. Sabbato et Dominica) intelligendi sunt: ይጸውም፡ በበ፡ ሰሙን፡ jejunabat per singulas hebdomades Lud. e Vit. Sanct. samun G ሰሙን፡ samun octava, octave (de une fête religieuse) Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 43. ሰሙን፡ ቅድስት፡ samun qǝddǝst Semaine Sainte, vid. ቅዱስ፡ 164 ሰሙነ፡ ሕማማት፡ samuna ḥǝmāmāt La Semaine Sainte, vid. ሕማም፡ (Grébaut) 45 ሰሙነ፡ ሕርቃል፡ samuna ḥǝrqāl (= semaine d’Héraclius) «première semaine du Carême», vid. ሕርቃል፡ 48 ሰሙነ፡ ሕርቃል፡ samuna ḥǝrqāl semaine d’Héraclius (Jeûne du Carême), Cf. τυροφάγος ἑϐδομάς la de l’Église grecque, vid. ሕርቃል፡ 453 L ሰሙን፡ samun the eight day (of a month), eight day, week ሰሙን፡ ዕለት፡ samun ʿǝlat the eight day, vid. ዕለት፡ 502b C for ጸመ፡ ሰሙነ፡ ሕማማት፡ vid. ጾም፡

woorden.betekenis: octoginta, octogesimus
woorden.definitie: nom. num. octoginta ( octogesimus ); ejus character est ፹፡; cant. 6,8; Ps. 89,11; Gen. 35,28; Jud. 3,20; Jud. 20,25; 2 Reg. 19,25; Luc. 2,37; Luc. 16,7.

woorden.betekenis: plaga australis, meridies, auster, ventus meridialis, septen
woorden.definitie: (forma antiquior ሴሜን፡, passim ut Zach. 14,4 in Cod. Laur.) subst., sc. תֵּימָן ܬܰܝܡܢܳܐ ٱلْتَّيْمَنُ (de transitu literae ተ in ሰ cfr. ex. gr. ሱራፊን፡ i.e. תְּרָפִים Hez. 21,21) 1 plaga australis, meridies, νότος, Jer. 13,19; Jer. 17,26; Dan. 8,4; Dan. 8,9; Zach. 6,6; Zach. 14,4; Koh. 11,3; Kuf. 7 seq.; Hen. 26,2; Luc. 13,29. 2 m. auster, ventus meridialis Cant. 4,16. 3 At Abyssinis recentioris aetatis genuina vocis significatio in contrariam abiit: septentrio, et vice versa significationem vocis ደቡብ፡ septentrio, illi oppositae, in contrariam sc. meridies converterunt, (similem confusionis labem etiam ad vocabulum መስዕ፡ serpisse vid. in annot. ad Gen. 20,1). Quam miram significationum permutationem gentibus meridionalis Abyssinae Amharice loquentibus primis in morem venisse et inde exortam esse, quod ሰሜን፡ voce montes Abyssinae Semên (ስሜን፡, olim etiam ሰሜን፡, ut Sx. Genb. 19) significari opinati essent, equidem in Göttinger Gelehrte Anzeigen 1859p. 1906 demonstrare conatus sum. Exempla hujus confusionis: Ex. 27,11 ann.; Kuf. p. 44; Kuf. p. 53; in libris recentioribus creberrime voci ደቡብ፡, ut Koh. 1,6; Jes. 14,31; Jer. 1,13; Jer. 3,18; Jer. 6,22; Jer. 10,22; Jer. 13,20; Jer. 16,15; Jer. 25,9; Jer. 27,3; Jer. 27,9; Jer. 38,8; Zeph. 2,13; Zach. 2,6; Hez. 1,4; Hez. 8,5; Hez. 8,14; Hez. 21,4; Hez. 26,7 al., et voci መስዕ፡ substituitur, ut Jes. 43,6; Jer. 3,12 al. samen G ሰሜን፡ samen septentrio, nord (signification actuelle), midi (signification ancienne) Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 43. 164 L ሰሜን፡ samen (ሴሜን፡ semen) south, nord, north wind 503a

woorden.betekenis: fulsit, innixus est
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., e.q. ܣܡܰܟ et סָמַךְ fulsit; innixus est.

woorden.betekenis: imponere, ita ut ei incumbat, inniti, adniti facere, fulcire
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 transit. imponere aliquid alicui ita ut ei incumbat; inniti vel adniti facere, fulcire: ያሰምክ፡ መዝራዕቶ፡ ቦቱ፡ Jer. 17,5; አስመከ፡ ርእሶ፡ ውስተ፡ ሙዳየ፡ በለስ፡ Rel. Bar.; Luc. 9,58; አስምከኒ፡ ላዕሌሆን፡ Jud. 16,26; ርእሱ፡ (ለሰዋስው፡) ያሰምክ፡ ሰማየ፡ Gen. 28,12 (coll. سَمَكَ). 2 plerumque omisso nomine membri, quod quis rei imponit, incumbere, c.c. በ፡, ut: ያሰምክ፡ በአረፍት፡ Am. 5,19; Can. 1,12; ይረክብ፡ በዘ፡ ያሰምክ፡ Sir. 3,21; c. ውስተ፡, ut: ያሰምክ፡ ውስተ፡ ዐምድ፡ 4 Reg. 11,14; ውስተ፡ ጽዮን፡ አስመኩ፡ Sir. 24,10; c. ላዕለ፡, ut: Gen. 28,13; አስመከ፡ ላዕሌሃ፡ Jes. 36,6; Sir. 31,18; አስመከት፡ ላዕለ፡ ርእሰ፡ ወለታ፡ Esth. apocr. 5; Sir. 31,18; ዝኩ፡ ዘያሰምክ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ላዕለ፡ እዴሁ፡ 4 Reg. 7,2; 4 Reg. 7,17; c. ዲበ፡, ut: አስመኩ፡ ዲቤከ፡ Hez. 29,7; ያሰምክ፡ ዲበ፡ እዴየ፡ 4 Reg. 5,18. Transl. ላዕላ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ያሰምኩ፡ Mich. 3,11; አስምኩ፡ በስመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Jes. 50,10; Jes. 48,2; አስምኩ፡ በቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ Clem. f. 193; Clem. f. 194; ቤተ፡ መቅደስ፡ ብነ፡ ያሰምክ፡ Judith 8,24; etiam c. ኀበ፡, ut: ናሰምክ፡ በኵሉ፡ ግብር፡ ኀበ፡ ረድኤተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Chrys. Ta. 12. – Voc. Ae.: ያሰምክ፡ ዘ፡ ይደግፍ። ʾasmaka G አስመከ፡ ʾasmaka II,1 ያሰምክ፡, ያስምክ፡ reclinavit, vacuit, se pencher, s’appuyer, appuyer sa tête ― ተጠጋ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 44. 165

woorden.betekenis: audire, audite me vocem meam, audite meam vocem, auditu prae
woorden.definitie: I,1 [שָׁמַע, ܫܡܰܥ, سَمِعَ amh. ሰማ፡] Subj. ይስማዕ፡ 1 audire: በከመ፡ ሰማዕክሙ፡ በእዘኒክሙ፡ Jer. 33,11; ሰሚዖ፡ Jes. 37,1; እንዘ፡ ይሰምዑ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ Gen. 23,10; Gen. 23,13; Gen. 18,10; Matth. 13,16; Matth. 13,17; Luc. 14,35; c.c. Acc. rei: Gen. 3,10; Gen. 24,52; Ex. 16,9; 1 Reg. 17,28; Matth. 7,24; Marc. 7,14; Marc. 14,64; Luc. 15,25; Joh. 12,47; c. Acc. pers. Matth. 17,5; Luc. 15,1; 4 Esr. 10,53; c. dupl. Acc. ስምዑኒ፡ ቃልየ፡ audite me vocem meam i.e. audite meam vocem Jer. 7,23; Jer. 11,4; Ps. 16,7; Matth. 10,14; Joh. 5,28; c. Acc. pers. seq. እንዘ፡, ut: ሰምዐቶ፡ እንዘ፡ ይብል፡ ἤκουσεν αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος Gen. 27,5; Gen. 27,6; Hen. 40,5; Hen. 40,6; Hen. 40,7; Marc. 14,58; vel omisso እንዘ፡ ut Act. 10,46; Gen. 37,17; ሰማዕክዎ፡ ይብለኒ፡ Hez. 2,2. a auditu praeditum esse Matth. 11,5; ድንቅወ፡ ሰምዑ፡ Matth. 13,15; ሰሚዕ፡ auditus (sensus) Clem. f. 237al. b audire i.e. auribus percipere, accipere, comperire, cognoscere (erfahren), c. Acc. rei: እለ፡ ኢሰምዑ፡ ምግባርየ፡ Jes. 66,19; Tob. 14,15; Matth. 11,2; Luc. 4,23; Luc. 21,9; ከመ፡ ይስማዕ፡ ዜናሃ፡ ዘከመ፡ ሀለወት፡ Esth. 2,11; vel seq. ከመ፡ et enuntiatione integra: 1 Reg. 26,4; Gen. 43,25; Jos. 9,14; Kuf. 34; Jes. 39,1; Jes. 40,28; Jer. 47,11; 2 Esr. 14,1; Marc. 12,28; c. እምኀበ፡ vel ኀበ፡ ejus, a quo auditur Ob. 1; Hen. 1,2; Matth. 2,9; Marc. 6,20; Joh. 1,41; Joh. 6,45; 1 Reg. 2,23; Jes. 21,10; ለአከቶ፡ ትስማዕ፡ ጥዩቀ፡ ነገረ፡ በኀበ፡ መርዶክዮስ፡ μαθεῖν παρά Esth. 4,5; vel c. እምነ፡ 1 Joh. 1,5 Platt; c. በእንተ፡ vel በላዕለ፡ causae, de qua auditur: Gen. 41,15; ሶበ፡ ሰምዐ፡ መኰንን፡ በእንተ፡ ተኣምራት፡ ዘገብረ፡ Sx. Mag. 2; Act. 9,13 Platt; Phil. 1,30; ንስማዕ፡ በውስተ፡ አፉሃ፡ ἐρωτήσομεν τὸ στόμα ἀυτῆς Gen. 24,57. c auscultare, aures dare, attendere ad quem vel quid, c. Acc. Gen. 42,23; Gen. 49,2; 1 Reg. 3,9; 1 Reg. 3,10; 2 Reg. 12,18; 2 Reg. 19,35; Koh. 7,6; Ps. 80,10; Ps. 80,12; ኪያየ፡ ያፀምኡኒ፡ ወይሰምዑ፡ Job 29,21; Job 34,2; ትስማዕ፡ እዝንየ፡ እንዘ፡ ያወጽኡ፡ ሊተ፡ እኩየ፡ ስመ፡ Job 31,30; ሰሚዖተ፡ ተላህዮ፡ በዕንዚራ፡ ወአርጋኖን፡ F.M. 32,7; c. ዲበ፡ Ps. 91,11; c. ማእከለ፡ utriusque partis audiendae διακούειν Deut. 1,16 (at Job 9,33 አፅምአ፡ ማእከለ፡); እለ፡ ይሰምዑ፡ ትምህርተ፡ catechumeni Const. Ap. 30. d exaudire ( erhören ): Gen. 30,6; Deut. 1,45; ይሰምዐከ፡ ፍጡነ፡ ስእለተከ፡ Job 8,6; Job 22,27; ይሰምዖኑ፡ ጸሎቶ፡ Job 27,9; Sir. 4,6; Sir. 31,29; Sir. 31,31; Jes. 19,22; Jer. 11,11; Jer. 14,12; Ps. 16,7; Ps. 53,2; Joh. 9,31; Joh. 11,41; Joh. 11,42; c. ለ፡ objecti: Gen. 16,11; c. በእንተ፡ de Gen. 17,20. e oboedire, obtemperare, morem gerere: 1 Reg. 15,22; ወልድ፡ ዘኢይሰምዕ፡ ἀνήκοος Prov. 13,1; c. Acc. Gen. 3,17; Gen. 27,14; Gen. 28,7; Gen. 42,22; Ex. 6,9; ይሰምዕዎ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ 1 Par. 29,23; አበይክሙ፡ ሰሚዖትየ፡ Jer. 16,12; ኢሰምዑ፡ ሕጎ፡ Jes. 42,24; ዘይሰምዓ፡ ላቲ፡ Sir. 4,15; Joh. 10,3; Joh. 10,8; Act. 3,22. f accipere, admittere, ( assentire, probare ): ላዕለ፡ ልሂቅ፡ ኢትስማዕ፡ ውዴተ፡ παραδέχεσθαι 1 Tim. 5,19; Did. 4; ሰምዐ፡ ነገረ፡ ብእሲቱ፡ Kuf. 39; ይሰምዐኒ፡ ቃልየ፡ Joh. 18,37; ምክረ፡ ይሰምዕ፡ Sx. Ter 5 Enc.; ኢሰምዐ፡ እምኔሁ፡ ejus consilium non admisit Sx. Masc. 7. g audita intelligere: ኢይስማዕ፡ ፩፩ቃለ፡ እኁሁ፡ Kuf. 10; ንግር፡ ሱርስት፡ እስመ፡ ንሰምዕ፡ Jes. 36,11; Deut. 28,49; 1 Cor. 14,2. 2 testem esse, testari (denom. a ስምዕ፡); ግብረ፡ ሐዋርያት፡ (Actus Apostolorum) ትሰምዕ፡ ከመ፡ ወረደ፡ መንፈስ፡ ቅዱስ፡ በአምሳለ፡ ልሳናተ፡ እሳት፡ Phlx. 58; ኢትስማዕ፡ ለቢጽከ፡ ስምዐ፡ በሐሰት፡ οὐ ψευδομαρτυρήσεις Ex. 20,16; c. Acc. pers. Luc. 4,22; c. በእንተ፡ Joh. 5,32.

woorden.betekenis: facere ut audiat, facere ut audiatur, nuntiare, annuntiare,
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 a facere ut audiat aliquis: ለጽሙማን፡ ያሰምዖሙ፡ Marc. 7,37 (i.e auditum restituere); ኣስምዕ፡ አሕዛበ፡ (v. ለአሕዛብ፡) Jes. 45,1; Rom. 1,5; c. dupl. Acc.: አስምዐኒ፡ ቃለከ፡ Cant. 2,14; Ps. 50,9; Sir. 45,5; ኢታስምዖ፡ ቃለ፡ ዘይብል፡ ዘይብል፡ ረሐቁ፡ እምኔነ፡ ኵልክሙ፡ Genz. f. 80. b facere ut audiatur aliquid: ያሰምዕ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ቃለ፡ ስብሐቲሁ፡ ἀκουστὴν ποιεῖ Jes. 30,30; ያሰምዖ፡ ድምፆ፡ በዐቢይ፡ ቃል፡ Sir. 50,16. c nuntiare, annuntiare: አስማዕኩከ፡ Jes. 48,5; Jes. 48,6; አስምዑ፡ በኢየሩሳሌም፡ Jer. 4,5; c. ለ፡ pers. Ex. 21,29; Ex. 21,36. d acclamare, inclamare alicui: አስምዕዎ፡ ቃለ፡ ሕሡመ፡ ወወገርዎ፡ በአእባን፡ Jsp. p. 360; Hen. 89,53. e vocem edere i.e. alta voce canere: ወያሰምዑ፡ መዘምራን፡ 2 Esr. 22,42 vers. nov. 2 testari a testem adhibere vel invocare, contestari aliquem: አስምዕ፡ ሰማዕተ፡ Jer. 39,44; አስምዕ፡ ሰብአ፡ ምእመናነ፡ Jes. 8,2; ናሰምዕ፡ ለክሙ፡ ሰማየ፡ ወምድረ፡ Judith 7,28; Deut. 8,19; Sir. 46,19; Hen. 100,11; 2 Tim. 4,1 rom. b obtestari, teste invocato affirmare: በሰማዕት፡ አስምዐ፡ ለነ፡ Gen. 43,3; 3 Reg. 2,42; Ps. 49,8; Hebr. 2,6 rom.; Kuf. 4; c. Acc. pers.: አስምዖ፡ ሎቱ፡ Zach. 3,6; vel teste invocato annuntiare alicui aliquid: አስምዕ፡ ላቲ፡ ለኢየሩሳሌም፡ ኀጢአታ፡ Hez. 16,2; vel teste invocato hortari et implorare: አስምዕ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ከመ፡ ኢየሀቡ፡ Kuf. 30; Deut. 32,46; Ex. 19,23; Hen. 81,6; Hen. 91,3. d testimonium perhibere, testem esse: ስምዐ፡ ያሰምዕ፡ ላቲ፡ Ex. 21,10; እስመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አስምዐ፡ ማእከሌከ፡ ወማእከለ፡ ብእሲትከ፡ Mal. 2,14.

woorden.betekenis: audiri, exaudiri, ad aures, pervenire, nuntiari, de, sonus r
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 audiri Gen. 45,2; Gen. 45,16; 1 Reg. 1,13; Cant. 2,12; Ps. 18,3; ተሰምዐ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ውስተ፡ እዝነ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Jes. 5,9; Jes. 15,4; ኢይሰማዕ፡ እንከ፡ ዐመፃ፡ በውስተ፡ ምድርኪ፡ Jes. 60,18; Jer. 6,7; Jer. 38,15; Hez. 10,5; Apoc. 19,1; ተሰምዐ፡ በውስተ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ከመ፡ 2 Esr. 16,6; ግሙራ፡ ኢተሰምዐ፡ ነገር፡ ዘከመዝ፡ ላዕለ፡ ሶስና፡ Dan. apocr. 1,27. a exaudiri: ተሰምዐ፡ ጸሎቶሙ፡ Tob. 3,16; Dan. 10,12. b ad aures alicujus pervenire, nuntiari: c. በኀበ፡ Matth. 28,14; 1 Cor. 5,1 (c. በላዕለ፡ de ); Eph. 5,3. c ይሰማዕ፡ ድምፀ፡ ሠሐቆሙ፡ ከመ፡ ንቃወ፡ አፍራስ፡ sonus risus eorum sicut hinnitus equorum adiebatur ( war anzuhören wie ) Clem. f. 17. d audientiam facere: ቃለ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ይሰማዕ፡ በውስተ፡ እንግልጋ፡ ζητήσεται Sir. 21,17. 2 palam fieri, percrebescere, in vulgus emanare, divulgari: ተሰምዐ፡ ስምከ፡ እስከ፡ ርኁቅ፡ ደሰያት፡ Sir. 47,16; ሶበ፡ ተሰምዐ፡ ዜናሁ፡ ኀበ፡ ነገሥተ፡ ምድር፡ Clem. f. 36; ተሰምዐ፡ ስምኪ፡ ውስተ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ἐξῆλθε Hez. 16,14; Marc. 1,28; Rom. 1,8; Rom. 9,17; Rom. 16,19. 3 nominis famam adipisci, celebrari: (Christo in Bethlehem nato) ተሰምዐት፡ ምድር፡ ዘይሁዳ፡ ወኤፍራታ፡ Clem. f. 152; ወይሰማዕ፡ ስምየ፡ በኵሉ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ἐπιφανές Mal. 1,14; ኢኮነ፡ እምዮም፡ ዘተሰምዐ፡ ጥበብኪ፡ πρόδηλος Judith 8,29.

woorden.betekenis: res audita, rumor, nuntius, testimonium, testificatio, conte
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. ስምዓት፡, Pl. Pl. ስምዐታት፡ 1 res audita, rumor, nuntius: መኑ፡ ገብረ፡ ዘንተ፡ ስምዐ፡ እምትካት፡ ἀκουστά Jes. 45,21; ስምዐ፡ ኮነ፡ Jes. 48,3; በከመ፡ ስምዕ፡ ዘሰማዕክሙ፡ Asc. Jes. 7,2; ἀκοή ወንሕነኒ፡ ንሰምዕ፡ ሠናየ፡ ስምዐ፡ በላዕሌኪ፡ Tob. 10,12; መኑ፡ አምነነ፡ ስምዐነ፡ Jes. 53,1. 2 testimonium, testificatio, contestatio Kuf. 1; Kuf. 4; Ruth 4,7; Ex. 20,16; Gen. 21,30; ስምዐ፡ ሐሰት፡ καταψευσμός Sir. 26,5; ስምዕ፡ በሐሰት፡ Matth. 15,9; በእንተ፡ ስምዐ፡ ሐሰት፡ F.M. 24; ስምዓት፡ testium dicta vel responsa F.N. 43,12; ስምዑ፡ ለክርስቶስ፡ 2 Tim. 1,8; 1 Cor. 2,1; 2 Cor. 1,12; Act. 4,33; Joh. 8,13; in specie a testimonium, locus probans, argumentum (e libro allatum): ስምዐታት፡ Phlx. 3; Catal. Cod. Bibl. Bodl. Ae. p. 24. b testimonium Dei vel revelatio (cum praeceptis) עֵדיּת Kuf. 1; Ps. 18,8; Ps. 118,88; Ps. 188,95; ቤተ፡ ስምዕ፡ σκηνὴ τοῦ μαρτυρίου 1 Par. 6,32; 1 Par. 9,20; ደብተራ፡ ቤተ፡ ስምዕ፡ 2 Par. 1,3; 2 Par. 5,5 (alias መርጡር፡ vel መርጡል፡). c martyrium: ከመዝ፡ ፈጸሙ፡ (martyres) ስምዖሙ፡ Sx. Tachs. 30; ምክንያተ፡ ስምዖሙ፡ causa martyrii eorum Sx. Tachs. 30; ሕማመ፡ ስምዕ፡ Org. 1. 3 concr., sing. et coll., m. et fem., testis vel testes: ስምዕ፡ አሐዱ፡ Num. 35,30; Deut. 17,6; ኢትኩን፡ ስምዐ፡ በሐሰት፡ ላዕለ፡ ቢጽከ፡ Deut. 5,17; Ruth 4,10; Ruth 4,11; ረሰይክዎ፡ ስምዐ፡ ለአሕዛብ፡ Jes. 55,4; 1 Reg. 20,23; Jer. 49,5; 1 Thess. 2,5; creberrime: ስምዐ፡ ኮነ፡ testis fuit vel testatus est Lev. 5,1; 1 Joh. 1,2; c. ለ፡ vel ላዕለ፡ prs. ( alicui ) 4 Esr. 6,67; ስምዐ፡ ኮኑ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ከመ፡ ፍጹም፡ ውእቱ፡ Did. 4; c. በ፡ rei, ut ኮንኩ፡ ስምዐ፡ በዝንቱ፡ Sx. Jac. 2; vel ለ፡ Sap. 4,6; Joh. 5,31; ስምዕ፡ ለዛቲ፡ ቃላት፡ Genz. f. 82; vel በእንተ፡ Apoc. 1,2; 1 Petr. 1,11; vel ላዕለ፡, ut: ኮንኩ፡ ስምዐ፡ ላዕለ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ነገር፡ Sx. Jac. 2; Apoc. 1,2; እግዚአብሔር፡ ስምዕ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵልያቲሁ፡ Sap. 1,6; seq. ከመ፡ conj., ut: ስምዐ፡ ኮነ፡ ከመ፡ 3 Reg. 21,10; 3 Reg. 21,13. – In specie 4 martyr et martyres: ቂርቆስ፡ ዘኮነ፡ ስምዐ፡ ለክርስቶስ፡ Mavâs. 61; በዛቲ፡ ዕለት፡ ኮኑ፡ ስምዐ፡ ኮርኖስ፡ ወፊልሞና፡ Sx. Tachs. 30; Sx. Ter 25; alias creberrime in Sx. – Nota, ስምዕ፡ et ስም፡ in libris Mss. passim confundi. – Voc. Ae.: ስምዕ፡ ዘ፡ ምስክር፡

woorden.definitie: vid. sub ስሙዕ፡

woorden.definitie: vid. sub ሰማዒ፡

woorden.betekenis: altum, conspicuum esse, nomen imponere, nominare, nuncupare,
woorden.definitie: I,1 [prima radicis potestas est altum, deinde conspicuum esse, cfr. Ges. thes. p. 1431] Subj. ይስሚ፡ 1 nomen imponere, nominare, nuncupare, appellare, c. Acc. pers. et c. Acc. nominis: ስምከ፡ ዘእግዚአብሔር፡ ሰመየከ፡ Jes. 62,2; ይሰምይዋ፡ ለኢየሩሳሌም፡ መንበረ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Jer. 3,17; Gen. 1,5; Gen. 2,19; Gen. 2,20; Gen. 26,18; Gen. 31,47; Luc. 6,13 al., vel c. በ፡ nominis: ሰመያ፡ በስመ፡ ወልዱ፡ Gen. 4,17; ዘሰመይክሙ፡ በቅዱስ፡ አስማት፡ Lev. 23,2; Jes. 40,26. At nomen proprium, quo quem nominant, tamquam indeclinabile in nominativo ponere solent: ኢትስምያኒ፡ ኖሔሚን። ስምያኒ፡ መራር፡ Ruth 1,20; 1 Reg. 4,21; Marc. 3,16; Luc. 2,21 al. In phrasi appellavit nomen ejus N.N. Aethiopes verbo pron. pers. suffigere amant: appellavit eum nomen (i.e. nomine) ejus N.N., ut: ሰመያ፡ አዳም፡ ስመ፡ ብእሲቱ፡ ሕይወት፡ Gen. 3,20 c. annot.; ስምዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ኢይዝራኤል፡ Hos. 1,4. Constr. praegn.: nominando attribuere alicui qualitatem: ቦኑ፡ ትሰምዮ፡ ለክርስቶስ፡ መለኮተ፡ . p. 500 Nr. 29. 2 vocare, pronuntiare nomen alicujus: ዘእንበለ፡ ያእምር፡ ሕፃን፡ ሰምየ፡ (v. ሰሚየ፡) አቡሁ፡ Jes. 8,4; Jes. 19,17; Jes. 26,13; ኢይሰምይዋ፡ በአፉሆሙ፡ Jer. 3,16; ኢይሰሚ፡ እንከ፡ ስመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Jer. 20,9; praedicare vel profiteri nomen alicujus 2 Tim. 2,19. samaya G ሰመየ፡ samaya I,1 ይሰሚ፡, ይስሚ፡ nominavit, nommer, désigner par un nom ― አለ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 44. 165 L ሰመየ samaya (yǝsmi) call, name, give a name, give a surname, address, (Gr) pray, invoke, appeal to 504a

woorden.betekenis: nomen consequi, nomine insignem, inclytum fieri, esse, incla
woorden.definitie: II,1 nomen consequi, nomine insignem vel inclytum fieri vel esse, inclarescere: ዕደው፡ እለ፡ አስመዩ፡ ἄνδρες ὀνομαστοί Sir. 39,2; Sir. 44,3 (በኀይሎሙ፡); እለ፡ አስመዩ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ Hez. 23,23; ብሔር፡ ዘያሰሚ፡ Hez. 39,11.

woorden.betekenis: nominari, appellari, nuncupari, dici, se nominari sinere, co
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 nominari, appellari, nuncupari, dici (nomine), se nominari sinere (Matth. 23,8; Matth. 23,11), cognominari: ተሰምየ፡ ስሙ፡ Koh. 6,10; Eph. 1,21; አሕዛብ፡ እለ፡ ተሰምዩ፡ በስምከ፡ Sir. 36,17; ከመ፡ ይሰመይ፡ በስምየ፡ Jes. 41,25; Jes. 43,7; Jes. 48,1; ስምከ፡ ተሰምየ፡ ላዕሌነ፡ Jer. 14,9; Jes. 63,19; Jac. 2,7; vel c. Acc. Subj.: ከመ፡ ተሰምየ፡ ስሞ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ላዕሌከ፡ Deut. 28,10; Gen. 25,30 (gramm. § 192,c); c.c. Acc. vel Nom. praedicati: 4 Esr. 10,23; እምዝ፡ ትሰመዪ፡ ሀገረ፡ ጽድቅ፡ Jes. 1,26; ተሰምዩ፡ ትጉሃነ፡ Kuf. 4; Gen. 17,5; Gen. 19,22; Num. 11,3; Luc. 2,23; ዘኢይሰመይ፡ ineffabilis Asc. Jes. 8,7; ልብነ፡ ድንግል፡ ዘተሰምየ፡ ወናግ፡ ሰገድ፡ Epil. Ev. Joh. in ed. rom.; በግምባር፡ ወተሰምዮ፡ re et nomine Sx. 21 Haml. Enc. 2 memorari, praedicari Asc. Jes. 7,24-26; Rom. 15,20. 3 nomine clarum, inclytum esse: መካን፡ ዘይሰመይ፡ τόπος ὀνομαστός Jes. 56,5. tasamya G ተሰምየ፡ tasamya III,1 ይሰመይ፡ cognominatus, nominatus fuit, être nommé, être surnommé ― ተባለ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 44. 165 L ተሰምየ tasamya be named, be called 504a

woorden.betekenis: coelum, samāy, heaven, sky, samāyāwi, heavenly, divine, cele
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. ሰማያት፡ [שָׁמַיִם ܫ̈ܡܰܝܳܐ سَمَآءٌ] coelum, m. Jes. 13,13; Jes. 42,5; Jes. 48,13; Job 9,8; ልዑል፡ ሰማይ፡ Job 11,8; Ps. 103,3; Matth. 16,2; Matth. 16,3; Apoc. 12,1 al.; fem. Lev. 26,19; Jes. 40,22; Jes. 44,24; Jes. 45,12; Jer. 2,12; Hez. 32,7; Hagg. 2,6; Ps. 18,1; Ps. 49,7; Ps. 101,26; Sir. 43,1; Sir. 43,9; Hen. 18,4 al.; στερέωμα Hez. 1,22; Hez. 10,1; ὕψιστα አንሰ፡ ውስተ፡ ሰማያት፡ ኀደርኩ፡ Sir. 24,4; አዕዋፈ፡ ሰማይ፡ Matth. 6,26; Matth. 8,20; Ex. 9,10; ልዕልና፡ ሰማያት፡ Sir. 17,32; ሰማይ፡ ዘመልዕልተ፡ ሰማይ፡ Sir. 16,18; ይትፌሥሓ፡ ሰማያት፡ Jes. 49,13; ተርኅወ፡ ሰማያት፡ Hez. 1,1; ሰማየ፡ ሰማያት፡ Ps. 113,25; መንግሥተ፡ ሰማያት፡ Matth. 3,2; Matth. 4,17; ዘበሰማያት፡ ἐπουράνιος Joh. 3,12; ዘእምሰማያት፡ Hebr. 6,4; እንተ፡ በሰማይ፡ Hebr. 12,22; ሣልስ፡ ሰማይ፡ 2 Cor. 12,2; ሳብዕ፡ ሰማይ፡ Asc. Jes. 3,13; Asc. Jes. 4,14; ሰማይ፡ ዳግሚት፡ ሣልሲት፡ Ssal. Req.; de septem coelis Asc. Jes. 7,9 seq.; Clem. f. 3; Clem. f. 48. samāy L ሰማይ samāy heaven, sky ሰማያዊ samāyāwi heavenly, divine, celestial being 504a C a for ሕብረ፡ ሰማይ፡ vid. ሕብር፡ b for ርኅወ፡ ሰማይ፡ vid. ርኅው፡ (Leslau)

woorden.betekenis: coelestis, coelicolae., caeruleus
woorden.definitie: adj. rel. 1 coelestis Matth. 5,48; Matth. 18,14; 1 Cor. 15,47; Ps. 67,15; 1 Esr. 6,14; ጸጋ፡ ሰማያዊት፡ Kedr f. 87; መርዓዊ፡ ሰማያዊ፡ Clem. f. 117; ኢየሩሳሌም፡ ሰማያዊት፡ Clem. f. 125; ሰማውያን፡ coelicolae. 2 caeruleus Lud. ex. auct. Gregorii.

woorden.betekenis: fatigavit se labore, laborare, facere, opus facere, labore c
woorden.definitie: I,1 [comparandum proposuit טְרַח fatigavit se labore Ges. in thes. p. 555; amh. ሰራ፡ laborare, facere, opus facere] Subj. ይስራሕ፡ 1 laborare in re usque ad defatigationem, labore confici, defatigari, (κοπιᾶν), ኢትስራሕ፡ ባሕቲትከ፡ ሎሙ፡ Num. 11,17; እንተ፡ ብዙኀ፡ ሰርሐት፡ ለክሙ፡ Rom. 16,6; በእንተ፡ እለ፡ ይሰርሑ፡ ከመ፡ ትባርክ፡ ፍሬ፡ ተግባሮሙ፡ Lit. 175,2; በኵሉ፡ ስራሕየ፡ ዘሰራሕኩ፡ μόχθῳ ᾧ ἐμόχθησα Koh. 2,19 seq.; Koh. 2,11; Koh. 3,9; ትረክብ፡ ምክረ፡ ሰሪሐከ፡ μετὰ κόπου Sir. 13,26; ቦ፡ ዘይጔጕእ፡ ወይሰርሕ፡ ወይጻሙ፡ Sir. 11,11; Sir. 34,4; ይሰርሕ፡ እስከ፡ ያገርር፡ ተያፍኒሁ፡ Sir. 38,26; ለከንቱ፡ ወለበክ፡ ሰርሐ፡ Job 20,18; 2 Thess. 3,8; c. በ፡ rei, in qua quis laborat: ሰርሐት፡ ሞአብ፡ በጣዖት፡ Jes. 16,12; Jes. 47,13; ሰራሕኪ፡ በዐዊድ፡ Sir. 57,10; Ps. 6,6; Ps. 68,4; περισπᾶσθαι Koh. 1,13; Koh. 3,10; vel c. እንዘ፡ ut Gen. 19,11; 1 Cor. 4,12; እንዘ፡ እልሕስ፡ ሰራሕኩ፡ Job 17,2; Luc. 2,48; c. በእንተ፡ ob 1 Tim. 4,10; 2 Cor. 5,1. 2 fessum, confectum esse, affligi, miseria vel aerumnis laborare, molestia premi: ሰርሑ፡ ግብጽ፡ Jes. 45,14; Thren. 5,5; de anima: ከመ፡ ኢትስራሕ፡ ነፍስክሙ፡ Hebr. 12,3; Ps. 106,12; 4 Esr. 3,22; de terra Hen. 65,3; ሰራሕነ፡ ἀσθενοῦμεν Jes. 28,20; ከመ፡ ትስራሕ፡ κακωθῆναι Dan. 10,12; እኪት፡ በዘ፡ ይሰርሑ፡ ነገሥት፡ εἰς τὸ βασιλεῖς ἐνοχλῆσαι 1 Esr. 2,24. 3 secundum usum loquendi Amharicum: fabricari, ut: ሰሪሐ፡ ወልታ፡, ኀጺን፡ fabricatio scutorum, ferri Lud. e Libr. Myst. sarḥa, ሠርሐ፡ śarḥa,ሠርኀ፡ śarḫa G ሰርሐ፡ sarḥa I,1 ይሰርሕ፡, ይስራሕ፡ fatigatus fuit, fabrefecit, être fatigué, fabriquer, façonner avec art ― ደከመ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 44. 165 L ሰርሐ sarḥa I (yǝsrāḥ), (, ) ሠርሐ፡ śarḥa, (Lt) ሠርኀ፡ śarḫa toil, labor to the point of exhaustion, drudge, weary oneself, be fatigued, be troubled, be anxious; (Amharism) fabricate, make, set (the hair), till (the land) 513a

woorden.betekenis: laborans, labore, molestia confectus, pressus, fatigatus, ve
