woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., Pl. ስራሓት፡ labor, molestia, fatigatio, afflictio, vexatio, aerumna, sollicitudo; opus domesticum Lud. e Can. Clem. f. 67; περισπαρμός, μόχθος Koh. 1,13; Koh. 2,10; Koh. 2,19 seqq.; Koh. 3,10; Koh. 4,8; Deut. 26,7; 2 Cor. 11,27; 1 Thess. 2,9; κόπος, πόνος Job 5,7; Jer. 51,33; ስራሕ፡ ወሕማም፡ Hab. 1,3; ሕማም፡ ወስራሕ፡ κόποι καὶ πόνοι Jer. 20,18; Ps. 24,19; 2 Cor. 6,5; ጋእዞሙ፡ ስራሕ፡ ለዘ፡ ይሰምዖሙ፡ ἀκοὴ μοχθηρά Sir. 27,15; ዕለተ፡ ስራሕ፡ ወምንዳቤ፡ Hen. 45,2; Hen. 63,8; Hen. 103,9; 4 Esr. 5,12; 4 Esr. 6,63; 4 Esr. 6,70; 4 Esr. 9,26; 4 Esr. 9,43; በብዙኅ፡ ስራሕ፡ 4 Esr. 9,45; Kuf. 23; ስራሓቲሁ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ዓለም፡ Deg.; ስራሑ፡ ለመንበርት፡ sollicitudo rei familiaris 1 Joh. 2,16. sǝrāḥ, Pl. አስርሕት ʾasrǝḥt work, labour ኢትሑሩ፡ አኮኑ፡ ለክሙ፡ መዋዕለ፡ አስርሕት፡ ‘ N’ (y) allez pas: n’avez-vous pas de jours de labeurs ’ 176 (564) l. 12-13 (ed.); 177 (565) l. 12 (tr.)

woorden.definitie: v. ሳረራ፡ n. peregr., sine dubio corruptum, significans speciem quandam gummis odoratae: ይወፅእ፡ እምኔሁ፡ ከመ፡ ኔቄጥሮ፡ ዘስሙ፡ ሳሪራ፡ Hen. 31,1. – Voc. Ae.: ሰራራ፡ ዘ፡ ጸሊም፡ ጽጌ፡ (si quidem hoc scholion huc referendum sit).

Bar.; አስራበ፡ ማይ፡ ὄμβροι Sap. 16,16; Hen. 28,3; Hen. 89,2; Hen. 89,7; አስራበ፡ ቀላይ፡ Org. 3; ቃለ፡ ነቢያት፡ ዘይውሕዝ፡ ከመ፡ አስራበ፡ ወርቅ፡ ንጹሕ፡ Clem. f. 176; Org.; ለእመ፡ አውሐዘ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አስራበ፡ እክል፡ እምሰማይ፡ 4 Reg. 7,2. – Voc. Ae.: አስራብ፡ ዘ፡ ሻሻታ፡ (v. ሻሽታ፡).

woorden.betekenis: vespera, vesperus, tempus vespertinum, vespere, vesperi, sub
woorden.definitie: subst. vespera, vesperus, tempus vespertinum (ἑσπέρα, δείλη) መስዋዕተ፡ ሰርክ፡ Ps. 140,3; እምሰርኩ፡ Ex. 12,18; እምንግህ፡ እስከ፡ ሰርክ፡ Ruth 2,7; Job 4,20; Sir. 18,26; Lev. 11,24 seq.; 1 Reg. 14,24; ወፍና፡ ሰርክ፡ ውእቱ፡ 1 Reg. 23,24; ለፍና፡ ሰርክ፡ Lev. 6,13; vespere vel vesperi በሰርክ፡ Jer. 31,33; በበሰርክ፡ 2 Par. 13,11; vel in Acc. ሰርከ፡, ut: በጽልመት፡ ሰርከ፡ Prov. 7,9; ሰርከ፡ ወነግሀ፡ Ps. 54,19; Ps. 58,7; Ps. 89,6; Ex. 16,12; Jac. 5,7; ሰርከ፡ ሰንበት፡ Matth. 28,1; ሰርከ፡ ሰርከ፡ ትበልዕ፡ Judith 12,9; 4 Esr. 14,47; ፍና፡ ሰርክ፡ sub vesperum Num. 9,3; Gen. 3,8; Gen. 19,1; Hez. 33,22; Esth. 2,14. Acc. piaculi et ዲበ፡ pro: Kuf. p. 54. 3 veniam impetrare, ከመ፡ ታስተስሪ፡ እምኵሉ፡ አበሳ፡ Kuf. p. 80. 4 raro de Deo praedicatur: expiare delictum i.e. delicti gratiam facere Kuf. p. 22, ann. 8. (In libris Mss. አስተስረየ፡ passim confunditur cum አስተርአየ፡ q.v.). ʾastasraya G አስተስረየ፡ ʾastasraya IV,1 intercessit, intercéder, intervenir comme médiateur Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 45. 166 C vid. also አስረየ፡

woorden.betekenis: remissio, venia, expiatio, piaculum, sǝryat, sǝret, sǝryāt,
woorden.definitie: , passim ስሬት፡ (ut Lit. 163,4; Lit. 167,4), subst. 1 remissio, venia Hen. 13,6; Kuf. 15; Kuf. 30; ስርየተ፡ ኀጢአት፡ F.M. 26,4; Did. 39; Chrys. ho. 20; ሰአሉ፡ ለነ፡ ስርየተ፡ ኀጢአት፡ Mavâs. 20; Mavâs. al. 2 expiatio, et expiationis causa: piaculum: ቤተ፡ ስርየት፡ οἶκος τοῦ ἱλασμοῦ 1 Par. 28,20 (aliter 1 Par. 28,11); ገብሮ፡ ስርየተ፡ Rom. 3,25 Platt. sǝryat, sǝret, ስርያት፡ sǝryāt G ስርየት፡ sǝryat, ስርያት፡ sǝryāt remissio, pardon, rémission des péchés Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 45. 166 L ስርየት sǝryat, ስርያት sǝryāt, ስሬት፡ sǝret remission of sins, forgivness, atonement, absolution, pardon 515b

woorden.betekenis: moveri, ire, duxit
woorden.definitie: rad. quadril. inus., praefixo ሰ፡ causativo (gramm. § 73; gramm. § 79) formata e רָגַל moveri, ire (de qua rad. vid. Ges. thes. p. 1261) sicut ܫܰܪܓܶܠ duxit.

woorden.betekenis: currus, vehiculum, plaustrum, pilentum, rheda, currus bellic
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., coll. et sing., Pl. ሰረገላት፡, qui et ipse singulariter usurpatur: 1 currus cujusvis generis (vehiculum, plaustrum, pilentum, rheda, currus bellicus); ሰረገላ፡ coll. ἅρματα Jes. 5,28 var.; Jes. 22,7; Jes. 31,1 var.; በብዙኅ፡ ሰረገላየ፡ Jes. 37,24; Jes. 43,17; Jes. 66,15; Jer. 4,13; Zach. 6,1 var.; sing. ἅρμα ሰረገላ፡ ሠናይ፡ Jes. 22,18; Job 39,25; Act. 8,28; ላዕለ፡ ሰረገላ፡ ዘኪሩቤል፡ Sir. 49,8; ἅμαξα 1 Reg. 6,7 seq.; 2 Reg. 6,3; ሰረገላ፡ ሐዲስ፡ 1 Par. 13,7; Sir. 36,5; ሰረገላት፡ pl. ἅρματα Jes. 2,7; Jes. 5,28; Jes. 22,7; Jes. 31,1; Jer. 27,3; Judith 2,19; ሰብአ፡ ሰረገላት፡ Judith 7,20; 1 Reg. 13,5; Ps. 19,8; Apoc. 9,9; ἅμαξαι Judith 15,11; Gen. 45,19; Gen. 45,21; λαμπηνικαί Num. 7,3; sing. ዘዐርገ፡ በነደ፡ እሳት፡ በሰረገላት፡ Sir. 48,9; 2 Reg. 6,3. 2 passim: rotae, rota: ሰረገላ፡ var. ሰረገላት፡ τροχοί Dan. 7,9; ሰረገላ፡ τροχοί Hez. 3,13; ሰረገላ፡ ፩፡ τροχὸς εἷς Hez. 1,15; ሰረገላት፡ τροχοί Hez. 1,16; Titus ገብረ፡ ዐበይተ፡ ማኅፈዳተ፡ እምዕፅ፡ ወታሕቴሁ፡ ሰረገላ፡ Jsp. p. 358. 3 saragalā beam, ‘trave’ ወተለወጠ፡ ሰረገላቲሃ፡ ወመራናቲሃ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ንዋያ፡ ለቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ ተለወጠ፡ ‘si mutarono le sue travi, si mutarono i suoi candelabri e tutte le sue suppellettili della chiesa’ 202 (ed.), 66 (tr.) (‘Cf. 512.’ 66 n. 283)

woorden.betekenis: plectere, comere, ornare
woorden.definitie: (crebro per ሠ) rad. quadril.; eam in gramm. § 73 praefixo ሰ፡ causativo e ረገወ፡ (vid. ረገፈ፡) formatam censui; nunc (cum Hupfeld exerc. Aeth. p. 29) ሰረገ፡ plectere, comere, ornare (coll. سَرِجَ et سَرَجَ I et II, ܣܪܰܓ סְרַג al.) statuere maluerim.

woorden.betekenis: ornare, comere, exornare, polire, ʾasargawa, ornavit, parer,
woorden.definitie: quadril. II ornare, comere, exornare: Ex. 39,6; አሰርገወ፡ ዕበያ፡ ለጥበቢሁ፡ Sir. 42,21; c. Acc. et በ፡ rei Hen. 18,1; c. dupl. Acc. Gen. 24,27; አሰርጎኩኪ፡ ሰርጐ፡ Hez. 16,11; Hez. 16,13; ያሰርግውዋ፡ (Subj.) አክሊለ፡ Esth. 1,11; Esth. 2,17; አሰርጎከ፡ ሰማየ፡ ፀሐየ፡ ወወርኀ፡ Mavâs. 8; etiam transl.: ornare vel polire orationem, ut: አሰርግዎ፡ (Infin.) ነገረ፡ hom. Severiani in Cyr. f. 122. ʾasargawa G አሰርገወ፡ ʾasargawa, quadrl. II, ያሰረጉ፡, ያሰርጉ፡ ornavit, parer, embellir, orner ― ሸለመ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 45. 166 L አሰርገወ ʾasargawa adorn, decorate, beautify, embellish 512b

woorden.betekenis: sex, sexaginta
woorden.definitie: sex, ስሳ፡ sexaginta vid. sub ሰደሰ፡

woorden.betekenis: discedere, secedere, recedere, abire, removeri, tolli, abole
woorden.definitie: I,2 [e quadril. ሰልሰለ፡, vicina videntur אָזַל ܐܶܙܰܠ زَالَ عَزَلَ. Alia conjectavit Hupfeld exerc. Aeth. p. 29] discedere, secedere, recedere, abire, removeri, tolli, aboleri; c. እምነ፡ loci vel rei, περιαιρεῖσθαι, ἀπέρχεσθαι Ex. 8,7; Ex. 8,25; Ex. 10,17; ἀπέστη Num. 12,10; ἐξῆρε Ex. 14,19; ἀνέβη Ex. 40,30; ዘኢይሴስል፡ እምቅድመ፡ ዐይንከ፡ Ex. 13,16; ከመ፡ ይሰስል፡ እምኔነ፡ መዐተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ 1 Esr. 9,13; sacerdotes coelestes ኢይሴስሉ፡ ወትረ፡ እመንበረ፡ መርዓዊ፡ Mavâs. 20; ሰሰለ፡ ረድኤተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ እምኔሁ፡ F.M. 3,6; ሰስሎ፡ እምነ፡ ሕሩም፡ Jsp. p. 351; { ሰሲለነ፡ Chrys. Ta. 34(vid. sub ነጎጋው፡)}; አዘዘ፡ ከመ፡ ይሰስሉ፡ እምቅትለቶሙ፡ Jsp. p. 353; absol. ἀναχωρεῖν Matth. 9,24 rom.; ሰሰለ፡ ዮሴፍ፡ ወሖረ፡ Jsp. p. 352; ርኢኩ፡ እበዶሙ፡ ለአብዳን፡ ወሰሰልኩ፡ Fal. f. 15; ይሴስላ፡ ግብተ፡ ነፍሳተ፡ ዐማፅያን፡ ἀφαιροῦνται Prov. 11,30; Apoc. 21,1; Apoc. 6,14 Platt; 2 Petr. 3,10; 4 Esr. 5,33; ወእምዝ፡ ሰሰለ፡ ጽልመት፡ ወአስተርአየ፡ ብርሃን፡ Did. 29; ለሰስሎ፡ Kuf. p. 61; መሥዋዕት፡ ይሴስል፡ ወይሰዐር፡ (in oeconomia Christiana) Chrys. ho. 18. – Voc. Ae.: ሰሰለ፡ ዘ፡ ወገደ። sassala G ሰሰለ፡ sassala I,2 ይሴስል፡, ይሰስል፡ longe recessit, se retirer au loin ― ወገደ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 45. 167 L ሰሰለ sassala withdraw (intr.), recoil, recede, pass away, be removed, depart, be separated 516a

woorden.betekenis: recedere facere, removere, amovere, amoliri, auferre, exuere
woorden.definitie: II,2 recedere facere, removere, amovere, amoliri (auferre, exuere, deponere, avertere, expellere), c. Acc. et እምነ፡; ይቤ፡ ያሰስሉ፡ ኵሎ፡ ሰብአ፡ እምቅድሜየ፡ Gen. 45,1; lapidem a puteo Gen. 29,3; corticem virgae 30,37; adipem victimae Lev. 4,8; Lev. 4,19; cineres Lev. 6,3; idola 1 Reg. 7,3; 1 reg. 7,4; ornamenta Ex. 33,5; Ex. 33,6; vestes ab aliquo 1 Reg. 17,39; Deut. 21,13; vestes a se (deponendo vel exuendo) 1 Reg. 19,24; Lev. 6,4; አሰሰለት፡ ሠቀ፡ Judith 10,3; altare 4 Reg. 16,14; ኢያሰሰልከ፡ ዐምደ፡ ደመና፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ 2 Esr. 19,19; tristitiam a se 4 Esr. 10,20; 4 Esr. 10,37; concupiscentiam ab aliquo: አሰስል፡ ፍትወተ፡ እምኔየ፡ Sir. 23,5; morbos: ያሴስል፡ ኵሎ፡ ሕማሞሙ፡ Sir. 38,7; peccata (αἵρειν) 1 Joh. 3,5; Joh. 1,29; lacrymas Apoc. 7,17; Apoc. 21,4; verba e libro Apoc. 22,19; iram a se: አሰስላ፡ ለመዐት፡ Sir. 28,7; malitiam a se (ἀποθέμενοι) 1 Petr. 2,1; jugum (excutere): እመ፡ አሰሰልከ፡ አርዑቶ፡ እምክሣድከ፡ Kuf. 26; homines, populos (depellendo, expellendo): አሰሰሎሙ፡ ἐξῆρεν αὐτούς Sir. 10,17; አሴስሎሙ፡ እማእከለ፡ ምድር፡ Kuf. 1; ከመ፡ ያሰስሎሙ፡ እምታሕተ፡ ምድር፡ Kuf. 5; ለአሰስሎ፡ Hen. 1,1. ʾasassala G አሰሰለ፡ ʾasassala II,2 ያሴስል፡, ያሰስል፡ abegit, éloigner, renvoyer, chasser ― አስወገደ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 45. 166 L አሰሰለ ʾasassala remove, do away with, take away, take off, drive out, dismiss, shake off, lay aside 516a

woorden.betekenis: lascivia, salacitas, light-minded, wanton, frivolons, lasciv
woorden.definitie: , v. ሶሰን፡, ሶስኔ፡, ሰስን፡, ስሰን፡ subst., secundum Ludolfum lascivia, salacitas (cui interpretationi convenit amh. ሴሰኛ፡ light-minded, wanton, frivolons, lascivious, Isenb. lex. p. 55): ኀጢአት፡ ሰሰን፡ እኪት፡ ይእቲ፡ (ubi Graecus habet: ἁμαρτία οἰώνισμά ἐστιν) 1 Reg. 15,23; Org. 4.

woorden.betekenis: suspendere, cui, in, ex, a, crucifigere, ponderare
woorden.definitie: I,1 [de vicinis שָׁקַל ܬܩܰܠ ܫܩܰܠ ثَقَلَ et شَقَلَ vid. Ges. thes. p. 1474] Subj. ይስቅል፡ 1 suspendere, c. Acc. ሰቀላ፡ ለምድር፡ ዲበ፡ ዕራቃ፡ Job 26,7; ንሕነ፡ ሰቀልናሁ፡ ለሰማይ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ዐምድ፡ Clem. f. 52; ዘገብረ፡ ሰማየ፡ ወሰቀሎ፡ Jes. 42,5 var.; ሰቀለ፡ መንጠዋልዐ፡ ዘወርቅ፡ Chrys. Ta. 25; c. በ፡, ውስተ፡, ዲበ፡ ላዕለ፡, rei, cui vel in, ex, a qua quid suspenditur: መትከል፡ በዘይሰቅሉ፡ ቦቱ፡ ኵሎ፡ ንዋየ፡ Hez. 15,3; Hez. 17,23; Hez. 27,10; Ps. 136,2; ንሥኡ፡ ዘንተ፡ ርእሰ፡ ወስቅሉ፡ ውስተ፡ ተድባበ፡ አረፍት፡ Judith 14,1; Judith 14,11; 1 Reg. 31,10. 2 in specie: suspendio necare, suspendere in arbore, patibulo, furca, cruce; crucifigere Gen. 40,19; Deut. 21,22; Jos. 10,26; Esth. 2,23; Esth. 6,4; Esth. 7,9; Esth. 7,10; ይስቅልዎ፡ ወይቅትልዎ፡ 2 Esr. 6,11; Asc. Jes. 11,20; Matth. 20,19; Matth. 23,34; Matth. 26,2; Matth. 27,22; Hebr. 6,6; Gal. 5,24; ሰቀልዎ፡ መልዕልተ፡ ዕፅ፡ ነዊኅ፡ Sx. Mag. 4 Enc. – 3 ponderare Lud. sine auct.

woorden.betekenis: suspendi, crucifigi, suspensum, pendulum, teneri, pendere, a
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 suspendi, in specie crucifigi: ይሰቀሉ፡ ቦቱ፡ Jes. 22,24 var.; መላእክት፡ በእደዊሆሙ፡ ተሰቅሉ፡ Thren. 5,12; አድባር፡ ዲበ፡ አድባር፡ ይሰቀሉ፡ Hen. 83,4; ሰማይ፡ ተሰቅለ፡ Hen. 69,16; Org. 1; በዕፅ፡ ይሰቀል፡ Asc. Jes. 3,13; Asc. Jes. 4,13; ተሰቅለ፡ ዲበ፡ ዕፅ፡ 1 Petr. 2,24; 1 Petr. 4,1; Rom. 4,25; Rom. 6,6; Marc. 15,32. 2 suspensum vel pendulum teneri, pendere: 3 Reg. 7,6; ተሰቅለ፡ ማእከለ፡ ሰማይ፡ ወምድር፡ 2 Reg. 18,9; ተሰቅለ፡ መልዕልተ፡ አየር፡ ቍልቍሊተ፡ Gad. T.H. 3 adhaerere, adhaerescere alicui, amplecti, affixum esse, pendere ab aliquo, proprie et translate: ተሰቅለ፡ ርእሶ፡ በዕፅ፡ 2 Reg. 18,9; አርዌ፡ ምድር፡ ተሰቅለ፡ ውስተ፡ እዴሁ፡ Act. 28,3 rom.; ወደዩ፡ አሕባለ፡ ውስተ፡ ግብ፡ ወጸርኁ፡ ኀቤሁ፡ ከመ፡ ይሰቀል፡ በሐብል፡ Sx. Tachs. 15; ተሰቅለ፡ ይስሐቅ፡ ውስተ፡ ክሣደ፡ ወልዱ፡ Kuf. 31; ኀቤነ፡ ተሰቅለ፡ ነፍሶሙ፡ Judith 8,24; c. በ፡ Gen. 44,30; ኢምንትኒ፡ ዘይሰቀል፡ ቦቱ፡ ኅሊናሁ፡ Phlx. 224; ይሰቀሉ፡ በአፅምኦቱ፡ ἐξεκρέματο αὐτοῦ ἀκούων (pendebant ab ore ejus) Luc. 19,48; በእላ፡ ትእዛዝ፡ ተሰቅሉ፡ ኦሪት፡ ወነቢያት፡ Matth. 22,40.

woorden.betekenis: suspensus, crucifixus, pendens, pendulus, adhaerens, affixus
woorden.definitie: part. 1 suspensus; in specie crucifixus: ዲበ፡ ምንት፡ ስቁል፡ ሕላቃቲሃ፡ Job 38,6; ወይከውኑ፡ ስቁላነ፡ ቦቱ፡ Jes. 22,24; ስቁላን፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ Jes. 22,25; ሰማይ፡ ስቁል፡ (በትእዛዘ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡) Did. 36; ስቁል፡ በመንኰራኵር፡ Sx. Ter 1Enc.; c. ውስተ፡ Cant. 4,4; ዘስቁል፡ ዲበ፡ ዕፅ፡ Deut. 21,23; Jos. 10,26; እንድርያስ፡ ስቁል፡ Cod. Mus. Brit. LIV, 7. 2 suspensus, pendens, pendulus, adhaerens, affixus: ነጸሩ፡ ጦማረ፡ ስቁለ፡ ማእከለ፡ ሰማይ፡ ወምድር፡ M. Tom.; Deut. 28,66; ሕግ፡ ወነቢያት፡ ስቅልት፡ ውስተ፡ ፍቅረ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወፍቅረ፡ ቢጽ፡ ( quae pendent ab i.e. continentur amore ) Phlx. 126; ሕዝብየ፡ ስቁል፡ እምነ፡ ምንባሪሁ፡ Hos. 11,7; ተግባሮሙ፡ ስቁል፡ በእግዚአ፡ መናፍስት፡ Hen. 38,2; Hen. 40,5; Hen. 46,8. 3 ponderatus: ስቁል፡ በለጽሊጸ፡ ሰቅል፡ ( bilance sicli ) Lud. e Mss. Colb.

woorden.betekenis: tentorium, tabernaculum, taberna, tres tabernae, domus regia
woorden.definitie: subst., Pl. ሰቃልው፡, tentorium, tabernaculum, taberna: ኖኅ፡ ቦአ፡ ውስተ፡ ሰቀላሁ፡ Kuf. 7; ከደንተ፡ (Platt: ገበርተ፡) ሰቀላ፡ σκηνοποιοί Act. 18,3; ሠለስቱ፡ ሰቃልው፡ σκηναί Matth. 17,4; ሠለስቱ፡ ሰቀላ፡ tres tabernae Act. 28,15 rom.; (urbs aedificata erat) በአምሳባ፡ ሰቀላ፡ Gad. T.H. (In lingua amharica domus regiae, longioris structurae, aliaeque domus magnae et amplae hoc nomine insigniuntur, vid. Lud. lex. Amh. c. 25; Lud. lex. Amh. c. 21; Isenb. lex. p. 35). saqalā ‘ hall ’ ወይትገበር፡ ሰቀላ፡ አው፡ ጽርሕ፡ በአፍአ፡ ቅጽራ፡ ለይእቲ፡ ቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን። ‘ Let there be a shed or a hall constructed outside the fence of the concerned church ’ 86 (ed.), 59 (tr.)

woorden.betekenis: praedam
woorden.definitie: vel ሳቂማ፡ Hoc nomen, quamvis nomen proprium urbis sit sc. Σίκιμα vel Συχέμ, Aethiopes praedam significare statuunt. – Voc. Ae.: ፄዋ፡ ሰቂማ፡ ምህርካ፡ ብ፡ ምርኮ፡ Rad. Abb.: ሰቀመ፡ ዘ፡ ማረከ፡ In locis Gen. 48,22 et Ps. 59,6 lectio ምህርካ፡ voci ሰቂማ፡ substituta reperitur (coll. Ps. 67,13), quamquam Ps. 107,7 lectio genuina conservata est.

woorden.betekenis: res cava, excavata, arca, navi Noae, aliud
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., res cava vel excavata; in specie usurpatur de arca vel navi Noae Hen. 89,1; Hen. 89,6; Hen. 89,8; Hen. 89,9; Gad. Ad. f. 152; መስቀረ፡ ዕፅ፡ Org. 3. – Voc. Ae.: መስቀር፡ ዘ፡ ታቦተ፡ ኖኅ፡; aliud: መስቀር፡ ዘ፡ ታቦት፡ ዘጽላት፡ ወአብላቅሂ፡ ይ።

woorden.betekenis: abominatio, abominandum, res abominanda
woorden.definitie: , passim ሰቈራር፡, subst. abominatio, abominandum ( res abominanda ): Ex. 5,21; Kuf. p. 81; Kuf. p. 85; ሰቆራረ፡ ኮንክሙኒ፡ Jes. 1,14; ሰቆራረ፡ ገብሩ፡ Jes. 8,11; Hos. 9,10; Thren. 1,8; Prov. 6,16; ኢኮነ፡ ሰቆራረ፡ ሰብሳብ፡ ዘበሕግ፡ Did. 33.

woorden.betekenis: anxius maestusque fuit, lamentari, plangere, ejulare, lessum
woorden.definitie: quinquel. II [vicina videntur ሰከየ፡ (شَكَا) et شَجِيَ anxius maestusque fuit; vid. Dorn de psalt. Ae. p. 69; Hupfeld exerc. Ae. p. 31] Imperf. et Subj. ያስቆቅው፡ vel ያስቆቁ፡; lamentari, plangere, ejulare, lessum facere, cantu lugubri deflere (κόπτεσθαι, θρηνεῖν): አስቆቅዉ፡ λάβετε θρῆνον Jer. 9,10; Jer. 30,3; እንዘ፡ ያስቆቅዉ፡ ወይግዕሩ፡ Sap. 19,3; Matth. 11,17; አዝማዲሆሙ፡ እለ፡ ይበክዩ፡ ወያስቆቅዉ፡ Clem. f. 261; c. Acc. pers. Luc. 8,52; Luc. 23,27; ያስቆቅዋክሙ፡ Jer. 9,18; Hez. 8,14; Hez. 19,1; Hez. 26,17; Hez. 28,12; Hez. 32,2; Hez. 32,16; c. Acc. lessi vel lamenti: አስቆቀወ፡ ከመዝ፡ ሰቆቃወ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፡ Thren. 1in tit.; Rel. Bar.; አስቆቅዉ፡ ሰቆቃወ፡ Mich. 2,4. – Voc. Ae.: ያስቆቁ፡ ብ፡ ይቃቃሉ፡

woorden.betekenis: rigare, irrigare, fluido implere
woorden.definitie: I,1 [سَقَى הִשְׁקָה ܐܰܫܩܺܝ] Subj. ይስቂ፡ rigare, irrigare, c. Acc. Gen. 2,6; Gen. 2,10; Deut. 11,10; Ps. 103,14; Jon. 4,10; Hez. 17,7; Koh. 2,6; እስቅያ፡ ለገነት፡ Sir. 24,31; ሰብዐቱ፡ መሳውር፡ በዘ፡ ይሰቅይዋ፡ ለመኃትዊሃ፡ Zach. 4,2; c. dupl. Acc.: ንስቅዮን፡ ማየ፡ Herm. p. 64; Ps. 35,9; Enc. Teq. 29; transl.; 1 Cor. 3,6; (Christus) ሰቀየነ፡ ማየ፡ (baptismo) Chrys. ho. 20; fluido implere: ይፈለፍል፡ ነቅዕ፡ ወይሰቂ፡ ፈለገ፡ ሰኪኖን፡ Joel 4,18.

woorden.betekenis: ê, eo tempore, tunc, tum, illico, confestim, statim, literis
woorden.definitie: vel ሶቤ፡ particula temporis; forma ሶቤ፡ antiquitus usitatior erat, posthac ሶበ፡ communi usu recepta est, nisi quod ante pron. suff. ሃ፡ forma ሶቤ፡ semper conservata est. [Etymon perobscurum est. Qui eam (sicut إِذَا, ثُمَّ, אֲזַי) e rad. pronominali propagatam statuunt, literam በ፡ ex alia labiali transformatam, ê autem sicut in adv. ይእዜ፡, አይቴ፡ al. exponendum judicaverint. Ewald in Göttinger Gelehrte Anzeigen 1857p. 1884 ሶበ፡ (ሶብ፡) primitus substantivum (collato arab. سِبَّة) fuisse censuit]. A adv. eo tempore, tunc, tum, illico, confestim, statim, rarius absolute, ut: ረኪቦ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ሶቤ፡ literis inventis tunc Sx. Mij. 6; Sx. Nah. 14 Enc.; Ps. 2,5; vel in enuntiatione relativa: እምአመ፡ ነጸረ፡ ሶቤ፡ ex quo tempore conspexit Sx. Enc.; saepius addito pronomine demonstr.: ይእተ፡ ሶቤ፡ (ይእቲ፡ ሶበ፡ rom.) τότε Matth. 7,23; Matth. 9,6; Kuf. p. 136; εὐθέως Matth. 14,31 rom.; ሶበ፡ ድኅረ፡ ሞቱ፡ postquam mortui sunt Lud. ex Enc.; vel pron. suff. ሃ፡, sc. ሶቤሃ፡ τότε Job 2,2; Job 33,16; Jes. 28,25; Jes. 58,8-10; Jes. 60,5; Jer. 22,22; Dan. 2,12; Dan. 4,16; Dan. 7,11; Prov. 3,8; Asc. Jes. 7,4; Asc. Jes. 8,21; εἶτα τότε Job 33,27; ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ὥρᾳ Marc. 13,11; ወቀትር፡ ሶቤሃ፡ Joh. 4,6; εὐθέως Marc. 11,2; Matth. 14,22; Matth. 21,3; Job 2,2; Asc. Jes. 9,29; Asc. Jes. 9,41; ἐξαυτῆς Phil. 2,23; παραχρῆμα Act. 12,23; προσφάτως ( nuper ) Act. 18,2; ምዕረ፡ አውሢአከ፡ ሶቤሃ፡ ፈጽም፡ ቃለከ፡ Sir. 35,8; ubi Graecus vocabulum respondens nullum habet Gen. 6,3; Matth. 2,14 al., ለሶቤሃ፡ πρὸς καιρόν, ad tempus (exiguum) Luc. 8,13; እምሶቤሃ፡ inde (ab eo tempore), protenus Hen. 89,20; Hen. 85,4. B conj. ሶበ፡ et { ሶቤ፡} (ut Matth. 10,23 rom.; Matth. 11,23 rom.; Matth. 14,22 rom.; Luc. 6,22; Asc. Jes. 6,3; Asc. Jes. 6,8; Asc. Jes. 8,1 al.); 1 temporalis a quum, ut, ubi postquam (ὅτε, ὡς, ἡνίκα, Part.), c. Perf., Gen. 11,31; Gen. 12,11; Gen. 30,1; 1 Reg. 8,1; 1 Reg. 9,11; Ps. 4,1; Jer. 44,11; 2 Esr. 14,1; 2 Esr. 16,1; Matth. 7,28; Matth. 9,25; Luc. 1,41; Luc. 1,44; Asc. Jes. 6,3; Asc. Jes. 6,8; Asc. Jes. 8,1 al.; 1 Reg. 18,3 ad particulam causativam prope accedit. b dum, cum, ut: c. Imperf., Gen. 27,34; Gen. 33,1; Gen. 37,25. c quando vel simulac, c. Perf. (Fut. exact.) 1 Reg. 9,13; 1 Reg. 10,2; Ex. 13,11; Jes. 64,3; Ps. 2,13; vel c. Imperf.: ሶበ፡ ይትሌዐል፡ ሰማይ፡ Jer. 38,37; Matth. 10,23; Luc. 6,22; Apoc. 4,9; crebro እስከ፡ ሶበ፡ usque dum, donec, ut Matth. 5,18; Matth. 5,26; Matth. 10,23; Matth. 14,22 (vid. እስከ፡). d quamdiu, donec, dum Ps. 38,2; ሊተሰ፡ ኢይሔውዘኒ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ሶበ፡ ርኢክዎ፡ ለመርዶክዮስ፡ Esth. 5,13; ἡνίκα ἂν Prov. 6,22. e de actione repetita: quoties, quando, vel si quando (ὅταν, إِذَا) raro c. Perf., ut Jud. 2,19; plerumque c. Imperf., ut Job 6,4; ሶበ፡ ይልእክዎ፡ Prov. 22,13; Ps. 48,17; Zach. 4,1; ሶበ፡ ትጼሊ፡ Sir. 7,10; Sir. 14,7; ተጋነይ፡ ሶበ፡ ትኤብስ፡ Sir. 18,21; Sir. 18,24; ሶበ፡ ይሥሕቅ፡ አብድ፡ Sir. 21,20; Sir. 23,9; Sir. 50,11; Hen. 73,3; Matth. 6,2; Matth. 6,5; Matth. 6,16; Matth. 15,2. – Praemisso ቦ፡ significat: est quando, ut: ቦ፡ ሶበ፡ ይብል፡ ποτὲ μὲν ἐρεῖ Jes. 41,7. – 2 conditionalis a si in conditione simplice (ὅταν, ἐάν, εἰ): Matth. 5,11; 1 Joh. 5,2; Rom. 3,5; 1 Petr. 4,18; ሶበ፡ ጻድቅ፡ እምዕፁብ፡ ይድኅን፡ ረሲዕ፡ በአይቴ፡ ያስተርኢ፡ Prov. 11,31; ሠናይ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ሶበ፡ ይነሥእ፡ አርዑቶ፡ Thren. 3,27; ሶበ፡ አንተ፡ እንዘ፡ ሰብእ፡ አንተ፡ ትትቀየም፡ ሰብአ፡ እፎ፡ እንከ፡ ትብሎ፡ Sir. 28,3; sed hic particulae usus rarior est. b creberrime: si c. Subj. (לוּ, لَوْ), ubi significatur id quod sumitur non esse nec fuisse nec futurum esse vel saltem incertum esse. Apodosis adjecta particula እመ፡ vel እም፡ ἄν notari solet (ut: ሶበ፡ ነገርከኒ፡ እምፈነውኩከ፡ Gen. 31,27); rarius omittitur, ut Gen. 3,11; Num. 14,2; Ps. 72,15; in protasi ሶበ፡ nonnumquam suffixa particula ሁ፡ intenditur, ut ሶበሁ፡ ሖርከ፡ ፍኖተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ እምነበርከ፡ ለዓለም፡ በሰላም፡ Bar. 3,13; Matth. 24,43; Matth. 11,23 rom.; Hebr. 8,4; Job 31,5; Job 31,17 seq.; Ps. 43,22; (at ሶበ፡ ታአምርኑ፡ εἰ ἔγνως; 4 Reg. 2,3 est sententia ex interrogativa et conditionali, cujus apodosis omissa est, mixta). Memorabilis est phrasis ሶበ፡ አኮ፡ እመ፡ ኢ፡ si non, ut: ሶበ፡ አኮ፡ እመ፡ ኢኮንከ፡ ብእሴ፡ ልሂቀ፡ አንተ፡ እምጸአልኩከ፡ ወእምሠሐቁ፡ ላዕሌከ፡ Rel. Bar.; Herm. p. 92. C.c. Perf. in protasi et apodosi: ሶበ፡ (ዝንቱ፡) ተገብረ፡ እምለብሱ፡ si ( hoc ) factum esset, induissent Luc. 10,13; Gen. 43,10; Job 4,12; Jes. 48,18; Jes. 48,19; Judith 11,2; 4 Reg. 13,19; Hez. 3,6; Ps. 50,17; Ps. 54,12; Ps. 54,13; 4 Esr. 6,39; Rom. 4,2; Rom. 7,7; Rom. 9,29; 2 Petr. 2,21; ሶበ፡ ፈቀድኪ፡ መንፈቀ፡ መንግሥትየ፡ እምወሀብኩኪ፡ si rogares – darem Esth. 7,2; Jud. 8,19; Matth. 24,22; Matth. 26,24; Joh. 15,22; Gal. 3,21; vel c. Imperf. in protasi: እምኀየሰነ፡ ሶበ፡ ኢነሐውር፡ melius esset nobis, si nobis non eundum esset 4 Esr. 6,44; Job 14,14; Prov. 2,20; Matth. 24,43; Rom. 4,14; vel sine verbo finito in protasi: ሶበሁ፡ ሰብእ፡ ውእቱ፡ እምሖርነ፡ ኅቡረ፡ ውስተ፡ ዐውድ፡ Job 9,32; ሶበሁ፡ ብየ፡ ኀይል፡ እምኢምህኩ፡ ከናፍርየ፡ Job 16,5; Job 42,8; Sir. 27,21; Hebr. 8,4. 3 optativa (לוּ, εἰ), { utinam }), c. Perf. ሶበ፡ ሞትነ፡ ὄφελον ἀπεθάνομεν Ex. 16,3; εἰ Jos. 7,7; ሶበ፡ ኢተወለድኩ፡ Sir. 23,14; Job 6,10; Job 27,7; c. Imperf. Job 6,2; Job 6,8; Job 16,21.

woorden.betekenis: spicas emittere, sabla, spicas emisit, produisit des épis, g
woorden.definitie: I,1 [سبل IV et سَنْبَلَ id.] spicas emittere: ስገም፡ እንበለ፡ ይስበል፡ Ex. 9,31. sabla G ሰብለ፡ sabla I,1 ይሰብል፡, ይስብል፡ spicas emisit, produisit des épis ― ጨረቋ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 46. 167 L ሰብለ sabla I (yǝsbǝl, yǝsbal) grow (ear of corn), become grain, ripen 484a

woorden.betekenis: facere ut spicas emittat
woorden.definitie: II,1 facere ut spicas emittat seges: ለአስብሎ፡ ሠዊት፡ (ventis tribuitur) Org. 1.

woorden.betekenis: spica, botro, e botro ejus, aliud
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem. [שִׁבֹּלֶת ܫܶܒܠܳܐ سَبَلٌ], sing. et coll., 1 spica (qua continentur grana frumenti): στάχυς Marc. 4,28; ሀለዉ፡ ውስተ፡ እዴሁ፡ ፯ ሰብል፡ ዘሠዊት፡ ዘሠረፁ፡ እም፩ ብርዕ፡ Jsp. p. 341; ሰብሉ፡ ይከውን፡ ውስቴታ፡ ፴ ኅጠት፡ Phlx. 4; ሰብለ፡ ሥርናይ፡ ወሰብለ፡ እክል፡ Macc. f. 19; II Abtel. Ap. 2. 2 „De botro acinos ferente usurpavit Gregorius in carmine: እምሰብላ፡ e botro ejus “ (sc. vitis), Lud. – Voc. Ae.: ሰብል፡ ዘ፡ ብቋያ፡ ወቦ፡ እሸት፡; aliud: ሰብል፡ ዘ፡ ዝርዝር፡

woorden.betekenis: sanbalt, nardo, non come il profumo dell’incenso o del nardo
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., i.q. ሰንቢል፡, ut: ሰንበልት፡ ቅድው፡ Hen. 32,1; ሰንበልት፡ ምዑዝ፡ III Sal. Mar. 1; Sx. Enc.; in Kuf. p. 64 ሰንበልት፡ a ናርዶስ፡ distinguitur; in Kuf. p. 14(coll. ex Ex. 30,34 hebr. et LXX) ሰንበልት፡ sicut chald. שׁוּבְלָא onychi marino (שְׁחֵלֶת) substitutum esse videtur. – Voc. Ae.: ሰንበልት፡ ዘ፡ ጦስኝ፡ ስንቡልሂ፡ ይ፡ sanbalt ‘ nardo ’ አኮ፡ ከመ፡ ጼነ፡ ዕጣን፡ ወሰንበልት፡ አላ፡ ይፈደፍድ፡ ‘ non come il profumo dell’incenso o del nardo, ma molto di più ’ 117 (ed), 40 (tr) (‘Cf. 356; «olio di spigo» sec. 505.’ 40 n. 188)

woorden.betekenis: pinguescere
woorden.definitie: pinguescere vid. sub ሠብሐ፡

woorden.betekenis: laudari, magnificari, celebrari, magnificum, laudabilem se p
woorden.definitie: III,2 refl. et pass. 1 laudari, magnificari, celebrari laudibus, hymnis al.: ይሴባሕ፡ ስምየ፡ በውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ አሕዛብ፡ Mal. 1,11; ጥበብ፡ በፍናዋት፡ ትሴባሕ፡ ὑμνεῖται Prov. 1,20; Prov. 8,3; 1 Petr. 4,11; ከመ፡ አቡክሙ፡ ዘበሰማይ፡ ይሰባሕ፡ Kid. f. 5. 2 magnificum, laudabilem se praestare, laudes suas manifestare, glorificari: ይሴባሕ፡ በርትዕ፡ አምላክ፡ Jes. 5,16; Jes. 24,23; Ps. 138,13; 2 Reg. 6,20; 2 Thess. 3,1; c.c. በ፡ ejus, in quo quis suam gloriam manifestat (ἐνδοξάζεσθαι): ተሰቢሕየ፡ በፈርዖን፡ Ex. 14,18; Ex. 8,18; Ex. 14,4; Hez. 28,22; Ps. 4,4 (θαυμασθοῦσθαι); vel c. በላዕለ፡, ut Thess. 1,12; Sir. 3,20; vel c. በኀበ፡, ut: ተሰባሕከ፡ በኀቤሆሙ፡ Sir. 33,4; passive: ይሴባሕ፡ ቤተ፡ ጸሎትየ፡ Jes. 69,7; ከመ፡ ትሰባሕ፡ ሕይወትየ፡ Job 33,30; ተሰብሐ፡ ሶበ፡ አንሥአ፡ እዴሁ፡ Sir. 46,2; Jes. 45,25. 3 splendore ( nimbo ) circumfusum esse, in spec. clarificari: ተሰብሐ፡ ሕብረ፡ ገጹ፡ Ex. 34,29; Ex. 34,30; 2 Cor. 3,9; 2 Cor. 3,10; de Christo: Job 7,39; Job 12,16; Job 12,23; Job 12, 28; Job 13,31.

woorden.betekenis: laudatus, laudabilis, celebratus, gloriosus, magnificus, spl
woorden.definitie: part. 1 laudatus, laudabilis, celebratus: Ps. 21,3; Ps. 88,8; Ex. 15,11; Dan. apocr. 3,27-64; Hen. 9,4; adv. ስቡሐ፡ in Cantico Mosis in Psalmorum editione Ludolf p. 324(Ex. 15,1). – Sensu speciali: ቅዱስ፡ ወስቡሕ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ αἰνετὸς τῷ Κυρίῳ Lev. 19,24; Lev. 27,21. 2 gloriosus, magnificus, splendidus, praeclarus, Asc. Jes. 9,33; Asc. Jes. 10,2; ቃል፡ ስቡሕ፡ λόγοι ἔνδοξοι Prov. 25,27; ፍሥሓ፡ ስብሕት፡ 1 Petr. 1,8; መንክር፡ ዐቢይ፡ ወስቡሕ፡ Hen. 34,1; ስቡሕ፡ ክፍልክሙ፡ Hen. 58,2; ምድር፡ ሐዋዝ፡ ወስብሕት፡ Hen. 89,40; ስቡሕ፡ ራእዮሙ፡ Hen. 24,2; (ዕፀው፡) ስቡሓን፡ Hen. 32,3. 3 lucidus, splendidus, clarus Hen. 108,4; Hen. 108,5.

woorden.betekenis: laudatio, laudes, hymnus, vide quomodo Deum magnificent
woorden.definitie: subst., Pl. ስባሔያት፡ et ስባሕያት፡ laudatio, laudes, hymnus: Ex. 15,1; አብዝኁ፡ ስባሔሁ፡ Jsp. p. 275; ርኢ፡ ስባሔሆሙ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ vide quomodo Deum magnificent Phlx. 195; ወሀበት፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ አኰቴተ፡ ወስባሔ፡ Kuf. 25; ዘምሩ፡ በአልባቢክሙ፡ ዝማሬያተ፡ ወስባሔያተ፡ F.M. 32,7; ስባሕያት፡ Org. 1.

woorden.betekenis: laudatio, cantatio laudis, laus, laudes, gloriae cupiditas,
woorden.definitie: vel ስብሓት፡ subst., m. et fem., Pl. ስብሐታት፡ 1 laudatio, cantatio laudis, αἴνεσις: አዕበይዎ፡ (ለእግዚአብሔር፡) በኵሉ፡ በረከት፡ ወስብሐት፡ 2 Esr. 19,5; Jes. 51,11; ቃለ፡ ስብሐት፡ Jes. 51,3; መሥዋዕተ፡ ስብሐት፡ 2 Par. 29,31; Sir. 32,4; ስብሐት፡ ወዘምሮ፡ Clem. f. 12; ኢያረሙ፡ እምስብሐቲነ፡ (ait Deus Trinus) Clem. f. 49; ጸሎተ፡ ዕንባቆም፡ ምስለ፡ ስብሐተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ μετ᾽ ᾠδῆς Hab. 3in tit.; በማሕሌት፡ በስብሐተ፡ መዝሙር፡ 2 Par. 7,6; መላእክተ፡ ስብሐታት፡ Asc. Jes. 6,13; ስብሐተ፡ ነግህ፡ vel ጽባሕ፡ appellantur preces matutinae in ecclesia celebratae Clem. f. 175; Kid. f. 11. 2 laus, laudes: ሀቡ፡ ስብሐተ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ Jer. 13,16; Asc. Jes. 6,9; Ps. 28,2; Ps. 95,7; Joh. 9,24; Luc. 2,14 formula doxologica: ሎቱ፡ ስብሐት፡ Rom. 11,36; Judae 25; Sx.; Abush., al.; et in malam partem: gloriae cupiditas, ut: ሰይጣነ፡ ስብሓት፡ Phlx. 56. 3 hymnus, canticum ( laudativum ): Judith 15,14; ሰብሕዎ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ስብሐተ፡ ሐዲሰ፡ Jes. 42,10; Ps. 32,3; Ps. 95,1; Asc. Jes. 7,15; Asc. Jes. 7,16; Asc. Jes. 7,27; Asc. Jes. 10,1 (Plur.). 4 gloria, magnificentia, splendor Ps. 8,6; Job 40,5; ስብሓተ፡ ብርሃን፡ በቀስተ፡ ደመና፡ Sir. 50,7; በስብሐት፡ ሞቱ፡ Hen. 103,6; Hen. 98,3; 1 Petr. 5,4; 2 Tim. 2,10; in specie: gloria, majestas, splendor Dei (δόξα) Ex. 33,19 seq.; Num. 20,6; Hez. 8,4; Hez. 10,18; Hez. 43,2 seq.; Jes. 6,1; Jes. 48,11; Jes. 60,1; Jes. 66,18; እምስብሐተ፡ ኀይሉ፡ Jes. 2,10; Sir. 17,13; Luc. 2,9; Joh. 1,14; Joh. 2,11; 1 Petr. 2,10; etiam quatenus hoc nomine divinae ejus virtutes et mirabilia facinora comprehenduntur: αἱ ἀρεταί Jes. 42,8; Jes. 43,21; τὰ θαυμάσια αὐτοῦ Sir. 18,6; Sir. 42,17; τὰ ἔνδοξα αὐτοῦ Jes. 12,4; αἰνέσεις Ps. 72,28; Ps. 9,14. 5 splendor, lux, claritas Apoc. 18,1; 2 Cor. 3,7-11; Hen. 60,19.

woorden.betekenis: majestas, splendor
woorden.definitie: subst. majestas, splendor: በስብሐናሁ፡ (legas: በስብሕናሁ፡ vel በስብሐቲሁ፡) Matth. 25,31 rom.

woorden.betekenis: frangere, confringere, effringere, perfringere, fregit virum
woorden.definitie: I,1 [שָׁבַר ܬܒܰܪ تَبَرَ; coll. መዝበረ፡ sub ዘበረ፡] Subj. ይስብር፡ 1 frangere, confringere, effringere, perfringere, baculum Sir. 32,23; ብርዐ፡ ቅጥቁጠ፡ ኢይሰብር፡ Jes. 42,3; catenam, vincula Jer. 2,20; Jer. 37,8; Marc. 5,4; ollam Lev. 6,21; arcum Ps. 45,9; jugum Jer. 35,4; ossa Ex. 12,46; Kuf. 49; ልሳን፡ ድክምት፡ ትሰብር፡ አዕጽምተ፡ Prov. 25,15; Sir. 28,17; dentes Ps. 3,7; Ps. 57,6; Ex. 21,27; Job 29,17; Thren. 3,16; caput: ስብሮሙ፡ አርእስቲሆሙ፡ Sir. 33,12; Ps. 73,14; cornua Jer. 31,12; Sir. 47,7; fores, januam Gen. 19,9; Kuf. 39; እሰብር፡ አናቅጸ፡ ብርት፡ Jes. 45,2; fures እለ፡ ይሰብሩ፡ ቍልፋተ፡ F.N. 49; አዘዘ፡ ይስብሩ፡ ቍያጺሁ፡ Sx. Nah. 25; ሰበሮ፡ ለብእሲ፡ fregit virum (sc. ejus crura et ossa) Sx. Tachs. 18 Enc. 2 infringere, debilitare; frangere (animum aegritudine): ሐዘኑ፡ ለልብ፡ ይሰብሮ፡ ለኀይል፡ κάμψει ἰσχύν Sir. 38,18; ይሰብር፡ ቀራንብተ፡ በድቃስ፡ debilitat palpebras sapore Lud. ex Org.; ለምንት፡ ትሰብሩኒ፡ ልብየ፡ Act. 21,13; devirginare διαπαρθενεύειν ሰበርዎን፡ Hez. 23,3; Hez. 23,8. sabara, ሠበረ፡ śabara G ሰበረ፡ sabara I,1 ይሰብር፡, ይስብር፡ fregit, rompe, briser, casser Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 46. 167 L ሰበረ sabara I (yǝsbǝr), (, ) ሠበረ፡ śabara break, break off, deflower, () vanquish 485a

woorden.betekenis: matrimonium
woorden.definitie: matrimonium vid. sub ወሰበ፡

woorden.betekenis: homo, homines, genus humanum, aliquis, vir, domestici, famil
woorden.definitie: subst., m., sing. et coll. [huic voci comparari solent etymologi nomina propria שְׁבָא et סְבָא; amh. ሰው፡] homo, homines, genus humanum (rarius: aliquis, vir): Sing. ut Gen. 1,26; Gen. 2,7; Jer. 14,9; Jes. 2,9; Jes. 5,15; Jes. 6,5; Ps. 21,6; እምከመ፡ ሞተ፡ ሰብእ፡ ይከውን፡ ክፍለ፡ ዕፄ፡ Sir. 10,11; Sir. 8,6; Sir. 11,2; Sir. 11,27; Sir. 27,5; Sir. 28,3; Sir. 32,24; Matth. 4,4; Rom. 7,1 al.; ኵሉ፡ ሰብእ፡ ἕκαστος Sir. 16,14; ሐሳዊ፡ ሰብእ፡ Sir. 20,26; ሰብእ፡ ነባቢ፡ Sir. 8,3; vir: Joh. 7,22; Matth. 14,21. Coll., ut: በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወበኀበ፡ ሰብእ፡ Sir. 45,1; ሰብእ፡ ወእንስሳ፡ Ps. 35,7; Ps. 140,5; Prov. 3,4; Prov. 8,4; እሉ፡ ሰብእ፡ Gen. 43,16; ሰብአ፡ ኖሎት፡ Gen. 43,32; አንትሙ፡ ሰብእ፡ አንትሙ፡ Job 12,2; ዐበይት፡ ሰብእ፡ Sir. 8,1; ሰብእ፡ ምእመናን፡ Jes. 8,2; ብዙኀ፡ ሰብእ፡ Jes. 43,4; ፈጠርክዋ፡ ለምድር፡ ወሰብአ፡ ዲቤሃ፡ Jes. 45,12; Marc. 1,17; Matth. 8,1; ἄνδρες ምስለ፡ ሰብኦሙ፡ Jer. 47,9; ፲ሰብእ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ Jer. 48,1; እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሰብእ፡ ἐκ πάσης σαρκός Sir. 45,4; ὄχλος Marc. 9,25; Marc. 10,46; Marc. 12,41; Luc. 5,1; Num. 20,20; πλῆθος Sap. 14,20. Crebro in statu constr. a domestici, familiares, propinqui, cognati: ሰብአ፡ ቤቱ፡ Gen. 35,2; ሰብአ፡ ቤተ፡ አቡሁ፡ 1 Reg. 22,1; Eph. 2,19; Am. 6,10; ኵሉ፡ ሰብኡ፡ παῖδες Gen. 41,37; Gen. 41,38; οἰκογενεῖς ሰብኡ፡ 1 Esr. 3,1; ሰብኣ፡ οἱ παρ᾽ αὐτῆς Dan. apocr. 1,33; οἰκεῖοι Lev. 18,6; ሰብአ፡ ሃይማኖት፡ οἱ οἰκεῖοι τῆς πίστεως Gal. 6,10. b incolae, cives, indigenae, conterranei: ሰብአ፡ ሀገር፡ Jes. 6,11; Judith 13,12; ሰብአ፡ ሀገርየ፡ 4 Esr. 9,44; 4 Esr. 10,3; ብእሲ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ይሜህሮሙ፡ ጥበበ፡ ለሰብኡ፡ Sir. 37,23; ሰብአ፡ ብሔር፡ αὐτόχθων Jer. 14,8; ሰብአ፡ ብሔሮሙ፡ πολῖται αὐτῶν Jes. 36,23; ሰብአ፡ ብሔርከ፡ σὸς πολίτης Prov. 24,43; ሰብአ፡ ሀገር፡ πολῖται Prov. 11,12; formandis patronymicis: ሰብአ፡ ይሁዳ፡ Jer. 42,13; ሰብአ፡ ጢሮስ፡ Ps. 82,6; ሰብአ፡ ባቢሎን፡ Dan. apocr. 13,3; ሰብአ፡ ጌት፡ Mich. 1,10; ሰብአ፡ ግብጽ፡ Gen. 46,34; ሰብአ፡ ሮሜ፡ Act. 16,21; ሰብአ፡ ቆሮንቶስ፡ 1 Cor. 1,1 in tit.; 2 Cor. 1,1 in tit. c aliis substantivis junctum significat eum, qui ad aliquam rem pertinet, ejus peritus est, in ea versatur, al., ut: ሰብአ፡ ዐይን፡ σκοπός vel σκοποί speculator Jes. 21,6; Hez. 3,17; Sir. 37,14; Clem. f. 90; ሰብአ፡ ሐጽ፡ τοξόται sagittarii Jes. 21,15; Judith 2,15; ሰብአ፡ ሐጽ፡ ወሰብአ፡ ኲናት፡ Hez. 23,34; ሰብአ፡ አፍራስ፡ equites Jer. 4,29; Judith 2,15; ሰብአ፡ ሰረገላት፡ Judith 7,20; 2 Reg. 8,4; ሰብአ፡ ምሥያጥ፡ οἱ ἀγοραῖοι Act. 17,5; ሰብአ፡ ሕግ፡ legis periti Chron. Ax.; ሰብአ፡ ዜና፡ εὐαγγελίζοντες Nah. 2,1; ሰብአ፡ አዝያዥ፡ auctores tabularum astronomicarum Abush. 11. sabʾ ወካዕበ፡ ጐለትኩ፡ ለሚካኤል፡ ዘድባርዋ፡ ጕልተ፡ ለሰብአ፡ ሰዓታት፡ ለደቂ፡ ኢታ፡ ለአባ፡ ዮሐንስ፡ ‘Encore, j’ai donné un fief à [l’église de] Mikāʾēl de Debārwā, aux gens [chargés de l’office] des Heures des Daqqi Itā, et à abbā Yoḥannes:’ 26 l. 29–30 (ed.), 30 l. 17–19 (tr.); ሠራዕክዎ፡ ለሊቃኖስ፡ አነ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ወናግ፡ ሰገድ፡ በዣን፡ ጽጌ፡ ዘውእቶሙ፡ ሰብአ፡ ሰዓታት፡ ዘገበዘ፡ አክሱም፡ ‘Moi, le roi Wanāg Sagad, j’ai établi Liqānos dans le nombre des žān ṣegē, qui sont les gens [chargés de l’office] des Heures dans la cathédrale d’Aksoum’ 38 l. 25–27 (ed.), 45 l. 24–26 (tr.); ንሕነኒ፡ አውገዝነ፡ በሥልጣነ፡ ጴጥሮስ፡ ወጳውሎስ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ካህናት፡ ሰብአ፡ ማኅበር፡ ወበዓለ፡ ጕልት። ‘nous défendons, sous peine d’excommunication, par la puissance de Pierre et de Paul, …, mais seulement les prêtres, qui appartienent à la communauté, et le maître du fief.’ 52 l. 2–3 (ed.), 62 l. 18–22 (tr.); ንሕነ፡ ሐደስነ፡ ወሠራዕነ፡ ወወሰነ፡ ወአውገዝነ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይሠየም፡ መኑሂ፡ እምባዕዳን፡ መኳንንት፡ ኀበ፡ ገብዘ፡ አክሱም፡ ቤተ፡ መንግሥትነ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ሰብአ፡ ርስት፡ ዘተወልዱ፡ ውስቴታ። ‘nous avons confirmé, établi, fixé et ordonné sous peine d’excommunication que personne d’entre les autres gouverneurs ne puisse être élu chef de la cathédrale d’Aksoum, siège de notre règne, [mais que le chef devait être choisi parmi les] habitants qui y ont des droits héréditaires et qui y sont nés’ 73 l. 17–20 (ed.), 88 l. 7–11 (tr.); ወረትእዎ፡ በብዙኅ፡ ንዋይ፡ ዘበልዓ፡ አምጺኦሙ፡ ሰብአ፡ ወግዕ፡ እለ፡ ነበሩ፡ በቀደምት፡ ነገሥት። ‘Ils démontrèrent qu’on avait saisi des bien nombreux, en faisant venir les hommes qui connaissaient la loi et qui avaient été en charge au temps des rois précédents,’ 75 l. 14–15 (ed.), 90 l. 24–26 (tr.); a ሰብአ፡ ፋላት፡ sabʾa fālāt ‘people of omens’ ወኢመሠርየ፡ ወኢእምነ፡ ሰብአ፡ ፋላት፡ ‘or one who casts spells, or one of the people of omens’ 18 l. 28 (ed.), 15 l. 9-10 (tr.), vid. ፋል፡ G ሰብአ፡ ሃይማኖት፡ sabʾa hāymānot «les fidèles de la religion» ኢኮነ፡ ውእቱ፡ እምሰብአ፡ ሃይማኖት። 180. vid. ሃይማኖት፡ 11 ሰብአ፡ ሥራይ፡ sabʾa śǝrāy augure, devin, vid. ሥራይ፡ 128 ሰብአ፡ አሕማር፡ sabʾa ʾaḥmār «matelots» ዛቲ፡ ልማድ፡ ተሠልጠት፡ ላዕለ፡ ሮማውያን፡ ከመ፡ ይጸሐፉ፡... ሰብአ፡ አሕማር፡ እለ፡ ይሐውሩ፡ በባሕር። 189, vid. ሐመር፡ 64 L ሰብአ፡ ሀገር sabʾa hagar citizens, vid. ሀገር፡ 216a ሰብአ፡ ልቃሕ sabʾa lǝqqāḥ creditors, vid. ልቃሕ፡ 317a ሰብአ፡ ምትሀት sabʾa mǝthat actors, vid. ምትሀት፡ 371b C a for ልሳነ፡ ሰብእ፡ vid. ልሳን፡ (Leslau)

woorden.betekenis: humanitas, natura humana, persona, persona mea nota est
woorden.definitie: subst. 1 humanitas, natura humana: ሶበ፡ ተግህደ፡ ሰብእናሁ፡ (sc. Melchisedeci, sice: eum hominem – non Deum – esse) Clem. f. 36; monachi በጾም፡ ወበጸሎት፡ ሰብእናሆሙ፡ ቀተሉ፡ Deg.; Cyr. c. Pall. f. 80; Chrys. ho. 2. 2 persona; „adhibetur in communi sermone, cum quis de semet ipso loquitur, ut: ሰብእና፡ ዚአየ፡ እሙር፡ persona mea nota est “ (Lud.) Gregor. in Epist. 3.

woorden.betekenis: fundere, conflare, liquefacere, sabaka, śabbaka, śabaka, liq
woorden.definitie: I,1 [i.q. سَبَكَ; vicina sunt סוּךְ, נָסַךְ; סָפַח سَفَحَ שָׁפַךְ سَفَكَ, nec non צוּק, יָצַק] Subj. ይስብክ፡ fundere, conflare, (liquefacere), χωνεύειν, c. acc. metalli Jud. 17,4; 4 Reg. 22,9; 2 Par. 34,17; Hez. 22,20; Mal. 3,3; Jes. 40,19; Jer. 10,3; Jer. 10,14; c. acc. operis fusilis Ex. 26,37; Ex. 38,3; 3 Reg. 7,3; 3 Reg. 7,33; 2 Par. 4,3; 2 Par. 4,17; transl.: ሐሰተ፡ ሰበኩ፡ Jer. 28,17. sabaka, ሠበከ፡ śabbaka, śabaka G ሠበከ፡ śabbaka I,2 ይሤብክ፡, ይሠብክ፡ «liquéfier, fondre, travailler en métaux» ― አቀለጠ፡, መታ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 52r. 130 L ሰበከ sabaka I (yǝsbǝk), () sabbaka, () ሠበከ śabaka smelt, melt down, cast molten images, make (an idol) 483b

woorden.betekenis: opus, fusum, fusile, arbor ex auro conflata, statua fusilis,
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. ስብክዋት፡ (Kuf. p. 46), opus e metallo fusum, fusile: ላህመ፡ ስብኮ፡ Ex. 32,4; Act. 7,41 rom.; አማልክት፡ ዘስብኮ፡ Lev. 19,4; 2 Esr. 19,18; χωνευτά 3 Reg. 7,4; 3 Reg. 7,19; ዘኀጺን፡ ስብኮ፡ σίδηρος χυτός Job 40,13; ስብኮ፡ ወርቅ፡ ግቡር፡ በአምሳለ፡ ዕፅ፡ arbor ex auro conflata Jsp. p. 312; in specie: statua fusilis Deut. 9,12; Deut. 27,15; Jud. 17,3; 4 Reg. 17,16; collective: Nah. 1,14; ስብኮየ፡ አዘዙኒ፡ Jes. 48,5. – Voc. Ae.: ስብኮ፡ ዘ፡ የተሰራ፡ ጣዖት። sǝbko, ሥብኮ፡ śǝbko, Pl. sǝbkǝwāt G ሥብኮ፡ śǝbko «chose fondue, tout ce qui sort de la fonderie, statue, idole» ― ምስል፡, ጣዖት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 52v. 131 L ስብኮ፡ sǝbko (Pl. ስብክዋት sǝbkǝwāt) casting, smelting, smelted metal, molten metal, molten image, molten statue 484a

woorden.betekenis: septem, septies, septuplum facere
woorden.definitie: I,2 septem vel septies vel septuplum facere: በስመ፡ አብ፡ ዘይሴብዖን፡ ለምዕዋደ፡ ሰንበታት፡ ከመ፡ ይኩና፡ ለኩፋሌ፡ መዋዕል፡ ወለፍጻሜ፡ ኢዮቤልዎሳት፡ M.M. f. 347.

woorden.betekenis: septem
woorden.definitie: nom. numerale, plerumque femininis junctum [שֶׁבַע ܫܒܰܥ سَبْعٌ] septem, ejus character est ፯፡; Gen. 21,28-30; Ex. 38,17; Deut. 16,9; ሰብዑ፡ አንስት፡ Jes. 4,1; ሰብዑ፡ አዋልድ፡ Esth. 2,9; ሰብዑ፡ እከያት፡ (v. እከይ፡) Prov. 26,25; Marc. 8,6; Matth. 15,34; Matth. 15,36; c. suff. ሰብዑሆን፡ Num. 8,3. Raro cum masculinis junctum, ut: ሰብዑ፡ ደቂቅ፡ Lud. ex Sx. Enc. – Apoc. 1,4; Apoc. 1,12; Apoc. 1,20; Apoc. 2,1 Platt ስብዑ፡ (pro ሰብዑ፡) exhibet.

woorden.betekenis: û, septem, septeni, septies, septimum, septemtriones, ursam
woorden.definitie: vel ሰባዕቱ፡, raro sine suff. û, sc. ሰብዐት፡ (ut Jos. 6,13), nom. num., plerumque masculinis junctum, Acc. ሰብዐተ፡ vel ሰባዕተ፡, septem Gen. 29,27; Gen. 41; Deut. 7,1; ሰብዐቱ፡ ኖሎት፡ Mich. 5,4; ሰብዐቱ፡ ዐይን፡ vel አዕይንት፡ Zach. 3,9; Zach. 4,2; ሰብዐቱ፡ ቈላተ፡ (Acc.) Jes. 11,15; Tob. 3,8; Tob. 12,15; 4 Esr. 6,55; Apoc. 1,4; Apoc. 1,11; Apoc. 1,20 Platt; Apoc. 5,1; Apoc. 5,6; c. suff. ሰብዐቲሆሙ፡ 1 Reg. 16,10; Kuf. 16; Kuf. 34; Marc. 12,22; ሰባዕቱ፡ ሰባዕቱ፡ septeni Gen. 7,2 seq. – ሰብዐተ፡ septies Jos. 6,16 (at legendum videtur ሳብዕተ፡ septimum ). – እለ፡ ሰባዕቱ፡ vocabat Ludolfi Gregorius septemtriones vel ursam majorem.

woorden.betekenis: septem, septies
woorden.definitie: nom. num. 1 septem, potissimum ante nomina mensurarum, ut: ስብዕ፡ በእመት፡ Kuf. 29; ዐሥሩ፡ ወስብዕ፡ Sx. Tachs. 14Enc. 2 adv. septies; et ስብዕ፡ et ስብዐ፡ usitatur: Gen. 33,3; Lev. 4,6; Lev. 4,17; Lev. 8,11; Lev. 14,7; Lev. 14,16; Lev. 14,27; Lev. 14,51; Lev. 16,14; Lev. 16,19; Jos. 6,4; Jos. 6,15; ከማሁ፡ ገብረ፡ እስከ፡ ስብዕ፡ 4 Reg. 4,35; Matth. 18,21; ስብዐ፡ ለዕለትየ፡ Ps. 118,164; 3 Reg. 18,43; Luc. 17,4.

woorden.betekenis: septimus, Septimum, septima vice, sābǝʿ, zasābǝʿ, septième s
woorden.definitie: adj. num., fem. ሳብዕት፡ septimus Gen. 2,2; Gen. 2,3; Num. 29,32; Jer. 35,17; Asc. Jes. 7,27 seq.; ውስተ፡ ሳብዕተ፡ እዴሃ፡ ለምድር፡ 4 Esr. 4,46; 4 Esr. 4,54; 4 Esr. 4,58; Kuf. – Septimum, septima vice: በሳብዕ፡ Job 5,19; በሳብዕት፡ 3 Reg. 18,44. sābǝʿ G ዘሳብዕ፡ zasābǝʿ septième semaine; dimanche dit de Nicodème 453

woorden.betekenis: septem, septimus, feria septima, septimana, hebdomas
woorden.definitie: nom. tempor. 1 septem (dies) et septimus (dies): እምድኅረ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ መዋዕል፡ Gen. 7,10; 4 Esr. 3,28; 4 Esr. 5,32; 1 Reg. 10,8; ሰቡዐ፡ መዋዕለ፡ Lev. 15,13; 4 Esr. 3,21; 4 Esr. 9,27; 4 Esr. 9,28; Hez. 3,15; Hez. 3,16; Tob. 11,18; Judith 16,24; አመ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ Zach. 7,5; በሰቡዕ፡ ሠርቅ፡ Bar. 1,2. 2 feria septima hebdomadis (alias ሰንበት፡) ዘሰቡዕ፡ ፋሲካ፡ Cod. Mus. Brit. XXIX, 1, 48 et Cod. Mus. Brit. XXX, 47. 3 septimana, hebdomas: ሰቡዐ፡ ዕለት፡ Ex. 7,25; ሰቡዐ፡ (Acc.) Ex. 22,29; Pl. ሰቡዓት፡ Kuf. p. 12et Kuf. p. 79.

woorden.betekenis: septuaginta, septuagesimus, septuagies septies
woorden.definitie: nom. num. septuaginta ( septuagesimus ); ejus character est ፸፡, Ps. 89,10; 1 Reg. 6,19; ሰብዓ፡ ብእሲ፡ Hez. 8,11; ሰብዓ፡ ዓም፡ Zach. 1,12; Zach. 7,5; Jes. 23,15; Dan. 9,2; Dan. apocr. 13,10; ሰብዓ፡ በበ፡ ስብዕ፡ septuagies septies Matth. 18,22; Did. 11.

woorden.betekenis: numerus septenarius, heptas, hebdomas, septimana, subaʿe, su
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. ሱባዔያት፡, rarius ሱባዕያት፡ (ut Kuf. p. 26 ann. 13) 1 numerus septenarius, heptas, poëtice: ሰላም፡ ለክሙ፡ ደቂቅ፡ ሱባዔ። ዘነበርክሙ፡ ክቡዳነ፡ እምንዋመ፡ ፍርሀት፡ ወምማዔ፡ Sx. Ter 13 Enc.; ካዕበተ፡ ሱባዔ፡ ሰየፍት፡ Sx. Genb. 14 Enc.; ፳ወሱባዔ፡ Sx. Tachs. 6 Enc. At plerumque 2 hebdomas, septimana (dierum, annorum) ut Kuf. 1; Kuf. 4; Kuf. 6 seq.; Abush.; ሱባዔ፡ ዓመታት፡ Sx. Enc. subaʿe, ሱባኤ፡ subaʾe G ሱባኤ፡ ሕማማት፡ subaʾe ḥǝmāmāt La Semaine Sainte vid. ሕማም፡ (Grébaut) 45

woorden.betekenis: numerus septuplex, septuplum, septempliciter, septifariam, s
woorden.definitie: subst. numerus septuplex, septuplum: ሰብዐቱ፡ ዓመት፡ ዘምስብዒት፡ ἑπτὰ ἔτη ἑπτάκις Lev. 25,8; ይፈዲ፡ ምስብዒተ፡ ἑπταπλάσια Prov. 6,31; Ps. 78,13; Sir. 32,13; የኀሥሥ፡ ይረስዩ፡ ምስብዒተ፡ (v. ምስቢዒቶ፡) Sir. 20,12; ይብእስ፡ ምስብዒተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ኵሉ፡ ἑπταπλάσια πρὸς ταῦτα Sir. 40,8. Adv. septempliciter, septifariam, septies: በምስብዒት፡ Lev. 26,28 vel ምስብዒተ፡ Lev. 26,24; Ps. 11,7; Dan. 3,19; Dan. 3,22; Sir. 7,3; ይበርህ፡ ምስብዒተ፡ እምፀሓይ፡ Clem. f. 240; Jes. 30,26.

woorden.betekenis: numerus septenarius, septuplum
woorden.definitie: subst. numerus septenarius, septuplum Kuf. p. 1 ann. 2; Kuf. p. 146.

woorden.betekenis: rad. inus., cujus potestas prima nondum liquet.
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., cujus potestas prima nondum liquet.

woorden.betekenis: negligi, vilipendi
woorden.definitie: III,1 negligi, vilipendi: ዳእሙኑ፡ በኀቤክሙ፡ ይሰተት፡ 1 Cor. 14,36 rom.

woorden.betekenis: negligens, res, persona contemtui, spretioni obnoxia, neglig
woorden.definitie: 1 part. negligens, ἀμελής Herm. p. 64; Herm. p. 82; Kedr f. 45. 2 subst. res vel persona contemtui, spretioni obnoxia: ከመ፡ ኢይኩን፡ እግዚእየ፡ መስትተ፡ ወዘኢይበቍዕ፡ ἔκβολος καὶ ἄπρακτος Judith 11,11; ከመ፡ ኢንኩን፡ መስትታነ፡ ὄνειδος ἐσόμεθα 2 Esr. 12,17 (fortasse primo legebatur መስትተ፡; Plur. enim negligentes significare videtur); episcopus እመ፡ ገብረ፡ ዐመፃ፡ ወኮነ፡ ዕቅፍተ፡ ወመስትተ፡ ለእለ፡ ነሥኡ፡ ጥምቀተ፡ Did. 4(ed. Platt p. 24).

woorden.betekenis: munus, donum mittere
woorden.definitie: II,1 munus, donum mittere Lud. sine auct.

woorden.betekenis: munus, donum, xenium, tributum, vectigal, aliud
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem. (Plur. አሳትዕ፡?) 1 munus, donum, xenium 1 Reg. 30,26; Hen. 53,1; አስትዓ፡ መንፈሳዊት፡ ξένιόν τι πνευματικόν Cuyr. ad Theod. f. 7; II Can. Ap. 65; Sx. Enc. 1Pag.; አስዓቲክሙ፡ (sic, pro አሳትዒክሙ፡?) Did. 9. 2 tributum, vectigal: ወዝንቱ፡ ውእቱ፡ ክብሩ፡ ወአስትዓሁ፡ እምዐበይተ፡ ሀገር፡ 2 Par. 1,16. – Voc. Ae.: አምኃ፡ መሐና፡ አስትዓ፡ ጋዳ፡ ብነት፡ ዘ፡ በረከት፡; aliud: አስትዓ፡ ዘ፡ እንቍጠጣሽ።

woorden.betekenis: bibere, potare, compotare
woorden.definitie: I,1 [שָׁתָה ܐܶܫܬܺܝ] Subj. ይስተይ፡, Imperat. ስተይ፡ et ስቲ፡ 1 bibere, absol. Gen. 30,38; Ex. 17,6; Num. 29,11; በሊዕ፡ ወሰትይ፡ Ruth 3,3; ንብላዕ፡ ወንስተይ፡ Jes. 22,13; Jes. 21,5; Jes. 29,8; Jer. 32,13; 4 Esr. 10,7; Luc. 17,8; c. Acc. rei Lev. 10,9; እለ፡ ይሰትይዎ፡ ለወይን፡ Jes. 5,22; Jes. 22,13; Jes. 25,6; Jer. 42,5; Jer. 42,6; Prov. 9,5; Ps. 109,8; Koh. 9,7; ስትዮ፡ Sir. 9,10; ትሰትዪ፡ ጽዋዐ፡ እኅትኪ፡ Hez. 23,33; Jes. 51,17; Matth. 26,29; Matth. 27,34; Joh. 6,56; 1 Cor. 10,4; c. እምነ፡ rei: Ruth 2,9; ይሰቲ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ማይ፡ ዘቀርቦ፡ Sir. 26,12; Kuf. 7; Joh. 4,13; Joh. 4,14; Luc. 22,18; c. በ፡ vasis Gen. 44,5; Kuf. 42; Kuf. 43; Dan. 5,3, et c. እምነ፡ vel እምውስተ፡ vasis: ስተይ፡ ማየ፡ እምቀሡትከ፡ Prov. 5,15; Matth. 26,27. 2 potare, compotare (sive addito sive omisso ወይነ፡): በኀበ፡ ይሰትዩ፡ ወይነ፡ ἐν συμποσίῳ Sir. 35,5; ብዙኀ፡ ሰትይ፡ Sir. 34,30; ስተዪ፡ ምስሌነ፡ Judith 12,17; Prov. 24,72; Dan. 5,2 (ወይነ፡); እምከመ፡ ሰተይከ፡ ኢትዘሀር፡ ἐν οἴνῳ μὴ ἀνδρίζου Sir. 34,25. – Voc. Ae.: ሰትየ፡ ብ፡ ጠጠ።

woorden.betekenis: bibi
woorden.definitie: III,1 bibi: ዘተበልዐ፡ ወተሰትየ፡ F.N. 52; Kuf. p. 10; Lit. 172,2.

woorden.betekenis: papyrus
woorden.definitie: (v. ሰት፡ et ሶት፡) subst., nomen plantae palustris, ut videtur papyrus (bibula, vid. Ges. thes. p. 1486): ውስተ፡ ስት፡ ወስማዝ፡ ወብርዕ፡ παρὰ πάπυρον καὶ κάλαμον καὶ βούτομον Job 42,16. – Voc. Ae.: ሰት፡ ዘ፡ ቄጠማ።

woorden.betekenis: potio, potus, potatio
woorden.definitie: , rarius ስተይ፡ (ut Cant. 8,2 var., Sir. 34,25 var.), subst., plerumque m. 1 potio, potus Hos. 2,7; Ps. 101,2; Joh. 6,55; ስቴ፡ ሮማን፡ Cant. 8,2; ንዋየ፡ ስቴ፡ Lev. 11,34; ዘወሀበ፡ ስቴ፡ ሕምዝ፡ F.N. 47. 2 potatio Tit. 2Platt; Tit. 3Platt; συμπόσιον Esth. apocr. 4,17; ስቴ፡ ወአብዝኆቱ፡ ሙስና፡ ልቦሙ፡ ለጠቢባን፡ Lud. e Syn.

woorden.betekenis: potatio, potus, compotatio, potio
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m. 1 potatio, potus, compotatio, μέθη, μέθαι Hez. 23,32; Rom. 13,13; Gal. 5,21; πότοι 1 Petr. 4,3; οἶνος ስታይ፡ ወአንስት፡ ያስሕቶ፡ ለጠቢብ፡ Sir. 19,2; Sir. 34,25; ዝሙት፡ ወስታይ፡ ወስካር፡ Hos. 4,11; እለ፡ ይጐነድዩ፡ ውስተ፡ ስታየ፡ ወይን፡ Prov. 23,30; ከመ፡ ማሕሌት፡ ውስተ፡ ስታየ፡ ወይን፡ ἐν συμποσίῳ οἴνου Sir. 49,1; እለ፡ ይውዕሉ፡ በስታይ፡ Jes. 5,11; Prov. 24,73; ተውኔት፡ ወበሊዕ፡ ወስታይ፡ Clem. f. 17; Did. 4. 2 rarius potio (id quod bibitur), ut: ዘይሠርባ፡ ለኀጢአት፡ ከመ፡ ስታይ፡ Job 15,16.

woorden.betekenis: potio, bibere
woorden.definitie: n. act. potio (, bibere ): ድዉይ፡ ዘይኤዝዞ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ከመ፡ ይትከላእ፡ እምነዊም፡ ወስትየት፡ ወሲሲት፡ Phlx. 20.

woorden.betekenis: sociare, communicare
woorden.definitie: i.q. שְׁתַף ܫܰܘܬܶܦ sociare, communicare; sed stirps I,1 haud usitata fuisse videtur; Hebr. 2,14 Polygl. locus corruptus est.

woorden.betekenis: communio, societas, communicatio, socius, consors, sodalis,
woorden.definitie: subst. 1 communio, societas, communicatio: ሱታፌ፡ መንፈስ፡ ቅዱስ፡ 2 Cor. 13,14; Kedr f. 1; Philem. 6; 1 Cor. 10,16 seq.; c. ምስለ፡ 1 Joh. 1,3; 1 Joh. 1,6; ከመ፡ ንንሣእ፡ እምሱታፌ፡ ምስጢር፡ ቡሩክ፡ Lit. 159,4; societas (mercaturae et negotiorum) F.N. 34. 2 concr., m. et fem., coll. et sing., socius, consors, sodalis, collega, particeps; Kuf. p. 113; ዝንቱ፡ ሱታፌ፡ ለረሲዕ፡ (κοινωνός) Prov. 28,24; ከመ፡ አንትሙኒ፡ ትኩኑ፡ ሱታፌ፡ ምስሌነ፡ 1 Joh. 1,3; Apoc. 1,9; 1 Cor. 10,18 rom.; 2 Cor. 8,23 rom.; አነ፡ ሱታፌከ፡ በኵሉ፡ ግብርከ፡ Jsp. p. 366; አስቴር፡ ሱታፌ፡ መንግሥትነ፡ Esth. 8,13 apocr.; ወይእቲ፡ ሱታፌከ፡ Mal. 2,14; ጽድቅ፡ ይከውን፡ ለክሙ፡ ሱታፌ፡ Hen. 91,4; ለእመ፡ ተፃብአ፡ ካህን፡ ምስለ፡ ካህን፡ ሱታፌሁ፡ F.N. 9; socius negotiorum Sir. 42,3. Ante pron. suffixa forma ሱታፍ፡ passim occurrit: ንኩን፡ ሱታፌ፡ ለጽድቅ፡ 3 Joh. 8; 1 Petr. 5,1; 1 Cor. 9,23; ሰላም፡ ለሕፅንኪ፡ ለጥበበ፡ ሰማይ፡ ምዕራፋ። ዘኢይትረከብ፡ ሱታፋ፡ III Sal. Mar. 22; Sx. Ter 17Enc.

woorden.betekenis: communio, consociatio
woorden.definitie: vel ስትፍና፡ subst. (conditio associati i.e.) communio, consociatio: አልቦ፡ ዘረብሐ፡ (ὁ ἄνθρωπος) እምሱቱፍና፡ (v. እምስትፍና፡) መለኮት፡ (τοῦ λόγου) Cyr. c. Pall. f. 88.

woorden.betekenis: calere, se, calefacere, incalescere
woorden.definitie: vel ሰኀነ፡ I,1 [سَخُنَ سَخِنَ, ܫܚܶܢ] Subj. ይስኀን፡, calere, se (i.e. corpus) calefacere admoto igne, incalescere: ይነሥእ፡ እምውስቴቱ፡ ወይስኅን፡ Jes. 44,15; Marc. 14,54; Marc. 14,67; Joh. 18,18; Joh. 18,25; ከመ፡ ንስኀን፡ እምጽንዐተ፡ ቍር፡ Act. 28,2 Platt; Imperat. ሰኀኑ፡ Jac. 2,16. – Voc. Ae.: ሰኀነ፡ ዘ፡ ሞቀ።

woorden.betekenis: incensum, thus
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., incensum i.e. thus, λίβανος Ex. 30,34; Lev. 2,1; Lev. 2,2; Lev. 5,11; Lev. 24,7; Num. 5,15; 2 Esr. 23,5; 2 Esr. 23,9; Cant. 3,6; Cant. 4,6; Jes. 43,23; Jes. 60,6; Jes. 66,3; Jer. 6,20; Jer. 17,26; Sir. 24,15; Sir. 50,9; Kuf. 3; Kuf. 6; Kuf. 16; Hen. 29,2; Matth. 2,11. [Ludolfus cum hoc vocabulo composuit gr. σχῖνος; sed σχῖνος Aethiopice nominatur ሰኪኖን፡].

woorden.betekenis: litera alphabeti Hebraici XXIa (Χσὲν, Σέν) Ps. 118
woorden.definitie: litera alphabeti Hebraici XXIa (Χσὲν, Σέν) Ps. 118,161; Thren. 1,21; Thren. 2,21; Thren. 3,60; Thren. 4,21; ubi de Psalmis agitur siglo ሳን፡ Ps. 118, 161-168 notatur, ut Genz. f. 69.

woorden.betekenis: altus et gibbosus fuit, gibbosus
woorden.definitie: i.q. سَنِمَ altus et gibbosus fuit, de camelo (سَنَامٌ gibbosus ).

woorden.betekenis: catena, manica, catenula opere plexili vel tortili facta, Vo
woorden.definitie: subst., Pl. ሰናስል፡ [שַׁרְשְׁרָה שַׁלְשֶׁלֶת ܫܺܝܫܰܠܬܳܐ سِلْسِلَةٌ] 1 catena ἅλυσις Act. 12,6 Platt; Hen. 69,28; ሰናስል፡ ዘኀጺን፡ Sx. Hed. 7; Sx. Haml. 1; አሰሮ፡ በሰናስል፡ Gad. T.H.; ሰናስለ፡ ዘኀጺን፡ σειρὰ χρυσῆ (fem.) Chrys. Ta. 9; አሰሮ፡ በሰናስል፡ Gad. T.H.; ሰናስለ፡ ወርቅ፡ Chrys. Ta. 9; መዋቅሕት፡ ወሰናስል፡ Jsp. p. 381; χειροπέδη manica: እለ፡ ሙቁሓን፡ እደዊሆሙ፡ በሰናስል፡ Job 36,8; Ps. 149,8. 2 catenula opere plexili vel tortili facta Ex. 28,14; Ex. 28,22 C; Ex. 36,22 c. – Voc. Ae.: ሰናስል፡ ገሪሳት፡ መዋቅሕት፡ ብ፡ ሰንሰቱ።

woorden.betekenis: instrumentum musicum, cithara, lyra, harpa, nablium, aliave
woorden.definitie: subst., Pl. መሰናቁት፡ vel መሰናቍት፡, rarius መሰናቅው፡ (Sx. Hed. 27 Enc.; Org. 3 et መሰንቆታት፡ (Apoc. 14,2 Platt); Pl. Plur. መሰናቁታት፡ (Apoc. 14,2 rom.) instrumentum musicum: ምስለ፡ መሰንቆ፡ μετὰ μουσικῶν 1 Esr. 5,2; 1 Esr. 5,57. a cithara, lyra, harpa, nablium, aliave instrumenta pulsatilia: κιθάρα Gen. 31,27; 2 Par. 9,11; Jes. 5,12 (si non ψαλτήριον); Jes. 16,11; Jes. 23,16; Jes. 24,8; Jes. 30,32; Dan. 3,5; Job 30,9; Job 30,31; Ps. 32,2; Ps. 42,5; Ps. 70,24; Ps. 80,2; Ps. 146,7; Ps. 150,3; Apoc. 5,8; Apoc. 14,2; Apoc. 15,2; Apoc. 18,22; κινύρα 2 Esr. 20,27; 1 Par. 15,27 var.; 1 Reg. 10,5; 1 Reg. 16,16; 1 Reg. 16,23; Sir. 39,15; ὄργανον Am. 5,23; Ps. 151,2; አውታረ፡ መሰንቆ፡ Hez. 23,42; Clem. f. 16; ዝብጠተ፡ መሰንቆ፡ ወዕንዚራ፡ Macc. f. 20. b tibia, fistula, መሰንቆ፡ ወመዝሙር፡ αὐλὸς καὶ ψαλτήριον Sir. 40,21; 1 Cor. 14,7 rom. c musica, concentus canentium instrumentis et saltantium: ሐዋዝ፡ ማሕሌት፡ ወመሰንቆ፡ μέλος μουσικῶν Sir. 35,6; ሐውዘ፡ መሰንቆ፡ ወማሕሌት፡ μέλη μουσικῶν Sir. 44,5; χοροί Jud. 11,34; Jud. 21,21; 2 Reg. 6,23. – Voc. Ae.: መሰንቆ፡ ዕንዚራ፡ አርጋኖን፡ ብ፡ በገና። { Vid. Description de l’Égypte, II éd. t. XIII p. 553; Harris II. 269}.

woorden.betekenis: sabbatum, dies hebdomadis septimus, sabbatum prius, sabbatum
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque fem., Pl. ሰናብት፡ et ሰንበታት፡ [אַבָּת] 1) sabbatum, dies hebdomadis septimus Ex. 16,23; Ex. 16,25; Ex. 16,29; Ex. 16,30; ዕለተ፡ ሰንበት፡ Ex. 20,8; Ex. 31,13-15; Matth. 12,2; Matth. 12,8; Marc. 6,2; Marc. 16,1; Hebr. 4,4; ሰንበተ፡ ሰናብት፡ Lev. 16,31; Lev. 23,32; እንተ፡ ቅድመ፡ ሰንበት፡ προσάββατον Judith 8,6; Asc. Jes. 3,13; ሰናብት፡ Ex. 31,16; ሰንበታት፡ Am. 8,5; Hez. 20,12; Jes. 56,2; Jes. 58,3; ዕለተ፡ ሰንበታት፡ Jer. 17,21 seqq.; መዋዕለ፡ ሰንበታት፡ Judith 10,2. 2 Aethiopes Christiani cum et septimum et primum septimanae diem celebrarent, utrumque ሰንበት፡ appellant, quare distinguere solebant a ሰንበተ፡ ቀዳሚት፡ sabbatum prius Lud. comm. hist. p. 239 nr. 7; Syn. in Proleg.; vel ሰንበተ፡ አይሁድ፡ sabbatum Judaeorum Kedr f. 64; Can. Laod. 28 (29). b እሑድ፡ ሰንበት፡ feria prima, dominica Marc. 16,2; Luc. 24,1; vel ሰንበተ፡ እሑድ፡ Lud. comm. hist. p. 239 nr. 8; ሰንበተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ sabbatum Christianorum Did. 10; Mavâs. 70. Sed passim dominicam quoque (sicut diem septimum) simpliciter ሰንበት፡ nominant, ut: ተንሥአ፡ ክርስቶስ፡ በዕለተ፡ ሰንበት፡ Did. 30; መፍትው፡ ናዕርፍ፡ በሰንበታት፡ Did. 38. 3 sabbatum i.e. hebdomas, septimana Lev. 23,15; Lev. 25,8; Deut. 16,9; 4 Esr. 4,39; Luc. 18,12; Tob. 2,1; በዓለ፡ ሰንበት፡ festum hebdomadum, pentecoste Ex. 34,22; Deut. 16,10; ሰንበታተ፡ መዋዕል፡ ፶ወ፪፡ Kuf. 6; ሰንበታተ፡ ዓመታት፡ Kuf. 50; Dan. 9,24-27; Hen. 91,12-17. 4 transl. sabbatum i.e. feriae aetatis sive extrema aetas (opp. መዋዕለ፡ ውርዙት፡) Hen. 10,17. 5 ut videtur, dies festus, solemnia in genere Act. 19,28; Act. 19,34.

woorden.betekenis: sabbatum celebrare, observare, otiari, feriari, duo sabbata,
woorden.definitie: quadril. II (denom.) 1 sabbatum celebrare vel observare, otiari vel feriari die sabbati vel dominicae: Kuf. 2,50; አሰንበተ፡ በዕለተ፡ ሰንበት፡ Ex. 16,30; Lev. 23,32; 1 Esr. 1,55; 2 Par. 36,21; Chrys. ho. 8; seq. እምነ፡ ግብር፡ Kuf. 2; Kuf. 50; c. Acc. diei Kuf. 50; de terra praedicatur Lev. 25,2; Lev. 25,4; Lev. 26,34; Lev. 26,35; Kuf. 50. 2 duo sabbata (vetus et novum) apud hospitem transigere Lud. sine auct.

woorden.betekenis: acuit
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., sc. שָׁנַן سَنَّ acuit vid. Ges. thes. p. 1453.

woorden.betekenis: dens, duplex dentium series
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. ስነን፡ et አስናን፡ [שֵׁן ܫܶܢ سِنٌّ] dens a hominum, animalium: ፅርስ፡ ወስን፡ Ex. 21,27; Prov. 24,37 (opp. ጥረስ፡); Job 29,17; Job 13,14; Job 16,9;Gen. 49,12; አስናኒሃ፡ ጽኑዕ፡ Kuf. 35; ጸርሱ፡ ስነኒሆሙ፡ Jer. 38,29; Sir. 30,10; ሐቀዩ፡ ስነኒሆሙ፡ Thren. 2,16; ሰበረ፡ ስነንየ፡ Thren. 3,16; Ps. 3,7; ስነነ፡ ዐንበሳ፡ ስነኒሃ፡ Sir. 21,2; ዖደ፡ ለስነኒሁ፡ ግርማ፡ Job 41,5; ስነነ፡ አራዊተ፡ ምድር፡ Sir. 39,30; ስነነ፡ አክይስት፡ Sap. 16,10; Dan. 7,5. Pl. አስናን፡ duplex dentium series: ክልኤ፡ አስናን፡ Tab. Tab. 64. b instrumentum: fuscinae 1 Sam. 2,13 var.; serrae ስነነ፡ ሞሰርት፡ Sx. Mij. 23. – Voc. Ae.: አስናን፡ ብ፡ ጥርሶች።

woorden.betekenis: iteravit, diversus, secundus fuit.
woorden.definitie: i.q. שָׁנָה ܬܢܳܐ ثَنَى iteravit; diversus, secundus fuit.

woorden.betekenis: vid. ሳንይ፡
woorden.definitie: vid. ሳንይ፡

woorden.betekenis: simila, similago, flos farinae triticae
woorden.definitie: n. peregr., sc. σεμίδαλις, simila, similago, flos farinae triticae, Gen. 18,6; Ex. 29,2; Lev. 2,1 seq.; Lev. 7,12 seqq.; Lev. 14,10; Num. 28,5 seq.; 1 Reg. 1,24; 4 Reg. 7,1; Hez. 16,19; Jes. 1,13; Jes. 66,3; Dan. apocr. 13,3;Sir. 32,3; Sir. 38,11; Apoc. 18,13; ኅብስተ፡ ስንዳሌ፡ ἄρτοι καθαροί Judith 10,5.

woorden.betekenis: sapphirus, Voc. Ae.
woorden.definitie: et ስንፒር፡ subst., σάπφειρος sapphirus Ex. 24,10; Ex. 28,18; etiam Ex. 36,18 in C (ubi caeteri ጸሊም፡ ያክንት፡ exhibent); ዕንቈ፡ ሰንፔር፡ Jes. 13,12; Jes. 54,11 var.; Thren. 4,7; እብነ፡ ሰንፔር፡ Job 28,6; Job 28,16; Hez. 1,26; Hez. 9,2; Hez. 10,1; Hen. 18,8; Cant. 5,14; Tob. 13,16; Apoc. 21,19. [Etymon alii a vocabulo Indico { शनिप्रिय}, alii a radice סָפַר (Ges. thes. p. 968) repetunt]. – Voc. Ae.: ሰንፔር፡ ወጸሊም፡ ያክንት፡ ፩።

woorden.betekenis: formare, pingere
woorden.definitie: formare, pingere vid. sub ሠዐለ፡

woorden.betekenis: deprecatorem facere, intercessione uti
woorden.definitie: II,1 deprecatorem facere aliquem, ejus intercessione uti: ዐቢየ፡ ነቢየ፡ ዮሐንስሃ፡ ሰአልነ፡ ያስተምሕር፡ በእንቲአነ፤ ሣህልከ፡ ይኩን፡ ላዕሌነ፡ Mavâs. 1.

woorden.betekenis: interrogare, percontari, sciscitari, de, quaestio, interroga
woorden.definitie: , rarius ተሰአለ፡ (ut Kuf. 41; Chrys. ho. 9) III,2 interrogare, percontari, sciscitari, c. Acc. pers.: እሴአለከ፡ Job 38,3; Job 8,8; Job 12,7; እመ፡ ተስእልክዎሙ፡ Jes. 41,28; ተሰአልዎሙ፡ ለአሕዛብ፡ (ἐρωτήσατε) Jer. 18,13; Jer. 43,17; 4 Esr. 8,4; 4 Esr. 10,12; Gen. 32,18; Hen. 40,8; Matth. 2,4; እለ፡ ኢተስእሉኒ፡ Jes. 65,1; Rom. 10,20; c. Acc. rei: ተሰአሉ፡ ፍኖተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ (Imperat.) Jer. 6,16; Gen. 32,30; 1 Reg. 23,2; 1 Reg. 28,6; 2 Reg. 2,1; c. dupl. Acc.: Ps. 136,3; ተስእልዎሙ፡ አስማቲሆሙ፡ 2 Esr. 5,4; Gen. 43,7; ዘይሴአሉኒ፡ Chrys. ho. 4; c. ኀበ፡ vel በኀበ፡ pers. Jud. 20,18; Dan. 2,10; Dan. 2,11; c. በእንተ፡ rei vel pers. ( de ): Koh. 7,10; 4 Esr. 2,34; ተሰአሉኒ፡ በእንተ፡ ደቂቅየ፡ Jes. 45,11; 1 Reg. 17,22; 1 Reg. 22,10; nota etiam: ተስእልክዎ፡ ከመ፡ ያርእየኒ፡ Hen. 60,9. – Infin. ተስእሎት፡ quaestio, interrogatio: ተስእሎታት፡ ዘተስእልዎ፡ ካልኣን፡ Sx. Jac. 10; Phlx. 6; ተስእሎታተ፡ ዜናሆሙ፡ ለአበው፡ ቅዱሳን፡ Phlx. in tit.

woorden.betekenis: rogatio, petitio, postulatio, petitum, postulatum, precatio,
woorden.definitie: n. act. et subst., fem. et m., rogatio, petitio, postulatio, petitum, postulatum; tamquam Infin. c.c. Acc. rei, ut: ኀፈርኩ፡ ስእለቶ፡ ለንጉሥ፡ ኀይለ፡ ወሰራዊተ፡ 2 Esr. 8,22; ስእለት፡ ብየ፡ እንተ፡ እስእል፡ እምኀቤከ፡ Kuf. 35; Jud. 8,24; 3 Reg. 3,5; ምንት፡ ውእቱ፡ ስእለትኪ፡ (τὸ αἴτημά σου) Esth. 7,2; Esth. 7,3; Ps. 36,4; Hen. 14,4; Phil. 4,6. In specie a precatio, preces, oratio δέησις Job 8,6; Thren. 3,55; Dan. 9,17; Ps. 5,2; Ps. 38,16; Ps. 39,2; 1 Petr. 3,12; ወኮነ፡ እምድኅረ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ስእለት፡ 1 Par. 18,1; προσευχὴ Tob. 12,12. b intercessio Hen. 13,2; Hen. 14,7.

woorden.betekenis: locus petitionis, sacellum precibus fundendis destinatum, or
woorden.definitie: subst. locus petitionis, sacellum precibus fundendis destinatum, oratorium, praedicatur de ecclesia: Clem. f. 108; ትኩን፡ ምስኣለ፡ ወምስጋደ፡ ወምስትስራየ፡ ኀጢአት፡ Clem. f. 194; Clem. f. 231; Deg.; Org. 4.

woorden.betekenis: orcus, inferna, abyssus, sedes damnatorum
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem. (ut Apoc. 6,8; Jes. 14,9; Ps. 85,12; 4 Esr. 8,64, al.), orcus, inferna, ᾅδης: አኮኑ ክሡት፡ ሲኦል፡ በቅድመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Job 26,6; Job 33,22; Prov. 2,18; Prov. 7,27; Cant. 8,6; Ps. 6,5; Sap. 2,1; ትቀልል፡ ሲኦል፡ እምኔሃ፡ Sir. 28,21; Jes. 14,15; Jes. 14,19; Jes. 28,15; Jes. 38,10; Jes. 57,9; Bar. 3,11; ወረዱ፡ ሲኦለ፡ (v. ሲኦል፡) Bar. 3,19; Kuf. 5; Christi ርደት፡ ውስተ፡ ሲኦል፡ Asc. Jes. 4,21; Luc. 16,23; 1 Cor. 15,55; Apoc. 1,18; Apoc. 20,13; Apoc. 20,14; Hen. 22; Hen. 51,2; ሞትሂ፡ ወሲኦልኒ፡ ይቤሉ፡ ἡ ἀπώλεια καὶ ὁ θάνατος Job 28,22; ἄβυσσος abyssus Job 41,22; Job 41,23; deinde in libris Christianorum saepius sedes damnatorum post mortem, ut Clem. f. 105; Clem. f. 213[De etymo vid. Ges. thes. p. 1348; שְׁאוֹל ܫܺܝܘܽܠ].

woorden.betekenis: gramen
woorden.definitie: gramen vid. sub ሣዕር፡

woorden.betekenis: impotentem, rei imparem esse, non posse, nequire, iis non pr
woorden.definitie: I,1 [contigua sunt יָשֵׁן et שָׁאֵן (ሰንአ፡); amh. ሳነ፡] Imperf. ይስእን፡ (sed raro usitatum; magis frequentant ኢይክል፡); Subj. ይስእን፡; impotentem, rei imparem esse, non posse, nequire; c.c. Acc. Infin.: ስእኑ፡ አውሥኦቶ፡ ለኢዮብ፡ Job 32,3; Job 4,20; ርእሶሙ፡ ስእኑ፡ አድኅኖ፡ Jes. 20,6; Jes. 59,14; Jer. 5,4; ስእንኩ፡ ጸዊሮቶ፡ Jer. 20,9; Dan. 4,15; Gen. 41,8; Gen. 45,1; Ex. 7,21; Ex. 40,29; Lev. 25,35; Num. 9,6; 1 Reg. 2,5; 4 Reg. 16,5; Hen. 39,14; Matth. 17,16; Matth. 17,19; Marc. 1,45; Rom. 9,13; ስኢነነ፡ ተዐግሦ፡ 1 Thess. 3,1; nec raro pron. suff., ad objectum Infinitivi relatum, verbo ስእነ፡ adjicitur: ስእንዋ፡ ቀቲሎታ፡ Jes. 7,1; ንሕነሰ፡ ሎቱ፡ ስእናሁ፡ እኂዞ፡ (v. እኂዞቶ፡) Dan. apocr. 1,39; Hebr. 12,19; rarius c. Subj. verbi: ዐናብስት፡ ስእኑ፡ ይግሥሥዎ፡ Sx. Pag. 1 Enc.; { c.c. ከመ፡ et Subj., Clem. f. 219(vid. sub መንገድ፡)}; c.c. Acc. rei vel pers.: ጻድቃን፡ የሐውርዎን፡ (ለፍናዊሁ፡) ወኃጥኣን፡ ይስእንዎን፡ ἀσθενήσουσιν ἐν αὐταῖς Hos. 14,9; ስእኖሙ፡ iis non praevaluit Apoc. 12,8; ስእኑ፡ ሕይወተ፡ ዘለዓለም፡ nequiverunt (acquirere) vitam aeternam, Lud. e V.S.; passim absol. (omisso Infin. vel Obj.) ut: ኀሠሥኩ፡ ኣእምር፡ ወስእንኩ፡ 4 Esr. 13,8; in specie de impotentia utriusque sexus: ለእመ፡ ስእነ፡ ብእሲ፡ ሰኪበ፡ ምስለ፡ ብእሲቱ፡ ለአቅሞ፡ ዘርእ፡ ወዝንቱ፡ ስኢን፡ ይከውን፡ እም፫ምክንያት፡ F.M. 12,5; በእንተ፡ ስኢነ፡ ውሉድ፡ quod nullos poterant (procreare) liberos, Lud. e V.S. – Stirpis I,2 esemplum Ludolfus affert e Mss. Colb.: ይሴእንዋ፡ ለርኅራኄ፡ incapaces erant mansuetudinis (nisi hanc formam, sicut in gramm. p. 145, ex analogia formae ይሬኢ፡ explicare malueris).

woorden.betekenis: uva, racemus, botrys, vitis, dactylorum, vite, corymbo, ʾask
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., coll. et sing., Pl. ሰኳላት፡ vel አስካላት፡ [אֶשְׁכֹּל ܣܓܽܘܠܳܐ إِثْكَالٌ عُثْكُولٌ; de etymo vid. Ges. thes. p. 1406] 1 uva, racemus, botrys a vitis Gen. 40,10-12; ደመ፡ አስካል፡ Gen. 49,11; Sir. 39,26: Lev. 25,5; Num. 6,3; አስካል፡ ልምሉም፡ Num. 6,4 C; Num. 13,23; Deut. 23,26; Deut. 32,32; አስካለ፡ ወይን፡ Cant. 7,9; Hos. 9,10; Mich. 7,1; ይፍረይ፡ አስካለ፡ Jes. 5,2; Jes. 65,8; አልቦ፡ አስካል፡ ውስተ፡ ወይን፡ Jer. 8,13; አስካለ፡ ቀምሕክሙ፡ Hez. 36,8; 2 Esr. 23,15; 4 Esr. 9,24; 4 Esr. 12,47; Sir. 50,15; Matth. 7,16; Apoc. 14,18; βοτρύδια Jes. 18,5; σταφίδες 1 Par. 12,40; χαλαστά ሰኳላት፡ v. አስካላት፡ (v. አክሊላት፡) 2 Par. 3,5. b dactylorum: አስካለ፡ በቀልት፡ Hen. 24,4; Sx. Mij. 20; Sx. Sen. 16. 2 transl. de vite: ይረክብ፡ ፍሬ፡ በውስተ፡ አስካሎሙ፡ Lud. e Vit. Pach.; አስካለ፡ አእምሮ፡ እንተ፡ ታሠርጽ፡ ጥበበ፡ Lud. e Cant. Sam.; de corymbo floris vitis: አስካል፡ ዘጸገየ፡ Cant. 1,14. – Voc. Ae.: አስካል፡ ዘ፡ ዘለላ። ʾaskāl C for ማየ፡ አስካል፡ vid. ማይ፡

woorden.betekenis: frigora
woorden.definitie: subst., incertae significationis Kuf. p. 84(var. ለካሕካሕ፡); Monum. sacr. et prof., Mediol. 1861, tom. I, p. 27 exhibent frigora. – Voc. Ae.: ሰካሕካሕ፡ ዘ፡ አሽሽ፡ v. ውሽሽ፡

woorden.betekenis: bajulare, gestare, portare humeris
woorden.definitie: I,1 [coll. שְׁכֶם, et Ges. thes. p. 1406; amh. ሸከመ፡] Subj. ይስክም፡ (ይስከም፡ Sir. 13,2 var.), bajulare, gestare, portare humeris: ተሐዝሉ፡ በገቦክሙ፡ ወትሰክሙ፡ በመታክፊክሙ፡ Hez. 34,21; c. Acc. rei Ex. 25,14; Ex. 37,5 hebr. in C; ረስዮ፡ ለክሣድየ፡ ያድንን፡ ወይስክም፡ አርዑተ፡ ትእዛዝከ፡ Sx. Sen. 4.

woorden.betekenis: onus imponere humeris, cervici
woorden.definitie: II,1 onus imponere humeris vel cervici alicujus, c.c. Acc. pers.: አስከማ፡ ለአጋር፡ Kuf. 17; ነሥአ፡ ዕፀወ፡ ወአስከሞ፡ ለይስሐቅ፡ Kuf. 18; ያሰክምዎ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ዲበ፡ መትከፍቱ፡ Matth. 23,4; Act. 15,10.

woorden.betekenis: mercede conducere
woorden.definitie: mercede conducere vid. sub ሠከረ፡

woorden.betekenis: ebrietas, crapula, ebriositas, vinolentia, potus inebrians
woorden.definitie: subst. 1 ebrietas, crapula 1 Reg. 1,14; 1 Reg. 25,37 var.; እለ፡ ትሰትይዎ፡ ለወይን፡ ለስካር፡ Joel 1,5; Tob. 4,15; μέθη Jes. 28,7; Clem. f. 237; ነቂሆ፡ ኖኅ፡ እምንዋመ፡ ስካሩ፡ Clem. f. 26; ዘያተነትኖ፡ ስካረ፡ ወይን፡ Jer. 23,9; Jer. 28,57. 2 ebriositas, vinolentia Hos. 4,11; ብእሲ፡ ሀካይ፡ ዘአኅለቀ፡ ኵሎ፡ ንዋዮ፡ በስካር፡ ወበዝሙት፡ Did. 3; F.N. 50. 3 potus inebrians μέθη እመልኦሙ፡ ስካረ፡ μεθύσματι Jer. 13,13.

woorden.betekenis: ebriosus, bibax
woorden.definitie: n. ag. ebriosus, bibax, sed nonnisi exempla fem. inventa sunt: እመሂ፡ ዘማዊት፡ ወእመሂ፡ ሰካር፡ Kid. f. 23; Lud. e Syn.

woorden.betekenis: cubare, recumbere, procumbere, discumbere, cubitum ire, dorm
woorden.definitie: et ሰክበ፡ (vid. Gen. 34,2; Gen. 35,22; Num. 5,13 ann.) I,1 [שָׁכַב ܫܟܶܒ] Subj. ይስከብ፡ et ይስክብ፡ 1 cubare, recumbere, procumbere, discumbere: ትሰክብ፡ በገቦከ፡ ዘፀጋም፡ Hez. 4,4; ሶበ፡ ይሰክብ፡ ዲበ፡ ምስካቡ፡ Job 33,15; ጉዜ፡ ይሰክብ፡ ዲበ፡ ምስካቢሁ፡ Sir. 40,5; ሰከበ፡ ውስተ፡ ሠቅ፡ ወሐመድ፡ Jes. 58,5; ἀνέπεσεν Judith 12,16; ሰከበ፡ ሰኪሮ፡ Kuf. 7; Num. 24,9; 2 Reg. 12,16; 2 Reg. 13,31; ሰከበት፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ 3 Reg. 3,19; 4 Reg. 4,34; Luc. 2,16; Luc. 17,34; etiam de rebus inanimatis, ut: vitis ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ሰከበ፡ Herm. p. 50. a de dormituris et dormientibus: cubitum ire, dormire: (κοιμᾶσθαι, καθεύδειν) Ruth 3,4; Gen. 19,4; Gen. 28,13; እለ፡ ይሰክቡ፡ ውስተ፡ ዐራታት፡ Am. 6,4; 1 Reg. 3,5; 2 Reg. 11,13; 1 Esr. 3,6; Ps. 3,5; Prov. 3,24; Matth. 8,24 rom. b de aegrotantibus 2 Reg. 13,6; 4 Esr. 6,80 (var.). c de morientibus et mortuis: occumbere, obdormiscere, dormire (κοιμᾶσθαι): 2 Reg. 7,12; 3 Reg. 1,21; 4 Reg. 10,35; 4 Reg. 13,9; 4 Reg. 14,16; Job 3,13; Hez. 32,21; Jes. 14,8 var.; 1 Cor. 11,30. 2 concumbere: conjuges እለ፡ ሰከቡ፡ በእንተ፡ ውሉድ፡ Lit. 174,3; c.c. ምስለ፡ Gen. 19,33-35; Gen. 26,10; Gen. 34,2; Gen. 39,7; Gen. 39,14; Gen. 39,17; Ex. 22,15; Lev. 15,16; Lev. 18,20; Lev. 18,22; Lev. 19,20; Lev. 20,11; 2 Reg. 11,11; 2 Reg. 13,11; c. ኀበ፡ Gen. 19,32; c. Acc. (potissimum de concubitu maris cum mare et hominis cum bestia): Lev. 18,23; Lev. 20,16 (quamquam etiam c. ምስለ፡ Gen. 18,22; Gen. 20,13; Deut. 27,21); እለ፡ ይሰክቡ፡ ተባዕተ፡ ἀρσενοκοῖται Chrys. ho. 30; F.M. 34,2; (sed etiam de concubitu maris cum muliere) ዘይሰክብ፡ ብእሲተ፡ F.N. 5. – Voc. Ae.: ሰከበ፡ ደቀሰ፡ ዘ፡ ተኘ።

woorden.betekenis: facere ut cubet vel jaceat, deponere, reponere, collocare, p
woorden.definitie: II,1 facere ut cubet vel jaceat, deponere, reponere, collocare, prosternere, a hominem: አስከቦ፡ ዘከብዱ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡ Gen. 22,9; አስከቡኪ፡ ውስተ፡ መሬት፡ በከብድኪ፡ Jes. 51,23; 2 Reg. 8,2; አስከበቶ፡ ውስተ፡ ዐራት፡ 1 Reg. 19,13; ውስተ፡ ጎል፡ Luc. 2,7; Deg.; 2 Par. 16,14; በአረፍተ፡ ቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ ታሰክቦ፡ ለበድን፡ Genz. f. 16; in lectum conjicere (vulnerando) Ex. 21,18; mortuos: አስከብዎሙ፡ ለአእሩግ፡ Thren. 2,21; Jes. 14,8. b res, ut murum: ትወድቅ፡ ወኣስክባ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ Hez. 13,14; gladium Hen. 90,34.

woorden.betekenis: cubatio, cubitus
woorden.definitie: n. act. cubatio, cubitus, Org. 2.

woorden.betekenis: membrum genitale
woorden.definitie: subst. membrum genitale (concubitus instrumentum) Kuf. p. 60 (si quidem lectio sana est).

woorden.betekenis: locus, res, ubi cubant, cubile, stratum, lectus, torus, toru
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. ምስካባት፡ locus vel res, ubi cubant a cubile, stratum, lectus, torus κλίνη Gen. 48,2; 2 Reg. 4,7; Prov. 26,14; Cant. 1,16; Judith 10,21; ምስካባት፡ Judith 15,11; Kuf. 33; κοίτη Job 7,13; Job 33,15; Sir. 49,5; Dan. 2,29; Dan. 7,1; Ps. 4,5; στρωμνή ውስተ፡ ጽልመት፡ ተነጽፈት፡ ምስካብየ፡ Job 17,13; Job 41,21; Am. 6,4; Ps. 6,6; ይነብራ፡ ውስተ፡ ዐራተ፡ ምስካቦን፡ Hez. 23,41; Ps. 131,3; ውስተ፡ ምስካበ፡ ሲኦል፡ ይነውሙ፡ Job 21,13; κώδια Judith 12,15; ምስካባት፡ Hen. 39,4; Hen. 39,5; Hen. 46,4. b lectus vel torus legitime vel illegitime concumbentium, κοίτη Sap. 3,13; Gen. 49,4; Sir. 23,18; ህየ፡ ነጸፍኪ፡ ምስካቢኪ፡ Jes. 57,7; Hez. 23,17; Hebr. 13,4. c cubile, lustrum bestiae Job 37,7. d lectus carnificando ed cruciando inserviens: ምስካበ፡ ኀጺን፡ Sx. Genb. 19al.

woorden.betekenis: conjurare, conspirare, conjungi, aliud
woorden.definitie: III,3 conjurare, conspirare Ps. 82,5; Ps. 101,9; Act. 23,12; Act. 23,14; ወተሰካተዩ፡ በማዕሌቶሙ፡ Macc. f. 14; in bonam partem: (martyres) እለ፡ ተሰካተዩ፡ ወተዘጋደዩ፡ ለመዊት፡ Ssal. Req.; etiam conjungi in genere: ተንሥአ፡ በኀይል፡ እምሀገሩ፡ ወተሰካተዩ፡ ምስለ፡ እለ፡ እምድኅሬሁ፡ ወተዐየኑ፡ Macc. f. 14. – Voc. Ae.: ተሰካተዩ፡ ዘ፡ ተመማሉ፡; aliud: ዘ፡ ተከማቹ።

woorden.betekenis: planta, solum pedis, palma, calx, ungula
woorden.definitie: (passim ሰኮና፡), subst., m. et fem., coll. et sing., Pl. ሰኳንው፡ [aliud etymon conjectavit Dietrich semit. Wurzelforsch. p. 88] 1 planta sive solum pedis: ሰኰና፡ እገሪሃ፡ (respondent እራኃተ፡ እደዊሃ፡) 4 Reg. 9,35; ኢይቀውሙ፡ በሰኰና፡ እገሪሆሙ፡ (ἴχνος ποδῶν) Judith 6,4; ትከይዶሙ፡ በሰኰናከ፡ Hez. 32,2; τὰ ἴχνη μου Ps. 17,20; ποῦς Sir. 6,36; διαβήματα Ps. 16,6; Ps. 36,33; Ps. 72,2 (alias መከየድ፡, መካይድ፡); ሰላም፡ ለሰኰናኪ፡ I Sal. Mar. 32; de planta i.e. palma manus 4 Esr. 4,16 (siquidem lectio sana est). 2 calx pedis, πτέρνα Gen. 3,15; Gen. 25,26; Sir. 12,27; ተከሥተ፡ ሰኰናኪ፡ Jer. 13,22; Joh. 13,18. 3 ungula, equi Gen. 49,17; Jud. 5,22; ሰኰና፡ አፍራሲሆሙ፡ Jes. 5,28 var.; ἴχνος κτηνῶν ሰኰና፡ እንስሳ፡ Hez. 32,13; πτέρναι τῶν ποιμνίων Cant. 1,8; ἀκρωτήρια Lev. 4,11; ὁπλή Mich. 4,13; ዘንፉቅ፡ ሰኰናሁ፡ Lev. 11,3-7; Deut. 14,6-8; እለ፡ ሰኰና፡ (v. ጽፍረ፡) ላህም፡ እግሪሆሙ፡ ὀνοκένταυροι Jes. 13,21; Jes. 34,14. – Voc. Ae.: ሰኮና፡ ብ፡ ተረከዝ።

woorden.betekenis: fenestra, lumen, maskot, masākǝw, fenêtre, masākut, window
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. መሳክው፡ [cfr. مِشْكَاةٌ] fenestra, (lumen), θυρίς Gen. 26,8; Jos. 2,15; 1 Reg. 19,12; 3 Reg. 6,8; 4 Reg. 9,30; 4 Reg. 9,32; 4 Reg. 13,17; Jes. 24,18; Jer. 9,21; Jer. 22,14; Hez. 40,16; Hez. 40,22; አርኀወ፡ መሳክወ፡ ጽርሑ፡ Dan. 6,10; Joel 2,9; Prov. 7,6; Cant. 2,9; ዘይሔውጽ፡ እንተ፡ መሳክዊሃ፡ Sir. 14,23; 2 Par. 3,7 (ὀροφώματα); Hen. 72,3 seq.; Chron. Ax.; distinguuntur መሳክው፡ ለብርሃን፡ et መሳክው፡ ለንጻፌ፡ F.N. 37. maskot, Pl. masākǝw, መሳኩት፡ G መስኮት፡ maskot, Pl. መሳክው፡ masākǝw «fenêtre» Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 38v. 91 L መስኮት maskot (Pl. መሳክው፡ masākǝw, መሳኩት፡ masākut) window 365a C vid. also መሳክው፡

woorden.betekenis: vid. sub እስኩ፡
woorden.definitie: vid. sub እስኩ፡

woorden.betekenis: confugere, precibus, adire, queri, incusare, criminari, reum
woorden.definitie: I,1; Subj. ይስኪ፡ (raro ይስከይ፡, ut Hen. 89,15 in cod. Abbad. XXXV) 1 confugere in locum vel ad aliquem: ይሰኪ፡ ህየ፡ ቀታሊ፡ Num. 35,11; ከመ፡ ይስኪ፡ ህየ፡ Num. 35,15; Deut. 4,41; Deut. 19,4 seq.; Jos. 20,4 seq.; precibus vel auxilium petendo adire aliquem, c. ኀበ፡, ut: ሰከይኩ፡ ኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወሰአልክዎ፡ (ἐνέτυχον) Sap. 8,21; ይሰክዩ፡ ኀቤሁ፡ Clem. f. 194; c. Acc. Hen. 45,3. 2 queri; incusare; criminari, reum facere, accusare, agere in aliquem شَكَا et شَكِى; absol. Hen. 22,5; Hen. 22,6; ትትፈደዩ፡ ዕዳክሙ፡ ወትሰክዩ፡ ወትትዋቀሡ፡ ወትትላኰዩ፡ ወትትጋአዙ፡ Jes. 58,3; Jes. 58,4; ለእመ፡ ሰከዩ፡ ለለ፩እምኔሆሙ፡ si uterque actionem instituit F.N. 43; Did. 10; ዘይሰኪ፡ actor F.N. 43,6; አምጽኦ፡ ሰማዕት፡ ለጥያቄ፡ ላዕለ፡ ዘይሰኪ፡ testes producere actoris est F.N. 43,6; c. ለ፡ vel plerumque ኀበ፡ pers., apud quam queruntur vel actionem instituunt: Hen. 9,3; Hen. 89,15; Hen. 103,14; እመቦ፡ ዘሰከይዎ፡ ኀበ፡ ፈታሒ፡ F.N. 43,9; ሰከያ፡ (ለወለቱ፡) ለመኳንንት፡ Sx. Haml. 25; ሰከዩ፡ ሎቱ፡ ( Augusto ) ዘገብረ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ሄሮድስ፡ Jsp. p. 340; c. Acc. causae vel pers., quam queruntur vel accusant: Hen. 7,6; Hen. 22,7; Rom. 11,2; Lit. 172,4; እለ፡ ይሰክይዎ፡ ejus accusatores Jsp. p. 315; Alexandra ትሰክዩ፡ ለሄሮድስ፡ (Herodem) Jsp. p. 322; ከመ፡ ይስክይዎ፡ ኀበ፡ ቄሳር፡ Jsp. p. 363; ዘሰከየ፡ ግብረ፡ ዘኢይትሌበው፡ qui actionem haud perspicuam instituit F.N. 43,6; ዘሰከይዎ፡ reus F.N. 43,6; vel c. በእንተ፡ causae, F.N. 43,6; vel c. በ፡, ut: ይስክይዎሙ፡ ለአርድእት፡ በዘ፡ ሐሰዉ፡ ἐγκαλείτωσαν αὐτοῖς τὴν ψευδηγορίαν Cyr. c. Pall. f. 84. – Voc. Ae.: ሰከየ፡ ዘ፡ ተማሕፀነ፡ አጸላሂ፡ ይ።

woorden.betekenis: actio, accusatio
woorden.definitie: n. act. actio, accusatio F.N. 43,6; ለእመ፡ ሰከየ፡ ስክየተ፡ ዘጥዩቅ፡ F.N. 43,6; ስክየት፡ ዲበ፡ ጸላኢ፡ Prec. Mat.

woorden.betekenis: refugium, asylum
woorden.definitie: subst. refugium, asylum: አህጉር፡ ዘምስካይ፡ Num. 35,6; Num. 35,11 seq.; Deut. 19,4 seq.; Jos. 20,2 seq.; Ps. 3,3; Ps. 9,9; Ps. 32,20; Ps. 45,7; Christus ምስካዮሙ፡ ለግፉዓን፡ Deg.; ማርያም፡ ደብረ፡ ምስካያ፡ ለነፍስየ፡ III Sal. Mar. 9.

woorden.betekenis: taurus, aliud
woorden.definitie: subst., m., Pl. አስዋር፡ taurus [שׁוֹר ܬܰܘܪܳܐ ثَوْرٌ, vid. etiam ቶራ፡] μόσχος ሶር፡ አሐዱ፡ እምውስተ፡ አልህምት፡ Num. 29,8; Num. 28,11; Num. 28,19 seq.; Hez. 39,18; ταῦρος Jes. 5,17; Jes. 30,24; Jes. 34,7; Jer. 27,11; Gen. 32,16; Ps. 21,12; Matth. 22,4; Kuf. p. 115; Hen. 85,9; አልህምተ፡ አስዋር፡ βόες νομάδες 3 Reg. 3a,16; 3 Reg. 4,23. – Voc. Ae.: ሶር፡ ዘ፡ በሬ፡; aliud: አስዋር፡ ዘ፡ ገች።

woorden.betekenis: animal, quadrupedes, quadrupedes domesticae, pecus, jumentum
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., coll. et sing., Pl. እንስሳት፡ (F.N. 17), animal („a facultate locomotiva sic dictum, sicut مَاشِيَةٌ,“ Lud.) 1 in specie: quadrupedes, τετράποδα Gen. 1,24; Ex. 9,9; Ex. 9,10; Lev. 20,15; Num. 35,3; Job 12,7; Job 18,3; Job 35,11. 2 quadrupedes domesticae, pecus, jumentum (boves, oves, asini, cameli, al.) κτῆνος, κτήνη Gen. 6,19; Gen. 30,29; Gen. 47,1; Gen. 47,16; Job 1,3; Job 1,10; Job 42,12; Koh. 3,18; Prov. 12,10; Ps. 146,10; 1 Reg. 23,5; Ex. 9,3 seq.; Ex. 20,17; Lev. 11,2 seq.; Num. 32,1; Jes. 46,1; Jes. 63,14; Jer. 7,20; Sir. 7,22; Sir. 40,8; Joh. 4,12; Apoc. 18,13; βουκόλια 1 Reg. 30,20; ከመ፡ እንስሳ፡ ἴσα βουσίν Job 40,10; μόσχος Hez. 1,10; እንስሳየ፡ ዘእጼአን፡ 2 Esr. 12,14; ζῶον Hebr. 13,11; θηρίον Hebr. 12,20. 3 animal, bestia, brutum in genere; ζῶον ኵሉ፡ እንስሳ፡ ያፈቅር፡ ዘመዶ፡ Sir. 13,15; Sir. 43,25; 2 Petr. 2,12; ፪እንስሳ፡ (behemoth et leviathan) 4 Esr. 4,56; እንስሳ፡ ገዳም፡ Ps. 79,14; brutum Ps. 72,22; convicii causa impingitur haereticis, Sx. Enc. Hoc nomine appellantur quatuor animalia coelestia: ፬እንስሳ፡ Hez. 1,5 seq.; Apoc. 4,6; Lit. 165,1; Sx. Hed. 8; Cod. Mus. Brit. XXIX, 11; al. ʾǝnsǝsā C for ሐዋሬ፡ እንስሳ፡ vid. ሐዋሪ፡ (TraCES)

woorden.betekenis: fulcire, cohibere
woorden.definitie: I,2 quasi mole opposita fulcire i.e. cohibere aquas: ኢያሱ፡ ወልደ፡ ነዌ፡ ሰወቀ፡ ማየ፡ ዮርዳኖስ፡ ሎሙ (Israelitis) ወኀለፉ፡ Sx. Sen. 26.

woorden.betekenis: ignem facere, ignem, ferre
woorden.definitie: I,1 (Perf. nondum repertum est) ignem facere vel ignem (in acerra) ferre: ወአልቦ፡ ዘይሰውድ፡ (var. ዘይወስድ፡ እሳተ፡) በቤተ፡ ዔሳው፡ οὐκ ἔσται πυρφόρος τῷ οἴκῳ Ἡσαῦ Ob. 18.

woorden.betekenis: reducere
woorden.definitie: reducere vid. sub ሦጠ፡

woorden.betekenis: effundere, confundere
woorden.definitie: I,2 effundere, confundere: ሰወጠ፡ ልሳናቲሆሙ፡ Kuf. p. 43 ann. 14.

woorden.betekenis: hora, vigiliis, momentum temporis, pars temporis, extemplo,
woorden.definitie: vel ሰዓት፡, fem. et m., Pl. ሰዐታት፡ vel ሰዓታት፡ [שָׁעָה ܫܳܥܳܐ سَاعَةٌ vid. Ges. thes. p. 1455; amh. ሰዓት፡ et ሳት፡] 1 hora: Gen. 29,7; መስየ፡ ወድአ፡ ሰዓት፡ Marc. 6,35; Apoc. 9,15; Apoc. 11,13; Apoc. 17,12; መንፈቀ፡ ሰዓት፡ ἡμιώριον Apoc. 8,1; በአይ፡ ሰዓት፡ Apoc. 3,3; ኵሎ፡ vel ኵላ፡ ሰዐተ፡ Ex. 18,22; Ex. 18,25; 4 Esr. 9,42; በኵሉ፡ ሰዓት፡ Lev. 16,2; ጌሠመ፡ በዛቲ፡ ሰዓት፡ 4 Esr. 14,29; መጠነ፡ አሐቲ፡ ሰዓት፡ Dan. 4,16; በዛቲ፡ ሰዓት፡ Judith 13,4; ዕለት፡ ወሰዓት፡ Matth. 24,36; ጊዜ፡ ሰዐተ፡ ተሱዓት፡ Matth. 27,46 rom.; እስከ፡ ተሱዐት፡ ሰዓት፡ Did. 29; በስድስቱ፡ ሰዓት፡ Asc. Jes. 4,5; Marc. 15,25; Joh. 1,40; ጊዜ፡ ሣልስ፡ ሰዓት፡ Matth. 20,3 rom.; Herm. p. 7; በከየ፡ ሰዐተ፡ ነዋኀ፡ Sx. Nah. 14; ዐቢየ፡ ሰዓተ፡ 1 Reg. 20,41; እለ፡ ያሰግሉ፡ ውስተ፡ ሰዐታት፡ ወዕለት፡ ወለያልይ፡ Clem. f. 178; de horis precum canonicis Clem. f. 10-13. De horis nocturnis vel vigiliis: φυλακαί ሰዐታት፡ Ps. 76,4; Ps. 89,4; ከመ፡ ይዕቀቡ፡ ሰዐታተ፡ ደብተራ፡ 1 Par. 23,32; Judith 12,5; እምሰዐተ፡ ጽባሕ፡ ἀπὸ τῆς φυλακῆς πρωίας Ps. 129,6; በቀዳሚት፡ ሰዓት፡ Thren. 2,19; Jud. 7,19; Marc. 6,48. 2 momentum temporis, pars temporis, etiam minutissima: እምውእቱ፡ ሰዓት፡ Matth. 9,22; ሖረ፡ በሰዐቱ፡ extemplo, illico Phlx. 3; Phlx. 71; ለሰዐትከ፡ πρὸς ὥραν Philem. 15; ለሰዓት፡ πρόσκαιρος Hebr. 11,25; 2 Cor. 4,17- 3 tempus in genere; tempus statutum, certum, festum: ሰዐተ፡ መንሱት፡ Apoc. 3,10; Apoc. 14,7; በአሐቲ፡ ሰዓት፡ ἐν μιᾷ ἡμέρᾳ ለለ፡ ሰዐቱ፡ καθ᾽ ὥραν Deut. 33,14; ሠለስተ፡ ሰዐተ፡ ዘበዓልክሙ፡ τρεῖς καιρούς Ex. 33,14; ደኃሪት፡ ሰዓት፡ ይእቲ፡ 1 Joh. 2,18; እምቅድመ፡ ሰዓቱ፡ πρὸ ὥρας Job 24,6; እምሰዐት፡ እስከ፡ ሰዐት፡ 1 Par. 9,25; ለምንት፡ ይረስዖን፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለሰዓታትየ፡ Job 24,1.

woorden.betekenis: osculari
woorden.definitie: I,1 [amh. ሳመ፡] Subj. ይስዐም፡ osculari, c.c. Acc. Gen. 27,26; Gen. 27,27; Ruth 1,9; Ruth 1,14; Kuf. 22; Kuf. 26; Kuf. 31; 1 Reg. 10,1; እስዐም፡ እገሪሁ፡ Esth. 4,17 apocr.; Tob. 7,6; አኀዘቶ፡ ወሰዐመቶ፡ Prov. 7,13; ይስዕመኒ፡ በስዕመተ፡ አፉሁ፡ Cant. 1,2; Cant. 8,1; እስከ፡ ይትሌቃሕ፡ ይስዕመከ፡ ርእሰከ፡ Sir. 29,5; Matth. 26,48; Matth. 26,49; አዘዘ፡ ከመ፡ ይስዐም፡ እግረ፡ አቡሁ፡ Jsp. p. 332; አእጋረ፡ ክርስቶስ፡ ሎቱ፡ (in ejus gratiam) እንዘ፡ ትስዕሚ፡ Sx. 7Tachs. Enc.

woorden.betekenis: osculo excipi, se invicem osculari
woorden.definitie: et ተሰዐመ፡ III,1 osculo excipi, se invicem osculari: ናስተሐውዝ፡ በተስዕሞ፡ (v. ስዒም፡) Prov. 7,18; ተሐቀፉ፡ በበይናቲሆሙ፡ ወተሰዐሙ፡ (nisi malueris ወተሳዐሙ፡) Sx. Mij. 18.

woorden.betekenis: osculatio, osculum
woorden.definitie: n. act. et subst., osculatio, osculum Cant. 1,2; ሠናይ፡ ስዕመት፡ ዘጸላኢ፡ Prov. 27,6; Judas ወሀቦሙ፡ ስዕመተ፡ ትእምርት፡ Did. 29.

woorden.betekenis: torpor, torpedo, stupor, spasmus
woorden.definitie: (v. ሰዖዝዝ፡) subst. torpor, torpedo, stupor, spasmus Kuf. 23; Org.

woorden.betekenis: effudit, defluxit, fluxit, liquefactus est
woorden.definitie: rad., cui illustrandae comparaveris سَحَّ effudit; defluxit (e loco superiore); سَاحَ et سَاعَ med. i fluxit, ܫܳܚ liquefactus est.

woorden.betekenis: tabes, phthisis, tumor pedum, hydrops
woorden.definitie: subst., nomen morbi, tabes, phthisis: ደዌ፡ ሲሕ፡ ἀρρώστημα ἔμμονον Sir. 30,17; ደዌ፡ ሲሕ፡ ἀπορία (שַׁחֶפֶת) Lev. 26,16; Deut. 28,22; Macc. f. 14. – Voc. Ae.: ሲሕ፡ ዘ፡ ኮብሽ፡ (i.e. tumor pedum, hydrops ).

woorden.betekenis: alere, nutrire, cibum, victum praebere, sustentare
woorden.definitie: quadril. I [vicinum videtur זוּן ܙܳܢ, nec non ⲥⲁⲛϣ, ϣⲁⲛϣ] alere, nutrire, cibum vel victum praebere, sustentare animalis, homines; c.c. Acc. vel dupl. Acc.: Gen. 7,3; ከመ፡ እሴሲክሙ፡ Gen. 45,7; Gen. 45,11; Gen. 50,21; 2 Reg. 19,33; ሴሰይክዎሙ፡ እክለ፡ ወማየ፡ 3 Reg. 18,13; Deut. 1,31; Deut. 8,3; Deut. 8,16; ሴሰዮሙ፡ ለአቡሁ፡ ወለአኀዊሁ፡ ወለጥሪቶሙ፡ ኀባውዘ፡ Kuf. 45; ሴሰይክሙኑ፡ ለደቂቁ፡ Job 39,3; ለገብር፡ ሴስዮ፡ Sir. 30,33; Ps. 32,19; Ps. 80,15; Tob. 2,10; ኵሎ፡ አሚረ፡ ይሴስይዎሙ፡ (ለዐናብስት፡) ፪ ሰብአ፡ ወ፪ አባግዐ፡ Dan. apocr. 13,32; 4 Esr. 8,15; አዘዘ፡ ይሴስይዋ፡ እምነ፡ ዘይገብሩ፡ ሎቱ፡ ሲሳዮ፡ Judith 12,1; Matth. 6,26; ሴስዮት፡ Hen. 7,3; ይሴስየከ፡ ርስተ፡ ያዕቆብ፡ Jes. 58,14; አነ፡ እሴስዮሙ፡ ሕማመ፡ Jer. 23,15; ትሴስዮ፡ እክለ፡ ጥበብ፡ Sir. 15,3.

woorden.betekenis: ali, nutriri, vesci, cibum sumere, vietum quaeritare, vivere
woorden.definitie: III,1 refl. et pass. ali, nutriri, vesci, cibum sumere, vietum quaeritare vel vivere re: Hen. 60,24; ዘኢይፈቅድ፡ ይትቀነይ፡ ኢይሴሰይ፡ 2 Thess. 3,10; 1 Tim. 4,3; እለ፡ ይሴሰዩ፡ ውስተ፡ ማእድየ፡ 2 Esr. 15,17; c. Acc.: እለ፡ ይሴሰዩ፡ እክልየ፡ Sir. 20,16; Ps. 40,10; Ps. 126,3; ይሴሰዩ፡ ሰገመ፡ Jes. 30,24; ሐምለ፡ Rom. 14,2; ሲሳየ፡ Thren. 4,5; መሓስዐ፡ Am. 6,4; ዳፍንተ፡ Hez. 4,12; መዓረ፡ ወቅብአ፡ Hez. 16,13; ሶበ፡ አኅለቁ፡ ተሴስዮ፡ እክለ፡ Gen. 43,2; Gen. 6,21; 1 Tim. 4,6; c. በ፡ Gen. 50,20; Org. 2; c. እምነ፡ 4 Esr. 9,28; 4 Esr. 12,58; እምነ፡ ዘአምጻእኩ፡ እሴሰይ፡ Judith 12,2; እለ፡ ይሴሰዩ፡ እማእደ፡ ንጉሥ፡ Dan. 1,13; ኵሉ፡ እምኔሁ፡ ይሴሰይ፡ Dan. 4,9; አንስት፡ ይሴሰያ፡ እምግብረ፡ እደዊሆን፡ Clem. f. 190; ተሴሰዩ፡ እምጻማ፡ እደዊሆሙ፡ Sx. Ter 17.

woorden.betekenis: alimentum, nutrimentum, cibus
woorden.definitie: subst. alimentum, nutrimentum, cibus: ወሀብኩክሙ፡ አራዊተ፡ ለሲሲት፡ Kuf. 6; ልብስ፡ ወሲሲት፡ Kuf. 29; Kuf. 40; Macc. f. 25; Matth. 6,25; ሲሲተ፡ ልብ፡ ቃላታሁ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ Cyr. c. Pall. f. 65.

woorden.betekenis: adversarius, satanas, diabolus, daemonion
woorden.definitie: (etiam per ሠ, ut Herm. p. 47) subst., m., Pl. ሰይጣናት፡, nec non ሰያጥንት፡ (M.M. f. 236), proprie adversarius, deinde satanas, diabolus ( daemonion ) [שָׁטָן ܣܳܛܳܢܳܐ شَيْطَانٌ] σατάν 3 Reg. 11,14; σατανᾶς Matth. 16,23; Marc. 8,33; Matth. 4,10; Matth. 12,26; Luc. 10,18; 1 Tim. 1,20; Apoc. 2,9; διάβολος Job 1,6; Zach. 3,1; 1 Par. 21,1; Ps. 108,5; Hebr. 2,14; 1 Tim. 3,6; 1 Tim. 3,7; Apoc. 12,12; Apoc. 20,10; 1 Joh. 3,8; Joh. 6,70; Hen. 40,7; Kuf. 17; Kuf. 18; Kuf. 19; Asc. Jes. 2,2; Asc. Jes. 5,16; Asc. Jes. 7,9; Asc. Jes. 11,23; Asc. Jes. 11,41; Asc. Jes. 11,43; Clem. f. 4 seq.; ሰይጣነ፡ ትዝህርት፡, ሰይጣነ፡ ዝሙት፡, ሰይጣነ፡ ስብሓት፡ Phlx. 39; Phlx. 56al.; δαιμόνια 1 Tim. 4,1.

woorden.betekenis: gladius, ensis, acinaces
woorden.definitie: subst., m. (ut Kuf. 22; 1 Reg. 31,4; Jos. 5,13) et fem. (ut 1 Reg. 21,9; 1 par. 10,4; Hez. 21,28); Pl. አስያፍ፡ (Mich. 4,3; Hagg. 2,22) et plerumque አስይፍት፡ [سَيْفٌ ܣܰܝܦܳܐ] gladius, ensis, ῥομφαία Gen. 3,24; Jos. 5,13; 1 Reg. 13,19; 1 Reg. 21,8; 1 Reg. 25,13; 1 Reg. 31,4; 2 Esr. 14,18; 1 Par. 10,4; Ps. 7,13; 1 Ps. 36,16; Ps. 149,6; Cant. 3,8; Hez. 21,18; Hagg. 2,22; Mich. 4,3; ሰይፍ፡ በሊኅ፡ ዘክልኤ፡ አፉሁ፡ Apoc. 1,16; Hen. 8,1; Kuf. 5; በአፈ፡ ሰይፍ፡ Kuf. 34; ὁ ἀκινάκης acinaces Judith 16,9; መተሩ፡ ክሣዶ፡ በሰይፍ፡ Sx. Genb. 25; በዓለ፡ ሰይፍ፡ (qui capita amputat) Sx. Jac. 6.

woorden.betekenis: sex
woorden.definitie: rad. nominum numeralium, quae ad numerum sex pertinent.

woorden.betekenis: sex
woorden.definitie: nom. numerale, masculinis junctum, Acc. ስድስተ፡, sex Gen. 30,20; Ex. 25,32; Num. 7,3; ስድስቱ፡ ተወልዱ፡ ሎቱ፡ 1 Par. 3,4; ስድስቱ፡ ዕደው፡ Hez. 9,2; Jes. 6,2; Asc. Jes. 7,21; Asc. Jes. 10,5; Jac. 5,17; Apoc. 13,18.

woorden.betekenis: sex, sexies
woorden.definitie: nom. numerale 1 sex, potissimum ante nomina mensurarum usitatum: Ruth 3,15; Ruth 3,17; ዘዘርአ፡ ስድሰ፡ ያአቱ፡ ሥልሰ፡ Jes. 5,10; 1 Reg. 17,4; ግድሙ፡ ስድስ፡ በእመት፡ Dan. 3,1; Hez. 40,6; Dan. 40,12; Dan. 41,1 seq. 2 ስድስ፡ et ስድሰ፡ sexies Job 5,19; 4 Reg. 13,19.

woorden.betekenis: sextus, sexta pars, sādǝs, zasādǝs, zagabr ḫer, sixième sema
woorden.definitie: adj. numerale (ordin.), fem. ሳድስት፡ sextus Gen. 1,31; Hagg. 1,1; Hagg. 2,1; 4 Esr. 4,61; Num. 29,29; Asc. Jes. 8,1; Luc. 1,26; c. suff. 2 Reg. 3,5; ሳድስተ፡ (sexta pars) ኢፍ፡ Hez. 45,13. sādǝs G ዘሳድስ፡ zasādǝs ou ዘገብር፡ ኄር፡ zagabr ḫer sixième semaine du Carême ou dimanche dit du Bon Serviteur 454 C vid. also ገብር፡

woorden.betekenis: sex, sextus
woorden.definitie: nom. temporale sex (dies) et sextus (dies): Kuf. 1,2; Ex. 13,6; Ex. 23,12; Ex. 35,2; ነበረ፡ ህየ፡ ሰዱሰ፡ ዕለተ፡ Dan. apocr. 13,31; በሰዱሱ፡ ለጽልመት፡ Hagg. 2,1; Luc. 13,14.

woorden.betekenis: sexaginta, sexagesimus
woorden.definitie: (pro ስድሳ፡) nom. numerale sexaginta, ( sexagesimus ); ejus character est ፷፡; Dan. 3,1; ስሳ፡ ወ፪፡ Dan. 9,25; Dan. 9,26; ስሳ፡ በእመት፡ 2 Esr. 6,3; Cant. 6,8; Matth. 13,8; 1 Tim. 5,9; Apoc. 11,3.

woorden.betekenis: vid. sub ስንዱን፡
woorden.definitie: vid. sub ስንዱን፡

woorden.betekenis: omnipotens
woorden.definitie: n. peregr. sc. Σαδδαΐ שָׁדָּי omnipotens, nomen Dei: Hez. 10,5; Kuf. 15; Kuf. 27; Sx. Tachs. 23 Enc.

woorden.betekenis: propellere, expellere, extrudere, protrudere, ejicere, extur
woorden.definitie: I,1 [שָׁדַד شَدَّ vid. Ges thes. p. 1364] Subj. ይስድድ፡ 1 propellere, expellere, extrudere, protrudere, ejicere, exturbare: ሰደድዎሙ፡ እምአብያቲሆሙ፡ Job 24,12; Job 31,39; Sir. 28,15; ይሰዱከ፡ እምሰብእ፡ Dan. 4,22; Dan. 4,30; Kuf. 17; Kuf. 30; Jer. 23,2; ፍጡነ፡ እሰድዶሙ፡ እምኔሃ፡ Jer. 29,20; Thren. 3,42; 2 Esr. 23,3; Deut. 6,19. In specie a pellere domo uxorem, repudiare: እመ፡ ሰደዳ፡ ብእሲ፡ ለብእሲቱ፡ Jer. 3,1; Jer. 3,8; 2 Esr. 10,19; F.M. 6,7. b expellere potestate vel munere, Chrys. c ejicere vel expellere ex ecclesia, excommunicare; Syn.; አውጊዘክሙ፡ ስድድዎሙ፡ Clem. f. 202. d in exilium mittere, exterminare, relegare: ሰደዶ፡ ኀበ፡ ብሔር፡ ዘሰደድዎ፡ Sx. Jac. 18; ኀበ፡ አሐቲ፡ ደሴት፡ Sx. Jac. 21. e abigere, discutere, dispellere: ዘወገሮን፡ ለአዕዋፍ፡ ይሰድዶን፡ Sir. 22,20; ተፅናስከ፡ ይሰድዶሙ፡ ለአዕርበቲከ፡ Sir. 12,9; Hen. 40,7; tenebras, Sx. Enc. 2 persequi, insectari Koh. 3,15: Jer. 17,18; Ps. 108,15; Ps. 118,161; (de Ps. 101,9 vid. Ludolfi annotationes a. 1); Hen. 95,7; Kuf. 1; Kuf. 35; ሰደደ፡ ዓሣ፡ ድኅሬሆሙ፡ እስከ፡ ጌዶር፡ 2 Par. 14,13; Kuf. p. 136; christianos, ecclesiam Matth. 5,11; Matth. 5,14; Matth. 23,34; Phil. 3,6; Rom. 12,14; Sx. 3 foras emittere, excludere, ἀπέκλεισε Judith 13,1; ἐξαποστέλλειν (cum እምኀበ፡) Dan. apocr. 1,21; Marc. 5,40. 4 mittere (sed nonnisi aevo inferiore sicut in lingua amh.): ወሰደደት፡ ኀቤሃ፡ ብዙኀ፡ አምኃ፡ Jsp. p. 321, al. (At Mal. 1,8, quem locum Lud. affert, ad ወሰደ፡ referendus est).

woorden.betekenis: expelli, exturbari, protrudi, ejici, relegari, dispelli, exc
woorden.definitie: (vel ተሰድደ፡) III,1 1 expelli, exturbari, protrudi, ejici, relegari, dispelli, excommunicari: Hen. 32,6; Hen. 41,2; Hen. 46,8; Hen. 63,6; Hen. 63,10; ዐማፅያን፡ ይሰደዱ፡ እምውስቴታ፡ Prov. 2,22; ጊሜ፡ እንተ፡ ተሰደ፡ Sap. 2,4; Sap. 4,15; ይሰደዱ፡ እምቍርባን፡ F.M. 6,13; ይሰደድ፡ እምቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ vel እምትድምርተ፡ ምእመናን፡ F.M. 8,1, etiam absolute: ይሰደድ፡ excommunicetur Clem. f. 89; Clem. f. 192; Syn. 2 persecutionem pati: ተሰዱ፡ በዝናም፡ ወበበረድ፡ Sap. 16,16; ተሰዶትየ፡ διωγμός μου Thren. 3,19; ስደቱ፡ ዘይሰደድ፡ Asc. Jes. 3,13; ተሰዶ፡ διωγμός Rom. 8,35; 2 Tim. 3,11; Matth. 5,10.

woorden.betekenis: rad. inus, cui שָׂכַל ܣܟܰܠ potius quam سَحَرَ שָׁח
woorden.definitie: rad. inus, cui שָׂכַל ܣܟܰܠ potius quam سَحَرَ שָׁחַר comparaverim.

woorden.betekenis: divinationi se dedere, ominari, hariolari
woorden.definitie: III,2 divinationi se dedere, ominari, hariolari Did. 7(Platt p. 48); ዘይሴገል፡ በበድን፡ ርኩስ፡ Kid. f. 24; ተሰግሎ፡ በተኣምረ፡ ሰማይ፡ Kuf. 11.

woorden.betekenis: divinatio, hariolatio, ominatio, augurium, astrologia, magia
woorden.definitie: subst., Pl. ሰገላት፡ (Lud. e Syn.) divinatio, hariolatio, ominatio, augurium, astrologia, magia, μαντεία Mich. 3,6; Jes. 16,6; Hez. 13,7; μαντεῖον Prov. 16,10; እስመ፡ ሐሰዉ፡ ሰገሎሙ፡ ወተዋርዶቶሙ፡ ለከ፡ እምልቦሙ፡ ዘፈጠሩ፡ ይትኔበዩ፡ Jer. 14,14; ሰገለ፡ ይሴአል፡ ἐν συμβόλοις ἐπηρώτων Hos. 4,12; οἰωνισμός Num. 23,23; Sir. 31,5; በኀይለ፡ ሰገልኪ፡ τῶν ἐπαοιδῶν σου Jes. 47,9; Jes. 47,12; ሰብአ፡ ሰገል፡ μάγοι Dan. 1,20; Dan. 2,2 seq.; Dan. 4,3; Dan. 5,15; Matth. 2,16; Clem. f. 12,33; saepissimo in aliis libris, ut Syn., Sx., al.; እለ፡ ይገብሩ፡ ሰገለ፡ Sx. Enc.

woorden.betekenis: occludendi
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., cui primitus potestas cohibendi vel occludendi infuisse videtur (coll. שְׁגַם, ܫܓܰܡ ܙܓܰܡ ܙܓܰܪ سَجَمَ, al.).

woorden.betekenis: status muti
woorden.definitie: n. act. status muti Kuf. p. 49.

woorden.betekenis: hordeum
woorden.definitie: et ስገም፡ subst. m. et fem., [etymon obscurum est; nescio an componi possit cum כֻּסֶּמֶת] hordeum Ex. 9,31; Lev. 27,16; Num. 5,15; Deut. 8,8; Jud. 5,8; Jud. 7,13; Ruth 1,22; Ruth 2,17-23; Ruth 3,15; Ruth 3,17; 2 Reg. 14,30; 2 Reg. 21,9; 3 Reg. 4,21; 1 Par. 11,13; Judith 8,2; Jes. 28,25; Jes. 30,24; Jer. 48,8; Hez. 13,19; Hagg. 2,16; Job 31,40; Joh. 6,9; Joh. 6,13; Apoc. 6,6; Macc. f. 5ubi ሰከም፡ scriptum reperitur. – Voc. Ae.: ሰገም፡ ብ፡ ገብስ።

woorden.betekenis: amygdala
woorden.definitie: (v. ሰጋድ፡) subst. amygdala arbor [שָׁקֵד שִׁגְדָא ܫܶܓܕܬܳܐ] Kuf. 21.

woorden.betekenis: se prosternere, procumbere, humillime adorare, submisse vene
woorden.definitie: I,1 [סָגַד ܣܓܶܕ سَجَدَ] Subj. ይስግድ፡, se prosternere vel procumbere coram aliquo, fronte humum tangendo, honoris testificandi vel adorandi causa; provolutum in genua vel prostratum in terra humillime adorare, submisse venerari, precibus venerari homines, Deum (προσκυνεῖν): ሰገደት፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ Ruth 2,10; ሰገደ፡ በብረኪሁ፡ 2 Par. 6,13; ይሰግዱ፡ በገጾሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ Sir. 50,17; Gen. 18,2; Gen. 42,6; Gen. 48,12; 1 Reg. 25,41; 2 Reg. 18,28; 2 Reg. 24,20; Matth. 26,39: Marc. 14,35; Hebr. 11,21; c.c. ለ፡ pers.: ይሰግዱ፡ ሎቱ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ Esth. 3,2 seq.; 1 Reg. 24,9; Jes. 45,14; Asc. Jes. 9,31; ይሰግዱ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ Jes. 27,13; Ex. 20,5; Kuf. 11; Kuf. 20; Ep. Jer. 5; Zach. 14,16: ደነኑ፡ ወሰገዱ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ 2 Esr. 18,6; ይሰግዱ፡ ለፀሓይ፡ Hez. 8,16; Ps. 28,2; Matth. 4,10; Matth. 15,25; Apoc. 19,10; ከመ፡ ለስሙ፡ ይስግድ፡ ኵሉ፡ ብርክ፡ Phil. 2,10; c. ቅድመ፡ Kuf. 12; Gen. 23,7; Gen. 23,12; ሰገደት፡ ታሕተ፡ እገሪሁ፡ Esth. 8,3; absol.: ንሰግድ፡ ወሰጊደነ፡ ንገብእ፡ Kuf. 18; Gen. 22,5; ያስተበርክ፡ ወይሰግድ፡ ወይጼሊ፡ Jes. 44,17; እለ፡ መጽኡ፡ ይስግዱ፡ ውስተ፡ ቤተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Jer. 33,2; Joh. 4,20. Nota locum: ይከውን፡ ጸሎት፡ በሰንበት፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ሰጊድ፡ ዲበ፡ ምድር፡ አላ፡ በደኒን፡ ወአትሕቶ፡ ርእስ፡ II Can. Nic. 32.

woorden.betekenis: facere ut quis se prosternat, adoret
woorden.definitie: II,1 facere ut quis se prosternat, adoret: Mavâs. 13 (vid. sub ሆባይ፡); Deg.; Org. 1; c. dupl. Acc.: ሥጋ፡ እንተ፡ ነሥአ፡ (ὁ Λόγος) እምኔነ፡ አስገዶሙ፡ ለመላእክት፡ Chrys. ho. 5.

woorden.betekenis: adorari
woorden.definitie: III,1 adorari (ritu solemni) Christus እመላእክት፡ ይሰገድ፡ Hom. Procli in Cyr. f. 121; ለግሙራ፡ ኢይወጽእ፡ እምተሰግዶ፡ እምኔነ፡ ወእምቅዱሳን፡ መላእክት፡ ዋሕድ፡ (Filius Dei) προσκυνεῖσθαι πρὸς τῶν Cyr. ad Theod. f. 19; Org.

woorden.betekenis: demergi, submergi, aquis hauriri, obrui, sidere, paene mergi
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 demergi, submergi, aquis hauriri vel obrui: Ex. 14,28; Ps. 140,7; Hen. 1,7; Hen. 48,9; Hen. 56,8; Hen. 81,8; Hen. 83,4; Hen. 89,6; እመ፡ ተሰጥሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ቀላየ፡ ባሕር፡ Am. 9,3; Jes. 29,4; Jes. 32,2; Jer. 28,64; ወረዉ፡ ነፍሳቲሆሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ፈለግ፡ ወተሰጥሙ፡ Jsp. p. 354; ተሰጢሞሙ Hebr. 11,29; Matth. 14,30; አልጸቀት፡ ሐመር፡ ለተሰጥሞ፡ Sx. Mij. 25; transl. Ps. 106,27; ተሰጠምነ፡ በኀጣውኢነ፡ 4 Esr. 6,43; ተሰጥሞ፡ ውስተ፡ ጣዕማት፡ F.M. 17,4. 2 sidere ( paene mergi ), de navi: እስከ፡ ይሰጠማ፡ Luc. 5,7.

woorden.betekenis: pinus
woorden.definitie: n. peregr. sc. στρόβιλος pinus Kuf. 21.

woorden.betekenis: acceptio, approbatio, sǝṭwat, acceptance, approval, acquiesc
woorden.definitie: n. act. acceptio, approbatio Kuf. p. 65. sǝṭwat L ስጥወት sǝṭwat acceptance, approval, acquiescence, answer 519b

woorden.betekenis: se extendere, expandere, protendere, dilatare, extendere, di
woorden.definitie: I,1 [vic. ጸፍሐ፡, צָפַח, צָפָה ܛܦܰܚ صَفَحَ شَبَحَ سَبَحَ ሰብሐ፡; amh. ሰፋ፡] Subj. ይስፋሕ፡ A intransit. se extendere, expandere, protendere, dilatare, Gen. 49,13; Prov. 23,32; Sap. 7,24; Sap. 8,1; 3 Reg. 2,35; 3 Reg. 4,25; Herm. p. 80(quamquam hoc loco etiam III,1 interpretari licet); እምቅድመ፡ ይስፍሑ፡ ደመናት፡ Lit.
