Orth.; Org. 1 B transit. 1 extendere, distendere, protendere, expandere, pandere: እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘሰፍሐ፡ ሰማየ፡ Zach. 12,1; Job 9,8; Jes. 40,22; Jes. 44,24; Jes. 51,16; Jer. 10,12; Jer. 28,15; መሥገርተ፡ Hos. 5,1; Thren. 1,13; Hez. 19,8; ሰፍሑ፡ ሠቃቲሆሙ፡ Judith 4,11; መንጸፈ፡ Deut. 22,17; አዕጻደ፡ Ex. 40,17; አልባሰ፡ Ex. 19,10 var.; ፀምረ፡ Jud. 6,37; እሰፍሕ፡ ላዕሌክሙ፡ ማእሰ፡ Hez. 37,6; አዕጹቀ፡ Ps. 79,12; ሰፍሐት፡ ማእደ፡ ቅድሜሆሙ፡ ወአንበረት፡ ሥጋ፡ ላዕለ፡ ማእድ፡ Jsp. p. 369; ዐራተ፡ Act. 9,34; መካይደ፡ Ps. 59,9; alas: ይቀውም፡ ሰፊሖ፡ ክነፊሁ፡ Job 39,26; Jer. 29,23; Jer. 31,40; እግረ፡ Job 30,12; Gen. 49,33; Kuf. 23. a in specie: manus Ex. 3,20; Ex. 4,4; Ex. 4,26; Ex. 4,27; ሰፍሑ፡ እደዊሆሙ፡ ወነሥኡ፡ Kuf. 8; ሰፍሐ፡ እዴሁ፡ ይንሣእ፡ መጥባሕተ፡ Kuf. 18; Gen. 8,9; እደዊሃ፡ ይሰፍሕ፡ ዲበ፡ ዘይበቍዕ፡ Prov. 29,37; ትሰፍሕ፡ መዝራዕታ፡ ለፈቲል፡ Clem. f. 190; Matth. 8,3; Matth. 26,51; ሰፍሐ፡ እዴሁ፡ ኀቤየ፡ Jer. 1,9; Matth. 12,49; c. ላዕለ፡ pers. Luc. 22,53; ad adjuvandum: እሰፍሕ፡ እደዊየ፡ ለሕዝብ፡ ዐላውያን፡ Jes. 65,2; ad precandum: ሰፍሐት፡ አፃብዐ፡ እደዊሃ፡ ውስተ፡ ሰማይ፡ Kuf. 25; Jer. 4,31; 2 Par. 6,12; ad largiendum ( aperire manum): ስፉሕ፡ እዴሃ፡ ወሀብ፡ Sir. 14,13; Sir. 40,14; ለነዳይ፡ ስፉሕ፡ እዴከ፡ Sir. 7,32; Prov. 29,38; Ps. 144,17; ትሰፍሕ፡ እደዊሃ፡ ለውሂብ፡ Clem. f. 190. b expandere vel patefacere epistolam, ut ab omnibus legi possit; ἐκτιθέναι Esth. apocr. 8,13 (bis). c protendere i.e. porrigere: ሰፍሐ፡ ክሣዶ፡ ወመተሩ፡ ክሣዶ፡ በሰይፍ፡ Sx. Genb. 25. d distendere distorquendo: እንዘ፡ ይሰፍሕዎ፡ ሐቌ፡ Sx. Sen. 19 Enc. e Ps. 62,2 Aethiops legit: πῶς ἁπλῶς σοι ἡ σάρξ μου; ሰፍሐ፡ enim expandere idem valet quod ἁπλοῦν, vid. ስፉሕ፡ f extendere, protendere እኪተ፡ Hen. 99,11; ምሕረተ፡ Ps. 35,11. 2 dilatare, latum facere πλατύνειν Ex. 34,24; Matth. 23,5.

woorden.betekenis: facere ut extendatur, dilatare, latum et amplum facere, dist
woorden.definitie: II,1 facere ut extendatur, dilatare, latum et amplum facere, distendere, diducere: አስፊሖሙ፡ ርእሶሙ፡ ውስተ፡ አስትቶ፡ εὐρυνόμενοι εἰς εὐθυμίαν Cyr. c. Pall. f. 87; ያስፍሕ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለያፌት፡ Kuf. 7; Kuf. 24; አስፍሐ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ እደ፡ ኵርሽ፡ (Cyri) ወአኀየሎ፡ Jsp. p. 276(vid. ተሰፍሐ፡); Org. 2; (seprens) አስፍሐ፡ (fauces) Gad. Ad. f. 16.

woorden.betekenis: extensus, expansus, extensam habens manum, patens, latus, am
woorden.definitie: part. et adj. 1 extensus, expansus: ክነፊሆሙ፡ ስፉሓን፡ 2 Par. 3,13; Hez. 1,11; ሰይፉ፡ ስፍሕት፡ ውስተ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፡ 1 Par. 21,16; ስፉሕ፡ እደዊሆን፡ Herm. p. 76; Herm. p. 84; ስፍሕተ፡ እድ፡ extensam habens manum Org. 5. 2 patens, latus, amplus, spatiosus: ምድር፡ ቡርክት፡ ወስፍሕት፡ Kuf. 8; Jes. 8,8 var.; 2 Esr. 19,35; ርሒብ፡ ወስፉሕ፡ παλτεῖς καὶ εὐρύχωροι Jes. 33,21; 4 Esr. 5,3; ስፍሕት፡ ፍኖት፡ Matth. 7,13; Clem. f. 167; hinc ስፉሕ፡ spatium amplum: አሐውር፡ ስፉሐ፡ ἐν πλατυσμῷ Ps. 118,45. 3 (opp. implicito, contorto, simulato) simplex, integer, sincerus, ἁπλοῦς Matth. 6,22; በስፉሕ፡ ልብ፡ ἐν ἁπλότητι καρδίας Sap. 1,1; Eph. 6,5; Col. 3,22; Herm. p. 6; Herm. p. 25; Clem. f. 174; በንጹሕ፡ ልብ፡ ወበስፉሕ፡ ኅሊና፡ Org.; hinc ስፍሕት፡ simplicitias, sinceritas Herm. p. 15; Herm. p. 91, et ስፉሐ፡ simpliciter, sincere: ዘይኔጽር፡ ስፉሐ፡ ὁ πλέπων λεῖα Prov. 12,13; vel በስፉሕ፡ Jac. 1,5. 4 liberalis (proprie: qui apertam habet manum, vid. ሰፍሐ፡) እግዚአብሔር፡ ስፉሐ፡ ሀብት፡ Genz. f. 87. 5 obductus, obtentus (vid. ተሰፍሐ፡ n. 3): ዘሕብረ፡ በረድ፡ ስፉሕ፡ ዲበ፡ ክነፊሆሙ፡ Hez. 1,22.

woorden.betekenis: extensio, latitudo, tractus, res expansa, extensa, simplicit
woorden.definitie: (raro ሰፍሕ፡) subst. 1 extensio, latitudo, tractus (vid. ጽፍሕ፡): ውስተ፡ ሰፍሐ፡ በሓውርት፡ τὸ πλάτος τῆς χώρας Jes. 8,8; እለ፡ የሐውሩ፡ በስፍሐ፡ ምድር፡ Hab. 1,6; እላስ፡ ወኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ ምስሌኪ፡ ዘስፍሖሙ፡ Hez. 27,13; τὸ κύτος Dan. 4,17; Job 11,9 var.; Chron. Ax. f. 89; Lit. Epiph.; ይኩን፡ ስፍሐ፡ ምጣኔ፡ ማእከለ፡ ቤት፡ ወቤት፡ ፲ወ፪መከየድ፡ F.N. 37. 2 res expansa vel extensa: ውስተ፡ ስፍሐ፡ ይብስት፡ ፀምር፡ እንዘ፡ ይወርድ፡ ጠል፡ Sx. Tachs. 16Enc. (cfr. Jud. 6,37); segmenta hostiarum expansa Kuf. p. 56; Pl. ስፍሓት፡ Kuf. p. 57. 3 simplicitas, sincritas: ስፍሐ፡ ልብ፡ Herm. p. 98. 4 stamen (telae), στήμων Lev. 13,48-58; hom. Procli in Cyr. f. 119(vid. sub ምሕን፡); Lit. 170,3.

woorden.betekenis: extensio, expansio, liberalitas, amplitudo, capacitas
woorden.definitie: n. act. 1 extensio, expansio: በስፍሐተ፡ እዴሁ፡ (Christi) በዲበ፡ ዕፀ፡ መስቀል፡ Clem. f. 218. 2 apertio manus i.e. liberalitas: ስፍሐተ፡ እድ፡ Clem. f. 211. 3 amplitudo, capacitas: ንበሩ፡ ውስተ፡ ስፍሐተ፡ (var. pro ስፍሕት፡) ፍናው፡ (ubi viae ampliores, latiores fiunt) 4 Reg. 11,6; ስፍሐታ፡ ለማኅደር፡ F.N. 23.

woorden.betekenis: numerare, metiri, dimetiri, admetiri, metiendo distribuere,
woorden.definitie: I,1 [amh. idem; סָפַר numerare; de etymo vid. Ges. thes. p. 966] Subj. ይስፍር፡ metiri, dimetiri, et fune mensorio, cubito al.: ከመ፡ ይስፍራ፡ ለኢየሩሳሌም፡ Zach. 2,2; Hez. 40,11; Hez. 40,13; Hez. 40,23; Hez. 45,3; ሰፊሮሙ፡ በአሕባል፡ 2 Reg. 8,2; et mensura cubica Ex. 16,18; Ruth 3,15; ስእኑ፡ ኈልቆቶ፡ ወሰፊረ፡ እምነ፡ ብዝኁ፡ Kuf. 40; Matth. 7,2; Marc. 4,24; መኑ፡ ዘሰፈሮ፡ ለማይ፡ በሕፍኑ፡ Jes. 40,12; 4 Esr. 2,8; 4 Esr. 2,46. In specie a admetiri c. ለ፡ pers. Gen. 47,12; Kuf. p. 149. b metiendo distribuere vel attribuere: ይሰፍርዋ፡ ለምድርከ፡ በሐብል፡ Am. 7,17; Mich. 2,4; Hen. 70,3; Num. 34,29. c mensura et numero definire: ሰፈራ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለመንግሥትከ፡ Dan. 5,26. d in libris amharico-aethiopicis: castra metari, ut: ግዕዘ፡ እምነ፡ አራራ፡ ወሰፈረ፡ ውስተ፡ ዱቂ፡ Chr. L. Atq. f. 23.

woorden.betekenis: mensura, immensus, extensio, longitudo, ad justam staturam,
woorden.definitie: , raro መስፈር፡ (Lud.) subst., plerumque m., Pl. መሳፍር፡ { Pl. መስፈርታት፡ 3 Reg. 18,32 var. (in Cod. Abb. XXXV)}: 1 mensura (et cubitalis et cubica): ሐብለ፡ መስፈርት፡ σχοινίον γεωμετρικόν Zach. 2,1; Jes. 34,11; ላዕሌሁ፡ አልቦ፡ መስፈርተ፡ ἀμέτρητος immensus Bar. 3,25; አልቦ፡ መስፈርተ፡ ለ፡ Org. 1; διαμέτρησις 2 Par. 3,3; (cubica:) Matth. 7,2; Marc. 4,24; ገብረ፡ ማየ፡ በመስፈርት፡ Job 28,25; በመስፈርት፡ ἐν μέτρῳ Judith 7,21; Sir. 42,7; ንገብር፡ መስፈርተ፡ ንስቲተ፡ Am. 8,5; Zach. 5,6; Sir. 42,4; Kuf. 40; መሳፍር፡ M.M. f. 264; መሳፍር፡ ክልኤ፡ Prov. 20,10; መስፈርተ፡ ኢፍ፡ Ruth 2,17; Num. 15,4 seq.; መስፈርተ፡ ኢን፡ Num. 15,4 seq.; በመስፈርተ፡ አርጣቦስ፡ Dan. apocr. 13,3. a Pro variis mensurarum specialium nominibus መስፈርት፡ nudum: κόρος 2 Par. 2,10; 2 Par. 4,5; 2 Par. 27,5; οἰφί 1 Reg. 17,17; κύαθος Ex. 25,29; δέκατον Lev. 14,20; Lev. 14,21; μετρητής 3 Reg. 18,32; Joh. 2,6; κανοῦν Lev. 8,2; Lev. 8,26; Lev. 8,31; χοῖνιξ Apoc. 6,6. b Etiam de mensura ponderalium: ወሀቦ፡ ሤጦ፡ ለውእቱ፡ መካን፡ በመስፈርተ፡ ወርቅ፡ ፮፻፡ 1 Par. 21,25; ኢይግበሩ፡ ዐመፃ፡ በውስተ፡ ሐሳበ፡ አውራኆሙ፡ ወኢበመሳፍረ፡ ሚዛኖሙ፡ Macc. f. 10. c extensio, longitudo: አብጽሖሙ፡ ውስተ፡ መስፈርተ፡ አካል፡ ad justam staturam (alias መጠነ፡ አካል፡) Ssal. Req. 2 metrum, rhythmus Cyr. c. Pall. f. 65(vid. sub አምጣን፡).

woorden.betekenis: mǝsfār, hump of animal, arm, leg, yäsǝga sǝfr, safara
woorden.definitie: subst. 1 i.q. መስፈርት፡ Kuf. p. 141 ann. 8. 2 ምስፋር፡ (v. ምዕራፍ፡) ወክንፋር፡ ዘ፡ ሻኛ፡ መዝራዕት፡ ወርች፡ Voc. Ae. mǝsfār L ምስፋር mǝsfār (, 1200) hump of animal, (Sw. in 405) arm, leg; 1200 explains it through Amh. yäsǝga sǝfr ‘heap (or ‘quality’) of meat’; vid. ሰፈረ safara I 363a C vid. also ምንፋር፡

woorden.betekenis: sapphirus
woorden.definitie: nomen gemmae, sine dubio sapphirus Sx. Masc. 16; Sc. Jac. 19 Enc.; Deg.; Org. 7. (Aliud ሶፎር፡ sc. Σωφίρ occurrit Job 22,24).

woorden.betekenis: spem facere, promittere, polliceri, confidere facere, minita
woorden.definitie: II,2 spem facere, promittere, polliceri, ( confidere facere ), c. dupl. Acc.: ዘአሰፈወ፡ διαθήκη Gen. 15,18; ἐνελπίζειν Ps. 118,49; 4 Esr. 7,21; አሰፈውክሙ፡ ለዝ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ሐሰተ፡ πεποιθέναι ἐποίησας ἐπί Jer. 35,15; ἐπαγγελία Rom. 4,16; Rom. 9,4; Hebr. 11,9; Jac. 1,12; 1 Joh. 2,55; Tit. 1,2; አሰፈዎሙ፡ ብዙኀ፡ ንዋየ፡ Jsp. p. 358; c. Acc. pers.: Rom. 9,9; Hebr. 6,13; c. ለ፡ pers. Hebr. 9,15; c. Acc. rei: ከመ፡ ታግዕዞ፡ እንተ፡ አሰፈውከ፡ Sir. 7,21; c. ለ፡ rei: እመክር፡ ከመ፡ ኣሰፍዎ፡ ለመርድእ፡ Jsp. p. 309; absol.: ለእመ፡ ወሀቡ፡ ወለእመ፡ አሰፈዉ፡ ለድኅር፡ (in posterum) F.M. 25,3; seq. Subj. verbi: Rom. 9,8; vel seq. ከመ፡ cum Subj. Sap. 17,8. { minitari alicui aliquid, Jsp. p. 297 vid. sub ጥብጣቤ፡}

woorden.betekenis: exspectare, sperare, confidere, spera, fructum laboris tuum
woorden.definitie: III,2 exspectare, sperare, ( confidere ), c.c. Acc. rei vel pers.: እሴፎ፡ ሕይወትየ፡ Job 2,9; Job 7,2; ምድር፡ እንተ፡ ትሴፎ፡ ዝናመ፡ Job 29,23; ተሰፎኩ፡ ብርሃነ፡ Job 30,26; ኪያየ፡ ይሴፈዉ፡ አሕዛብ፡ Jes. 51,5; Jes. 60,9; ይሴፈዉ፡ ሣህለከ፡ Jes. 38,18; ተሰፈውነ፡ ሰላመ፡ Jer. 8,15; Jer. 14,19; ተሰፎናከ፡ Jer. 14,22; Ps. 24,2; Ps. 24,5; Ps. 70,6; Ps. 70,15; Ps. 144,16; Sir. 2,9; Sir. 34,7; Sir. 34,15; ተሰፈው፡ ጻማከ፡ spera (laborem i.e.) fructum laboris tuum ἔμμενε τῷ πόνῳ σου Sir. 11,21; ተሰፊዎሙ፡ ንዋየ፡ Hebr. 11,1; Judae 21; Joh. 5,45; Rom. 8,24; Rom. 8,25; በተሰፍዎ፡ ከንቱ፡ ἐν κενῇ ἐλπίδι Job 7,6 (cfr. Jes. 29,8); c. በ፡ Ps. 117,9; c. ኀበ፡ Ps. 103,28; absol. Hen. 96,1; ከንቱ፡ (v. ከንቶ፡) ተሰፈወ፡ Jes. 29,8. Deinde verba subjunguntur, vel ope Infin. in Acc.: ኢይሴፎ፡ ሐይወ፡ Job 15,31; Job 24,23, vel ከመ፡ seq. Imperf. Hen. 98,10 (Hen. 46,6); vel ከመ፡ seq. Subj. Hen. 10,10; vel (omisso ከመ፡) seq. Subj. nudo: ኢይሴፈዉ፡ እንከ፡ ይርአዩኒ፡ Tob. 10,7; አዕይንተ፡ እስራኤል፡ ይሴፈዋከ፡ ታይዶዖሙ፡ 3 Reg. 1,20; Hen. 103,11; Act. 3,5; Rom. 15,24; Phil. 2,23, vel seq. Imperf. nudo: ተሰፈወ፡ ዳኅነ፡ ይነብር፡ v. ይንበር፡ Job 15,21; ተሰፈወ፡ ያዐርፍ፡ v. ያዕርፍ፡ Sir. 11,19.

woorden.betekenis: spes, expsectatio, desperantes, causa spei, promissio, promi
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. ተስፋት፡ 1 spes, expsectatio Job 4,6; Job 5,16; Job 8,13; Job 11,20; ለዕፅ፡ ቦ፡ ተስፋ፡ Job 14,7; Jer. 2,36; Hez. 37,11; Prov. 1,33; Prov. 11,7; Koh. 9,4; Sir. 14,2; 4 Esr. 6,35; 4 Esr. 7,22; Rom. 5,4; Rom. 8,24; Eph. 4,4; 1 Thess. 1,3; እለ፡ ቀብጹ፡ ተስፋሆሙ፡ desperantes Sir. 17,24; ሠናየ፡ ተስፋ፡ εὔελπις Sap. 12,19; c. per st. constr., ut: ተስፋ፡ ኀይል፡ Prov. 14,26; አልቦ፡ ተስፋ፡ ወፂእ፡ እምጽልመት፡ Job 15,22; c. ኀበ፡ Ps. 61,5; c. ዲበ፡ Hen. 63,7; c. ለ፡ et Infin., ut: እመቦ፡ ተስፋ፡ ለድኂን፡ Clem. f. 256; Herm. p. 18; ተስፋት፡ Phlx. 244; Saepius: causa spei; id quod vel a quo speratur: Gen. 49,10; Ps. 61,7; እስመ፡ ውእቱ፡ ተስፋሁ፡ Sir. 31,16; Jes. 24,16; Jer. 17,7; 2 Cor. 3,4. 2 promissio, promissum, ἐπαγγελία Rom. 15,8; 1 Tim. 4,8; Hebr. 6,15; Hebr. 11,13 (Hebr. 12,1); 1 Joh. 2,25; Act. 1,4; Act. 26,6; Luc. 24,49; እልክቱ፡ ተስፋት፡ Chrys. ho 11; Chrys. ho. 23; ፍኂር፡ ኪዳን፡ ውእቱ፡ ወተስፋ፡ F.N. 24,3. – Voc. Ae.: ተስፋ፡ ብ፡ አለኝታ።

woorden.betekenis: vox, verbum
woorden.definitie: vox, verbum vid. sub ቆለ፡

woorden.betekenis: vallis, locus depressus et humilis, regio, in alvei speciem,
woorden.definitie: (minus bene ቆላ፡), subst., m. et fem., Pl. ቈላት፡ [non tam cum ܓܰܠܳܐ (גַּל גַּלִּים), quam cum غَوْرٌ et غَوْلٌ (a rad. עוּר, חוּר, קוּר) componendum esse videtur; vid. etiam ቀላይ፡; forma nominis a ቀለወ፡ repetenda sit] 1 vallis, locus depressus et humilis, regio ( in alvei speciem ) depressior, κοιλάς, κοίλωμα, φάραγξ; Sing. ቈላ፡ Jes. 10,29; ቈላ፡ ዕሙቅ፡ Jes. 30,23; Hen. 26; Hen. 27; at frequentius occurrit ቈላት፡ pro sing. acceptum: Gen. 14,10; Gen. 23,2; Gen. 26,17; Gen. 37,14; Num. 13,23; Deut. 2,36; Kuf. 24; Jes. 15,7; Jes. 17,5; Jes. 22,1; Jes. 22,5; Jes. 28,21; Jer. 7,31; Jer. 21,13; Judith 12,7; Plur. ቈላት፡ Jes. 7,19; Jes. 8,7; Jes. 11,15; Jes. 34,9 ልገታተ፡ ቈላት፡ Hagg. 1,4; Cant. 2,1; Ps. 64,14; Ps. 103,11; Judith 2,8; Judith 7,4; Hen. 26,4; Hen. 26,5. 2 Hoc nomine appellant Aethiopes regiones Abyssiniae humiles ac depressas, ardoribus solis obnoxias, insalubres (opp. ደጋ፡, Isenb. lex. amh. p. 168; vid. . I,5,1; Bruce Bd. II p. 4. 536; IV p. 330; Rüppell Bd. II p. 133), ut: እስመ፡ መካነ፡ ብሔሩ፡ ቈላ፡ ውእቱ፡ Chr. L. Atq. f. 29.

woorden.betekenis: levitas, qǝllat, légèreté, agilité, rapidité, lightness, swi
woorden.definitie: n. act. levitas, Lud. sine auct. qǝllat G ቅለት፡ qǝllat levitas, légèreté, agilité, rapidité Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 54. 169 L ቅለት qǝllat lightness, (*, 169) swiftness, rapidity 428a

woorden.betekenis: calamus, stylus scriptorius, graphiarium, calamarium, ductus
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., Pl. አቅላም፡, Pl. Pl. አቅላማት፡ (Org. 4 1) calamus vel stylus scriptorius [قَلَمٌ], κάλαμος Ps. 44,2; Did. 30; 3 Joh. 13; Hen. 69,10; ቀለመ፡ ኀጺን፡ (עֵט) Jer. 17,1 vers. nov. 2 graphiarium, calamarium, ቀለመ፡ ጸሓፊ፡ በሐቌሁ፡ (קֶסֶת) Hez. 9,2 vers. nov.; Lud. comm. hist. p. 499 n. 26. 3 ductus calami p. 502 n. 37. a atramentum, color scriptorius [sicut in lingua Amh.]: ገቢረከ፡ ደመከ፡ ቀለመ፡ ወዐጽመከ፡ ብርዐ፡ Deg.; ጽሑፍ፡ በቀይሕ፡ ቀለም፡, በጸሊም፡ ቀለም፡ Abush. 46; (pictura in veste apparuit) እንበለ፡ ቀለም፡ ( sine colore picta) Sx. Tachs. 22Enc.

woorden.betekenis: commoveri, concuti, fluctuari, labefactari, vacillare, immob
woorden.definitie: V A intrans. 1 commoveri, concuti, fluctuari, labefactari, vacillare (σείεσθαι, σαλεύεσθαι, κινεῖσθαι; de fundamentis Ps. 17,9; muris, domibus Hez. 26,10; አብያቲሃ፡ ዘኢያንቀለቅላ፡ Jes. 33,20; statua: ከመ፡ ኢያንቀልቅል፡ Ps. 40,20; Ps. 41,7; columnis: አዕማዲሃ፡ ኢያንቀለቅል፡ Clem. f. 212; montibus, terra Jer. 4,24; Mich. 1,4; Nah. 1,5; Ps. 59,2; Ps. 92,2; Ps. 95,10; Jes. 13,13; pedibus Prov. 3,26; coelo Hen. 60,4 (አንቀልቅሎ፡) Matth. 24,29; navibus Hen. 101,4; Clem. f. 128; ያንቀለቅል፡ ለፌ፡ ወለፌ፡ Chrys. ho. 11; jugo: አርዑተ፡ ብዕራ፡ ዘያንቀለቅል፡ Sir. 26,7; ossibus Jer. 23,9; membris Job 9,28; cordo (አንቀልቅል፡) Hab. 2,16; hominibus Jer. 17,8; Jes. 22,25; 1 Thess. 3,3 Platt; ዘኢያንቀለቅል፡ immobilis Ex. 25,15; Hebr. 12,27; Hebr. 12,28. 2 rarius: se movere, amoveri ab aliquo: ኢያንቀለቅል፡ እኩይ፡ እምነ፡ ቤቱ፡ Prov. 17,13; Cant. 2,17. B transitive: ስእንዎ፡ አንቅልቅሎቶ፡ Luc. 6,48; Cant. 8,7; ያንቀለቅሎ፡ ነፋስ፡ Sap. 4,4; Am. 9,5; Job 9,5; አንቀልቀለ፡ አዕጽምትየ፡ Job 4,14; Phil. 1,28; አንቅልቅሉ፡ ሎቱ፡ κινήσατε αὐτῷ Jer. 31,17. ʾanqalqala G አንቀልቀለ፡ ʾanqalqala, V, ያንቀለቅል፡, ያንቀልቅል፡ concussit, moveri, ébranler, secouer, faire chanceler, être ébranlé, vaciller ― ነቀነቀ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 55. 170 L qlql II አንቀልቀለ ʾanqalqala move, shake, swing, quake, agitate, make tremble, vacillate, totter, stagger; some of the verbs are both transitive and intransitive ዘኢየንቀለቅል zaʾiyyanqalaqqǝl immovable goods 430a

woorden.betekenis: satelles praetoris, minorem, puella parva, famulus, domestic
woorden.definitie: subst., m., PI. ቍልዔያት፡ [ei Lud. comparavit قَلَّاعٌ satelles praetoris; fortasse propagatum est e rad. primaria ቀለለ፡, ob servi minorem sive aetatem (cfr. قُلَّى puella parva et de significatione נַעַר, غُلْمَانٌ al.) sive ordinem] famulus (domesticus, minister) παῖς, παιδάριον, θεράπων Gen. 18,7; Jud. 7,10; Jud. 19,3 seq. (νεανίας); 1 Reg. 1,14; 3 Reg. 18,43; Jer. 41,16; ቍልዓያት፡ Jsp. p. 286; Jsp. p. 291. In specie nomine ቍልዔ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ honorifico distinguuntur viri pietate eximii Gen. 18,17; Num. 14,24; Jos. 1,2; Jos. 11,12; Jos. 11,15; Kuf. 24; Job 2,3; Job 42,7; Job 42,8; Jes. 20,3; Jes. 22,20; Jos. 37,35; Jos. 43,10; Jos. 44,1; Jos. 44,21; Jos. 45,4; Jos. 52,13; Bar. 8,37; Hez. 28,26; 4 Esr. 5,30; Luc. 1,54; Luc. 1,69. – Voc. Ae.: ወዓሊ፡ ቍልዔ፡ ዘ፡ ሎሌ፡; aliud: ቍልዔ፡ ብ፡ ሎሌ፡ ወዳጅሂ፡ ይ፡ qʷǝlʿe, Pl. qʷǝlʿeyāt G ቍልዔ፡ qʷǝlʿe puer, famulus, enfant, adolescent, serviteur ― ልጅ፡, ወዳጅ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 55. 171 L ቍልዔ፡ qʷǝlʿe (Pl. ቍልዔያት qʷǝlʿeyāt) youth, boy, friend, servant, domestic 426b

woorden.betekenis: torrere, urere, mordere, pungere, condemnare, aliud
woorden.definitie: I,1 [vicinum est ቀለወ፡] proprio torrere, deinde transl. urere (i.e. mordere, pungere vel condemnare ), de conscientia: ይቀልየከ፡ ልብከ፡ (v. ልበከ፡ et በልብከ፡) 3 Reg. 2,44 (hebr.); Rom. 2,15; 1 Joh. 3,20 rom.; 1 Joh. 3,21 (καταγιγνώσκειν); ሊተሰ፡ ፈድፋደ፡ ያሐዝነኒ፡ ወያቴክዘኒ፡ ወይቀልየኒ፡ ልብየ፡ በእንተ፡ Macc. f. 19. – Voc. Ae.: ይቀልየነ፡ ዘ፡ ይዛለፈነ፡; aliud: ይቀልየነ፡ ዘ፡ የሐተነ፡ ወቦዘ፡ ይገልጽ።

woorden.betekenis: profundum, imum, abyssus, vorago, barathrum, qalāy, qalayāt,
woorden.definitie: subst. m. et fem., Pl. ቀለያት፡ et ቀላያት፡ profundum, imum tam maris et fluviorum quam terrae, abyssus, vorago, barathrum, βάθος Jes. 7,11 (opp. አርያም፡); ቀላየ፡ ባሕር፡ Jes. 51,10; Am. 9,3; Hez. 26,12; Luc. 17,2; ቀላያተ፡ አፍላግ፡ Job 28,11; Zach. 10,11; ቀላያተ፡ ማያት፡ Ps. 76,16; Ps. 68,18; ἄβυσσος Gen. 7,11; ቀላያት፡ ነቅዑ፡ Prov. 3,20; Ps. 32,7; Ps. 41,9; Ps. 103,7; Ps. 148,7; Job 28,14; Job 36,16; Job 38,16; ዕሙቅ፡ ቀላይ፡ Sir. 24,5; ማየ፡ ቀላይ፡ Sir. 24,29; Sir. 16,18; Sir. 42,18; Sir. 43,23; Jes. 44,27; Jes. 51,10; Dan. apocr. 3,31; Rom. 10,6; Apoc. 9,1; Apoc. 9,2; Apoc. 11,7; Kuf. 2; Kuf. 5; Kuf. 48; 4 Esr. 6,6; 4 Esr. 8,27; βόθυνος Jer. 31,43; Jer. 31,44; καταιγίς Ps. 68,19; λίμνη Luc. 8,22; ባሕርኑ፡ አው፡ ቀላይ፡ δράκων (תַּנִּין) Job 7,12; ᾅδης ዕመቃ፡ ለቀላይ፡ Job 11,8; Am. 9,2. Transl.: de rebus immense profundis, ut de misericordia Dei Org. 3. qalāy, Pl. qalayāt, qalāyāt G ቀላይ፡ qalāy abyssus, mare, abîme, gouffre, mer Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 55. 171 L ቀላይ qalāy (Pl. ቀለያት qalayāt) depth (of river, sea), ocean, gulf, abyss, pit, ravine, gully, underworld, lower regions, () pool, pond 431a

woorden.betekenis: praeputium, qʷǝlfat, prépuce, foreskin, prepuce, uncircumcis
woorden.definitie: n. act et subst., Pl. ቍልፈታት፡ (Jos. 5,3) praeputium 1 Reg. 18,27; Kuf. 1; Kuf. 15; Kuf. 30; Col. 2,13; Eph. 2,11; Gal. 2,8 Platt; Rom. 2,25; Rom. 2,26; Rom. 2,27. qʷǝlfat G ቍልፈት፡ qʷǝlfat praeputium, prépuce Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 55. 171 L ቍልፈት qʷǝlfat foreskin, prepuce, uncircumcised state 427b

woorden.betekenis: transpositis literis pro ቀምሐ፡ passim in libris Mss
woorden.definitie: transpositis literis pro ቀምሐ፡ passim in libris Mss. occurrit.

woorden.betekenis: colli indumentum, torques, monile, qāmā, qamā, ornamentum, c
woorden.definitie: subst. colli indumentum, torques, monile, μανιάκης Dan. 5,16; Dan. 5,29 in Cod. Curz. (v. ባዝግና፡); ሰላም፡ ለክሣድኪ፡ ቃማ፡ ንጽሕ፡ ዘዐነቀ፡ III Sal. Mar. 18; Form. Conf.; Sx. Nah. 30Enc. (vid. sub አስተርሰየ፡); ቃማ፡ ወርቅ፡ ይደይ፡ ውስተ፡ ርእሱ፡ Org. – Voc. Ae.: ቃማ፡ ዘ፡ የኀንገት፡ [Altera vocabuli forma est ገማ፡ De etymo haud constat. Num κημός ⲕⲏⲙⲟⲥ ܩܰܐܡܳܐ?]. qāmā, ቀማ፡ qamā G ቃማ፡ qāmā monile, ornamentum, collier (de femme), parure, ornement ― ዝርግፍ፡ ወርቅ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 55. 172 L ቃማ qāmā, ቀማ፡ qamā necklace, chain, collar, (Lt) neck (of an animal) 431b

woorden.betekenis: pabulum, carpere, et vorare, pasci, vesci, pinguis fuit, in
woorden.definitie: I,1 pabulum carpere (et vorare), pasci, vesci [قَمُؤَ pinguis fuit; in loco permansit ob pabuli copiam camelus; IV pinguefecit pecora pabulum; قَمْحٌ triticum; קֶמַח farina] proprie de bestiis: ይቀምሕ፡ በውስተ፡ ጎል፡ Job 6,5; c. Acc.: ይቀምሕ፡ ዐንበሳ፡ ሐሠረ፡ ከመ፡ ላህም፡ Jes. 11,7; Jes. 30,24; Jes. 65,25; ኢይረክቡ፡ አልህምት፡ ዘይቀምሑ፡ ውስተ፡ ምቅማሖሙ፡ Hab. 3,17; transfertur ad homines: ሐመደ፡ ከመ፡ እክል፡ ቀማሕኩ፡ Ps. 101,10; Ps. 71,9; Mich. 7,17; (infans cum alimenta noxia et salubria distinguere nesciat,) ይቀምሕ፡ መሬተ፡ ውስተ፡ አፉሁ፡ χοῦν ἐνέβαλε εἰς τὸ στόμα Chrys. ho. 8; (Judaei cum nec molere nec coquere possent) ይበልዑ፡ ኅጠተ፡ ሥርናይ፡ ጥራዮ፡ ወይቀምሑ፡ ሐሪጸ፡ Jsp. p. 367. – Rad. Abb.: ቀምሐ፡ ዘ፡ ኦፈረ፡ (i.e. አውፈረ). qamḥa G ቀምሐ፡ qamḥa I,1 ይቀምሕ፡, ይቅማሕ፡ edit, voravit (legumina de pecoribus), manger, dévorer les légumes, les graines (se dit des bestiaux) ― ቃመ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 55. 172 L ቀምሐ qamḥa I (yǝqmāḥ) eat grain or other fodder, gaze 431b

woorden.betekenis: esculentum, quod terra gignit, cujusvis generis, proventus,
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., Pl. አቅማሕ፡ et አቅማሕት፡ (Apoc. 18,14), Pl. Pl. አቅማሓት፡ (Jer. 2,21; Jer. 36,6) esculentum, quod terra gignit, cujusvis generis, proventus, fruges, fructus, γέννημα ፍጡነ፡ ትበልዕ፡ Sir. 6,19; ትጸግቡ፡ እምነ፡ ቀምሕየ፡ Sir. 24,19. a arborum et fruticum, poma, fructus auctumnales: ይተክሉ፡ ወይነ፡ ወይበልዑ፡ ቀምሖ፡ Jes. 65,21; አልቦ፡ ቀምሐ፡ ውስተ፡ ወይን፡ Hab. 3,17; βότρυς Deut. 32,32; ሠረጸ፡ ፍሬሃ፡ ከመ፡ ቆዐ፡ ቀምሕ፡ ὡς περκαζούσης σταφυλής Sir. 51,15; καρπός (ἀμτελώνων) Jes. 37,30; ኵሎ፡ አቅማሓተ፡ ጽድቅ፡ Jer. 2,21; ዐቃቢሁ፡ ለቀምሕ፡ ይሬኢ፡ ፍሬሁ፡ Sir. 27,6; ἀκροδρύα Cant. 4,13; Cant. 5,1; Cant. 7,14; ዕፀወ፡ ቀምሕ፡ ξύλον βρώσιμον 2 Esr. 19,25; ኵሉ፡ አቅማሐ፡ ገዳም፡ Joel l, 12; ὀπώρα Jer. 31,32; Jer. 47,10; Apoc. 18,14; ልገተ፡ ዐቃቤ፡ ቀምሕ፡ ὀπωροφυλάκιον Jes. 1,8; Jes. 24,20; Ps. 78,1. b herbarum et seminalium, in specie hortensium: olera, legumina, al.; κῆπος: ሰሚሮ፡ አቅማሒክሙ፡ Am. 4,9; Jer. 36,28; ትክሉ፡ አቅማሓተ፡ φυτεύσατε παραδείσους Jer. 36,5; አቅማሐ፡ አዝርእት፡ ("legumina seminum") et አቅማሐ፡ አትክልት፡ ("legumina olerum") Lud. ex Org. 2; አቅማሐ፡ አፈዋት፡ et ጽጌያት፡ ("fructus aromatum et florum") Lud. ex Org. c Inde ዐጸደ፡ ቀምሕ፡ hortus, viridarium, κῆποι ዐጸደ፡ አቅማሕ፡ Am. 9,14; παράδεισος አዕጻዳተ፡ ቀምሕ፡ Hez. 28,13; 2 Esr. 12,8; vel ገነተ፡ አቅማሕ፡ Dan. apocr. 1,7. – ቀምሕ፡ ብ፡ ፍሬ። qamḥ G ቀምሕ፡ qamḥ automnales frustus, fruit d’automne Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 55. 172 L ቀምሕ qamḥ produce, yield, fruit, leguminous plant 432a

woorden.betekenis: colligi, decerpi, vindemiari
woorden.definitie: III,1 colligi de fructibus, decerpi, vindemiari, de vino Num. 13,20; ficis Rel. Bar.; fructibus Kuf. 7; transl.: 4 Esr. 8,63; Org. 5.

woorden.betekenis: phialae, hydria, urceus, urna, qaśut, qasut, qaśutāt, qaśāwǝ
woorden.definitie: (etiam per ሰ) subst., m. et fem., Pl. ቀሡታት፡, ቀሣውይ፡ et ቀሣውት፡ [cfr. קְשָׂוֹת phialae, et ea quae Ges. thes. p. 1240 sub voce קֶסֶת comparata sunt] hydria, urceus, urna, ὑδρία (כַּד) Gen. 24,14-18; 3 Reg. 17,12; Joh. 4,28; ἀγγεία ስተይ፡ ማየ፡ እምቀሡትከ፡ Prov. 5,15; ቀሣውቲሆሙ፡ v. ቀሣውዪሆሙ፡ Jer. 14,3; ቀሣውቲክሙ፡ v. ቀሣውኢክሙ፡ Jer. 47,10; ቀሡተ፡ ልሕኵት፡ βίκος Jer. 19,1; Jer. 19,10; Jer. 19,11; ቀሡታት፡ Sx. Genb. 21; Gad. T.H. – Voc. Ae.: ቀሡት፡ ዘ፡ ማድጋ። qaśut, ቀሱት፡ qasut, Pl. qaśutāt, qaśāwǝt, qaśāwǝy G ቀሡት፡ qaśut hydria, vas aquae vel frugum, vase en terre pour l’eau et pour les céréales, légumes et fruits Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 56. 173 L ቀሡት qaśut (Pl. ቀሡታት qaśutāt, ቀሣውት qaśāwǝt, ቀሣውይ qaśāwǝy), () ቀሱት qasut vase, water pot, container for mead 448b

woorden.betekenis: virga, fuste, flagro, scutica caedere, percutere, verberibus
woorden.definitie: I,1 [etymon obscurius est; an שָׂפַק vel סָפַק?] Subj. ይቅሥፍ፡ 1 virga, fuste, flagro, scutica caedere vel percutere, verberibus castigare, verberare, flagellare: ዘይቀሥፍ፡ ብዕራሁ፡ Sir. 38,25; μαστιγοῦν Deut. 25,2; Deut. 25,3; 3 Reg. 12,11; Job 30,21; Prov. 3,12; Matth. 10,17; Hebr. 11,36; Hebr. 12,6; παίειν Job 5,18; πατάσσειν Jes. 5,25; Jes. 11,15; Jes. 14,6; ይቀሥፎሙ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ መቅሠፍተ፡ Jes. 19,22; Jes. 60,10; Jer. 20,2; φραγελλοῦν Matth. 27,26; Marc. 15,15; Clem. f. 179; ቦቱ፡ (ለሰይፍ፡) ይቀሥፎሙ፡ ለአሕዛብ፡ Apoc. 19,15. 2 in genere: plagam infligere, percutere, castigare, punire, de poenis et plagis a Deo inflictis: ቀሠፎ፡ በመቅሠፍት፡ ዐቢይ፡ Kuf. 13; ቅሥፎሙ፡ በመዐት፡ ወበእሳት፡ Sir. 33,11; ይቀሥፋ፡ ለምድር፡ በቃለ፡ አፉሁ፡ Jes. 11,4; ἐκδικήσω ὑμᾶς Jes. 57,16; Jer. 5,3; ቀሠፍከኒ፡ ወተቀሠፍኩ፡ Jer. 20,6; Ps. 6,1; Ps. 37,1; Apoc. 7,2; እቀሥፍ፡ ኵሎ፡ አፍራሰ፡ በድንጋፄ፡ Zach. 12,4. – Voc. Ae.: ቀሠፈ፡ ዘ፡ ገረፈ።

woorden.betekenis: verberari, flagellari, percuti, plaga affici, castigari, pun
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 verberari, flagellari Ex. 5,16; ተቀሢፎ፡ Prov. 17,10; ሕቡል፡ እንዘ፡ ይትቀሠፍ፡ Prov. 19,25; ተቀሥፎ፡ πληγαί 2 Cor. 6,5. 2 in genere: percuti, plaga affici, castigari, puniri Ps. 72,5; Job 15,11; Jes. 9,13; ሕማመ፡ ወመቅሠፍተ፡ ትትቀሠፍ፡ Jer. 6,7; Jer. 6,8; Jer. 20,7; Sap. 16,16; ተቀሥፈት፡ Apoc. 8,12; ትትቀሠፍ፡ በውሉዳ፡ Sir. 28,24.

woorden.betekenis: flagrum, flagellum, scutica, virgae, verber, plaga, vibex, c
woorden.definitie: raro መቅሠፍ፡ (ut Herm. p. 59) subst., m. et fem.; Pl. መቅሠፍታት፡ 1 flagrum, flagellum, scutica, virgae, μάστιξ መቅሠፍት፡ ወተግሣጽ፡ Sir. 22,6; Sir. 40,9; ቍስለ፡ መቅሠፍት፡ (v. አብትር፡) ይገብር፡ አምግልተ፡ Sir. 28,17; ድምፀ፡ መቅሠፍት፡ Nah. 3,1; 3 Reg. 12,11; 2 Par. 10,14; (Christus in templo) ነሢኦ፡ ሐብለ፡ ገብረ፡ መቅሠፍተ፡ ወሰደዶሙ፡ hom. Cyr. f. 129; transl. መቅሠፍተ፡ ልሳን፡ Job 5,21; Sir. 26,6. 2 verber, plaga, nec non vibex: πληγή Sir. 27,25; Jes. 10,24; Jes. 10,26; Jes. 14,6; Jes. 30,31; መጠውኩ፡ ዘባንየ፡ ለመቅሠፍት፡ Jes. 50,6; Jes. 53,10; Luc. 12,47; Luc. 12,48; Act. 16,33 rom.; ምንትኑዝ፡ መቅሠፍት፡ ዘማእከለ፡ እደዊከ፡ Zach. 13,6. 3 in specie: castigatio divina, plaga, calamitas, poena a Deo inflicta, πληγή Ex. 11,1; Ex. 12,13; Num. 25,18; Num. 26,1; Job 2,13; Apoc. 15,1; Apoc. 16,9 (መቅሠፍታት፡); μάστιξ Job 21,9; Sir. 23,11; Ps. 31,13; μετεωρισμοί Ps. 87,7; θυμός መቅሠፍተ፡ መዐት፡ Jes. 9,19; Jes. 12,1; Jes. 13,9; Jer. 43,7; Job 3,17; ὀργή Job 6,2; Sir. 16,11; Dan. 9,16; Jes. 10,6; መቅሠፍተ፡ መዐቱ፡ Jes. 42,25; Jes. 69,19; Jer. 21,5; Jer. 23,19; Thren. 1,12; Thren. 4,11; Ps. 6,1; Ps. 37,1; Rom. 1,18; Rom. 3,5; 1 Thess. 2,16; κόλασις መቅሠፍተ፡ ኀጢአቶሙ፡ Hez. 14,3; 1 Joh. 4,18; τιμωρία 1 Esr. 8,24; ἐκδίκησις ፬መቅሠፍት፡ Hez. 14,21; βάσανος Hez. 32,30.

woorden.betekenis: quidquid foris est, qaśf, qǝśf, which is outside, outdoors,
woorden.definitie: subst. quidquid foris est; ውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ በሓውርት፡ ቀሥፍ፡ (v. ዘቀሥፍ፡) ἐν πάσχῃ χώρᾳ τῇ ἔξω Esth. 9,19. qaśf, ቅሥፍ፡ qǝśf L ቀሥፍ qaśf, ቅሥፍ qǝśf which is outside, outdoors, outhouse, (OT) assembly (kept outdoors) 448a C vid. also ቅሥፍ፡ qǝśf

woorden.betekenis: pix
woorden.definitie: subst. [قَارٌ قِيرٌ] pix (liquida): ቃር፡ ወፒሳ፡ ወተይ፡ ወቅጥራን፡ Sx. Haml. 5.

woorden.betekenis: frigidum esse, algere, frigescere, refrigerari, defervescere
woorden.definitie: (Gen. 49,4) et ቈረ፡ (Kuf. 23) 1,1 [קָרַר ܩܰܪ قَرَّ] 1) frigidum esse, algere, frigescere, refrigerari: ቈረ፡ አብርሃም፡ ከመ፡ በረድ፡ Kuf. 23; Gen. 49,4; Job 37,8; Hen. 67,11. 2 defervescere, remittere, de ira Gen. 27,44; Job 14,13; Jes. 1,24; Jes. 10,26; Sir. 23,16.

woorden.betekenis: frigus, algor, gelu
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., 1 frigus, algor, gelu Gen. 8,22; Kuf. 2; Kuf. 8; Hen. 34,2; Hen. 76,6; Ps. 147,6; 4 Esr. 6,9; ሞተ፡ በቍር፡ Job 31,18; ከመ፡ ቍረ፡ ዐዘቅተ፡ ማይ፡ Jer. 6; Jer. 7; ቍር፡ ወአስሐትያ፡ Dan. apocr. 3,48; ቍር፡ ወበረድ፡ Zach. 14,6; ይርዕዱ፡ በእንተ፡ ቍር፡ 1 Esr. 9,6; ቍረ፡ ሌሊት፡ παγετὸς τῆς νυκτός Jer. 43,30; Bar. 2,25; Job 18,18. 2 Bis positum occurrit pro τάρταρος Job 40,15; ቍረ፡ ሲኦል፡ Job 41,23.

woorden.betekenis: appropinquare, accedere, propinquum esse, prope abesse, se a
woorden.definitie: (perraro ቀረበ፡ Dan. 3,27 var.; 3 Reg. 2,7 var.) I,1 [קָרֵב ܩܪܶܒ قَرِبَ قَرُبَ] Subj. ይቅረብ፡ 1 appropinquare, accedere, propinquum esse, prope abesse: ይቅረቡ፡ ἐγγισάτωοσαν Jes. 45,21; ቅረብ፡ Kuf. 26; ቀሪቦቱ፡ Asc. Jes. 3,21; Asc. Jes. 3,22; Gen. 18,23; Matth. 15,12; Matth. 26,17; ቅረብ፡ ዝየ፡ Hen. 15,1; c.c. ለ፡ Prov. 10,14; Ex. 32,19; c. መንገለ፡ Kuf. 8; Kuf. 9; c. ኀበ፡ Gen. 27,22; Gen. 37,18; Gen. 45,4; 1 Reg. 10,24; ናሁ፡ አነ፡ ቀረብኩ፡ ኀበ፡ ፍትሕየ፡ Job 13,18; ሶበ፡ ቀርቡ፡ ኀበ፡ ራጌስ፡ Tob. 6,10; Tob. 10,13; Asc. Jes. 9,39; Ps. 31,8; Asc. Jes. 90,7; Hen. 91,4; Matth. 18,1; Hebr. 4,16; c. Acc.: Gen. 27,21; Deut. 4,7; Prov. 3,15; ይቀርቡኒ፡ በከናፍሪሆሙ፡ Jes. 29,13; 4 Esr. 10,39; Jac. 4,8; ይሰቲ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ማይ፡ ዘቀርቦ፡ Sir. 26,12; ኢቀርቦሙ፡ (v. ኢቀረቦሙ፡) እሳት፡ ሥጋሆሙ፡ Dan. 3,27; se applicare: ቦ፡ ዐርከ፡ ዘይቀርበከ፡ አመ፡ ትፍሥሕትከ፡ Sir. 37,4. a de tempore: α instare: ቀርበት፡ ዕለተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Jes. 13,6; ቀርበ፡ ጊዜነ፡ Thren. 4,19; Zeph. 1,14; 1 Petr. 4,7; Matth. 3,2; Joh. 2,13; ቀርበ፡ መዋዕሊሁ፡ ለመዊት፡ Gen. 47,29; Hen. 51,2. β brevem esse, breviorem fieri Hen. 72,34 (vid. ቅሩብ፡). b de cognatione et affinitate: Jud. 4,11; ይቀርብ፡ እምኔየ፡ Ruth 3,12. c de similitudine: ቀርበ፡ መዋዕልየ፡ ለመዋዕለ፡ ሕይወትኪ፡ Kuf. p. 126. d honesta de complexu venereo, plerumque c. Acc.: Ex. 19,15; Gen. 38,26; Kuf. 41; Tob. 3,8; Rom. 7,3; 1 Cor. 7,1. 2 accedere ad altaris communionem, communicare: እለ፡ ኢትቀርቡ፡ ፃኡ፡ Lit. 164,1; Kid. f. 8; ይባእ፡ ወይትከነስ፡ ወይቅረብ፡ Clem. f. 161; ይቅረቡ፡ ቍርባነ፡ F.M. 5,2; F.M. 14,1. qarba L ቀርበ፡ ቍርባነ qarba qʷǝrbān receive the Eucharist, vid. ቍርባን፡ 440b

woorden.betekenis: appropinquare, accedere facere, jubere, adhaerere facere, ad
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 appropinquare vel accedere facere sive jubere, c. Acc. (de reliqua constr. vid. ቀርበ፡): Matth. 15,10 rom.; Gen. 48,10; Ex. 19,4; Ex. 21,6; Ex. 29,4; Kuf. 31; ያቀርበከ፡ ለኵነኔ፡ Koh. 11,9; Koh. 12,14; de tempore: አቅረብኪ፡ መዋዕለኪ፡ Hez. 22,4. 2 adhaerere facere, adjungere: አቅረብክዎሙ፡ ለቤተ፡ እስራኤል፡ ኀቤየ፡ Jer. 13,11; በምሕረትየ፡ አቅረብኩኪ፡ Jes. 60,10. 3 admovere, afferre Prov. 2,2; ኀበ፡ ቃለ፡ ጠቢባን፡ አቅርብ፡ እዝነከ፡ Prov. 22,17; 4 Reg. 4,5; 4 Reg. 4,6. 4 apponere, anteponere mensam, cibum; objicere pabulum: Gen. 18,8; Gen. 43,31; Gen. 43,32; 4 Reg. 4,40; Kuf. 26; ጠይቅ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘአቅረቡ፡ ለከ፡ Sir. 31,15; Tob. 7,9; Prov. 23,1; Marc. 6,41; Gen. 24 32. 5 offerre a munera: አቅረቡ፡ ሎቱ፡ አምኃሁ፡ ዘአምጽኡ፡ Kuf. 42; Org. 1. b sacrificia: Lev. 21,6; Lev. 21,8 var.; Prov. 21,27; 1 Petr. 2, 5; አቅርቦ፡ መሥዋዕት፡ Chrys. ho. 14; Lit. 161,2. 6 in specie: ad communionem altaris admittere aliquem, eucharistiam vel sacramentum altaris communicare vel administrare alicui, c. Acc. pers. et rei: ኢታቅርብዎሙ፡ Clem. f. 179; Clem. f. 248; Kedr f. 73; F.M. 5,12; ካህናት፡ አኰቴተ፡ ያቅርቡ፡ Kid. f. 14; ያቅርብዎ፡ ቍርባነ፡ (ei sacrificium) F.M. 4,2; F.M. 7,2.

woorden.betekenis: offerri, sacrificium altaris accipere
woorden.definitie: vel ተቀረበ፡ III,1; III,2 1 offerri, de munere: እምዘ፡ ይትቀረብ፡ F.N. 16; ይትቄረብ፡ Org. 1. 2 sacrificium altaris accipere: ለእመ፡ ፈቀደ፡ ይትቀረብ፡ ቍርባነ፡ F.M. 14,9.

woorden.betekenis: propinquus, vicinus, prope instans, proximus antea, nuperus,
woorden.definitie: part. et adj. A adj. propinquus 1 de loco: Gen. 19,20; Joh. 19,42; ለርሑቃን፡ ወለቅሩባን፡ Jes. 57,1; Dan. 9,7; c. ለ፡ Deut. 21,6; Ps. 33,19; Joh. 11,18; Joh. 11,54; Joh. 19, 20; Rom. 10,8; c. ኀበ፡ Deut. 22,2; እለ፡ ቅሩባን፡ ኀበ፡ ንጉሥ፡ Esth. 1,14; per st. constr.: Gen. 45,10; ዘቅሩብኪ፡ ወዘርሑቅኪ፡ Hez. 22,5. 2 vicinus Deut. 13,8; ቅሩባንኪ፡ οἱ ὁμοροῦντές σοι Hez. 16,26; γείτονες Job 19,15. 3 de cognatione et affinitate: Ruth 2,20; Lev. 25,25; Deut. 25,5; ቅሩቡ፡ ለጦብያ፡ 2 Esr. 23,4; ለኵሉ፡ ቅሩበ፡ ምናሴ፡ ምታ፡ ወለቅሩበ፡ አዝማዲሃ፡ Judith 16,24; ቅሩባን፡ አዝማድ፡ (opp. ርሑቃን፡ አዝማድ፡) F.N. 42,2. 4 de tempore: a prope instans Ps. 84,10; Phil. 4,5; Hebr. 6,8; Hebr. 8,13; Apoc. 1,3; ቅሩባን፡ ለሐዊር፡ እምዛቲ፡ ሕይወት፡ F.N. 42,6. b proximus antea, nuperus: እስመ፡ ቅሩብ፡ ዘመኑ፡ Jsp. p. 302. c brevis: ፍሥሓ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ዓለም፡ ቅሩብ፡ ወኅዳጥ፡ Clem. f. 254; ቅሩብ፡ ውእቱ፡ ረኪቦታ፡ (ለጥበብ፡) Sir. 51,26. <Β< adv. 1 Acc. ቅሩበ፡ a prope, in propin qu o, cominus: per st. constr.: Ex. 34,3; Num. 22,5; Deut. 2,19; Kuf. 11; Kuf. 14; ዘየኀድር፡ ቅሩበ፡ ቤታ፡ Sir. 14,24; ቅሩበከ፡ ሀለዉ፡ πλησίον σοῦ Judith 5,5; Joh. 4,5; Joh. 6,23; seq. ኀበ፡ Kuf. 10. b nuper, proximo: ለእመ፡ ኮነ፡ ምታ፡ ሞተ፡ ቅሩበ፡ (opp. እምጕንዱይ፡ መዋዕል፡) Const. Ap. 25. 2 ኀበ፡ ቅሩበ፡ a in propinquum vel propinquo, prope: ነዐርግ፡ ኀበ፡ ቅሩበ፡ አጽዋኒሆሙ፡ Judith 7,13; Jud. 4,11. b prope, paene: ሶበ፡ በጽሐት፡ ኀበ፡ ቅሩበ፡ ፹ ዓመት፡ Sx. Mag. 15. 3 በቅሩበ፡ in propinquo, prope: Joh. 3,23; Kuf. 16. 4 እምቅሩብ፡ e propinquo: እለ፡ እምቅሩብ፡ oἱ ἐγγίζοντες Jes. 33,13. >B>

woorden.betekenis: appropinquatio, propinquitas, adjunctio
woorden.definitie: n. act. appropinquatio, propinquitas, adjunctio; συνάφεια (Nestorii) Cyr. c. Pall. f. 76(i.q. ልጽቀት፡).

woorden.betekenis: oblatio, donum, vot, ivum, anathêma, sacrificium, panes prop
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., Pl. ቍርባናት፡ [קָרְבָּן ܩܽܘܪܒܳܢܳܐ قُرْبَانٌ] oblatio a donum Deo oblatum vot ivum, anathêma, δῶρον Num. 7,10 seq.; ἐισφορά Ex. 30,13; Ex. 30,14. b sacrificium cujusvis generis: δῶρον Gen. 4,4; Lev. 1,14; Lev. 2,1; Lev. 2,13; (ቍርባነ፡ መስዋዕት፡); Jer. 40,11; Matth. 8,4 rom.; Hebr. 5,1; θυσία Lev. 17,8; Lev. 23,13; Jes. 56,7; Am. 5,22; Jer. 6,20; Jer. 7,22; Jer. 14,12; ὁλοκάρπωσις Gen. 8,20; κάρπωμα Lev. 1, 9; Lev. 1,13; Lev. 1,17; ὁλοκαύτωμα Lev. 4,7; Lev. 4,18; Lev. 4,25; Lev. 4,30; Lev. 14,31; አልህምት፡ ለቍርባናት፡ 1 Par. 21,23; 2 Par. 1, 6; 2 Par. 2,4; 2 Par. 7,1; Ps. 49,9; Ps. 50,20; Ps. 49,9; Ps. 50,20; μωκήματα Sir. 31,22; 4 Esr. 10,58; ቍርባናት፡ Sx. Mag. 23; ኅብስተ፡ ቍርባን፡ ἄρτοι τῆς προθέσεως panes propositionis 1 Reg. 21,6; Matth. 12,4. c in ecclesia Christiana ቍርባን፡ est α προσφοραί oblationes F.N. 13; Lit. 164,4; Clem. f. 256. β sacrificium altaris, eucharistia (vid. አቅረበ፡ et አቀረበ፡): ኢይመጥዎሙ፡ ቍርባነ፡ Clem. f. 179; ነሢአ፡ ቍርባን፡ F.M. 6,2; የሀብዎ፡ ቍርባነ፡ F.M. 7,2; ተመጠወ፡ ቍርባነ፡ Can. Anc. 11; በእንተ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ቍርባን፡ Kid. f. 8. γ panis eucharisticus: በእንተ፡ ቍርባን፡ ወደም፡ F.M. 26. qʷǝrbān G ቍርባን፡ qʷǝrbān oblatio, sacrificium, sacra communio, offrande, sacrifice de la messe, sainte communion Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 56. 174 L ቍርባን፡ qʷǝrbān offering, dedication, gift, sacrifice, Eucharist, oblation, Holy Communion, Host (see 130–132) ቀርበ፡ ቍርባነ qarba qʷǝrbān receive the Eucharist, vid. ቀርበ፡ አዕረገ፡ ቍርባነ ʾaʿǝraga qʷǝrbāna celebrate Mass, vid. አዕረገ፡ 440b መዝመዘ፡ ቍርባነ mazmaza qʷǝrbāna rub the bread of the Eucharist to test the soundness of the loaf and to remove loose particles (587), vid. መዝመዘ፡ 378b C for አኰቴተ፡ ቍርባን vid. አኰቴት፡

woorden.betekenis: scorpio
woorden.definitie: scorpio vid. sub ዐቅረብ፡

woorden.betekenis: cornu, monoceros, unicornis, bicornis, symbolum roboris et p
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., Pl. አቅርንት፡ [קֶרֶן ܩܰܪܢܳܐ قَرْنٌ] 1) cornu Gen. 22,13; Ps. 21,22; Dan. 7, 8 seq.; Gen. 8,3 seq.; Apoc. 6,6; Apoc. 12,3; Apoc. 13,1; Hen. 90,9 seq.; 3 Reg. 22,11. a ቀርነ፡ ነጌ፡ (cornu i.e. dens elephanti) Am. 3,15; Am. 6,14 (alia vid. sub ነጌ፡); etiam omisso ነጌ፡, ut: ክቡዳን፡ አቅርንት፡ Ps. 44,10; Jsp. p. 283. b ዘአሐዱ፡ ቀርኑ፡ monoceros, unicornis Ps. 21,22; Ps. 28,6; Ps. 91,10; Num. 23,22; Deut. 33,17. c ዘክልኤቱ፡ አቅርንቲሁ፡ bicornis, de Alexandro M., Cat. Cod. Ox. Bodl. p. 79; እስክንድር፡ ዘይሰመይ፡ ዘ፪ አቅርንቲሁ፡ እስመ፡ ውእቱ፡ ነግሠ፡ በአቅርንተ፡ ፀሓይ፡ እምሥራቂሃ፡ እስከ፡ ምዕራቢሃ፡ Abush. 48. d cornu est symbolum roboris et potentiae: ይበቍል፡ ቀርን፡ ለቤተ፡ እስራኤል፡ Hez. 29,21; ተሰብረ፡ ቀርነ፡ ሞአብ፡ Jer. 31,25; Sir. 47,7; አንሥአ፡ ቀርኖ፡ Ps. 74,4; Ps. 74,5; Ps. 88,17; Ps. 91,10; Ps. 131,18; Sir. 47,5; 1 Reg. 2,1. e cornua altaris Ex. 27,2 seq.; Ps. 117,26; Joel 2,17; Apoc. 9,13. f cornu, buccina, tuba: σάλπιγξ Ps. 97,7; Job 39,24; Job 39,25; ቀርነ፡ ዝብጦ፡ Sir. 50,16; ቃለ፡ ቀርን፡ Jes. 18,3; Jes. 27,13; Jes. 44,23; Jes. 58,1; Jer. 4,5; Jer. 4,19; Dan. 3,5; Zeph. 1,16; 1 Esr. 5,57; 1 Par. 15,24; 2 Par. 5,13; Matth. 24,31; 1 Cor. 14,8; κερατίνη Jud. 7,8; 2 Reg. 15,10; Jos. 6,4; etiam 1 Par. 25,6 (ubi Graecus νάβλαι habet). g cornu, quo pro vasculo utuntur: ቀርነ፡ ቅብእ፡ κέρας 1 Reg. 16,1; 3 Reg. 1,39; φακός 1 Reg. 10,1. h frustum panis cornu simile (de pane orbiculari): ቀርነ፡ ኅብስት፡ κλάσμα ἄρτου Hez. 13,19. – Voc. Ae.: ቀርን፡ መጥቅዕ፡ ብ፡ ነጋሪት፡ ቀንድ፡; aliud: ቀርን፡ ዘ፡ ነጋሪት፡ ገንታሂ፡ ይ። { i pars rei anterior vel extrema (Spitze), I Sal. Mar. 33 (vid. sub አጽባዕት፡) } qarn, Pl. ʾaqrǝnt G ቀርን፡ qarn, Pl. አቅርንት፡ ʾaqrǝnt cornu, tuba, corne, trompette ― ቀንድ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 57. 174 L ቀርን፡ qarn (Pl. አቅርንት፡ ʾaqrǝnt) horn, trumpet, tip, point, () symbol of power, might ቀርነ፡ ነጌ qarna nage ivory, elephant tusk, vid. ነጌ፡ ቀርነ፡ ፀሓይ qarna ḍaḥāy ray of sun, vid. ፀሓይ፡ ዘአሐዱ፡ ቀርኑ zaʾaḥadu qarnu unicorn 442a

woorden.betekenis: apex spicae, arista, pili oculorum, cilia, palpebrae, nictus
woorden.definitie: , ቀርንብ፡, ቀርነብ፡ subst., Pl. ቀራንብት፡ [sine dubio pro ቅርንው፡, adjecto ው formativo, e ቀርን፡ propagatum] 1 apex spicae, arista: (semen agit) ቈጽለ፡ ወብርዐ፡ ወሐሠረ፡ ወቅርንበ፡ Macc. f. 5. 2 Pl., pili oculorum, cilia, palpebrae, βλέφαρα Ps. 10,5; Ps. 131,4; Job 16,16; Sir. 26,9; Jer. 9,18; ቀራንብቲከ፡ ይቅጽባ፡ ጽድቀ፡ Prov. 4,25; Prov. 6,4; Prov. 6,25; Prov. 24,86; Hen. 8,1; ሰላም፡ ለቀራንብቲኪ፡ I Sal. Mar. 6; (evulsit) ጸጕረ፡ ቀራንብቲሁ፡ Sx. Genb. 13; ነበስባሰ፡ ቀራንብት፡ nictus palpebrarum i.e. momentum temporis M.M. f. 58. – Voc. Ae.:ቍርንብ፡ (v. ቀርንብ፡) ዘ፡ ምርቅ፡; aliud: ጠስ፡ ቀርነብ፡ ቀልደድ፡ ብ፡ ቅንድብ።

woorden.betekenis: ranae, coaxatio, cochlea, concha

Isenb. p. 128; at ቈርናናት፡ amharice: cochlea, concha ).

woorden.betekenis: galea
woorden.definitie: subst. amh., sc. ራሰ፡ ቍርዕ፡ galea p. 484 n. 6. (aeth. ጌራ፡).

woorden.betekenis: insculpere, scidit, abscidit, pupugit, incidere
woorden.definitie: et ቈረጸ፡ I,1 [i.q. ኀረጸ፡; amh. ቀረጠ፡ et ቀረጸ፡ insculpere; vic. ቀረፀ፡ q.v. nec non חרץ; arab. قَرَصَ non tantum scidit, abscidit sed etiam pupugit pulex] incidere, insculpere: ለኵሎሙ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ሀለዎሙ፡ ምግባራት፡ ዘልማድ፡ ዘትሤኒ፡ በኀቤክሙ፡ ወቦ፡ ዘትከውን፡ ኀሳረ፡ በኀበ፡ ካልኣኒሃ፡ ከመ፡ ቀሪጸ፡ ገጽ፡ በኀበ፡ ኢትዮጵየ፡ ወኖባ፡ (vid. p. 240) ወከመ፡ ተላጽዮ፡ ጽሕም፡ በኀበ፡ አፍርንጅ፡ F.N. 51; ረከበ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ዘቈረጹ፡ ቀደምት፡ ውስተ፡ ኰኵሕ፡ Kuf. 8.

woorden.betekenis: tonderi, se, sibi tondere, discindi, dilacerari
woorden.definitie: (ተቈርፀ፡), III,1 1 tonderi, se vel sibi tondere: መራዕይ፡ እለ፡ ተቀርፃ፡ Cant. 4,2; Cant. 6,6. ተቀርፆ፡ ሥዕርት፡ Sx. Haml. 21Enc.; አመ፡ ይትቀረፅ፡ 2 Reg. 24,16; l Cor. 11,6; (monachus) አልቦ፡ ዘይትቀረፅ፡ ርእሶ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ያእምር፡ አባስ፡ Reg. Pach. 2 ut videtur: discindi, dilacerari: monachus ነበረ፡ እንዘ፡ ይትጋደል፡ ውስተ፡ በአት፡ ንስቲት፡ እንተ፡ ይእቲ፡ ገዳመ፡ ጼው፡ እስከ፡ ተቈርፀ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ Sx. Genb. 28.

woorden.betekenis: presbyter
woorden.definitie: presbyter vid. sub ቀሰሰ፡

woorden.betekenis: secare, debilem, infirmum esse, vulnerari, sauciari, laedi,
woorden.definitie: I,1 [amh. ቈሰለ፡; num ad قَصَلَ خَصَلَ خَزَلَ جَزَلَ جَزِلَ secare, an ad כָּשַׁל חָשַׁל חָלַשׁ debilem, infirmum esse referendum?] 1 vulnerari, sauciari, ( laedi ): πληγῆναι Ex. 22,2; Jes. 1,5; ቈሰልኩ፡ Zach. 13,6; ቈስሉ፡ በኀጺን፡ 2 Par. 29,9; τραυματίζεσθαι Jes. 53,5; Hez. 28,16; ዘቈስለ፡ τὸ συντετριμμένον Zach. 11,16; Hez. 34,4; አልቦ፡ ዘይቈስል፡ እምነ፡ ሰብእክሙ፡ (διαφωνήσει) Judith 10,13; ብዙኅ፡ ወድቀ፡ ወቈስለ፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ (ἐτροπώσατο) 1 Par. 19,16: ἐκκρουσθῇ Deut. 19,5; ቈስለ፡ አንደፊር፡ (Antipater) በውስተ፡ ሰብእ፡ ብዙኀ፡ ቍስላተ፡ Jsp. p. 313. 2 in firmum esse, dolere vel laborare morbo: አነ፡ ጠቢብ፡ (medicus) ወእፌውሶሙ፡ ለድውያን፡ እለ፡ ቈስሉ፡ በደዌ፡ Sx. Genb. 26.

woorden.betekenis: vulnerare, sauciare, dolore afficere
woorden.definitie: II,1 vulnerare, sauciare, dolore afficere Ex. 21,12; Ex. 18,20; 4 Reg. 8,28; 4 Reg. 8,29; 2 Par. 28,20; ነደፍዎ፡ ወአቍሰልዎ፡ 2 Par. 22,5; 4 Reg. 18,21; Judith 9,13; አቍሰሉከ፡ ፀርከ፡ Jer. 37,14; Hos. 6,1; አቍስሎ፡ Koh. 3,3 var.; አቍሲላ፡ Prov. 7,26; Kuf. 4; Job 5,18 (ἀλγεῖν ποιεῖ); Job 9,17; Act. 19,16; transl.: ትፍሥሕትከ፡ ያቈስሎሙ፡ ለጸላእትከ፡ Sir. 12,8; ኀበ፡ አቍሰለት፡ (ኀጢአት፡) አልባቲ፡ ፈውሰ፡ ለቍስላ፡ Sir. 21,3; አነ፡ አቍሰልኩ፡ ነፍስየ፡ Jsp. p. 335.

woorden.betekenis: vulnus, plaga, vibex, vulnus letale, ulcus, dolor, morbus
woorden.definitie: subst, plerumque in., Pl. ቍሰል፡ et ቍስላት፡ 1 vulnus, plaga, vibex (πληγή, τραῦμα, σύντριμμα, μώλωψ) Ex. 21,12; 4 Reg. 8,29; ከመ፡ ይትፈወስ፡ እምቍስል፡ ዘአቍስልዎ፡ 2 Par. 22,6; Job 6,21; Job 16,6; Jes. 1,6; ቍስለ፡ ሕዝቡ፡ Jes. 30,26; Jer. 3,22 (ቍስላት፡); Jer. 10,19; Jer. 15,18; እምኵሉ፡ ቍስል፡ የአኪ፡ ቍስለ፡ ልብ፡ Sir. 25,13; Sir. 25,23; Sir. 27,21; ቍስለ፡ መቅሠፍት፡ Sir. 28,17; ቍስለ፡ ልሳን፡ Sir. 28,17; ቍስለ፡ ልብ፡ Sir. 40,9; ቍስላት፡ Jsp. p. 314; F.M. 3,3; ቍስለ፡ ሞት፡ vulnus letale Apoc. 13,3; Apoc. 13,12; μώλωψ Jes. 53,5; Sir. 23,10; 1 Petr. 2,24; διαφθορά Jer. 28,8. 2 ulcus, ἰχώρ Job 2,8; ἕλκος Prov. 25,20; Lev. 13,18; Lev. 13,19; Luc. 16,21; ደዌ፡ ቍስል፡ ovium et hominum Sx. Hed. 15; ebrietas gignit ቍስለ፡ አማዑት፡ F.N. 50. 3 dolor, morbus, ἄλγος Thren. 1,12; Thren. 1,18; Ps. 38,3; Sir. 26,6; ἀρρώστημα μακρόν ቍስል፡ ዐቢይ፡ Sir. 10,10.

woorden.betekenis: cibi conditi
woorden.definitie: vel መቅሰም፡ (sing. nondum repertus) subst., Pl. መቃስም፡ Pl. Pl. መቃስማት፡ cibi conditi: (diebus jejunii) ይትዐቀብ፡ እመቃስማተ፡ መብልዕ፡ ወመስቴ፡ Kedr f. 35; እመቦ፡ ዘጥዕመ፡ ዘኮn፡ እመቃስማት፡ Kedr f. 70; ይኅድግ፡ ኵሎ፡ መቃስማተ፡ ወኢይብላዕ፡ ቀስመ፡ Kedr f. 73; ኢይብልዑ፡ መቃስማተ፡ F.N. 15.

woorden.betekenis: supellex, v, asa, omnis generis
woorden.definitie: , ቍስቍስ፡, ቍስቊስ፡, ቍስቋስ፡, ቈስቊስ፡ subst, Pl. ቍስቋሳት፡, ቍስቊሳት፡, ቈስቊሳት፡, et ቈሳቊስ፡, ቆሳቊስት፡ Pl. Pl. ቈሳቊሳት፡ (vid. ann. ad Gen. 31,18) supellex vel v asa omnis generis [coll. ماش قاش et ماش خاش] ἀποσκευή Gen. 31,18; Gen. 31,37; Gen. 34,29; σκεύη Gen. 45,20; ወባዕድኒ፡ ቍስቋሳት፡ (v. ቈስቊሳት፡) 1 Esr. 2,12; ኵሎ፡ ንዋዮ፡ ወቍስቍሶ፡ ማህረኩ፡ Macc. f. 18; reliquit vasa sua ወብዙኀ፡ ቆሳቍስተ፡ Gad. T.H.; ዕፀወ፡ ኵነኔ፡ ፈድፋደ፡ ቈስቈሰ፡ መዐዛ፡ Hen. 29,2 (nisi hic ኰሳኵሰ፡ intelligere malueris).

woorden.betekenis: arcus, iris, qast, qasta dammanā, Les qasta damanā (arcs-en-
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem. (ut Gen. 9,13 seq.; Jer. 28,56), Pl. አቅስስት፡ et አቅስት፡ [קֶשֶׁת ܩܶܫܬܐ قَوْسٌ; de etymo vid. Ges. thes. p. 1211] arcus a jaculatorius: Gen. 27,3; Jes. 7,24; Jer. 6,22; Jer. 25,14; Hez. 39,3; ቀስት፡ ጠዋይ፡ Ηοs. 7,15; Ps. 7,13; Ps. 75,3; Ps. 77,63; Job 20,24; Job 29,20; Job 39,23; Hen. 17,3; Apoc. 6,2; Pl. Gen. 49,24; Ps. 36,16; 1 Par. 10,3; Jes. 5,28; Jes. 21,15; Jes. 41,2; Jer. 4,29; Hez. 39,9. b coelestis i.e. iris: ቀስተ፡ ደመና፡ Hez. 1,28; Sir. 50,7; Gen. 9,13 seq.; ቀስተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Kuf. 6; Sir. 43,11; coll. Chron. Ax. f. 89. c architectonicus, Lud. ex auct. Gregorii. qast ቀሰተ፡ ደመና፡ qasta dammanā ወቀስተ፡ ደመና፡ ፲። ወርእሰ፡ ህበይ፡ ፴፻ወ፰፻፲ወ፭። ‘Les qasta damanā (arcs-en-ciel) sont au nombre de 10; les reʾesa hebay, 3,815;’ 7 l. 10 (ed.), 7 l. 17–18 (tr.), vid. ደመና፡

woorden.betekenis: costus
woorden.definitie: , ቍስጥ፡, ቁስጥ፡, ቈስጤ፡ subst. costus, genus aromatis. [قُسْطٌ קשְׁטְ] Kuf. 16; ስምኪ፡ ሐዋዝ፡ እምነ፡ ከልበኔ፡ ወቅሱጥ፡ III Sal. Mar. 1. – Voc. Ae.: ቈስጥ፡ ብ፡ ሽቹ።

woorden.betekenis: n. peregr. sc. κάβος (in Gen. κάβου), mensura quae
woorden.definitie: n. peregr. sc. κάβος (in Gen. κάβου), mensura quaedam aridorum (hebr. קַב) 4 Reg. 6,25; ሀሎ፡ ውስተ፡ አስፋሬዳ፡ ሥርናይ፡ ንስቲት፡ ዘየአክል፡ መጠነ፡ መስፈርተ፡ ቃቡ፡ Gad. T.H.

woorden.betekenis: obviam ire, venire, occurrere, obviam ferre, obviam eundo, m
woorden.definitie: III,2 1 obviam ire vel venire, occurrere, c. Acc. Gen. 14,17; Gen. 32,7; Num. 22,36; 1 Reg. 6,13; 4 Reg. 1,3; Kuf. 45; 1 Par. 12,17; Ps. 58,5; ፃእ፡ ተቀበሎ፡ ለአካዝ፡ Jes. 7,3; Jes. 14,9; Jes. 21,14; ወፅአ፡ ከመ፡ ይትቀበሎሙ፡ Jer. 48,6; Zach. 2,3; Tob. 7,1; Matth. 8,28; Matth. 8,34; Luc. 9,37; hostiliter: Deut. 3,1; 1 Reg. 4,1; ሐጽ፡ ዘይትቄበሎ፡ Job 39,22. a c. በ፡ rei et Acc. pers.: obviam ferre aliquid alicui Deut. 23,5. b obviam eundo vel mittendo excipere aliquem: ፈኒውየ፡ እትቄበለከ፡ እምህየ፡ Kuf. p. 98; ይትቀበልዎሙ፡ መላእክት፡ ውስተ፡ ትፍሥሕት፡ Clem. f. 156. 2 accipere, excipere, recipere a hospites, advenientes Luc. 10,38; Hebr. 13,2; Jac. 2,25; 3 Joh. 8; Judith 3,7; ተቀበልዎሙ፡ በትፍሥሕት፡ Tob. 7,8; Herm. p. 99; ተቀብሎ፡ ነግድ፡ φιλοξενία hospitalitas Hebr. 13,2. b aliquid vel aliquem gratum accipere, acceptare, suscipere, admittere, Gen. 32,21; ተቀበሉ፡ አበሳየ፡ (v. ስረዩ፡) Ex. 10,17; Jac. 1,21; Marc. 10,15; Luc. 23,51 (at ibi προσδέχεσθαι significat exspectare, quare Platt ይሴፈው፡ habet). 3 passive: gratum accipi ለይትቀበል፡ 1 Reg. 26,19 (at var.: ቍርባነከ፡). taqabbala, ተቀብለ፡ taqabla G ተቀብለ፡ taqabla III,1, cette forme verbale fait parfois concurrence à la forme ተቀበለ፡ III,2 aller au devant, venir, arriver 454 L qbl II, ተቀበለ taqabbala go out to meet, accept, receive, welcome, repeat a chant after the ‘marāḥi’ and the ‘tamarāḥi’ (687) 418b

woorden.betekenis: abscondit, sepulchrum, sepelire, humare, pollinctores
woorden.definitie: I,1 [קָבַר ܩܒܰܪ قَبَرَ; vic. كَفَرَ abscondit, كَفْرٌ sepulchrum ] Subj. ይቅብር፡ (et ይቅበር፡ Matth. 8, 21; Matth. 8,22 Platt; 4 Reg. 9,34 S sepelire, humare, c. Acc. Gen. 23,4 seq.; Gen. 25,9; Gen. 25,10; Gen. 47,29; Kuf. 19; Kuf. 35; Kuf. 36; 4 Reg. 9,35; 2 Par. 9,31; Tob. 1,17; Tob. 1,18; Tob. 4,3; Tob. 4,4; Jer. 7,32; Jer. 7,33; Jer. 14,16; Sir. 38,16; Apoc. 11,9; እለ፡ ይቀብሩ፡ ἐνταφιασταί pollinctores Gen. 50,2.

woorden.betekenis: sepelire sinere, jubere
woorden.definitie: II,1 sepelire sinere vel jubere, Gen. 23,8.

woorden.betekenis: sepeliri, humari
woorden.definitie: III,1 sepeliri, humari Gen. 25,17; Gen. 35,19; Kuf. 4; Kuf. 32; Num. 20,1; Jud. 8,32; Jud. 12,10; 4 Reg. 10,35; 2 Par. 12,16; Judith 16,23; Matth. 28,6; Rom. 6,4.

woorden.betekenis: sepultura, humatio
woorden.definitie: n. act. sepultura, humatio, Lud.

woorden.betekenis: obduxit, oleum, oblinere, illinere, ungere, inungere, perung
woorden.definitie: I,1 [חִפָּה obduxit, vid. ቀብአ፡ n. 3; ቅብእ፡ oleum sicut ܡܶܫܚܳܐ a ܡܫܰܚ;{etymon propositum mihi quidem probabilius videtur quam si quis ቀብአ፡ a ቅብእ፡ denominatum, ቅብእ፡ autem a קָּפָה propagatum censuerit.}] Subj. ይቅባእ፡ 1 oblinere, illinere, Joh. 9,6; M.F.; c. Acc. et በ፡, ut: ቀብኦ፡ በህጕሬ፡ Sap. 13,14; በኅፅበ፡ እግሩ፡ ብርሃነ፡ ለዕዉር፡ ቀብአ፡ Sx. Genb. 8 Enc.; c. dupl. Acc. Gen. 6,14; Ex. 2,3: ኢቀብእዎ፡ ሥራየ፡ Hez. 30,21; transl.: aliquem i.e. oculos ejus oblinero, ne videant Hez. 22,28. 2 ungere, inungere, perungere, c. Acc. corporis vel unguenti vel c. dupl. Acc: ቀባእኩኪ፡ ቅብአ፡ Hez. 16,9; vulnus Jes. 1,6 var.; (Jacobus) ቀብኦን፡ ለአእባን፡ ዘይተ፡ ቅዱሰ፡ Clem. f. 38; Gen. 31,13; Matth. 6,17; ኢትቅብኦ፡ (ለሥዕርትከ፡) ዕፍረተ፡ F.N. 51; Ps. 44,9; aegrotos Marc. 6,13; cadaver Marc. 16,1; ይገንዙ፡ ወይቀብኡ፡ ἐνταφιάζειν Joh. 19,40 rom.; in specie de unctione rerum hominumve consecrandorum: Ex. 28,37; Ex. 30,26; Ex. 31,11; Ex. 35,16; Ex. 40,7 seq.; 1 Reg. 10,1; 1 Reg. 16,12; 2 Reg. 5,3; Ps. 88,20; 1 Par. 11,3; ቀብኦ፡ ቅብአ፡ ቅድሳት፡ Sir. 45,15; መንፈሰ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ላዕሌየ፡ ዘቀብአኒ፡ Jes. 61,1; በቅብአ፡ ጸጋሁ፡ ይቅባእ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አልባቢክሙ፡ Genz. f. 153. 3 obducere, illinere: ቀብኦ፡ ወርቀ፡ ንጹሐ፡ 3 Reg. 10,18; ከመ፡ ይልብጡ፡ ወይቅብኡ፡ አረፍተ፡ ቤት፡ 1 Par. 29,4; ቀብኦ፡ በሰሌዳ፡ Jer. 22,14; Org. 4. qabʾa, ቀብዐ፡ qabʿa G ቀብዐ፡ qabʿa I,1 ይቀብዕ፡, ይቅባዕ፡ unxit, illevit, tinxit, perfudit, oindre Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 58. 176 L ቀብአ qabʾa (yǝqbāʾ), (, ) ቀብዐ qabʿa smear, smear over, grease, anoint, plaster, plate, gild, paint 418a

woorden.betekenis: pinguedo, oleum, oleum olivarum, unguentum, butyrum, beta, V
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., Pl. ቅብኣት፡, pinguedo cujusvis generis: መባልዕተ፡ ቅብእ፡ Clem. f. 239. 1 oleum ἔλαιον Gen. 28,18; Lev. 2,1 seq.; Lev. 7,12; ቅብእ፡ ቅድው፡ 3 Reg. 15,11; ቅብአ፡ ዕፍረት፡ σμυρνίνῳ ἐλαίῳ Esth. 2,12; Ps. 4,8; Ps. 103,17; Ps. 140,6; Sir. 39,26; Jer. 47,10; Hez. 27,17; Koh. 9,8; ቅብአ፡ መዐዛ፡ Koh. 7,1; Apoc. 6,6; Matth. 25,3; Marc. 6,13; Luc. 7,46; Luc. 16,6; ቅብአ፡ ማኅቶት፡ Org. 1. In specie: a de oleo consecrationis: ቅብእ፡ ቅዱስ፡ Ex. 30,25; Ex. 38,25; et de oleo, quo baptizandi unguntur (ἔλαιον ἅγιον, μυστικόν): ቅብአ፡ ጥምቀት፡ Can. Laod. 47(Can. Laod. 48); ቅብእ፡ ቅዱስ፡ vel ዘቅዳስያት፡ Const. Ap. 84; sed etiam ἅγιον μύρον, χρίσμα ቅብአ፡ በለሳን፡ Clem. f. 227; oleum, quo aegroti unguntur: ቅብአ፡ ጸሎት፡ Jac. 5,14; ቅብእ፡ ለድውያን፡ Kid. f. 10; et reges sacordotesve consecrantur: ቅብአ፡ መንግሥት፡ Chron. Ax. f. 89; በቅብአ፡ ክህነት፡ ወንግሥ፡ ዘተኀትመ፡ Sx. Teq. 19Enc. b oleum olivarum: ቅብአ፡ ዘይት፡ Ex. 27,20; Syn.; ዐጸደ፡ ቅብእ፡ ἐλαιών olivetum 4 Reg. 5,26; 2 Esr. 15,11; ደብረ፡ ቅብእ፡ 2 Reg. 15,30. c de aliis olei generibus: ምንትኒ፡ እምዘመደ፡ ቅብአት፡ F.M. 26,1; ቅብእ፡ ዘሰሊጥ፡ Sx. Haml. 5; ቅብአ፡ መለንስ፡ Gad. T.H. 2 unguentum, σμῆγμα Esth. 2,3; Esth. 2,12; ቅብአ፡ ጽጌ፡ እምነ፡ ቍስሉ፡ አፈልፈለ፡ Sx. Mag. 17 Enc.; Haml. 5; vid. etiam n. 1, a. 3 butyrum Jes. 7,15; Jes. 7,22; 2 Reg. 17,29; ቅብአ፡ እጐልት፡ Deut. 32,14; ቅብአ፡ ላህም፡ Sx. Haml. 5; ቅብአ፡ ጠሊ፡ Lud.; አመ፡ ይውኅዝ፡ ቅብእ፡ ውስተ፡ ፍናውየ፡ Job 29,6; ዘይት፡ ዘቅብእ፡ Lit. 164,4; ኢያኅቱ፡ ውስተ፡ ታቦት፡ (altari) በሥብሕ፡ ወበቅብእ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ባሕቱ፡ በዘይት፡ Kedr f. 88. 4 ሐምለ፡ ቅብእ፡ Jes. 51,20 σευτλίον beta vid. sub ሐምል፡ – Voc. Ae.: ቅብእ፡ ዘ፡ ቅቤ። qǝbʾ, ቅብዕ፡ qǝbʿ G ቅብዕ፡ qǝbʿ unguentum, huile sainte Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 59. 176 L ቅብእ qǝbʾ ointment, oil, butter, unction ቅብአ፡ ዘይት qǝbʾa zayt olive oil, vid. ዘይት፡ 418a C a for ሐምለ፡ ቅብእ፡ vid. ሐምል፡ b for ዐጸደ፡ ቅብእ፡ vid. ዐጸድ፡ c for ወልደ፡ ቅብእ፡ vid. ወልድ፡

woorden.betekenis: galea, mitra, pileus, cidaris, infula, orarium, cucullus, qo
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem. (Sx. Masc. 30; Phlx. 56), Pl. ቆብዓታት፡ (Ex. 28,36 C), ቀዋብዕ፡ et ቀዋብዕት፡ (Reg. Pach.) [קוֹבַע כּוֹבַע galea, מִגְבָּעָה mitra; ܩܽܘܒܳܥܳܐ pileus, قُبَّعَةٌ, amh. ቆብ፡] 1 mitra, cidaris, (infula), sacerdotalis: Ex. 29,6 (v. አክሊል፡); Ex. 36,36 in C (pro ሚጥራ፡); Ex. 28,36 in C (pro ማዕፈርታት፡). „Aethiopibus est mitra recta rubro cum apice, qua principes utuntur“, Lud. – Gen. 38,18; Gen. 38,25, ubi Gr. ὁρμίσκος habet; (scholiastes quidam ad Gen. 38annotavit, ὁρμίσκον significare ὠράριον orarium vid. Schleusner lexicon in LXX, vol. IV. p. 124). – 2 cucullus monachorum: ሥራዕ፡ ሎሙ፡ ቀዋብዕተ፡ ዘአልቦ፡ ዝዕላ፡ ዘከመ፡ ደቂቅ፡ Reg. Pach.; ቆብዑ፡ ውርውት፡ ዲበ፡ መታክፍቲሁ፡ Phlx. 56; ነሥአ፡ ቆብዐ፡ ወአስኬማ፡ በእደ፡ (እገሌ፡) cod. Didascaliae Stuttg. f. 117; Vit. Sam. qobʿ cap (see also 155) ፮ፊቃር፡ ፮ቆብዕ፡ ‘6 cinture, 6 cappucci,’ 44 VII l. 2 (ed.), 38 VII l. 2–3 (tr.); ወቆብዕ፡ ዘወርቅ፡ ፩[፡] ወዘግምዛ፡ ፪፡ ‘4 cappucci d’oro e 2 di stoffa colorata,’ 64 l. 7 (ed.), 53 l. 12–13 (tr.)

woorden.betekenis: occidere, interficere, necare, trucidare, mortifer, letalis,
woorden.definitie: I,1 [קָטַל ܩܛܰܠ قَتَلَ. { Vid. etiam II ገደለ፡}] Subj. ይቅትል፡, raro ይቅተል፡ (Rom. 13,9; Act. 26,10 Platt), 1 occidere, interficere, necare, trucidare, c. Acc Gen. 4,8; Gen. 12,12; Gen. 34,25; ለቀቲሎቱ፡ Gen. 37,18; Gen. 37,20; Gen. 38,7; Ex. 2,12; Ex. 2,14; Ex. 2,22; Ex. 2,23; Deut. 13,11; Jud. 9,54; Job 1,15; 1 Reg. 22,17; Judith 5,22; Jer. 33,23; ቀተልከ፡ ሕዝብየ፡ Jes. 14,20; Matth. 10,21; Matth. 23,35; Rom. 8,36; Kuf. 11; ዘይቀትል፡ mortifer, letalis Ps. 7,14; ንቅትሎ፡ በልሳን፡ Jer. 18,18; ይቅትሎሙ፡ ጽምእ፡ Judith 7,13; ከመ፡ ትቅትለነ፡ በጽምእ፡ Ex. 17,3; ይቀትል፡ ርእሶ፡ Joh. 8,22; ቀተለ፡ ርእሶ፡ ለሊሁ፡ Jsp. p. 295. In specie a homicidium committere, sive absol.: Ex. 20,13; Jer. 7,9; ይመክሩ፡ ለቀቲል፡ Jes. 59,7; Matth. 15,19; በእንተ፡ ቀቲል፡ F.N. 47; F.M. 4,1; sive subjuncto ነፍሰ፡, ut Matth. 5,21; Matth. 19,18; Rom. 13,9; Clem. f. 88; Clem. f. 220; ቀቲለ፡ ነፍስ፡ Clem. f. 147. b de supplicio capitis: Deut. 27,25; ቦኑ፡ ቀቲለ፡ ዘቀተሎ፡ Jer. 33,19; Matth. 26,59; Matth. 27,1. c de caede hostium in bello: Num. 21,24; Jos. 10,11; 1 Reg. 31,2; 1 Reg. 31,3; 2 Reg. 8,1; 1 Par. 10,2; 1 Par. 18,1; 1 Par. 18,5; Jer. 26,2; item de internecione terrae vel urbis i.e. incolarum: Jos. 10,37; Jos. 10,39; Jos. 10,40; Jud. 20,37; 1 Reg. 22,19; 1 Reg. 27,9. d profligare, fugare hostes Gen. 14,15; Jud. 1,5; Jud. 3,13; Jud. 11,33; 1 Reg. 13,4; 1 Reg. 14,31; 1 Reg. 14,48; 1 Reg. 30,17. e interficere, necare res, ut plantas: ዕፄ፡ ቀተሎ፡ ለዝኩ፡ ሐምሐም፡ Jon. 4,7; Ps. 104,31; በጾም፡ ሰብእናሆሙ፡ ቀተሉ፡ Deg. 2 pugnare: እለ፡ ቀተሉ፡ Num. 31,49;a oppugnare urbem: ስእንዎ፡ ቀቲሎታ፡ πολιορκῆσαι Jes. 7,1; ቀተላ፡ ለአዛጦን፡ ἐπολέμησε τὴν Ἄζωτον Jes. 20,1; Dan. 1,1 var. b expugnare 3 Reg. 15,20; 4 Reg. 3,19 (vid. nr. 1, c).

woorden.betekenis: pugnax, pugnator, bellator, miles bellicosus, pugnae aptus,
woorden.definitie: part. pugnax, pugnator, bellator, miles bellicosus, pugnae aptus, vel strenuus, (πολεμιστής, μαχητής, μάχιμος, al.) Jos. 6,3; Jos. 8,3 seq.; 2 Reg. 17,8; 3 Reg. 12,21; መስተቃትላነ፡ ቀትል፡ 1 Par. 12,8; ብእሲ፡ መስተቃትል፡ ወተባዕ፡ Sir. 26,28; Jes. 3,2; Jer. 20,11; Jer. 26,9; Jer. 27,9; Jer. 27,35; Jer. 28,56; Jer. 30,15; Jer. 48,16; Joel 4,9; Hez. 27,10; አሕዛብ፡ መስተቃትላን፡ (ὁπλομάχος) Jes. 13,4; Jes. 13,5; συμμαχία Jes. 16,4; እዴከ፡ መስተቃትልት፡ ወመዋኢት፡ Sap. 10,20; ኮነ፡ መስተቃትለ፡ ምስለ፡ (እገሌ፡) 2 Reg. 8,10 var.; መስተቃትላን፡ ለፀረ፡ እግዚእ፡ oppugnatores hostium domini Org. 3. mastaqātǝl መስተቃትላነ፡ ገጽ፡ front-line worriors ወእምዝ፡ ሶበ፡ ተራከቡ፡ መስተቃትላነ፡ ገጽ፡ ምስለ፡ መለሳይ፡ ንስቲተ፡ ጐንደዩ። ‘ Ensuite, lorsque les guerriers du front se rencontrèrent avec les cavaliers musulmans (malasāy), ils s’arrêtèrent un peu ’ 40 l. 31-34 (ed.), 47 l. 23-25 (tr.), ወሶቤሃ፡ ተምዓ፡ ዝንቱ፡ መሲሐ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወወረደ፡ ምስለ፡ መስተቃትላን፡ እለ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ እለኒ፡ ጐዩ፡ ኮኑ፡ መስተቃትላነ፡ ገጽ። ‘ Alors l’oint du Seigneur fut irrité et descendit avec les guerriers qui étaient avec lui; ceux qui s’étaient enfuis se tournèrent (contre les ennemis) ’ 119 l. 1-3 (ed.), 135 l. 15-17 (tr.), vid. ገጽ፡

woorden.betekenis: meridies, tempus meridianum, meridie, plaga meridionali
woorden.definitie: subst. meridies i.e. tempus meridianum: Joh. 4,6; Sir. 43,3; 3 Reg. 18,27; ጊዜ፡ ቀትር፡ Marc. 15,33; Dan. apocr. 1,7; 2 Reg. 4,5; Cant. 1,7; ይጼልለከ፡ እምፀሓየ፡ ቀትር፡ Sir. 31,19; ጋኔነ፡ ቀትር፡ Ps. 90,6; ብርሃነ፡ ቀትር፡ Jes. 18,4; ቀትረ፡ መዓልት፡ Sir. 35,16; Jer. 15,9; እስከ፡ ቀትር፡ 2 Esr. 18,3; እስከ፡ ቀትረ፡ መዓልት፡ 1 Reg. 11,11 (nisi hoc ቀትረ፡ pro verbo accipere malueris). Acc. adv. ቀትረ፡ meridie Job 5,14; Jer. 6,4; Zeph. 2,4; Gen. 18,1. – Pro plaga meridionali usurpatum videtur Kuf. p. 48.

woorden.betekenis: tinea, blatta, parvi ricini, ricinus, pediculus, curculio, v
woorden.definitie: subst., coll., 1 tinea, blatta [ni fallor i.q. قَمَاقِمُ parvi ricini; sicut قَمْلٌ ricinus, pediculus syriace significat tinea, curculio] σής, σῆτες ቍንቍኔ፡ Sir. 42,13; Prov. 25,20; Hos. 5,12 (עָשׁ); ቍንቍኔ፡ ልብስ፡ Jes. 33,1; ከመ፡ ብላዐ፡ ቍንቍኔ፡ Jes. 51,8; Job 27,18; ልብስ፡ ዘተበልዐ፡ እምቍንቍኔ፡ Job 13,28; ፃፄ፡ ወቍንቍኔ፡ σὴς καὶ βρῶσις Matth. 6,19. 2 ቅንቅን፡ vermis in ligno nascens, alas habens, auribus periculosus, M.F. (vid. ቍንቍን፡ Lud. lex. amh. c. 35, et Isenb. p. 77sub ቍንቍን፡ et ቍንቍኔ፡). – Voc. Ae.: ቍንቍኔ፡ ብ፡ ነቅዝ፡ qʷǝnqʷǝne, Pl. ቍንቍኔያት፡ qʷǝnqʷǝneyāt G ቍንቍኔ፡ qʷǝnqʷǝne, Pl. ቍንቍኔያት፡ qʷǝnqʷǝneyāt tinea, ver qui ronge le bois, les étoffes, le papier, les fruits, etc. ― ነቀዝ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 59. 177 L ቍንቍኔ qʷǝnqʷǝne woodworm, moth 435a

woorden.betekenis: constrinxit fune, impedivit, constringendi, continendi, se,
woorden.definitie: I,1 [vicinum videtur قَمَطَ constrinxit fune, (قَنَطَ impedivit ); ad notionem constringendi et continendi etiam قَنِيتٌ, كَنِيتٌ, قَنَتَ, كَمَتَ referenda videntur. Alii comparaverint نَطَقَ II] Subj. ይቅንት፡ Imperat.ቅንት፡ (raro ቅነት፡), se vel sibi cingere, accingere, praecingere a c. Acc. cinguli, vestis, gladii, quo quis cingitur et c. ውስተ፡ membri cingendi: Ps. 108,18; ህየንተ፡ ቅናቲኪ፡ ዘወርቅ፡ ሐብለ፡ (v. በሐብል፡) ቅንቲ፡ Jes. 3,24; ዘትቀንት፡ አሐዱ፡ παραζώνην μίαν 2 Reg. 18,11; ቅንቱ፡ (v. ቅነቱ፡) ሠቀ፡ Jes. 15,3; Jer. 4,8; Jer. 6,26; Thren. 2,10; Joel 1,8; Hez. 27,31; ቀነተት፡ ሠቀ፡ ውስተ፡ ሐቌሃ፡ Judith 8,5; 1 Reg. 2,18; ይቀንት፡ ጽድቀ፡ ውስተ፡ ሐቌሁ፡ Jes. 11,5; ቀነታ፡ (ለመጥባሕት፡) ውስተ፡ ሐቌሁ፡ Jud. 3,16; 1 Reg. 25,13; Ps. 44,4. b c. Acc. membri cingendi et በ፡ cinguli vel vestis: ቅንት፡ ሐቌከ፡ ከመ፡ ብእሲ፡ Job 38,3; Job 40, 2; Jer. 1,17; አጽኒዓ፡ ወቀኒታ፡ ሐቌሃ፡ Prov. 29,35; Job 21,18 Platt; Act. 12,8; ቀኒተክሙ፡ ሐቌክሙ፡ በጽድቅ፡ Eph. 6,14. c omisso Acc: Ps. 64,13; Ps. 92,1; Luc. 12,37; Luc. 17,8; c. በ፡, ut: ቅንት፡ በልብሰ፡ ዐጌ፡ ወቀነትኩ፡ ልብሰ፡ ዐጌ፡ Herm. p. 66. – Voc. Ae.: አጠቀ፡ ቀነተ፡ ገለደ፡ ብ፡ ታጠቀ።

woorden.betekenis: canon, constitutio, regula, lex, canones regum, canones conc
woorden.definitie: n. peregr., sc. κανών in Acc., m. et fem. (ut F.N. 9), Pl. ቀኖናት፡ 1 canon a constitutio, regula, lex: ቀኖና፡ ብሂል፡ ሥርዐት፡ Syn.; ቀኖናተ፡ ነገሥት፡ canones regum F.N. 32; ቀኖና፡ ጉባኤ፡ canones concilii Syn. p. 179; ቄርሎስ፡ ሠርዐ፡ ጊዜ፡ ጸሎተ፡ ቀኖና፡ tempus horarum canonicarum Sx. Nah. 15; Kedr al. qannonā, Pl. ቀኖናት፡ qannonāt G ቀኖና፡ qannonā, Pl. ቀኖናት፡ qannonāt canon, constitutio, poenitentia imposita, canon, constitution, pénitence imposée Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 59. 177 L ቀኖና፡ qannonā, (Lt) ቃኖን፡ qānon canon, dogma, constitution, rule, rite, penance imposed by a priest, devotion (religious), prayer, supplication 73. 434b

woorden.betekenis: valde rubuit, zelotypus fuit, invidit, invidia, zelotypum es
woorden.definitie: I,1 [amh. ቀና፡; قَنَأَ valde rubuit; קִנֵּא zelotypus fuit, invidit; ܩܶܢܶܐܬܳܐ invidia] Subj. ይቅናእ፡ 1 zelotypum esse, invidere; c.c. ላዕለ፡ pers. Gen. 26,14; Gen. 30,1; Gen. 37,11; Num. 5,14; Kuf. 24; Ps. 36,1; Ps. 72,3; Prov. 23,17; Sir. 45,18; Jes. 11,13; c. ለ፡ pers.: Kuf. p. 103; c. በ፡ pers. vel rei: Kuf. p. 103; Prov. 23,17; Asc. Jes. 11,19; ኢትቅናእ፡ በፍናዊሆሙ፡ Prov. 3,31. 2 zelare, ardenti studio vel ira flagrare: ቀንኡ፡ ቅንአተከ፡ Judith 9,4; ከመ፡ ይቅንኡ፡ ተረፍ፡ Jes. 11,11; Deut. 32,19. a c. ለ፡ ejus, cujus causam quis defendit: Num. 11,29; Num. 25,11; Num. 25,13; 3 Reg. 19,10; ቀናእኩ፡ ለሠናይ፡ Sir. 51,18; ቀንአ፡ ለፍርሀተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Sir. 45,23; Rom. 10,2 Platt; 2 Cor. 11,2; rarius c. ላዕለ፡, ut Rom. 10,2; ቀናእኩ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፡ ዐቢየ፡ ቅንአተ፡ Zach. 1,14; ቀንአ፡ ላዕሌሃ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ወፈቀደ፡ ያውስባ፡ Vit. Dan.; vel c. Acc. pers.: ከመ፡ ይቅናእ፡ ተረፈ፡ Jes. 11,11 var. b c. ላዕለ፡ ejus, contra quem quis ira flagrat Num. 25,11. c seq. ለ፡ c. Infin.: ኢትቅንኡ፡ ለመዊት፡ Sap. 1,12; vel ለ፡ c. abstr., ut: ቅናእ፡ ለንስሓ፡ Apoc. 3,19; seq. ከመ፡ c. Subj., Kuf. 30. 3 aemulari: ትቀንኡ፡ ለገቢረ፡ ሠናይ፡ μιμηταί 1 Petr. 3,13; ተመየጥ፡ ኀበ፡ ቃህም፡ ወቅናእ፡ ርእየከ፡ ፍናዊሁ፡ Prov. 6,6; Rom. 11,11; Gal. 4,18 Platt. qanʾa G ቀንአ፡ qanʾa I,1 ይቀንእ፡, ይቅናዕ {sic} zelo, individia, amore ductus fuit, être poussé par la jalousie, l’envie, l’amour ― ቀና፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 60. 177 L ቀንአ qanʾa (yǝqnāʾ) be envious, be jealous, be zealous, be eager, emulate, imitate 433b

woorden.betekenis: se invicem aemulari, sibi invicem invidere, contentiosum ess
woorden.definitie: III,3 1 se invicem aemulari Gal. 4,18 ant.; Herm. p. 70. 2 sibi invicem invidere, contentiosum esse, rixari: ትትቃንኡ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ምስለ፡ ዝንቱ፡ (v. ትትቀንኡ፡ in cod. <Α< Kuf. 7; 1 Cor. 3,3; 2 Cor. 12,20; Jac. 3,14; Jac. 4,2; ተቃንኦ፡ φθόνος 1 Petr. 2,1; Tit. 3,3; ἔρις 1 Tim. 6,4.>Α> taqānǝʾa G ተቃንአ፡ taqānǝʾa III,3 sibi mutuo invidere, se jalouser, s’envier réciproquement Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 60. 177 L ተቃንአ taqānǝʾa be envious of one another, emulate 433b

woorden.betekenis: zelotypia, invidia, aemulatio, simultas, studium ardens, amo
woorden.definitie: et rarius ቀንአት፡ (Num. 25,11 FH), n. act. et subst., m. et fem., 1 zelotypia Num. 5,15 in C; Num. 5,18 in c. 2 invidia, aemulatio, simultas: ቅንአት፡ ወመዐት፡ ζῆλος καὶ θυμός Sir. 30,24; Prov. 6,34; ζῆλος Koh. 9,6; Job 5,2; Sir. 40,5; Jes. 11,13; Rom. 13,13; φθόνος በቅንአተ፡ ዲያብሎስ፡ Sap. 2,24; Phil. 1,15; Matth. 27,18; Asc. Jes. 3,30. 3 studium ardens, amor ardens Cant. 8,6; Sir. 48,2; ቅንአተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ይገብር፡ ዘንተ፡ Jes. 9,7; Jes. 26,11; Jes. 37,32; ያነሥእ፡ ቅንአተ፡ Jes. 42,13; አይቴ፡ ውእቱ፡ ቅንአትከ፡ Jes. 63,15; c. Gen. objecti: Num. 25,11; Ps. 68,12; Ps. 118,139; 2 Cor. 11,2; በከመ፡ ኮነ፡ ውስቴቱ፡ (ለጳውሎስ፡) ቅንአት፡ በሕገ፡ ኦሪት፡ ከማሁ፡ ተመክዐበ፡ ውስቴቱ፡ ቅንአቱ፡ በሕገ፡ ኢየሱስ፡ Sx. Haml. 5. 4 ira vel indignatio ardens Hez. 23,25; Ps. 78,5; እሳተ፡ ቅንአቱ፡ Zeph. 1,18; Hebr. 10,27. qǝnʾat, ቀንአት፡ qanʾat, ቅንዐት፡ qǝnʿat G ቅንአት፡ qǝnʾat zelus, studium, invidia, odium, jalousie, passion, envie, haine Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 60. 177 L ቅንአት qǝnʾat, ቀንአት፡ qanʾat, () ቅንዐት፡ qǝnʿat jalousy, envy, emulation, rivalry, ardor, indignation 433b

woorden.betekenis: galbanum, stactes
woorden.definitie: et ቅንአት፡ (Kuf.; Ex. 30,34 FH) subst. [قِنَّةٌ galbanum ] galbanum, stactes species, χαλβάνη Ex. 30,34; στακτή 2 Par. 9,24; Ps. 44,10; Lit. 174,3; ስኂን፡ ወቀንአት፡ ወማየ፡ ልብን፡ ወሰንበልት፡ Kuf. 3.

woorden.betekenis: tonus, sonus modulatus, vox canora, modulatio, melodia
woorden.definitie: subst., tonus, sonus modulatus, vox canora, modulatio, melodia: ከመ፡ ቃለ፡ መዝሙር፡ ዘሐዋዝ፡ ቃለ፡ ቃናሁ፡ φωνὴ ψαλτηρίου ἡδυφώνου εὐαρμόστου Hez. 33,32; አውታረ፡ መሰንቆ፡ ፍሉጥ፡ ወሊሉየ፡ ቃና፡ Fal. f. 64; Chrys. Ta. 29(vid. sub ልኅሉኅ፡) Org. 4; demas መስፍነ፡ (κορυφαῖος) a ትዕይንት፡ (χορός) neque relinquetur ቃና፡ ወኢሥርዐት፡ (μέλος κσὶ τάξις) Chrys. ho. 34. for ንስር፡ ቃና፡ vid. ንስር፡

woorden.betekenis: cantus lugubris, sonus musicus, cantatrix, fidicina
woorden.definitie: I,1 [cui radici praeter II ቀነወ፡ amh. ቀኘ፡ et ቅኔ፡, comparanda sunt קִינָה cantus lugubris (קוֹנֵה) ܩܺܝܢܬܳܐ sonus musicus, قَيْنَةٌ cantatrix, fidicina, fortasse etiam נִגֵּן] i.q. ቃነየ፡ I,3; Nah. 3,8 var.; Hez. 23,42 var.

woorden.betekenis: cantus (liturgicos) cantare, modulari, concentum facere, taq
woorden.definitie: (an ተቀነየ፡) III,1 (III,2 ?) cantus (liturgicos) cantare vel modulari, concentum facere, c Acc. cantus: ካህናት፡ ይትቀነዩ፡ ዘንተ፡ መዝሙረ፡ በዜማ፡ ሐዘንዚን፡ Genz. f. 36; ትትቀነይ፡ ዘንተ፡ Genz. f. 45; ወእምዝ፡ በል፡ ወተቀነይ፡ ሃሌሉያ፡ Cod. Mus. Brit. LIV,7; Gad. T.H. taqanya ‘ present qǝne ’ ወዘንተ፡ ይብል፡ በሕሰመ፡ ቃሉ፡ ወበልሳኑ፡ ጽልሕው፡ በከመ፡ ሰመያ፡ ለእግዝእትነ፡ ማርያም፡ እንዘ፡ ይትቀነይ፡ በቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ በቅድመ፡ ገጸ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ‘ He said this in the wickedness of his words and with his deceitful tongue, as he (once) abused Our Lady Mary while presenting qǝne in church before the king ’ 3 l. 4-6 (ed.), 2 l. 25-27 (tr.)

woorden.betekenis: cantus modulatus, modulatio
woorden.definitie: subst. cantus modulatus, modulatio: አህ፡ አህ፡ ለድምፀ፡ ቅኔሆሙ፡ ለካህናት፡ በቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ እስመ፡ ናሁ፡ ተለጕመ፡ ዜማ፡ መሰንቆ፡ ጥዑም፡ በውስተ፡ መዝሙር፡ ወጸሎት፡ Genz. f. 46.

woorden.betekenis: salire, absilire, desilire, subsilire, exsilire, prosilire,
woorden.definitie: I,1 et I,2 [قمص قلص قلز قزّ نقز قحز قحص قهز, vid. etiam Ges. thes. p. 1226] I,1 Subj. ይቅንጽ፡, salire, ይቀንጹ፡ Sap. 5,22; ይቄንጽ፡ Phlx. 106; Cant. 2,8. a absilire, ቀነጸ፡ እምኔሃ፡ ወወፅአ፡ Jsp. p. 306; ቅንጽ፡ ἀποπήδησον Prov. 9,18; fortasse etiam Hen. 89,52 (saliendo se abripere). b desilire: ቀነጸ፡ እምዲበ፡ ሰረገላ፡ M.M. f. 66. c subsilire (sursum) Jsp. p. 369. d exsilire, prosilire contra aliquem, insilire: ቀነጸ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ወዘበጦ፡ በሰይፍ፡ Jsp. p. 292; ቀነጸ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ሐሙሁ፡ ወቀተሎ፡ Jsp. p. 298; ቀነጹ፡ ላዕለ፡ ሠራዊተ፡ ዮናናውያን፡ Jsp. p. 294. e adsilire i.e. (beispringen) succurrere: በረድኤትነ፡ ቅንጽ፡ Cod. Mus. Brit. LIV,7. qanṣa, qannaṣa, ቀንጸ፡ qanṣa G ቀንጸ፡ qanṣa I,1 sauter; le parfait statif ቀንጸ፡ manque dans le . Le fondamental intensif ቀነጸ፡ qannaṣa I,2 est mentionné et présenté comme forme concurrente du fondamental simple ቀነጸ፡ I,1. Texte et référence: ዙኀር፡ ሮጸ።, ዙኀር፡ ቀንጸ። Ms. BAVet47, fol. 106r. 178 L ቀነጸ qanṣa (yǝqnǝṣ), ቀነጸ qannaṣa, (178) ቀንጸ qanṣa leap, spring away 435a

woorden.betekenis: thos, vulpes, qʷǝnṣǝl, qʷanāṣǝl, renard, fox, jackal
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem. (Luc. 13,32), Pl. ቈናጽል፡ thos, vulpes Jud. 1,34; Jud. 15,4 seq.; Cant. 2,14; Ps. 62,9; 1 Reg. 24,15 var.; 3 Reg. 20,10; 2 Esr. 14,3; Hez. 13,4; Hen. 89,10 seq.; Thren. 5,18; Matth. 8,20; ይበውእኑ፡ ዐንበሳ፡ ውስተ፡ ግበ፡ ቍንጽል፡ አው፡ ቍንጽል፡ ኀበ፡ ዐንበሳ፡ (proverbium) Th. P.; epitheton hominum astutorum, ut Herodis Luc. 13,23; Arii, Sal. Nic. 2; et Satanae: ሰይጣን፡ ቍንጽል፡ ጕሕላዊ፡ ወዐንበሳ፡ ዘይጥሕር፡ Kedr f. 87. – Voc. Ae.: ቍንጽል፡ ዘ፡ ቀበሮ፡ de quo vid. Harris II Anh. p. 51. [A saliendo nominatum videtur animal, cfr. ቀነጸ፡]. qʷǝnṣǝl, Pl. qʷanāṣǝl G ቍንጽል፡ qʷǝnṣǝl vulpes, renard Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 60. 178 L ቍንጽል qʷǝnṣǝl (Pl. ቈናጽል qʷanāṣǝl) fox, jackal 435b

woorden.betekenis: stare, se sistere, positum esse, constitutum esse, niti, con
woorden.definitie: I,1 [קוּם ܩܳܡ قَامَ] Subj. ይቁም፡ stare, se sistere Matth. 6,5; Matth. 13,2; Matth. 20,3; Matth. 20,6; Matth. 24,15; Matth. 27,11; Matth. 27,47; Luc. 5,1; Luc. 6,17; Luc. 19,8; Luc. 21,36; Luc. 23,35; Joh. 1,26; Joh. 18,18; Joh. 18,25; Joh. 20,14; ቁም፡ በእገሪከ፡ Hez. 2,1; Hez. 37,10; ቆመት፡ በእግረ፡ ሰብእ፡ ዲበ፡ ምድር፡ Dan. 7,4; አዕማደ፡ ወርቅ፡ ዘይቀውሙ፡ በዲበ፡ ምክያደ፡ ብሩር፡ Sir. 26,18; ቁም፡ ውስተ፡ አንቀጸ፡ ቤተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Jer. 7,1 vers. nov.; ቆሙ፡ ቅድመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Job 1,6; παραστήσονται Jes. 60,10; Ps. 5,4; ከመ፡ ኢይቁም፡ ውስተ፡ መካንከ፡ Sir. 12,12; ቁም፡ ላዕሌየ፡ 2 Reg. 1,9; 2 Reg. 1,10; ቆመ፡ ማእከለ፡ – ወማእከለ፡ Jes. 59,2; Hen. 18,3; አፍአ፡ ይቀውም፡ Sir. 21,23; ይቀውሙ፡ በፍርሀት፡ 4 Esr. 8,25. Passim c. Acc. loci, ut: ኢየሱስ፡ ይቀውም፡ ሐይቀ፡ M.M. f. 207. a stare i.e. positum esse Jud. 16,26; Hen. 14,22; እመ፡ ቆመ፡ አረፋቲሃ፡ 2 Esr. 4,16; 1 Esr. 2,20; c. በ constitutum esse in re, niti re Rom. 5,2; 2 Tim. 2,19; 1 Petr. 5,12; 1 Joh. 5,19; Col. 1,17. b consistere, insistere, subsistere, inhiberi, de iis, quae antea movebantur: 1 Reg. 20,38; Gen. 19,17; Ex. 15,8; Matth. 2,9; Matth. 20,32; Luc. 18,40; አኮኑ፡ በእዴሁ፡ ቆመት፡ ፀሓይ፡ Sir. 46,4; Jos. 10,12; Sir. 10,13; ቁም፡ ምስሌየ፡ 1 Reg. 9,27; 1 Reg. 30,9; 4 Reg. 2,8; አንቅዕተ፡ ማያት፡ ይቀውሙ፡ ወኢይውሕዙ፡ 4 Esr. 4,28; Luc. 8,44; Hen. 90,41; ቆመ፡ ዝናም፡ እምነ፡ ሰማይ፡ Gen. 8,2; (afflictus transeunti inclamat:) ቁመኒ፡ ቁመኒ፡ በእንተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ (c. suff. Dat.) Gad. T.H.; ቁም፡ subsiste (in legendo) i.e. pausam fac Oct. Aeth. P. II. p. 164; Rom. 3,2. c adstare, circumstare Gen. 45,1; Asc. Jes. 6,14; Matth. 26,73; Joh. 3,29; Joh. 12,29. d locum tenere, persistere (opp. fugere), ከመ፡ ትቁም፡ ውስተ፡ ፀብእ፡ Hez. 13,5 vers. nov.; c. ቅድመ፡ Dan. 8,4; Dan. 8,7; Jos. 7,12; Jos. 7,13; Job 9,4; Ps. 129,3; Sx. Mag. 28 Enc. e perstare i.e. α perdurare, constare (bestehen) Job 8,15; Koh. 1,4; 4 Esr. 5,40; 4 Esr. 7,12; 4 Esr. 8,63; ኪዳንክሙ፡ ኢይቀውም፡ Jes. 28,18; Jes. 51,8; ሃይማኖትሰ፡ ለዓለም፡ ትቀውም፡ Sir. 40,12; Sir. 41,13; ይቀውም፡ ስሙ፡ ለትውልደ፡ ትውልድ፡ Sir. 39, 9; Hen. 50,4; Hen. 41,2; Matth. 12,25; Luc. 11,18; Col. 1,17. β perseverare: ቁም፡ በሥርዐትከ፡ Sir. 11,20; 4 Esr. 9,31; ኢትቁም፡ በነገር፡ እኩይ፡ Koh. 8,3; Joh. 8,44. γ manere Ruth 2,7; ይቀውም፡ ምስሌከ፡ Sir. 12,15; ሐሠር፡ ቅድመ፡ ዐውሎ፡ ዘኢይቀውም፡ Sir. 22,18; ቁመኒ፡ Ex. 34,2; Num. 9,8 ( mane me ). δ ratum esse vel fieri Num. 30,5; Num. 30,8; Num. 8,12; Matth. 18,16; 2 Cor. 13,1; ዘመኑ፡ ቃል፡ ይቀውም፡ Jer. 51,28; ኢይቀውም፡ ትእዛዙ፡ ejus testamentum irritum est F.N. 41,2. ε confirmari: ወቆመ፡ ግብሩ፡ ὠρθώθη 1 Esr. 1,21. ζ exsistere: ዘእንበለ፡ ትቁም፡ ምድር፡ 4 Esr. 1,6; Ps. 89,2; oriri c. እምነ፡ Hen. 44. f praepositum esse, praeesse, c. ላዕለ፡ Ruth 2,5; c. ለ፡ 1 Thess. 5,12; Prov. 26,17; de patriarcha Alexandrino ዘቆመ፡ Sx. Jac. 5 Enc. g resistere, insurgere, obsistere c. ላዕለ፡, ut: ትቀውሙ፡ ላዕለ፡ ነፍስየ፡ Job 21,27; Lev. 19,16; Num. 26,9; Ps. 17,43; Ps. 17,52; Ps. 43,7. h assistere, adesse alicui protegendo vel defendendo, c. ለ፡ ut Ps. 19,1; (cfr. Prov. 26,17); እቀውም፡ ለዛቲ፡ ሀገር፡ Jes. 38,6; Dan. 12,1; vel c. Acc. pers.: ጥበብየ፡ ቆመተኒ፡ Koh. 2,9; ቁሙኒ፡ በፍኖት፡ Enc. Ter 16. i foras stare i.e. segregari c. እምነ፡ vel አፍአ፡ እምነ, ut: ይቁም፡ እምቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ Clem. f. 127; Clem. f. 128; Clem. f. 133; Clem. f. 146; Clem. f. 161 seq.; ይቁም፡ ἀφοριζέσθω II Can. Ap. 43. (vid. ቅዉም፡ et ተቀውመ፡; etenim poenitentes ይቀውሙ፡ አፍአ፡ እምቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ Clem. f. 146.).

woorden.betekenis: stare facere, sistere, erigere, statuere, collocare, ponere,
woorden.definitie: rarius አቆመ፡ (ut 1 Reg. 6,14; Macc. f. 16 al.) II,1, Imperf. ያቀውም፡, Subj. ያቅም፡ stare facere, sistere, Ps. 30,10; ምንት፡ ያቀውመከ፡ አፍአ፡ Gen. 24,31; Matth. 20,6; አቀመኒ፡ በእገርየ፡ Hez. 2,2; 4 Esr. 10,44; አቀመኒ፡ በብረክየ፡ Dan. 10,10. a erigere, statuere Job 40,12; አቀመ፡ ቤተ፡ Sir. 47,13; ያቀውም፡ ደብተራሁ፡ Sir. 14,25; መኑ፡ አቀሞሙ፡ ለአድባር፡ Jes. 40,13; ምስለ፡ Dan. 3,1; Asc. Jes. 4,11; altare Gen. 33,20; turres Judith 1,3; lapides Deut. 27,4; columnam Kuf. 27; Gen. 28,18; ያቀውሞ፡ ውስተ፡ ቤቱ፡ Jes. 44,13. b collocare, ponere: ኢታቅሞ፡ መንገሌከ፡ Sir. 12,12; Num. 8,13; Matth. 4,5; Matth. 18,2; Matth. 25,33; Luc. 9,47; Act. 1,23; Act. 22,30; አቀመኒ፡ ከመ፡ መጠራ፡ ለሐጽ፡ Thren. 3,12; አቅሙ፡ ላዕሌሃ፡ ነዳፍያነ፡ Jer. 28,27. c stabilire: 2 Reg. 3,10; ያቀውሞን፡ ለእገሪከ፡ ከመ፡ ኢያንቀልቅላ፡ ἐρείσει Prov. 3,26. d surgere vel prodire facere, excitare, suscitare: አቅም፡ ነቢያተ፡ ለስምከ፡ Sir. 36,20; Hen. 84,6; in specie: prolem, Deut. 25,7; Deut. 25,8; Ruth 4,5; Ruth 4,10; Kuf. 22; ኣቀውም፡ ለዳዊት፡ ሠርፀ፡ ጽድቅ፡ Jer. 23,5; አቀመት፡ ውሉደ፡ እምላዕላ፡ መሐዛ፡ Sir. 23,23; Matth. 22,24; vel hostes 1 Reg. 22,8; ኣቀውም፡ ገጽየ፡ ላዕለ፡ ይእቲ፡ ነፍስ፡ ἐφιστάναι Lev. 17,10; Lev. 20,3. e instituere, constituere, foedus Gen. 6,18; Gen. 9,11; Ex. 34,27; Kuf. 15; በመሐላ፡ አቀመ፡ ሎቱ፡ ኪዳነ፡ Sir. 44,21; legem 2 Cor. 10,13; festum Enc.; diem Act. 17,31; testimonium Ps. 104,9; ያቀውመከ፡ ሎቱ፡ ሕዝበ፡ ቅዱሰ፡ Deut. 28,9; ልዑለ፡ መዓርገ፡ እምዕራገ፡ ዲያቆን፡ ያቅሞ፡ in altiorem gradum, quam estgradus diaconi, constituat cum Enc. f stabilire i.e. confirmare, ratum facere, exsequi, ያቀውም፡ ቃለ፡ ገብሩ፡ Jes. 44,26; Jer. 36,10; እለ፡ ኢያቀውሙ፡ ቃለ፡ ኪዳንየ፡ Jer. 41,18; 1 Reg. 3,12; ኣቀውም፡ መሐላየ፡ Kuf. 24; ከመ፡ ያቅም፡ ቃሎ፡ Ruth 4,7; Num. 30,14; Num. 30,15; ከመ፡ ኣቅም፡ መሐላየ፡ Jer. 11,5; Ps. 20,11; Ps. 118,38; Hebr. 10,9; Hen. 84,5. g sistere; subsistere facere; cohibere, inhibere, detinere, Act. 8,38; አዘዘ፡ ያቅሙ፡ ሰረገላሁ፡ M.M. f. 47; አቅም፡ እዴከ፡ ἄνες τὴν χεῖρά σου 1 Par. 21,15; ምንት፡ አቀመክሙ፡ ዝየ፡ Jes. 52,5; ታቀውም፡ ዝናመ፡ ሰማይ፡ Hagg. 1,10; አቀምኩ፡ አፍላጊሃ፡ Hez. 31,15; 4 Esr. 13,46; 4 Esr. 13,49; Ps. 77,16; አኀዝዎ፡ ወአቀምዎ፡ Luc. 4,42. α morari (anstehen lassen): circumcisionem ኢይክሉ፡ አቅሞ፡ ወኢአድኅሮ፡ M.M. f. 292; Hen. 80,2. β desistere, absistere i.e. cessare, አቀመት፡ ወሊደ፡ Gen. 29,35. γ desistere vel desciscere facere c. Acc. et እምነ፡ Asc. Jes. 1,9. ʾaqama C for አቀመ፡ ሕገ፡ vid. ሕግ፡ (Grébaut)

woorden.betekenis: poni, constitui, abigi, segregari
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 poni, constitui Hebr. 8,1 Polygl. 2 abigi, segregari c. እምነ፡ Hen. 53,2 (vid. ቆመ፡ n. i.).

woorden.betekenis: stans, positus, collocatus, ratus, in usu receptus, exclusus
woorden.definitie: vel ቅውም፡ part. 1 stans, positus, collocatus Asc. Jes. 9,35; Sx. Jac. 9; እሙንቱ፡ ቅዉማን፡ ላዕሌሃ፡ (sc. ለቅጽር፡) Jsp. p. 370. 2 ratus, in usu receptus: ወውእቱ፡ (sc. ቀኖና፡ ባስልዮስ፡) ቅዉም፡ በኀበ፡ ግንጻውያን፡ ወመለካውያን፡ F.N. p. 9. 3 exclusus, segregatus: ሕሩም፡ ወቅውም፡ እምቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ Clem. f. 86; Clem. f. 89; ይኩን፡ ቅዉመ፡ ወሕሩመ፡ እምቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ Clem. f. 85; ቅዉም፡ እምኆኅተ፡ አንቀጸ፡ ብርሃን፡ Clem. f. 123; ርጉም፡ ወቅዉም፡ ወውጉዝ፡ ውእቱ፡ Clem. f. 160; ቅዉም፡ እማዕርገ፡ ቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ Clem. f. 127; II Can. Ap. 31. qǝwwum ወእመሂ፡ ሕዝባዊ፡ (ቅዉም፡ ወእመ፡ አኮ፡ ኢቅዉም፡ ሐዊሮ፡ ውስተ፡ ካልእት፡ ሀገር፡ ኢይትወከፍዎ፡) ዘእንበለ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ መባሕት፡ ይቁም። ‘ If an official or a layman — one with or without authority — moves to another region without a written permission, let him be barred ’ 101 (ed.), 70 (tr.) (‘The word qǝwwum stands for “barred” and “spokesman,” someone with authority.’ 70 n. 326 ); ቅውማንሰ፡ እሙንቱ፡ እለ፡ (ኢ)ከልእዎሙ፡ በዊአ፡ ቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን። ‘ “The spokesmen” are those who deny (an unauthorized person) entry to church ’ 102 (ed.), 71 (tr.)

woorden.betekenis: protector, defensor, patronus
woorden.definitie: part. act. protector, defensor, patronus: አነ፡ ቃውምከ፡ ወዐስብከ፡ ጥቀ፡ Kuf. p. 55; ንጉሥ፡ ልብው፡ ቃውመ፡ ሕዝብ፡ Sap. 6,26; Org. – Voc. Ae.: ቃውም፡ ሊቅ፡ ብ፡ አለቃ።

woorden.betekenis: statio, statura, altitudo, animus elatus?
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., 1 statio, ተዘከረኒ፡ በቆምየ፡ (var. pro ቁመትየ፡) Jer. 18,20. 2 statura Matth. 6,27; Luc. 12,25; Luc. 19,3; Cant. 7,8; 1 Reg. 9,2; Phlx. 60. 3 altitudo Apoc. 21,16; Ex. 25,10; Ex. 25,23; Ex. 30,2; ቆመ፡ አረፍት፡ Judith 1,2; Judith 1,4; ወኖኀ፡ ቆማ፡ Hez. 19,11; Hez. 31,3; Hez. 40,5; 2 Esr. 6,3; Dan. 4,7; Dan. 4,8; Jer. 52,21 vers. nov.; ኢይትዐወቅ፡ ኑኃ፡ ወግድማ፡ ወኢቆማ፡ Clem. f. 50; transl.: በአምጣነ፡ ኀይሉ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ቆሙ፡ Sir. 28,10; ደምስስ፡ ቆሞሙ፡ በእደ፡ ብእሲት፡ τὰ ἀνάστεμα ( animus elatus? ) Judith 9,10.

woorden.betekenis: statio, standi actus, statura, constitutio, substantia, Best
woorden.definitie: (ቍመት፡) n. act. 1 statio, standi actus: ተዘከር፡ ቁመትየ፡ Jer. 18,20. 2 statura Kuf. p. 86. 3 constitutio, substantia ( Bestand ): ሥርዐተ፡ ቁመተ፡ ዓለም፡ σύστασις κόσμου Sap. 7,17; (episcopus ne prae se contemnat clericos et laicos) እስመ፡ ውስቴቶሙ፡ ይከውን፡ ቍመተ፡ ጉባኤ፡ (ecclesiae) Const. Ap. 49. 4 status, conditio ( Stand, Zustand ): አኀው፡ (monachi): እለ፡ ይከውኑ፡ ውስተ፡ ቁመት፡ ፍጽምት፡ Phlx. 45. 5 segregatio, exclusio (vid. ቅዉም፡) ቁመት፡ ወሕርመት፡ Clem. f. 141; ἀφορισμός II Can. Ap. 72.

woorden.betekenis: locus standi, ubi quis stat, commoratur, statio, locus, stat
woorden.definitie: subst., ምቅዋማት፡ 1 locus standi, ubi quis stat vel commoratur; statio; locus; ቆመ፡ በበምቅዋሞሙ፡ (στάσις) 2 Esr. 19,3; በበምቅዋማቲሆሙ፡ 2 Par. 7,6 (φυλακαί); ቆመ፡ ፀሓይ፡ ወወርኅ፡ በበምቅዋሞሙ፡ Jos. 10,13; Hen. 12,4; ኢትምርሖ፡ ፍኖተ፡ ፀጋም፡ ምቅዋመ፡ አጣሊ፡ ርጉማን፡ ዳእሙ፡ ምርሖ፡ መንገለ፡ የማን፡ ምቅዋመ፡ አባግዒከ፡ ቡሩካን፡ Genz. f. 105; in ecclesia sit ዐጸደ፡ ምቅዋም፡ ለካህናት፡ Kid. f. 6; ምቅዋምከ፡ ዘልዑል፡ መዓርጋ፡ Sx. Masc. 12 Enc.; ምድረ፡ ምቅዋም፡ (terra, ubi quis aliquamdiu commoratur, Lud. ex) Enc.; (si quae mulier in judicium venire noluerit,) ትሢም፡ ላቲ፡ ህየንቴሃ፡ ዘይቀውም፡ በምቅዋማ፡ F.N. 43,6. 2 statumen, basis, fundamentum: ምቅዋማት፡ altaris Ex. 38,2 hebr. in Oct. aeth. P. II. p. 93; ἐσχάρα Sir. 50,12. 3 stagnum, ምቅዋመ፡ ማይ፡ Ex. 7,19; Sir. 43,20; Jes. 37,25; መርሕብ፡ ቅድመ፡ ምቅዋመ፡ ማይ፡ πύλη τοῦ ὕδατος 2 Esr. 18,1. 4 commoratio, mansio Hen. 49,2. 5 sectio, caput libri (i.q. ምዕራፍ፡): ወላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምቅዋም፡ ኍልቍ፡ Syn. f. 1(Lud. in comm. hist. p. 305 exhibet ምቅዋመ፡ ኍልቍ፡, male).

woorden.betekenis: corvus, cornix, qʷāʿ, raven, corvo, Trovandosi del grano che
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., Pl. ቋዓት፡, ቈዓት፡, ቆዓት፡ [onomatopoëticum, coll. غَاقٌ काक, al.; vid. etiam ጉጓ፡] corvus, cornix, κόραξ Gen. 8,7; Lev. 11,15; Deut. 14,14; Kuf. 11; Kuf. 37; ጸሊም፡ ከመ፡ ቋዕ፡ Cant. 5,11; Rel. Bar.; Clem. f. 224; ቋዓት፡ et ቈዓት፡ Zeph. 2,14; Jes. 34,11 (v. ቆዓት፡); Prov. 24,52; 3 Reg. 17,4; 3 Reg. 17,6; Job 38,41; Hen. 89,10; Luc. 12,24; ቆዓት፡ Sx. Sen. 12; እጕለ፡ ቋዓት፡ Ps. 146,10; κορώνη ከመ፡ ቋዓተ፡ በድው፡ Jer. 3,2; Ep. Jer. 54. – Voc. Ae.: ቋዕ፡ ዘ፡ ቍራ። qʷāʿ raven, ‘ corvo ’ እንዘ፡ ሀሎ፡ ሥርናይ፡ ዘአስተዳለውዎ፡ ከመ፡ ይሕርፅዎ፡ ለምሥዋዕ፡ ወመጽአ፡ ቋዕ፡ ጸሊም፡ ቋዕ፡ ብሂል፡ በነገረ፡ አክሱም፡ ይሰምይዎ፡ ኳኳ፡ ‘ Trovandosi del grano che avevano preparato per macinarlo per il sacrificio, venne un qʷāʿ (corvo) nero; qʷāʿ vuol dire ciò che nella lingua di ʾAksum chiamano kʷākʷā. ’ 86 § 216 (ed.), 52 § 216 (tr.) (‘« qʷāʿ... kʷākʷā »: entrambe le parole significano «corvo»; qʷāʿ è il termine corrente in etopico, vd. 456; 417.’ 52-53 n. 17 ); vid. ኳኳ፡

woorden.betekenis: compressus, arctus, angustus
woorden.definitie: part. (I,3) compressus, arctus, angustus: ፍኖተ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ጸባብ፡ ወመቃዐን፡ እንተ፡ ትወስድ፡ ውስተ፡ ሕይወት፡ Macc. f. 17 (cfr. Matth. 7,14); ፍኖተ፡ ጸባብ፡ ወመቃዐን፡ Gad. Kar.

woorden.betekenis: rufus, ruber, rubidus, rubicundus, rutilus, fuscus, qayyiḥ,
woorden.definitie: et ቀይሕ፡ adj., fem. ቀያሕ፡ (Num. 19,2) et ቀይሕት፡, Pl. m. ቀይሓን፡ (ቀዪሓን፡), fem. ቀይሓት፡ (ቀዪሓት፡) rufus, ruber, rubidus, rubicundus, rutilus: ቀይሕ፡ ከመ፡ ጽጌ፡ ረዳ፡ Gen. 25,25; Hen. 106,2; ከመ፡ ጽጌ፡ ረዳ፡ ቀይሕት፡ Enc. Sen. 1; ሕብራት፡ ቀይሓት፡ Fal. f. 16; ዘጽሑፍ፡ በቀይሕ፡ (ቀለም፡) Abush. 33; Abush. 46; vinum sacramenti ይኩን፡ ቀይሐ፡ ወኅሩየ፡ Kedr f. 89; ቀይሕ፡ ያክንት፡ Ex. 36,18; እብን፡ ቀዪሕ፡ Hez. 28,14; እብን፡ ቀይሕት፡ et ቀዪሓት፡ Hez. 28,16; እጐልት፡ ቀያሕ፡ Num. 19,2; ፈረስ፡ ቀይሕ፡ et አፍራስ፡ ቀይሓን፡ Zach. 1,8; Zach. 6,2; Apoc. 6,4; አርዌ፡ ቀይሕ፡ Apoc. 17, 3; πυρράκης 4 Reg. 16,12; πυρρός Cant. 5,10; κόκκινος Cant. 4,3; ቀይሐ፡ አልባስ፡ Jes. 63,1; ወርቅ፡ ቀዪሕ፡ vel ቀይሕ፡ Sir. 7,18; Bar. 3,30; Kebr. Nag. 22; Org. 2; φαιός; fuscus Gen. 30,35. qayyiḥ, qayyǝḥ, ቀዪሕ፡ qayyiḥ fem. qayyāḥ, qayyǝḥt; Pl. qayyǝḥān, qayyiḥān, fem. qayyǝḥāt, qayyiḥāt ‘Letteralmente: rossa’ ወአስተርአዮ፡ ካዕበ፡ ብእሲ፡ ግሩም፡ ወቀዪሕ፡ ራእዩ፡ ‘E di nuovo gli si rivelò un uomo temibile, dall’apparenza chiara’ 110 (190) l. 5 (ed.); 111 (191) l. 6–7 (tr.) (cf. 1025 che spiega ቀይሕ, come «light complexioned (Ethiopian)».’ 111 (191) n. 1) G ቀይሕ፡ qayyǝḥ ruber, rubicundus, rouge, rouge vif, rubicond Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 60. 178 L ቀይሕ qayyǝḥ, ቀዪሕ፡ qayyiḥ, fem. ቀያሕ qayyāḥ, ቀይሕት qayyǝḥt red, ruddy, fair (complexion) 456b

woorden.betekenis: pars rei purior meliorque, flos farinae, simila, similago, a
woorden.definitie: vel ቄቃሕ፡ subst. [referendum ad radices قَيَّح كَيَّح نَقِيَ נָקָה] proprie: pars rei purior meliorque, in specie: farinae, hinc flos farinae, simila, similago, ቄቅሐ፡ (v. ቄቀሐ፡) ሥርናይ፡ Deut. 32,14; Ps. 147,3; Jsp. p. 276; ቄቀሐ፡ ሥርናይ፡ Macc. f. 12. – Voc. Ae.: ቄቃሕ፡ ዘ፡ ፍትግ፡ aliud: ቄቅሕ፡ ዘ፡ ሕጽቦ። qeqǝḥ, ቄቃሕ፡ qeqāḥ G ቄቅሕ፡ qeqǝḥ simila, flos farinae triticeae, farine, fleur de farine de froment Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 57. 175 L ቄቅሕ qeqǝḥ, ቄቃሕ qeqāḥ (, *, ) fine flour, crushed cereal, hull, husk 438b

woorden.betekenis: haustus, cyathus, scyphus
woorden.definitie: subst., undo derivaverim Pl. አቅዳሕ፡ haustus, vel cyathus, scyphus (coll. قَدَحٌ Pl. أَقْدَاحٌ), ይስተዩ፡ ፫አቅዳሐ፡ ወይን፡ (sc. monachi moerore afflicti) Phlx. 79; ይስተይ፡ ፫ አቅዳሐ፡ በበዓላተ፡ እግዚእነ፡ ባሕቲቱ፡ Kedr f. 73.

woorden.betekenis: locus unde hauritur, puteus, emporium
woorden.definitie: subst. 1 locus unde hauritur, puteus, Org.; ምቅዳሐ፡ ፈውስ፡ ወዐዘቅተ፡ በረከት፡ Org.; ገይበ፡ ወርቅ፡ ምቅዳሐ፡ ስብሓት፡ Org. 2 locus unde merces hauriunt, emporium: ትከውን፡ ምቅዳሐ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ነገሥተ፡ ዓለም፡ Jes. 23,17.

woorden.betekenis: praeire, praecedere, antecedere, anteire, praevenire, ante v
woorden.definitie: I,1, (raro I,2 (ut Jes. 11,14 var.) [קָדַם ܩܕܰܡ قَدَمَ] Subj. ይቅድም፡ 1 praeire, praecedere, antecedere, anteire, c. Acc. Matth. 14,22; Matth. 26,32; Marc. 6,45; Marc. 10,32; Marc. 16,7; ሖሩ፡ ቅድሜየ፡ ቅድሙኒ፡ 1 Reg. 25,19; Sap. 12,8; c. እምነ፡ pers.: ንቅድም፡ እምብእሲትከ፡ Tob. 11,2; 1 Reg. 9,27; c. ለ፡ pers.: ለደም፡ ይቀድም፡ ላኳ፡ Sir. 22,24; ለእሳት፡ ይቀድም፡ ይጠይስ፡ ተነ፡ ጢስ፡ Sir. 22,24. 2 praevenire, ante venire, antevertere: Jud. 7,24 ann.; ይቀድመኒ፡ ወሪደ፡ Joh. 5,7; Matth. 21,31; Kuf. p. 28. 3 priorem esse, praestare, potiorem esse, a praecedere tempore: እለ፡ ቀደሙከ፡ Hen. 32,6; 4 Esr. 3,53. b ordine: እለ፡ ይቀድሙ፡ οἱ πρῶτοι Num. 10,13; Num. 10,14; እምኵሉ፡ ዘይቀድም፡ πρὸ πάντων ante omnia Jac. 5,12; 1 Petr. 4,8; hinc ቀዲም፡ prioratus, jus praecipuum: አምላክ፡ ፩ ዘእንበለ፡ ቀዲም፡ Org. 3; ቀዲም፡ ዘኮነ፡ ሎቱ፡ በውስተ፡ ርስት፡ F.N. 42,3. c creberrime cum aliis verbis conjunctum significat adverbia ante, primum, primo, prius, vel praepositiones prae, pro, ante in verbis compositis: α c.c. alio verbo in eodem tempore, numero et persona, ut: ይቀድማ፡ ወያመጽኣ፡ አሕማረ፡ ተርሴስ፡ ደቂቀኪ፡ ἐν πρώτοις ἀγαγεῖν Jes. 60,9; Jes. 61,4; ቅድም፡ ወንሣእ፡ προκαταλήψῃ Judith 2,10; plerumque omissa copula: Ex. 12,18; ትቀድም፡ ተሐውር፡ ምስሌሁ፡ πορεύεται μετ’ αυτοῦ ἐν πρώτοις Sir. 4,17; ይቄድሙ፡ (v. ይቀድሙ፡) ያወርዱ፡ እዴሆሙ፡ Jes. 11,14; ለእለ፡ ቀደመ፡ አእመሮሙ፡ οὓς προέγνω Rom. 8,29 Platt; et inverso ordine: ይሑሩ፡ ይቅድሙ፡ ውስተ፡ Judith 7,1; 2 Reg. 19,20; ንግር፡ አንተ፡ ቅድም፡ Jes. 43,26; 1 Cor. 15,3 rom. β c. Acc. Infin.: ቀደመ፡ ተምህሮ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ Kuf. 4; ቀደመ፡ ተወልዶ፡ Kuf. 36; ቦኑ፡ እምሰብእ፡ ቀደምከ፡ ተፈጥሮ፡ Job 15,7; Judith 10,13; ቅድም፡ ለከ፡ ነሢአ፡ ብእሲት፡ Tob. 4,12; Gen. 29,26; Gen. 33,4; Gen. 37,18; Prov. 26,18; 1 Tim. 2,13; 2 Petr. 1,20; 1 Joh. 4,19; Marc. 3,27. d ይቀድመከ፡ ተሐምዎ፡ tibi primo convenit (jus affinitatis) Ruth 4,4. 4 initium facere, incipere: ቀደመት፡ ማርያ፡ ወትቤ፡ ἐξῆρχε Ex. 15,21; ቅድሙ፡ እምቅዱሳንየ፡ Hez. 9,6; Kuf. p. 147; c.c. Infin., ut: ቅድም፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ኀዲገ፡ Sir. 34,17; ኢትቅድም፡ አውርዶ፡ እዴከ፡ Sir. 34,18, vel c. Subj. verbi: ዝንቱ፡ ቀደመ፡ ይኩን፡ ረዐይተ፡ 1 Par. 1,10; ንቀድም፡ በረድኤተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ንጽሐፍ፡ crebro ab initio librorum Mss.

woorden.betekenis: praecedere facere, priorem, primum reddere, primo loco const
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 praecedere facere i.e. a priorem vel primum reddere, primo loco constituere: አቅድምዎ፡ (ለዝ፡ ወርኅ፡) እምአውራኀ፡ ዓመት፡ Ex. 12,2. b praemittere: አቅድሙኬ፡ ምጽዋተ፡ ከመ፡ ይኩንክሙ፡ ሥንቀ፡ (sc. in itinere post mortem faciendo) Clem. f. 274; ወታቀድም፡ ዘንተ፡ ጸሎተ፡ Genz. f. 56. { c anteponere, praeferre, ut: አቅድምክዋ፡ እምኵነኔ፡ ወመናብርት፡ Sap. 7,8 in Abb. LV} 2 priorem esse in faciendo, praevenire, antevertere: ፈነወ፡ ሰራዊተ፡ ይዕርጉ፡ አቅዲሞ፡ እምኔሁ፡ 4 Reg. 12,17; Matth. 17,25. 3 prius vel antea fecisse vel facere aliquid: ተዘከረ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ዘአቅደመ፡ ምስለ፡ አበዊነ፡ Rel. Bar.; creberrime cum aliis verbis conjunctum ad significanda adv. prius, antea, primo, ( supra ) vel praepos. pro, prae, ante in verbis compositis: c.c. verbo finito: አቅደመ፡ ፈነወኒ፡ ቅድሜክሙ፡ Kuf. p. 149; c. Acc. Infin.: Ps. 73,2; Ps. 101,26; Kuf. 28; ዘያቀድም፡ ነጊረ፡ ὁ προλέγων Jes. 41,26; Sap. 18,19; Rom. 1,2; አቅደመ፡ ብሂል፡ προείρηκε Rom. 9,29; ያቀድምኑ፡ ዘሪአ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ይሕርስ፡ ምድረ፡ Jes. 28,24; 4 Esr. 4,62; ያቀድም፡ አእምሮ፡ προγιγνώσκει Sap. 8,8; አቅደመ፡ ሠሪዐ፡ προητοίμασε Eph. 2,10; Rom. 1,8; Matth. 14,8; በከመ፡ አቅደምኩ፡ ነጊረ፡ ut supra dixi Cyr. c. Pall. f. 81; Did. 3. 4 initium facere, incipere: አቅደመ፡ ስምዐ፡ ከዊነ፡ እስጢፋኖስ፡ Mavâs. 4. 5 ut videtur: obviam ferre, suggerere vel significare alicui aliquid: ኪያየ፡ አቅደመኒ፡ (v. አቀመኒ፡) እሕንጽ፡ ἐσήμηνέ μοι οἰκοδομῆσαι 1 Esr. 2,4.

woorden.betekenis: id quod ante est, pars antica, frons, initium, primordium, t
woorden.definitie: subst. 1 de loco: id quod ante est, pars antica ( frons ): እምቅድም፡ ወእምድኅር፡ Mavâs. 17; Apoc. 4,6; ውስተ፡ ቅድመ፡ ደብተራ፡ Num. 3,38; እመንገለ፡ ቅድም፡ Ex. 28,14; እምቅድም፡ 2 Reg. 10,9; ውስተ፡ ቅድመ፡ ἀπέναντι Num. 33,7. 2 de tempore: a initium, primordium Gen. 10,10; Cant. 4,8; እምቅድመ፡ ዓለም፡ Hebr. 4,3 ant.; Hen. 41,4; እምቅድመ፡ ዓለም፡ ወእስከ፡ ለዓለም፡ 1 Par. 29,10; እምቅድም፡ ἀπ᾽ ἀρχῆς 1 Joh. 1,1 Platt; እምቅድም፡ ወእስከ፡ ለዓለም፡ Hen. 39,10; Hen. 62,7. b tempus praeteritum, prius: እምቅድም፡ πρότερον prius, olim 1 Par. 9,2; እከያቲሁ፡ ዘቅድም፡ iniquitates ejus priores Sx. Enc.; (corpus ejus translatum) እመቃብሪሁ፡ ዘቅድም፡ ኀበ፡ መቃብሪሁ፡ ዘካዕብ፡ Sx. Teq. 6 Enc. c primitiae: ቅድመ፡ (v. ቀዳሜ፡) እክሎሙ፡ Sir. 45,20. d prioratus: ብኵርናከ፡ ዘቅድመ፡ ልደት፡ Kuf. p. 88. Hinc ቅድመ፡ part of n. pr. (personal name) vid. ቅድመ፡ ሰገድ፡

woorden.betekenis: primo loco, ante, prae, protenus, ex adverso, a parte antica
woorden.definitie: Acc. A Adv. 1 loci: a primo loco Gen. 33,2; Matth. 19,30; Matth. 20,16. b ante, prae: ሑሩ፡ ቅድመ፡ Gen. 32,17; ፀብአ፡ ቅድመ፡ እምነ፡ ንጉሥ፡ Judith 2,19; protenus Luc. 19,28; ex adverso 2 Reg. 18,13 var.; a parte antica, orientem versus Gen. 2,8. 2 temporis et ordinis: antea, prius, primum, primo: Matth. 17,10; Matth. 20,8 rom. (ቅድም፡ Platt); Joh. 19,39; Kuf. p. 29; Hen. 39,8; ቅድመ፡ (v. ቅድም፡ Imperat.) ጠይቅ፡ ወድኅረ፡ ትጌሥጽ፡ Sir. 11,7; Rom. 3,2 Platt; Act. 7,12; Marc. 16,9; Matth. 5,24; Matth. 7,5; Matth. 13,30. B Praep.; pron. suff. per ê sibi subjungit, ቅድሜየ፡, ቅድሜከ፡ al. 1 ቅድመ፡ simplex a loci: ante, pro, prae Gen. 24,7; Gen. 33,3; Gen. 33,14; Gen. 45,5; Ex. 14, 19; Ex. 33,2; Num. 14,43; Jos. 4,23; Jos. 20,32; 1 Reg. 25,19; Judith 15,13; Matth. 5,24; Matth. 6,2; Matth. 11,10; Luc. 1,76; Luc. 9,52; Luc. 10,1; Act. 14,13; Apoc. 4,6; ሮጸ፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ Luc. 19,4; ቅድሜየ፡ እሜልዕ፡ Phil. 3,14. b coram, in facie, ex adverso, ἐναντίον Gen. 13,9; Gen. 47,6; Luc. 1,8; ἐνώπιον ቅድሜየ፡ አንቲ፡ ዘልፈ፡ Jes. 49,16; Ps. 17,8; 1 Reg. 12,3; Gen. 31,35; Ex. 3,21; Deut. 16,16; Deut. 31,11; ἀπὸ προςώπου Lev. 19,32; ቅድመ፡ አዕይንቲሁ፡ ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς 1 Reg. 8,6; Rom. 3,18; κατὰ πρόςωπον Gen. 16,12; Gen. 25,18; κατέναντι Ps. 5,6; Marc. 11,2; Luc. 19,30. c temporis: ante: ቅድመ፡ ዮም፡ Lud. e V.S. (aliâs እምቅድመ፡ q.v.). d ordinis Rom. 3,2 ant. 2 ለቅድመ፡ proprie: versus coram i.e. ut sit coram Ex. 29,24; erga 2 Cor. 8,21; 2 Cor. 8,24. 3 በቅድመ፡ ante, prae, coram, ex adverso, ἔμπροσθεν Matth. 5,16; በቅድሜሆሙ፡ ወበድኅሬሆሙ፡ Ep. Jer. 5; ἐναντίον, ἔναντι Gen. 6,8; Gen. 13,13; Gen. 47,15; Ex. 19,11; Num. 3,4; Num. 3,7; Num. 11,10; Ruth 4,4; Hen. 39,8; Hen. 39,11; Hen. 39,12; Hen. 62,8; Marc. 2,12; Luc. 20,26; Luc. 24,19; ἐνώπιον Ps. 9,26; Jud. 20,39; Ex. 34,10; Lev. 20,17; κατενώπιον 2 Cor. 2,17; 2 Cor. 12,19; በቅድመ፡ አዕይንትየ፡ ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς 1 Reg. 29,6; de sententia alicujus ( ut videtur alicui aliquid) በቅድመ፡ ሰብእ፡ ἐν ὄψει ἀνθρώπων Sap. 3,4 et Gen. 29,20 (ἐναντίον); Hen. 4. 4 እምቅድመ፡ a de iis quae ante aliquid fuerunt et ex hoc loco exeunt vel removentur: a, de, ex, e conspectu, ἀπὸ sive ἐκ προςώπου Ps. 16,3; Ps. 17,10; Act. 3,19; Hen. 37,4; Gen. 2,10; Gen. 4,14; Gen. 45,1; 1 Reg. 4,17; 1 Reg. 23,5; Jos. 4,7; Jos. 8,6; Ex. 14,19; Hen. 9,10; 2 Thess. 1,9; Apoc. 12,14. b a parte anteriore alicujus i.e. α ante Jos. 4,11; Jos. 5,1; 2 Reg. 10,9. β adversus, contra, እስመ፡ እምቅድሜሆሙ፡ ውእቱ፡ ነፋስ፡ ἄνεμος ἐναντίος Matth. 14,24. c passim i.q. מׅפְּנֵי, de causa, a qua quid proficiscitur: ob, propter Jud. 6,6; Hos. 10,15; 3 Reg. 8,11. d de tempore: ante, abhinc: ሞተት፡ አጋር፡ እምቅድመ፡ ሳራ፡ Kuf. 19; እለ፡ እምቅድሜከ፡ Sir. 41,3; Num. 13,22; Ex. 10,14; Jes. 18,5; Matth. 5,12; Matth. 24,38; Luc. 21,12; Joh. 10,8; Col. 1,17; 2 Tim. 4,21; Judae 25; እምቅድመ፡ ፲ወ፬ዓመቱ፡ 2 Cor. 12,2; 1 Reg. 9,15; እምቅድመ፡ ፫አውራኅ፡ ዘማእረር፡ Am. 4,7; እምቅድመ፡ ክልኤቱ፡ ዓመት፡ ዘድልቅልቅ፡ Am. 1,1; Joh. 12,1. C Conj. ቅድመ፡ et እምቅድመ፡ priusquam, antequam, c.c. Subj., ut: ቅድመ፡ ይሱጥ፡ ርእሶ፡ Cyr. c. Pall. f. 89; እምቅድመ፡ ይትፈጠር፡ ዓለም፡ ፈጠረኒ፡ Sir. 24,9; Gen. 2,5; እምቅድመ፡ ትሙት፡ Judith 16,24; 4 Esr. 11,17; Prov. 8,23; Joh. 17,24.

woorden.betekenis: primum, primo, prius, antehac, antea, olim, quondam, antiqui
woorden.definitie: adv.
