(gramm. § 163,2) 1 primum, primo Gen. 43,20; Joh. 5,4; Joh. 8,7; Joh. 18,13. 2 prius, antehac, antea, እለ፡ ያአምርዎ፡ ቀዲሙ፡ Job 42,11; Jer. 7,12; እለ፡ ቀዲሙ፡ ትፈርህዎሙ፡ Jes. 33,7; Jes. 16,13; 4 Esr. 5,1; 4 Esr. 10,43; 4 Esr. 10,44; Hen. 16,2; 1 Petr. 2,10; 1 Petr. 3,20; 1 Tim. 1,13; Joh. 16,4; olim, quondam, antiquitus 1 Reg. 9,9; Kuf. 29; Jes. 52,4; Judith 5,7; 3 praepositiones et notam Genitivi (ዘ፡) et st. constr. ante se fert, et significandis adjectivis prior, praeteritus, pristinus, priscus al. inservit: መዋዕለ፡ ቀዲሙ፡ αἱ ἡμέραι αἱ πρότεραι Νum. 6,12; በመዋዕለ፡ ቀዲሙ፡ ἐξ ἡμερῶν ἀρχαίων Jes. 37,26; ዘቀዲሙ፡ τὰ πρότερον Jes. 41,22; τὰ ἀρχαῖα Jes. 43,18; τὰ πρότερα Jes. 48,3; Jes. 65,17; አኮ፡ ዘቀዲሙ፡ መዋዕል፡ οὐ προτέραις ἡμέραις Jes. 48,7; በዘቀዲሙ፡ መዋዕል፡ Hez. 38,17; አበዊሆሙ፡ ዘቀዲሙ፡ Jer. 11,10; እምቀዲሙ፡ ἀπ᾽ ἀρχῆς Jes. 48,8; Joh. 1,2; nec non praedicati vice fungitur Apoc. 12,9

woorden.betekenis: primus, primi, qadām, Saturday, Jewish Sabbath, Le jour suiv
woorden.definitie: adj. primus, መንገደ፡ ቀዳም፡ σαββάτου ὁδόν primi sc. sabbathi Act. 1,12 Platt (ቀዳሚት፡ ሰንበት፡ rom.), si quidem lectio bona est. qadām subst. (day of the week) Saturday, Jewish Sabbath ወበሳኒታሁ፡ ዘውእቱ፡ ዕለተ፡ ቀዳም፡ ተንሥአ፡ እምህየ፡ ወረሰየ፡ ፍኖቶ፡ መንገለ፡ ለርዊ፡ ‘ Le jour suivant, qui était un samedi, (le roi) partit de là, et se dirigea vers Larwi ’ 86 l. 10-11 (ed.), 98 l. 22-24 (tr.)

woorden.betekenis: primus, prior, primae literae, libri prioris et posterioris,
woorden.definitie: adj., fem. ቀዳሚት፡, Pl. ቀደምት፡, fem. ቀዳምያት፡ A Adj. 1 primus, prior (adj. ordinale) Gen. 32,18; Ex. 12,15; Ex. 12,16; Ex. 40,2; 4 Reg. 1,14; Dan. 9,1; 4 Esr. 9,5; Koh. 1,11; Matth. 10,2; Matth. 17,27; Matth. 19,30; Matth. 20,8; Matth. 20,10; Luc. 2,2; 1 Cor. 15,45; Apoc. 21,1; እምቀዳሚ፡ እስከ፡ ተፍጻሜቱ፡ Hen. 2,2; ጽላት፡ ከመ፡ ቀዳምያት፡ Ex. 34,1; በዓለ፡ ቀዳሚ፡ ማእረር፡ Kuf. p. 63; Kuf. p. 79; ቀዳሚ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ primae literae Hebr. 5,12; እምነ፡ ቀዳሚ፡ መዋዕልኪ፡ Judith 8,29; አይኑ፡ ትእዛዝ፡ ቀዳሚት፡ Marc. 12,28; ዘቀዳሚ፡ ወዘደኃሪ፡ Ps. 138,4; መጻሕፍት፡ ዘቀዳሚ፡ ወዘደኃሪ፡ libri prioris et posterioris (sc. Testamenti, seu V. et N.) Lud. e Syn. Ubi ቀዳሚ፡ per se ponitur, pron. suff. ሁ፡ assumere amat: ቀዳሚሁ፡ እምላዕለ፡ ብእሲት፡ ወጽአት፡ ኀጢአት፡ Sir. 25,24; Joh. 1,1; ቀዳሚሁ፡ አበዊክሙ፡ Jes. 43,27; vid. etiam sub litera C infra; etiam ubi Adjectivi vice fungitur, pronomen suff., substantivo affigendum, ad se trahere potest: በዓመት፡ ቀዳሚሁ፡ ለዝ፡ ሱባዔ፡ Kuf. p. 46; passim substantivo ope pron. relativi adjungitur, ut: ተኣምር፡ ዘቀዳሚ፡ Ex. 4,8 (coll. Gen. 32,18; 4 Esr. 9,5). 2 pristinus, prior, superior, priscus, antiquus: ነገሥት፡ ቀደምት፡ 2 Par. 1,12; Jes. 19,11; ነቢያት፡ ቀደምት፡ Zach. 1,4; በመዋዕለ፡ ቀደምት፡ ἐν ταῖς πρότερον ἡμέραις Judith 8,18; ቀደምተ፡ ዓለም፡ Job 8,8; Sir. 2,10; Kuf. 23; Hen. 37,2; ቀደምት፡ እለ፡ ይርባሕ፡ Sir. 16,7; አበው፡ ቀደምት፡ ( patriarchae ) Hen, 70,4; Act. 7,8; οἱ ἀρχαῖοι Matth. 5,21; 2 Reg. 20,18; 3 Reg. 3,1. 3 princeps: ቀደምት፡ αἱ ἀρχαί principatus Eph. 3,10; Col. 1,16 Col. 2,15; Tit. 3,1; Rom. 8,38. B Subst. abstr., et ቀዳሚ፡ et ቀዳሚት፡ 1 ቀዳሚ፡ initium, principium, primordium: ቀዳሚሃ፡ ለጥበብ፡ ፈሪሀ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Ps. 110,9; Prov. 1,7; ቀዳሚሃ፡ ለትዕቢት፡ Sir. 10,12; Sir. 10,13; Sir. 37,16; ቀዳሚሁ፡ ለካልእ፡ ዓለም፡ 4 Esr. 4,14; 4 Esr. 7,12; ቀዳሜ፡ ማእረር፡ Ruth 1,22; በቀዳሚ፡ Gen. 1,1; አመ፡ ቀዳሜ፡ የአረሩ፡ initio messis 2 Reg. 21,9; እምቀዳሚ፡ ab initio Hen. 88,1. 2 ቀዳሚት፡ status vel conditio prior (opp. ደኃሪት፡) Job 8,7; Job 42,12; Luc. 11,26. 3 primum in suo genere a praestantissimum: ቀዳሜ፡ ተግባሩ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ Job 40,44; Num. 24,20. b primitiae: ቀዳሜ፡ ወልድየ፡ Gen. 49,3; Deut. 33,21; ቀዳሜ፡ ቅድሳት፡ Sir. 7,31; ቀዳሜ፡ ማእረሩ፡ Jer. 2,3; Ex. 35,5; Lev. 23,10; Deut. 18,4; Deut. 26,10; Ps. 77,56; Rom. 8,23; ቀዳምያት፡ Sir. 7,31; Mal. 3,8; Hez. 48; Lit. 160,1; Syn. C Adv. ቀዳሚ፡ (gramm. § 163,2), raro ቀዳሜ፡ (ut Marc. 4,28) primum, primo, prius, antea, olim, quondam, pridem Hen. 37,3; 1 Cor. 12,28; Marc. 4,28; 4 Esr. 10,55; Hen. 15,6; Hen. 58,6; 1 Reg. 3,10: ቀዳሜ፡ ኵሉ፡ πρῶτον πάντων 1 Tim. 2,1. pron. suff. ሁ፡ assumit (vid. A. 1.): ቀዳሚየ፡ ቃለ፡ አልብየ፡ ወትካትየ፡ Ex. 4,10; 4 Esr. 4,1.

woorden.betekenis: antecessio, prioratus, jus praecipuum, principatus, primatus
woorden.definitie: n. act. 1 antecessio, prioratus, M.M. f. 193; አልቦ፡ ቅድመት፡ ለሀልዎቶሙ፡ (sc. personarum Trinitatis) Lud. e L. M.; jus praecipuum haeredis F.N. 42,5. 2 principatus, primatus, ቅድመት፡ ኮነ፡ ዲበ፡ መትከፍቱ፡ ἀρχή Jes. 9,6 var.; Did. 29; አሐቲ፡ ቅድመት፡ ወአሐቲ፡ ስፍነት፡ Ssal. Req.

woorden.betekenis: primus, prior
woorden.definitie: et ቀዳማይ፡ adj. (ordinale), fem. ቀዳማዊት፡, ቀዳማይት፡, ቀዳማዪት፡ (2 Par. 28,17 var.) primus, prior Ex. 12,2; Deut. 24,4; Jes. 41,4; Jes. 44,6; Jes. 48,12; Dan. 7,4; Zach. 6,2; 1 Par. 12,15; Asc. Jes. 7,19; Asc. Jes. 10,27; 4 Esr. 1,20; 4 Esr. 11,15; 4 Esr. 11,19; 1 Esr. 3,16; Hen. 40,4; Hen. 69,2; Hen. 69,4; Kuf. 24; Sir. 24,28; Matth. 21,28; Apoc. 1,17; Apoc. 21,1; ὁ ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς 1 Joh. 2,13; ቀዳማይት፡ Cyr. c. Pall. f. 69; ህርቃኖስ፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ (opp. juniore vel altero) Jsp. p. 327.

woorden.betekenis: exsistentia primordialis, prioratus temporalis, aeternitas,
woorden.definitie: subst. exsistentia primordialis, prioratus temporalis, ( aeternitas ): አልቦ፡ ጥንት፡ ለቅድምናከ፡ ወለድኅርናከ፡ አልቦ፡ ፍጻሜት፡ F.N. in Proleg.; (personae Trinitatis) ዕሩያን፡ በባሕርይ፡ ወበአምላክና፡ ወበቅድምና፡ F.M. 27,8; ወልድ፡ ኢቀደመ፡ እምአብ፡ በቅድምና፡ Fid. Jac. Bard.; verbis አቅደምከ፡ ሣርሮታ፡ ለምድር፡ (Hebr. 1,10) አኀዘ፡ የአምር፡ ( coepit monstrare ) ቅድምናሁ፡ Chrys. ho. 3; ቅድምናሁ፡ ወሀልዎቱ፡ ለዓለም፡ Chrys. ho. 12.

woorden.betekenis: primum, praestantissimum, principium, initium, exordium, pro
woorden.definitie: et መቅድም፡ subst. 1 primum in suo genere a praestantissimum: Cant. 4,14. b principium, initium: መቅድመ፡ ቃል፡ ἡ ἀρχὴ τῶν λογίων Hebr. 5,12 Platt; ገብሩ፡ መቅድመ፡ ርኵስ፡ Kuf. p. 31. c exordium, prolegomena, introductio librorum: F.N. in Proleg.; መቅድመ፡ ወንጌል፡ Cod. Mus. Brit. VIII,1; Cod. Bibl. Bodl. Ox. X,1; መቅደመ፡ ጳውሎስ፡ 148. d adverbialiter usurpatur መቅድመ፡ primum, primo, initio, primitus, potissimum: ἐν τῇ ἀρχῇ Prov. 8,23; πρῶτον Matth. 6,33; Clem. f. 268; 1 Thess. 4,16 Platt; መቅድመ፡ (opp. ድኅረ፡) Jer. 27,17 vers. alt.; ውእቱ፡ መቅድመ፡ ተቀብረ፡ Kuf. 4; ውእቱ፡ መቅድመ፡ ገብረ፡ በዓለ፡ መጸለት፡ Kuf. 16; መቅድመ፡ ante omnia Kedr f. 39; መቅድመ፡ ፈድፋደ፡ maxime vero seu potissimum Lit. 170,2. e praepos. α ante መቅድመ፡ ኵሉ፡ ante omnia F.M. 27,1; fortasse Hen. 61,7. β coram Hen. 48,2. 2 principatus, imperium, Kuf. p. 45 ann. 11.

woorden.betekenis: sordidus, immundus, venenum
woorden.definitie: n. peregr. 1 nomen libri cujusdam liturgici: መጽሐፈ፡ ቄድር፡ ዘአንበሩ፡ መምህራን፡ በእንተ፡ ዘክሕደ፡ ሃይማኖቶ፡ አው፡ ዘአርኰሰ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ ምስለ፡ ዘኢምእመናን፡ አው፡ ተባዕት፡ አው፡ አንስት፡ አው፡ መነኮስ፡ አው፡ መነኮሳይት፡ Homines hujus generis contaminati secundum ritum in hoc libro descriptum aqua et oleo variis precibus et nominibus mysticis recitatis consecrato asperguntur et repurgantur. [Nomen e قَذْرٌ sordidus, immundus ortum videtur]. Exstat in Bibliotheca Tubingensi et in Abbadiana. Praeterea Voc. Ae. enumerant 2 inter plantarum nomina ቄድር፡ ዘ፡ መርዝ፡ venenum; 3 inter vestium nomina ቄዳር፡ ዘ፡ ጥቁር፡ ግምጃ፡ (nomine proprio ቄዳር፡ Ps. 119,5; Cant. 1,5 male intellecto).

woorden.betekenis: cidaris, tiara
woorden.definitie: , ቄዳርስ፡, ቂዳርን፡, ቄድራን፡, ቀዲራን፡, ቄዳራን፡ al., n. pers. gr. κίδαρις cidaris, tiara Ex. 36,36; Lev. 8,13; Lev. 16,4; Sir. 45,12.

woorden.betekenis: cedrus, Cedron
woorden.definitie: , ቄድሮን፡, ቄዳር፡ n. peregr. 1 κέδρος cedrus Cant. 5,15; Cant. 8,9; Sir. 24,13; Hez. 17,3; 3 Reg. 5,9; 3 Reg. 6,13; Kuf. 13; Kuf. 21(ubi a ቄድሮን፡ distinguitur ቄዳር፡ ዘስሙ፡ አረባተ፡ vel አርቦት፡ p. 77). Etiam ቄድሮና፡ 3 Reg. 5,10. 2 Cedron torrens inter Hierosolyma et montem olivarum (קִדְרוֹן): ፈለገ፡ ቄድሮስ፡ Joh. 18,1 (ቄድሮስ፡ ፈለገ፡ አርዝ፡ Platt, coll. 2 Sam. 15,23 al.).

woorden.betekenis: sanctum habere, sanctum declarare, reddere, sanctificare, re
woorden.definitie: I,2 [קִדַּשׁ ܩܰܕܶܫ قَدَّسَ] 1) sanctum habere: ቀድስዎ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ Jes. 8,13; እመ፡ ቀደስኮን፡ (ለሰንበታት፡) ለእግዚአብሔር፡ καλέσεις ἅγια τῷ θεῷ Jes. 58,13; Jer. 17,22; Deut. 5,12; Kuf. 2. 2 sanctum declarare vel reddere, sanctificare, rem sacram instituere, sabbathum Gen. 2,3; Kuf. 2; Sir. 36,9; እቄድሶሙ፡ ለሕዝብ፡ ሊተ፡ Kuf. 2; ይቄድሰከ፡ ἔσται σοι εἰς ἁγίασμα Jes. 8,14; Hez. 20,12; Lev. 21,23; Jos. 7,13; Jer. 1,5; Matth. 23,17; Joh. 17,17; Eph. 5,26; Hebr. 9,13; c. Acc. et እምነ፡ Lev. 16,19. 3 consecrare, ritu sacro inaugurare, dedicare, Ex. 29,1; Ex. 29,44; Lev. 8,12; Lev. 8,15; Num. 7,1; 1 Reg. 16,5; Ps. 45,4; 4 Esr. 9,9; c. ለ፡ Dei Ex. 13,2; Lev. 22,2; Lev. 22,3; Num. 3,13; Deut. 15,19; ecclesias Sx. Teq. 25; Sx. Mag. 20; ቀድሱ፡ ኵሎ፡ አብያተ፡ ክርስቲያናት፡ ዘሐነጽክምዎሙ፡ ወኅትምዎሙ፡ በማኅተመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘውእቱ፡ ቅብአ፡ ሜሮን፡ ቅዱስ፡ F.M. 28,1. 4 sacra administrare, sacrificium altaris (ቅዳሴ፡) celebrare vel peragere, ἱερατεύειν Ex. 28,3 (c. Acc. Dei, μοι; coll. 29,46; absol. de sacerdotibus Christianorum, sacrificium celebrantibus: Can. Ant. 3(4); አልባሰ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡ ዘይቄድሱ፡ ቦሙ፡ F.M. 31,5; Abush. 50; ለቀሲስ፡ ሥልጣን፡ ከመ፡ ይምሀር፡ ወያጥምቅ፡ ወይቀድስ፡ ወይባርክ፡ ሕዝበ፡ F.N. 6. 5 sanctum praedicare, trisagion cantare, Hen. 61,12 (ቀድሶት፡); Lit. 165,2; ይሴብሕዎ፡ ወይቄድስዎ፡ ወይባርክዎ፡ Clem. f. 15; ቦ፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ ዘይዜምር፡ ወቦ፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ ዘይቄድስ፡ ወቦ፡ ዘይዌድስ፡ Clem. f. 61.

woorden.betekenis: sanctum haberi, sanctum se praestare, sanctum reddi, sanctif
woorden.definitie: III,2 reflex. et pass. 1 sanctum haberi, sanctum se praestare Lev. 22,32; Matth. 6,9; Ex. 29,43; እትቄደስ፡ ብኪ፡ Hez. 28,22; ሶበ፡ ተቀደስኩ፡ በላዕሌክሙ፡ Hez. 36,23; ተቀደስከ፡ በኀቤነ፡ Sir. 33,4. 2 sanctum reddi, sanctificari Ex. 29,37; Lev. 6,11; Lev. 6,20; Hagg. 2,12; Jes. 10,17; ውእቱ፡ እምከርሠ፡ እሙ፡ ተቀደሰ፡ ይኩን፡ ነቢየ፡ Sir. 49,7; 1 Reg. 21,5; 1 Cor. 7,14; 1 Tim. 4,5; 1 Thess. 4,3; Hebr. 2,11; Hebr. 10,10; c. እምነ፡ ut: ይትቄደስ፡ ምድር፡ እምኵሉ፡ አበሳ፡ Kuf. 4; c. ለ፡ Dei Num. 6,8; 3 se purificare vel sanctificare 1 Reg. 16,5; እለ፡ ይትቄደሱ፡ οἱ ἀγνιζόμενοι Jes. 66,17 vers. alt. 4 consecrari, ritu sacro inaugurari, dedicari: ካህናት፡ እለ፡ ተቀደሱ፡ Hez. 48,11; Ex. 29,33; ቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ ዘተቀደሰት፡ Sx. Mij. 15. 5 sanctum praedicari, Lit. Chr.

woorden.betekenis: sanctus, sacer, alicui, sanctissimus, sacrosanctus, sanctus
woorden.definitie: part. et adj. 1 sanctus, sacer, a (sanctus) de Deo: Lev. 11,44; Lev. 11,45; Lev. 19,2; Jes. 6,3; Ps. 98,3; Ps. 98,10; ቅዱሰ፡ ቅዱሳን፡ ስሙ፡ Jes. 57,15; ቅዱስ፡ እስራኤል፡ Jes. 1,4; Jes. 5,19; Jes. 5,24 al.; ቅዱስ፡ ወዐቢይ፡ Hen. 1,3 al.; de Christo et Spiritu S.: Marc. 1,24; Luc. 4,34; Matth. 1,18; Matth. 28,19 al.; angelis: Job 15,15; Ps. 88,6; Ps. 88,8; Hen. 20,1 seq.; hominibus: Lev. 11,44; Lev. 19,2; Lev. 21,6; Num. 6,5; Ps. 33,10; ቅዱሳነ፡ ልዑል፡ Dan. 7,27; Hen. 38,4 seq.; ቅዱሳኒሃ፡ Ναζιραῖοι αὐτῆς Thren. 4,7; Luc. 1,70; Eph. 3,5; Eph. 3,8; Rom. 1,7; Rom. 12,13; 2 Cor. 1,2 al. b (sacer) de rebus et locis: መጻሕፍት፡ ቅዱሳት፡ Rom. 1,2; ኦሪት፡ Rom. 7,12; 2 Petr. 2,21; ምግባር፡ 2 Petr. 3,11; ጽዋዔ፡ 2 Tim. 1,9; ዕለት፡ ቅድስት፡ Jes. 58,13; Ex. 12,16; ኅብስት፡ 1 Reg. 21,4; ዕጣን፡ Ex. 30,35; Ex. 30,36; ዐራዝ፡ vel ልብስ፡ Ex. 28,2 seq.; በመካን፡ ቅዱስ፡ Lev. 6,19; Lev. 6,20; Matth. 24,15; ደብተራሁ፡ ቅዱስ፡ Sir. 24,10; ሀገር፡ ቅድስት፡ Jes. 48,2; Matth. 4,5. – c.c. ለ፡ pers. alicui: Lev. 19,24; Lev. 27,21; Lev. 27,30; Ex. 28,32 al. Crebro occurrit: ቅዱሰ፡ ቅዱሳን፡ sanctissimus, sacrosanctus Ex. 29,37; Ex. 30,10; Ex. 30,29; Ex. 30,36; Lev. 27,28; Kuf. 8; alium sensum habet ቅዱስ፡ ለቅዱሳን፡ sanctus sanctis (sc. sacerdotibus) Lev. 2,10; Lev. 6,18; Lev. 6,22; Lev. 7,6; vel ቅዱስ፡ ዘቅዱስ፡ Lev. 2,3. 2 Passim usurpatur substantive: sacrum, res sacra, sacrarium, sanctuarium: ቅዱሳን፡ τὰ ἅγια res Ex. 28,34; locus Ex. 29,30; Ex. 39,l; Lev. 10,4; ቅድስት፡ τὸ ἅγιον (res) Matth. 7,6; τὰ ἅγια (locus) Hebr. 9,12; Apoc. 21,3 rom.; ቅዱሰ፡ ቅዱሳን፡ sanctum sanctorum (pars tabernaculi vel templi) Lev. 16,33; Num. 18,10; Dan. 9,24; ቅድስተ፡ ቅዱሳን፡ Hebr. 9,25; Hebr. 13,11; ውስተ፡ ቤተ፡ ቅድስተ፡ ቅዱሳን፡ 2 Par. 3,10. Nonnumquam ቅድስት፡ i.q. ቅዳሴ፡ vel ቅድሳት፡, ut Rom. 6,19 Polygl. qǝddus C for ሰሙን፡ ቅድስት፡ vid. ሰሙን፡

woorden.betekenis: sanctitas, res sacra
woorden.definitie: n. act. sanctitas, ( res sacra ); hoc Lud. e Ps. 29,4 affert, sed ipse in sua editione exhibet ቅድሳት። 4 Esr. 10,30 var.

woorden.betekenis: sanctitas, sanctimonia, sanctificatio, sacrum, res sacra, sa
woorden.definitie: subst. 1 sanctitas, sanctimonia, (et sanctificatio ) a personarum: ἁγιότης Hebr. 12,10; ἁγιωσύνη 1 Thess. 3,13; Ps. 95,6; Ps. 144,5; ἀγιασμός 1 Thess. 4,7; 1 Tim. 2,15; 1 Cor. 1,30; Rom. 6,19; Rom. 6,22; Lit. Chr. Hoc titulo appellantur patriarchae (episcopi): ፈነውኩ፡ ለቅድሳቲከ፡ ፍቁርየ፡ τῇ σῇ ὁσιότητι Cyr. f. 116 (Mansi t. V p. 309). b nominibus rerum in genitivo postpositum adjectivo significando inservit: Ex. 29,29; Lev. 4,6; Lev. 4,17; መሥዋዕተ፡ ቅድሳት፡, ቀዳሜ፡ ቅድሳት፡ Sir. 7,31; Sir. 26,17; ሀገረ፡ ቅድሳት፡ Sir. 36,18; አልባሰ፡ ወርቅ፡ ዘቅድሳት፡ Sir. 45,10; ልብሰ፡ ቅድሳተ፡ ስብሐት፡ Sir. 51,11; Ps. 96,13; ንዋየ፡ ቅድሳት፡ 1 Esr. 6,17; Judith 4,3; F.M. 29. 2 sacrum, res sacra Lev. 22,2; Lev. 22,10; (Lev. 22,14); Num. 18,32; Ps. 131,19; 3 Reg. 7,37; 4 Reg. 12,18; 2 Par. 5,1; 2 Par. 15,18; Hez. 20,40; Hez. 22,8; Matth. 7,6; Lit. 158,2; Lit. 172,4; cfr. etiam ወሀቦ፡ ቅድሳቶሙ፡ ለሕዝብ፡ ἱερατείαν λαοῦ Sir. 45,7. 3 sacrarium, sanctuarium, locus sacer Lev. 6, 23; Lev. 16,2; Lev. 16,3; Lev. 16,17; Lev. 16,23; Lev. 16,27; Hez. 37,26; 4 Esr. 10,30. qǝddǝsāt ‘ la cose sante ’ (‘È un termine che tra gli altri significanti, si riferisce al Corpo e al Sangue di Cristo.’ 84 (196) n. 86) L qəddəsāt holiness, sanctity, sanctification, sacredness, sanctuary, holy things, divine service 423a

woorden.betekenis: sanctificatio, sanctitatis praedicatio, consecratio, dedicat
woorden.definitie: subst. Pl. ቅዳሴያት፡ et ቅዳስያት፡ 1 sanctificatio: ይከውን፡ (ለከ፡) ለቅዳሴ፡ Jes. 8,14 vers. alt.; ለቅዳሴ፡ ምድር፡ Kuf. 4. 2 sanctitatis praedicatio, Lit. 165,2; Seraphim ወሀቡ፡ ፫ቅዳሴያት፡ M.M. f. 8; መልአከ፡ ቅዳሴ፡ Kuf. 2; Kuf. 15; ለቅዳሴ፡ ወለበረከት፡ Kuf. p. 9; በኵሉ፡ ቅዳሴያቲክሙ፡ Hez. 20,40 var. 3 consecratio, dedicatio, inauguratio, encaenia: ቅብእ፡ ዘቅዳስያት፡ Const. Ap. 34; ቅዳሴ፡ ቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ F.M. 28,1; F. N. p. 11; Sx. Teq. 4; Sx. Teq. 25; Sx. Haml. 25, al. 4 consecratio eucharistiae a missa, peractio sacrificii altaris: በእንተ፡ ቅዳሴ፡ F.N. 12; አልባሰ፡ ቅዳሴ፡ F.N. 12, እምድኅረ፡ ፍጻሜ፡ ቅዳሴ፡ ዘምስጢር፡ Chrys. Ta. 17; Lit. 158,1; Lit. 163,2. b liturgia (anaphora, oratio eucharistica) Lit. 168,1; Lit. 170,1; Catal. cod. Aeth. Bibl. Bodl. p. 33; d’Abb. Cat. n. XIII et LXXII; ናሁ፡ ንቡር፡ በቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ ቅብጣዊት፡ ፫ ቅዳሴያት፡ ዘባስልዮስ፡ ወዘጎርጎርዮስ፡ ወቄርሎስ፡ F.N. 12. qǝddāse C for ሥርዐተ፡ ቅዳሴ፡ vid. ሥርዐት፡ (Leslau)

woorden.betekenis: sanctimonia, sanctitas
woorden.definitie: subst. sanctimonia, sanctitas a personarum: ኰነነ፡ ሴት፡ ሕዝቦ፡ በጽድቅ፡ ወበንጹሕ፡ ወበቅድስና፡ Clem. f. 12; ሀቦ፡ (presbytero consecrando) መንፈሰ፡ ቅድስና፡ Kid. f. 15; Org. 3. b de rebus: (Mariae) ገጸ፡ ቅድስና፡ ስቡሕ፡ l Sal. Mar. 4; ሀብተ፡ ቅድስናሆሙ፡ Ex. 28,34 (vid. ቅድሳት፡ Nr. 1, b). c titulus, quo appellantur patriarchae (episcopi): ነኀሥሥ፡ እምነ፡ ቅድስናከ፡ Sx. Teq. 12.

woorden.betekenis: ad sanctum pertinens, sanctus
woorden.definitie: adj. rel. ad sanctum pertinens, sanctus, Greg. in Epist., sed abusive (Lud.).

woorden.betekenis: res sacra, sacrum, locus sacer, sanctuarium, sacrarium, temp
woorden.definitie: , raro መቅድስ፡ (Ps. 10,4), subst., plerumque m., Pl. መቃድስ፡ 1 res sacra, sacrum, τὰ ἅγια Jes. 43,28; Hez. 5,11; መቃድስ፡ Chrys. ho. 17. 2 locus sacer, sanctuarium, sacrarium, templum, τὸ ἅγιον Jes. 26,21; Dan. 9,26; ἁγίασμα Sir. 47,13; Thren. 1,10; Thren. 2,7; ἁγιαστήριον Ps. 72,17; ναός Sir. 50,7; Sir. 51,14; 4 Esr. 10,28; ደብረ፡ መቅደስየ፡ τὸ ὄρος τὸ ἅγιόν μου Jes. 11,9; Jes. 56,7; Jes. 57,13; Dan. 9,16; Ps. 2,6; Ps. 14,1; ጽርሐ፡ መቅደስ፡ Ps. 5,8; Ps. 10,4; ሀገረ፡ መቅደስከ፡ Jes. 64,10; ቤተ፡ መቅደስ፡ Kuf. 49; Jes. 44,28; Jes. 60,13; Jes. 63,15; Judith 4,3; Dan. 5,2; Matth. 21,12; Matth. 24,1; Marc. 11,11; Marc. 11,15; de templo Hierosolymitano Clem. f. 94; de urbe Hierosolymorum f. 36; de ecclesiis Christianorum Genz. f. 69; θυπαστήριον Ex. 30,20 c. annot. et Matth. 23,35.

woorden.betekenis: boni odoris saporisque fuit, a rebus impuris sibi cavens, el
woorden.definitie: I,1 [قَدَا significatum specialem boni odoris saporisque fuit habet; vicina videntur قَزَزٌ a rebus impuris sibi cavens, elegans, politus, قَزْوٌ abstinentia a rebus impuris, nec non قَدَسَ (ቀደሰ፡) purus fuit; aliae linguae frequentant: זׇכַךְ זָכָה ܕܟܳܐ زَكَا] purum, candidum, nitidum esse: ኢቀደወ፡ ኅሊናሁ፡ (Judae Ischariotae) አላ፡ ከመ፡ ዛሕለ፡ ብርት፡ ኮነ፡ M.M. f. 202.

woorden.betekenis: fregit, contrivit, glarea, comminuta, parva, confregit, comm
woorden.definitie: quadril. I [ܩܨܳܐ fregit, قَضَّ contrivit (قَضَّةٌ glarea comminuta, parva ), قَضْقَضَ confregit comminuitque praedam leo; coll., כָּתַת חָתַת هَدَّ كَدَّ, ጐድጐደ፡] 1 rumpere, disrumpere, chordam, rete vel funem, Lud. e Vit. Jacobi Sar. 2 confringere, perfringere, conterere, contundere, quassare, comminuere, (plerumque συντρίβω, ἐκτρίβω, rarius κλάω, συγκλάω, συνθλάω, θραύω, συγκόπτω, πατάσσω), ut tabulas Ex. 34,1; Deut. 9,17; idola Ex. 23,24; Deut. 7,5; Deut. 9,21; Dan. 2,35; columnas Jer. 50,13; vas figlinum Jer. 19,10; Ps. 2,9; catenas Marc. 5,4; jugum Jes. 14,5; Jer. 2,20. Jer. 5,5; pessulos, vectes Jes. 45,2; Am. 1,5; arbores Ps. 28,5; Ex. 9,25; naves Ps. 47,6; cornua Thren. 2,3; Dan. 8,7; Hen. 90,13; Hen. 90,16; capita Jud. 9,53; Ps. 73,15; Ps. 109,6; brachia Job 38,15; Ps. 9,39; lumbos Sir. 32,22; ossa: በመፍጽሐ፡ ኀጺን፡ ዐጽመ፡ እገሪሁ፡ ቀጥቀጡ፡ Sx. Nah. 25Enc.; homines Jer. 9,21; Job 9,17; transl. ( frangere, conficere al.): hominem Job 38,15; Jes. 10,33; Jes. 22,17; Luc. 9,39 (ቀጥቂጦ፡); Satanam Rom. 16,20; reges Sir. 46,18; hostes ( clade ): ቀጥቅጦ፡ ለፀረዊ፡ Sir. 33,9; Jos. 10,10; Jos. 10,12; terram Jes. 2,10; Jes. 2,19; bellum (i.e. hostes, arma hostium) Ex. 15,3; እግዚአብሔር፡ ይቀጠቅጥ፡ ፀብአ፡ Judith 16,2; c. እምነ፡ effringere i.e. confringendo exstirpare: ንቀጥቅጦ፡ እምድረ፡ ሕያዋን፡ Jer. 11,19; frangere cor alicujus Jsp. p. 362(vid. ተባደወ፡).

woorden.betekenis: rumpi, disrumpi, confringi, perfringi, conteri, contundi, co
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 rumpi, disrumpi: መሥገርት፡ ተቀጥቀጠት፡ Ps. 123,7; Vit. Sam. 2 confringi, perfringi, conteri, contundi, comminui: Nah. 1,6; Jer. 27,23; Koh. 12,6; Job 24,20; Ps. 33,21; Ps. 36,16; ተቀጥቀጠኒ፡ አዕጽምትየ፡ Jes. 38,13; Kuf. 49; membra sibi frangere: (mulier, quae se de muro dejecit), ኢሞተት፡ ባሕቱ፡ ተቀጥቀጠት፡ ወተመንደበት፡ Jsp. p. 436; c. እምነ፡ sive defringi: ይትቀጥቀጥ፡ እዴየ፡ እምኵርናዕየ፡ Job 31,22, sive confringendo exstirpari: Num. 19,13; Gen. 34,30 (sine እምነ፡). Transl.: de viribus Ps. 36,18; hominibus: ይትቀጠቀጥ፡ ከመ፡ ዕፅ፡ ብኍብኍ፡ Job 24,20; Jes. 1,28; Jes. 8,15; Thren. 1,15; ተቀጥቀጠ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ συνετρίβη εἰς γῆν Jes. 14,12; corde contrito: ይትቀጠቀጥ፡ ልቦሙ፡ Jes. 19,1; populo, exercitu, clade affectis: Jos. 10,12; ቅጥቃጤ፡ ትትቀጠቀጥ፡ ወለተ፡ ሕዝብየ፡ Jer. 14,17; Jer. 31,4; hinc ተቀጥቅጦ፡ σύντριμμα clades Jes. 60,18; ይመጽእ፡ ተቀጥቅጦ፡ እምኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Jes. 13,6.

woorden.betekenis: fractio, fractura, comminutio, contritio, clades, afflictio
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., 1 fractio, fractura, comminutio, contritio: ቅጥቃጤ፡ ጻሕብ፡ Jes. 30,14; ቅጥቃጤ፡ ሐቌያት፡ Hez. 21,6; transl.: ቅጥቃጤ፡ ነፍስ፡ Jes. 65,14; ቅጥቃጤ፡ ልብ፡ (poenitentis) Jsp. p. 338. 2 clades, afflictio magna (שֶבֶר) Jos. 10,10; Ps. 13,7; Rom. 3,16; Jes. 59,7; Jes. 15,2; Jes. 22,4; Jes. 28,12; Jer. 4,6; Jer. 6,1; Jer. 6,14; Jer. 27,22; Thren. 2,11; Thren. 4,10; Am. 5,9; Prov. 10,14; Prov. 18,7.

woorden.betekenis: exilitas, exiguitas, tenuitas, tenues vestes, subtilitas
woorden.definitie: n. act. et subst., Pl. ቅጥነታት፡ 1 exilitas, exiguitas: ቅጥነተ፡ ልቡናሁ፡ (angustiae mentis) F.N. 43,2. 2 tenuitas, deinde concr. tenues vestes: እለ፡ ይለብሱ፡ ቅጥነታተ፡ ወአክሊለ፡ መንግሥት፡ (aliâs ቀጠንተ፡) Chrys. Ta. 7. 3 subtilitas: ርኢከኑ፡ ቅጥነተ፡ ልቡ፡ ለሐዋርያ፡ θέα πῶς συνετῶς αὐτὸ εἴρηκεν Chrys. ho. 1; በቅጥነተ፡ ልብ፡ (συντεῖναι τὸν νοῦν) Chrys. ho. 14; ቅጥነተ፡ ጥበብ፡ Chrys. ho. 26.

woorden.betekenis: fastidivit, taedio habuit, timidus fuit, iratus, fuit, vehem
woorden.definitie: inus., i.q. קוּץ, קוּט, ܩܛܰܥ fastidivit, taedio habuit; قَعَطَ timidus fuit; iratus fuit.; vehementer se gessit in debitorem; amh. ቄጣ፡

woorden.betekenis: impatientem, pertaesum esse, fieri, animo deficere, taedio h
woorden.definitie: III,2, raro III,1 (ut: እንዘ፡ ይትቈጥዑ፡ Sx. Genb. 12) 1 impatientem, pertaesum esse vel fieri, animo deficere, ὀλιγοψυχεῖν Jud. 16,16; ተቈጥዐት፡ ነፍሳ፡ ἀπεκάκησεν ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτῆς Jer. 15,9 (nisi ነፍሳ፡ Accusativum interpretari malueris); ἐκκακεῖν 2 Cor. 4,1; Herm. p. 38; κεκοπίακας Apoc. 2,3; ኢተቈጥዐ፡ ልቡ፡ Thren. 3,22; c. በ፡ rei Num. 21,4; Num. 21,5. 2 taedio habere, fastidire, aversari, taedet, piget, c. Acc. rei vel pers.: ተቈጥዐ፡ ነፍሶ፡ Jon. 4,8; 2 Cor. 1,8; ἐκπτύειν Gal. 4,14; ἐκκακεῖν Eph. 3,13; ኢትትቈጣዕ፡ ነባሪከ፡ μὴ ἀπαναίνου Sir. 4,4; βδελύσσεσθαι ለዘ፡ ያበዝኅ፡ ነቢበ፡ ይትቌጥዕዎ፡ Sir. 20,8; ἐξουδενεῖν Ps. 101,18; plerumque προςοχθίζειν Ps. 21,25; Ps. 94,10; Lev. 18,25; Lev. 18,28; Lev. 26,30; Sir. 6,25; Hebr. 3,10. 3 indignari, stomachari, aegre ferre: Tit. 3,2 Platt; ተቈጢዖ፡ (Infin. verb.) Cyr. ad Theod. f. 23; ተምዕዐ፡ ወተቈጥዐ፡ Kuf. p. 47; ኢተቈጥዖ፡ (Infin. nom.) Kid. f. 16; c. ዲበ፡, ut: ይትቌጣዕ፡ ዲበ፡ ሰብእ፡ Phlx. 48; c. Acc. pers. ተቈጥዕዎ፡ በእንተ፡ ዘ፡ Jsp. p. 302.

woorden.betekenis: fastidium, indignatio, ira, permanens, stomachus
woorden.definitie: subst., fem. et m. (ut Koh. 5,17) fastidium, indignatio, ira ( permanens ), stomachus, θυμός, ὀργή, μῆνις, Gen. 49,7; Ps. 36,8; Ps. 123,3; Koh. 5,16; Rom. 2,9; Eph. 4,31; Herm. p. 31; ቍጥዓከ፡ Hos. 9,7; ለዕለተ፡ መዐት፡ ወቍጥዓ፡ Kuf. 24; Kuf. 36; መዐትኒ፡ ወቍጥዓ፡ ርኩሳን፡ እሙንቱ፡ Sir. 27,30; በእንተ፡ መዐት፡ ወቍጥዓ፡ F.M. 21.

woorden.betekenis: cupressus
woorden.definitie: , (etiam ቂጵርስስ፡, ቄጰርሶስ፡, ቄጶረስስ, ቄጵሮስ፡, ቄጴርስ፡, ቄጶሮሶን፡, ቄጳርሳን፡ al.) peregr. sc. κυπάρισσος cupressus Kuf. 13; Kuf. 21; 4 Reg. 19,23; Jes. 37,24; Jes. 41,19; Hez. 27,5; Hez. 31,8; Sir. 24,13; Sir. 50,10; Job 40,12. – Voc. Ae.: ቄጵርስስ፡ ስኖባር፡ ጳውቂና፡ ብ፡ ጽድ።

woorden.betekenis: cupressinus
woorden.definitie: , ቂጰርስና፡, ቂጶሪስና፡, ቄጵርሶን፡, ቄጳርስን፡ al. κυπαρίσσινος cupressinus Hez. 27,24; 2 Esr. 18,15.

woorden.betekenis: multis ramis foliisque praedita fuit, viruit, frondes arbori
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., cui conferas خضل XI multis ramis foliisque praedita fuit arbor; خَضِرَ viruit c. derivatis (חַצִיר); קַצִיר frondes arboris.

woorden.betekenis: folia emisit, produxit
woorden.definitie: II,1 folia emisit, produxit arbor, Lud.ex Org. 1.

woorden.betekenis: folium, folia, frons, lamina, bractea
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., sing. et coll., Pl. አቍጽል፡ (et ቈጽላት፡, si quidem Chrys. Ta. 28pro ያነግፍ፡ ነፋስ፡ ቈላተ፡ legendum videtur ቈጽላተ፡) [amh. ቅጠል፡ et ቅጸል፡] 1 folium, folia, frons; sing.: Gen. 8,11; ቈጽል፡ ዘተነግፈ፡ እምነፋስ፡ Job 13,25; coll. Gen. 3,7; Kuf. 3; Jes. 1,30; Jes. 34,4; Jes. 64,6; ወይከውን፡ ቈጽለ፡ አዕጹቂሁ፡ Jer. 17,8; Dan. 4,9; Dan. 4,18; Hez. 6,13; Hez. 47,12; Prov. 11,14; Ps. 1,4; Hen. 24,4; Sir. 6,3; ከመ፡ ቈጽለ፡ ዕፅ፡ ዘጽፉቅ፡ ቈጽሉ፡ Sir. 14,18; 2 Esr. 18,15; ዖመ፡ ቈጽል፡ Jes. 57,5; Matth. 21,19; ቈጽለ፡ በለስ፡ (ὄλυνθοι) Apoc. 6,13; በኅብስት፡ ወማይ፡ ወቈጽል፡ Clem. f. 250; አቍጽል፡ Hen. 3; Hen. 5,1; στοιβάδες Marc. 11,8 rom.; Herm. p. 68. 2 res foliis similes, ut a lamina, bractea: ቈጽለ፡ ወርቅ፡ πέταλον χρυσοῦν Ex. 28,32; Ex. 36,38; Lev. 8,9 (vid. etiam ቀጸላ፡); M.M. f. 36 (vid. አፍረጽ፡); στάμνος Ex. 16,33. b folium libri, Lud. sine auct.

woorden.betekenis: circumscribere limite, incarcerare, circumsepire, circumvall
woorden.definitie: I,1 i.q. ሐጸረ፡ [amh. ቀጸረ፡ et ቀጠረ፡, قَصَرَ circumscribere limite, incarcerare ] circumsepire, circumvallare, praemunire, ቀጸሩ፡ ላዕለ፡ አህጉር፡ ἐτειχίσαντο τὰς κώμας Judith 4,5.

woorden.betekenis: sepes, maceria, murus, moenia, munitio, munimentum, locus mu
woorden.definitie: et ቀጽር፡ (Num. 32,17; Num. 32,38), subst., m. et fem., Pl. አቅጻር፡, Pl. Pl. አቅጻራት፡ 1 sepes, maceria, murus: φραγμός Ps. 143,17; ለእመ፡ ፈቀደ፡ ይሕንጽ፡ ብእሲ፡ ቅጽረ፡ ይርሐቅ፡ እምቢጹ፡ አሐተ፡ ምሥጋረ፡ እግር፡ F.N. 37; etiam ሐጹረ፡ ቅጽር፡ F.N. 37; ቅጽረ፡ ንድቅ፡ οἰκοδομή Sir. 22,16; ቅጽረ፡ ምኔት፡ Sx. Enc. 2 moenia, munitio, munimentum urbis, arcis: ሀገር፡ እንተ፡ ባቲ፡ ቅጽረ፡ Lev. 25,29; Lev. 25,30; Lev. 25,31; Num. 13,19; Num. 32,17; Num. 32,38; ሀገረ፡ ቅጽር፡ 4 Reg. 18,8; ቅጽረ፡ ሀገር፡ Rel. Bar.; አረፍት፡ (v. አረፍተ፡) ቅጽሮን፡ Deut. 9,1; τεῖχος Cant. 5,7; Cant. 8,10; Act. 9,25 Platt; ይጠቅሙ፡ ለርእሶሙ፡ ቅጽረ፡ Prov. 28,4; φραγμός 3 Reg. 11,27; χαράξ Deut. 20,19; 4 Esr. 11,47; de variis munimentis et moenibus Hierosolymorum Jsp. p. 370 al,: ኢያሪኮ፡ እንt፡ የዐውዳ፡ ፯አቅጻራት፡ Sx. Sen. 26; Sx. Nah. 21; περιοχῆ 1 Reg. 22,4; 1 Reg, 22,5; 2 Reg. 5,7; locus munitus, arx, castrum (قَصْرٌ) Jsp. p. 358 seq.; ቅጽረ፡ ንጉሥ፡ Lud. e V.S. – Voc. Ae.: ጸቈን፡ አጽዋን፡ ቅጽር፡ ዘ፡ ሐፅር።

woorden.betekenis: nictando, nutando, sannis deludere, subsannare
woorden.definitie: III,2 et III,1 nictando, nutando, sannis deludere aliquem, subsannare: ይትቄጸበከ፡ διαψιθυρίσει Sir. 12,18; ትትቀጸበኒ፡ (v. ትትቃጸበኒ፡) Job 19,17.

woorden.betekenis: nutus, nictatio, nictus oculi, ictus, momentum, punctum temp
woorden.definitie: n. act. 1 nutus: ይኤምር፡ በቅጽበተ፡ አጻብዕ፡ διδάσκει ἐννεύμασι δακτύλων Prov. 6,13; Deus creavit በቅጽበት፡ Clem. f. 49; Clem. f. 83; Clem. f. 218. 2 nictatio vel nictus oculi; usurpatur do temporis spatio minimo: ictus, momentum, punctum temporis; rarius praemisso በ፡, ut: ዘነበበ፡ በጊዜሃ፡ ይገብር፤ በቅጽበት፡ ዘኀለየ፡ ይከውኖ፡ Lit. Orth.; በመጠነ፡ አሐቲ፡ ቅጽበት፡ πρὸς μίαν ῥοπήν Sap. 18,12; vel in Acc.: ኢተፈልጠ፡ መለኮት፡ እምትስብእት፡ ወኢቅጽበተ፡ ዐይን፡ Haim. Ab.; Lit. 166,4; plerumque praemisso ከመ፡, ut: 1 Cor. 15,22; Genz. f. 34; በሣልስ፡ ንፍሐተ፡ ቀርን፡ ይትነሥኡ፡ ሙታን፡ ከመ፡ ቅጽበተ፡ ዐይን፡ Clem. f. 157; ያነሥኦሙ፡ ለምውታን፡ ከመ፡ ቅጽበተ፡ ዐይን፡ Macc. f. 5; ተዐገሥ፡ ከመ፡ ቅጽበተ፡ ዐይን፡ አሐተ፡ ሰዓተ፡ Jsp. p. 290; ወለእመኒ፡ ኮነ፡ ከመ፡ ቅጽበተ፡ ዐይን፡ እምቅድመ፡ ሞትነ፡ እመዋዕሊነ፡ F.N. 28,1. 3 significatio obscura, aenigma: ፈክሮ፡ ቅጽበት፡ λύσεις αἰνιγμάτων Sap. 8,8; ነገረ፡ ጠቢባን፡ በቅጽበት፡ ῥήσεις σοφῶν καὶ αἰνίγματα Prov. 1,6.

woorden.betekenis: deprimi, incurvari, humiliari, se submittere, fractum corrue
woorden.definitie: III,1 reflex. et pass. a deprimi, incurvari, humiliari, se submittere: ለይትቀጻዕ፡ ዘባናቲሆሙ፡ Rom. 11,10; Ps. 68,28; አረጋዊ፡ ዘተቀጽዐ፡ ዘባኑ፡ (senectute) Chrys. Ta. 23; ἐκάμφθησαν Job 9,13; ἔκυψε ተቀጽዐ፡ ሰብእ፡ Jes. 2,9; Ps. 9,33; κατεκάμφθην Ps. 37,6. b fractum corruere, collabi: ተቀጽዐት፡ ቀስቶሙ፡ ἐπτόηται τὸ τόξον αὐτῶν Jer. 28,56; ተቀጽዐ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሐቌ፡ Nah. 2,10; Jer. 37,6; Hen. 60,3; ትትቀጻዕ፡ ኵሉ፡ ነፍስ፡ ἐκψύξει πᾶν πνεῦμα Hez. 21,7. c consternari, terrore vel timore deprimi: ይትቀጽዑ፡ ἐκστήσονται Jes. 13,8; ተቀጽዑ፡ ወኢተርፈት፡ ነፍሶሙ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ 2 Esr. 16,1. – Voc. Ae.: ተቀጽዐ፡ ብ፡ አጐነበሰ፡; aliud: ዘ፡ ተቀራደደ። taqaṣʿa, ተቀፅዐ፡ taqaḍʿa G ተቀፅዐ፡ taqaḍʿa III,1 (ተቀጽዐ፡ taqaṣʿa III,1) être coupé, être taillé, être ajusté, être adapté, être raccommodé, lorsqu’il s’agit d’un morceau d’étoffe ou de cuir, manque dans le . Texte et référence: ሰላም፡ ለሀገርከ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፡ እንተ፡ አንሶሰውከ፡ በአሣዕን፡ ዘኢተቀፅዓ፡ በእደ፡ ሰብእ፡ ዘኢይደልዎ፡ ለዮሐንስ፡ ይፍታሕ፡ ቶታነ፡ አሣዕኒከ፡ እምእገሪከ። Ms. BNFabb226, fol. 106vb. 180 L ተቀጽዐ taqaṣʿa pass. of vid. ቀጽዐ qaṣʿa; also be pressed down, be overcome with awe, stoop, bow down, bend (intr), fall in ruins, collapse, faint, sink to the ground, be overwhelmed with terror, () be chopped up 449a

woorden.betekenis: litera alphabeti Aethiopici nona, quae ቤት፡ vocatur
woorden.definitie: litera alphabeti Aethiopici nona, quae ቤት፡ vocatur (ut Chrys. ho. 1, vid. ሆህያት፡).

woorden.betekenis: per, secundum, singuli, tim, atim, per singulas earum, singu
woorden.definitie: sive በ፡ duplicatum (cfr. ለለ፡ et ዘዘ፡), praep. (et separabilis, et voci sequenti praefixa), quae vim distributionis habet, ἀνά vel κατά c. Acc. per, secundum, singuli, - tim, - atim (gramm. § 159, g). Non ibi tandum usurpatur, ubi simplex praep. በ፡ ipsa constructione postulatur, sed aliâs quoque: በበ፩እምኔሆሙ፡ per singulas earum Hen. 34,2; በበምድሮሙ፡ ወበበነገሮሙ፡ ወበበነገዶሙ፡ singuli in suis terris et cum suis linguis et gentibus Gen. 10,5; Gen. 7,14; Gen. 1,11; Gen. 1,12; Ex. 6,14; Ex. 6,19; Num. 1,18 seq.; Jes. 19,13; በበነገረ፡ በሓውርቲሆሙ፡ Esth. 3,12; በበአስማቲሆሙ፡ Sir. 46,11; በበዓመት፡ singulis annis, quotannis 1 Reg. 7,16; Deut. 14,22; Deut. 14,23; Hebr. 9,25; per singulos annos 4 Esr. 3,59; 4 Esr. 3,60; በበ፡ በዓል፡ Matth. 27,15; በበነግህ፡, በበሰርክ፡ Ex. 30,7; Ex. 30,8; በበጽባሕ፡ 1 Par. 9,27; በበ፡ ጊዜሁ፡ Ps. 103,28; በበዲናር፡ ለለ፡ ዕለት፡ singulis denariis singulis diebus Matth. 20,2; አቀምዎሙ፡ በበ፩፡ singulatim Dan. apocr. 1,52; በበዚአነ፡ ሐለምነ፡ quivis suum (somnium) somniavimus Gen. 41,11; ነሥኡ፡ በበዲናር፡ acceperunt singuli denarium Matth. 20,9; Matth. 20,10; በበ፡ መሌሊት፡ membratim Ex. 29,17; መተሩ፡ ሥጋሃ፡ በበ፡ ምታር፡ Sx. Masc. 29; በበ፡ ክፍሉ፡ secundum partes suas Hen. 90,41; በበንስቲት፡ sensim, paulatim Act. 18,23 Platt; በበሕቅ፡ Sap. 12,2 et በበሕቀ፡ Deg. Creberrime ante nomina numeralia: በበ፡ ክልኤቱ፡ ፩፩በበ፡ ዚአሁ፡ δύο δύο ἓν κατέναντι ἑνός Sir. 36,15; በበክልኤቱ፡ bini Luc. 10,1; Gen. 45,22; ይበሉ፡ በበ፩፡ dicant singuli Matth. 26,22; በበ፡ ዐሠርቱ፡ deni Jud. 20,10; በበስሱ፡ seni 2 Reg. 21,20; 1 Par. 20,6; በበ፡ ምእት፡ ወበበ፡ ኀምሳ፡ per centenos et quinquagenos Marc. 6,40; ሰብዓ፡ በበ፡ ስብዕ፡ septuagies septies Matth. 18,22.

woorden.betekenis: maledixit, supplex fuit, aliud quid dixit, ut dixisti, quod
woorden.definitie: I,1 [amh. ባለ፡ Isenb. grammar p. 136; sine dubio i.q. ܡܰܠܶܠ (cfr. ብዕል፡ et مَالٌ); Arabice occurrit quidem بَهَلَ sed significat maledixit, VIII supplex fuit in oratione (መሐለ፡ ማሕለለ፡)]; Perf. nonnisi apud scriptores inferioris aevi usitatum est, ex. gr. in Chrys. crebro, ut: ብህለ፡ ካልአ፡ aliud quid dixit Chrys.; በከመ፡ ብህልከ፡ ut dixisti, Chrys.; ዘብህልዎ፡ quod ei dixerunt p. 499; vice Perfecti frequentant (abjecto ል፡) ይቤ፡ ትቤ፡ ትቤ፡ ትቤሊ፡ እቤ፡ ይቤሉ፡ ይቤላ፡ ትቤሉ፡ ትቤላ፡ ንቤ፡; sed ante pron. suff. ል፡ abjectum resumitur: ይቤለኒ፡ እቤሎ፡ caet. (gramm. § 92; gramm. § 152); Imperf. ይብል፡ (ትብሊ፡, ይብሉ፡ caet.); Subj. ይበል፡, Imperat. በል፡, Infin. verb. ብሂል፡ (ut: ከመዝ፡ ብሂሎ፡ 1 Esr. 3,23; 4 Esr. 3,38); Infin. nom. ብሂል፡ (ut: ብሂል፡ ይብሉ፡ Jer. 38,23; 4 Esr. 4,41; Matth. 3,9, etiam in Pl. ብሂላት፡ verba Lud.; ብህሎ፡ (Asc. Jes. 5,9), ብሂሎት፡ (ut: ኢትክል፡ ብሂሎቶ፡ Dan. apocr. 13,24; Gen. 18,30; Ruth 1,18). 1 dicere: ውእቱ፡ ይቤ፡ ወኮኑ፡ Ps. 32,9; ከመዝ፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Jes. 43,1; Jes. 49,5; Jer. 4,3; በል፡ Jer. 3,12; በሊ፡ እኅቱ፡ አነ፡ Gen. 12,13; 4 Esr. 3,40; 4 Esr. 10,26; እንዘ፡ ይብል፡ dicens Matth. 3,14; Matth. 23,1; ርኢከኑ፡ ምንተ፡ ይትናገር፡ ዝንቱ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ለብሂል፡ Jer. 40,24 vers. alt.; plura exempla innumeris in locis obvia non est quod afferamus. C.c. Acc. pers. (alicui), ut: ይብለከ፡ ምንተ፡ ትቤ፡ Sir. 22,8; በለኒ፡ ኢትፍራህ፡ Thren. 3,56; በሎሙ፡ Hez. 14; Hez. 4; Matth. 3,7; Matth. 3,9; Matth. 3,15; ሰላም፡ እብል፡ አርያኖስሃ፡ ቀሲስ፡ Sx. Tachs. 15Enc.; c. Acc. rei: ዘንተ፡ ብሂሎ፡ አርመመ፡ Clem. f. 65; Tob. 14,11; ለመንት፡ ትብለኒ፡ ዘንተ፡ ነገረ፡ 1 Reg. 9,21; Ex. 22,28. a Sequitur α plerumque oratio directa, ut Matth. 4,3; Matth. 4,4; Matth. 4,6; Matth. 4,7; ኢትበሎ፡ ብፁዕ፡ μὴ μακάριζε αὐτόν Sir. 11,28; እለ፡ ይብልዎ፡ ለሠናይ፡ እኩይ፡ (v. እኩየ፡) Jes. 5,20. β rarius oratio obliqua, sc. Subj. verbi, non tantum ubi quis dicit, se aliquid facere velle vel facturum esse, ut: እንተ፡ ይቤ፡ ይግበር፡ ἣν εἶπε ποιῆσαι Ex. 32,14; Judith 16,4, sed etiam ubi quis dicit, aliquid esse:መኑ፡ ይብልዎ፡ ይኩን፡ ሰብእ፡ ለወልደ፡ እጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ Matth. 16,13. γ perraro Acc. Infin.: መኑ፡ (v. መነ፡) ትብሉኒ፡ ከዊነ፡ quem me dicitis esse? Matth. 16,15. b Hoc verbum in extrema oratione, quam quis dicit, collocare licet, ut: እፎ፡ እንከ፡ ትሣሀለኒ፡ ትብሎ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ quomodo igitur Deo „ propitius mihi esto “ dices? Sir. 28, 3; Sir. 22,8; Jes. 58,9; 1 Esr. 4,7; 1 Esr. 4,8; 1 Esr. 4,9; Judith 13,3; Dan. apocr. 13,24; Rom. 9,7; 1 Cor. 10,8; 1 Cor. 10,9; 1 Cor. 10,10; crebro in libris prophetarum (sicut נְאֻם יְהוָֹה), ut Jes. 48,22; Jes. 58,6. c Non de personis tantum praedicatur, sed etiam de libris et literis, et verbis, ubi Latini utuntur dictum vel scriptum est (in libro, vel verba) haec sunt: ወይብል፡ መጽሐፉ፡ ላሕ፡ ወብካይ፡ ወወይሌ፡ Hez. 2,10; ከመዝ፡ ትብል፡ መጽሐፉ፡ 2 Esr. 4,11; 2 Esr. 16,6; ጽሑፍ፡ ዘይብል፡ Luc. 4,1; Marc. 15,26; 4 Reg. 5,6; ከመዝ፡ ይብል፡ ቃለ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ 3 Reg. 21(20),9; ኢታስምዖ፡ ቃለ፡ ዘይብል፡ ረሐቁ፡ እምኔየ፡ አላ፡ አስምዖ፡ ቃለ፡ ዘይብል፡ ኦገብር፡ ኄር፡ ወምእመን፡ Genz. f. 80; ita, ubi scriptura sacra allegatur: ከማሁ፡ ይቤ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ Rom. 9,33; Rom. 11,26; Rom. 15,3; 1 Cor. 10,7; Clem. f. 92; Clem. f. 94; በከመ፡ ይቤ፡ ወንጌል፡ ቅዱስ፡ Sx. Sen. 24. d Memorabilis est usus Infinitivi ብሂል፡, ubicumque verba orationis vel singula vocabula aliis exponuntur: እስመ፡ ብሂሎቱ፡ አመ፡ አብኦ፡ ለበኵሩ፡ ውስተ፡ ዓለም፡ዝብሂል፡ አመ፡ ኰነኖ፡ ውስተ፡ ዓለም፡ ብሂል፡ Chrys. ho. 3; ኬፋ፡ ብሂል፡ በነገረ፡ዕብራዊያን፡ ኰኵሕ፡ ብሂል፡ „Cephas“ dicere in lingua Hebraeorum (est), „petra“ dicere i.e. Cephas significat petram Clem. f. 86; ተልሚድ፡ ዝውእቱ፡ ረድእ፡ ብሂል፡ ዘበትርጓሜሁ፡ Clem. f. 152; እስመ፡ ጼዴቅ፡ ብሂል፡ ጽድቅ፡ ብሂል፡ Chrys. ho. 12; etiam: ዘ፡ — ብሂል፡ quod — significat Gen. 19,37; ዝውእቱ፡ ብሂል፡ id est Matth. 27,46, vel ዝብሂል፡ — ውእቱ፡ Sx. Haml. 7; vel ዝብሂል፡ hoc est (sive) Chrys. ho. 8; vel ብሂል፡ nudum (postpositum), ut: ሰመያ፡ አቤኔዜር፡ እብነ፡ ረድኤት፡ ብሂል፡ nominavit eam Abenezer i.e. lapidem auxilii 1 Reg. 7,12; Marc. 3,17; Marc. 5,41; Hebr. 7,2. 2 perraro: loqui, Jos. 22,7; ኢትብል፡ በትእምርታት፡ ne loquaris e signis i.e. ne divines e prodigiis, Lud. e Syn. (Can. Clem. 8). 3 dicere i.e. appellare, nominare, vocare, c. dupl. Acc.: ወልደ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ይብል፡ ርእሶ፡ Sap. 2,13; Judith 3,8; 1 Reg. 9,9; 2 Reg. 20,21; Apoc. 2,2; Apoc. 2,20; ለኪ፡ ይደሉ፡ ብሂል፡ እምነ፡ ወብሂለ፡ እግዚእትነ፡ Org. 4 jubere, seq. ከመ፡ c. Subj., ut: ይቤለነ፡ ከመ፡ ንእስር፡ ኵሎ፡ Kuf. 10; 1 Reg. 19,1; 2 Reg. 1,18; Matth. 4,3, vel seq. Subj., 4 Esr. 10,65; 4 Esr. 10,67 var.; Judith 5,9; Judith 13,3; Dan. apocr. 1,17; Hez. 33,8. 5 a ኦሆ፡ ብሂል፡ obtemperare, annuere Sir. 13,9; Jac. 4,7; በእንተ፡ ኦሆ፡ ብሂሎቱ፡ ወትሕትናሁ፡ ob ejus obedientiam et submissionem Phlx. 129(vid. ኦሆ፡). b እንብየ፡ ብሂል፡ nolle, abnuere, recusare Jac. 4,7 (vid. እንብየ፡). c ጸጥ፡ ብሂል፡ obmutescere, silere Job 33,31; 4 Esr. 4,42 (vid. ጸጥ፡). d ባሐ፡ ብሂል፡ ave dicere, salvere jubere vid. ባሐ፡. 6 — Alias significationes non est, quod statuamus, quamquam latine nonnumquam vertere licet a respondere ut Matth. 4,10; Matth. 8,7; Matth. 14,17. b interrogare ut Matth. 9,14; Matth. 15,1. c contra dicere, opponere vel occurrere verbis ut Rom. 10,18. d putare, opinari, sibi videri: ዘይብል፡ ኢአበስኩ፡ ὃς δοκεῖ μὴ ἁμαρτάνειν Prov. 28,23; ዘይብል፡ ርእሶ፡ ጠቢብ፡ (vid. Nr. 3) δόξαντα παρ' αὐτῷ σοφὸν εἶναι Prov. 26,12. bǝhl, ብሕለ፡ bǝḥla በል፡ bal v. 2SgM Imper. ‘come on!, well then!, so then!’ 1096a, በሉ፡ ትፍኡ፡ ዘበላዕክሙ፡ ‘Su, sputate quel che avete mangiato’ 86 (ed.), 30 (tr.) (‘Su በል፡ in questo senso cf. p. es. 212 and 213 n. 3. ’ 30 n. 156); (‘Uno dei tanti esempi di bal come “orsù”, a non “di”. 213 n. 3.’). E This seems to be an Amharic expression. በል, በዪ, በሉ are very often used in spoken Amharic with the meaning ‘come on!, well then!, so then!’ 1096a. G ብህለ፡ bǝhla I,1 ይብል፡, ይቤ፡, ይበል፡ dixit, dire, parler ― ማለት፡, አለ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 64. 181 L ብህለ bǝhla (impf. ‘yǝbl, yǝbe,’ juss. ‘yǝbal’), () ብሕለ bǝḥla say, speak, call, announce, command (see 179, 351, 181–182) ዘይብል za-yǝbl the following 89b

woorden.betekenis: dicere facere, annuere facere, in suam sententiam perducere,
woorden.definitie: (pro አብሀለ፡] II,1, Subj. ያብህል፡ et ያብል፡ dicere facere; usitatum in phrasi: ኦሆ፡ አበለ፡ c. Acc. annuere facere, in suam sententiam perducere, persuadere, Matth. 27,20 seq. ከመ፡ c. Subj.; 4 Esr. 3,59; ስእነ፡ ኦሆ፡ አብሎቶ፡ Sx. Tachs. 5; ኀለየ፡ ከመ፡ እሙ፡ ኦሆ፡ አበለቶ፡ ለተወክፎ፡ ትእዛዝ፡ Jsp. p. 290; አንጠይዎ፡ ከመ፡ ኦሆ፡ ያብልዎ፡ Jsp. p. 308; ኦሆ፡ በልኒ፡ ወኦሆ፡ አብልዮ፡ Org.

woorden.betekenis: dici, pronuntiari, narrari, referri, alicui, nominari, appel
woorden.definitie: III,1 dici, (pronuntiari, narrari vel referri), Jos. 24,27; Hen. 62,3; Hen. 91,17; Matth. 24,15; Luc. 4,12; ምንትኒ፡ ሐሰት፡ እምልሳነ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ኢይትበሀል፡ Prov. 24,23; (formula absolutionis) ይትበሀል፡ በዜማ፡ ግንዘት፡ Genz. f. 44.; Genz. f. 124; c. ለ፡ pers. (alicui) Kuf. 14; Num. 23,23; seq. ከመ፡ c. Verb. fin. Phlx. 72; vel እስመ፡ c. Verb. fin. Jsp. p. 280; Jsp. p. 328. a nominari, appellari, vocari (inscribi) seq. Nom. vel Acc. praedicati: ዘሀሎ፡ ይትበሀል፡ ውስተ፡ ዓለም፡ ወልድ፡ Asc. Jes. 8,25; Asc. Jes. 9,5; Asc. Jes. 9,13; Asc. Jes. 10,6; Asc. Jes. 10,7; መጽሐፍ፡ ዘይትበሀል፡ ፈውስ፡ መንፈሳዊ፡ F.M. f. 119; እስመ፡ ኅሊና፡ ጽቡስ፡ ምኑነ፡ ይትበሀል፡ Sap. 2,11. b annuntiari vel promitti: የኀጥእ፡ ብፅዓነ፡ እንተ፡ ተብህለት፡ ለሕዙናን፡ (Matth. 5,4) Phlx. 79. c mandari, juberi: ተብህለ፡ ለቀደምት፡ Matth. 5,21; Matth. 5,27; ተብህለ፡ ሎቱ፡ ይግበር፡ Kuf. p. 27; seq. ከመ፡ c. Subj. Hen. 58,5. tabǝhla G ተብህለ፡ tabǝhla III,1 ይትበሀል፡ dictus, vocatus, nominatus est, être dit, être appelé, être nommé ― ተባለ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 64. 181 L ተብህለ tabǝhla be spoken, be said, be mentioned, be named, be spoken of 89b

woorden.betekenis: non, dic
woorden.definitie: non vid. sub እንበለ፡; በል፡ dic vid. sub ብህለ፡

woorden.betekenis: rad. inus., vicina est መልኀ፡ q.v.
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., vicina est መልኀ፡ q.v.

woorden.betekenis: n. peregr. βελίαρ, nomen Satanae 2 Cor. 6,15; Kuf.
woorden.definitie: n. peregr. βελίαρ, nomen Satanae 2 Cor. 6,15; Kuf. p. 4et Kuf. p. 61; II Can. Ap. 44.

woorden.betekenis: ficus, ficetum, massa ficuum aridarum, sycaminus, sycomorus,
woorden.definitie: subst. [بَلَسٌ, בָּלַס], m. et fem. (ut Jud. 9,10; Jud. 9,11; Hab. 3,17; Jes. 28,4; Marc. 11,13), coll. et sing., Pl. በለሳት፡ (Jer. 24,3 var.; Rel. Bar.) et አብላስ፡ (M.M. f. 268; Rel. Bar.; Org.) 1 ficus a arbor Jud. 9,10; Jud. 9,11; Num. 13,23; Deut. 8,8, Kuf. 13; በለስ፡ ኢትፈሪ፡ Hab. 3,17; ዘተከለ፡ በለሰ፡ ይበልዕ፡ ፍሬሃ፡ Prov. 27,18; Cant. 2,13; Jes. 36,16; Hos. 2,14; Joel 1,7; Mich. 4,4; Zach. 3,10; Jac. 3,12; Matth. 21,19; Marc. 11,13; ቈጽለ፡ በለስ፡ Kuf. 3; Jes. 34,4; συκεών ficetum Jer. 5,17; Am. 4,9. b fructus Jes. 28,4; 2 Esr. 23,15; Jac. 3,12; ረከቡ፡ በምሥያጥ፡ በለሰ፡ ሐዲሰ፡ ወተሣየጡ፡ እምኔሁ፡ Sx. Haml. 24; ረከበ፡ ዝኰ፡ በለሳተ፡ (v. በለሰ፡) ሐዲሳነ፡ Rel. Bar.; παλάθη (massa ficuum aridarum) Judith 10,5; ዐጽቀ፡ በለስ፡ παλάθη σύκων 4 Reg. 20,7; Jes. 38,21; Jer. 24,1; በለሰ፡ ማእረር፡ τὰ σῦκα τὰ πρώιμα Jer. 24,2. 2 sycaminus, sycomorus a arbor (aliâs ሰግላ፡] Ps. 77,52; ዕፀ፡ በለስ፡ 2 Par. 9,27. b sycaminum fructus Am. 7,14; አልቦ፡ በለስ፡ ውስተ፡ ሰግላ፡ Jer. 8,13 (sed Gr. habet σῦκα ἐν ταῖς συκαῖς). balas C for ሕንባበ፡ በለስ፡ vid. ሕንባብ፡

woorden.betekenis: balsamum, chrisma, balasān, balsān, balson, baume, suc du ba
woorden.definitie: , etiam በልሳን፡ በለሶን፡ (በለስን፡ Jsp. p. 310), subst., [بَلَسَانٌ, בָּשׂם] balsamum a arbor balsamifera: ዝንቱ፡ በለሳን፡ ዘተከልናሁ፡ (nos, sc. Christus infans cum parentibus, in Aegypto) ይነብር፡ ዝየ፡ እስከ፡ ለዓለም፡ Sx. Genb. 24; ቈጽለ፡ በለሶን፡ ከደነቶ፡ እሙ፡ Deg. b aroma et unguentum: μύρα Hez. 27,17; chrisma ἅγιον μύρον, quo baptizati ungebantur: ቅብአ፡ በለሳን፡ Did. 17; Clem. f. 227; በለሳን፡ Clem. f. 228; ቅብአተ፡ በለሳን፡ et በልሳን፡ Const. Ap. 39; በእንተ፡ በለሳን፡ ወዕጣን፡ Lit. 175,3; aliâs distinguitur a myro: ተኀትም፡ ገጾ፡ (ለበድን፡) በቅብአ፡ በለሳን፡ ወእመ፡ ካህን፡ በሜሮን፡ Genz. f. 13. balasān, balsān, balson G በለሳን፡ balasān 1 balsamum (βάλσαμον), baume, suc du baumier, baumier (arbrisseau) 2 chrisma (χρίσμα) chrême L’expression usitée pour désigner l’onctionsacramentelle est: ቅብአ፡ በለሳን፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 65. 182 L በለሳን balasān, በልሳን balsān, በለሶን balson balm, balsam tree, balm tree, chrism (holy oil) 97b

woorden.betekenis: tabulae
woorden.definitie: , ባለቅ፡, ባላቅ፡ subst., Pl. አብላቅ፡ 1 marmor بَلَقٌ Apoc. 18,12; Cant. 5,15; (unde hausit Paulus hanc sapientiam?) አምኀበ፡ አብላቅኑ፡ አው፡ እምኀበ፡ አእባን፡ ወአምእስተ፡ አባግዕ፡ አው፡ እምሥያጥኑ፡ ἀπὸ τῆς σμίλης καὶ τῶν δερμάτων ἢ τοῦ ἐργαστηρίου; Chrys. ho. 1; ባላቅ፡ (v. በለቅ፡) ቅድው፡ ὄνυχι τιμίῳ Job 28,16 (Nescio an hoc loco Aethiopes aroma intelligant; in Voc. Ae. enim ባላቅ፡ inter nomina ሽቱ፡ recensetur). 2 Πλάκες tabulae lapideae Mosis appellantur ፪አብላቅ፡ 2 Par. 5,10; ሰሌዳተ፡ አብላቅ፡ M.M. f. 67.

woorden.betekenis: specillum, bǝlen, specillum quo oculi stibio illinuntur, spa
woorden.definitie: subst. „specillum seu instrumentum, quo ad illinendos stibio oculos utuntur, arab. مِيلٌ, gr. μήλη, Th. P.“, Lud. (Caeterum videas Isenb. p. 84sub ብሌን፡) bǝlen G ብሌን፡ bǝlen specillum quo oculi stibio illinuntur, spatule pour noircir les paupières avec de l’antimoine Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 65. 182 L ብሌን bǝlen II spatula with which one applies antimony to the eyelashes 96b

woorden.betekenis: deglutivit, devoravit, edere, comedere, cibum sumere, prande
woorden.definitie: I,1 [בָּלַע (ܒܠܰܥ) بَلْعَمَ بَلِعَ deglutivit, devoravit; amh. በላ፡] Subj. ይብላዕ፡ 1 edere, comedere a de hominibus; absol.: Gen. 3,17; Gen. 18,8; Gen. 19,3; Gen. 24,33; Gen. 27,4; Gen. 27,10; Jes. 29,8; Judith 12,9; 4 Esr. 10,7; Ps. 21,28; ያደዊ፡ ብዙኀ፡ በሊዕ፡ Sir. 37,30; Matth. 24,38; Rom. 14,6; በሊዕ፡ ወሰትይ፡ Koh. 5,17; Job 1,4; Jes. 22,13; ብላዕ፡ በዐቅም፡ Prov. 25,16; c. እምነ፡ vel እምውስተ፡ Gen. 2,16; Gen. 2,17; Ex. 12,43; Lev. 7,21; Lev. 25,22; Tob. 1,10; Koh. 5,18; 4 Esr. 9,27; Hen. 32,3; Hen. 32,6; c. Acc. Gen. 9,4; Lev. 7,15; Lev. 7,16; Lev. 7,17; Lev. 7,18; Lev. 7,19; Lev. 7,20; Lev. 7,21; Lev. 7,22; Lev. 7,23; Lev. 7,24; Lev. 7,25; Lev. 11,2 seq.; Deut. 7,16; Deut. 12,15; Deut. 12,16; Deut. 12,17; Deut. 12,18; Deut. 14,23; Deut. 15,20; Jud. 13,16; Hen. 7,4; Matth. 6,25; Matth. 6,31; Matth. 12,4; Matth. 15,32; Joh. 4,32; Joh. 6,54; 6,55; 6,56; 6,57; 6,58; al. innumeris in locis; nonnumquam: edere terram, arborem al. i.e. fructum ejus comedere Jes. 1,7; በዕለት፡ እንተ፡ ትበልዕዎ፡ (ለዕፅ፡) Kuf. p. 19 ann. 10. In specie: በልዐ፡ እክለ፡ vel ኅብስተ፡ i.e. cibum sumere, prandere, coenare, epulari Ex. 18,12; 1 Reg. 20,34; 4 Reg. 4,8; Jer. 48,1; Ps. 101,5; Koh. 9,7; Marc. 3,20; Luc. 7,33; Hen. 15,11, passim በልዐ፡ abs. ut Koh. 10,16; Hen, 62,14. b de animalibus (vesci) Gen. 3,14; Gen. 37,20; Gen. 40,19; Ex. 10,5; Ex. 22,4; Joel 1,4; Hen. 86,6; Hen. 89,68 seq.; Matth. 13,4; Marc. 4,4; Apoc. 12,4. c do inanimatis (absumere, consumere, vorare), ut de igne: በልዐቶሙ፡ እሳት፡ Hos. 7,7; Jes. 9,18; Job 1,16; Apoc. 20,9; Hebr. 10,27, gladio: በልዐቶሙ፡ መጥባሕት፡ Jer. 2,30; Deut. 32,42; de aerugine Jac. 5,3, ira Ex. 15,7; zelo Ps. 68,12; Joh. 2,17; morte Hen. 69,11. 2 a በሊዐ፡ ሥጋ፡ ሰብእ፡ non tantum sensu proprio ut Jer. 19,9, sed etiam transl. usurpatur: calumniari, accusare (ut ܐܶܟܰܠ ܩܰܪܨܳܐ et أَكَلَ لَحْماً): በሊዐ፡ ሥጋ፡ ቢጽ፡ በሐሜት፡ Clem. f. 118; Gad. Lal. b consumere vel absumere aliquem vel opes ejus: በልዕዎ፡ ለእስራኤል፡ Jer. 10,25; ይበልዑ፡ ሥጋሆሙ፡ ለሕዝብየ፡ Mich. 3,3; pariter: በልዐ፡ ጥሪተ፡ Koh. 5,10; Hen. 53,2; Matth. 23,13; Luc. 15,30. c devorare, ut መጽሐፈ፡ Apoc. 10,9; Apoc. 10,10. d frui: ኢይበልዕ፡ ሠናየ፡ Job 21,25; Jes. 3,10. balʾa C for በልዐ፡ መሐላ፡ vid. ማሕላ፡

woorden.betekenis: comedendum dare, cibare, devorandum dare, ad edendum adigere
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 comedendum dare, cibare; abs. ታበልዕኒ፡ ወታሰትይኒ፡ Sir. 29,25; c. Acc. pers.: እመ፡ ርኅበ፡ ጸላኢከ፡ አብልዖ፡ Prov. 25,21; Matth. 25,35; Rom. 12,20; c. dupl. Acc.: 1 Cor. 3,2; Num. 11; Num. 4; አብልዐኒ፡ ዘብከ፡ Sir. 29,26; የኀሥሥ፡ ሎሙ፡ ዘያበልዖሙ፡ Job 39,29; አነ፡ ኣበልዖሙ፡ ጻዕረ፡ Jer. 9,15; devorandum dare: አብልዐኒያ፡ ለይእቲ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ Hez. 3,2. 2 ad edendum adigere, aliquem: ከመ፡ ኢያብልዖ፡ Dan. 1,8; vel depascere sinere c. dupl. Acc: ለእመ፡ አብልዐ፡ ገራህተ፡ ሰብእ፡ እንስሳሁ፡ Ex. 22,4.

woorden.betekenis: edi, comedi, exedi, devorari, consumi, quod non edi potest
woorden.definitie: III,1 edi, comedi, exedi, devorari, consumi: ይትበላዕ፡ እክል፡ Job 6,6; Sir. 36,23; ዘኢይትበላዕ፡ quod non edi potest Jer. 24,2; Jer. 24,3; እስከ፡ አመ፡ ኢይትበላዕ፡ እምእጕለ፡ አንስርት፡ Prov. 24,23; ለተበልዖ፡ Kuf. 1; ልብስ፡ ዘተበልዐ፡ እምቍንቍኔ፡ Job 13,28; Nah. 1,10; ከመ፡ፃፄ፡ ትትበልዑ፡ Jes. 50,9; Num. 12,12; Herm. p. 69; ተበልዑ፡ እምዓሣት፡ Hen. 61,5; Hen. 89,57; በእሳት፡ ኢይትበላዕ፡ Sx. Sen. 20Enc.

woorden.betekenis: res comesta, a feris discerptum, dilaceratum, tineis, blatti
woorden.definitie: subst., st. c. ብላዐ፡ et ብልዐ፡, res comesta: a ብላዐ፡ (v. ብልዐ፡) አርዌ፡ θηριάλωτον a feris discerptum vel dilaceratum Gen. 31,39; Lev. 5,2; Lev. 7,24; Lev. 17,15; Lev. 22,8; Hez. 4,14; Hez. 44,31. b ብላዐ፡ (vel ብልዐ፡) ቍንቍኔ፡ tineis vel blattis corrosum Job 27,18; Jes. 51,8; ብልዐ፡ ፃፄ፡ Nah. 1,10. bǝllāʿ G ብላዕ፡ bǝllāʿ quod manducatum in parte est, ut ብላዐ፡ አርዌ፡ residuum feræ, ce qui est mangé en partie, les restes d’une bête fauve Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 65. 183 L ብላዕ bǝllāʿ food, that which is eaten up, leftover, residue of food, fodder 94b

woorden.betekenis: comestio, devoratio, consumtio
woorden.definitie: n. act. comestio, devoratio, consumtio Ps. 52,5 ann.; ለብልዐት፡ Kuf. p. 86; ብልዐተ፡ ዕፄ፡ ረከቦሙ፡ Job 4,19.

woorden.betekenis: edens, comedens, devorans, vescens, edax, vorax, edo, comedo
woorden.definitie: n. ag., fem. በላዒት፡ Pl. c. በላዕት፡, Pl. m. በላዕያን፡ 1 edens, comedens, devorans, vescens, ( edax, vorax ): ይወድቁ፡ ውስተ፡ አፈ፡ በላዒ፡ Nah. 3,12; በላዒተ፡ ሰብእ፡ አንቲ፡ κατέσθουσα ἀνθρώπους εἶ Hez. 36,13; de leone Jud. 14,14; saepius de igne: እሳት፡ ዘይነድድ፡ በላዒ፡ Kuf. 36; ነበልባለ፡ እሳት፡ በላዒ፡ Jes. 29,6; Jes. 30,30; Hebr. 12,29; de anthropophagis et transl. de iis, qui homines (eorum opes) consumunt: በላዕያነ፡ ሥጋ፡ ሰብእ፡ Clem. f. 76; በላዕያነ፡ ሥጋ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወሰታይያነ፡ ደም፡ Macc. f. 10; በላዕተ፡ ሰብእ፡ M.M. f. 43; Sx. Masc. 1; Sx. Mag. 8. 2 edo, comedo, devorator Matth. 11,19; ሥሡዓን፡ በላዕያን፡ Macc. f. 9.

woorden.betekenis: edulium, esca, cibus, pabulum, cupediae
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., Pl. መባልዕ፡ et መባልዕት፡, edulium, esca, cibus, pabulum, ለክሙ፡ ውእቱ፡ መብልዕ፡ Gen. 1,29; Gen. 1,30; ተውህበ፡ መብልዐ፡ ለአንስርት፡ Job 15,23; ይከውን፡ አብድንቲሆሙ፡ መብልዐ፡ ለአዕዋፍ፡ Jer. 7,33; Jer. 16,4; Jer. 19,7; Jer. 41,20; Hez. 34,5; ወሀቡ፡ ፍትወቶሙ፡ ለመብልዕ፡ Thren. 1,11; βρώματα Gen. 6,21; 1 Par. 12,40; Prov. 23,6; Rom. 14,15; 1 Tim. 4,3; Matth. 14,15; Marc. 7,19; βρῶσις Job 33,20; Hebr. 12,16; Joh. 4,32; Joh. 6,27; βρωτόν Jud. 14,14; ἐδέσματα Gen. 27,9; Gen. 27,17; ግበር፡ መባልዕተ፡ Kuf. 26; Prov. 23,3; Sir. 37,29; መባልዕተ፡ ቅብእ፡ Clem. f. 239; መባልዕት፡ ጥዑም፡ ἡδύσματα cupediae 2 Par. 9,24.

woorden.betekenis: i.e. መባልኅት፡ q.v.
woorden.definitie: i.e. መባልኅት፡ q.v.

woorden.betekenis: usu et vetustate atteri, consumi, veterascere, senio, confic
woorden.definitie: I,1 [בָּלָה, ܒܠܺܝ, بَلِىَ] Subj. ይብሊ፡ 1 usu et vetustate atteri vel consumi, veterascere, senio confici, consenescere, (putrescere, marcescere), de vestibus Deut. 8,4; Deut. 29,4; Jos. 9,11; 2 Esr. 19,21; ኵልክሙ፡ ከመ፡ ልብስ፡ ትበልዩ፡ Jes. 50,9; Jes. 51,6; Ps. 101,27; ኵሉ፡ ዘነፍስ፡ ይበሊ፡ ከመ፡ ልብስ፡ Sir. 14,17; saxo: ኰኵሕ፡ ይበሊ፡ Job 14,18; plantis: ዝናም፡ ያሠርጽ፡ ዘበልየ፡ Job 36,28; fructibus Kuf. 32; ossibus Ps. 31,3; corpore: ወሀቦ፡ ለሥጋሁ፡ ጸጋ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይብሊ፡ ወለአዕጽምቲሁ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይማስን፡ Sx. Haml. 26; በልየ፡ ሥጋየ፡ ወማእስየ፡ Thren. 3,4; de quavis re: ኵሉ፡ ግብር፡ ይበሊ፡ ወየኀልቅ፡ σηπόμενον ἐκλείπει Sir. 14,19; specie hominis: ክብርየ፡ ተወለጠ፡ ወበልየ፡ Dan. 10,8; hominibus: Ps. 6,7; Ps. 17,49; በልየ፡ (እስራኤል፡) በብሔረ፡ ነኪር፡ Bar. 3,10; transl.: በልየ፡ ነገር፡ እምኔክሙ፡ oratio consenuit (et evanuit) e vobis Job 32,15. 2 inveterascere: እለ፡ በልያ፡ በላዕሌሁ፡ ኀጣውኢሁ፡ 2 Petr. 1,9. 3 antiquari, obsolescere: Hebr. 8,13. balǝya G በልየ፡ balǝya I,1 ይበሊ፡, ይብሊ፡ senuit, veteravit, vieillir ― አረጀ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 65. 183 L በልየ balǝya (yǝblay, yǝbli) be old, grow old, age, be worn-out, be decrepit, be obsolete, be antiquated 98b

woorden.betekenis: vetus, vetustus, vetus testamentum, homines Veteris, inveter
woorden.definitie: part. fem. ብሊት፡, 1 vetus, vetustus, ut vestis Matth. 9,16; Hen. 62,16; calcei Jos. 9,3; uter, commeatus Jos. 9,2; lignum (opp. ሐዲስ፡) Kuf. 21; folia arborum Hen. 3; panni et funiculi Jer. 45,11; frumentum Kuf. 44; Lev. 25,22; fructus Cant. 7,14; ብሉይ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ παλαιότης γράμματος Rom. 7,6; ብሉይ፡ ብእሲነ፡ Rom. 6,6; Eph. 4,22; de ecclesia: እንዘ፡ ብሊት፡ ይእቲ፡ በንዝኀተ፡ ደሙ፡ ሐደሳ፡ Mavâs. 70. In specie: vetus testamentum: ብሉይ፡ ሕግ፡ 2 Cor. 3,14; ሕግ፡ ብሊት፡ F.M. 4,1; በሉይ፡ ወሐዲስ፡ ቀኖና፡ Clem. f. 86, et (omisso ሕግ፡ vel ሥርዐት፡) ብሉይ፡ vel ብሊት፡ absol., ut: መጻሕፍተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘብሉይ፡ ወዘሐዲስ፡ Clem. f. 86; መጻሕፍተ፡ ብሊት፡ ወሐዲስ፡ Sx. Ter 17; Sx. Haml. 11; ሰብአ፡ ብሊት፡ homines Veteris (testamenti) Chrys. Ta. 19; ጻድቃነ፡ ብሊት፡ Sx. Nah. 8. 2 inveteratus, antiquus: ብሉያተ፡ ረሰይኮን፡ ለመዋዕልየ፡ Ps. 38,7; ብሉይ፡ መዋዕሊከ፡ እኩያት፡ Dan. apocr. 1,52; ብሉየ፡ መዋዕል፡ (de Deo) Dan. 7,9; Clem. f. 2; et abstr. inde formatum: ብሉየ፡ መዋዕልና፡ dierum-antiquitas: ዕሩያን፡ በመለኮት፡ ወበህላዌ፡ ወበብሉየ፡ መዋዕልና፡ Haim. Ab. Nr. 24. – Voc. Ae.: ብሉይ፡ ዘ፡ የአረጅ። bǝluy, fem. bǝlit G ብሉይ፡ bǝluy vetus, Vetus Testamentum, vieux, Ancien Testament ብሊት bǝlit fem. vetus, Vetus Testamentum, vieille, Ancien Testament Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 65. ብሉይ፡ bǝluy m. et ብሊት bǝlit fem. désignant les livres de l’Ancien Testament. Voici texte et référence: ማእምር፡ በኵሉ፡ መጻሕፍተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ንጹሓት፡ ዘብሊት፡ ወሐዲስ። 311. 183 L ብሉይ bǝluy (fem. ብሊት bǝlit) old, ancient, antiquated, decrepit, obsolete, worn-out; ብሉይ bǝluy and ብሊት bǝlit also refer to the Old Testament 98b

woorden.betekenis: ave!, euge, io, evax!, ave dicere, salutare
woorden.definitie: , ባሐ፡, በሐ፡ interjectio salutantis: ave! χαῖρε [arab. بَخٍ بَخْ euge, io, evax! ] a { ባሕ፡} Lit. 158,2; ኢትበልዎሙ፡ ባሕ፡ Clem. f. 187; ባሕ፡ ሄርማ፡ Herm. 1; Herm. 2. b ባሐ፡ vel በሐ፡, ut: ንበላ፡ ባሐ፡ ወትረ፡ Clem. f. 165; በሐ፡ በልዋ፤ ተሳለምዋ፡ Deg.; Mavâs. 5; ባሐ፡ ረቢ፡ Matth. 26,49; Matth. 27,29; ባሐ፡ ንጉሦሙ፡ ለአይሁድ፡ Marc. 15,18; Joh. 19,3; quare ባሐ፡ ብሂል፡ i. est q. ave dicere, salutare: ወበሐሂ፡ (ወባሐሂ፡) ኢትበልዎ፡ 2 Joh. 10; 2 Joh. 11; Clem. f. 183; ኢትበሎ፡ በሐ፡ ወእመ፡ ይቤለከ፡ በሐ፡ (εὐλογεῖν) 4 Reg. 4,29 vers. nov. c c. pron. suff.: ባሐከ፡ (v. ባሕከ፡) ባሮክ፡ Rel. Bar.; በሐኪ፡ ኦማርያም፡ Kedr f. 24; በሐኪ፡ ኦዐባይ፡ ሀገር፤ ሀገረ፡ ናግራን፡ Deg.; ባሐኪ፡ ማርያም፡ Mavâs. 65; ባሕክን፡ Matth. 28,9; ባሕከ፡ ሄርማ፡ Herm. p. 21; ባሕኪ፡ እግዝእትየ፡ Herm. p. 2. – Voc. Ae.: በሐ፡ ሐዊሳ፡ ብ፡ ምንኛ፡ ዋልሕ።

woorden.betekenis: vid. sub በሀመ፡
woorden.definitie: vid. sub በሀመ፡

woorden.betekenis: fidit, spatiatus, dilatatus fuit
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., بَحَرَ (vicin. بَقَرَ) fidit, X spatiatus, dilatatus fuit.

woorden.betekenis: regio, terra, spatium, locus, provincia, fines, incolis, pop
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m. [ut videtur i.q. بِحَارٌ Pl. a بَحْرَةٌ regio, terra], Pl. በሓውርት፡ (perraro ብሔራት፡, Lud. e Syn.) spatium, ut: ይጸብበነ፡ ብሔር፤ ግበሪ፡ ለነ፡ ብሔረ፡ ኀበ፡ ንነብር፡ Jes. 49,20. 1 spatium circumscriptum i.e. locus τόπος; Gen. 21,17; 2 Reg. 7,10; ቦ፡ ብሔር፡ እምኀበ፡ ይወፅእ፡ ብሩር፡ Job 28,1; አይቴ፡ ብሔራ፡ ለጥበብ፡ Job 28,12; Bar. 3,15; Jer. 7,20; Jer. 14,13; Jer. 16,9; Jer. 19,3; Jer. 22,3; Jes. 14,2; Jes. 30,23; Jes. 33,14; እሬስያ፡ ለምድረ፡ በድው፡ ብሔረ፡ አርዝ፡ Jes. 41,19; Matth. 14,15; Matth. 27,33; Luc. 4,37; locus, qui alicui convenit, vel partes: ፈለጦሙ፡ ሥርዐቶሙ፡ በበ፡ ባሓውርቲሆሙ፡ διέστειλε μερίδας αὐτῶν Sir. 16,26. 2 spatium extensius, i.e. regio, terra, provincia, fines, τόπος Matth. 14,35; Matth. 24,7; እመ፡ ታአምር፡ ብሔሮ፡ εἰ ἔμπειρος εἶ τῶν τόπων Tob. 5,5; χώρα Gen. 42,9; Luc. 15,13; Luc. 19,12; Marc. 5,10; በሓውርተ፡ አሕዛብ፡ Sir. 10,16; Koh. 2,8; Esth. 3,12; Jes. 2,6; Jes. 2,7; Jes. 8, 8; Jes. 10,9; Jes. 36,10; Jes. 36,18; Jer. 16,15; Dan. 2,48; Num. 32,1; አይቴ፡ ብሔርከ፡ ἐκ ποίας χώρας εἶ σύ; Jon. 1,8; ብሔረ፡ ሕያዋን፡ Ps. 55,13; ብሔረ፡ ኤላም፡ Dan. 8,2; ብሔረ፡ ፋርስ፡ Jes. 52,4; ብሔረ፡ ሮሜ፡ Rom. 1,7; γῆ ብሔረ፡ ዕብራውያን፡ Gen. 40,15; ብሔረ፡ ብንያም፡ Jer. 1,1; እምርሑቅ፡ ብሔር፡ Jes. 13,5; Jes. 36,17; Sir. 48,15; ብሔረ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ነኪር፡ Sir. 39,4; Job 10,21; Job 38,19; ὅρια በሓውርተ፡ አሕዛብ፡ Jes. 10,13; Ps. 147,3; Mal. 1,4; Mal. 1,5; κατοικία Lev. 23,3; Lev. 23,14. Proverbium: ለእመ፡ ሖርከ፡ ብሔረ፡ ባዕድ፡ ኢትኩን፡ ከማከ፤ ኩን፡ ከማሆሙ፡ Th. P. α crebro pro incolis terrae, populis, gentibus, hominibus: ኢምሕኮሙ፡ ለብሔር፡ ኀበ፡ ነበረ፡ ሎጥ፡ τῆς παροικίας Λώτ Sir. 16,8; አንከሩከ፡ በሓውርት፡ Sir. 47,17; ኵሉ፡ ብሔር፡ ኢመስሐ፡ πᾶσα ἡ γῆ ἠρίστα 1 Reg. 14,24; ይጼንዑ፡ መፍቅዶሙ፡ ለብሔር፡ (αἰῶνος) Sir. 38,34; መጽኡ፡ ኵሉ፡ በሓውርት፡ ውስተ፡ ግብጽ፡ Gen. 41,57; አሕዛብ፡ ወበሓውርተ፡ አሕዛብ፡ Gen. 35,11; ἔθνη Apoc. 5,9; አሕዛብ፡ ወበሓውርት፡ ἔθνη καὶ λαοί Jes. 60,5; 4 Esr. 1,10; γλῶσσαι Dan. 3,4; Dan. 3,29; Dan. 5,19; Dan. 6,25; Apoc. 10,11; Apoc. 11,9. β patria c. pron. suff., tribus, gens, πατρίς ኢነገረት፡ አስቴር፡ አዝማዲሃ፡ ወኢብሔራ፡ Esth. 2,10; Jes. 13,14; ምድረ፡ ብሔሩ፡ Jer. 22,10; πατριά Tob. 5,12; Judith 8,18; ኵሉ፡ በሓውርት፡ ዘቤተ፡ እስራኤል፡ Jer. 2,4; Ps. 48,2; st. constructo annexum passim: indigena, vernaculus: ዕፀ፡ ብሔር፡ ξύλον ἐγχώριον 1 Esr. 6,24; Gen. 34,1. γ provincia, parochia clericorum, ut: ካህን፡ ዘኀደገ፡ ብሔሮ፡ ወሖረ፡ ኀበ፡ ካልእ፡ ብሔር፡ (παροικία) Can. Ant. 2, al. δ agri, rus (opp. urbe) 4 Esr. 9,16; Luc. 12,16; Joh. 4,35; ብሔር፡ ጥሉል፡ Jes. 5,1; ብሔር፡ ሥዑር፡ Ps. 22,1; Luc. 21,21; st. constructo annexum passim: vicanus, ut: ቀሲሰ፡ በሓውርት፡ ἐπιχώριοι πρεςβύτεροι, Can. Neocaes. 13. ε quidquid de coeli temperie, lumine, tenebris al. praedicandum est, Aethiopes de regione praedicare amant: ክረምት፡ ብሔር፡ καιρὸς χειμερινός hiems erat 2 Esr. 10,13; ቍር፡ ብሔሩ፡ frigus erat Joh. 18,18 rom.; ነግህ፡ (v. ነግሀ፡) ብሔር፡ ἔστι ὥρα τρίτη τῆς ἡμέρας dies jam illustris est Act. 2,15; ጽሕው፡ ብሔር፡ εὐδία serenum est Matth. 16,2; ሶበ፡ ጸብሐ፡ ብሔር፡ illucescente die 4 Reg. 3,20; 1 Reg. 25,36; ጽልመት፡ ብሔር፡ tenebrae sunt Sir. 23,18; መስየ፡ ብሔር፡ diei vesper est, vesperascit Gad. T.H. ζ operis e pluribus libris compositi libri singuli ብሔር፡ nominantur: ይቤ፡በኦሪት፡ ውስተ፡ ሣልስ፡ ብሔር፡ ዘሌዋውያን፡ F.M. 2,6; በውስተ፡ ዳግም፡ ብሔረ፡ ኦሪት፡ F.M. 4,1; ኦሪት፡ ባቲ፡ ኀምስቱ፡ ብሔር፡ Abtel. Ap. 81; ፬ብሔር፡ ዘነገሥት፡ Abtel. Ap. 81; ክፍል፡ ፭ እምዳግም፡ ብሔር፡ ዘመጽሐፈ፡ ነገሥት፡ Abush. 19; 29; 76 3 raro: terra continens, orbis terrarum, ብሔር፡ ወማይ፡ Judith 2,7; ውእቱ፡ ተረፈ፡ ለብሔር፡ Sir. 44,17; Sir. 49,14. bǝḥer, Pl. በሓውርት፡ baḥāwǝrt, በሓይርት፡ baḥāyǝrt, በሓውርታት፡ baḥāwǝrtāt G ብሔር፡ bǝḥer, Pl. በሓውርት፡ baḥāwǝrt locus, regio, lieu, région, contrée, pays, provinvce ― ስፍራ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 65. 183 L ብሔር bǝḥer (Pl. በሓውርት፡ baḥāwǝrt, በሓይርት፡ baḥāyǝrt, በሓውርታት፡ baḥāwǝrtāt) region, province, district, country, homeland, land, place, nation; part of a text, individual book of a collection (as, for instance, the Bible); is also used in expressions about weather, light, as in መስየ፡ ብሔር masya bǝḥer it is evening, ጸብሐ፡ ብሔር ṣabḥa bǝḥer it is morning, ጽሕው፡ ብሔር ṣǝḥǝw bǝḥer fair weather (cp. a similar usage with Amh. mǝdǝr earth, Ar. dunyā world; e.g. ʾamsat ʾaddunyā it is dark) ብሔር bǝḥer also occurs in vid. እግዚአብሔር ʾǝgziʾabǝḥer God, from vid. እግዚእ ʾǝgziʾ Lord, and ብሔር bǝḥer world በሓውርት፡ baḥāwǝrt (Pl. of ብሔር bǝḥer) countrymen, inhabitants or people of a country በሓውርተ፡ ዓለም baḥāwǝrta ʿālam (Lt) secular domain, vid. ዓለም፡ 91b

woorden.betekenis: mare, lacus magnus, mare aheneum, plaga occidentalis, bāḥr,
woorden.definitie: subst., fem. et m., [بَحْرٌ ܒܰܚܪܳܐ] Pl. አብሕርት፡{ Pl. etiam ባሕራት፡ Hen. 5,3 var. in Cod. Abb. LV} 1 mare, lacus magnus Gen. 1,10; Gen. 1,26; Gen. 1,28; Gen. 32,13; Ex. 15,8; Ex. 15,10; Job 11,9; Job 14,11; Job 28,14; Job 38,8; Job 38,9; Job 38,10; Job 38,11; Jes. 23,4; Jes. 50,2; Jes. 51,10; Jes. 51,15; Jer. 28,42; Zach. 14,8; Koh. 1,7; 4 Esr. 1,19; 4 Esr. 2,28; 4 Esr. 2,46; 4 Esr. 5,3; 4 Esr. 9,36; Judith 5,13; Ps. 73,14; Ps. 94,5; Ps. 103,26; Apoc. 4,6; Apoc. 15,2; እለ፡ ይነግድዋ፡ ለባሕር፡ Sir. 43,24; ባሕር፡ ዘይትሀወክ፡ Jes. 5,30; እለ፡ መንገለ፡ ባሕር፡ αἱ παραωαλάσσιοι Jer. 29,7; አብሕርት፡ Kuf. 2; Hen. 5,3; Hen. 77,3; Lit. 172,1; ባሕር፡ ዐቢይ፡ Dan. 7,2; Kuf. 8; Num. 34,6; Num. 34,7; ባሕረ፡ ኤርትራ፡ Ex. 10,19; Ex. 23,31; Ps. 135,13; Ps. 135,15; Hen. 32,2; Hen. 77,6; ባሕር፡ ኬኔሬት፡ Num. 34,11; ባሕር፡ ዘገሊላ፡ Matth. 15,29; Matth. 4,18; Matth, 4,15; ባሕረ፡ ሚኦት፡ Kuf. 8; ባሕር፡ ምዉት፡ Sx. Nah. 14; ባሕረ፡ ጥብርያዶስ፡ Clem. f. 152; ባሕረ፡ ጸና፡ in Abyssinia, . I,8. n. 112. a de fluviis magnis: Hez. 32,2; ባሕረ፡ ኒል፡ Abush. 8; Sx. Sen. 4; ተከዜ፡ ዮርዳኖስ፡ ባሕር፡ Sx. Masc. 2 Enc. b de labro vel lavacro magno: ባሕር፡ ዘብርት፡ mare aheneum Jer. 52,17; 4 Reg. 16,17; 3 Reg. 7,10 seq. c transl.: ባሕረ፡ እሳት፡ Macc. f. 9; Johannes Apostolus cognominatur ባሕረ፡ ጥበባት፡ Deg. 2 in Bibliis secundum Hebraeorum loquendi usum: plaga occidentalis Gen. 12,8; Gen. 13,14; Gen. 28,14; Ex. 27,12; Ex. 37,10; Num. 2,18; Deut. 3,27; Ps. 106,3; Hez. 45,7; Dan. 8,4. bāḥr, Pl. ʾabḥǝrt, bāḥrāt ባሕረ፡ ሊባ፡ bāḥra libā northwest ወእመ፡ ይትከሀሎሙ፡ ይብጽሑ፡ ፊንቄ፡ ወይክ(ር)ሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ቀሬጤ፡ ዘአንጻረ፡ ባሕረ፡ ሊባ፡ ‘if it were possible for them, to reach Phoenicia and winter in Crete, which is facing northwest (?)’ 73 (ed.), 50 (tr.) (‘In some sources, baḥr and liba refer to opposite directions, the former to northeast and the latter to southwest. In others baḥr is southwest and liba northwest. How “baḥrä liba” stood for “northwest” (χῶρος) is not clear.’ 50 n. 233) vid. ሊባ፡ G ባሕር፡ bāḥr, Pl. አብሕርት፡ ʾabḥǝrt mare, lacus, flumen, mer, lac, fleuve Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 66. 183 ባሕረ፡ ሐሳብ፡ bāḥra ḥassāb «chronologie astronomique et historique» Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 23v., vid. ሐሳብ፡ 49 L ባሕር፡ bāḥr (Pl. አብሕርት ʾabḥǝrt, ባሕራት bāḥrāt) sea, lake, ocean, large river; west, northwest, north 91b ባሕረ፡ ሐሳብ bāḥra ḥassāb Treatise on Computation, vid. ሐሳብ፡ 245a ባሕር፡ ምውት bāḥr mǝwwǝt the Dead Sea, vid. ምዉት፡ 375b C a part of n. pr. (lake) vid. ባሕረ፡ ሳፍ፡ b part of n. pr. (personal name) vid. e.g. ባሕር፡ ሰገድ፡, ባሕረ፡ አስግድ፡ c part of n. pr. (sea) vid. ባሕረ፡ ኢያሪኮ፡ d for ማእከለ፡ ባሕር፡ vid. ማእከል፡ (TraCES) e for ሥዩመ፡ ባሕር፡ vid. ሥዩም፡ (TraCES) f for አተረ፡ ባሕር፡ vid. ዐተር፡ (TraCES)

woorden.betekenis: margarita, unio, gemma, natura, essentia, substantia, hypost
woorden.definitie: (ባሕሪ፡) proprie adj., deinde subst., m. et fem., coll. et sing., Pl. ባሕርያት፡ [i.q. بَحْرىٌّ] 1 margarita, unio, collect. Matth. 7,6; 1 Tim. 2,9; Apoc. 18,12; Apoc. 18,16; sing. Matth. 13,45; Matth. 13,46; Apoc. 21,21; Pl. Apoc. 17,4; Jsp. p. 370; (ደናግል፡) እማንቱ፡ ዕንቈ፡ ባሕርያት፡ ክቡራት፡ Sx. Mij. 8; ባሕርዮን፡ (v. ባሕርያቲሆን፡) τὸ κάθεμα αὐτῶν Jes. 3,19; ባሕርይ፡ ዘያንጸበርቅ፡ vel እንተ፡ ታበርህ፡ Lud. ex Org. 2 gemma: እብነ፡ ባሕርይ፡ Hen. 18,7; Sap. 7,9; Sap. 18,24; Jsp. p. 340; transl. de personis vel rebus pretiosis: ሰላም፡ ለደቅስዮስ፡ ባሕርያ፡ ወኤጲስቆጶስ፡ ዘብሔረ፡ ዋልጥያ፡ Sx. Tachs. 22 Enc.; በባሕርየ፡ በድኑ፡ ተሰውጠት፡ ለባዊት፡ ነፍስ፡ Sx. Mag. 12 Enc.; Sx. Sen. 1 Enc. 3 natura, essentia, substantia, hypostasis (sicut جَوْهَرٌ) a de hominibus: እስመ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ኀደጉ፡ ፍጥረቶሙ፡ ወባሕርየ፡ ጠባይዖሙ፡ ወነዱ፡ በበይናቲሆሙ፡ በፍትወት፡ F.M. 7,1 (e Rom. 1,23 seq.); qui matrimonium abominatur, መስተሳልቀ፡ ኮነ፡ ላዕለ፡ ባሐርየ፡ ፍጥረቱ፡ F.M. 9,2. b de Deo trino: οὐσία Chrys. ho. 22; እስመ፡ ብሂሎቱሰ፡ ኀየሰ፡ እመላእክት፡ አኮ፡ ዘያኤምር፡ ኀበ፡ ባሕርይሁ፡ ዘእምአብ፡ እስመ፡ ባሕርየ፡ መለኮቱ፡ አኮ፡ ዘኮነ፡ ሥጋ፡ አላ፡ ተወልደ፡ ወባሐቱ፡ ይኤምር፡ ኀበ፡ ባሕርየ፡ ሥጋዌሁ፡ τὸ γὰρ Κρείττων γενόμενος οὐκ οὐσίας δηλωτικόν ἐστι τῆς κατὰ πατέρα. ἐκείνη γὰρ οὐκ ἐγένετο ἀλλὰ γεγέννηται. ἀλλὰ τῆς κατὰ σάρκα Chrys. ho. 1; ባሕርየ፡ ሥላሴ፡ ፩ውእቱ፡ ዘውእቱ፡ ፩መለኮት፡ Haim. Ab.; አርአያ፡ አካለ፡ ባሕርይሁ፡ χαρακτὴρ τῆς ὑποστάσεως αὐτοῦ Chrys. ho. 1; tres personae ዕሩያን፡ በባሕርይ፡ ወበአምላክና፡ ወበቅድምና፡ F.M. 17,8; Org., al. (In disputationibus theologicis de naturis Christi ባሕርይ፡ non tantum pro hypostasi vel persona, sed etiam pro natura ab Abyssinis accipi, demonstrat Lud. lex. c. 229). — Libellus መጽሐፈ፡ ባሕርይ፡ exstat in codice Tubing. Kedr f. 39; Kedr f. 40; Kedr f. 41; Kedr f. 42; Kedr f. 43; Kedr f. 44; Kedr f. 45; d’Abb. cat. p. 84, qui etiam ጸሎተ፡ ዘይት፡ በዘይሰረይ፡ ኀጢአት፡ appellatur; ሰማይናሃ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ባሕርይ፡ እስመ፡ ቃለ፡ መለኮት፡ ይእቲ፡ (Kedr f. 42). – Voc. Ae.: ግዕዝ፡ ወባሕርይ፡ ዘ፡ ጠባይ። bāḥrǝy, bāḥri, Pl. ባሕርያት፡ bāḥrǝyāt G ባሕርይ፡ bāḥrǝy, Pl. ባሕርያት፡ bāḥrǝyāt gemma, natura, substantia, indoles, pierre précieuse, gemme, nature, instinct, substance, essence, caractère, qualité, dispositions naturalles Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 66. 183 L ባሕሪ bāḥri, ባሕርይ፡ bāḥrǝy (Pl. ባሕርያት፡ bāḥrǝyāt) pearl, precious stone, essence, element, nature, substance, quality, hypostasis ባሕርየ፡ መለኮት bāḥrǝya malakot (Lt) divine nature, vid. መለኮት፡ ባሕርየ፡ ሥጋ bāḥrǝya śǝgā (Lt) human nature, vid. ሥጋ፡ 91b

woorden.betekenis: arundo, canna, calamus, bāḥrus, bǝḥrus, calamus ad scribendu
woorden.definitie: (ብሕሩስ፡) subst. [sec. Lud. “forsan sic dictum a ባሕር፡ quod in fluminibus crescat”] arundo, canna, calamus (sec. Lud.: “species quaedam arundinis tenuioris, cujus usus in toto Oriente ad scribendum frequens): ብርዐ፡ ባሕሩስ፡ (v. ብሕሩስ፡) Jes. 1,31 (καλάμη στιππύου); ባሕሩስ፡ (v. ብርዐ፡ ባሕሩስ፡) καλάμη Nah. 1,10; በትረ፡ ባሕሩስ፡ (v. በርሁስ፡) ῥάβδος καλαμίνη 4 Reg. 18,21; ለየዐይ፡ በሀሩስ፡ (cod. Laur.; al.: ቢሮሽ፡ πίτυς) Zach. 11,2; tempore Salomonis ኀጺን፡ ኮነ፡ ብዙኀ፡ ከመ፡ ዕፀ፡ ባሕሩስ፡ ወከመ፡ ብርዐ፡ ገዳም፡ Kebr. Nag. 22. – Voc. Ae.: ባሕሩስ፡ ዘ፡ መቃዕ፡ (v. መቃ፡). bāḥrus, bǝḥrus G ባሕሩስ፡ bāḥrus arundo, calamus ad scribendum, roseau, roseau pour écrire (calamus scriptorus) ― መቃ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 66. 184 L ባሕሩስ bāḥrus, ብሕሩስ bǝḥrus reed, cane, stubble 92a

woorden.betekenis: catarrhacta, dejectus aquae
woorden.definitie: et መንባሕባሕት፡, subst., Pl. ምንባሕባሓት፡, ምንባሐብሓት፡, ምንበሐብሓት፡, መንበሐብሓት፡, ምንብሐብሓተ፡ catarrhacta, dejectus aquae: ድምፀ፡ ምንብሐብሓተ፡ (c. varr.) ማይ፡ ዘየሐውር፡ በኀይል፡ Sap. 17,17; ውሒዝ፡ ዐቢይ፡ ዘይወርድ፡ በኀይል፡ እምውስተ፡ መንባሕባሕት፡ (c. varr.) Jes. 17,13; de catarrhactis coeli (Gen. 7,11 seq.; aliâs አስራብ፡) Kuf. 5; Gad. Ad. f. 159; transl.: ክርስቶስ፡ አምላኪየ፡ ወተስፋየ፤ ወዕፀ፡ መስቀሉ፡ በትረ፡ ሃይማኖትየ፤ ወርግዘተ፡ ገቦሁ፡ መንበሐብሓተ፡ ጥምቀትየ፡ M.M. f. 66; ጰራቅሊጦስ፡ መንበሐብሓተ፡ ጥምቀትነ፡ M.M. f. 308.

woorden.betekenis: copiam, facultatem, potestatem, nancisci, habere, pollere, p
woorden.definitie: I,1 [denom. a መባሕት፡ q.v. sub ቦሐ፡] copiam, facultatem, potestatem rei nancisci vel habere, pollere, posse: ሶበ፡ ብሕትኩ፡ እልእክ፡ ዘይጼውዐከ፡ καιρὸν μεταλαβών Act. 24,25 Platt; de Christo: እንዘ፡ ትብሕት፡ አንተ፡ በኵለሄ፡ Org. 2. bǝḥta G ብሕተ፡ bǝḥta I,1 ይብሕት፡, ይብሐት፡ imperio, potestate praeditus fuit, être investi du pouvoir suprême ― ሰለጠነ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 66. La forme ብሕቶት፡ bǝḥtot présentée par E. Goodspeed comme ayant la même signification que vid. መብሐት፡ pouvoir, moyen, faculté, permission, autorisation, manque dans le . Texte et référence: ወአንተኒ፡ አሳዊሮስ፡ ትጠብሖ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ካህን፡ ዘይፈልጦ፡ ለወለድ፡ ወለኵሉ፡ ዘይክሕድ፡ ብሕቶቶ፡ ለዋሕድ፡ ወይከፍሎ፡ ለ፪፡ ግዕዝ፡ ወለ፪፡ አምሳል። 33. Le contexte où se trouve le vocable ብሕቶት፡ exige un autre sens; la forme ብሕቶት፡, elle aussi, réclame une autre origine. Ce mot provient du radical inusité በሐተ፡, d’où dérivent ብሑት፡ unique, ባሕቲት፡ solitude, ባሕተወ፡ être seul, ብሕትው፡ seul, ብሕቱት፡ seule. Le vocable ብሕቶት፡ s’insère dans le groupe des mots dont la désinence est en ‘ōt’, comme ምልኮት፡, ጽላሎት፡, ጥብዖት፡, ሃይማኖት፡, etc. Ce mot signifie solitude, unité, unicité. Dans le contexte théologique où il se trouve, il semble devoir être traduit par unicité. Voici la traduction proposée du texte cité plus haut: «Pour toi, ô Sévère, tu retrancheras tout prêtre qui partage le Fils et quinconque nie l’unicité de l’Unique et le partage en deux natures et deux apparences.» 184 L bḥt II, ብሕተ bǝḥta (yǝbḥat) have power, have capacity, have means, prevail 92b

woorden.betekenis: û, solum, tantum, at, sed, autem, attamen, verum, verumtamen
woorden.definitie: particula restrictiva et adversativa (e ባሕት፡ et suff. û, vid. gramm. § 163,2; gramm. 168,8) 1 rarius: solum, tantum, ut: በዝንቱ፡ ባሕቱ፡ Gen. 34,15; Gen. 2,6. 2 plerumqne: at, sed, autem, attamen, verum, verumtamen, a ባሕቱ፡ nudum, πλήν, ባሕቱ፡ (v. ወባሕቱ፡) ዘንተ፡ ረከብኩ፡ Koh. 7,30; δέ Prov, 14,22; vel postpositum (δέ), ut: መበለት፡ ባሕቱ፡ Lev. 21,14; Prov. 14,22 var.; Prov. 15,1. b crebro: ወባሕቱ፡ πλήν Gen. 9,4; Jer. 3,20; ምህረኒ፡ እግዚኦ፡ ወባሕቱ፡ በፍትሕ፡ Jer. 10,24; Matth. 11,22; Matth. 11,24; Matth. 26,39; Luc. 6,24; Luc. 10,11; Luc. 10,20; Luc. 18,8; 1 Cor. 11,11; ἀλλά 1 Reg. 15,30; Job 1,11; Tob. 5,2; Tob. 5,15; Rom. 5,14; Rom. 7,7; 2 Tim. 3,9; Gal. 1,8; 4 Esr. 2,53; 4 Esr. 10,19; 4 Esr. 11,6; Sir. 14,20; Sir. 19,24 (ubi in Gr. nihil respondet); οὐ μὴν δὲ ἀλλά Job 5,8; Job 21,17; Job 27,7; Job 34,36; ἀλλὰ δὴ Job 27,11; μέντοι Prov. 16,26; እነብር፡ ኀቤከ፡ ወባሕቱ፡ በሌሊት፡ ትወፅእ፡ አመትከ፡ ገዳመ፡ Judith 11,17; Asc. Jes. 9,10; Asc. Jes. 9,38; ወባሕቱ፡ — ሰ፡ καίτοι γε Job 4,2. c ወ — ባሕቱ፡ δέ Deut. 31,2; Judith 5,18; Judith 5,24; Matth. 17,12; vel ወ — ሰ፡ — ባሕቱ፡ δέ Gen. 3,3; Gen. 24,8; Kuf. 6. 3 ባሐቱ፡ postpositum: quin, imo, potius ( vielmehr, ubi contrarium rei negatae ponitur): δέ Matth. 5,33; Matth. 5,37; μᾶλλον Matth. 10,6; Luc. 10,20; 1 Joh. 2,19; አኮ፡ ይእዜ፡ አላ፡ ባሕቱ፡ እምድኅረ፡ ኅዳጥ፡ መዋዕል፡ Clem. f. 14; ወባሕቱ፡ Matth. 10,28; Prov. 18,2.

woorden.betekenis: solitudo, solus, sua solius voluntate, seorsum, solitarie, q
woorden.definitie: subst., proprie solitudo, cum affixis pronominibus pers. usurpatur, et circumscribendis adjectivis vel adverbiis aliarum linguarum inservit (sicut לְבַד ܒܰܠܚܽܘܕ وَحْدٌ; gramm. § 157,2; gramm. § 163,2). 1 Subjunctis pronominibus suff. omnium personarum (nota formas quasdam anomalas Ex. 36,12 annot.) a solus (et unicus, et solitarius); non de personis tantum usurpatur sed etiam de rebus, ut Gen. 34,22; Gen. 47,26; Ex. 22,26; (nihil edebat) ዘእንበለ፡ በቀዳሚት፡ ሰንበት፡ ወበዕለት፡ እሑድ፡ ባሕቲቶሙ፡ Sx. Mag. 5; ወአኮ፡ ለአፅምዖ፡ ባሕቲቱ፡ Jac. 1,22; explere potest vicem subjecti: ባሕቲትከኑ፡ መልአክ፡ አንተ፡ σὺ μόνος εἶ ἄρχων; Jes. 10,8; praedicati: ሶበ፡ ይሄልዉ፡ ባሕቲቶሙ፡ Asc. Jes. 11,8; appositionis (id quod longe frequentissimum est): ኖኅ፡ ባሕቲቱ፡ Kuf. 5; እግዚአብሔር፡ ባሕቲቱ፡ ጻድቅ፡ Sir. 18,2; Jos. 22,20; አነ፡ ባሕቲትየ፡ Job 1,15; Jes. 49,21; Tob. 6,15; ምንተ፡ በጻሕከ፡ ባሕቲትከ፡ 1 Reg. 21,1; Judae 4; እፎ፡ ነበረት፡ ባሕቲታ፡ ሀገር፡ Thren. 1,1; ባሕቲትየ፡ እነብር፡ καταμόνας Jer. 15,17; ባሕቲቶሙ፡ ይነብሩ፡ Sir. 30,9; ወትተርፍ፡ ባሕቲታ፡ ምድሮሙ፡ በድወ፡ Jes. 6,11, nonnumquam in Acc., ut: እንዘ፡ ናንሶሱ፡ ባሕቲተነ፡ (v. ባሕቲትነ፡) Dan. apocr. 1,36; ለከ፡ ለባሕቲትከ፡ Ps. 50,5; ኪያሁ፡ ባሕቲቶ፡ Matth. 4,10; Matth. 10,42; cuivis st. constructo subjungere licet: በፈቃደ፡ ባሕቲቱ፡ sua solius voluntate F.N. 6; አኮ፡ በእንተ፡ ባሕቲቶሙ፡ ዘእብል፡ (Platt: በእንተ፡ እሉ፡ ባሕቲቶሙ፡) Joh. 17,20 rom.; Rom. 4,23; አኮ፡ ለባሕቲትየ፡ ዘጻመውኩ፡ οὐκ ἐμοὶ μόνῳ Sir. 24,34; Rom. 3,29. b praefixis praepositionibus α በ፡ seorsum, solitarie (secum, sine arbitris): በባሕቲቶሙ፡ καθ᾽ ἑαυτούς Zach. 12,12 seq.; ሠሐቀት፡ በባሕቲታ፡ ἐν ἑαυτῇ Gen. 18,12; በባሕቲቶሙ፡ ተስእልዎ፡ quum soli (cum eo) essent, interrogarunt Marc. 4,10; Matth. 18,15. β እንተ፡ seorsum, separatim: አቀሞን፡ እንተ፡ ባሕቲቶን፡ Gen. 21,28; Gen. 21,29; Gen. 32,17; Gen. 43,32; Ex. 29,26; Ex. 36,12; Jud. 7,5; 3 Reg. 18,6; Matth. 17,1; Matth. 17,19. c praemissa negatione አኮ፡ et sequente ዓዲ፡ vel ወዓዲ፡ vel ዓዲ፡ — ኒ፡, ዓዲ፡ — ሂ፡ non solum ( tantum, modo ) — sed etiam 1 Cor. 5,10; Joh. 13,9; Act. 21,13; Rom. 4,12; Rom. 5,3; Rom. 8,23; Rom. 9,10; Rom. 9,24; Rom. 16,4; Phil. 2,27; 1 Thess. 1,5; Hebr. 12,26. 2 Subjuncto pron. III. p. m. sing., sc. ባሕቲቱ፡ (rarius in Acc. ut 4 Esr. 9,27 bis): solum, tantum, modo, solummodo Gen. 2,6; ኢ vel አኮ፡ — ባሕቲቱ፡ — አላ፡ vel አላ፡ — ኒ፡ Sap. 19,14; Phlx. 31; 1 Joh. 2,2; 1 Joh. 5,6. — (De significatu ባሕቲት፡ unica i.e. carissima, quam Ludolfus affert, vehementer dubito; etenim Sx. Teq. 25 Enc. ለባሕቲትከ፡ non tuae (animae) carissimae sed tibi soli significat; pariter Lud. comm. hist. p. 303 Nr. 10 ግበሩ፡ በዓላ፡ ለባሕቲትየ፡ non „ celebrate festum unicae (carissimae) meae “ sed „ festum ejus mihi soli “ (sicut ሊተ፡ . p. 303 Nr. 11) exponendum videtur).

woorden.betekenis: insilivit, coivit, subegit, subigendo, coëundo, mas gregis,
woorden.definitie: subst. m. Pl. አብሓኵ፡ (plerumque አብሐኵ፡ scriptum) [etymon obscurum est; nescio an componendum sit cum بَاكَ insilivit et coivit, subegit, sicut כֶּבֶשׂ a subigendo et coëundo dictus est] mas gregis, tam ovium quam caprarum, aries, hircus: አብሓኵ፡ ዘአባግዕ፡ ወዘአጣሊ፡ οἱ τράγοι καὶ οἱ κριοί Gen. 31,10; Gen. 31,12; Gen. 30,35; አብሓኰ፡አባግዕ፡ κριοὶ τῶν προβάτων Ps. 64,14; Jer. 32,20; Jer. 32,21; Jer. 32,22; አብሓኵ፡ κριοί Thren. 1,6; በሐኵ፡ Hez. 34,22; Dan. 8,3 seq.; κριοὶ καὶ τράγοι በሐኵ፡ ወዳቤላ፡ Hez. 34,17, at ዳቤላት፡ ወአብሓኵ፡ Hez. 39,18; τράγος በሐኵ፡ እንዘ፡ ይሜብል፡ ላዕለ፡ መርዔት፡ Prov. 24,66; praeterea Kuf. 6; Kuf. 7 seq.; Kuf. 32al. – Voc. Ae.: በሐኵ፡ ዘ፡ የበግ፡ (v. የበግዕ፡) አውራ። baḥakʷ, ብሕኵ፡ bǝḥkʷ, Pl. ʾabḥākʷ, ʾabāḥǝkʷ G አባሕኵ፡ ʾabāḥǝkʷ Pl., Le pluriel brisé አባሕኵ፡ béliers, boucs, manque dans le . Texte et référence: ወሀብዋ፡ አምኃ፡ ብዙኀ፡ ወእንዘ፡ ትነብር፡ በእማንቱ፡ ሰሙን፡ ዕለታት፡ ጽባሕ፡ ወሠርከ፡ ፻፻፡ አባግዐ፡ ፻፻፡ መጋዝአ፡ ላህም፡ ፸፸፡ አጣሌ፡ ወአባሕኰ። 5. 185 L በሐኵ baḥakʷ, (Lt) ብሕኵ bǝḥkʷ (Pl. አብሓኵ ʾabḥākʷ, አባሕኵ ʾabāḥǝkʷ) male of cattle, ram, billy goat 91a

woorden.betekenis: herbae inutilis
woorden.definitie: subst. ut videtur, herbae inutilis species: ኮነት፡ ሀገር፡ በድወ፡ ወበቈለ፡ ላዕሌሃ፡ ሦክ፡ ወአሜከላ፡ ወኮነት፡ ብሕውሰ፡ ወምጉሕያ፡ ወኮነት፡ በድወ፡ ወዐፀ፡ Macc. f. 13[an בָּאְשָׁה?]

woorden.betekenis: calvum esse
woorden.definitie: calvum esse vid. sub በርሐ፡

woorden.betekenis: lucere facere, lucidum reddere, collustrare, illustrare, ill
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 trans., c.c. Acc., lucere facere, lucidum reddere, collustrare, illustrare, illuminare, aliquem Luc. 11,36; lucernam Ps. 17,31; lumina ( accendere ): አብርሆ፡ ብርሃናት፡ (ceremonia funebris) Genz. f. 84; አንደዱ፡ እሳት፡ ወአብርሁ፡ ἅψαντες πῦρ εἰς φαῦσιν Judith 13,13; ኣበርሃ፡ ለጥበብ፡ ከመ፡ ጎሕ፡ Sir. 24,32; tenebras Ps. 17,31; oculos Ps. 12,4; Ps. 18,9; Sir, 31,20; አብርሀ፡ አዕይንትየ፡ visum mihi (caeco) reddidit Sx. Nah. 15; faciem Ps. 103,17; አብርህ፡ ገጸ፡ እምቅብእ፡ Sx. Ter 23Enc.; hilarem reddere, exhilarare faciem alicujus Koh. 8,1; ላሕያ፡ ለብእሲት፡ ያበርሆ፡ ለገጻ፡ Sir. 36,27; faciem suam (de Deo) Ps. 79,4; አብርህ፡ ገጸከ፡ ላዕለ፡ መቅደስከ፡ Dan. 9,17. a in lucem proferre, manifestum facere 2 Tim. 1,10; 1 Cor. 4,5. b illustrare i.e. explanare alicui aliquid Asc. Jes. 7,8. c illuminare animos: አብርሀ፡ አልባቢሆሙ፡ ለሰብአ፡ ይእቲ፡ ሀገር፡ በሃይማኖተ፡ ኢየሱስ፡ Sx. Masc. 24; coll. Ps. 118,130. 2 intrans. lucem emittere vel praebere, lucere, c. ለ፡ alicui, c. ላዕለ፡ vel ዲበ፡ super, c. ውስተ፡ in, ad: de astris Gen. 1,14; Gen. 1,15; Gen. 1,16; Gen. 1,17; Kuf. 2; Job 25,5; Job 31,26; ፀሓይ፡ ያበርህ፡ ወያርኢ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ Sir. 42,16; Jes. 60,19; Jer. 38,35; Hen. 14,18; Apoc. 21,23; lucerna Matth. 5,15; Sir. 26,17; fulmine Luc. 17,24; igne Hen. 71,2; Hen. 72,4; Ps. 104,37; facie Matth. 17,2; አብርሂ፡ አብርሂ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፡ φωτίζου Jes. 60,1; de viis Prov. 4,18; Deus ያበርህ፡ ውስተ፡ ፍናዊከ፡ Job 22,28; Apoc. 22,5; እግዚአብሔር፡ ያበርህ፡ ሊተ፡ Ps. 26,1; c. ለ፡ lucere alicui passim i.q. illuminare aliquem φοτίζειν ut Eph. 3,9; Eph, 5,13; Joh. 1,9.

woorden.betekenis: illuminari
woorden.definitie: III,1 illuminari, Lud. sine auct.

woorden.betekenis: lucens, lucidus, pellucidus, candidus, splendidus, illustris
woorden.definitie: part. 1 lucens: ከመ፡ ይኩና፡ አዕይንቲከ፡ ብሩሃተ፡ ላዕለ፡ ቤት፡ ἀνεῳγμένοι 2 Par. 6,20; ገጹ፡ ከመ፡ ፀሓይ፡ ብሩህ፡ φαίνει Apoc. 1,16. 2 lucidus, pellucidus, candidus, splendidus, illustris, clarus, φωτεινός Luc. 11,34; Matth. 6,22; ደመና፡ ብሩህ፡ Matth. 17,5; νεφέλη κούφη Jes. 19,1; φωτισμός, φωτισθείς Ps. 138,10; ጽዕዱት፡ ወብርህት፡ λελευκανθισμένη Cant. 8,5; λευκός Apoc. 6,11; Apoc. 7,13; Apoc. 14,14; αὐγάζον Lev. 13,39 (v. በራህርህት፡); λαμπρός Sap. 6,13; የዐውድዎ፡ ለውእቱ፡ መንበር፡ ካህናት፡ ብሩሃን፡ ከመ፡ ፀሓይ፡ Mavâs. 20; de loco illuminato, Kid. f. 6; de verbo Dei τηλαυγής Ps. 18,9; de voce Lit. Joh.; de oratione: አግሀደ፡ ሃይማኖተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ በቃላት፡ ብሩሃት፡ ወልዑላት፡ Sx. Mag. 4. Adv. በብሩህ፡ 4 Esr. 8,34; et ብሩሀ፡ τηλαυγῶς clare, perspicue Marc. 8,25 Platt. 3 hilaris, serenus: አሠሩ፡ ለልብ፡ ፍሡሕ፡ ገጽ፡ ብሩህ፡ πρόςωπον ἱλαρόν Sir. 13,26; Sir. 26,4; ዘወሀበ፡ (eleemosynas) እንዘ፡ ፍቱሕ፡ ልቡ፡ ወብሩህ፡ ኅሊናሁ፡ Clem. f. 174; ልብ፡ ብሩህ፡ Org. 1. — (Did. 29occurrit locus haud satis clarus: Judaeorum principes consilium inierunt postridie dominicam palmarum ላዕለ፡ እግዚእ፡ በቀዳሚ፡ ወርኅ፡ ብሩህ፡ ዘውእቱ፡ ሚያዝያ፡).

woorden.betekenis: lux, lumen, ignis
woorden.definitie: subst. 1 lux, lumen Ps. 96,12; በርህ፡ ወጽልመት፡ Dan. apocr. 3,47; Deg. 2 ignis collustrandi causa accensus Marc. 14,54; Luc. 22,56.

woorden.betekenis: lux, lumen, splendor, fulgor, lux refulgens, candor, lumina,
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m. (fem. ex. gr. Jac. 1,17), Pl. ብርሃናት፡ 1 lux, lumen (φῶς, φέγγος) Gen. 1,3; Gen. 1,4; Jes. 5,20; Jes. 9,1; Jes. 45,7; Jes. 60, 1; Jes. 60, 2; Jes. 60, 3; Jer. 28,16; Koh. 11,7; Job 3,4; Job 17,12; Job 38,19; Joh. 11,10; Matth. 10,27, al. creberrime; ብርሃነ፡ ወርኅ፡, ፀሓይ፡ Jes. 30,26; Apoc. 22,5; ብርሃነ፡ ማኅቶት፡ Apoc. 18,23; Luc. 8,16, ብርሃነ፡ እሳት፡ Jes. 4,5; Hez. 1,13; ብርሃነ፡ መዓልት፡ μεσημβρία Jes. 58,10; Dei Ps. 103,2; Hen. 1,8; 1 Tim. 6,16; 1 Joh. 1,5; Joh. 1,7; መልአከ፡ ብርሃን፡ 2 Cor. 11,14, al.; transl. ad lucem vitae Job 3,16; Job 3,20; felicitatis Job 18,5; Jes. 58,8; Jes. 58,10; doctrinae, veritatis Jes. 2,5; Ps. 42,3; Joh. 3,19 seq.; Eph. 5,13; de hominibus, qui aliis luminis instar sunt: Jes. 42,6; Jes. 49,6; Joh. 1,4 seq.; Joh. 5,35; Joh. 8,12; Matth. 5,14. Pl. ብርሃናት፡ Hen. 43,2; Hen. 59,l; Asc. Jes. 8,21; Asc. Jes. 8,22; Asc. Jes. 8,25; በእደዊሆሙ፡ ይጸውሩ፡ ብርሃናተ፡ እሳት፡ Rel. Bar. a splendor, fulgor: ብርሃነ፡ መብረቀ፡ ወልታከ፡ Hab. 3,11; 4 Esr. 4,6; λαμπρότης Dan. 12,3; 4 Esr. 10,64; lux refulgens (repercussa) ἀπαύγασμα Hebr. 1,3; candor ሜላተ፡ ብርሃን፡ βύσσινον λευκόν Apoc. 19,8; Apoc. 19,14. b lumina coeli vel luminaria i.e. sidera Gen. 1,14; Gen. 1,15; Gen. 1,16; Gen. 1,17; Ps. 135,7; Hen. 2,1; Hen. 20,4; Hen. 72,1 seq.; Phil. 2,15. c lumina i.e. oculi: ብርሃነ፡ ለዕዉር፡ ቀብአ፡ ( oculos coeci unxit ) Sx. Genb. 8Enc.; ጸጎከ፡ ለዕዉር፡ ብርሃነ፡ Sx. Nah. 15Enc. d nitor faciei ብርሃነ፡ ገጽ፡ ob hilaritatem Job 29,24, ob benignitatem Ps. 4,9; Ps. 43,5. e Acc. ብርሃነ፡ adv. τηλαυγῶς clare, perspicue Marc. 8,25 rom. 2 in libris ex Arabico versis i.q. بُرْهَانٌ probatio vel demonstratio evidens, ut Abush. 53. bərhān part of n. pr. (epithet) vid. መልአከ፡ ብርሃን፡

woorden.betekenis: charta pergamena, membrana
woorden.definitie: subst., ut videtur amh. charta pergamena, membrana, Lud. ex Epist. Greg. sui (sec. Lud. a perspicuitate sic dicta; Isenb. in lex. amh. p. 87 ብራና፡ a membrana μεμβράνα propagatum putat). vid. also ብራና፡

woorden.betekenis: purus, mundus fuit, verax, justus fuit
woorden.definitie: rad. inus.; בׇּרַר, ܒܰܪ purus, mundus fuit; arab. بَرَّ,بَرِرَ sensu ethico: verax, justus fuit.

woorden.betekenis: argentum, argenteus, bǝrur
woorden.definitie: (part.) subst., plerumque m. (fem. Koh. 7,12 ጽላሎታ፡ ለብሩር፡), Pl. ብሩራት፡ (Lud.) 1 argentum (a purgando, si non a puritate i.e. candore dictum): ብሩር፡ ጽሩይ፡ Job 22,25; Job 28,1; Jes. 13,17; Jes. 60,17; Ps. 11,7; ብሩር፡ ምኑን፡ Jer. 6,30; Hez. 22,18; Hez. 27,12; ብሩር፡ ኅሩይ፡ Prov. 8,19; Sir. 47,18; Hen. 52,7; Hen. 65,7; Matth. 10,9; 1 Cor. 3,12; 1 Petr. 1,18. In Genit. ዘብሩር፡, vel statui constr. subjunctum: argenteus Gen. 24,53; Ex. 3,22; Judith 12,1; Num. 7,13; Dan. 2,32; Apoc. 9,20; 2 Tim. 2,20. 2 argenteus numus vel siclus: ሠላሳ፡ ብሩር፡ Ex. 21,32; 2 Reg. 18,11; Cant. 8,11; Zach. 11,12; Matth. 26,15. bǝrur C for መጥቅዕ፡ ብሩር፡ vid. መጥቅዕ፡

woorden.betekenis: lentes, lens, Voc. Ae., bǝrsǝn, bǝrsǝnāt, pisum, cicer, pois
woorden.definitie: subst., coll. et sing., [بُلْسٌ lentes, بُلْسُنٌ lens; coll. ⲁⲣϣⲓⲛ, ⲡⲓ] lens, lentes: Gen. 25,34; Kuf. 24; 2 Reg. 17,28; 2 Reg. 23,11; Hez. 4,9; ይበልዑ፡ ፫ብርስነ፡ Sx. Hed. 13. – Voc. Ae.: ብርስን፡ ዘ፡ ምስር። bǝrsǝn, Pl. ብርስናት፡ bǝrsǝnāt G ብርስን፡ bǝrsǝn, Pl. ብርስናት፡ bǝrsǝnāt pisum, cicer, lens, pois, pois chiche, lentille ― ምስር፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 66. 185 L ብርስን bǝrsǝn lentil, (185) pea, chickpea, pulse 107b

woorden.betekenis: fulgere, micare, effulgere, splendere, coruscare, fulgurare
woorden.definitie: I,1 [בָּרַק ܒܪܰܩ بَرَقَ] Subj. ይብርቅ፡ 1 fulgere, ( micare, effulgere, splendere, coruscare ): በዕጠሱ፡ ይበርቅ፡ ብርሃን፡ ἐπιφαύσκεται Job 41,9; እሳት፡ ይበርቅ፡ እምኔሁ፡ πῦρ ἐξαστράπτον Hez. 1,4; ወላትው፡ ይበርቅ፡ Nah. 3,3; στίλβειν Hez. 21,10; Hez. 21,15; Marc. 9,3; በረቀ፡ ሥጋሆሙ፡ Macc. f. 2. 2 fulgurare: ግብተ፡ በረቀ፡ መብረቅ፡ ዲቤሁ፡ እምሰማይ፡ Deg.; Luc. 17,24; Act. 9,3; Act. 12,7; Act. 22,6; Hen. 59,1; Hen. 60,13; Hen. 60,15. (Sap. 11,19 var.).

woorden.betekenis: fulgur, fulmen, fulgor, nimbus
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., Pl. መባርቅት፡ (sec. Lud. etiam መባርቅ፡) 1 fulgur, fulmen: ይረውጽ፡ መብረቅ፡ ቅድመ፡ ነጐድጓድ፡ Sir. 35,10; ገብረ፡ መባርቅተ፡ ለዝናም፡ Jer. 10,13; Jer. 28,16; Hez. 1,13; Dan. 10,6; Nah. 2,5; 4 Esr. 4,6; 4 Esr. 10,38; Hen. 41,3; Hen. 59,1; Hen. 60,14 seq.; Ps. 17,16; Ps. 76,18; Ps. 96,4; Ps. 134,7; Matth. 24,27; መብረቅ፡ ወፃዓዕ፡ ወነጐድጓድ፡ Apoc. 4,5; Apoc. 8,5; ብልኀተ፡ መብረቅ፡ Lit. Epiph. 2 rarius: fulgor, ( nimbus Sanctorum capita circumdans, Lud.): ሰላም፡ ለሥንኪ፡ ዘአዋከየ፡ መብረቃ፤ ለብሔረ፡ ጽልመት፡ ወጣቃ፡ Sx. Mag. 20Enc.; መብረቅ፡ ለሥጋሁ፡ ከለላ፡ Sx. Mij. 30 Enc.

woorden.betekenis: secare, caedere, purgare, aes, aeneus, aeramenta, aenea inst
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., [meo judicio e rad. بَرَتَ (بَرَى) secare, caedere formatum; Ges. thes. p. 1097 hoc vocabulum sicut ብሩር፡ a rad. בָּרַר purgare derivatum esse censet] 1 aes Ex. 25,3; Deut. 8,9; 1 Reg. 17,5; 1 Reg. 17,6; 2 Reg. 8,8; Job 28,2; Job 41,18; Jes. 60,17; Jer. 6,28; Hez. 22,18; Dan. 2,32; ብርት፡ ርሱን፡ χαλκός στίλβων Hez. 40,3; l Cor. 13,1. In Genit. ዘብርት፡, vel st. constructo subjunctum: aeneus Gen. 4,22; Ex. 30,18; Job 6,12; Job 20,24; Job 40,13; Sir. 28,20; Jes. 45,2; ፍጽምከ፡ ዘብርት፡ Jes. 48,4; Jer. 1,18; Zach. 6,1; item passim, ubi ብርት፡ praedicati vicem explet, ut Ex. 27,18. Pl. ብርታት፡ aeramenta, aenea instrumenta Lud.; (de ዘብርታት፡ ኀጺን፡ Sir. 22,15 vid. ዘብርት፡) 2 ብርተ፡ ሊባኖስ፡ χαλκολίβανον quod varie interpretantur aes album, aurichalcum, aes corinthium Apoc. 1,15; Apoc. 2,18; አእጋረ፡ ክርስቶስ፡ ርሱናን፡ አምሳለ፡ ላህቡ፡ ለብርተ፡ ሊባኖስ፡ Sx. Jac. 6Enc. bǝrt metal መፍየል፡ ዘብርት፡ ፪፡ ‘2 tazze di metallo’ 43 VI l. 27 (ed.), 36 l. 26–27 (tr.); ጻሕል፡ ዘብርት፡ ፫[፡] ወጽዋዕ፡ ዘብርተ፡ ፩[፡] ‘3 vassoi di metallo, 1 calice di metallo,’ 64 l. 10 (ed.), 53 l. 16 (tr.); ወሙዳየ፡ ዕጣን፡ ዘብርት፡ ፮[፡] ‘6 repositori per l’incenso di metallo,’ 64 l. 11 (ed.), 53 l. 17 (tr.)

woorden.betekenis: in genua procumbere, baraka, genua flexit, fléchir le genou,
woorden.definitie: I,1 [בָּרַךְ ܒܪܶܟ بَرَكَ] in genua procumbere, de asina Num. 22,27; camelo: ሶበ፡ በጽሐ፡ ገመል፡ ኀበ፡ ውእቱ፡ መካን፡ በረከ፡ በብረኪሁ፡ ወኢተንሥአ፡ Sx. Nah. 19. baraka G በረከ፡ baraka I,1 ይበርክ፡, ይብርክ፡ genua flexit, fléchir le genou, faire des génuflexions ― ሰገደ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 66. 186 L brk I, በረከ፡ baraka (yǝbrǝk) kneel, kneel down, bend the knee, make genuflection (denominative from vid. ብርክ bǝrk) 105a

woorden.betekenis: laudare, celebrare, venerari, hymnum celebrare, cantare, fau
woorden.definitie: I,3 1 genibus flexis laudare, celebrare, venerari Deum, c.c. Acc. Deut. 8,10; Jud. 5,2; Ps. 15,7; Ps. 25,12; Ps. 144,2; Kuf. 22; Sir. 50,22; Jes. 25,3; Jes. 38,18; Jes. 65,16; Hen. 39,12; Hen. 61,7; Hen. 61,12; Hen. 63,2; Luc. 1,64; Luc. 24,53; c. ለ, ut: ባርኩ፡ ለስሙ፡ በኵሉ፡ ጊዜ፡ Sir. 39,35; Ps. 95,2; Ps. 144,2; absol. Hen. 61,9; Hen. 61,11. Inde: hymnum celebrare vel cantare: ባረከ፡ ዘ፡ ቡራኬ፡ [ᾖσε τὴν ᾠδὴν ταύτην Ex. 15,1. 2 fausta precari, benedicere alicui, c. Acc.: Gen. 12,3; Gen. 48,15; Gen. 49,28; Hen. 1,1; Matth. 5,44; Marc. 10,16; Luc. 2,34; 1 Petr. 3,9; c. Acc. በረከተ፡ Gen. 27,41; Deut. 33,1; Jos. 24,10; in specie a de benedictione sacerdotis Lev. 9,22; Num. 6,23; 3 Reg. 8,14; ከመ፡ ይባርክዎ፡ ለሕዝቡ፡ በስሙ፡ Sir. 45,15; Lit.; etiam c. ላዕለ፡, ut: ባረከ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ Sx. Ter 9. b benedictione consecrare aliquid 1 Reg. 9,13; Matth. 14,19; Matth. 26,26; Act. 2,42; Act. 2,46; Act. 20,7; Gen. 2,3; ኢይባርኩ፡ ላዕለ፡ በጸል፡ F.N. 17; vel aliquem Ex. 19,14; Ex. 19,23 (ἁγιάζειν). 3 de Deo: benedicere alicui i.e. fortunare, prosperare, c. Acc. Gen. 1,22; Gen. 1,28; Gen. 12,2; Gen. 12,3; Gen. 17,16; Gen. 24,1; Ex. 23,25; Deut. 1,11; Deut. 15,14; Job 1,10; Ps. 5,4; Ps. 66,1; Ps. 131,16; Jes. 61,9; c. ላዕለ፡ pers. Gen. 5,2; c. Acc. beneficii Gen. 49,25; Kuf. 19; vel c. በ፡ Eph. 1,3; formula salutandi: ይባርከ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Ruth 2,4; hinc 4 salutem precando salutare, valedicere Gen. 24,60; Gen. 47,7; 1 Reg. 13,10; 2 Reg. 6,20; 2 Reg. 19,39. 5 valedicere ei, cui quis obsequium et venerationem debet, i.e. ei renuntiare (quare vulgo interpretantur Aethiopes: maledicere, exsecrari, vid. etiam Ges. thes. p. 241), Job 1,11; Job 2,5; 3 Reg. 21,10; Sx. Tachs. 1. – Voc. Ae.: ባረከ፡ ዘ፡ መረቀ። bāraka G ባረከ፡ bāraka I,3 ይባርክ፡ benedixit, bénir Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 66. 186 L brk II, ባረከ bāraka bless, praise, worship, celebrate, salute, bid farewell, congratulate, (, ) offend, calumniate, curse 105a

woorden.betekenis: in genua procumbere facere
woorden.definitie: II,1 in genua procumbere facere, Lud.sine auct.

woorden.betekenis: laudari, celebrari, benedicere sibi, sibi invicem, benedicti
woorden.definitie: III,3 1 laudari, celebrari: ይትባረክ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ εὐλογητὸς Κύριος Ruth 4,14; 1 Reg. 25,32; 2 Reg. 18,28; Ps. 27,8; Ps. 30,27; Ps. 71,19; Ps. 71,20; Hen. 39,10; Hen. 61,11; Eph. 1,3; Luc. 1,68; Jes. 65,16. 2 benedicere sibi vel sibi invicem (reflex. et recipr.), benedictionem petere vel accipere (pass.): ይትባረኩ፡ ቦቱ፡ አሕዛበ፡ ምድር፡ Ps. 71,18; ተባረኩ፡ በበይናቲሆሙ፡ Sx. Jac. 9; c. እምነ፡ ejus, a quo quis benedictionem petit et accipit: ተባረከ፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ Sx. Masc. 14; Sx. Masc. 18; Abraham ሰገደ፡ ሎቱ፡ (Melchisedeco) ወተባረከ፡ እምኔሁ፡ Mavâs. 67; ሖረ፡ ሀገረ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፡ ወተባረከ፡ እምካናት፡ ቅዱሳት፡ Sx. Haml. 11; vel c. በኀበ፡, ut: ሴም፡ ተባረከ፡ በኀበ፡ ኖኅ፡ Kebr. Nag. 9. 3 benedictione consecrari Ex. 19,22 (ἁγιαθήτωσαν). 4 benedici i.e. fortunari, prosperari, Hen. 1,8; Hen. 67,3; c. በ፡ Gen. 22,18; Gen. 26,4; Sir. 44,21; ተባረኩ፡ በውሉዶሙ፡ Tob. 4,12; c. በእንተ፡ Gen. 12,3; Gen. 18,18; Gen. 28,14.

woorden.betekenis: benedictus, laudatus, celebratus, veneratione ornatus, fortu
woorden.definitie: part. benedictus a laudatus, celebratus, veneratione ornatus: ሙሴ፡ ዘቡሩክ፡ ዝክሩ፡ Sir. 45,1; ቡሩከ፡ ይኩን፡ ዝክሮሙ፡ Sir. 46,11; Ps. 71,17; Matth. 21,9; Matth. 23,39; Rom. 9,5; ቡሩክ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Ex. 18,10; Marc. 14,61; 2 Cor. 11,31; Rom. 1,25; Rom. 9,5; ቡሩክ፡ አንተ፡ አምላክነ፡ Judith 13,17; ቡርክት፡ አንቲ፡ ወለትየ፡ Judith 13,19. b benedictus a Deo i.e. fortunatus, beatus, felix: ቡሩክ፡ ብእሲ፡ ዘ፡ Jer. 17,7; 1 Reg. 25,33; Deut. 7,11; Deut. 28, 3; Deut. 28, 4; Deut. 28, 5; Deut. 28, 6; ቡርክት፡ አንቲ፡ እምአንስት፡ Luc. 1,28; Luc. 1,42; ቡሩክ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ benedictus a Deo Gen. 14,19; Jud. 17,2; Ruth 2,20; Ruth 3,10; 1 Reg. 23,21; 1 Reg. 26,25; hinc c crebro: ἀγαθός, bonus, probus, praestans, egregius: ምድር፡ ቡርክት፡ ἡ γῆ ἀγαθή Deut. 1,35; Deut. 3,25; Deut. 4,22; Tob. 14,4; Hen. 26,1; Hen. 27,1; ፍሬ፡ ቡሩክ፡ οἱ ἀγαθοί καρποί Sir. 6,19; ሠናይ፡ ዘመድ፡ ወቡሩክ፡ Tob. 5,14; በእደ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ቡርክት፡ χεὶρ θεοῦ ἡ ἀγαθή 2 Esr. 7,28; 2 Esr. 12,8 al.; መንፈስከ፡ ቡሩክ፡ 2 Esr. 19,20; Judith 8,29; ቡርክት፡ አንቲ፡ በቃልኪ፡ ἀγαθὴ ἐν τοὶς λόγοις σου Judith 11,23. d benedictione consecratus: ቅብእ፡ ቡሩክ፡ ἔλαιον τῆς χρίσεως Ex. 29,21.

woorden.betekenis: benedictio, laudatio, celebratio, fausta precatio, dona, mun
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. በረከታት፡ benedictio 1 laudatio, celebratio: አዕበይዎ፡ (ለእግዚአብሔር፡) በኵሉ፡ በረከት፡ ወስብሐት፡ 2 Esr. 19,5; Apoc. 5,12; Apoc. 5,13; Hen. 39,7; Hen. 39,9; Hen. 71,12. 2 fausta precatio Gen. 27,12; Gen. 27,35; Gen. 27,36; Gen. 27,38; Num. 24,1; Deut. 11,26; Deut. 11,27; Hen. 1,1; በረከተ፡ አሮን፡ ፈኑ፡ ላዕለ፡ ሕዝብከ፡ Sir. 36,22; ከመ፡ የሀቦሙ፡ በረከተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ በከናፍሪሁ፡ Sir. 50,20. 3 benedictio Dei i.e. dona vel munera Dei bona fausta praestantia, prosperitas: በበረከተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዕሴቶሙ፡ ለጻድቃን፡ Sir. 11,22; Sir. 39,22; Gen. 39,5; Gen. 49,25; ኵሉ፡ በረከት፡ እለ፡ ባረከኒ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Kuf. 19; Kuf. 22; Kuf. 27; Ex. 32,29; Lev. 25,21; Deut. 28,2; Deut. 33,23; Ps. 3,8; Ps. 23,5; Ps. 83,7; Ps. 128,8; Jes. 44,3; Hez. 34,26; Eph. 1,3; inde 4 bonum, optimum, bona, (opes, fortunae): ሠናይት፡ በዲበ፡ በረከት፡ χάρις ἐπὶ χάριτι Sir. 26,15; τὰ ἀγαθά Sir. 34,11; Sir. 35,13; ትበልዑ፡ በረከተ፡ Jes. 55,2; Jes. 58,14; Jer. 2,7; Jer. 38,14; Ps. 83,13; Job 22,18; 1 Reg. 8,16; Gen. 45,18; Gen. 45,23; Luc. 12,18; Luc. 12,19; ἀγαθή Rom. 7,12; ἀγαθωςύνη Koh. 9,18. 5 consecratio benedictione facta: ጽዋዐ፡ በረከት፡ 1 Cor. 10,16; ኅብስተ፡ በረከት፡ (aliâs አውሎግያ፡) panis (in agapen) oblatus, a clerico consecratus, Const. Ap. 36; Const.
