Ap. 37. barakat G በረከት፡ barakat bededictio, prosperitas, bédédiction (sens général), bonheur, prospérité, succès Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 66. በረከት፡ barakat objet bénit, relique bénite, manque dans le . Texte et référence: ወሶበ፡ ይመጽኡ፡ ኀቤሁ፡ ሕዝባውያን፡ ያቄርብ፡ ሎሙ፡ ማእደ፡ ወይፌንዎሙ፡ በሰላም። ወሶበ፡ ይወስዱ፡ እምውእቱ፡ በረከተ፡ ንስቲተ፡ ውስተ፡ አብያቲሆሙ፡ ወያነብርዎ፡ ላዕለ፡ ድውያን፡ ወይትፌወሱ፡ ሶቤሃ፡ ወይሴብሕዎ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር። 102. 186 L በረከት barakat blessing, benediction, praise, gift, gift expressing of a blessing, offering, fortune, good things, (186) blessed object, blessed relic; for በረከት barakat used as a form of ‘gematria’, see 162 በበረከት ba-barakat bountifully 105a C a for በረከት፡ ቤት፡, ቤተ፡ በረከት፡ vid. ቤት፡ (TraCES) b for ኅብስተ፡ በረከት vid. ኅብስት፡ (TraCES) c for ገጸ፡ በረከት፡ vid. ገጽ፡ (Leslau)

Ex. 25,36), Pl. አብራዕ፡ [dictum a tremendo et nutando وَرُعَ يَرعَ, יָרַע respondet يَرَاعٌ arundo, calamus ] calamus, arundo, κάλαμος Luc. 7,24; Matth. 11,7; Jes. 19,6; Jes. 42,3; Job 40,16; በትረ፡ ብርዕ፡ Jes. 36,6; Hez. 29,6; ብርዐ፡ ባሕሩስ፡ Jes. 1,31; አብትር፡ ፅቡሳን፡ ወአብራዕ፡ ቅጥቁጣን፡ M.M. f. 108. a calamus scriptorius Jes. 8,1 var.; Deg. (vid. ረቅ፡). b scapus candelabri Ex. 25,31; Ex. 25,32; Ex. 25,33; Ex. 25,34; Ex. 25,35; Ex. 25,36; in C Ex. 37,17 hebr. c culmus frugum: ፯ሰብል፡ ዘሠዊት፡ ዘሠረጹ፡ እም፩ብርዕ፡ Jsp. p. 341. d stipula, καλάμη: ብርዐ፡ ይመስሎ፡ መፍጽሕ፡ Job 41,20; ሣዕር፡ ወብርዕ፡ ዘይየብስ፡ Job 13,25; (Jes. 1,31); እሳት፡ እንተ፡ ትበልዕ፡ ብርዐ፡ Joel 2,5; Ob. 18; Ex. 5,12; Ex. 15,7.

woorden.betekenis: in locum alius succedere, dies et nox, imitatus, se invicem
woorden.definitie: inus., proprie, ut videtur, in locum alius succedere, vicinum est II በረረ፡ (de significatione cfr. חָלַף et خَلَفَ); Arabes habent أَلْمُتَبَارِيَان dies et nox (duo alternantes); بَرَى III imitatus est; VI se invicem imitati sunt, certarunt.

woorden.definitie: III,3 1 sibi alterum alteri succedere, vices alternare, vel mutare, variare, alternis vicibus agere vel facere: እስከ፡ አመ፡ የኀልቅ፡ ይትባረይ፡ ብርሃን፡ ምስለ፡ ጽልመት፡ μέχρι συντελείας φωτὸς μετὰ σκότους Job 26,10; ዘእንበለ፡ ይኩን፡ ተባርዮ፡ ሌሊት፡ ወመዓልት፡ (vicissitudo) Macc. f. 23; Deus astra creavit, ወእምዝ፡ ተባረዩ፡ ፀሓይ፡ ወወርኅ፡ ወከዋክብት፡ መዓልተ፡ ወሌሊተ፡ Macc. f. 10; regnaverunt ኅቡረ፡ በኢትባርዮ፡ Sx. Teq. 4; ዘበጥዎ፡ በአብትር፡ እንዘ፡ ይትባረዩ፡ Sx. Haml. 20; ኵሎ፡ አሚረ፡ ይትባረዩ፡ ዘምሮ፡ 2 Esr. 22,47. 2 certamine mutuo certare (in libris ex Arab. versis), ut: Herodes ገብረ፡ መካነ፡ ርሒበ፡ ወረሰየ፡ ውስቴታ፡ ሰረገላ፡ ይስሐብዎ፡ አፍራስ፡ በተባርዮ፡ Jsp. p. 328; Jsp. p. 348. tabāraya G ተባረየ፡ tabāraya III,3 ይትባረይ፡ changer alternativement (tour à tour), les rôles, les fonctions, les travaux divers ― ተፈራረቀ፡ Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 66. 186 L bry II, ተባረየ tabāraya follow successively, do by turns, alternate with one another, relay one another 108b

Grandinat ( ningit ) ይዘንም፡ በረድ፡ κατέσπευσε χιόνα Sir. 43,13; Ps. 67,15. 2 crystallus: ዘሕብረ፡ በረድ፡ Hez. 1,22; Hen. 14,9; Hen. 14,10; ባሕር፡ ከመ፡ እንተ፡ በረድ፡ θάλασσα ὑαλίνη Apoc. 4,6.

[amh. id.], sine dubio i.q. بَقَرَ fidit; interrogando perscrutatus est; בָּקַר Pi. diligenter inspexit, animadvertit, unde בִּקֹרֶת animadversio, punitio; ܒܩܳܪܳܐ vel ܒܽܘܩܳܪܳܐ inquisitiio, exploratio. Acc. pers.: ሶበ፡ ተበቀልኩኪ፡ በመዐትየ፡ Hez. 5,15; Nah. 1,2; Jes. 1,24; Jer. 9,9; Job 21,22; Judith 1,12; ለተበቅሎ፡ ፀር፡ Judith 9,2; Judith 11,10; ዮጊ፡ ኢትክል፡ ተበቅሎቶ፡ ለዘአበሰ፡ Sir. 7,6; Sir. 12,6; Sir. 23,21; Sir. 25,14; ዘይትቤቀሎሙ፡ ለጸላእቱ፡ Sir. 30,6; Sir. 46,1; 2 Thess. 1,8; 2 Cor. 10,6; c. Acc. poenae Num. 31,2; c. dupl. Acc.: በቀለኑ፡ ትትቤቀለኒ፡ Joel 4,4; እትቤቀሎሙ፡ ፬በቀለ፡ Jer. 15,3; Ps. 136,11; እምኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ይትቤቀልዋ፡ በቀለ፡ Jer. 27,15; c. ላዕለ፡ pers. Kuf. p. 159; c. እምነ፡ pers.: ይትቤቀል፡ በቀለ፡ እምፀሩ፡ Jes. 66,6; Hen. 54,6; cfr. Apoc. 6,10; c. በ፡ criminis Ps. 98,9; 1 Reg. 3,13; እትቤቀሎሙ፡ በኀጢአቶሙ፡ Jes. 66,4; Hen. 54,6; Tob. 3,3; c. በእንተ፡ criminis Luc. 11,50; Apoc. 6,10. 2 vindicare, ulcisci, c. ለ፡ pers., cujus causa agitur: Ps. 42,1; Ps. 73,23; Ps. 137,9; ይትቤቀል፡ ሎቱ፡ Sir. 28,1; Sir. 32,22; Act. 7,24; raro c. Acc. pers. Ps. 36,30; c. Acc. ultionis: Num. 31,2; እትቤቀል፡ በቀለኪ፡ Jer. 28,36; Sir. 35,16; ይትቤቀል፡ በቀለ፡ ሕዝቡ፡ Sir. 32,25; c. Acc. causae vel criminis: ይትቤቀል፡ ደመ፡ ደቂቁ፡ Deut. 32,43; Apoc. 19,2; c. እምነ፡ pers., a qua ultionem exigunt: Num. 31,2; Apoc. 19,2. 3 se vindicare vel ulcisci: ኢትትበቀሉ፡ ለሊክሙ፡ Rom. 12,19; ለእመ፡ ተምዐ፡ ወተበቀለ፡ ፩ይትከላእ፡ እምቍርባን፡ F.M. 21,2.

woorden.betekenis: poena, vindicta, ultio
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., poena, vindicta, ultio: እትበቀለኪ፡ በቀለ፡ ዘማት፡ Hez. 16,38; Hez. 23,45; Ps. 42,1; Ps. 57,10; ለብሰ፡ ልብሰ፡ በቀል፡ Jes. 59,17; ዕለተ፡ በቀል፡ Jer. 26,10; crebro ገብረ፡ በቀለ፡, c. በ፡ pers. Hez. 25,11; Hez. 25,12; vel ላዕለ፡ Hez. 25,17; Kuf. 30; Kuf. 48; vel እምነ፡ Ex. 12,12; c. ለ፡ alicui Ps. 9,4; እትበቀል፡ በቀለ፡ ህየንተ፡ አዕይንትየ፡ Jud. 16,28; ከመ፡ ያግብኡ፡ በቀለ፡ እምኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለምድያም፡ Num. 31,3; በበቀለ፡ እኁሁ፡ 2 Reg. 3,27; በቀለ፡ ደም፡ ἡ δίκη Act. 28,4 rom.

woorden.betekenis: findere, provenire, enasci, germinare, pullulare, crescere,
woorden.definitie: vel በቍለ፡ (ut 4 Esr. 4,47; 4 Esr. 6,21 Laur.) I,1 [بَقَلَ; amh. በቀለ፡ et በቈለ፡; vid. etiam Ges. thes. p. 816; contiguum est בקר بقر findere ] Subj. ይብቍል፡ et ይብቈል፡ (ut Gen. 2,5; Gen. 3,18; Jud. 16,22), provenire, enasci, germinare, pullulare, crescere: proprie de plantis, ut herbis Gen. 2,5; ሣዕር፡ ይበቍል፡ Job 8,11; Marc. 4,5; በቊሎ፡ ሣዕሩ፡ Matth. 13,26 rom.; ይበቍል፡ ውስቴቱ፡ ሣዕር፡ ወሦክ፡ Jes. 5,6; spinis et tribulis Gen. 3,18; በቈለ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ሦክ፡ Prov. 24,46; Job 31,40; Jes. 32,13; radicibus plantarum ( agi, exigi ): ኢበቈለ፡ ሥርዎሙ፡ Jes. 40,24; Job 5,3; Hez. 31,7; ዘለሊሁ፡ ይበቍል፡ quod sponte nascitur Lev. 25,5; fructibus Hen. 80,3; 4 Esr. 4,47 var.; arboribus Hen. 32,3; deinde de pilis 2 Reg. 10,5; Jud. 16,22; በቈለ፡ ሢበቱ፡ ውስተ፡ ገጹ፡ Hos. 7,9; alis: ይበቍል፡ ክንፊሆሙ፡ Jes. 40,31; cornibus Dan. 7,8; Dan. 8,8; Dan. 8,9; Am. 6,13; carne Hez. 37,8; capitibus avis 4 Esr. 11,3; translate de hominibus: ይበቍሉ፡ ከመ፡ ሣዕር፡ Jes. 44,4; Ps. 91,13, de variis rebus, ut quae cum plantis comparentur, ut malitia 4 Esr. 6,21; 4 Esr. 7,9; justitia 7,13, dolore vel labore Job 5,6; coelo novo Hen. 91,15. a construere licet cum pron. suff., cui sensus Dativi insit: ይብቍልከ፡ proveniat tibi Kuf. 3; Gen. 3,18; ይብቍለኒ፡ Job 31,40. b transitive c. Acc. rei, germinare vel producere aliquid, ut: ትበቍል፡ (v. ታበቍል፡) ምድር፡ ርትዐ፡ Jes. 45,8; omisso Accusativo Ps. 64,11; et impers.: በውስቴታ፡ በቈለ፡ ጽጌያተ፡ in ea germinabat flores 3 Reg. 7,11 (AS); fortasse etiam 4 Esr. 4,47 Laur.

woorden.betekenis: germinare, producere, efferre, agere, promittere, alere, ger
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 germinare, producere, efferre, agere: ታብቍል፡ ምድር፡ ሐመልማለ፡ ሣዕር፡ Gen. 1,11: Jac. 5,18; አብቈልኩ፡ ሥርውየ፡ Sir. 24,12; አብቍሉ፡ ጽጌክሙ፡ ከመ፡ ጽጌ፡ ረዳ፡ Sir. 39,14; ዘአብቈለ፡ ቀርነ፡ ወጽፍረ፡ Ps. 68,36; Org. 3; transl. Jos. 45,8 var. 2 crescere sinere i.e. promittere, alere capillos: አብቈለ፡ ድምድማ፡ 1 Cor. 11,14. 3 germinare facere vel crescere facere, de Deo Gen. 2,9; Ps. 103,15; Ps. 146,9; ኣበቍል፡ ዖመ፡ Jes. 41,18; ዘርእ፡ ዘያበቍል፡ ፈጣሪከ፡ Sir. 7,15; Ps. 131,18; de pluvia: ከመ፡ ያብቍል፡ ሣዕረ፡ በውስተ፡ ገዳም፡ Job 38,27; Jes. 55,10. 4 plantare, serere: ዕፀ፡ Ex. 10,5; ዕፅ፡ ዘእግዚአብሔር፡ አብቈለ፡ Jes. 44,14; Hez. 17,5; Hez. 17,22; transl.: populum 2 Reg. 7,10.

woorden.betekenis: planta, herba, olus, plantae veneniferae, vimina, virgulta f
woorden.definitie: subst., Pl. በቍላት፡ بَقْلٌ proventus terrae i.e. planta, herba, olus: ከመ፡ በቍላት፡ ዘይሠርጹ፡ Ps. 72,5 vers. nov. (ubi hebr. שׁית Ps. 73,6 hoc nomine versum est); በቍላት፡ φυτά Chrys. ho. 12et Chrys. Ta. 23; carnem non edit አላ፡ አሕማላተ፡ በቍላት፡ Sx. Genb. 10; አላ፡ ይሴሰይ፡ በቍላተ፡ ምድር፡ Sx. Ter 28; በቍላት፡ ቀታልያን፡ plantae veneniferae F.N. 23. — (Quod Lud. statuit, አብቍልት፡ vimina, virgulta flexibilia, errore nititur; etenim Sx. Genb. 24 Enc. legitur: ፍትሓ፡ ለመንፈስየ፡ አቡየ፡ አብቍልታ፤ በማእሰረ፡ ጌጋይ፡ ዘልፈ፡ ኢታንብር፡ ሙቅሕታ፤; hoc interpretatus est ligamenta animae meae; sed አብቍልታ፡ n. pr. est, nam Acta hujus diei in Sx. exhibent: በዛቲ፡ ዕለት፡ ስምዐ፡ ኮነ፡ ብፁዕ፡ አብቍልታ፡, ኮነ፡ እምዘመደ፡ ክቡራን፡ ዘሀገረ፡ እንጽና፡).

woorden.betekenis: palma, dactylifera, palma pumila, vestis e fibris palmae con
woorden.definitie: (በቍልት፡ Lud. ex Sx. Mij. 27Enc. affert; vid. infra locum e Sx. Genb. 19), m. et fem., Pl. በቀልታት፡, etiam በቀላት፡ (Lud. ex Org. 4), 1 palma ( dactylifera ), arbor [cfr. arab. وَقْلٌ palma pumila, cujus fructus مُقْلٌ appellatur; in caeteris linguis frequentantur תָּמָר (ተመርት፡), ܕܶܩܠܳܐ, نَخْلٌ] φοίνιξ Cant. 7,8; Ps. 91,12; Sir. 24,14; ወፈረየት፡ ይእቲ፡ በቀልት፡ ፲ወ፪ አስካለ፡ ሶቤሃ፡ Sx. Mij. 20; አስካለ፡ በቀልት፡ Hen. 20,4; φοίνικες 3 Reg. 6,27; 2 Par. 3,5; ቈጽለ፡ በቀልት፡ (v. በቀልታት፡) 2 Esr. 18,15; Lev. 23,40; Joh. 12,13 Platt; በቀልታት፡ ወተምር፡ Sx. Ter 22; በቀላተ፡ ወጸበራተ፡ አሥዐለ፡ Org. 4; ልብስ፡ ዘጸጕረ፡ በቀልት፡ vestis e fibris palmae confecta Sx. Jac. 2; አልባሰ፡ጸጕር፡ ዘብቍልት፡ (sic, pro በቍልት፡) Sx. Genb. 19. 2 palmae truncus, caudex, surculus, στέλεχος, στελέχη, በቀልተ፡ ተመርት፡ Job 29,18; Num. 33,9; Ex. 15,27; በቀልት፡ ወተመርት፡ (v. ተመርት፡) Sir. 50,12; በቀልት፡ Gen. 49,21; Hez. 19,11; Joh. 12,13 rom. – Voc. Ae.: በቀልት፡ ዘ፡ ዘባባ፡; aliud: በቀልት፡ ብ፡ ዘምባባ፤ ጸበርት፡ ብ፡ ቅጸሉ፤ ተመርት፡ ብ፡ ፍሬሁ፡, aliud: በቀልት፡ ዘ፡ ግንዱ፤ ጸበርት፡ ዘ፡ አዕጹቂሁ፤ ተመርት፡ ዘ፡ ፍሬሁ። baqalt, baqʷǝlt, baqat palm tree, ‘ palmier ’ ቃለ፡ ኦሪት፡ ንፍተሌም፡ በቀት፡ ዕረፍት፡ እንተ፡ ትሤኒ፡ አውጽአት፡ እክል። ‘ Parole de la Loi: Nephtali (est) un palmier, un repos qui est beau (et) produit de la nourriture. ’ 15 l. 9-10 (ed.), 15 l. 22-23 (tr.) (‘Texte በቀት፡, 512, donne ce mot sous la forme በቀልት፡ comme plus bas.’ 15 n.15)

woorden.betekenis: findendo, perrumpendo, aperiendo est, perficere, proficere,
woorden.definitie: I,1 [vis radicis primaria in findendo, perrumpendo, aperiendo est (vicin. በቀወ፡); hinc derivatur perficere, proficere, (ut in צָלַה); proxime ad hoc verbum accedit ܦܰܩܳܚ utilis, conveniens; expedit, melius, consultius est; amh. በቃ፡ significat sufficere ] Subj. ይብቋዕ፡ 1 proficere, utilitatem percipere: (Pharisaei de Jesu deliberantes sibi invicem dixerunt:) ትሬእዩ፡ ከመ፡ አልቦ፡ ዘትበቍዑ፡ Sx. Mag. 22; አልቦ፡ ዘበቋዕኩ፡ οὐδὲν ὠφελοῦμαι 1 Cor. 13,3 ant.; Herm. p. 5et Herm. p. 88; አልቦ፡ ዘይበቍዕ፡ ዘይረቂ፡ οὐκ ἔστι περισσεία τῷ ἐπᾴδοντι Koh. 10,11; ፈቀደ፡ ይትባረክ፡ ወይብቋዕ፡ እምኔከ፡ Phlx. 56. 2 prodesse, juvare, utilem esse a personaliter, de hominibus et rebus; abs.: ዐርክ፡ ወማኅፈር፡ ይበቍዑ፡ በመዋዕሊሆሙ፡ Sir. 40,23; Jer. 15,10; ኢይበቍዕ፡ ንዋይ፡ Prov. 11,4; Hen. 52,8; ዘኢይበቍዕ፡ inutilis Job 15,3; Prov. 28,3; Sap. 1,11; c. ለ፡ pers.: ይበቍዕ፡ ለርእሱ፡ sibi ipsi prodest Sir. 20,28; Sir. 37,7; Chrys. Ta. 7; ኢይበቍዕ፡ መዛግብት፡ ለኃጥኣን፡ Prov. 10,2; Sir. 30,19; c. Acc. pers.: እንስሳ፡ ዘይበቍዐከ፡ Sir. 7,22; ኢይበቍዕዎሙ፡ Jes. 30,5; Jes. 30,6; ነበብክሙ፡ ዘኢይበቍዐክሙ፡ Jes. 59,4; ተለዉ፡ ዘኢይበቍዖሙ፡ Jer. 2,8; Jer. 7,8; ኢበቋዕኩ፡ ወኢይበቍዑኒ፡ Jer. 15,10; Jer. 16,19; Rom. 2,25; Tit. 3,8; Hebr. 4,2; ኢይክል፡ በቍዖታ፡ ለነፍሱ፡ Sir. 37,19; c. ለ፡ rei ( ad ): ለኅዳጥ፡ ትበቍዕ፡ 1 Tim. 4,8; 2 Tim. 4,11; Matth. 5,13; ኢይበቍዕዎሙ፡ ለረድኤት፡ Jes. 30,6; ነገረ፡ ሐሰት፡ ዘለምንትኒ፡ ኢይበቍዐክሙ፡ Jer. 7,8; Jer. 16,19, vel c. Acc. utilitatis: ምንተ፡ ይበቍዐኒ፡ Sir. 20,16; ምንተ፡ ይበቍዕ፡ ሠዊዕ፡ ለአማልክት፡ Sir. 30,19; Matth. 15,5. b impers.: Marc. 5,26; አልቦ፡ ዘይበቍዕ፡ Job 9,27; seq. ለእመ፡ si Gen. 37,26; Matth. 16,26; Jac. 2,14; seq. ዘ፡ quod: Job 4,2; 4 Esr. 6,42; 4 Esr. 7,18; 4 Esr. 7,21; seq. ከመ፡, ut: ምንተ፡ ይበቍዐነ፡ ከመ፡ ንሑር፡ ኀቤሁ፡ Job 21,15. 3 idoneum, aptum, commodum esse, c. ለ፡ rei ( ad, vel Dat.), de rebus et hominibus: Act. 27,12 rom.; ይስሐቅ፡ ይበቍዕ፡ ለዛቲ፡ ሢመት፡ Sx. Hed. 9; ይበቍዕ፡ ለምግበ፡ ንዋዩ፡ F.N. 32; c. Acc. pers.: idoneum videri alicui, ut: አልቦ፡ ዘትበቍዖ፡ ለከዊነ፡ እሙ፡ nulla ei idonea videbatur Org. 1. 4 se utilem praebere alicui, ei se accommodare vel commodare rem, gratificari, favere: c. Acc. pers., እግዚአብሔር፡ በቍዐነ፡ በኵሉ፡ Jsp. p. 330; ተወከፍ፡ ንስሓየ፡ ወብቋዕ፡ ለፈውሶትየ፡ Jsp. p. 293; እስእለክሙ፡ ብቍዑኒ፡ 1 Petr. 2,11; አኀውየ፡ ብቍዑኒ፡ Genz. f. 71. Hinc formula obtestandi: ብቍዐኒ፡, ብቍዑኒ፡ (proprie: gratificare vel gratificamini mihi; etiam ብቅዐኒ፡, ብቅዑኒ፡) obsecro, quaeso, oro te vel vos (δέομαι): Gen. 19,18; Act. 8,34; 2 Cor. 10,2; 4 Esr. 3,69; seq. Imperativo vel Optativo: Gen. 44,18; 4 Esr. 10,52; Luc. 9,38; Act. 21,39 rom.; Act. 26,3; Act. 27,34 Platt; Num. 12,11; Num. 22,16; seq. ከመ፡ c. Subj.: ብቍዐኒ፡ ከመ፡ ትግበር፡ 1 Esr. 4,46.

woorden.betekenis: sibi gratiam petere, in beneficii loco et gratia petere, da
woorden.definitie: , rarius አስተበቍዐ፡ (ut Esth. 7,7; Esth. 8,3 var.) IV,1 [non est, quod cum Ludolfo radicem ab antecedente diversam statuamus, vel ܒܥܳܐ بَغَا huc referamus] 1 sibi gratiam petere, in beneficii loco et gratia petere aliquid, c. Acc. rei et በኀበ፡ vel እምኀበ፡ vel እምነ፡ pers., ut: አሐተ፡ ስእለተ፡ ኣስተበቍዕ፡ በኀቤከ፡ Kuf. p. 126; አስተብቍዓ፡ እምኀበ፡ ኤላም፡ Kuf. p. 45; Kuf. p. 70; Kuf. p. 108; Hen. 63,1; c. Acc. pers.: ናስተበቍዐከ፡ δεόμεθα da nobis hanc veniam, bona venia oramus, quaesumus Gen. 43,20; Ex. 4,10; Gen. 17,18. 2 in genere: precibus appellare aliquem i.e. a rogare, petere, orare, postulare (plerumque παρακαλεῖν et ἀξιοῦν) Hen. 14,7; Hen. 39,5; Hen. 40,6; Hen. 83,10; c. Acc. pers.: Deut. 13,17; 1 Reg. 22,4; Prov. 1,11; Prov. 8,4; እመ፡ አስተብቍዐከ፡ ጸላኢከ፡ ἐάν σου δέηται Prov. 26,25; ከመ፡ ኢትግባእ፡ ታስተበቍዖሙ፡ Sir. 30,28; παραιτεῖσθαι Esth. 7,7; Hen. 62,9; Matth. 8,31; Matth. 18,32; Matth. 26,53; Marc. 1,40; Marc. 5,23; Act. 16,15; c. ኀበ፡ pers. Sap. 13,17 seq.; c. በእንተ፡ causae: Hen. 13,6; Hen. 83,2; Philem. 10; Sap. 13,17 seq.; c. Acc. rei: ምንት፡ ዘታስተበቍዕኒ፡ Esth. 5,3; 1 Esr. 4,46; seq. ከመ፡ c. Subj. verbi: Matth. 14,36; Marc. 5,17; Marc. 6,56; Hen. 63,1; Hen. 84,5; Esth. 8,3; Jer. 7,16; Dan. 1,8; Asc. Jes. 8,23; Herm. p. 20; vel seq. Subj. verbi: ኣስተበቍዕ፡ ባዕደ፡ ይግበር፡ ሊተ፡ Job 30,24; Matth. 8,34; Marc. 5,18; Luc. 8,41; አስተብቍዖትየ፡ τὸ ἀξίομά σου Esth. 7,3; Lit. 165,1; ጸሎታት፡ ወስእለታት፡ ወአስተብቍዖታት፡ Genz. f. 23. α precibus urgere παραβιάζεσθαι 4 Reg. 5,16. β deprecari, intercedere pro aliquo, c. በእንተ፡ (vel ለ፡) Hen. 89,76; Jer. 7,16; (Jer. 11,14); Lit Cyr. b consolari, παρακαλεῖν, Gen. 37,35; 2 Reg. 10,3; ኢታብዝኁ፡ አስተብቍዖትየ፡ (v. ናዝዞትየ፡) Jes. 22,4; 1 Thess. 3,2 Platt. c adhortari, admonere Rom. 12,1; Rom. 16,17; 1 Tim. 1,3; 1 Cor. 4,16; 1 Cor. 16,15; 2 Cor. 6,1; 2 Cor. 8,6.

woorden.betekenis: utilis, fructuosus, frugi, sine utilitate, inutilis, irritus
woorden.definitie: part. (passim በቍዕ፡ exscriptum), fem. ባቍዕት፡ (Org.) 1 utilis, fructuosus, frugi: ባቍዓኒሃ፡ (v. በቍዓኒሃ፡) τῶν χρησίμων αὐτῆς Zach. 6,10; ባቍዓን፡ εὔχρηστοι Herm. p. 13; c. ለ፡ pers. Rom. 1,14 rom.; Philem. 11. Nonnumquam subst. (i.q. በቍዕ፡), ut: ፆማሆሙ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ባቍዕ፡ sine utilitate i.e. inutilis (ἄχρηστος) Sap. 3,11; 2 Tim. 2,16; አልባቲ፡ ባቍዐ፡ Hebr. 7,18; etiam irritus, ἄκυρος, ዘእንበለ፡ ባቍዕ፡ II Can. Ap. 72. 2 idoneus, aptus, dignus: ἐπιεικής 1 Tim. 3,3; εὔχρηστσς c. ለ፡ rei 2 Tim. 2,21; ባቍዐ፡ ረሰየኒ፡ ἄξιόν με ἡγήσατο Herm. p. 20; Herm. p. 27.

woorden.betekenis: usus, utilitas, commodum, efficacitas, erbauliche Reden, ver
woorden.definitie: , etiam ባቍዔት፡ subst. Pl. በቍዔታት፡ 1 usus, utilitas, commodum: ኢይከውነከ፡ ለበቍዔትከ፡ 2 Reg. 18,22; ኢይክል፡ በቍዔታ፡ ለነፍሱ፡ (v. በቍዖታ፡) Sir. 37,19; Chrys. ho. 8; Hen. 102,6. 2 efficacitas: ቃላተ፡ በቍዔት፡ ( erbauliche Reden; verba profectura aliquid ad animos excitandos) Sx. Haml. 7. 3 gratificatio, beneficium: Deus አበ፡ በቍዔታት፡ Const. Ap. 21. 4 sensu forensi: ususfructus: እመ፡ ኢተፈጸመ፡ ነሢአ፡ በቍዔት፡ ባቲ፡ F.N. 28; F.N. 41 (vid. ሕስት፡ sub ወሐሰ፡); በቍዔታት፡ F.N. 28.

woorden.betekenis: bābil, e la tua corsa sia come quello, senza rumore; vola da
woorden.definitie: “nomen avis fictae: አዕዋፈ፡ ባቢል፡ ዘውእቱ፡ አጎርጋናት፡ ፫፻, Lib. Myst. Crediderim esse aves illas Muhammedieas ابابيل Sur. 105,3”, Lud. bābil subst., meaning unknown in the present context, ወይኩን፡ ሩጸትከ፡ ከማሁ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ድምፅ፡ ወስርር፡ እምሥራቅ፡ እስከ፡ ምዕራብ፡ እምሰሜን፡ እስከ፡ ደቡብ፡ እምድር፡ እስከ፡ ባቢል፡ ነፋስ፡ ‘ e la tua corsa sia come quello, senza rumore; vola dall’oriente, dal settentrione al meridione, dalla terra fino al vento bābil ’ 62 (ed.), 22 (tr.); ሰሪሮ፡ ከመ፡ ንስር። ወዓዲመ፡ በሰረገላ፡ ባቢል፡ ነፋስ፡ ‘ volando come un’aquila, e inoltre su un carro di vento bābil ’ 114 (ed.), 39 (tr.) (‘«Nomen avis fictae» in 516; un serpente (da Daniele) in 50 (ed.), 46 (tr.). L’edizione etiopica ha እስከ፡ ሰማይ፡ 39.’ 22 n. 101)

woorden.betekenis: nomen fructus aliusve rei, quam una e ficis horti
woorden.definitie: nomen fructus aliusve rei, quam una e ficis horti Eden pondere aequat, ignotum (si quidem lectio sana est), Gad. Ad. f. 42.

woorden.betekenis: nomen literae alphabeti Hebraici secundae Ps. 118,
woorden.definitie: nomen literae alphabeti Hebraici secundae Ps. 118,9; Thren. 1,2; Thren. 2,2; Thren. 3,5; Thren. 4,2. Ubi de psalmis agitur, siglo ቤት፡ Ps. 118,9; Ps. 118,10; Ps. 118,11; Ps. 118,12; Ps. 118,13; Ps. 118,14; Ps. 118,15; Ps. 118,16; notatur.

woorden.betekenis: rad. inus., cui potestas secandi inest, vid. መተረ፡
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., cui potestas secandi inest, vid. መተረ፡

woorden.betekenis: virga, baculus, scipio, pedum, sceptrum, fustis, bacillum, t
woorden.definitie: subst., fem. et m., coll. et sing., Pl. አብትር፡, raro አብታር፡ (Num. 17,17), 1 virga Gen. 30,37; Gen. 30,38; Gen. 30,39; Gen. 30,40; Gen. 30, 41; Herm. p. 62 seq.; ትወጽእ፡ በትር፡ እምሥርወ፡ ኤሰይ፡ Jes. 11,1; አብትረ፡ ልብኔ፡ κλῶνες ἀγροῦ Job 40,17. 2 baculus, scipio, pedum, sceptrum, Gen. 38,18; Gen. 38,25; Ex. 4,3 seq.; Num. 17,17 seq.; Kuf. 41; Mich. 7,14; Zach. 11,7 seq.; Hez. 20,37; Hez. 37,l6 seq.; ዐቀበ፡ መርዔቶ፡ በበትሩ፡ Sx. Mag. 27Enc.; Ps. 22,5; ኢትጹሩ፡ በትረ፡ Clem. f. 45; Matth. 10,10; በትረ፡ ብርዕ፡ Hez. 29,6; Jes. 36,6; ይሰብራ፡ ለበትረ፡ ኃጥኣን፡ Sir. 33,23; Hen. 48,3; በበትሩ፡ እንተ፡ወርቅ፡ Esth. 4,11; Esth. 5,2; Esth. 8,4; በትር፡ እንተ፡ ዲበ፡ ክሣዱ፡ Jes. 9,4; ይእኅዙ፡ በትረ፡ Ep. Jer. 13; Jer. 31,17; በትረ፡ ኀጺን፡ Ps. 2,9; Apoc. 2,27; በትረ፡ ብርሃን፡ Sx. Teq. 18et Sx. Teq. 18Enc.; baculus, quo frumentum excutitur Jes. 28,27; fustis Dan. apocr. 13,26; ῥόπαλον Ρrov. 25,18; fullonis በትረ፡ መሃፒል፡ Sx. Teq. 27Enc.; bacillum ferreum በትረ፡ ኀጺን፡ (inter cruciatus instrumenta) Vit. Barb.; Sx. 3 virga, baculus, scipio i.e. castigandi instrumenta: ዘይምሕክ፡ በትሮ፡ Prov. 13,24; Job 9,34; ቍስለ፡ አብትር፡ var. Sir. 28,17; በትረ፡ መዐትየ፡ Jes. 10,5; Thren. 3,1; 1 Cor. 4,21. 4 tribus, stirps populi: እንተ፡ ትንእስ፡ በትረ፡ ነገዶሙ፡ 1 Reg. 9,21; 1 Reg. 10,19; 1 Reg. 10,20; 3 Reg. 11,3; በትረ፡ ነገድ፡ Sx. Genb. 10Enc. (Lud.); Org.

woorden.betekenis: patriarcha
woorden.definitie: ያርክ፡ n. peregr. patriarcha (ecclesiae) Sx. Mag. 13; Sx. Tachs. 1Enc.

woorden.betekenis: patrum
woorden.definitie: peregr. πατέρων, patrum: ደብረ፡ በታሮን፡ ዘውእቱ፡ ብሂል፡ ደብረ፡ አበው፡ Sx. Sen. 18.

woorden.betekenis: dissecuit, amputavit, secuit, resecuit, abrupit, fidit, rupi
woorden.definitie: I,1 [بَتَكَ dissecuit, amputavit (مَتَكَ); بَتَّ secuit, resecuit, abrupit; فَتَقَ fidit, rupit ] Subj. ይብትክ፡, 1 rumpere, abrumpere, divellere (hebr. נתק), vincula, laqueos, funes, al.: Ps. 2,3; Jud. 16,9; እበትክ፡ ማኅሜከ፡ Nah. 1,13; በተከ፡ መኣስረ፡ Jer. 5,5; Hez. 24,23 var.; ብትክ፡ Genz. f. 115(vid. sub አሥጋሪ፡). 2 discindere, abscindere, caput alicujus, Sx. Mij. 15Enc. (Lud.). — Schol. Voc. Ae.: vid. sub መተረ፡

woorden.betekenis: discerptum, dilaniatum
woorden.definitie: subst. discerptum, dilaniatum Lev. 19,7; Act. 21,25 rom.; Clem. f. 96; Clem. f. 118; Clem. f. 141; Syn. f. 396; Kebr. Nag. 9.

woorden.betekenis: n. peregr., unum e nominibus lunae Hen. 78,2; Voc.
woorden.definitie: n. peregr., unum e nominibus lunae Hen. 78,2; Voc. Ae.

woorden.betekenis: tributum facere, conferre, vectigal pendere
woorden.definitie: I,2 [denom. a ብነት፡] tributum facere vel conferre, vectigal pendere: ወለዘሂ፡ ጸባሕተ፡ ጸብሑ፡ ወለዘሂ፡ ብነተ፡ በንቱ፡ τῷ τὸν φόρον τὸν φόρον. τῷ τὸ τέλος τὸ τέλος Rom. 13,7.

woorden.betekenis: strenuus et audax fuit, malis et damnis afflictus, miser fui
woorden.definitie: I,1 [بَؤُسَ strenuus et audax fuit, malis et damnis afflictus, miser fuit; بَئِسَ malus; ܒܺܝܫܳܐ displicuit; ܐܶܬܒܺܐܝܫ male oluit; amh. ባሰ፡ malum vel pejorem esse vel fieri; arab. etiam بَهْسٌ audacia, et بَاسَ asper fuit ] Subj. ይብአስ፡ 1 asperum i.e. acerbum, vehementem esse, de dolore: ወእመሂ፡ አርመምኩ፡ ይብእሰኒ፡ (mihi) ሕማምየ፡ Job 16,6. 2 malum vel pejorem esse vel fieri: ዘላዕለ፡ ኃጥኣን፡ ይብእስ፡ ምስብዒተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ኵሉ፡ Sir. 40,8; c.c. Acc. pers. alicui, sc. a male vertere alicui: ይብእሰከ፡ ረጊጽ፡ ውስተ፡ ቀኖት፡ በሊኅ፡ Act. 9,5 Platt; Luc. 11,26; እስመ፡ ደኃሪታ፡ (ለሐሰት፡) ትብእሰከ፡ οὐκ εἰς ἀγαθόν ἐστι Sir. 7,13. b malum videri alicui, displicere: ብእሶ፡ ለንጉሠ፡ ፋርስ፡ እስመ፡ εὗρεν ἀδικίαν 4 Reg. 17,4; eundem in modum Lud. interpretatur locum Lev. 20,22. c adversum, infestum, noxium, perniciosum esse alicui, nocere: ለእመቦ፡ ዘብእሰከ፡ ἐάν εἰς σέ πλημμελήσῃ Sir. 26,11; አእምር፡ ዘይብእሳ፡ τί πονηρὸν αὐτῇ Sir. 37,27; ለዘላፉ፡ ኢይብአስከ፡ Sir. 19,7; Lev. 20,22; βλαβερός 1 Tim. 6,9; ይብእሶሙ፡ βλαβερόν ἐστι Chrys. ho. 8; Act. 28,6 Platt; Herm. p. 30; ኢይብአስከ፡ ለሥጋከ፡ Herm. p. 18.

woorden.betekenis: male habere, aspere tractare, vexare
woorden.definitie: II,1 male habere, aspere tractare, vexare: ያብእሳ፡ ለነፍስከ፡ (v. ያአክያ፡ ለልብከ፡) Κοh. 7,23 (Koh. 7,22).

woorden.betekenis: se, violentum praebere, vim adhibere, vires contendere, acri
woorden.definitie: (nonnumquam ተባአሰ፡ scriptum) III,1 se asperum vel violentum praebere, vim adhibere, a vires contendere, acriter agere, contendere et laborare: ወተበአሱ፡ ይትመየጡ፡ መንገለ፡ ምድር፡ Jon. 1,13; ተበአሰ፡ ያድኅኖ፡ Dan. 6,14. b vim facere vel afferre alicui, cogere, c. Acc.: ተበአሳ፡ ወአድከማ፡ 2 Reg. 13,14; ከመ፡ ትትበአሶ፡ ይስክብ፡ ምስሌሃ፡ Kuf. p. 138.

woorden.betekenis: vir, mas, masculus, vir fortis, juvenis, maritus, homo, aliq
woorden.definitie: subst. [vir a vi, strenuitate, fortitudine dictus, sicut גֶּבֶר], m., nonnisi in sing. usitatum (pro Pl. frequentant ዕደው፡) 1 vir, ἀνήρ sexcenties, ut Gen. 4,23; Gen. 19,8; Gen. 39,1; Gen. 39,2; Gen. 42,11; Num. 31,35; Deut. 22,5; Jud. 3,29; Jos. 4,4; Jos. 7,14; Jos. 7,15; Ps. 33,9; 1 Reg. 2,33; 1 Reg. 4,12; 1 Reg. 6,19; 1 Reg. 9,1; 1 Reg. 9,2; 1 Reg. 9,22; 1 Reg. 13,15; 1 Reg. 17,33; 2 Reg. 17,8; Dan. 8,15; 1 Tim. 2,12. a opp. feminae mas, masculus (sed nonnisi de homine) Gen. 4,1; 1 Reg. 1,11; ትወልድ፡ ወልደ፡ ብእሴ፡ F.N. 24,6 (aliâs ተባዕት፡, ሮስ፡, ዕድ፡). b opp. pueris et senibus: vir fortis, juvenis, 1 Reg. 9,2; 1 Reg. 26,15; 3 Reg. 2,2; Job 38,3; አመ፡ ኮንኩ፡ ብእሴ፡ ὅτε ἐγενόμην ἀνήρ Tob. 1,9; ተፈሣሕ፡ ብእሲ፡ በውርዙትከ፡ νεανίσκε ἐν νεότητί σου Koh. 11,9. c crebro opp. uxori: maritus (aliâs ምት፡): Matth. 19,3; Marc.10,2; Rom. 7,2; Rom. 7,3; 1 Cor. 7,2; Gen. 3,6; ብእሲ፡ ምስለ፡ ብእሲቱ፡ Jer. 6,11; 4 Esr. 9,42; 4 Esr. 9,44; vid. ብእሲተ፡ ብእሲ፡ sub ብእሲት፡ 2 homo, ἄνθρωπος, creberrime, ut Gen. 6,9; Gen. 32,25; Gen. 37,15; Gen. 41,33; Gen. 42,11; Ex. 2,11; 1 Reg. 13,14; Ps. 51,6; Ps. 87,4; Joh. 16,21; Joh. 19,5; 2 Cor. 12,2; Phil. 2,7; Rom. 5,12; Rom. 5,16; Rom. 5,17; Rom. 5,18; ብእሲ፡ አብድ፡ Sir. 4,27; Sir. 23,15; ብእሲ፡ ዘማዊ፡ Sir. 23,17; Sir. 25,7; ብእሲ፡ ጠቢብ፡ Sir. 20,27; ብሉይ፡ ብእሲ፡ ὁ παλαιὸς ἄνθρωπος Eph. 4,22; Rom. 6,6; ሐዲስ፡ ብእሲ፡ Eph. 4,24; ቀዳማዊ፡ ብእሲ፡ 1 Cor. 15,47; ብእሴ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ 1 Tim. 6,11; 1 Reg. 9,6; 1 Reg. 9,10. a aliquis Jud. 6,8; Cant. 8,7; Matth. 18,12; Marc. 14,13; Luc. 8,27; Act. 8,27; ብእሲ፡ ዘይብል፡ Sx. Mij. 14Enc.; Sx. Mag. 29 (Lud.); maxime in libris ex Arabico translatis. b repetitum ብእሲ፡ ብእሲ፡ vel quisque, quilibet Hez. 14,4; Ex. 16,29; Lev. 15,2; Lev. 17,8; Lev. 17,10; Lev. 18,6, vel singuli Cant. 3,8; 2 Esr. 14,19. c alter: ብእሲ፡ ቢጾ፡ Jes. 19,2; Jes. 41,6; ብእሲ፡ እምቢጹ፡ Koh. 4,4; ብእሲ፡ እኁሁ፡ Jes. 9,19; Hebr. 8,11; ብእሲ፡ ዲበ፡ ብእሲ፡ Jes. 3,5. d passim in st. c., sequente nomine rei vel qualitatis, eum notat, cui illa tamquam attributum convenit, ut: ብእሴ፡ ሰላም፡ pacificus, pacis amator Ps. 36,39; ብእሴ፡ ሐቅል፡ ἄγροικος Gen. 25,27; ብእሴ፡ ዕዳከ፡ debitor tuus Deut. 24,11; ብእሴ፡ ደም፡ sanguinolentus Ps. 5,7; 2 Reg. 16,7; 2 Reg. 16,8, vel mortis reus ἀνὴρ θανάτου 3 Reg. 2,26; ብእሴ፡ ዐመፃ፡ 2 Thess. 2,3. bǝʾǝsi C for ሐዋሬ፡ ብእሲ፡ vid. ሐዋሪ፡ (TraCES)

woorden.betekenis: femina, mulier, unaquaeque, quaelibet, uxor, conjux, noverca
woorden.definitie: subst., fem., nonnisi in sing., usitatum (pro Pl. frequentant አንስት፡ vel አንስትያ፡); in Vocativo ብእሲቶ፡ (ut Judith 11,1; Luc. 13,22; Luc. 22,57; Joh. 4,21; Joh. 20,13; Joh. 20,15) vel ኦብእሲቶ፡ (Joh. 2,4; Matth. 15,28; Chrys. Ta. 15) 1 femina, mulier, plerumque adulta, sive nupta, sive innupta: ብእሲት፡ ድንግል፡ Lev. 21,13; Sir. 15,2; Gen. 24,5; Esth. 2,4; በእደ፡ ብእሲት፡ ἐν χειρὶ θηλείας Judith 13,15; ልህቀ፡ አጥባትኪ፡ ወኮንኪ፡ ብእሲተ፡ Hez. 16,7; ብእሲት፡ ሐፃኒት፡ Ex. 2,7; ብእሲት፡ ፅንስት፡ Ex. 21,22; ብእሲ፡ ወብእሲት፡ Ex. 21,28; Ex. 21,29; Ex. 35,25; Lev. 12,2; Lev. 18,17; Lev. 18,19; ብእሲት፡ ትክት፡ Lev. 20,18; ብእሲት፡ ዘማ፡ Lev. 21,7; Deut. 22,5; ብእሲት፡ ነቢይት፡ Jud. 4,4; አሐቲ፡ ብእሲት፡ Jud. 9,53; Ruth 3,8; ብእሲት፡ መበለት፡ 2 Reg. 14,5; 3 Reg. 11,26; Matth. 5,28; ብእሲተ፡ ኀይል፡ Ruth 3,11. Passim: unaquaeque, quaelibet ut Ex. 3,22; Ex. 11,2. 2 uxor, conjux Gen. 2,22; Gen. 2,23; Gen. 2,24; Gen. 2, 25; Gen. 11,29; Ex. 21,3; ብእሲት፡ እንተ፡ ተኀድግ፡ ምታ፡ Sir. 23,22; ብእሲተ፡ ሕፅንከ፡ Sir. 9,1; Sir. 7,26; Jer. 3,1; ብእሲትከ፡ Ps. 127,3; Ps. 108,8; Mal. 2,14; Matth. 27,19; አውሰበ፡ ብእሲተ፡ Gen. 25,1; ነሥአ፡ ብእሲተ፡ Gen. 26,34; Gen. 28,1; Kuf. 25; ኮነተኒ፡ ብእሲትየ፡ Gen. 20,12; ነሣእካሃ፡ ትኩንከ፡ ብእሲተ፡ Deut. 21,11; Deut. 21,13; Deut. 22,19; ኢትንሣእ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ለወልድየ፡ Gen. 24,3; Gen. 24,4; 4 Esr. 9,46; etiam de concubina et de sponsa Gen. 16,3; Gen. 30,4; Gen. 29,21; ብእሲተ፡ አቡከ፡ noverca tua Lev. 18,8; Lev. 18,11; Deut. 23,1; crebro nupta, marita appellatur ብእሲተ፡ ብእሲ፡ Deut. 5,17; Gen. 20,3; Jer. 9,2; Prov. 6,24; Job 31,9; Sir. 9,9; vel ብእሲተ፡ ባዕድ፡ Sir. 9,8; Sir. 41,20; Sir. 41,21.

woorden.betekenis: contendens, pugnator, bellator, pugnax, contentionem, excita
woorden.definitie: part. 1 contendens, pugnator, bellator, pugnax (ad III 3 μαχητής Joel 4,11; Kuf. 37; Org. 4; መስተባእሳነ፡ ሃይማኖት፡ οἱ τῇ δόξῃ μαχόμενοι Cyr. ad Theod. f. 19; de litigantibus F.N. 43,4. 2 contentionem excitans, dissidia disseminans (ad IV,3): ኢይኩኑ፡ መስተባእሳነ፡ በእከይ፡ II Can. Nic. 28.

woorden.betekenis: spelunca
woorden.definitie: spelunca vid. sub ቦአ፡

woorden.definitie: , ብኡናህ፡ nomen mensis Aegyptiorum decimi ⲡⲁⲱⲛⲓ (بونه), Abush. 8; aliae nominis formae ባውኒ፡ Abush. 8; በአውና፡ Voc. Ae.; ጵዮን፡ q.v.

woorden.betekenis: propter
woorden.definitie: propter vid. sub እንተ፡

woorden.definitie: , በከ፡ vide sub II በከየ፡

woorden.definitie: i.q. בכר ܒܟܪ بكر, de quibus vid. Ges. thes. p. 206.

woorden.betekenis: primogenitura, primi partus proles, primogenitus, primogenit
woorden.definitie: subst. [בְּכוֹר, ܒܽܘܟܪܳܐ] m. et fem., sing, et coll., Pl. አብኵር፡ et አብኳር፡ et በኵራት፡ 1 primogenitura, κρωτοτόκια Gen. 25,31; Gen. 25,33; Gen. 27,36; Deut. 21,17; 1 Par. 5,1. 2 primi partus proles, sive mascula sive femella (1 Reg. 14,49), primogenitus, primogenita, primogenitum, de hominibus et de brutis: ኵሉ፡ በኵር፡ Ex. 11,5; Ex. 12,29; Ex. 13,15; በኵሩ፡ ለላህም፡, ለበግዕ፡, ለአድግ፡ Ex. 34,19; Ex. 34,20; Gen. 4,4; Deut. 12,6; Deut. 14,23; Tob. 5,14; ይስማኤል፡ በኵሩ፡ Gen. 25,13; Gen. 35,23; Num. 1,20; 1 Reg. 8,2; 1 Reg. 14,49; 1 Par. 8,1; 1 Par. 8,39; ኤፍሬም፡ በኵርየ፡ ውእቱ፡ Jer. 38,9; እንተ፡ ትወልድ፡ በኵራ፡ Jer. 4,31; Ps. 88,27; Ps. 134,8; Rom. 8,29; Col. 1,15; Col. 1,18; Apoc. 1,5; ubi alii nomini appositionis instar adjungitur, ዘ፡ praepositum habere solet: ወልዳ፡ ዘበኵራ፡ Gen. 25,25; Gen. 27,19; Gen. 27,32; Ex. 4,22; Matth. 1,25; Luc. 2,7; seq. Gen. fratris: በኵረ፡ ወልድከ፡ Ex. 22,28; Ex. 34,20; በኵረ፡ ተባዕት፡ primogenitus inter masculos i.e. masculus Ex. 13,13; collective Hebr. 11,28; Pl. ደቂቀ፡ ዳዊት፡ አብኵር፡ (v. አብኵረ፡) ዐቃብያነ፡ መንግሥት፡ 1 Par. 18,17; አብኳር፡ (hominum) F.N. 14; transl.: በኵረ፡ አበው፡ ቀደምት፡ sc. Adamus, Lit. Jac., primus 1 Par. 18,17 var. — Ut videtur juvencus, ἁπαλός, tener Gen. 27,9. 3 primitiae; በኵረ፡ በለስ፡ ficus praecox Hos. 9,10; Jes. 28,4 var.; Pl. በኵራት፡ F.N. 16; F.N. 18; በኵራት፡ ይሰዐሩ፡ primitiae abrogantur Sx. Nah. 28.

woorden.betekenis: flere, plorare, vagire, deflere, deplorare, lamentari, gemer
woorden.definitie: I,1 [בׇּכׇה ܒܟܳܐ بَكَى] Subj. ይብኪ፡ flere, plorare, ( vagire ) deflere, deplorare, lamentari Matth. 11,17; Marc. 14,72; Luc. 6,25; Joh. 16,20; Apoc. 5,4; ብክዩ፡ Jes. 15,2; ኢትብክዪ፡ Kuf. 27; ኀደገት፡ በኪየ፡ (v. በክየ፡) Tob. 6,1; Gen. 33,4; Gen. 43,30; Num. 11,10; Jud. 20,26; 2 Reg. 15,23; Hen. 14,7; Hen. 89,69; de infante Ex. 2,6; στενάζειν, ἀναστενάζειν, καταστενάζειν ( gemere, singultire ) Jes. 30,15; Jes. 46,8; Thren. 1,4; ብቢ፡ Hez. 21,6; ብክዩ፡ (κόπτεσθε) Jer. 4,8; c. Acc. pers.: Gen. 23,2; 1 Reg. 28,3; 2 Reg. 1,17 (θρηνεῖν); 2 Reg. 3,33; Kuf. 23; Kuf. 26; አምርር፡ በክዮቶ፡ (v. በኪዮቶ፡) Sir. 38,17; ብክዮ፡ ለዘሞተ፡ Sir. 22,11; Hez. 26,16; ኢይበክይዎሙ፡ Jer. 8,2; Jer. 16,4; Luc. 23,27; Apoc. 18,11; c. ዲበ፡ Hen. 95,1; c. ላዕለ፡ pers. vel rei: 2 Reg. 1,24; ብኪ፡ ላዕለ፡ ዘሞተ፡ Sir. 38,16; Apoc. 18,9; Jac. 5,1; Luc. 19,41; 4 Esr. 9,41; c. በእንተ፡ vel እምነ፡ ob, propter: Matth. 2,18; በእንተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምንዱብ፡ እበኪ፡ Job 30,25; እመ፡ በከየ፡ ትለሚሃ፡ እምኔየ፡ Job 31,38; c. Acc. ብካየ፡, ut: ብካየ፡ በከየት፡ በሌሊት፡ Thren. 1,2; በከዩ፡ ብካየ፡ ዐቢየ፡ Kuf. 23; እብኪ፡ መሪረ፡ Jes. 22,4; Matth. 26,75. Praeterea nota: በከየ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ flevit super eum i.e. coram eo, flendo adiit eum Num. 11,13; Jud. 14,16; Jud. 14,17; vel super eo i.e. in amplexu ejus Gen. 45,14; Gen. 45,15; Gen. 50,1.

woorden.betekenis: flere, plorare facere, ad flendum movere
woorden.definitie: II,1 flere vel plorare facere, ad flendum movere: በከየ፡ ብካየ፡ መሪረ፡ እስከ፡ አብከየ፡ እለ፡ ሀለዉ፡ ህየ፡ Jsp. p. 339; ለእመ፡ ኢበከይነ፡ በፈቃድነ፡ በዝየ፡ ያበክዩነ፡ በህየ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ፈቃድነ፡ Macc. f. 25; ምንት፡ ያበክየኪ፡ 1 Reg. 1,8; Kuf. 17; 4 Esr. 9,40 (ምንተ፡); ምንት፡ ዘያበክየከ፡ Hez. 21,7.

woorden.betekenis: simul, alium cum alio flere, complorare
woorden.definitie: III,3 simul, alium cum alio flere vel complorare: ሶበ፡ ተኣምኁ፡ ወተባከዩ፡ በበይናቲሆሙ፡ ወተሳዐሙ፡ Rel. Bar.

woorden.betekenis: fletus, ploratus, lamentatio
woorden.definitie: subst., m., fletus, ploratus, lamentatio Gen. 46,29; በከየ፡ ብካየ፡ ዐቢየ፡ Jer. 38,3, Jud. 21,2; Koh. 3,4; Job 16,16; 1 Esr. 5,62; Matth. 2,18; Matth. 8,12; ብካየ፡ ኢያዜር፡ Jes. 16,9; ብካይ፡ ወላሕ፡ Jes. 22,12; Joel 2,12; Ps. 6,8; ቃለ፡ ብካይ፡ ወቃለ፡ ዐውያት፡ Jes. 65,19; Jer. 9,19 (φονὴ οἰκτροῦ); ብካየ፡ ገዓሮሙ፡ Jer. 3,21; በዝኀ፡ ብካይ፡ Jer. 31,5; κοπετός Am. 5,16.

woorden.betekenis: permittere, concedere, sinere, potestatem, facultatem, venia
woorden.definitie: II,1 permittere, concedere, sinere; potestatem, facultatem, veniam dare, abs. Hebr. 6,3; c. ለ፡ pers. Job 32,14; Sir. 15,20; plerumque c. Acc. pers. ut: ኢያብሖ፡ አቡሁ፡ Kuf. 31; 4 Esr. 8,9; ንብብ፡ ለእመ፡ አብሑከ፡ Sir. 35,7; 1 Reg. 15,24; seq. Subj. verbi: Gen. 18,32; Gen. 31,7; Gen. 44,18; Ex. 3,19; Jos. 10,19; 2 Reg. 21,10; አባሕክሙ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ይንብብ፡ ዘከመዝ፡ ነገረ፡ Job 32,14; ኢያብሐ፡ መነሂ፡ (v. መኑሂ፡) ያእምር፡ ግብሮ፡ Sir. 18,4; Judith 12,6; Dan. apocr. 13,26; 1 Tim. 2,12; Hebr. 7,23; Apoc. 11,9; ለእመ፡ አብዛኅከ፡ (ተግባረከ፡) ትጸደቅ፡ ኢያበውሐከ፡ (sc. ብዝኀ፡ ተግባርከ፡) Sir. 11,10; seq. ከመ፡ c. Subj.: Ruth 1,16; ኢያብሐ፡ ወኢለመኑሂ፡ ከመ፡ የአብሱ፡ Sir. 15,20; 1 Reg. 24,8; Kuf. 48; c. ላዕለ፡ rei: አብሖሙ፡ ላዕለ፡ አጋንንት፡ ἐδίδου αὐτοῖς ἐξουσίαν τῶν πνευμάτων Marc. 6,7. ʾabḥa, አበውሐ፡ ʾabawḥa v. II, ? permit, allow ወበውእቱ፡ መዋዕል፡ ገብረ፡ ፀብአ፡ በሽምብራ፡ ኵሬ፡ ምስለ፡ ውእቱ፡ እስላም፡ ዘአበውሐ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለክዒወ፡ ደመ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ ‘ in que’tempi, il re combattè in Śemberā Kurē con quell’islamita, cui Dio aveva permesso di versare sangue cristiano ’ 11 (627) l. 17-19 (ed.); 22 (638) l. 11-13 (tr.), vid. also አብሐ፡

woorden.betekenis: potestatem habere, nancisci, auctoritate et potestate poller
woorden.definitie: III,1 potestatem habere vel nancisci a auctoritate et potestate pollere, dominari, c. ላዕለ፡, ut: (አጋንንት፡) ኢይትበውሑ፡ ላዕለ፡ ውሉደ፡ ጻድቃን፡ Kuf. 10; 4 Esr. 4,64; Lud. comm. hist. p. 504 n. 47; c. በ፡, ut: አሜሃ፡ ተበውሐ፡ (ጢጦስ፡) በኵሉ፡ ሀገር፡ Jsp. p. 377. b facultatem, veniam, licentiam concessam habere, (permissum est alicui): እስመ፡ ተበዋሕኩ፡ እትናገር፡ Gen. 18,31; ተበውሐት፡ ከመ፡ ታብዝኃ፡ ለኀጢአት፡ Rom. 5,20 rom. c potestati suae subjectum vel commissum habere aliquid: ሥርዐት፡ ቅድስት፡ ዘተበዋሕክሙ፡ Clem. f. 92. d licentia concessa admitti ad aliquid: ወትትበዋሕ፡ ኀበ፡ ቅዳሴሆሙ፡ Lud. e Mss. Colb.

woorden.betekenis: lituus
woorden.definitie: vel በውቅ፡ subst. (sing. nondum repertus), Pl. አብዋቅ፡ [بُوقٌ Pl. أَبْوَاقٌ] lituus: ወይትነፋሕ፡ ቀርን፡ ወብዕዛት፡ ወአብዋቅ፡ Chron. Ax. f. 90.

woorden.betekenis: vid. በኡናህ፡
woorden.definitie: vid. በኡናህ፡

woorden.betekenis: intrare, ingredi, introire, inire, ad, in, inter, per, in me
woorden.definitie: I,1 [בּוֹא بَاءَ] Subj. ይባእ፡ intrare, ingredi, introire, inire Gen. 6,18; Hen. 14,21; Jos. 6,1; c.c. Acc. loci: ቦአ፡ ቤቶ፡ Dan. 2,17; Ps. 5,8; ቦአ፡ ጽርሐ፡ 1 Esr. 3,3; Gen. 24,67; ባኡ፡ አህጉረ፡ Jer. 4,5; ኢይክል፡ በዊአ፡ ቤተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Jer. 43,5; ባእ፡ ቤተከ፡ Jes. 26,20; Jes. 13,20; ቦአ፡ ብሔረ፡ ግብጽ፡ Gen. 46,6; Marc. 1,21; Marc. 1,45; Matth. 6,6; Act. 3,3; ዘይበውኡ፡ አብያተ፡ ሰብእ፡ ከመ፡ ይስርቁ፡ F.M. 17,7; c. ኀበ፡ pers. ad aliquem Ex. 5,1; Ex. 7,26; Ex. 9,1; Gen. 34,27; Hen. 40,7; Hen. 81,13; vel c. ኀበ፡ loci ( ad ) Hen. 72,5; c. ውስተ፡ loci ( in ): ባእ፡ ውስተ፡ ታቦት፡ Gen. 7,1; Ex. 40,29; ኢትባኢ፡ ውስተ፡ ገራህተ፡ ባዕድ፡ Ruth 2,8; 4 Esr. 10,1; 4 Esr. 10,24; ባኢ፡ ውስተ፡ ጽልመት፡ Jes. 47,5; Cant. 5,1; Hen. 14,10; Hen. 14,12; Hebr. 9,6; ( inter ) 1 Reg. 26,7; ( in vel per ) Ps. 99,4; Hen. 72,13; Hen. 72,15; c. እንተ፡ per: ባኡ፡ እንተ፡ አናቅጽየ፡ Jes. 62,10; Joh. 10,9; c. ማእከለ፡ in mediam rem vel inter Ex. 24,18; Act. 19,30; c. adv., ut: እፎ፡ ቦእከ፡ ዝየ፡ Matth. 22,12; ቦአ፡ ኀበ፡ ሀለወት፡ ሕፃን፡ Marc. 5,40; ኀበ፡ ቦአት፡ Sir. 4,13. a inire feminam, coire, c. ኀበ፡ feminae Gen. 16,2; Gen. 19,31; Gen. 29,21; Lev. 18,19; Kuf. 28; Deut. 25,5; 2 Reg. 16,21; Ps. 50in tit.; Hen. 7,1. b ex Hebraismo recepta est phrasis de duce populi: ይበውእ፡ ወይወፅእ፡ ቅድመ፡ ገጾሙ፡ 1 Reg. 18,16; Num. 27,17; de eo, qui vivit vel versatur cum aliquo Act. 9,28. c ingredi i.e. admitti, recipi, adscisci in societatem, civitatem, ecclesiam al., participem fieri rei: Deut. 23,2; Deut. 23,4; ኢይባኡ፡ በጽድቅከ፡ Ps. 68,32; ከመ፡ ንባእ፡ ውስተ፡ ዕረፍቱ፡ Hebr. 4,1; ኢትበውኡ፡ ውስተ፡ መንግሥተ፡ ሰማያት፡ Matth. 5,20; Marc. 10,15; 1 Cor. 7,18 rom. 1 Cor. 7,20; እለ፡ ቦኡ፡ ውስተ፡ ሕግነ፡ Syn.; በእንተ፡ ጥምቀት፡ ወ(በእንተ፡) እለ፡ ይበውኡ፡ ኀበ፡ አሚን፡ F.N. 3. Nonnumquam in Canonibus ecclesiasticis ቦአ፡ absolute (pro ቦአ፡ ቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡, ut Clem. f. 248) dicitur de eo, cui in ecclesiam intrare et sacra adire licet (opp. excommunicato), ut: (ቅዉም፡ እመ፡ ነስሐ፡) ይባእ፡ ወይትከነስ፡ ወይቅረብ፡ Clem. f. 160; Clem. f. 161; Clem. f. 162; Clem. f. 163; Clem. f. 164. d incidere in rem: ከመ፡ ኢትባኡ፡ ውስተ፡ መንሱት፡ Matth. 26,41; ከመ፡ ኢትባእ፡ ላዕለ፡ ደም፡ 1 Reg. 25,26; 1 Reg. 25,33. e in judicium intrare cum aliquo i.e. eum in jus vocare Ps. 142,2. f frequentare: ይበውእ፡ ቤተ፡ መያሲ፡, ቤተ፡ ብለኒ፡ Clem. f. 127. g inire foedus ቦኡ፡ ኪዳነ፡ 2 Esr. 20,29. h subire aliquid Hen. 67,2. i se immittere, immisceri: ከመ፡ ኢትባኡ፡ ውስተ፡ አሕዛብ፡ Jos. 23,7; ውስተ፡ ነገረ፡ ባዕድ፡ ኢትባእ፡ ἐν μέσῳ λόγων μὴ παρεμβάλλου (ne interjicias te, ne interrumpas sermonem) Sir. 11,8. k de rebus: introduci, immitti, ingeri: ቦአት፡ ኀጢአት፡ ውስተ፡ ዓለም፡ Rom. 5,12; ዘይበውእ፡ ውስተ፡ አፍ፡ Matth. 15,17; Marc. 7,15; Lev. 10,18; Num. 31,23. l offerri (de collationibus): ወርቅ፡ ዘቦአ፡ τὸ ἀργύριον τὸ εἰςενεχθέν 4 Reg. 22,4 (vid. አብአ፡). m penetrare, c. Acc. 2 Tim. 3,6 rom.; c. ውስተ፡, ut: ይበውእ፡ ስርዋጽ፡ ውስተ፡ እዴሁ፡ Jes. 36,6; ገዓሮሙ፡ ቦአ፡ ውስተ፡ እዘኒሁ፡ Jac. 5,4; Ps. 17,8; ለትባእ፡ ኵሉ፡ እከዮሙ፡ ቅድሜከ፡ Thren. 1,22; de oratione animos movente, in animos descendente: ነገሩ፡ ይበውእ፡ ውስተ፡ ልብ፡ Sir. 21,17; 2 Reg. 19,7; Gen. 50,21. n venire in mentem alicui: ቦአክሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ልብክሙ፡ seq. ከመ፡ et Subj., Mal. 2,2; Marc. 4,19. o supervenire, invadere aliquem (quamquam raro): ሐዘን፡ ኢይባእከ፡ Sir. 38,17. – Voc. Ae.: አተወ፡ ቦአ፡ ዘ፡ ገባ።

woorden.betekenis: introducere, inducere, incidere facere, adducere, recipiendu
woorden.definitie: II,1 intrare vel inire facere i.e. 1 introducere, inducere, c.c. Acc. pers.: Gen. 6,19; Luc. 2,27; Joh. 18,16; c. Acc. loci vel c. variis praep. (sicut ቦአ፡): አብአቶሙ፡ ቤተ፡ Tob. 7,1; አባእኩክሙ፡ ምድረ፡ እስራኤል፡ Hez. 20,42; 2 Esr. 19,23; Gen. 43,17; 2 Joh. 10; አብእዎ፡ ባሕረ፡ (sc. በሐመር፡) Sx. Masc. 30 Enc.; አባእናሁ፡ ውስተ፡ ገነት፡ Kuf. 3; ኢታብእ፡ ኵሎ፡ ሰብአ፡ ዘረከብከ፡ ውስተ፡ ቤትከ፡ Sir. 11,29; Gen. 43,18; Ex. 23,20; Num. 14,16; Cant. 1,4; አብእዎ፡ ኀቤሆሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ቤት፡ Gen. 19,10; Luc. 5,18; Luc. 5,19; Ps. 143,17; e bello: ዘያወጽኦሙ፡ ወዘያበውኦሙ፡ Num. 27,17; ወሎቱኒ፡ አባእኮ፡ ቅድሜከ፡ ይትዋቀስ፡ Job 14,3. In specie: a incidere facere aliquem in malum Matth. 6,13; Ps. 65,10. b introducere vel adducere aliquem in societatem, religionem, i.e. recipiendum, adsciscendum curare: አብኦሙ፡ (paganos) ውስተ፡ አእምሮ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Sx. Genb. 7; ዘእንበለ፡ አብእዎ፡ ክርስትና፡ Sx. Teq. 25; Sx. Nah. 24; ዘእንበለ፡ ያብእዎን፡ ለአንስቲያሆሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ሃይማኖት፡ F.M. 5,11. 2 introferre, inferre, importare, immittere, ingerere, inserere, invehere, ut: sanguinem in sacrarium Lev. 4,5; Lev. 4,16; Lev. 16,15; Hebr. 13,11; ዓሥራቲየ፡ አባእክሙ፡ ቤተክሙ፡ Joel 4,5; 2 Par. 5,1; 2 Par. 5,7; onera per portas Jer. 17,24; Jer. 17,27; Kuf. 2; aliquid in speluncas Jes. 2,19; aquas in urbem (inducere) Sir. 48,17; naves in portum Jac. 3,4; አብእ፡ እገሪከ፡ ውስተ፡ አርዑታ፡ Sir. 6,24; vectes in annulos Ex. 25,14; Ex. 27,7. a invehere proventum in horrea: Deut. 28,38; Kuf. p. 48(aliâs አእተወ፡) b accipere (einnehmen, opp. expendere): ዘአባእከ፡ ወዘአውጻእከ፡ Sir. 42,7. c inducere, introducere morem, παρειςάγειν 2 Petr. 2,1; libros haereticorum F.N. 2 (vid. sub አንበረ፡). d injicere, interjicere, immittere: ኢታብእ፡ ሐዘነ፡ ውስተ፡ ነፍስከ፡ Sir. 38,20; ኢታብእ፡ ሐዘነ፡ ማእከለ፡ ትፍሥሕትከ፡ Sir. 13,8; ዮጊ፡ ታበውእ፡ ኀጢአተ፡ ማእከለ፡ ጽድቅከ፡ Sir. 7,6. 3 afferre: አብእ፡ ኤፉደ፡ προσάγαγε τὸ Ἐφούδ 1 Reg. 30,7; አብኡ፡ ለነ፡ ፍትሐ፡ ኀበ፡ ልዑል፡ Hen. 9,3; አነ፡ አባእኩ፡ ተዝካረ፡ ስእለትክሙ፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ Tob. 12,12; Tob. 12,15; in specie offerre a munus, donarium, collectam Matth. 2,11; Ex. 30,14; Ex. 30,15; Ex. 36,3; Prov. 3,9; Luc. 21,1; Luc. 21,4. b sacrificia Lev. 1,2; Lev. 2,12; Kuf. 49; Jes. 19,21; Jer. 14,12; 4 Esr. 10,58; 4 Esr. 10,59; እምከመ፡ አባእኩ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ልዑል፡ ይሣሀለኒ፡ Sir. 7,9; Sir. 14,11; ዘበንዋየ፡ ዐመፃ፡ ያበውእ፡ መባአ፡ Sir. 31,24; Sir. 32,1; Act. 21,26; ካህን፡ ዘያበውእ፡ መሥዋዕተ፡ Lev. 7,8.

woorden.betekenis: introduci, qui introducti fuerunt nobis
woorden.definitie: III,1 introduci Rom. 5,20 Platt; ቢጽ፡ እለ፡ ተበውኡነ፡ (v. ተባውኡነ፡ Platt) qui introducti fuerunt nobis (παρείσακτοι) Gal. 2,4.

woorden.betekenis: intrans, ingrediens, is qui introit, frequentator, commeans,
woorden.definitie: n. ag. intrans, ingrediens, is qui introit: (janua aperta fuit) በእንተ፡ ብዝኀ፡ በዋእያን፡ ወወፃእያን፡ Phlx. 122; a frequentator, commeans: ጽፉቅ፡ በዋኤ፡ ቤታ፡ Prov. 29,45; Did. 3; vid. በዋኢት፡ b Macc. f. 15legitur: ( puerorum captivorum quosdam constituit ) በዋእያነ፡ ውስተ፡ ምስካቡ፡ i.e. cubicularios.

woorden.betekenis: multitudo intrantium, frequentantes
woorden.definitie: subst. (fem. ad በዋኢ፡) multitudo intrantium, frequentantes: ኀበ፡ ብዙኅ፡ በዋኢቱ፡ በመዝግሕ፡ አንብር፡ Sir. 42,6.

woorden.betekenis: ingressus, introitus, aditus, occasus
woorden.definitie: et ሙባእ፡, subst., Pl. ምብዋኣት፡ vel ሙባኣት፡፡, ingressus, introitus, aditus: ኢያአምር፡ ሙፃእየ፡ ወሙባእየ፡ 3 Reg. 3 b,7; Jes. 37,28; εἴςοδος Prov. 8,34; ምብዋእ፡ Hez. 42,9; ሙባኣቲሁ፡ Hez. 43,11; ሙባአ፡ ቤት፡ Hez. 44,5; Hez. 46,19; ምብዋኣት፡ 2 Par. 23,4; እስመ፡ እንተ፡ ህየ፡ ቦቱ፡ ምብዋእ፡ (v. ምቡአ፡!) ላዕለ፡ ይሁዳ፡ Judith 4,7; 4 Esr. 5,3; 4 Esr. 5,4; 4 Esr. 13,44; ሙባአ፡ ግብጽ፡ Kuf. 10; ሙባአ፡ ባቢሎን፡ Kuf. 20; Jos. 13,5; Jud. 1,24; Org. 2. In specie: locus occasus astri Hen. 73,3.

woorden.betekenis: oblatio, donum, donarium, munus, collatio, collecta, sacrifi
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., coll. et sing.; Pl. መባኣት፡ oblatio cujusvis generis in usum Dei, templi, ecclesiae facta ( donum, donarium, munus, collatio, collecta, sacrificium, anathema, al.): καρπώματα Deut. 18,1; θυσίαι Jer. 7,21; Sir. 31,23; προςφοραί አብእ፡ መባአ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ Sir. 14,11; Sir. 31,21; ἀναφορά Ps. 50,20; δῶρον Job 8,20; Lev. 1,2; Hez. 20,39; በብዝኀ፡ መባእየ፡ ይሰሪ፡ ሊተ፡ Sir. 7,9; Matth. 5,24; Matth. 8,4; Luc. 21,1; ἀνάθεμα Lev. 27,28; Lev. 27,29; ἀπαρχή, ἀπαρχαί Ex. 25,2; Ex. 25,3; Num. 15,19; Num. 15,20; Num. 15,21; ἀφαίρεμα, ἀφόρισμα Ex. 35,5; Ex. 35,21; Ex. 39,2; Lev. 10,14; Lev. 10,15; Num. 31,52; ጸሐፍተ፡ መባእ፡ γραμματοειςαγωγεῖς Deut. 16,18; collecta 2 Par. 24,9 seq.; ወርቀ፡ መባእ፡ ዘሣጹን፡ F.M. 17,1; christianorum προςφοραί Lit. 159,1; Lit. 160,1; Const. Ap. 36; መባኣት፡ F.M. 26,3; ጸሎተ፡መባእ፡ oratio illationis (quum panis et vinum ex prothesi ad altare inferuntur) Lit. 159,1.

woorden.betekenis: manus distendit, orgyia, dimensus fuit
woorden.definitie: inus., بَاعَ manus distendit, quoad potuit, orgyia (بَاعٌ) dimensus fuit.

woorden.betekenis: spithama, palmus major
woorden.definitie: subst. spithama, palmus major, σπιθάμη Ex. 36,16.

woorden.betekenis: possedit, dominatus est, uxorem duxit, dives fuit, divitem e
woorden.definitie: I,1 [Hebraei habent בָּעַל possedit, dominatus est; in specie: uxorem duxit, sicut بَعَلَ et ܒܥܰܠ; Arabes frequentant مَالَ dives fuit; vid. etiam መበለ፡] Subj. ይብዐል፡ 1 divitem esse vel fieri, locupletari: ነዲይኒ፡ ወብዒልኒ፡ Sir. 11,14; ሠናይ፡ ብዒል፡ Sir. 13,24; ሠያጢ፡ ወሰካሪ፡ ኢይብዕል፡ Sir. 19,1; ብዕሉ፡ Jer. 5,27; Judith 15,6; Gen. 30,43; ብዕልክሙ፡ 1 Cor; 4,8; ይብዕል፡ Job 15,29; ሀለወ፡ ዘይብዕል፡ በብዝኀ፡ ጠዊዕ፡ Sir. 11,18; ከመ፡ ትብዐሉ፡ 2 Cor. 8,9; 1 Tim. 6,9; 1 Tim. 6,18; Apoc. 3,18; Cyr. de r. fid. 55; ይጔጕእ፡ ይብዐል፡ Prov. 28,22; እንተ፡ እምኔሃ፡ ብዕሉ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ Apoc. 18,19; c. Acc. ብዕለ፡ Hen. 97,8; ይብዕል፡ ብዕለ፡ ዐቢየ፡ Dan. 11,2; c. Acc. pers. i.e. ditiorem esse aliquo: ዘይብዕለከ፡ Sir. 8,2; Sir. 8,12; Sir. 13,2; ምንትኑ፡ ይብዕላ፡ ለጥበብ፡ τί σοφίας πλουσιώτερον; Sap. 8,5. 2 conjugium inire: in loco Jes. 62,5 ከመ፡ ይነብር፡ ወሬዛ፡ ምስለ፡ ድንግል፡ verbo ይነብር፡ in vers. nov. ይብዕል፡ vel ይቤዕል፡ (I,2) sive substitutum sive appositum est (יִבְעַל σ).

woorden.betekenis: dives, locuples, opulentus, festus, magnificus
woorden.definitie: part. 1 dives, locuples, opulentus Ps. 9,30; Ps. 44,14; Ps. 122,5; Koh. 10,20; ዕደው፡ ብዑላን፡ Sir. 44,6; አንስት፡ ብዑላት፡ Jes. 32,9; Apoc. 2,9; Apoc. 3,17; Sx. Teq. 14; አልቦ፡ ብዕል፡ ዘይፈደፍድ፡ እምነፍስ፡ ብዕልት፡ Fal. f. 59; ሀገር፡ ብዕልት፡ Jes. 33,20; c. በ፡ vel እምነ፡ rei Gen. 13,2. 2 ut videtur: festus, magnificus Hen. 41,5.

woorden.betekenis: divitiae, opulentia, opes
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., divitiae, opulentia, opes Koh. 5,12; Koh. 9,11; Job 21,7; ብዙኅ፡ ብዕልየ፡ Job 31,25; Prov. 8,18; Prov. 24,31; Sir. 8,2; Sir. 9,11; Sir. 30,15; Sir. 30,16; ብዕል፡ ወክብር፡ Kuf. 43; ብዕል፡ ወንዋይ፡ 2 Par. 1,11; Ps. 111,3; Jes. 16,14; Jes. 29,2; ብዕለ፡ ባሕር፡ Jes. 60,5; Jer. 9,23; ዘይገብር፡ ብዕሎ፡ Jer. 17,11; Hen. 94,8; ብዕል፡ ዓለማዊት፡ F.M. 18,1; 1 Tim. 6,17; ብዕለ፡ ስብሐቲሁ፡ Rom. 9,23; ብዕለ፡ ጥበቢሁ፡ Rom. 11,33.

woorden.betekenis: dives, locuples, opulentus, possessor, dominus, herus, pater
woorden.definitie: adj. et subst., fem. ባዕልት፡, Pl. አብዕልት፡ (m. et fem., ut Ruth 3,10) 1 dives, locuples, opulentus Jer. 9,23; Dan. apocr. 1,4; Matth. 19,23; Matth. 27,57; Sir. 10,22; Sir. 13,18; Sir. 13,19; Sir. 21,4; ባዕል፡ ደንጻዊ፡ Sir. 25,2; Sir. 25,30; Sir. 25,14; ብእሲት፡ ክብርት፡ ወባዕልት፡ Sx. Haml. 15; Sx. Teq. 18; Kebr. Nag. 21; አብዕልት፡ Hen. 94,8; Koh. 10,6; Jes. 5,14; Jes. 53,9; Prov. 10,15; Ps. 48,2; 1 Tim. 6,17; Jac. 2,5; Luc. 6,24; c. በ፡ rei, ut: ባዕል፡ በወርቅ፡ ወበብሩር፡ Sx. Ter 1. 2 possessor, dominus, herus: ባዕለ፡ ንዋይ፡ Lev. 5,24; Num. 5,7; ባዕለ፡ ላህም፡ Ex. 21,28; ባዕለ፡ ቤት፡ Ex. 22,7; Jud. 19,22; Matth. 10,25; Marc. 14,14; Luc. 14,21 ( paterfamilias ); (ባዕልተ፡ ቤት፡ materfamilias 3 Reg. 17,17 Lud., sed vid. በዓልት፡); ባዕለ፡ ብሔር፡ ὁ κύριος τῆς γῆς Gen. 42,33 (Gen. 42,30); Gen. 43,3; ባዕለ፡ ቤተ፡ ነግድ፡ xenoparochus Sx. Nah. 15; Pl. አብዕልት፡ Lev. 25,33; አግብኦ፡ ለአብዕልቲሃ፡ Tob. 2,13; ἄρχοντες Job 3,15. 3 sicut በዓል፡ q.v. usurpatur ad significandum eum, qui aliqua re praeditus est, pollet, eam habet, ut: ባዕለ፡ (v. በዓለ፡) ዕዳ፡ creditor Jes. 24,2; Luc. 7,41; Ps. 108,10; ባዕለ፡ (v. በዓለ፡) ጸጋ፡ donator ( liberalis ) Sx. Masc. 28 Enc.; አብዕልተ፡ ነውራት፡ vitiis (corporis) affecti F.M. 20,5; አብዕልተ፡ ኀጣውእ፡ ንኡሳት፡ peccatillis affecti F.M. 1,5; አበው፡ አብዕልተ፡ ጉባኤ፡ ቅድስት፡ patres qui S. Synodo interfuerunt F.M. 5,4. ባዕለ፡ ፋል፡ bāʿla fāl subst. one who does witchcraft አው፡ መምካሪ፡ አው፡ ባዕለ፡ ፋል፡ አው ዘይትነግር፡ በትእምርተ፡ ሐሰት፡ ‘ o persuasore, o che si occupa dei sortilegi o che parla per falsi segni ’ 68 l. 10-11 (ed.), 33 l. 28 - 34 l. 1 (tr.) (‘Per ባዕለ፡ ፋል፡ cf. Vs n. 2.’ 33 l. 28 - 34 l. 1 n. 25), vid. ፋል፡; for ሰብአ፡ ፋላት፡ vid. ሰብእ፡

woorden.betekenis: possessor, dominus, domina, herus, hera, habet, administrat,
woorden.definitie: subst. m. (Pl. አብዕልት፡ vid. sub ባዕል፡); fem. በዓልት፡, Pl. fem. በዓልታት፡ 1 possessor, dominus, domina, herus, hera: በዓለ፡ ምድር፡ Job 31,39; በዓለ፡ ቤት፡ Luc. 13,25; Hebr. 3,3; F.M. 17,7; በዓለ፡ ሐመር፡ Jsp. p. 351; በዓልተ፡ ቤት፡ 3 Reg. 17,17; Jud. 19,22 var.; 1 Tim. 5,14. 2 usurpatur ad significandum eum, qui aliquid habet, administrat, facit, re praeditus est, pollet, ejus auctor est: በዓለ፡ ዕዳ፡ creditor Jes. 24,2; Ps. 108,10 ann.; 4 Reg. 4,1; በዓለ፡ መንበር፡ qui sedem (episcopalem) tenet F.N. 4; በዓለ፡ መዛግብት፡ thesaurensis Jsp. p. 378; በዓለ፡ ሰይፍ፡ decollator Sx. Jac. 6; በዓለ፡ ጸብኅ፡ culinarius (monasterii) Sx. Jac. 12; በዓለ፡ ርዴ፡ fenerator Kedr f. 64; በዓለ፡ ውዴት፡ calumniator F.N. 5; vidua በዓልተ፡ ክልኤ፡ ጸሪቅ፡ (Luc. 21,2) Phlx. 54; ርግብ፡ በዓልተ፡ የውሀት፡ ወሰላም፡ Phlx. 105; በዓለ፡ እቶን፡ faber fornacarius, በዓለ፡ ሕብር፡ infector F.N. 23; in specie auctor libri, dicti: ይቤ፡ በዓለ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ ait scriptor Jsp. p. 271 seq.; Chrys. Ta. 8; በከመ፡ በዓለ፡ ምሳሌ፤ ዘያከብር፡ ሰብአ፡ ያከብር፡ ርእሶ፡ οὐχὶ παροιμία τοιαύτη ἐστίν ὁ τιμῶν, ἑαυτὸν τιμᾷ; Chrys. Ta. 25. 1 በዓል፡ baʿāl X a በዓለ፡ መዋዕል፡ baʿāla mawāʿǝl, Pl. በዓለ፡ መዋዕሎች baʿāla mawāʿǝločč courtier ኵሎሙ፡ ሰብአ፡ ሐፄጌ፡ እስከ፡ አዛዞች፡ ወውስጥ፡ ብላቴኖች፡ ወበዓለ፡ መዋዕል፡ ይትወገዙ፡ ሊተ፡ ‘Que tous les hommes du Ḥaṣēgē jusqu’aux azaž, aux wesṭ belāttenā et aux baʿāla mawāʿǝl me jurent la paix sous peine d’excommunication’ 29 l. 14–16 (ed.), 34 l. 8–10 (tr.), vid. መዋዕል፡ b በዓለ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ baʿāla maṣḥaf master of the book/writing, scribe, secretary ወእንዘ፡ በዓለ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ አብርሃም፡ ‘pendant que le baʿāla maṣḥaf était Abrehām’ 27 l. 1 (ed.), 30 l. 22–23 (tr.); ወቃል፡ ሐፄ፡ በዓለ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ ያዕቆብ፡ ‘le porte parole du roi baʿāla maṣḥaf, Yāʿǝqob’ 33 l. 28–29 (ed.), 39 l. 16–17 (tr.), vid. መጽሐፍ፡ c በዓለ፡ ርስት፡ baʿāla rǝst a person who holds inherited land ወአልቦ፡ በዓለ፡ ርስት፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ማኅበር፡ በእሉ፡ ፭፡ አህጉር። ‘et personne ne possède rien dans ces cinq pays à titre héréditaire, hormis la communauté religieuse;’ 57 l. 20–21 (ed.), 69 l. 5–7 (tr.), vid. ርስት፡ d በዓለ፡ በገና፡ baʿāla baganā harpist ወ፩በዓለ፡ በገና፡ አመ፡ ነበረ፡ ‘un était le baʿāla baganā’ 75 l. 29 (ed.), 91 l. 6 (tr.), vid. በገና፡ e በዓለ፡ ኀርብ፡ baʿāla ḫarb spearmen ወርእሰ፡ በዐለ፡ ኀርብ፡ ረከቦ፡ በውስተ፡ ቤቱ፡ ለኢሳይያስ፡ ለውእቱ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ጠንቋልያን፡ ‘The head of the spearmen found the book of magicians in the house of Isayǝyyas’ 72 l. 10–12 (ed.), 58 l. 9–10 (tr.), vid. ሐርብ፡ f በዓለ፡ ነጋሪት፡ baʿāla nagārit lit. ‘an owner of kettledrum’ a person in power በዓለ፡ ነጋሪት፡ የሚሰጠው ነው፡ ፩፡ አሞሌ፡ የፈረስ፡ ከሀገር፡ ግዛት። ‘ce que le gouverneur doit donner, sur le gouvernement du pays, c’est 1 amolē par cheval.’ 55 l. 22–23 (ed.), 67 l. 9–11 (tr.), vid. ነጋሪት፡ g በዓለ፡ ዋኮ፡ baʿāla wāko, በዓለ፡ ዋካ፡ baʿāla wākā, በዓለ፡ ዋኾ፡ baʿāla wāḵo meaning unknown በዓለ፡ ዋኮ፡ አብርሃም፡ ‘le baʿāla wāko, Abrehām’ 27 l. 11–12 (ed.), 31 l. 6–7 (tr.); በዓለ፡ ዋኮ፡ ሰንኮራ፡ ‘le baʿāla wāko, Sankorā’ 28 l. 5 (ed.), 32 l. 9 (tr.); በዓለ፡ ዋካ፡ ወብሕትወደድ፡ የማነ፡ ክርስቶስ፡ ‘le baʿāla wākā et beḥt wadad, Yamāna Krestos’ 48 l. 1 (ed.), 57 l. 22 (tr.); ወዳኛሂ፡ በዓለ፡ ዋኾ፡ ማዕቀቦ፡ ወሮም፡ ‘les dāñā baʿāla wāḵo furent Māʿeqabo et Rom’ 75 l. 20 (ed.), 90 l. 31–32 (tr.), vid. ዋኮ፡ h በዓለ፡ ገንታ፡ baʿāla gantā (title) meaning unknown, the same as vid. ገንተይና፡ as the same proper names occur with both titles,ወበዓለ፡ ገንታ፡ ጰንጠሌዎን፡ ወእምባይ፡ ‘les baʿāla gantā, Panṭalēwon et Embāy’ 36 l. 18–19 (ed.), 43 l. 6–7 (tr.); ወበዓለ፡ ገንታ፡ ፩፡ ተስፋይ፡ ወካልኡ፡ ፍሬ፡ መስቀል፡ ‘les baʿāla gantā, l’un, Tasfāy et l’autre, Ferē Masqal’ 47 l. 7 (ed.), 56 l. 22–23 (tr.) i በዓለ፡ ጕልት፡ baʿāla gʷǝlt fief holder እምይእዜሰ፡ መኑ፡ ኢይቅረባ፡ እመሂ፡ ሥዩመ፡ ትግሬ፡ ወንቡረ፡ እድ፡ ወአፈ፡ መኰንን፡ ንሕነሂ፡ አውገዝነ፡ በሥልጣነ፡ ጴጥሮስ፡ ወጳውሎስ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ካህናት፡ ሰብእ፡ ማኅበር፡ ወበዓለ፡ ጕልት። ‘A partir d’aujourd’hui, nous défendons, sous peine d’excommunication, par la puissance de Pierre et de Paul, que personne ne s’approche de [cette terre], ni le chef du Tegrē, ni le nebura ed, ni le procureur du gouverneur, mais seulement les prêtres, qui appartiennent à la communauté, et le maître du fief’ 51 l. 32, 52 l. 1–3 (ed.), 62 l. 17–22 (tr.); ወካዕበ፡ ሀለዎ፡ ለአባ፡ ሳሙኤል፡ ጕልተ፡ በአውግር፡ ፳ወ፩ገንታ፡ ለ፳፡ ገንታ፡ ይትበላዕ፡ መንፈቁ፡ ለበዓለ፡ ጕልት፡ ወመንፈቁ፡ ለሥዩመ፡ ሃገር፡ ‘En outre, abbā Sāmuʿēl a, en concession féodale, 21 gantā dans l’Awger: une moitié [du revenu] des 20 gantā reviendra au feudataire et une moitié au chef du pays’ 76 l. 11–13 (ed.), 91 l. 28–31 (tr.), vid. ጕልት፡ j በዓለ፡ ጋዳ፡ baʿāla gādā meaning unknown በውእቱ፡ ዕለት፡ ዘተቀበለ፡ በዓለ፡ ጋዳ፡ ዓምዴ። ዘነቦ፡ ፯። ‘La même jour, le baʿāla gādā ʿĀmdē reçut: 7 zanabo,’ 70 l. 26 (ed.), 85 l. 8 (tr.), vid. ጋዳ፡ 2 በዓልት፡ baʿālt (title ?) meaning unknown ወበዳግም፡ አዕረፋ፡ ኢቴ፡ በዓልተ፡ ሐሽሕና። ‘La deuxième fois, la itē baʿālta Ḥašeḥenā y mourut.’ 69 l. 11–12 (ed.), 83 l. 29–30 (tr.) L በዓለ፡ ርዴ፡ baʿāla rǝde one who lends at interest, vid. ርዴ፡ 463a

woorden.betekenis: spelunca
woorden.definitie: spelunca vid. sub ቦአ፡

woorden.betekenis: antilopis, oryx
woorden.definitie: subst., secundum Ludolfum animal in septentrionalibus Aethiopiae partibus frequens, magnitudine cervo, figura vaccae simile, colore cinereo; antilopis species, oryx secundum Harris I p. 160; Harris I p. 191; Harris I p. 192; Harris I p. 193; Harris I p. 194; Harris I p. 195; Harris I p. 214.

woorden.betekenis: distitit, longius abfuit, removit, mutare
woorden.definitie: I,1 [بَعُدَ distitit, longius abfuit; IV removit ], mutare: በዐደ፡ ገጾ፡ ἠλλοίωσε τὸ πρόςωπον αὐτοῦ Ps. 33in tit.; አኮ፡ መይጥ፡ ርእሶ፡ ወብዒድ፡ እምፍጥረቱ፡ M.M. f. 381.

woorden.betekenis: alius, alter, nihil aliud quam mensam, caeteri, alienus, per
woorden.definitie: (part.) adj. alius, alter, et adj. et substantive: ዘእምባዕድ፡ ዘመድ፡ Lev. 22,10; ባዕድ፡ ሰብእ፡ Ex. 30,32; ወኢጸውዐ፡ ባዕደ፡ ሰብአ፡ ወኢመነሂ፡ Judith 12,10; Hen. 89,35; አልቦ፡ ባዕደ፡ እንበሌሁ፡ Deut. 4,35; Jes. 64,4; ገራህተ፡ ባዕድ፡ Ruth 2,8; Ruth 2,22; ዘዘራእኩ፡ ባዕድ፡ ይብልዖ፡ Job 31,8; Job 30,24; የኀድግ፡ ኵሎ፡ ለባዕድ፡ Sir. 11,19; ይዘግብ፡ ለባዕድ፡ Sir. 14,4; ቤተ፡ ባዕድ፡ Sir. 21,23; እንዘ፡ ባዕድ፡ ይነግር፡ ኢታይድዕ፡ ቃለከ፡ Sir. 35,9; Dan. 5,17; Prov. 27,2; Koh. 7,22; Ps. 104,42; Jes. 42,8; መኑ፡ ባዕድ፡ ዘይመይጥ፡ ምክሮሙ፡ Jes. 44,25; Joh. 4,38; Marc. 15,31; 1 Petr. 4,15; c. እምነ፡, ut: ኢይርአይ፡ ባዕደ፡ እምነ፡ ማእድ፡ወጻሕል፡ ( nihil aliud quam mensam ) Reg. Pach. a caeteri: ወባዕደኒ፡ ኵሎ፡ ተግባሮሙ፡ 2 Esr. 23,16; Ps. 147,9; Asc. Jes. 6,16; Marc. 4,19; 1 Cor. 11,34. b alienus, peregrinus: አሕዛበ፡ ባዕድ፡ ἔθνη ἀλλότρια Sir. 29,18; በብሔረ፡ ባዕድ፡ Jer. 5,19; Judith 5,18; ኮነ፡ ለባዕድ፡ ርስትነ፡ Thren. 5,2; ለባዕድ፡ አማልክት፡ Jer. 16,13. c እንተ፡ ባዕድ፡ ἄλλοθεν aliunde, alibi, aliorsum Esth. 4,14 (vid. etiam Ruth 2,8).

woorden.betekenis: mutabilitas, diversitas, differentia, discretio
woorden.definitie: subst. 1 mutabilitas; Deo non convenit ብዕድና፡ (nec ሚጠት፡ nec ውላጤ፡) Cyr. ad Theod. f. 10; τροπή Cyr. ad Theod. f. 15(ubi ውላጤ፡ μετάστασις]). 2 diversitas, differentia, discretio: ዘእንበለ፡ ኑፋቄ፡ ወብዕድና፡ τομῆς τινὸς δίχα καὶ διαφορᾶς (citra ullam sectionem et distinctionem) Cyr. ad Theod. f. 19; διαφορά Cyr. ad Theod. f. 21.

woorden.betekenis: vellendo, digitis, carpendo divisit lanam, gossypium carmina
woorden.definitie: I,2 [respondent نَفَشَ vellendo, digitis carpendo divisit lanam, gossypium carminavit, فَشَّ II id.; ܦܽܘܫܳܫܳܐ carminatio, פִּשְׁתִּים linum ] carminare, digitis carpendo dividere lanam: እንተ፡ ትቤዝት፡ ጸምረ፡ (v. ትፈትል፡) μηρυομένη ἔρια Ρrov. 29,31; Did. 3 (Platt p. 13).

woorden.betekenis: intumescendo, multum fieri, esse, multiplicari, augeri, cres
woorden.definitie: I,1 [amh. በዛ፡; Abyssinis usitatissimum, sicut كَثُرَ Arabibus; vis radicis prima in intumescendo fuisse videtur (cfr. بَزُعَ, بَذِخَ, بَسَقَ, بَزَخٌ,); non est quod eam cum وَسِعَ vel فَسَحَ vel פּוּשׁ componamus; neque intelligi potest, quomodo cum E. Schrader de linguae Aethiop. indole 1860p. 15 በዝኀ፡ idem quod יָסַף dicere liceat.] Subj. ይብዛኅ፡, multum fieri vel esse, multiplicari, augeri, crescere, numerosum esse: Gen. 1,22; Gen. 1,28; Gen. 8,17; Ex. 1,7; Jes. 6,12; Jes. 14,2; Jer. 3,16; Jer. 36,6; Kuf. 5; Kuf. 6; Kuf. 46; Hen. 6,1; Sir. 16,2; Joh. 4,1; ጸንዐ፡ ማይ፡ ወበዝኀ፡ Gen. 7,18; Gen. 7,19; በዝኀ፡ ድምፀ፡ ሁከት፡ 1 Reg. 14,19; Gen. 18,20; በዝኀ፡ ሥዕርትኪ፡ Hez. 16,7; በዝኁ፡ አዕፁቂሁ፡ Hez. 31,5; ይበዝኅ፡ ክብረ፡ ቤቱ፡ Ps. 48,17; Deut. 8,13; ሰላም፡ ይብዛኅ፡ ለክሙ፡ (v. ይብዛኅክሙ፡) Dan. 3,31; 1 Petr. 1,2; 2 Petr. 1,2; Hen. 5,5; Jes. 7,22; እኪት፡ በዝኀት፡ ላዕለ፡ ሰብእ፡ Koh. 6,1; Ps. 3,1; Ps. 15,3; Ps. 24,20; ከመ፡ ይብዛኅ፡ መዋዕሊከ፡ Deut. 22,7; Hen. 5,9; c.c. pron. suff. pro Dativo: ከመ፡ ኢይብዝኀኒ፡ ጌጋይየ፡ Sir. 23,3; Dan. 3,31 var.; Jes. 22,9 var. Comparative: plurem vel plurimum esse a seq. እምነ፡ 2 Reg. 18,8; Ps. 39,8; Ps. 68,5; Ps. 138,17; Matth. 21,36; Act. 23,21. b seq. Acc.: ሕዝብ፡ ዘይበዝኀከ፡ λαὸν πλείονά σου Deut. 20,1. c abs.: ንሕነ፡ ንበዝኅ፡ πλείους ἐσμέν, nos plures sumus Hez. 33,24; Num. 26,54; ዘይበዝኅ፡ ሕዝብ፡ τὸ πλεῖστον τοῦ λαοῦ plurima pars populi Jes. 9,3; Matth. 21,8; Act. 19,32 rom.; እለሰ፡ ይበዝኁ፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ plurimi eorum Act. 19,32 Platt; ዝኒ፡ በዝኀ፡ τὸ πλεῖστον ut plurimum 1 Cor. 14,27 Platt.

woorden.betekenis: multum facere, multiplicare, augere, multum comparare, haber
woorden.definitie: II,1 multum facere, multiplicare, augere, Gen. 3,16; Gen. 17,2; Gen. 26,22; Gen. 26,24; Gen. 34,12; Ex. 7,3; Deut. 1,10; Deut. 30,5; Jud. 16,24; ኣበዝኆሙ፡ ወኢይውሕዱ፡ Jer. 37,19; Ps. 17,16; Ps. 104,22; 2 Esr. 19,23; Job 1,10; Num. 26,54; ከመ፡ ኆፃ፡ ኣብዝኅ፡ መዋዕለ፡ Job 29,18; አብዝኀ፡ ምሕረቶ፡ Sir. 18,12; 4 Esr. 7,40; አብዝኅዋ፡ለኀጢአት፡ Sir. 48,16; Rom. 5,20; Rom. 15,13; Ps. 70,23; Hen. 16,4; 1 Thess. 3,12; አብዛኅኪ፡ ዝሙተኪ፡ Hez. 16,25; አብዝኀ፡ ኀሳራ፡ ለወለተ፡ ይሁዳ፡ ኅስርት፡ Thren. 2,5. a passim: multum comparare vel habere: Deut. 17,16; Deut.17,17; ያበዝኁ፡ አዋልደ፡ ወደቂቀ፡ 1 Par. 8,40; በአብዝኆ፡ ንዋይ፡ Luc. 12,15; አብዝኁ፡ ወርቀ፡ Judith 5,9; ዘአብዝኀ፡ ብዕለ፡ Koh. 5,11; ዘአብዝኀ፡ ጥበበ፡ አብዝኀ፡ ሐዘነ፡ Koh. 1,18. b seq. Infin. vel nom. abstracto in Acc. vocabulis multum, plus, exponere licet: ኢታብዝኅ፡ ተናግሮ፡ ምስለ፡ አብድ፡ ne multum colloquaris Sir. 22,13; ነቢበ፡ Job 4,2; Job 11,3; አብዝኆ፡ ነገር፡ Job 4,2; ዘያበዝኅ፡ ሰትየ፡ ወይን፡ F.N. 6; አብዝኀ፡ ሐይወ፡ diu vixit Kuf. 23; አብዛኅክሙ፡ ገቢረ፡ እኩይ፡ እምአበዊክሙ፡ Jer. 16,12; Marc. 12,43; አኮ፡ በአብዝኆ፡ አላ፡ በአውሕዶ፡ non multis sed paucis, Lit. Cyr.

woorden.betekenis: multiplicari, augeri
woorden.definitie: III,1 multiplicari, augeri: amor እንዘ፡ ይበዝኅ፡ ወይትበዛኅ፡ Lud. ex Org. 4.

woorden.betekenis: facere ut sese invicem multiplicent, multiplicare, augere
woorden.definitie: IV,3 facere ut sese invicem multiplicent, multiplicare, augere Gen. 17,6; Gen. 17,20; Gen. 22,17; Gen. 48,4; Deut. 7,13; Deut. 8,1; Deut. 13,18; Deut. 28,11; Jos. 24,3; Hebr. 6,14.

woorden.betekenis: multus, longus, multus misericordiae, multae misericordiae,
woorden.definitie: part. et adj. multus: Num. 32,1; Jos. 11,4; ብዙኅ፡ ብዕልየ፡ Job 31,25; ብዙኅ፡ ማያት፡ Joh. 3,23; Apoc. 17,1; ብዙኅ፡ ሰብእ፡ Job 31,34; Apoc. 19,1; ብዙኅ፡ አሕዛብ፡ Gen. 17,2; ብዙኅ፡ ውሉድ፡ Sir. 16,1; ዘብዙኅ፡ እገሪሁ፡ Lev. 11,42; ዕንቍ፡ ዘብዙኅ፡ ሤጡ፡ Judith 10,21; ዝንቱ፡ ብዙኅ፡ ተኀሥሦ፡ 4 Esr. 10,43; ሰላም፡ ብዙኅ፡ Ps. 118,165; ብዙኅ፡ ጽልመት፡ Asc. Jes. 8,24; ብዙኅ፡ ትዕቢት፡ 4 Esr. 8,61; ብዙኅ፡ መከራ፡ Koh. 5,2; Matth. 2,18; Marc. 13,26; 1 Thess. 1,6; ብዙኅ፡ መዋዕል፡ Matth. 25,19; Gen. 26,8; ብዙኃት፡ አዋልድ፡ Esth. 2,8; Jud. 8,30; ብዙኃን፡ አዕርክት፡ Sir. 28,13; Sir. 11,5; ብዙኃነ፡ ኄራነ፡ አሕመሞሙ፡ ተሐብዮ፡ Sir. 29,18; 1 Joh. 4,1; ለብዙኃን፡ ቀተሎሙ፡ ሐዘን፡ Sir. 30,23; Sir. 13,22; Matth. 7,22; Matth. 8,11; Hebr. 12,15; ብዙኃን፡ እምውሉደ፡ ግብጽ፡ Kuf. 42; Joh. 4,41; crebro seq. pron. rel., ut ብዙኃን፡ እለ፡ ጸላእኩ፡ Sir. 27,24; Sir. 9,8; ብዙኃን፡ እለ፡ ፈቀድዋ፡ Judith 16,22; Matth. 7,13. a de tempore: longus Marc. 6,35; እምዘመን፡ ብዙኅ፡ F.N. 10,8. b in st. c. positum: ብዙኀ፡ ምሕረት፡ multus misericordiae i.e. multae misericordiae Ex. 34,6; Joel 2,13; 4 Esr. 7,40; ብዙኀ፡ ጥበብ፡ πολὺς ἐν φρονήσει Prov. 14,29; ሀገር፡ ብዝኅተ፡ ሰብእ፡ πολυάνδριον Hez. 39,16. c crebro neutraliter ብዙኅ፡ multum: ብዙኀ፡ ሐዘን፡ multum tristitiae 4 Esr. 10,37; Gen. 33,9; Ps. 119,6; ብዙኀ፡ ዘከመዝ፡ ዘርእየት፡ ዐይንየ፡ Sir. 16,5; Sir. 31,12; ቦዘይሠይጥ፡ ብዙኀ፡ በኅዳጥ፡ Sir. 20,12; 2 Cor. 8,22; Marc. 6,34. d passim et ብዙኅ፡ et ብዙኃን፡ multitudo hominum, vulgus: Ex. 19,21; Ex. 23,2; 1 Reg. 14,6; በማእከለ፡ ብዙኃን፡ ἐν μέσῳ ἐκκλησίας Sir. 15,5; Marc. 3,7. e comparative: plus, plures, plurimus: ማእከለ፡ ብዙኅ፡ ἀνὰ μέσον πλειόνων Sir. 34,18; ብዙኃን፡ οἱ πλείονες 1 Cor. 9,19; τὸ πλεῖον Luc. 7,43; οἱ πλείστοι Matth. 11,20; sufficiens Ex. 36,5. f adv. ብዙኀ፡ α multum, multo, multifariam, valde: Ruth 1,20; ኢትትአመኖ፡ ብዙኀ፡ Sir. 6,7; ዘብዙኀ፡ ተመንደበ፡ ብዙኀ፡ ይትሜየን፡ Sir. 31,11; ብዙኀ፡ ሕጹጽ፡ አንተ፡ 4 Esr. 8,56; Luc. 5,26; Luc. 7,47; Marc. 3,12; Marc. 12,27. β saepe, pluries Koh. 5,19; Matth. 9,14; Jac. 3,2; πλειστάκις Koh. 7,22.{; Marc. 9,26 γ diu Lev. 25,36 }

woorden.betekenis: incrementum, multiplicatio, multitudo, copia, magnitudo, mul
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., (raro Pl. አብዛኅ፡ Jer. 26,16 var.), 1 incrementum, multiplicatio Matth. 24,12. 2 multitudo, copia Gen. 16,10; Gen. 36,7; Deut. 10,22; ብዝኀ፡ ብዕሎሙ፡ Ps. 48,6; ብዝኀ፡ አሕዛብ፡ Prov. 14,28; Ex. 12,6; Judith 7,4; Ps. 63,2; 4 Esr. 8,65; Sir. 16,3; ብዝኀ፡ ዓሣት፡ Joh. 21,6; ብዝኀ፡ መዋዕል፡ Zach. 8,4; በብዝኀ፡ ዓመታት፡ ወበብዝኀ፡ ንብረት፡ Job 12,12; በብዝኀ፡ ነገር፡ ἐκ πολλῆς λαλιᾶς Sir. 13,11; Prov. 10,19; Sir. 20,5; Sir. 31,23; nonnumquam latine magnitudo vertitur, ut: ብዝኀ፡ የውሀቱ፡ Job 21,23; ብዝኀ፡ ጠዊዕ፡ Sir. 11,18; ብዝኀ፡ ምሕረቱ፡ Sir. 16,12; Jes. 63,15; Thren. 3,31; Tob. 8,16; Ps. 68,20; 1 Petr. 1,3; በብዝኀ፡ ስብሐቲሁ፡ Jes. 40,26. Passim a multitude hominum Ex. 23,2; ብዝኅከ፡ (v. አብዛኅከ፡) ደክመ፡ Jer. 26,16. b plerique, pars major eorum, ብዝኆሙ፡ Phlx. 4.

woorden.betekenis: multitudo
woorden.definitie: n. act. multitudo: ብዝኀተ፡ ሰብእ፡ Jsp. p. 282.

woorden.betekenis: pars major, maxima, plerique, plurimi, plerumque, saepe, cre
woorden.definitie: subst. pars major vel maxima, plerique, plurimi, Jos. 5,6; Ps. 77,35; Hen. 89,33; Asc. Jes. 4,9; 1 Cor. 10,5; 1 Cor. 15,6; 4 Esr. 13,50; Jsp. creberrime; መብዝኅተ፡ መዋዕሊሆሙ፡ Kuf. 23; መብዝኅተ፡ ሕዝብ፡ Org. — Adv.: መብዝኅቶ፡ plerumque, saepe, crebro 4 Esr. 8,57; πλεονάκις Tob. 1,6; πολλάκις Matth. 17,15.

woorden.betekenis: collare, monile, ornamentum colli, torques, aliud
woorden.definitie: (Num. 31,50; 1 Esr. 3,6), ብዝግና፡ (Hez. 16,11), ባዝግና፡, በዝጋና፡ et ብዝጋና፡ subst., Pl. —ናት፡, collare, monile, ornamentum colli, torques, animalium: ባዝግናት፡ ዘውስተ፡ ክሣዳተ፡ አግማል፡ Jud. 8,21; Jud. 8,26; hominum: ባዝግና፡ ወርቅ፡ ዘውስተ፡ ክሣድ፡ Fal. f. 18; Num. 31,50; Prov. 1,9; Sir. 35,6; Org.; tam virorum Gen. 41,42; Kuf. 40; 1 Esr. 3,6; Dan. 5,7; Dan. 5,16; Dan. 5,29; 1 Par. 18,7; quam feminarum Jes. 3,18; Jer. 2,32; Judith 10,4; Hos. 2,15; Hez. 16,11. [Etymon semiticum indagaturo ad זנק, زنق, ازق, עזק recurrendum fuerit]. – Voc. Ae.: ባዝግና፡ ዘ፡ ዝርግፍ፡: aliud: ዘ፡ ሥርግው፡; aliud: ብ፡ ዘርፍ።

woorden.betekenis: pernoctare, noctem transigere, noctu manere, deversari, comm
woorden.definitie: I,1 [arm. בּוּת ܒܳܬ, arab. بَاتَ (بَيتٌ)] Subj. ይቢት፡ 1 pernoctare, noctem transigere, alicubi noctu manere vel deversari vel commorari vel cubitum ire: ቤትኩ፡ ወወዐልኩ፡ እንዘ፡ እጸብት፡ 2 Cor. 11,25; ቤትኩ፡ እንዘ፡ እጼሊ፡ Herm. p. 86; በይእቲ፡ ሌሊት፡ ቤትኩ፡ ሥኡብየ፡ Tob. 2,9; ዘአሕጸጸ፡ ድራሮ፡ ይበይት፡ ጥዑየ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ Fal. f. 56; ቤተት፡ ወኖመት፡ Judith 12,5; 1 Reg. 9,25; Ex. 23,18; Jud. 19,6; Jud. 19,10; c. nominibus temporis: Num. 22,8; ቤቱ፡ ክልኤሆሙ፡ በይእቲ፡ ሌሊት፡ Tob. 8,9; ትበይት፡ ሌሊተ፡ውስተ፡ ዖም፡ Jes. 21,13; Ruth 3,13; 4 Esr. 10,74; c. nominibus loci: Gen. 31,40; Gen. 31,54; Ex. 22,26; Lev. 14,47; Ps. 54,7; 2 Esr. 14,22; Sir. 14,26; አልቦ፡ ንብረተ፡ ዘኀበ፡ መሲዮ፡ ይበይት፡ Sir. 36,31; Job 8,17; Job 15,28 (εἰσέλθοι); Ruth 3,14; 4 Esr. 10,73; Luc. 9,12; de cohabitatione conjugum: ቤትኩ፡ ምስሌኪ፡ በሕግ፡ Hez. 16,8; Gen. 30,15; Gen. 30,16; de bestiis: ይበይታ፡ ህየ፡ Hez. 34,14; ይቢት፡ ውስተ፡ ቤትከ፡ Job 39,9; de avibus ( nidulari ): ይበይት፡ ውስተ፡ በአታተ፡ ኰኵሕ፡ Job 39,27; Job 39,28. 2 raro: permanere, subsistere in genere, በጸጋሁ፡ ተፈጥረ፡ ኵሉ፡ ወበኂሩቱ፡ ይበይት፡ Lith. Orth.

woorden.betekenis: pernoctare facere, facere, sinere, ut per noctem maneat, noc
woorden.definitie: II,1 pernoctare facere i.e. a facere vel sinere, ut per noctem maneat vel noctem transigat, ለአቢቶ፡ 1 Reg. 3,3; alicubi Gen. 24,11, in aliquo statu, conditione: ለብዙኃን፡ ዕሩቃን፡ አቤትዎሙ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ልብስ፡ Job 24,7. b per noctem secum detinere vel asservare Deut. 24,12; Ex. 16,20; pecuniam acceptam statim pauperibus distribuit ወኢያቤተ፡ ምንተኒ፡ Gad. T.H.; ተኵላተ፡ ዐረብ፡ እለ፡ ኢያበይቱ፡ ሎሙ፡ ለነግህ፡ Zeph. 3,3.

woorden.betekenis: distitit et segregata et distincta fuit, facile discernenda,
woorden.definitie: inus., i.q. بَانَ distitit et segregata et distincta fuit res a re; facile discernenda, perspicua fuit (בִּין ܐܶܬܒܰܝܰܢ).

woorden.betekenis: perspicuum, manifestum reddere, demonstrare, perspicere, obs
woorden.definitie: II,2 1 perspicuum, manifestum reddere, demonstrare: ንፈቅድ፡ ከመ፡ ታበይን፡ ለነ፡ ስምዐታተ፡ Phlx. 3; Phlx. 98; Sx. Mag. 13; ከመ፡ታበይን፡ ዐመፃየ፡ Jsp. p. 338; አበይኖ፡ 1 Cor. 14,26 Platt; seq. ከመ፡ c. Indic., Sx. Jac. 18. 2 perspicere, observare, perspicue cognoscere Clem. f. 94; astra Kuf. p. 50; አበይኖት፡ Gad. Ad. f. 20. – Voc. Ae.: አበየነ፡ ብ፡ ፈረደ፡ ለየሂ፡ ይ፡ ʾabayyana 3 decide ወሰሚዖ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ዘንተ፡ ነገሮሙ፡ አበየነ፡ ‘ Le roi ayant entendu cette grave (?) proposition {decided} ’ 163 l. 9 (ed.); 163 l. 10-11 (tr.); አበየነ፡ ብያኔ፡ take, make a decision ወሶቤሃ፡ አበየነ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ብያኔ፡ ጽኑዓ፡ ወአዘዘ፡ ከመ፡ ይትመየጡ፡ ካህን፡ ወዲያቆን፡ እምቤተ፡ መቅደስ፡ ‘ Alors le roi prit une grande détermination et ordonna au prêtre et au diacre de revenir du sanctuaire ’ 123 l. 4-6 (ed.), 139 35-36 (tr.)

woorden.betekenis: inter
woorden.definitie: (i.e. በ፡ et በይናት፡ Pl. a በይነ፡) et በቤናት፡ (N. T. rom.) praep. inter, post verba jungendi et separandi, comparandi et opponendi, actionum reciprocarum et de ratione, quae inter plures interest, sed nonnisi c. pron. suff. usitatum: Ex. 14,20. Ex. 26,3; Dan. apocr. 1,13; Matth. 9,3; Matth. 12,25; Matth. 16,7; Matth. 16,8; Matth. 24,10; Marc. 8,16; Luc. 9,46; Joh. 9,16; Rom. 1,27; 1 Thess. 3,12; Hebr. 12,3; Jac. 4,11; Jac. 5,16; 1 Petr. 1,22; 1 Petr. 4,10; Apoc. 6,4; al. sexcenties. Etiam በበ፡ በይናቲሆሙ፡ Gen. 42,21; Gen. 42,28.

woorden.betekenis: stella lucida, lucifer, phosphorus, hesperus, Venus
woorden.definitie: subst., m., Pl. አብያዝ፡ et ቤዛት፡ [sine dubio a ቤዘ፡ i.e. بَاضَ, collato بَصَّ ] stella lucida, in specie lucifer, phosphorus, ( hesperus,) Venus, ἑωσφόρος Job 3,9; φωσφόρος 2 Petr. 1,19; አንተ፡ ቤዝ፡ ኮከበ፡ ጽባሕ፡ Kedr f. 18; Ssal. Req.; አዕይንቲሃ፡ ይመስል፡ ሥርቀተ፡ ቤዝ፡ Gad. T.H.; በሰዓተ፡ ሞታ፡ ደመነ፡ ቤዝ፡ Sx. Masc. 11; ሰላም፡ ለአዕይንትኪ፡ ዘተመሰለ፡ አብያዘ፡ III Sal. Mar. 6; Org. 6; በከመ፡ ኮከበ፡ ጽባሕ፡ ይፈደፍድ፡ ብርሃነ፡ እምዘተርፉ፡ ቤዛት፡ Phlx. 227. – Voc. Ae.: ቤዝ፡ ዘ፡ ኮከብ።

woorden.betekenis: sibi redimere, redimi
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 reflex. sibi redimere Lev. 25,31; Lev. 25,33; (c. በኀበ፡); 1 Petr. 1,18; ተቤዘውዎሙ፡ ለፂውዋን፡ Did. 21; አልቦ፡ ዘይክል፡ ተቤዝዎትየ፡ Org.; ኢያድኅን፡ ወርቅ፡ ወኢይትቤዘው፡ ብሩር፡ Sx. Haml. 4Enc. 2 pass. redimi Lev. 25,31 var. 54; በደሙ፡ ትትቤዘው፡ ነፍስ፡ Lev. 17,11; Apoc. 14,3; Apoc. 14,4; እስመ፡ እምኢተቤዘውነ፡ እመ፡ ኢኮነ፡ ከመዝ፡ Cyr. ad Theod. f. 10.

woorden.betekenis: dissecare, separare, divisit, partitus fuit, separatus fuit,
woorden.definitie: I,1 [proprie: dissecare, deinde: separare; cfr. בִּצַּע בְּצַּע بَضَعَ; بَعَّضَ divisit, partitus fuit; ٱنْفَازَ separatus fuit, تَفَاوَصَ id.] ut videtur decernere Prov. 16,30 var.

woorden.betekenis: singulus, singuli, quidam, unus e sociis, par, aequalis, coa
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., coll. et sing., Pl. አብያጽ 1 singulus, singuli, quidam e multitudine animantium vel rerum aequalium ad idem genus pertinentium vel unus e sociis ad eandem societatem pertinentibus; de viris; ፵፼ ቢጸ፡ እስራኤል፡ ({400,000 Mann von Israel}) 1 Reg. 15,4; ከመ፡ ያምጽእ፡ እም፡ ደቂቀ፡ እስራኤል፡ ቢጸ፡ ወራዙተ፡ νεανίσκους Dan. 1,4; ቢጽ፡ እኩያን፡ τινὲς ἄνδρες πονηροί Act. 17,5; Act. 15,5; Act. 14,2; እምቢጸ፡አጉሥጦስ፡ (von der Mannschaft des) σπείρης Σεβαστῆς Act. 27,1 rom.; de bestiis: ቢጸ፡ ተባዕት፡ (die männlichen Stücke) Gen. 30,40; de rebus: ቢጾን፡ ርቡዓት፡ ወጸዓድው፡ Herm. p. 11; ወእቤ፡ በለሳተ፡ ቢጸ፡ (etliche Feigen) καὶ εἶπα· σῦκα Jer. 24,3; በበ፡ ቢጾሙ፡ (Mann für Mann) Herm. p. 64; በበ፡ ቢጾን፡ (Stück für Stück) Herm. p. 65. 2 qui ejusdem generis est cum alio: par, aequalis, coaequalis, socius, sodalis, consors, collega, amicus, comes: Gen. 2,18; Kuf. 3; ምስለ፡ ቢጽከ፡ Job 39,32; ኢኮንኩ፡ አነ፡ እግዚእከ፡ አላ፡ ቢጽከ፡ Asc. Jes. 8,5; ኢትኩኖሙ፡ ቢጾሙ፡ (in peccando) Kuf. 22; ኮንኩ፡ ቢጾን፡ ለአዕዋፍ፡ Job 30,29; συνήλικοι Dan. 1,10; ገብኡ፡ ወሖሩ፡ ኀበ፡ ቢጾሙ፡ εἰς τὰς διατάξεις αυτῶν Judith 8,36; እለ፡ ምስሌሆሙ፡ ቢጾሙ፡ οἱ συνεταῖροι 1 Esr. 6,3; σύνδουλοι ( conservi ) Matth. 18,28; Matth. 18,31; ለቢጹ፡ ለአርዳእ፡ συμμαθηταί Joh. 11,16; Joh. 21,8; rom.; ቢጾን፡ αἱ λοιπαὶ σὺν αὐταῖς Luc. 24,10; Act. 2,37; አብያጺሁ፡ Dan. 7,20; ἑταῖροι Matth. 11,16; οἱ πλησίον Ps. 37,11; Ps. 87,19; Ps. 121,8; Zach. 3,8; ቢጻ፡ αἱ πλησίον αὐτῆς Ps. 44,16; φίλοι ut: ነዳይ፡ ለእመ፡ ወድቀ፡ ይከይድዎ፡ ቢጹ፡ Sir. 13,21; οἱ ἀδελφοί Act. 11,1; Act. 18,18; 1 Cor. 15,6; 2 Thess. 3,6; ኢይትፈለጥ፡ እምአብያጽየ፡ Chrys. ho. 27; ቢጽክሙ፡ ውእቱ፡ ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν (opp. ዕድው፡ καθ᾽ ὑμῶν) Marc. 9,40; አጥሪ፡ አግዋረ፡ እምቅድመ፡ ትሕንጽ፡ አብያተ፡ ወአብያጸ፡ እምቅድመ፡ ትሑር፡ ፍኖተ፡ Fal. f. 27. a quivis alius, quocum vivimus, proximus, frater (sensu biblico; der Nächste), ὁ πλησίον Ex. 20,17; Deut. 19,14; Job 16,21; Jer. 5,8. Jer. 7,5; Jer. 9,8; Hez. 22,11; Sir. 6,17; Sir. 10,6; Sir. 29,1; Sir. 29,2; Hen. 99,15; Hen. 100,1; Matth. 19,19; Marc. 12,33; Rom. 13,9; Rom. 13,10; ἀδελφός Sir. 7,12; Deut. 22,1; 1 Joh. 2,9; 1 Joh. 2,10; 1 Thess. 4,6; Rom. 12,10. b alter: ብእሲ፡ እምቢጹ፡ Koh. 4,4; Jes. 19,2; Mal. 2,10 al.

woorden.betekenis: secare, acutum esse, acies, velocem, celerem esse, properare
woorden.definitie: I,1 [i.q. بَدَرَ; significatus radicis primus secare et acutum esse videtur, coll. መተረ፡ بَتَرَ et بَادِرَةٌ acies gladii; nec non بَذَّ] Subj. ይብድር፡ 1 acutum, acrem, vehementem i.e. velocem, celerem esse, properare: ይበድሩ፡ እምተኵላተ፡ ዐረብ፡ ὀξύτεροι Hab. 1,8; ይበድሩ፡ እምነ፡ አንስርት፡ አፍራሲሆሙ፡ κουφότεροι Jer. 4,13; ከመ፡ ይብድር፡ እምረዋጺ፡ Lud. e Mss. Colb. 2 praecurrere, praevenire, antevertere, praevertere, antecessisse: ዘበደረ፡ ወዘሮጸ፡ Rom. 9,16 Platt; 1 Cor. 9,24; Hen. 74,12; c. Acc.: ብድሮሙ፡ ተንሥእ፡ ante eos surge Sir. 34,21; Phlx. 3; ይበድረኒ፡ ኀበ፡ ገነት፡ Phlx. 35; ሕቀ፡ ክመ፡ በደሩክሙ፡ 2 Reg. 17,20; በደሮ፡ በጺሐ፡ ግያዝ፡ 4 Reg. 4,31; በደሮ፡ ለጴጥሮስ፡ በጺሐ፡ (Platt በጺሖ፡) ኀበ፡ መቃብር፡ Joh. 20,4; Joh. 20,8; 3 praevertere i.e. potiorem esse, praecellere: ትበድር፡ (v. ትትበደር፡) ይእቲ፡ ወትመውእ፡ ለከ፡ ጸላኢከ፡ Sir. 29,13; Hen. 65,8.

woorden.betekenis: praevertere, anteponere, praeponere, anteferre, praeferre, a
woorden.definitie: II,1 praevertere i.e. anteponere, praeponere vel anteferre, praeferre, antehabere, pluris aestimare, praeoptare, malle, diligere, c. Acc.: እመ፡ አብደሩ፡ ዘአነ፡ እፈቅድ፡ Jes. 56,4; እሙንቱ፡ አብደሩ፡ ፍኖቶሙ፡ Jes. 66,3; Ps. 83,12; Ps. 108,16; Ps. 131,14; Mal. 3,17; Hos. 4,18; ኀሠሥክዋ፡ ለጥበብ፡ ወአብደርክዋ፡ በጸሎት፡ Sir. 51,13; Apoc. 12,11; c. Acc. et እምነ፡, ut: ምጽዋተ፡ ኣበድር፡ እመሥዋዕት፡ Hos. 6,6; አብደሩ፡ ሞተ፡ እምሕይወት፡ Jer. 8,3; 1 Esr. 4,19; Ps. 86,1; አብደርኪ፡ እምኔየ፡ መሐዛኒኪ፡ Jes. 57,8; አብደሩ፡ ነኪረ፡ እምኔየ፡ Job 19,13; Sir. 51,28; ዘያበድር፡ ርእሶ፡ እምነ፡ እግዚኡ፡ Did. 25; 2 Tim. 3,4; Joh. 3,19; seq. Subj. verbi: እምአብደርኩ፡ እስዐም፡ እገሪሁ፡ ηὐδόκουν φιλεῖν πέλματα ποδῶν αὐτοῦ Esth. 4,17 apocr.; Ps. 83,11; 1 Thess. 3,1; አብደርክዋ፡ ህየንተ፡ (v. እምነ፡) ወርቅ፡ ትኩነኒ፡ Sap. 7,10; እምአብደረ፡ ትሙት፡ mallet eam mori Tob. 6,13; Phil. 3,7; Joh. 12,43; c. Acc. Infin. Deut. 7,7.

woorden.betekenis: praestare, praeferri, optabiliorem, meliorem, pluris aestima
woorden.definitie: III,1 praestare, praeferri, optabiliorem, meliorem, pluris aestimandum esse vel videri, c. እምነ፡, ut: ይትበደር፡ ቃል፡ ሠናይ፡ እምውሂብ፡ Sir. 18,17; ኢይትበደር፡ ብዕል፡ እምነቢረ፡ ጥዑይ፡ Sir. 30,16; Jes. 13,12; Prov. 16,16; 1 Petr. 1,17; ጥበብ፡ ትትበደር፡ እምወርቅ፡ Fal. f. 35; vel c. ላዕለ፡, ut: ኢይትበደር፡ ዕንቍ፡ ላዕለ፡ ብእሲት፡ ኄርት፡ Fal. f. 51.

woorden.betekenis: periit, interiit, abiit, a suis separatus fuit, interire, pe
woorden.definitie: quadril. I [vicina sunt אָבַד, ܐܶܒܰܕ) periit, interiit (coll. آبِدَةٌ) et بَادَ abiit, a suis separatus fuit; periit ] interire, perire: ወርቆሙኒ፡ በድበደ፡ ወይወርሶ፡ ሦክ፡ ውስተ፡ አብያቲሆሙ፡ τὸ ἀργύριον αὐτῶν ὄλεθρος κληρονομήσει αὐτό, ἄκανθαι ἐν τοῖς σκηνώμασιν αὐτῶν Hos. 9,6. (Etiam Sir. 34,20 var.; vid. sub ደበደበ፡). — Rad. Abb.: በድበደ፡ ዘ፡ ዛገ፡ (e conjectura).

woorden.betekenis: pernicies, pestis, lues, pestilentia
woorden.definitie: subst. pernicies, pestis, lues, pestilentia, θραῦσις Num. 17,12; Num. 17,13; Num. 17,14; Ps. 105,23; Ps. 105,30; πτῶσις Ps. 105,29; ὁ ὀλοθρεύων Hebr. 11,28; ἀνάλωσις Deut. 28,20; λοιμός Prov. 21,24; ἴκτερος Am. 4,9; θάνατος Jer. 14,12; Jer. 18,21; Jer. 24,10; Thren. 1,20; Hez. 5,12; Hez. 14,19 seq.; Sir. 39,29; Sir. 40,9; 4 Esr. 7,5; de hominibus perniciosis vel pestilentibus, ut: አውሥእዎ፡ ለውእቱ፡ ብድብድ፡ ንጉሥ፡ Macc. f. 1; vid. etiam Prov. 21,24. – Voc. Ae.: ብድብድ፡ ብ፡ ቸነፈር።

woorden.betekenis: mortuo, cadaveri similem esse, fieri
woorden.definitie: (si non በደነ፡) I,1 denom. mortuo vel cadaveri similem esse vel fieri: ሥጋ፡ ትበድን፡ በንዋም፡ ከመ፡ ዘምዉት፡ M.M. f. 269.

woorden.betekenis: corpus mortuum, exanime, mortuus, cadaver, morticinum
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., Pl. አብድንት፡ (Kuf. p. 81 ann. 4 አብዳን፡) [بَدَنٌ; vid. Ges. in thes. p. 201] corpus mortuum vel exanime, mortuus, cadaver, a maxime hominum: Gen. 23,4; Gen. 23,6; Gen, 23,11; Gen. 23,13; (ὁ νεκρός); Kuf. 19; አልቦ፡ ቤተ፡ ዘአልቦ፡ በድን፡ ውስቴታ፡ Kuf. 49; ረከብዎ፡ እንዘ፡ ይሰክብ፡ በድኖ፡ Kuf. 23; 4 Esr. 10,44; በዝኀ፡ አብድንቲሆሙ፡ Jes. 5,13; Jes. 14,19; Jes. 22,2; Jer. 7,33 seq.; Jer. 9,22; ዝንቱ፡ አብድንት፡ Hez. 37,9; Tob. 12,12; Sir. 31,30; ዘአንሥአ፡ በድነ፡ እምነ፡ ሙታን፡ Sir. 48,5; Matth. 8,22; Apoc. 1,17; θνησιμαῖον Ps. 78,2; Jes. 5,25; τραυματίαι Jer. 14,18; Judith 2,8 al.; Ex. 22,2; κῶλα Num. 14,29; Num. 14,32; Hebr. 3,17; Jes. 66,24; σῶμα 1 Reg. 31,10; መዊቶሂ፡ ተነበየ፡ በድኑ፡ Sir. 48,13; Judith 13,9; Matth. 27,52; Matth. 27,58; እጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ በድን፡ υἱος ἀνθρώπου σκώληξ Job 25,6; de diis mortuis vel idolis Kuf. p. 81. b rarius brutorum ( morticinum ): Lev. 11,11; Lev. 11,24; Lev. 11,27; Lev. 5,2; Jud. 14,8.

woorden.betekenis: desertum, in campo et deserto, habitavit, solitudine, desola
woorden.definitie: I,l [بَدْوٌ desertum; بَدَا in campo et deserto habitavit; vis radicis prima est in solitudine, vic. בָּדַד بَدَّ] desolatum, vastum, desertum, incultum esse vel fieri, de terris, urbibus, domiciliis: ምድርክሙ፡ በድወ፡ ወአህጉሪክሙኒ፡ ውዕየ፡ Jes. 1,7; በድወት፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፡ Jes. 64,10 var.; Jer. 27,12 var.; ecclesia ተንሕለት፡ ወበድወት፡ Sx. Jac. 1; አብያቲሆሙ፡ በድወት፡ ወተመዝበረት፡ Abush. 50.

woorden.betekenis: locus vastus, desolatus, incultus, desertus, vastitas, deser
woorden.definitie: subst, m. et fem. (ut Jes. 42,11), locus vastus, desolatus, incultus, desertus, vastitas, desertum: Ex. 13,20; ውስተ፡ በድው፡ ἔρημος Ps. 54,7; Ps. 77,18; Ps. 77,20; Jes. 21,1; Jes. 32,15; በድው፡ ጽሙእ፡ Jes. 35,1; Jes. 35,6; Jes. 35,7 (ἡ ἄνυδρος); Jes. 41,18; Jes. 44,3; Jes. 62,4; Job 30,3; Hen. 61,5; Matth. 12,43; ምድረ፡ በድው፡ Ps. 62,3; 4 Esr. 9,29; Jes. 41,19; Jer. 2,31; Jer. 6,8 (ἄβατος γῆ); Jer. 9,2; Jer. 30,2; ብሔረ፡ በድው፡ Jer. 2,6; በድወ፡ ገዳም፡ Prov. 9,12; መካነ፡ በድው፡ Hen. 18,12; በድው፡ ፋራም፡ Kuf. p. 67; ባሕር፡ በድወ፡ ይመስሎ፡ Job 41,22; crebro praedicati vice usurpatur, ubi per adjectiva exponere licet: Matth. 23,38; ትተርፍ፡ ባሕቲታ፡ ምድሮሙ፡ በድወ፡ Jes. 6,11; በድወ፡ ትከውን፡ ኵላ፡ ምድር፡ Jer. 4,27; Tob. 14,4; Hez. 12,20; Hez. 35,4; Ps. 68,30; ረሰየ፡ በድወ፡ ἐρημοῦν Lev. 26,22; et adjectivi instar substantivo apponitur: የብስ፡ በድው፡ Hen. 60,9 var.; c.c. እምነ፡, ut: በድው፡ ውእቱ፡ እምሰብእ፡ ወእንስሳ፡ Jer. 40,10.

woorden.betekenis: vastatio, desolatio
woorden.definitie: n. act. vastatio, desolatio: ከመ፡ ኢይርአይ፡ ብድወታ፡ ለኢየሩሳሌም፡ Sx. Mij. 12.

woorden.betekenis: ovis, pecus ovillum, aries, agnus, baggǝʿ
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem. (Matth. 12,11; Luc. 15,4; Clem. f. 112; fem. በግዕት፡ vid. infra), coll. et sing., Pl. አባግዕ፡ (passim fem., ut Hez. 34,8; Gen. 29,2; Gen. 30,38; Hen. 82,19) et አባግዕት፡ (Reg. Pach.; Sx. Genb. 18 Enc.; F.N. 30) [amh. በግ፡; in caeteris linguis deest; fortasse onomatopoëtice dictum a balatu, cfr. بَغْبَغَةٌ] ovis sine discrimine sexus et annorum, pecus ovillum, raro collective ut Ex. 12,38; sing.: πρόβατον በግዕ፡ ዘተኀጥአ፡ Jes. 13,14; Jes. 53,7; በግዕ፡ ጽኑዕ፡ ወበግዕ፡ ድኩም፡ Hez. 34,20; Ex. 12,3; Lev. 3,6; Lev. 4,32; Lev. 14,10; Lev. 23,12; Pl.: Gen. 4,2; Gen. 4,4; Gen. 12,16; Gen. 33,13; Gen. 46,34; Ex. 9,3; Job 42,12; Jes. 7,21; Jes. 53,6; Jes. 60,7; Jer. 23,1; Zach. 11,4; Zach. 11,7; 2 Par. 30,24; 2 Par. 31,6; Ps. 73,1; Matth. 7,15; Matth. 9,36; Matth. 10,16; አባግዕ፡ አትቡዕ፡ κριοὶ προβάτων 2 Par. 17,11; አባግዕ፡ አንስት፡ Num. 7,17; κριός, κριοί aries: Gen. 15,9; Gen. 22,13; Ex. 26,14; Ex. 29,15 seq.; Lev. 9,2; Lev. 16,5; አባግዐ፡ ጸምር፡ 4 Reg. 3,4; 2 Par. 13,9; ἀμνός, ἀμνοί agnus: Lev. 14,12 seq.; Sir. 13,17; Jes. 53,7; Hez. 27,21; 2 Par. 29,32; ἄρνες, ἀρνίον Lev. 1,10; Jes. 1,11; Jes. 5,17; Jes. 11,6; Jes. 65,25; በግዕ፡ የዋህ፡ Jer. 11,19; transl. de hominibus: አባግዐ፡ ሰብእ፡ Hez. 36,38; Joh. 1,29; Joh. 1,36; Apoc. 5,6; Apoc. 12,11; Matth. 10,6; Matth. 15,24; Joh. 10,7; Joh. 10,8; Joh. 21,17. baggǝʿ C for ማሕስዕ፡ በግዕ vid. ማሕስዕ፡

woorden.betekenis: n. peregr. βῆτα, secunda alphabeti graeci litera,
woorden.definitie: n. peregr. βῆτα, secunda alphabeti graeci litera, Kid. f. 33, Reg. Pach. (vid. ሆህያት፡).

woorden.betekenis: vanum, inanem, irritum, frustra, incassum esse, evadere, in
woorden.definitie: I,1 בָּטַל ܒܛܶܠ بَطَلَ Subj. ይብጠል፡ 1 vanum, inanem, irritum, frustra vel incassum esse vel evadere, in irritum cadere: ደም፡ ዘይቀይእ፡ ኢይበጥል፡ Jsp. p. 302; ትበጥል፡ እንተ፡ መከርኩ፡ Kebr. Nag. 72; በጠለ፡ ዐቂበ፡ ትእዛዝ፡ እምኔየ፡ observatio praeceptorum frustra mihi incepta est Org. 5; sensu forensi, ut: cessio በጠለት፡ irrita est F.N. 39,3. 2 aboleri, abrogari, abolitum esse: ተጸርዐት፡ ኦሪት፡ በምጽአተ፡ ወንጌል፡ ወበጠለት፡ ትንቢት፡ በስብከተ፡ ሐዋርያት፡ M.M. f. 4; de juribus, pactis, al. F.N. 37. 3 interrumpi, cessare, finem capere: (Macedonius compellatur:) አብጠልከ፡ ግጻዌሁ፡ ለመንፈስ፡ ቅዱስ፤ ብጠልኬ፡ እምጾታ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ M.M. f. 313; ኢበጠለ፡ ጸልዕ፡ አላ፡ ጸንዐ፡ Jsp. p. 322.

woorden.betekenis: v. በጽላት፡ vid. sub ብጻል፡
woorden.definitie: v. በጽላት፡ vid. sub ብጻል፡

woorden.betekenis: pervenire, advenire, pervenisse, epistola tua pervenit, alla
woorden.definitie: I,1 [Aethiopibus tritissimum, caeteris inusitatum; non variatione radicis መጽአ፡, מָצָא ortum videtur; an ad פָּגַשׁ נָגַשׁ (הִשִּׂיג?) referendum?] Subj. ይብጻሕ፡ 1 pervenire, advenire, pervenisse, abs.: ዘበጽሐ፡ እምኤዶም፡ Jes. 63,l; በጽሐ፡ ብርሃንኪ፡ ἥκει Jes. 60,1; በጽሐ፡ መልእክትከ፡ epistola tua pervenit i.e. allata est Jsp. p. 316; Jsp. p. 322; በጽሐ፡ ማኅፈርነ፡ Sir. 29,27; c. ውስተ፡ loci Matth. 2,1; Job 38,16; Num. 13,27; Num. 20,1; Deut. 9,7; c. እስከ፡ loci Deut. 1,19; Deut. 1,20; c. Acc. loci: በጺሖ፡ ሐጌ፡ Jes. 10,28; Hen. 8,4; Hen. 45,2; c. ኀበ፡ pers. vel loci Kuf. 13; Job 38,22; Jes. 37,5; Dan. 6,20 (ἐγγίζειν); 4 Reg. 9,18 seq.; Ex. 3,9. 2 a de tempore: venisse, venire, appetere, adesse: በጽሐት፡ ዕለተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ πάρεστι Joel 2,1; ወበጽሐ፡ ሳብዕ፡ ወርኅ፡ 2 Esr. 18,1; ናሁ፡ ይበጽሕ፡ መዋዕል፡ Jer. 40,14 vers. nov.; አመ፡ ትበጽሕ፡ ይኃሪትከ፡ Sir. 30,32; ዘእንበለ፡ ይብጽሖሙ፡ ጊዜ፡ ሞቶሙ፡ Sir. 27,29; በጽሐ፡ጊዜ፡ ዘርእ፡ ለዘሪእ፡ Kuf.11; በጽሐ፡ ዕድሜ፡ Hez. 7,2; Hez. 7,6; Gen. 6,13. b de eventis, vaticiniis, desideriis, al.: evenire, evadere, ad finem vel exitum pervenire, impleri, consummari, Deut. 18,22; 3 Reg. 2,27; በጽሐ፡ (v. በጽሖ፡) ዝነገር፡ ሎቱ፡ Dan. 4,30; Kuf. p. 28; በጽሐ፡ በከመ፡ ነገረ፡ Kuf. 40; Jes. 48,3; Jes. 48,7; 4 Esr. 9,1; Matth. 26,56; Matth. 27,9. c nonnumquam: provectum esse: ዳዊት፡ ልህቀ፡ ወበጽሐ፡ መዋዕሊሁ፡ 1 Par. 23,1; በጽሐ፡ (ዓለም፡) ውስተ፡ ዓሥር፡ (ክፍል፡) 4 Esr. 14,9. 3 pervadere: በጽሐ፡ ስሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ Jos. 6,27; ጼናሁ፡ የሐውር፡ ወይበጽሕ፡ ነዊኀ፡ Hen. 32,4. 4 attingere, pertingere, pertinere, c. እስከ፡ Deut. 1,28; Ps. 18,4; ይበጽሕ፡ (ማይ፡) እስከ፡ ክሣድ፡ Jes. 8,7 vers. alt.; ትበጽሕ፡ (መንግሥትየ፡) እስከ፡ አጽናፈ፡ በሓውርት፡ Esth. 3,13 apocr.; Judith 7,3; c. ውስተ፡ Hen. 17,2; c. Acc.: ይበጽሕ፡ ደመናተ፡ ርእሱ፡ Hez. 31,3; ኑኁ፡ በጽሐ፡ ሰማየ፡ (v. እስከ፡ ሰማይ፡) Dan. 4,17; በጽሐኒ፡ ማይ፡ እስከ፡ ነፍስየ፡ Ps. 68,1. a prope accedere, prope abesse: በጽሐ፡ እስከ፡ ለሞት፡ Jes. 38,1; በጽሐ፡ ለሞት፡ (እስከ፡ ለሞት፡ Platt) Phil. 2,27; Phil. 2,30; Jes. 53,8. b attingere i.e. assequi, c. Acc., ዘእንበለ፡ ይበጽሑ፡ ምድረ፡ ግብ፡ Dan. 6,24; ለጻድቃን፡ ኢትበጽሖሙ፡ Sir. 28,22; ኢትበጽሕዎ፡ οὐ μὴ γὰρ ἐφίκησθε Sir. 43,30; አመ፡ በጽሐ፡ ፵ ዓመተ፡ 2 Reg. 15,7; mente: እፎ፡ እበጽሕ፡ ፍናዊከ፡ Lud. e V.S.; Org. 3. 5 supervenire alicui, invadere, attingere aliquem, obvenire, evenire, accidere alicui, c. Acc. pers.: መዋዕለ፡ ተጽናስ፡ በጽሐኒ፡ προέφθασέ με Job 30,27; Ps. 16,13; ἐπέπεσεν αὐτούς Gen. 14,15; እስከ፡ በጽሖሙ፡ ፍዳሆሙ፡ ἐλθῃ ἐπ᾽ αὐτούς Sir. 47,25; Jes. 63,4; ከመ፡ ትብጻሕከ፡ በረከቱ፡ Sir. 3,8; Jes. 28,15; 4 Esr. 8,70; በጽሐቶሙ፡ አምሳል፡ ዘመሰሉ፡ 2 Petr. 2,22; Hen. 108,7; ምንዳቤ፡ በጽሐኪ፡ Lit. Cyr.; ኀበ፡ ሞት፡ ኢይበጽሖ፡ Sx. Ter 27 Enc.; c. ላዕለ፡ pers. Koh. 8,14. 6 obtingere, contingere, de sorte et de rebus sorte divisis, c. ላዕለ፡ pers. 1 Reg. 10,21; 1 Reg. 14,41; c. Acc. Jos. 18,11; Jos. 19,1; ለከ፡ ይበጽሐከ፡ ርስታ፡ Tob. 6,12; c. ለ፡, ut: መክፈልት፡ ቡርክት፡ በጽሐት፡ ለሴም፡ Kuf. 8; venditione Lev. 25,27. 7 in arithmetica: evenire i.e. effici, colligi (cfr. بَلَغَ, مَبْلَغٌ) Hen. 74,10 seq.; ዘበጽሐ፡ እምትድምርት፡ Abush. 30. – Voc. Ae.: በጽሐ፡ ዘ፡ ደረሰ፡

woorden.betekenis: adducere, ducere, deducere, venire jubere, afferre, perferre
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 pervenire facere a adducere, ducere, deducere, c. Acc. pers. Marc. 13,11; c. Acc. loci: Gen. 12,15; ፈነወ፡ ሰብአ፡ ፈረስ፡ ያብጽሕዎሙ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፡ 1 Esr. 5,2; c. praep. ውስተ፡, ut: ብእሲት፡ ኄርት፡ ሠናይ፡ መክፈልታ፡ ወታበጽሖ፡ ለፈራሄ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ውስተ፡ መክፈልቱ፡ Sir. 26,3; c. ኀበ፡ Gen. 47,2; 1 Reg. 30,15; Judith 10,15; ወሰደኒ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፡ ወአብጽሐኒ፡ ኀበ፡ አንቀጽ፡ Hez. 8,3. α venire jubere: ፈነወ፡ ወአብጽሖ፡ ኀቤሁ፡ Sx. Masc. 13. β mira est versio ἐκδου θυγατέρα አብጽሓ፡ ለወለትከ፡ በዐቅማ፡ ወዕቀባ፡ Sir. 7,25. b afferre, perferre, epistolam 4 Reg. 5,6; አብጽሐ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ኀበ፡ ባሮክ፡ Rel. Bar.; Jsp. p. 331; nuntium: ትክልኑ፡ እላንተ፡ ነገረ፡ አብጽሖ፡ ኀበ፡ ኤርምያስ፡ ውስተ፡ ባቢሎን፡ Rel. Bar.; alias res, ut: አዘዘ፡ በአብጽሖተ፡ ቃራራ፡ Jsp. p. 339. c de viis, causis: ducere, ferre, inducere, adducere ad aliquid: ስምዐ፡ ሐሰት፡ ላዕለ፡ ነፍስ፡ ዘያበጽሕ፡ ለሞት፡ Sir. 26,5; ያበጽሕ፡ ለሞት፡ ሐዘን፡ ወትካዝ፡ Sir. 38,19; ደኃሪታ፡ (ለፍኖት፡) ታበጽሕ፡ ውስተ፡ ሲኦል፡ Prov. 14,12; መዐት፡ ያበጽሕ፡ ኀበ፡ ቀቲል፡ F.M. 4,1. d adducere ad finem: ከመ፡ ለፍጻሜ፡ ያብጽሕ፡ ወይግበር፡ ኵሎ፡ 1 Par. 29,19. 2 appetere vel appropinquare facere: አቅረብኪ፡ መዋዕለኪ፡ ወአብጻሕኪ፡ ዕድሜ፡ ዓመትኪ፡ Hez. 22,4. 3 a attingere facere (vel evehere aliquem ad ): ያበጽሕዎ፡ እስከ፡ ደመና፡ Sir. 13,23. b assequi facere, c. Acc. et ኀበ፡ rei, ut: አብጻሕክዎ፡ ኀበ፡ ዘተመነየ፡ Jsp. p. 338. c omisso objecto (sicut in Latino ad annum C perduxit et in Germano es auf 100 Jahre bringen ): perducere i.e. pervenire ad, assequi, c. ኀበ፡, ut: ኢያብጻሕኩ፡ ኀበ፡ ሥርዐቱ፡ ad gradum ejus nondum perveni Sx. Teq. 13; c. Acc., ut: እንተ፡ ኢያብጽሐት፡ መጠነ፡ አካል፡ (aliis in locis በጽሐት፡) maturam aetatem non assecuta F.N. 24,3; ሶበ፡ አብጽሐ፡ ዝኩ፡ ሕፃን፡ ዐቅመ፡ ውርዛዌ፡ Sx. Haml. 26. 4 a referre vel deferre aliquid ad aliquem i.e. indicare, nuntiare: ናብጽሕ፡ ለከ፡ ὑποδεικνύομέν σοι 1 Esr. 2,20. b facere ut aliquid redundet ex aliqua re i.e. argumentis efficere, demonstrare, probare, convincere: ለእመ፡ አብጻሕክሙ፡ ሊተ፡ ከመ፡ ቤል፡ ይበልዕ፡ ἐὰν δείξητε ὅτι Dan. apocr. 13,9; ἐπιδεικνύναι Act. 18,28; παρατίθεσται Act. 17,3; συμβιβάζειν Act. 9,22 Platt; ኢይክሉ፡ አብጽሖ፡ ሊተ፡ በዘ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘያስተዋድዩኒ፡ Act. 24,13 rom.; Act. 25,18 Platt.

woorden.betekenis: supervenire, convenire, consociari, secum ducere, deducere,
woorden.definitie: III,3 1 supervenire alicui: እስከ፡ ይትባጽሖሙ፡ ወይዳደቆሙ፡ መዐተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ F.M. 17,2. 2 convenire i.e. consociari cum aliquo: (vita spiritualis est) ተባጽሖታ፡ ለልብ፡ ምስለ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Phlx. 110. 3 secum ducere vel deducere vel trahere (cfr. ተማልዐ፡) spec. in jus: c. Acc. pers. Act. 19,37 { et c.} ኀበ፡ judicis Marc. 13,9; Luc. 12,58: Act. 18,12.

woorden.betekenis: perventio, adventus, probatio, id quod efficitur
woorden.definitie: n. act. 1 perventio, adventus Sx. Haml. 19; Phlx. 194; Sx. Tachs. 10Enc.; ብጽሐትከ፡ ኀቤየ፡ Gad. T.H.; ሶበ፡ አእመረ፡ ብጽሐቶሙ፡ እምቤተ፡ መቅደስ፡ Jsp. p. 286; ጊዜ፡ ብጽሐተ፡ ሐጋይ፡ F.N. 10,6; መጽሐፍ፡ (epistola) ብጽሐት፡ ወአስተፍሥሐተኒ፡ በብጽሐታ፡ Jsp. p. 315. 2 prolatio rei testimonii causa i.e. probatio, c. በ፡ rei probandae Act. 24,13 Platt. 3 id quod efficitur, in arithmetica, Abush. 9.

woorden.betekenis: locus quo quis pervenit, perducitur, defertur, id quod effic
woorden.definitie: subst. 1 locus quo quis pervenit, perducitur, defertur, Gad. Kar. 2 in arithmetica: id quod efficitur, etiam residuum vel reliquum (detracto numero minore a majore) Hen. 74,11.

woorden.betekenis: inus., sine dubio a በፀወ፡ et radicibus sub በፀወ፡ lau
woorden.definitie: inus., sine dubio a በፀወ፡ et radicibus sub በፀወ፡ laudatis haud multum differens.

woorden.betekenis: linum, lini semen
woorden.definitie: , ተለቤ፡, ትላቤ፡, ተላቤ፡, ተልቤ፡ (ተልባ፡), subst. m., linum herba, Ex. 9,31 c. varr.; እመ፡ ዘራእከ፡ ከሚረ፡ ተአርርኑ፡ ተልቤ፡ Macc. f. 5; ተለቤ፡ ዘኢነሥኡ፡ ፍሬሁ፡ (materia ignis) Sx. Haml. 5; forma ተልባ፡ lini semen (vid. Isenberg p. 95) legitur in M.F. [An ad لَوَى referendum?]. { Vid. Bruce III 116; Rüppell II 20; Harris II Anh. p. 34.}

woorden.betekenis: suspendi, adhaesit, affixus est, secutus est, hangen an, adh
woorden.definitie: I,1, [תָּלָה ܬܠܳܐ suspendi; intransit. adhaesit, affixus est; تَلَا secutus est; proprie: hangen an ] Subj. ይትሉ፡ (at ይትለው፡ Luc. 21,8 rom.; Rom. 12,9 Polygl.) 1 adhaerere, adhaerescere ( deditum esse, studio propensum vel defixum esse ) κολλᾶσθαι, προςκολλᾶσθαι, c.c. ኀበ፡ pers.: ተለወ፡ ነፍሱ፡ ኀቤሃ፡ ጥቀ፡ Tob. 6,18; ትተሉ፡ ነፍሶሙ፡ ኀቤየ፡ Kuf. 1; ተለወት፡ ነፍሶሙ፡ ኀበ፡ ጣዖት፡ Kuf. 12; { c. በ፡ rei Jer. 18,12 vid. sub ዕልወት፡;}c. ምስለ፡ Ruth 2,21; Ruth 2,22; Sir. 13,16; c. Acc. Gen. 2,21; Matth. 19,5 ዘይተልዋ፡ ለዘማ፡ Sir. 19,2; Ps. 100,5: c. መንገለ፡ 1 Reg. 25,25. 2 sequi, sectari, subsequi, obsequi, abs.: Matth. 21,9; c. Acc. pers. Ruth 1,14; Ruth 2,3; Ruth 2,8; Ruth 2,9; Ruth 3,10; Num. 22,20; 1 Reg. 13,7; 1 Reg. 25,42; Hen. 89,22; Hen. 89,23; እመ፡ ተለወ፡ ልብየ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ብእሲ፡ Job 31,9; Matth. 4,20; Matth. 8,10; Matth. 9,19; Marc. 3,7; Joh. 21,20; Apoc. 14,13; ሠናይ፡ ተሊዎቱ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ Sir. 46,10; 2,3; ኀደግነ፡ ተሊዎቶ፡ ለአምላክነ፡ Jes. 59,13; ተሊወ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Ps. 72,27; vel c. Acc. rei: 4 Esr. 7,23; ትልዉ፡ ፍኖትየ፡ ወስምዑኒ፡ Jes. 55,3; ተለዉ፡ ኀጢአቶሙ፡ Jes. 65,2; ትሉ፡ አሠራ፡ Sir. 6,27; ኢትትሉ፡ ፈቃዳ፡ ለኀጢአት፡ Sir. 18,30; እለ፡ ይተልዉ፡ ሕጎ፡ Sir. 18,14; እመ፡ ተለውከ፡ ቃለ፡ (v. በቃለ፡) አመትከ፡ Judith 11,6; 1 Petr. 2,21; 1 Tim. 5,10; Rom. 12,9; c. ድኅረ፡ pers.: Matth. 10,38; ትሉ፡ ድኅሬየ፡ Prov. 24,42; Ps. 62,8; Jer. 2,2; vel rei: Koh. 2,11; ተለወ፡ ልብየ፡ ድኅረ፡ ዐይንየ፡ Job 31,7; vel c. Acc. et ድኅረ፡ pers. vel rei: ትተልዎ፡ ድኅረ፡ እገሪሁ፡ Jes. 41,2; ይተልዉከ፡ ድኅሬከ፡ Jes. 45,14; ትልዋ፡ ድኅሬሃ፡ Sir. 14,22; Matth. 4,19; 2 Petr. 2,10; c. ውስተ፡ rei 1 Cor. 12,11. Nonnumquam: venire post alium, succedere, 2 Reg. 21,1 var.; c. Acc. Apoc. 14,8; Apoc. 14,9; ይሢሙ፡ ህየንቴሁ፡ ካልአ፡ ዘይተልዎ፡ F.N. 4. 3 persequi, insequi hostili modo: ዴገኖሙ፡ ወተለዎሙ፡ Gen. 14,14; ኢተለውዎሙ፡ ድኅሬሆሙ፡ Gen. 35,5; Gen. 44,4; Jos. 2,5; Jud. 4,16; Jud. 8,5; 1 Reg. 23,25; 1 Reg. 24,15; 2 Reg. 17,1; 2 Reg. 20,10; 4 urgere, instare, Luc. 12,48; Voc. Ae.: ዴገነ፡ ወተለወ፡ ዘ፡ ተከተለ።

woorden.betekenis: alterum alterum, sese invicem sequi, excipere, alium post al
woorden.definitie: III,3 a alterum alterum vel sese invicem sequi vel excipere 2 Reg. 21,1; Num. 2,17; እንዘ፡ ይታልዉ፡ ፩ድኅረ፡ ፩፡ Sx. Tachs. 23. b alium post alium ( ex ordine ) sequi aliquem: ይታለዎ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዝንቱ፡ መርገም፡ Deut. 29,19; servavit eos እሞት፡ በማእከለ፡ ግብጽ፡ ወእመከራ፡ ብዙኅ፡ እንተ፡ ተታለወት፡ Chrys. ho. 27; በተታልዎ፡; omnes deinceps vel alius post alium vel ex ordine Mich. 1,5 gloss. c se invicem consociare (de maribus et feminis) coeundi causa Hen. 82,19 ( sich paaren ).

woorden.betekenis: humilem, humiliorem fieri
woorden.definitie: vel ትሕተ፡ I,1 [cfr. תַּחַת ܬܰܚܬ تَحْتٌ, Ges. thes. p. 1495] Subj. ይትሐት፡ humilem vel humiliorem fieri: ኵሉ፡ ደብር፡ ወአውግር፡ ይትሐት: Jes. 40,4 in Cod. Laur. et Luc. 3,5 rom.

woorden.betekenis: humiliare, deprimere
