Gen. 20,6 et Gen. 20,5); በንጹሕ፡ ἐν σεμνότητι 1 Tim. 2,2; 1 Tim. 3,4 rom.; ይዕቀቡ፡ ሥጋሆሙ፡ በንጹሕ፡ Clem. f. 118; ንጽሕት፡ σεμνότης Herm. p. 15; ἁγνεία Herm. p. 91. 3 ንጹሐ፡ adverbialiter usurpatur: ዘየሐውር፡ ንጹሐ፡ Prov. 20,7; ነባሪ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ንጹሐ፡ (v. በንጹሕ፡) ይትለአክ፡ Sir. 10,25; Lud. e Lit.

woorden.betekenis: purificatio, purgatio, puritas, castitas, continentia, tempe
woorden.definitie: subst., 1 purificatio, purgatio, መዋዕለ፡ ንጽሓ፡, ደመ፡ ንጽሓ፡ Lev. 12,4; Lev. 12,5; Lev. 12,6; Kuf. 3; Luc. 2,22. 2 puritas: ንጽሐ፡ ነፍስ፡ ወአኮ፡ ንጽሐ፡ ሥጋ፡ Lit. 173,3; ንጽሐ፡ እደዊከ፡ Job 22,30; Ps. 17,23; Ps. 17,27; ያገብእ፡ ለከ፡ ንጽሐከ፡ Job 22,25; ሃይማኖተ፡ ንጽሕ፡ Asc. Jes. 3,21. In specie: a castitas, continentia, temperantia, opp. ዝሙት፡ Fal. f. 23; ἐγκράτεια Act. 24,25; በንጽሕ፡ σωφρόνος Tit. 2,12; ንጽሕ፡ ወጥበብ፤ ጽድቅ፡ ወጽንዕ፡ σωφροσύνη φρόνησις δικαιοσύνη ἀνδρεία Sap. 8,7. b integritas, innocentia 1 Thess. 2,10; 1 Thess. 3,13; 1 Thess. 5,23. c sanctimonia: Phil. 1,17; l Petr. 3,2; 2 Cor. 6,6; 2 Cor. 7,11; 1 Tim. 4,12; 1 Tim. 5,2; Phil. 4,8. 3 raro: nitor a serenitas coeli, καθαριότης Sir. 43,1. b majestas, splendor regis Ps. 88,43. nǝṣḥ C for ለባሴ፡ ንጽሕ፡ vid. ለባሲ፡ (Grébaut)

woorden.betekenis: puritas, purgatio
woorden.definitie: n. act. puritas, purgatio: አልቦ፡ ክቡር፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ከመ፡ ንጽሐተ፡ ልብ፡ Phlx. 15.

woorden.betekenis: puritas, integritas, innocentia, sanctimonia, castitas
woorden.definitie: subst. puritas, integritas, innocentia, sanctimonia, castitas: ንጽሕና፡ መንፈስ፡ Lit. 173,3; Lit. 171,1; Phlx. 102; Phlx. 163; Kedr f. 12; Macc. f. 25; ይኄይስ፡ ንጽሕና፡ ምስለ፡ ንዴት፡ እምብዕል፡ ምስለ፡ ዝሙት፡ Fal. f. 70.

woorden.betekenis: custodivit, observavit, spectare, intueri, spectatorem esse,
woorden.definitie: I,2 [amh. id.; نَظَرَ id.; נָצַר ܢܛܰܪ (نطر) custodivit, observavit ] 1 spectare, intueri a absol.: በከመ፡ አዕይንቲከ፡ ይኔጽራ፡ βλέπουσι Jer. 49,2; ከመ፡ መዋቲኑ፡ ትኔጽር፡ ወትሬኢ፡ Job 10,4; ነጽር፡ ወርኢ፡ ኀሳረነ፡ Thren. 5,1; Hen. 14,25; Rom. 11,8. α spectatorem esse ( zusehen ): አበዊሆሙኒ፡፡ ይኔጽሩ፡ Kuf. 5. β speculari: ዘይኔጽር፡ σκοπός 2 Reg. 13,34. b c. Acc. vel c. variis praepositionibus α aspicere, inspicere, c. Acc.: Marc. 14,67; ኢነጸርክዋ፡ ለድንግል፡ Job 31,1; ነጽረነ፡ Jes. 64,9; Ps. 12,3; Ps. 103,33; ዘይኔጽር፡ ደመና፡ Koh. 11,4; ነጺርየ፡ ገጸክሙ፡ Job 6,28; ኢይኔጽር፡ ምግባሮሙ፡ ለኃጥኣን፡ Job 21,16; Hen. 22,2; Hen.81,1; ነጽሮቶ፡ Hen. 89,31; 4 Esr. 8,31; 4 Esr. 8,34; c. ውስተ፡ Jes. 5,30. β conspicere Hen. 21,7. γ circumspicere: ነጽሪ፡ ዐውደኪ፡ Clem. f. 104; Jes. 60,4. δ oculos convertere in aliquem vel aliquid: ነጸረ፡ ለፌ፡ ወለፌ፡ Ex. 2,11; Hen. 39,14; c. ኀበ፡, ut: ይኔጽራ፡ አዕይንቲሁ፡ ኀበ፡ ቅዱስ፡ እስራኤል፡ Jes. 17,7; Jes. 66,2; Hos. 3,1; Ex. 33,8; Act. 3,4; Chrys. ho. 7; ኢንኔጽር፡ ኀበ፡ ዝየ፡ Chrys. Ta. 16; c. ውስተ፡, ut: ነጽር፡ ውስተ፡ ሰማይ፡ Kuf. 14; Ruth 2,9; Gen. 15,5; Ps. 39,6. ε suspicere: ነጸረ፡ ሰማየ፡ (ἀναβλέψας εἰς) Luc. 9,16; Dan. apocr. 1,35; Jes. 8,21; Jes. 8,22; ስእንኩ፡ ነጽሮ፡ ኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ሰማየ፡ Jes. 38,14; Jes. 51,6; ζ despicere: ትኔጽሩ፡ ላዕለ፡ ውስተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ወታሕተ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ Jes. 8,21; Jes. 8,22; እምሰማይ፡ Lit. 170,3; Deut. 26,15. η oculis prosequi, retro respicere: ነጸረ፡ ይኅሬሁ፡ 1 Reg. 24,9; Gen. 19,17; Gen. 19,26. θ spectatorem adesse rei: ካህናት፡ ኢይኔጽሩ፡ ተውኔተ፡ ወኢዘፈነ፡ F.M. 32,7. ι cum voluptate intueri aliquid: c. Acc. Job 10,4. κ prospicere super aliquid, perlustrare, c. መልዕልተ፡ Hen. 32,l; c. ዲበ፡ Koh. 2,11. λ contemplari, observare: እለ፡ ያሰግሉ፡ ለኪ፡ ወይኔጽሩ፡ ሰማየ፡ οἱ ἀστρολόγοι οὐρανοῦ Jes. 47,13. μ de rebus inanimatis: spectare regionem, ut: ልሳን፡ እንተ፡ ትኔጽር፡ መንገለ፡ ሰሜን፡ Kuf. 8; Hez. 11,1; አንቀጽ፡ ዘይኔጽር፡ ደቡበ፡ Hez. 8,3; Hez. 9,2; Prov. 16,25. ν ex adverso esse alicui, c. ለ፡ Hen. 41,7 (vid. ተናጸረ፡). 2 a respicere, curare, rationem habere, c. Acc. 1 Reg. 16,7; Ps. 12,3; c. ውስተ፡ Ps. 73,21; c. በ፡, ut: ነጺሮ፡ በናእሰ፡ መዋዕሊሁ፡ ወልህቅናሁ፡ respectu habito sive adolescentiae sive senectutis ejus F.M. 10,3. b animum attendere vel advertere ad aliquid, προσέχειν, ንባበ፡ ዚአየ፡ ነጽር፡ Prov. 4,20; Prov. 5,1; Prov. 5,3; Prov. 17,4; c. ውስተ፡ Ps. 69,1. c considerare, deliberare (نظر c. في): ሰአልዎ፡ ከመ፡ ያስተጋብእ፡ ማኅበረ፡ ከመ፡ ይነጽሩ፡ በእንተ፡ ክሕደቶሙ፡ ለእሉ፡ ፫ ከሓድያን፡ Sx. Jac. 1. — Voc. Ae.: ነጸረ፡ ወርእየ፡ ዘ፡ ሐየ፡; aliud: ነጸረ፡ ርእየ፡ አስተሐየጸ፡ ብ፡ ተመለከተ።

woorden.betekenis: oculos, faciem convertere, in adversum, via recta, suspicere
woorden.definitie: II,1 oculos vel faciem convertere: አንጸሩ፡ መንገለ፡ ሶዶም፡ Gen. 18,16; እስመ፡ ኀበ፡ አንጸረ፡ ይወጽእ፡ ἀλλ᾽ ἢ κατ᾽ εὐθὺ αὐτῆς ἐξελεύσεται, i.e. in adversum vel via recta Hez. 46,9; sursum ( suspicere ) Lit. 172,3. ʾanṣara አንጸረ፡ በአጽባዕቱ፡, በአጻብዑ፡ point at, indicate with a finger እስመ፡ ነአምር፡ ከመ፡ ትሜግቦ፡ እድ፡ ጽንዕት፡ ወመዝራዕት፡ ልዕልት፡ ኀበ፡ ሐለየ፡ በልቡ፡ ወኀበ፡ አንጸረ፡ በአፅባዕቱ። ‘ car nous savons qu’une main puissante et un bras redoutable l’aident où il veut aller at où il fait signe du doigt ’ 80 l. 31-32 (ed.), 92 l. 17-19 (tr.), ዝኒ፡ መዊአ፡ አፅራር፡ ዘይከውን፡ ለእግዚእነ፡ ኀበ፡ ኀለየ፡ በልቡ፡ ወኀበ፡ አንጸረ፡ በአፃብኡ፡ ‘ Au contraire, la victoire sur les ennemis, qui es donnée à notre maître, partout où son cœer médite et ses doigts font signe de se rendre ’ 103 l. 14-15 (ed.), 117 l. 23-25 (tr.)

woorden.betekenis: sese invicem intueri, aspicere, adversis oculis intueri, e r
woorden.definitie: III,3 1 sese invicem intueri vel aspicere, c. በበይናት፡ vel ምስለ፡, ut: ወእምዝ፡ ተናጸሩ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ወመገብቱ፡ በበይናቲሆሙ፡ ἔβλεπον εἷς τὸν ἕτερον 1 Esr. 4,33; Joh. 13,22. a explorandi causa: ተናጸሩ፡ ክልኤሆሙ፡ ἀνετάζοντες ἀλλήλους Dan. apocr. 1,14. b obnitendi vel inquirendi causa, adversis oculis intueri aliquem: ኢንጉሥ፡ ወኢመስፍን፡ ተናጽሮ፡ ኢይክል፡ ምስሌከ፡ እንዘ፡ የሐምየከ፡ በእንተ፡ እለ፡ ኰነንኮሙ፡ ἀντοφθαλμῆσαι Sap. 12,14. c e regione alicujus vel exadverso esse (situm, positum): ገጾን፡ ይትናጸራ፡ በበይኖን፡ Ex. 25,20; ትትናጸሩ፡ በበይናቲክሙ፡ κατέναντι ἀλλήλων Am. 4,3; ወይትናጸሩ፡ ገጾሙ፡ Hez. 1,8; አንቀጸ፡ ዐጸድ፡ ውሣጢ፡ ይትናጸር፡ ምስለ፡ አንቀጽ፡ ሰሜናዊ፡ Hez. 40,23; συστοιχεῖν ( parallelum esse ) Gal. 4,25. d coram aliquo esse vel stare, c. Acc.: tres viri, ዘኢይትናጸሮሙ፡ ተቃኅዎ፡ ወቅንአት፡ . p. 504 Nr. 48; ቃሎሙ፡ ጽዱቅ፡ ዘኢይትናጸር፡ ሕሳዌ፡ ወጽልሑት፡ Lud. e Mss. Colb. 2 cavere, seq. እምነ፡ Kuf. p. 121(Vers. Lat.: attendant ab ipsis ).

woorden.betekenis: sternere, substernere, lectum sternere
woorden.definitie: I,1 [amh. id., sed intransit.; vic. videntur ጸፍጸፈ፡, صفّ, رصف (Hebraei frequentant יָצַע)], sternere, substernere, c. Acc. rei substratae, ut: ነጸፉ፡ አልባሲሆሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ፍኖት፡ Matth. 21,8; 4 Reg. 9,13; ቈጽለ፡ Marc. 11,8; ሠቀ፡ ወሐመደ፡ ነጸፉ፡ ሎሙ፡ Esth. 4,3; Hez. 27,30; ዘርቤታተ፡ ነጸፍኩ፡ Prov. 7,16; Did. 2; ህየ፡ ነጸፍኪ፡ ምስካቢኪ፡ Jes. 57,7; Judith 12,15; ንነጽፍ፡ ሎቱ፡ ዐራተ፡ 4 Reg. 4,10; in specie: lectum sternere, ut: ነጸፈ፡ ሎቱ፡ 1 Reg. 9,25.

woorden.betekenis: dejici, projici, sterni, prosterni, corruere, concidere, pro
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 pass. a dejici, projici, sterni, prosterni: ብዙኅ፡ አብድንቲሆሙ፡ ዘይትነፃኅ፡ ውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ በሓውርት፡ Am. 8,3; ይትነፅኁ፡ በውስተ፡ ፍናወ፡ አህጉሪሆሙ፡ Judith 7,14; 1 Cor. 10,5; Lit. 169,1; Pisidia ዲበ፡ ምድር፡ ትትነፃኅ፡ Kid. f. 5. b corruere, concidere: ፍጡነ፡ ትትነፃኅ፡ ውስተ፡ ገጸ፡ ገዳም፡ Hez. 29,5; Act. 5,5; Act. 26,14 rom.; ሰማይ፡ ይትነፃኅ፡ Hen. 83,3. c prostratum jacere: እለ፡ ይትነፅኁ፡ (v. ተነፅኁ፡) ውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ፍናዋት፡ ከመ፡ ሐምለ፡ ቅብእ፡ ዕቡር፡ (καθεύδοντες) Jes. 51,20; ረከቦ፡ ለአቡሁ፡ ተነፂኖ፡ Jsp. p. 280. 2 reflex. a se projicere vel praecipitare: ተነፅኀት፡ ለሊሃ፡ እመካን፡ ልዑል፡ ዲበ፡ ምድር፡ ከመ፡ ትሙት፡ ወኢሞተት፡ Jsp. p. 336. b se prosternere: አሜሃ፡ ተነፅኀ፡ አበ፡ ሕፃን፡ ወሰገደ፡ ታሕተ፡ እግረ፡ አባ፡ ዘይኑን፡ Sx. Jac. 3.

woorden.betekenis: spirare, flare
woorden.definitie: I,1 [נפשׁ ܢܦܫ نفس] spirare, flare, de vento: ፬ ነፋሳት፡ ነፍሱ፡ (v. pro ይነፍኁ፡) Dan. 7,2; ነፋሳት፡ ይነፍሱ፡ ዲበ፡ ምድር፡ Hen. 76,1.

woorden.betekenis: respirare, spiritum ducere, anhelare, animatus, vivus, animo
woorden.definitie: IV,1 1 respirare a spiritum ducere, anhelare: ዘያስተነፍስ፡ animatus (i.e. vivus ) Genz. f. 152; ሶበ፡ ያስተነፍስ፡ εὔψυχος ( animatus i.e. animosus ) Prov. 24,66. b ut videtur odorari Lit. 170,3. c animam recipere, recreari: ከመ፡ ያስተንፍስ፡ ወልደ፡ አመትከ፡ ἀναψύξῃ Ex. 23,12. d spirare i.e. aestum remittere: እስከ፡ ሶበ፡ ታስተነፍስ፡ ዕለት፡ Cant. 2,17; Cant. 4,6. 2 inspirare, inflare: እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘአስተንፈሰ፡ ቦቱ፡ ነፍሰ፡ Sap. 15,11; መጻሕፍተ፡ ሐሰት፡ ዘአስተንፈሰ፡ ሰይጣን፡ ውስተ፡ አፉሆሙ፡ M.M. f. 50; መንፈስ፡ ቅዱስ፡ ዘአስተንፈሰ፡ ቦሙ፡ (ለነቢያት፡) በእስትንፋሰ፡ አፉሁ፡ M.M. f. 268. 3 recreare, reficere: አስተንፈስከ፡ ለልብየ፡ Lud. e Mss. Colb.

woorden.betekenis: anima, animus, halitus, spiritus, usque ad extremum spiritum
woorden.definitie: subst., fem. et m., Pl. ነፍሳት፡ anima, animus 1 halitus, spiritus: እምጣነ፡ ሕያው፡ አንተ፡ ወሀለወት፡ ነፍስከ፡ πνοή Sir. 30,29; Job 27,3; Jes. 38,16; ነፍሱሂ፡ ፍሕም፡ ይእቲ፡ Job 41,13; Act. 17,25; Ps. 118,31; እስከ፡ ነፍስ፡ ደኃሪት፡ usque ad extremum spiritum Lit. 173,1. 2 anima i.e. vis vitalis, vita: ነፍሰ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሕያው፡ Job 12,10; ሀለወት፡ ነፍሱ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ Act. 20,10; አልጸቀት፡ ትፃእ፡ ነፍሳ፡ Gen. 35,18; ትግባእ፡ ነፍሱ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ 3 Reg. 17,21; ትሕዮ፡ ነፍስየ፡ Gen. 12,13; ሐይወት፡ ነፍስከ፡ 1 Reg. 1,26; 1 Reg. 17,55; ለትሙት፡ ነፍስየ፡ Jud. 16,30; ነፍሶሙ፡ መጠዉ፡ reddiderunt animam i.e. exspiraverunt Sx. Hed. 3Enc.; Luc. 23,46; መጠወ፡ ነፍሶ፡ በእንተ፡ Sir. 7,20 vel ህየንተ፡ Sir. 29,15; የኀሥሥዋ፡ ለነፍሶ፡ Matth. 2,20; ቀታሌ፡ ነፍስ፡ Hez. 18,10; Matth. 19,18; ይቀትሎ፡ ነፍሶ፡ Deut. 22,26; Gen. 9,4; Gen. 9,5; Lev. 17,14; Deut. 19,21; ዕቀቡ፡ ነፍሰክሙ፡ Deut. 4,15; Ps. 3,2; Ps. 68,1; Matth. 6,25; Matth. 10,28; Matth. 20,28; Marc. 3,4; Marc. 10,45; Luc. 12,22; Hebr. 4,12; ነፍስ፡ ነባቢት፡ anima rationalis Lit. Chrys.; እስመ፡ ፪ ነፍሳት፡ ሀለዋ፡ ኀበ፡ ሰብእ፤ አሐቲ፡ መንፈሰ፡ ሕይወት፡ ዘወፅአት፡ እምአፉሁ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ወኢትትኌለቍ፡ ምስለ፡ ጠባይዕ፡ ወኢትመውትሂ፤ ወአሐቲመ፡ ደመ፡ ነፍስት፡ ይእቲ፡ እምጠባይዕ፡ ወይእቲሰ፡ መዋቲት፡ Org. (vid. sub ዐብረ፡) a ዘነፍስ፡ anima praeditum, animatum, animans opp. ዘአልቦ፡ ነፍስ፡ inanimatum 4 Esr. 4,55; ኵሉ፡ ዘነፍስ፡ πᾶσα σάρξ omnes mortales Jes. 40,5; Jes. 49,26; Jes. 66,16; Jes. 66,23; Hez. 21,5; Sir. 14,17; Sir. 17,4; Rom. 3,20. b ዘነፍስ፡ ψυχικός animalis (opp. rationalis et spiritualis) 1 Cor. 2,14; 1 Cor. 15,44. c anima (a corpore separata) mortuorum, manes: ከመ፡ ታዕርፍ፡ ነፍሱ፡ Sir. 38,23; Job 14,22; ትረክቡ፡ ሕይወተ፡ ዘለዓለም፡ ወክፍለ፡ ምስለ፡ ነፍሳተ፡ ጻድቃን፡ በመንግሥተ፡ ሰማያት፡ Did. 34; Hen. 22,3; Hen. 22,9; Hen. 22,11 seq.; Apoc. 6,9; Apoc. 20,4; 1 Petr. 3,19. 3 animus (ψυχή et πνεύμα, etiam καρδία et θυμός): Ps. 6,3; Ps. 41,2; Ps. 85,3; Ps. 103,1; Ps. 138,13; Ps. 142,10; Koh. 6,3; Koh. 6,7; Koh. 7,28; ኵሉ፡ ነፍስ፡ ይደነግፅ፡ Jes. 13,7; Jes. 19,3 (πνεῦμα); Jes. 42,5 (πνεῦμα); Gen. 27,4; 1 Reg. 1,15; 1 Reg. 20,4; Matth. 11,29; Matth. 26,38; Luc. 1,46; l Thess. 5,23 (πνεῦμα); በፍትወተ፡ ነፍሶሙ፡ Judae 19; አፍቅሮ፡ እምነፍስከ፡ Sir. 7,21; በኵሉ፡ ነፍስከ፡ Sir. 6,26; Sir. 7,29; Deut. 4,29; Matth. 22,37; καρδία Sir. 37,13; Sir. 38,20; ነፍስ፡ ጠባብ፡ ψυχή πεπαιδευμένη Sir. 26,14; ነፍስ፡ መስተዓግሥት፡ ψυχή εγκρατής Sir. 26,15; ነፍስ፡ እንተ፡ ትፈርሆ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ πνεῦμα φοβούμενων Sir. 31,14; ነፍሳተ፡ አራዊት፡ θυμοὶ θηρίων Sap. 7,20. 4 animans: ኵሉ፡ ነፍሰ፡ ሕይወት፡ Gen. 1,21; Gen. 9,12; Gen. 9,15; ነፍሰ፡ ሕያው፡ Gen. 9,10; Lev. 11,10. a in specie homo, persona: Lev. 4,27; Lev. 5,1; Lev. 5,2; Act. 3,23; ነፍስ፡ ሕዝንት፡ Sir. 4,2; ነፍስ፡ መዐትም፡ Sir. 23,16; ነፍስ፡ እንተ፡ ተኀሥሦ፡ Thren. 3,26; ነፍሳቲነ፡ (v. ነፍስትነ፡) αἱ ἰδέαι ἡμῶν Dan. 1,13; in censu populi: Gen. 46,27; Deut. 10,22; Kuf. 44; Act. 2,41; Act. 7,14; ኵሉ፡ ነፍሳት፡ ዘአትረፈ፡ Jer. 50,6; ወኢአሐቲ፡ ነፍስ፡ Judith 10,13; ፸፻ ነፍስ፡ ὀνόματα Apoc. 11,13. b de mancipiis: በነፍሰ፡ ሰብእ፡ Hez. 27,13; Apoc. 18,13. c de mortuo vel cadavere: ነፍስ፡ እንተ፡ ሞተት፡ Lev. 21,11; Num. 6,6; ነፍስ፡ Lev. 21,1; ምስለ፡ ነፍሰ፡ ሕፃን፡ Sx. Jac. 11 Enc. d spiritus coelestes vel daemones: Hen. 69,22; ነፍሳት፡ ርኩሳት፡ ወአጋንንት፡ Hen. 99,7; Hen. 15,12; Hen. 69,12; coll. እምነፍሰ፡ አጋንንት፡ Jac. 3,15. 5 cum pron. suff.: ipse (quamquam rarius usitatum), ut: ከመ፡ ኢታውድቅ፡ ነፍሰከ፡ εἰς πτῶσίν σου Sir. 4,22; Job 4,20; Rom. 13,9; መጠወ፡ ነፍሶ፡ ለሞት፡ Lit. Chrys. nafs በነፍስ፡ በደም፡ banafs badam, በነፍስ፡ ወበደም፡ banafs wabadam Conti Rossini translates it as ‘for reasons of time’, see below, but his rendering seems incorrect ዝኵሉ፡ ሐደስኩ፡ አነ፡ ልብነ፡ ድንግል፡ ከመ፡ ኢይባእ፡ መኰንን፡ እመሂ፡ አፈ፡ መኰንን፡ እመሂ፡ አንበሳ፡ ወእመሂ፡ ፈረስ፡ እመሂ፡ በነፍስ፡ በደም፡ ወእመሂ፡ በቀደስተይና። ‘J’ai confirmé tout cela; que personne ne puisse y entrer, ni le gouverneur, ni le procureur du gouverneur (afa makuannen), ni le lion ni le cavalier, ni pour raisons temporelles ni sous prétextes ecclésiastiques (?)’ 32 l. 24–26 (ed.), 38 l. 1–4 (tr.); ወአውገዝነ፡ በአፈ፡ ጳጳስነ፡ አባ፡ ማርቆስ፡ ወበአፈ፡ አብ፡ ወወልድ፡ ወመንፈስ፡ ቅዱስ፡ ወበአፉሃ፡ ለእግዝእትነ፡ ማርያም፡ ከመ፡ ኢይታዓደዎ፡ ትግሬ፡ መኰንን፡ በነፍስ፡ ወበደም፡ ‘Sous peine d’excommunication par la bouche de notre métropolite abbā Mārqos, par la bouche du Père, du Fils et du saint Esprit, et par la bouche de Notre-Dame Marie, nous avons défendu au gouverneur du Tigré de violer ce fief, pour l’âme et pour le sang’ 34 l. 24–27 (ed.), 40 l. 22–26 (tr.) L ነፍሰ፡ ሕይወት nafsa ḥǝywat living creature, vid. ሕይወት፡ 252b C a for ሊቀ፡ ነፍስ፡ vid. ሊቅ፡ (Leslau) b for መሥዋዕተ፡ ነፍስ፡ vid. መሥዋዕት፡

woorden.betekenis: ventus, aër, aurae
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m. (fem. Act. 27,14 Platt), Pl. ነፋሳት፡ (Matth. 8,26 ed. Platt, perperam praebet ነፋስት፡) 1 ventus Kuf. 10; Ps. 1,5; Ps. 17,46; Ps. 103,4; Koh. 11,4; Job 4,21; Job 13,25; Job 15,30; Job 21,18; Job 37,9; Prov. 8,27; Jes. 40,24; Jer. 22,22; Matth. 7,25; Matth. 7,27; Matth. 14,24; Eph. 4,14; ነፋስ፡ ዐቢይ፡ Job 1,19; 4 Esr. 13,1; ነፋስ፡ ኀያል፡ Jes. 11,15; Jer. 18,14; ቈሪር፡ ነፋስ፡ ይነፍኅ፡ Sir. 43,20; Dan. apocr. 3,26; ነፋሰ፡ መርቄ፡ Jer. 28,1; ነፋሰ፡ ዐውሎ፡ Job 21,18; ነፋሰ፡ ደዌ፡ ἀνεμοφθορία 2 Par. 6,28; ነፋሰ፡ ጽባሓዊ፡ Sir. 43,16; ዐረባዊ፡ Sir. 43,17; Hen. 18,1; Hen. 18,2; Hen. 18,3; Hen. 18,4; Hen. 18,5; Hen. 76; Hen. 77; እምከመ፡ መጽአ፡ ነፋስ፡ Sir. 22,18; ዘይዴግን፡ ነፋሰ፡ Sir. 31,2; አይኅ፡ ዘነፋስ፡ Clem. f. 32; አውፅአ፡ ነፋሳተ፡ እመዛግብቲሆሙ፡ Jer. 10,13 vers. alt; 4 Esr. 11,2; ፬ ነፋሳት፡ Dan. 4,2; Jer. 25,15. 2 aër, aurae, ἀήρ Sap. 5,11; Sap. 5,12; ነፋስ፡ ዘፍጡነ፡ ይነፍኅ፡ ταχινὸς ἀήρ Sap. 13,2; Sap. 15,15; Act. 22,23; ምስለ፡ ነፋስ፡ ነበበ፡ εἰς ἀέρα λαλεῖ 1 Cor. 14,9; መኰንነ፡ ርእየተ፡ ነፋስ፡ Eph. 2,2; ዘይሰርር፡ ውስተ፡ ነፋሳት፡ Clem. f. 3; Clem. f. 19; homo creatus est e መሬት፡ ቱሱሕ፡ በእሳት፡ ወነፋስ፡ ወማይ፡ Clem. f. 60; vid. ጠባይዕ፡

woorden.betekenis: animatum, corpus, venter, pudenda, anus, podex, genitalia
woorden.definitie: subst. (proprie: animatum ), plerumque m., sing. et coll. 1 corpus Job 20,25; ሥጋ፡ ነፍስቱ፡ σάρκες τοῦ σώματος Job 41,14; Prov. 5,11; አዕፅምት፡ ወነፍስት፡ Prov. 34,1; ነፍስትነ፡ αἱ ἰδέαι ἡμῶν Dan. 1,13; Dan. 1,15; σῶμα Dan. 5,21; Dan. 10,6; Hez. 1,11; Hen. 15,8; Hen. 16,1; Matth. 6,25; Luc. 11,34; Luc. 12,4; Luc. 12,23; ከመ፡ ነፍስተ፡ በድን፡ ሥጋሁ፡ Rom. 4,19; Rom. 6,6; Rom. 6,12; እምዝንቱ፡ ነፍስትየ፡ መዋቲ፡ Rom. 7,24; Rom. 8,3 seq. (σάρξ); σώματα Rom. 1,24; Rom. 12,1; μέλη Rom. 6,13; Jac. 3,6; እንዘ፡ ከመ፡ በድን፡ ነፍስቶሙ፡ Hebr. 11,12; 1 Cor. 12,14 seq.; 1 Cor. 15,35 seq.; ደመ፡ ነፍስት፡ Org. 1; venter: ኢይክበድከ፡ ነፍስትከ፡ Sir. 34,19. 2 verecunde: pudenda, a anus, podex: Deut. 28,27; 1 Reg. 5,9 seq.; 1 Reg. 6,4; 1 Reg. 6,17. b genitalia, in specie viri: ከተማ፡ ነፍስት፡ Gen. 17,11; Gen. 17,14; Gen. 17,24; ከተማ፡ ሥጋ፡ ነፍስት፡ Gen. 17,23; Gen. 17, 25; Kuf. 15; Lev. 12,3; ቈላፋን፡ ነፍስቶሙ፡ Jer. 9,25; Jer. 9,26; Lev. 15,3 seq.; ዘይዜሙ፡ በነፍስተ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ Sir. 23,16; እለ፡ ዐቢይ፡ ነፍስቶሙ፡ μεγαλόσαρκοι Hez. 16,26; እለ፡ መጠነ፡ ነፍስተ፡ አድግ፡ ነፍስቶሙ፡ Hez. 23,20.

woorden.betekenis: spiritus, halitus, ventus, anima, vis vitalis, vita, animans
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. መንፈሳት፡ et መናፍስት፡, spiritus, τὸ πνεῦμα, 1 halitus, spiritus, Hen. 14,2; Hen. 108,9; πνοή Gen. 2,7; Gen. 7,22; ይሁቦሙ፡ መንፈሰ፡ ለሕዝብ፡ Jes. 42,5; መንፈሰ፡ ገጽነ፡ πνεῦμα προςώπου ἡμῶν Thren. 4,20; በመንፈሰ፡ ከናፍሪሁ፡ Jes. 11,4; Ps. 134,17. 2 ventus Gen. 8,1; Ex. 15,10; Num. 11,31; Ps. 10,7; Ps. 106,25; Ps. 147,7; Ps. 148,8; መንፈሰ፡ ዘይትፋጸይ፡ Sap. 17,17; Joh. 3,8; Hebr. 1,7; Hen. 70,3. 3 anima, vis vitalis, vita: አልቦ፡ መንፈስ፡ ውስቴቶሙ፡ Jer. 10,14; Kuf. 6; Koh. 3,19; Koh. 3,21; Koh. 12,7; Jes. 57,16; መንፈሰ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘሕያው፡ ψυχή Sir. 16,30; ትፃእ፡ እምላዕሌሁ፡ መንፈሱ፡ 4 Esr. 6,51; ወፅአት፡ መንፈሱ፡ Matth. 27,50; ሥጋ፡ ዘአልቦ፡ መንፈስ፡ Jac. 2,26; Gen. 1,20; 4 Esr. 1,5; መንፈሰ፡ ሕይወት፡ Hez. 37,5; Hez. 37,9 (fem.); ይፈዲ፡ መንፈሰ፡ ፍዳ፡ መንፈስ፡ Ex. 21,23; ዘቀተለ፡ መንፈሰ፡ Num. 35,15; Num. 35,30; ገብአት፡ መንፈሱ፡ Jud. 15,19; 1 Thess. 5,23 ψυχή (ነፍስ፡ πνεῦμα); ኵሉ፡ ዘመንፈስ፡ πᾶν τὸ ἐμπνέον Jos. 10,28; Jos. 10,30; Jos. 10,37; Jos. 10,39; Jos. 10,40; anima i.e. animans, homo, in censu populi, ut: ኵሉ፡ መንፈስ፡ ወያዕቆብ፡ ዘቦአ፡ ውስተ፡ ግብጽ፡ ፸ መንፈስ፡ Kuf. 44. 4 animus, spiritus hominis, quatenus eo continentur affectus et commotiones, voluntas, intellectus, sentiendi agendique ratio: መንፈሰ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሰብእ፡ Job 12,10; 1 Cor. 5,5; Matth. 26,41; Rom. 8,16; Ex. 23,9; ሐመት፡ መንፈስየ፡ ጥቀ፡ 4 Esr. 12,8; የሐዝኖ፡ መንፈሱ፡ Kuf. 34; መንፈስ፡ ትክዝት፡ Bar. 3,1; Matth. 5,3; Luc. 1,47; Rom. 1,9; አንኀ፡ መንፈሰ፡ vid. sub አንኀ፡ (ኖኀ፡); ሐይወት፡ መንፈሳ፡ Kuf. 31; Kuf. 43; Ps. 50,13; እሁቦሙ፡ መንፈሰ፡ ሐዲሰ፡ Hez. 11,19; Hez. 36,26; Eph. 4,23; መንፈሰ፡ ቀንእ፡ Num. 5,14; መንፈሰ፡ ዝሙት፡ Hos. 4,12; መንፈሰ፡ ሐሰት፡ Zach. 13,2; መንፈሰ፡ የውሀት፡ Gal. 6,1; 1 Joh. 4,1; 1 Joh. 4,2; 1 Joh. 4,3; በአሐዱ፡ መንፈስ፡ ወበአሐዱ፡ ነፍስ፡ Phil. 1,27; መንፈሰ፡ ነቢብ፡ Job 8,2; ለአኅልፎ፡ መንፈሱ፡ Kuf. 26; 4 Esr. 14,43; ወአርአያ፡ በመንፈሰ፡ ዚአሁ፡ 1 Par. 28,12; opponitur corpori et animae, ut Rom. 8; 1 Petr. 4,6; ሥጋ፡ ዘመንፈስ፡ σῶμα πνευματικόν 1 Cor. 15,44; ለሴስዮ፡ ነፍሳት፡ ወሥጋት፡ ወመናፍስቲሆሙ፡ Lit. Joh. 5 spiritus a divinus (plerumque m.; passim fem. ut: 1 Joh. 4,2; ወመንፈስከ፡ እንተ፡ ትጼልል፡ 4 Esr. 4,41 var.): መንፈሰ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Matth. 3,16; Matth. 12,18; Luc. 4,18; መንፈስ፡ ቅዱስ፡ (non ቅድስት፡) Ps. 50,12; Ps. 142,12; Jes. 63,10; Matth. 1,18; Matth. 3,11; Matth. 12,32 al.; መልአከ፡ መንፈስ፡ ቅዱስ፡ Asc. Jes. 3,15; እግዚአብሔር፡ መንፈስ፡ ውእቱ፡ Joh. 4,24; መንፈሰ፡ ትንቢት፡ Kuf. 31; መንፈሰ፡ ጥበብ፡ Deut. 34,9; Jes. 11,2; Sir. 39,6; 4 Esr. 3,28 (fem.); መንፈሰ፡ ኀይል፡ 2 Tim. 1,7 al. b natura incorporalis, angeli, daemones, genii: መናፍስት፡ ንጹሓት፡ ለባውያት፡ ወቀጢናት፡ Sap. 7,23; መንፈሳት፡ Hen. 39,12; እግዚአ፡ መናፍስት፡ Hen. 38,2 seq.; ኵሉ፡ መንፈስ፡ ወኵሉ፡ መልአክ፡ Kuf. 1; ኵሉ፡ መንፈስ፡ ዘይትለአክ፡ Kuf. 2; ሰብዐቱ፡ መንፈስ፡ Apoc. 1,4; Hebr. 1,14; genii naturae rerum praepositi Hen. 60,16 seq.; Kuf. 2; መንፈስ፡ እኩይ፡ Tob. 6,8; 1 Reg. 16,14; 1 Reg.16,15; 1 Reg. 19,9; መንፈስ፡ እኩያን፡ Kuf. 10; መናፍስት፡ ርኩሳን፡ Matth. 10,1. c spiritus vel animae mortuorum (postquam e corpore discesserunt): Hebr. 12,23; Hen. 22,3; Hen. 22,5; Hen. 103,3. d spectrum (ut videtur), πνεῦμα Luc. 24,37; Luc. 24,39. — Voc. Ae.: መንፈስ፡ ብ፡ ረቂቅ፡ ሥልጣን፡ ሽሽግሂ፡ ይ፡ manfas C for ለባሲተ፡ መንፈስ፡ ቅዱስ፡ vid. ለባሲ፡ (Grébaut)

woorden.betekenis: spiritualis
woorden.definitie: adj. rel. spiritualis: Hen. 15,4; Hen. 15,6; Hen. 15,7; 1 Petr. 2,5; Lit. 160,2; ኀጢአት፡ መንፈሳዊያት፡ (i.e. quibus Spiritus S. et spiritualis Christianorum vita violatur) F.M. 5,2; ፍትሕ፡ መንፈሳዊት፡ (i.e. jus ecclesiasticum vel canonicum) F.M. 4,2; ኵነኔ፡ መንፈሳዊ፡ (poenae sp. vel ecclesiasticae) F.M. 19,3; ማሕሌት፡ መንፈሳዊት፡ (opp. profanum) F.M. 32,7; አዋልድ፡ መንፈሳውያት፡ (sacerdotis sc. omnes mulieres parochiae ejus) F.M. 6,1; ተዋስቦ፡ መንፈሳዊ፡ (matrimonium hominum sponsione baptismali junctorum) F.M. 5,2.

woorden.betekenis: spiratio, respiratio, spiritus, halitus, ad extremum usque s
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., spiratio, respiratio, spiritus, halitus, πνοή, Ps. 17,18; Ps. 32,6; Clem. f. 145; Sap. 2,2; እነግረክሙ፡ እስትንፋሰ፡ ቃልየ፡ Prov. 1,23; Prov. 11,13 var.; Prov. 20,27; Prov. 24,12; Hen. 108,10; እስትንፋሱ፡ ሀለወት፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ Asc. Jes. 6,11; Jsp. p. 283; ሰላም፡ ለእስትንፋስኪ፡ I Sal. Mar. 16; Lit. 173,4; እስከ፡ ድኃሪት፡ እስትንፋስ፡ ad extremum usque spiritum Lit. 164,3; Sx. Genb. 11; መንፈሰ፡ እስትንፋስ፡ Kuf. 2. vid. also ምስትንፋስ፡

woorden.betekenis: exiit, defecit, vendibilis fuit, diffindere, dissecare, divi
woorden.definitie: I,1 [amh. id.; vicina sunt فَقَّ et فَكَّ ܦܩܰܥ בָּקַע በቀወ፡ al.; in specie cfr. ܢܦܰܩ exiit; نَفِقَ exiit e latibulo, defecit; نَفَقَ vendibilis fuit (de merce veno exposita); III hypocritam egit] Subj. ይንፍቅ፡ 1 diffindere, dissecare: Ps. 135,13; ነፈቀ፡ ባሕረ፡ ቅድሜሆሙ፡ ἔῤῥηξας 2 Esr. 19,11; ኀለየ፡ ከመ፡ ይንፍቆሙ፡ (בקע) 2 Par. 32,1; ንንፍቆሙ፡ Jes. 7,6 vers. nov.; ነፈቆን፡ (sc. hostias) እማእከል፡ Kuf. 14. 2 dividere, in specie bifariam vel bipartiri; Ps. 16,14; ነፈቆ፡ (v. ናፈቆ፡) ለሕዝብ፡ ክልኤ፡ ትዕይንተ፡ Gen. 32,8; Gen. 33,1; ተዋሕዶ፡ አምላክ፡ ወሰብእ፡ ለ ፪ ነፈቀ፡ Sx. Masc. 7 Enc.

woorden.betekenis: diffindi, dissecari, dividi, sibi dividere, discernere
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 pass. diffindi, dissecari, dividi, (vid. Jer. 46,2 sub ተናፈቀ፡); ይትነፈቅ፡ διαιρεθήσεται Jes. 30,28; ይትነፈቅ፡ እስራኤል፡ ለክልኤ፡ 1 Reg. 15,29; Org. 4. 2 reflex.: sibi dividere vel discernere, crinem: ተነፍቀት፡ ሥዕርታ፡ διέταξε τὰς τρίχας Judith 10,3.

woorden.betekenis: arca, cista, scrinium, loculus, loculus sepulchralis, nafq,
woorden.definitie: et ንፍቅ፡ subst., m. et fem., Pl. ነፍቃት፡ (Lud. e Vit. Greg.), arca, cista, scrinium, loculus, θίβις Ex. 2,3; Ex. 2,4; Ex. 2,5; Ex. 2,6; Kuf. 47; arca Noae ንፍቀ፡ ታቦት፡ Hebr. 11,7; Matth. 24,38 rom.; Luc. 17,27; in specie: loculus sepulchralis (σορός, σωρός) Gen. 50,26; Jos. 8,29; Luc. 7,14; ውእቱ፡ ውስተ፡ ንፍቁ፡ (ነፍቁ፡) ይተግህ፡ Job 21,32. — Voc. Ae.: አስከሬን፡ መግነዝ፡ መዝገበ፡ ታቦት፡ ንፍቅ፡ ፌሎን፡ ብ፡ ሳፅን፡ nafq, nǝfq, ንፍቆ፡ nǝfqo, Pl. nafqāt perhaps a kind of container in which a specific type of offering for a church was given 12 l. 13 (ed.), 13 l. 7 (tr.), 12 l. 25 (ed.), 13 l. 19 (tr.) L ነፍቅ nafq, ንፍቅ nǝfq box, chest, ark, compartment, coffin 389a

woorden.betekenis: dimidium, dimidia pars
woorden.definitie: subst. dimidium, dimidia pars: እምንፍቃሃ፡ ለዲድረክም፡ Ex. 30,15; ንፍቃ፡ ሌሊት፡ Lud. e Mss.

woorden.betekenis: divisio, dissectio, discretio, indiscreti, dubitatio, simula
woorden.definitie: subst. 1 divisio, dissectio, discretio: ዘእንበለ፡ ኑፋቄ፡ ወብዕድና፡ Cyr. ad Theod. f. 19; እለ፡ እንበለ፡ ኑፋቄ፡ ἀδιάκριτοι indiscreti Prov. 25,1. 2 dubitatio, simulatio, hypocrisis, incredulitas, haeresis: διαλογισμοί 1 Tim. 2,8; Phil. 2,14; διψυχία Herm. p. 38; πρόςκομμα Rom. 14,20 Platt; ዘእንበለ፡ ኑፋቄ፡ ልብ፡ አመንክሙ፡ ብየ፡ Kid. f. 3; ዘእንበለ፡ ኑፋቄ፡ ἀνυπόκριτος Rom. 12,9; 1 Tim. 1,5; Jac. 3,17; Sx. Mag. 22Enc.

woorden.betekenis: dimidium, dimidia, media pars, semestre, pars altera, altera
woorden.definitie: subst. dimidium, dimidia vel media pars: መንፈቀ፡ ንዋዩ፡ Tob. 8,21; Tob. 12,2; እምዕፁብ፡ ለእመ፡ መንፈቆ፡ ፈደየከ፡ Sir. 29,6; ሰማርያ፡ መንፈቀ፡ ኀጢአትከ፡ ኢአበሰት፡ Hez. 16,51; መንፈቀ፡ ነገደ፡ ማናሴ፡ Num. 32,33; Jos. 14,2; Marc. 6,23; Luc. 19,8; ይሠፅርከ፡ እመንፈቅከ፡ πρίσαι σε μέσον Dan. apocr. 1,59; መንፈቀ፡ እመት፡ Ex. 25,10; Ex. 25,17; በመንፈቀ፡ መዋዕሊሁ፡ Jer. 17,11; Ps. 101,25; መንፈቀ፡ ዓመት፡ semestre Dan. 7,25; 4 Esr. 13,46; መንፈቀ፡ ወርኅ፡ Kuf. 14; Kuf. 15; መንፈቀ፡ ሰንበት፡ Dan. 9,27; መንፈቀ፡ ሌሊት፡ Ruth 3,8; Jes. 59,10; Matth. 25,6 rom.; መንፈቀ፡ ሰዓት፡ Apoc. 8,1; ሠሉስ፡ መዋዕል፡ ወመንፈቅ፡ Apoc. 11,9; Apoc. 11,11; de hominibus: ወይፄወዉ፡ መንፈቀ፡ ሀገር፡ Zach. 14,2. — Bis ponitur መንፈቅ፡ — መንፈቅ፡ i.e. pars altera — altera Kuf. p. 6; Jes. 44,16; Jes. 44,19; Dan. 2,33; Dan. 2,41; Dan. 2,42; Rom. 9,21; ኮነ፡ መንፈቅነ፡ ንትቀነይ፡ ወመንፈቅነ፡ በንዋየ፡ ሐቅል፡ 2 Esr. 14,16. 2 pars: እለ፡ ይኴንኑ፡ መነፈቀ፡ ፈለገ፡ ግብጽ፡ μέρος Jes. 7,18; Act. 14,4; Matth. 16,14.

woorden.betekenis: flare, spirare, spirando, flandο emittere, flando excitare,
woorden.definitie: vel ነፍሐ፡ I,1 [נָפַח ܢܦܰܚ نفخ et نفح; amh. ነፋ፡] Subj. ይንፋኅ፡ flare, spirare, de vento: ይነፍኅ፡ ነፋስ፡ ጽባሓዊ፡ Sir. 43,16; Sir. 43,20; 4 Esr. 4,4; Apoc. 7,1 (c. ውስተ፡); Matth. 7,25; Joh. 3,8; Hen. 34,2; Hen. 34,3; de igne: እሳት፡ ዘይነፍኅ፡ ወይልህብ፡ Sap. 11,19; ላህበ፡ እሳት፡ ይነፍኅ፡ እምኔሁ፡ Sir. 43,4. a spirando vel flandο emittere: ይነፍኅ፡ መንፈሶ፡ Ps. 147,7 ann. (non est quod cum Ludolfo ያነፍኅ፡ emendemus). b flando excitare, sufflare: እመ፡ ነፋኅካሃ፡ ለፍሕም፡ ትነድድ፡ Sir. 28,12; እደዊሁ፡ እሳተ፡ ይነፍኃ፡ Job 20,10. c flando dispergere vel disjicere: ነፋኅክዎ፡ Hagg. 1,9; Mal. 1,13. d flando movere vel agere Hen. 72,5. e afflare, insufflare, c. Acc.: 3 Reg. 17,21; እምከመ፡ ነፍኆሙ፡ ነፋስ፡ Jes. 40,24; Job 4,21; ተሀውኩ፡ ከመ፡ ዕፀ፡ ገዳም፡ ሶበ፡ ይነፍኆ፡ ነፋስ፡ Jes. 7,2; c. ላዕለ፡ 4 Esr. 11,2; እነፍኅ፡ ላዕሌከ፡ Hez. 21,31; Hez. 37,9. f inflare, afflare, inspirare: c. Acc. et ዲበ፡ vel ላዕለ፡ Gen. 2,7; Hen. 82,7; 4 Esr. 1,5; Christus ነፍኀ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ መንፈሰ፡ ቅዱሰ፡ Clem. f. 234; ነፍኀ፡ ላዕሌነ፡ ወይቤ፡ ንሥኡ፡ ሀብተ፡ መንፈስ፡ Clem. f. 45; Joh. 20,22. g inhalare: ለእመ፡ ኢረከቡ፡ ማየ፡ (sc. ad manus lavandas) ይንፍኁ፡ እደዊሆሙ፡ F.N. 14. h perflare, perspirare: ንፋሕ፡ ገነትየ፡ διάπνευσον Cant. 4,16. i inflare vel sufflare i.e. tumefacere: ዝንቱ፡ ማይ፡ (Num. 5) ይነፍኅ፡ ኵሎ፡ ሥጋሃ፡ F.N. 24,6. k inflare buccinam, tuba canere vel clangere, buccinare, c. Acc. instrumenti: Jos. 6,9; Jud. 3,27; ንፍኁ ፡ ቀርነ፡ Hos. 5,8; Joel 2,1; Jes. 44,23; Jer. 4,5; Jer. 6,1; Ps. 80,3; c. በ፡ instrumenti: Jos. 6,4 seq.; 2 Par. 5,13; Zach. 9,14; ይነፍኅ፡ በቀርን፡ ዐቢይ፡ Jes. 27,13; Sir. 50,16; c. Acc.: signum canere, ነፍኀ፡ በቀርን፡ ትእምርተ፡ ለሰራዊት፡ Hez. 33,3.

woorden.definitie: I,1 [vid. נָפַץ in Ges. thes. p. 899] Subj. ይንፍጽ፡, dissipari, diffugere, 1 dilabi, de aqua Kuf. p. 23 ann. 12; dispergi, de palea ventilata Lud. sine auct. 2 aufugere, fugere: ነፍጸ፡ ንዋም፡ እምአዕይንትየ፡ Gen. 31,40; ነፍጸ፡ ሕዝብ፡ πέφυγεν ὁ λαός Ex. 14,5; Ex. 14,25; Hen. 86,6; Hen. 89,16; Hen. 89,49 (c. እምነ፡); Hen. 90,19; አይቴ፡ ትነፍጹ፡ Hen. 102,1; Org. 3; ነፍጸ፡ እምገጸ፡ ሰብእ፡ Sx. Mij. 10Enc. 3 evadere, effugere, Hen. 10, 3. — Schol. Voc . Ae . vid. sub ነትዐ፡

woorden.betekenis: litera alphabeti Aethiopici decima et tertia, quae
woorden.definitie: litera alphabeti Aethiopici decima et tertia, quae አልፍ፡ appellatur.

woorden.betekenis: ah, heu, eheu, proh
woorden.definitie: interj. dolentis et gementis: ah, heu, eheu, proh, አህ፡ አህ፡ አህ፡ (אֲהָהּ) Hez. 4,14 (v. ሐሰ); Lud. Comm. hist. p. 41; seq. ለ፡, ut: አህ፡ አህ፡ ለድምፀ፡ ቅኔሆሙ፡ Genz. f. 46(vid. sub ቅኔ፡ col. 447); seq. እምነ፡, ut: አህ፡ አህ፡ እምዛቲ፡ ኀፍረት፡ Chrys. Ta. 11; አህ፡ እምዛቲ፡ ሕሠም፡ (ὢ τῆς) Chrys. Ta. 15.

woorden.betekenis: immo, utique, esto, praesto sum, ita faciam, bene, obtempera
woorden.definitie: (እሆ፡ Herm. p. 33; Herm. p. 34) adv. a concedentis: immo, utique, esto, ኦሆ፡ እንከ፡ አበስኩ፡ አነ፡ አማን፡ καὶ δὴ ἐπ᾽ ἀληθείας ἐπλανήθην Job 19,4. b annuentis et obsequentis: praesto sum, ita faciam, bene, al. (opp. እንብየ፡), ut: Gen. 17,19 (ναί); Gen. 21,24; Gen. 37,13; Ex. 8,6; Ex. 10,29; 1 Esr. 9,10 (οὕτως); ወይቤሉ፡ ኦሆ፡ ናገብእ፡ ሎሙ፡ 2 Esr. 15,12; Kuf. 15; Matth. 21,30; Clem. f. 28; ἐν ἐμοί Jud. 6,13; Jud. 6,15; ἆ ἆ Jud. 6,22 (at dubium videtur, annon lectio primaria አህ፡ fuerit). – Hinc orta est phrasis usitatissima c ኦሆ፡ ብህለ፡ obtemperare, obsequi, annuere, morem gerere, obsecundare, indulgere, veniam dare: ኢትበልዎ፡ ኦሆ፡ ለፍትወቱ፡ (ὑπακούειν) Rom. 6,12; ኦሆ፡ ይቤሎ፡ 4 Reg. 16,9; Sir. 13,9; 4 Esr. 10,26; Jac. 4,7 (ὑποτάγητε); ወኦሆ፡ ኢይቤ፡ ἠπείθησε 4 Reg. 5,16; Jac. 5,6 rom.; Jac. 3,3 (πείθεσθαι, de equis praedicatur); ኦሆ፡ ብሂልየ፡ ለመማክርትየ፡ πυθομένου μου τῶν συμβούλων Esth. 3apocr.; ኦሆ፡ በልነ፡ συγκατάθου ἡμῖν Dan. apocr. 1,20; ኦሆ፡ በሎ፡ συγγνώμην ἔχε Sir. 3,13; Eph. 4,2; ኦሆ፡ ብሂሎት፡ obsequium, ut: በእንተ፡ ኦሆ፡ ብሂሎቱ፡ ወትሕትናሁ፡ Phlx. 129; indulgentia, μακροθυμία vel ἀνοχή Rom. 2,4; Rom. 3,26; ኦሆ፡ በሃሊ፡ obsequens, tractabilis Jac. 3,17; Phlx. 99; Deg. d ኦሆ፡ አበለ፡ persuadere: Matth. 27,20; 4 Esr. 3,59; Jsp. p. 290; Sx. Tachs. 5. – Voc. Ae.: ኦሆ፡ ብ፡ በጀ።

woorden.betekenis: non est penes eum, te, me, ei, tibi, mihi, non habere, nihil
woorden.definitie: adv. negandi [אַל] obsoletum, nonnisi cum praep. በ፡ seq. pron. suff. compositum reperitur, sc. 1 Sing. III pers. አልቦ፡ vel አልቦቱ፡ m., አልባ፡ vel አልባቲ፡ fem., II pers. አልብከ፡ m., አልብኪ፡ fem., I pers. አልብየ፡; Pl. III pers. አልቦሙ፡ m., አልቦን፡ vel አልቦንቱ፡ fem., II pers. አልብክሙ፡ m., አልብክን፡ fem., I pers. አልብነ፡ non est penes eum, te, me vel ei, tibi, mihi i.e. non habere; c.c. Acc. vel Nom. rei, qua quis caret (gramm. § 176 h): አልብየ፡ ምተ፡ Joh. 4,7; Joh. 8,49; ኀይል፡ አልብየ፡ Ps. 68,2; 1 Reg. 21,4; አልብነ፡ ክፍለ፡ 2 Reg. 20,1; Matth. 14,7; 1 Joh. 1,8; Act. 8,21; Matth. 6,1; Matth. 16,8; 1 Cor. 11,22; 2 Cor. 6,10; Jos. 22,25; ዘአልቦ፡ ክንፈ፡ Lev. 11,10; Matth. 9,36; Matth. 13,6; Matth. 22,24; Matth. 22,25; አልቦቱ፡ ውሉደ፡ Num. 27,4; Num. 27,9; Num. 27,10; Num. 27,11; ሀገር፡ ዘአልባ፡ ጥቅመ፡ Prov. 25,28; Jac. 3,8; እንተ፡ አልባቲ፡ ኍልቈ፡ Ps. 39,16; እለ፡ አልቦሙ፡ ልበ፡ Ps. 48,10; Ps. 48,12; Judith 5,23; ለእመ፡ ቦንቱ፡ ቅጽረ፡ ወለእመ፡ አልቦንቱ፡ Num. 13,19; c. ለ፡ vel sine ለ፡ ejus, qui habet, ut: ለዐርክ፡ ምእመን፡ አልቦ፡ ተውላጠ፡ Sir. 6,15; ወሐናሰ፡ አልባቲ፡ ውሉዳ፡ 1 Reg. 1,2; Matth. 8,20; አልቦሙ፡ ኍልቍ፡ ዘመዶሙ፡ Judith 5,10; Hen. 25,4. a abs.: አልቦ፡ nihil habet Matth. 13,12; ይኄይሰከ፡ ተሀሉ፡ እንዘ፡ አልብከ፡ እምተሀሉ፡ እንዘ፡ ብከ፡ Lud. e Vit. Dan. b አልቦ፡ seq. subst. crebro vicem adjectivorum negativorum explet ( in -): ዘአልቦ፡ አሰር፡ ἀνεξιχνίαστος Job 34,24; እንተ፡ አልባቲ፡ ኍልቈ፡ innumerabilis Ps. 39,16; ዘአልቦ፡ ኀጢአተ፡ ἀναμάρτητος Joh. 8,7; ወአልቦሙ፡ ምሕረት፡ ἀνελεήμονες Rom. 1,31; ዘአልቦ፡ ሐሜት፡ ἀνέγκλητος Tit. 1,7; Gen. 37,24; Jud. 16,7; Hen. 26,3; Hen. 26,4; Hen. 26,5; Hen. 39,6; Hen. 40,1. 2 አልቦ፡ vel አልቦቱ፡ non est, non datur vel reperitur, deest, c.c. Nom. vel Acc. rei vel pers., quae non est: አልቦ፡ ባዕደ፡ 1 Reg. 21,9; አልቦቱ፡ ዝየ፡ ዘማ፡ Gen. 38,21; Gen. 38,22; Gen. 47,4; Gen. 47,13; Ex. 10,14; Ex. 12,30; Num. 20,5; Ps. 5,10; Ps. 13,1; Ps. 35,1; Ps. 37,3; Rom. 3,10; Rom. 3,11; Rom. 3,18; Hen. 18; Hen. 12; c. ለ፡ ejus, cui non est: Num. 20,2; Matth. 13,5. a አልቦ፡ ዘ፡ α nullus, nemo: አልቦ፡ ዘይቀብሮሙ፡ Jer. 7,33; Ps. 6,5; Ps. 13,2; Ps. 21,11; Ps. 70,12; አልቦ፡ ዘይሬእየኒ፡ Sir. 23,18; አልቦ፡ ለዘ፡ አዘዘ፡ ይግበሩ፡ ኀጢአተ፡ Sir. 15,20; Apoc. 3,8; አልቦ፡ ገብር፡ ዘይክል፡ Luc. 16,13; Luc. 23,53; neque hac constructione Subjunctivus prohibetur, ut: አዘዝኩ፡ ከመ፡ አልቦ፡ ዘይልክፍኪ፡ Ruth 2,9; 3 Joh. 7; Gal. 6,17; Col. 2,16. β nihil: ያአምር፡ ከመ፡ አልቦ፡ ዘይኄይስ፡ እምፈሪሀ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Sir. 23,27; Matth. 5,13; Matth. 10,26; Matth. 17,20; አልቦ፡ ምንትኒ፡ ዘይትኀባእ፡ እምኔሁ፡ Job 34,21; ከመ፡ አልቦ፡ ዘይሥንቁ፡ ለፍኖት፡ Marc. 6,8; Luc. 3,13. γ non est ut i.e. simpliciter non vel ne: አልቦ፡ ዘይነብር፡ ውስቴቶሙ፡ ሰብእ፡ Jer. 4,29; አልቦኑ፡ አባ፡ ዘአትረፍከ፡ በረከተ፡ ሊተኒ፡ Gen. 27,36; አልቦ፡ ሰብእ፡ ዘይርአይኪ፡ vir ne te videat Ruth 3,3; Gen. 45,24. b አልቦ፡ አመ፡ numquam Jud. 19,30; Matth. 9,33 rom.; Matth. 21,16; Matth. 21,42; አልቦ፡ ግሙራ፡ አመ፡ Hen. 24,4; አልቦ፡ አመ፡ ኢ፡ numquam non Lit. Orth. c አልቦ፡ ኀበ፡ nusquam: አልቦሙ፡ ኀበ፡ ይትኀብኡ፡ (non habent ubi se abdant i.e.) nusquam se abdere poterunt Sir. 17,15. 3 Absolute ponitur: non, minime, nequaquam a ubi respondetur ad quaestionem: Num. 22,30; Zach. 4,13; Joh. 1,21; Matth. 13,29. b ubi aliquid recusatur vel abnuitur: Gen. 18,15; Gen. 19,2; Gen. 23,5; Gen. 42,10; Gen. 42,12; Ex. 10,25; 1 Reg. 8,19; Ruth 1,13; Tob. 10,9; Matth. 5,37 (opp. እወ፡); 2 Cor. 1,17; Jac. 5,12. c in enunciationibus (interrogationibus) disjunctivis: ከመ፡ ይርአይ፡ እመ፡ ይሤርሖ፡ ፍኖቶ፡ ወለእመሂ፡ አልቦ፡ Gen. 24,21; Gen. 42,16; Ex. 16,4; Num. 11,23; Marc. 12,14. vid. also አይ፡

woorden.betekenis: articulus arabicus, أَلْ, quem in quibusdam nomini
woorden.definitie: articulus arabicus, أَلْ, quem in quibusdam nominibus e sermone arab. haustis servarunt Aethiopes, ut: እልሑት፡ (vid. supra col. 117), እልቆሞስ፡ (c. 419), al.

woorden.betekenis: allâ, sed, non tantum, sed etiam, at, verum enim vero
woorden.definitie: (i.e. allâ ) particula adversativa [simili modo composita atque إِلاَّ, gramm. § 168,6] a plerumque praevia negatione: sed, Gen. 3,5; Gen. 17,15; Gen. 40,23; Num. 10,30; Num. 11,20; Deut. 7,5; Deut. 9,4; Deut. 9,5; Prov. 23,31; Prov. 24,8; Jer. 50,3; Sir. 24,34; Judith 2,13; Judith 12,2; Judith 13,20; Hen. 5,2; Hen. 5,4; 4 Esr. 6,23; 4 Esr. 6,25; Asc. Jes. 7,15; Asc. Jes. 8,5; Asc. Jes. 8,7; Matth. 5,15; Matth. 5,17; Matth. 6,13; Matth. 9,13; Matth. 9,24; Matth. 10,20; Matth. 10,34; Matth. 15,11; Matth. 16,12; Matth. 16,17; Matth. 22,30; Joh. 1,13; Joh. 3,16 al.; post non tantum አላ፡ – ሂ፡ vel አላ፡ – ኒ፡ sed etiam Deut. 29,14; 1 Petr. 2,18 Platt, vel አላ፡ – ዓዲ፡ Act. 26,29, vel አላ፡ Joh. 11,52; Act. 19,26. b sine praevia negatione: sed, at, verum enim vero (crebrius ወባሕቱ፡) Gen. 48,19; Num. 14,21; Asc. Jes. 7,21; አላ፡ ባሕቱ፡ Cyr. c. Pall. f. 72; Lud. ex Hist. VII Puer.

woorden.betekenis: vae
woorden.definitie: interj. dolentis vel minantis: vae [אַלְלַי; אָלַל ألَّ יָלַל; vid. etiam ወይሌ፡] seq. praep. ለ፡, sc. I pers. woorden.betekenis: si, quodsi, si interfectus fuisset, si non, nisi, re vera, q
woorden.definitie: (raro እም፡, vid. infra annot.), conj. [אִם ܐܶܢ إِنْ] et cum praep. ለ፡ composita ለእመ፡ (gramm. § 170,1 et § 205) A conditionalis, 1 in conditione simplice, ubi utrum aliquid fiat factumve sit an non, in medio relinquitur (quare differt a ሶበ፡ col. 355) si, quodsi: c.c. Perf., sive actio praeterita significatur: Sir. 22,21; Job 8,4; Job 31,9; Dan. apocr. 1,54; Col. 2,20; 1 Tim. 5,10; sive praesens vel futura Gen. 28,20; Gen. 28,21; Gen. 44,22; Ex. 10,4; Ex. 21,2 seq.; Jud. 16,6; 1 Reg. 16,2; 1 Esr. 4,31; Ps. 49,13; Job 9,3; Job 11,12; Sir. 4,6; Sir. 11,10; Jes. 57,8; Jer. 4,1; Jer. 33,15; Jer. 45,17; Jer. 45,18; Hez. 33,13; Dan. apocr. 1,22; Matth. 16,26; Rom. 7,3; 1 Joh. 1,6; c. Imperf.: Gen. 15,5; Ex. 30,33; እመ፡ ታፈቅራ፡ ለጥበብ፡ ዕቀብ፡ ትእዛዞ፡ Sir. 1,26; Sir. 4,16; Sir. 6,32; Sir. 12,1; Jer. 45,21; Matth. 27,43; Act. 18,15; 1 Cor. 7,9; 2 Cor. 2,2; 1 Petr. 2,20; in enunciatione nominali: 1 Reg. 21,4; እመሰ፡ ነቢያት፡ እሙንቱ፡ ወቦሙ፡ ቃለ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Jer. 34,15; Sir. 22,23; Matth. 19,10; Matth. 27,42. 2 Rarius እመ፡ usurpatur in ea conditione, in qua aliquid sumitur quod nec factum est nec facile fiet: ውእቱ፡ ነኪር፡ ለእመ፡ ድኅነ፡ Sir. 16,11; c. እም፡ in apodosi: 1 Cor. 12,17; እፎመ፡ እምጸንዐ፡ በቅድሜከ፡ እመ፡ ለሊከ፡ ኢፈቀድከ፡ Sap. 11,26; እመ፡ ነበርኩ፡ ድኅሬክሙ፡ እምዐብየ፡ ሐዘንየ፡ (si vobis superstes essem, magna esset aegritudo mea) Jsp. p. 366; እመ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ተቀትለ፡ ምስሌሆሙ፡ እምአዕረፈ፡ ( si interfectus fuisset ) Jsp. p. 366; ለእመ፡ ፈቀደ፡ ከመ፡ ይንሣእ፡ መኑ፡ እምከልኦ፡ ለንጉሥ፡ Gad. Lal. 3 a c. negatione: si non, nisi, Ex. 4,1; Gen. 29,8; Prov. 4,16; Sir. 31,6; Matth. 18,3; Matth. 18,34; Matth. 26,42; Marc. 11,26; Joh. 5,47; Joh. 10,37. b እመሰ፡ si ( re vera ), si ( quidem ): Ps. 7,3; Ps. 7,4; Job 8,4; Jer. 34,15; Matth. 4,3; Matth. 4,6; Matth. 26,39; Matth. 27,40; Marc. 10,21; Joh. 18,23; Rom. 6,5; Col. 3,1; etiam እመሰ፡ – ሁ፡ Matth. 14,28. c ወእመሰ፡ si autem, sin Jer. 49,13; Ps. 27,1; Joh. 18,23; Matth. 12,28. d ለእመቦ፡ ዘ፡ si forte, ut: ለእመቦ፡ ዘአበስከ፡ ኢትድግም፡ Sir. 21,1; deinde forsan ( ne forte, si forte, si quo modo seq. Subj.; vielleicht, daß), ut: ለእመቦ፡ ዘይኄልዩ፡ ደቂቅየ፡ እኩየ፡ ላዕለ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ μὴ ποτε Job 1,5; crebrius እመቦ፡ (vel ለእመቦ፡) ከመ፡, c. Imperf., Jer. 43,7 (ἴσος); Jer. 28,8 var.; Luc. 13,9; c. Subj. Kuf. p. 57; Kuf. p. 150; Jer. 28,8; Rom. 1,13; Rom. 11,14 (εἴ πως); Phil. 3,11. e Insertis particulis interrog. ሁ፡ et ኑ፡ dubii aliquid in sententiam conditionalem infertur, ut Num. 22,20; Matth. 14,28; Act. 16,15. f etsi, etiamsi, quamvis, licet; raro እመ፡ vel ለእመ፡ nudum, ut Luc. 18,4; Col. 2,5; Ps. 45,2; Koh. 6,3; plerumque እመሂ፡ vel እመኒ፡, ለእመሂ፡ vel ለእመኒ፡, Jer. 4,30; Jer. 14,12; Job 8,15; Matth. 26,33; Matth. 26,35; Luc. 11,8; 2 Esr. 11,9; Jes. 1,18; Jes. 5,9; Jes. 32,19; Esth. 4,16; Sir. 30,4; Sir. 41,9; Ps. 22,4; Ps. 49,13; Hen. 100,5; Joh. 11,25. g pronominibus interrogativis praepositum እመ፡ pronomina rel. indefinita efficit, ut -vis, -libet, -cumque: ወእመ፡ ሚመጠነ፡ ኀሠሠ፡ quantumvis quaesierit Koh. 8,17; ወለእመኒ፡ መኑ፡ ኮነ፡ ὅστις ἂν ἦ Gal. 5,10 ant. 4 in locutionibus disjunctivis, a in quibus duae pluresve res vel actiones sumuntur, α እመ፡ – ወእመ፡ sive - sive Koh. 5,11; ለእመ፡ – ወለእመ፡ Ex. 19,13. β plerumque እመሂ፡ – ወእመሂ፡, እመኒ፡ – ወእመኒ፡, vel ለእመኒ፡ caet., cum ubi singulae enunciationes disjunguntur, ut: Luc. 20,5; Luc. 20,6; Rom. 6,16; Phil. 1,21; Am. 9,2; Am. 9,3; Ps. 138,7; Ps. 138,8; tum ubi singula vocabula, ut: Gen. 31,39; Ex. 21,18; Ex. 22,5; Ex. 22,6; Ex. 22,8; Lev. 1,10; Lev. 3,1; Lev. 13,52; Lev. 13,57; Num. 5,6; Num. 15,3; Koh. 12,14; Jes. 30,21; Jer. 49,6; 4 Esr. 9,37; Sir. 37,18; Sir. 42,4; Matth. 5,37; Rom. 2,9; Phil. 1,18; Phil. 1,20; 1 Cor. 3,22; Jac. 5,12. γ rarius እመሂ፡ – አው፡ Clem. f. 91; Sx. Mag. 4. δ quare ut in sententiis conditionalibus እመሂ፡ Ex. 22,9 vel ወእመሂ፡ Ex. 22,5; Ex. 22,6; Ex. 23,4, vel ወእመኒ፡ Tob. 6,8; Lev. 17,3 ita in aliis quoque, ut Matth. 12,25; Num. 15,3; Num. 19,18 graeco ἤ sive, vel respondet; item ወለእመ፡ Hen. 59,2. b in quibus duo contraria sumuntur, α ወእመ፡ አኮሰ፡ vel ወእመ፡ አኮ፡, crebro contractum in ወእማእኮ፡, si vero non i.e. sin minus: Gen. 24,49; Gen. 30,1; Ex. 32,32; Jos. 22,22; Jud. 9,20; 1 Reg. 2,16; 3 Reg. 20,6; 4 Reg. 5,17; Jer. 11,21; Ps. 49,23; Dan. apocr. 13,12; Matth. 6,1; Marc. 2,21; Luc. 14,32; Hebr. 10,2; quare β ወእመ፡ አኮ፡ vel ወእመ፡ አኮሰ፡ respondet graeco ἢ aut, vel: Gen. 24,40; Gen. 33,13; Job 7,2; Job 30,24; Jes. 17,6; 2 Par. 6,28; Luc. 2,24; Jac. 3,12; et γ እማእኮ፡ vel ወእመአኮ፡ – ወእማእኮ፡ aut - aut Gen. 13,9; Gen. 24,49; Lev. 1,14; Jos. 24,15; Jes. 7,11; Matth. 6,24; Matth. 12,33; Luc. 16,13. 5 Rarius እመ፡ usurpatur a in formulis jurandi ellipticis, ut: እመ፡ አኮ፡ (i.e. אִם־לֹא) Num. 14,28. b tamquam particula temporis quando: ወሶበ፡ የሐውሩ፡ የሐውር፡ ወእመ፡ ቆሙ፡ ይቀውም፡ Hez. 1,21. c post varia verba, ubi ad significationem quod vel ut inclinat, ut: አኮ፡ መንክር፡ እመ፡ ተእኅዘ፡ Prov. 6,30; ምንተ፡ እፈቅድ፡ ለእመ፡ ወድአት፡ ነደት፡ Luc. 12,49. B እምከመ፡ vel ለእምከመ፡ vid. sub ከመ፡ C Particula interrogativa: an, num, utrum, 1 rarius in interrogatione directa: 3 Reg. 19,2; Jer. 47,14; ለእመ፡ ይድኅን፡ (v. ይድኅንሁ፡) Hez. 17,15. 2 creberrime in obliqua, et post verba explorandi et dubitandi, a sive እመ፡ vel ለእመ፡ nudum, sive adjecto ሁ፡ vel ኑ፡, ut: ርኢ፡ እመ፡ ትረክብ፡ Ps. 138,23; Ps. 13,3; Cant. 6,11; Cant. 7,13; Jon. 3,9; Thren. 1,12; Jer. 2,10 seq.; Jer. 5,1; Jer. 20,10; Luc. 6,7; 1 Cor. 7,16; 1 Joh. 4,1; Act. 10,18; ከመ፡ ኣእምር፡ ለእመሁ፡ 2 Cor. 2,9; Matth. 26,63; Mal. 1,8; ለእመ፡ ኑ፡ Gen. 37,14; እመ፡ ኑ፡ Tob. 5,9; Tob. 8,12. b utrum-an: እመ፡ (ለእመ፡) – ወለእመሂ፡ አልቦ፡ Gen. 24,21; Gen. 42,16; Ex. 16,4; Num. 11,23; ለእመ፡ ኑ፡ – ወለእመ፡ ኢ፡ Gen. 27,21; እመ፡ – ወለእመሂ፡ ኢ፡ Gen. 37,32; Ex. 17,7; ለእመ፡ – አው፡ Act. 23,9. c እመቦ፡ ከመ፡ an forte Jer. 21,2; 1 Thess. 3,5. d rarius an, ubi interrogatio nulla praemissa est: ወእመቦ፡ ἤ Job 9,26. D እመ፡ vel እም፡ ἄν vid. mox sub እም፡ – Pro እመ፡ nonnumquam occurrit እም፡, cum verbo proxime sequenti conjunctum: ዘእምገበርኩ፡ quod si fecero Matth. 19,16; Sir. 28,12 (in uno libro, a me inspecto).

woorden.betekenis: melius esset nobis, si non creati essemus, mallet eam mori,
woorden.definitie: inseparabilis et እመ፡ particula conditionalis et optativa; forma እም፡ in communi usu recepta est, forma እመ፡ passim, maxime in libris vel editionibus antiquioribus occurrit, ut in ed. Rom. N.T. Marc. 13,20; Joh. 11,21; Hebr. 4,8; Rom. 4,14; Jud. 9,29; 2 Reg. 18,12; 4 Esr. 3,54; 4 Esr. 7,20; Job 3,13; Jes. 48,19; Ob. 5, al. 1 part. conditionalis, sc. ἄν, usitata in apodosi enuntiationis conditionalis ejus, in qua id, quod non factum est nec facile fiet, sumitur, sive protasis a scriptore addita sit sive omissa. a protasi addita: እምኀየሰነ፡ ሶበ፡ ኢተፈጠርነ፡ melius esset nobis, si non creati essemus 4 Esr. 2,23; Job 14,13; ሶበ፡ ፈቀድከ፡ እምወሀብኩ፡ εἰ ἠθέλησας, ἔδωκα ἄν Ps. 50,17; ita fere semper in apodosi ea, cujus protasis conjunctione ሶበ፡ notata est, vid. exempla sub ሶበ፡ col. 355 allata (gramm. § 205,2); rarius in ea apodosi, cujus protasis conjunctione እመ፡ vel ለእመ፡ regitur, vid. sub እመ፡ A, 2 (col. 725). b protasi omissa: እምአስተገበርክዎ፡ Matth. 25,27; Matth. 26,9; Matth. 16,26; Gen. 21,7; Gen. 31,29; ወእምአብደረ፡ ትሙት፡ mallet eam mori Tob. 6,13; 4 Esr. 3,54; እመኢሰረቁኑ፡ ዘየአክሎሙ፡ Ob. 5. c Nota locutionem: ሕቀ፡ ክመ፡ ዘእም …፡ seq. Perf., haud multum abfuit quin, vid. sub ሕቀ፡ col. 98. 2 Nota optativi: a raro እም፡ nudum, ut: እምፈተውኩ፡ ለልየ፡ እትጐርዐይ፡ εἰ γὰρ ὄφελον δυναίμην ἐμαυτὸν χειρώσασθαι (optarem) Job 30,24. b crebrius post መኑ፡ quis? ut: መኑ፡ እምወሀበኒ፡ τίς δῴη Num. 11,29; Jud. 9,29; መኑ፡ እምጸሐፎ፡ ለዝ፡ ነገርየ፡ Job 19,23; Job 29,2; Job 31,35; መኑ፡ እምከፈለኒ፡ Org. 2; (plura exempla vid. sub መኑ፡ col. 187). c nonnumquam እም፡ seq. Perf. si! o si! idem valet quod debebat, ut: እምነሣእከ፡ si sumsisses i.e. sumere debebas Matth. 25,27; unde explicanda videtur d locutio: ዘእም …፡ seq. Perf. qui debebat…, seu tantum abest ut-ut, vel loco ejus quod: ዘእምአፍቀሩኒ፡ አስተዋድዩኒ፡ ἀντὶ τοῦ ἀγαπᾶν (qui me diligere debebant, me accusarunt) Ps. 108,3; ዘእምትቤሉ፡ ἀντὶ τοῦ λέγειν ὑμᾶς Jac. 4,15; ያኀስረከ፡ ዘእምአክበረከ፡ ἀντὶ δόξης ἀποδώσει ἀτιμίαν Sir. 29,6; Job 4,3; Job 4,4. ʾǝmma mǝnet L እመ፡ ምኔት ʾǝmma mǝnet abbess of a monastery, vid. ምኔት 351b

woorden.betekenis: avus, avia, avia ejus paterna, avi paternus, maternus, avius
woorden.definitie: (etiam per ሄ et ኄ) subst. m., fem. እምሔውት፡ (et እምሔት፡?), Pl. c. እምሔዋት፡ et እምሔዋን፡ et አማሑት፡ (nonnumquam እምሔውት፡ pro Plur. fem.) 1 avus, avia a sensu proprio: እምሔው፡ πάππος Chrys. ho. 26; Hen. 83,3; Jsp. p. 321; Jsp. p. 334; Sx. Mij. 7Enc. (ubi ኢያቄም፡ avus salvatoris nominatur); እምሔውት፡ μάμμα 2 Tim. 1,5; ሐና፡ እምሔውተ፡ አምላክ፡ በሥጋ፡ Sx. Hed. 11; እምሔውቱ፡ ዘአቡሁ፡ avia ejus paterna F.N. 42,2; እምሔዋን፡ ዘአብ፡ et ዘእም፡ avi paternus et maternus F.N. 42,6; ወላድያን፡ ወእምሔዋን፡ F.N. 24,2; F.N. 42,4; እምሔዋት፡ avius et avia F.N. 52; F.N. 42,3; F.M. 5,3; እማት፡ ወእምሔውት፡ matres et aviae F.N. 24,2. b in genere: proavus, proavia ( abavus, atavus, al.), progenitor, progenitrix, propator: Jsp. p. 275(ubi Nebucadnezar እምሔው፡ Belsazaris nominatur); አሮን፡ እምሔወ፡ ቀደምቶሙ፡ 2 Esr. 7,5; προπάτωρ Chrys. ho. 12; እምሔውየ፡ Hen. 60,8; Hen. 65,2; እግዚአብሔር፡ ይቤሎሙ፡ ለእምሔው፡ ወለእምሔውት፡ ቀዳማውያን፡ ብዝኁ፡ ወተባዝኁ፡ F.N. 24,1; አማሑቶሙ፡ Ex. 10,6. 2 altor, altrix, nutritor, nutrix, tutor, tutrix: ἐπίτροπος Gal. 4,2; ወነገሥት፡ አማሑትኪ፡ ἔσονται βασιλεῖς τιθηνοί σου Jes. 49,23. – Voc. Ae.: ሔው፡ (sic) እማሁት፡ (sic) ብ፡ አያት።

woorden.betekenis: cubitus, ulna, Voc. Ae.
woorden.definitie: subst., fem. et m. [אַמָּה ܐܳܡܳܐ, ⲙⲁϩⲓ; vid. etiam Ges. thes. p. 110] Pl. እመታት፡ cubitus, ulna, 1 pars brachii anterior: እደዊሃ፡ ትሰፍሕ፡ ዲበ፡ ዘይበቍዕ፡ ወእመታ፡ ታጸንዕ፡ ለፈቲል፡ Prov. 29,37; Did. 3; ሰላም፡ ለእመታትኪ፡ I Sal. Mar. 23; መላጼያት፡ ዘእመት፡ (tormenti genus) Sx. Ter 15. 2 mensura: Matth. 6,27; ኑኁ፡ በአምጣነ፡ እመተ፡ ኬንያ፡ 2 Par. 3,3; Ex. 25,10; Ex. 25,17; numeralibus jungi solet intercedente በ፡, ut: ዕፅ፡ ዘ፶ በእመት፡ Esth. 5,14; Gen. 6,15; Ex. 26,2; Ex. 27,1; Kuf. 5; Hez. 40,5 seq.; ዝንቱ፡ አምጣነ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡ በእመታት፡ Hez. 43,13; ኑኁ፡ ዕሥራ፡ በእመት፡ Zach. 5,2; Dan. 3,1; Jer. 52,21 vers. nov.; Judith 1,2; Judith 1,3; Judith 1,4; Hen. 7,2; Joh. 21,8; distinguuntur እመተ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወእመተ፡ መልአክ፡ Apoc. 21,17; de እመተ፡ መንፈስ፡ ቅዱስ፡ vid. Clem. f. 55; Gad. Ad. – Voc. Ae.: እመት፡ ብ፡ ክንድ።

woorden.betekenis: eminuit, conspicuus, clarus fuit, ostendere, cognoscere, sci
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., quae primitus significavit eminuit (vid. אָמִיר et Ges. thes. p. 119), deinde conspicuus, clarus fuit (vid. አሚር፡); inde propagantur significationes aeth. ostendere, cognoscere, scire, hebr. et syr. dicere, jubere, arab. jubere, imperare.

woorden.betekenis: cognoscere, nosse, scire, percipere, videre, animadvertere,
woorden.definitie: II,1 cognoscere, nosse, scire 1 percipere, videre, animadvertere, sentire, seq. ከመ፡ c. Ind.: አእመረ፡ ዳዊት፡ ከመ፡ መጽአ፡ ሳኦል፡ εἶδεν ὅτι 1 Reg. 26,3; Gen. 3,7; Jud. 6,22; Marc. 5,30; seq. pron. interrog. Ex. 2,4; c. Acc. pers. et rei 1 Reg. 26,12; Ps. 34,9; Matth. 9,4; Luc. 8,46; Luc. 9,47; Joh. 6,61; abs. Matth. 12,15; Matth. 24,50; Gen. 19,33; Cant. 6,12. 2 comperire, percontari, rescire: ከመ፡ ያእምር፡ ሰላሞሙ፡ Kuf. 34; 1 Reg. 17,56; 1 Reg. 23,22; Gen. 9,24; Ruth 3,4; Matth. 9,30; c. በኀበ፡ pers. Gal. 3,2; Marc. 15,45; አእመሩ፡ ኀበ፡ አቡሁ፡ ወይቤልዎ፡ ምንተ፡ ትፈቅድ፡ Sx. Sen. 30; seq. ከመ፡ Act. 23,27. a experiendo cognoscere aliquid i.e. experiri: ኢያአምር፡ ነገረ፡ እኩየ፡ Koh. 8,5; Job 21,19; Rom. 7,7; 2 Cor. 5,21. b animadvertere vel curare aliquid Gen. 39,6; Hebr. 3,10; አእምሮ፡ አእምር፡ መንፈሰ፡ መራዕይከ፡ Prov. 27,23; martyres ኢያእመርዎ፡ ለሕማመ፡ ስምዕ፡ Org. 3 cognoscere, intelligere, agnoscere: አእምሪ፡ ወርእዪ፡ ዘከመ፡ 1 Reg. 25,17; seq. ከመ፡, ut: አእመረ፡ ዳዊት፡ ከመ፡ ሞተ፡ ሕፃን፡ 2 Reg. 12,19; 1 Reg. 3,20; Jes. 45,6; Jer. 16,21; Hez. 2,5; 4 Esr. 9,1; Matth. 21,45; Matth. 24,32; Joh. 4,1; Joh. 6,69; Joh. 7,17; አእመርነ፡ ከመ፡ ንሰብሖ፡ cognovimus eum nobis laudandum esse Hen. 63,4; c. Acc. rei vel pers.: አእሚሮ፡ ምግባሮሙ፡ መጠዎሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ጽልመት፡ Job 24,14; Matth. 22,18; አእመርነ፡ ኀጢአተነ፡ Jer. 14,20; አእምሪ፡ ዐመፃኪ፡ Jer. 3,13; Num. 22,23; Joh. 8,32; ንዴግን፡ ከመ፡ ናእምሮ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ Hos. 6,3; Joh. 13,35; Joh. 17,3; ኣአምር፡ ርእስየ፡ ከመ፡ መሬት፡ ወሐመድ፡ አነ፡ Job 42,6; c. በ፡ notae ( ex, vel Abl.): በዝንቱ፡ ታአምሩ፡ ከመ፡ Ep. Jer. 22; Num. 16,28; 1 Esr. 4,22; 1 Joh. 3,16; 1 Joh. 4,2; Joh. 13,35; vel c. በእንተ፡ 1 Joh. 2,3; vel c. እምነ፡ fontis Dan. 9,2; Rom. 1,20 ant. In specie: a agnoscere: Gen. 42,7; Gen. 42,8; 1 Reg. 26,17; Job 2,12; Job 6,15; Joh. 1,10; Marc. 7,24. b dignoscere, Gen. 3,5; Deut. 1,39; 1 Cor. 11,29; c. Acc. et እምነ፡ 3 Reg. 3b,9. c discere, c. እምነ፡ ab aliquo Ps. 118,152; Matth. 11,29; Matth. 24,32. d cognoscere mulierem vel virum, euphemistice de consuetudine et familiaritate sexuum ( concumbere ): አእመራ፡ ለብእሲቱ፡ Gen. 4,1; 1 Reg. 1,19; Matth. 1,25; ኢታአምር፡ ብእሴ፡ Gen. 24,16; Gen. 19,8; Num. 31,17; Jud. 11,39. 4 mente capere, comprehendere, intelligere, perspicere: ታአምርኑ፡ ዘታነብብ፡ Act. 8,30; Marc. 4,13; Joh. 12,16; Joh. 13,12; Prov. 2,5; Prov. 2,9; Prov. 8,5; ኢክህሉ፡ አእምሮቶ፡ (ለሕልም፡) Kuf. 40. 5 cognovisse, nosse, c. Acc. rei: ዘያአምር፡ ልበ፡ Job 7,20; ታአምር፡ ልበ፡ ወኵልያተ፡ Jer. 20,12; አልቦ፡ ዘያአምር፡ መኑሂ፡ መቃብሮ፡ Deut. 34,6; Ps. 43,23; Ps. 68,7; Ps. 68,23; Ps. 103,20; በኢያእምሮ፡ ወጻሕፍት፡ Matth. 22,29; Marc. 10,19; ታአምሩ፡ ፍኖተ፡ Joh. 14,4; c. Acc. pers.: Gen. 29,5; Ex. 1,8; Jes. 1,3; Jes. 45,5; Jes. 63,16; እለ፡ ያአምሩ፡ ርእሶሙ፡ Prov. 13,10; ሕዝብ፡ ዘኢታአምር፡ ትካት፡ Ruth 2,11; Jer. 1,5; Matth. 25,12; Marc. 14,71; Joh. 1,49; Joh. 10,15; Joh. 16,3; ናአምረከ፡ መኑ፡ አንተ፡ Marc. 1,24; c. Acc. pers. seq. ከመ፡, ut: አነ፡ አእመርኩከ፡ ከመ፡ እኩይ፡ አንተ፡ Jes. 48,4; Joh. 5,42; Act. 26,5. In specie a de amicis et familiaribus, qui sese invicem norunt: እለ፡ ያአምሩኒ፡ οἱ γνωστοί μου ( noti ) Ps. 87,8; ዘያአምሮ፡ ለምታ፡ γνώριμος τῷ ἀνδρὶ αὐτῆς Ruth 2,1; Job 20,7; Job 42,11. b ቀደመ፡ vel አቅደመ፡ አእምሮ፡ praenovisse, ante cognovisse, προγιγνώσκειν Rom. 11,2; Rom. 8,29. 6 scire, cum negatione nescire, ignorare, c. Acc. rei, 1 Reg. 22,15; ምንተ፡ ታአምር፡ ዘኢናአምር፡ ንሕነ፡ Job 15,9; እለ፡ ታአምሩ፡ ፍትሐ፡ Jes. 51,7; Ps. 34,13; Ps. 138,1; Ps. 138,4; Koh. 9,5; Matth. 13,11; Matth. 20,22; Luc. 22,60; Joh. 18,4; Rom. 10,3; c. በ፡ 2 Reg. 17,19 { 3 Reg. 2,32}; c. ለ፡, ut: ያአምር፡ ሊተ፡ ዘውስተ፡ አርያም፡ ὁ δὲ συνίστωρ μου ἐν ὑψίστοις Job 16,19; (Matth. 6, 32); seq. pron. interrog., ut Gen. 21,26; Ex. 32,1; Jos. 2,4; Jos, 2,5; 1 Reg. 25,11; Matth. 12,7; Joh. 7,27; Apoc. 3,3; seq. ከመ፡ Jos. 8,14; Jos. 16,20; Tob. 3,14; 1 Par. 29,17; 1 Reg. 14,3; 1 Reg. 20,3; Joh. 21,24; Rom. 2,2; Rom. 3,19; Rom. 7,14; 1 Joh. 3,14; 1 Joh. 3,15; seq. እስመ፡ ut Hen. 98,8; c. Acc. pers. et seq. ከመ፡, ut: ምስለ፡ ብእሲ፡ ዘታአምር፡ ከመ፡ ቦ፡ ሃይማኖተ፡ (quem scis habere fidem) Sir. 37,12; Luc. 4,41; omisso objecto Ex. 16,15; Gen. 4,9; Gen. 48,19; Ps. 72,11; seq. Infin. (in Acc): ታአምሩ፡ ሠናየ፡ ሀብተ፡ ውሂበ፡ Luc. 11,13; Jac. 4,17; Koh. 10,15; Jes. 8,4; ኢያአምሩ፡ ገቢረ፡ ሠናይ፡ Jer. 4,22; ኢያአምር፡ አክብሮ፡ ዐቢይ፡ Job 34,19. Nonnumquam a scire i.q. didicisse, peritum, scitum, gnarum esse, c. Acc., ut: አእመረ፡ ብሔረ፡, ፍኖተ፡ Tob. 5,5; Tob. 5,6; እለ፡ ያአምሩ፡ ሰቆቃወ፡ Am. 5,16; ዘያአምር፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ἐπιστάμενος γράμματα Jes. 29,11; ታአምርኑ፡ ጽርዐ፡ Act. 21,37; c. Infin. (in Acc.) Matth. 16,3; አልብነ፡ ዘያአምር፡ ገዚመ፡ ዕፀው፡ 3 Reg. 5,6. b አቅደመ፡ አእምሮ፡ praescire Ps. 36,13; ያቀድም፡ አእምሮ፡ ተኣምራት፡ Sap. 8,8; Gal. 3,8. c nonnumquam significat scientia imbutum esse, sapere (vid. ማእምር፡, አእምሮ፡); ኢያእመረ፡ inscium, imprudentem esse, ut: ኢያአምሩ፡ Jes. 45,20; Ps. 72,11; Ps. 81,5; በኢያእምሮ፡ imprudenter, ignorantia, errore, involuntarie: Koh. 5,5; Koh. 10,5; Gen. 43,12; Lev. 4,2; Lev. 5,17; Lev. 22,14; Num. 35,11; Rom. 8,20. – Infin. አእምሮ፡ et አእምሮት፡ vid. infra. – Voc. Ae.: አእመረ፡ ዘ፡ አወቀ፡

woorden.betekenis: se cognoscendum praebere, nosci, cognosci, agnosci, dignosci
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 se cognoscendum praebere, nosci, cognosci, agnosci, dignosci, notum esse, innotescere: ተአመርኩ፡ ሎሙ፡ ἐγνώσθην αὐτοῖς Hez. 20,5; Ex. 2,25; Ex. 25,22; ተአምረ፡ ἐγνώσθη Koh. 6,10; አልቦ፡ ዘተአምረ፡ ዘገብአ፡ እምሲኦል፡ Sap. 2,1; 4 Esr. 4,12; ልበ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ኢይትአመር፡ Prov. 25,3; Rom. 7,13; 1 Petr. 1,20; ከመ፡ ኢይትአመር፡ ( ut ne cognosceretur ) Asc. Jes. 10,24; Asc. Jes. 11,17; Rom. 1,20; Asc. Jes. 7,27; ውስተ፡ ልበ፡ አብድ፡ ኢትትአመር፡ ጽድቅ፡ διαγινώσκεται Prov. 14,33; c. በ፡ notae 4 Esr. 8,42, vel c. እምነ፡, ut: ልበ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ይትአመር፡ እምአፉሁ፡ Prov. 16,23; Sir. 26,9; ዘኢይትአመር፡ ignotus vel qui cognosci non potest, ut: አራዊት፡ እለ፡ ኢይትአመሩ፡ θῆρες ἄγωστοι Sap. 11,19; ልበ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ኢይትአመር፡ ἀνεξέλεγκτος Prov. 25,3; Act. 17,23; Deus ኢኮነ፡ ስዉረ፡ ዘኢይትአመር፡ ዳእሙ፡ ጥዩቀ፡ አእመርናሁ፡ Did. 33; ኀይላት፡ ዘኢተአምሩ፡ Jer. 40,3. 2 sese invicem agnoscere Gen. 45,1 (nisi III,3 legere malueris). 3 sibi invicem indicare vel designare aliquid i.e. convenire de signo: በከመ፡ ተአምረ፡ (v. ተአመረ፡) ምስለ፡ ዳዊት፡ ለስምዕ፡ 1 Reg. 20,35. 4 signum dare (aliâs III,2), ut: እመ፡ ኢተአምረ፡ በቃለ፡ ቀርን፡ Hez. 33,6.

woorden.betekenis: clarus, illustris, pellucidus, notus, cognitus, agnoscibilis
woorden.definitie: part. 1 clarus, illustris, pellucidus (cfr. አሚር፡): ከመ፡ ደመናት፡ ወነፋሳት፡ ወዝናማት፡ እሙራት፡ በመዋዕለ፡ ማእረር፡ ኢይበቍዑ፡ ἐπιφανέστατα Prov. 25,14 vers. ant. 2 notus, cognitus: እሙረ፡ ይከውን፡ ለክሙ፡ እስመ፡ Hen. 97,2; ከመ፡ እሙረ፡ ይኩን፡ በልብየ፡ ፈቃድከ፡ Rel. Bar.; ወይእቲ፡ (ሀገር፡) እምርት፡ እስከ፡ ይእዜ፡ Jsp. p. 273; መቃብረ፡ ጴጥሮስ፡ ወጳውሎስ፡ ወዮሐንስ፡ ወቶማስ፡ እሙራን፡ ወክሡታን፡ Chrys. ho. 26; c. ለ፡ pers.: ወትከውን፡ ግብጽ፡ እምርተ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ Jes. 19,21, vel c. በኀበ፡, ut: እምርት፡ ይእቲ፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Sap. 4,1; Zach. 14,7; Prov. 16,2; ቀትል፡ በመጥባሕት፡ (i.e. sica) ኢኮነ፡ እሙረ፡ በኀበ፡ አይሁድ፡ ቅድመ፡ ውእቱ፡ አዝማን፡ Jsp. p. 347; c. በ፡ nominis (i.e. مَعْرُوفٌ بِ): ዮሐንስ፡ በመጽሐፈ፡ ራእዩ፡ ዘእሙር፡ በአቡቀለምሲስ፡ Abush. 20; F.N. prolg. (et in aliis libris ex Arabico versis). a agnoscibilis, noscibilis, c. በ፡ notae 1 Joh. 3,10; c. እምነ፡, ut: እምብርሃነ፡ አዕይንቲከ፡ እሙር፡ አንተ፡ Rel. Bar. b bene notus, insignis: ሀገር፡ እምርት፡ οὐκ ἄσημος πόλις Act. 21,39; ብእሲ፡ ዘእሙር፡ በኀይል፡ ወጽንዕ፡ Jsp. p. 347. 3 significatus vel notatus i.e. certus, constitutus, status: በእምርት፡ ዕለት፡ ἐν εὐσήμῳ ἡμέρᾳ Ps. 80,3; እስከ፡ ዕድሜ፡ እሙር፡ Jsp. p. 281; Hen. 78,9; በበዓላት፡ እሙራት፡ F.M. 10,3; በዓላት፡ vel መዋዕል፡ እሙራት፡ festa solemnia, Lud. e Syn.; በእምርት፡ ዕለት፡ በዓልነ፡ ንዑ፡ ንትፈሣሕ፡ Mavâs. 47; በበሰዓቱ፡ እሙራን፡ Clem. f. 250; etiam certus i.e. quidam, ut Hen. 74,4; እሙራን፡ ሰብእ፡ τινές Cyr. de r. fid. f. 58 ( Voc. ad Cyr. male: እሙር፡ ዘ፡ ረሲዕ፡); sine dubio etiam 2 Petr. 3,16 ant.

woorden.betekenis: cognitio, scientia, inscitia, ignorantia, intelligentia, int
woorden.definitie: vel አእምሮት፡ m. et fem., Infin. (II,1), crebro Substantivi instar usurpatur: 1 cognitio, scientia: አእምሮ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Jes. 11,9; አእምሮ፡ ጥበብ፡ ἐπιστήμη συνέσεως Sir. 17,7; Rom. 1,19; 2 Petr. 2,20; 1 Cor. 8,1; 1 Cor. 12,8; እምኢያእምሮ፡ ውስተ፡ አእምሮ፡ አማን፡ አግብኦሙ፡ Lud. e Syn.; ኢያእምሮ፡ inscitia, ignorantia Rom. 1,21; vid. etiam supra sub አእመረ፡ Nr. 6,c. 2 intelligentia, intellectus, sapientia, disciplina: γνῶσις Koh. 1,16; Koh. 1,17; Koh. 9,10; σύνεσις Job 12,13; Sir. 15,3; Jes. 11,2; Prov. 1,7; Prov. 2,2; Prov. 2,3; αἴσθησις Prov. 15,14; Prov. 22,12; ተዐውቆ፡ ወአእምሮ፡ αἴσθησις καὶ ἔννοια Prov. 1,4; ጥበብ፡ ወአእምሮኒ፡ σοφία καὶ παιδεία Sir. 1,27; Jer. 3,15 var.; Dan. 1,17; አእምሮቱ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ Rom. 11,33; ኵላ፡ አእምሮቶሙ፡ Kuf. p. 84.

woorden.betekenis: sciens, scitus, gnarus, peritus, eruditus, doctus, divinator
woorden.definitie: part. 1 sciens, scitus, gnarus, peritus, 1 Reg. 2,3; ማእምረ፡ ልብ፡ καρδιογνώστης Act. 1,24; ማእምረ፡ ኅቡኣት፡ Org.; ማእምራን፡ ለገቢረ፡ ሠናይ፡ Koh. 4,17; ማእምራነ፡ ቃል፡ συνετοὶ ἐν λόγοις Sir. 18,29. a eruditus, doctus Jsp. p. 328, al. b in malam partem: divinator, hariolus, vates, magus, fatidicus, οἱ γνῶσται ማእምራን፡ 1 Reg. 28,3; 1 Reg. 28,9; 4 Reg. 21,6; γνωρισταί 4 Reg. 23,24; στοχαστής Jes. 3,2, Χαλδαῖοι Dan. 2,2; γαζαρηνοί Dan. 4,3; Dan. 5,15; ኢትኩን፡ ማእምረ፡ ትእምርታት፡ . p. 315 Nr. 50. 2 intelligens, sapiens, prudens, Deut. 1,13; Deut. 1,15; 1 Reg. 18,14; Job 34,2 (ἐπιστάμενοι); Koh. 9,11 (συνετοί); Sir. 3,29; Sir. 9,15; Prov. 10,19 (νοήμων); Prov. 17,12; Prov. 12,16 (πανοῦργος); Prov. 13,1; Prov. 14,15; Prov. 14,24; Prov. 22,3; Prov. 12,23 (συνετός); Matth. 11,25. 3 qui novit aliquem, familiaris, amicus, notus: ማእምርነ፡ ὁ γνώριμος ἡμῶν Ruth 3,2; Ps. 54,14; Sir. 6,5 (φίλος). māʾmǝr C for ሊቀ፡ ማእምራን፡ liqa māʾmǝrān vid. ሊቅ፡

woorden.betekenis: signum, nota, indicium, notae, insigne, monumentum, tropaeum
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. ተኣምር፡ (crebro ተአምር፡ scriptum), rarius ትእምርታት፡, Pl. Pl. ተኣምራት፡; Pl. ተኣምር፡ crebro pro Singulari usurpatur (gramm. § 141); 1 signum a nota, indicium: Matth. 16,3; Matth. 26,48; Rom. 4,11; 1 Cor. 14,22; ርእዮ፡ ትእምርቶ፡ ለዓለም፡ Sir. 42,18; ምንት፡ ትእምርቱ፡ ለዕድሜሁ፡ 4 Esr. 4,14; 4 Esr. 3,1; Marc. 13,4; Lev. 13,2 seq.; Lev. 14,36 seq.; Gen. 1,14; Sir. 43,6; Sir. 43,7; ትእምርታት፡ notae (rei inventae) F.N. 40. b insigne: ትእምርተ፡ ኪዳንየ፡ Gen. 9,12 seq.; Kuf. 15; Ex. 31,13; Ex. 31,17. c monumentum; Ex. 13,9; Ex. 13,16; Jos. 4,6; Hez. 39,15; Jes. 19,20; Jes. 55,13; ትእምርቱ፡ ለበዓል፡ στήλη τοῦ Βάαλ Num. 22,41; ትእምርተ፡ መዊእ፡ τὸ τρόπαιον tropaeum Chrys. Ta. 5. d monitorium Num. 17,3; Num. 17,25; Num. 26,10; Deut. 6,8; Deut. 28,46. e ( signum militare i.e.) vexillum: Num. 2,2; ይገብር፡ (v. ያነሥእ፡) ትእምርተ፡ ለአሕዛብ፡ ርሑቃን፡ Jes. 5,26; Jes. 11,12; ንሥኡ፡ ትእምርተ፡ Jer. 6,1. f bellicum, classicum, signum tuba datum: ነፍኀ፡ በቀርን፡ ትእምርተ፡ ለሰራዊት፡ Hez. 33,3; Jos. 6,8; Lev. 25,11 seq.; Num. 29,1. g signum coeleste, astrum, sidus, constellatio: ፀሓይ፡ ወተኣምር፡ Hen. 48,3; Hen. 8,3; Kuf. 4; Kuf. 8; ሰገደ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ተኣምረ፡ ሰማይ፡ 2 Par. 33,3; 2 Par. 33,5; Jer. 10,2; μαζουρώθ Job 38,32 var. h miraculum, prodigium, portentum, monstrum, Ex. 4,8; Ex. 4,9; Ex. 7,3; Ex. 7,9; Ex. 11,9; Num. 14,11; Deut. 4,34; Deut. 6,22; Deut. 7,19; Deut. 26,8; Deut. 29,2; Kuf. 48; Ps. 85,16; Ps. 95,3; Dan. 6,27; እገብር፡ ተኣምረ፡ በሰማይ፡ Joel 3,3; Hen. 36,4; 4 Esr. 8,71; 4 Esr. 9,1; 4 Esr. 9,6; ይትወለድ፡ ትእምርት፡ እምአንስት፡ ( monstrum ) 4 Esr. 3,12; Sir. 45,3; Asc. Jes. 11,18; Matth. 24,3; Matth. 24,24; Matth. 24,30; Marc. 16,17; Marc. 16,20; Act. 2,22; Act. 2,43; Act. 4,30; Apoc. 12,1; Apoc. 13,13. i imago vel typus rei futurae Jes. 8,18; Hez. 4,3; ትከውን፡ ሎሙ፡ ትእምርተ፡ Hez. 24,27; ትእምርተ፡ ልደቱ፡ (sc. Christi) Sx. Tachs. 16Enc.; Matth. 12,39. k documentum, argumentum, α in genere: Luc. 2,12; 2 Thess. 3,17; Job 21,29; ወትእምርተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ እስመ፡ (hoc demonstratur eo quod) Chrys. (crebrius); seq. ከመ፡ Ex. 3,12. β in specie: quo divina alicujus auctoritas confirmatur vel propheticum; Deut. 13,2; Deut. 13,3; 1 Reg. 2,34; 1 Reg. 10,1; Jes. 7,11; Jes. 37,30; Jer. 51,29; Joh. 2,18; Joh. 6,30. l vestigium: ሶበ፡ ዘበጦ፡ (ለኀጺን፡) ነሃቢ፡ በሰፌልያ፡ ይትረከብ፡ ትእምርተ፡ ዝብጠት፡ በኀጺን፡ Fid. Jac. Bar. m siglum, F.N. in prolg. n figura, nota, characteres: ትእምርተ፡ መስቀል፡ Sx. Mij. 9 Enc.; ትእምርተ፡ መጻሕፍት፡ (characteres superstitiosi) Lud. ex Org. 2; fortasse Hen. 68,1. o በትእምርት፡ significanter, distincte, ubi de canendo et sonando agitur: 1 Cor. 14,7; 1 Cor. 14,8; Jos. 6,8. 2 demonstratio, explicatio, δήλωσις Lev. 8,8; fortasse Hen. 68,1. – Voc. Ae.: ትእምርት፡ ብ፡ ምልክት፡

woorden.betekenis: serva, ancilla, aliud
woorden.definitie: subst. fem., Pl. አእማት፡ [in caeteris quidem linguis אָמָה ܐܰܡܬܳܐ أَمَةٌ, unde ት primitus notam feminini fuisse constat; sed in lingua Ae. ት pro radicali habitam esse, e Pluralis formatione elucet, gramm. § 136,2] serva, ancilla, ለሠይጠ፡ ገብር፡ ወአመት፡ Kuf. 11; አግብርት፡ ወአእማት፡ Gen. 32,6; Job 31,13; Jes. 24,2; አእማት፡ Jes. 14,2; Jes. 56,6; Gen. 12,16; Gen. 16,1 seq.; Gen. 21,10; Gen. 29,24; Ex. 21,7; Ex. 21,20; Kuf. 50; Ruth 2,13; Tob. 3,7; Joh. 18,17; Act. 2,18; F.N. 42,12; አመት፡ እንተ፡ ትነብር፡ ዲበ፡ ማሕረፅ፡ Ex. 11,5; in colloquio cum nobilioribus mulier se dicit አመትከ፡ Ruth 2,13; Ruth 3,9; 1 Reg. 1,11; 1 Reg. 1,18; 1 Reg. 25,27; 1 Reg. 28,21; 1 Reg. 28,22; 2 Reg. 14,15; Luc. 1,38. – Voc. Ae.: አመት፡ ዘ፡ ገረድ፡; aliud: አመት፡ ዘ፡ ሴት፡ ባርያ።

woorden.betekenis: amavit, dilexit, osculari, dilectionis et venerationis signi
woorden.definitie: I,2 [componendum videtur cum وَمِقَ amavit, dilexit ] 1 osculari (sicut φιλεῖν), ut: epistola perveniens ad eum ተአምኅ፡ ሊተ፡ አእዳዊሁ፡ ህየንተ፡ አፈ፡ ዚአየ፡ (osculetur meo nomine manus ejus vice oris mei), p. 43 Nr. 49; cfr. ተኣምኀ፡ et አምኃ፡ 2 dilectionis et venerationis significationem dare alicui, salutare aliquem (non tantum ሰላም፡ dicendo, sed „cum aliqua honoris praefatione et corporis vel capitis inclinatione vel cum muneris alicujus oblatione vel cum osculo,“ et amplexu ut inter familiares Lud.) a familiares, amicos, sive praesentes, sive per literas vel nuntios Ex. 18,7 (προσεκύνησεν); ἀσπάζεσθαι Luc. 1,40; Hen. 71,14; Rom. 16,3; Rom. 16,4; Rom. 16,5; Rom. 16,6; Rom. 16,7; Rom. 16,8; Rom. 16,9; Rom. 16,10; Rom. 16,11; Rom. 16,12; Rom. 16,13; Rom. 16,14; Rom. 16,15; Rom. 16,16; Rom. 16,21; Rom. 16,22; Rom. 16,23; Phil. 4,21; Phil. 4,22; 2 Thess. 3,17; Tit. 3,15; 1 Petr. 5,13. b alios, reverentiae causa, Asc. Jes. 6,4. c principes, reges: Herodes አምኆ፡ ለአውግስጦስ፡ ወይቤሎ፡ Jsp. p. 325; ፈነዎሙ፡ ኀበ፡ ሰሎሞን፡ የአምኅዎ፡ 3 Reg. 5,1; Matth. 4,9; etiam de peregrinantibus, qui loca sacra visitantes salutant, p. 302 Nr. 4. 3 salutationis causa munus offerre alicui, munere oblato salutare aliquem, c. dupl. Acc.: Herodes አዘዞሙ፡ ለኵሎሙ፡ ዐበይቱ፡ ከመ፡ የአምኅዎ፡ (sc. Herodis filium) ንዋየ፡ በከመ፡ ክሂሎቶሙ፡ Jsp. p. 334; ይኤምኅዎ፡ ሎቱ፡ ወርቀ፡ Sx. Mij. 6; እለ፡ ይኤምኁከ፡ ወርቀ፡ Sx. Mag. 29 Enc.

woorden.betekenis: osculari, consalutare inter se, sese invicem salutare, oscul
woorden.definitie: III,3 (plerumque ተአምኀ፡ scriptum) 1 osculari vel consalutare inter se, sese invicem salutare: ተኣምኁ፡ ወተሓቀፉ፡ 1 Esr. 4,47; Ex. 18,7; Tob. 5,19; Hen. 81,7; ተኣምኁ፡ በበይናቲክሙ፡ በአምኃ፡ ቅድሳት፡ ἀσπάσασθε ἀλλήλους ἐν φιλήματι ἁγίῳ Rom. 16,16; 1 Petr. 5,14; inde de osculo pacis quo sese excipiunt Christiani, Lit. 164,1; Did. 12, al. 2 osculo excipere, salutare aliquem, c. Acc., καταφιλεῖν Ex. 4,27; 2 Reg. 15,5; Luc. 7,45; Herm. p. 86; ተቀበሎሙ፡ ወተኣምኆሙ፡ 1 Par. 12,17; ἀσπάζεσθαι Matth. 5,47; Luc. 1,41; Marc. 12,38; ተኣምኆሙ፡ በአምኃ፡ መንፈሳዊት፡ Gad. T.H.; ተኣምኆ፡ salutatio, salutationes Matth. 23,7; etiam c. Acc. rei, quae quasi salutatur Hebr. 11,13. 3 salutare i.e. valedicere alicui: ዘይፈቱ፡ ድንግልና፡ ይትኣማኅ፡ ኵሎ፡ ጥሪቶ፡ ውሂቦ፡ ለምስኪናን፡ Kid. f. 28.

woorden.betekenis: osculatio, osculum, salutatio, munera, dona, munus
woorden.definitie: subst., fem. et m., 1 osculatio, osculum, φίλημα Rom. 16,16; 1 Thess. 5,25; 1 Petr. 5,14; ከመ፡ ንትኣማኅ፡ በበይናቲነ፡ በአምኃ፡ ቅድሳት፡ Lit. 164,1. 2 salutatio, ἀσπασμός, እፎኑ፡ ዘከመዝ፡ አምኃ፡ Luc. 1,29; አምኃ፡ ዘአምኀ፡ ባቲ፡ አብ፡ ለወልድ፡ Kedr f. 16. 3 munera, dona, munus, quae offeruntur salutationis vel venerationis causa: Gen. 32,14; Gen. 43,11; Kuf. 42; 1 Reg. 25,27; 4 Reg. 5,15; Jes. 60,14; አምኃ፡ ወሀብት፡ Jer. 47,5 var.; Matth. 2,11; Mavâs. 27; in specie quae offerentur a sponsae ejusve parentibus et consanguineis Gen. 24,53; F.N. 24,3. b principi, regi, Deo: 1 Reg. 10,27; 3 Reg. 10,25; 4 Reg. 16,8; አምጽኡ፡ ሎቱ፡ አምኃ፡ 2 Par. 17,5; 2 Par. 26,8; Ps. 44,14; Ps. 71,10; Ps. 75,11; Jes. 18,7; Jes. 39,1; Jes. 66,20; ያመጽኡ፡ አምኃ፡ ለንጉሠ፡ ሰማይ፡ Tob. 13,11; Jsp. p. 325 seq. c judici (corruptionis causa): አምኃ፡ ወሕልያን፡ Sir. 20,29; ኢትንሣእ፡ ሕልያን፡ ወአምኃ፡ ሰብእ፡ Kuf. 21. – Scholion Voc. Ae. vide supra sub መሀና፡ col. 145.

woorden.betekenis: credere facere, persuadere, ad fidem, convertere, quos ab in
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 credere facere i.e. a persuadere, c. Acc.: ንሕነ፡ ናኣምኖ፡ ἡμεῖς πείσομεν αὐτόν Matth. 28,14; Act. 14,19 rom.; Act. 18,4. b ad fidem (Christianam) convertere: c. Acc. pers.: ዘብዙኀ፡ አሕዛበ፡ አእመነ፡ Deg.; Clem. f. 108; Clem. f. 234; Sx. Masc. 17Enc.; Sx. Haml. 30; c. በ፡ numinis: አእመኖ፡ በስመ፡ ኢየሱስ፡ Sx. Hed. 14; c. እምነ፡, ut: እለ፡ አእመነ፡ እምክሕደት፡ quos ab incredulitate ad fidem convertit Clem. f. 114. 2 confiteri facere, a adigere aliquem ad confessionem: Herodes አእመኖሙ፡ ለዕደው፡ እለ፡ ፈነዎሙ፡ Jsp. p. 321. b praedicare vel celebrare facere: ወያአምን፡ ከናፍሪሆሙ፡ Job 8,21 var.; ለዘረከባ፡ (ለጥበብ)፡ ታአምኖ፡ ወታፈርሆ፡ τῷ εὑρόντι αὐτὴν δώσει ἐξομολόγησιν Sir. 18,28. – De loco Asc. Jes. 3,5 dubito.

woorden.betekenis: fidum, verum se praebere, fidere, confidere, fiduciam, spem
woorden.definitie: et ተአመነ፡ III,1; A reflex. 1 fidum vel verum se praebere: ተአመነ፡ ምስሌነ፡ ምሕረቱ፡ Sir. 50,24. 2 fidere, confidere, fiduciam vel spem ponere in aliquo, fidem habere alicui, fretum esse, sperare, c.c. በ፡, ut: ተአመንኩ፡ በዕንቍ፡ Job 31,24; መኑ፡ ተአመነ፡ በእግዚአብሔር፡ ወተኀፈረ፡ Sir. 2,10; Sir. 11,21; Sir. 35,24; Jes. 30,12; Jer. 17,5 (ἐλπίδα ἔχει ἐπὶ); Jer. 31,11; ተአመነ፡ በጽድቁ፡ Hez. 33,13; Ruth 2,12; Ps. 43,8; Ps. 59,12; Ps. 118,66; Gal. 5,10; Phil. 2,24; Philem. 21; c. Acc.: 2 Thess. 3,4; Ps. 77,26; ኢይትአመና፡ ለሕይወቱ፡ Job 24,22; Job 4,18; Job 15,15; ተአመንዎ፡ πιστεύσατε αὐτῷ Sir. 2,8; Sir. 4,16; እንተ፡ ትትአመን፡ መዛግብቲሃ፡ Jer. 30,4; ኢትትአመኖ፡ ብዙኀ፡ Sir. 6,7; እለ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ተአመነ፡ Jes. 30,32; c. Acc. et በ፡, ut: ኢትትአመንዎሙ፡ በሕይወቶሙ፡ μὴ ἐμπιστεύσῃς τῇς ζωῇ αὐτῶν Sir. 16,3; Ps. 77,36; seq. ከመ፡ c. Ind. vel Subj., ut: ተአመኒ፡ ከመ፡ እገብር፡ ፈቃደኪ፡ Kuf. 25; Job 11,18; ተአሚንየ፡ ከመ፡ ብዙኅ፡ ረድኤት፡ ብየ፡ Job 31,21; ትትአመኖ፡ ከመ፡ ያእቱ፡ ተግባረ፡ ማእረርከ፡ Job 39,12; Ps. 26,19; Rom. 2,19; Phil. 2,19 (ἐλπίζω); Phil. 2,24; absol.: Sir. 2,6; ነአምን፡ ወንትአመን፡ Lit. 165,3; ተአምኖትየ፡ Ps. 83,9. 3 credere, ሃይማኖት፡ እንተ፡ ባቲ፡ ተአመነ፡ (v. ተአምነ፡) 4 Esr. 9,8; c. Acc. rei: ኢትትአመን፡ ኵሎ፡ ቃለ፡ ዘነገሩከ፡ Sir. 19,15; ዘይትአመን፡ ሕልመ፡ (v. በሕልም፡) Sir. 31,2; c. በ፡, ut: ተአመኑ፡ በመስቀል፡ Asc. Jes. 3,18; Asc. Jes. 3,19; Jon. 3,5; Rom. 4,5; Sx. Jac. 13 Enc.; seq. ከመ፡ Rom. 4,18; absol. Rom. 4,19; ተአምኖ፡ fides Hebr. 11,4 seq. 4 sibi persuadere, persuasum habere, seq. ከመ፡ c. Ind. vel Subj., Rom. 8,38; Rom. 14,14; እትአመነክሙ፡ ከመ፡ ትፈጽሙ፡ Rom. 15,14; Hebr. 6,9. 5 bono et confidenti animo esse, nihil sibi timere, securum esse: ኢይትአመኑ፡ Job 29,24; ተአመኒ፡ θάρσει Tob. 7,17; Judith 11,1; Matth. 9,2; Matth. 9,22; Matth. 14,27; Ex. 14,13; Kuf. 50; 4 Esr. 6,72; ይነብር፡ ተአሚኖ፡ Sir. 4,15; Jes. 14,6; Jes. 32,18; Jes. 47,8; Jer. 23,6; seq. Acc. ( ab aliqua re securum esse): ነፍስ፡ አኮ፡ ትትአመን፡ ወዲቀ፡ ለአብሶ፡ Jsp. p. 382. 6 fateri, profiteri, confiteri, c. Acc.: Hebr. 3,1; እንዘ፡ ይትአመኑ፡ ኀጣውኢሆሙ፡ Matth. 3,6; Marc. 1,5; Jac. 5,16; ተአመነ፡ ኀጢአቶ፡ F.M. 6,3; እመ፡ ተአመነ፡ ጌጋዮ፡ Clem. f. 123; c. በ፡, ut: ተአመነ፡ በጌጋዩ፡ Clem. f. 124; F.N. 39 (vox forensis). a ዘይትአመኑ፡ confessores (distincti a martyribus) Const. Ap. 54. b praedicare, celebrare: እትአመን፡ በስምከ፡ ἐξομολογοῦμαι τῷ ὀνόματί σου Sir. 51,1; በኵሉ፡ ዘገብረ፡ እትአመን፡ ቦቱ፡ Sir. 47,8. c professione facta tradere vel donare alicui aliquid (vox forensis), c. በ፡ rei et ለ፡ pers.: F.N. 39,2; F.N. 39,3. 7 fidei alicujus concredere vel committere vel credere, c. Acc. rei et ውስተ፡, ut: በእንተዝ፡ ይትአመኑ፡ ሰብእ፡ ነፍሶሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ዕፅ፡ ሕጹጽ፡ Sap. 14,5; c. Acc. pers. et በ፡ rei: Rom. 3,2 rom.; 1 Thess. 2,4; c. ላዕለ፡ rei Tit. 1,3; c ለ፡ rei (muneris) Lit. 163,2; potestatem dare alicui 1 Tim. 1,12 (τῷ ἐνδυναμώσαντί με). B Pass. 1 credi: Christus ዘተሰብከ፡ ውስተ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ወተአምነ፡ ውስተ፡ ዓለም፡ ወዐርገ፡ በስብሐት፡ Cyr. ad Theod. f. 8; 1 Tim. 3,16 (ተአመነ፡); seq. Acc. Infin., 1 Reg. 3,21. 2 ad fidem converti, 1 Cor. 3,5 ant. 3 fidum haberi, c. በኀበ፡ ab aliquo, 1 Reg. 27,12. 4 concredi, committi, 1 Tim. 1,11 rom. 5 concreditum accipere, fidei vel arbitrio commissum habere aliquid, aucoritate vel plena potestate rei ornatum esse: ወንጌል፡ ዘአነ፡ ተአመንኩ፡ ቦቱ፡ 1 Tim. 1,11 Platt; c. ላዕለ፡ rei, ut: በእንተ፡ ተአምኖ፡ ኤጲስቆጶስ፡ ላዕለ፡ ንዋየ፡ ቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ Can. Ap. 31; Abtel. Ap. 39; c. ዲበ፡, ut: ተአመነ፡ ዲቤሆሙ፡ Lud. e Vit. Greg. Arm.; seq. Subj.: ሰላም፡ ለመቃርስ፡ በእለስክንድርያ፡ ዘተአመነ፤ (v. ዘተአምነ፤) መርዔተ፡ ክርስቶስ፡ ይርዐይ፡ Sx. Masc. 4 Enc.

woorden.betekenis: fidus, verus, verum, veritas, veritasne vestra est? non ador
woorden.definitie: adj. 1 fidus: እመ፡ አማንኑ፡ ውእቱ፡ ለሐዊር፡ ምስሌከ፡ εἰ πιστὸς τοῦ πορευθῆναι μετὰ σοῦ Tob. 5,9. 2 verus: እመ፡ አማነ፡ ኮነ፡ ወጥዩቀ፡ ነገሩ፡ Deut. 13,15; እመሰ፡ አማንኬ፡ 4 Reg. 10,15; አማነ፡ ረሰይክሙ፡ ለነ፡ ዘነገርናሁ፡ 2 Cor. 7,14. a subst. verum, veritas: ይውኅድ፡ ዝምሳሌ፡ እምአማን፡ Cyr. c. Pall. f. 97. b c. pron. suff.: አማንክሙኑ፡ ኢታመልኩ፡ ( veritasne vestra est? non adorabitis? i.e.) an vere non adorabitis? Dan. 3,14; አማንየ፡ እብለከ፡ Sx. Haml. 8. 3 adv. vere, revera, re ipsa, sane, profecto, recte, a አማነ፡, ut: እስመ፡ አማነ፡ ለአከኒ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Jer. 33,15. b plerumque አማን፡, ἀληθῶς Ex. 33,16; 3 Reg. 8,27; 2 Par. 6,18; Jer. 35,6; Joh. 7,26; Joh. 8,31; Joh. 17,8; Matth. 14,33; Luc. 9,27; 1 Joh. 2,5; ἀληθινῶς Sir. 41,24; ἀληθείας Dan. 2,8; Dan. 2,47; Job 19,4; Jes. 37,18; ὄντως Jer. 3,23; Jer. 10,19; Asc. Jes. 9,23; 4 Esr. 8,41; 4 Esr. 8,43; 4 Esr. 10,10; Matth. 4,6; Ps. 7,11; እስመ፡ አማን፡ ከማሁ፡ ውእቱ፡ Judith 11,10; ναί Gen. 42,21; ὀρθῶς Dan. apocr. 1,55; Dan. apocr. 1,59; ἀμήν Joh. 6,32; Matth. 5,18; Matth. 24,2 Platt; አማን፡ ትቤ፡ verum (v. recte ) dixisti Cyr. c. Pall. f. 65; Gen. 42,16. c በአማን፡ ut Kuf. 1; Kuf. 31; Sir. 42,8; 1 Tim. 5,3; Act. 10,34 (ubi in ed. Platt lapsu calami በአምን፡ scriptum est). d ዘበአማን፡ qui vere est, verus, ἀληθής Prov. 1,3; Ps. 68,17; Joh. 1,48; ἀληθινός 1 Joh. 2,8; Joh. 17,3. – Voc. Ae.: አማን፡ አማን፡ ዘ፡ እውን፡ እውን፡ (v. ኡን፡ ኡን፡).

woorden.betekenis: certo, profecto, ita sit, fiat!
woorden.definitie: adv. peregr. sc. ἀμήν, אָמֵן, certo, profecto, ita sit, fiat! γένοιτο γένοιτο አሜን፡ ወአሜን፡ Num. 5,22; Deut. 27,15 seq.; Judith 13,20; ἀμήν 2 Esr. 15,13; 2 Esr. 18,6; Tob. 8,8; Matth. 5,18 rom.; Matth. 6,13; Matth. 24,2 rom.; Joh. 6,32 rom.; Rom. 1,25; Rom. 15,33; Rom. 16,27; Gal. 1,5; Apoc. 1,7 rom.; Apoc. 5,14; Apoc. 7,12; Apoc. 19,4 al.; በቃለ፡ አሜን፡ (v. አሚን፡) አድመፁ፡ ወገብሩ፡ በዓለ፡ Sx. Masc. 10Enc.; in fine orationum et librorum ter repetere solent አሜን፡ Abyssini.

woorden.betekenis: fides, religio, fidei, religionis genera, confessio, fiducia
woorden.definitie: n. act., Pl. እምነታት፡ fides a quae creditur, religio: ዘወለጠ፡ እምነተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ Can. Ant. 1; እምነት፡ ዘመስቀለ፡ ክርስቶስ፡ Sx. Masc. 17Enc.; እምነታት፡ fidei vel religionis genera (ab orthodoxa discrepantia) Chrys. Ta. 8. b confessio: Christus ሊቀ፡ ካህናት፡ ዘእምነትነ፡ ἀρχιερεὺς τῆς ὁμολογίας ἡμῶν Cyr. c. Pall. f. 85(Hebr. 3,1). c qua quis credit, fiducia: Lit. Jac.; ማሕፀንት፡ ንዋይ፡ ይእቲ፡ ዘይሁባ፡ አማሕፃኒ፡ ለዘያመሐፅኖ፡ ከመ፡ ይዕቀባ፡ ሎቱ፡ ወይእቲኬ፡ እምነት፡ ዘአማሕፃኒሃ፡ ዘያነብሩ፡ ኀበ፡ ዘያመሐፅኖ፡ F.N. 29.

woorden.betekenis: verus, qui vere est
woorden.definitie: adj. rel. (ab አማን፡), verus, qui vere est (opp. ficticius, adulterinus): አምላክ፡ አማናዊ፡ F.M. 6,1; በቃሉ፡ አማናዊት፡ F.M. 2,5; Lud. comm. hist.p. 238 Nr. 5; ድንግልና፡ አማናዊ፡ ድንጋሌ፡ ነፍስ፡ ይእቲ፡ Chrys. Ta. 28.

woorden.betekenis: confidens, credens, fidelis, pius Christianus, fidus, fide d
woorden.definitie: et ማእመን፡ (መእመን፡ in antiquioribus libris et editionibus) et ማእምን፡ part., fem. ማእምንት፡ et ማእመንት፡, Pl. m. ምእመናን፡ et ማእመናን፡ et ማእምናን፡, fem. ማእምናት፡ et ማእመናት፡ 1 a confidens, credens (cui significationi proprie forma activa ማእምን፡ convenit): ዕደው፡ ምእመናን፡ በኀይሎሙ፡ ἄνδρες πεποιθότες ἐν ἰσχύι αὐτῶν Judith 2,5; አዋልድ፡ ምእመናት፡ (ἐν ἐλπίδι) Jes. 32,9; baptizandus ይትአመን፡ ከመ፡ ውእቱ፡ ምእመን፡ በአብ፡ ወበወልድ፡ ወበመንፈስ፡ ቅዱስ፡ F.N. 3; ዘምእመን፡ በስምከ፡ Genz. f. 81. b sensu theolog.: fidelis vel pius Christianus: Syn.; ብእሲት፡ ማእምንት፡ F.N. 24,5; ማእምን፡ et ማእምንት፡ Kid. f. 19; ምእመናን፡ et ምእመናት፡ F.M. 5,11. 2 fidus, fide dignus, fidelis (cui significationi proprie forma passiva ምእመን፡, ማእመን፡ convenit) πιστός, maxime de personis: Num. 12,7; Deut. 7,9; 2 Reg. 23,1; Kuf. 17; Kuf. 21; Sir. 44,20; Sir. 48,22; Jes. 55,3; Dan. 6,4; Prov. 17,6; Prov. 20,6; Matth. 24,45; Matth. 25,21; Matth. 25,23; Luc. 19,17; 2 Thess. 3,3; 1 Tim. 1,12; 1 Petr. 4,19; 1 Joh. 1,9; de nuntio Prov. 25,13; teste Jes. 8,2; Jer. 49,5; amico Sir. 6,14 seq.; urbe (i.e. ejus incolis) Jes. 1,21; Jes. 1,26; rarius de rebus: 1 Thess. 1,5; Ps. 88,36; Jes. 22,23; Jes. 22,25; F.N. 16 (vid. sub ረባሒ፡); c.c. ለ፡ (alicui, erga aliquem) Hebr. 3,2; c. pron. suff.: ወእግዚአብሔርኒ፡ ይከውኖ፡ ምእመኖ፡ ወያስተፌሥሖ፡ Sir. 36,3; እስመ፡ ይእቲ፡ (ነፍስከ፡) እምኵሉ፡ ምእመንከ፡ οὐ γὰρ ἐστί σοι πιστώτερος αὐτῆς Sir. 37,13. a passim subst.: firmum praesidium, protector, defensor: ውእቱ፡ ምእመኑ፡ ἀντιστρήριγμα Sir. 31,18; ምእመን፡ ኀይሉ፡ ὑπερασπισμός Sir. 31,19; ὑπερασπιστής Ps. 17,3; Ps. 17,33; Ps. 26,2; Ps. 27,9; Ps. 27,11; Ps. 113,17. b fide dignus i.e. credibilis, Herm. p. 103.

woorden.betekenis: ii,, eae
woorden.definitie: ii, እማንቱ፡ eae vid. sub ውእቱ፡

woorden.betekenis: aut
woorden.definitie: aut vid. sub እመ፡ col. 726.

woorden.betekenis: rubi, sentis, tribuli, sentes, herba mala
woorden.definitie: subst. „ rubi vel sentis genus, in Dembea fruticans“ Lud.; in Bibliis aliisque libris haud raro obvium: tribuli, sentes, herba mala, τρίβολοι, አሥዋክ፡ ወአሜከላ፡ Gen. 3,18; Kuf. 3; ሦክ፡ ወአሜከላ፡ Hos. 10,8; Herm. p. 57; Clem. f. 14; Hez. 28,24; Hebr. 6,8; Herm. p. 57; Clem. f. 14; አሜከላ፡ Prov. 22,5; Matth. 7,16; Chrys. ho. 10(masc.); χόρτος Jes. 32,13; βάτος Luc. 6,44; βολίδες አሜከላ፡ ለገበዋቲክሙ፡ Num. 33,55. – Voc. Ae.: አሜከላ፡ ዘ፡ ሦክ፡ ዘዋስማ።

woorden.betekenis: deinde
woorden.definitie: deinde vid. sub እምነ፡ col. 193 et sub ዝ፡

woorden.betekenis: ligare, vincire
woorden.definitie: ligare, vincire vid. sub አሰረ፡

woorden.betekenis: Aramaei, gentilium, Hellenes, gentiles, ethnici, pagani, ʾar
woorden.definitie: (etiam አረሚይ፡ Zach. 9,13 var.) subst., plerumque coll., rarius Pl. አረሚያን፡ vel አረምያን፡; primitus Aramaei, deinde postquam nomina pr. Ἕλληνες et ܐܰܪܡܳܝܳܐ in significatum gentilium abierunt, et Hellenes et gentiles significat: a gentiles, ethnici, pagani, τὰ ἔθνη አረሚ፡ Rom. 9,24; Rom. 9,30; Matth. 10,5 rom.; Matth. 18,17 Platt; 1 Thess. 4,5 Platt; ἐθνικοί Herm. p. 39; አእምንዎ፡ ለአረሚ፡ Clem. f. 108; Clem. f. 196; አረሚያን፡ Jer. 10,2 var. b Hellenes: Joh. 7,35; Joh. 12,20; Rom. 1,14; 1 Cor. 1,22; 1 Cor. 1,23; 1 Cor. 1,24; መጥባሕተ፡ አረሚ፡ Jer. 26,16; Jer. 27,16; Zach. 9,13; Ἑλληνισταί እለ፡ እምአረሚ፡ Act. 6,1, et አረሚ፡ Act. 9,29. – Voc. Ae.: አረሚ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ዮናናውያን። ʾarami subst. a collective name for non-Christians ወአረሚኒ፡ ይበዝኁ፡ እንተ፡ ብሔርከ፡ ‘ There are many arämi in your country ’ 54 l. 22 (ed.), 47 l. 29-30 (tr.) (‘Originally “Barbarians” but at this time the word was used for all non-Christians, including Muslims’ 47 n. 136)

woorden.betekenis: gentilis, Hellen, ʾaramāwi, Greek, The people came from Rome
woorden.definitie: vel አረማይ፡ adj. rel. gentilis, Hellen Matth. 18,17 rom.; Rom. 1,16; Rom. 2,9; Rom. 3,9; Rom. 10,12; አረማይ፡ 1 Thess. 4,5 et 1 Cor. 5,1 rom.; Clem. f. 136; fem. አረማዊት፡ Marc. 7,26; F.M. 5,12; ብእሲት፡ ተንበላዊት፡ አው፡ አረማዊት፡ Syn. f. 397; አረማውያን፡ Jer. 10,2; Dan. 10,20; Dan. 11,2; Jes. 9,12; Clem. f. 226. ʾaramāwi Greek ወመጽኡ፡ ሰብእ፡ እምሮም፡ ወአፍርንጅ፡ ወእማረማዊያን፡ ወሶርያ፡ ወኵርጅ፡ ወእም ፭ አህጉር፡ ከመ፡ ይስምዑ፡ ጥበቦ። ‘The people came from Rome, from the Franks and the Greeks, and from Syria, and Georgia and from five cities (Pentapolis) to listen to his wisdom’ 66 § 126 (ed.), 38-39 § 126 (tr.)

woorden.betekenis: decerpere, metere, demetere, colligere, messem agri colliger
woorden.definitie: I,1 [vicinum አረየ፡, אָרָה] Subj. ይእረር፡ et ይእርር፡, decerpere, metere, demetere, colligere; τρυγᾶν አረርኩ፡ ከርቤ፡ Cant. 5,1; plerumque fruges, θερίζειν, ἀμᾶν, abs. Matth. 6,26; Matth. 25,24; Matth. 25,26; Joh. 4,36; Joh. 4,38 (ትእረሩ፡ v. ትእርሩ፡); Ps. 125,6; ዝራዕ፡ ወእረር፡ 4 Reg. 19,29; ትዘርኡ፡ ወተአርሩ፡ Jes. 37,30; Mich. 6,15; c. Acc. frugum: Jes. 17,5; Jes. 17,10 var.; እርሩ፡ ፍሬ፡ ሕይወት፡ Hos. 10,12; Deg.; ትዘርዑ፡ ሥርናየ፡ ወተአርሩ፡ አስዋከ፡ Jer. 12,13; Luc. 19,21; Luc. 19,22; 2 Cor. 9,6; Gal. 6,7; crebro transl.: ከመ፡ ትእረራ፡ (v. ትእርራ፡) ለከ፡ ምስብዒተ፡ Sir. 7,3; የአርር፡ እከየ፡ Prov. 22,8; Job 4,8; Hos. 8,7; c. Acc. agri ( messem agri colligere ): ገራህተ፡ ዘኢኮነ፡ ዚአሆሙ፡ አረሩ፡ Job 24,6; አረሩ፡ ብሔረ፡ ፊንቆን፡ ἐκαρπίσαντο Jos. 5,12; frugum instar colligere: ለወርቅ፡ ቦ፡ ብሔር፡ እምኀበ፡ የአርርዎ፡ Job 28,1. – Voc. Ae.: አረረ፡ ዘ፡ አጨደ፡

woorden.betekenis: messis, fruges demetendae, demessae, aestas, ver, vindemia,
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., 1 messis a actio demetendi et tempus messis: Gen. 8,22; Kuf. 6; Lev. 19,9; Ruth 1,22; Ruth 2,21; Ruth 2,23; Jes. 9,3; Jes. 18,5; Mich. 7,1; Am. 4,7 (τρυγητός); Am. 9,13; Prov. 25,13; Prov. 26,1; ተግባረ፡ ማእረርከ፡ Job 39,12; መዋዕለ፡ ማእረር፡ Sir. 24,26; Sir. 50,8; 4 Esr. 2,36; Joh. 4,35; Matth. 13,30; Marc. 4,29; ዐውደ፡ ማእረር፡ ἅλων θερινή Dan. 2,35; transl. 4 Esr. 2,44. b fruges demetendae vel demessae: Jer. 5,16; ማእረር፡ ወቀሥም፡ Jes. 16,9; Jes. 17,5; γεννήματα, ምድር፡ ትሁብ፡ ማእረራ፡ Zach. 8,12; Hez. 36,30; καρποί Jer. 38,12; Job 5,26 var.; transl.: ማእረረ፡ ምግባሮሙ፡ Jes. 3,10; Matth. 9,37; Luc. 10,2; Apoc. 14,15. c tempus messis i.e. α aestas: ክረምት፡ መፀው፡ ማእረር፡ ሐጋይ፡ Kuf. 2; ክረምት፡ ወማእረር፡ ወሐጋይ፡ Sir. 36,9; ዐውደ፡ ማእረር፡ ἅλων θερινή Dan. 2,35; θέρος Matth. 24,32; Marc. 13,28; Luc. 21,30. β cui includitur ver: ἔαρ Num. 13,20; በለሰ፡ ማእረር፡ τὰ σῦκα τὰ πρώϊμα Jer. 24,2. 2 vindemia, messis pomorum: ማእረረ፡ ወይን፡ Sir. 30,25; በመዋዕለ፡ ማእረረ፡ ቀሥም፡ Sir. 24,27; τρυγητός Jes. 24,13; Joel 4,13.

woorden.betekenis: archimandrita
woorden.definitie: መትሪዳ፡ አርሲመትረዳስ፡, አርሳይ፡ መትርያድስ፡ n. peregr. ἀρχιμανδρίτης archimandrita, Cat. Cod. Ae. Mus. Brit. p. 27; አባ፡ ሲኖዳ፡ አርሲ፡ መትሪዳ፡ (v. አርሲመትረዳስ፡) ዝብሂል፡ ርእሰ፡ ባሕታውያን፡ ውእቱ፡ Sx. Haml. 7.

woorden.betekenis: (v. አረባተ፡) n. peregr. arboris cujusdam: ቄዳር፡ ዘስሙ፡
woorden.definitie: (v. አረባተ፡) n. peregr. arboris cujusdam: ቄዳር፡ ዘስሙ፡ አርቦት፡ Kuf. p. 77(sine dubio corruptum, fortasse ex ἄρκευθος).

woorden.betekenis: lex Mosaica, doctores legis, Octateuchi, ʾorit, ʾafa mamhǝr,
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque fem., n. peregr. sc. אוֹרַיְתָּא, ܐܰܘܪܳܝܬܳܐ (i.e. תּוֹרָה) ) 1 lex Mosaica universa, νόμος Jes. 8,16; ትትገደፍ፡ ኦሪት፡ እምካህን፡ Hez. 7,26; Judith 11,12; 4 Esr. 2,34; 4 Esr. 14,23; Rom. 2,23; Rom. 3,19; Rom. 4,15; Rom. 7,7; Rom. 7,12; Gal. 3; Hebr. 7,19; ዳግም፡ ኦሪት፡ δευτερονόμιον Deut. 17,18; ኦሪት፡ ሙሴ፡ 2 Esr. 3,2; Dan. 9,11; Dan. apocr. 1,3; ዘጽሑፍ፡ ውስተ፡ ኦሪተ፡ ሙሴ፡ Bar. 2,2; መጽሐፈ፡ ኦሪት፡ ሙሴ፡ 2 Esr. 18,1 seq.; መጽሐፈ፡ ሕገ፡ ኦሪት፡ 2 Esr. 18,3; ሕገገ፡ ኦሪት፡ Rom. 4,13; Rom. 4,14; Rom. 4,15; Gal. 2,16; ሕገ፡ ኦሪት፡ Rom. 2,27; ሊቃነ፡ ኦሪት፡ νομοδιδάσκαλοι doctores legis Luc. 5,17; መምህረ፡ ኦሪት፡ Act. 5,34. 2 Nomine ኦሪት፡ appellantur singuli OctateuchiAethiopici libri sc. Pentateuchus et libri Josuae, Judicum, Ruth, vid. in mea Octateuchi editione titulos singulis libris inscriptos nec non in ejusdem Apparatu critico p. 159; et supra sub ብሔር፡ Nr. 2, ζ (c. 493). ʾorit L አፈ፡ መምህር ʾafa mamhǝr representative of an abbot, vid. መምህር፡ 334a

woorden.betekenis: erythraeum, rubrum
woorden.definitie: vel ኢርትራ፡ n. peregr. sc. ἐρυθρά sc. θάλασσα i.e. erythraeum seu rubrum sc. mare: ባሕረ፡ ኤርትራ፡ Ex. 10,19; Ex. 13,18; Ex. 15,4; Ex. 23,31; Jos. 4,23; Ps. 105,8; Ps. 105,22; 2 Esr. 19,8; Judith 5,13; Sap. 19,7; Hen. 32,2; Hen. 77,6; Hebr. 11,29; Kuf. 8; Kuf. 9.

woorden.betekenis: carpere, decerpere
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., sine dubio cognata cum አረየ፡ et አረረ፡, carpere, decerpere.

woorden.betekenis: bestia, fera, animal, belluae, monoceros, reptilia, insecta,
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., coll. et sing., Pl. አራዊት፡ 1 bestia, fera, animal: ልበ፡ አርዌ፡ ተውህቦ፡ Dan. 5,21; ቦኡ፡ አራዊት፡ Job 37,7; Marc. 1,13. a bestiae terrestres (distinguuntur a volatilibus) Sir. 17,4; አራዊተ፡ ምድር፡ 1 Reg. 17,44; አራዊተ፡ ገዳም፡ Jes. 18,6; Jer. 15,3; Jer. 16,4; Jer. 19,7; Jer. 34,5; Judith 11,7; Gen. 2,19; Gen. 9,2; አርዌ፡ ገዳም፡ θηρία τῆς γῆς Jer. 7,33. b ferae (agrestes, silvestres, rapaces, noxiae): አርዌ፡ ፀዋግ፡ Kuf. 34; አርዌ፡ እኩይ፡ Gen. 37,33; Jes. 35,9 (πονηρά θηρία); Hez. 5,15; Hez. 34,25; አራዊተ፡ ምድር፡ Ex. 23,29; Job 39,15; Sir. 39,30; አራዊተ፡ ሐቅል፡ et ገዳም፡ Job 5,22; Job 5,23; vel ሕለት፡ Ps. 67,33; አርዌ፡ ገዳም፡ Jes. 13,21; አራዊተ፡ ገዳም፡ Dan. 4,22; Hez. 34,28; Ps. 103,12; Ps. 103,21; distinguuntur ab እንስሳ፡ (pecore, jumentis quadrupedibus) Gen. 1,24; Gen. 1,26; Gen. 6,19; Kuf. 2; Kuf. 3; Kuf. 4; Job 41,16; Jes. 46,1; Judith 11,7; Act. 10,12; Act. 11,6. c belluaemajores: Jes. 5,29; Dan. 7,4; Dan. 7,5; Dan. 7,6; Dan. 7,7; እሉ፡ ፬ አራዊት፡ ዐበይት፡ Dan. 7,17; Job 40,10; Apoc. 11,7; Apoc. 13,1; አርዌ፡ ሐሪስ፡ monoceros Job 39,9. d reptilia: ἑρπετά አርዌ፡ Hab. 1,14; አራዊት፡ Jes. 16,1; አራዊተ፡ ገዳም፡ ወአራዊተ፡ ምድር፡ τὰ θηρία τοῦ ἀγροῦ καὶ τὰ ἑρπετά τῆς γῆς Hos. 4,3. e insecta: አራዊት፡ ደቂቅ፡ ዘይሰርር፡ Const. Ap. 52; Sx. Jac. 5Enc.; አራዊት፡ ደቃውቅ፡ Lud. e Libr. Myst. 2 in specie አርዌ፡ et plerumque አርዌ፡ ምድር፡ est serpens, anguis, aspis, draco [coll. حَيَّةٌ, ܚܶܘܝܳܐ חֶוְיָא]: አርዌ፡ እኩይ፡ ὄφις Sir. 21,2; አርዌ፡ ዐቢይ፡ δράκων μέγας Apoc. 12,3; Apoc. 13,11; ግበበ፡ አራዊት፡ Jer. 9,11; ὄφις አርዌ፡ ምድር፡ Gen. 3,1; Kuf. 3; Ps. 57,4; Ps. 139,3; Prov. 24,54; Am. 5,19; Jes. 27,1; Koh. 10,8; Koh. 10,11; Sir. 12,13; Sir. 25,15; Matth. 7,10; ὄφεις Num. 21,6 seq.; አራዊተ፡ ምድር፡ ዘይሰርር፡ Jes. 14,29; Jer. 8,17; ἀσπίς Job 20,14; Jes. 11,8; Jes. 30,6; Jes. 59,5; Ps. 57,4; Ps. 139,3; Rom. 3,13; δράκων Ex. 7,9; Ex. 7,10; Job 20,16; Sir. 25,16. a Primi Aethiopiae regis nomen አርዌ፡ fuisse traditur vid. II,2,14; III,3,5, III,3,6, III,3,7; Zeitschrift der Deutschen morg. Gesellschaft Bd. 7, p. 341. b Duobus in locis V. Testamenti interpretes vocem Graecam ἀσπίς, ἀσπιδίσκη scutum, scutulum interpretati sunt አርዌ፡ serpens, ut: አራዊት፡ ዘብርት፡ Job 41,6; Ex. 28,13; Ex. 28,14 (ubi serpentum imagines intelligunt). c At quid አርዌ፡ Ex. 28,33 (ubi Graecus μίτρα habet) significet, haud liquet. – Voc. Ae.: ከይሲ፡ አርዌ፡ ብ፡ እባብ። ʾarwe G አርዌ፡ ሖራስ፡ ʾarwe ḥorās, ሖራስ፡ ḥorās «rhinocéros» ― አውራሪስ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 22v. 48 C vid. also ሐሪሥ፡

woorden.betekenis: lunae
woorden.definitie: n. peregr., nomen lunae (sine dubio יֶרַח), Hen. 78,2; Voc. Ae.

woorden.betekenis: vid. sub ራዛ፡ col. 312.
woorden.definitie: vid. sub ራዛ፡ col. 312.

woorden.betekenis: carpsit, decerpsit, legere, colligere, conquirere, legendo p
woorden.definitie: I,1 [אָרָה carpsit, decerpsit; vicinum አረረ፡; vid. etiam አረወ፡] Subj. ይእሪ፡, legere, colligere, conquirere, spicas Ruth 2,2; Ruth 2,3; Ruth 2,7; Ruth 2,15; Ruth 2,17; Ruth 2,18; Ruth 2,19; Lev. 19,9; Lev. 23,22; ከመ፡ ዘየአሪ፡ ድኅረ፡ ዘይቀሥም፡ Sir. 30,25; herbas (carpendo) 4 Reg. 4,39; Matth. 13,28; Matth. 13,29; pisces Matth. 13,48; homines Jud. 20,45; de avibus, quae grana legunt, Kuf. p. 47; legendo purgare 2 Reg. 4,6.

woorden.betekenis: grandaevus, senex, vetulus, vetula, anus, seniores, senatus,
woorden.definitie: et አረጋይ፡ adj. rel. et subst., fem. አረጋዊት፡, አረጋይት፡, አረጊት፡ Pl. m. አረጋውያን፡ et plerumque c. አእሩግ፡ grandaevus, senex, vetulus, vetula, anus; m. Gen. 43,27; Gen. 43,28; Hen. 32,6; Lev. 9,1; አረጋዊ፡ ዘበርሥአቱ፡ ይተሉ፡ ዝሙተ፡ Sir. 42,8; አረጋዊ፡ ዘማዊ፡ Sir. 25,2; ልሂቅ፡ ምስለ፡ አረጋዊ፡ Jer. 6,11; Asc. Jes. 2,9; አረጋይ፡ Gen. 19,31; Asc. Jes. 6,7; Rel. Bar.; Sx. Tachs. 8Enc.; fem. አረጋዊት፡ Phlx. 54; Sx. Mij. 8; አረጋይት፡ መበለት፡ Sx. Hed. 22; አረጊት፡ Sx. Tachs. 15; Sx. Haml. 19; Sx. Mij. 8Enc.; Chrys. ho. 23; አረጊት፡ ዘድክምት፡ ፈድፉደ፡ Fal. f. 19; Pl. መነኮሳት፡ አረጋውያን፡ Sx. Tachs. 8; Sx. Ter 25; Sx. Hed. 3; አእሩግ፡ Kuf. 23; Prov. 17,6; Sir. 6,34; Sir. 25,20 (πρεςβύτεροι); Sir. 8,9; Sir. 25,4 (γέροντες); Jes. 20,4 (πρεσβῦται); Jes. 47,6; Thren. 2,21; ሊቅኒ፡ ወአእሩግኒ፡ Job 15,10; አእሩግ፡ ወሊቃውንት፡ Zach. 8,4; Ps. 118,100. a seniores, senatus, አእሩግ፡ Ex. 3,18; Ex. 4,29; Lev. 9,1; 1 Par. 15,25; Judith 15,8. b senior vel prior monachorum Phlx. 146; ይቤ፡ እኍ፡ ለአረጋዊ፡ Phlx. 147; Phlx. 155. c patriarcha, አረጋዊ፡ ዐቢይ፡ Gad. Ad. f. 200. ʾaragāwi, ʾaragāy C for ሊቀ፡ አዕሩግ፡ vid. ሊቅ፡

woorden.betekenis: paries, intergerinus, murus, moenia
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. አረፋት፡, 1 paries, τοῖχος, አረፍት፡ ጽንንት፡ Ps. 61,3; ምራገ፡ አረፍት፡ Job 33,24; Sir. 14,24; Sir. 22,17; አረፍት፡ ይሴውረኒ፡ Sir. 23,18; አረፍት፡ እንተ፡ ገየሩ፡ Jes. 16,11; Jes. 38,2; Jes. 59,10; Act. 23,3; አረፋት፡ (templi) 2 Par. 3,7; altaris Ex. 30,3; Lev. 5,9; አረፍተ፡ ማእከል፡ μεσότοιχον Eph. 2,14; intergerinus: ይንሥት፡ አረፍተ፡ እንተ፡ ጽልእ፡ እማእከለ፡ ሰብእ፡ እንተ፡ ነበረት፡ በዕልወተ፡ አዳም፡ Clem. f. 215. 2 murus, moenia, τεῖχος, አንሥአነ፡ ለነ፡ አረፍተ፡ ውድቅተ፡ Sir. 49,13; Kuf. 46; ኵሉ፡ አረፍት፡ ቀዋም፡ Jes. 2,15; Jes. 8,7; Jes. 24,23; አረፍት፡ ወጥቅም፡ Jes. 26,1; Jes. 36,11; Jes. 56,5; የሐንጹ፡ አሕዛብ፡ አረፋተኪ፡ Jes. 60,10; Jer. 15,20; Jer. 28,12; Hez. 26,9 seq.; 1 Reg. 31,10; አረፋቲሃ፡ ለኢየሩሳሌም፡ ተነሥተ፡ 2 Esr. 11,3; Ex. 14,22; Job 6,10; Ps. 50,19; 2 Cor. 11,33; Hebr. 11,30; አረፍተ፡ ጥቅመ፡ ሀገር፡ ὀχυρώματα τείχους Jes. 22,10; Jer. 1,15; 4 Reg. 25,10; አረፋት፡ ἐπάλξεις Jes. 54,12. – Voc. Ae.: አረፍት፡ ዘ፡ ግድግዳ።

woorden.betekenis: quod, confessa est, quia, quoniam, cum, nam, enim, etenim, n
woorden.definitie: conj. relativa et causalis, quam Abyssini certe inferioris aetatis tamquam ስመ፡ pronuntiant (Lud. gramm. aeth. p. 13), perraro ስመ፡ scribunt (ut Dan. 2,20 in Cod. Curz.), ut videtur e quibusdam pronominibus conflata (sc. ስ፡ vel እስ፡ – ut אשׁ in אֲשֶׁר et in amhar. ስለ፡ – et መ፡; accurate respondet ὅτι, vid. gramm. § 64, b). 1 relative a ad objectum vel subjectum, de quo agitur, indicandum: ὅτι, כִּי, quod vel Acc.c. Infin., daß (quamquam ከመ፡ vel ዘ፡ multo crebrius usitata sunt): እኩየ፡ ኮነ፡ እስመ፡ ከመዝ፡ ገብረ፡ Gen. 38,10; 4 Reg. 17,4; post verba dicendi et sentiendi: Dan. apocr. 1,21; Hen. 98,6; ይትአመር፡ እስመ፡ Sap. 16,28; አእምር፡ እስመ፡ Sx. Pag. 5; Hen. 98, 8; crebro in Phlx., Jsp., ut: ጽሑፍ፡ እስመ፡ Phlx. 59; አምነት፡ ( confessa est ) እስመ፡ Jsp. p. 335; ተብህለ፡ እስመ፡ Jsp. p. 328; ርእዩ፡ እስመ፡ Jsp. p. 330; 1 Par. 10,7; ኢትርስዑ፡ እስመ፡ 2 Petr. 3,8. b post verba affectuum intransitiva, ad causam affectuum significandam, quod (daß), ut: ያደምመኒ፡ እስመ፡ Chrys. Ta. 15; vel post አንከረ፡ Luc. 11,38; Joh. 3,7; መንክር፡ Joh. 9,30; ነስሐ፡ 1 Reg. 15,11; ሐዘነ፡ Hen. 89,67; Hen. 102,5; አእኰተ፡ Joh. 11,41; ተፈሥሐ፡ Hen. 89,58; Kuf. 17; Kuf. 22; ፈርሀ፡ Gen. 45,5; ተምዕዐ፡ Luc. 13,14. c ad explicandum pron. demonstr. praemissum, ut: ምንትኑ፡ ዝነገር፡ እስመ፡ ይኤዝዞሙ፡ Luc. 4,36; Joh. 3,19; 1 Joh. 3,16; 1 Joh. 4,9; Luc. 10,20. 2 indicandae causae et rationi: quod, quia, quoniam, cum, nam, enim, etenim, ὅτι (innumeris in locis, ut) Gen. 5,24; Gen. 6,7; Gen. 6,13; Gen. 8,9; Gen. 9,6; Gen. 12,10; Gen. 13,8; Gen. 21,12; Jes. 8,10; Jes. 9,6; Matth. 5,3; Matth. 5,4; Matth. 5,5; Matth. 5,6; Matth. 5,7; Matth. 5,8; Matth. 5,9; Matth. 5,10; Matth. 5,11; Matth. 5,12; Matth. 5,34; Matth. 5,35; Matth. 5,36; Matth. 7,13; አኀዘ፡ ይሒሶን፡ እስመ፡ ኢነስሑ፡ Matth. 11,20; ንእዶ፡ እስመ፡ ከመ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ገብረ፡ Luc. 16,8; በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ እስመ፡ Joh. 10,17; Joh. 16,19; በእንተ፡ ምንት፤ እስመ፡ Rom. 9,32; διότι Jes. 8,4; Jes. 9,4; Hez. 20,38; Luc. 1,13; Luc. 2,7; Luc. 21,28; Rom. 1,19; Rom. 1,21; Rom. 3,20; ἀφ᾽ οὗ Jes. 43,4; ἀνθ᾽ ὧν vel οὗ Job 36,15; Hez. 20,24; Hez. 28,2; Luc. 19,44; 2 Thess. 2,10; ἐπεί Matth. 18,32; Matth. 27,6; ἐπειδή Matth. 21,46; Luc. 11,6; ἐπείπερ Rom. 3,30; εἴπερ Rom. 8,9; γάρ (innumeris in locis, ut) Gen. 2,5; Gen. 7,4; Gen. 18,15; Gen. 19,30; Gen. 21,20; Matth. 1,20; Matth. 1,21; Matth. 2,2; Matth. 2,5; Matth. 2,6; Matth. 2,13; Matth. 2,20 al.; καὶ γάρ Gen. 16,13; 2 Cor. 13,4.a Ei sententiae, cujus causam vel rationem indicat, praemittere licet እስመ፡ cum sua sententia, ut: Ex. 1,21; Ex. 2,3; Deut. 7,7; Jud. 15,2; Job 4,5; Matth. 1,19; Matth. 13,6; Matth. 22,25; Luc. 1,1. b ubi ejusdem sententiae plures rationes afferuntur, እስመ፡ repetere licet Sir. 19,20; Ps. 21,11; Koh. 7,22. c explicative: enim, nempe, scilicet (nämlich): Matth. 4,18; Matth. 19,12; Marc. 7,3; Rom. 9,8 (τοῦτ᾽ ἔστιν).

woorden.betekenis: vestigium
woorden.definitie: vestigium vid. sub አሠር፡

woorden.betekenis: ligare, alligare, deligare, colligare, religare, nectere, an
woorden.definitie: (etiam አሠረ፡) I,1 [amh. id.; אָסַר ܐܶܣܰܪ أَسَرَ; vicin. אָזַר]. Subj. ይእስር፡ 1 ligare, alligare, deligare, colligare, religare, nectere, annectere, jungere, adstringere, constringere: Ex. 14,25; ተአስሮን፡ Hez. 37,17; ኢትፀምር፡ አሲረ፡ ክልኤቲ፡ ኀጣይእ፡ Sir. 7,8; c. Acc. et ውስተ፡ Gen. 38,28; Gen. 49,11; ተአስር፡ እብነ፡ ውስቴታ፡ Jer. 28,63; Rel. Bar.; Jos. 2,21; Jud. 15,4; vel በ፡ Lev. 8,7 (συνέσφιγξεν); Matth. 18,6, vel c. ምስለ፡, ut: አሰረ፡ ኅሊናሁ፡ ምስለ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Phlx. 24. a manipulos, sarcinas: እስርዎሙ፡ ከላስስተ፡ Matth. 13,30; እለ፡ የአስሩ፡ ከላስስተ፡ Judith 8,3; የአስሩ፡ ጾረ፡ ዐቢየ፡ Matth. 23,4. b currui jumenta: 1 Reg. 6,10; Jes. 5,18. c contexere: አሰርከኒ፡ አዕጽምትየ፡ በአሥራው፡ Job 10,11. d cingere: እስራ፡ ሐቌክን፡ Jes. 32,11. e obligare i.e. o bturare 1 Petr. 2,15; አአስር፡ ልሳነከ፡ Hez. 3,26. f contignare, contabulare 3 Reg. 6,14. g ligare, sensu spirituali vel ecclesiastico: Matth. 16,19; Chrys. Ta. 4. h obligare vel fascinare incatatione: ኣምሕለክሙ፡ ወአአስረክሙ፡ Ssal.
