Req. 2 vincire, devincire, vinculis adstringere: Gen. 42,24; Jud. 15,12 seq.; Jes. 3,10; አሰሮ፡ በመዋቅሕተ፡ ኀጺን፡ Jer. 46,7 vers. nov.; Jer. 52,11; Ps. 149,8; ሞቃሕኩከ፡ ወአሰርኩከ፡ Hez. 3,25; Hez. 4,8; Kuf. 5; እስሮ፡ በእዴሁ፡ ወእገሪሁ፡ Hen. 10,4; Hen. 10,12; Hen. 13,1; Hen. 14,5; Hen. 22,11; አሰሮ፡ እደዊሁ፡ ወእገሪሁ፡ Hen. 88,1; Dan. 3,21; ቀደመ፡ አሲሮቶ፡ ለኀያል፡ Matth. 12,29; አሲሮሙ፡ Matth. 27,2; Apoc. 20,2.

woorden.betekenis: ligari, alligari, colligari, affixa erat, coërceri, obligari
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 ligari, alligari, colligari: Lit. 172,1; ተአስረት፡ ከርሥየ፡ ከመ፡ ዝቅ፡ Job 32,19; c. በ፡, ut: ተአስረት፡ ነፍስ፡ በሥጋ፡ Jsp. p. 381; ነፍሰ፡ ዮናታን፡ ትአስረት፡ በነፍሰ፡ ዳዊት፡ ( affixa erat ) 1 Reg. 18,1. a coërceri 2 Tim. 2,9. b obligari, obstringi, ተአሰርኩ፡ በመንፈስየ፡ Act. 20,22. 2 vinciri, vinculis adstringi, captivum fieri: Hen. 10,14; Hen. 21,4; Kuf. p. 21; Sap. 17,2; ከመ፡ ከልብ፡ ዘየሐውር፡ ለተአስሮ፡ Prov. 7,22; Judae 6; 2 Reg. 3,34; c. በ፡ vinculi Hen. 69,28; Job 18,8 var.; ይትአሰሩ፡ በመዋቅሕት፡ Jes. 43,14; ይጼወኑ፡ ወይትአሰሩ፡ Jes. 24,22. 3 se ipsum ligare vel vincire, vel se vinciri sinere: ተአስረ፡ ለሊሁ፡ እደዊሁ፡ ወእገሪሁ፡ Act. 21,11; ተአሰሩ፡ (Imperat.) Jsp. p. 378.

woorden.betekenis: ligatus, alligatus, colligatus, affixus, suspensus, suspensa
woorden.definitie: part. 1 ligatus, alligatus, colligatus, Matth. 21,2; Marc. 11,2; ንዋይ፡ ዘኢኮነ፡ እሱረ፡ ማእሰር፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ Num. 19,15; እሱራን፡ እሙንቱ፡ ከመ፡ ጾረ፡ ኵስሕ፡ Jes. 46,1; እሱረ፡ መንኮብያቲሁ፡ Luc. 2,12; c.c. በ፡ rei ut: ነፍስ፡ እስርት፡ በሥጋ፡ Jsp. p. 381; ከናፍር፡ ጠበብት፡ እሱራን፡ በአእምሮ፡ Prov. 15,7; fuit እሱረ፡ አእዳው፡ ወአእጋር፡ በእግረ፡ ፈረስ፡ Sx. Sen. 6Enc.; እመ፡ ኮንከ፡ ኦብእሲ፡ እሱረ፡ በብእሲትከ፡ ኢትኅሥሥ፡ ተፈልጦታ፡ F.N. 24,1; vel c. ምስለ፡, ut: እመ፡ ኮነከ፡ እሱረ፡ ምስለ፡ ብእሲትከ፡ F.N. 24,5. a alligatus i.e. affixus, suspensus: ነፍሱ፡ እስርት፡ እመንፈሰዝ፡ (tamquam: suspensa ab anima ejus ) Kuf. 43(vid. ተአስረ፡ Nr. 1; aliâs ስቁል፡). b obligatus, obstrictus: እስርት፡ ይእቲ፡ በሕግ፡ Rom. 7,2; 1 Cor. 7,39; ብእሲት፡ ዘእስርት፡ በሕግ፡ (opponitur concubinae) F.N. 25. c ligatus, sensu spirituali vel ecclesiastico, Matth. 16,19; Chrys. Ta. 4. d intextus, inclusus: ልቡጥ፡ በወርቅ፡ ወእሱር፡ በወርቅ፡ Ex. 28,20; Ex. 36,20. e illigatus, ἐνδεδεμένος, seq. በ፡ 1 Reg. 25,29; seq. ውስተ፡ Sir. 22,16. 2 vinctus, vinculis adstrictus, Hen. 21,3; Dan. 3,23; Dan. 3,24; ይፈትሕ፡ ዘእሱር፡ Dan. 5,12; Apoc. 9,14; ኵሉ፡ እሱራነ፡ ምድር፡ δέσμιοι Thren. 3,33 var.; ዘእሱር፡ እዴሁ፡ ዘየማን፡ Sir. 21,19.

woorden.betekenis: ignis, igneus, incendium, ʾǝsāt
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem. [אֵשׁ, אֶשָּׁא אֶשְׁתָּא, ܐܶܫܳܬܳܐ] ignis: Gen. 22,6; Gen. 22,7; Num. 21,28; Num. 31,23; Ps. 20,9; Ps. 38,4; Ps. 57,8; Ps. 77,25; Ps. 77,69; Jes. 26,11; Jes. 33,14; Sir. 16,6; Sir. 27,5; እሳት፡ በላዒ፡ Sir. 30,30; Kuf. 36; Job 15,34; በልዐቶ፡ እሳት፡ Job 22,20; እሳት፡ ዘይነድድ፡ Job 31,12; Kuf. 1 እሳት፡ እንተ፡ ትነድድ፡ Sir. 3,30; ለእሳት፡ ይቀድም፡ ይጠይስ፡ ተነ፡ ጢሱ፡ Sir. 22,24; በአምጣነ፡ ዕፁ፡ ለእሳት፡ የዐቢ፡ ነዱ፡ Sir. 28,10; ያነድዳ፡ ለእሳት፡ Sir. 28,11; ዘኢይጠፍእ፡ እሳት፡ Sir. 28,23; Jes. 66,24; Matth. 3,10; Matth. 3,12; Matth. 7,19; Luc. 12,49; Luc. 22,55; ነደ፡ እሳት፡ Hebr. 1,7; እሳት፡ ንስቲት፡ ጥቀ፡ Jac. 3,5; እሳት፡ እሳት፡ Hen. 14,22; ignis Dei, a coelo delabens, Gen. 19,24; Ex. 9,23; Lev. 10,2; Job 1,16; Luc. 9,54; ignis irae Dei Deut. 4,24; Deut. 32,22; Ps. 17,10; Jes. 66,16; ገሃነም፡ እሳት፡ Matth. 5,22; Matth. 18,9; Marc.9,47; ዐዘቅተ፡ እሳት፡ Apoc. 20,10; እሳት፡ ዘለዓለም፡ Matth. 18,8; Matth. 25,41; እሳት፡ መለኮት፡ Lit. 170,1. a in Gen. positum vel st. constructo subjunctum: igneus, ut: ሰረገላ፡ ዘእሳት፡ 4 Reg. 2,11; ሰይፈ፡ እሳት፡ Gen. 3,24; አእባነ፡ እሳት፡ ቀይሕ፡ Hez. 28,14; vers. nov.; Hen. 17,3; Hen. 17,4; Hen. 17,5. b ignis i.e.incendium: ፈቀዱ፡ ያድኅጎኑ፡ አማልክቲሆሙ፡ እምእከለ፡ እሳት፡ Kuf. 12. c de ignis cultu divino (Persarum) vid. Clem. f. 32; እምውእቱ፡ ጊዜ፡ ሰገዱ፡ ሰብአ፡ ሰገል፡ ለእሳት፡ Clem. f. 33. ʾǝsāt C for መዋግደ፡ እሳት፡ vid. ሞገድ፡

woorden.betekenis: stater
woorden.definitie: n. peregr. sc. stater (aliâs ሰጥጢራ፡ q.v.), arab. إِسْتَارُ. Voc. Ae.: አስታር፡ ዘ፡ ፲ወ፪ወቄት፡ ወቦ፡ እለ፡ ይ፡ መጠነ፡ መክሊት። – At lectio እስመ፡ ኢይሁቦ፡ አስታረ፡ (v. አስታር፡, v. ዐሥራተ፡) ሞገስ፡ οὐ γὰρ ἐδόθη αὐτῷ παρὰ Κυρίου χάρις Sir. 37,21 non potest non esse corrupta (pro እግዚአብሔር፡ ሞገሰ፡?).

woorden.betekenis: lunae
woorden.definitie: n. peregr. et corruptum lunae, Hen. 78,2; Voc. Ae. (in quo et forma አስበንያ፡ et አሶንያ፡ inter nomina lunae recensetur).

woorden.betekenis: donec, dum, usque, quoad, adeo, ut, ita, absit!, quo, quamdi
woorden.definitie: conj. et praep. [conflata ex እስ፡ i.e. עַד et ከ፡; gramm. § 64]; forma ejus in antiquioribus libris et editionibus usitata est እስኬ፡ (ut Am. 6,14; Am. 8,12 in cod. Laur.; Matth. 15,31 rom.; Gen. 35,20 F). – A conj. 1 እስከ፡ a donec, dum, usque dum, quoad, c.c. Perf. Ruth 1,19; እስከ፡ ተፈጸመ፡ ፲ወ፩ ዓመተ፡ ንጉሥ፡ Jer. 1,3; 43,23; c. Imperf. Ruth 3,18; Ps. 17,41; Ps. 109,2; Ps. 131,5; 4 Esr. 10,7; Jes. 6,11; Jes. 26,20; Jes. 55,11; Jes. 62,1; Jes. 65,6; Asc. Jes. 8,10; እስከ፡ እሬኢ፡ Jon. 4,5; እስከ፡ ትረሥእ፡ Sir. 6,18; እስከ፡ ትበጽሕ፡ ለሞት፡ Sir. 4,28; Job 7,19; Gen. 27,44; Gen. 28,15; Deut. 28,21; c. Subj. Tob. 14,5. b adeo ut, ita ut, ut, c. Imperf. Dan. 3,19; 4 Esr. 10,39; እስከ፡ ይለክፉ፡ 2 Par. 3,11; ይሰርሕ፡ እስከ፡ ያገርር፡ ተያፍኒሁ፡ Sir. 38,26; Matth. 27,14; Marc. 4,1; 1 Cor. 13,2 Platt; in specie post ጥቀ፡, ut: ተሠነየት፡ ጥቀ፡ እስከ፡ ታስሕት፡ ዐይኖሙ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ዕደው፡ Judith 10,4; ተከዘት፡ ጥቀ፡ እስከ፡ ትፈቱ፡ ትትኀነቅ፡ Tob. 3,10; 2 Reg. 13,2; c. Subj. Gen. 16,10; 1 Cor. 13,2 var. c post ሓሰ፡ ሊተ፡ absit! sequitur እስከ፡, ut Gen. 44,17 (alia exempla vid. col. 90 sub ሓሰ፡). 2 componitur cum aliis conjunctionibus: a እስከ፡ አመ፡ usque quo, dum, donec, quoad, c. Perf. Jer. 1,3; Tob. 1,21; Tob. 2,10; Cant. 3,5 ( quamdiu ); c. Imperf. Ruth 2,21; Ps. 122,3; እስከ፡ አመ፡ ይመውት፡ Sir.23,17; Sir. 9,12; Sir. 46,9; Jes. 22,14; Judith 12,4; Matth. 2,13. (vid. alia exempla sub አመ፡ col. 724.). b እስከ፡ ሶበ፡ α i.q. እስከ፡ አመ፡; c. Perf.: እስከ፡ ሶበ፡ ቀርበ፡ Kuf. 37; Matth. 2,9; c. Imperf. Matth. 5,18; Matth. 5,26; Koh. 2,3; Prov. 4,18; Jes. 55,10. β ita ut, ut: Matth. 8,24; Matth. 8,28; Matth. 13,2; Matth. 13,54; Matth. 15,31, al. B Praep.; pronomina suffixa non assumit. 1 እስከ፡ a de termino: usque ad, usque in, tenus: α spatii: እስከ፡ አጽናፈ፡ ምድር፡ Ps. 2,8; Ps. 45,8; እስከ፡ ምድር፡ Ps. 146,6; Am. 6,14; Am. 8,12; Gen. 14,14; Deut. 1,7; Deut. 1,19; Deut. 1,20; ይበጽሕ፡ እስከ፡ ክሳድ፡ Jes. 8,7; Ps. 68,1; Matth. 11,23; Matth. 26,58; Joh. 2,7; Act. 1,8; Act. 17,15; እምላዕሉ፡ እስከ፡ ታሕቱ፡ Matth. 27,51; ante adverbia: እስከ፡ ቅሩበ፡ Kuf. p. 39; እስከ፡ ዝየ፡ Luc. 23,5. β temporis: እስከ፡ ዛዕለት፡ Jer. 51,6; Jer. 51,22; እስከ፡ መንፈቀ፡ ሌሊት፡ Judith 12,5; እስከ፡ ዮም፡ Gen. 26,33; Gen. 50,23; Ex. 20,5; Lev. 15,5; Matth. 1,17; Matth. 13,30; Matth. 26,29; Matth. 27,45; እስከ፡ ይእዜ፡ Koh. 4,2; Matth. 11,12; Joh. 2,10; እስከ፡ ማእዜኑ፡ Matth. 17,17; Joh. 10,24; እስከ፡ ዝንቱ፡ Lev. 26,18; Lev. 26,23; እስከ፡ ውእተ፡ አሚረ፡ Dan. 12,1; (vid. sub አሚር፡). γ ordinis: Matth. 11,13; Matth. 20,8; Matth. 22,26; Joh. 8,9; እምካህን፡ እስከ፡ ሐሳዊ፡ ነቢይ፡ Jer. 6,13; Gen. 44,12; Jos. 6,21; ከማሁ፡ ገብረ፡ እስከ፡ ስብዕ፡ 4 Reg. 4,35; Matth. 18,21. δ gradus: 2 Reg. 23,19; Marc. 6,23 (vid. እስከ፡ ለ፡ et እስከ፡ Adv.); እመቦ፡ ዘአጥረየ፡ እስከ፡ መርፍእሂ፡ (i.e. nihil possideat, ne acum quidem) Reg. Pach. b de tenore temporis: α per, ut: እስከ፡ ፫ዓመት፡ ἔτη τρία Dan. 1,5; እስከ፡ ፵ዓመት፡ Hez. 29,11; Gen. 42,17; Hen. 72,9; Num. 11,20. β intra vel post: እስከ፡ ክልኤ፡ ዓመት፡ አነ፡ ላገብእ፡ ἔτι δύο ἔτη καὶ ἐγώ Jer. 35,3; Gen. 40,13; Jon. 3,4; Matth. 26,2; Joh. 4,35; እስከ፡ ሠሉስ፡ መዋዕል፡ εἰς τρεῖς ἡμέρας 2 Esr. 10,8. 2 componitur cum aliis praepositionibus: a እስከ፡ ለ፡ usque ad vel in: እስከ፡ ለሞት፡ Jon.4,9; እስከ፡ ለመዊት፡(ሐመ፡) 2 Par. 32,24; Jes. 38,1; Matth. 26,38; Asc. Jes. 10,8; Tob. 14,3; እስከ፡ ለዓለም፡ Jes. 44,7. b እስከ፡ ኀበ፡ usque ad Asc. Jes. 10,8; 2 Reg. 6,6; Jud. 18,13; Apoc. 14,20 Platt (vid. sub ኀበ፡ col. 594). c እስከ፡ ውስተ፡ usque intro in Marc. 14,54; እስከ፡ ቅድመ፡ usque ante Jud. 19,10; እስከ፡ አመ፡ usque in tempus Matth. 2,15 (vid. sub አመ፡ col. 724.); እስከ፡ እምድኅረ፡ usque post Gen. 17,19. C raro Adv.: adeo Jos. 6,21; omnia persolvere debebis እስከ፡ ጥቀ፡ ግማሰ፡ ኅብስት፡ ዘሄድከ፡ Clem. f. 269.

woorden.betekenis: usque, in, cum, eo
woorden.definitie: vel እስከነ፡ i.q. እስከ፡(vid. sub ኔ፡ et ነ፡ col. 630). 1 conj.: Hen. 89,5; Chrys.; እስከኔ፡ ጐየ፡ Phlx. 30. 2 praep.: Mal. 1,11; Par. 13,9; Ps. 49,2, Ps. 112,3; Ex. 13,2; Jud. 15,14; 2 Reg. 10,4. 3 c. pron. suff.: እስከኔሁ፡ usque in cum Kuf. p. 9 ann. 10; usque eo Chrys. ho. 4; Sx Jac. 16.

woorden.betekenis: mederi, sanare
woorden.definitie: rad. inus. e.q. אֲסָא, ܐܶܣܳܐ, أَسَا mederi, sanare.

woorden.betekenis: leo
woorden.definitie: i.e. أَلْأَسَدُ leo, nomen sideris, Abush. 3; Cod. Mus. Brit. LXXXII, 4.

woorden.betekenis: asphaltus, bitumen
woorden.definitie: vel አስፋሊጦስ፡ vel አስፋሊጣ፡ vel አስፈሊጥ፡ n. peregr. sc. ἄσφαλτος asphaltus i.e. bitumen Ex. 2,3; Kuf. 10; Kuf. 47; Macc. f. 2(አፍለጢስ፡ sic); አስፈሊጥ፡ Sx. Tachs. 2. – Voc. Ae.: አስፈሉጡ፡ ዘ፡ ሰሊጥ፡ (inter plantarum nomina!).

woorden.betekenis: pater, parens, genitor, patres, parentes, mater, progenitor,
woorden.definitie: subst., [אָב, אַבָּא, ܐܰܒܳܐ, أَبٌ] m., st.c. et Acc. አበ፡ (ut: Gen. 44,19; Gen. 44,20; አልብነ፡ አበ፡ Thren. 5,3; ዘአልቦ፡ አበ፡ ἀπάτωρ Hebr. 7,3; Matth. 3,9; Sir. 3,2; quamquam Matth. 19,29 Platt exhibet አባ፡), ante pron. suff. አቡ፡ in Nom. (Gen. 24,23; Gen. 31,5; Gen. 31,6; Gen. 31,7; Gen. 38,11; Gen. 44,25; Gen. 44,31; Gen. 44,32; Gen. 45,18; Gen. 45,19; Gen. 47,5; Gen. 47,6; Ex. 2,16; Ex. 2,18; Deut. 22,15; Deut. 22,16). { Pro አቡሃ፡ poëta አባ፡ scripsit, vid. col. 1123 sub ድክታም፡}; አባ፡ in Acc. (ut: አባሁ፡ Gen. 2,24; Lev. 19,3; Sir. 3,3 seq.; Mal. 1,6; Mich. 7,6; Prov. 10,1; Prov. 15,20; Matth. 19,5; አቦ፡ pro አባሁ፡ praebent duo libri a me inspecti Prov. 24,52; አባሃ፡ Sir. 22,5; አባሆሙ፡ Marc. 1,20; Rom. 4,17; አባከ፡ Ex. 20,12; Deut. 5,16; Eph. 6,2; አባኪ፡ Jos. 2,18; Ruth 2,11; አበኪ፡ Tob. 11,16 in uno libro a me inspecto; አባየ፡ Joh. 8,49), sed etiam አቡ፡ (vid. gramm. § 154, d; ut: አቡሃ፡ Deut. 21,13; Jud. 15,6; አቡሆሙ፡ Gen. 4,21; አቡኪ፡ Jos. 2,18 ann.; አቡየ፡ Joh. 8,19; Joh. 15,24; አቡነ፡ Jud. 18,19), in Vocat. አባ፡ (ut: Kuf. 11; Gen. 22,7; Gen.27,18; Gen. 44,32; 4 Reg. 2,12; 4 Reg. 13,14; Tob. 5,1; Tob. 11,10; Tob. 12,2; Matth. 11,25; vel አቡየ፡ Sir. 23,1; Sir. 23,4; አባ፡ ወአቡየ፡ ἀββᾶ ὁ πατὴρ Marc.14,36; Gal. 4,6; Rom. 8,15); Pl. አበው፡, pater a parens, genitor, ut 1 Reg. 9,3; Ps. 103,13; Jer. 6,21; Matth. 2,22; Matth. 4,21; Luc. 1,17; Eph. 6,4, aliis in locis innumeris; አበወ፡ ሥጋ፡ et አበው፡ ሥጋውያን፡ (opp. spiritualibus) Chrys. ho. 29. b Pl. አበው፡ (non tantum patres sed etiam) parentes i.e. pater et mater: Hebr. 11,23; Reg. Pach.; Sx. Mag. 27; Sx. Nah. 15; Const. Ap. 34; c progenitor, auctor generis, majores, ut: አበ፡ ብዙኅ፡ አሕዛብ፡ Gen. 17,4; Gen. 19,37; Gen. 22,21; Matth. 3,9; አበ፡ ኵልነ፡ Rom. 4,16; አበዊነ፡ Sir. 44,1; አበዊክሙ፡ Zach. 1,5; Ps. 38,16; Ps. 44,18; Matth. 23,30; Matth. 23,32; ርእሰ፡ አበው፡ Act. 2,29; አበ፡ አበወ፡ patriarcha Chrys. ho. 25; አበው፡ ቀደምት፡ Act. 7,8. d altor vel tutor, qui patris instar beneficiis de aliis bene meretur: Ps. 67,5; Jes. 9,6 vers. alt.; Jes. 22,21; አነ፡ ውእቱ፡ አበ፡ ምሰኪናን፡ Job 29,16. e de Deo, patre hominum, in specie Christi et Christianorum: Jes. 63,16; Jes. 64,8; Tob. 13,4; Deut. 32,6; 2 Reg. 7,14; Matth. 6,9; Matth. 11,27; Matth. 24,36; Hebr. 12,9; Eph. 4,6; Rom. 1,7; 1 Cor. 1,3, al.; አቡነ፡ ዘበሰማያት፡ „pater noster“, ut: ወትብል፡ ኪርያላይሶን፡ ወአቡነ፡ ዘበሰማያት፡ Genz. f. 52. f patris nomine honorifice compellantur. α magistri, prophetae, sacerdotes Jud. 17,10; Jud. 18,19; 4 Reg. 2,12; 4 Reg. 6,21; 4 Reg. 13,14; Matth. 23,9; et in libris Christianis sacerdotes episcopi al. patres spirituales appellantur, ut: አበ፡ መንፈስ፡ የዐቢ፡ እምአበ፡ ሥጋ፡ Genz. f. 148; Did. 8. β abbas monachorum, sive አብ፡ ut Phlx., sive አበ፡ ምኔት፡ Kedr f. 79, al. γ annis provectiores, seniores, ut 1 Joh. 2,13; Joh. 2,14; magistratus, senatores, ut Act. 7,2; Act. 22,1; seniores gentium vel familiarum; ut: እሉ፡ መላእክተ፡ ቤተ፡ አበዊሆሙ፡ 1 Par. 7,2; መላእክተ፡ አበዊሆሙ፡ 2 Esr. 18,13, et rex ipse, in formula ሕያው፡ vel ሕየው፡ አበ፡ ነጋሢ፡ (vid. supra sub ነጋሢ፡ col. 688.; sec. Lud. in lex. c. 350: ሕየው፡ አባ፡ ነጋሢ፡). g አበ፡ ደም፡ consanguineorum maximus, cujus vindicta sanguinis est i.e. sanguinis ultor vel vindex, Num. 35,12; Num. 35,19; Num. 35,21; Num. 35,25; Num. 35,27; Deut. 19,6; Deut. 19,12; Jos. 20,5; 2 Reg. 14,11. h possessor dominus: አበ፡ ላህም፡ Ex. 21,35; (coll. አበጉንባሕ፡ sub ጉንባሕ፡). i auctor, ut: አቡሃ፡ ለሐሰት፡ Joh. 8,44; ubi de libris agitur: prototypum, archetypum (exemplar) libri: N.T. rom. f. 157 (sub finem Actorum). ʾab ʾaba dam እመቦ፡ አበ፡ ደም፡ ለውእቱ፡ ብእሲ፡ ወይፈቅድ፡ ይቅትሎ፡ ይትቤዘዎ፡ እምኔሁ፡ በቃለ፡ ድኩም፡ ‘If there was an avanger of the blood and he wanted to kill this man (culprit), he redeemed him from him with humble word and paid the proper redemption’ 62 § 117 (ed.), 36 § 117 (tr.) L አበ፡ ምኔት ʾabba mǝnet abbot of a monastery, vid. ምኔት 351b C a vid. also ሊቀ፡ ምኔት under ሊቅ፡ (TraCES) b for ሊቀ፡ አበው፡ vid. ሊቅ፡ (TraCES)

woorden.betekenis: subst. (sicut אַבָּא) 1) Vocat. vocis አብ፡,vid. sub
woorden.definitie: subst. (sicut אַבָּא) 1) Vocat. vocis አብ፡,vid. sub አብ፡ 2 titulus honorificus patriarcharum, episcoporum, abbatum, doctorum, monachorum, eremitarum, creberrime in Sx., ut አባ፡ ሆር፡ Sx. Sen. 29; አባ፡ ኪሮስ፡ Sx. Haml. 8; አባ፡ ዮሴፍ፡ Sx. Gen. 19, al.; monachus salutatur: ዳኅንኑ፡ አባ፡, respondet: እወ፡ ዳኅን፡ Gad. T.H.

woorden.betekenis: ad, patrem, pertinens, paternus, una, e, proavis, majoribus
woorden.definitie: adj. rel. ad patrem pertinens, paternus: ሶበ፡ በጽሐ፡ ጊዜ፡ ተራኅርኆተ፡ ሣህል፡ አባዊት፡ ላዕለ፡ ልሕኵት፡ አዳማዊት፡ Fid. Jac. Bar.; fem. አባዊት፡ una e proavis vel majoribus, Gad. Ad. f. 187.

woorden.betekenis: dignitas, patris, necessitudo, paterna, paternitas
woorden.definitie: subst. dignitas patris, necessitudo paterna, paternitas (Vaterschaft): እስመ፡ አብ፡ ይሰመይ፡ አበ፡ በእንተ፡ አብናሁ፡ Chrys. ho. 2; Deo patri convenit ከዊነ፡ ወላዲ፡ ወአብና፡ Fid. Jac. Bar.; M.M. f. 20; ዝምደተ፡ አብና፡ ወወልድና፡ F.N. 42,6.

woorden.betekenis: dignitas, parentum, necessitudo, paterna
woorden.definitie: subst. (ab አበው፡) dignitas parentum, necessitudo paterna, F.N. 10,6.

woorden.betekenis: dixi
woorden.definitie: dixi vid. sub ብህለ፡

woorden.betekenis: lunae
woorden.definitie: n. peregr. et corruptum, nomen lunae Hen. 78,2; Sx. Nah. 17. Enc. (vid. ኦርያሬስ፡); Voc. Ae.

woorden.betekenis: grandaevus, fuit
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., quae neque cum ዐብረ፡ neque cum אָבֵל, sed cum كَبِرَ grandaevus fuit (vicinae sunt אָבַר et גָּבַר) componenda videtur

woorden.betekenis: grandaeva, anus, vidua
woorden.definitie: vel እቤራይ፡, adj. rel., fem. እቤራዊት፡ vel እቤራይት፡, grandaeva, anus, vidua እምከ፡እቤራዊት፡ Hen. 32,6 መዐንዝርት፡እቤራይት፡ Sx. Masc. 18; M.M. f. 88; ብእሲት፡እቤራዊት፡ Lud. e Vit. Dan.

woorden.betekenis: crimen, committere, peccare, cum
woorden.definitie: I,2 [etymo convenit cum خَبُثَ, significatu cum אָשֵׁם, أَثِمَ, sicut ሐሠመ፡ etymo cum أَثِمَ, significatu cum خَبُثَ; quamquam Arabes etiam sub أَبَسَ similes quasdam significationes habent] crimen committere, peccare, ἀσεβεῖν, ἀνομεῖν, ἀδικεῖν, plerumque ἁμαρτάνειν, Ex. 32,33; Lev. 4,2; Lev. 4,22; Lev. 4,27; Ps. 105,6; Job 1,22; Job 7,20; Job 10,3; Job 33,9; Job 34,10; Job 35,6; Koh. 2,25; Koh. 7,20; Sir. 38,15; Prov. 13,21; Jes. 21,3; Jes. 24,5; Jes. 59,13; Hez. 3,21; አብሶ፡ አበሰት፡ Thren. 1,8; ኢይደግሙ፡ አብሶ፡ Hen. 5,8; Matth. 27,4; Joh. 5,14; Joh. 9,3; Rom. 5,14; 1 Joh. 1,10; 1 Joh. 3,6; አቢሶሙ፡ 2 Petr. 2,4; ኢአበሰ፡ ወኢጌገየ፡ ግሙራ፡ Job 34,8; Sir. 49,4 (πλημμελίαν ἐπλημμέλησαν); Thren. 3,41; Rom. 3,23; c.c. Acc. peccati: አበስኩ፡ ዐቢየ፡ ጌጋየ፡ Job 31,33; ሰማርያ፡ መንፈቀ፡ ኀጢአትከ፡ ኢአበሰት፡ Hez. 16,51; c. በ፡ instrumenti: ኢተአብስ፡ በቃልከ፡ Sir. 35,12; እመ፡ አበስነ፡ እመሂ፡ በቃል፡ አው፡ በምግባር፡ ወእመሂ፡ በኅሊና፡ ኅድግ፡ Genz. f. 95; c. ለ፡ ejus, in quem peccatur: ኢተአብስ፡ ለሀገርከ፡ Sir. 7,7; ዘአበሰ፡ ኢተ፡ አበሰ፡ Jes. 21,2; Jes. 42,24; Jer. 8,14; Jer. 47,3; Dan. 9,8; Gen. 40,1; Ps. 50,5; Matth. 6,12; vel c. ላዕለ፡ ejus rei vel personae, in qua peccatur: Lev. 5,16; 1 Reg. 19,4; Prov. 8,36; አበሱ፡ ላዕለ፡ ሕግየ፡ Hos. 8,1; Esth. 1,16; ዘይገብር፡ ኀጢአተ፡ ይኤብስ፡ ላዕለ፡ ነፍሱ፡ Sir. 19,4 (πλημμελήσει). Sir. 10,29; 1 Cor. 6,8; vel c. ዲበ፡ Act. 25,8 Platt; vel c. በ፡, ut: Hen. 7,5; ዳዊት፡ አመ፡ ይኤብስ፡ በብእሲተ፡ ኦርዮ፡ Did. 10; Luc. 15,18; Luc. 15,21; 1 Cor. 6,18; c. ምስለ፡ cum aliquo: መላእክት፡ አበሱ፡ ምስለ፡ አዋልደ፡ ሰብእ፡ Kuf. 4; c. እምነ፡, ut: አበስከ፡ እመሐላ፡ (peccasti contra jusjurandum i.e. mutando j.) Kuf. 37.

woorden.betekenis: crimen, peccatum, peccata, improbitas, culpa, peccando, cont
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. አበሳት፡, crimen, peccatum et peccata, improbitas, culpa peccando contracta: ኢይደግሙ፡ አበሳ፡ Hen. 5,8; 4 Esr. 8,31; ἁμαρτία Lev. 4,3; Koh. 5,5; 1 Joh. 5,16; አበሳ፡ ሞት፡ Kuf. 33; አበሳ፡ ዘበኢያእምሮ፡ ጌገይከ፡ Kuf. 22; ἁμαρτίαι Jes. 6,7; ይዌርዎን፡ ውስተ፡ ባሕር፡ ለአበሳነ፡ Mich. 7,19; ἀδικία 1 Joh. 1,9; አልብየ፡ አበሳ፡ Job 34,6; ἀνομία Ps. 31,5; 1 Joh. 3,4; 1 Joh. 5,17; Matth. 13,41; παράπτωμα Rom. 5,17; ἀνομίαι Job 13,23; Ps. 102,10; Hebr. 8,12; Hebr. 10,17; ἀδικίαι Dan. 9,24; παραπτώματα Marc. 11,25; Marc. 11,26; Matth. 6,14; ὀφειλήματα Matth. 6,12. Pl. አበሳት፡ nonnisi in libris inferioris aevi, ut: ወዘይመስሎ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ እምአበሳት፡ F.M. 6,1; Chrys. Ta. 9; ገባርያነ፡ አበሳት፡ F.N. in proleg.; አበሳት፡ F.N. 50,7.

woorden.betekenis: abbas, ʾabbās, Immagine del santo abate (abbās), il grande n
woorden.definitie: n. peregr. sc. abbas monachorum, Reg. Pach. (pluries). ʾabbās subst. (see the comment below) ሥዕለ፡ ቅዱስ፡ አባስ፡ ዐቢይ አቡነ፡ ፊልጶስ፡ ሰማዕተ፡ አግዓዚ፡ ‘Immagine del santo abate (abbās), il grande nostro padre Fileṗos, martire dei liberi (Agʿāzi),’ 46–47 Didascalia; ሥዕለ፡ ቅዱስ፡ አቡነ፡ ክቡር፡ አባስ፡ ፊልጶስ፡ ‘Immagine del santo nobile nostro padre abate (abbās) Fileṗos’ 36 Didascalie (‘Il titolo di abbas (5) risulta proprio di Filepos.’ 47 n. 36)

woorden.betekenis: Apocalypsis, qalamsis, ʾabuqalamsis, ʾabu qalamsis, Parole d
woorden.definitie: ቀለምሲስ፡ አቡቀለምሲስ፡ n. peregr. corruptum sc. ἀποκάλυψσις i.e. Apocalypsis Joannis, liber N.T., ut: ራእየ፡ ዮሐንስ፡ አቡቀለምሲስ፡ Sx. Tachs. 1; ዮሐንስ፡ ጸሐፈ፡ ወንጌለ፡ ወአቡቀለምሲስ፡ ዘርእየ፡ ውስተ፡ ደሴተ፡ ፍጥሞ፡ Sx. Ter 4; at aliis in locis, ut in subscriptione Apocalypsis in N.T. rom. et Plattiano, Abyssini hoc nomen cognomentum Joannis interpretati esse videntur. qalamsis, ʾabuqalamsis, አቡ፡ ቀለምሲስ፡ ʾabu qalamsis ቃል፡ ዘዮሐንስ፡ አቡ፡ ቀለምሲስ፡ ‘ Parole de Jean Abou Qalamsis ’ 386

woorden.betekenis: lapis, lapides, auriferi, lapideus, pretiosus, gemma, gemmae
woorden.definitie: [אֶבֶן, ܐܰܒܢܳܐ], m. et fem., sing. et coll., Pl. እበን፡ et አእባን፡, Pl. Pl. አእባናት፡, 1 lapis, Gen. 11,3; Gen. 31,45; Ex. 7,19; Ex. 15,5; Ex. 17,12; እብን፡ ዐበይት፡ Deut. 27,2; ዐበይት፡ እብን፡ ወሠናያት፡ 3 Reg. 6,2; እብን፡ ዐቢይ፡ 1 Reg. 6,14; እብን፡ አሐተ፡ 1 Reg. 7,12; ንሕንጽ፡ በእብን፡ Jes. 9,10; Jes. 28,16; Job 14,19; Zach. 12,3; Ps. 117,21; Sir. 6,21; Sir. 27,25; Matth. 4,6; Matth. 7,9; 1 Petr. 2,4; እበን፡ Sir. 21,10; Lev. 14,42; Deut. 27,5; Deut. 27,6; Jos. 4,7; Jos. 4,8; Ps. 101,15; አእባን፡ Koh. 10,9; አእባን፡ ዐበይት፡ Jer. 50,9; ዝንቱ፡ አእባን፡ Jer. 50,10; Matth. 3,9; Matth. 4,3; Matth. 27,60; ዘያሰግሉ፡ በአእባን፡ Clem. f. 178; አእባናት፡ Sx. Jac. 9; እብነ፡ መከራ፡ Sir. 6,21; እብነ፡ ሞጸፍ፡ Zach. 9,15; አእባነ፡ ወርቅ፡ lapides auriferi Sx. Genb. 8; st. constructo subjunctum vel in Genitivo: lapideus, ut: ልበ፡ እብን፡ Hez. 11,19; ጽላት፡ ዘእብን፡ Ex. 32,15; Jos. 5,2; Joh. 2,6; Apoc. 9,20. a lapis pretiosus, gemma: እብን፡ ክቡራት፡ በበሕበሪሆሙ፡ 1 Par. 29,2; እብነ፡ ስርድዮን፡ Ex. 25,7; Ex. 28,9; እብነ፡ ሰንፔር፡ Job 28,6; 1 Cor. 3,12; አእባነ፡ ህንደኬ፡ gemmae Indicae Macc. f. 25; እብነ፡ አድማስ፡ adamas Lit. 172,2; Macc. f. 25; እብነ፡ ፈውስ፡ lapis collyrii (cfr. Apoc. 3,18) i.e. stibium, ut: በእብነ፡ ፈውስ፡ ኰሐሉኒ፡ ዐይነ፡ Sx. Tachs. 24 Enc.; Hen. 18,7. b እብነ፡ በረድ፡ lapis grandinis vel grando Jos. 10,11; Sir. 43,15; Sir. 46,5; Hez. 38,22; Kuf. 48; Hen. 14,9; Hen. 14,10; እብነ፡ አስሐትያ፡ Hen. 71,5; etiam crystallus (እብነ፡ በረድ፡) Org., id. fortasse in locis Henochi modo commemoratis. c lapides ponderis, pondus: እበን፡ Lev. 19,36 in CG; እብነ፡ መዳልው፡ Hez. 5,1; አእባነ፡ ቍናማት፡ Prov. 16,11. d እብነ፡ ኰኵሕ፡ σμυρίτης λίθος smyrites Job 41,6. 2 saxum, rupes, πέτρα Job 22,24; አብን፡ ጽኑዕ፡ Jes. 5,28; Ps. 60,2; እብን፡ ኰኵሕ፡ Deut. 8,15; Rom. 9,33; πετροβόλος Job 41,19. – Voc. Ae.: እብን፡ ብ፡ ደንጊያ፡ ʾǝbn L እብነ፡ መረግድ ʾǝbna maragd emerald, vid. መረግድ፡ 358a

woorden.betekenis: in, lapidem, convertere
woorden.definitie: II,1 in lapidem convertere: እግዚአብሔር፡ አእበና፡ ወሜጠ፡ ህላዌሃ፡ ለከዊነ፡ ሐውልት፡ (sc. Lothi uxorem) M.M. f. 60.

woorden.betekenis: patres, paternus
woorden.definitie: patres, አባዊ፡ paternus vid. sub አብ፡ col. 754.

woorden.betekenis: animi, impetum, voluntatis, intentionem, voluit, noluit, nol
woorden.definitie: I,1 [primitus animi impetum vel voluntatis intentionem (coll. أَبَّ) significat, sive propensae: אָבָה voluit, sive aversae: أَبَى አበየ፡ noluit ] Subj. ይእበይ፡ 1 nolle, recusare, denegare, negare alicui aliquid, abnuere, aspernari, detrectare: አበይነ Act. 16,37; Act. 21,14; c. Acc. rei: ኢየአቢ፡ ስእለተኪ፡ Kuf. 35; περιΐστασο 2 Tim. 2, 16; παραιτοῦ 2 Tim. 2,23; 1 Tim. 4,7; οὐκ ἀνέχεσθαι 2 Tim. 4,3; Herm. p. 45,b; c. Acc. Infin.: Ex. 8,17; Ex. 10,3; Ex. 10,4; ተአብዩ፡ ትእዛዝየ፡ ሰሚዐ፡ ወሕግየ፡ Ex. 16,28; Num. 22,14; 1 Reg. 28,23; 2 Reg. 2,23; 2 Reg. 13,9; Ps. 77,13; አበየት፡ ሰሚዖቶ፡ Esth. 1,12; Esth. 3,4; Jes. 30,9; Jes. 42,24; Jer. 3,7; አበዩ፡ ተምህሮ፡ Jer. 5,3; Zach. 7,13; Marc. 15,23; Matth. 2,18; አበየ፡ ዝናም፡ ተውህቦ፡ ለምድር፡ Kuf. 42; አበዩ፡ አይድዖ፡ οὐκ ἐνδυνάσθησαν ἀναγγεῖλαι 2 Esr. 2,59; seq. ለ፡ c. Infin. 2 Reg. 23,17; seq. ከመ፡ ኢ፡, ut: ኢይእበይ፡ ባዕል፡ ከመ፡ ኢይጠመቅ፡ ምስለ፡ ነዳይ፡ F.N. 3; seq. Acc. pers. ( alicui negare aliquid): Gen. 39,8; እመ፡ ጸውዐከ፡ ኢትእበዮ፡ Sir. 13,9; ዘአበዮ፡ Sir. 31,25; Matth. 18,30; Marc. 6,26; Luc. 18,4; c. Acc. pers. et Acc. Infin.: Gen. 24,41; አበዮሙ፡ ነጊፈ፡ ላሖ፡ Gen. 37,35; አልቦ፡ ዘየአብዮ፡ ተኰንኖ፡ Jes. 22,22. 2 nolle obtemperare, non obedire, repugnare, resistere, reniti, contumacem esse, ዘየአቢ፡ ይእበይ፡ ὁ ἀπειθῶν ἀπειθείτω Hez. 3,27; c. Acc. mandati: ከመ፡ የአቢ፡ ትእዛዘ፡ ንጉሥ፡ Esth. 3,4; አበዩ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ትእዛዘ፡ ንጉሥ፡ Judith 1,11; Judith 2,6; Dan. 3,12; Rom. 13,2; ከመ፡ ኢይእበዩ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ Dan. 6,8; c. Acc. pers. vel rei Hebr. 12,25 (παραιτεῖσθαι); Herm. p. 34; Herm. p. 35; Herm. p. 45; c. ለ፡ pers. ለ፩እምኔሆሙ፡ ኢትእበይ፡ μηδετέρῳ ἀπειθήσῃς Prov. 24,21; Luc. 16,13; c. እምነ፡ mandati: እመሰቦ፡ ዘአበየ፡ እምቃልከ፡ ይኩን፡ ሕሩመ፡ Clem. f. 85; እመሰ፡ አበየ፡ እምዝንቱ፡ (wenn er sich aber dessen weigert) F.M. 12,2.

woorden.betekenis: deerrando, vagando, ferum et a consuetudine alienum evasit,
woorden.definitie: I,1 [potestas racidis prima est in deerrando et vagando; inde oriuntur 1) ferum et a consuetudine alienum evasit animal أَبَدَ; mente alienari, insanire አብደ፡; efferari, rabere عَبِدَ أَبِدَ አብደ፡ ሀርበደ፡; 2) desertum esse أَبِدَ (vic. በድወ፡, بَدَا); 3) oberrare, amitti אָבַד ܐܶܒܰܕ; 4) perire אָבַד ܐܶܒܰܕ በድበደ፡ بَدَا] Subj. ይእበድ፡ 1 oberrare, profugere, vagari 1 Reg. 25,10. 2 mente errare vel capi i.e. a insanire, amentem esse vel fieri: አብደ፡ ἐξέστη Marc. 3,21; ተአብዲ፡ μαίνῃ Act. 12,15; Act. 26,24. b stultum esse vel fieri, imprudenter agere, errorem committere: የአብዱ፡ መላእክተ፡ ጣኔዎስ፡ μωροὶ ἔσονται Jes. 19,11; Rom. 1,22; 1 Cor. 1,23; Clem. f. 189; እምኔክሙ፡ ኢየአብድ፡ (ἀσυνετώτερος) Job 13,2; እስመ፡ አብዱ፡ ኖሎት፡ ἠφρονεύσαντο Jer. 10,21; Tit. 3,3 (ἦμεν ἀνόητοι); Luc. 6,11; κορήσουσι Deut. 31,20; ኢትእበድ፡ μὴ ἀγνόει Hos. 4,15; አብደ፡ ዐቢየ፡ እበደ፡ 1 Reg. 14,24. 3 efferari, furere, furore corripi vel exsultare, saevire, rabiosum esse vel fieri: አበድኩ፡ 2 Esr. 9,3 var.; አብደ፡ መራዕይ፡ Marc. 5,13; የአብዱ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ ነሰኮሙ፡ (ከልብ፡ እቡድ፡) ኅቡረ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ Did. 6; c. ላዕለ፡ vel ዲበ፡ contra vel in aliquem: Act. 26,11 Platt; Act. 19,16; አብዱ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ M.M. f. 53; ἐξηγριάνθη πρὸς αὐτόν Dan. 8,7.

woorden.betekenis: amentem, stultum reddere, infatuare, decipere, ad insaniam a
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 amentem vel stultum reddere, infatuare, decipere: አኮኑ፡ አእበዳ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለጥበበ፡ ዝዓለም፡ 1 Cor. 1,20; ያአብድዎሙ፡ (አጋንንት፡ ለሰብእ፡) Kuf. 10; Act. 8,11; ኢታእብደኒ፡ (v. ታስተአብደኒ፡) μὴ πλάνα με Tob. 10,7; አእብዶት፡ Ssal. Req. 2 ad insaniam adigere, in furorem vel rabiem agere, furiosum reddere: Luc. 8,29; ለምንት፡ ታአብድ፡ (ሰይጣን፡) ሰብአ፡ Gad. T.H.

woorden.betekenis: stultus, amens, demens, stupidus, insipiens, imprudens, impe
woorden.definitie: adj. et subst., m. et fem. (ut 4 Esr. 10,8, pro አብድት), Pl. m. አብዳን፡, fem. አብዳት፡ 1 stultus, amens, demens, stupidus, insipiens, imprudens, imperitus, ineruditus, disciplinae expers, de personis: ἄφρων Koh. 4,13; Koh. 10,3; Job 5,2; Prov. 6,12; Prov. 24,9; Sir. 22,13; Sir. 27,11; Sir. 31,1; Jer. 17,11; Ps. 13,1; Luc. 12,20; 2 Cor. 11,16; አብዳን፡ Koh. 4,17; Jer. 4,22; 2 Reg. 13,13; Luc. 11,40; Rom. 2,20; 2 Cor. 11,19; ወለት፡ አብድ፡ Sir. 22,3; 4 Esr. 10,8; አብዳት፡ Job 2,10; μωρός Sir. 20,31; Sir. 21,14 seq.; Sir. 22,11; Sir. 27,13; Dan. apocr 1,48; Deut. 32,6; Ps. 93,8; Matth. 7,26; Matth. 23,17; አብዳት፡ Matth. 25,2; Matth. 25,3; ἀσύνετος Sir. 22,15; Sir. 27,12; አብዳነ፡ ልብ፡ Ps. 75,4; Rom. 1,31; ἡττώμενος ἐν συσέσει Sir. 19,24; ἀνόητος Prov. 15,21; Prov. 17,28; Rom. 1,14; Gal. 3,1; ἀπαίδευτος Sir. 6,20; Sir. 8,4; Sir. 10,3; Sir. 51,23; Prov. 5,23; Prov. 15,12; Prov. 24,8; ሕዝብ፡ አብዳን፡ Jes. 26,11; Zeph. 2,1; ἄνους Hos. 7,11; ἄπειρος Zach. 11,15 (cfr. Rom. 1,28); ἰδιώτης 1 Cor. 14,23; 2 Cor. 11,6; raro de rebus, ut: ዘይኄሊ፡ አብድ፡ ውእቱ፡ ἃ λογιεῖται ἀφροσύνη ἐστί Koh. 10,3. 2 rarius (i.q. አቡድ፡) insanus, vesanus, furiosus, rabidus, μωρός Matth. 5,22; ἄγριος Herm. p. 44; እመኒ፡ በምክንያተ፡ ጋኔን፡ ዘያጌብሮ፡ ዝንቱ፡ አብድ፡ ውእቱ፡ … አው፡ በተማስኖ፡ ናላሁ፡ በደዌ፡ ወዝንቱ፡ ዝንጉዕ፡ ውእቱ፡ F.N. 32; de bestiis: አብድ፡ ከልብ፡ ዘነሰኮ፡ M.F.; tyrannus saevus comparatur cum አብድ፡ ሐራውያ፡ Sx. Nah. 23Enc. – Voc. Ae.: አብድ፡ ዘ፡ ሰነፍ፡ የዋህሂ።

woorden.betekenis: thronus, sedes, cathedra, suggestus, pulpitum, supina
woorden.definitie: , rarius አትሮኖስ፡ et አትራኖስ፡ n. peregr. sc. θρόνος thronus, sedes, cathedra, a regis 3 Reg. 10,9; 3 Reg. 10,18; b Dei, Sx. Hed. 8Enc. c patriarchae seu episcopi, Sx. Hed. 30Enc. d anagnostae ( suggestus, pulpitum ): M.M. f. 325; Sx. Mag.13; F.N. 8,4; ἄμβων Can. Laod. 15. e in genere: thronus, cathedra supina, መንበረ፡ አትሮንስ፡ Hen. 24,3; Reg. Pach. (vid. ደበርቢር፡).

woorden.betekenis: se, amovere, procul, ire, discedere, abscedere, recedere, de
woorden.definitie: III,1 et III,2 1 refl. se amovere (sich entfernen) i.e. procul ire, discedere, abscedere, recedere, ኢትትኤተቱ፡ ወርሑቀ፡ ኢተሐውሩ፡ Ex. 8,24; ተአተተ፡ ሕቀ፡ እምህየ፡ Matth. 26,39; Marc. 14,35; ኢይትአተቱ፡ እምኔሁ፡ Hen. 14,23; Stephanus ኢተአተተ፡ ወኢተዐደወ፡ እምነ፡ ዚአሁ፡ ዐቅም፡ (አላ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ዲያቆን፡ ዐቀበ፡) Mavâs. 12; etiam desistere vel absistere incepto, seq. እምነ፡ Jsp. p. 272. 2 pass.: amoveri, removeri, submoveri, auferri, tolli: ተአተተ፡ እምኔየ፡ በትር፡ Job 9,34; Jer. 4,1 var.; ሶበ፡ ጥቀ፡ ይትሌዐል፡ ሰማይ፡ ወይትአተት፡ Jer. 38,37; Jer. 39,40 var.; ይትአተት፡ በትረ፡ ግብጽ፡ Zach. 10,11; Act. 8,33. – Voc. Ae.: ተአተተ፡ ዘ፡ ረሐቀ።

woorden.betekenis: fumavit, clibanus, furnus, fornax, caminus, faber, fornacari
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., Pl. እቶናት፡ [ܐܰܬܽܘܢܳܐ אַתּוּן أتُّونٌ, a rad. ܬܢܰܢ fumavit (ተነነ፡), vid. Ges. thes. p. 1512] clibanus, furnus, fornax, caminus, κλίβανος Gen. 15,17; Kuf. 14; 4 Esr. 2,55; እቶናት፡ Ex. 7,28; ብሱል፡ በእቶን፡ Lev. 2,4; Lev. 11,35; Lev. 26,26; ከመ፡ እቶን፡ ዘአንደዱ፡ ለኀቢዘ፡ ኅብስት፡ Hos. 7,4; Hos. 6,7; Ps. 20,9; κάμινος Gen. 19,28; Ex. 9,8; Num. 25,8; እቶነ፡ ኀጺን፡ Deut. 4,20; Jer. 11,4; Jes. 48,10; Dan. 3,6; Job 41,11; Sir. 43,4; Hen. 54,6; Matth. 13,50; እቶነ፡ ገሃነም፡ 4 Esr. 6,1; እቶነ፡ እከይ፡ Prov. 16,30; ለእመ፡ ገብረ፡ አሐዱ፡ እቶን፡ ዘየዐርግ፡ እምኔሁ፡ ጢስ፡ F.N. 37; በዓለ፡ እቶን፡ faber fornacarius F.N. 23; F.N. 36 (ubi varia opificum genera enumerantur).

woorden.betekenis: domum, in, patriam, venire, ire, abire, reverti, revenire, r
woorden.definitie: I,1 [אָתָה ܐܶܬܳܐ أَتَا et أَتَى] Subj. ይእቱ፡ (raro ይእተው፡ ut 4 Reg. 6,22 var.), Imperat. እቱ፡ (raro እተው፡, ut 2 Reg. 14,8), domum (vel in patriam ) venire vel ire vel abire vel reverti, revenire, abs. Ruth 1,11; Jes. 37,37; እቱ፡ 2 Reg. 15,19; 2 Reg. 19,14; ለእመ፡ ዳኅነ፡ አቶክሙ፡ Tob. 5,16; አቲዎሙ፡ ἡνίκα ἀπέτρεχεν Dan. apocr. 1,7; እስከ፡ ማእዜ፡ ትትመየጥ፡ ወማእዜ፡ ተአቱ፡ 2 Esr. 12,6; Luc. 19,13; Luc. 23,48; ይጐነዲ፡ አቲወ፡ Matth. 24,48; እትዊ፡ Ruth 1,15; c. Acc. domi vel patriae: እቱ፡ ቤተከ፡ Num. 24,11; Kuf. 43; Ruth 1,8; 1 Reg. 2,20; ይእቱ፡ ብሔሮ፡ Jes. 13,14; የአትዉ፡ ጽዮንሃ፡ Jes. 35,10; Jes. 51,11; Act. 8,39; etiam c. Acc. viae: አተወ፡ ፍኖቶ፡ ᾤχετο εἰς τὴν ὁδὸν αὐτοῦ Jer. 35,11; c. ውስተ፡ domi vel patriae: 1 Reg. 8,22; 2 Reg. 14,8; ንእቱ፡ ኵልነ፡ ውስተ፡ ብሔርነ፡ Jer. 28,9; Ruth 1,7; 1 Par. 16,43; c. ኀበ፡ pers.: Ruth 1,15; Ruth 3,16; Ruth 3,17; 4 Reg. 6,22; c. እምነ፡ loci: Gen. 30,16; Num. 31,14; Ruth 4,3; vel c. እምኀበ፡, ut: ወአተወ፡ እምኀበ፡ መዝብር፡ Jer. 19,14. a redire in possessionem suam i.e. recuperare eam, Lev. 25,10; Lev. 25,13. b transl. de morientibus: ተአቱ፡ መቃብሪከ፡ Job 5,26; እቱ፡ ኀበ፡ ሕዝብከ፡ Deut. 32,50; item de pie defunctis, qui in patriam coelestem abeunt: አተዉ፡ በሠናይ፡ ስም፡ Lit. Joh. (sind heimgegangen). c de animalibus, qui se recipiunt in lustra, cavernas, nidos Ps. 103,23. d raro: venire, ingredi in genere, ut: ንፈቅድ፡ ወንፈቱ፤ ከመ፡ … ውስተ፡ ማኅበርነ፡ እምሰማይ፡ ትእቱ፡ Sx. Masc. 10Enc. – Voc. Ae.: አተወ፡ ቦአ፡ ዘ፡ ገባ።

woorden.betekenis: ah, heu
woorden.definitie: ah, heu vid. sub አህ፡

woorden.betekenis: ; ተአኀለ፡ dubiae significationis, var. pro ተተሐለ፡ q.v
woorden.definitie: ; ተአኀለ፡ dubiae significationis, var. pro ተተሐለ፡ q.v.

woorden.betekenis: differre, retardare, post se relinquere
woorden.definitie: I,2 vel አእኀረ፡ II,1 [i.q. أَخَّرَ, אֵחַר, ܐܰܘܚܰܪ, vid. ድኅረ፡] 1 differre, retardare: ከተማ፡ ዐውድከ፡ ኢታእኅር፡ var. ትእኅር፡ Ex. 22,28. 2 { አእኀረ፡ post se relinquere ብፁዐነ፡ ያእኅሮሙ፡ ለውሉዱ፡ Prov. 20,7 in Abb. LV}

woorden.betekenis: soror
woorden.definitie: soror vid. post እኅው፡

woorden.betekenis: frater, agnatus, cognatus, consanguineus, affinis, contribul
woorden.definitie: vel እኍ፡ (passim እኁ፡ pro እኍ፡) subst., m., [אָח ܐܰܚܳܐ أَخٌ], st.c. et Acc. እኅወ፡ vel እኈ፡ (ut እኅወ፡ አቡሁ፡ Kuf. p. 35; Gen. 24,29; Gen. 43,6; Gen. 44,19), quamquam pro st.c. እኍ፡ cum pron. suff. seq. ለ፡ usurpare amant, ut Joh. 1,41; ante pron. suff. እኁ፡ in Nom. (እኁየ፡ Matth. 12,50; Matth. 18,21; Luc. 6,42; እኁነ፡ 2 Cor. 12,18; Phil. 2,25; እኁከ፡ Matth. 5,23; Matth. 7,3; እኁኪ፡ Esth. 5,1; እኁክሙ፡ Gen. 42,15; Gen. 42,34; Jud. 9,18; et እኍክሙ፡ Apoc. 1,9 Platt; እኁሁ፡ Gen. 22,23; Gen. 24,15; Jud. 1,13; Jud. 3,9; እኁሃ፡ Gen. 28,5; Gen. 29,10; እኁሆሙ፡ Jud. 9,24), እኋ፡ vel እኅዋ፡ in Acc. (ut: እኅዋሁ፡ vel እኋሁ፡ Kuf. 11; Jer. 38,34; Ps. 48,7; Matth. 10,21; Marc. 13,12; Hebr. 8,11; እኋከ፡ Ex. 28,1; እኅዋክሙ፡ Gen. 42,20 c. ann.; እኋሆሙ፡ Ps. 37,21), sed etiam እኁ፡ (ut እኁሁ፡ Jes. 9,19; እኁሆሙ፡ 2 Reg. 3,30; እኁከ፡ Deut. 25,3; እኁየ፡ Philem. 16; እኁነ፡ 2 Cor. 8,22), Pl. አኀው፡ (ut Gen. 42,8; Sir. 25,1; 2 Par. 21,2; Matth. 4,18; Matth. 5,47; Matth. 12,47; Matth. 12,48; Matth. 13,55; Matth. 19,29; Matth. 20,24; Matth. 22,25; Matth. 23,8; Luc. 18,29; Act. 3,22) frater, ut Marc. 1,16; Marc. 19,3; Marc. 19,31; Marc. 6,18; Marc. 10,29; Marc. 12,19; Marc. 13,12; Gen. 43,3; Gen. 43,29; Gen. 44,20, al. creberrime. a agnatus, cognatus, consanguineus, affinis, ut Gen. 13,8; Gen. 14,16; Gen. 29,15; Ex. 32,27; Lev. 10,4; Jes. 9,19; Tob. 7,11; Tob. 10,12; Tob. 11,1; Org. 2, ubi Salomo rex frater Mariae virginis vocatur (Lud.). b contribulis, popularis, ut Num. 16,10; Deut. 15,2; Deut. 18,15; Deut. 25,3; Act. 2,29; Act. 2,37; Act. 7,2; Act. 7,23; Rom. 9,3; Hebr. 7,5; de populis cognatis Num. 20,14; Am. 1,11. c socius, amicus, 2 Esr. 15,10; 2 Esr. 15,14; Gen. 19,7; 2 Reg. 1,26; 2 Reg. 20,9; etiam de maritis et sponsis Esth. 5,1; Cant. 1,13; Cant. 1,15. d eidem religioni vel religiosorum ordini addicti et fraterno amore conjuncti, α Christiani Matth. 23,8; Act. 9,17; Act. 11,12; Rom. 1,13; Rom. 7,1; Rom. 7,4, al.; ኦአኀው፡ ፍቁራን፡ Chrys. ho. (crebro). β monachi, Phlx. creberrime, F.N. 10, al. e quivis alius homo, alius, alter ( proximus ), Gen. 9,5; ይቀትል፡ ብእሲ፡ እኁሁ፡ Jes. 19,2; Matth. 5,22; Matth. 7,3; Matth. 18,15; Matth. 18,21.

woorden.betekenis: necessitudo, fraterna, fraternitas
woorden.definitie: subst. necessitudo fraterna, fraternitas: inter monachos non intercedit መዓርገ፡ አበውና፡ ዳእሙ፡ መዓርገ፡ እኅውና፡ F.N. 10,6.

woorden.betekenis: consanguinitas, necessitudo, fratrum, fratres, cognati, foed
woorden.definitie: (ተእኃ፡) et ተአኃ፡ et ታአኃ፡ subst., 1 a consanguinitas vel necessitudo fratrum, Kuf. p. 135 ann.6; b pro concreto: fratres, cognati, Gen. 19,12. 2 foedus fratrum i.e. a amicitia, φιλία, ሰዐረ፡ ታእኃሁ፡ Sir. 22,20; ታእኃሆሙ፡ ለአዕርክት፡ Sir. 25,1; Sir. 27,18; ያረትዕ፡ ተአኃሁ፡ Sir. 6,17; ታአኃ፡ et ተአኃ፡ Prov. 19,7; Prov. 25,10. b pro concreto: amici, ታበዝኅ፡ ታእኃሁ፡ πληθυνεῖ φίλους αὐτοῦ Sir. 6,5; ለምስኪኖሙ፡ ወለተአኃሆሙ፡ (v. ወለተአኃዎሙ፡, nam ተአኃ፡ e ተአኃው፡ ortum est) Esth. 9,22.

woorden.betekenis: prehendere, comprehendere, apprehendere, prehendit, corripit
woorden.definitie: I,1 [אָחַז ܐܶܚܰܕ أَخَذَ; amh. ያዘ፡] Imperf. ይእኅዝ፡ (I pers. sing. passim እኅዝ፡ pro እእኅዝ፡ ut Ps. 17,41; Cant. 7,9; 1 Reg. 22,15 in uno libro), Subj. ይእኀዝ፡ (Matth. 21,46; Matth. 26,55; Marc. 12,12; Marc. 14,1; Joh. 7,30 in ed. rom.; Gen. 18,19 FH.), plerumque የአኀዝ፡ (vid. eosdem locos in ed. Platt; Am. 3,5; Hez. 21,11; Jer. 19,3; 1 Reg. 3,11, al.; at forma የአኅዝ፡ Ps. 15,6; Ps. 34,9 intempestiva Ludolfi emendatione nititur), Imperat. አኀዝ፡ (Kuf. 10; Kuf. 17; Kuf. 26; Sir. 6,27; Tob. 6,4, al.), Infin. እኂዝ፡, እኂዞት፡. 1 prehendere, comprehendere, apprehendere, abs. Job 9,19; Am. 3,5; c.c. Acc.: Jes. 4,1; Jud. 16,3; አኀዘቶ፡ ወሰዐመቶ፡ Prov. 7,13; አኀዘተ፡ ሥዕርተ፡ ርእሱ፡ Judith 13,7; አኀዞ፡ ለውእቱ፡ ዓሣ፡ ἐπιλαβοῦ Tob. 6,4; Matth. 14,31; Luc. 23,26; Apoc. 1,17; ትእኅዞሙ፡ ከመ፡ ነምር፡ Sir. 28,23; c. Acc. pers. et c. Acc. membri: አኀዝከኒ፡ እዴየ፡ Ps. 72,23; አኀዛ፡ እዴሃ፡ Tob. 7,12, vel c. በ፡ membri: Asc. Jes. 7,3; Hez. 8,3; Gen. 19,16; Deut. 25,11; 4 Esr. 10,44; c.c. በ፡ rei vel pers.: አመ፡ አኀዝኩ፡ በእደዊሆሙ፡ Jer. 38,32; ከመ፡ የአኀዝ፡ በእዴሁ፡ Hez. 21,11. a timor, terror, calamitas, dolor, morbus prehendit i.e. corripit aliquem: Ex. 15,14; Ex. 15,15; ምምዓ፡ ይእኅዞ፡ Prov. 19,15; Ps. 17,5; Ps. 47,6; አኀዞ፡ ሕማም፡ Jer. 27,43; ይእኅዞሙ፡ ማሕምም፡ ከመ፡ እንተ፡ ትወልድ፡ Jes. 13,8; Jes. 21,3; Jes. 33,14; አኀዘኒ፡ ምንዳቤ፡ Jer. 6,24; Judith 15,2; አኀዞ፡ ለኢዮብ፡ ዝልጋሴ፡ Job 2,7; ግርማ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አኀዘኒ፡ Job 31,23; ignis corripit aliquid Ex. 22,5. b comprehendere, deprehendere aliquem captivum: Deut. 22,18; አኀዝዎ፡ ሕያዎ፡ 1 Reg. 15,8; 1 Reg. 19,14; 4 Reg. 10,14; Gen. 44,4; Kuf. 10; Jer. 2,26; Jer. 27,9; Jer. 33,8; Jer. 52,9; Judith 10,12; Asc. Jes. 3,12; Dan. apocr. 1,39; Dan. apocr. 13,21; Matth. 26,55; Luc. 22,54; Act. 1,16; Act. 12,3; Act. 12,4. c capere, Job 5,13; Ps. 34,9; venando Kuf. p. 94; Kuf. p. 95; piscando Luc. 5,5; ኢያመስጥ፡ እምእኂዞቱ፡ (v. እምእኅዞቱ፡) Job 31,23. d capere radices: ዘእንበለ፡ የአኀዝ፡ ሥርወ፡ ወኀይለ፡ Kuf. 37; አኀዘ፡ ሥርወ፡ Herm. p. 64; Herm. p. 65. 2 prehensum tenere, tenere: Gen. 25,26; አኀዝዮ፡ ለሕፃን፡ በእደዊኪ፡ Kuf. 17; አኀዝኩከ፡ በእዴየ፡ Jes. 42,6; Jes. 41,10; ይእኅዝ፡ ሐቌሁ፡ Jer. 37,6; አኀዛ፡ ወኢትኅድጋ፡ Sir. 6,27; እኂዝ፡ Koh. 2,3; Hen. 56,2; ከመ፡ ኵሉ፡ የአኀዝ፡ እዘኒሁ፡ Jer. 19,3; 1 Reg. 3,11. a tenere memoria, animo Hen. 94,5. b continere, coërcere: ኢይእኅዙ፡ ልሳኖሙ፡ ἀκρατεῖς γλώσσῃ Prov. 27,20; ዘይእኅዝ፡ ኵሎ፡ ፍጥረተ፡ τὸ συνέχον τὰ πάντα Sap. 1,7; Gen. 18,19 FH. c occupare, potiri, possidere, dominari, obtinere, raro c. በ፡ rei Hen. 60,8; plerumque c. Acc. Kuf. 8; Kuf. 25; ይእኅዙ፡ ምድረ፡ Prov. 8,16; እለ፡ ይእኅዝዋ፡ ለምድር፡ Hen. 38,4; Hen. 48,8; Hen. 62,3; እግዚእ፡ ዘኵሎ፡ ይእኅዝ፡ ὁ παντοκράτωρ Rel. Bar.; Lit. 160,1; መኑ፡ አኀዘ፡ ኵሎ፡ አጽናፈ፡ ምድር፡ Prov. 24,27; ዘአኀዞ፡ ጋኔን፡ daemoniacus Clem. f. 178; Marc. 3,30; Luc. 8,26 in tit.; abs. dominari Asc. Jes. 4,12; እኂዝ፡ potentia, dominatio Lit. 159,4; Lit. 160,1; Genz. f. 67. d detinere, retinere, inhibere: ኢተአኀዙኒ፡ Gen. 24,56; Job 34,14; ትክልኑ፡ ተአኀዛ፡ ለትርያ፡ ከመ፡ ኢትሑር፡ Job 38,31; Dan. apocr. 13,19. 3 incipere, coepisse, በዝንቱ፡ ዓመት፡ አኀዘ፡ ዐባር፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ (si non: obtinuit ) Kuf. 24; c. እምነ፡ ab aliqua re Num. 1,2; Num. 26,2; Ex. 12,18; Matth. 20,8; c. Acc. (aliquid), ut: አኀዙ፡ ፀብአ፡ Jsp. p. 357; seq. verbo finito asyndeto: አኀዝ፡ ኈልቍ፡ Num. 4,22; plerumque seq. Subj. verbi: አኀዘ፡ ይግበር፡ Gen. 2,3; Gen. 6,1; Gen. 11,6; 1 Reg. 3,2; 1 Reg. 22,15; 2 Par. 3,1; 2 Esr. 4,4; 2 Esr. 5,2; 1 Esr. 4,1; Tob. 7,14; Tob. 10,4; 4 Esr. 1,14; 4 Esr. 1,15; 4 Esr. 3,29; 4 Esr. 9,29; 4 Esr. 10,3; Marc. 14,19; Matth. 4,17; vel seq. Imperf. 4 Esr. 8,21; Kuf. p. 41, lin. 1; Kuf. p. 47 ann. 4; Gen. 44,11 FH; Ex. 4,10 annot.; Matth. 26,22; Matth. 26,37 rom.; vel seq. ከመ፡ c. Subj.: አኀዘ፡ ከመ፡ ይሕንጽ፡ 2 Par. 3,3; 2 Par. 34,3; vel seq. እንዘ፡ c. Indic., Hen. 86,5; Hen. 88,2; vel seq. ለ፡ c. Infin. ይእኅዙ፡ ለአቅሞ፡ ቃል፡ Hez. 13,6; አኀዙ፡ ይጼውዉ፡ ወለሠይጥ፡ Kuf. p. 45. 4 recipere, accipere, Hen. 17,4; በእኂዘ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ ወደሙ፡ ለክርስቶስ፡ Clem. f. 131. 5 pignus capere vel pro pignore capere aliquid ab aliquo, c. Acc. pers. Job 22,6; c. Acc. rei Job 24,3; ኢይደልዎ፡ ለካህን፡ ከመ፡ ይትወሐስ፡ ፩ሂ፡ ወየአኀዝ፡ ንዋየ፡ F.N. 27. — Voc. Ae.: አኀዘ፡ ወጠነ፡ ዘ፡ ዠመረ፡

woorden.betekenis: prehendere jubere, tenendum dare, observare jubere, pignori
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 prehendere jubere aliquem, tenendum dare alicui aliquid, Matth. 27,29 rom. 2 tenere i.e. observare jubere aliquem aliquid, Gen. 18,19 c. 3 pignori dare, oppignerare, c. dupl. Acc., Ex. 22,25.

woorden.betekenis: comprehendi, capi, teneri, prehensum, captivum, contineri, i
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 comprehendi, capi, de hominibus Matth. 4,12; እመ፡ ተእኅዞ፡ ተእኅዘ፡ ዘይሰርቅ፡ Prov. 6,30; ተእኅዝከ፡ Prov. 6,2 var.; ይትአኀዙ፡ በሐብለ፡ ንዴት፡ Job 36,8; ተእኅዘ፡ በመሥገርት፡ Jer. 31,44; de avibus Koh. 9,12; piscibus Luc. 5,6; de urbibus: ሶበ፡ ተእኅዘት፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፡ Jer. 46,1 vers. nov. 2 teneri a prehensum: ዘገሰሰ፡ ፒሳ፡ ይትአኀዝ፡ ቦቱ፡ Sir. 13,1. b captivum Hen. 21,20. c contineri, inhiberi: በልጓም፡ ይትአኀዙ፡ Hen. 60,15; ተእኅዘ፡ አዕይንቲሆሙ፡ ከመ፡ ኢ፡ Luc. 24,16. d retineri, cohiberi: አስራበ፡ ሰማይ፡ ተእኅዘ፡ Gen. 8,2; Kuf. 5. e tenere, obtinere (Intransit.): ተእኅዘ፡ ልማደ፡ እብሰት፡ ወርስዐት፡ Sap. 14,16; ወትትአኀዝ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብረ፡ ዐመፃ፡ Hen. 91,6 (in mea editione verbum ወትትአኀዝ፡ errore omissum, ante ኵሉ፡ inserendum est), f retineri i.e. continuari: ተእኅዞተ፡ ጾም፡ እስከ፡ ምሴት፡ Phlx. 29. 3 a pro pignore sibi capere aliquid, c. Acc.: ኢትትአኀዝ፡ ማሕረፀ፡ Deut. 24,6; Deut. 24,10. b pignore obstringi, adigi ut pignus det ( haften für etwas ): አብ፡ ኢይትአኀዝ፡ በዕዳ፡ ልቃሐ፡ ወልዱ፡ ለእመ፡ ኢኮነ፡ ዘተለቅሐ፡ በትእዛዘ፡ ዚአሁ፡ F.N. 27.

woorden.betekenis: comprehensus, captus, detentus, haerens, contentus, conjunct
woorden.definitie: part. 1 a comprehensus, captus, δεδεμένος Act. 10,11 Platt; ውስተ፡ ቤተ፡ ሞቅሕ፡ ኀበ፡ ሀሎ፡ ዮሴፍ፡ እኁዝ፡ ህየ፡ Kuf. p. 139. b detentus, haerens, Gen. 22,13. c contentus: እስመ፡ ዓለም፡ ወኵሉ፡ ዘውስቴታ፡ እኁዝ፡ ውስተ፡ እዴሁ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ Did. 25; Lit. 171,2; Org. 2. d conjunctus, connexus, Ex. 36,29; Trinitas እኁዝ፡ በሐብለ፡ አምልኮት፡ Syn. in Proleg. (Lud.). e occupatus, possessus, obsessus, Ps. 15,6; እኁዛነ፡ አጋንንት፡ Marc. 3,11. 2 tenens (sicut אָחוּז et ܐܰܚܺܝܕ): ኵሎሙ፡ እኁዛነ፡ አስይፍት፡ Cant. 3,8; ሱራፊ፡ እኁዘ፡ ሰይፍ፡ Org. 5; ሊቃናት፡ እኁዛነ፡ መዓጥን፡ Org. 3; c.c. Acc. rei Hen. 56,1. 3 contingens, contiguus, continens, continuus: ወእኁዝ፡ ክነፊሆሙ፡ ለለ፩፩፡ Hez. 1,8; Hez. 1,23; እንዘ፡ እኁዛን፡ ምስሌሆሙ፡ Hez. 10,16; ከመ፡ ኢይኩኑ፡ እኁዛነ፡ Hez. 41,6; 3 Reg. 7,17; 3 Reg. 7,35.

woorden.betekenis: potentia, dominatio
woorden.definitie: Infin. potentia, dominatio vid. sub አኀዘ፡

woorden.betekenis: apprehensio, comprehensio, occupatio, possessio, dominium, d
woorden.definitie: n. act. 1 apprehensio, comprehensio: ወኮነት፡ ስምዐ፡ እኅዘትየ፡ Job 16,7; Job 16,8; Job 31,23 var.; እኅዘትከ፡ (sc. Christi) በመጣብሕ፡ ወበአብትር፡ Cod. Mus. Brit. LIV,7. 2 occupatio, possessio, κατάσχεσις Hez. 46,16; Hez. 46,18. 3 dominium, dominatio: Deus Filius Patri par est በእኅዘት፡ ወሥልጣን፡ (posthac በምልክና፡ ወሥልጣን፡) Chrys. ho. 2.

woorden.betekenis: ego, nos
woorden.definitie: pron. pers. I sing. ego, Pl. ንሕነ፡ nos (gramm. § 148, c); አነ፡ cum particula ሰ፡ in አንሰ፡ concrescit (gramm. § 171): አነ፡ ኣጸንዐከ፡ Gen. 15,1; እትገፋዕ፡ አንሰ፡ እምኔከ፡ Gen. 16,5; Gen. 16,8; Koh. 2,1; Koh. 2,12; ብየ፡ አንሰ፡ ብዙኀ፡ Gen. 33,9; ወአንሰ፡ 1 Reg. 25,25; Jer. 2,21; Jer. 11,19; አንሰኬ፡ Jes. 49,25; Matth. 3,11; Matth. 3,14; Matth. 5,22; Joh. 4,14; አነ፡ ጥበብ፡ አኅደርኩ፡ ምክረ፡ Prov. 8,12; ከማሁ፡ ንገብር፡ ንሕነ፡ Ex. 32,31; 3 Joh. 12; in sententiis nominalibus: አነ፡ ውእቱ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Gen. 15,7; Gen. 3,10; Gen. 4,9; ወለተ፡ ባቱኤል፡ አነ፡ Gen, 24,24; Gen. 50,19; እስመ፡ አኀው፡ ንሕነ፡ Gen. 13,8; Gen. 29,4; Gen. 42,31; Jud. 19,18; Marc. 5,9; እስመ፡ አነ፡ ኄር፡ አነ፡ Matth. 20,15; ወንሕነ፡ ምንት፡ ንሕነ፡ Ex. 16,7; Ex. 16,8.

woorden.betekenis: en, ecce, hie, da, en vobis, accipite
woorden.definitie: particula demonstrativa (cognata cum ና, ነው፡, ነይ፡ col. 630.) obsoleta, cujus propria vis en, ecce ( hie, da ) fuisse videtur; occurrit 1 እንክሙ፡ en vobis i.e. accipite λάβετε Matth. 26,26. 2 in particulis compositis እንከ፡, እንጋ፡ quas videre licet suo quamque loco. { Cfr. etiam ኢንከ፡, ኢንኪ፡ al. in }

woorden.betekenis: mensura liquidorum
woorden.definitie: n. peregr. sc. εἴν i.e. הִין, mensura liquidorum apud Hebraeos, sextam partem Bathi seu duodecim Logos continens; plerumque fem., Ex. 29,40; Lev. 23,13; Num. 15,4 seq.; Num. 28,5 seq.; ሳድስተ፡ እዴሃ፡ ለኢን፡ Hez. 4,11.

woorden.betekenis: hominem, virum, feminam
woorden.definitie: rad., unde in linguis Semiticis vocabula varia, hominem, virum, feminam significantia derivari solent, vid. Ges. thes. p. 86.

woorden.betekenis: quidquid, feminei est sexus, femina, feminae, mulieres, gy,
woorden.definitie: subst. fem., coll., raro sing., Pl. አእኑስ፡, quidquid feminei est sexus, femina, feminae 1 femina opp. mari vel masculo, a de hominibus: ተባዕት፡ ወአንስት፡ Gen. 1,27; 1 Reg. 27,9; Lev. 27,3 seq.; Marc. 10,6; Gal. 3,28; ብእሲት፡ ኀራስ፡ ለእመ፡ ኮነት፡ እመ፡ (mater) ተባዕት፡ aut እመ፡ አንስት፡ Clem. f. 246. b de animalibus: Gen. 6,20; Lev. 3,1; አፍራስ፡ አንስት፡ 3 Reg. 10,26; Am. 6,12; ዶርሆ፡ ተባዕት፡ ዘየሐውር፡ ውስተ፡ አንስት፡ Prov. 24,66; አእዱግ፡ አእኑስ፡ Job 1,3; Job 1,14; Job 42,12; አፍራስ፡ አእኑስ፡ 2 Par. 9,25. 2 mulieres, feminae cujusvis aetatis et conditionis (pro Plurali vocis ብእሲት፡ frequentatur): ዘይትወለድ፡ እምነ፡ አንስት፡ Sir. 10,18; ስታይ፡ ወአንስት፡ ያስሕቶ፡ ለጠቢብ፡ Sir. 19,2; ዕድ፡ ወአንስት፡ Deut. 31,12; Jes. 19,16; Matth. 11,11; Matth. 14,21; Matth. 15,38; Act. 5,14; Act. 8,3; 1 Cor. 7,27; ቤተ፡ አንስት፡ gy naeceum vid. sub ቤት፡; c. fem. Pl., ut: ጠባባት፡ አንስት፡ ሐነጻ፡ አብያተ፡ Prov. 14,1; Ruth 1,4; Jer. 6,12; Jer. 7,18; Jer. 14,16; Jer. 48,16; ይበልዓኑ፡ አንስት፡ ፍሬ፡ ከርሦን፡ Thren. 2,20; Job 38,36; Sir. 28,15; Sir. 47,19; Dan. apocr. 13,20; 1 Tim. 2,9; 1 Petr. 3,1; Matth. 27,55; Luc. 23,27; Luc. 23,55; st. constr. subjunctum vel in Genit.: muliebris, ut: ሰርጐ፡ አንስት፡ Judith 12,15; Pl. (a poëta usurpatur): ሰላም፡ እብል፡ ለአእላፍ፡ ሠላስ፤ ፩፻ወ፴ ምስለ፡ ፪ አእኑስ፤ Sx. Nah. 11 Enc. (Sx. Nah. 10Enc. sec. Lud.). [Errat Lud., qui in suo lexico አንስ፡ homo, Pl. አእኑስ፡ statuit; አንስ፡ enim non occurrit, አእኑስ፡ autem nonnisi feminas significat]. ʾanǝst C for ረባሐ፡ አንስት፡ vid. ርባሕ፡ (Leslau)

woorden.betekenis: mulieres, feminae, maritae, uxores, conjuges, concubinae
woorden.definitie: vel አንስትያ፡ subst. coll. (gramm. § 140,IV), 1 mulieres, feminae, usurpari solet pro አንስት፡, ubicumque pronomina suffigenda sunt, ut 1 Reg. 22,19; Judith 4,10; Judith 4,11; Jer. 18,21; Jer. 51,9; Rom. 1,26. 2 in specie: maritae, uxores, conjuges, (etiam concubinae ); vicem Pluralis vocis ብእሲት፡ obit, ut: Kuf. 5; Hen. 7,1; Hen. 15,5; Hen. 15,7; Hen. 19,2; 4 Esr. 10,33; Gen. 6,18; Gen. 30,26; Gen. 32,23; Ex. 32,2; 1 Reg. 25,43; 2 Reg. 2,2; ፯፻ አንስቲያሁ፡ 3 Reg. 11,1; Jer. 8,10; Jer. 36,23; Gen. 42,8; ምስለ፡ አንስትያ፡ ቢጾሙ፡ ይሰክቡ፡ Hez. 22,11; Matth. 19,8; Eph. 5,25; Eph. 5,28.

woorden.betekenis: si, non, nisi, quod si non, praeterquam, nisi quod, excipe t
woorden.definitie: [compositum ex እም፡ si et በል፡ (i.e. בַּל non ) in st. constr. gramm. § 57, ut proprie significet nisi ] et ዘእንበለ፡ [proprie: quod si non vel nisi ] conj. et praep. A Conj. 1 nisi, praeterquam, post sententias negativas. a sequente nomine: ኢታገምር፡ ፍኖት፡ ዘእንበለ፡ አሐተ፡ (v. አሐቲ፡) ኪደተ፡ እግረ፡ ብእሲ፡ 4 Esr. 5,7; 4 Esr. 9,27; አልቦ፡ ዘአትረፉ፡ ሊተ፡ እንበለ፡ ሐናሃ፡ Tob. 1,20; ኀበ፡ መኑ፡ እንከ፡ እኔጽር፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ኀበ፡ የዋህ፡ Jes. 66,2; ምንተ፡ ይፈቅድ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ዘርአ፡ (v. ዘርእ፡) Mal. 2,15; Kuf. 27; Dan. 6,7; Dan. 6,12; Jos. 22,29; Ex. 3,19; Matth. 5,13; Matth. 12,4; Marc. 6,8; Luc. 4,26; ዘእንበለ፡ አመ፡ Marc. 9,9; እንበለ፡ ሶበ፡ Ex. 33,16. b sequente verbo: ዘእንበለ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወሀቦ፡ ኢይክል፡ ፈክሮ፡ Gen. 41,16; ይልህቅኑ፡ ሐመልማል፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ይሰቅይዎ፡ (v. ይሰቀይ፡) Job 8,11; የሐውሩኑ፡ ፪ ኅቡረ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ (v. እንዘ፡ ኢ፡) ይትራአዩ፡ Am. 3,3; seq. Subj.: ዘእንበለ፡ይዝልፍዎ፡ 1 Tim. 5,19; Matth. 5,32. Nota etiam ዘእንበለ፡ እመ፡ ኢቀደመ፡ አሲሮቶ፡ Matth. 12,29; ubi aut ዘእንበለ፡, aut እመ፡ ኢ፡ superfluum videtur. c seq. ዘ፡ nisi quod Num. 23,13; Koh. 3,12; Koh. 3,22. d እንበለ፡ ዳእሙ፡ excipe tamen, non autem (negatione non praemissa) Sir. 22,22; 2 Reg. 2,10; vel sed nonnisi (negatione praemissa) Act. 27,22. 2 nisi nonnumquam idem est quod ( ohne daß ) ita ut non, quin, vel Part. cum negatione, vel quamvis non; seq. Imperf., አሐቲ፡ እምኔሆን፡ ኢትወድቅ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ያአምር፡ አቡክሙ፡ Matth. 10,29; seq. Subj.: ዘእንበለ፡ ይደረር፡ ἄδειπνος Dan. 6,18; Matth. 22,12; p. 335; ዘረወ፡ ምጽዋተ፡ እንበለ፡ ያትርፍ፡ ጥሪተ፡ ብዕሉ፡ Sx. Ter 26Enc.; Sx. Mag. 29; እንበለ፡ ትግበር፡ ጌጋየ፡ (ተቀትለት) Sx. Genb. 30 Enc. 3 seq. Subj. ne forte, μήποτε, እንበለ፡ ትፍተው፡ (paulo infra ከመ፡ ኢትምክን፡) Sir. 42,9. 4 seq. Subj. priusquam, antequam, ut: ንግበር፡ ለነ፡ ስመ፡ እንበለ፡ ንዘረው፡ (proprie: si non volumus dissipari i.e. ut ne posthac dissipemur i.e. priusquam caet.) Gen. 11,4; Gen. 48,5; Ex. 1,19; Jos. 2,8; Jos. 3,1; Ps. 118,67; Job 10,21; Prov. 8,24; Prov. 18,13; Koh. 12,1 seq.; Jes. 44,7; Jes. 66,7; Jer. 1,5; Tob. 14,15; 4 Esr. 4,2; 4 Esr. 4,3; 4 Esr. 4,4; 4 Esr. 4,5; 4 Esr. 4,6; 4 Esr. 4,7; 4 Esr. 4,8; 4 Esr. 4,9; 4 Esr. 4,10; 4 Esr. 4,11; 4 Esr. 4,12; 4 Esr. 4,13; 4 Esr. 8,24; 4 Esr. 9,19; እንበለ፡ ትስማዕ፡ ኢታውሥእ፡ Sir. 11,8; Sir. 14,13; Sir. 18,19 seq.; Hen. 83,2; Matth. 1,18; Matth. 26,34; Rom. 9,11, al. Passim nondum — quum, ut: እንበለ፡ ይስክቡ፡ ሰብእ፡ ዐገቱ፡ Gen. 19,4; Gen. 24,15. 5 sed, post sententias negativas: Mal. 2,6; Hez. 3,5; ἀλλά Zach. 4,6; Ps. 43,5; Matth. 7,21; Matth. 9,12; Matth. 16,23; Matth. 19,6; Matth. 19,11; Matth. 20,28, al.; ἀλλ᾽ ἤ Deut. 4,12; Matth. 20,23; Luc. 12,51; a seq. ዳእሙ፡ quin potius Rom. 9,32; Hez. 15,4; Jer. 9,24; Dan. apocr. 13,5. b seq. ዘ፡ nisi quod i.e. quin potius, Ps. 117,17; Ps. 130,3; Num. 16,30. B Praep.; ante pron. suff. formam (ዘ)እንበሌ፡ assumit, ut: እንበሌየ፡ al.; aliâs forma እንበሌ፡ obsoleta est nec nisi raro occurrit (ut Matth. 15,38). 1 praeter, extra, excepto: Gen. 14,24; Gen. 39,9; Gen. 41,40; Num. 26,65; 1 Reg. 27,1; 1 Reg. 30,17; 2 Reg. 12,3; Jes. 26,13; Koh. 2,24; Judith 8,6; Matth. 14,17; Marc. 5,37; Marc. 8,14; Marc. 11,13; Marc. 12,32; 1 Cor. 2,2; 1 Cor. 8,4; Act. 8,1; 2 Esr. 17,67; Gen. 46,26; Matth. 14,21; Matth. 15,38; በበአርብዓ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ አሐቲ፡ ( minus una ) 2 Cor. 11,24. 2 sine, absque; አንሰ፡ አሐውር፡ እንበለ፡ ወልድ፡ Kuf. 14; ኢይክሉ፡ ዕደው፡ እንበለ፡ አንስት፡ 1 Esr. 4,17; ዘእንበሌሆሙ፡ ኢይትከሀል፡ ነቢረ፡ ሀገር፡ Sir. 38,32; ዘእንበለ፡ ንጉሥ፡ οὐκ ὄντος βαβιλέως Hos, 3,4; Jes, 28,1; ዘእንበለ፡ ወርቅ፡ Jes. 55,1; እንበለ፡ ሤጥ፡ Sir. 51,25; Job 6,6; Job 24,7; Job 31,39; οὐ μετά Jer. 17,11; Dan. 2,34; Matth. 13,34; Luc. 6,49; Joh. 15,5; Phil. 2,14; Hebr. 4,15; ዘእንበለ፡ መባሕት፡ F.N. 4; inscio et invito aliquo Gen. 41,44; Jes. 36,10; Jer. 51,19; Joh. 1,3. a crebro adhibetur exponendis Graecorum adjectivis vel adverbiis negativis et privativis, ut: ἄτεκνος ዘእንበለ፡ ውሉድ፡ Sir. 16,3; ἀνέγκλητος ዘእንበለ፡ ነውር፡ 1 Cor. 1,8; ዘእንበለ፡ ዐስብ፡, ዘእንበለ፡ ሲሳይ፡ ἀμισθί, ἀσιτί Job 24,6; ἀνελεημόνως Job 6,21, al. b seq. Infin. Matth. 15,20. 3 prius quam, ante: ዘእንበለ፡ ጊዜከ፡ Koh. 7,17; ዘእንበለ፡ ቅጥቃጤ፡ πρὸ συντριβῆς Prov. 18,12. — Ubi praepositioni ዘእንበለ፡ plura nomina subjunguntur, posteriori negatio ኢ፡ praemitti solet, ut: ዘእንበለ፡ ክልአት፡ ወኢጽርዐት፡ Lit. 163,4 (alia exempla vid. sub ኢ፡).

II Sing. m., fem. አንቲ፡, Pl. m. አንትሙ፡, fem. አንትን፡ tu, vos: አንተ፡ ትቤ፡ Matth. 26,25; Matth. 3,14; Gen. 4,12; Gen. 17,9; Gen. 23,6; Deut. 5,24; አንቲኒ፡ ዓዲ፡ እምሰአልኪዮ፡ Joh. 4,10; Ruth 1,15; Jes. 52,1; ኩኑ፡ አንትሙ፡ ፍጹማነ፡ Matth. 5,48; Matth. 6,9; Matth. 6,26; ኢትፍርሃ፡ አንትንሰ፡ Matth. 28,5; ante Vocativum: አንተ፡ ወልደ፡ እጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ Hez. 2,3; Gen. 33,9; ወአንቲኒ፡ Matth. 2,6; አንትሙ፡ ዕደው፡ 1 Esr. 3,17; Act. 27,31 rom.; አንትን፡ አንስት፡ Did. 3; 1 Petr. 3,1; in sententiis nominalibus: ዕራቅከ፡ አንተ፡ Gen. 3,11; Gen. 3,9; መኑ፡ አንተ፡ Gen. 27,32; Gen. 24,23; Ps. 24,5; Matth. 5,11; Matth. 7,11; Matth. 27,11; አንተ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዔሳው፡ Gen. 27,21; Matth. 5,14; Matth. 16,16; Luc. 3,22; አንትሙ፡ ኢለባውያን፡ አንትሙ፡ Matth. 15,16; Jud. 12,5.

woorden.betekenis: igitur, itaque, ergo, nimirum, jam, jam vero, und nun, und s
woorden.definitie: particula consecutiva [composita ex I እን፡ et ከ፡, gramm. § 62,c et gramm. § 64; ከ፡ autem e forma pleniore extenuatum videtur, coll. ኬ፡; frustra Schrader de linguae Ae. indole p. 29 እንከ፡ ex እንተ፡ ከ፡ contractum esse conjecit], postpositiva, nec nisi emphaseos causa (ut Matth. 12,26 rom.) vel ubi vocibus encliticis ሰ፡ et ኬ፡ aucta est (sc. እንከሰ፡ Jes. 57,12; 2 Tim. 4,8 vel እንከሰኬ፡ Prov. 1,31; Matth. 19,6) primum orationis locum obtinet. 1 de consecutione causali: igitur, itaque, ergo, (nun, also), οὖν Matth. 7,11; Matth. 10,32; Matth. 21,40; Matth. 22,28; Matth. 22,45; Rom. 11,1; Rom. 11,11; Rom. 11,22 al. ἄρα, ታአምር፡ እንከሰ፡ Job 38,21; Matth. 7,20; Matth. 22,25 ( nimirum; thesi propositae firmandae exemplum infert, sicut Graeci nonnumquam voce ἄρα utuntur); in sententiis interrogativis: Job 17,15; በቀለኑ፡ እንከ፡ ትትቤቀላኒ፡ Joel 4,4; ወአይቴኑ፡ እንከ፡ አምላከ፡ ጽድቅ፡ Mal. 2,17; መኑ፡ እንከ፡ Jes. 36,20; Jes. 46,5; Jes. 57,6; በውስተ፡ ርስተ፡ መኑ፡ እንከ፡ አኀድር፡ Sir. 24,7; Matth. 12,26; Matth. 13,27; Matth. 13,56; Matth. 19,7; Matth. 27,22; Rom. 2,21; Rom. 3,1; Rom. 3,27; Rom. 4,1; et cohortativis: ኅፈሩ፡ እንከ፡ ቃልየ፡ τοιγαροῦν Sir. 41,16; Ep. Jer. 14; Hebr. 4,1; Matth. 6,31; Matth. 9,38. Matth. 10,16; Matth. 24,42; Rom. 5,1. a እንከሰ፡ (so – denn) igitur, jam, jam vero; οὖν, δή, ግበሩ፡ እንከሰ፡ ሕጎ፡ Esth. 1,13; 1 Reg. 22,23; Gen. 16,2; Gen. 17,18; Gen. 18,21; Gen. 29,19; Gen. 29,21; ፈንወኒ፡ እንከሰ፡ Tob. 10,7; Ruth 1,12; 4 Esr. 3,25; Hen. 16,4; ንኅድጋ፡ እንከሰ፡ Jer. 28,9; Jes. 57,10; እንከሰ፡ እወቅስ፡ Jes. 57,12; et እንከሰኬ፡ τοιγαροῦν Prov. 1,31. b in apodosi sententiarum conditionalium, sive እንከ፡, ut አእመርኩ፡ እንከ፡ ከመ፡ Dan. 2,9; Jud. 16,11; sive ወ — እንከ፡ Jud. 16,7. c ወ — እንከ፡ ( und nun, und so ) duas enuntiationes ita conjungit, ut posteriorem e priori consequi significet (sicut וְ consec. et ف); ወያአምር፡ እንከ፡ ኵሉ፡ Sir. 23,27; 1 Reg. 17,46; Ex. 6,7; Ex. 7,5; ኢታውጽእ፡ ነገረ፡ ዘሰማዕከ፡ ወተአመን፡ እንከ፡ ከመ፡ ሕሡም፡ አልቦ፡ ዘይረክበከ፡ Sir. 19,10; ወወድቀ፡ እንከ፡ Matth. 18,26; 4 Reg. 11,20; Hen. 86,6; Hen. 93,3. 2 de consecutione temporali: adhuc, porro, amplius, diutius; passim, ubi temporis praesentis ratio habetur: nunc, jam, vel ubi temporis futuri: in reliquum sive posterum; ἔτι Gen. 31,14; ኀደገት፡ እንከ፡ ብሂሎታ፡ ἐκόπασε τοῦ λαλῆσαι πρὸς αὐτὴν ἔτι Ruth 1,18; አሐተ፡ እንከ፡ ἔτι τὸ ἅπαξ τοῦτο Jud. 16,18; ቦኑ፡ ለግሙራ፡ ኣረምም፡ እንከ፡ Jes. 42,14; እምይእዜ፡ እንከ፡ Ex. 5,7; 1 Reg. 27,1; 4 Reg. 12,7; ወተከልአ፡ ሕዝብ፡ እንከ፡ አብኦ፡ Ex. 36,6; Jer. 3,1; ትሬኢ፡ እንከ፡ ዘየዐቢ፡ ኀጢአተ፡ Hez. 8,6; እንከ፡ ዓዲ፡ Jes. 5,4; ወእምዝ፡ እንከ፡ καὶ τότε Esth. 2,13; τὸ λοιπόν Hebr. 10,13; 2 Tim. 4,8; ወይጸርኅ፡ እንከ፡ Kuf. p. 15; አእመርኩ፡ እንከሰ፡ 1 Reg. 26,21; ይብል፡ እበልዕ፡ ወእንከሰ፡ እፈግዕ፡ καὶ νῦν Sir. 11,19; 4 Esr. 10,48. Crebro componuntur a ኬ፡ — እንከ፡ igitur — jam, ergo — nunc vel in posterum ( also — nun ) potissimum in exhortationibus, ut Ep. Jer. 22; Jes. 50,11; Matth. 3,8; Matth. 6,31; Matth. 10,26; Matth. 22,9; Matth. 22,17; sed etiam aliâs ut Matth. 5,13; Rom. 3,31 ant. b ኢ፡ — እንከ፡ non amplius, non diutius, οὐκέτι, μηκέτι, Job 7,8; Koh. 9,5; Sir. 11,23; Sir. 11,24; Sir. 13,4; Sir. 27,16; Ps. 9,42; Ps. 82,4; Jes. 2,4; Jes. 14,8; Jes. 54,9; Jes. 62,8; Jer. 3,16; Jer. 22,10; Hez. 16,42; Hez. 36,15; Mal. 2,2; Ex. 5,10; Jud. 13,21; 4 Reg. 12,8; እንከሰኬ፡ ኢኮኑ፡ Matth. 19,6; Matth. 21,19; Joh. 14,30; አልቦ፡ — እንከ፡ Marc. 11,14; Apoc. 22,5; አኮ፡ — እንከ፡ ዘ፡ Jes. 60,19; ስእኑ፡ እንከ፡ ኀቢኦቶ፡ Ex. 2,3. — Voc. Ae.: እንከ፡ ዘ፡ እንግድያ፡

woorden.betekenis: onyx marinus, unguis odoratus, zibetum, odoratum, excrementu
woorden.definitie: , አንክሶ፡, አንክስ፡, አንኮስ፡ n. peregr. 1 sc. ὄνυξ i.e. onyx marinus, unguis odoratus (שְׁחֵלֶת) Sir. 24,15 (እንክስ፡ v. አንከሶ፡ v. አንክሶ፡). 2 Hoc vocabulum Aethiopes in usu receperunt, at aliud odoramenti genus idque vernaculum intelligendum esse interpretantur, sc. zibetum (زَبَادٌ) i.e. odoratum felis zibetae excrementum, Org. 3 felis Aethiopica, viverra zibeta, Lud.; Harris II p. 143et Harris II Anh. p. 50; Harris II Anh. p. 51. — Voc. Ae.: አንክሶ፡ (v. አንኮስ፡) ዘ፡ ጽርኝ፡ v. ጥርኝ።

woorden.betekenis: cum, dum, indem, dicens, dicendo, quamdiu, dum adhuc, währen
woorden.definitie: conj. [compositum ex እን፡ et ዘ፡; (non ex እንተ፡ ዘ፡ Schrader de linguae Ae. indole p. 29), vid. gramm. § 170,5; in caeteris linguis maxime respondet ܟܰܕ] a cum, dum, vel pron. rel. vel Part. vel Gerund. (Latinorum), indem: ወድቀ፡ እንዘ፡ ይቀውም፡ ἔπεσεν ἑστηκώς 1 Reg. 28,20; Gen. 3,8; Zach. 6,1; እንዘ፡ አልቦ፡ ዘያድኅን፡ μὴ ὄντος λυτρουμένου Ps. 7,2; Matth. 1,18; Matth. 1,20; አውሥአኒ፡ እንዘ፡ ይብል፡ dicens vel dicendo Hen. 25,3; እንዘ፡ ይብሉ፡ λέγοντες Hen. 2,2; Hen. 2,13; Hen. 17,20; { Matth. 2,2;Matth. 2,13;Matth. 2,17;Matth. 2,20}; እንዘ፡ ይትአመኑ፡ ἐξομολογούμενος Hen. 3,6; Hen. 6,7; Jac. 1,6; 1 Petr. 3,6, al. sexcenties; ብፁዕ፡ ብእሲ፡ እንዘ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዘሞተ፡ ὃς ἐν σοφίᾳ τελευτήσει Sir. 14,20; አብድ፡ እንዘ፡ ይፈርህ፡ ἔμφοβος Sir. 19,24; ሶበ፡ አንተ፡ እንዘ፡ ሰብእ፡ አንተ፡ ትትቀየም፡ ሰብአ፡ ዘከማከ፡ Sir. 28,3; Gen. 4,8; Ps. 21,9; Ps. 48,12; ita creberrime ad subjungendas eas enunciationes, in quibus status vel conditio alicujus describitur: እንዘ፡ አንተ፡ ውእቱ፡ ሳኦል፡ καὶ σύ al. 1 Reg. 28,12; እንዘ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ኀደገከ፡ καὶ Κύριος 1 Reg. 28,16; Gen. 18,1; Ex. 12,11; Jud. 8,11; እንዘ፡ ሀሎኩ፡ እነብር፡ Hez. 8,1; Zach. 2,3; post verba sentiendi, ut: ርእዮ፡ ለይስሐቅ፡ እንዘ፡ ይትዌነይ፡ εἶδε τὸν Ἰσαὰκ παίζοντα Gen. 26,8; ረከቦሙ፡ እንዘ፡ ይነውሙ፡ εὑρίσκει αὐτούς καθεύδοντας Matth. 26,40; Hen. 41,2; Marc. 14,58 al., et post verba incipiendi et desinendi Hen. 85,10; Hen. 86,5; Hen. 87,1; አኅለቀ፡ እንዘ፡ ይነግር፡ Jer. 50,1. (Singularis est constructio ለእመ፡ አድኀፀት፡ እንዘ፡ ምሱለ፡ Ex. 21,23). b cum, dum i.e. quamdiu, dum adhuc, während: Gen. 29,26; Gen. 34,25; 1 Reg. 2,27; 1 Reg. 3,2; 1 Reg. 14,19; 2 Reg. 3,35; 3 Reg. 1,22; Zach. 14,12; እንዘ፡ ትነብብ፡ ἔτι λαλοῦντός σου Jes. 58,9; Jes. 65,24; Jer. 40,1; እንዘ፡ ዓዲነ፡ ሕያዋን፡ Thren. 4,17; እንዘ፡ ሕያው፡ ውእቱ፡ Sir. 30,5; Sir. 30,28; እንዘ፡ ዓዲ፡ እትናገር፡ Asc. Jes. 9,33; 4 Esr. 9,12; 4 Esr. 9,42; 4 Esr. 10,44; Rom. 5,6. c quum i.e. in oratione adversativa licet, quamvis ( da doch, während ): Jos. 17,14; እንዘ፡ ሰብእ፡ አንተ፡ ወኢኮንከ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Hez. 28,2; Ruth 1,21; እለ፡ እንዘ፡ ቦሙ፡ አዕይንተ፡ ኢይሬእዩ፡ Jes. 43,8; Jer. 2,11; 2 Esr. 15,18; Kuf. p. 121; 4 Esr, 8,67; Matth. 7,11; Joh. 21,11; 1 Petr. 1,8; 1 Petr. 2,10; Hebr. 11,11; Hebr. 11,12. d cum negatione: cum non, quamvis non, nec tamen ( ohne daß ); ቦ፡ ዘይስሕት፡ እንዘ፡ ኢይፈቅድ፡ እምልቡ፡ Sir. 19,16; እንዘ፡ ኢታስተምሕር፡ ሰብአ፡ ዘከማከ፡ እፎ፡ ትስእሎ፡ ይስረይ፡ ለከ፡ ኀጢአተከ፡ Sir. 28,4; Prov. 6,7; 4 Esr. 1,34; Deus ኀደረ፡ ላዕሌኪ፡ (sc. Maria) እንዘ፡ ኢየዐርቅ፡ ህላዌሁ፡ Org.

woorden.betekenis: igitur, inde vix dubium est, quin, puto, opinor, nimirum, ut
woorden.definitie: particula opinandi et dubitandi [semel tantum sc. Mich. 6,6 in uno codice, እንገ፡ scriptam inveni; composita est ex I እን፡ et ጋ፡, quod (sicut ጓ፡ q.v.) e כֹּה vel כָּה emollitum videtur; significatione maxime convenit cum ܟܰܝ]. Proprie consecutionem significat, sicut እንከ፡, sed levior est vi et emphasi, et ab illa differt sicut ἄρα ab οὖν; usurpatur, ubi quis aliquid e verbis proxime praecedentibus vel e rebus factisve satis notis natura sua sequi opinatur vel cum dubitatione quadam conjicit. 1 Raro extra interrogationem: a igitur (inde vix dubium est quin, nun doch wohl) እንጋ፡ በጽሐት፡ ላዕሌክሙ፡ መንግሥተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Matth. 12,28. b puto, opinor: እስመ፡ እሙንቱሂ፡ እንጋ፡ ሶበ፡ ስሕቱ፡ τάχα Sap. 13,6. c nimirum, utique, እንጋ፡ ኵሉ፡ የኀሥሡከ፡ nimirum omnes te quaerunt (hoc ipse conjicere poteras) Marc. 1,36. 2 Creberrime in sententiis interrogativis, dubitativis, optativis, sed nonnisi raro primum orationis locum tenet (ut Matth. 17,26); plerumque uni verbo duobusve postponitur: a igitur (nonne sequitur? so denn also? nun wohl?), ἄρα (ἆρα), ut: ይፈልጠኒኑ፡ እንጋ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ እምሕዝቡ፡ Jes. 56,3; በከኑ፡ እንጋ፡ ትዬውሆሙ፡ ለአሕዛብ፡ Jer. 4,10; እደግምኑ፡ እንጋ፡ ርእየ፡ ቤተ፡ መቅደስ፡ Jon. 2,5; Ps. 57,11; Ps. 72,13; Ps. 138,10; Matth. 17,26; Matth. 18,1; Matth. 19,25; Matth. 19,27; Matth. 24,45; Act. 21,38; etiam Jes. 24,6 (በእንተ፡ ዝንቱኑ፡ እንጋ፡ ትውኅጦሙ፡ ምድር፡) et Jes. 28,8 ubi Aethiops ἄρα pro ἀρά legit; nec non aliis in locis, ubi Graecus ἄρα non habet, ut: በምንትኑ፡ እንጋ፡ (v. እንገ፡) እረክቦ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡, እረክቦኑ፡ እንጋ፡ በመሥዋዕት፡ Mich. 6,6; Ps. 30,28; Matth. 8,27. b putas? an sperare licet? (wohl? voraussichtlich?): ወእፎ፡ እንጋ፡ በአድያም፡ ገብሩ፡ πῶς οἴει ἐχρήσαντο; Esth. 9,12; አሐዩኑ፡ እንጋ፡ እስከ፡ እማንቱ፡ መዋዕል፡ (ubi Vulg. habet: putas vivo usque…) 4 Esr. 2,60; Job 7,13; Job 27,10; ቦሁ፡ እንጋ፡ ዘይትኀባእ፡ እምኔየ፡ Jer. 39,27; Luc. 18,8; Marc. 8,16; Rom. 3,8; Rom. 11,12. c forte? an? numquid? quaeso, — nam? (wohl?, etwa?): እንዳዒ፡ እንጋ፡ ለእመ፡ ቦኑ፡ (nescio an forte quis sit?) Rom. 5,7; አነሁ፡ እንጋ፡ እግዚኦ፡ μήτι Matth. 26,22; እስመሁ፡ እንጋ፡ an forte quia? Marc. 8,16; እፎኑ፡ እንጋ፡ Sir. 49,11; Deut. 28,67; መኑ፡ እንጋ፡ Sir. 34,9; Sir. 34,10; ማእዜ፡ ይጸብሕ፡ ሊተ፡ እንጋ፡ Job 7,4. — Voc. Ae.: እንጋ፡ ዘ፡ እስኪ፡ ወይ፡ ይሆንሂ፡ እንኪያሂ፡ ቦኑሂ፡ ይ፡; aliud: እንጋ፡ ዘ፡ በ ፪ ወይ፡ ይኈን።

woorden.betekenis: oh, ah, proh
woorden.definitie: oh, ah, proh vid. sub ኦ፡ col. 716.

woorden.betekenis: sic, ita, non, nequaquam, neutiquam, nec, neque, qui, quod,
woorden.definitie: partic. neg. [sine dubio composita e ኮ፡ (i.e. כֹּה, כָּה sic, ita ) et አ፡ ( non ), quod e pleniori quadam forma (ut እን፡ vel አል፡) extenuatum videtur; aliam conjecturam habet Ewald Lehrbuch der hebr. Sprache|1855 p. 692], vi gravior est quam ኢ፡, et ad neganda singula sententiarum verba adhihetur: non, nequaquam, neutiquam, praemisso ወ፡ nec, neque: a in sententiis imperfectis: አንተ፡ ወአኮ፡ አነ፡ Job 34,33; ሶበ፡ አኮ፡ በእንቲአሁ፡ Job 42,8, ወአኮ፡ ረኃበ፡ እክል፡ Am. 8,11; Zach. 4,6; አኮ፡ በቤዛ፡ Jes. 45,13; Jes. 48,1; Jer. 2,27; Jer. 10,24; Jer. 21,10; Ps. 21,6; Ps. 113,9; Hen. 1,2; Hen. 15,2; Hen. 30,1; Matth. 26,5. b in sententiis nominalibus: ሶበ፡ አኮ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ማስሌነ፡ Ps. 123,1; Ps. 123,2; አኮ፡ ሠናይ፡ ይደቅ፡ ጻድቅ፡ በቅድመ፡ ረሲዓን፡ Prov. 25,26; Prov. 25,27; Job 32,10; Sir. 10,23; Hebr. 13,14; Matth. 14,16; Matth. 19,10. c in sententiis integris, ubi vis negationis in unum potissimum nomen cadit, frequentatur አኮ፡ — ዘ፡, non (est) qui vel quod, ut: አኮ፡ እምድር፡ ዘይወፅእ፡ ጻማ፡ non (est quod ) e humo nascitur molestia Job 5,6; አኮ፡ ሰብእ፡ ዘይዘልፈኒ፡ non (est) homo ( qui ) me convincit Job 21,4; ርእዩ፡ ከመ፡ አኮ፡ ለባሕቲትየ፡ ዘጻመውኩ፡ Sir. 24,34; አኮ፡ ብዙኃን፡ እለ፡ ያአምርዋ፡ Sir. 6,22: Sir. 37,28; Jes. 28,27; Jes. 38,18; ኦኮ፡ ሊተ፡ ዘሦዕከ፡ አባግዒከ፡ Jes. 43,23; Jes. 58,5; Num. 11,19; Gen. 3,4; Gen. 3,11; Gen. 4,7; Gen. 45,8; Matth. 4,4; Matth. 7,21; Matth. 9,24; Matth. 16,11; Matth. 19,11; Marc. 13,7; Rom. 1,21; Rom. 9,29. d አኮ፡ — ባሕቲቱ፡ vel አኮ፡ ክመ፡ seq. ኒ፡, vel አላ፡ vel ዓዲ፡ vel ወዓዲ፡ vel ዓዲ፡ — ኒ፡ vel ሂ፡ non tantum — sed etiam, ut: አኮ፡ ሰብእ፡ ባሕቲቱ፡ ዘይትቀነይ፡ ሎቱ፡ አራዊተ፡ ገዳምኒ፡ ወእንስሳ፡ caet. Judith 11,7; 4 Esr. 1,21; Matth. 4,4; Joh. 5,18 (alia exempla habes sub ባሕቲት፡ col. 497). e ወእመ፡ አኮ፡ vel ወእመ፡ አኮሰ፡ vel ወእማእኮ(ሰ)፡ α si vero non, sin minus Jer. 47,5; Tob. 8,12; Dan. apocr. 1,24. β aut, et repetitum aut — aut vid. sub እመ፡ col. 724. f አኮኑ፡ vel አኮሁ፡ nonne, annon? አኮኑ፡ ቦቱ፡ ተወከልኩ፡ Job 6,13; አኮኑ፡ ኀይሉ፡ ያፈርሀክሙ፡ Job 13,11; Job 1,10; Job 22,2; Job 22,5; Job 31,15; Sir. 14,15; አኮኑ፡ በዕፅ፡ ጥዕመ፡ ማይ፡ Sir. 38,5; Sir. 47,4; አኮኑ፡ ዛቲ፡ ባቢሎን፡ Dan. 4,27; Ruth 3,2; Jes. 42,24; Mal. 1,2; Ps. 107,12; አኮኑ፡ ሰማርያ፡ Mich. 1,5; አኮሁ፡ አነ፡ ዘኣወልድ፡ Jes. 66,9; Matth. 5,46; Matth. 6,25; Matth. 18,33; አኮኑ፡ ነዳያን፡ እሙንቱ፡ ἴσως πτωχοί εἰσι Jer. 5,4. α In interrogatione iterata, cujus pars prior responsionem negativam, posterior affirmativam postulat, posteriori praemittitur አኮኑ፡ nonne e contrario? ( nicht vielmehr? ) i.e. immo, immo vero, quin etiam: Jes. 28,25; Jes. 36,12; Hez. 34,2; Jer. 3,1; Jer. 33,19; ኪያየኑ፡ ያምዕዑኒ፡ አኮኑ፡ ለርእሶሙ፡ Jer. 7,19; Luc. 17,8; አኮኑ፡ ፍኖትክሙ፡ ኢኮነ፡ ርቱዐ፡ (nonne i.e.) immo vero via vestra non est recta Hez. 18,29; 4 Esr. 3,60; quare passim pro ἀλλά ponitur, ut: አኮኑ፡ ኀጢአትክሙ፡ ይቀውም፡ Jes. 59,2; Rom. 7,19 rom. β i.q. καὶ γάρ etenim ({— ja doch}) Rom. 11,1; 1 Cor. 5,7. g rarius (praedicato praemissum) ad negandam enunciationem integram adhibetur: ዘአኮ፡ ንፈርሆሙ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ እስራኤል፡ Judith 5,23; Ps. 105,23; Hen. 104,5; ግዕዞሙ፡ ለረሲዓን፡ አኮ፡ አዳም፡ Prov. 12,26; Prov. 18,5. h emphaseos causa iteratur: አኮ፡ አኮ፡ በቅብአ፡ ደነስ፡ III Sal. Mar. 2. i አኮ፡ ኢ፡ affirmat: 2 Thess. 3,9; አኮ፡ ኢያእሚረከ፡ οὐκ ἀγνοών Sap.12,10.

woorden.betekenis: edere
woorden.definitie: inus. i.q. אָכַל ܐܶܟܰܠ أَكَلَ edere.

woorden.betekenis: cibus, esca, panis, pabulum, frumentum, fruges, far, provent
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., Pl. እክላት፡ (quamquam raro), [אֹכֶל, أُكْلٌ] 1) cibus, esca, a hominum, βρώματα Gen. 41,35; Gen. 42,7; Gen. 42,10; Lev. 11,34; Deut. 2,6; Deut. 2,28; Sir. 36,23; Judith 11,12; 1 Cor. 10,3; σῖτα ጕርዔ፡ እክለ፡ ይጥዕም፡ Job 12,11; Act. 7,12; ἄρτος, ἄρτοι ( panis ) Gen. 43,32; Gen. 49,20; Ex. 2,20; Num. 21,5; Ruth 1,6; ብልዒ፡ እክለኪ፡ Ruth 2,14; 2 Reg. 9,7; 4 Reg. 25,3; Koh. 9,11; Job 6,6; Job 28,5; እክል፡ ወማይ፡ Sir. 29,21; Jes. 3,1; Jes. 33,16; Jes. 55,10; Jes. 58,7; Jer. 5,17; Jer. 52,6; Hez. 12,18; Hez. 12,19; Ps. 40,10; Ps. 103,16; Tob. 1,10; Tob. 2,5; Marc. 3,20; Marc. 7,2; Marc. 7,5; Luc. 14,1; Luc. 15,17. b bestiarum, pabulum: χορτάσματα Gen. 24,25; Gen. 24,32; Gen. 42,27; Gen. 43,24; Jud. 19,19. 2 in specie: frumentum, fruges, far, proventus agrorum, σῖτος, አይቴ፡ እክል፡ ወወይን፡ Thren. 2,12; Gen. 42,25; Deut. 14,23; Deut. 15,14; Jos. 5,11; Jos. 5,12; Jes. 25,10; Jer. 38,12; Act. 7,12; γεννήματα Gen. 41,34; Lev. 26,4; Deut. 14,22; Deut. 26,10; Deut. 28,4; Deut. 32,13; እክለ፡ ማእረር፡ Jes. 29,1; Luc. 12,18; ἐκφόρια Deut. 28,33; ኀጣአ፡ እክል፡ inopia frugum vel caritas annonae Lev. 26,26; ኀጢአ፡ እክል፡ Org. 1; እእሪ፡ እክለ፡ συνάξω ἐν τοῖς στάχυσι Ruth 2,2; እክላት፡ frumenta Abush. 47; passim pro frugum specie, ut κριθή ( hordeum ) Apoc. 6,6 rom.; እክለ፡ ስገም፡ Ruth 3,15; ዐውደ፡ እክል፡ ἅλων τῶν κριθῶν Ruth 3,2; πυροί ( triticum ): ሀሎ፡ ውስተ፡ ዐውደ፡ እክል፡ 1 Par. 21,20. a ዐውደ፡ እክል፡ ἅλων area Num. 18,27; Hos. 9,1 al. (vid. ዐውድ፡). b ቀዳሜ፡ እክል፡ πρωτογεννήματα, primitiae Ex. 23,16; Ex. 34,26; Lev. 2,14.

woorden.betekenis: satis habere, satis, postquam satis didicit, satis viderunt
woorden.definitie: II,1 satis habere: አእከልኩ፡ Sir. 11,19; ከመ፡ አእኪልየ፡ (v. ጸጊብየ፡) ኢይኩን፡ ሐሳዌ፡ Prov. 24,32; 2 Cor. 11,9; c. ለ፡ pers. (für einen): ያአክል፡ ለኵሉ፡ ዘጸውዐ፡ Rom. 10,12; c. ለ፡ rei: አእከለ፡ ለቤዝወቱ፡ Lev. 25,26; seq. Infin. (Acc.) inservit significando adverbio satis, ut: ሶበ፡ አእከለ፡ ተምህሮ፡ መዝሙረ፡ ዳዊት፡ postquam satis didicit, Gad. Kar., vel በ፡ c. Infin., ut: ወአእከሉ፡ በርእይ፡: satis viderunt Sap. 13,7.

woorden.betekenis: medium, media pars, medius locus, nam tollunt eum de medio,
woorden.definitie: subst. (id quod continetur re i.e.) medium, media pars, medius locus: እስመ፡ ይነሥእዎ፡ እማእከል፡ nam tollunt eum de medio Jes. 57,2; 2 Thess. 2,7 Platt; እሙንቱ፡ ከመ፡ ሠርዌ፡ ይውዕዩ፡ በማእከል፡ Ep. Jer. 54; Lev. 11,3; Lev. 11,7; Gen. 15,10; ያንቅዕከ፡ እማእከልከ፡ Dan. apocr. 1,55; Hez. 28,18; መተሮ፡ ማእከሎ፡ ኀበ፡ ለምለሙ፡ Hez. 17,4; ወስተ፡ ማእከለ፡ ሰማይ፡ ἐν μεσουρανήματι Apoc. 19,17; በማእከል፡ Rom. 5,20. a In Genitivo: medius, ut: አዕማድ፡ እለ፡ ማእከል፡ columnae (medii i.e.) mediae Jud. 16,29; መክፈልተ፡ ሀገር፡ ዘማእከል፡ Hez. 48,22; አረፍተ፡ ማእከል፡ Eph. 2,14; idem est ዘበማእከል፡ qui in medio i.e. medius Hen. 74,5. b In Acc. ማእከለ፡ in mediovel medium, Asc. Jes. 7,14; Asc. Jes. 7,19; Asc. Jes. 7,24; Asc. Jes. 7,29; Marc. 3,3; Apoc. 3,16 rom. c In specie α de tempore: ማእከለ፡ መዋዕል፡ μεσότης χρόνων Sap. 7,18; β centrum: ዝንቱ፡ መካን፡ ማእከለ፡ ምድር፡ ውእቱ፡ Clem. f. 28; ያንብርዎ፡ ለሥጋየ፡ ውስተ፡ ማእከለ፡ ምድር፡ Clem. f. 10; Clem. f. 27. γ truncus corporis (abscisis capite manibus pedibus) 1 Reg. 5,4. δ ማእከለ፡ አፍላግ፡ regio media inter fluvios i.e. Mesopotamia Gen. 24,10; Gen. 27,43; Gen. 28,2; Gen. 28,5. — Acc. ማእከለ፡ frequentatur pro praepositione. māʾǝkal 1 ) a ማእከለ፡ ባሕር፡ māʾǝkala bāḥr, ማእከል፡ ባሕር፡ māʾǝkal bāḥr (title) 52:18 (ed.); 68:10 (ed.) Chron. Am. 11 Chron. Am. 53; 29 l. 22 (ed.), 34 l. 13–14 (tr.); ወበሃገራይሂ፡ ሥዩመ፡ አጽቢ፡ ወሕዱግ፡ ወገዛኢ፡ ወማእከለ፡ ባሕር፡ ወአደግሲኒሁ፡ አሕረምነ። ‘Dans le Hāgarāy, au chef d’Aṣbi, au vicaire, au commendant, au māʾekala bāḥr et à son adagsini, nous avons défendu d’[y] entrer’ 40 l. 14–15 (ed.), 47 l. 26–28 (tr.), vid. ባሕር፡ b ማእከለ፡ ተዋዛት፡ māʾǝkala tawāzāt (title) 52:17–18 (ed.); 68:10 (ed.) Chron. Am. 11 Chron. Am. 53, vid. ተዋዛት፡ c ማእከለ፡ አንጎት፡ māʾǝkala ʾangot (title) 52:17 (ed.) Chron. Am. 11, vid. አንጎት፡ G ማእከል፡ maʾǝkal «moyen, le milieu» ― ማኸል፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 42r. 101 L ማእከል māʾǝkal center, middle, midst, intermediary ዘማእከል zamāʾǝkal, ዘበማእከል zabamāʾǝkal mid-, middle (adj.) 15a

woorden.betekenis: ê, in media, re, in mediam, rem, inter, per mediam, e media,
woorden.definitie: praep. cui pron. I et II pers. crebrius per ê, pron. III p. crebro sine ê affigi solet, (gramm. § 167,3): 1 ማእከለ፡ a in media (re), vel post verba motus in mediam (rem): ሐነጽኩ፡ ማኅፈደ፡ ማእከሎ፡ Jes. 5,2; ሶቤሃ፡ ይሠርቅ፡ ማእከለ፡ ጽልመት፡ ብርሃንከ፡ Jes. 58,10; Gen. 2,9; Gen. 3,3; Gen. 37,7; ማእከላ፡ Hez. 14,14; Hez. 14,16; Hez. 21,20; ማእከሌኪ፡ Zach. 2,11; Zach. 8,3; Matth. 14,24; Luc. 17,11; Luc. 22,55; ማእከለ፡ ሌሊተ፡ Matth. 25,6; post verba motus Ex. 14,23; 1 Reg. 9,14; ወወረውዋ፡ ማእከለ፡ መስፈርት፡ Zach. 5,8. b ubi refertur ad plures: inter, Gen. 23,10; Ps. 54,17; እንዘ፡ የሐውሩ፡ ማእከለ፡ ፪ አድባር፡ Zach. 6,1; ይሰርር፡ ማእከለ፡ ሰማይ፡ ወምድር፡ Apoc. 8,13; መሐላ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ተርፈ፡ ማእከሎሙ፡ Ex. 22,10; እዘርዎሙ፡ ማእከለ፡ አሕዛብ፡ Kuf. 1; Hen. 39,5; Matth. 10,16; Matth. 13,25; Matth. 18,2; Matth. 18,20; Joh. 1,26; Joh. 20,19; 1 Thess. 2,7; ኢይትናገር፡ ነገረ፡ ኀፍረት፡ ኢማእከለ፡ ሥዩማን፡ ወኢማእከለ፡ ሕዝባውያን፡ F.N. 9. α iteratur, ut: ፈለጠ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ማእከለ፡ ብርሃን፡ ወማእከለ፡ ጽልመት፡ Gen. 1,4; Gen. 16,14; Gen. 26,28. Gen. 30,36; Ex. 14,20; Lev. 10,10; Lev. 26,46; Num. 30,17; Deut. 17,8; Jes. 59,2; Hen. 41,8. β ማእከለ፡ — ለ፡ inter, ut: ማእከለ፡ ሐሪስ፡ ወለዐጺድ፡ Kuf. p. 107. 2 Componitur cum aliis praepositionibus: a በማእከለ፡ α in media (re): በማእከሌኪ፡ ἐν σεαυτῇ Job 38,11; Jes. 12,6; Zach. 2,5; Hez. 2,10; Sir. 24,1; በማእከለ፡ ሌሊት፡ Lev. 23,5. β inter: 1 Reg. 10,10; 1 Reg. 16,13; Ps. 21,15; Ps. 21,23; Ps. 103,13; Matth. 14,6. b ውስተ፡ ማእከለ፡ in media (re) vel in mediam (rem), Apoc. 22,2; Num. 19,6. c እንተ፡ ማእከለ፡ per mediam (rem): Gen. 15,17; Ps. 135,14; Jer. 41,18; Sap. 10,18; Judith 11,19. d እምነ፡ ማእከለ፡ vel እማእከለ፡ e media (re), e medio: ፃኡ፡ እምነ፡ ማእከላ፡ Jes. 52,11; Gen. 48,12; Ex. 7,5; Ex. 25,22; Num. 8,14; Num. 27,4; Deut. 4,15; 4 Reg. 11,2; እማእከሌሆሙ፡ Jsp. p. 322. māʾǝkala G ማእከለ፡ māʾǝkala «au milieu, parmi» ― በማኸል፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 42r. 101 L ማእከለ māʾǝkala in the midst of, in the middle of, among (the suffix pronouns are added to the base māʿǝkale) ውስተ፡ ማእከለ wǝsta māʾǝkala in the middle of, in the midst of እምነ፡ ማእከለ ʾǝmǝnna māʾǝkala from among, from በማእከለ ba-māʾǝkala 15a–b

woorden.betekenis: medium locum tenere, in medio esse, ad medium pervenire
woorden.definitie: II quadril. (denom.), medium locum tenere, in medio esse, 2 Thess. 2,7 rom.{; ad medium pervenire, ሌሊት፡ እንተ፡ ታመአክል፡ νυκτὸς μεσαζούσης Sap. 18,14 in Abb. LV.}

woorden.betekenis: laudibus celebrari, laudari, praedicari, in honore esse, hab
woorden.definitie: III,1 laudibus celebrari, laudari, praedicari, in honore esse vel haberi, benedici, gratiam capere vel consequi, Ps. 112,3; ይትአኰት፡ በአናቅጽ፡ ምታ፡ Prov. 29,48; 4 Esr. 8,59; c. በኀበ፡ pers.: ትትአኰቲ፡ በኀቤሁ፡ Judith 12,13; Rom. 2,29; 4 Esr. 8,58; ይትአኰት፡ በኀበ፡ መኳንንት፡ θαυμασθήσεται Sir. 38,3; vel c. እምኀበ፡ Matth. 6,2; እምኀበ፡ መላእክት፡ ተአኵተ፤ እምኀበ፡ ሰብእ፡ ተወደሰ፡ Lit. Chrys.; vel c. እምነ፡, ut: Christus እመላእክት፡ ተአኵተ፡ Kid. f. 13; ብእሲ፡ ኄር፡ ብዙኀ፡ ይትአኰት፡ εὐλογηθήσεται Prov. 28,20; 4 Esr. 7,29.

woorden.betekenis: gratiarum actione celebratus, laudatus
woorden.definitie: (vel እኵት፡) part. gratiarum actione celebratus, laudatus: እኩት፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ χάρις τῷ θεῷ Rom. 6,17; Rom. 7,25; 2 Cor. 2,14; 1 Cor. 10,13 (πιστός?); αἰνετὸς Or. Az. 2 (Dan. apocr. 3); ክቡር፡ ወእኩት፡ Kuf. 35; እኩትኒ፡ አንተ፤ ብሩክኒ፡ አንተ፤ ልዑልኒ፡ አንተ፡ በመልዕልተ፡ ሰማያት፡ Mavâs. 24.

woorden.betekenis: laudatio, laus, gloria, gratiarum actio, gratiae, gratia, ne
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., 1 laudatio, laus, gloria: ያመጽኡ፡ አኰቴተ፡ ለቤተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ αἴνεσιν Jer. 17,26; ከመ፡ ተሀቡ፡ አኰቴተ፡ ለስምየ፡ δόξαν Mal. 2,2; ወሀበት፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ አኰቴተ፡ ወስባሔ፡ Kuf. 25; Ps. 47,1; Ps. 65,1; Ps. 144,3; Phil. 1,11; δόξα Sap. 8,10; ኢይደመሰስ፡ አኰቴትኪ፡ እምልበ፡ እጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ እንዘ፡ ይዜከሩ፡ Judith 13,19; κλέος 1 Petr. 2,20. 2 gratiarum actio, gratiae, gratia: Hen. 41,7; Hen. 69,24; Apoc. 7,12; ወአኰቴተ፡ አልብከ፡ neque gratiam reportabis (und du hast keinen Dank) Sir. 29,25; በእንተ፡ አኰቴቱ፡ ለመርዶክዮስ፡ ὑπὲρ τῆς εὐνοίας Μ., Esth. 2,23; Esth. 6,4; አኮ፡ ሊተ፡ አኰቴት፡ οὐ τῇ ἐμαυτοῦ χάριτι Tob. 12,18; እንበለ፡ አኰቴት፡ ይከውን፡ ቅኔነ፡ Judith 8,23; መበለታት፡ ይንሥኣ፡ ዘተጸገዋ፡ በአኰቴት፡ Did. 20; እለ፡ አልቦሙ፡ አኰቴተ፡ ἀχάριστοι ingrati 2 Tim. 3,2; ሕጸተ፡ አኰቴት፡ animus ingratus (at in LXX: ἀπιστία) Sap. 14,25; አብእ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ በከመ፡ አኰቴቱ፡ κατὰ τὴν δόσιν αὐτοῦ Sir. 32,12; ይብል፡ ካህን፡ ጸሎተ፡ አኰቴት፡ dicet orationem gratiarum actionis Lit. 159,3. a መሥዋዕተ፡ አኰቴት፡ vel (መሥዋዕት፡) በእንተ፡ አኰቴት፡ sacrificium eucharisticum (זֶבַח הַתּוֹדָה) Lev. 7,12. b eucharistia: እምድኅረ፡ ተመጠዉ፡ አኰቴተ፡ Kid. f. 10. c አኰቴተ፡ ቍርባን፡ oratio eucharistica vel liturgica, (anaphora), ut: አኰቴተ፡ ቍርባን፡ ዘቅዱስ፡ ዮሐንስ፡ አፈ፡ ወርቅ፡ Lit. Chrys., al. ʾakʷatet L አኰቴተ፡ ቍርባን ʾakʷateta qʷǝrbāna Eucharistic prayers, anaphora, vid. ቍርባን፡ 440b

woorden.betekenis: in quo nihil boni, nequam, verbis dolore affecit, increpavit
woorden.definitie: , rarius አከየ፡ (Lev. 13,8 C; 4 Esr. 8,35) I,1 [praeter كَيْكَاءٌ et مُكَوْكىً in quo nihil boni, nequam conferendum videtur كَأَى verbis dolore affecit ܟܐܳܐ increpavit, reprehendit ] Subj. ይእከይ፡ (Kuf. p. 86), malum vel pravum esse, et comparative pejorem vel deteriorem esse vel fieri, c.c. እምነ፡ vel Acc. ejus quo quis pejor est, etiam c. Acc. ejus, cui quid malum est; a physice ( noxium vel perniciosum esse vel fieri, übel, schlimm sein ): አክየት፡ ይእቲ፡ ሕብር፡ in pejus mutata est Lev. 13,8; አልቦ፡ ርእስ፡ ዘየአኪ፡ እምርእሰ፡ አርዌ፡ ምድር፡ Sir. 25,15; እምኵሉ፡ ቍስል፡ የአኪ፡ ቍስለ፡ ልብ፡ Sir. 25,13; ምንት፡ የአኪ፡ እምነ፡ ዐይነ፡ እጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ Sir. 34,13; 4 Esr. 8,35; Matth. 27,64; Joh. 5,14; ሐይው፡ የአክዮ፡ እምነ፡ መዊት፡ Sir. 22,11; vilem, viliorem esse: ዘየአክዮ፡ ἀνάξιος αὐτοῦ Sir. 25,8. b ethice: ፈድፋደ፡ አክዩ፡ pejores facti sunt Herm. p. 93; 1 Tim. 5,8; 2 Petr. 2,20; Kuf. p. 86; እምኵሉ፡ እኪት፡ ተአኪ፡ እኪት፡ ብእሲት፡ Sir. 25,13; Matth. 12,45; እለ፡ የአክይዎ፡ Luc. 11,26.

woorden.betekenis: male agere, improbe agere, malum reddere, depravare, afflige
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 male agere, improbe agere: ያአኪ፡ κακοποιεῖ Prov. 11,15; Jer. 10,5; Kuf. p. 20. 2 malum reddere, depravare, ut animum alius: Satanas አእከየ፡ ልበ፡ አይሁድ፡ ላዕለ፡ ክርስቶስ፡ Org. 2; vel animum sive mores suos, ut: አእከዩ፡ ልበሙ፡ Sir. 16,10; Kuf. p. 54 annot. 2; Dan. 11,27; አእከዩ፡ ግዕዘ፡ (ob rhythmum finalem pro ግዕዞሙ፡) Sx. Haml. 24 Enc.; vel actionem sive facinora sua: ኢያአኪ፡ ገቢረ፡ Kuf. p. 93; አብዝኀ፡ አእክዮ፡ ምግባሪሁ፡ Kuf. p. 127. In specie: a affligere: ያአክያ፡ ለልብከ፡ κακώσει καρδίαν σου Koh. 7,22. b aegrum reddere: ያአኪ፡ ዐይኖ፡ ላዕሌከ፡ እኁከ፡ Deut. 15,9; 3 male facere alicui, male habere aliquem, c. ላዕለ፡ pers., Herm. p. 97; c. ዲበ፡ pers.: ለአእክዮ፡ ዲቤከ፡ Kuf. p. 52; c. Acc. pers.: ለአእክዮቱ፡ Koh. 8,9.

woorden.betekenis: malus, vilis, futilis, foedus, noxius, perniciosus, malignus
woorden.definitie: (etiam እኵይ፡) part. et adj., fem. እኪት፡ (rarius እኪይት፡ ut in Herm.; 4 Esr. 14,16 L), A Adj. malus 1 vilis, futilis, foedus aspectu: Matth. 7,17; Matth. 7,18; Jer. 24,3; Lev. 27,10; Num. 13,19; Deut. 15,21; Gen. 41,3. 2 noxius, perniciosus, malignus, de morbis, vulneribus, ulceribus: Lev. 13,3; Lev.13,4; Lev. 13,7; እኩይ፡ ደዌ፡ Koh. 5,15; Deut. 28,35; Deut. 28,59; Apoc. 16,2; bestiis rapacibus: Gen. 37,33; Sir. 12,13; Sir. 21,2 (ὄφις); Tit. 1,12; aliis rebus 4 Reg. 4,41; Rom. 14,20; ተዘከር፡ ከመ፡ እኩይ፡ ዐይነ፡ ሰብእ፡ Sir. 34,13; Jac. 3,8. 3 adversus, molestus, gravis, sinister, miser: ነገር፡ እኩይ፡ Ex. 33,4; ጽልመት፡ እኪት፡ σκότος δεινόν 2 Reg. 1,9; ቅኔ፡ et ኵነኔ፡ እኩይ፡ σκληρός Jes. 19,4; እኩይ፡ ሞት፡ ሞታ፡ Sir. 28,21; እኪት፡ ኀሳር፡ Sir. 5,14; ድቀቶሙ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ኃጥኣን፡ እኩይ፡ Prov. 1,18; ዕለት፡ እኪት፡ Koh. 7,14; Job 21,30; Ps. 48,5; መዋዕል፡ እኩይ፡ Koh. 12,1; Eph. 5,16; Eph. 6,13; 2 Tim. 4,18; Gen. 47,9; እኪተ፡ መዋዕል፡ σκληρὰ ἡμέρᾳ 1 Reg. 1,15. 4 ethice: pravus, nequam, malignus, improbus; de personis: ብእሲ፡ እኩይ፡ πονηρός Ps. 139,1; 2 Reg. 4,11; እኩያን፡ Ps. 5,5; Jes. 53,9; Matth. 5,45; Matth. 12,34; ትውልድ፡ እኪት፡ Matth. 12,45; κακός Koh. 9,2; Prov. 3,31; Matth. 21,41; Matth. 24,28; φαῦλος Prov. 29,9; ብእሲት፡ እኪት፡ Prov. 5,3; Joh. 3,20; σκληρός Jes. 48,4; λοιμός 2 Par. 13,7; 1 Reg. 25,17; ἀσεβής Sir. 12,6; Sir. 16,1; እኩያነ፡ ልማድ፡ ወግዕዝ፡ Rom. 1,29; መንፈስ፡ እኩይ፡ 1 Reg. 16,15; ጋኔን፡ እኩይ፡ Jud. 9,23; Luc. 7,21; de Satana Matth. 13,19; Matth. 13,38; Eph. 6,16; de rebus, ut: ልብ፡ እኩይ፡ (σκληρά) Sir. 3,26; Sir. 3,27; Gen. 6,5; በእኪት፡ ዐይን፡ (ἀναιδεῖ) 1 Reg. 2,29; እኩይ፡ ፍኖትከ፡ Job 4,6; Prov. 2,12, ዘእኩይ፡ ምግባሩ፡ Joh. 3,20; ነገር፡ እኩይ፡ Gen. 39,9; ኅሊና፡ እኩይ፡ Marc. 7,21; ፍትወት፡ እኪት፡ Col. 3,5; ትምክሕት፡ እኪት፡ Jac. 4,16; ስም፡ እኩይ፡ nomen malum i.e. mali Sir. 6,1; Deut. 22,19; Luc. 6,22. — እኩይ፡ በኀበ፡ Gen. 28,8 vel በቅድመ፡ 1 Reg. 29,7; Gen. 35,22; Gen. 38,7 vel ላዕለ፡ Koh. 2,17 idem est quod displicens alicui. B Subst. sive እኩይ፡ sive እኪት፡ malum, Pl. እኩያት፡; 1 ethice a pravum, malitia, እኩይ፡ Jer. 13,23; Jes. 5,20; Jes. 7,16; Ps. 33,14; Ps. 33,15; Rom. 12,9; እኪት፡ 1 Petr. 3,11; Luc. 6,45; Gen. 8,21; Jud. 20,13; Sir. 17,7; ኵሉ፡ እኪት፡ ትንእስ፡ እምእኪት፡ ብእሲት፡ πᾶσα κακία Sir. 25,19; ብዙኀ፡ እኪተ፡ ትሜህር፡ አጽርዖት፡ Sir. 30,37; Sir. 39,4; Ps. 35,4; Ps. 96,11; 4 Esr. 2,36. b malum quod quis facit, loquitur, sentit: ገብሩ፡ እኩየ፡ በቅድሜየ፡ Jes. 66,4; Ps. 33,17; Joh. 5,29; Matth. 27,23; Rom. 3,8; ይነቡ፡ ኵሎ፡ እኩየ፡ Matth. 5,11; Joh. 18,23; ትኄልዩ፡ እኩየ፡ Matth. 9,4; ይፈድዩኒ፡ እኩየ፡ Ps. 7,4; ገቢረ፡ እኪት፡ Lev. 5,4; ገበርተ፡ እኪት፡ Phil. 3,2; Gen. 44,4; ኢትግበራ፡ ለእኪት፡ ወኢይርከብከ፡ እኩይ፡ Sir. 7,1; እስመ፡ ፪ እኩያተ፡ ገብሩ፡ ሕዝብየ፡ Jer. 2,13. 2 malum quod cui accidit: res adversae, calamitas, miseria, infortunium, እኩይ፡ ዐቢይ፡ Koh. 2,21; Sir. 7,1; Jer. 18,8; Jer. 39,42; እኪት፡ Gen. 19,19; Gen. 44,34; Koh. 6,1; Ps. 39,16; Sir. 11,14; Sir. 11,25; Sir. 22,26; Jes. 45,7; Jer. 4,6; Jer. 6,1; Jer. 11,11; Jer. 51,35; ለእኪትክሙ፡ ( ut male sit vobis ) Jer. 7,6; Jac. 4,3; በመዋዕለ፡ እኩያት፡ Ps. 36,20. C Adv. እኩየ፡ male Lit. Jac.; በእኩይ፡ male, ut: እስከ፡ ይጠወይ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ በእኩይ፡ Sx. Mag. 17; dolose Kuf. 29; ተናገሩ፡ ምስሌሆሙ፡ በእኩይ፡ Kuf. 30. — Voc. Ae.: እኩይ፡ ሕሡም፡ ብ፡ ቢስ።

woorden.betekenis: mala indoles, futilitas, malitia, pravitas, improbitas, faci
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. እከያት፡ 1 mala indoles rei, futilitas: ዘኢይትበላዕ፡ በእከዩ፡ Jer. 24,2. 2 malitia, pravitas, improbitas, facinus malum: እከየ፡ ልብ፡ 1 Reg. 17,28; እከየ፡ ልቡ፡ ὁ πονηρία αὐτοῦ Sir. 12,10; Sir. 14,9; እከይየ፡ Job 13,26; አኮኑ፡ ብዙኅ፡ እከይከ፡ Job 22,5; እከይሆሙ፡ Jud. 20,34; እከዪሃ፡ (v. እከይሃ፡) የዐልዎ፡ ለራእይ፡ Sir. 25,17; እከይሁ፡ v. እከዪሁ፡ Sir. 14,7; ይኄይስ፡ እከዪሁ፡ (v. እከይሁ፡) ለብእሲ፡ እምነ፡ ኂሩታ፡ ለብእሲት፡ Sir. 42,14; እከዮሙ፡ Ps. 7,10; Jer. 1,16; Nah. 3,19; Gen. 6,5; Ex. 32,12; Matth. 22,18; Marc. 7,22; Rom. 1,29; 1 Petr. 2,1; Gal. 1,4; κακίαι Jer. 3,2; Jer. 18,8; ሄኖክ፡ ይጽሕፍ፡ ኵሎ፡ እከዮሙ፡ Kuf. 4; ምግባረ፡ እከይ፡ Hebr. 10,22; እከየ፡ ምግባረ፡ እደዊሁ፡ Jes. 3,11; Jer. 23,3; Jac. 3,16; እከያት፡ Hen. 96,4; Jsp. p. 339; ኵሉ፡ እከያቲሁ፡ ዘቅድም፡ Sx. Sen. 24Enc. 3 malum, afflictio, vexatio, miseria Sap. 3,2; Matth. 6,34; እከየ፡ ልብ፡ tristitia Koh. 7,4. ʾǝkay C for አሠናዬ፡ እከይ፡ vid. አሠናዪ፡

woorden.betekenis: aut, vel, -ve, sive, sin minus, an?, necne? annon?, Voc, Ae
woorden.definitie: conjunctio disjunctiva [אוֹ ܐܰܘ أَوْ], 1 aut, vel, -ve: Gen. 44,8; Gen. 44,19; Lev. 5,2; Lev. 5,3; Lev. 5,4; Lev. 5,6; Lev. 5,21; Lev. 5,22; Lev. 7,21; Lev. 10,9; Lev. 12,6; Lev. 13,24; Lev. 13,29; Lev. 17,3; Lev. 21,2; Lev. 21,3; Num. 19,16; Num. 35,23; Deut. 13,2; Deut. 13,3; Deut. 13,4; Deut. 17,2; Deut. 17,3; 1 Reg. 12,3; 1 Reg. 20,26; 1 Reg. 21,8; Job 3,15; Job 7,2; Jer. 23,33; Tob. 6,8; Judith 5,3; 4 Esr. 5,4; Jac. 2,15; Jac. 4,13; Jac. 4,15; Apoc. 14,9; ፳፭ አው፡ ፴ Joh. 6,19; Matth. 18,16; Act. 25,6; Jos. 7,3; etiam praemissa copula ወ፡, sc. ወአው፡ Reg. Pach. a Iteratur bis: አው፡ — አው፡ vel — vel, aut — aut: 2 Reg. 2,21; 3 Reg. 3,42; አው፡ ሠምዕ፡ አው፡ ዘይት፡ F.M. 17,6; ንግሩኒ ፤ አው፡ ትሠውዑ፡ አው፡ ኣነሥእ፡ ላዕሌክሙ፡ ጥብጣቤ፡ ሐብል፡ Macc. f. 2; ter vel — vel — vel, sive — sive — sive 1 Cor. 14,6; quater 1 Petr. 4,15; quinquies Deut. 14,26. b ወአው፡ sin minus (oder aber) 2 Reg. 17,6. 2 in interrogatione: an? a አው፡ Job 7,12; Num. 11,22; Jos. 5,13; Jer. 2,14; Jer. 2,31; Jer. 5,22; Tob. 5,12. b ወአው፡ 2 Reg. 19,35. c አው፡ — ኑ፡ Job 15,7; Ex. 2,14; Ex. 10,7; 1 Reg. 24,15; 4 Esr. 1,32; 4 Esr. 2,52; 4 Esr. 10,16; Luc. 12,41. d አው፡ ቦኑ፡ 1 Reg. 12,3; 2 Reg. 19,42. e አው፡ አልቦ፡ necne? annon? Marc. 12,14. — Voc. Ae.: አው፡ ወሚመ፡ ብ፡ ወይ።

woorden.betekenis: sane, profecto, utique, etiam, ita, sic, maxime
woorden.definitie: particula affirmantis [إِي] sane, profecto, utique, etiam, ναί, ኢትቤ፡ እወ፡ አእመርክዎን፡ Jer. 48,7; Matth. 11,9; Matth. 11,26; Luc. 10,21; Luc. 12,5; Phil. 4,3; Philem. 20; Apoc. 1,7; Apoc. 14,13; Apoc. 22,20; Deg. a in responsione: ita, sic, etiam, maxime, Gen. 43,29; Kuf. 42; ቦኑ፡ ቃል፡ እምእግዚአብሔር፡ ወይቤሎ፡ እወ፡ ቦ፡ Jer. 44,17; Dan. 3,24; እወ፡ ዳኅን፡ Dan. apocr. 13,17; Tob. 7,5; 4 Esr. 2,3; 1 Reg. 9,12; 1 Reg. 26,17 var. b in rogatione et optatione: utique (o ja doch), እወ፡ እግዚኦ፡ ναί Judith 9,12; እወ፡ እግዚኦ፡ ፍትሖሙ፡ Genz. f. 69; እስእለከ፡ እወ፡ ማሕሌታይ፡ ሚካኤል፡ Rel. Bar.

woorden.betekenis: vapor, nebula, Voc, Ae
woorden.definitie: subst. [آلٌ], exhalatio terrae humida, vapor, nebula, ጠል፡ ወአውል፡ δρόσος καὶ νιφετός Dan. apocr. 3,45; Deus pluviam retinebit, ወትተርፍ፡ ምድር፡ ባሕቲታ፡ እንበለ፡ ጠል፡ ወአውል፡ Clem. f. 155; transl.: odor vestimentorum vestrorum ኮነኒ፡ አውለ፡ („exhalatio suavis“ sec. Lud.) ወምሕረተ፡ Lud. e Vit. Pachom. — Voc. Ae: አውል፡ ህቦ፡ ዘ፡ ጤዛ።

woorden.betekenis: vultur, Voc, Ae
woorden.definitie: (etiam ዐውስት፡) subst., nomen avis rapacis, ut videtur vultur, γύψ Job 39,27; Hen. 89,10; Hen. 90,2; Hen. 90,11; Hen. 90,13; Hen. 90,16; Hen. 96,2. — Voc. Ae.: ንስር፡ ወአውስት፡ ወፊንክስ፡ ዘ፡ አሞራ፡; aliud: አውስት፡ ብ፡ የጥምብ፡ አሞራ።

woorden.betekenis: vel አዌት፡ nomen, quo festum Joannis Baptistae (secu
woorden.definitie: vel አዌት፡ nomen, quo festum Joannis Baptistae (secundum Synaxarium mensis Senê die XXX celebrandum), sc. nativitatis, ab altero ejus festo, sc. decollationis, distinguere solent Abyssini [etymon et significatus non liquent]: በዓል፡ ዘስሙይ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዮሐንስ፡ አዊት፡ Abtel. Ap. 3; ዘአዌት፡ ዮሐንስ፡ Cod. Mus. Brit. XXX,58 (vid. Catal. Cod. Ae. Mus. Brit. p. 36 ann. a et Cod. Mus. Brit. XXIX,55.

woorden.betekenis: onania

woorden.definitie: vocula, semel tantum in Bibliis obvia, scilicet አዒ፡ (v. ነዓ፡) ወሑር፡ βάδιζε ἄπελθε Ex. 4,19. — Voc. Ae.: ዐዒ፡ ብ፡ ስማዕ፡; eandem expositionem Ludolfus a suo Gregorio accepit. [Interjectio sicut أَيْ, أَيَا, هَيَا, هَيَّا, عَايْ, al., esse et heus, age! significare videtur].

woorden.betekenis: vulturnus, auster, Africus, Vulturnus, regio australis, meri
woorden.definitie: (pro አዝየብ፡, أَزْيَبُ vulturnus, auster ) subst., plerumque m., 1 auster ventus, ( Africus, Vulturnus ), νότος, ነፋሰ፡ አዜብ፡ Ex. 10,13; አዜብ፡ Job 38,24; Ps. 77,30; Hen. 36,1; Hen. 77,1; Luc. 12,55; Act. 27,13; λίψ Jes. 43,6. 2 auster i.e. regio australis, meridies: νότος Job 37,17; Judith 2,23; Dan. 11,5; Ps. 125,5; 1 Reg. 13,5; 1 Reg. 27,10; 1 Reg. 30,1; Hen. 36,1; Matth. 12,42; λίψ Gen. 13,14; Ex. 37,7; Num. 2,10; Num. 34,3; Jos. 15,1.

woorden.betekenis: auris, audiente populo
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. እዘን፡ et አእዛን፡ [אֹזֶן ܐܰܕܢܳܐ et ܐܶܕܢܳܐ, أُذْنٌ] auris, Ex. 29,20; Lev. 8,23; Lev. 14,14; Lev. 21,18; Koh. 1,8; Koh. 12,9; እዝን፡ ነገረ፡ ይፈልጥ፡ Job 12,11; Job 34,3; Job 4,12; Job 13,1; Job 29,11; Job 31,30; Prov. 2,2; Prov. 5,1; Ps. 93,9; Sir. 16,5; አንበበ፡ ውስተ፡ እዝነ፡ ሕዝብ፡ (i.e. audiente populo ) Ex. 24,7; Matth. 10,27; ይብሉኪ፡ ውስተ፡ እዝንኪ፡ Jes. 49,20; Ex. 11,2; Luc. 12,3; ቀዲሙ፡ ሰማዕኩከ፡ በእዝንየ፡ Job 42,5; ሰምዓ፡ እዘኒሆሙ፡ Sir. 17,13; አጽመሙ፡ እዘኒሆሙ፡ Jes. 6,10; አእዛን፡ Hez. 24,26; Hez. 40,4; Ex. 32,3; Matth. 11,15; Matth. 13,9; Matth. 13,15; Matth. 13,16; Jac. 5,4. — Voc. Ae.: አእዛን፡ ብ፡ ዦሮች።
