woorden.betekenis: juberi, ab, jussu, legari, praefici, jussu mitti, contra, tr
woorden.definitie: III,2 1 pass. a juberi, ወተአዘዘ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዐንበሪ፡ Jon. 2,11; c. Acc. rei et በኀበ፡ vel እምኀበ፡ ab aliquo: ኀሊ፡ ዘተአዘዝከ፡ Sir. 3,22; Luc. 3,13; ተአዘዝክሙ፡ በኀቤነ፡ 1 Thess. 4,1; ወድአ፡ ተአዘዘ፡ እምኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Dan. apocr. 1,55; Ex. 37,19. α jussu alicujus legari ad aliquid vel praefici rei: ዕደው፡ እለ፡ ተአዘዙ፡ ውስተ፡ ሕንጻ፡ Herm. p. 80. β jussu mitti, c. በ፡ contra aliquem: ሶበ፡ ተአዘዘ፡ ቦሙ፡ ስነነ፡ አክይስት፡ Sap. 16,10. γ jussu tradi, c. ውስተ፡ in: ተአዘዘ፡ ወድአ፡ ውስተ፡ እደ፡ ኀጺን፡ ἐντέταλται ἤδη εἰς χεῖρας σιδήρου Job 15,22. b praecipi, statui: በአዝማነ፡ ዚአሆሙ፡ እለ፡ ተአዘዙ፡ ሎሙ፡ Hen. 80,6; ሥርዐት፡ ዘተአዘዘ፡ እምኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Lit. Jac.; seq. Subj., Kuf. p. 15. c testamentum fieri, testamento legari: ኢይትኤዘዝ፡ ሎሙ፡ F.N. 42,13. 2 reflex. ( imperio ) parere, obedire, obtemperare, c. ለ፡ alicui: Koh. 10,19; ዘረከበ፡ ዘይትኤዘዝ፡ ሎቱ፡ Sir. 25,9; አልቦ፡ ዘኢይትኤዘዝ፡ ለቃልከ፡ Judith 16,14; Deut. 17,12; Tit. 3,1; Marc. 4,41; Luc. 8,25; Luc. 17,6; አንትን፡ አንስት፡ ተአዘዛ፡ ለአምታቲክን፡ Did. 3; abs. Phil. 2,8; ተአዝዞት፡ obedientia Rom. 5,19; Philem. 21; እለ፡ ኢይትኤዘዙ፡ inobedientes Tit. 1,10; seq. Subj. verbi: ተአዘዘ፡ ይሖር፡ Hebr. 11,8.

woorden.betekenis: potestas, imperium, regedit eos sub imperium Romanorum, offi
woorden.definitie: subst., fem. et m., Pl. ትእዛዛት፡, 1 potestas, imperium: እስመ፡ በትእዛዝ፡ ውእቱ፡ ቃሉ፡ ἐν ἐξουσίᾳ Luc. 4,32; Luc. 4,36; አግነዮሙ፡ ለትእዛዘ፡ ሮም፡ Jsp. p. 313; ሜጦሙ፡ ለትእዛዘ፡ ሮም፡ regedit eos sub imperium Romanorum Jsp. p. 312; ይወጽኡ፡ እምትእዛዝነ፡ Jsp. p. 324; i.q. officium (episcopi) . 331 Nr. 93. 2 praeceptum, mandatum, edictum, statutum, jussus: ዛቲ፡ ትእዛዝ፡ ἐντολή Mal. 2,1; ዘንተ፡ ትእዛዘ፡ Mal. 2,4; Deut. 30,11; Rom. 7,8; Rom. 7,9; 1 Tim. 6,14; 1 Joh. 2,7; 1 Joh. 3,23; Marc. 12,28; ተውህበ፡ ትእዛዝ፡ Kuf. 3; ወፅአ፡ ትእዛዝ፡ እምኀበ፡ ንጉሥ፡ δόγμα Dan. 2,13; ከመዝ፡ ውእቱ፡ ትእዛዘ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ ዘወሀቦ፡ διάταγμα 2 Esr. 7,11; በትእዛዘ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ διὰ προςτάγματος Κυρίου Num. 33,38; Jos. 21,40; διὰ λόγου 1 Petr. 1,23; κατ᾽ ἐπιταγὴν 1 Tim. 1,1; θέλημα 1 Tim. 4,3; παραγγελία 1 Tim. 1,5; 1 Tim. 1,18; crebro ትእዛዝ፡ collective: ወሀቦ፡ ትእዛዘ፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ἐντολάς Sir. 45,5; Sir. 32,2; Sir. 35,24; ኵላ፡ ትእዛዝየ፡ Num. 15,40; ኵሎን፡ እላንቱ፡ ትእዛዝ፡ Asc. Jes. 1,7; Eph. 2,16; 1 Joh. 2,3; 1 Joh. 2,4; ἐντάλματα Jes. 55,11; προστάγματα Jes. 26,9; μαρτυρία Ex. 25,16; Ex. 25,21; መጻሕፍተ፡ ትእዛዝ፡ Ex. 40,18; Pl. ትእዛዛት፡ Koh. 12,13; ዐቂበ፡ ትእዛዛቲሁ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ Sir. 23,27; Kuf. 22; ትእዛዛተ፡ ሰብእ፡ Jes. 29,13; Ps. 118,16; Matth. 5,19; Matth. 19,17; ትእዛዛተ፡ ሐዋርያት፡ constitutiones Apostolorum, Syn. a lex vel regula naturae rerum insita, Hen. 2,1; Hen. 72,2; Hen. 73,1. b quod promissione statutum est, (promissio), ἐπαγγελία Am. 9,6; Hebr. 4,1; Did. ed. Platt p. 50 l. 4; Did. ed. Platt p. 106l. 2 cum annot. c testamentum, α sensu biblico: ታቦት፡ እንተ፡ ትእዛዝ፡ Ex. 39,15; 1 Par. 28,18; 2 Par. 5,2; Ex. 27,21. β sensu forensi: በእንተ፡ ትእዛዝ፡ ወጽሕፈቱ፡ F.N. 41,1; በእንተ፡ ጽሒፈ፡ ትእዛዝ፡ ዘንዋይ፡ F.N. 41,1. 3 passim i.q. ተአዝዞ፡ i.e. obedientia: 1 Reg. 15,22 S; በትእዛዙ፡ ለጽድቅ፡ ἐν τῇ ὑπακοῇ τῆς ἀληθείας 1 Petr. 1,22; ἀκοαί 2 Reg. 23,23. tǝʾzāz C for ጸሓፌ፡ ትእዛዝ፡ vid. ጸሓፊ፡ (TraCES)

woorden.betekenis: jussus, mandato instructus, praefectus, is cui quid testamen
woorden.definitie: n. ag. 1 jussus, mandato instructus, praefectus: ተአዛዚ፡ ዲበ፡ ሕዝብ፡ Hen. 20,5; Michael archangelus ተአዛዚ፡ ለትፍሥሕት፡ ወለኑዛዜ፡ Sx. Jac. 12Enc. 2 ተአዛዚ፡ ሎቱ፡ (ex Arabismo) i.q. ዘእዙዝ፡ ሎቱ፡ is cui quid testamento legatum est F.N. 41,5. 3 obediens, obsequens, obtemperans, se subjiciens imperio alicujus: Deg.;Lud. Comm. hist. p. 320 Nr. 62; ረድኡ፡ ወተአዛዚሁ፡ Sx. Teq. 19Enc.; ወትከውን፡ ተአዛዚተ፡ ለከ፡ Fal. f. 14; ተአዛዝያን፡ F.N. 7,1; ኢተአዛዚ፡ inobediens, Lud.; filius Herodis ዘኮነ፡ ተአዛዜ፡ ለሮም፡ ወመፍቀሬ፡ ሎሙ፡ Jsp. p. 341; አይድዖ፡ ከመ፡ ውእቱ፡ ተአዛዚ፡ ሎቱ፡ ( se se ei subjecturum esse ) Jsp. p. 313.

woorden.betekenis: qui ? qualis?, uter?, qualis Dei?, qui eorum sunt meliores?,
woorden.definitie: pron. interrog. adj. [أَيٌّ, אֵי], m. et fem., Pl. አያት፡ 1 interrog., in quaestionibus directis et indirectis, a adj.: qui ? qualis? ( uter? ): አይ፡ ብሔር፡ ማኅደሩ፡ ለብርሃን፡ (ποῖος) Job 38,19; አእምሩ፡ አይ፡ ፍኖት፡ ሠናይ፡ Jer. 6,16; adv. interrog. ኑ፡ annexo auctum: አይኑ፡ ዘርእ፡ ክቡር፡ Sir. 10,19; አይኑ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ኅድጋቲሃ፡ Jes. 50,1; አይኑ፡ ሕዝብ፡ 4 Esr. 1,33; Matth. 22,36; suo substantivo postpositum: ወያአምሩ፡ መናብርት፡ አይ፡ ዚአሆሙ፡ Asc. Jes. 9,12; praedicati loco positum: አይኑ፡ ውእቱ፡ መዋቲ፡ ዘይነጽሕ፡ Job 4,17; አይ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ወርኅ፡ Rel. Bar.; አይ፡ ይእቲ፡ ፍኖተ፡ ሲኦል፡ 4 Esr. 2,14; 4 Esr. 2,15; Acc.: አየ፡ ፍኖተ፡ (v. ፍኖት፡) ኀለፈ፡ 2 Par. 18,23; አየኑ፡ ቤተ፡ ተሐንጹ፡ ሊተ፡ Jes. 66,1; አየ፡ ኀጢአተ፡ ገብሩ፡ Rel. Bar.; Act. 7,49; Genit.: ዘአይ፡ አምላክ፡ qualis Dei? Cyr. de r. fid. f. 41; praemissis praepositionibus: በአይ፡ እደው፡ Cyr. ad Theod. f. 9; በአይ፡ እምእላንቱ፡ እሣሀሎሙ፡ Jer. 5,7; በአይ፡ ፍኖት፡ Sir. 30,40; Matth. 21,24; Matth. 24,42; Rom. 3,27; በአይ፡ ልሳን፡ ንክል፡ ነጊረ፡ ግብረቶን፡ Gad. Lal.; Clem. f. 46; Clem. f. 56; በአይ፡ ፍና፡ τίνα τρόπον Cyr. c. Pall. f. 97; ለአይ፡ ወለማእዜ፡ መዋዕል፡ 1 Petr. 1,11; እመአይ፡ ሕዝብ፡ Tob. 5,9; Tob. 5,11; በእንተ፡ አይ፡ ኀጢአት፡ Hen. 21,4; በታሕተ፡ አይ፡ ዕፅ፡ Dan. apocr. 1,54; Pl. Matth. 19,18; አያተ፡ ሥሕጸታተ፡ Cyr. c. Pall. f. 66; c. pron. suff.: አያቶሙ፡ ይኄይሱ፡ qui eorum sunt meliores? Phlx. 1. b quid? qualis res? አይ፡ ይከውን፡ እምዝ፡ ወእምዝ፡ Koh. 11,6; በአይ፡ quare? ዘይብሎ፡ ለአቡሁ፡ ምንተ፡ ወለድከኒ፡ ወለእሙኒ፡ በአይ፡ ማሕምምኪ፡ Jes. 45,10. c adv. አይ፡ quomodo? Ex. 4,10 (si non: qualis ego?). 2 indef. quicumque, qualiscumque, quilibet, quisquis, ( utercumque ); a አይ፡, ut: ውስተ፡ አይ፡ መካን፡ ሀሎ፡ in quocumque loco fuerit Genz. f. 155; ኵሉ፡ አሕላም፡ በአይ፡ ገጽ፡ ኮነ፡ omnia somnia qualiacumque sint Kedr f. 73. b አይሂ፡ — vel አይኒ፡, ut: አይሂ፡ ዘተምዐ፡ quicumque irascitur Phlx. 54; በእንተ፡ አይኒ፡ ኀጢአት፡ ዘኮነተ፡ Phlx. 37; Phlx. 171(vid. sub ታሕጻጽ፡). c ullus in sententiis negativis: ወኢበአይ፡ መንግሥት፡ 3 Reg. 10,20. — Vid. አይቴ፡, እፎ፡, እስፍንቱ።

woorden.betekenis: ʾaylul, ʾiloli, ʾiluli, ʾelol
woorden.definitie: n. mensis Hebraeorum sexti (Septembris), sc. אֱלוּל Ἐλούλ, 2 Esr. 16,15 (v. ኢሎሊ፡ et ኢሉሊ፡); Voc. Ae. ʾaylul, ʾiloli, ʾiluli, ኤሎል ʾelol (‘Il mese di Elul nel calendario del patriarcato di Antiochia, che equivale al mese di Settembre giuliano.’ 123 (203) n. 34)

woorden.betekenis: aer, aura, aether
woorden.definitie: n. peregr., m. et fem., Pl. አየራት፡, ἀήρ aer, aura, aether, 1 Thess. 4,7 Platt; Asc. Jes. 8,1; Asc. Jes. 8,12; Asc. Jes. 9,1; Asc. Jes. 10,30; Clem. f. 101; equites ignei apparuerunt በአየረ፡ ሰማይ፡ Jsp. p. 287; Jsp. p. 377; አዕዋፍ፡ ዘውስተ፡ አየር፡ ይሰርሩ፡ Fal. f. 66; መልዕልተ፡ አየር፡ Prov. 9,12 gl.; ተመልአት፡ አየር፡ እምነ፡ መላእክት፡ Sx. Genb. 19; Sx. Hed. 27; አየር፡ ጽሕወ፡ ኮነ፡ ἀὴρ ἦν καθαρός Chrys. ho. 23; Pl. አየራት፡ Lit. 172,1; Lit. Chrys.; Lit. Orthd.; ሐውዘ፡ አየራት፡ Genz. f. 138; Simon Magus ዐርገ፡ ውስተ፡ አየራት፡ M.M. f. 1; Org. 2; Joannes Evangelista ይኔጽር፡ አየራተ፡ Deg.

woorden.betekenis: aether
woorden.definitie: n. peregr. sc. ἀήρ إِيَارٌ, aether: Org. 1(„ubi intelligitur unum e septem coelis, altissimo (i.e. አርያም፡) proximum“ Lud.); Rel. Bar.; Deus ዘዲበ፡ ኢዮር፡ መንበሩ፡ Mavâs. 17; ከመ፡ ከዋክብት፡ ዘኢዮር፡ ይበዝኅ፡ ኀጢአትየ፡ Form. Conf.

woorden.betekenis: mollis, lenis fuit, desperavit, phthisis, tabescere, liquesc
woorden.definitie: I,1 [i.q. أَيِسَ mollis, lenis fuit; desperavit; يَئِسَ (יַָשׁ) desperavit; يَأَسٌ phthisis morbus] tabescere, liquescere: አአይስ፡ በሕማም፡ ውቱረ፡ ἐν ὀδύναις πέφυρμαι Job 30,14; ነፍስየ፡ ተዐነብዝ፡ ወተአይስ፡ ልብየ፡ σπαράσσεται ἡ καρδία Jer. 4,19. — Voc. Ae. ad Jobum: የአይሰከ፡ ዘ፡ ይብእሰከ፡; Rad. Abb.: ዐየሰ፡ ዘ፡ ዘበረ።

woorden.betekenis: jubilum, annus jubili, jubilaeus
woorden.definitie: (ኢዩቤል፡) n. peregr. sc. Ἰωβήλ יוֹבֵל 1) jubilum: አቅርንት፡ ዘኢዮቤል፡ Jos. 6,4 (κερατίναι τοῦ Ἰωβήλ); መጣቅዕት፡ ዘኢዮቤል፡ σάλπιγγες τοῦ Ἰωβήλ, Jos. 6,6. 2 annus jubili vel jubilaeus, Kuf. creberrime, ubi occurrunt formae ኢዮቤል፡, ኢዮቤላት፡, ኢዮቤላታት፡, ኢዮቤልዮን፡, ኢዮቤልዩ፡, ኢዮቤልዮታት፡, ኢዮቤልዩታት፡, ኢዮቤልው፡, ኢዮቤልዉ፡, ኢዮቤልውሳት፡, al.

woorden.betekenis: ai, na, ubi?, ubinam?, quo?, quorsum?, unde?, unde, gentium
woorden.definitie: adv. interrog. [compositum ex አይ፡ q.v., et ቴ፡ gramm. § 62,a; gramm. § 63,b; gramm. § 161,a, sicut أَيْنَ אַיִן ex ai et na ], quod semel አይተ፡ scriptum inveni in Cod. Laur. Jes. 16,8. A interrog., crebro ኑ፡ et መ፡ annexo auctum, usitatum in interrogationibus directis et indirectis, 1 a ubi? አይቴ፡ አንተ፡ Gen. 3,9; አይቴ፡ ሀሎከ፡ Job 38,4; Job 28,12; Jes. 10,3; Jes. 33,18; Jes. 36,19; Jes. 37,13; Jes. 51,13; Jer. 2,6; Jer. 2,28; አይቴኑ፡ መርዔት፡ Jer. 13,20; ሰብእ፡ ኢይርአዩክሙ፡ አይቴ፡ አንትሙ፡ Jer. 43,19; Jer. 44,19; Thren. 2,12; ተመሀር፡ አይቴ፡ ውእቱ፡ ጥበብ፡ ወአይቴ፡ ውእቱ፡ ኀይል፡ Bar. 3,14; Zach. 1,5; Ps. 41,3; Ps. 78,10; Matth. 2,2; Joh. 1,39; Joh. 7,11; Joh. 8,19 al.; አይቴመ፡ ubinam? Hez. 13,12; አይቴኑመ፡ Jer. 17,15. α በአይቴ፡ ubi? Jud. 20,3; Ruth 2,19; Jer. 43,17; Matth. 2,4; Matth. 26,17; Marc. 14,12. β ኀበ፡ አይቴ፡ ubi? ut: nemo novit, ኀበ፡ አይቴ፡ ይከውን፡ Sx. Teq. 6. b quo? አይቴ፡ ተሐውር፡ Zach. 2,2; አይቴ፡ ይወስዳ፡ Zach. 5,10; Hen. 41,5; Hen. 46,5; Ps. 138,6; Judith 10,12; Asc. Jes. 7,3; Gen. 37,30. α ኀበ፡ አይቴ፡ quorsum? quo? ኀበ፡ አይቴ፡ (v. እንተ፡ አይቴ፡) ናነብሮ፡ ለዋሕድ፡ ὅποι ποτὲ θήσομεν τὸν μονογενῆ; Cyr. c. Pall. f. 84. β እንተ፡ አይቴ፡ quorsum? quo?, Cyr. c. Pall. f. 84. c እምአይቴ፡ unde? Job 1,7; Job 28,12; እምአይቴኑ፡ Sir. 37,3; Jes. 41,24; Jes. 49,21; Tob. 7,3; Judith 12,3; Asc. Jes. 11,14; Ps. 120,1; 4 Esr. 3,24; Jon. 1,8; 1 Reg. 25,11; Num. 11,13; Gen. 16,8; እምነ፡ አይቴ፡ Gen. 29,4; Matth. 15,33; Matth. 21,25; etiam: እምአይቴ፡ ሀገር፡ አንተ፡ unde (urbis) gentium es? Sx. Nah. 20. d እስከ፡ አይቴ፡ usque quo? ({bis wohin?}?) Asc. Jes. 9,1. 2 በአይቴ፡ qui? quomodo? ποῦ Prov. 11,31; 1 Petr. 4,18; በአይቴ፡ ይትዓረክ፡ መቅጹት፡ ምስለ፡ ጽህርት፡ τί Sir. 13,2; Sir. 13,17; Sir. 31,4; በአይቴ፡ ታአምረኒ፡ πόθεν Joh. 1,49; Matth. 9,15 Platt. B indef., sive adjecto sive omisso ሂ፡ vel ኒ፡, uspiam, quopiam, usquam, in sententiis negativis: ኢትፃእ፡ እምህየ፡ ወኢአይቴ፡ 3 Reg. 3,36; ወኢበአይቴሂ፡ 3 Reg. 10,12; ወኢበአይቴኒ፡ 4 Reg. 5,25. — Voc. Ae.: አይቴ፡ ዘ፡ ወዴት።

woorden.betekenis: de coelo delabi, diluvium, diluvio ventorum, ʾayḫ
woorden.definitie: subst. [vicinum est ይኅአ፡, አይኅአ፡ de coelo delabi; vid. etiam quae Ewald Jahrbuch der bibl. Wissenschaft VII. p. 3de nominibus diluvii Semiticis observavit] diluvium a magnum illud Noae tempore factum: Gen. 7,6; Gen. 10,1; 2 Petr. 2,5; Matth. 24,38; Clem. f. 69; Did. 12; Hen. 10,22; 4 Esr. 1,12; እምነ፡ ማይ፡ ዘአመ፡ አይኅ፡ ἀπὸ τοῦ ὕδατος τοῦ ἐπὶ Νῶε Jes. 54,9; ማየ፡ አይኅ፡ Gen. 6,17; Kuf. 4; Sir. 40,10; Sir. 44,18; Luc. 17,27. b in genere: በአይኅ፡ ἐν κατακλυσμῷ Dan. 9,26; በፍኖተ፡ አይኅ፡ Nah. 1,8; ይመጽእ፡ ዝናም፡ ከመ፡ አይኅ፡ ὑετος κατακλύζων Hez. 13,11; ማየ፡ አይኅ፡ Sir. 21,13; Sir. 39,22; Ps. 28,9. c de አይኅ፡ ዘነፋስ፡ vel አይኀ፡ ነፋስ፡ diluvio ventorum (Windfluth) fabulantur in suis libris ut Arabes ita Abyssini, Clem. f. 32; Gad. Ad. ʾayḫ C for ማየ፡ አይሕ፡ vid. ማይ፡ (TraCES)

woorden.betekenis: ê, manus, manu propria, per, ope, opera, ad fidem perducti s
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. እደው፡ et አእዳው፡ [יָד ܝܰܕ ܐܺܝܕܳܐ يَدٌ (etiam أَدٌ), amh. እጅ፡; vid. etiam ውእደ፡] Sing. እድ፡ pronomina suff. per ê sibi annectit, ut እዴየ፡, እዴሆሙ፡, caet. (gramm. § 154,d), 1 manus (cum brachio), Gen. 3,22; Gen. 5,29; Gen. 8,9; Gen. 22,10; Gen. 37,27; Gen. 38,28; Gen. 40,21; Gen. 41,42; Gen. 48,17; Ex. 4,4; Ex. 29,9; Ex. 29,10; Lev. 1,4; Lev. 21,19; Deut. 4,28; Deut. 9,15; Deut. 11,18; Deut. 19,21; Jud. 3,15; Jud. 3,21; Koh. 2,11; Koh. 9,10; Koh. 11,6; Job 30,21; Hez. 2,9; Ps. 90,12; ውስተ፡ እዴሁ፡ ፍሕም፡ Jes. 6,6; ደይ፡ እዴከ፡ ላዕለ፡ እዴየ፡ Gen. 24,2; ዘእሱር፡ እዴሁ፡ ዘየማን፡ Sir. 21,19; Matth. 3,12; Matth. 5,30; Matth. 8,3, alias sexcenties; ጸሐፍኩ፡ በእዴየ፡ manu propria Philem. 19; ጸሐፈ፡ ክታበ፡ በእዴሁ፡ Sx. Jac. 9; ሰፍሐ፡ እደ፡ ለነዳይ፡ Sir. 7,32; Sir. 14,13; Pl. አእዳው፡ maxime in libris inferioris aetatis, ut I Sal. Mar. 21; F.M. 26,8; Org. 1, quamquam passim etiam in Bibliis, ut Jer. 31,37. In specie significatur manu a fides: ወሀቡ፡ እደ፡ ይስድዱ፡ አንስቲያሆሙ፡ 2 Esr. 10,19; መጥወኒ፡ እዴከ፡ ወመጠዎ፡ እዴሁ፡ 4 Reg. 10,15. b dexteritas: በከመ፡ እዴሁ፡ ከማሁ፡ ክብሩ፡ Sir. 38,1. c auxilium et instrumenta: 2 Reg. 3,12; እደ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ሀለወት፡ ምስሌሁ፡ 2 Esr. 7,6; ኢይጻምዋ፡ እደው፡ ባቲ፡ Thren. 4,6; ዘእንበለ፡ እድ፡ Dan. 2,34; Act. 11,21; inde በእደ፡ vel በእደወ፡ per, ope, opera alicujus: ተፈነወ፡ ቃል፡ በእዴየ፡ Kuf. 12; Deut. 33,3; ዘነገረ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ በእደ፡ ኤርምያስ፡ Jer. 44,2; Hagg. 1,1; 1 Reg. 28,17; Act. 5,12; 1 Petr. 2,5; አምኑ፡ በእደዊሃ፡ (ad fidem perducti sunt per eam) Sx. Masc. 27; Sx. Hed. 26; Sx. Genb. 3 Enc. d ductus, unde ላዕለ፡ እደ፡ vel ዲበ፡ እደ፡ (على يد) sub auspiciis, ductus alicujus: 1 Petr. 1,21 Platt; ወአምነ፡ ጢሞቴዎስ፡ ዲበ፡ እደዊሁ፡ ለጳውሎስ፡ Sx. Ter 23; Sx. Ter 27. e possessio: አልብየ፡ ወስተ፡ እዴየ፡ Kuf. 41; Lev. 5,7; Lev. 5,11; Lev. 12,8. f vis et potestas: ውስተ፡ እዴሁ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሕያው፡ Job 12,10; ኵሉ፡ በእደ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Kuf. 12; Sap. 3,1; Ps. 118,109; ወሀብኩክሙ፡ ውስተ፡ እዴክሙ፡ Gen. 9,2; Gen. 14,20; Ex. 4,21: እወድቅ፡ ውስተ፡ እዴሆሙ፡ Jud. 15,18; Sir. 2,18; አትሕቲ፡ ርእሰኪ፡ ታሕተ፡ እዴሃ፡ Gen. 16,9; አድኅነኒ፡ እምነ፡ እዴሁ፡ Gen. 32,12; Matth. 17,22; Joh. 3,35; Joh. 10,28; 2 Cor. 11,33; etiam ante nomina bestiarum rerumque inanimatarum: ውስተ፡ እደ፡ ኵናት፡ Jer. 18,21; Ps. 21,21; Ps. 48,16; Ps. 62,9; Ps. 88,47; 1 Reg. 17,37. g robur, potentia: በእድ፡ ጽንዕት፡ Ex. 6,1: Deut. 4,34; እድ፡ ጽቡስ፡ Sir. 25,23; ኵሉ፡ እድ፡ ይደክም፡ Jes. 13,7. 2 a brachium hominis, βραχίων Job 3l,32 (ubi ὠμός መዝራዕት፡); ከመ፡ ድጕልማ፡ ውስተ፡ እደ፡ የማን፡ Sir. 21,21; አውቃፍ፡ ለእደዊሃ፡ Gen. 24,22. b armus bestiarum, manus quarumdam bestiarum: βραχίων Ex. 29,22 (at Ex. 29,27 መዝራዕት፡); χείρ ዘየሐውር፡ በእደዊሁ፡ Lev. 11,27; ላጽቄት፡ ዘበእደዊሁ፡ የሐውር፡ Prov. 24,63. 3 manus arte factae vel brachia arte facta: a manubrium: እደ፡ መንሥግ፡ Cant. 5,5. b manica, α vinculum manus: በእደ፡ ሰናስለ፡ ኀጺን፡ ἐν χειροκέδαις σιδηραῖς Ps. 149,8; β chirotheca, vel tegumentum digitorum: ገብሩ፡ አምሳለ፡ እድ፡ ወአጻብዕ፡ ዘኀጺን፡ Sx. Haml. 5; በእደወ፡ ኀጺን፡ እንዘ፡ ይጸፍዕ፡ ገጾ፡ Sx. Genb. 25 Enc. c axis rotae, 3 Reg. 7,17; 3 Reg. 7,19. d ut videtur, specillum: እድ፡ ዘኀጺን፡ ዘየሐትት፡ ዘውስተ፡ ከርሥ፡ (cruciatus instrumentum) Sx. Ter 15. e monumentum (quatenus manus instar indicat aliquid) 2 Reg. 18,18. f brachia (fulcra lateralia) solii 3 Reg. 10,19. g prominentia 3 Reg. 7,21. 4 pars (sicut יָד): ፲ እድ፡, ፱ እድ፡ δέκα μέρη, ἐννέα μέρη 2 Esr. 21,1; የኀልቅ፡ ክልኤ፡ እድ፡ ወይተርፍ፡ ሣልስት፡ እዴሃ፡ Zach. 13,8; Zach. 13,9; Hen. 72,12; Hen. 72,28; Gen. 47,24; Ex. 16,36; 4 Esr. 4,47; ብርሃነ፡ ዚአሁ፡ ፯ እደ፡ ያበርህ፡ እምዘወርኅ፡ (septies lucidior erit quam) Hen. 72,37; numeralia ordinalia in st. constr. voci እድ፡ praeponi solent, ut: ሣልስተ፡ እዴሃ፡ ለምድር፡ tertia (partis i.e.) pars terrae Apoc. 8,7; Apoc. 8,9; Apoc. 11,13; Lev. 5,11; 2 Reg. 18,2; 4 Reg. 11,5; 4 Reg. 11,6; ውስተ፡ ሣልስተ፡ እደ፡ መንግሥትየ፡ Dan. 5,7; 4 Esr. 4,46; ለዝኩ፡ ሳብዕተ፡ እድ፡ 4 Esr. 4,54; 4 Esr. 4,58, quamquam etiam occurrit: ራብዕት፡ እዴሃ፡ ለምድር፡ Apoc. 6,8 rom.; Apoc. 8,9 rom.; Zach. 13,8 al.; in Acc.: ትሰቲ፡ ሳድስተ፡ እዴሃ፡ ለኢን፡ Hez. 4,11; Hez. 5,2; — 5 latus: መንገለ፡ እደ፡ ማየ፡ ባሕር፡ Kuf. 8; በእደ፡ ባሕር፡ Kuf. 10; በእደ፡ አቡሁ፡ Kuf. 7. (vid. ወእደ፡ et ውእደ፡). 6 locus, deinde in st. constr. relative usurpatur, (quamquam ወእደ፡ vel ውእደ፡ magis frequentatur), a እደ፡ quο loco, ubi{ cfr. Hebr. יָד חָזִית (ubicumque conspexeris) Jes. 57,8}, ut: እደ፡ እውዕል፡ ወእበይት፡ Lud. ex Org. b በእደ፡ quο loco, ubi, ut: በኵሉ፡ መካናት፡ በእደ፡ ገብሩ፡ Kuf. p. 62. c እምእደ፡ e loco ubi, ut: መጽአ፡ ኀቤሃ፡ ፩ ወሬዛ፡ እምእደ፡ (v. እምውእደ፡) ይትኀባእ፡ Dan. apocr. 1,37 (vid. ወእደ፡ et ውእደ፡). — Locus Asc. Laur. p. 80, ubi Laurentius እድ፡ longitudo vertit, dubius videtur (an: duodecim palmas et quatuor…latus?) ʾǝd a for ምልአ፡ እድ፡ vid. ምልእ፡ (Leslau) b for ሣልስተ፡ እድ፡ vid. ሣልስ፡ c for ራብዕተ፡ እድ፡ vid. ራብዕ፡ (Leslau) d for ትሥልስት፡ እድ፡ vid. ትሥልስት፡ (Leslau) e for አፈ፡ ንቡረ፡ እድ፡ vid. አፍ፡ (TraCES)

woorden.betekenis: indumentum, tunica, Voc, Ae
woorden.definitie: vel አደል፡ (etiam per ዐ፡), subst., nonnisi in Pl. አእዳል፡ repertum, indumentum, tunica: አእዳለ፡ ማእስ፡ Kuf. 3; Gen. 3,21 (χιτῶνας δερματίνους). — Voc. Ae.: አእዳል፡ ወማእስ፡ ዘ፡ ቍርበት።

woorden.betekenis: rubuit, fuscus evasit
woorden.definitie: inus., i.q. אָדַם rubuit, أدُمَ fuscus evasit.

woorden.betekenis: Adam
woorden.definitie: n. pers. hominis protoplasti (אָדָם), Adam, Gen. 2,16 seq.; Deut. 32,8; Kuf.; Macc. f. 11.

woorden.betekenis: adamas
woorden.definitie: n. peregr. sc. ἀδάμας, adamas gemma: Am. 7,7; Am. 7,8; ከመ፡ ቅጽረ፡ አድማስ፡ Rel. Bar.; እብነ፡ አድማስ፡ Macc. f. 25; Lit. 172,2; መላዬ፡ ኀጻውንት፡ አድማስ፡ Sx. Hed. 12Enc. — Voc. Ae.: አድማስ፡ ዘ፡ የደንገያ፡ ንጉሥ፡

woorden.betekenis: manus
woorden.definitie: Pl. ab እድ፡ manus vid. sub እድ፡ col. 798.

woorden.betekenis: onere clitellisve impositis constrinxit et oneravit, jumentu
woorden.definitie: subst. m., fem. አድግት፡ et እድግት፡, Pl. አእዱግ፡ [حَدَجَ onere clitellisve impositis constrinxit et oneravit; هَودَجٌ i.q. هِدْجٌ] proprie: jumentum onerarium vel clitellarium, i.e. asinus, asina, ὑποζύγιον Ex. 4,20; Ex. 23,4; Ex. 23,5; Ex. 23,12; Jud. 1,14; Job 24,3; 2 Petr. 2,16; ὁ et ἡ ὄνος Gen. 22,3; Gen. 22,5; Gen. 24,35; Gen. 45,23; Gen. 49,11; Jud. 5,10; Jud. 15,16; 1 Reg. 8,16; 2 Reg. 16,2; Sir. 30,33; Judith 2,17; Jes. 21,7; πῶλοι Jud. 10,4; Jud. 12,14; አድግት፡ et እድግት፡ Kuf. 18; Ex. 13,13; Num. 22,21 seq.; 2 Reg. 19,26; Matth. 21,2 seq.; አእዱግ፡ አእኑስ፡ Job 1,3; Job 42,12. a አድገ፡ ገዳም፡ onager, asinus agrestis vel sylvestris (vid. ሐለስትዮ፡): Job 24,5; Jes. 32,14; Hen. 89,11. b አድገ፡ መረብ፡ pelecanus onocrotalus vid. sub መረብ፡ col. 166. c ማሕረፀ፡ አድግ፡ μύλος ὀνικός vid. sub ማሕረፅ፡ col. 90. [Alia asini nomina caeteris gentibus Semiticis usitata, ut חֲמוֹר אָתֹן, Aethiopibus deperdita sunt.] — Voc. Ae.: አድግ፡ ብ፡ አሕያ፡ (coll. ⲉⲓⲁ, ⲉⲉⲓⲱ). marab L መረብ marab, አድገ፡ መረብ ʾadga marab wild ass, pelican, vid. መረብ 357a

woorden.betekenis: defraudare, vim inferre
woorden.definitie: , ተአገለ፡ defraudare, vim inferre, vid. sub ዐገለ፡

woorden.betekenis: vitulus, pullus, foetus, suboles, proles, natus, vituli, agn
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., coll. et sing., Pl. እጐል፡, Pl. Pl. እጐላት፡ [עֵגֶל ܥܶܓܠܳܐ عِجْلٌ vitulus; amh. ገልገል፡ pullus ] foetus, suboles, proles, natus, pullus omnis generis, a raro hominum (pro እጓል፡), ut: እጕለ፡ ማውታ፡ Joh. 14,18 rom.; እጐሊሆን፡ τὰ παιδία αὐτῶν Thren. 4,10; rex mortuus est ወኀደገ፡ እጐሊሁ፡ ውሉደ፡ ንኡሳነ፡ Macc. f. 15. b plerumque bestiarum, collective: እጕለ፡ አልህምት፡ vituli Deut. 32,14; እጕለ፡ መራዕይ፡ Deut. 28,51; Job 20,17; እጕለ፡ ሐራጊት፡ agni Ps. 28,1; pulli capreolorum Cant. 4,5; Cant. 7,4; እጕለ፡ ዐናብስት፡ scymni vel catuli leonum Job 4,11; Ps. 103,22; sing.: እጕለ፡ ጠሊ፡ Kuf. p. 124; Pl.: τέκνα τῶν τραγελάφων እጐሊሆሙ፡ Job 39,4; Jer. 14,5; leonis Nah. 2,12; Hez. 19,2; camelorum Gen. 32,16; vituli boum 1 Reg. 6,7; Jes. 11,7 var.; Pl. Pl. እጐላቲሆሙ፡ (v. እጓላቲሆሙ፡) sc. boum et ursorum, Jes. 11,7. c serpentum vel viperarum proles: እጐሊሆሙ፡ Jes. 14,29; Thren. 4,3. d in specie: avium; coll.: እጕለ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ Job 5,7; Jes. 43,20; እጕለ፡ ቋዓት፡ Ps. 146,10; እጕለ፡ ርግብ፡ Lev. 5,7; Lev. 12,6; Lev. 12,8; Luc. 2,24; እጕለ፡ አንስርት፡ Prov. 24,23; Prov. 24,52; Pl.: እጐሊሆሙ፡ (ለቋዓት፡) Job 38,41; Jes. 16,2; ከመ፡ ርግብ፡ ምስለ፡ እጐሊሃ፡ Jes. 60,8; Ps. 83,3; ተሐፅን፡ ውስተ፡ መሬት፡ እጐሊሃ፡ ὦα Job 39,14; νοσσιά Job 39,27; Jer. 29,17; Ob. 4; ከመ፡ ዖፍ፡ ትከድን፡ እጐሊሃ፡ Deg.

woorden.betekenis: vitula, juvenca, Voc, Ae
woorden.definitie: , rarius እጕልት፡, subst., fem., sing. et coll., Pl. እጐላት፡ et እጕላት፡, etiam እጓላት፡ [עֶגְלָה] vitula, juvenca, Lev. 22,27; Num. 19,2 seq.; Deut. 21,3 seq.; Jud. 14,18; 1 Reg, 16,2; እጐልት፡ እምውስተ፡ አልህምት፡ Jes. 7,21; Jes. 15,5; Jer. 26,20; Hos. 10,11; Hebr. 9,13 (እጕልት፡ rom.); cum nominibus numeralibus: Gen. 32,16; Num. 7,17; collective: Hen. 85,8; Joel 1,17; እጐልተ፡ ባሳን፡ Am. 4,1; Gen. 33,13 var.; Pl. እጐላት፡ 1 Reg. 6,7; Gen. 33,13 var.; Hen. 86,4; እጕላት፡ Gen. 33,13; እጓላት፡ Ps. 67,13; 1 Reg. 6,7 var. — Voc. Ae.: እጐልት፡ ዘ፡ ጌደር።

woorden.betekenis: ad genus humanum pertinens, humanus
woorden.definitie: እመሕያዊ፡ adj. rel. ad genus humanum pertinens, humanus: ፍጥረት፡ (natura) እጓለ፡ እመሕያዊ፡ Phlx. 1; በከመ፡ ምግባረ፡ መላእክት፡ መንፈሳዊያን፡ ይትሌዐል፡ እምግባረ፡ እጓለ፡ እምሕያዊያን፡ Phlx. 3; ዘርእ፡ እጓለ፡ እመሕያዊት፡ (sperma genitale hum.) F.M. 11,1.

woorden.betekenis: âi, î, agmen boum, populi, grex, agmen, hominum agmen, gens,
woorden.definitie: (pro እገላይ፡ vel እገሊ፡), adj. et subst., fem. እገሊት፡ [amh. id.; terminatione adjectivorum âi vel î formatum est nomen ex እገል፡, quod equidem cum أَجْلٌ agmen boum, populi, جُولٌ grex, agmen, جِيلٌ hominum agmen, gens componere haud dubito (de vicinitate radicum אגל et גלל גול cfr. etiam أَجلٌ et גָּלָל causa, אֶגְלֵי־טַל guttae roris), ita ut እገሌ፡ proprie significet unus e circulo vel agmine, caterva al.] quidam, certus quidam, cujus nomen ignoratur vel reticetur, ὁ δεῖνα (פְּלֹגִי ܦܠܳܢ فُلَانٌ et فُلَانِيٌّ) a de personis: ኀበ፡ እገሌ፡ Matth. 26,18; እገሌ፡ እምቤተ፡ እገሌ፡ ውእቱ፡ ἐκ τῆς οἰκίας τῆς τοῦ δεῖνός ἐστιν Chrys. ho. 5; እገሌ፡ ገብርከ፡ Chrys. Ta. 24; in Acc. እገሌሃ፡ 4 Esr. 6,51 L; Sx. Genb. 21; እገሌ፡ ወእገሊት፡ Chrys. ho. 11(at Macc. f. 22 ወእገሌት፡); ፈለጥከኒ፡ እምአመትየ፡ እገሊት፡ Jsp. p. 333; in Vocativo: ሰማዕከኑ፡ ኦእግሌ፡ Jsp. p. 337; ኢትትአመን፡ ኦእገሌ፡ ትሕትናሁ፡ Jsp. p. 338; Jsp. p. 341; in Liturgiis aliisque libris, in quibus formulae dicendi praescribuntur, pro nominibus propriis inter legendum addendis እገሌ፡ vel እገሊት፡ inscriptum esse solet, ut: በእንተ፡ ንጉሥነ፡ እገሌ፡ pro rege nostro Ν. Ν., Lit.; አንተ፡ እገሌ፡ tu N. Ν., Kid. f. 22; አይቴ፡ ሀለዉ፡ እገሌ፡ ወእገሊት፡ Genz. f. 4; Genz. f. 50 al. b de rebus; ita quidem usurpatur, ut m. እገሌ፡ nomini in st. constr. posito subjungatur, ex. gr.: ሤጥኩ፡ በሤጠ፡ እገሌ፡ (um den und den Preis) F.N. 33,3; ረሳዕነ፡ ግብረ፡ እገሌ፡ (wir haben das und das vergessen) Gad. Ad. f. 133; fem. እገሊት፡ autem adjectivi instar suo nomini apponatur: ሖር፡ ኀበ፡ እገሊት፡ ሀገር፡ Phlx. 3. ǝgale‘so and so’ ወእመሰ፡ ትፈቅድ፡ ታእምር፡ ዘወሀበኒ፡ ቀሚሰ፡ አባ፡ እገሌ። ʻIf you want to know who gave me the habit, it is Abba so and so’ 8 (ed.), 7 (tr.) (‘It substitutes for a name that is unknown or that the author would evade for a reason.’) 7 n. 30; አባ፡ እገሌ፡ አጥፍአ፡ ሀገረ፡ በእሳት፡ ‘“Father so-and-so has destroyed the inhabited place by fire”’ 52 (348) l. 1 (ed.); 53 (349) l. 1 (tr.) (‘The employment of ǝgäle “N.N.; so-an-so” referred to humans can be interpreted in two ways: hostility to the person who would be punished with anonymity, a very common practice in Gǝʿǝz hagiography or because the memory of his name was swept away by the distance between the facts and the composition of the text. The second element regards toponyms as well. The usage of the ǝgäle jargon may suggest that the narrator is not an eyewitness.’ 53(349) n. 63

woorden.betekenis: pes, quadrupes, multipes, ad pedes ejus, pede, in pedibus, v
woorden.definitie: subst., fem. et m. [רֶגֶל, ܪܶܓܠܳܐ, رِجْلٌ; in dialecto Mandaeorum ܥܶܓܪܳܐ; in dialecto Arabum vulgari إِجْر; quamquam etiam radicis ረገለ፡: vestigium superest in ሰረገላ፡ q.v.], Pl. እገር፡ rarius አእጋር፡, 1 pes: ኢየኀልፍ፡ እንተ፡ ህየ፡ እግረ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወእንስሳ፡ Hez. 29,11; bestiarum Matth. 7,6; ክልኤ፡ እግር፡ Am. 3,12; ርቱዕ፡ እገሪሆሙ፡ Hez. 1,7; ዘአርባዕቱ፡ እግሩ፡ vel እገሪሁ፡ quadrupes Ex. 9,9; Lev. 11,23; ዘብዙኅ፡ እገሪሁ፡ multipes Lev. 11,42; hominum: ኪደተ፡ እግረ፡ ብእሲ፡ 4 Esr. 5,7; ከመ፡ እግር፡ ሙቁሕ፡ Sir. 21,19; እግር፡ ፅዉስ፡ Sir. 25,23; Job 13,27; Job 18,8; Job 31,7; Matth. 4,6; Matth. 10,14; ወይቀውማ፡ እገሪሁ፡ Zach. 14,4; እገሪሆሙ፡ ይረውጻ፡ Prov. 1,16; ወድቀ፡ ውስተ፡ እገሪሃ፡ ለዮዲት፡ Judith 14,7; Job 33,11; Jer. 12,5; Ps. 17,36; Ps. 72,2; Cant. 5,3; ኀበ፡ እገሪሁ፡ ad pedes ejus Ruth 3,4; Ruth 3,7; Ruth 3,8; አእጋር፡ Job 13,27; Sap. 14,11; Prov. 6,18; 2 Reg. 19,24; በእግር፡ pede Matth. 14,13; Act. 20,13 Platt; Ps. 65,5; በእግሩ፡ Jud. 4,15; Jud. 4,17; በእገሪሆሙ፡ 2 Reg. 15,16; እንተ፡ እግር፡ pede Marc. 6,33; Act. 20,13 rom.; በእግረ፡ ዚአየ፡ in pedibus i.e. vestigiis meis Gen. 30,30; በእግረ፡ ደቂቅ፡ pedibus i.e. gressibus puerorum Gen. 33,14; ዘበእግር፡ pedes Judith 7,2. 2 Varie transfertur: a pes sellae Herm. p. 19; literae M.M. f. 246 (vid. sub ስሑብ፡). b imum rei: ታሰክቦ፡ ለግኑዝ፡ ኀበ፡ እግረ፡ ታቦት፡ Genz. f. 69. c pes, nomen mensurae, ut: ለጽላሎት፡ በግንቦት፡ ፳ወ፩ እግር፡ ወመንፈቀ፡ እግር፡, in Appendice Codicis Cyrilli (Ethiopic Ms. Nr. 3in the library of the Eastindia House), creberrime. d „pes clavis: እግረ፡ መራኁት፡, Mss. Colb., incertum quid sibi velit“ Lud. e radius solis: በእግረ፡ አሚር፡ ὑπὸ ἀκτίνων ἡλίου Sap. 2,4; እገሪሃ፡ ለፀሓይ፡ Hen. 75,4; Hen. 106,5; Hen. 106,10; በረቀ፡ ሥጋሆሙ፡ ከመ፡ እግረ፡ ፀሓይ፡ Macc. f. 2; Lud. e Mss. Colb. [cfr. पाद; alii Semitae frequentant קֶרֶן]. f እግረ፡ ሐመር፡ prora Act. 27,30 rom. (ርእሰ፡ ሐመር፡ puppis Act. 27,29) si quidem lectio bona est. — Voc. Ae.: አእጋር፡ ብ፡ እግሮች። ʾǝgr እግር፡ ዛቍኔ፡ ʾǝgr zāqʷǝne እግር፡ ዘቍኔ፡ ʾǝgr zaqʷǝne (title ?) meaning unknown እግር፡ ዛቍኔ፡ ሙሴ፡ ‘le eger zāquenē,’ 27 l. 13 (ed.), 31 l. 8 (tr.); ወእግር፡ ዛቍኔ፡ ጋሞ፡ ‘l’eger zāquenē, Gāmmo’ 36 l. 14 (ed.), 43 l. 1 (tr.); እግር፡ ዘቍኔ፡ ተክሌ፡ ‘l’eger zaquenē, Taklē’ 33 l. 15 (ed.), 38 l. 31 (tr.), vid. ዛቍኔ፡

woorden.betekenis: pedes, copiae pedestres, ʾagār, ʾagāri, ʾagārān, ʾagārǝyān
woorden.definitie: et አጋሪ፡ n. ag., Pl. አጋራን፡ et አጋርያን፡, pedes, copiae pedestres: Ex. 12,37; Num. 11,21; Jud. 5,15; Jud. 20,2; 2 Reg. 8,4; ፲፻ አጋር፡ ብእሲ፡ 4 Reg. 13,7; አጋራን፡ Judith 2,5; አጋሮሙ፡ Judith 7,20; አጋርያን፡ Judith 2,19; Judith 2,22; Judith 7,2; ስሳ፡ እልፍ፡ አጋር፡ Sir. 16,10; ስሳ፡ እልፍ፡ አጋራን፡ Judith 46,8. ʾagār, ʾagāri, Pl. ʾagārān, ʾagārǝyān C for ሊቀ፡ ሐራ፡ ለአጋር፡ vid. ሊቅ፡ (Grébaut)

woorden.betekenis: dominus
woorden.definitie: dominus vid. sub ገዝአ፡

woorden.betekenis: os
woorden.definitie: os vid. sub አፈወ፡

woorden.betekenis: quomodo?, quam, quantopere, quantum, quanto!, qui?, quo pact
woorden.definitie: adv. interrog., [compositum ex እ፡ (i.e. אֵי አይ፡) et ፎ፡ (i.e. פֹּה), sicut كَيْفَ, אֵיכָה al.; gramm. § 64,6; gramm. § 161,a]; tam interrogantis quam exclamantis (sive admirantis sive deplorantis) est; ubi interrogantis est, nonnumquam suffixo adv. ኑ፡ et መ፡ intenditur; etiam praepositionem በ፡ sibi praepositam patitur. 1 quomodo? እፎ፡ ትጠብብ፡ Sir. 25,3; እፎ፡ ትስእሎ፡ Sir. 28,4; Koh. 4,11; Ps. 10,1; እፎ፡ ትብል፡ Job 33,13; Jes. 19,11; Jer. 2,21; Jer. 2,23; Matth. 23,33; Luc. 10,26; Joh. 9,10; Joh. 9,26; Herm. p. 50; እፎ፡ ኮነት፡ ዘማ፡ ሀገረ፡ ጽዮን፡ Jes. 1,21; Jes. 14,4; Jes. 14,12; Koh. 2,16; Jer. 9,19; Jer. 27,23; Thren. 1,1; Thren. 2,1; Hez. 26,17; ኢታአምርኑ፡ እፎ፡ ኀደጋሁ፡ ለአቡከ፡ Tob. 11,1; 4 Esr. 1,30; Prov. 4,19; 1 Reg. 24,11; Ruth 2,11; Hen. 5,1; Asc. Jes. 11,32; ወእፎ፡ ይክል፡ Matth. 12,29; 1 Reg. 16,2; እፎኑ፡ እንጋ፡ ናዐብዮ፡ Sir. 49,11; እፎኑመ፡ ἀλλὰ πῶς ἄν Job 11,5; እፎኑመ፡ እንከ፡ Rom. 3,6; እፎ፡ እንከ፡ Matth. 12,26; Matth. 22,43; Joh. 6,42; Jer. 8,8; Ep. Jer. 49; Jes. 36,9; እፎ፡ ምንተ፡ πῶς ἢ τί Matth. 10,19; ዝኬ፡ እፎ፡ ὗυτοζ δὲ τί Joh. 21,21. 2 quam, quantopere, quantum, quanto! ኦሞት፡ እፎ፡ መሪር፡ ዝክርከ፡ Sir. 41,1; እፎ፡ ዐቢይ፡ ቤተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Bar. 3,24; Hen. 21,8; Num. 24,5; Marc. 10,23; Marc. 10,24; እፎ፡ ተሰባሕከ፡ ኤልያስ፡ Sir. 48,4; (in Enc. ob rhythmum finalem: በስብሐቲከ፡ ኤልያስ፡ ተሰባሕከ፡ እፎ፤); እፎ፡ ብዙኀ፡ እምገብረት፡ ፍሬ፡ 4 Esr. 2,40; πόσῳ Sap. 13,3; Sap. 13,4; ጽልመትከ፡ እፎ፡ πόσον Matth. 6,23. 3 qui? quo pacto? quid quod? qui fit ut? cur? a sive እፎ፡ nudum, ut: 4 Esr. 1,29; Asc. Jes. 11,24; Jes. 11,26; ወእፎ፡ ኢታአምሩ፡ Luc. 12,56; 1 Reg. 20,27; Jer. 30,14; διὰ τί Judith 5,4; እፎመ፡ Ex. 2,18; ter repetitum Sx. Teq. 15 Enc. (vid. sub ከዋው፡). b sive በእፎ፡, ut: በእፎ፡ ዕለት፡ እምዕለት፡ ትነውኅ፡ διὰ τί Sir. 36,7; Sir. 51,24; በእፎ፡ ጾምነሂ፡ ወኢርኢከነ፡ τί ὅτι Jes. 58,3; Hez. 18,19; 2 Esr. 12,2; 2 Esr. 12,3; በእፎ፡ ኢዐቀብከ፡ 3 Reg. 3,43; Marc. 2,18. c sive እፎ፡ ዘ፡ vel በእፎ፡ ዘ፡, ut: ወእፎኑመ፡ ዘይብል፡ መጽሐፍ፡ Rom. 4,3; እፎ፡ ዘኢይትመዓዕ፡ (διὰ τί) Job 21,4; Matth. 16,11; Marc. 8,21; Asc. Jes. 9,11; በእፎኬ፡ ዘ፡ Matth. 21,25. d sive እፎ፡ ከመ፡ vel በእፎ፡ ከመ፡ seq. Indic., ut Gen. 44,4; Ex. 1,18; Ex. 3,3; 2 Reg. 16,17; እፎ፡ ከመ፡ ነግሠ፡ አዶንያስ፡ 3 Reg. 1,13; በእፎ፡ ከመ፡ 4 Reg. 1,16; seq. Subj. 1 Reg. 20,2. 4 in syllogismis, a quanto magis ? α እፎ፡ nudum: ποσαχῶς; Sir. 10,31. β እፎ፡ እንከ፡ Prov. 15,11; Esth. 9,12 (v. እፎ፡ እንጋ፡). γ እፎ፡ ፈድፋደ፡ Matth. 7,11; Asc. Jes. 8,25; Rom. 11,15 Platt. δ እፎኬ፡ ፈድፋደ፡ Deut. 31,27; እፎ፡ እንከ፡ ፈድፋደ፡ Matth. 6,30; Rom. 5,9; Rom. 5,10; Rom. 5,15; Rom. 11,24; Hebr. 9,14; Hebr. 10,29; Hebr. 12,9. b quanto minus? α እፎ፡ 4 Esr. 2,21; Ex. 6,12. β እፎኬ፡ Job 4,19; Job 9,14; Gen. 44,8; Did. 12. γ እፎ፡ እንከ፡ Kuf. 43; Jes. 20,6; Hebr. 2,3. 5 Componitur ዘከመ፡ እፎ፡ a qualis? Matth. 8,27 rom.; ሕቱ፡ ዘከመ፡ እፎ፡ ውእቱ፡ ግዕዙ፡ ወልማዱ፡ Did. 10; Num. 13,18; Num. 13,19; Num. 13,20; Jac. 1,24 (ὁποῖος); Haim. Ab. (vid. sub አስተኀለፈ፡). b quantus? 1 Joh. 3,1. c quomodo se habens? ከመ፡ ያርእዮ፡ በአይ፡ መካን፡ ሀሎ፡ ወዘከመ፡ እፎ፡ ውእቱ፡ Genz. f. 155. d quomodo? ነጽርኬ፡ ዘከመ፡ እፎ፡ ይትዋረድ፡ Chrys. Ta. 1; vid. etiam ከመ፡: -እፎ፡ Hen. 3. — In loco 4 Reg. 2,14 ወእፎ፡ e Graeco ἀφφώ (אַף־הוּא) transformatum est.

woorden.betekenis: rotae, Ophanim
woorden.definitie: vel አፍንን፡ n. peregr. sc. אוֹפַנִּים rotae (Hez. 1; Hez. 10), nomen ordinis archangelorum, Ophanim: Hen. 61,10 et Hen. 71,7 (ubi equidem in mea editione absque auctoritate librorum Mss. ኦፍኒን፡ scripsi); etiam pro sing. usurpator, ut: አፍኒን፡ ሊቀ፡ መላእክት፡ ፩ እም ፱ ሊቃናት፡ Sx. Hed. 8.

woorden.betekenis: foris
woorden.definitie: et አፍአ፡ foris vid. sub አፈወ፡

woorden.betekenis: invertit, vertit, evertit, convertit
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., e.q. أَفَكَ invertit, הָפַךְ vertit, evertit, convertit.

woorden.betekenis: flandi, efflandi
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., e.q. פָּאָה (פָּעָה, vid. ፈዐወ፡) فَاهَ, al. (vid. Ges. thes. p. 1085), cui potestas flandi et efflandi inest.

woorden.betekenis: aroma, odor suavis, odoramentum
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., coll. et sing., Pl. አፈዋት፡ [cfr. فُوهٌ, فَوْعَةٌ, فَوْغَةٌ, أَفْعاءٌ] aroma, odor suavis, odoramentum (ἀρώματα, ἡδύσματα), Gen. 37,25; Ex. 30,23; Ex. 30,34; አግማል፡ ይጸውሩ፡ አፈዋተ፡ 3 Reg. 10,2; 3 Reg. 10,25; 4 Reg. 20,13; Kuf. 16; Esth. 2,12; ቅድው፡ አፈዋት፡ Hez. 27,22; 1 Par. 9,29; 1 Par. 9,30; 2 Par. 9,1; 2 Par. 16,14; Cant. 1,3; Cant. 3,6; Cant. 4, 6; Cant. 5,1; አፈወ፡ ቅብእ፡ ጥዑመ፡ (Acc.) Koh. 10,1; ኵሉ፡ አፈው፡ Hen. 31,3; እሉ፡ አፈው፡ Hen. 32,1; Marc. 16,1; Luc. 23,56; አፈወ፡ ሃይማኖት፡ ነአልድ፡ ምስለ፡ ፍሬ፡ ምግባር፡ ጥዑም፡ Sx. Masc. 25Enc.

woorden.betekenis: viperae
woorden.definitie: viperae vid. sub ፈዐወ፡

woorden.betekenis: coquere
woorden.definitie: i.q. אָפָה ܐܶܦܰܐ coquere panem, ut videtur.

woorden.betekenis: ibi
woorden.definitie: ከሀከ፡ ibi vid. sub. ከሓ፡

woorden.betekenis: posse, valere, pollere, non, possum, officium, duplex, possu
woorden.definitie: , raro ከሀለ፡ (ut Herm. p. 32; 1 Esr. 5,37 var.) I,1 [יָכֹל, כְּהַל; vicinum est አከለ፡ q.v.], Imperf. raro ይክህል፡ (ut 1 Reg. 26,25), plerumque ይክል፡ (gramm. § 92), Subj. ይክሀል፡, posse, valere ( pollere ), c.c. Acc. rei: ትክል፡ ኵሎ፡ Job 10,13; Job 42,2; ምንተ፡ ይክል፡ Job 21,15; ዘዘንተ፡ ገብረ፡ ኵሎ፡ ይክል፡ Sir. 50,29; Gen. 13,16; Luc. 12,26; ኢይክል፡ ሢመታተ፡ መንታ፡ non possum officium duplex (sc. sustinere) Sx. Mij. 21Enc.; c. Acc. Infin.: ኢይክል፡ ቀዊመ፡ Thren. 1,14; መኑ፡ አነ፡ ከመ፡ እክሀል፡ ሐኒጸ፡ ሎቱ፡ ቤተ፡ 2 Par. 2,6; Ps. 139,11; Gen. 15,5; Gen. 19,19; Gen. 31,35; Gen. 44,1; Gen. 45,3; Num. 22,37; Tob. 1,15; Hen. 4; 4 Esr. 6,77; 4 Esr. 7,14; 4 Esr. 15; ይክሀሉ፡ ሐይወ፡ 4 Esr. 8,9; 4 Esr. 10,70; 4 Esr. 13,49; Matth. 22,46; Jac. 1,21; Jac. 2,14; Jac. 3,12; 2 Cor. 13,8; Eph. 3,18; Hebr. 11,19; nonnumquam c. pron. suff., ad objectum verbi subjuncti relato, ut: ኢይክልዎሙ፡ ለሕዝብ፡ ተበቅሎቶሙ፡ non possunt eos sc. populum punire Judith 11,10; 4 Esr. 3,50; rarius c. ለ፡ seq. Infin., ut: ኵሎ፡ ዘትክል፡ እዴከ፡ ለገቢር፡ Koh. 9,10, vel c. Subj. verbi: Dan. 2,26; Asc. Jes. 9,37; seq. ከመ፡ c. Subj.: Hen. 93,11; abs.: በአምጣነ፡ ትክል፡ quantum potes ( pro virium ratione ) Sir. 9,14; Sir. 10,28; Sir. 14,11; Sir. 43,30; በከመ፡ ክሂሎትነ፡ Sx. Sen. 12; ባዕድ፡ ዘይክል፡ δυνάμενος ἄλλος Ex. 4,13; ክሂል፡ vel ክሂሎት፡ potentia, ut: ሥልጣን፡ ወክሂል፡ Ssal. Req.; ሰብሕዎ፡ በክሂሎቱ፡ Ps. 150,2. a effecere posse vermögen, durchsezen: ገበርቢ፡ ዘንተ፡ እኩየ፡ ወክሀልኪ፡ Jer. 3,5; ወክሂለኒ፡ ትክህል፡ 1 Reg. 26,25; Herm. p. 32. b posse per legem i.e. (dürfen), licet alicui: ኢይክሉ፡ ገቢረ፡ ጳስካ፡ በአህጉሪሆሙ፡ Kuf. 49; Gen. 43,32; Gen. 44,34; Deut. 12,17; Deut. 16,5; Deut. 17,15; Rom. 9,20. c a se impetrare posse ut, ኢክሀሉ፡ ተናግሮቶ፡ ቃለ፡ ሠናየ፡ Gen. 37,4; 1 Joh. 3,9; Joh. 8,43. d fere, sustinere: ኢይክል፡ ባሕቲትየ፡ ክሂሎተክሙ፡ φέρειν Deut. 1,9; ὑποφέρειν Prov. 18,14. e) praevalere, superare: c. Acc. pers., Gen. 32,26; ኢይክሉከ፡ Jer. 1,19; Jer. 15,20; Ps. 128,2; Jud. 16,5; 1 Reg. 17,9; Rom. 8,31; c. ምስለ፡ pers. i.e. praevalere pugnando cum aliquo Gen. 32,29; Hos. 12,3; Hos. 12,4. f potestatem habere alicujus, c. ላዕለ፡, ut: Satanas a Deo petiit, ከመ፡ የሀቦ፡ ክሂለ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ (ለኢዮብ፡) ወላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ንዋዩ፡ Sx. Genb. 2.

woorden.betekenis: potentem, valentem, facere, vires, potentiam, facultatem, pr
woorden.definitie: II,1 potentem vel valentem facere aliquem, i.e. a vires, potentiam, facultatem praebere alicui, c. Acc. pers.: ከመ፡ ያክህሎ፡ Herm. p. 47; እግዚአብሔር፡ አክሀሎሙ፡ Phlx. 172; seq. በ፡ rei, ut: ኵሎ፡ እክል፡ በዘውእቱ፡ አክሀለኒ፡ (ἐνδυναμοῦν) Phil. 4,13; እግዚአብሔር፡ አክሀለነ፡ በኵሉ፡ ዘንፈቅድ፡ Jsp. p. 330; seq. ለ፡ c. Infin., ut: ያክህልክሙ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለገቢረ፡ ኵሉ፡ ፈቃዱ፡ Genz. f. 154; seq. Subj. verbi: ኢታክህሎሙ፡ ለፀርነ፡ ይቅትሉነ፡ Jsp. p. 278. b praevalere facere, superiorem reddere aliquem aliquo, c. Acc. et በ፡, ut: ኀጢአትነ፡ አክሀለት፡ ፀረ፡ ብነ፡ Jsp. p. 352; c. dupl. Acc.: አነ፡ አክሀልኩከ፡ ኪያሃ፡ (ለሀገር፡) p. 366.

woorden.betekenis: possibile esse, fieri posse, posse, non, potest, numerari, p
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 possibile esse, fieri posse, posse seq. verbo passivo vel intransitivo: ኢይትከሀልዝ፡, ኵሉ፡ ይትከሀል፡ Matth. 19,26; c.c. Nom. vel Acc. Infin.: እምእደ፡ ዚአከ፡ ጐይይ፡ ኢይትከሀል፡ ወኢይደሉ፡ Sap. 16,15; ኢይትከሀል፡ ረቲዐ፡ Koh. 1,15; Dan. 5,16 var.; Marc. 6,5; Hebr. 6,18 rom.; seq. ለ፡ c. Infin.: ኢይትከሀል፡ ለኈልቆ፡ ( non potest numerari ) Koh. 3,14; c. Subj. verbi: ኢይትከሀል፡ ከመዝ፡ ይኩን፡ Ex. 8,22; 4 Esr. 10,68; Hen. 9,5; Jac. 3,11; Hebr. 5,11; Hebr. 6,4; Hebr. 6,5; Hebr. 6,6; seq. ከመ፡ c. Subj. 4 Esr. 9,33; c. በኀበ፡ pers. Matth. 19,26; c. ለ፡ pers. Hebr. 6,18 rom.; c. Acc. pers. ( possibile est alicui i.e. potest aliquis ): ኵሉ፡ ይትከሀለከ፡ Job 42,2; በከመ፡ ይትከሀለከ፡ Sir. 38,11; ኢተክህተሙ፡ በዊአ፡ ውስተ፡ ሀገር፡ 2 Reg. 17,17; Ps. 140,8; Rom. 12,18; Marc. 6,5. 2 a potentiâ superare aliquem: ኢትሕትት፡ ዘይትከሀለከ፡ μὴ ἐξέταζε τὰ ἰσχυρότερά σου Sir. 3,21. b impersonaliter: ኢተክህሎ፡ ላዕሌሃ፡ ei non obtigit potentia super eam (mulierem) i.e. eam (resistentem) superare non potuit, Sx. Masc. 21(bis).

woorden.betekenis: sacerdos, summus, presbyter, archipresbyter, classis, colleg
woorden.definitie: subst. m. [כֹּהֵן ܟܳܗܢܳܐ كَاهِنٌ], Pl. ካህናት፡ (gramm. § 133, a sacerdos Dei veri Gen. 14,18; Israelitarum Ex. Lev. al. sexcenties; Matth. 8,4; Matth. 12,4 al.; ጋይራስ፡ ካህን፡ ለዳዊት፡ 2 Reg. 20,25; ይከውነኒ፡ ካህነ፡ Ex. 40,11; Jud. 17,10; ከህን፡ ዐቢይ፡ summus sacerdos Num. 35,25; Zach. 3,1; Judith 4,6; Judith 15,8; Sir. 50,1; ከህን፡ ዘየዐቢ፡ እምአኀዊሁ፡ Lev. 21,10; ሊቀ፡ ካህናት፡ summus sacerdos Lev. 4,3; Hebr. 2,17; Hebr. 4,14; ሊቃነ፡ ካህናት፡ Matth. 2,4; Matth. 16,21; ፳ወ፬ካህናተ፡ ሰማይ፡ (πρεςβύτεροι Apoc. 4,4; Apoc. 4,10) Sx. Hed. 24; sacerdos vel presbyter Christianorum, Syn.; F.N. 6; Genz. f. 36; Genz. f. 37; Genz. f. 38; Genz. f. 39; Genz. f. 40; Genz. f. 41; Genz. f. 42; Genz. f. 43; Genz. f. 44; Genz. f. 45; Genz. f. 46; Genz. f. 47; Genz. f. 48, al.; ርእሰ፡ ካህናት፡ archipresbyter F.N. 4; ንፍቀ፡ ካህን፡ Lit. 161,3 i.q. ንፍቀ፡ ቀሲስ፡ q.v. - Pl. ካህናት፡ etiam pro abstracto usurpatur classis vel collegium sacerdotum 1 Reg. 2,36; 1 Par. 29,22 var. kāhǝn a ካህናተ፡ ደብተራ፡ kāhǝnāta dabtarā priests that serve in the royal tent ወዘያወጹኡ፡ ዘንተ፡ ተዝካርየ፡ ወተዝካረ፡ እሉ፡ በዓላትየ፡ ውእቶሙ፡ ካህናተ፡ ደብተራ፡ በበዕለቶሙ፡ እምዓመት፡ እስከ፡ ዓመት፡ ወኅልቆሙ፡ ፵ወ፬። ‘Ceux qui célébreront ma commémoraison et la commémoraison de mes fêtes sont les prêtres du tabernacle, chacun à son jour, d’un bout à l’autre de l’année: leur nombre est de 44’ 54 l. 8–10 (ed.), 65 l. 1–4 (tr.); ወእንዘ፡ ንቡራን፡ ውስተ፡ ጸፍጻፍ፡ ካህናተ፡ ደብተራ፡ ‘et pendant que les prêtres du sanctuaire se tenaient debout sur le pavé’ 64 l. 8–9 (ed.), 77 l. 9–10 (tr.); ሐደስኩ፡ አነ፡ ደጅ፡ አዝማች፡ ውቤ፡ ዘስመ፡ ጥምቀትየ፡ ኪዳነ፡ ማርያም፡ በዘመነ፡ ዮሕንስ፡ ምድረ፡ መዶጌ፡ ለእመነ፡ ጽዮን፡ ገበዘ፡ አክሱም፡ ወሠራዕኩ፡ ፵ወ፬፡ ካህናተ፡ ደብተራ፡ ‘Moi, le daǧ azmāč Oubié, dont le nom de baptême est Kidāna Māryām, j’ai donné―du temps de l’évangéliste Jean―la terre de Madogē à ma mère Ṣyon, cathédrale d’Aksoum, et j’ai réglé les 44 ecclésiastiques du tabernacle,’ 64 l. 14–17 (ed.), 77 l. 16–19 (tr.); ሐደስኩ፡ ለእምነ፡ ጽዮን፡ ገበዘ፡ አክሱም፡ ምድረ፡ ኵሉ፡ ይፈርሃ፡ ወሠራዕኩ፡ ካህናተ፡ ደብተራ፡ ‘[Moi, daǧ azmāč Oubié], j’ai renouvelé à ma mère Ṣyon, cathédrale d’Aksoum, [la concession de] la terre de Kuellu Yfarhā, et j’ai réglé les ecclésiastiques du tabernacle’ 64 l. 24–26 (ed.), 78 l. 2–4 (tr.), vid. ደብተራ፡ C a for ሊቀ፡ ካህናት፡ vid. ሊቅ፡ (TraCES) b for ርእሰ፡ ካህናት፡ vid. ርእስ፡ (Leslau)

woorden.betekenis: sacerdotem, constitui, esse, sacerdotio, fungi, sacra, perag
woorden.definitie: III,1 sacerdotem constitui vel esse, sacerdotio fungi, sacra peragere, de sacerdotibus Israelitarum et Christianorum: ለተክህኖ፡ ሊተ፡ Hez. 44,13; Lit. 165,4; ይርዐይ፡ መርዔተ፡ ወይትከሀን፡ Kid. f. 7; Clem. f. 210; Kedr f. 74; ተክህኖ፡ Clem. f. 210; Lit. 172,4; እፎ፡ ተኀረይከ፡ ለተክህኖ፡ M.M. f. 31.

woorden.betekenis: sacerdotium, munus, sacerdotale, summi, sacerdotis, sacerdot
woorden.definitie: subst. sacerdotium, munus sacerdotale: Ps. 98,6; 1 Petr. 2,5; ተኀርየ፡ ዘርአ፡ ሌዊ፡ ለክህነት፡ Kuf. 30; ሳዶቅ፡ ተሠይመ፡ ውስተ፡ ክህነት፡ (v. ካህናት፡) 1 Par. 29,22; ሰዐርዎሙ፡ እምክህነቶሙ፡ 2 Esr. 2,62; አኅደግዎ፡ ክህነቶ፡ 1 Esr. 5,39; ግብረ፡ ክህነት፡ Luc. 1,8; ዐቢይ፡ ክህነት፡ munus summi sacerdotis Sir. 45,24; Christianorum: ኢይግበር፡ ሕዝባዊ፡ ግብረ፡ ክህነት፡ Did. 16; ኢይሠየም፡ ለክህነት፡ Kedr f. 78; Org. 1. a in Genitivo positum: sacerdotalis, ut: አልባስ፡ ዘክህነት፡ Ex. 39,19; Ex. 35,19; Kuf. 32; ሕዝበ፡ ክህነት፡ Kuf. 33. b sacerdotium i.e. sacerdotes, populus sacerdotalis: ይኩን፡ መንግሥተ፡ ወክህነተ፡ ወሕዝበ፡ ቅዱሰ፡ Kuf. p. 64(at legendum videtur ዘክህነት፡, cfr. 1 Petr. 2,5). c pro σαββατισμός usurpatur Hebr. 4,9 rom.

woorden.betekenis: malum
woorden.definitie: malum vid. sub ከወለ፡

woorden.betekenis: universitas, et, universum, omnia
woorden.definitie: subst. כֹּל ܟܰܠ, كُلٌّ, proprie: universitas (Gesammtheit): ወለኵልሂ፡ et universum i.e. omnia, Asc. Jes. 4,18 (siquidem lectio sana est). In exemplo ስርጉት፡ በኵል፡ ሥን፡ ወላሕይ፡, a Lud. ex Org. allato, ኵል፡ manifesto errore pro ኵሉ፡ scriptum est. – Usitatur 1 annexis pron. suff., vid. ኵሉ፡ 2 annexa particula ሄ፡, vid. ኵልሄ፡ vel ኵለሄ፡

woorden.betekenis: omnis, omnes, nos, vos, omnia, quivis, unusquisque, et, sing
woorden.definitie: i.e. ኵል፡ c. pron. suff. III pers. m. Sing. (gramm. § 157,2) Acc. ኵሎ፡ (i.e. ኵለ፡ et ሁ፡). A Refertur ad res multas, individua multa, et latine redditur omnis. Quam ubi significationem habet, pron. suff. secundum genera et numeros variare licet, ut fem. Sing. ኵላ፡, Pl. m. ኵሎሙ፡, fem. ኵሎን፡, quamquam plerumque ኵሉ፡ sine ulla mutatione nominibus fem. et m., Sing. et Pl., apponitur. Sed ubi omnes ad pers. II vel I Pl. refertur, harum personarum pronomina voci ኵል፡ suffigantur necesse est, ut: ኵልነ፡, Acc. ኵለነ፡ nos omnes, ኵልክሙ፡ m., ኵልክን፡ fem., Acc. ኵለክሙ፡, ኵለክን፡ vos omnes. 1 omnis, omnes, a abs. (vel subsantive): ከመ፡ ትቅትል፡ ኵለነ፡ Ex. 16,3; አበ፡ ኵልነ፡ Rom. 4,16; ብዙኀ፡ ንስሕት፡ ኵልነ፡ Jac. 3,2; Jes. 64,8; ኵልነ፡ ኃጥኣን፡ ንሕነ፡ Sir. 8,5; 4 Esr. 10,9; 4 Esr. 10,10; ኵልክሙ፡ Jes. 14,29; Jes. 22,1; 1 Reg. 10,24; Ps. 2,10; Matth. 23,8; እመሂ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ዐለዉከ፡ Matth. 26,33; Matth. 27,22; Joh. 6,45; crebro etiam ኵሉ፡ omnes, ut Gen. 16,12; 1 Petr. 2,17; Marc. 1,37; Matth. 26,70; Joh. 1,7; Joh. 2,15 al., et omnia Matth. 8,33; Matth. 19,27; Marc. 4,11; Koh. 6,6; Hen. 5,2; 1 Reg. 16,4; 1 Petr. 4,7 al. b adjectivi instar alii nomini apponitur (plerumque praepositum, rarius postpositum): α sive utrumque in Sing.: ኵሉ፡ ሰብእ፡ Matth. 10,22; Joh. 5,23; እነግር፡ ኵሎ፡ ስበሓቲከ፡ Ps. 9,1; ኅድግዋ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ርስሐት፡ Jac. 1,21; ኵላ፡ እከይ፡ 1 Petr. 2,1; ኵሎ፡ ንዋዮሙ፡ Gen. 12,5; ኵሉ፡ እኪት፡ እንተ፡ Gen. 50,15; አይድዖሙ፡ ዘኵሎ፡ ቃለ፡ Ex. 19,7; ኵላ፡ ትእዛዝየ፡ Num. 15,40; ኵሉ፡ ሕዝብ፡ Matth. 24,9; ኵሎ፡ አምሳለ፡ Marc. 4,13. β sive utrumque in Pl.: ኵሎሙ፡ ኃጥኣን፡ Ps. 144,21; Matth. 27,1; Marc. 7,3; ለኵሎን፡ ኀጣውእ፡ 1 Petr. 4,8; Matth. 25,7. γ sive ኵሉ፡ solum in Pl.: ኵሎን፡ በረከት፡ Kuf. p. 96; ኵሎሙ፡ ይእቲ፡ ትውልድ፡ Num. 32,13; Matth. 1,17; Matth. 10,30. δ sive ኵሉ፡ solum in Sing. (in specie ante nomina inanimatorum et rerum): ኵሉ፡ መዋዕሊሁ፡ Gen. 5,5; ኵሉ፡ ቀላያት፡ Gen. 7,11; Gen. 9,10; ኵሉ፡ ዕፀው፡ Luc. 21,29; Luc. 24,27; ኵሉ፡ አሕዛብ፡ Luc. 24,47; Marc. 4,31; Marc. 6,33; Marc. 7,19. ε cum adjectivis et pronominibus: ኵሉ፡ ነዋኅ፡ πᾶν ὑψηλόν Job 41,25; ምስለ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ኵሉ፡ Jes. 5,25; Joh. 15,21; ነገርዎ፡ ኵሎ፡ እንተ፡ ረከበቶሙ፡ Gen. 42,29; Ex. 3,16; Gen. 7,22; Ps. 2,13; Col. 3,17 al. 2 omnis i.e. quivis, unusquisque, (jeder): ለኵሉ፡ ነፍስ፡ Gen. 9,10; Gen. 17,12; ኵሉ፡ ዐራት፡ Lev. 15,4; ኵሉ፡ ለባዊ፡ Sir. 18,28; አተወ፡ ኵሉ፡ ውስተ፡ ርስቱ፡ Judith 16,21; ያስተርኢ፡ ለዐይነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ወያአምር፡ ኵሉ፡ Kuf. 1; Hen. 2,1; Luc. 3,5; Luc. 3,9; ኵሉ፡ ዘሰአለከ፡ Luc. 6,30; Luc. 6,47; 1 Joh. 3,9; ἕκαστος 1 Cor. 7,20; Matth. 16,27; Luc. 2,3; Luc. 6,44; etiam ኵሉ፡ ኵሉ፡ omnes et singuli Sx. Haml. 27Enc. a ullus, quicumque Deut. 4,25; Deut. 17,1; Deut. 27,21; Kuf. p. 166, l. 12; cum negandi particula: nullus, nihil Ex. 12,16; Ex. 12,48; Lev. 3,17; Jud. 13,4; 2 Reg. 18,13; 1 Cor. 1,29. b omnis generis, quilibet, varius, Act. 13,10; Col. 1,9; Rom. 15,13; Matth. 4,23; Matth. 9,35. 3 ኵሉ፡ universum, universitas rerum: አምላከ፡ ኵሉ፡ Kuf. 22; እግዚአ፡ ኵሉ፡ Lit.; እንተ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ catholica, ut: ቅድስት፡ እንተ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ Cyr. ad Reg. f. 28; Clem. f. 112; Clem. f. 120; Clem. f. 131; Genz. f. 92. B Refertur ad rem unam, continuam, et latine vertitur: totus. Quam ubi significationem habet, nonnisi formas ኵሉ፡ et ኵላ፡ adhibere licet, eaeque nonnisi cum nominibus Sing. componuntur. (Ad nomina Pl. vel ad personas I et II Sing. et I, II, III Pl. relata, vox totus nomine ኵለንታ፡ c. pron. suff. exprimitur). Exempla: ውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ Gen. 9,19; Gen. 11,1; ኵሉ፡ ሕዝቦሙ፡ Gen. 19,4; ኵሎ፡ በግዖ፡ Ex. 29,18; Ps. 32,8; Ps. 65,3; 1 Reg. 14,23; ኵሉ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ Jac. 3,2; ኵሉ፡ ሕንጻ፡ Eph. 2,21; ኵላ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፡ Matth. 3,5; Marc. 11,18; በኵሉ፡ ልብክሙ፡ Deut. 4,29; Ps. 110,1; ኵላ፡ ሌሊተ፡ 1 Reg. 15,11; 1 Reg. 19,24; Ex. 10,13. C Adverbialiter usurpatur a ኵሉ፡ prorsus: ኵሉ፡ ለምዕር፡ ወግብተ፡ διὰ τάχους ἐξάπινα Sir. 11,21; cfr. ኵሉ፡ ዘከመ፡ 4 Reg. 16,11. b በኵሉ፡ α omnino, prorsus ὅλως Job 21,23. β quaqua, ubique, omnifariam: πάντη Act. 24,3; Kuf. 4; በኵሉ፡ ኀበ፡ ubicumque Kuf. 27; Ex. 10,23; Lev. 23,31; ubicumque ውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘ፡ Jos. 1,9.

woorden.betekenis: quoquo, versus, ex, omnibus, partibus, ubivis, ubique, plenu
woorden.definitie: et ኵለሄ፡ (i.e. ኵል፡ et ሄ፡, q.v. col. adv. 1 Absolute, sine praepositione praemissa: quoquo versus, ex omnibus partibus, ubivis, ubique; a ኵልሄ፡ Marc. 16,20 rom.; ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ኵልሄ፡ Ex. 10,13; tamquam Subjectum usurpatum est: ምሉእ፡ እምኔሁ፡ ኵልሄ፡ plenum est eo (quoquoversus i.e.) universum, Hom. Jac. Sar. b ኵለሄ፡ Job 2,2; ወኵለሄ፡ ተሐረትም፡ Sir. 22,5; 1 Tim. 4,15 rom.; ተሐውር፡ ኵለሄ፡ ኀበ፡ ፈነውኩከ፡ quocumque Jer. 1,7; ኀበ፡ ታንሶሱ፡ ኵለሄ፡ ubicumque ambulat Sx. Haml. 26Enc. 2 Praemissis praepositionibus: a በኵልሄ፡ vel በኵለሄ፡ ubique: Luc. 9,6; Marc. 16,20 Platt; Act. 24,3; Rom. 16,19; Hebr. 13,4; አዐቅበከ፡ በኵለሄ፡ Kuf. 27; Kuf. 32; Sir. 22,6; Sir. 50,22; በኵልሄ፡ v. በኵለሄ፡ Jes. 42,22; Judith 9,2; Sap. 2,9; Clem. f. 8; በኵልሄ፡ ኀበ፡ ubicumque: Ex. 40,32; Lev. 3,17; Lev. 7,26. b እንተ፡ ኵለሄ፡ vel ኵልሄ፡ ab omni parte, circumcirca: Job 19,10; እንተ፡ ኵልሄ፡ (v. ኵለሄ፡) ይነድፍዋ፡ Jer. 27,29; Jer. 31,31; Org. c እምኵልሄ፡ vel እምኵለሄ፡ undique, Sir. 51,7; Jer. 20,9; Dan. ap. 1,22; Hen. 28,3; Marc. 1,45; Ex. 28,24; d ውስተ፡ ኵለሄ፡ quoquoversus: አንሶሰወ፡ ውስተ፡ ኵለሄ፡ Sx. Genb. 26Enc. kʷǝllǝhe, kʷǝllahe C vid. also ሄ፡ (Grébaut)

woorden.betekenis: totum, universum, totus, meum, ego, universus, cunctus
woorden.definitie: subst. totum, universum (gramm. § 157,2); non nisi subjunctis pronominibus suff. usurpatur, et latine vertitur 1 totus; quoad constructionem, a suam subsantivi vim retinet, ut: ኵለንታየ፡ ተመስወ፡ (non: ተመሶኩ፡) totum meum i.e. ego totus Hen. 60,3; ኵለንታከ፡ ኢየሀሉ፡ (non: ተሀሉ፡) ኀበ፡ ነኪርት፡ Prov. 5,20; ኵለንታሃ፡ ለዛቲ፡ ምድር፡ Gen. 13,15; እንተ፡ ኵለንታሆሙ፡ ምሉኣን፡ Apoc. 4,8; ወኵለንታሁ፡ በወርቅ፡ ወበዕንቍ፡ Esth. 5apocr.; ተቅዋመ፡ ማኅቶት፡ ዘኵለንታሃ፡ ዘወርቅ፡ Zach. 4,2. b adjectivi instar alii nomini apponitur: ኵለንታሃ፡ ሌሊተ፡ Ex. 14,20; Ex. 19,5; Ex. 19,18; 4 Reg. 10,21; ክበብ፡ ኵለንታሃ፡ 2 Par. 4,2; Gen. 14,10; Matth. 5,30; Apoc. 6,12; et ubi Subjecti vice fungitur, Praedicatum numerum et personam et genus pronominis ei suffixi sequitur: ወትከውን፡ ኵለንታከ፡ ብሩሀ፡ Luc. 11,36; ኵለንታኪ፡ ሠናይት፡ Cant. 4,7; ትጠፍእ፡ ኵለንታሃ፡ Jer. 27,13; Judith 4,7; እንተ፡ ማሰነት፡ ኵለንታሃ፡ Hez. 38,8; Gen. 25,25; Ex. 4,6; Hen. 27,1. 2 universus, cunctus: እስመ፡ መልአ፡ መቅሠፍታ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵለንታሃ፡ εἰς πᾶν τὸ πλῆθος αὐτῆς Hez. 7,12.

woorden.betekenis: corona, diadema, cidaris, tiara, mitra, infula, taenia, sert
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. አክሊላት፡ ܟܠܺܝܠܐ, إِكْلِيلٌ corona, diadema, አክሊላት፡ ውስተ፡ ርእሶሙ፡ Kuf. 16; አእተተ፡ አክሊልየ፡ እምርእስየ፡ Job 19,9; Judith 3,7; አክሊለ፡ ትፍሥሕት፡ ታስተቄጽለከ፡ Sir. 6,31; ወድቀት፡ አክሊለ፡ ርእስነ፡ Thren. 5,16; አክሊል፡ ዘሦክ፡ Marc. 15,17; regia 2 Reg. 1,10 (βασίλειον); 1 Par. 10,2; Ps. 20,3; Sir. 11,5 (διάδημα); Clem. f. 30(de Nimrodo); አክሊሎሙ፡ ለአእሩግ፡ ብዙኅ፡ ትምህርት፡ Sir. 25,6; አክሊለ፡ ጥበብ፡ ወትፍሥሕት፡ Sir. 15,6; አክሊለ፡ ክብር፡ Sir. 35,2; አክሊለ፡ ስብሓት፡ Sir. 47,6 (διάδημα); Prov. 1,9; Prov. 12,4; Jes. 22,17; Jes. 28,1; Jes. 28,3 (fem.); Jes. 28,5; Jes. 62,3; Jer. 13,18; Thren. 2,15; Hez. 16,12; 2 Tim. 4,8; Apoc. 2,10; Jac. 1,12; አክሊላት፡ Zach. 6,11; Apoc. 4,4; Asc. Jes. 7,22; Asc. Jes. 8,26; Asc. Jes. 9,10; martyrum: አክሊለ፡ ስምዕ፡ Chrys. Ta. 11; Deg.; ነሥእ፡ አክሊለ፡ (i.q. ተከለለ፡) Sx. Masc. 7; Org.; አክሊለ፡ መዊእ፡ ጽጉይ፡ Org. a cidaris, tiara, mitra, infula, sacerdotis Israelitarum, κίδαρις in Cod. C Ex. 28,4; Ex. 28,35; Ex. 36,36 et Lev. 16,4; μίτρα Lev. 8,9; sacerdotum Christianorum F.M. 31,5 (vid. sub መንዲል፡); Kedr f. 1(vid. sub ቀሚጽ፡) b corona i.e. taenia, στεφάνη Jer. 52,18. c sertum vel catenula, χαλαστά 2 Par. 3,5. ʾaklil G አክሊለ፡ ሃይማኖት፡ ʾaklila hāymānot couronne de la foi. ለአግብርቲከ፡ አክሊለ፡ ክብር፡ አሜን፡ አክሊለ፡ ሃይማኖት፡ አሜን። 166 (Grébaut gives page 20 but in the quoted edition the citation appears on p. 166). vid. ሃይማኖት፡ 10 L አክሊል ʾaklil crown, diadem 15b

woorden.betekenis: clamare, exclamare, proclamare, vociferari, acclamare, incla
woorden.definitie: I,1 et I,2 [non tam ad ጸርኀ፡ ጠርአ፡ quam ad כרז (mand. ܟܠܙ), (ܐܰܟܪܰܚ قلح قلخ?) referendum videtur] Subj. I,1 ይክላሕ፡, clamare, exclamare, proclamare, vociferari, (βοᾶν, κράζειν), ከልሕ፡ et ክላሕ፡ Jes. 40,6; Jes. 40,9; ከልሕ፡ በኀይልከ፡ Jes. 58,1; ኵላ፡ ምድር፡ ትኬልሕ፡ Jes. 14,1; Jes. 31,4; ከልሐ፡ በዐቢይ፡ ቃል፡ Jes. 36,13; ኢይኬልሕ፡ ወኢይጤርእ፡ Jes. 42,2; Jes. 42,11; ይከልሕ፡ et ይኬልሕ፡ Jes. 44,5; Jes. 52,5 (ὀλολύζετε); ዘእንበለ፡ ይክልሑ፡ Jes. 65,24; ክልሑ፡ Jer. 22,20; Hez. 9,1; Zach. 1,14; Zach. 1,17; Zach. 7,13; Hab. 1,2; Dan. apocr. 1,46; Dan. apocr. 3,4; Ps. 65,16; ሰራሕኩ፡ በከልሖ፡ Ps. 68,4; Ps. 130,3; Luc. 1,42 (ἀνεφώνησε). Luc. 19,40; Joh. 12,13 rom. a acclamare, inclamare: ይኬልሑ፡ ፩፩ ምስለ፡ ካልኡ፡ Jes. 6,3; ይኬልሕ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ Kuf. 11. b de hominibus alta voce cantantibus: ከመ፡ ይርአይ፡ ቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ ወይክላሕ፡ በውስቴታ፡ በቃለ፡ መዝሙር፡ Gad. Za Mich.; ክላሕ፡ በኀይል፡ ሃሌሉያ፡ Cod. Mus. Brit. LIV,7. c de bestiis, ut leone: Jes. 31,4; de daemonibus Jes. 34,14; de tonitru: ይኬልሕ፡ ቃለ፡ ነጐድጓድ፡ M.M. f. 12; de inanimatis, ut: Apostoli ከልሑ፡ ከመ፡ ቀርን፡ Lit. Joh. – Voc. Ae.: ዐውየወ፡ ከልሐ፡ ወውዐ፡ ዘ፡ ጫኸ።

woorden.betekenis: canis, scorto, virili
woorden.definitie: subst., m., Pl. ከለባት፡, አክልብት፡, አክላብ፡, Pl. Pl. አካልብት፡ כֶּלֶב ܟܰܠܒܳܐ كَلْبٌ; canis, Jes. 66,3; Koh. 9,4; Prov. 7,22; Prov. 26,11; Tob. 5,17; 1 Reg. 17,43; 1 Reg. 24,15; ርእሰ፡ ከልብ፡ 2 Reg. 3,8; 2 Reg. 9,8; ከልብ፡ ገብአ፡ ዲበ፡ ቅያኡ፡ 2 Petr. 2,22; ከልብ፡ እቡድ፡ Did. 6; ከለባተ፡ መራዕይየ፡ Job 30,1; Jes. 56,10; ከለባት፡ ይቤጽልዎሙ፡ Jer. 15,3; ከለባት፡ ብዙኃን፡ Ps. 21,17; 3 Reg. 22,38; Phil. 3,2; Matth. 7,6; Marc. 7,27; Marc. 7,28 (ubi ed. Rom. ከልባት፡ habet); Luc. 16,21; አክልብት፡ Jes. 56,10 var.; Sir. 13,18; Sx.; አክላብ፡ Apoc. 22,15; Hen. 89,42; Hen. 90,4; አካልብት፡ Hen. 89,10; transl. de scorto virili Deut. 23,9; Apoc. 22,15.

woorden.betekenis: inclusit, retinuit, denegavit, custodivit, arcere, cohibere,
woorden.definitie: I,1 [ܟܠܳܐ id.; כָּלָא inclusit, retinuit, denegavit; كَلَأَ II retinuit; I custodivit; vid. etiam ከልከለ፡] Subj. ይክላእ፡, 1 arcere: አብራም፡ ይከልኦሙ፡ (sc. aves) Kuf. 14. 2 cohibere, retinere, c. Acc.: ከሊአ፡ መንፈስ፡ Koh. 8,8; ከልአ፡ ዝናመ፡ እምሰማይ፡ Job 12,15; በቃለ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ከልኦ፡ ለሰማይ፡ Sir. 48,3; Hez. 31,15; ኢትክልኦሙ፡ Jes. 43,6; Ps. 39,12; c. Acc. et እምነ፡, ut: እምፍኖተ፡ ዐመፃ፡ ከላእኩ፡ እግርየ፡ Ps. 118,101; Hen. 100,2. 3 prohibere, a impedire, avertere Hen. 41,9, c. Acc. ክልኦሙ፡ Num. 11,28; 1 Reg. 25,7; 4 Esr. 1,11; Asc. Jes. 9,3; Asc. Jes. 9,4; c. Acc. pers. et እምነ፡ rei, ut: ክላእ፡ ልሳነከ፡ እምእኩይ፡ Ps. 33,14; c. dupl. Acc.: ከልእዎሙ፡ ለሕዝብ፡ ጌጋየ፡ κωλῦσαι λαὸν ἀπὸ ἁμαρτίας Sir. 46,7; 2 Petr. 2,16; ይከልእዎ፡ ትድምርተ፡ Can. Sard. 15; c. Acc. seq. ከመ፡ ኢ፡ c. Subj.: 1 Reg. 25,33; Rom. 3,3; ይከልኦ፡ ከመ፡ ኢያንቀልቅል፡ Chrys. ho. 11; seq. ኢ፡ c. Subj. verbi: 1 Thess. 2,16; Thren. 4,18; Jes. 28,9; አኀዞ፡ ለንጉሥ፡ ወከልኦ፡ ኢይባእ፡ (v. ይባእ፡) Dan. apocr. 13,19; c. Acc. Infin.: Hen. 63,10; c. Acc. pers. et Acc. Infin.: እመ፡ ከላእክዎ፡ (ለሰማይ፡) አውርዶ፡ ዝናም፡ 2 Par. 7,13; ኢትክልኦ፡ ነቢበ፡ ቃሉ፡ ለዘይትናገር፡ Sir. 4,23; 2 Esr. 6,8; ከመ፡ ይክልእዎሙ፡ ኀሊፈ፡ Judith 4,7; Jud. 15,1; Matth. 19,14. b recusare, denegare alicui aliquid, c. Acc. rei et እምነ፡ pers.: Ps. 88,33; አነኑ፡ ከላእኩ፡ እምኔኪ፡ ፍሬ፡ ከርሥኪ፡ Kuf. 28; ኢይከልእ፡ ምሕረቶ፡ እምገብሩ፡ Kuf. 45; c. Acc. pers. et እምነ፡ rei: Koh. 2,10; Koh. 6,2; c. dupl. Acc.: Ps. 20,2; Gen. 30,2; Prov. 24,30; ኢትክልኦ፡ ለነዳይ፡ ሕይወቶ፡ Sir. 4,1. 4 vetare, c. Acc. pers.: Am. 2,12; c. Acc. rei: 1 Tim. 4,3; c. dupl. Acc.: ዘከልኦሙ፡ Judith 11,12; Gen. 3,11; c. Acc. pers. seq. ኢ፡ c. Subj. verbi: Luc. 5,14; Luc. 8,51; Marc. 11,16; ዘከላእከ፡ ኢይባኡ፡ Thren. 1,10; vel seq. ከመ፡ ኢ፡ c. Subj.: Act. 5,28; እግዚአብሔር፡ ከልኦ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይእበይ፡ F.N. 27.

woorden.betekenis: arceri, coërceri, includi, cohiberi, retineri, intermitti, p
woorden.definitie: III,1 A Pass. 1 arceri i.e. coërceri, includi: ይትከላእ፡ ውስተ፡ ብካይ፡ ወሐቅየ፡ ስነን፡ Clem. f. 183. 2 cohiberi, retineri: እመ፡ ተከልአ፡ ዝናመ፡ ሰማይ፡ 3 Reg. 8,35; Hen. 80,3; Hen. 100,11; intermitti: ተከልአ፡ ፀብእ፡ ፭ዕለተ፡ Jsp. p. 359. 3 prohiberi: Lit. 173,2; c. እምነ፡ rei: ይትከላእ፡ እምቍርባን፡ (sc. a communione sacramenti) F.M. 12,2; ይትከላእ፡ እምቍርባን፡ ፪ዓመተ፡ F.M. 6,13; Kedr f. 65; seq. Infin. verbi: Ex. 36,6; Hen. 100,12; ይትከላእ፡ ተመጥዎ፡ ቍርባን፡ II Abt. 10; ኢይትከላእ፡ ተደምሮ፡ ምስለ፡ ማኅበር፡ ወኢእምነሢአ፡ ቍርባን፡ F.M. 6,6; seq. ከመ፡ ኢ፡ c. Subj., Hen. 100,11. a vetari: ተከልአኒ፡ ገቢር፡ (vetitus sum facere) Kid. f. 14. b prohiberi ad tempus a munere: ይትከላእ፡ እምተልእኮ፡ ፫ዓመተ፡ F.M. 6,6; distinguitur a ተመትረ፡ removeri, ut: (clericus) ይትከላእ፡ ወእመ፡ አበየ፡ ይትመተር፡ F.M. 12,1. B Refl., se avertere i.e. aversari, repudiare, abstinere, c. እምነ፡ rei: ዘይትከላእ፡ እምተግሣጽ፡ ὃς ἀπωθεῖται παιδείαν Prov. 15,32; ወልድ፡ ዘይትከላእ፡ እምዐቂበ፡ ትምህርተ፡ አብ፡ Prov. 19,27; ተከልኦ፡ እምጽእለት፡ ἀποστρέφεσθαι λοιδορίας Prov. 20,3; በእንተ፡ ዘይትከላእ፡ እምተዋስቦ፡ ኀልዮ፡ ከመ፡ ይእቲ፡ ሕርምት፡ F.M. 9; ትእዛዝ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምእመናን፡ በምልኦሙ፡ ውእቱ፡ ተከልኦ፡ እምአንስቲያሆሙ፡ ኵሎ፡ ለያልየ፡ እሑዳት፡ ወበእሙራት፡ በዓላት፡ F.M. 10,3.

woorden.betekenis: prohibitio, impedimentum, impedimenta
woorden.definitie: n. act., Pl. ክልአታት፡, prohibitio, impedimentum: ዘእንበለ፡ ክልአት፡ Genz. f. 67(vid. sub ማኅለፍት፡); Lit. 163,4; Deus ወሃቢ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ክልአት፤ ጸጋዊ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ደንጽዎ፡ Lit. Epiph.; አልቦ፡ ክልአት፡ ለሞትነ፡ ἀναποδισμός Sap. 2,5; ዘእንበለ፡ ምሕረት፡ ወኢክልአት፡ ἀπαραίτητος Sap. 16,16; ክልአታት፡ impedimenta (Abhaltungen) Phlx. 55. (At Prov. 19,13 ክልአት፡ est lectio corrupta pro ካልእት፡).

woorden.betekenis: seclusio, sejunctio, separatio, res, separata, duae, diversa
woorden.definitie: subst. [c. terminatione Dualis (gramm. § 131) formatum e ክልእ፡ i.e. כֶּלֶא, proprie: seclusio, sejunctio, separatio, deinde res separata, unde כִּלְאַיִם duae res diversae, Ges. thes. p. 684; كِلَا كِلْتَا ambo] 1 n. num., femininis, rarius masculinis junctum (gramm. § 158): duo, duae; ejus character est ፪, usurpatur absolute: ክልኤ፡ ይሄልዉ፡ Matth. 24,40; Matth. 18,16; Matth. 19,6; et aliis nominibus appositum: ክልኤ፡ አንስት፡ Hez. 23,2; 1 Reg. 1,2 var.; ክልኤ፡ እጐላት፡ 1 Reg. 6,7; Gen. 29,16; ክልኤ፡ ደቂቅ፡ Gen. 10,25; ክልኤ፡ ባሕታዊያን፡ Tob. 8,17; ክልኤ፡ ዘይት፡ Zach. 4,3; ክልኤ፡ አብትር፡ Zach. 11,7; Asc. Jes. 11,6; Asc. Jes. 11,7; Hez. 35,10; Matth. 2,16; Matth. 14,17; Matth. 14,19; Matth. 18,8; Matth. 18,9; Matth. 22,40. a par (jugum): ክልኤ፡ አእዱግ፡ 2 Reg. 16,1. b ለክልኤ፡ bifariam, dis-, ut: ተወሠረ፡ ለክልኤ፡ Asc. Jes. 5,14; Marc. 15,38. c passim respondet: duplex, δισσός, ut: በክልኤ፡ ልብ፡ ἐν καρδίᾳ δισσῇ Sir. 1,28; መላፄ፡ በሊኅ፡ ዘክልኤ፡ አፉሁ፡ (cujus ora duo i.e.) δίστομος Sir. 21,3; ዘክልኤ፡ ልቡ፡ δίψυχος Jac. 1,8; episcopus ኢይኩን፡ ዘክልኤ፡ ልቡ፡ ወዘክልኤ፡ ልሳኑ፡ Did. 4; ድንግልናኪ፡ ክልኤ፡ ዘውሣጤ፡ ወ(ዘ)አፍአ፡ Sx. Mij. 21Enc. 2 ambo, uterque, a ክልኤ፡ አጥባትኪ፡ Cant. 7,4; Ex. 29,13; ምስለ፡ ክልኤ፡ አዋልዲሃ፡ Dan. apocr. 1,15; ክልኤ፡ ድቂቆ፡ Gen. 48,1. b c. pron. suff. α abs.: ክልኤሆሙ፡ ἀμφότεροι Tob. 5,17; ወፅኣ፡ ክልኤሆን፡ ኅቡረ፡ Judith 13,10; 2 Esr. 17,2; Hebr. 11,12; Matth. 9,17; ክልኤነ፡ 1 Reg. 20,42; 3 Reg. 3,18; de rebus; ክልኤሆሙ፡ እምውስተ፡ አፍ፡ ይወጽኡ፡ Sir. 28,12; Sir. 20,25; Sir. 20,30; Sir. 41,14; ይእዜ፡ ይመጽኡ፡ እሉ፡ ክልኤሆሙ፡ ላዕሌኪ፡ Jes. 47,9. β aliis nominibus appositum; ክልኤሆሙ፡ ደቂቁ፡ Tob. 1,21; ክልኤሆን፡ እራሓተ፡ እደዊሁ፡ 1 Reg. 5,4; Lev. 3,4; Gen. 19,15; Luc. 5,7; Matth. 20,21. – Pro ክልኤሆሙ፡ passim reperitur ክልኤዎሙ፡, ut Zach. 6,13 Cod. Laur.

woorden.betekenis: duo, duae, in, psalmo, secundo, bini, duplex, anceps, bipart
woorden.definitie: m. (raro fem. ut Matth. 10,29), ክልኤቲ፡ fem., n. num. Acc. ክልኤተ፡ (gramm. § 158), duo, duae, abs.: Matth. 18,20; Matth. 24,41; Matth. 5,41; Gen. 44,27; ክልኤቱ፡ እምኔክሙ፡ Matth. 18,19; Marc. 16,12; ክልኤተ፡ አውራኅ፡ Jud. 11,37; appositum aliis nominibus: ደቂቁ፡ ክልኤቱ፡ 1 Reg. 1,3; ወካልኣን፡ ከልኤቱ፡ ዕደው፡ 1 Reg. 28,8; Matth. 8,28; Matth. 9,27; 1 Tim. 5,19; ክልኤቲ፡ አነስት፡ Zach. 5,9; ክልኤቲ፡ ኀጣውእ፡ Sir. 7,8; ክልኤተ፡ አባግዐ፡ Jes. 7,21; Gen. 1,16; ክልኤተ፡ ዕደወ፡ 1 Reg. 10,2; ዐሠርተ፡ ወክልኤተ፡ አሕዛበ፡ Gen. 17,20; Matth. 10,10; Matth. 25,22; ክልኤቱ፡ እሙንቱ፡ እለ፡ ያመጽእዋ፡ ለኀጢአት፡ δύο εἴδη Sir. 23,16; እሉ፡ ክልኤቱ፡ ይጸንሑኪ፡ δύο ταῦτα Jes. 51,19; ውስተ፡ መዝሙር፡ ዘክልኤቱ፡ in psalmo secundo Act. 13,33. a repetitum vel praefixo በበ፡, ለለ፡, bini: ክልኤተ፡ ክልኤተ፡ Gen. 7,2; Gen. 7,3; በበክልኤቱ፡ Gen. 45,22; Marc. 6,7; Luc. 10,1. b passim respondet: duplex, anceps, bipartitus: ኵሉ፡ በበ፡ ክልኤቱ፡ አሐዱ፡ አሐዱ፡ በበዚአሁ፡ Sir. 36,15; ዘክልኤቱ፡ ቃሉ፡ δίγλωσσος Sir. 6,1; Sir. 25,14; Sir. 28,13; ኃጥእ፡ ዘክልኤቱ፡ ግዕዙ፡ Sir. 2,12; በክልኤቱ፡ ልብ፡ Sir. 1,28 var.; ወእንተ፡ ክልኤቲ፡ ውእቱ፡ Lev. 11,3; ተሠጠ፡ ወክልኤተ፡ ኮነ፡ Matth. 27,51. – [Amh. ሁለት፡].

woorden.betekenis: diversus, alius, praeter, secundus, secundo, alter, socius,
woorden.definitie: adj. (forma part.), fem. ካልእት፡, Pl. ካልኣን፡, m. ካልኣት፡ fem., 1 diversus, 1 Tim. 5,25; c. እምነ፡, ut: ሕጎሙ፡ ካልእ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ አሕዛብ፡ (ἔξαλλος) Esth. 2,8; F.M. 31,5 (vid. sub መንዲል፡); Hen. 40,2. 2 alius, a indefinite: α absolute, ut: ይዘግብ፡ ለባዕድ፡ ወካልእ፡ ይፈግዕ፡ በንዋዩ፡ Sir. 14,4; አልቦ፡ ካልእተ፡ እንተ፡ ከማየ፡ Jes. 47,10; Matth. 19,9; Matth. 26,71; ካልኣን፡ Matth. 16,14; Matth. 20,3; Matth. 20,6; Matth. 21,8; pro neutro: ቦ፡ ዘያደሉ፡ ለገጽ፡ እንዘ፡ ካልእ፡ ውስተ፡ ልቡ፡ Sir. 19,27. β alii nomini appositum: ወትከውን፡ ካልአ፡ ብእሴ፡ 1 Reg. 10,6; ለካልእ፡ ብእሲ፡ Gen. 29,19; ካልአ፡ ሕልመ፡ Gen. 37,9; Gen. 43,22; Deut. 20,5; Deut. 20,6; Matth. 2,12; Matth. 13,14; Matth. 13,31; Rom. 7,23; 1 Cor. 15,40; 1 Cor. 15,41; Gal. 1,6; ካልኣን፡ ዐቀብት፡ Matth. 21,41; Matth. 22,4; ይልበሱ፡ አልባሰ፡ ካልኣተ፡ Hez. 44,19; ካልአ፡ ሰቡዐ፡ መዋዕለ፡ Lev. 13,33; Matth. 25,16; Matth. 25,17; seq. ዘእንበለ፡ ( praeter ) Gen. 26,1. b ut ካልእ፡ definiatur (ὁ ἄλλος), plerumque pron. suff. annectunt, ut: ወካልእታሂ፡ ማርያ፡ καὶ ἡ ἄλλη Μαρία Matth. 27,61; Matth. 28,1; ካልኣኒሁ፡ አርዳእ፡ Joh. 20,25; Matth. 5,39; Matth. 8,9; Matth. 10,23; Matth. 12,13, vel pron. demonstr. addunt, ut: ዝኩ፡ ካልእ፡ ረድእ፡ Joh. 20,2; Joh. 20,3; Joh. 20,4; Joh. 20,8; rarius, maxime in Pl., omittunt, ut Joh. 21,8. 3 secundus: Gen. 1,8; Ex. 16,1; Num. 1,1; Zach. 1,1; Hagg. 1,1; Job 42,14; Dan. 2,1; 4 Esr. 6,57; Luc. 12,38; Apoc. 21,19; ubi absolute (alii nomini non appositum) usurpatur, pronomine suff. definitur: ወወፅአ፡ ካልኡሂ፡ 4 Esr. 11,14; Matth. 22,26; nota etiam: ካልእታ፡ ዐለወቶ፡ ለምታ፡ (secunda i.e.) secundo (τὸ δεύτερον) Sir. 23,23. 4 alter, Luc. 5,7; Gen. 17,21; ubi absolute usurpatur: ካልኡ፡, ut Matth. 21,30; Matth. 22,39; ካልእ፡ ኢዮርብዓም፡ Jerobeam II 4 Reg. 13,13; crebro: አሐዱ፡ – ወካልኡ፡ alter – alter: ሶበ፡ አሐዱ፡ ይድኅር፡ ወካልኡ፡ ይረግም፡ Sir. 34,29; Hen. 33,1; Jer. 24,2; Ps. 11,2; Matth. 6,24; Luc. 17,35; Luc. 23,39; Luc. 23,40. 5 socius, amicus, collega, quivis alius quocum vivimus, proximus, frater, (sensu biblico, vid. ቢጽ፡): ካልእየ፡ ἑταῖρε Matth. 20,13; Matth. 22,12; Matth. 26,50; ኵሲ፡ ካልኡ፡ ለዳዊት፡ Χουσὶ ὁ ἑταῖρος Δαυίδ 2 Reg. 15,37; (vid. Epil. N.T. rom., ubi Paulus III pontifex Romanus ካልኡ፡ ለጴጥሮስ፡ vocatur); ወለኵሎሙ፡ ካልኣኒሁ፡ Kuf. 37; ካልኣትየ፡ αἱ συνεταιρίδες μου Jud. 11,37; Jud. 11,38; ካልእትኪ፡ ἡ σύννυμφός σου Ruth 1,15; ὁ πλησίον σου ካልእከ፡ 1 Reg. 28,17; Lev. 18,20; Lev. 19,16; Lev. 19,17; Jac. 4,12; ካልእታ፡ Jer. 9,20; Cant. 5,2; ἀδελφός Lev. 25,25; πολίτης Hebr. 8,11; φίλος Jer. 9,5, al.

woorden.betekenis: secundus
woorden.definitie: (et ከልኣዊ፡), adj. rel., fem. ካልኢት፡ secundus, Phlx. 165; Phlx. 191. – Ubi de diei divisione in horas caet. agitur, ካልኢት፡ (etiam ካልእት፡) est [1/(60*60)] pars diei (vid. ኪክሮስ፡) Abush. 11 seq.

woorden.betekenis: exuere, detrahere, deponere, mutavit, alteravit, vestes, exu
woorden.definitie: (ከልአ፡) I,1 [vic. ቀልዐ፡ et alia verba sub ቀልዐ፡ memorata] Subj. ይክላዕ፡, exuere, detrahere, deponere vestes, calceos: ኢትክልዑ፡ አልባሲየ፡ Lud. e Vit. Dan.; ከላዕኩ፡ ክዳንየ፡ ዘእትዐጸፍ፡ ወወገርኩ፡ Vit. Dan.; ከልዐ፡ አልባሲሁ፡ ወለብሰ፡ ሠቀ፡ Vit. Dan.; ክላዕ፡ አሣእኒከ፡ እምእገሪከ፡ Clem. f. 169 (bis); vincula, Vit. Sam. [Lud. hujus verbi significatum definivit: mutavit, alteravit; mutavit vestes i.e. exuit; at m u tandi significatus nullo exemplo probatur].

woorden.betekenis: salix, Voc. Ae.:
woorden.definitie: et ኵሓ፡ subst., Pl. ኲሓት፡ salix arbor, ἰτέα, Lev. 23,40; ከመ፡ ኲሓ፡ (v. ኴሓ፡) ዘኀበ፡ ሙሐዘ፡ ማይ፡ Jes. 44,4; Kuf. p. 65; Pl. Ps. 136,2. – Voc. Ae.: ኲሓ፡ ዘ፡ ኽያ።

woorden.betekenis: commiscuit, agitando, mixtura, versicolor, varietas
woorden.definitie: vel ከሐከሐት፡ Hen. 32,3 vox obscura et dubia est. Rad. Abb. praebent አንከሐክሐ፡ ዘ፡ ፈተፈተ፡ (cfr. كَعْكَعَ commiscuit agitando ), quare nescio an illi nomini significatum mixtura versicolor, varietas tribuere liceat.

woorden.betekenis: negare, infitiari, recusare, ne, abnegare, denegare, infidel
woorden.definitie: I,1 [amh. ካደ፡; جَحَدَ, כָּחַשׁ, vic. כָּחַד vid. Ges. thes. p. 675] Subj. ይክሐድ፡, 1 negare id quod verum est, infitiari; abs.: Gen. 18,15; Matth. 26,70; Matth. 26,72; Luc. 8,45; Joh. 1,20; c. Acc. rei, ut: rem inventam F.N. 45. a recusare, ne, seq. ኢ፡ c. Subj. verbi Hebr. 11,24. b abnegare, denegare aliquem (i.e. negavit quis, se novisse aliquem), c. Acc.: ይክሕዱከ፡ Sap. 16,16; Matth. 10,33; Matth. 26,34; Marc. 14,27.. 2 in specie: negare eum vel id, cui quis obedientiam vel fidem debet, i.e a infidelem esse, non credere Act. 19,9. b inobedientem vel contumacem esse, rebellare: ኢይክሕድ፡ οὐκ ἀπειθῶ Jes. 50,5; c. Acc.: ዝንቱ፡ ወልድ፡ ይክሕደነ፡ Deut. 21,20; እለ፡ ኢይክሕድዎ፡ Sap. 1,2; Jes. 59,13 (ἀπειθεῖν); c. በ፡ rei: እስመ፡ ክሕድክሙ፡ በዝንቱ፡ ነገር፡ Jes. 30,12. c fidem alicui datam fallere, perfide agere, perfide violare vel deserere, deficere, desciscere, abs.: ክሕድነ፡ ἀπέστημεν Dan. 9,9; c. Acc. pers. vel rei: ክሕዱኒ፡ κατεφρόνησέ μου Hos. 6,7; ክሕዱኒ፡ ቤተ፡ እስራኤል፡ ἠθέτησεν Jer. 3,20; ክሒደ፡ ትክሕደኒ፡ Jes. 48,8; እምትጥበብ፡ ወትክሐድ፡ ሕጎ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ παραβαίνειν Sir. 19,24; ክሕዱ፡ ኪዳነ፡ ἤλλαξαν Jes. 24,5; 4 Esr. 5,11; ἀρνεῖσθαι Tit. 1,16; ኢይክል፡ ክሒደ፡ ርእሶ፡ non potest (se ipsum negare i.e.) a se ipso desciscere 2 Tim. 2,13; ክሕደ፡ መሐላ፡ F.M. 22,9; አምጽኡ፡ ላዕሌነ፡ መሐላ፡ ዘኢንክል፡ ክሒደ፡ Judith 8,30; c. ለ፡ 1 Thess. 4,8; c. በ፡ pers. vel rei: ክሕደት፡ በእግዚአብሔር፡ Sir. 23,23; Jos.7,11; 1 Joh. 2,22; 1 Joh. 2,23; c. እምነ፡ Tob. 1,4 (ἀπέστη); c. እምውስተ፡ Deut. 9,12 (παρέβησαν). d in specie: abnegare Deum Christum, abjurare fidem Christianam, apostatam fieri: ክሕደ፡ ሃይማኖቶ፡ 1 Tim. 5,8; 1 Tim. 5,12; ክሒድ፡ ስመ፡ እግዚእነ፡ ኢየሱስ፡ F.M. 16; Sx. ut Sx. Masc. 13; Syn., crebro.

woorden.betekenis: negari, obnegari
woorden.definitie: III,1 negari, obnegari: እለ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ይትከሐዱ፡ ወይትሀጐሉ፡ Hen. 52,8 (si non i.q. נִכְחַד).

woorden.betekenis: negatio, infitiatio, id quod fidei, verae religioni contrari
woorden.definitie: subst. negatio, infitiatio, a id quod fidei vel verae religioni contrarium est ( Unglaube ), haeresis, impietas: αἵρεσις ካሕድ፡ ዘሕርትምና፡ 2 Petr. 2,1; Act. 24,5; Sx. Masc. 17 Enc.; ut ethnicos converteret እምፍኖተ፡ ካሕድ፡ Sx. Ter 6 Enc. ትምህርተ፡ ካሕድ፡ Sx. Mij. 14 Enc.; እለ፡ ይገብሩ፡ ካሕደ፡ (Lud. ከሐደ፡) በላዕለ፡ ክርስቶስ፡ አምላክ፡ Sx. Jac. 8 Enc. b fides et inobedienta denegata ( Untreue ), perfidia, inobedientia, rebellio, ἀπείθεια Herm. p. 91; እስመ፡ ኵሉ፡ ካሕድ፡ ምግባሪሆሙ፡ Kuf. p. 85. c contradictio, α altercatio, contentio, contentionis studium: ἀντιλογίαι ካሕድ፡ (v. ጋእዝ፡) Prov. 18,18; Judae 11; ἐπιθεία Jac. 3,14; እለ፡ ደወዩ፡ ካሕደ፡ νοσοῦντες ἀπαιδευσίαν Cyr. ad Theod. f. 22. β disceptatio, controversia, dubitatio vel dubium ( Widerrede ): ዘእንበለ፡ ካሕድ፡ χωρὶς πάσης ἀντιλογίας Hebr. 7,7; ἄνευ λόγου 1 Petr. 3,1; προηγουμένως ( unläugbar, sine controversia ) Cyr. ad Theod. f. 8; ἀναμφιλόγως Cyr. c. Pall. f. 78; አልቦ፡ ካሕድ፡ በዝንቱ፡ οὐκ ἔστι ἀμφίλογον Cyr. de r. fid. f. 53. γ offensio, scandalum: ያመጽኡ፡ ካሕደ፡ ላዕለ፡ ትምህርትክሙ፡ Rom. 16,17; እብነ፡ ካሕድ፡ 1 Petr. 2,8.

woorden.betekenis: i.q. ካሕድ፡, Lud. ex Sx. Jac. 8 Enc. (ubi Cod. Tubin
woorden.definitie: i.q. ካሕድ፡, Lud. ex Sx. Jac. 8 Enc. (ubi Cod. Tubing. ካሕድ፡ exhibet).

woorden.betekenis: fere, propemodum, fere quotidie, -dem, -met, idem, ipse, ego
woorden.definitie: adv. [gramm. § 64,6; gramm. § 150,c; gramm. § 162]; ejus vis non in ከ፡ sed in መ፡ niti videtur (ከ፡ tenuius pronuntiatio ክ፡), et potestate fere cum vocula መ፡ (q.v. col. 141) convenit, sed fortius et gravius est. 1 fere, propemodum: ክመ፡ እንተ፡ ጸብሐት፡ fere quotidie Gen. 39,10; ሎቱ፡ ያስዖዝዞ፡ ክመ፡ እግሩ፡ (propemodum vel paululum) ἐπέσκαζε Gen. 32,32 (at ὃ ἐνάρκησεν Gen. 32,33 simplice ዘአስዖዘዞ፡ versum est). 2 Pronominibus vel adverbiis pronominalibus postpositum vim quamdam distinguendi et restringendi („vim identitas“ Lud.) habet: -dem, -met, idem, ipse (eben, gerade): እመሂ፡ ትልህቁ፡ አነ፡ ክመ፡ ውእቱ፡ ἐγώ εἰμι ( ego idem sum, nec mutatus) Jes. 46,4; ወአንተሰ፡ አንተ፡ ክመ፡ σὺ δὲ ὁ αὐτὸς εἶ Hebr. 1,12; አንተ፡ ክመ፡ ዘታወፅኦሙ፡ tu (neque alius quidam) eras educens eos 2 Reg. 5,2; አነ፡ ክመ፡ ወአልቦ፡ እንተ፡ ከማየ፡ ego (sola) nec ulla mihi similis Zeph. 2,15; እምቅድመ፡ ዓለም ፡ ወእስከ፡ ለዓለም፡ አንተ፡ ክመ፡ ante saeculum et usque in saeculum tu idem (es) Ps. 89,2; Ps. 92,3; Ps. 101,28; ዝኩ፡ ዘእጸልእ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ክመ፡ እገብር፡ gerade das id ipsum (nec aliud quidquam) Rom. 7,15; ኪያሃ፡ ክመ፡ መሥዋዕተ፡ ለግሙራ፡ eadem semper sacrificia Hebr. 10,11; Phil. 2,2; Matth. 26,44; ከማሁ፡ ክመ፡ itidem, (et ipsi) Gen. 46,34; ὡσαύτως eodem modo Deut. 15,17; Matth. 20,5; Matth. 21,36; Asc. Jes. 11,28; Phil. 1,30; ዘንተ፡ ክመ፡ hoc ipsum 1 Thess. 3,4; Ps. 61,11; አመ፡ ኮነ፡ ህየ፡ ክመ፡ ሀለውኩ፡, ἡνίκα ἐγένετο, ἐκεῖ ἤμην ( ibi, in ipso loco, aderam ) Jes. 48,16. 3 nonnisi, modo, tantummodo, solum (אַךְ): ከማሁ፡ ክመ፡ ውእቱ፡ non est nisi illis similis (nequaquam iis superior) 1 Reg. 17,36; 2 Cor. 10,18; ሕያዋን፡ ክመ፡ ይባርኩከ፡ (non mortui) Clem. f. 259; Gen. 27,38; Lev. 21,14; Marc. 7,19; Matth. 5,47; እሙንቱሰ፡ እምከንቱ፡ ውስተ፡ ከንቱ፡ ክመ፡ ii autem nonnisi a vanitate in vanitatem (ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό, יַחַד) Ps. 61,9; ለጊዜሃ፡ ክመ፡ ውእቱ፡ temporalis tantum est Matth. 13,21 rom. a ንስቲተ፡ ክመ፡ ተርፎሙ፡ ወይዌግሩኒ፡ paulum tantum abest quin (me lapident) Ex. 17,4. b አኮ፡ ክመ፡ seq. ዓዲ፡ vel አላ፡ non modo – sed etiam Matth. 4,4; Matth. 21,21; Asc. Jes. 10,5; vel አኮ፡ ባሕቲቶ፡ ክመ፡ – ዳእሙ፡ ዓዲ፡ Joh. 5,18; Joh. 13,9; – Voc. Ae.: ክመ፡ ብ፡ እንዴሁ፡; aliud: ጽመ፡ ወክመ፡ (vid. Marc. 7,19) ዘ፡ እንዴኽ፡ ዝምብሎ።

woorden.betekenis: pron. Plur. II pers. m., et nominibus et verbis su
woorden.definitie: pron. Plur. II pers. m., et nominibus et verbis suffixum.

woorden.betekenis: austerus fuit, flaccidum esse, marcere, contrahendo, corruga
woorden.definitie: i.q. كَمَسَ austerus fuit (כּמַשׁ flaccidum esse, marcere, sine dubio proprie de contrahendo et corrugando ). Hinc propagatum est

woorden.betekenis: cuminum, – Voc. Ae.:, aliud
woorden.definitie: , ከሚን፡, ካሚን፡, ከሙን፡, ከሜን፡ n. peregr. κύμινον כַּמּוֹן ܟܰܡܽܘܢܳܐ كَمُّونٌ cuminum, Matth. 23,23; Jes. 28,25; Jes. 28,27; ወኮነ፡ ኢይበልዕ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ኅብስት፡ ወጼው፡ ምስለ፡ ከሙን፡ ወሐምል፡ ዘኢያበስልዎ፡ በእሳት፡ Sx. Haml. 24; Macc. f. 5(vid. sub ከሚር፡); inter suffimenta enumeratur: ከርቤ፡ ወሚዓ፡ ወሎዛን፡ ወስንድሪስ፡ ወከሜን፡ ወጥፋሕ፡ ወሜዓር፡ (sic) Sx. Haml. 8 – Voc. Ae.: ከሚን፡ ዘ፡ ፌፆ፡; aliud: መለንስ፡ ኑግ፡ ከሚን፡ ብ፡ ተልባ፡ ፌጾሂ።

woorden.betekenis: dimovit, sustulit, alteram tegentem, detexit, revelavit, ret
woorden.definitie: I,1 [i.e. كَشَطَ (قَشَطَ) dimovit, sustulit rem alteram tegentem; vicin. كَشَفَ (ቀፈጸ፡) detexit, revelavit ] Subj. ይክሥት፡ 1 retergere, detergere, nudare, omisso Acc.: Ruth 3,4; Ruth 3,7; seq. Acc. tegumenti: ክነፊሃ፡, ክዳነ፡ አቡሁ፡ Kuf. 33; ግልባበ፡ Jes. 47,2; tectum Gen. 8,13; etiam volvendo amoliri aliquid ad aliqua re Marc. 16,3; seq. Acc. pers. vel rei obvelatae: Dan. apocr. 1,32; ከሠተ፡ ኀፍረተ፡ አቡሁ፡ Kuf. 33; Lev. 18,6 seq.; Deut. 23,1; Deut. 27,20; ገጸ፡ 2 Cor. 3,18; ትከሥት፡ ምድር፡ ደማ፡ Jes. 26,21. 2 aperire, patefacere: fiscellam Ex. 2,6; puteum Ex. 21,33; መዛግብተ፡ Kuf. 42; Sir. 43,14; Hen. 46,3; in specie a os suum Matth. 5,2; Ps. 38,13; Jes. 53,7; Kuf. 25; Sir. 24,2; Job 3,1; 4 Esr. 9,29; os alicujus Hez. 3,27; labra sua Job 11,5; Job 32,20; alicujus Ps. 50,15; oculos suos Kuf. 17; Job 27,19; Gen. 48,10 (ከሢቶት፡); Hen. 89,28; alicujus Joh. 9,26; ትከሥት፡ አዕይንተ፡ ዕዉራን፡ Jes. 42,7; aurem alicujus Jes. 50,5; τὸν νοῦν እግዚአብሔር፡ ይከሥት፡ ልቦ፡ ለሰብእ፡ Job 35,16; Luc. 2,35. b librum, literas: Jes. 37,14; Hez. 2,10; 2 Esr. 6,1; 2 Esr. 18,5; Dan. 7,10; Apoc. 5,2; Apoc. 5,3; Apoc. 20,12; ወከሢቶ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ Luc. 4,17. 3 transl.: a revelare arcana, mysteria, (de revelatione divina), c. Acc. rei et ለ፡ pers.: Dan. 2,22; Dan. 2,28; Ps. 97,3; 4 Esr. 10,53; Hen. 48,7; Matth. 11,25; Matth. 11,27; Matth. 16,17; 1 Cor. 2,10; Gal. 1,16. b manifestum facere, patefacere, expromere, c. Acc. rei: ቃሉ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ይከሥት፡ ፍትወተ፡ ልቡ፡ Sir. 27,6; Hen. 61,5; Jes. 52,10; እከሥት፡ ምረረ፡ ነፍስየ፡ Job 7,11; c. Acc. rei et ለ፡ pers.: Ps. 36,5; ለከ፡ ከሠትኩ፡ ቅሥትየ፡ Jer. 20,12. c evulgare, prodere aliquid: Prov. 11,13; ለእመ፡ ከሠትከ፡ ምክሮ፡ Sir. 22,22; Sir. 27,16; Sir. 27,21; ኀፍረት፡ ከሢተ፡ ምክረ፡ ዐርክከ፡ Sir. 41,23; Jos. 2,20; aliquem Matth. 1,19. – Voc. Ae.: ከሠተ፡ ዘ፡ ገለጸ።

woorden.betekenis: se retergere, nudare, retegi, detegi, aperiri, patefieri, re
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 Refl. se retergere vel nudare, Kuf. p. 15; Kuf. p. 30; 2 Reg. 6,20. 2 Pass. a retegi, detegi: ግላ፡ 2 Cor. 3,14; ተከሥተ፡ ሰኰናኪ፡ Jer. 13,22; አልቦ፡ ክዱን፡ ዘኢይትከሠት፡ Marc. 4,22; ይትከሠት፡ መሠረታቲሃ፡ Hez. 13,14; Ps. 17,17. b aperiri, patefieri: መቃብራት፡ ተከሥቱ፡ Clem. f. 218; Matth. 27,52; አፍ፡ Luc. 1,64; እዘን፡ Marc. 7,35; አዕይንት፡ 1 Reg. 14,27; 1 Reg. 14,29; ተከሢቶ፡ Asc. Jes. 9,37; Matth. 9,30; Matth. 20,33; Joh. 9,10; ልብ፡ Act. 2,37; መጻሕፍት፡ 4 Esr. 4,22; Hen. 47,3. c transl. α revelari (de revelatione divina): ኢተከሥተ፡ ሕግ፡ እስከ፡ አሜሃ፡ Kuf. 33; ተከሥተ፡ ሎቱ፡ ከመ፡ ይግበር፡ Kuf. 32; 1 Reg. 3,7; Dan. 2,19; Dan. 10,1; Jes. 31,1; Hen. 52,5; 1 Cor. 14,30. Eph. 3,5. β manifestum fieri, patefieri, apparere: ተከሥተት፡ ምሕረትየ፡ Jes. 56,1; ኅቡኣት፡ ኢተከሥቱ፡ ለክሙ፡ Hen.16,3; Hen. 38,3; ምድር፡ ተከሥተት፡ Hen. 89,8; 2 Thess. 2,3; 2 Thess. 2,8.

woorden.betekenis: retectus, detectus, nudatus, apertus, patefactus, revelatus,
woorden.definitie: part., fem. ክሥት፡ 1 retectus, detectus, nudatus: ወክሡት፡ ገጽየ፡ Tob. 2,9; 4 Esr. 1,1; ርእሱ፡ ክሡተ፡ ይኩን፡ Lev. 13,45; 1 Cor. 11,5; ሲኦል፡ ክሡት፡ ቅድሜከ፡ γυμνός Job 26,6. 2 apertus, patefactus: ንዋይ፡ ክሡት፡ Num. 19,15; መቃብር፡ Ps. 5,11; Rom. 3,13; አፍ፡ Hez. 29,21; 2 Cor. 6,11; እዘን፡ Jes. 42,20; ይኩና፡ ክሡታተ፡ እዘኒከ፡ ወአዕይንቲከ፡ 2 Esr. 11,6; አዕይንት፡ Kuf. 22; Asc. Jes. 6,11; Hen. 1,2; መጽሐፍ፡ Apoc. 10,2. 3 transl.: revelatus, manifestus, palam factus, apertus, ingenuus: Rom. 1,19; Hebr. 4,13; Hen. 9,5; ተወልደ፡ እምኅቡእ፡ ውስተ፡ ክሡት፡ Deg.; ክሡተ፡ ኮነ፡ ስሙ፡ Marc. 6,14; Ex. 2,14; ዘለፋ፡ ክሡት፡ Prov. 27,5. – Adv. ክሡተ፡ aperte, palam, manifesto, ingenue: ἐν τῷ φανερῷ Matth. 6,4; Matth. 6,18; φανερῶς Marc. 1,45; παῤῥησιᾳ, ክሡተ፡ ተናገረ፡ Joh. 7,13; Act. 2,29; 1 Thess. 2,2.

woorden.betekenis: detectio, nudatio, revelatio, patefactio, revelationes Canon
woorden.definitie: n. act., Pl. ክሥተታት፡ 1 detectio, i.e. nudatio: ክሥተታተ፡ ኀፍረቶን፡ (vid. Lev. 18) Can. Laod. 29. 2 revelatio i.e. patefactio: ክሥተታተ፡ ሴኖዶስ፡ ዘሐዋርያት፡ revelationes Canonum Apostolorum (Lud.: apertiones i.e. prolegomena? ), Syn. (inLud. Comm. hist. p. 305 n. 17).

woorden.betekenis: collum
woorden.definitie: collum vid. sub ክሳድ፡

woorden.betekenis: poculum, scyphus
woorden.definitie: poculum, scyphus vid. sub ከወረ፡

woorden.betekenis: pluvia, tempus pluvium, hiems, hiemes, annus, kǝramt
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. ክራማት፡, et ክረማት፡ et አክራም፡, 1 pluvia Ps. 146,8; አመ፡ ክረምት፡ ἐν ἡμέραις ὑετοῦ Hez. 1,28. 2 tempus pluvium (anni), hiems: χειμών ዝናመ፡ ክረምት፡ Job 37,5 (vid. ዝናም፡); Cant. 2,11; አስሐትያ፡ ክረምት፡ Sap. 16,29; መዋዕለ፡ ክረምት፡ Prov. 27,15; 2 Esr. 10,9; ክረምት፡ ብሔር፡ 2 Esr. 10,13; 1 Esr. 9,11; በክረምት፡ Matth. 24,20; 2 Tim. 4,21; ወክረምት፡ ውእቱ፡ Joh. 10,22; እግዚአብሔር፡ ያስተዴሉ፡ ክረምተ፡ ለምድር፡ ዘያበቍል፡ ሣዕረ፡ ውስተ፡ አድባር፡ Deg.; መዋዕለ፡ ክረምት፡ ἡμέραι θερισμοῦ (ut quibus alvei fluviorum impleti sint) Jos. 3,15; opp. ሐጋይ፡, ut: 4 Esr. 6,8; Hen. 2,3; Gen. 8,22; Kuf. 6; Kuf. 29; በክረምት፡ ወበሐጋይ፡ ἐν θέρει καὶ ἐν ἔαρι Zach. 14,8; Ps. 73,18; ክረምት፡ ወማእረር፡ ወሐጋይ፡ Sir. 36,9; ክረምት፡ ወመጸው፡ ወማእረር፡ ወሐጋይ፡ Kuf. 2; በኵረ፡ በለስ፡ ዘክረምት፡ πρώϊμος Hos. 9,10; μαζουρώθ Job 38,32; አክራም፡ hiemes (vid. sub ክንትሮሳት፡) M.M. f. 127. 3 annus, Hen. 3; Gen. 12,4; Ex. 21,2; Ex. 23,10; ሐይወ፡ ኢዮብ፡ ፻ወ፸ክረምተ፡ Job 42,16; ኍልቈ፡ መዋዕሊሁ፡ ምእት፡ ክረምት፡ Sir. 18,9; እጐልት፡ እንተ፡ ሠለስቱ፡ ክረምታ፡ τριετής Jes. 15,5; Dan. 5,31; Asc. Jes. 1,1; Kuf. 40; Hez. 1,1; 3 Reg. 13,38; 4 Reg. 8,17; 4 Reg. 11,21; 4 Reg. 12,1; Rom. 4,19; 1 Tim. 5,9; Luc. 2,42; ሰብዓ፡ ክራማት፡ Ps. 89,10; ዘአብዝኀ፡ ክራማተ፡ Job 32,8; Job 32,10; 4 Esr. 12,24; Ex. 30,14 c. var.; ክራማት፡ et ክረማት፡ 4 Reg. 8,26; 4 Reg. 10,36; 4 Reg. 20,6; Hen. 10,10; Hen. 80,2; አክራም፡ Sx. Masc. 1; Sx. Ter 6; Org. 5. kǝramt C for መዋግደ፡ ክረምት፡ vid. ሞገድ፡

woorden.betekenis: annotinus, (annotinum et bimum), vetustus, vinum vetus est a
woorden.definitie: n. ag. et adj., 1 annotinus, de frugibus: እክል፡ ከራሚ፡ Lev. 25,22; ትበልዑ፡ ከራሜ፡ ወከራሜ፡ ከራሚ፡ (annotinum et bimum) Lev. 26,10; Deg.; Org. 2. 2 vetustus in genere, de vino, παλαιός Luc. 5,39; ወይን፡ ዘከራሚ፡ ዐርክ፡ ዘቀዳሚ፡ vinum vetus est amicus primus, Prov. Th. Petr. IX (Lud. Comm.hist. p. 560).

woorden.betekenis: hibernaculum, domicilium hibernum, (castra) hiberna
woorden.definitie: subst. hibernaculum, domicilium hibernum, (castra) hiberna: ንጉሥ፡ ይነብር፡ ውስተ፡ ቤተ፡ ምክራም፡ Jer. 43,22; ቤተ፡ ምክራም፡ ወቤተ፡ ሐጋይ፡ Am. 3,15; de copiis militaribus: ገብሩ፡ ምክራመ፡ ውስተ፡ … Chron. Ax.

woorden.betekenis: venter, ventriculus animalis, venter cum intestinis, stomach
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque fem., Pl. ከርሣት፡ [כְרֵשׂ ܟܪܶܣ venter; كِرْشٌ ventriculus animalis ruminantis; de etymo vid. Ges. thes. p. 717] 1 venter, κοιλία, γαστήρ, a animalium et hominum, ሕንብርተ፡ ክርሡ፡ Job 40,11; Cant. 7,3; Ps. 43,27; Joh. 7,38. α venter cum intestinis Lev. 3,3; Lev. 3,9 seq.; Job 16,16; Job 30,27; Jer. 4,19. β venter quatenus cibo repletur, stomachus, abdomen, Job 15,2; Job 15,35; Ps. 16,14; ኵሉ፡ እክል፡ ይትበላዕ፡ ወይወርድ፡ ውስተ፡ ከርሥ፡ Sir. 36,23; እንበይነ፡ ከርሡ፡ Sir. 37,5; Matth. 12,40; Matth. 15,17; 1 Cor. 6,13; Apoc. 10,9; Apoc. 10,10; Rom. 16,18; Phil. 3,19; ርኅብት፡ ከርሥየ፡ ወነደት፡ ከመ፡ እሳት፡ Clem. f. 222; ዶርሆ፡ እንዘ፡ ይበልዕ፡ በበ፡ አሐዱ፡ (grana singula) ይመልእ፡ ከርሦ፡ Prov. (Lud.); transl.: እምከርሠ፡ ሞት፡ ἐκ κοιλίας ᾅδου Sir. 50,5. b inanimorum, α alveus, uterus, cavum rei concavae, ut navis: ከርሠ፡ ሐመር፡ Jon. 1,5; arcae: አንብርዎ፡ ውስተ፡ ከርሣ፡ ለታቦት፡ Deut. 31,26; vasis Lev. 11,33. β media pars rei: episcopus ይቁም፡ ውስተ፡ ከርሠ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡ stet ad medium altaris, II Can. Nic. 63; ከርሠ፡ ባሕር፡ Sx. Mag. 30Enc.; በውሳጤ፡ ከርሣ፡ ለማየ፡ ዮርዳኖስ፡ Sx. Masc. 11 Enc. γ ut videtur: pars rei crassior, ወከርሠ፡ ንድቁ፡ ፯ በእመት፡ Chron. Ax. 2 In specie a uterus feminae: sive ከርሠ፡ እም፡ Koh. 5,14; Koh. 11,5; Job 38,8; Sir. 40,1; Jes. 46,3; Jes. 49,1; Matth. 19,12; Luc. 1,15, sive ከርሥ፡ Gen. 25,22; Gen. 25,23; Ruth 1,11; Ps. 21,9; Job 3,11; Job 31,15; Job 38,29; Jes. 44,2; Luc. 1,41; Luc. 1,42; Luc. 2,21; Luc. 11,27; Luc. 23,29; ፍሬ፡ ከርሥ፡ Kuf. 28; ብፁዓት፡ ከርሣት፡ እለ፡ ጾራሆሙ፡ Sx. Ter 3. b interiora hominis, imum pectus, ut quibus affectus animae tribuantur: Job 32,18; Thren. 1,20; Jes. 16,11; Ps. 50,11; Cant. 5,4; Jer. 4,19; ከርሥየኒ፡ ተሀውከት፡ ላቲ፡ ወኀሠሠታ፡ Sir. 51,21. – Voc. Ae.: ከርሥ፡ ብ፡ ሆድ። karś C for ሥሡዐ፡ ከርሥ፡ vid. ሥሡዕ፡

woorden.betekenis: chrysolithus
woorden.definitie: ቶሎቤ፡ (Apoc. 21,20 rom.), ክርስቲሎቤ፡ (Apoc. 21,20 Platt; Sx. Genb. 8Enc.), ክሬሎሶቶቤ፡ (Org. 2 n. peregr. corruptum, sc. χρυσόλιθος chrysolithus gemma.

woorden.betekenis: rad. inus., e.q. حَرَبَ in مِحرَابٌ, vic. حَرَمَ,
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., e.q. حَرَبَ in مِحرَابٌ, vic. حَرَمَ, ሐረመ፡

woorden.betekenis: corbis, sporta (viminea), qualus
woorden.definitie: subst., corbis, sporta (viminea), qualus, κάρταλλος ሚጥ፡ እዴከ፡ ከመ፡ ዘይቀሥም፡ ውስተ፡ ከረቦ፡ Jer. 6,9 (ubi glossa marginalis addita est: ሳዕር፡ አምሳለ፡ ቀፎ፡); Rel. Bar.; dedit ei ከረቦ፡ ወይን፡ ከመ፡ ይምላእ፡ ቦቱ፡ ማየ፡, neque exstillavit aqua (miraculo), Sx. Tachs. 23. – Voc. Ae.: ከረቦ፡ ዘ፡ መሶብ፡

woorden.betekenis: lacrymarum fluxus, lacrymae, myrrha
woorden.definitie: subst. [vicinum videtur غَرْبٌ lacrymarum fluxus, غُرُوبٌ lacrymae, cfr. ערף, רעף quibus significatio stillandi inest] myrrha, Ex. 30,23; Ps. 44,10; Cant. 3,6; Cant. 5,1; Cant. 5,5; Kuf. 16; Hen. 29,2; Matth. 2,11; Marc. 15,23; Joh. 19,39; Clem. f. 8; al.

woorden.betekenis: charta, papyrus, literae, liber, volumen, scheda, schedula
woorden.definitie: n. peregr., m. et fem., Pl. ክርታሳት፡ χάρτης charta, a i.e. papyrus, scribendo inserviens: ንሣእ፡ ክርታሰ፡ ወጸሐፍ፡ ኵሎ፡ Clem. f. 46; ንሣእ፡ ክርታሰ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ Jer. 43,2 seq.; ጦማረ፡ ክርታስ፡ Jes. 8,1; 2 Joh. 12; Hen. 69,9; አምጽአ፡ ክርታሰ፡ ወማየ፡ ሕመት፡ Rel. Bar. b literae, liber, volumen, Jer. 43,6; Jer. 43,14; Jer. 43,20; Jer. 43,21; Jer. 43,22; Jer. 43,23; Jer. 43,24; Jer. 43,25; Jer. 43,26; Jer. 43,27; Jer. 43,28; Jer. 43,29; Jer. 43,30; Jer. 43,31; Jer. 43,32; ተጠውመ፡ ከመ፡ ክርታስ፡ (βιβλίον) Apoc. 6,14; c scheda, schedula: አብጽሐ፡ ለነ፡ ክርታሰ፡ መጽሐፍክሙ፡ τὴν χάρτην (i.e. epistolae) Cyr. f. 115; ኢታርእዮሙ፡ ዘንተ፡ ክርታሰ፡ ዘጸሐፍኩ፡ ለከ፡ Clem. f. 151; ጸሐፉ፡ አስማቲሆሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ፫ክርታስ፡ ንኡሳት፡ (schedulae in sortitione adhibitae, Looszettel) Sx. Mij. 3; ይእቲ፡ ክርታስ፡ እሉ፡ ክርታሳት፡ Sx. Ter 16; schedula magica Sx. Masc. 7; Sx. Masc. 13– Voc. Ae.: ክርታስ፡ ጦማር፡ ዘ፡ ክታብ፡

woorden.betekenis: chorepiscopus
woorden.definitie: ኤጲስቆጶስ፡ n. peregr. χωρεπίσκοπος, chorepiscopus, F.N. 4; etiam ኮሮ፡ ኤጲስቆጶስ፡ M.M. f. 326; et ኮሬ፡ አቤስ፡ ኮቦስ፡ F.N. 7,3; F.N. 9,2.

woorden.betekenis: grus
woorden.definitie: subst. [ܟܽܘܪܟܝܳܐ, כּוּרְכְּיָא, كُرْكِيٌّ] grus avis, F.N. 44,2 (vid. sub ራዛ፡ col. 312).

woorden.betekenis: rotatio, circumversio, turbo
woorden.definitie: et ነኰርኳር፡ subst. rotatio, circumversio, turbo, በነኰርኳረ፡ ነፋስ፡ Hen. 52,1; ዘአዕረጎ፡ ለሄኖክ፡ በነኰርኵረ፡ ነፋሳት፡ Cod. Mus. Brit. LIV,7; እፎኬ፡ አርመሙ፡ ነኰርኳረ፡ መባርቅት፡ ወኢያውዐዩከ፡ M.M. f. 32.

woorden.betekenis: nux, nux juglans, amygdala, amygdalum, amygdalus, nuceus, ca
woorden.definitie: subst., sing. et coll., nux [videtur a rotunditate dicta, vid. ከረረ፡; ኰርኰረ፡) a fructus: nux juglans, sine dubio etiam amygdala, amygdalum, τὰ κάρυα Gen. 43,11; Kuf. 42; Num. 17,23; Hen. 31,2; Const. Ap. 39. b arbor, nux, amygdalus: ገነተ፡ ከርካዕ፡ κῆπος καρύας Cant. 6,11; ዘከርካዕ፡ καρύϊνος nuceus Gen. 30,37; Jer. 1,11; ይጸጊ፡ ከርካዕ፡ ἀνθήσῃ τὸ ἀμύγδαλον Koh. 12,5; ዕፀ፡ ከርካዕ፡ Org. 2. c Obscurus est locus Jer. 52,21 vers. nov., ubi legitur ወግዘፉ፡ ፬አጻብዕ፡ ዘከርካዕ፡ (hebr. נָביּב cavus ); an nucalis, nuci similis ob rotunditatem et concavitem? (Vid., quomodo καρυωτά interpretati sint Ex. 38,16) – Voc. Ae.: ከርካዕ፡ ዘ፡ ሎሚ፡ (sic!).

woorden.betekenis: fodere, graben, effodere, defodere, fodiendo invenire, fodie
woorden.definitie: I,1 { et I,2} [כָּרָה כְּרָא كَرَا, كَارَ, al.; vid. Ges. thes. p. 671] Subj. ይክሪ፡ (raro ይክረይ፡ Lud. ex Hist. VII Puer.; Imperat. ክረይ፡ Clem. f. 223), fodere, 1 sensu proprio ( graben ): a fodere, effodere, defodere α rei in terra occultae quaerendae causa: abs. ut: በህየ፡ ከረየ፡ Clem. f. 225; ከረይኩ፡ ወነሣእኩ፡ Jer. 13,7; (Matth. 6,19), vel c. Acc. rei, sive: fodiendo invenire: ከረዩ፡ ንዋየ፡ ልሕኵት፡ Sx. Jac. 30, sive fodiendo elicere: ይከሪ፡ ለርእሱ፡ እከየ፡ Prov. 16,27; ብእሲ፡ መዐትም፡ ይከሪ፡ ጋእዘ፡ Prov. 29,22. β foveam, puteum, sepulcrum al.; ከረየ፡ ምድረ፡ Matth. 25,18; ዘይከሪ፡ ግበ፡ Prov. 26,27; Ps. 7,16; Koh. 10,8; Sir. 27,26; Zach. 3,9; አዕመቀ፡ ከሪየ፡ ግበ፡ Jer. 30,8 var.; ከረየ፡ ዐዘቅተ፡ Kuf. 24; Gen. 21,30; Gen. 26,15 seq.; Jes. 51,1; Jer. 2,13; Ex. 7,24 (omisso Acc.); ከረየ፡ መቃብረ፡ Tob. 8,9; ከረይኩ፡ (omisso Acc.) ወቀበርክዎ፡ Tob. 2,7; መቃብር፡ ዘከረየ፡ ለርእሱ፡ Kuf. 45; Jsp. p. 368; ከረየ፡ ምክያደ፡ Marc. 12,1. b perfodere parietes, muros al.: ይቤለኒ፡ ክሪ፡ ውስተ፡ አረፍት፡ ወከረይኩ፡ Hez. 8,8; c. Acc.: ክሪ፡ አረፍተ፡ Hez. 12,5; ይከሪ፡ አብያተ፡ በጽልመት፡ Job 24,16; Luc. 12,39; እለ፡ ይከርዩ፡ አብያተ፡ (fures) F.M. 17,7; omisso Acc. ( einbrechen ): ከረየ፡ ወሰረቀ፡ ቤተ፡ ነዳይ፡ Clem. f. 226; Matth. 6,19; ከሪዮ፡ Ex. 22,1. c pastinare, repastinare: ኢይከርዮ፡ Jes. 5,6; ከረየ፡ ታሕቴሁ፡ Herm. p. 53. d suffodere, diruendi causa Hen. 89,66. e incisiones facere: ኢይላሕውዎሙ፡ ወኢይከርዮ፡ ሎሙ፡ ( für sie ) Jer. 16,6. 2 fodicare ( stechen ), a fodere, effodere oculos Hen. 90,2 { stirps I,2}. b transl.: fodere i.e. incitare aliquem ad lasciviam, ferociam: ፈሐል፡ ኢይክርየኒ፡ Sir. 23,6; በእኪት፡ ዕለት፡ ይከሪ፡ ጽጋብ፡ Sir. 11,27; ከረያ፡ ጽጋብ፡ Hez. 16,49; Deut. 32,15. – Voc. Ae.: ከረየ፡ ወደኀየ፡ ዘ፡ መሐሰ፡ aliud: ከረየ፡ ዘ፡ መሐሰ፤ ደኀየ፡ ዘ፡ አጐደጐደ።

woorden.betekenis: fodiendum curare
woorden.definitie: II,1 fodiendum curare: አክረይኩ፡ ሎቱ፡ ምክያደ፡ Jes. 5,2; Luc. 20,9; ዐዘቅተ፡ Ex. 21,33; ወደዩ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ ውስተ፡ ገራውህ፡ ዘአበው፡ አክረዩ፡ (sc. sepulcro) Sx. Ter 15.

woorden.betekenis: fodi, perfodi, suffodi
woorden.definitie: III,1 a fodi: እስከ፡ ይትከረይ፡ ግብ፡ለኃጥኣን፡ Ps. 93,13; Vis. Bar.; መቃብር፡ ኢይትከረይ፡ ለክሙ፡ Hen. 98,13. b perfodi, de pariete, domo Matth. 24,43 Platt. c suffodi, diruendi causa, Hen. 89,67; አህጉር፡ ዘመዝበረ፡ ወማሰነ፡ ወተከርየ፡ Hez. 36,35.

woorden.betekenis: pala, bipalium, spatha
woorden.definitie: subst., pala, bipalium, spatha, Lud. e Vit. Dan.

woorden.betekenis: excrementa egerere, cacare
woorden.definitie: I,1 (denom. a ኵስሕ፡), Subj. ይኵሳሕ፡, excrementa egerere, cacare: non edam hoc terrenum ፋሲካ፡ ዘቦቱ፡ በሊዕየ፡ እኰስሕ፡ ወሰቲይየ፡ እሠይን፤ ዳእሙ፡ እውዕል፡ ፋሲካ፡ ሰማየዌ፡ ዘአልቦቱ፡ ኵስሕ፡ ወኢሥንት፡ Cod. Bibl. Bodl. XXVIII (in historia Claudii); ተሀውከ፡ ከርሡ፡ ለአርዮስ፡ (Arii) ወሖረ፡ ኀበ፡ ሙጻአ፡ ኵስሕ፡ ከመ፡ ይኵሳሕ፡ ወወጽአ፡ አማዑቱ፡ Sx. Nah. 18.

woorden.betekenis: circumcidere
woorden.definitie: I,1 [e familia radicum a קץ et גז incipientum late propagata, cfr. כסה, כסם, כסס, كسف] Subj. ይክስብ፡ circumcidere ትከስቡ፡ ቍልፈተክሙ፡, ከሰበ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ Kuf. 15; Kuf. 16; ከመ፡ ይክስቡ፡ ውሉዶሙ፡ Kuf. 20.

woorden.betekenis: sibi circumcidere, circumcidi
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 sibi circumcidere: ተከሰብዎ፡ ኵሎ፡ ሮሰ፡ Kuf. 15. 2 circumcidi: ዘኢተከስበ፡ Kuf. 15; Kuf. 16; M.M. f. 141; Abraham ኢኀፈረ፡ ከሢተ፡ ዕርቃኑ፡ ለተከስቦ፡ M.M. f. 24.

woorden.betekenis: circumcisio, nec est circumcisio temporalis
woorden.definitie: n. act. circumcisio, Kuf. 15; Kuf. 17(etiam ወአልቦ፡ ክስበተ፡ መዋዕል፡ Kuf. p. 60ita explicare licet nec est circumcisio temporalis; in Vers. Lat. deest).

woorden.betekenis: urceus, guttus aquarius, kʷǝskʷǝs, kʷǝskʷǝst, kʷǝsākʷǝsāt, k
woorden.definitie: vel ኵስኵስት፡ (Lud.) subst., (nonnisi in Pl. repertum) Pl. Pl. ኰሳኵሳት፡, urceus, guttus aquarius, (sec. Ludolfi Gregorium: vasis genus, quo aqua manibus superfunditur), ξέσται Marc. 7,4; Marc. 7,8; Judaei እለ፡ ኢይጥዕሙ፡ እክለ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ያጥምቁ፡ ኵሎ፡ አሚረ፡ ዓረታተ፡ ወኰሳኵሳተ፡ ወአጽሕልተ፡ ወጽዋዓተ፡ ወመንበራተ፡ የኀፅቡ፡ ወያነጽሑ፡ በማይ፡ Did. 31. [Etymo cognatum videtur cum ቀሡት፡ et vocibus sub ቀሡት፡ allatis; adde قَازُوزَةٌ; Lud. comparavit כּוֹס]. kʷǝskʷǝs, kʷǝskʷǝst Pl. ኵሳኵሳት፡ kʷǝsākʷǝsāt, Pl. Pl. ኰሳኵሳታት፡ kʷasākʷǝsātāt, ኵሳኵሳታት፡ kʷǝsākʷǝsātāt Krüge xxixb; 10 n.8 (ed.); ፯ ዶል፡ ፩ ቃጽል፡ ፭ ኵስኵስት፡ ፪ ገይብ፡ ዘብሩር፡ ‘1 campana, 5 campanelli da chiesa, 2 recipienti kʷeskʷest, 2 recipienti gayb di argento,’ 43 VI l. 28 (ed.), 36 l. 27 (tr.); ፩ኵስኵስት፡ ዘማህው። ‘1 recipiente kʷeskʷest di vetro,’ 44 IX l. 6 (ed.), 39 IX l. 8 (tr.); ወኵስኵስት፡ ዘብርት፡ ፪[፡] ‘2 recipienti kʷeskʷest di metallo,’ 64 l. 13 (ed.), 53 l. 20 (tr.); ወ፩፡ ኵስኵስት፡ ዘአቤቶ፡ ዮሐንስ። ‘Une cruche provenant de l’abēto Yoḥannes’ 65 l. 23–24 (ed.), 79 l. 9–10 (tr.); ወርቅ፡ ኵስኵስት፡ ፩። ‘une carafe en or’ 70 l. 27 (ed.), 85 l. 10 (tr.) L ኵስኵስ kʷǝskʷǝs, ኵስኵስት፡ kʷǝskʷǝst, Pl. ኰሳኵስት kʷasākʷǝst, ኵሳኵስት kʷǝsākʷǝst, ኰሳኵስ kʷasākʷǝs pitcher, pot 296a

woorden.betekenis: crasso collo praeditus, cervix, occiput, se incurvavit, post
woorden.definitie: et ክሣድ፡ subst., m. et fem. [قِسْوَدٌّ crasso collo praeditus; Aramaei frequentant קְדַל ܩܕܳܠܳܐ cervix (قَذَالٌ occiput); quae omnia nescio an e rad. קָדַד se incurvavit (coll. قُذَذٌ postica pars capitis) propagata sint] Pl. ክሳዳት፡ et ክሳውድ፡ (passim ከሳውድ፡ scriptum), collum, cervix; animalium, ut equi Job 39,19, cameli Jud. 8,21, crocodili Job 41,13; avis Lev. 1,15; Rel. Bar.; hominum Kuf. 43; Gen. 41,42; Gen. 45,14; ሐቀፎ፡ ክሳዶ፡ Gen. 46,29; Sir. 6,24; Prov. 3,3; Cant. 1,10; Cant. 4,4; Dan. 5,16; Matth. 18,6; Luc. 15,20; እስከ፡ ክሳድ፡ Jes. 30,28; አዘዘ፡ ይምትሩ፡ ክሳዶ፡ Jsp. p. 321; መጠወ፡ ክሳዶ፡ ለሰይፍ፡ Sx. Masc. 28Enc.; Rom. 16,4; አንተ፡ ታበውእ፡ ክሳደከ፡ ታሕተ፡ አርዑቱ፡ Kuf. 37; Jes. 10,27; Jer. 34,1; Jer. 34,9; ገምጽ፡ ክሳዶሙ፡ Sir. 7,23; አትሐቱ፡ ክሳዶሙ፡ Kuf. 38; አትሕቱ፡ ክሳደክሙ፡ ወተሰከምዋ፡ ጾራ፡ Sir. 51,26; ያደንኖ፡ ለክሳድ፡ Sir. 30,35; ዘአግዘፈ፡ ክሣዶ፡ Sir. 16,11; Job 15,25; Jes. 48,4; ጽኑዐ፡ ክሳድ፡ σκληροτράχηλος Prov. 29,1; ክሳድከ፡ ጽኑዕ፡ Deut. 31,27; ክሳድ፡ ይቡስ፡ Kuf. 1; ክሳዳት፡ Deut. 33,29; Jos. 10,24; Jud. 8,21; ክሳውድ፡ Thren. 5,4; Hen. 98,12; Kuf. 31; Org. – Voc. Ae.: ክሳድ፡ ዘ፡ ሐንገት፡ (v. አንገት፡). kǝsād C for ሐብለ፡ ክሳድ vid. vid. ሐብል፡ (Leslau)

woorden.betekenis: magni aestimari, honorari, celebrari, gloriosum, illustrem,
woorden.definitie: (ከበረ፡, Lud. e Vit. Sam.) I,1 [كَبُرَ c. deriv.; vid. Ges. thes. p. 657] Subj. ይክበር፡ magni aestimari, 1 honorari, celebrari, gloriosum, illustrem, honoratum esse, μεγαλύνεσθαι Prov. 8,16; ወከብረ፡ ወተለዐለ፡ ሰሎሞን፡ 2 Par. 9,22; ὑψοῦσθαι Job 36,7; ይከብር፡ ነዳይ፡ በጥበቢሁ፡ Sir. 11,1; ቦዘይከብር፡ በአትሕቶ፡ ርእሱ፡ Sir. 20,11; ἐπαινεῖσθαι Ps. 43,10; Ps. 104,2; δοξάζεσθαι, Ps. 36,21; በክብረ፡ አቡሁ፡ ይከብር፡ ሰብእ፡ Sir. 3,11; እለ፡ ከብሩ፡ በመዋዕሊሆሙ፡ Sir. 44,7; ከበርከ፡ Jes. 43,4; ይከብሩ፡ ዐበይትኒ፡ ወመላእክትኒ፡ Sir. 10,24; ይትሌዐል፡ ወይከብር፡ Jes. 52,13; 4 Esr. 9,31; ብክሙ፡ ይክበር፡ ዘርአ፡ አብርሃም፡ Kuf. 31; ዘበኀቤሁ፡ ሀለዎሙ፡ ይክበሩ፡ 4 Esr. 6,72; ከመ፡ ይክበሩ፡ Sir. 38,6; Sir. 46,12; Deut. 33,16. Comparative: honoratiorem, gloriosiorem esse aliquo, c.c. እምነ፡ Num. 22,15; 2 Reg. 23,19; ውእቱ፡ ይከብር፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ Dan. apocr. 1,4; Gen. 34,19; Hen. 41,5; vel c. Acc.: Luc. 14,8. 2 pretiosum, pretiosiorem esse: ከብረት፡ ነፍስየ፡ በአዕይንቲከ፡ 1 Reg. 26,21; 4 Reg. 1,13; ዘይውኅድ፡ ይከብር፡ ወይቴሐት፡ ዘይበዝኅ፡ 4 Esr. 6,33; seq. እምነ፡ Koh. 10,1.

woorden.betekenis: magni aestimare, honorare, honore prosequi, afficere, suspic
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 magni aestimare, honorare, honore prosequi vel afficere, suspicere aliquem: አክብር፡ አባከ፡ ወእመከ፡ Ex. 20,12; Tob. 4,3; Tob. 10,12; Kuf. 7; Kuf. 35; Sir. 3,3 seq.; Sir. 7,27; Mal. 1,6; ኀደገት፡ አክብሮታ፡ ለእግዝእታ፡ Gen. 16,4; 1 Tim. 6,1; maritum Kuf. 36; medicum Sir. 38,1; Sir. 38,3; regem 1 Petr. 2,17; ዘኢያአምር፡ አክብሮ፡ ዐቢይ፡ Job 34,19; አክብሮሙ፡ ለካህናቲከ፡ θαύμαζε Sir. 7,29; Aegyptii ያከብርዎሙ፡ ለውሉደ፡ እስራኤል፡ Kuf. 46; ገጸ፡ ሊቃናት፡ ኢያክበሩ፡ Thren. 5,12; Matth. 27,9; Deum Prov. 7,1; 1 Reg. 2,30; Marc. 7,6; c. ለ፡ pers. 1 Petr. 2,17 rom.; c. በ፡ rei ut Sir. 3,8; 1 Tim. 6,1 al.; festum: አክበረ፡ በዓለ፡ Syn.
