woorden.betekenis: secandi, amputandi
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., quae sicut وجز ad familiam radicum גזז, גזה, גזם, גזע, גזר al. referenda primitus significatum secandi, amputandi habuisse videtur.

woorden.betekenis: excommunicare, interdicere, anathematizare, exsecrari, diris
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 excommunicare, interdicere, anathematizare: ወኪያሁኒ፡ ያወግዝዎ፡ እምነ፡ ማኅበሩ፡ 2 Esr. 10,8 vers. alt.; አውገዝዎሙ፡ እስከ፡ ዛቲ፡ ዕለት፡ 1 Par. 4,41; ብእሲ፡ ዘአውገዘ፡ ኤጲስ፡ ቆጶስ፡ Can. Nic. 7. 2 exsecrari, diris devovere, Hen. 6,5; እለ፡ ታወግዙ፡ ግዘታተ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይፍትሑ፡ Hen. 95,4; in specie: diabolum, ut: ዘይፈቅድ፡ ይጠመቅ፡ ይምሀርዎ፡ ያውግዝ፡ ሰይጣነ፡ ወይእመን፡ በክርስቶስ፡ Did. 39; ኣወግዘከ፡ ሰይጣን፡ ወኵሎ፡ ምግባራቲከ፡ Did. 39; አውገዞ፡ ለከይሲ፡ Sx. Jac. 2Enc. { 3 interdicere i.e. vetare, seq. ከመ፡ ኢ፡ c. Subj., Chr. Ax., vid. sub መጽንሕ፡.}

woorden.betekenis: excommunicare
woorden.definitie: III,1 excommunicare: ካህን፡ ዘተወግዘ፡ Abtel. Ap. 10; II Abt. 10;Lud. comm. hist. p. 331 n. 91; M.M. f. 216.

woorden.betekenis: fluxit
woorden.definitie: rad. inus. e.q. נְגַד fluxit (نَجَدَ fluxit corpus sudore).

woorden.betekenis: fluctuum aestum excitare, undare facere
woorden.definitie: quadril. II (denom.) fluctuum aestum excitare, undare facere: በባሕር፡ አውግራትኒ፡ ወአድባራት፡ እለ፡ ያሞግዱ፡ ወየሀውኩ፡ χαλεπωτάτην ζάλην ἐπεγείρουσι, Chrys. Ta. 34.

woorden.betekenis: initium facere, coepisse, incipere, inchoare, exordiri, aggr
woorden.definitie: I,1 et I,2, raro ወጥነ፡ I,1 (Sx. Mag. 13,si quidem lectio sana est) [بَدَأَ بَدَا], Subj. I,1 ይውጥን፡ (ut F.M. 2,11; Chrys. ho. 4; Jsp. p. 363, al.), raro ይጠን፡ (M.M. f. 211), initium facere, coepisse, incipere, inchoare, exordiri, aggredi, Ps. 76,10; seq. Subj.: ዘይዌጥን፡ ይርዳእ፡ Prov. 13,12; ትዌጥን፡ ትቅትሎሙ፡ Jes. 27,8; Kuf. p. 21; Hen. 13,10; Luc. 1,1; vel seq. ከመ፡ c. Subj., ut: ወጥነ፡ ከመ፡ ይቀድስ፡ Sx. Mag. 13; Phlx. 48; seq. እንዘ፡ Hen. 85,10; Hen. 89,15; seq. ወ፡ c. verbo finito Hen. 61,4; seq. Acc. Infin.: ወጠነ፡ ጸውዖ፡ ስመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Kuf. 4; ንዌጥን፡ ጽሒፈ፡ Cod. Mus. Brit. XXIX; እምቅድመ፡ ትውጥኑ፡ ዐሊወ፡ Jsp. p. 363, vel seq. ለ፡ c. Infin., ut: ይዌጥኑ፡ ለገቢር፡ Kuf. 1; ይዌጥን፡ ለገቢረ፡ ሠናይ፡ Phlx. 4; seq. በ፡ c. Infin.: ንዌጥን፡ በጽሒፈ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ Fal. f. 1; seq. Acc. rei: Gal. 3,3; ወጠንዋ፡ (sc. portam aedificandam) 2 Esr. 13,1 var.; ኢብዉሕ፡ ሎቱ፡ (sc. diacono) ከመ፡ ይውጥን፡ ጸሎተ፡ ቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ F.M. 31,2; ሰይጣን፡ ወጠነ፡ ዘንተ፡ ኀጢአተ፡ F.M. 3,2; ንጠንኬ፡ ዘለፋ፡ M.M. f. 211; ከመዝ፡ አኀዘ፡ ይውጥን፡ ሕንጻሆን፡ Gad. Lal.; ወጠነ፡ ለክሙ፡ ግብረ፡ ሠናየ፡ Phil. 1,6; ጢጦስ፡ ፈቀደ፡ ይውጥን፡ ሎሙ፡ ሰላመ፡ Jsp. p. 356; c. በ፡ vel Acc. rei, a qua incipiunt: ይውጥን፡ በቀዳማይ፡ F.N. 43,4; ወውጥን፡ ሕዋረ፡ ማእከላዌ፡ Sx. Mag. 13; omisso objecto: እምዘ፡ ወጠነ፡ ንጉሠ፡ ባቢሎን፡ ዲበ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፡ (sc. bellum) Hez. 24,2.

woorden.betekenis: libamentum, libatio, patera, phiala libatoria, vas spondeum
woorden.definitie: subst., Pl. መዋጽሕ፡ et መዋጽሕት፡ 1 libamentum, libatio, ሞጻሕት፡ Gen. 35,14; Ex. 29,40; Ex. 29,41; Ex. 30,9; Lev. 23,18; Num. 28,7 seq.; Kuf. 14; Jes. 57,6; Jer. 51,17 seq.; Joel 1,13; Hez. 45,17. 2 patera vel phiala libatoria, vas spondeum, σπονδεῖον, አንሥአ፡ እዴሁ፡ በሞጻሕት፡ (v. በሞጽሕት፡) Sir. 50,15; መዋጽሕት፡ 1 Esr. 2,12; Num. 4,7; መዋጽሕ፡ Ex. 38,12; ቤተ፡ መዋጽሕት፡ Ex. 25,29; ψυκτῆρες መዋጽሕት፡ 2 Esr. 1,9; መዋጽሕ፡ κύαθοι Ex. 25,29 c.

woorden.betekenis: exire
woorden.definitie: exire vid. sub ወፅአ፡

woorden.betekenis: superari, inferiorem esse
woorden.definitie: III,1 et III,2 superari, inferiorem esse in proelio, Ex. 17,11. – Voc. Ae.: ተወጽአ፡ ዘ፡ ተሸበረ፡ ተሸነፈ።

woorden.betekenis: exire, egredi, per, proficisci, emigrare, procedere, prodire
woorden.definitie: et ወጽአ፡ I,1 [amh. ወጣ፡ et ወጻ፡; יָצָא, ܝܺܥܳܐ; vid. etiam ጼአ፡] Subj. ይፃእ፡, Imperat. ፃእ፡, exire, egredi, Gen. 14,17; Gen. 24,11; Gen. 25,25; Jud. 3,24; ወፅአት፡ ነፍሱ፡ 4 Reg. 9,27; ፃኣ፡ Cant. 3,11; ፃኡ፡ Dan. 3,26; ወፂኦን፡ Dan. apocr. 1,19; c. እምነ፡ loci, Matth. 8,28; Matth. 13,1; Matth. 15,22; Act. 13,43; Apoc. 18,4; Gen. 8,19; Ex. 9,29; Jos. 8,22; Jud. 11,31; ወፃእኩ፡ እምከርሠ፡ እምየ፡ Job 1,21; ወፂእየ፡ እምከርሥ፡ Job 3,11; እምቤተ፡ ሞቅሕ፡ ዘይወፅእ፡ Koh. 4,14; vel እምውስተ፡ Gen. 9,10; Matth. 15,11; Matth. 15,18, vel እማእከለ፡, ut: ፃኡ፡ እማእከለ፡ ባቢሎን፡ Jer. 27,8; Jes. 52,11; vel እንተ፡ ውስተ፡ per, ut: ወፅኡ፡ እንተ፡ ውስተ፡ አናቅጽ፡ Mich. 2,13; 4 Reg. 9,24; c. እምኀበ፡ pers.: Kuf. 21(v. በኀበ፡); Gen. 47,10; Ex. 8,26; Ex. 9,33; Ex. 10,6; 2 Reg. 13,9; vel እምቅድመ፡ Gen. 4,16; Gen. 41,46; vel እምነ፡ et እምላዕለ፡ (si quis antea fuit in aliquo nel super aliquem) Marc. 1,25; Matth. 12,43; Matth. 17,18; seq. አፍአ፡ foras: Matth. 10,14; Apoc. 3,12; ትፃእ፡ አፍአ፡ Judith 13,3; Judith 14,2; seq. Acc. loci: ንፃእ፡ ሐቅለ፡ Cant. 7,12; Gen. 27,3; Sir. 8,16; Jer. 6,25; እመሂ፡ ወፃእኩ፡ ገዳመ፡ Jer. 14,18; vel seq. praepositionibus, ut ውስተ፡ Jos. 16,2; ላዕለ፡ Jos. 15,3; ኀበ፡ Lev. 16,18; Gen. 19,6; Ex. 2,11; Matth. 3,5; ይጽብቱ፡ ወይፃኡ፡ ለሐይቅ፡ Act. 27,43. a egredi vel proficisci in bellum: ዘይወፅእ፡ ፀብአ፡ Num. 26,2; 1 Reg. 28,1; Deut. 28,7; 1 Reg. 8,20; 1 Reg. 26,20; Ps. 67,8; etiam: egredi portis contra hostes obsidentem (Ausfall machen) Jsp. p. 358. b emigrare, Gen. 10,11; Gen. 12,1; Gen. 12,4; Gen. 24,5; Ex. 34,18; Ruth 1,7. c procedere: እምኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወፃእኩ፡ Joh. 16,27; Joh. 16,28; Joh. 17,8; Spiritus S. ዘይወፅእ፡ እምኀበ፡ አብ፡ Joh. 15,26; (v. ሠረጸ፡). d prodire: እምውእቱ፡ ጢስ፡ ወፅአ፡ አንበጣ፡ Apoc. 9,3; Apoc. 13,1; Act. 28,3. e exoriri, progigni: እምኔኪ፡ ይወፅእ፡ ንጉሠ፡ ይሁዳ፡ Mich, 5,1; Matth. 2,6; Gen. 15,4; Gen. 35,11; 2 Reg. 7,12; 2 Reg. 16,11; Num. 12,12. f evadere, liberum exire: ይወፅእ፡ እምኵሉ፡ Koh. 7,18; 1 Cor. 10,13; Lev. 25,41; Lev. 25,54; Ex. 21,3; 1 Reg. 14,41; ወፃእክሙ፡ እምኦሪት፡ Gal. 5,18; Rom. 6,14; etiam evadere i.e. fieri, ut: ፈረስ፡ ዘኢተረየፀ፡ ይወፅእ፡ እኩየ፤ ወልድ፡ ዘኢተገሠጸ፡ ይወፅእ፡ ዝሉፈ፡ Sir. 30,8. g discedere, decedere, excedere, recedere: ይወፅኡ፡ እምኔኪ፡ እለ፡ አማሰኑኪ፡ Jer. 49,17; እመ፡ ወፅአ፡ ቀታሊ፡ አፍአ፡ ውእተ፡ አድዋለ፡ Num. 35,26. α ab aliquo i.e. desciscere: እምእግዚአብሔር፡ ኢወፅኡ፡ ἀπὸ θεοῦ οὐκ ἀπέστησαν Herm. p. 72. β i.e. dissentire: sermo noster ኢይወፅእ፡ እመንፈሳዊ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ Cyr. c. Pall. f. 68. γ a vel e consuetudine, statu, lege, officio: ኢትፃእ፡ እምልማድከ፡ Phlx. 78; ዘይወፅእ፡ እምንኵስና፡ (austreten) F.M. 5,2; ዘይወፅእ፡ እምዓለም፡ Phlx. creberrime (de monachis); ይወፅኡ፡ እምሕገ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ Did. 6; እምሕግ፡ Did. 4; ወፂእ፡ እምሃይማኖት፡ F.M. 6,14. δ cedere possessione: Luc. 14,33. h excludi, privari re: ወፅአ፡ እምኵሉ፡ ጥበብ፡ πάσης σοφίας ἐστερήθη Sir. 37,21; virgines stultae quinque እለ፡ ወፅኣ፡ እምከብካብ፡ ዘበሰማያት፡ Did. 4. i emanare, profluere, scaturire: Hen. 14,19; Hen. 31,1; Gen. 2,10; Ex. 17,6. k oriri, de sole, astris: ወፅአት፡ ፀሓይ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ Judith 14,2; እስከ፡ ይወፅኡ፡ ከዋክብት፡ 2 Esr. 14,21. l exire, de sorte: ዛቲ፡ መክፈልት፡ ወፅአት፡ ለሴም፡ በዕፁ፡ Kuf. 8. m effici, colligi, in arithmetica, Abush.; de reditibus et proventibus annuis: ዘይወፅእ፡ ግብር፡ Lud. e suo Comm. hist. p. 303 n. 10 (ubi ዘያወፅእ፡ scripsit). n provenire, progerminare: Job 5,6; Jes. 11,1. o effici, proficisci: ኵሉ፡ ዘይወፅእ፡ እምነ፡ ወይን፡ Jud. 13,14; እምነ፡ በላዒ፡ ወፅአ፡ መብልዕ፡ Jud. 14,14; 1 Reg. 24,14. p exardescere, erumpere: ለእመ፡ ወፅአ፡ እሳት፡ Ex. 22,5; ወኢትፃእ፡ ከመ፡ እሳት፡ መዐትየ፡ Jer. 4,4; de lepra Lev. 13,22; Lev. 13,27. q excĭdere: ኢትርሳዕ፡ ዘንተ፡ ነገረ፡ ወኢይፃእ፡ እምነ፡ ልብከ፡ Deut. 4,9. r evanescere: ወፅአ፡ መዐዛሁ፡ Kuf. 21. s emitti: ወፅአ፡ ትእዛዝ፡ እምኀበ፡ ቄሳር፡ Luc. 2,1; Ps. 18,4. t efferri, pronuntiari: ዘወፅአ፡ እምአፉኪ፡ 1 Reg. 1,23; Jes. 48,3; Num. 30,3; Num. 32,24; Jos. 6,10; Jud. 11,36; Matth. 4,4. u „de scriptura non transscripta ajunt በከመ፡ ወፅአ፡ ቀዳሚ፡ sicut e calamo effluxit“, Lud.

woorden.betekenis: exire facere, jubere, educere, ejicere, expellere, emittere,
woorden.definitie: II,1 exire facere vel jubere, ut Gen. 48,12; a educere: አውፅኦ፡ አፍአ፡ Gen. 15,5; አውፅኦሙ፡ ኀቤነ፡ Gen. 19,5; Gen. 38,24; አውፅአነ፡ እምድረ፡ ግብጽ፡ Ex. 13,14; Ex. 16,6; Ex. 18,1; Deut. 17,5; አውፅእዎሙ፡ ኀበ፡ አንቀጽ፡ Deut. 22,24; Ps. 67,7; አውፅአኒ፡ ውስተ፡ መርሕብ፡ Ps. 17,22; Marc. 1,12; Marc. 8,23; Luc. 24,50. b ejicere, expellere: አውፅእዎሙ፡ አፍአ፡ እምገጹ፡ ἐξέβαλον Ex. 10,11; Ex. 11,1; Ex. 33,2; Gen. 3,23; Gen. 21,10; አውፅኦሙ፡ እምነ፡ ምድሮሙ፡ Sir. 47,24; Prov. 22,10; Prov. 27,15; አውፅኦ፡ (Infin.) Koh. 3,6; daemones Matth. 12,24 seq.; Marc. 7,26; uxorem matrimonio Lev. 21,7; Sir. 7,26; እንተ፡ አውፅእዋ፡ ἐκβεβλημένη Hez. 44,22; aliquid, ut: ተፋቅሮ፡ ታወፅኣ፡ ለፍርሀት፡ 1 Joh. 4,18. c emittere, dimittere: አውፃእኮን፡ ዕራቆን፡ ለእቤራት፡ ἐξαπέστειλας Job 22,9; uxorem 1 Esr. 9,36 (ἀπέλυσαν); እመ፡ አድምዐተከ፡ (sc. ኀጢአት፡) ኢታወፅአከ፡ Sir. 21,2. d eripere aliquem 2 Reg. 22,49; Ps. 142,13; liberare 1 Petr. 2,24. e efferre, foras efferre aliquid, Am. 6,10; Ex. 12,46; Gen. 14,18; Deut. 24,11; Act. 5,6. f producere, homines ex utero: ታወፅአኒ፡ እምከርሠ፡ እምየ፡ Job 10,18; muscas e terra Ex. 8,14; plantas, animalia Gen. 1,12; Gen. 1,20; 4 Esr. 7,17; folia, fructus Num. 17,23; Gen. 40,10; Cant. 2,13; Ps. 103,16. g extrahere, educere aliquid vel aliquem, Matth. 7,4; Ex. 4,6; Ex. 4,7; አውፅኡ፡ አምእስቲሆሙ፡ እምላዕለ፡ አዕፅምቲሆሙ፡ (ἐξέδειραν) Mich. 3,3; ኣወፅእ፡ መጥባሕትየ፡ እምነ፡ ቀቀባ፡ Hez. 21,3; aliquem Am. 9,2; animam Ps. 103,30. α expromere: አውፅአት፡ ርእሶ፡ እምነ፡ ጽፍነታ፡ προελοῦσα Judith 13,15; Gen. 24,53; Luc. 10,35. β exuere, deponere vestes Cant. 5,3. h eruere oculos: አውፅአ፡ አዕይንቲሁ፡ Jer. 52,11; Jud. 16,20; 1 Reg. 11,2; Matth. 5,29; Matth. 5,30. i efferre i.e. α proloqui: አውፅኦ፡ ቃል፡ Koh. 5,1; Job 15,13 (እምአፍ፡); ነገረ፡ እምልብ፡ Job 8,10; Prov. 10,13. β in vulgus efferre, evulgare: ያወፅእ፡ ቃለ፡ Koh. 10,20; አውፅአ፡ ስመ፡ እኩየ፡ ሊተ፡ Job 31,30; Deut. 22,14; Luc. 6,22; ዘያወፅእ፡ ምክረ፡ ቢጹ፡ μὴ συντηρῶν Sir. 13,12; ኢታውፅእ፡ ቃለ፡ ዘሰማዕከ፡ Sir. 19,7; Sir. 19,10; Sir. 19,12; ኀፍረት፡ አውፅኦ፡ ነገር፡ ዘሰማዕከ፡ Sir. 41,23. k edere, emittere librum, F.N. p. 6; F.N. p. 7. l exserere, linguam Herm. p. 21; penem Hen. 86,4. m emittere sanguinem venis: ኢያወፅእ፡ ደመ፡ M. Tom.; elicere humorem ex lapide, Sx. Haml. 30Enc.; emittere liquorem, ut: ubera puellae አውፅኡ፡ ሐሊበ፡ Chrys. ho. n absistere facere, removere: ዘኢያውፅኣ፡ ለጽድቁ፡ እምነ፡ እግዚእየ፡ Gen. 24,27; c. Acc. et እምላዕለ፡ Sir. 30,23 (ἀπόστησον). o expendere, erogare: ዘአባእከ፡ ወአውፃእከ፡ Sir. 42,7; እለ፡ ታወፅኡ፡ ወርቀ፡ ወብሩረ፡ እምቍናማቲክሙ፡ Jes. 46,6 (vid. አስተዋፅአ፡) p excipere, excerpere: ከመ፡ ያቀልል፡ አውፅኦ፡ ትእዛዝ፡ hist. p. 305 n. 16.

woorden.betekenis: exitus, egressus, emigratio, discessus, decessus, prolatio,
woorden.definitie: n. act. et subst., fem. et m., exitus, egressus: በፀአትከ፡ እምነ፡ ሴይር፡ Jud. 5,4; Ps. 28tit.; ፀአቶሙ፡ (i.q. ወፂኦሙ፡) Ex. 5,20; ፀአተ፡ ያወፅአክሙ፡ Ex. 11,1; በበአትከ፡ ወበፀአትከ፡ Deut. 28,6; 2 Par. 1,10; 1 Reg. 29,6; ከመ፡ ፀአተ፡ አስሐትያ፡ በማእረር፡ Prov. 25,13; ተፈሥሑ፡ ግብጽ፡ በፀአቶሙ፡ ( emigratio ) Ps. 104,36; እምድኅረ፡ ፀአቶሙ፡ ለአዳም፡ ወለሔዋን፡ እምውስተ፡ ገነት፡ Clem. f. 8. a discessus, decessus: ሶበ፡ በጽሐ፡ ጊዜ፡ ፀአቱ፡ እምዝንቱ፡ ዓለም፡ Clem. f. 16; ትትፌሣሕ፡ ነፍስ፡ ኄርት፡ በፀአታ፡ እምሥጋ፡ Jsp. p. 381. b prolatio, pronuntiatio: እምፀአተ፡ ቃሉ፡ Dan. 9,25; ወኢአሐተ፡ ፀአተ፡ ቃል፡ እምአፉየ፡ Org. c ortus, origo: እምሀገረ፡ መኑፍ፡ ፀአቱ፡ Sx. Nah. 11Enc. d exitus i.e. exodium, finis, Lev. 23,36. e elatio funeris, ἐκφορά, ወኢገብረ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ፀአተ፡ ቀበረ፡ ዚአሁ፡ በላዕሌሁ፡ 2 Par. 21,19. f ejectio, expulsio, ἀποβολή Rom. 11,15. g emanatio, effusio sanguinis Fal. f. 16(vid. sub አንሳሕስሐ፡).

woorden.betekenis: munus, donum quod abeunti datur, expiationis
woorden.definitie: subst. munus vel donum quod abeunti datur ( expiationis causa, vid. ሞፃእት፡ n. d), 1 Reg. 6,3; 1 Reg. 6,4; 1 Reg. 6,8; 1 Reg. 6,17.

woorden.betekenis: exitus, finis, discessus, amolitio, expiatio
woorden.definitie: (minus bene ሙፃእት፡) subst. exitus a termini Num. 34,4; Jos. 15 seq.; Kebr. Nag. 92; viae: ሙፃእታ፡ (v. ሙፃኣታ፡) ለፍኖት፡ Sir. 21,10. b finis: ሞፃእቱ፡ ለቅሥቶሙ፡ Hebr. 6,16. c discessus Hebr. 13,7. d amolitio i.e. expiatio: ቤተ፡ ሞፃእት፡ (v. ሙፃእት፡) οἶκος ἐξιλασμοῦ 1 Par. 28,11 (at ቤተ፡ ስርየት፡ 1 Par. 28,20). { Pl. forma መዋፅእ፡ occurrit Hen. 33,3 in Abb. LV}

woorden.betekenis: locus unde quid exit, exitus, egressus, ortus, fontes, os, o
woorden.definitie: subst., Pl. ሙፃኣት፡ 1 locus unde quid exit, exitus, egressus, Jes. 37,28; አልቦ፡ ሙፃአ፡ እምነ፡ ማእከሎሙ፡ οὐκ ἦν διαφυγεῖν ἐκ μέσου αὐτῶν Judith 7,19; inferna እንተ፡ አልባቲ፡ ሙፃአ፡ እስከ፡ ለዓለም፡ Clem. f. 91; Clem. f. 95; Clem. f. 180. a ortus siderum Ps. 18,6; Hen. 33,5; Hen. 73,3; ሙጻኣት፡ Hen. 35. b fontes aquarum: ከመ፡ ዘይደፍን፡ ዐዘቅተ፡ ወያማስን፡ ሙፃአ፡ ማይ፡ Prov. 25,26; አስተርአየ፡ ሙፃኣተ፡ ማያት፡ 2 Reg. 22,16. c os, ostium fluvii, Kuf. 8. d porta: ሙፃኣቲሁ፡ Hez. 43,11. e finis: ሙፃኣታ፡ ለፍኖት፡ Sir. 21,10 var.; ἐξόδιον ገብረ፡ ሙፃአ፡ 2 Par. 7,9. f ሙፃአ፡ ኵስሕ፡ latrina Sx. Nah. 18(vid. sub ኰስሐ፡). 2 pompa elationis funeris (vid. ፀአት፡): ገብሩ፡ ሎቱ፡ ሙፃአ፡ ቀበር፡ ዐቢይ፡ ጥቀ፡ 2 Par. 16,14.

woorden.betekenis: campus, rus, exivit in campum, rus ire, in agros exire, excu
woorden.definitie: I,1 [referendum videtur ad בַּר ܒܰܪܳܐ بَرٌّ campus, rus, أَبَرَّ; etiam بَرَزَ exivit in campum ] Subj. ይውፍር፡ etiam ዩፈር፡, Imperat. ውፍር፡ et ፈር፡, rus ire, in agros exire vel excurrere, per agros vel campos deambulare, ruri esse: ወፈሩ፡ ሕዝብ፡ 2 Esr. 18,16; ጸግወነ፡ ሰላመ፡ ኑፈር፡ ወንእቱ፡ Deg.; seq. Acc. loci: ወፈረ፡ ሐቅለ፡ Dan. apocr. 13,33; ገዳመ፡ 4 Reg. 4,39; c. ውስተ፡ loci, ut: ሑሩ፡ ውፍሩ፡ (v. ወፈሩ፡) ውስተ፡ ደብር፡ 2 Esr. 18,15; ውስተ፡ አህጉር፡ Herm. p. 4; c. እንተ፡ per Marc. 2,23; Luc. 6,1; in specie: operis rustici causa, Luc. 8,5; Ps. 125,7; ይወፍር፡ ውስተ፡ ተግባሩ፡ Ps. 103,24; ወፈረ፡ ኀበ፡ አቡሁ፡ ውስተ፡ ማእረር፡ 4 Reg. 4,18; ሶበ፡ እወፍር፡ ኀበ፡ ኵዕንት፡ Sx. Tachs. 13(vid. ኵዕንት፡); ወዓዲ፡ ይወፍር፡ አባግዕ፡ በእደ፡ ዘይኌልቆን፡ Jer. 40,13; transl.: a frequentare aliquem agricolae instar agros frequentantis, c. ኀበ፡ pers.: ውፍር፡ (v. ፈር፡) ኀቤሃ፡ (ለጥበብ፡) ከመ፡ ዘየሐርስ፡ ὡς ὁ ἀροτριῶν πρόσελθε αὐτῇ Sir. 6,19; በኵሉ፡ ነፍስከ፡ ውፍር፡ (v. ፈር፡) ኀቤሃ፡ Sir. 6,26. b serpere vel diffundi per agros: ይወፍር፡ አዕጹቂሁ፡ πορεύσονται οἱ κλάδοι αὐτοῦ Hos. 14,6 (ubi caveas, ne ex وَفَرَ explices locum). – Voc. Ae.: ወፈረ፡ ዘ፡ ተሰመረ።

woorden.betekenis: rus, ager, agri, arvum, praedium, fundus, ager pascuus, pasc
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., 1 rus, ager, agri, arvum, praedium, fundus: ዘይትቀነይ፡ ወፍረ፡ Kuf. 50; ሐረሳዌ፡ ወወፍሮ፡ Jer. 28,23; ወፍረ፡ ሐረስት፡ Koh. 5,8; γεώργιον Prov. 6,7; Prov. 9,12; ወፍር፡ ዐባይ፡ Prov. 16,32; ወፍር፡ ዐቢይ፡ Prov. 24,5; Prov. 29,34; ἀγρός Prov. 24,42; Luc. 17,7; ዐጸደ፡ ወፍር፡ ἄρουρα 1 Reg. 22,6; አዕጻደ፡ ወፍር፡ ἀγροί 1 Reg. 22,7; Jud. 1,14. 2 ager pascuus, pascua: ዐብረ፡ ኵሉ፡ ወፍር፡ ዘውስተ፡ ገዳም፡ αἱ νομαὶ τῆς ἐρήμου Jer. 23,10; አዕጻዳተ፡ ወፍርነ፡ βουκόλια ἡμῶν Judith 3,3; Am. 6,4; Jes. 65,10 (v. ወፍረ፡ ላህም፡); Luc. 15,15. 3 res rustica, oeconomia: episcopus ዘኢይዘሩ፡ ንዋየ፡ ቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ ለወፍረ፡ ቤቱ፡ Clem. f. 86.

woorden.betekenis: oeconomia
woorden.definitie: subst. res rustica et domestica, oeconomia (i.q. ወፍር፡ n. 3, si quidem lectio sana est): materfamiliâs ትኤዝዝ፡ ወፈራ፡ Clem. f. 190.

woorden.betekenis: agri, praedium rusticum, villa, viculus cum agris, ager pasc
woorden.definitie: subst., Pl. ሙፋራት፡ 1 agri, praedium rusticum, villa vel viculus cum agris: በምድሮሙ፡ ወበሙፋሮሙ፡ Hen. 80,2; ሙፋራት፡ in CG (pro አዕጻዳት፡ κῶμαι) Jos. 16,9; Jos. 17,11; Jos. 17,16; Jos. 18,24; Jos. 18,28; Jos. 19,6; Jos. 19,7; Jos. 19,16; Jos. 19,31; Jos. 19,47; Jos. 21,12. 2 ager pascuus, pascua: ሚጥ፡ ልበከ፡ ለመርዔትከ፡ ወለሙፋረ፡ ዚአከ፡ Prov. 27,23; Ps. 143,16; ሙፋራት፡ in CG (pro ጺኦት፡ περισπόρια) Jos. 21,2 seq. (vid. ann. ad hunc locum). 3 exitus (in rus vel campum), opp. ምእታው፡, Ssal. Req.

woorden.betekenis: igne torrere, coquere, fornax lateraria
woorden.definitie: igne torrere vel coquere [אָפָה; مِيفًى fornax lateraria; an etiam نَفَتَ et نَفَطَ?], ut lateres, Kuf. p. 43 ann. 5. – Voc. Ae.: ወፈጠ፡ ዘ፡ ተኰሰ፡

woorden.betekenis: litera alphabeti Aethiopici decima sexta, quae ዐይን
woorden.definitie: litera alphabeti Aethiopici decima sexta, quae ዐይን፡ nominatur.

woorden.betekenis: signare, consignare
woorden.definitie: I,1 [عَڶمَ] signare, consignare literis: በቅድመ፡ እለ፡ ቆሙ፡ ወዐለሙ፡ (v. ተዓለሙ፡) ውስተ፡ ይእቲ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ γραφόντων ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ Jer. 39,12; sumserunt tabulas plumbeas ወዐለሙ፡ ውስቴቶን፡ ዜናሆሙ፡ Lud. ex. Hist. VII Puer.; አበው፡ ናሁ፡ ዐለሙ፡ ወሰመዩ፡ ትሕትና፡ ({die Demuth}) በአስማት፡ ሠናያት፡ ወትእምርት፡ ትርፍት፡ Phlx. 152. – Voc. Ae.: ሠዐለ፡ ዐለመ፡ ብ፡ ጻፈ።

woorden.betekenis: aevum, saeculum, tempus antiquum, tempus remotissimum, tempu
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem. (ut Jes. 14,17; Jes. 34,1; 4 Esr. 1,19 var.; Ps. 9,8; Ps. 92,2), Pl. ዓለማት፡ [עוֹלָם ܥܳܠܰܡ عَالَمٌ; de hujus nominis perantiqui etymo vid. 91] 1 a aevum,saeculum,tempus antiquum: ዓለምነ፡ Ps. 89,8; Henoch ኮነ፡ አርአያ፡ ለዓለም፡ ከመ፡ ይነስሑ፡ γενεαί Sir. 44,16; ቀደምተ፡ ዓለም፡ Sir. 2,10; Job 8,8; በከመ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ዓለም፡ Mich. 7,14; እምዓለም፡ Jer. 2,20. b tempus remotissimum sive praeteritum sive futurum, tempus perpetuum,saecula,aeternitas, αἰών, αἰῶνες, Deus ንጉሠ፡ ዓለም፡ Tob. 13,6; Kuf. 12; Kuf. 25; እግዚአ፡ ዓለማት፡ Hen. 81,10; በኵሉ፡ ዓለማት፡ ዘይመጽእ፡ Judae 25; እስከ፡ ኵሎን፡ ዓለማት፡ Kuf. 22; አበ፡ ዓለም፡ Jes. 9,6 vers. alt.; እስከ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ዓለም፡ Jes. 18,7. α እምዓለም፡ ab aeterno Jer. 7,7; Hen. 14,1; Ps. 102,16, al. β ለዓለም፡ in aeternum velperpetuum Job 7,16; Jer. 3,5; Jes. 28,28 al., vel ለዓለመ፡ ዓለም፡ Ps. 9,5; Ps. 9,40; Sir. 24,9, vel እስከ፡ ለዓለም፡ usque in aeternum Kuf. 22; Jes. 32,14; Jes. 44,7; Jes. 45,17; Jer. 7,7; Ps. 89,2. γ ዘለዓለም፡ aeternusvelperpetuus, Gen. 21,33; Job 33,12; Job 34,17; Jes. 51,11; Jes. 54,8; Jes. 61,7; Hez. 35,9; Tit. 3,7 al.; ቊርባኖሙ፡ ዘለዓለም፡ (perpetuumveljuge) Lit. Joh. c)homines singulorum aevorumvelsaeculorum, γενεά Ps. 48,20; ዓለም፡ ቀደምት፡ 2 Petr. 2,5. d)aeonvelsaeculum, quatenus hic aeon aeoni venturo opponitur a Judaeis et Christianis (Weltlauf): 4 Esr. 5,31; 4 Esr. 5,32; 4 Esr. 5,33; 4 Esr. 14,8 seq.; ዝንቱ፡ ዓለም፡ Rom. 8,5; Rom. 8,18; Rom. 12,2; ዝዓለም፡ et ዘይመጽእ፡ ዓለም፡ Org. 2 mundus,a rerum universitas,res creatae, Gen. 2,2; እምቅድመ፡ ይትፈጠር፡ ዓለም፡ Sir. 24,9; ውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዓለም፡ ἐν ἀμετρήτῳ κτίσει Sir. 16,17; እምፍጥረተ፡ ዓለም፡ Job 3,18; 4 Esr. 2,35; Joh. 17,24; 1 Petr. 1,20; Hebr. 4,3; Rom. 1,20; Rom. 8,20 (κτίσις); laudant eum coeli et terrae ምስለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዓለሞሙ፡ (σὺν τῷ κόσμῳ αὐτῶν) Lit. Orth.; እምቅድመ፡ ዓለም፡ ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς κόσμου Matth. 24,21; Hen. 41,4; እምቅድመ፡ ዓለም፡ ወእስከ፡ ለዓለም፡ ἀπὸ τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος 1 Par. 29,10; Ps. 89,2. b orbis terrarum: መልአ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዓለም፡ ማየ፡ Kuf. 5; οἰκουμένη Ps. 9,8; Ps. 18,4; Ps. 92,2; Ps. 95,10; Jes. 10,14; Jes. 10,22; Jes.13,5; Jes. 13,9; Jes. 14,17; Jes. 24,1; Jes. 34,1; Jes. 37,18; Jer. 10,12; Thren. 4,12; Luc. 2,1; Luc. 4,5; Luc. 21,26; Luc. 23,44; ኵሉ፡ ዓለም፡ πάσης τῆς γῆς Judith 11,1; κόσμος Rom. 1,8; Rom. 3,6; Matth. 4,8; Matth. 26,13; Clem. f. 153; Clem. f. 168al. c passim incolae terrae,homines: ኵሉ፡ ዓለም፡ Gen. 11,1; Apoc. 12,9; Act. 19,27; Joh. 7,4; Joh. 12,19. d mundusvelsaeculum sensu biblico et ecclesiastico, quatenus opponitur α Deo, rebus divinis, ecclesiae: Joh. 8,23; Joh. 9,39; Joh. 14,17; Joh. 14,27; Joh. 16,11; 1 Joh. 2,15; 1 Joh. 2,16; Matth. 18,7; ፍትወተዝ፡ ዓለም፡ Tit. 2,12; ፍትወታተ፡ ወጣዕመ፡ ዝዓለም፡ Clem. f. 153. β vitae monachorum et eremitarum, ut: ነበረ፡ ውስተ፡ ዓለም፡ እምቅድመ፡ ይመንኵስ፡ ፳ ዓመተ፡ Sx. Haml. 8; Masc. 14; ፈለሱ፡ ገዳመ፡ ወመነኑ፡ ዓለመ፡ Clem. f. 153. ʿālam C a for መናኔ፡ ዓለም፡ vid. መናኒ፡ (Leslau) b for በሓውርተ፡ ዓለም፡ vid. ብሔር፡ (Leslau)

woorden.betekenis: repercutere, pervertere, mutare, transformare, depravare, pr
woorden.definitie: I,1 [vid. ዐለየ፡ et ለወወ፡; עול, ܥܘܠ, عال] Subj. ይዕሉ፡ (Perf. ዐልወ፡ semel inveni 2 Par. 10,19 in codice Abbad. CXLI), 1 reflectere, retorquere, repercutere sonum: ድምፀ፡ ቃል፡ ዘአድባር፡ መፍርሃን፡ እለ፡ ያወሥኡ፡ ወየዐልዉ፡ ድምፀ፡ በበይናቲሆሙ፡ Sap. 17,18. 2 pervertere, mutare, transformare, depravare, ዐለዉ፡ ልቦሙ፡ ከመ፡ ኢየኀልዩ፡ μετέστησαν τὴν διάνοιαν Jes. 59,15; ይፈቅዱ፡ ይዕልዉ፡ ትምህርቶ፡ μεταστρέψαι Gal. 1,7; ዕልዋ፡ እግዚኦ፡ ለምክሩ፡ διασκέδασον 2 Reg. 15,31; የዐሉ፡ ለክሙ፡ (v. የዐልወክሙ፡) ማሕላክሙ፡ ዘምስለ፡ ሞት፡ (ἀφέλῃ) Jes. 28,18; ድኅረ፡ የዐልወከ፡ ቃለከ፡ (v. ቃሎ፡) διαστρέψει Sir. 27,23; እከዪሃ፡ የዐልዎ፡ ለራእይ፡ ἀλλοιοῖ τὴν ὅρασιν Sir. 25,17; የሀውከከ፡ ወየዐልወከ፡ διαστρέψει σε (sc. statum tuum) Sir. 11,34; ቦእለ፡ ረገመ፡ ወአኅሰሮሙ፡ ወዐለዎሙ፡ ἀνέστρεψεν ἀπὸ στάσεως αὐτῶν Sir. 36,12. 3 praevaricari, migrare, transgredi, violare legem, praecepta, foedus, rarius c. እምነ፡, ut: ዐለዉ፡ ፍጡነ፡ እምነ፡ ፍኖት፡ Ex. 32,8, vel c. በ፡, ut: ዘዐለወ፡ በወግዝ፡ 1 Par. 2,7; plerumque c. Acc.: ዐለዉ፡ ሕገከ፡ παρέβησαν Dan. 9,11; Rom. 2,27; παρήλθοσαν Jes. 24,5; Jes. 24,16; ἀπώσαντο Hez. 20,13; διεσκέδασται Hab. 1,4; Ex. 32,25; ዐለዉ፡ ኪዳንየ፡ Hos. 8,1; ዐሎኪ፡ ሥርዐትየ፡ Hez. 16,59; διεφθείρατε Mal. 2,8; እለ፡ ዐለዉ፡ ቃለከ፡ ἀθετοῦντες Jer. 15,16; Marc. 7,9; Clem. f. 7; Clem. f. 18. 4 fidem fallere, perfide agere, rebellem vel refractarium esse, desciscere, deficere, perfide desedere, abs.: Ps. 13,4; Rom. 3,12; ዐለውነ፡ ἀπέστημεν Dan. 9,5; ἀπώσαντο Act. 7,39 Platt; σκανδαλίζεσθαι Matth. 13,21; Matth. 24,10; c. Acc. pers.: ዐሊው፡ ዐለዉኒ፡ ቤተ፡ እስራኤል፡ ἀθετεῖν Jer. 5,11; Jes. 1,2; ከመ፡ ተዐልዎ፡ ብእሲት፡ ለምታ፡ Jer. 3,20; ዐለዎ፡ ሴዴቅያስ፡ ለንጉሠ፡ ባቢሎን፡ Jer. 52,3 vers. nov.; Judith 14,18; 2 Par. 10,19; 3 Reg. 12,19; 3 Reg. 22,54; Jsp. p. 363; ἀπειθεῖν ከመ፡ ኢይዕሉከ፡ Sir. 30,12; Rom. 11,30; Rom. 11,31; Jes. 36,5; ዐለዉኒ፡ ἐφαύλισάν με Judith 11,2; Judith 14,5; ἀσεβεῖν ዐሎክኒ፡ Jer. 3,13; Jer. 2,8; Jer. 2,29; ἀνομεῖν Jes. 43,27; ዐለወቶ፡ ለምታ፡ εἰς ἄνδρα ἑαυτῆς ἐπλημμέλησε Sir. 23,23; ዐለዉኒ፡ ἀπέστησαν Jes. 33,14; ተዐልዉኒ፡ σκανδαλισθήσεσθε ἐν ἐμοί Matth. 26,31; የዐልዉ፡ ሰብእ፡ አማልክቲሆሙ፡ ἀπαρνήσονται Jes. 31,7; προδιδόναι Luc. 6,16; c. Acc. religionis, a qua quis deficit: 1 Tim. 4,1; የዐልዉ፡ ሃይማኖቶሙ፡ Clem. f. 154; c. Acc. peccati: ዐለዉ፡ ማዕሌተ፡ እኪየ፡ Jer. 8,5; c. dupl. Acc.: ዐለውዎ፡ ማዕሌተ፡ 4 Reg. 14,19; ጌጋዮሙ፡ ዘዐለዉኒ፡ Jer. 40,8 var.

woorden.betekenis: pervertere, depravare, corrumpere, ad defectionem, seducere,
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 pervertere, depravare, corrumpere, a aliquid, ut: verba Asc. Jes. 11,39 (nisi hunc locum e n. 3,b interpretari malueris); religionem: ሶበ፡ አዕለውዎ፡ ለሃይማኖት፡ Kebr. Nag. n. 113. b aliquem i.e. ad defectionem seducere: ዘአዕለዎሙ፡ ለሕዝብ፡ በምክሩ፡ ἀπέστησε Sir. 47,23; διασκεδάζειν Ex. 32,25; διαστρέφειν Luc. 23,2; ἐκστρέφειν Herm. p. 69. 2 mutare locum i.e.decedere(sicut ܝܰܢܺܝ) vel defungi munere, abire officio, c. Acc.: እለ፡ አዕለዉ፡ ምግቦሙ፡ በንጽሕ፡ Lit. Joh.; Lit. Orth.; አዕሉ፡ እንከሰ፡ ወንትሓሰብ፡ ምግበከ፡ Luc. 16,2. 3 librum a transferre,vertere e lingua in linguam: M.M. f. 49; F.N. proleg.; አስተሓመመ፡ አዕልዎቶ፡ (librum Philexii) ለግዕዝ፡ አቡነ፡ ሊቀ፡ ኤጲስ፡ ቆጶሳት፡ ዘአዜብ፡ አባ፡ ሰላማ፡ Phlx. in subscr.; አዕለዋ፡ (sc. librum Chrysostomi:) እምልሳነ፡ ጽርዕ፡ ኀበ፡ ልሳነ፡ ዐረቢ፡ Chrys. in proleg. b transscribere,describere, Kuf. 8. (nisi hunc locum ad n. 3,a referre malueris); ሀብኒ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ከመ፡ አዕልዎ፡ Herm. p. 5; ፈነውነ፡ ለከ፡ (sc. literas) አዕሊወነ፡ Cyr. f. 116; (ከመ፡) ያዕልዉ፡ እመጽሐፍ፡ መጻሐፍተ፡ (libros vel exemplaria transscribant e libro) F.N. 51. – (Deut. 25,1 si pro አዕሉ፡ (var. pro ሰአሉ፡) legitur አዕለዉ፡, statuendus erit significatustransgressorem vel reum declarare aliquem).

woorden.betekenis: conversio, catastropha, perversitas, pravitas, rebellio, def
woorden.definitie: n. act. et subst., fem. et m., Pl. ዕልወታት፡, 1 conversio (rerum divinitus immissa), catastropha: እስመ፡ ኮነ፡ ዕልወተ፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ μεταστροφὴ παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ 3 Reg. 12,15; 2 Par. 10,15; እምኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ኮነት፡ ዕልወተ፡ አኮዝያስ፡ καταστροφή 2 Par. 22,7; ትበጽሖሙ፡ ዕልወቶሙ፡ Job 21,17. 2 perversitas, pravitas, rebellio, defectio, transgressio, haeresis, apostasia: ንትሉ፡ በዕልወትነ፡ ὀπίσω τῶν ἀποστροφῶν ἡμῶν Jer. 18,12; Hen. 91,7; እስመ፡ ዕልወተ፡ ሕግ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዝግብር፡ Did. 15; Lit. 158,3; ዕልወታት፡ αἱρέσεις, Chrys. Ta. 8; Lit. 166,3; አዝማነ፡ ዕልወታት፡ Sx. Nah. 20Enc.; ድኅረ፡ ኀለፈ፡ ዕልወት፡ Sx. Sen. 22Enc. 3 descriptum vel transscriptum ( exemplar ), apographum: ሀሎ፡ ኀቤነ፡ ዕልወቱ፡ ለውእቱ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ ἐξ ἀντιγράφων τῶν παρ’ ἡμῖν, Epist. Cyr. ad Joann. in Cyr. f. 116.

woorden.betekenis: defectio, rei publicae conversio, rebellio, seditio, conspir
woorden.definitie: subst., fem. et m., 1 defectio a Deo vel lege ejus: ዐለዉ፡ ማዕሌተ፡ እኩየ፡ Jer. 8,5; ἀθέτημα Dan. 12,1; በማዕሌቶሙ፡ ዘዐለዉከ፡ ἀθεσία Dan. 9,7. 2 rei publicae conversio, rebellio, seditio, conspiratio: ማዕሌተ፡ ሀገር፡ διαβολὴ πόλεως Sir. 26,5; ሀገረ፡ ማዕሌት፡ πόλις ἀποστάτις 2 Esr. 4,15; መልአከ፡ ማዕሌት፡ συστρέμματος 3 Reg. 11,14; Num. 32,14; συστροφή Ps. 63,2; 4 Reg. 15,15; Act. 23,12 rom.; σύνδεσμος 4 Reg. 11,14; Jer. 11,9 vers. alt.; ከመ፡ ይኅበር፡ ማዕሌቶሙ፡ Hos. 7,2; 1 Reg. 22,13; ማዕሌተ፡ ይገብር፡ ላዕሌከ፡ አሞጽ፡ Am. 7,11; Hez. 17,15; 2 Esr. 16,6; 2 Par. 25,27. – Voc. Ae.: ማዕሌት፡ ዘ፡ መንጂያ።

woorden.betekenis: annus
woorden.definitie: subst. m., [عَامٌ] annus: በውእቱ፡ ሳብዕ፡ ዓም፡ Lev. 25,20; Lev. 25,21; Lev. 19,23; Gen. 11,10; 1 Reg. 4,15; Ps. 89,11; በሣልስ፡ ዓም፡ እምዘ፡ ነግሠ፡ Esth. 1,3; Esth. 2,16; በኵሉ፡ ዓም፡ ወዓመት፡ Kuf. 6; ዓም፡ እምዓም፡ (de anno in annum) Kuf. 32; ዓመ፡ ከመ፡ ዮም፡ Gen. 18,10; 4 Reg. 4,16; ለዓሙ፡ Luc. 13,9.

woorden.betekenis: annus, singulis annis, quotannis, anniculus, aera, epocha, a
woorden.definitie: subst., fem. et m., Pl. ዓመታት፡ (multo magis frequentatur quam ዓም፡), annus: በካልእት፡ ዓመተ፡ መንግሥቱ፡ Hagg. 1,1; በቀዳሚ፡ ዓመተ፡ መንግሥቱ፡ Dan. 7,1; በውእቱ፡ ዓመት፡ Dan. apocr. 1,5; ትመውት፡ በዝንቱ፡ ዓመት፡ Jer. 35,16; በእሉ፡ ዓመት፡ 3 Reg. 17,1; እምቅድመ፡ ፪ ዓመት፡ ዘድልቅልቅ፡ Am. 1,1; ምእት፡ ወኀምሳ፡ ዓመት፡ ሎቱ፡ Tob. 14,11; ዓመታተ፡ ብዙኀ፡ ሐይወ፡ Koh. 6,3; Prov. 13,23; ኊልቈ፡ ዓመታትከ፡ Job 38,21; Hen. 5,5; Prov. 4,10; Gen. 1,14; Ps. 89,5; ይዌልጥ፡ ዓመታተ፡ ወመዋዕለ፡ καιροὺς καὶ χρόνος Dan. 2,21; ዓመት፡ (v. ዓመተ፡) እምዓመት፡ (Jahr für Jahr) Kuf. 32; በበዓመት፡ singulis annis,quotannis Job 38,32; 1 Reg. 7,16; ለለዓመት፡ singulis annis, quotannis, Jes. 32,10; Hen. 5,2; 1 Reg. 1,7; Ex. 30,10; ማእረር፡ ዘዘዓመት፡ (annus) Jes. 29,1; ዘዓመት፡ anniculus Lev. 9,3; Ex. 12,5; 4 Esr. 4,23. a in st. c. integrae enuntiationi praemittitur: በዓመተ፡ እሔውጾሙ፡ ἐν ἐνιαυτῷ ἐπισκέψεως αὐτῶν Jer. 11,23; Jer. 23,12; Jer. 26,21; Jer. 31,44. b in chronologia: aera,epocha, ut: ዓመተ፡ ዓለም፡ aera mundi conditi, ዓመተ፡ ሰማዕታት፡, ዓመተ፡ ሥጋዌ፡, al., vid. de variis aeris p. 385–388; Catalog. Cod. Ae. Mus. Brit. in Indice sub voce Aera; Catal. Cod. Ae. Bibl. Bodl. p. 29. ʿamat L ዓመተ፡ ምሕረት ʿamata mǝḥrat year of grace; it designates the Ethiopian calendar, vid. ምሕረት 336b

woorden.betekenis: profundum, depressum, cavum, esse, fieri, inexploratum esse,
woorden.definitie: I,1 (quamquam Perf. nusquam inveni) [עָמק عَمُقَ ܥܡܩ] Subj. ይዕምቅ፡ et ይዕመቅ፡, 1 profundum ( depressum et cavum ) esse vel fieri: እምቅድመ፡ ይዕምቁ፡ ቀላያት፡ Lit. Chrys.; እምቅድመ፡ ይዕመቅ፡ ባሕር፡ M.M. f. 27; toties se prostravit, እስከ፡ የዐምቅ፡ ምድሩ፡ (ኀበ፡ ቆሙ)፡ ከመ፡ ግብ፡ Gad. T.H.; transl. ( inexploratum esse ): የዐምቅ፡ እምነ፡ ማየ፡ ቀላይ፡ ምክራ፡ Sir. 24,29. 2 effodere, excavare (austiefen): የዐምቅ፡ ምድረ፡ በእግሩ፡ ἀνορύσσων Job 39,21 (sic quidem libri Mss.; at praestat II,1 ያዐምቅ፡ vel I,2 ይዔምቅ፡ legere).

woorden.betekenis: profundus, altus, profunda, alta, multa, absconditus, inexpl
woorden.definitie: part. et adj. profundus ( altus ): ሰማይ፡ ልዑል፡ ወምድር፡ ዕሙቅ፡ Prov. 25,3; ግብ፡ ዕሙቅ፡ Prov. 22,14; ማይ፡ ዕሙቅ፡ Prov. 18,4; ዕሙቅ፡ ቀላይ፡ Ps. 68,2; Sir. 24,5; Hen. 88,1; ቈላ፡ ዕሙቅ፡ Hen. 26,3; Hen. 26,4; Hen. 26,5; Jes. 30,33; mare Ex. 15,22; puteus Joh. 4,11; poculum Hez. 23,32; ዕሙቃት፡ profunda, ut: ይከሥት፡ ዕሙቃተ፡ እምጽልመት፡ Job 12,22. a de nocte alta vel multa: ሌሊተ፡ ዕሙቀ፡ Kid. f. 21. b transl.: absconditus, inexploratus, qui investigari non potest, ዘዕሙቅ፡ Dan. 2,22; Ps. 35,6; Ps. 91,5; ይመክሩ፡ ዕሙቀ፡ ምክረ፡ Jes.29,15; Jes. 31,6; de corde humano Jer. 17,9; mysterio Cyr. ad Th. f. 15; ዘዕሙቅ፡ ከናፍሪሁ፡ βαθύχειλος Hez. 3,5. – Voc. Ae.: ዕሙቅ፡ ዘ፡ ጥልቅ፡

woorden.betekenis: profunditas, profundum, altitudo, altum
woorden.definitie: subst. (m.), Pl. ዕመቃት፡ profunditas, profundum, ( altitudo, altum ): Eph. 3,18; Matth. 13,5; ዕመቀ፡ ቀላይ፡ Job 11,8; Hen. 17,3; Hen. 18,11; Hen. 61,5; Hen. 90,26; ዕመቂሆሙ፡ (Mss.: ዕመቃቲሆሙ፡) ለአብሕርት፡ Lit. 172,1; ዕመቀ፡ ዕመቅ፡ βαθὺ βάθος Koh. 7,24; transl.: ዘዕመቀ፡ ልቡ፡ ኢታአምሩ፡ Judith 8,14; ይመጽእ፡ ሕርትምና፡ ላዕሌኪ፡ ወኢታአምሪ፡ ዕመቂሁ፡ Jes. 47,11; ዕመቀ፡ እከያት፡ Prov. 18,3; ዕመቀ፡ ንዴቶሙ፡ 2 Cor. 8,2; ኣዕመቂሁ፡ ለብዕለ፡ ጥበቢሁ፡ Rom. 11,33; ዕመቀ፡ ምስጢር፡ Cyr. ad Reg. f. 26.

woorden.betekenis: profundum, locus profundus, abyssus, locus depressus, vallis
woorden.definitie: (etiam ማዕመቅ፡ Lud. ex Org. Edz. ) et ማዕምቅት፡, subst., (m.), Pl. መዓምቅ፡ et መዓምቅት፡, Pl. Pl. መዓምቃት፡ (Hen. 89,7), profundum, locus profundus: ማዕምቀ፡ ባሕር፡ Ps. 68,3; Ps. 129,1; ማዕምቅቲሃ፡ ለምድር፡ Kuf. 5. Kuf. 48; Jes. 14,15; Hen. 60,11; ማዕምቅተ፡ ሲኦል፡ Prov. 14,12; መዓምቅተ፡ ሲኦል፡ Prov. 16,25; Ps. 62,9; Lit. 172,2. a transl.: ዘይኔስሕ፡ እማዕምቀ፡ ልቡ፡ Clem. f. 83; ፍቅር፡ እማዕምቅ፡ ልብ፡ Jsp. p. 326; እማዕምቀ፡ ኅሊና፡ Org. 2; ማዕምቀ፡ ጽባሕ፡ (multum mane) ዘእንበለ፡ ይጻእ፡ ኮከበ፡ ጽባሕ፡ Kid. f. 7 (vid. ዕሙቅ፡ n. a). b abyssus, Apoc. 20,3; Hen. 56,3; Hen. 88,1; Hen. 90,25; Hen. 90,26; Kuf. p. 32. c locus depressus, vallis: ኵሉ፡ ማዕምቅ፡ ይምላእ፡ φάραγξ Jes. 40,4; Luc. 3,5; ይምላእ፡ ኵሉ፡ መዓምቅ፡ Bar. 5,7.

woorden.betekenis: colluvies, collectio aquae, palus, stagnum, limus
woorden.definitie: (ዓምዓም፡), etiam per አ፡, subst., [an colluvies, collectio aquae ab عَمّ sicut قَمْقَامٌ جَمٌّ?] palus, stagnum, limus: ጽቡረ፡ ዐምዐም፡ (v. ጽንጕን፡) πηλοῦ βάραθρον Jes. 14,23; ἀπὸ πηλοῦ ἰλύος Ps. 39,2; Ps. 68,18; Gad. Ad. f. 196; ውእቱ፡ አውጽአኒ፡ (sc. Jeremiam) እምውስተ፡ ዐዘቅተ፡ ዐምዐም፡ Rel. Bar.; ለኤርምያስ፡ እምግበ፡ ዐምዐም፡ መድኀኒሁ፡ Cod. Mus. Brit. LIV, n. 7; ዐምዐመ፡ ኀጢአት፡ Genz. f. 140 (vid. sub ስጡም፡). – Voc. Ae.: ሐዝሐዝ፡ ረግረግ፡ ዐምዐም፡ ዘ፡ የቄጠማ፡ ወኸ።

woorden.betekenis: stetit
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., eadem quae עָמַד stetit.

woorden.betekenis: columna, stylites, obeliscus, statua, stele, malus, scapus,
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. አዕማድ፡, Pl. Pl. አዕማዳት፡ (2 Reg. 8,8 var.) [עַמּוּד ܥܰܡܽܘܕܳܐ عَمُودٌ عِمَادٌ al.] columna, domus, templi: አቀመት፡ ፯ አዕማደ፡ Prov. 9,1; Hez. 42,6; Jud. 16,26; 3 Reg. 7,3; 3 Reg. 7,4; 3 Reg. 7,5; 3 Reg. 7,6; 3 Reg. 7,7; 3 Reg. 7,39; 3 Reg. 7,40; Jer. 52,17; Apoc. 3,12; tabernaculi Ex. 26,15 seq.; Ex. 26,32; Ex. 27,10 seq.; Ex. 35,10; ዐምደ፡ ኀጺን፡ Jer. 1,18; ከመ፡ አዕማደ፡ ወርቅ፡ እለ፡ ይቀውሙ፡ (ይቀውማ፡) … Sir. 26,18; ዐምደ፡ ምስማኩ፡ ይእቲ፡ Sir. 36,29; አዕማደ፡ መጾር፡ Cant. 3,10; κίονες 3 Reg. 15,15; ገዚፍ፡ ዐምድ፡ Sx. Pag. 1Enc.; አቀምዎሙ፡ በዐምደ፡ ሰኖባር፡ ገዚፍ፡ Sx. Haml. 5; አዕማድ፡ ዘንድቅ፡ ወአዕማድ፡ ዘእብን፡ Chron. Ax. f. 89; ዐምደ፡ ደመና፡ et ዐምደ፡ እሳት፡ Ex. 13,20; Ex. 13,21; Ex. 33,9; Ex. 33,10; Sir. 24,4; 2 Esr. 19,12; Apoc. 10,1; Hen. 18,11; columnae coeli et terrae Job 9,6; Job 26,11; Ps. 74,3; Hen. 18,3. a transl.: Gal. 2,9; 1 Tim. 3,15; ጳጳሳት፡ ኄራን፡ ዘይብልዎሙ፡ አዕማድ፡ Sx. Ter 6Enc.; ዐምደ፡ ሃይማኖት፡ Lud. ex Sx. Pag. 1Enc.; detrahas epactem ab ዐምደ፡ ጾም፡ ዘውእቱ፡ ፵ ዕለት፡ Abush. 27; b ዘዐምድ፡ stylites, ut: አጋቶን፡ ዘዐምድ፡ Sx. Masc. 14. c obeliscus: ዐምደ፡ ሀገረ፡ ፀሓይ፡ Jer. 50,13. d statua, stele, Ex. 23,24. e malus navis: ዐምድኪ፡ ὁ ἱστός σου Jes. 33,23; ሰቀልዎ፡ ዲበ፡ ዐምደ፡ ሐመር፡ Sx. Sen. 19; Sx. Haml. 24; f scapus candelabri, Ex. 25,31. g crus pedis: አዕማደ፡ እገር፡ σκέλη 1 Reg. 17,6; Deut. 28,35. { h columna paginae, ut: ኅልፍ፡ አሐደ፡ ብራና፡ ወእምዝ፡ ኀሊፈከ፡ ፰ አዕማደ፡ ወ፲ወ፫ መሥመራተ፡ ትረክብ፡ መትልወ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ቃል፡, annotatio librarii Codicis Abb. XXXV ad 2 Esr. 15} ʿamd, ዓምድ፡ ʿāmd part of n. pr. (personal name) vid. e.g. ዓምደ፡ ጽዮን፡

woorden.betekenis: inique agere, injustum, iniquum esse, injustitiam facere, in
woorden.definitie: I,2 [חָּמַס et חָמֵץ] 1) inique agere, injustum, iniquum esse, injustitiam facere: ለዐምፆ፡ Ex. 23,2; እንዘ፡ ይዔምፅ፡ Sir. 19,25; ኢተዐምፁ፡ Job 6,29; Job 36,18; ዐምፆ፡ ἀδικία Sir. 10,7; ኢይጸድቅ፡ መያሲ፡ እምዐምፆት፡ Sir. 26,29; ዐመፁ፡ በፍናዊሆሙ፡ Jer. 3,21; Jer. 9,5; Jes. 31,6; Hez. 18,18; ኢተዐምፁ፡ μὴ ἀσεβεῖτε Jer. 22,3; ዐመፅነ፡ ἠνομήσαμεν Dan. apocr. 3,5; Rom. 3,5; Rom. 9,14; Hebr. 6,10; አፉየ፡ ዐመፀ፡ እምጽድቅ፡ τὸ στόμα μου ἀσεβήσει Job 9,20. 2 c. Acc. a pers.: injuria afficere, Gen. 21,23; Lev. 5,21; ይዔምፅዎ፡ ለጻድቅ፡ Jes. 5,23; በእንተ፡ ጌጋዩ፡ ዘዐመፀኒ፡ Hez. 17,20. b rei: injuria violare, injuste agere in re: ዘይፈቱ፡ የዐምፅ፡ (var.: ያዕምፅ፡ II,1) ፍትሐ፡ Sir. 20,4; እመ፡ ዐመፅኩ፡ ፍትሐ፡ ገብርየ፡ Job 31,13; ኢዐመፅነ፡ኪዳነከ፡ Ps. 43,19; እለ፡ ይዔምፁ፡ መዳልወ፡ Did. 21; Ps. 61,9; ሂድክሙ፡ ወዐመፅክሙ፡ ዐስቦሙ፡ Jac. 5,4. 3 passim: rebellare, ut 4 Reg. 9,14 var., maxime in libris amharico-aethiopicis ut Chr. L. Atq. f. 44.

woorden.betekenis: injuria affici
woorden.definitie: III,2 injuria affici: ይትዔመፅ፡ ከመ፡ ሐሳዊ፡ ὡς πλάνος συκοφαντεῖται ho. Procli in Cyr. f. 122.

woorden.betekenis: injustitia, iniquitas, improbitas, injustus, iniquus, injust
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque fem., injustitia,iniquitas, improbitas, ἀδικία, ἄδικον Job 6,30; Job 8,3; Job 16,17; Jes. 60,18; Jer. 3,13; Ps. 7,17; Ps. 61,9; 1 Esr. 4,37; 1 Esr. 3,38; 1 Esr. 4,39; 1 Esr. 4,40; Sir. 7,2; Sir. 10,8; Sir. 17,14; Hen. 42,3; Hen. 91,5; Hen. 91,6; 4 Esr. 3,15; Rom. 1,18; Act. 1,18; Luc. 16,11; ልህቀት፡ ዐመፃ፡ ዲበ፡ ምድር፡ Kuf. 5; ዐመፃ፡ ወግፍዕ፡ Kuf. 35; ἀνομία, ἄνομον Job 11,14; Jes. 5,7; Jes. 5,18; Dan. apocr. 1,28; Ps. 118,3 seq.; ኢነሥአ፡ ዘዐመፃ፡ πλεονασμόν Hez. 18,8; ኢይገብር፡ ዐመፃ፡ Jes. 56,2; Matth. 7,23; Lev. 19,35; ገበርተ፡ ዐመፃ፡ Job 34,8; Job 34,22; Marc. 15,28; Luc. 13,27. a in Genitivo: injustus,iniquus (de personis et rebus): Luc. 18,6; መዳልወ፡ ዐመፃ፡ Prov. 11,1; አኅድግ፡ ኵሎ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ዐመፃ፡ Jes. 58,6. b በዐመፃ፡ injuste, inique: Prov. 1,11; Lev. 5,24; Lit. Cyr. ʿamaḍā L መሐለ፡ በዐመፃ maḥala ba-ʿamaḍā perjure oneself, swear falsely vid. መሐለ 335b

woorden.betekenis: reptilia, volatilia, piscis, ʿāśā
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., Sing. et coll., Pl. ዓሣት፡ [de etymo vid. Dietrich semit. Wortforschung p. 271, at pro עָשׁ et عُثَّةٌ (i.e. ዕፄ፡) quae ille comparavit, substituas خِشَاشٌ reptilia et volatilia] piscis, Tob. 6,3 seq.; Tob. 8,2; Matth. 7,10; Matth. 17,27; በከመ፡ ዓሣ፡ ሶበ፡ ወፅአ፡ እማይ፡ ይመውት፡ Phlx. 61; coll.: Matth. 14,17; Matth. 15,34; Matth. 15,35; Matth. 15,36; Pl. Gen. 1,26; Ex. 7,18; Num. 11,5; Kuf. 23; Koh. 9,12; Job 12,8; Jes. 50,2; Dan. 2,38; Hab. 1,14; Hez. 29,4; Hez. 29,5; 4 Esr. 4,54; Hen. 61,5; Marc. 6,41. ʿāśā C for መሠግረ፡ ዓሣ፡ vid. መሠግር፡ (Leslau)

woorden.betekenis: societatem inivit, coetus, agmen, coetum convocare, invitare
woorden.definitie: I,2 [عَشَرَ III societatem inivit; مَعْشَرٌ coetus, agmen ] coetum convocare, in specie a invitare, ad epulas, Matth. 22,4; Matth. 22,8; Luc.14,16; Luc. 14,17; Luc. 14,24 (Lud.: „fortassis ideo, quod hora diei decima epulae instituerentur apud Aethiopes, sicut nona apud Romanos“). b ritu sacro inaugurare vel consecrare bellum: ዐሥሩ፡ ፀብአ፡ ἁγιάσατε πόλεμον Joel 4,9. – Voc. Ae.: ዐሠረ፡ ብ፡ ዐደመ፡ አቀጸረሂ፡ ይ፡ (vid. scholion ad ዓሥራት፡).

woorden.betekenis: convivium, tempus convivii
woorden.definitie: subst. convivium vel tempus convivii Luc. 14,17.

woorden.betekenis: û, decem, decalogus
woorden.definitie: n. num. (i.e. ዐሥር፡ cum suff. û; etiam ዓሥሩ፡ scriptum), nominibus fem. junctum; ejus character est ፲; decem: Lev. 26,26; Gen. 31,7; ዐሥሩ፡ መካልየ፡ ብሩር፡ Tob. 4,20; Deut. 4,13; 2 Reg. 17,28; Matth. 25,1; ዐሥሩ፡ ወክልኤ፡ Ex. 36,21; Apoc. 21,21; Joh. 1,40; ዐሥሩ፡ ወአሐቲ፡ Matth. 20,6. a Pro suff. û etiam alia pron. suff. admittit: ዐሥሮን፡ ቃላት፡ decalogus M.M. f. 246; ዐሥሮን፡ ደናግል፡ Deg. b Forma ዐሥር፡ nuda raro occurrit, ut ሶበ፡ ተፈጸመ፡ ዓመታት፡ ዓሥር፡ Sx. Mag. 8Enc. (ob rhythmum finalem); Sx. Mij. 26Enc.

woorden.betekenis: û, decem, mille, ʿaśartu, ʾaśartu mǝʾǝt
woorden.definitie: n. num. (i.e. ዐሠርት፡ cum suff. û), plerumque nominibus m. junctum, Acc. ዐሠርተ፡, decem: Gen. 14,4; Gen. 32,23; Gen. 37,2; Gen. 37,9; Ex. 16,36; Ruth 4,2; 1 Reg. 1,8; 1 Reg. 25,5; Jes. 38,5; Jes. 38,8; ዐሠርቱ፡ ወአሐዱ፡ ወርኅ፡ Zach. 1,7; Hez. 26,1; አመ፡ ተርፉ፡ ዐሠርቱ፡ Am. 6,9; 4 Esr. 14,19; Judith 1,1; Ps. 91,3; Matth. 9,20; Matth. 10,1; Matth. 20,24; ዐሠርቱ፡ ምእት፡ mille Ps. 104,7; 2 Petr. 3,8; Apoc. 11,3; etiam alia suff. admittit, ut: ዐሠርቲሆሙ፡ 4 Esr. 3,60. ʿaśartu G አሠርቱ ፡ ምእት፡ ʾaśartu mǝʾǝt «mille» ― ሽሕ፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 42r., vid. ምእት፡ 101

woorden.betekenis: decimus
woorden.definitie: adj. num. decimus, Num. 14,22; በዓሥር፡ ዓመተ፡ መንግሥቱ፡ Jer. 39,1; ዓሥር፡ ወአሐዱ፡ 1 Par. 12,13; 1 Par. 24,12; 1 Par. 24,13; 1 Par. 24,14; 1 Par. 24,15; 1 Par. 24,16; 1 Par. 25,18; 1 Par. 25,19; 1 Par. 25,20; 1 Par. 25,21; 1 Par. 25,22; 1 Par. 25,23; 1 Par. 25,24; 1 Par. 25,25; 1 Par. 25,26; በዓሥር፡ ወኃምስ፡ ዓመት፡ 2 Par. 15,10; በዓሥር፡ ወካልእ፡ ዓመት፡ 2 Par. 34,3; 2 Par. 34,8; pron. suffixa admittit, ut: ወዓሥሮሙ፡ እነግር፡ Sir. 25,7.

woorden.betekenis: viginti, vicesimus
woorden.definitie: n. num. viginti ( vicesimus ); ejus character est ፳; Gen. 31,38; Hagg. 2,16; ዕሥራ፡ በእመት፡ Zach. 5,2; ዕሥራ፡ ሰቅል፡ Hez. 4,10; 1 Par. 24,17; 1 Par. 25,29; 1 Par. 25,30; 1 Par. 25,31; 2 Par. 8,1; Act. 1,15; Apoc. 4,4.

woorden.betekenis: decimus
woorden.definitie: (ዓሥራዊ፡) adj. num., fem. ዓሥሪት፡ (Lud. e Mss. Colb.) decimus: በዓሥራይ፡ ወርኅ፡ Hez. 33,21 var.

woorden.betekenis: decima pars, nomen mensurae, decimae, tributum, munus, oblat
woorden.definitie: vel ዐሥራት፡ subst., fem. et m., decima pars cujuscumque rei, Kuf. p. 42; ዓሥራተ፡ እደ፡ ዘርእክሙ፡ 1 Reg. 8,15; ወሀቦ፡ ዓሥራተ፡ እድ፡ Gen. 14,20; Gen. 28,22; ዓሥራተ፡ እዴሃ፡ ለመስፈርተ፡ ኢፍ፡ Num. 15,4; ዓሥራታ፡ ለኢን፡ Ex. 29,40; Hez. 45,11; ዓሥራቲሁ፡ ለባት፡ Hez. 45,14; Matth. 23,23. a nomen mensurae (δέκατον עִשָּׂרוֹן), quae decimam Ephae partem continet: Lev. 23,17; Lev. 24,5; Num. 15,9; Num. 28et Num. 29. b decimae (frugum pecorisve), deinde tributum, munus, oblatio in genere: τὰ ἐπιδέκατα Deut. 14,23; Lev. 27,30 seq.; Num. 18,21 seq.; ዐሥራቱ፡ ለዐሥራት፡ Num. 18,26; Kuf. 13; ደገመ፡ ዓሥራተ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ Kuf. 32; Mal. 3,8; Am. 4,4; 1 Reg. 1,21; 2 Esr. 20,37; 2 Esr. 20,38; 2 Par. 31,5; 2 Par. 31,6; Sir. 32,11; ቀዳሚ፡ ዓሥራት፡ et ዳግም፡ ዓሥራት፡ Tob. 1,7; ሣልስ፡ ዓሥራት፡ Tob. 1,8; ዓሥራተ፡ እክልነ፡ Tob. 5,14; Hebr. 7,2 seq.; Lit. 160,1; ἀπαρχή Ex. 36,6; Ex. 39,1; Lev. 2,12; Lev. 22,12; μερίς 2 Par. 31,4; τὰ ἐπίλεκτα Joel 4,5. – Voc. Ae.: ዓሥራት፡ ዘ፡ ቀረጽ፡

woorden.betekenis: candicavit, plumbum album, nigrum, stannum
woorden.definitie: subst. [referendum videtur ad غَرَّ candicavit (vic. ܚܘܰܪ, حار, ሐረረ፡)] plumbum album et nigrum, ( stannum ), κασσίτερος et μόλιβος Hez. 22,18 seq.; Hez. 27,12; Sir. 47,18; Ex. 15,10; Num. 31,22; Jer. 6,29; Zach. 5,7; Zach. 5,8; Job 19,24; ምንት፡ ይከብድ፡ እምነ፡ ዐረር፡ Sir. 22,14; 4 Esr. 6,26; 4 Esr. 6,27; 4 Esr. 6,28; 4 Esr. 6,29; 4 Esr. 6,30; 4 Esr. 6,31; Hen. 52,2; Hen. 52,8.

woorden.betekenis: nuditatis, nudus, vacuus, fuit, nudum, esse, se, nudare, vac
woorden.definitie: et ዐረቀ፡ I,1 [vicina sunt עָרָה עוּר עָרַר, quibus significatus nuditatis inest; عَرِيَ nudus et vacuus fuit ] Subj. ይዕረቅ፡ et ይዕርቅ፡ 1 nudum esse, se nudare, Matth. 25,36; Did. 25; 1 Cor. 4,11 rom.; ዕረቃ፡ (v. ዕርቃ፡) γυμναὶ ἔσεσθε Jes. 32,11; ዐረቁ፡ (Perf. III p. Pl. m.) Fek. Jas.; seq. እምነ፡ vestis, ut: Asc. Jes. 9,9; ዐረቀ፡ (II p. Sing. m.) እምነ፡ ልብሰ፡ ኀጢአት፡ Chrys. ho. 2. 2 vacuum esse vel fieri: evacuari [רִיק]: ዐርቀ፡ ኵሉ፡ አህጉር፡ ἐγκατελείφθη Jer. 4,29; ዐረቀ፡ አናቅጺሃ፡ ἐκενώθησαν Jer. 14,2; ዐርቁ፡ Mich. 1,14; የዐርቃ፡ (አብያት፡) Jes. 24,12 var.; ዝቃተ፡ ወይንነ፡ ዐርቀ፡ ወበልየ፡ Jos. 9,11; seq. እምነ፡ Cant. 7,3; transl.: ዐረቀት፡ ሃይማኖት፡ κεκένωται ἡ πίστις Cyr. ad Theod. f. 9. 3 orbari, orbum esse, privari: ዐርቀት፡ እንተ፡ ሰብዐተ፡ ወለደት፡ Jer. 15,9 (ἐκενώθη); Filius homo factus est እንዘ፡ ኢየዐርቅ፡ እመንበረ፡ መለኮቱ፡ . p. 238 n. 3. 4 deficere, cessare: ኢየዐርቅ፡ ህላዌሁ፡ (sc. Christi) በጽርሐ፡ አርያም፡ M.M. f. 3; Org. 1.

woorden.betekenis: nudus, capite inoperto, denudatus, carens, destitutus, priva
woorden.definitie: part. 1 nudus, Matth. 25,38; Matth. 25,44 rom.; Apoc. 3,17; Jac. 2,15; ልብሰ፡ ዕሩቅ፡ Job 22,6; ዕሩቃን፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ልብስ፡ Job 24,7; Job 31,19; Jes. 58,7; ዕሩቃን፡ Tob. 1,17; ኮንኪ፡ ዕርቅተ፡ Hez. 16,7; ዕሩቀ፡ ርእስ፡ capite inoperto F.M. 26,8; sacerdos ኢይኩን፡ ዕሩቀ፡ አባል፡ ቅድመ፡ ገጸ፡ መኑሂ፡ F.M. 32,3. a transl. ( denudatus, carens, destitutus, privatus ): ዐጽም፡ ዕሩቀ፡ ሥጋ፡ Sx. Ter 29 Enc.; c. Acc. rei, ut: እንዘ፡ ዕሩቃን፡ ጥበበ፡ Asc. Jes. 3,23 (cfr. Asc. Jes. 3,26); c. እምን፡ rei: Adam et Eva ኮኑ፡ ዕሩቃነ፡ እምጸጋ፡ ዘላዕሌሆሙ፡ Clem. f. 6; ምድር፡ ዕርቅት፡ እምሰብአ፡ ቀትል፡ (i.e. militibus) Jsp. p. 295; Paulus Samosatenus statuit Christi naturam humanam ዕሩቀ፡ እመለኮት፡ Sx. Teq. 19 Enc. b nudus i.e. solus vel inanis: በእንተ፡ ስብሐት፡ ዕሩቅ፡ Phlx. 40; Phlx. 136. 2 vacuus: መሳብክት፡ ዕሩቃት፡ Jud. 7,16 var.; ከርሥ፡ ዕርቅት፡ ኢትወልድ፡ ፍትወተ፡ እኪተ፡ Chrys. Ta. 29.

woorden.betekenis: nuditas, verenda, pudenda, vacuitas, otium
woorden.definitie: subst. (m.) 1 nuditas Rom. 8,35; Deut. 28,48 var.; ዕርቃነ፡ ክሳዱ፡ Kuf. 26; ኢያጽሕበኒ፡ ዕርቃን፡ III Sal. Mar. 17; እመ፡ አልብነ፡ ልብሰ፡ ለዕርቃንነ፡ Macc. f. 21. 2 verenda, pudenda: Gen. 9,23; Apoc. 3,18; Org. 1; ኢይደሉ፡ ከመ፡ ይነጽር፡ ብእሲ፡ ዕርቃነ፡ ብእሲት፡ F.N. 3. 3 vacuitas, otium: ዕርቃኖሙ፡ ለሕፃናት፡ እምኅሊናት፡ ሕሥምት፡ Phlx. 235; in solitudinem se recipiat ከመ፡ ይኩን፡ ሎቱ፡ ዕርቃን፡ ለገቢረ፡ ኵሉ፡ ትእዛዛት፡ ልዑላት፡ Phlx. 44.

woorden.betekenis: occidere, obire, alicui
woorden.definitie: et ዐረበ፡ I,1 [עָרַב ܥܪܰܒ غَرَبَ] Subj. ይዕረብ፡ et ይዕርብ፡, occidere, obire, de sideribus: ዐርበት፡ ፀሓይ፡ Jos. 8,29; ሶበ፡ ዐረበ፡ ፀሓይ፡ Tob. 2,7; Gen. 28,11; Lev. 22,7; Jos. 10,27; እስከ፡ የዐርብ፡ ፀሓይ፡ Tob. 2,4; Jes. 60,20; Gen. 15,12; Hen. 2,1; Hen. 71,11; Marc. 1,32; ለከዋክብት፡ የዐርብ፡ ብርሃኖሙ፡ Joel 4,15; ይዕረብ፡ Gen. 15,17; Jud. 14,18; ይዕርብ፡ Ex. 22,25; 2 Reg. 3,35; ዐሪቦ፡ ፀሓይ፡ 2 Par. 18,34; Deut. 23,12; Deut. 24,13; በዐሪቦቶሙ፡ Org. 1; c. pron. suff. ( alicui ): ዐረባ፡ ፀሓይ፡ (v. ዐረበ፡ ፀሓያ፡) ἐπέδυ ὁ ἥλιος αὐτῇ Jer. 15,9.

woorden.betekenis: occidens, plaga, occidentalis, Arabia, ʿarab, ʾarab
woorden.definitie: (etiam ዐራብ፡ Kuf. p. 100 ann. 2), 1 occidens, plaga occidentalis, Ps. 49,2; Ps. 74,6; Jes. 43,5; Jes. 45,6; Jes. 59,19; Bar. 4,37; Mal. 1,11; Hez. 27,9; Zach. 8,7; Hen. 23,1; Matth. 24,27; λίψ Ex. 27,9; መንገለ፡ ዐረባ፡ ለሞአብ፡ Num. 22,1; መንገለ፡ ዐረቢሁ፡ Deut. 1,1; Jos. 5,10; ዐረቢሆሙ፡ Judith 1,7. 2 Arabia, Hab. 1,8; Zeph. 3,3; Sx. Tachs.29 Enc., al. ʿarab n. pr. (place name) Arabia; አረብ፡ ʾarab, ዓረብ፡ ʿarab 12 n. 33 (ed.)

woorden.betekenis: vespera, ante, sabbathum, feria, sexta, vigilia, sabbathi, p
woorden.definitie: subst. [proprie vespera, deinde vespera ante sabbathum i.e. feria sexta, sicut עֲרוּבְתָּא ܥܪܘܽܒܬܳܐ] vigilia sabbathi, parasceue, feria sexta: አመ፡ ዕለተ፡ ዐርብ፡ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἕκτῃ Ex. 16,5; Ex. 16,22; παρασκευή Matth. 27,62; Luc. 23,54; በዐርብ፡ ዕለት፡ Did. 29; መዋሥእት፡ ዘዐርብ፡ ፋሲካ፡ Mavâs. n. 47; Cod. Mus. Brit. XXIX, 47; al.

woorden.betekenis: occasus
woorden.definitie: n. act. occasus, solis, Hen. 17,4; Ex. 17,12; ዕርበተ፡ ፀሓይ፡ (Acc. temporis) 3 Reg. 22,36.

woorden.betekenis: occidentalis, Arabicus
woorden.definitie: adj. rel. 1 occidentalis, Ex. 26,20; Ex. 26,35. 2 Arabicus, ut: ልሳነ፡ ቅብጢ፡ ወዐረቢ፡ Sx. Masc. 4; Sx. Nah. 29Enc., al.

woorden.betekenis: occidens, occasus, plaga, occidentalis, hesperus
woorden.definitie: subst. (m.), Pl. ምዕራባት፡, occidens, occasus, plaga occidentalis, Ps. 103,20; Hen. 22,1; Hen. 36,3; Hen. 57,1; Hen. 72,2 seq.; እምዕራበ፡ ፀሓይ፡ Jes. 9,12; Jes. 11,11; Jes. 45,6; Bar. 5,5; Matth. 8,11; Luc. 13,29; Pl. ምዕራባት፡ Hen. 74,4; ኮከበ፡ ምዕራብ፡ hesperus Sx. Jac. 2.

woorden.betekenis: miscuit, permutavit, emporium, locus, mercatus
woorden.definitie: et ማዕረብ፡ subst. i.q. מַעֲרָב (ab עָרַב ܥܪܰܒ miscuit; permutavit merces) emporium, locus mercatus, ἐμπόριον, ማዕረብቶሙ፡ ለአሕዛብ፡ Hez. 27,3; ተርሴስ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ማዕረብኪ፡ (v. ማዕረብትኪ፡) Hez. 27,12 vers. nov. (in glossa marg.: ነጋድያንኪ፡); አራም፡ ማዕረብትኪ፡ Hez. 27,16 vers. nov.

woorden.betekenis: lectus, cubile, grabatus, feretrum, ferreus
woorden.definitie: (etiam አራት፡) subst., m. (ut Job 7,13) et fem. (ut Deut. 3,11; Luc. 17,35.), Pl. ዐራታት፡ [sine dubio i.q. עֶרֶשׂ ܥܰܪܣܳܐ; de etymo vid. Ges. thes. p. 1074] lectus, cubile, κοίτη, κλίνη, Lev. 15,4; Lev. 15,26; Deut. 3,11; Kuf. 22; Kuf. 33; Kuf. 36; Job 7,13; Job 7,18; Cant. 3,1; Cant. 3,7; Ps. 6,6; Esth. 7,8; Asc. Jes. 6,2; Tob. 8,4; ዐራተ፡ ሕማም፡ Ps. 40,3; ይነብራ፡ ውስተ፡ ዐራተ፡ ምስካቦን፡ Hez. 23,41; Ps. 131,3; Matth. 9,2; ዐራታት፡ 2 Reg. 17,28; Esth. 1,6; Am. 6,4; Sir. 48,6; Did. 31. a κράββατος grabatus Marc. 2,4 seq.; Marc. 6,55; Joh. 5,8 seq. b feretrum: 2 Reg. 3,31; 2 Par.16,14; efferebant Herodem በዐራት፡ ዘወርቅ፡ ስርግው፡ በባሕርይ፡ Jsp. 340. c lectus ferreus, torquendo inserviens: ዐራተ፡ ኀጺን፡ Sx. Genb. 19; Sx. Haml. 8, al.; ዐራተ፡ ኀጺን፡ ልሁብ፡ Sx. Tachs. 9Enc.

woorden.betekenis: struere, componere, comparare
woorden.definitie: inus.; vicina II ዐረቀ፡ et ዐረየ፡; עָרַךְ struere, componere, comparare.

woorden.betekenis: vestire, vestitum, praebere, parare, vestitu, carere, nudum,
woorden.definitie: I,2 vestire aliquem, vestitum praebere vel parare alicui, c. Acc. pers.: maritus ይሴስያ፡ ወይዔርዛ፡ sc. uxorem, Clem. f. 137; c. dupl. Acc.: ይዔርዙኒ፡ አልባስየ፡ ወመዋጥሕየ፡ Hos. 2,7; አውጽኡ፡ ሎሙ፡ ዘይዔርዞሙ፡ 4 Reg. 10,22; አልባስ፡ ወክዳናት፡ ዘዐረዘቶን፡ ዶርቃስ፡ Act. 9,39 Platt. [At amh. ታረዘ፡ vestitu carere, nudum esse, Isenb. p. 118].

woorden.betekenis: aequum, planum esse, fieri, aequalem, aequabilem esse, aequa
woorden.definitie: I,2, rarius I,1 [vic. ዐረቀ፡ et ዐረከ፡] 1 Intransit. I,1 et I,2; Subj. I,1 ይዕሪ፡ a aequum, planum esse vel fieri: ወይዕሪ፡ ምድር፡ εἰς ὁμαλισμὸν τῆς γῆς Bar. 5,7; የዐሪ፡ ፍኖተ፡ መብእስ፡ Luc. 3,5; አድባር፡ ወአውግር፡ ይቴሐቱ፡ ወአፍላግ፡ ወመዓምቅት፡ ይዔርዩ፡ ወይከውኑ፡ መጽያሕተ፡ Macc. 5. b aequalem, aequabilem esse vel fieri, aequari, exaequari, passim adverbiis aequaliter, aequabiliter vertendum: እስከ፡ ይልህቅ፡ ወይዔሪ፡ ጽሕምክሙ፡ 1 Par. 19,5; ይዔሪ፡ መዓልት፡ ወሌሊት፡ አመ፡ ፳ወ፭ ለወርኀ፡ መጋቢት፡ Did. 30; Hen. 73,3; ኵሉ፡ ዐረየ፡ ወኅቡረ፡ ዐለወ፡ Ps. 13,4; Rom. 3,12; እስመ፡ መልክእ፡ ለመልክኡ፡ ይዔሪ፡ ወአርአያ፡ ለአርአያሁ፡ Cyr. ad Theod. 12. c congruere, convenire, consentire: ምስለ፡ ብሉይ፡ ኢየዐሪ፡ Luc. 5,36; ዕሩያነ፡ ምክር፡ ለክሒድ፡ ወኢይዔርዩ፡ ለምክር፡ ሠናይ፡ Kid. 3; ሶበ፡ ዘመሩ፡ ወሶበ፡ ዐረዩ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ በ፩ ቃል፡ 2 Par. 5,13; Ps. 82,4. 2 Transit. I,2 a exaequare, complanare: ዐርዩ፡ መጽያሕቶ፡ Jes. 40,3; Marc. 1,3; Luc. 3,4; እዔርያ፡ (v. ኣዔርያ፡) Zach. 4,7. b unire, conciliare: ከመ፡ ተዐርዩ፡ ልበ፡ ὁμόφρονες 1 Petr. 3,8; ዐርዮ፡ ግዕዝ፡ ὁμόνοια Herm. 36; ዐርዮ፡ ὁμόνοια Herm. 91; እስመ፡ ኮነ፡ ዐርዮ፡ በማእከሎሙ፡ Kuf. 36. c idem facere vel pati cum aliquo; passim adverbiis simul, unâ cum vertendum: እምከመ፡ ዐረይነ፡ ሕማመ፡ ንዔሪ፡ ክብረ፡ Rom. 8,17; 2 Tim. 2,11; 2 Tim. 2,12; 2 Cor. 1,7 rom.; 1 Cor. 11,32. d aequiparare, ut videtur: ከመ፡ መቅሠፍተ፡ ልሳን፡ ንዔሪ፡ በኵሉ፡ እኩይ፡ μάστιξ γλώσσης πᾶσιν ἐπικοινωνοῦσα Sir. 26,6 var. – Voc. Ae.: ይዔሪ፡ ዘ፡ ይትአከል፡; ዐረዩ፡ ዘ፡ አስተካከሉ።

woorden.betekenis: aequalem, parem fieri, haberi, exaequari, aequiparari, meum
woorden.definitie: III,2 aequalem vel parem fieri vel haberi, exaequari, aequiparari: በይእቲ፡ ዕለት፡ ይትዔረይ፡ መዓልት፡ ምስለ፡ ሌሊት፡ Hen.72,20; እምይእዜ፡ ተዐረይነ፡ Hen. 102,7; ተዐርዮ፡ Kuf. p. 64; c.c. ምስለ፡ Sap. 18,11; c. በ፡, ut: ሊተ፡ (i.e. meum est ) ተዐርዮ፡ በእመ፡ እሉ፡ ውሉድ፡ Jsp. p. 366; c. ለ፡ Lud. ex Sx. Teq. 6Enc. (at in Sx. Tubing. c. Acc.); c. ከመ፡ Chrys. Ta. 28(vid. sub ንጥበት፡); c. Acc.: Ps. 88,7; ኢይትዔረዮ፡ ቄጵርስስ፡ Hez. 31,8 var.; Job 28,19; አልቦ፡ ዘይትዔረዮ፡ ለቅንአት፡ Prov. 27,4; ኢድልው፡ ይትዐረዮሙ፡ (non dignus qui iis aequiparetur) Jsp. p. 332.

woorden.betekenis: aequalis, par, idem, coaequalis divinitate, aequaliter, pari
woorden.definitie: part., fem. ዕሪት፡ 1 aequalis, par, idem, Ex. 26,24; Lev. 7,10; 3 Reg. 7,48; Hez. 41,8; 4 Esr. 1,12; 4 Esr. 8,11; Asc. Jes. 8,16; Act. 11,17; Apoc. 21,16; Luc. 6,34; ዕሩየ፡ ግበሩ፡ ሎሙ፡ τὰ αὐτά Eph. 6,9; c.c. ለ፡, ut: ዕሩየ፡ ትከውን፡ ለመላእክት፡ Asc. Jes. 8,15; c. ምስለ፡ crebro in Chrys. et Cyr.; አእመረ፡ ከመ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዕሩይ፡ ምስለ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ አርድእት፡ F.M. 3,6; Filius ዘዕሩይ፡ ምስለ፡ አብ፡ በመለኮቱ፡ Lit. 163,3; ዕሩየ፡ መለኮት፡ coaequalis divinitate, Lud. 2 በዕሩይ፡ vel ዕሩየ፡ adv. aequaliter, pariter, Kuf. p. 64; Jsp. p. 332(vid. sub ከፈለ፡); መፍትው፡ ለነ፡ ንመጽውት፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ በዕሩይ፡ እንዘ፡ ኢንሌሊ፡ ጽኑሳነ፡ Chrys. Ta. 10; Hen. 60,15; ዕሩየ፡ ተጸልኡ፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ረሲዕኒ፡ ወርስዓኑ፡ ἐν ἴσῳ Sap. 14,9; Sap. 18,11; ἑξῆς Ex. 10,1. 3 conciliatus, concors: ልበ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዕሩይ፡ ብእሲ፡ ምስስ፡ ብእሲ፡ Kuf. 43; ኮኑ፡ ዕሩያነ፡ በልቦሙ፡ ከመ፡ ያፈቅር፡ እኍ፡ እኋሁ፡ Kuf. 46.

woorden.betekenis: aequalitas, coaequalitas divinitatis, aequaliter, aequabilit
woorden.definitie: et plerumque ዕሪና፡ subst., aequalitas: Abush. 37; τοῦ Λόγου ዕሪና፡ ዘእግዚአብሔር፡ አብ፡ ἡ ἰσότης ἡ πρὸς τὸν πατέρα Cyr. c. Pall. f. 66; ዘኢየአምን፡ በአካላተ፡ ሥሉስ፡ አው፡ ዘኢየአምን፡ ዕሪናሆሙ፡ በባሕርይ፡ ወበአምላክና፡ F.M. 27,7; ዕሪና፡ መለኮት፡ coaequalitas divinitatis (in Trinitate), Lit. Joh.; c.c. ለ፡, ut: ሀሎ፡ ወልድ፡ በአርአያ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወበዕሪና፡ ወበመልክእ፡ ለዘወለዶ፡ Cyr. ad Theod. f. 12; እንዘ፡ ሀሎ፡ በአርአያ፡ ወበዕሪና፡ ለአቡሁ፡ ἐν μορφῇ καὶ ἰσότητι τοῦ πατρός Cyr. c. Pall. f. 98; በዕሪና፡ (i.q. ዕሩየ፡) aequaliter, aequabiliter: Deus አዘዘ፡ አክብሮቶሙ፡ (sc. patrem et matrem) በዕሪና፡ Jsp. p. 331; እፎ፡ ትከውን፡ ክብር፡ በዕርይና፡ ποῦ ἴση ἡ τιμή Chrys. ho. 33; ለይረሱ፡ በዕሪና፡ F.N. 42,4; { aequinoctium: Abush. (vid. sub ጸዳያዊ፡)}

woorden.betekenis: senescere
woorden.definitie: senescere vid. sub አረገ፡

woorden.betekenis: ascendere, escendere, conscendere, assumi, ascendunt, veniun
woorden.definitie: I,1 [عَرَجَ; vid. etiam Ges. thes. p. 1067] Subj. ይዕረግ፡ et ይዕርግ፡, ascendere, ( escendere, conscendere ). a sensu proprio: Ex. 24,1; Gen. 28,12; 1 Reg. 9,11; 1 Reg. 14,13; Koh. 3,21; Asc. Jes. 8,1; Asc. Jes. 9,1; Asc. Jes. 9,2; Asc. Jes. 9,3; c.c. variis praepos.: ርቱዐ፡ የዐርግ፡ እምነ፡ ምድር፡ 1 Reg. 28,14; ሶበ፡ የዐርግ፡ ውስተ፡ መዓርገ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡ Sir. 50,11; Num. 13,17; Jud. 4,12; Jud. 9,48; አዐርግ፡ ውስተ፡ ሰማይ፡ Jes. 14,13; Apoc. 11,12; ዐርገ፡ ውስተ፡ ሐመር፡ Joh. 6,22; Jon. 1,3; ዲበ፡ ምርካብ፡ Gen. 49,4; አብሓኵ፡ የዐርጉ፡ ዲበ፡ አጣሊ፡ Gen. 31,10; Hen. 86,4; ዐርገ፡ ኀበ፡ አንቀጽ፡ Ruth 4,1; ዕርግ፡ ኀቤነ፡ Prov. 25,7; Joh. 20,17; ዝየ፡ Asc. Jes. 8,14; c. Acc. loci: ዘዐረግሙ፡ አንሕስተ፡ Jes. 22,1; 2 Reg. 18,24; ዐርገ፡ ሰግላ፡ Luc. 19,4; ሐመረ፡ Joh. 6,24; ዐርገ፡ ቤተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Jes. 37,1; Matth. 20,18; de sidere ascendente Hen. 72,5; transl.: ኈለቈ፡ እምኔሁ፡ ወዐርገ፡ Kuf. 32. b pergere e regione depressiore in editiorem: Gen. 13,17; Gen. 50,5; Gen. 50,6; Ex. 33,1; Jos. 2,1; Jes. 2,3; Jes. 7,6; Joh. 12,20; Act. 8,31. c ascendere vel assumi in coelos: Deus ዐርገ፡ እምኀቤሁ፡ Kuf. 32; Gen. 35,13; Jud. 13,20; ዐርገ፡ በሰረገላት፡ ἀναληφθείς Sir. 48,9; Marc. 16,19; Mavâs. n. 54. d de rebus: ዐርገ፡ ጢሱ፡ Apoc. 8,4; Apoc. 14,11; Ps. 17,10; የዐርግ፡ ንስኀቱ፡ Joel 2,20; de termino Jos. 15,15; Jos. 16,1; Jos. 18,12; de fonte Gen. 2,6; de germine: የዐርግ፡ ፍሬ፡ እምጕንዱ፡ Jes. 11,1; de clamore, precibus: Jer. 14,2; Ps. 73,24; Sir. 32,20; Act. 10,4. e de cogitationibus, quae ascendunt in corde i.e. veniunt in mentem, subeunt animum: ዐርገ፡ ዲበ፡ ኅሊናሁ፡ ከመ፡ ይግበር፡ 2 Par. 24,4; ዐርገ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ውስተ፡ ልብከ፡ 2 Par. 1,11; ዐርገኒ፡ (mihi) ኅሊናየ፡ ውስተ፡ ልብየ፡ ወኀለይኩ፡ ከመ፡ … 1 Par. 28,2; 4 Esr. 1,1; ዐርገ፡ ውስተ፡ ልቡ፡ Jer. 51,21; Luc. 24,38. f de rebus, quae ascendunt i.e. inscribuntur in libros coelestes: ኢየዐርግ፡ ውስተ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ሕይወት፡ Kuf. 36; ኀጢአት፡ ተዐርግ፡ በእንቲአሁ፡ ውስተ፡ መጻሕፍት፡ Kuf. 39. – Voc. Ae.: ዐርገ፡ ዘ፡ ኼደ፡ ሰረረሂ፡ ይ፡; aliud: ዐርገ፡ ብ፡ ወጻ።

woorden.betekenis: ascendere, conscendere, escendere, facere, sursum ducere, su
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 ascendere (conscendere, escendere) facere, aliquem: 1 Reg. 28,15; Jos. 2,6; ይፈቅዱ፡ ያዕርግዎ፡ ውስተ፡ ሐመር፡ Joh. 6,21; አዕረግዎ፡ ለቅዱስ፡ እምውስተ፡ ሐመር፡ Sx. Hed. 28; aliquid, ut መዐዛ፡ Kuf. 6; fumum Jud. 20,38. 2 a sursum ducere: አዕረጎሙ፡ ደብረ፡ ነዋኀ፡ Marc. 9,2; Matth. 4,1; ውስተ፡ ደብር፡ Luc. 4,5; አይቴ፡ ታዐርገኒ፡ Asc. Jes. 7,3; Asc. Jes. 7,4; Asc. Jes. 8,8; ያዐርጎሙ፡ እምድር፡ Hos. 2,2; ኣዐርገከ፡ ዲበ፡ ምድርየ፡ Hez. 38,16; Ex. 3,17; de via, quae sursum ducit Jud. 20,31; Jud. 21,19. b sursum portare vel ferre, 3 Reg. 17,19; Act. 21,35; Ex. 19,8; Hen. 90,14; Hen. 13,4. c sursum trahere Matth. 13,48; አዕረገ፡ ደመና፡ እምአጽናፈ፡ ምድር፡ Jer. 28,16. d sursum emittere: አንቅዕተ፡ ቀላያት፡ ያዐርጉ፡ ማያተ፡ Kuf. 5; vel s.pellere: ያዐርጋ፡ ማየ፡ ላዕለ፡ ውስተ፡ ከተማ፡ አቊጽል፡ Macc. 20; vel s. efferre ከመ፡ ታዐርግ፡ ባሕር፡ ማዕበላ፡ Hez. 26,3; vel educere scalas, Ex. 20,26. e invehere frumentum in horrea, Kuf. 89. f sursum ferre in coelum et inscribere in libros coelestes Kuf. 110; Kuf. 115. 3 ascendere facere i.e. altari impositum offerre Deo sacrificium, ἀναφέρειν (הֶעֳלָה): Gen. 8,20; Num. 23,2; Num. 23,4; Kuf. 6 seq.; Jes. 57,6; 2 Par. 29,29; 2 Par. 29,32; Jac. 2,21; 1 Petr. 2,5; transfertur in preces et laudes: እለ፡ ያዐርጉ፡ ጸሎቶሙ፡ ለቅዱሳን፡ Tob. 12,15; ኪያከ፡ ይሴብሑ፡ ወለከ፡ ያዐርጉ፡ ስብሓተ፡ Mavâs. n. 17 et Mavâs. n. 19; Clem. 2. a adolere thus: ካህን፡ ያዐርግ፡ ዕጣነ፡ Lit. 162,2; Lit. 172,2. b de oblatione (ἀναφορᾷ), sacramenti altaris proprie dicta, qua consecratio fit: p. 308 (n. 43); Sx. Teq. 2 Enc.; p. 239 n. 8. ʾaʿǝraga L አዕረገ፡ ቍርባነ ʾaʿǝraga qʷǝrbāna celebrate Mass, vid. ቍርባን፡ 440b

woorden.betekenis: ascendens, oblatus
woorden.definitie: part. ascendens, in specie oblatus, Lit. 160,2.

woorden.betekenis: ascensio, emersus, assumtio, oblatio, suffitio, ascensus, lo
woorden.definitie: n. act. et subst. 1 ascensio: die creationis secundo ኮነ፡ ዕርገቱ፡ ለማይ፡ Clem. f. 3. a emersus: ሰላም፡ ለዕርገተ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ እምባሕር፤ እንዘ፡ እብን፡ ክቡድ፡ ውስተ፡ እገሪሁ፡ እሱር፡ Sx. Jac. 6Enc. b ascensio vel assumtio in coelum, Luc. 9,51; Asc. Jes. 1,5; ዕርገተ፡ ሰማይ፡ Asc. Jes. 2,9; ዕርገቱ፡ ለኢየሱስ፡ ውስተ፡ ሰማይ፡ Clem. f. 1; festum ascensionis Christi: ዕለተ፡ ዕርገት፡ Cod. Mus. Brit. XXIX n. 54; ዋዜማ፡ ዘዕርገት፡ Deg.; ዕርገተ፡ ኢሳይያስ፡ ነቢይ፡ inscriptus est liber Asc. Jes. (a Laurentio editus). c oblatio sacramenti proprie dicta: nemo ecclesia exeat ዘእንበለ፡ ይትፈጸም፡ ዕርገተ፡ ቍርባን፡ F.N. 12 (vid. አዕረገ፡ n. 3, b). d suffitio thuris: ዕርገተ፡ ዕጣን፡ Lit. Epiph. 2 ascensus, locus acclivis: የዐርጉ፡ ውስተ፡ ዕርገተ፡ አሳኢ፡ κατὰ τὴν ἀνάβασιν Ἀσσεῖς 2 Par. 20,16 (v. ምዕራገ፡).

woorden.betekenis: remissus, laxus fuit, quietavit, quies
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., quam cum רָפָה remissus, laxus fuit, رَفَا quietavit, رَوْفٌ quies componere haud dubito. – Forma ይዕርፍ፡ Kuf. p. 131 ann. 9 nonnisi lapsu calami scriptum videtur pro ያዕርፍ፡

woorden.betekenis: quiescere, requiescere, quietem invenire, nancisci, quietum,
woorden.definitie: II,1 A Intransit. 1 quiescere, requiescere, Job 3,13; ከመ፡ ኣዕርፍ፡ ሕቀ፡ Job 10,20; Jes. 13,20; Jes. 14,1; Ruth 3,18; ዘሞተ፡ አዕረፈ፡ Sir. 38,23; Dan. 12,13; Ex. 23,12; Jes. 11,6; Marc. 6,31; Marc. 14,41; ከመ፡ ያዕርፉ፡ እምጻማሆሙ፡ Apoc. 14,13; ዕረፍት፡ እንተ፡ እምይእዜ፡ ያዐርፉ፡ 4 Esr. 6,68; a vexatione: ያዐርፍ፡ እምኵሉ፡ እኩይ፡ Prov. 1,33; Hen. 53,7; አዕረፈት፡ ምድር፡ እምነ፡ ቀትል፡ Jos. 14,18. a quietem invenire vel nancisci: እነብብ፡ ከመ፡ ኣዕርፍ፡ Job 32,20; በእማንቱ፡ መዋዕል፡ አዕረፉ፡ አይሁድ፡ እምነ፡ ጸላኢሆሙ፡ Esth. 9,22; Hen. 95,1; Hen. 103,13; Philem. 7. b quietum vel tranquillum se tenere: Job 11,19; ኢይክላ፡ እንከ፡ አዕርፎ፡ Jer. 30,12; አዕርፊ፡ Jer. 29,6; በቤታ፡ ኢያዐርፍ፡ እገሪሃ፡ Prov. 7,11. c otiari, feriari: Gen. 2,2; Ex. 34,21; Deut. 5,14; Hebr. 4,4; Hebr. 4,10; de agro: ኅድጋ፡ ታዕርፍ፡ (relinque eum ut cultu vacet) Ex. 23,11. d residere, commorari: Gen. 8,9; ታቦት፡ አዕረፈት፡ ዲበ፡ ርእሰ፡ ሉባር፡ Kuf. 5; Koh. 7,9; ያዐርፍ፡ ዲቤሁ፡ መንፈሰ፡ ጥበብ፡ Jes. 11,2; Num. 11,25; Luc. 10,6; Kuf. p. 131; Hen. 2,3; Hen. 60,25; Org. 1; accumbere mensam Apoc. 3,20. e aquiescere: ታዐርፍ፡ በኦሪትከ፡ ἐπαναπαύῃ τῷ νόμῳ Rom. 2,17. f niti, sustineri Hen. 33,2. g obdormire, obire: ወአዕረፈ፡ ምስለ፡ አበዊሁ፡ Sir. 47,23; አዕረፈ፡ በሠናይ፡ ርሥእ፡ 1 Par. 29,28; ዕድሜ፡ ለአዕርፎ፡ 2 Tim. 4,6; አኀዊክሙ፡ እለ፡ አዕረፉ፡ በሃይማኖት፡ በክርስቶስ፡ Did. 34; Lit. 164,2; Sx. crebro; አዕረፈ፡ እምዓለም፡ Sx. Pag. 3 Enc. 2 remittere, cessare, desinere: ኢያዐርፍ፡ እስከ፡ ይመውት፡ οὐ μὴ κοπάσῃ Sir. 23,17; Job 6,7; አዕረፍኩ፡ እምእኩይ፡ Jer. 49,10; ታዐርፍ፡ ዘርአ፡ ወታዐርፍ፡ ዐፂደ፡ Ex. 34,21; ኢያዕረፈ፡ ያንእስ፡ Jsp. p. 307; ሶበ፡ አዕረፈ፡ እንዘ፡ ይነግር፡ Jer. 50,1. B Transit. 1 quiescere sinere vel facere, quietem dare vel concedere, ad requiem perducere, refocillare, recreare, Ex. 5,5; ያረውጾን፡ ወኢያዐርፎን፡ Herm. p. 58; ኢናዐርፎሙ፡ μὴ ἀνῶμεν αὐτούς Jer. 27,7; ἀναπαύειν, ያዕርፍኪ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዕረፍተ፡ ስራሕኪ፡ 4 Esr. 10,37; c. Acc. pers. et እምነ፡, ut: ያዐርፈኒ፡ እምኵነኔየ፡ Job 23,7; እምሕማምከ፡ Jes. 14,3; እምነ፡ ፀር፡ Deut. 25,19; Deut. 12,10; እምኵሉ፡ ጸላእቱ፡ 1 Par. 22,9; 2 Par. 14,7; አዕረፎ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ እምኵሉ፡ ዐውዱ፡ Sir. 47,13; Jos. 21,42; populum: Ex. 33,14; Deut. 3,20; Hebr. 4,8; singulos (de quiete et corporis et animi): ዘይፈትሖ፡ ለእሱር፡ ወያዐርፎ፡ ለምንዱብ፡ ወያሰትዮ፡ ለጽሙእ፡ Clem. f. 172; 1 Reg. 16,16; ያዐርፋ፡ ለእሙ፡ Sir. 3,6; Prov. 29,17; Matth. 11,28; Clem. f. 201; አዕርፋ፡ ለነፍስየ፡ Philem. 20; ἀνέψυξε 2 Tim. 1,16; ἀπαλλάξῃ Hebr. 2,15; Asc. Jes. 4,15; ጸለየ፡ እምደዌ፡ እግሩ፡ ያዕርፎ፡ (sc. morte) Sx. Teq. 3 Enc.; አዕርፍ፡ ነፍሶሙ፡ (sc. mortuorum) ወተሣሀሎሙ፡ Lit. 165,2; እግዚኦ፡ አዕርፍ፡ አበዊነ፡ ወአኀዊነ፡ እለ፡ ኖሙ፡ Lit.164,4. 2 remittere vel cessare facere: ወያዐርፍዋ፡ ለመዐት፡ Zach. 6,8. 3 demittere vel deponere ut quiescat: አዕረፈ፡ ሊተ፡ ፈጣሪየ፡ መንበርየ፡ Sir. 24,8.

woorden.betekenis: quies, requies, respiratio, intermissio, decessus in requiem
woorden.definitie: subst., fem. et m., Pl. ዕረፍታት፡, quies, requies, Gen. 49,15; Koh. 6,5; Koh. 9,17; Ps. 22,2; በኀቤክሙ፡ አልብየ፡ ዕረፍት፡ Job 21,34; አልባ፡ ዕረፍተ፡ Thren. 1,3; መካነ፡ ዕረፍት፡ 4 Esr. 6,1; በዕረፍት፡ ይሄሉ፡ Sap. 4,7; ዕረፍተ፡ ኀሠሥኩ፡ Sir. 24,7; Ruth 3,1; Matth. 12,43; ረከበ፡ ዕረፍተ፡ Ruth 1,9; Sir. 6,28; Sir. 30,34; Jes. 57,20; Matth. 11,29; ውእቱ፡ ይሁቦሙ፡ ዕረፍተ፡ Job 34,29; Jes. 25,10; ዕረፍተ፡ ስራሕ፡ 4 Esr. 10,37; ዕረፍት፡ እምኵሉ፡ ሐዘን፡ Genz. f. 33; ንባእ፡ ውስተ፡ ዕረፍቱ፡ Hebr. 4,1; Hebr. 4,3; ፫ ዕረፍታት፡ (tria requiei genera) Chrys. ho. 6. a respiratio, ἀνάψυξις Ex. 8,11. b intermissio: Apoc. 4,8; Apoc. 14,11; እምዝ፡ ኮነ፡ ዕረፍተ፡ ዘሕንጻ፡ Herm. p. 79; ገብሩ፡ ዕረፍተ፡ ለሕንጻ፡ Herm. p. 90. c decessus in requiem aeternam, obitus: ሶበ፡ በጽሐ፡ ጊዜ፡ ዕረፍቱ፡ ለአዳም፡ Clem. f. 9; Sx. Ter 11; በዕረፍቱ፡ (tempore obitus ejus) Sx. Sen. 13 Enc.; በዕለተ፡ ዕረፍትከ፡ ውስተ፡ ብሔረ፡ ተድላ፡ ወፍግዕ፡ Sx. Masc. 21 Enc.

woorden.betekenis: locus quietis, locus quo quis residet, mansio, statio, dever
woorden.definitie: subst. (m.), Pl. ምዕራፋት፡ 1 locus quietis, locus quo quis residet, mansio, κατάπαυσις Deut. 12,9; Ps. 131,15; ወይከውን፡ ክቡረ፡ ምዕራፊሁ፡ Jes. 11,10; ይእኅዝ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ምዕራፈ፡ Jes. 32,17; Jes. 34,14; ማኅደረ፡ ምዕራፍየ፡ Jes. 66,1; ኢየሩሳልም፡ ሀገረ፡ ማኅደረ፡ ምዕራፊከ፡ Sir. 36,18; ደብተራ፡ ምዕራፈ፡ ስብሐተ፡ ስምከ፡ Judith 9,8; ሀገረ፡ ምዕራፍከ፡ κατασκηνώσεως Sap. 9,8; Hen. 38,2; μονή Joh. 14,23; Chrys. Ta. 27; ሰላም፡ ለሕፅንኪ፡ ለጥበበ፡ ሰማይ፡ ምዕራፋ፡ III Sal. Mar. 22; ከመ፡ ንኩን፡ ምዕራፈ፡ ስሙ፡ ለሥሉስ፡ Clem. f. 201. a statio Num. 10,33; ምዕራፋት፡ Hen. 60,14; ወትብል፡ ሶበ፡ ታወጽእ፡ ግኑዘ፡ እማኅደሩ፡ ሜም፡ እስከ፡ ሳምኬት፡ ወታዐርፍ፡ ፩ ምዕራፈ፡ ወእምዝ፡ ትብል፡ … Genz. f. 63. b deversorium: ዘእንበለ፡ በምዕራፍ፡ ወበፍኖት፡ በግብር፡ አዕሪፎ፡ παρὲξ τοῦ ἐν πανδοχείῳ ἐν ὁδῷ δι’ ἀνάγκην καταλύειν II Can. Ap. 49. c ምዕራፈ፡ መዛርዕ፡ fulcra brachiorumsellae, ἀγκῶνες 2 Par. 9,18. d conditorium pie defuncti, Lud. ex Sx. Ter 3 Enc. 2 nomen mensurae viae vel longitudinis, ut stadium, millarium, lapis: στάδιον Luc. 24,13; Joh. 6,19; Joh. 11,18; Apoc. 14,20; Herm. p. 20; μίλιον Matth. 5,41; Kuf. 10; መጠነ፡ ፪ ምዕራፍ፡ Gad. T.H.; ወመጠነ፡ ውእቱ፡ ቅጽር፡ ፵ወ፭ ምዕራፍ፡ Jsp. p. 274; ወኮነት፡ በአቱ፡ ርሕቅተ፡ ፲ ምዕራፈ፡ Phlx. 55. 3 sectio vel caput vel locus libri, ex. gr. capita librorum biblicorum a nobis recepta ab Aethiopibus appellantur ምዕራፋት፡, vid. Cat. Cod. Ae. Bibl. Bodl. p. 1-9; Oct. P. II p. 163; Oct. P. II p. 173; ኢትሌቡ፡ እሎንተ፡ ምዕራፋተ፡ (τούτους τοὺς ψαλμούς) i.e. haec capita vel hos locos (postquam antea quidam Psalterii loci allegati sunt) Chrys. Ta. 4; ወከመዝ፡ ገብረ፡ ውስተ፡ ብዙኅ፡ ምዕራፋት፡ እምነ፡ መልእክቱ፡ (in multis locis epistolae) Chrys. ho. 8. – Hoc titulo inscriptus est liber quidam, quo hymni et lectiones in dies festos continentur, vid. Cod. Bibl. Mus. Brit. XXXIII et d’Abbad. Cat. p. 99. 4 pausa, signum vel nota pausae, ut ፤, ። ፨, ።=።, al., F.M. 2,11; Kedr f. 52 (vid. sub ሆሄ፡ col. 1). mǝʿrāf ? ምዕራፍ፡ መቃብረ፡ እሙ፡ ለአባ፡ ሳሙኤል። ‘le meʿerāf, tombeau de la mère d’abbā Sāmuʾēl’ 3 l. 23 (ed.), 3 l. 28–29 (tr.) L ምዕራፍ mǝʿǝrāf resting place, quiet place, site, residence, support; also a measure of length, chapter of a book, section of a book, common antiphonary, collection of hymns and chants, punctuation mark 69b

woorden.betekenis: pallium
woorden.definitie: subst., ut videtur, pallium prophetae: ኤልሳዕ፡ ሶበ፡ ወረወ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ምዕራፊቶ፡ ኤልያስ፡ ኀደገ፡ ዓለመ፡ ወተለዎ፡ Phlx. 5. (Si quidem lectio bona est, equidem ምዕራፊት፡ e ምዕፋሪት፡ transpositum existimaverim).

woorden.betekenis: cochlea, r, hausit, cochlear crucis, vomer, aratrum, ʿǝrf, ʾ
woorden.definitie: subst., fem. et m. 1 cochlea r [غَرَفَ hausit aquam manu aliave re]: ግበር፡ እዴከ፡ ላዕለ፡ ዛቲ፡ ዕርፈ፡ መስቀል፡ (cochlear crucis) ለሠሪዐ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ ወደሙ፡ Lit. 159,1; Lit. 158,4; ዲያቆን፡ ኢያጥምቅ፡ ወኢያቅርብ፡ በእዴሁ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ እምጽዋዕ፡ በዕርፈ፡ መስቀል፡ F.M. 31,2; Graecis appellatur λαβὶς ἁγία, vid. ,6,79; Renaudot lit. orient. I p. 195 seq. 2 vomer, aratrum, Kuf. p. 48; ዘያጸንዕ፡ ዕርፎ፡ ὁ κρατῶν ἀρότρου Sir. 38,25; Luc. 9,62; ወዕርፈ፡ ወመንኰራኵረ፡ καὶ τὸ ἄρατρον 1 Par. 21,23; Apostoli እለ፡ ሐረስዋ፡ ለምድር፡ በዕርፈ፡ መስቀል፡ ወዘርኡ፡ መዝገበ፡ ቃልከ፡ ውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ Mavâs. n. 60; Lit. Joh.; Org. 5. 3 Dubium quid significet ዕርፍ፡ in loco F.N. 33,4, sc.: latroni ne vendant arma ወኢዕርፈ፡ ለጕሕላዊ። ʿǝrf ዕርፈ፡ መስቀል፡ ʾǝrfa masqal ‘spoon serving for administering the Eucharist’ 70a; ወዕርፈ፡ መስቀል፡ ዘወርቅ፡ ፩፡ ‘1 cucchiaio eucaristico d’oro’ 43 l. 25 (ed.), 36 l. 23–24 (tr.); ፫፡ ዕርፈ፡ መስቀል፡ ዘብሩር። ‘3 ʿerfa masqal en argent’ 13 l. 8 (ed.), 14 l. 4 (tr.), ወርቅ፡ ዕርፈ፡ መስቀል፡ ፩። ‘un ʿerfa masqal en or’ 71 l. 2 (ed.), 85 l. 14–15 (tr.), vid. መስቀል L ዕርፈ፡ መስቀል፡ ʾǝrfa masqal spoon serving for administering the Eucharist, lit. ‘spoon of the cross’ (it is so called because the handle has a little cross) 70a

woorden.betekenis: pretio conductus, opus fecit, pretium locati, mercede conduc
woorden.definitie: I,1 [عَسَفَ pretio conductus pro aliquo opus fecit; عَسْبٌ pretium locati admissarii] Subj. ይዕስብ፡, mercede conducere, μισθοῦσθαι, c. Acc. pers.: Jud. 18,4; 2 Reg. 10,6; 4 Reg. 7,6; 1 Par. 19,7; ከመ፡ ይዕስብ፡ ሎቱ፡ እምብሔረ፡ ሶርያ፡ 1 Par. 19,6; ተዐስብዎ፡ ለነሃቢ፡ Jes. 46,6; ዐሰቡ፡ ሰብአ፡ ላዕሌየ፡ 2 Esr. 16,12; 2 Esr. 4,5; Herm. p. 43.

woorden.betekenis: mercede conduci, mercedem accipere, sibi conducere, de condu
woorden.definitie: et ተዐሰበ፡ III,1 (crebro ተዓስበ፡ / ተዓሰበ፡ scriptum, sed non est quod cum Lud. stirpem III,3 statuamus) 1 pass.: mercede conduci, mercedem accipere, Herm. p. 43. 2 reflex. sibi conducere, c. Acc., aliquem Matth. 20,1; Matth. 20,7; Deut. 23,5; Jud. 9,4; Kuf. p. 133; 2 Par. 25,6; omisso Acc.: ተዐሰብኩ፡ ሊተ፡ በ፲ወ፭ ጠፋልሐ፡ ብሩር፡ Hos. 3,2; aliquid: ቤተ፡ ዐስብ፡ ዘተዐስበ፡ (Platt: ዘተዐሰበ፡) Act. 28,30 rom.; ዘተዐሰበ፡ ምንተኒ፡ F.N. 36; ዘተዐስበ፡ ዐጸደ፡ ለለኵሉ፡ አውራኅ፡ በዲናር፡ ወኢአመረ፡ ኍልቈ፡ ኵሎን፡ አውራኅ፡ ይከውኖ፡ ለተዐሳቢ፡ እምድኅረ፡ ፩ ወርኅ፡ ከመ፡ ያብጥል፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ተዐስቦ፡ F.N. 36; omisso Acc.: ረከበ፡ ሐመረ፡ ወተዐሰበ፡ ἔδωκε τὸ ναῦλον αὐτοῦ Jon. 1,3; በእንተ፡ ተዐስቦ፡ ቤት፡ de conductione domicilii F.N. 36; ሥርዐተ፡ ተዐስቦ፡ (pactum conductionis) F.N. 36; Infin. Pl.: በእንተ፡ ተዐስቦታት፡ ወዐሳብ፡ F.N. 36 in tit. (in Cod. Francof.).

woorden.betekenis: caelibatus, viduatus, viduitas, mǝʿǝssǝbǝnnā, veuvage, widow
woorden.definitie: subst. caelibatus et viduatus, (viduitas): ኢይክሉ፡ ምዕስብና፡ Can. Ancyr. 8; ጳጳስ፡ sit caelebs vel unius tantum uxoris vir ከመ፡ ሕማማተ፡ ዘምዕስብና፡ ይጠይቅ፡ Kid. f. 6; χηρεία Jes. 54,4; Kuf. p. 142; Kedr f. 62. mǝʿǝssǝbǝnnā G ምዕስብና፡ mǝʿǝssǝbǝnnā «veuvage» ― ብችኝነት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 44r. 106 L ምዕስብና mǝʿǝssǝbǝnnā widowhood, celibacy, state of being a divorcée 327b

woorden.betekenis: viduum, viduam esse, vitam viduitatis agere
woorden.definitie: III,1 viduum vel viduam esse, vitam viduitatis agere, Kuf. p. 142.

woorden.betekenis: gratiam, praemium accipere, praemio, remuneratione affici, a
woorden.definitie: III,1 pro meritis gratiam vel praemium accipere, praemio vel remuneratione affici: Luc. 14,14; Hen. 93,10; 4 Esr. 6,72; ትትዐሰዩ፡ በከመ፡ ገበርክሙ፡ Macc. f. 20; Sx. Mag. 28Enc.; c. Acc. praemii: Marc. 10,30; Luc. 18,30; Ps. 18,12; ተዐስየ፡ ምሕረተ፡ በዝንቱ፡ (pro hac re) Cyr. ad Theod. f. 7; ተዐስየ፡ ዕሴተ፡ ሠዋዒ፡ Chrys. Ta. 34; c. በኀበ፡ pers. ( ab aliquo) Eph. 6,8; በኀበ፡ እግዚኡ፡ ተዐስየ፡ Deg.

woorden.betekenis: coërcuit, cohibuit, retinuit, sterilem reddidit, constrinxit
woorden.definitie: I,2 et I,1 [vicina sunt ሐከመ፡, حَكَمَ coërcuit, cohibuit, retinuit, حَقَنَ retinuit, عَقَمَ sterilem reddidit, عَكَمَ constrinxit ] 1 concludere, incarcerare: ወዐቀመ፡ ስምዖንሃ፡ ባሕቲቶ፡ Kuf. 42(Vers. lat.: ligavit ). 2 compescere, coërcere, continere, moderari: ጥዑይ፡ ንዋም፡ ለዘይዔቅማ፡ (v. ለዘየዐቅማ፡) ለከርሡ፡ (v. ለነፍሱ፡) ὕπνος ὑγιείας ἐπὶ ἐντέρῳ μετρίῳ Sir. 34,20; ይዔቅም፡ ቃሎ፡ οἰκονομήσει τοὺς λόγους αὐτοῦ Ps. 111,5; ተዐቅም፡ አፉከ፡ Lud. e Syn. 3 modum rei facere vel statuere, certis terminis circumscribere, definire, praefinire; በመስፈርት፡ ዘዐቀመ፡ ለነ፡እግዚአብሔር፡ 2 Cor. 10,13; Deo ባሕረ፡ ዐቀመ፡ ከመ፡ ኢትትዐደው፡ እምዐቅማ፡ Kid. f. 33; ዐቀመ፡ ዕድሜ፡ Eph. 1,10; Act. 28,23; ዘዐቀመ፡ ለከ፡ Fal. f. 27(vid. sub ወሰነ፡). – Job 39,21 pro ወየዐቅም፡ legendum est ወየዐምቅ፡ q.v.

woorden.betekenis: involvere, constringere, colligare, retinere, cohibere
woorden.definitie: I,1 [vicina sunt عَجَرَ et multae radices Arab. Syr. et Hebr., ab עק incipientes, quas enumeratas videas in Ges. thes. p. 1062 sub עָקַשׁ] Subj. ይዕቈር፡, involvere, constringere, colligare: መኑ፡ የዐቊር፡ እሳተ፡ ውስተ፡ ሕፅኑ፡ ἀποδήσει Prov. 6,27; Sx. Tachs. 5Enc.; Sx. Mag. 12Enc.; ወአሰርዎ፡ ዐቊሮሙ፡ ኵሎ፡ ወርቀ፡ ἔσφιξαν 4 Reg. 12,10; የዐቊሮ፡ ለማይ፡ ዲበ፡ ደመና፡ δεσμεύων Job 26,8; መኑ፡ ዐቈረ፡ ማያተ፡ በልብሱ፡ συνέστρεψε Prov. 24,27; ለዛቲ፡ ገነት፡ (horto comparatur collectio sententiarum) ትጸውራ፡ በእንግዳእከ፡ ወበልብከ፡ ተዐቊራ፡ Fal. (in proleg.); ሕንባባተ፡ ሮማን፡ በልብሱ፡ ዐቊሮ፡ Sx. Ter 13Enc.; Deus ይኤዝዝ፡ ደመናተ፡ ከመ፡ ይዕቈሩ፡ ወይጾሩ፡ ወይሰዱ፡ (sc. ማየ፡) ኀበ፡ ዘፈቀዱ፡ ያውርዱ፡ Clem. f. 171; የዐቊር፡ ማየ፡ (sc. seminis) በማሕፀን፡ Lit. Orth.; passim retinere, cohibere: ወሚመ፡ ደመናት፡ ይክሉኑ፡ ዐቊረ፡ ዝናም፡ Macc. f. 4; ደመናት፡ ይዕቈሩ፡ ማያተ፡ Lit.

woorden.betekenis: custodire, ab, vigilare, excubias agere, tueri, incolumem se
woorden.definitie: I,1 [رَقَبَ] Subj. ይዕቀብ፡, Imperat. ዕቀብ፡ (forma ዕቅብ፡ 4 Esr. 14,6 in editione Laur. lapsu calami scripta videtur), 1 custodire, c. Acc., 4 Reg. 9,14; Jes. 21,12; 1 Reg. 25,21; Luc. 11,21; Act. 22,20; Matth. 27,36; gregem Luc. 2,8; Gen. 30,31; ኮነ፡ የዐቅብ፡ አባግዐ፡ አቡሁ፡ Sx. Sen. 4; urbem Ps. 126,2; portam Judith 13,11; 3 Reg. 14,27; Asc. Jes. 10,24; hortum Gen. 2,15; c. እምነ፡ ab aliquo: የዐቅብ፡ ገነተ፡ እምአዕዋፍ፡ Kuf. p. 13; ከመ፡ ይዕቀቡ፡ ዘርኦሙ፡ እምገጸ፡ ቋዓት፡ Kuf. p. 47; Kuf. p. 157; homines: እለ፡ የዐቅቡኪ፡ Jes. 52,8; እመ፡ ብከ፡ አዋልደ፡ ዕቀቦን፡ Sir. 7,24; ለወለትከ፡ አጽንዓ፡ ዐቂቦታ፡ Sir. 26,10; 1 Reg. 26,15. a absol.: vigilare, excubias agere, Judith 7,5; Jes. 21,12; Jes. 21,13 var.; Koh. 5,7; Matth. 28,4; ሠገራት፡ የዐቅቡ፡ እንተ፡ ኵለሄ፡ Org. b tueri, incolumem servare, defendere: Ps. 11,8; Ps. 120,5; Ps. 120,8; Prov. 2,11; Hen. 1,8; 4 Esr. 6,68; ዐቀበ፡ መንፈስየ፡ Job 10,12; Gen. 28,15; Gen. 28,20; Ex. 23,20; 1 Reg. 30,23; Matth. 4,6; Joh. 17,12; c. እምነ፡ ab: 2 Thess. 3,3; Ps. 120,7; Ps. 139,4; Sir. 31,19. c custodire aliquid i.e. caute uti, cautionem adhibere(in Acht nehmen): ዕቀብ፡ እገሪከ፡ Koh. 4,17; ዐቂበ፡ ልሳን፡ Fal.; ዘየዐቅብ፡ አፉሁ፡ Prov. 13,3; Prov. 21,23; seq. ርእሶ፡ vel ነፍሶ፡ i.q. cavere: ዕቀቡ፡ ነፍሰክሙ፡ Jer. 17,21; Deut. 4,9; Deut. 4,15; ዐቀብኩ፡ ነፍስየ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይብላዕ፡ Tob.1,11; ዕቀቡ፡ ርእሰክሙ፡ እምነ፡ አማልክት፡ 1 Joh. 5,21; ከመ፡ ይዕቀቡ፡ ነፍሶሙ፡ እምዝሙት፡ Kuf. 7. d rationem vel curam habere alicujus, respicere, colere: ዕቀብ፡ እመከ፡ μὴ ὑπερίδῃς τὴν μητέρα σου ἐπιμελεῖσθαι Tob. 4,3; ዕቀቢ፡ ያዕቆብሃ፡ Kuf. 19; ἐπισκέπτεσθαι Jac. 1,27; ἐπιμελεῖσθαι Gen. 44,21; ዕቀብ፡ ዐርከከ፡ στέρξον Sir. 27,17. 2 observare, attendere, abs. Jes. 42,20; c. Acc. rei: ዘየዐቅብ፡ ንፋሰ፡ Koh. 11,4; ዕቀብ፡ ፍናዊሃ፡ ἐνεδρεύειν Sir. 14,22; ዕቀብ፡ አፈ፡ ንጉሥ፡ Koh. 8,2; ዘየዐቅብ፡ ተግሣጸ፡ Prov. 13,18; ዐቀበ፡ ኵሎ፡ ፍናውየ፡ Job 33,11; Ps. 106,43; in malam partem: callide attendere, insidiari, c. Acc. Gen. 3,15; ሶበ፡ አበስኩ፡ እምዐቀብከኒ፡ Job 10,14. 3 servare, observare praecepta, legem al.: Gen. 17,9; Ex. 12,24; Ex. 12,25; Lev. 19,37; Num. 18,5; Ps. 102,17; Ps. 118,5; Ps. 118,8; Jer. 16,11; ዕቀቡ፡ ጽድቀ፡ Jes. 56,1; Jes. 56,6; 4 Esr. 6,67; 4 Esr. 9,31; Sir. 21,11; Sir. 44,20; አልቦ፡ ዘይጥዕም፡ እምነ፡ ዐቂበ፡ ትእዛዙ፡ Sir. 23,27; Sir. 28,6; Joh. 14,21; 1 Joh. 2,3; Apoc. 1,3; Apoc. 22,7; Matth. 19,17; sabbathum, festum Kuf. 2; Ex. 23,15; Ex. 31,14; Lev. 19,30; Joh. 9,16; foedus Gen. 17,10; Deut. 7,9; Deut. 7,12. 4 servare, reservare, asservare: ዐቂብ፡ (opp. አውጽኦ፡) Koh. 3,6; c. Acc.: Jer. 43,20 var.; Gen. 41,36; 4 Esr. 4,60; 4 Esr. 12,37; 4 Esr. 13,33; 4 Esr. 14,51; ማሕፀንተ፡ F.N. 29; 1 Tim. 6,20; Joh. 2,10; Joh. 12,7; 2 Petr. 2,17. a in animo servare, memoria tenere: ዐቀብኩ፡ ነገሮ፡ በልብየ፡ Dan. 7,28; 4 Esr. 14,6; 4 Esr. 14,43; ዐቀቦ፡ (ለሕልም፡) ውስተ፡ ልቡ፡ Esth. 1apocr.; Gen. 37,11; 1 Reg. 21,12; Sir. 21,14; Prov. 3,1. α peccata (opp. remissione): ዐቀብከ፡ ሊተ፡ ኀጢአተ፡ ንእስየ፡ Job 13,26; M.M. f. 96. β reticere: አብድ፡ ኢይክል፡ ዐቂበ፡ ነገር፡ ዘሰምዐ፡ Sir. 8,17. b conservare: ዐቀብከ፡ ሎቱ፡ ዘንተ፡ ምሕረተ፡ 3 Reg. 3,6 ዐቀበ፡ መራደ፡ Am. 1,11; ዘዐቀበ፡ ፈሪሀ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ (κρατῶν) Sir. 25,11; Judae 6; Apoc. 16,15; Jac. 1,27; omisso Acc., Eph. 4,3. – Voc. Ae.: ዐቀበ፡ ዘ፡ ጠበቀ። ʿaqaba G ዐቀበ፡ ልቡና፡ ʿaqaba lǝbbunā «garder fidélité» በእንተ፡ ዘሐነፁ፡ ማኅፈደ፡ ዐላውያነ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወጻመዉ፡ ከንቶ፡ ሶበ፡ ሐለዩ፡ እኩየ፡ ወኤቦርሰ፡ ኢኀበረ፡ ምስሌሆሙ፡ ዳእሙ፡ ዐቀበ፡ ልቡናሁ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ድነት። 157, vid. ልቡና፡ 35 L ዐቀበ ʿaqaba (yǝʿqab) guard, stand guard, watch, keep watch, keep safe, safequard, keep, tend (flocks), preserve, take care of, care for, take heed, protect, handle with care, observe (the law, a holiday) 66a

woorden.betekenis: custodire facere, jubere, praesidio munire, excubiis custodi
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 custodire facere vel jubere, a praesidio munire: ወአዕቀበ፡ አህጉሪሆሙ፡ ἐφρούρησε τὰς πόλεις Judith 3,6. b excubiis custodiendum curare aliquid: እምወራዙት፡ አዕቀብኩ፡ ኆኃተ፡ ἐκ τῶν παιδαρίων ἔστησα ἐπὶ τὰς πύλας 2 Esr. 23,19. c observare vel servare facere, c. dupl. Acc.: Gen. 18,19; የዐቅቡ፡ ሕገ፡ እስመ፡ ህርቃኖስ፡ አዕቀቦሙ፡ ዘንተ፡ Jsp. p. 327. 2 custodiendum tradere, a in custodiam tradere aliquem: ዘአዕቀቦ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ἐν ᾗ κατέκλεισεν αὐτόν Jer. 39,3. b asservandum tradere vel committere, custodiae causa deponere, c. Acc. pers. vel rei vel c. dupl. Acc.: Ex. 22,6; Ex. 22,11; አዕቀብክዎ፡ ለጋብኤል፡ ዐሠርተ፡ መካልየ፡ ብሩር፡ Tob. 1,14; አዋልደ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ዘአዕቀቦ፡ ለጎዶልያን፡ Jer. 48,10; ለዘአዕቀብዎ፡ ብዙኀ፡ ይትኀሠሥዎ፡ ብዙኀ፡ Did. 6; vel c. ኀበ፡ pers.: ብሩር፡ ዘአዕቀብኩ፡ ኀበ፡ ጋብኤል፡ Tob. 4,20; vel c. ውስተ፡ loci: መጽሐፈ፡ አዕቀቡ፡ (v. ይዕቀቡ፡ ወሀቡ፡) ውስተ፡ ቤተ፡ … Jer. 43,20.

woorden.betekenis: custodiri, servari, asservari, reservari, ab, conservari, se
woorden.definitie: vel ተዐቅበ፡ III,1 I Pass. a custodiri: አነ፡ እትዐቀብ፡ Jer. 43,5; ይትዐቀብ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይደቅ፡ ውስተ፡ ሞት፡ Job 33,24; ከመ፡ ትትዐቀብ፡ እምኵሉ፡ እኩይ፡ Kuf. 21. b servari, asservari, reservari, Gen. 41,35; Ex. 16,34; Num. 17,25; ይከውን፡ ለተዐቅቦ፡ Num. 19,9; Kuf. 3; ይትዐቀብ፡ ረሲዕ፡ ለዕለት፡ እኪት፡ Prov. 16,4; (c. በኀበ፡ ab aliquo) Koh. 5,12; Hen. 45,2; Hen. 69,23. c conservari, Hen. 69,25; Matth. 9,17. II Reflex. 1 se custodire, se abstinere, sibi cavere, cavere, seq. እምነ፡ rei: Ps. 17,26; ይትዐቀቡ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዝሙት፡ ወርኵስ፡ Kuf. 20; Deut. 23,10; Jud. 13,13; Sap. 1,11; Luc. 12,1; Luc. 12,15; Clem. f. 188; vel pers.: ተዐቀብ፡ እምነ፡ እኩይ፡ Sir. 11,33; Matth. 7,15; c. Acc. pers. ( ab aliquo): ተዐቀቦሙ፡ ለአዕርክቲከ፡ Sir. 6,13; ተዐቀቦ፡ φύλαξαι ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ Sir. 12,11; ተዐቀብዎሙ፡ ለቢጽክሙ፡ Jer. 9,4; 2 Tim. 4,15; Luc. 20,46; Rom. 16,17; seq. ከመ፡ ኢ፡ c. Subj.: ተዐቀብኩ፡ በመንፈስየ፡ ከመ፡ ኢየአብስ፡ Kuf. 25; Sir. 22,13; vel seq. ኢ፡ c. Subj., ut: Ex. 19,12; ተዐቀብ፡ ኢያስሕትከ፡ Sir. 13,8; Sir. 29,20; Gal. 6,1; sed post ኢተዐቀበ፡ seq. ከመ፡ c. Subj., ut: ኢተዐቀበ፡ ከመ፡ ይሖር፡ 4 Reg. 10,31; abs.: ተዐቀበ፡ Jes. 7,4; በተዐቅቦ፡ ዐቢይ፡ cautissime F.M. 29,4; ተዐቅቦ፡ (sive cautio sive abstinentia ) p. 319. a nonnumquam additur ርእሰከ፡ vel ርእስከ፡, ut: ተዐቀብ፡ ርእሰከ፡ (v. ርእስከ፡) ኢያስሕትከ፡ Sir. 29,20; vel ለርእሱ፡, ut Gal. 6,1. b cautionem adhibere c. በ፡ in re: ተዐቀብ፡ በዕፀ፡ መሥዋዕት፡ Kuf. 21; ተዐቀብ፡ በደም፡ Kuf. 21; c. እምነ፡, ut: መፍትው፡ ይትዐቀቡ፡ በአስተሓምሞ፡ እምስጢር፡ (decet caute tractare mysterium) p. 308; seq. ከመ፡ c. Subj.: Deut. 24,8. 2 se servare, c. በ፡ in re; Judae 21; እመ፡ ኢያፍጠነ፡ ተዐቅቦ፡ በፍርሀተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Sir. 27,3. 3 sibi custodire i.e. a observare, attendere ad aliquid vel aliquem, c. Acc.: Ps. 129,3; 1 Reg. 1,12; 2 Reg. 18,12; Phil. 3,17; Hebr. 2,1; sidera Abush. 3; በተዐቅቦ፡ μετὰ παρατηρήσεως Luc. 17,20 (nisi hunc Infin. passive sumere malueris); huc nescio an referendus sit etiam locus ከመ፡ ይትዐቀባ፡ ለሕይወቱ፡ ከመ፡ ዐሳብ፡ ἵνα εὐδοκήσῃ τὸν βίον ὥσπερ μισθωτός Job 14,6; providere 1 Cor. 3,10. b callide observare, insidiari, παρατηρεῖν, c. Acc. pers.: Marc. 3,2; Luc. 6,7; Luc. 14,1; ዘይትዐቀበከ፡ ὁ ὑποβλεπόμενός σε Sir. 37,10. c sibi observandum vel servandum sumere praeceptum vel ceremoniam: Marc. 7,4; Gal. 4,10; ተዐቀብ፡ ዑቃቤ፡ ዘአምላክ፡ Kuf. 21.

woorden.betekenis: concubina, pellex
woorden.definitie: adj. et subst. fem. (proprie: part. fem.), Pl. ዕቁባት፡ et ዕቅብታት፡, concubina, pellex, Gen. 22,24; ብእሲት፡ ዕቅብት፡ Jud. 19,1; Jud. 19,2; 2 Reg. 3,7; Kuf. 33; 1 Esr. 4,29; 2 Esr. 12,6; Gal. 4,22; አንበረ፡ ዕቅብት፡ F.M. 8,1; ዕቁባት፡ Gen. 31,33; Gen. 32,23; አንስት፡ ዕቁባት፡ 2 Reg. 5,13; 2 Reg. 20,3; 1 Par. 3,9; Cant. 6,8; ዕቅብታት፡ Jsp. p. 304; F.N. 25 (in quo capite በእንተ፡ ዕቁባት፡ agitur).

woorden.betekenis: custos, medicus, pharmacus, custos corporis, satelles, vicar
woorden.definitie: n. ag., fem. ዐቃቢት፡, Pl. m. ዐቃብያን፡, c. ዐቀብት፡ custos: Gen. 4,9; ዐቃብያን፡ (v. ዐቀብተ፡) ቤት፡ Koh. 12,3; ዐቃቤ፡ ኅለት፡ Jes. 27,4; መኑ፡ ይሠይም፡ ዐቃቤ፡ ላዕለ፡ አፉየ፡ Sir. 22,27; Ps. 38,2; Ps. 140,3; አንትሙ፡ ካህናት፡ ዐቃብያነ፡ ቤተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Clem. f. 205; ካህናት፡ ዐቃብያነ፡ ሕጉ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ Clem. f. 207; Petrus ዐቃቤ፡ መራኁተ፡ መንግሥተ፡ ሰመያት፡ Clem. f. 266; ዐቀብት፡ Asc. Jes. 3,14; Act. 12,6; ሊቀ፡ ዐቀብተ፡ ቤተ፡ ሞቅሕ፡ Kuf. 39. a In specie α ዐቃቤ፡ ሥራይ፡ medicus, pharmacus, vid. sub ሥራይ፡ (col. 245); Tob. 2,10; Clem. f. 248; Clem. f. 255. β ዐቃቤ፡ ሥጋ፡ 1 Reg. 28,2 et ዐቃቤ፡ ርእስ፡, ut: ሊቃነ፡ ዐቀብተ፡ ርእሱ፡ Esth. 2,21; 1 Esr. 3,4 custos corporis, satelles. γ ዐቃቤ፡ መንግሥት፡ διάδοχος τοῦ βασιλέως vicarius regis, procurator regni 2 Par. 26,11. δ ዐቃቤ፡ ሙዳየ፡ ምጽዋት፡ custos arcae eleemosynarum 2 Esr. 23,4 et ዐቃቢ፡ γαζοφύλαξ thesaurarius 1 Esr. 2,10. ε ዐቃቤ፡ ቀምሕ፡ c. pomorum vid. sub ቀምሕ፡; adde Sir. 27,6. ζ ዐቃቤ፡ ነቢብ፡ orator Act. 24,1. η ዐቃቤ፡ ነግድ፡ caupo Luc. 10,34. θ ዐቃቤ፡ አልባስ፡ custos vestiarii 4 Reg. 22,14. ι ዐቃቤ፡ አንስት፡ c. gynaecei Esth. 2,8; Esth. 2,14. κ ዐቃቤ፡ አንቀጽ፡ janitor 1 Par. 9,17; 1 Par. 23,5; ዐቀብት፡ (simplex) F.N. 8,3. λ ዐቃቤ፡ ወይን፡ vel ዐጸደ፡ ወይን፡ vinitor Marc. 12,1; Luc. 13,7; Jes. 1,8; Jes. 24,20; Jes. 61,5 var.; ዐቀብተ፡ ወይን፡ Jer. 52,16; Joel 1,11; ዐቃቢተ፡ ዐጸደ፡ ወይን፡ Cant. 1,6; ዐቀብተ፡ ዐጸደ፡ ወይን፡ 2 Par. 26,10. μ ዐቃቤ፡ ገነት፡ hortulanus Joh. 20,15; Sx. Haml. 25(vid. ዐውድ፡). b ἐπίσκοπος, praefectus,episcopus Jud. 9,28; 1 Petr. 2,25. c custosi.e. tutor: Deus ዐቃቢሁ፡ ለያዕቆብ፡ Kuf. 35; Deus ይከውን፡ ዐቃቢሁ፡ ለሠናይ፡ Kuf. 21; መልአክ፡ ዐቃቢሁ፡ angelus ejus tutelaris Gad. Lal.; item de angelo Sx. Mag. 25 Enc.; Sx. Pag. 1 Enc. d custodiens: ብእሲት፡ አርማሚት፡ ወዐቃቢተ፡ ልሳን፡ (linguam compescens) Fal. f. 50. ʿāqqābi 1 እቃ፡ ቤት፡ ዐቃቢ፡ ʾǝqā bet ʿaqqābi keeper of the church treasury ዕቃቤት፡ ዓቃቢ፡ ቄስ፡ ወልደ፡ አረጋይ፡ ‘le ʿeqābēt ʿĀqābi, le prêtre Walda Aragāy’ 61 l. 27 (ed.), 74 l. 2 (tr.), vid. እቃ፡ ቤት፡ under ቤት፡ 2 ዐቃቤ፡ ʿaqqābe ዓቃቤ፡ ʿāqqābe subst. st.c. guardian of keeper of a ዓቃቤ፡ መርኆ፡ ʿāqqābe marḫo key-bearer ወዓቃቤ፡ መርኆ፡ ተርቢኖስ፡ ‘et le ʿāqābe marḫo, Tarbinos’ 34 l. 10–11 (ed.), 40 l. 7 (tr.), vid. መርኆ፡ b ዓቃቤ፡ ሰዓት፡ ʿāqqābe saʿāt ዓቃቤ፡ ሰዓት፡ ነገደ፡ ክርስቶስ፡ ‘Le ʿāqābē saʿāt était Nagada Iyasus’ 29 l. 18 (ed.), 33 l. 16–17 (tr.), vid. ሰዓት፡ c ዓቃቤ፡ ቀምሕ፡ ʿāqqābe qamḥ keeper of crops ወረሰይዋ፡ ለቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ መዝብረ፡ ከመ፡ ልገተ፡ ዓቃቤ፡ ቀምሕ፡ ‘They have converted the church into ruins like the hut of yield keeper’ 78 § 154 (ed.), 45–46 § 154 (tr.), vid. ቀምሕ፡ d ዓቃቤ፡ ንዋየ፡ ግበር፡ ʿāqqābe nǝwāya gǝbar keeper of the property ወዓቃቤ፡ ንዋየ፡ ግበሪሃ፡ ለገበዝ፡ ጽንዕነ፡ ማርያም፡ ‘l’économe des biens de la cathédrale, Ṣeneʿena Māryām’ 31 l. 13 (ed.), 36 l. 17–18 (tr.), vid. ንዋይ፡, ግብር፡ e ዓቃቤ፡ አስካሬን፡ ʿāqqābe ʾaskāren treasurer ወሶበ፡ ርእዮ፡ ከመ፡ መፍቀሬ፡ ንዋይ፡ ውእቱ፡ ረሰዮ፡ ዓቃቤ፡ አስካሬን፡ ዘውእቱ፡ ሙዳየ፡ ምጽዋት፡ እንተ፡ ያስተጋብኡ፡ ቦቱ፡ ወርቀ፡ መባእ። ‘lorsqu’il vit qu’il aimait les richesses, il lui avait donné (la charge de) aqābē askārēn, c’est-à- dire de (gardien de) la bourse des aumônes, où l’on réunissait l’or des oblations’ 70 l. 29–31 (ed.), 81 l. 23–25 (tr.), vid. እስክሬን፡ f ዓቃቤ፡ ገበዝ፡ ʿāqqābe gabaz ‘Il testo dice ዓቃቤ፡ ገበዝ. ገበዝ o ቄስ፡ ገበዝ è il titolo dell’addetto alla custodia dei beni della chiesa che ha anche l’incarico di aprirla a di chiuderla. Da notare che nessun dizionario di gəʼəz né di amarico registra questi due termini in coppia.’ 33 (145) n. 44, vid. ገበዝ፡ g ዐቃቤ፡ ጽንጽንያ፡ ʿaqqābe ṣǝnṣǝnyā, ዓቃቤ፡ ጽንጽንያ፡ ʿāqqābe ṣǝnṣǝnyā, ዐቃቤ፡ ጸንጸን፡ ʿaqqābe ṣanṣan, ዐቃቤ፡ ጸንጸን፡ ʿāqqābe ṣanṣan lit. ‘keeper of the fly-whisk’ a title bestowed to a ruler of ʾƎndartā, also to a ruler of Tigray (Chernetsov, and after him Derat, identifies it with the title vid. ዓቃጼን፡ considered to be its later, abbraviated form .) ወበጊዜ፡ በአቱ፡ ውስተ፡ አናቅጺሃ፡ ቆሙ፡ ትግሬ፡ መኰንን፡ ወነብ[ር]እድ፡ ዘአክሱም፡ በየማን፡ ወበፀጋም። እንዘ፡ ይከለክሉ፡ ይኂዞሙ፡ ጨንገረ፡ ዘአውልዕ፡ እስመ፡ ከማሁ፡ ሕጎሙ። ወበእንተዝ፡ ይሰመይ፡ ትግሬ፡ መኰንን፡ ዓቃቤ፡ ጽንጽንያ፡ ‘A son entrée aux portes de la ville, le roi avait à sa droite et à sa gauche le gouverneur du Tigré et l’administrateur d’Aksum qui portaient et agitaient, suivant l’usage, des rameaux d’olivier; c’est pour cela que l’on appelle le gouverneur du Tigré ʿAqâbê Ṣenṣenyâ’ 49 l. 8–10, 50 l. 1–2 (ed.), p. 49 l. 9–12, 50 l. 1 (tr.); ዘኢይበውእ፡ ዓቃቤ፡ ጸንጸን፡ ወኢከንቲባ፡ ዘአልቦ፡ ግብረ፡ ለባዕድ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ አበ፡ ምኔት፡ ዘመጣዕ፡ ‘Que l’ʿaqqābē ṣanṣan n’entre pas, ni le kantibā, à l’exception de l’abbé de Maṭāʿ’ 56, 57; ዓቃ፡ ጸንጸን፡ ባራ፡ ጽዮን፡ ‘le liqā{sic} ṣanṣan Bārā Ṣeyon’ 57, 58, vid. ጽንጽንያ፡ G ዐቃቤ፡ ሥራይ፡ ʿaqqābe śǝrāy «médecin, pharmacien» ― ባለ፡ መድኃኒት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 51r., vid. ሥራይ፡ 127 L ዐቃቤ፡ ሥራይ ʿaqqābe śǝrāy physician, whitch doctor; see 182–3, vid. ሥራይ 536a ዐቃቤ፡ ሰዓት ʿaqqābe saʿāt ‘Times Keeper’ for the emperor’s schedules as well as for the hours of the prayers 66a

woorden.betekenis: custodia, tutela, tuitio, cautio, attentio, observantia, obs
woorden.definitie: subst., fem. et m. 1 custodia, φυλακή Job 7,12. a tutela, tuitio: Behütung M.M. f. 145; ቀራንብትኪ፡ ንጻሬ፡ አዕይንት፡ ለዑቃቤ፡ (zum Schuze des Blickes der Augen) I Sal. Mar. 6. b cautio, attentio: ያንብርዎ፡ ለሥጋየ፡ በዐቢይ፡ ዑቃቤ፡ ውስተ፡ ማእከለ፡ ምድር፡ Clem. f. 10; huc nescio an referendus sit locus: ይጸልእ፡ ድምፀ፡ ዑቃቤ፡ μισεῖ ἦχον ἀσφαλείας Prov. 11,15. 2 observantia: ዑቃቤ፡ ሕግ፡ Org. 3; ዑቃቤ፡ ሰንበት፡ M.M. f. 266. 3 observatio astrorum: አስተናበሩ፡ ዓመታቲሆሙ፡ ወአውራኂሆሙ፡ ዲበ፡ ዑቃቤ፡ ጥንቁቅ፡ ፀሓያዊ፡ Abush. 3; ሰብአ፡ ዑቃቤ፡ observatores (siderum), Abush. 3. 4 vigilia (pars noctis), Kuf. p. 91. 5 id quod observandum vel servandum est, ut lex, ritus: ተዐቀብ፡ ዑቃቤ፡ ዘአምላክ፡ ልዑል፡ (מִשְׁמֶרֶת) Kuf. 21; fortasse bona servanda Koh. 7,11 (ubi Ae. pro κληρονομία Graeci ዑቃቤ፡ exhibet).

woorden.betekenis: locus acclivis, clivus
woorden.definitie: subst. [عَقَبَةٌ עָקֹב; de etymo vid. Ges. thes. p. 1060; amh. ዐቀበት፡] locus acclivis, clivus: ዐቀበ፡ ኆፃ፡ ἀνάβασις ἀμμώδης Sir. 25,20; Jes. 15,5; Judith 6,7; Judith 13,10; 2 Esr. 13,31; 2 Reg. 6,2; Num. 34,4.

woorden.betekenis: offensio, lapsus, causa offensionis, offendiculum, scandalum
woorden.definitie: subst., Pl. ዕቅፍታት፡ 1 offensio pedis: (ዘያስተሰግል፡) በዕቅፍተ፡ እግር፡ (inter alia divinationis genera) Clem. f. 178; lapsus offensione pedis effectus: ዕቅፍቱ፡ ὑποσκέλισμα αὐτοῦ Prov. 24,17. 2 causa offensionis et lapsus, offendiculum, scandalum, πρόσκομμα vel σκάνδαλον, ኢትደይ፡ ዕቅፍተ፡ ቅድመ፡ ዕዉር፡ Lev. 19,14; Ps. 68,27; Ps. 139,6; የዐቅበከ፡ እምዕቅፍት፡ Sir. 31,19; Sir. 39,24; Judith 5,20; Hos. 4,17; ዕፀ፡ ዕቅፍት፡ Sir. 34,7; እብነ፡ ዕቅፍት፡ Jes. 8,14; Rom. 9,32; ትከውኖ፡ ዕቅፍተ፡ 1 Reg. 18,21; Ex. 23,33; Jud. 2,3; ዕቅፍታት፡ F.N. 5. 3 remora, Lud. ex Org. 3.

woorden.betekenis: causa offensionis, lapsus, offendiculum, scandalum, perversi
woorden.definitie: , ማዕቅፍ፡, ማዕቅፍት፡ subst. causa offensionis et lapsus, offendiculum, scandalum, Kuf. 1; Ps. 140,10; በማዕቅፍ፡ ይወድቅ፡ Prov. 10,8; στραγγαλιῶδες ( perversi aliquid et tortuosi ) ማዕቅፍ፡ Prov. 8,8; ያመጽኡ፡ ማዕቅፍተ፡ Jes. 29,21; Hen. 56,7; Matth. 16,23; Lit. Epiph.; ማዕቀፍ፡ Sx. Haml. 5 Enc.

woorden.betekenis: aridum, sterilem esse, fieri, exarescere, sterilescere
woorden.definitie: I,1 [עָרֵב, חָרֵב, vid. Ges. thes. p. 1066] Subj. ይዕበር፡ aridum, sterilem esse vel fieri, exarescere, sterilescere, de terra, ዐብረ፡ ኵሉ፡ ወፍር፡ ዘውስተ፡ ገዳም፡ Jer. 23,10; de plantis: ኵሉ፡ ይየብስ፡ ወየዐብር፡ Jes. 19,7; ኢየዐብር፡ ወይንክሙ፡ Mal. 3,11; Apoc. 6,6; Herm. p. 99; የዐብር፡ ሣዕሩ፡ ፍጹመ፡ Prov. 24,46; ጽጌሃ፡ ኢይትነገፍ፡ ወፍሬሃ፡ ኢየዐብር፡ ወቈጽላ፡ ኢይጸመሂ፡ M.M. f. 124; Org. 5; de aquis: እመቦ፡ ዘዐብረት፡ ዝናመ፡ ሰማይ፡ 2 Par. 6,26; de sanguine: duae sunt animae sc. ነፍስ፡ መዋቲት፡ ወነፍስ፡ ዘኢይመውት፤ ዘሰ፡ ይመውት፡ ደም፡ ውእቱ። ለእመ፡ በተረግዞ፤ ይትከዐው፡ ዲበ፡ ምድር። ወለእመ፡ በደዌ፡ ሥጋ፤ የዐብር፡ ወበዐባረ፡ ዚአሁ፡ ይትፈለጥ፡ ነፍስ፡ (sc. ዘኢይመውት፡) እምሥጋ፡ M.M. f. 109; de annis: ዓመታት፡ አኀዙ፡ ይዕበሩ፡ Kuf. 11.

woorden.betekenis: siccitas, sterilitas, penuria, caritas annonae
woorden.definitie: subst. (m.) siccitas, sterilitas, penuria vel caritas annonae: በዓመተ፡ ዐባር፡ ἐν ἐνιαυτῷ ἀβροχίας Jer. 17,8; ዐባረ፡ ዝናም፡ (v. ዐባር፡) Jer. 14,1; Hen. 80,5; Kuf. 13; Kuf. 23; Kuf. 40; Deut. 28,22; ἀπορία Hagg. 2,17; Org. 1.

woorden.betekenis: per, propter
woorden.definitie: , በዕብሬተ፡ per, propter vid. sub በረየ፡ col. 507.

woorden.betekenis: Hebraeus, puellae, ʿǝbrāwi, ʿǝbrāwiyān, Hebrew
woorden.definitie: et ዕብራይ፡ (Ex. 1,15) n. peregr., Hebraeus, ut: ዕብራዊት፡, ዕብራውያን፡, ዕብራውያት፡ Jer. 41,9; Gen. 39,14; Gen. 39,17; Gen. 40,15; Phil. 3,5 al.; Hebr. 1,1 in tit. Lectione vel interpretatione falsa nituntur hi loci: ብእሲት፡ ዕብራዊት፡ (v. ብዕራዊት፡) Sir. 26,2 ubi Gr. γυνὴ ἀνδρεία habet; ዕብራዊያት፡ Kuf. p. 157pro ἅβραι (Vers. Lat. praebet puellae ). – Secundum . III,4,18 libri Regum duo, qui aliâs ዘነገሥት፡ ፫ወ፬ inscribuntur, titulo ዘዕብራውያን፡ insigniuntur (quem equidem nusquam legi). ʿǝbrāwi n. pr. (ethnonym) Pl. ዕብራዊያን፡ ʿǝbrāwiyān Hebrew 22a l. 8, 78b l. 9, 126a l. 6 (ed.)

woorden.betekenis: hebraice
woorden.definitie: et ዕብራይስጢ፡ adv. ἑβραϊστί hebraice, ut: ኢትነግረነ፡ ዕብራይስጥ፡ (v. ዕብራይስጠ፡) ἰουδαϊστί Jes. 36,11; 4 Reg. 18,26; ጽሑፋት፡ ዕብራይስጥ፡ Kuf. p. 51; plerumque praemissa a praepositione በ፡, sc. በዕብራይስጥ፡ vel በዕብራይስጢ፡ ut Kuf. 12; Apoc. 9,11; Apoc. 16,16; Joh. 5,2; Joh. 19,13; Joh. 19,20; Act. 22,2; Luc. 23,38, vel b voce ነገረ፡ vel ልሳነ፡, ut: በነገረ፡ ዕብራይስጢ፡ 2 Par. 32,18; Joh. 20,16; Act. 21,40; Act. 26,14; በልሳነ፡ ዕብራይስጥ፡ Kuf. 43.

woorden.betekenis: crassus, densus, fuit, magnus, crassus fuit, crescere, magnu
woorden.definitie: I,1 [עָבָה crassus ( densus ) fuit, ܥܰܒܝܳܐ crassus, densus, وَغُبَ magnus et crassus fuit; vid. Ges. thes. p. 981] Subj. ይዕበይ፡ 1 crescere, magnum vel majorem fieri: ዐበይኩ፡ ከመ፡ ጵላጣኖስ፡ Sir. 24,14. a de luna: ነኪር፡ ከመ፡ ተዐቢ፡ Sir. 43,8. b adolescere: ልህቂ፡ ወዐበይኪ፡ Hez. 16,7. c proficere, provehi: ዐብየ፡ በጸጋ፡ Luc. 2,52; dignitate: ዐብየ፡ መርዶኬዎስ፡ προήχθη Esth. 2,21; Gen. 48,19; opibus: Gen. 26,13; በበይነዝ፡ ዐብዩ፡ ወብዕሉ፡ Jer. 5,27. d de rebus: ዐብየት፡ ሃይማኖትክሙ፡ 2 Thess. 1,3; ዐብየ፡ ስሙ፡ በኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ Kuf. 11; ይዕበይ፡ ስብሐቲሁ፡ Jes. 42,21; ወዐብየ፡ ማዕበለ፡ ባሕር፡ Jon. 1,4; ዐብየ፡ ረኃብ፡ ጥቀ፡ ( ingravescere ) Gen. 47,13. 2 magnum esse: ዐበይከ፡ ፈድፋደ፡ Ps. 103,1; ዐብየ፡ ገዓሮሙ፡ Gen. 19,13; ኀጣውኢሆሙ፡ ዐብየት፡ ጥቀ፡ Gen. 18,20; ምሕረት፡ Ps. 107,4; ዐብየ፡ ቍስልየ፡ Jer. 15,18; Thren. 2,13. a magni aestimari: 1 Reg. 2,21; 1 Reg. 26,24; Judith 12,18. b magnificari: 2 Reg. 7,26; Ps. 19,5. 3 majorem vel maximum esse vel fieri, seq. እምነ፡, ut Gen. 43,34; ዐብየት፡ ኀጢአታ፡ ለወለተ፡ ሕዝብየ፡ እምኀጢአተ፡ ሰዶም፡ Thren. 4,6; ውእቱ፡ የዐቢ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብሩ፡ Sir. 43,28; 2 Reg. 13,15; Hen. 14,15; Hebr. 1,4; Matth. 11,11; Matth. 12,6; Matth. 13,32; Joh. 1,51; Joh. 4,12; Joh. 5,20; Joh. 13,16; al.; vel Acc.: የዐብዮ፡ eo major erit Gen. 48,19; አልቦ፡ እምውስቴቶሙ፡ ዘየዐብዮ፡ ለፈራሄ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Sir. 10,24; Hen. 75,9; absol.: ትሬኢ፡ እንከ፡ ዘየዐቢ፡ ኀጢአተ፡ ἀνομίας μείζονας Hez. 8,6 seq.; Gen. 1,16; Hebr. 7,7; Jac. 3,1; Matth. 18,1; Matth. 18,4; Matth. 23,17; Matth. 23,19; Luc. 12,18; Joh. 19,11; ዘየዐቢ፡ majora 4 Esr. 3,21. a potentia, i.e. praevalere seq. ላዕለ፡ pers., Kuf. p. 123. b potiorem, majoris vel maximi momenti esse: ነፍስ፡ ተዐቢ፡ እምሲሲት፡ Matth. 6,25; Matth. 12,41; ወእምኵሉ፡ ዘየዐቢ፡ 4 Esr. 10,36. c natu majorem esse, Rom. 9,12; Gen. 10,21; 1 Reg. 17,13; መቃርስ፡ ዘየዐቢ፡ (si non magnus ) Sx. Mag. 27.

woorden.betekenis: magnum facere, augere, magna facinora facere, magna opera fa
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 magnum facere, augere, Matth. 23,5; Luc. 1,58; Gen. 12,2; Gen. 19,19; አዕበይኩ፡ ጥበበ፡ Koh. 1,16; ረሲዓን፡ ያዐብዩ፡ ኀሳረ፡ Prov. 3,35; ያዐብያ፡ ለመዐቱ፡ Sir. 28,10; Ps. 17,54; 2 Tim. 2,16. a seq. ገቢረ፡ magna facinora facere Ps. 125,3; Ps. 125,4; vel አዕበየ፡ ከመ፡ ይግበር፡ Joel 2,21; vel absol.: 1 Reg. 12,24 vel አዕበየ፡ ምግባረ፡ magna opera facere Koh. 2,4; etiam omisso ምግባረ፡ Koh. 2,9. b magnum i.e. opulentum, potentem reddere: Gen. 24,35; Gen. 28,3; ያዐብዮ፡ ወያከብሮ፡ Sir. 11,13. c magnificare, amplificare: Jos. 3,7; Jos. 4,14; Ps. 36,36; ወአዕበዮ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለሰሎሞን፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ 1 Par. 29,25; Jer. 38,14 (vid. n. 2,a). d magnifacere: Job 7,17; Act. 5,13. e vocem, clamorem vehementem facere: አዕበዩ፡ ጸሪኀ፡ Matth. 20,31. f natu majorem facere vel declarare: ኢይክል፡ አዕብዮቶ፡ Deut. 21,16. g አፈ፡ os i.e. magna loqui(insolenter jactare), μεγαλοῤῥημονεῖν: Ps. 37,17; Ps. 54,13; መጠነ፡ አዕበየ፡ አፉሁ፡ Judith 6,17; እመ፡ አዕቤከ፡ አፉከ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ Sir. 22,22; Sir. 20,15, vel seq. ነቢበ፡ Ps. 11,3; Ps. 11,4. h crescere facereplantam, Lud. e Ssal.
