Req. 2 tollere, extollere, exaltare: ያዐብያ፡ ለክምረ፡ እክሉ፡ Sir. 20,28; ታዐቢ፡ እደዊከ፡ ኀቤሁ፡ Job 11,13. a laudibus (magnificare): አዕብይዎ፡ ለስሙ፡ Sir. 39,15; Sir. 43,30; Ps. 33,4; Ps. 68,35; Luc. 1,46; Act. 19,17. b ad dignitatem, potentiam, felicitatem evehere: አዕበዮ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ለሐማ፡ Esth. 3,1; ጥበብ፡ አዕበየቶሙ፡ ለደቂቃ፡ Sir. 4,11; ታዐብዮ፡ እምነ፡ ቢጹ፡ Sir. 15,5; ያዐብያ፡ ለነፍስከ፡ Sir. 31,20; Phil. 2,9; እምውስተ፡ መዋዕል፡ ቦ፡ ዘቀደሰ፡ ወአዕበየ፡ Phil. 36,9. c ርእሶ፡ se efferre: ኢታዕቢ፡ ርእሰከ፡ Sir. 1,30; Sir. 4,7; Sir. 6,2; Sir. 11,4; Luc. 18,14; Matth. 23,12. d ልቦ፡ magnos sibi sumere spiritus, superbire: ዘያዐቢ፡ ልቦ፡ Jes. 10,12; Jer. 31,29; አዕብዮ፡ ልብ፡ fastus Kuf. 40. e ምግባሮ፡ fastuose agere Joel 2,20. f vocem tollere seu clamorem: ያዐቢ፡ ቃሎ፡ Sir. 21,20; ከመ፡ ያዕቢ፡ ቃለ፡ በውውዓ፡ Hez. 21,22 vers. nov.

woorden.betekenis: se efferre, se jactare, insolescere, superbire, inflatum ess
woorden.definitie: III,2 (raro III,1) se efferre, se jactare, insolescere, superbire, inflatum esse, ኢትትዐበዩ፡ μὴ ἐπαίρεσθε Jer. 13,15; μεγαλύνεσθαι Dan. 8,25; እስመ፡ ተዐበየ፡ ልብከ፡ ὑψώθη Hez. 28,2; Ps. 130,1; ለምንት፡ ይትዔበይ፡ (v. ይትዐበይ፡) መሬት፡ ወሐመድ፡ ὑπερηφανεύεται Sir. 10,9; Rom. 12,3; ἐφυσιώθησαν 1 Cor. 4,18; ኢትትዐበይ፡ በመዋዕለ፡ ተጽናስከ፡ μὴ δοξάζου Sir. 10,26; Phil. 2,3; ኢትትዐበይ፡ በቅድመ፡ ንጉሥ፡ μὴ ἀλαζονεύου Prov. 25,6; c.c. በ፡ rei, qua quis superbit: እለ፡ ይትዔበዩ፡ በወርቅ፡ Zeph. 1,11; በጥበብከ፡ ኢትትዐበይ፡ Prov. 3,5; c. ላዕለ፡ contra aliquem: Ps. 12,3; ተዐበየ፡ ላዕለ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Jer. 21,26; 4 Esr. 9,12; ከመ፡ ኢይትዐበይ፡ ንኡስ፡ ላዕለ፡ ዐቢይ፡ Clem. f. 173; fastidire aliquid, seq. ለ፡ c. Infin., ut: ዲያቆናት፡ ኢይትዐበዩ፡ ለተልእኮ፡ ጽኑሳን፡ Did. 17; ኢተዐብዮ፡ modestia, Lud. ex Sx. Masc. 23Enc.

woorden.betekenis: superbus, arrogans, insolens, fastuosus, inflatus, superbia
woorden.definitie: part. superbus, arrogans, insolens, fastuosus, inflatus, (superbia tumens), ὑπερήφανος Ps. 17,30; Ps. 88,11; Job 38,15; Job 40,7; Sir. 3,28; Sir. 11,30; Sir. 23,8; Sir. 27,15; Sap. 14,6; Prov. 3,34; Jes. 13,11; Jac. 4,6; συκοφάντης Ps. 71,4; ὑβρισταί Rom. 1,30 Platt; አዕይንት፡ ዕቡይ፡ Prov. 24,36; Jes. 5,15; ዕቡየ፡ ልብ፡ Prov. 14,14; ዕቡየ፡ መንፈስ፡ Koh. 7,8; ዕቡየ፡ ዐይን፡ Ps. 100,7. ʿǝbbuy G ዕቡየ፡ ልብ፡ ʿǝbbuya lǝbb «orgueilleux» ወአክሪሱስሰ፡ ኮነ፡ ግዙፈ፡ ክሳድ፡ ወዕቡየ፡ ልብ። 167, vid. ልብ፡ 33 L ዕቡይ፡ ʿǝbbuy proud, arrogant, boastful, haughty, insolent ዕቡየ፡ ልብ ʿǝbbuya lǝbb presumptuous 55b

woorden.betekenis: magnitudo, pars major, potior, amplitudo, magnificentia, maj
woorden.definitie: subst., Pl. ዕበያት፡ magnitudo, domus Hen. 14,16; corporis humani F.N. 10; ዕበየ፡ ሣህልከ፡ Ps. 50,1; Num. 14,19; ዕበየ፡ ኀይሉ፡ Eph. 1,19; Ps. 78,12; ዕበየ፡ ስብሐት፡ Ps. 8,2; Ps. 95,6; Ps. 103,2; Sir. 17,13. a pars major vel potior Kuf. p. 131lin. 5 et 7. b magnitudo dignitatis, honoris, potentiae, amplitudo: በአምጣነ፡ ዕበይከ፡ Sir. 3,18; Hebr. 7,4. c magnificentia, majestas, Dei, በከመ፡ ዕበይሁ፡ (v. ዕበዪሁ፡) ከማሁ፡ ዕበየ፡ ምሕረቱ፡ Sir. 2,18; Sir. 43,29; Hen. 84,2; Tob. 13,6; Tob. 13,7; Ps. 144,3; Judae 25; Hebr. 1,3; Dianae Act. 19,27; regis Dan. 5,18; በዕበይ፡ ወበክብር፡ Sx. Haml. 4Enc. d magnalia, ዕበያቲሁ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ Herm. p. 94; Herm. p. 107; ዕበየ፡ ግብሩ፡ τὰ μεγαλεῖα τῶν ἔργων αὐτοῦ Sir. 17,9; ገባሬ፡ዕበይ፡ Sx. Tachs. 29Enc. e elatio et causa elationis vel gloriationis: ወይከውን፡ ፍሥሓ፡ ወክብረ፡ ወዕበየ፡ ለኵሉ፡ አሕዛብ፡ Jer. 40,9; ለዕበይ፡ ወለክብር፡ Kuf. 4; አንቲ፡ ይእቲ፡ ዕበዮሙ፡ ለእስራኤል፡ Judith 15,9.

woorden.betekenis: magnus, vehemens, altus, gravis, magni momenti, magna facino
woorden.definitie: adj., fem. ዐባይ፡, Pl. m. ዐቢያን፡, fem. ዐቢያት፡, c. ዐበይት፡ 1 magnus, bestia Ps. 103,27; Apoc. 12,3; Apoc. 12,14; Joh. 21,11; እብን፡ ዐበይት፡ Deut. 27,2; Marc. 16,4; ጥቅም፡ ዐቢይ፡ Koh. 9,14; mons Jes. 57,7; ሀገር፡ ዐባይ፡ Jon. 1,2; arbor Matth. 13,22; ብርሃናት፡ ዐበይት፡ Gen. 1,16; domus Jes. 5,9; Hen. 14,10; cubiculum Marc. 14,15; fluvius Gen. 15,18; mare Num. 34,6; በረድ፡ ዐበይት፡ Jes. 30,30; Apoc. 11,19; ዐበይት፡ መዋቅሕት፡ Apoc. 20,1; መጥባሕት፡ ዐቢይ፡ Apoc. 6,4; ሕዝብ፡ ዐቢይ፡ Gen. 12,2; Gen. 18,18; ዕሴት፡ ዐቢይ፡ Hebr. 10,35; 1 Tim. 6,6; Act. 4,33; Luc. 1,49; በዓል፡ ዐቢይ፡ Luc. 14,16; Apoc. 19,17; ተኣምራት፡ ዐቢያን፡ ወስቡሓን፡ Hen. 36,4; Ps. 91,5; ዐውያት፡ ዐበይት፡ Hen. 85,6; ግብር፡ ዐበይት፡ Kuf. 2; እኪት፡ ዐበይት፡ Kuf. 23; ኵነኔ፡ ዐበይት፡ Kuf. 48; 1 Reg. 5,9; መቅሠፍት፡ ዐቢይ፡ Job 2,13; ኀጢአት፡ ዐባይ፡ F.M. 6,1; caet.; raro junctum nominibus temporis, ut: ዐቢየ፡ ሰዓተ፡ 1 Reg. 20,41. a vehemens, ut ventus: Job 1,19; Jon. 1,4; Ex. 10,19; ዝናም፡ ዐቢይ፡ 3 Reg. 18,45; ድልቅልቅ፡ ዐቢይ፡ Jer. 10,22; ማዕበል፡ ዐቢይ፡ Jon. 1,11; ድቀት፡ ዐቢይ፡ Matth. 7,27; ድንጋፄ፡ Marc. 5,42; fletus Gen. 50,10; ira Apoc. 12,12; timor Marc. 4,41; gaudium Act. 8,8; tribulatio Matth. 24,21, al. b altus, de voce በዐቢይ፡ ቃል፡ Hez. 9,1; Dan. apocr. 1,24; Jes. 36,13; Job 2,12; በዐቢይ፡ ፀዓዕ፡ Sir. 46,17; 4 Esr. 9,38; 4 Esr. 10,39; de somno et tranquillitate: ናዋም፡ ዐቢይ፡ ὕπνος βαθύς Sir. 22,7; ዛሕን፡ ዐቢይ፡ Matth. 8,26. c gravis, magni momenti: ዐቢይ፡ ዝነገር፡ ለነ፡ 2 Esr. 10,12; 2 Esr. 16,3; 1 Reg. 20,2; 1 Reg. 22,15; Jes. 49,6; Gen. 45,28; አኮ፡ ዐቢይ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ሊተ፡ እመ፡ አፍቀርክዎ፡ Kuf. 35; ዐቢይ፡ ውእቱ፡ ሊተ፡ እስመ፡ ዮሴፍ፡ሕያው፡ Kuf. 43; Matth. 22,38; Act. 8,9; 1 Cor. 9,11; Eph. 5,32. d magnum vel magna i.e. magna facinora, magnalia: ይገብር፡ ዐቢየ፡ በኵለሄ፡ Sir. 50,22; ገብረ፡ ዐቢያተ፡ Jes. 12,5; Ps. 105,22; Job 5,9; Job 42,3. e magnus, de verbis insolentis vel superbi: አፉሁ፡ ይነብብ፡ ዐቢያተ፡ Dan. 7,8 seq.; Hen. 5,4; 2 Petr. 2,18; ዐቢይ፡ ነገር፡ Sx. Teq. 17 Enc. f Adv. ዐቢየ፡ α valde Deut. 26,5; Sap. 3,5; Apoc. 17,6. β altavel clara voce: ስብኩ፡ ዐቢየ፡ Jer. 4,5. 2 de personis, a magnus potentia, dignitate, opibus al.: ንጉሥ፡ ዐቢይ፡ Koh. 9,14; Esth. apocr. 1; Matth. 5,35; Ex. 11,3; 2 Reg. 19,32; 4 Reg. 5,1; Matth. 5,19; Matth. 20,26; Luc. 1,15; Hebr. 4,14. α de Deo: Sir. 39,6; Ps. 34,31; Ps. 39,22; Ps. 46,2; Ps. 69,5; Tit. 2,13. β de sacerdote summo: ካህን፡ ዐቢይ፡ Num. 35,25; 4 Reg. 23,4; Sir. 50,1 al. γ nobilis, procer, primoris, princeps: ትሑት፡ ምስለ፡ ዐቢይ፡ Kuf. 23; Job 18,20; Job 34,19; Lev. 19,15; ዐቢይ፡ ወንኡስ፡ Jes. 9,14; Jer. 6,13; Jer. 38,34; Gen. 19,4; δυνάστης Sir. 7,6; ዐበይት፡ ሰብእ፡ Sir. 8,1; ዐበይት፡ Sir. 11,6; Sir. 25,5; Jes. 5,14; Jes. 10,33; Jes. 24,4; Jer. 41,10; Dan. 3,2; Ps. 130,2; Ex. 7,9; Ex. 8,7 seq.; ዐበይተ፡ ተዓይን፡ Num. 16,2; ዐበይተ፡ ነገድክሙ፡ Deut. 29,9; Matth. 20,25; ዐቢያን፡ Prov. 8,16. b annis i.e. natu majorvel maximus: አንተ፡ ዐቢይነ፡ πρεσβύτερος Jer. 39,8 (crebrius ዘየዐቢ፡). Huc referenda videtur phrasis ዐቢይ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ Christiani(adultivel maturi, opp. ንኡስ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ catechumenisvel neophytis) Const. Ap. 34; Kid. f. 10; 1 Petr. 3,21 rom. C ● for ዐቢይ፡ ሕማም፡ vid. ሕማም፡ (TraCES) ● for ዓቢየ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ vid. ክርስቲያን፡ (TraCES)

woorden.betekenis: superbia, insolentia, arrogantia, fastus, tǝʿbit, tǝʿ(ǝ)bit,
woorden.definitie: subst., fem. et m., superbia, insolentia, arrogantia, fastus, ὑπερηφανία, Prov. 8,13; Ps. 16,10; Ps. 72,6; Ex. 18,21; Sir. 10,7; Sir. 10,12; Sir. 10,13; Sir. 10,18; Jes. 16,6; Jer. 31,29; Dan. 4,34; ኀበ፡ ሀለወት፡ ትዕቢት፡ ህየ፡ ሀሎ፡ ኀሳር፡ Tob. 4,13; Judith 6,19; Hen. 5,8; አልቦ፡ ትዕቢት፡ ወአዕብዮ፡ ልብ፡ Kuf. 40; Marc. 7,22; Rom. 12,16; ὕβρις Jes. 13,11; ትዕቢት፡ ብእሴ፡ ያቴሕት፡ Prov. 29,23; ትዕቢተ፡ ኀይሎሙ፡ φρύαγμα Hez. 7,24; ገብረ፡ ትዕቢተ፡ Num. 15,30; ትዕቢተ፡ ልቦሙ፡ Sir. 3,24; ትዕቢት፡ ወምክሕ፡ ወትዝህርት፡ ያማስኖ፡ ለባዕል፡ Sir. 21,4; ዑቅ፡ ኢትንብብ፡ ነገረ፡ ትዕቢት፡ Sir. 35,12; ትዕቢትሰ፡ ጥንተ፡ ኀጢአት፡ ይእቲ፡ ዘቦአት፡ ውስተ፡ ፍጥረት፡ እስመ፡ ባቲ፡ ወድቀ፡ ሰይጣን፡ F.M. 3,1; በትዕቢት፡ Lit. Orth. tǝʿbit, tǝʿ(ǝ)bit G ትዕቢተ፡ ልብ፡ tǝʿbita lǝbb «orgueil» ኮነ፡ አኃዜ፡ ዓለም፡ ኵላ፡ ወወለጠ፡ ስሞ፡ በትዕቢተ፡ ልብ። 169, vid. ልብ፡

woorden.betekenis: sonare, resonare, strepere, concentum musicum edere, organum
woorden.definitie: quadril. I (etiam አንዘረ፡) [ܢܨܰܪ sonare, resonare, strepere ]; passim tamquam stirps II,1 radicis ነዘረ፡ flectitur; concentum musicum edere, organum vel fides pulsare, tibia cantare, 2 Reg. 6,5; የዐነዝሩ፡ ወይሰነቅዉ፡ Job 21,12; ዳዊት፡ የዐነዝር፡ በዕንዚራ፡ 2 Reg. 6,14; በብዕዛ፡ የዐነዝሩ፡ (v. ያነዝሩ፡) ወይገንዩ፡ 1 Par. 25,3; 1 Par. 25,5; ዐንዘርነ፡ ηὐλήσαμεν Matth. 11,17. a canere vel strepere, de regina apium, Lud. e Libr. Myst. (vid. ንህብ፡). b concentu laudare aliquem, c. Acc. pers., Sx. Ter 28Enc. (si quidem lectio bona est). – Rad. Abb.: ዐንዘረ፡ ዘ፡ መታ፡

woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. ዕንዚራት፡ instrumentum musicum et tibia, fistula al. et cithara, lyra, nablium, organon al.: ይስዕር፡ ኵሎ፡ ዕንዚራተኪ፡ πὸ πλῆθος τῶν μουσικῶν σου Hez. 26,13; συμφωνία Luc. 15,25; በዕንዚራ፡ μετὰ αὐλοῦ Jes. 30,29; 1 Esr. 5,2; 1 Reg. 10,5; ይኔቁ፡ ከመ፡ ዕንዚራ፡ ὥσπερ αὐλὸς βομβήσει Jer. 31,36; σύριγξ (ut videtur) Dan. 3,5; ὄργανον vel ὄργανα Am. 6,5; 1 Par. 16,42; 1 Par. 23,5; 2 Par. 7,6; 2 Par. 29,26; 2 Par. 30,21; Ps. 136,2; Ps. 150,4; 2 Reg. 6,5; 2 Reg. 6,14; κιθάρα κινύρα νάβλη 1 Cor. 14,7; 1 Par. 15,20; 1 Par. 25,1; accedunt Jes. 5,12; 1 Par. 15,16, al., ubi quid apud LXX respondeat dubium est; ዕንዚራ፡ ስብሐት፡ titulus opusculi cujusdam, 139. – Forma ንዚራ፡ occurrit in F.N., sc.: እለ፡ ይነፍኁ፡ ንዚራተ፡ F.N. 23 (si quidem lectio sana est). – Voc. Ae.: አርጋኖን፡ ወዕንዚራ፡ ዘ፡ በገና፡, vid. etiam schol. ad መሰንቆ፡ (Vid. Description de l’Egypte, II éd., tom. XIII, p. 538.)

Ae.: ዐውሎ፡ ዘ፡ ሐምበላይ፡ ነፋስ፡; aliud: ዘ፡ እምብሉይት።

woorden.betekenis: effodere, eruere, caecum reddere, excaecare, occaecare, alic

II,1 Subj. ያዑር፡; in Imperf. etiam II,2 ያዔውር፡; 1 effodere, eruere oculos alicujus: ወአዕይንቲሁ፡ ለጼዴቅያስ፡ አዖረ፡ Jer. 46,7 vers. nov.; አዕወሮ፡ (v. አዖሮ፡) et አዐሮ፡ 4 Reg. 25,7; Clem. f. 77. 2 caecum reddere, excaecare, occaecare, c. Acc. hominum vel c. Acc. oculorum et pron. suff. pers. ( alicui vel alicujus ): Gen. 19,11; 1 Joh. 2,11; አዑሮሙ፡ አዕይንቲሆሙ፡ ወአዖሮሙ፡ 4 Reg. 6,18; ሕልያን፡ ያዐውር፡ አዕይንተ፡ Ex. 23,8; Deut. 16,19; አምኃ፡ ወሕልያን፡ ያዐውሮሙ፡ አዕይንቲሆሙ፡ ለጠቢባን፡ Sir. 20,29; Did. 10; አዖረ፡ አዕይንተ፡ ልብ፡ F.M. 25,1; ጸላኢ፡ አዖረ፡ ልቦሙ፡ Clem. f. 263; Clem. f. 267; ለልቡ፡ አዖሮ፡ ሰይጣን፡ Macc. f. 1; ሕልያን፡ ያዔውር፡ አዕይንተ፡ Did. 4. (Asc. Jes. 7,17 est locus corruptus).

woorden.betekenis: se caecum simulare, connivere, oculos avertere, negligere, d
woorden.definitie: III,2 (rarissime III,1 ut 4 Esr. 9,10 Laur.) se caecum simulare, Ps. 9,22. a connivere, c. እምነ፡ pers.: እመ፡ ተዐወረ፡ አዕይንቲሁ፡ እምእሉ፡ እለ፡ ይገብሩ፡ ርኩሰ፡ Kuf. 30; c. Acc. pers., Lev. 20,4. b oculos avertere ab aliquo, negligere, seq. እምነ፡, ut: ኢተዐወርከ፡ እምኔነ፡ ὑπερεῖδες Sap. 19,21; ኢትትዐወር፡ እምዘርአ፡ ቤትከ፡ Jes. 58,7; c. Acc. rei vel pers.: Gen. 42,21; Lev. 26,37; Jos. 1,5; Judith 8,20; Esth. 4,17 apocr. (ὑπερίδῃς τὴν μερίδα σου); ይትዔወር፡ ነፍሶ፡ Sir. 14,8; ይትዔወር፡ ቢጾ፡ Sir. 29,14; ኀፍረት፡ ተዐውሮቱ፡ ለቢጽከ፡ Sir. 41,21. c despicere, contemnere, spernere, despicatui habere, c. Acc. pers., Ps. 21,18; Num. 5,19; omisso Acc.: ተዐውሮ፡ ተዐወርክሙ፡ Mal. 3,9; ተዐውሮቶሙ፡ Job 6,19; in specie: praecepta, foedus, al.: ተዐወሩ፡ ኪዳኖ፡ 4 Esr. 5,24; 4 Esr. 9,10; Num. 22,18 (παραβῆναι); Luc. 11,42; ትእዛዘ፡ Clem. (creberrime); etiam omisso ትእዛዘ፡, ut: ኢይባእ፡ ውስተ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡ ወእመሰ፡ ተዐወረ፡ ከመ፡ ይባእ፡ al., Clem. f. 177. – Ra d. Abb.: ተዐወረ፡ ዘ፡ ቸል፡ አለ።

woorden.betekenis: caecus
woorden.definitie: vel ዕውር፡ part. caecus (sensu proprio et translate), Lev. 19,14; Lev. 21,18; Deut. 28,29; Job 5,14; ዕዉራን፡ Job 29,15; Jes. 29,18; Jes. 35,5; Jes. 42,16; Jes. 42,18; ሕዝብ፡ ዕዉር፡ Jes. 43,8; Jes. 59,10; Jes. 61,1; Ps. 145,7; Matth. 9,27; Matth. 21,14; Marc. 8,22; Joh. 9,1 seq.; 2 Petr. 1,9; ብእሲ፡ ዘዕውርት፡ አሐቲ፡ ዐይኑ፡ Sx. Haml. 11; ዕዉረ፡ አዕይንት፡ Syn. p. 347; ዕዉረ፡ ልብ፡ M.M. f. 22; ዘያጠብቦ፡ ለዕዉር፡ Clem. f. 172; ዝቀትል፡ (sc. caedes በመጥባሕት፡ i.e. sicâ perpetrata) ተሰምየ፡ ሞተ፡ ዕዉር፡ (sic) Jsp. p. 343.

woorden.betekenis: servare, observare, respicere, attendere, videre, prospicere
woorden.definitie: I,1 [contiguum videtur ዐቀበ፡, an وَقَى?] Subj. ይዑቅ፡ 1 servare, observare: ነፍሶ፡ ዑቅ፡ τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ διαφύλαξον Job 2,6; ዑቅ፡ ትእዛዘ፡ ወግበር፡ Kuf. p. 77. a respicere, attendere, videre, prospicere, c. Acc. pers. vel rei: ዑቀኒ፡ ἐπιγνῶναί με Ruth 2,10; εἰδέναι 1 Thess. 5,12; ዘኢየዐውቅ፡ ቤቶ፡ ይወርሶ፡ ነፋስ፡ Prov. 11,29; βλέπειν Col. 4,17; diaconi ይዑቅዎሙ፡ ለእለ፡ አልቦሙ፡ (prospiciant iis qui nihil habent) p. 321; etiam c. ላዕለ፡ vel ለ፡ pers.: ዑቅኬ፡ ላዕለ፡ (v. ለ)ኢዮብ፡ προσέχειν Job 2,3. b cavere α aliquem vel aliquid i.e. vitare, c. Acc.: ዑቅዎሙ፡ ለከለባት፡ βλέπετε τοὺς κύνας Phil. 3,2; ዘንተ፡ ዑቅ፡ ከመ፡ ኢታግብኦ፡ ለወልድየ፡ Gen. 24,8; seq. እምነ፡ rei, ut: ዑቅ፡ ርእሰከ፡ (v. ዑቅ፡) እምእኩይ፡ Sir. 4,20. β providere, videre, cautionem adhibere, sive addito ርእሶ፡ (proprie: semet custodire ) sive omisso; absol.: ዑቅ፡ ርእሰከ፡ 1 Reg. 19,2; Deut. 4,9; Deut. 8,11; Marc. 13,9; Luc. 17,3; ዑቅ፡ ወተዐቀብ፡ Sir. 13,13; ዑቂ፡ ወለብዊ፡ Did. 3; ዑቁ፡ ወኢታፅርዑ፡ 2 Esr. 7,23; c. በእንተ፡ rei 1 Tim. 4,16; seq. ኢ፡ cum Subj. verbi ( ne ): Deut. 4,23; Deut. 6,12; Deut. 11,16; Deut. 12,13; Deut. 12,19; Deut. 12,30; Gen. 24,6; ዑቁ፡ ኢታርኅዉ፡ 2 Esr. 17,3; Ep. Jer. 4; ዑቅ፡ ኢያስሕቱከ፡ Jes. 41,10; Sir. 21,1; Sir. 29,24; Luc. 21,34; Hebr. 12,25; raro seq. Imperf., ut: ዑቅ፡ አልቦ፡ ዘትኄሊ፡ Job 1,8; Matth. 9,30; seq. ከመ፡ c. Subj. ( ut ): ዑቁ፡ ከመ፡ ትግበሩ፡ Deut. 27,1; Hebr. 8,5; seq. ዮጊ፡ ኢ፡ ne forte c. Subj., Apoc. 19,10 Platt. 2 animadvertere, cognoscere: ዑቅ፡ ከመ፡ „scito, quod“ Lud. e Vit. Pach. [quae verbi አወቀ፡ significatio in lingua Amh. tritissima est; cfr. נָצַר custodire, at نظر ነጸረ፡ intueri, aspicere ]. 3 intrans.: notum, manifestum esse vel fieri, apparere: ድኅረ፡ የዐውቅ፡ እከይሁ፡ (nisi ያዐውቅ፡ ἐκφαίνει τὴν κακίαν legere malueris) Sir. 14,7; አዕረፈ፡ (ያሬድ፡ ማሕሌታዊ፡) በሰላም፡ ወመቃብሪሁሰ፡ ኢተዐውቅ፡ (ni ተዐውቀ፡ legendum est) Sx. Genb. 11; ናሁኬ፡ የዐውቅ፡ ከመ፡ … („elucet“, ni ያዐውቅ፡ „indicat“ interpretandum est) M.M. f. 109.

woorden.betekenis: animadverti, percipi, cognosci, agnosci, ab, alicui, qua, e
woorden.definitie: (raro ተዐወቀ፡ ut Jes. 3,9) III,1 1 animadverti, percipi, cognosci, agnosci, γνωσθήσεται Ps. 87,13; ከመ፡ ይትዐወቅ፡ ጽድቁ፡ Mich. 6,5; Jes. 61,9; Hez. 39,7; ተዐውቀ፡ ἐπεγνώσθη Job 6,17; Thren. 4,8; ይትዐወቅ፡ እምርሑቅ፡ ዘይክል፡ ነቢበ፡ Sir. 21,7; Hen. 15,11; ኢተዐውቀ፡ መካኑ፡ εὑρέθη Dan. 2,35; ዘእንበለ፡ ይትዐወቅ፡ (non animadversus) Job 22,16; ሕልመ፡ ሌሊት፡ ዘኢይትዐወቅ፡ Job 20,8; Lit. 162,1; አኮ፡ ዘይትዐወቅ፡ οὐκ εὔγνωστοι Prov. 5,6; c. በኀበ፡ ab aliquo: Prov. 15,10; ይትዐወቅ፡ ስምከ፡ በኀቤሆሙ፡ Jes. 64,2; vel c. pron. suff. ( alicui ): አኮ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ዘይትዐወቆ፡ ብርሃን፡ ὁρατόν Job 37,20; c. እምነ፡ rei ( qua vel e qua quis agnoscitur vel cognoscitur): እምራእዩ፡ ይትዐወቅ፡ ሰብእ፡ Sir. 19,29; Sir. 19,30; Sir. 4,24; Sir. 10,5; Sir. 26,9; Prov. 14,4; Rom. 1,20; Rom. 3,20; seq. ከመ፡ Ex. 33,16. 2 notum, manifestum, cognitum esse, innotescere, revelari: እስመ፡ ተዐውቀ፡ ሥምረቱ፡ ለአምላክነ፡ γνωστά ἐστι Bar. 4,4; ተዐውቀ፡ኵሉ፡ γνωστὰ πάντα Tob. 2,14; Ps. 75,1; φανερός ἐστι Gal. 5,19; Jes. 3,9; Jes. 33,9; πρόδηλός ἐστι 1 Tim. 5,24; 1 Tim. 5,25; φανεροὺς γενέσθαι Phil. 1,13; Gen. 42,16; ἐσημειώθη Ps. 4,7; ኢይትዐወቁ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ወኢኃጥኣን፡ φαίνονται Herm. p. 51; ከመ፡ ይትዐወቅ፡ ኂሩትከ፡ ἀποφάνῃς δίκαιος Job 40,3; ኢተዐውቀ፡ ኀይሉ፡ οὐκ ἐγνώσθη Jud. 16,9; ἐπεφάνη Tit. 2,11; φανεροῦσθαι Hebr. 9,8; 1 Joh. 1,2; 1 Joh. 3,2; በደኃሪቱ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ይትዐወቅ፡ ምግባሩ፡ (ἀποκάλυψις) Sir. 11,27; c. በ፡ rei, qua quid notum vel manifestum fit: Gen. 42,15. a manifestum, evidens, apertum, certum est, constat, apparet seq. Acc. c. Infin. α constr. impersonaliter, seq. ከመ፡, ut Hebr. 7,7; ተዐውቀኬ፡ ገሃደ፡ከመ፡ … Cyr. ad Theod. f. 24; በዝንቱ፡ ይትዐወቅ፡ ከመ፡ ኢኮኑ፡ አማልክተ፡ Ep. Jer. 14; ዘእንበለ፡ ይትዐወቅ፡ ከመ፡ ገብረት፡ ዝሙተ፡ F.M. 12,2;Lud. comm. hist. p. 505 n. 49; c. እምነ፡ pers. ( de aliquo): ተዐውቀ፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ ከመ፡ ነስሑ፡ F.M. 15,3. β personaliter: ትትዐወቅ፡ ከመ፡ ፈያት፡ አንተ፡ 3 Reg. 20,40; ተዐውቀት፡ ከመ፡ ፀንሰት፡ Kuf. 41. b indiciis et testimoniis probatum esse: እመሰቦ፡ ዘተዐውቀ፡ አበሳሁ፡ በውስተ፡ ፍትሕ፡ Did. 10; c. በ፡ pers. ( contra aliquem vel de aliquo): ብእሲ፡ ለእመ፡ ተዐውቀ፡ ቦቱ፡ ከመ፡ ውእቱ፡ ይዔምፃ፡ ለብእሲቱ፡ F.M. 12,2. 3 Suffixo pron. pers.: mente percipere, sentire, sibi conscium esse rei, persuasum habere aliquid: አብድ፡ ተቀሢፎ፡ ኢይትዐወቆ፡ οὐκ αἱσθάνεται (proprie: ei non percipitur) Prov. 17,10; ኢተዐውቆ፡ ሕማም፡ non sensit dolores, Sx. Mag. 7 Enc.; ተዐውቀቶሙ፡ ኀጢአቶሙ፡ γνωσθῇ αὐτοῖς ἡ ἁμαρτία Lev. 4,14; Hez. 36,32; ኢይትዐወቀኒ፡ ዘገበርኩ፡ እኩየ፡ οὐ σύνοιδα ἐμαυτῷ ἄτοπα πράξας Job 27,6; 1 Cor. 4,4; እስመ፡ ተዐውቆ፡ ቅትለቶሙ፡ በሐሰት፡ (ei persuasum erat, causam supplicii eorum esse mendacia) Jsp. p. 334; Infin.: cognitio, scientia, perspicientia: αἴσθησις ተዐውቆ፡ Prov. 1,4; Prov. 1,7; Prov. 11,9; ἐπιγνωμοσύνη Prov. 16,23; በተዐውቆቱ፡ ἐν αἰσθήσει Prov. 3,20.

woorden.betekenis: ejulare, ululare, flebilem clamorem tollere, lamentari, plor
woorden.definitie: quadril. I [pro አውየወ፡, a ወይ፡ propagatum, coll. عَوَى ܥܘܳܐ; semel sc. Jes. 10,10 in uno codice formam አውየ፡ iveni] ejulare, ululare, flebilem clamorem tollere; lamentari, plorare, clamare, vociferari: ἀλαλάζειν, ὀλολύζειν Am. 8,3; ዐውይዉ፡ Jes. 13,6; Jes. 15,2; Jes. 15,3; Jes. 65,14; Jer. 4,8; Jer. 30,3; Jer. 31,20; ወውዕ፡ ወዐውይው፡ (v. ወዐውዩ፡) Hez. 21,12; Marc. 5,38; κράζειν, βοᾶν, ἀναβοᾶν: ዐውየወ፡ በሕቁ፡ Judith 14,16; Judith 14,19; Ex. 2,23; 2 Reg. 13,19; Job 2,12; ኢይረክብኑ፡ ብሔረ፡ ኀበ፡ አዐወዩ፡ Job 16,18; Job 30,28; የዐወይዉ፡ እምብዝኀ፡ መስተዐግላን፡ Job 35,9; Jes. 15,4; ዐውየወት፡ በሕማማ፡ Jes. 26,17; Jer. 29,2; Thren. 3,8; Marc. 1,24; Marc. 1,26; Jac. 5,4; አኀዝኩ፡ እብኪ፡ ወአዐውዩ፡ Hen. 89,69; auxilio vocantis, implorantis: Jes. 57,13; Dan. apocr. 1,24; Job 19,7; Job 36,13; Luc. 18,38; Luc. 18,39; c. ኀበ፡ pers.: Ex. 8,8; Ex. 14,10; ነዐወዩ፡ ኀቤከ፡ Hab. 1,2; Ps. 106,6; Ps. 106,28; Job 38,41 (de corvis); Jes. 19,20; Jes. 46,7; ዐውየወ፡ ልቦሙ፡ ኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Thren. 2,18; clamorem tollere Jes. 5,30. – Voc. Ae.: ዐውየወ፡ ከልሐ፡ ወውዐ፡ ዘ፡ ጮኸ፡ (cfr. scholion ad ወክሐ፡).

woorden.betekenis: ejulatio, ululatus, lamentum, flebilis clamor, ploratus, voc
woorden.definitie: subst. (semel inveni ዐውያ፡, sc. ጊዜ፡ ዐውያከ፡ Jes. 58,9 in cod. Laur.; caeteri habent: በጊዜ፡ ዐውየውከ፡) ejulatio, { ululatus }, lamentum, flebilis clamor, ploratus, vociferatio, Gen. 21,17; Ex. 2,23; አንሥኡ፡ ዐውያተ፡ εἶπον ὤ 4 Reg. 3,21; οὐαί οὐαὶ Am. 5,16; ቃለ፡ ብካይ፡ ወቃለ፡ ዐውያት፡ Jes. 65,19; Kuf. 49; Zeph. 1,10; ቃለ፡ ዐውያቲሃ፡ Jer. 8,19; Jer. 14,2; ይሰምዖ፡ ዐውያቶ፡ Sir. 32,16; ዐውያቶሙ፡ Ps. 9,12; ዐውያተ፡ ነዳያን፡ Job 34,28; Jes. 15,8; Jes. 22,2; Jer. 18,22; Jer. 20,16; Jer. 32,22; Ps. 143,17; ዐውየወት፡ ዐውያተ፡ ዐበይተ፡ Hen. 85,6.

woorden.betekenis: circumdedit, vertit, mutavit, reversus est, assuefecit, incu
woorden.definitie: I,1 [עִוֵּד circumdedit; عَادَ vertit, mutavit; reversus est, II assuefecit (ܥܳܕ); vic. أَاد incurvavit, inflexit; significationis continuandi et durandi, quae et ipsa huic radici inerat, vestigium relictum est in ዓዲ፡ q.v.] Subj. ይዑድ፡ 1 se vertere, circumverti: ከመ፡ መንኮኮት፡ እንተ፡ ተዐውድ፡ ὡς ἄξων στρεφόμενος Sir. 36,5; Prov. 26,14 (vid. sub ማዕጾ፡). 2 circumire, ambire, obire, ዖድኩ፡ ἐκύκλωσα Koh. 7,25; የዐውድ፡ ዐውደ፡ κυκλοῖ κυκλῶν Koh. 1,6; ዖድኩ፡ እንዘ፡ አኀሥሣ፡ περιῄειν Sap. 8,18; ዖደ፡ ዐዋዲ፡ Gen. 41,43; የዐውድ፡ ይንግር፡ ለከ፡ ዘወሀበከ፡ Sir. 20,15; Hen. 21,1; c. ለ፡ loci: Hen. 75,9; ንዑድ፡ ለዝ፡ መኅፈድ፡ Herm. p. 84; c. ውስተ፡ loci: Gen. 2,11; ዖደ፡ ውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ደወሎሙ፡ Judith 3,8; መዓቅብት፡ ይዑዱ፡ ውስተ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፡ 2 Esr. 17,3; c. እንተ፡ ውስተ፡, ut: ዖዳ፡ እንተ፡ ውስተ፡ ቈላት፡ ἐκύκλωσαν τὴν φάραγγα Judith 13,10; c. Acc. loci: Koh. 12,5; Cant. 3,2; Gen. 2,13; Jos. 6,3; ዑዲ፡ ሀገረ፡ Jes. 23,16 vers. nov.; የዐውድ፡ ምሥዋዐ፡ Kuf. 16; ዖድኩ፡ ባሕቲትየ፡ አጽናፈ፡ ምድር፡ (γῦρον οὐρανοῦ ἐκύκλωσα μόνη) Sir. 24,5. a circumire locum, ad eum vitandum, Num. 21,4; Deut. 2,1; Deut. 2,3 (ዐዊዶት፡). b obire i.e. peragrare: Job 1,7; Gen. 12,6; እለ፡ ፈነወ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ይዑድዋ፡ ለምድር፡ Zach. 1,10; c. እንተ፡ Matth. 12,43. c circumvagari: ሰራሕኪ፡ በዐዊድ፡ ταῖς πολυοδίαις Jes. 57,10; c. Acc. ( per ) 1 Tim. 5,13 Platt. d circumcurrere: (አምጣኒሃ፡) የዐውድ፡ ጥቅማ፡ Jes. 38,39; አምጣን፡ ዘየዐውዶ፡ ( circuitus, circumferentia, linea circumcurrens ) 3 Reg. 7,3; Jer. 52,21 vers. nov. e ambire, i.e. quaerere, 1 Petr. 1,10. 3 cingere, circumdari ( circumstare, circumvenire, circumsedere ), c. Acc.: ዖድዋ፡ περιεκύκλωσαν αὐτήν Judith 13,13; Ps. 88,9; Ps. 124,2; 2 Par. 4,3; ዑዳ፡ περιχαράκωσον αὐτήν Prov. 4,8; ዖዶ፡ ለስነኒሁ፡ ግርማ፡ Job 41,5; Hen. 71,6; Hen. 14,9; Hen. 24,3; በሓውርት፡ ዘየዐውድዎሙ፡ Sx. Mag. 20. 4 Componitur cum aliis verbis ad significandum circum-, ut: ይዑዱ፡ ይትቀፈሉ፡ κύκλῳ κατηργυρωμέναι Ex. 27,17.

woorden.betekenis: circumdatus, cingens, stipatus
woorden.definitie: vel ዕውድ፡ part. circumdatus: ዕዉድ፡ በወርቅ፡ ወእሱር፡ በወርቅ፡ Ex. 36,20; ዕዉድ፡ በሜላት፡ ውስተ፡ አሕባለ፡ ቢስንሶ፡ Esth. 1,6. a cingens: ይኩን፡ ቀሚስ፡ ስፉየ፡ ወዕዉድ፡ et መዛርዐ፡ ቀሚስ፡ ይኩኑ፡ ዕውዳነ፡ F.M. 31,5 (vid. sub መንዲል፡ col. 195). b stipatus: ፈቃድ፡ ዕውድ፡ በምግባር፡ (opp. voluntate vana vel inani) Chrys. Ta. 16.

woorden.betekenis: circuitio, circuitus, circulus, orbis, ambitus, circulatio,
woorden.definitie: n. act., Pl. ዑደታት፡, circuitio, circuitus, circulus, Koh. 1,6. a orbis, ambitus, circulatio, siderum: ዑደተ፡ ከዋክብት፡ Sap. 13,2; ዘእንበለ፡ ይግበር፡ ዑደታተ፡ ከዋክብት፡ ለአዝማን፡ Macc. f. 23; Ssal. Req.; ዑደተ፡ ፀሓይ፡ Abush. 37; annorum: ዑደተ፡ ዓመታት፡ Sap. 7,19; ዑደታተ፡ ኢዮቤል፡ M.M. f. 242. b processio, pompa in orbem facta (Umzug): ዑደተ፡ የማን፡ (תַּהֲלֻכֹת לַיָּמִין) 2 Esr. 22,31 vers. nov.; ዑደተ፡ ሆሳዕና፡ Lud. e Lit. c peragratio (in orbem facta, Rundreise) በዑደተ፡ ገዳማተ፡ ትግሬ፡ Gad. T.H.

woorden.betekenis: volatus, alites, animalia volucria, aves, ales, animal voluc
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., coll. et Sing., Pl. አዕዋፍ፡, Pl. Pl. አዕዋፋት፡ [עוֹף (ܥܰܘܦܳܐ); de etymo vid. Ges. thes. p. 1002] 1 volatus: እጕለ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ ያሌዕሉ፡ ዖፈ፡ νεοσσοὶ γυπὸς τὰ ὑψηλὰ πέτονται Job 5,7. 2 alites, animalia volucriacujusvis generis, in specie aves, deinde ales, animal volucre, avis, coll.: Gen. 1,21; ዖፍ፡ ዘይሰርር፡ ὄρνεα πετόμενα Jes. 31,5; Koh. 10,20; Prov. 9,12; Apoc. 18,2; Sing.: ከመ፡ ዖፍ፡ እንተ፡ ታመሥጠከ፡ እምእዴከ፡ Sir. 27,19; Job 28,7; Jes. 16,2 (fem.); እጼውዖ፡ ለዖፍ፡ እምጽባሕ፡ Jes. 46,11; ὄρνεον Am. 3,5; Prov. 6,5; στρουθίον (passer) Thren. 3,51; Thren. 4,3; Ps. 83,3 (fem.); Did. 6(vid. sub ሐቀፈ፡); Pl. Gen. 1,20; Gen. 1,30; Gen. 7,3; Gen. 15,10; Gen. 15,11; Lev. 1,14; ዘወገሮን፡ ለአዕዋፍ፡ Sir. 22,20; እምኵሉ፡ አዕዐፍ፡ ትንእስ፡ ንህብ፡ Sir. 11,3; አዕዋፍ፡ ምስለ፡ ዘመዱ፡ የኀድር፡ Sir. 27,9; Sir. 43,17; አዕዋፈ፡ ሰማይ፡ Jer. 7,33; Matth. 6,26; Matth. 8,20; Matth. 13,32; στρουθία Tob. 2,10; Jer. 8,7; Jer. 10,22; Matth. 10,29; στρουθοί Jer. 30,11; ቢጾን፡ ለአዕዋፍ፡ Job 30,29; አጕለ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ Jes. 43,20; Pl. Pl. Sir. 17,4; Gen. 8,19; Apoc. 19,17 rom. – ዖፍ፡ ባሕታዊ፡ στρουθίον μονάζον Ps. 101,8 in Voc. Ae. exponitur ጉጉት፡ – ዖፈ፡ መስቀል፡ sec. Lud. „avis, quae circa festum Crucis mense Septembri Aethiopiam frequentat“, sec. Isenberg p. 25„a certain red and beautiful bird“, vid. scholion ad ኢብን፡ – ዖፈ፡ ያሬድ፡ upupa, Lud. auct. Greg. (vid. Lud. lex. col. 381 sub ኤጶጳ፡). – Quatenus ዖፍ፡ significat ales, alatus, etiam angelis attribuitur, ut: ሚካኤል፡ ዖፍ፡ Sx. Genb. 25Enc.; አዕዋፈ፡ ገነተ፡ ሰማይ፡ dicuntur Patres beati, Lud. ex Enc. Patr. ʿof C for ተመርሖ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ vid. ተመርሖ፡

woorden.betekenis: puteus, cisterna, fovea, lacus, lacuna, aliud
woorden.definitie: subst., fem. et m., Pl. ዐዘቃት፡ et ዐዘቅታት፡ 1 puteus, cisterna, Kuf. 16; Kuf. 24; φρέαρ Gen. 16,14; Gen. 21,19; Gen. 29,2; Prov. 5,15; Jer. 14,3; Ps. 68,19; Luc. 14,5; Joh. 4,11; Joh. 4,12; λάκκος Gen. 37,24; Ps. 87,4; Ps. 87,6; Koh. 12,6; 2 Reg. 17,18; 2 Reg. 17,19; 2 Reg. 23,15; 2 Reg. 23,16; ዐዘቅት፡ ዘውቅሮ፡ Dan. 6,11; 2 Esr. 19,25; ቤተ፡ ዐዘቅት፡ οἰκία τοῦ λάκκου Jer. 44,16; πηγή Cant. 4,12; Prov. 5,16; Prov. 5,18; ከመ፡ ዐዘቅት፡ ዘኢይንፅፍ፡ ማዩ፡ Jes. 58,11; Joh. 4,6; ዐዘቅት፡ ንፅፍት፡ 2 Petr. 2,17; καταράκτης Jer. 20,2 seq.; ዐዘቃት፡ Gen. 26,15; Lev. 11,36; Num. 24,17; Jes. 51,1; Judith 8,31; Prov. 4,21; ዐዘቅታት፡ 1 Reg. 13,6; Jes. 36,16 var. 2 fovea vel lacus, ዐዘቅተ፡ (v. ግበ፡) ዐናብስት፡ Dan. 6,7 seq.; ዐዘቅተ፡ እሳት፡ λίμνη πυρός Apoc. 19,20; Apoc. 20,10. 3 lacuna lacunaris: ዐዘቅታተ፡ ጠፈር፡ χῶραι 3 Reg. 7,41; 3 Reg. 7,42; Spiritus S. descendit sicut columba ወእሳት፡ ተደብተረ፡ ውስተ፡ ዐዘቃተ፡ ጠፈራ፡ ለቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ M.M. f. 66. – Voc. Ae.: ዐዘቅት፡ ዘ፡ የተመሐስ፡ ወኸ፡; aliud: ዘ፡ የወሀ፡ ጉድጓድ።

woorden.betekenis: peragravit, pauper, fuit, circumerrare, per, errare, oberrar
woorden.definitie: I,1 et ዐየለ፡ I,2 (quamquam equidem Perf. nonnisi ዔለ፡ inveni), Subj. I,1 ይዒል፡ [عال (عَيْلٌ) peragravit regionem; pauper (proprie: vagus, bonis expulsus) fuit ] circumerrare, per errare, oberrare, palari, vagari, pervagari, vagum et profugum esse, de bestiis Job 38,41; Job 39,8; de hominibus (in specie de iis qui domo emigrarunt, ex hominum commercio vel in desertum secesserunt): በውስተ፡ በድው፡ ኀበ፡ ዔልክሙ፡ በበ፡ መራዕይክሙ፡ Hos. 13,5; Hos. 13,6; Hebr. 11,37; 4 Esr. 6,54; 4 Esr. 6,66; c. እምነ፡ viae ( aberrare ): ወኢየዐይሉ፡ እምኔሃ፡ (ለፍኖት፡) Jer. 38,9; vel c. ውስተ፡ viae: ኢትኅድገኒ፡ እዒል፡ ውስተ፡ ፍኖት፡ Sx. Sen. 4; c. Acc. loci: ዔልኩ፡ ገዳመ፡ Herm. p. 20; እንዘ፡ ይዔይል፡ አድባረ፡ ወአውግረ፡ Sx. Tachs. 10et Sx. Mij. 6; c. ውስተ፡ loci: የዐይል፡ (v. ይዔይል፡) ውስተ፡ ገዳም፡ ይትረዐይ፡ Job 39,8; Ps. 10,1; ዔሉ፡ ውስተ፡ ገዳም፡ Jes. 16,8; የዐይሉ፡ ውስተ፡ አድባር፡ Jes. 22,5; Gen. 34,15; Hebr. 11,34; de anachoretis: አበው፡ ቅዱሳን፡ እለ፡ ዔሉ፡ ውስተ፡ አድባር፡ ወበአታት፡ Genz. f. 69; Org.; Sx. Masc. 2Enc.; ንዒል፡ ውስተ፡ አድባር፡ ወበአታት፡ ወግበበ፡ ምድር፡ Deg.; de animo: የዐይል፡ እንተ፡ ኵለሄ፡ Lit. 172,1; de inanimatis: ከመ፡ ኢይርከብ፡ ቂም፡ መካነ፡ በውስቴትነ፡ አላ፡ ይዒል፡ ውስተመካነ፡ በድው፡ Chrys. Ta. 19; transl.: ውስተ፡ ኀልዮ፡ ኀጢአት፡ ከመ፡ ኢይዒል፡ Ssal. Req. – Voc. Ae.: ዔለ፡ ዘ፡ ዞረ።

woorden.betekenis: caula
woorden.definitie: caula vid. sub ምእያም፡ col. 795.

woorden.betekenis: probro afficere, exprobrare, conviciari, improperare
woorden.definitie: III,2 (etiam III,3 si quidem Jac. 1,5 rom. lectio sana est) probro afficere, exprobrare, conviciari, ὀνειδίζειν, c. Acc. pers.: Jes. 37,4; Jes. 37,23; እንዘ፡ ይትዔየሮ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ 2 Par. 32,17; Tob. 3,7; Ps. 68,12; Ps. 73,19; Ps. 78,13; Rom. 15,3; c. በ፡ vel በእንተ፡ causae: Jud. 8,15; 1 Petr. 4,14; abs.: clericus ኢይትዐየር፡ እንዘ፡ ይብል፡ ኦዕዉር፡ ኦጽሙም፡ ኦሕጹጽ፡ ኦገብር፡ ኦፀጋማዊ፡ ኦሀካይ፡ ወዘተርፉ፡ ትዕይርታተ፡ F.N. 9. a improperare, exprobrare alicui beneficia, Jac. 1,5. b ዘይትዔየር፡ በክብረ፡ ርእሱ፡ „qui superbit gloria sui ipsius cum aliorum injuria et contemtu“ Lud. ex Org. 3.

woorden.betekenis: probrum, convicium, opprobrium, exprobratio, insultationes,
woorden.definitie: subst., Pl. ትዕይርታት፡ probrum, convicium, opprobrium, exprobratio, ὄνειδος, ὀνειδισμός 4 Esr. 10,43; Tob. 3,4; ትዕይርተ፡ ይከውኖ፡ Tob. 3,10; Tob. 3,13; Judith 9,2; 2 Par. 32,20; Ps. 68,12; Ps. 78,13; Rom. 15,3; Hebr. 11,26; Hebr. 13,13; ትዕይርታት፡ F.N. 9 (vid. sub ተዐየረ፡); ἀπειλαί ( insultationes, minae ) Act. 4,29 rom.

woorden.betekenis: vigil, custos
woorden.definitie: n. peregr. sc. εἴρ עִיר vigil, custos, epitheton angelorum Dan. 4,10.

woorden.betekenis: oculus, oculo ad oculum, sub oculo, coram, oculus aeger, inv
woorden.definitie: subst., fem. et m., Pl. አዕይንት፡ [עַיִן ܥܻܝܢ ܥܰܝܢܳܐ عَيْنٌ] 1 oculus, Ex. 21,24; fem. Job 7,7; Job 13,1; Job 16,20; Job 29,11; Sir. 16,5; Matth. 5,29; m. Koh. 1,8; Koh. 4,8; Matth. 6,22; Matth. 6,23; Matth. 20,15; Luc. 11,34; (ad sensum) Job 24,15; Sir. 14,9; Sir. 14,10; Sir. 23,19 al.; በፍሡሕ፡ ዐይን፡ Sir. 32,10; በሠናይ፡ ዐይን፡ Sir. 32,12; ከመ፡ እኩይ፡ ዐይነ፡ ሰብእ፡ Sir. 34,13; አዕይንቲሃ፡ ድኩም፡ Kuf. 28; 1 Reg. 16,12; ትደዊ፡ አዕይንቲሃ፡ Gen. 29,17; ሚጥ፡ ዐይነከ፡ እምነ፡ ብእሲት፡ ሠናይት፡ Sir. 9,8; Sir. 4,1; ይኔጽራ፡ አዕይንቲሁ፡ Jes. 17,7; ተሀይዳ፡ አዕይንቲሁ፡ Judith 16,9; ከደኑ፡ አዕይንቲሆሙ፡ Matth. 13,15; ከሠተት፡ አዕይንቲሃ፡ Kuf. 17; ፈትሐ፡ አዕይንቲሃ፡ Gen. 21,19; አንሥኡ፡ አዕይንቲሆሙ፡ Matth. 17,8; አልዐለ፡ አዕይንቲሁ፡ Gen. 13,10; ከብዱ፡ አዕይንቲሁ፡ 1 Reg. 3,2; ታነብዕ፡ ዐይንየ፡ Jer. 13,17; ተሀውከት፡ ዐይንየ፡ Ps. 30,11; ይቀጽብ፡ በዐይን፡ Prov. 6,13; ቅድመ፡ አዕይንቲከ፡ 2 Reg. 11,25. a ዐይነ፡ በዐይን፡ oculo ad oculum: ይትራአዩ፡ ዐይነ፡ በዐይን፡ Jer. 39,4; Jes. 52,8; Num. 14,14. b ለዐይነ፡ sub oculo alicujus i.e. coramaliquo: ለዐይንከ፡ Sir. 27,23; Matth. 6,1 Platt; Matth. 22,5; Luc. 16,15 (coll. አዕይንቲከ፡ ለአዕይንቲሁ፡ ይሬእያ፡ Jer. 41,3); Sx. Haml. 7Enc. c ዐይን፡ ሕሙም፡ vel ሐማሚ፡ oculus aegervel invidus Luc. 11,34 rom.; Matth. 20,15; eundem sensum habet ያአኪ፡ ላዕሌከ፡ ዐይኖ፡ invidebit tibi Deut. 15,9; በዐይን፡ እኪት፡ ἀναιδεῖ ὀφθαλμῷ 1 Reg. 2,29; ዐይን፡ ዕቡይ፡ oculus superbus Prov. 24,36; ዕቡየ፡ ዐይን፡ Ps. 100,7; ዘይሬእዮሙ፡ ለሕዝብ፡ በዐይን፡ ሕጽጽት፡ qui homines(oculo vel obtutu exiguo intuetur i.e.) ut multum infra despectatF.N. 5. d ሰብአ፡ ዐይን፡ vel (omisso ሰብእ፡) ዘዐይን፡ (2 Reg. 13,34) homo vel homines oculorum i.e. α explorator, e xploratore s, speculator, speculator es, σκοπός, σκοποί, κατάσκοπος, κατάσκοποι, Gen. 42,9; Num. 13,2 seq.; Kuf. 42; Jos. 2,1 seq.; 1 Reg. 26,4 var.; Kuf. 42; Jer. 6,17; Hez. 33,6; Judith 7,7; Sir. 11,30; Sir. 37,14; Phil. 3,14; Jac. 2,25; τερατοσκόποι Zach. 3,8. β custos vel inspector(ἐπίσκοπος), ex. gr. beneficii testamento legati, F.N. 18. e Etiam ዐይን፡ oculusvel አዕይንት፡ oculi (sicut عَيْنٌ) dicitur α speculator, explorator 1 Reg. 26,4; 2 Reg. 10,3. β insidiator, ἐπίβουλος, 1 Reg. 29,4. f ብንተ፡ ዐይን፡ pupilla oculi vid. sub ብንት፡ col. . g ቅጽበተ፡ ዐይን፡ nutus oculii.e. momentumtemporis vid. sub ቅጽበተ፡ col. . 2 Varie transfertur oculus: a examenbilancis (cfr. عَيْنٌ): ከመ፡ እንተ፡ ታገብእ፡ ዐይነ፡ መዳልው፡ እሙንቱ፡ ὡς ῥοπὴ ζυγοῦ Jes. 40,15; 4 Esr. 1,35. b speciesvel imago insculpta, sculptura sigilli: ዐይነ፡ ማኅተም፡ γλύμμα σφραγῖδος Ex. 28,11; Ex. 28,21; Sir. 38,27; Sir. 45,11. c dubius est sensus vocis ዐይን፡ Ex. 36,31, ubi Gr. ὤα habet (an circulusoculo similis?). d in libris ex Arabico translatis ዐይን፡ seq. Gen. significat ipseille (sicut عَيْنٌ), ut: እመ፡ ኢተረክበ፡ ዐይኑ፡ (sc. rei furto ablatae) ያገብእ፡ አምሳሊሁ፡ F.N. 35 aliud exemplum vid. sub ሕስት፡ col. 891. e ዐይነ፡ ወርቅ፡ oculus vel species auri i.e. icterus(morbus regiusq.d.), Lud. 3 fons, Ex. 15,27; Jac. 3,11; Deus አቀመ፡ አዕይንቲሁ፡ ለተከዚ፡ 4 Esr. 13,46 et Deg.; fortasse Hen. 21,7; transl.: ተመክሮ፡ ዐይነ፡ ተመርሖ፡ ውእቱ፡ Fal. f. 55. – Eodem referendum est ዐይነ፡ ምድር፡ oculus terrae i.e. cavumut talpae, mustelae, Lud. auct. Greg. (cfr. etiam Isenberg lex. amh. sub ዐይን፡). ʿayn C a for ምኡከ፡ ዐይን፡ vid. ምኡክ፡ (Leslau) b for ቀልደደ፡ ዐይን፡ vid. ቀልደድ፡

woorden.betekenis: intente intueri, speculari
woorden.definitie: III,2 intente intueri, speculari, c. Acc.: ወእምዝ፡ ኮነ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ፈተና፡ ሰይጣን፡ እንዘ፡ ይትዔየኖ፡ ዘልፈ፡ እመ፡ ይፈርህ፡ ወይጸንዕ፡ Gad. Kar.; በጽኑዕ፡ ይትዔየነኒ፡ Gad. Kar. – Voc. Ae.: ተዐየነ፡ ዘ፡ ጠበቀ፡

woorden.betekenis: castra, tentoria, tentorium, tabernaculum, vici, pagi, exerc
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. ትዕይንታት፡ et plerumque ተዓይን፡ (semel inveni ተዓይንት፡ Jes. 22,6 in cod. Laur.) 1 castra, tentoria, ut nomadum ita militum, παρεμβολή Gen. 32,22; Ex. 32,19; Ex. 32,26; Ex. 33,7; Ex. 33,11; Lev. 14,8; Num. 4,5; Num. 4,15; 1 Reg. 4,3 seq.; 4 Reg. 7,4 seq.; Judith 12,7; Judith 14,19; Ps. 105,17; Apoc. 20,9; Pl. Gen. 32,3; 1 Reg. 17,1; 1 Reg. 28,1; ትዕይንታት፡ 1 Par. 9,18; σκηναί ትዕይንት፡ Num. 24,6. 2 tentorium, tabernaculum, Judith 5,22; Judith 12,9; 1 Par. 15,1; Ex. 25,9; 4 Reg. 7,8; Pl. a tentoria: ተዓይን፡ Num. 24,5; Ps. 86,1; Jer. 30,7; Judith 15,1; ትዕይንታት፡ 1 Par. 5,10. b castra 1 Reg. 28,5; Judith 13,10; Sir. 48,21; Jes. 8,8; Ps. 26,5. c vicivel paginomadum, ἐπαύλεις 1 Par. 4,33. 3 a exercitus, copiae: Ex. 14,19; Ex. 14,20; Jud. 8,10; 1 Reg. 17,46; 1 Reg. 28,19; 4 Reg. 7,6; ትዕይንታቲሆሙ፡ ለኢሎፍሊ፡ ተዐየኑ፡ 1 Par. 11,15; ተዓይንተ፡ (v. ትዕይንተ፡) ጸባኢት፡ Jes. 22,6; Hen. 1,4. b multitudo congregata, agmen, turba: ትዕይንቶሙ፡ለእለ፡ቆሬ፡ συναγωγή Sir. 45,18; Ps. 105,18; Num. 16,5; ተዓይነ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ብዙኅ፡ Hez. 26,7; Gen. 33,8; Gen. 50,9. c coetus, conventus, συναγωγή, populi Israelitarum Lev. 16,5; Lev. 19,2; Lev. 22,18; Num. 14,1; Num. 14,10; Num. 20,2; Num. 20,4; ተዓይነ፡ ክርስቶስ፡ coetus Christianorum, Sx. Enc.; ትዕይንቱ፡ ለሆር፡ i.e. socii Hori, Sx. Haml. 12Enc.; በውስተ፡ ትዕይንትከ፡ ἐν τῇ συνεδρείᾳ σου (consessus, concilium) Judith 11,9. d chorus, Chrys. ho. 34(vid. sub ቃና፡ col. 447). – Voc. Ae.: ትዕይንት፡ ዘ፡ ከተማ፡ v. መከማቻ፡ tǝʿyǝnt, Pl. tǝʿyǝntāt, taʿāyǝn tabernacle ወበይእቲ፡ ዕለት፡ {...}፡ ወፅአት፡ እምት ዕይንት፡ ታቦት፡ ዘስምይት፡ በስመ፡ ተድባበ፡ ማርያም፡ ‘In that day, the Tabot called in the name of Tädbabä Maryam came out from the tabernacle’ 58 § 109 (ed.), 33 § 109 (tr.) L ትዕይንት tǝʿyyǝnt (pl. tǝʿyyǝntāt, taʿāyǝn) tabernacle, tent 80a

woorden.betekenis: î, continuationem, iterationem, adhuc, etiamnum, etiamtum, a
woorden.definitie: adv. [ut videtur, primitus Adj. (gramm. § 163,2), terminationeî formatum ex ዓድ፡ i.e. עוֹד, quod proprie continuationemet iterationemsignificans in Adv. abiit; de radice ejusque significationibus vid. supra ዖደ፡] 1 ratione habita temporis praeteriti: adhuc, etiamnum(etiamtum), Gen. 43,27; Ps. 77,34; Ps. 138,17; ዓዲ፡ ብየ፡ ነገር፡ ኀቤየ፡ Job 36,2; plerumque cum pronominibus suffixis ad Subjectum enunciationis relatis: ዓዲሆሙ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ይሠረዉ፡ ἔτι ὁ λαὸς κατεφθείρετο 2 Par. 27,2; እንዘ፡ ዓዲነ፡ ሕያዋን፡ ንሕነ፡ Thren. 4,17; እደ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዓዲሃ፡ ልዕልት፡ Jes. 5,28; ወልድየ፡ ዓዲሁ፡ ደቂቅ፡ ውእቱ፡ 1 Par. 22,5; ዓዲየ፡ ጽኑዕ፡ አነ፡ Jos. 14,11; Gen. 18,12; Gen. 43,28; Gen. 44,14; Gen. 45,3; Ex. 4,18; Lev. 18,18; Lev. 18,19; Jud. 6,24; Jud. 19,11; 1 Reg. 13,7; Jes. 29,8; Act. 9,1. a cum particula negativa: adhuc non, nondum, መዋዕል፡ እለ፡ ዓዲ፡ ኢበጽሐ፡ Jes. 7,17; ዓዲ፡ ኢኀልቀ፡ ዕድሜሁ፡ Dan. 8,17; 4 Esr. 4,42; 1 Reg. 3,3; 1 Reg. 3,7; Koh. 4,13; Joh. 7,8; Matth. 16,9; vel c. pron. suff.: ዓዲየ፡ ኢነሣእኩ፡ Phil. 3,13; Rom. 5,13; Hebr. 9,8; Hen. 89,25. b nonnumquam ዓዲ፡ pronomine (neutr.) suff. ሁ፡ augetur: ዓዲሁ፡ ኢትሌብዉኑ፡ adhuc non intelligitisne? Matth. 16,9 (aliter 15,16 ubi ሁ፡ nota interrog. est); እስከ፡ ዓዲሁ፡ ኢ፡ usque adhuc noni.e. nondum Chrys. ho. 4. 2 ratione habita temporis futuri: adhuc, porro, amplius, diutius: ተዐገሡ፡ ዓዲ፡ ኀሙሰ፡ መዋዕለ፡ Judith 8,30; ተዐገሠኒ፡ ዓዲ፡ ኅዳጠ፡ Job 36,2; Gen. 7,4; ዓዲ፡ ኅዳጥ፡ ወይቈርር፡ Jes. 10,25; ዓዲ፡ ኅዳጠ፡ Jes. 28,10; Ps. 36,10; ዓዲ፡ እስከ፡ ፲ወ፭ ዓመት፡ ትጠፍእ፡ መንግሥት፡ Jes. 7,8; እፎ፡ ዓዲ፡ (v. እንከ፡) ትቈስሉ፡ Jes. 1,5; ዓዲ፡ እረድአከ፡ Jes. 44,2; Jes. 54,3; Jer. 2,9; Jer. 39,15; Jer. 39,43; 2 Reg. 6,22; እንከ፡ ዓዲ፡ Jes. 5,4. a cum negatione pro ዓዲ፡ ኢ፡ frequentant ኢ፡ እንከ፡ b nonnumquam iterum, rursus(noch einmal), Gen. 29,35; Gen. 30,7; Gen. 37,9; Gen. 38,4; Gen. 38,5. 3 de accessione rei alicujus ad aliquid: adhuc, praeterea, insuper, etiam: ወወለደት፡ ዓዲ፡ ፱ ደቂቀ፡ Kuf. 4; ይዌስክ፡ ዓዲ፡ ዲቤሁ፡ Sir. 21,15; Gen. 2,19; 1 Reg. 2,21; Ex. 5,8; Ex. 11,1; 2 Cor. 8,22 Platt; εἶτα Sap. 14,22; οὐ μόνον δὲ ἀλλὰ καί 2 Cor. 8,19; ፶ ዕደው፡ ወዓዲ፡ አንስት፡ Sx. Genb. 14Enc.; crebro ወዓዲ፡ Sir. 39,12; Koh. 4,17; Ps. 8,7; Asc. Jes. 8,1; Gen. 30,15; Hebr. 7,15; 1 Tim. 5,13; F.N. 15. a seq. ሂ፡ vel ኒ፡, etiam, adeo (sogar): ወዓዲ፡ ኪያሁኒ፡ ይመስለከ፡ ከመ፡ ዘበዲበ፡ ምድር፡ ረከብከ፡ Sir. 29,6; Phil. 4,16; Ps. 15,7; Act. 21,28. b tamen(noch immer): Luc. 14,22; ወዓዲ፡ ኢ፡ Jes. 57,10. c imo, imo vero, potius (vielmehr): ኢታጠነቅቁ፡ ፈጽሞ፤ ዓዲ፡ የዐቢ፡ እምኵሉ፡ ዝንቱ፡ Sir. 43,30; Eph. 5,11 rom.; Herm. p. 104 b; አላ፡ ዓዲ፡ Matth. 18,22; ዘእንበለ፡ ዓዲ፡ Matth. 27,24. d in specie post non tantum usitatur ዓዲ፡ sed etiam, sive ዓዲ፡ simplex, ut Matth. 21,21; Phil. 2,12; 1 Thess. 1,8; 2 Cor. 7,7; 2 Cor. 9,12, sive ዓዲ፡ – ኒ፡ vel ሂ፡ vel ወዓዲ፡ – ኒ፡ Phil. 2,27; 1 Thess. 1,5; 1 Thess. 2,8; Joh. 13,9; Rom. 4,12 sive አላ፡ ዓዲ፡ Act. 26,29; Phil. 1,29; vel ዳእሙ፡ ዓዲ፡ Joh. 5,18 (vid. ባሕቲት፡ et ዳእሙ፡ et ክመ፡). – Voc. Ae.: ዓዲ፡ ዘ፡ አሁን።

woorden.betekenis: rubere, placere
woorden.definitie: rubere et ዐደመ፡ placere vid. sub አደመ፡ col. 799; col. 800.

woorden.betekenis: tempus constitutum, condictum, praefinitum, finis, dies fest
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., Pl. ዕድሜያት፡, tempus constitutum vel condictum, praefinitum, 2 Reg. 20,5; 4 Esr. 4,14; 4 Esr. 8,71; 4 Esr. 9,1; 4 Esr. 9,5; ሄሮድያኖስ፡ ያአምር፡ ዕድሜሁ፡ Jer. 8,7; 1 Thess. 5,1; በዕድሜሁ፡ Sir. 39,16; Rom. 5,6; Luc. 1,20; እስከ፡ ዕድሜሆሙ፡ Dan. 7,12; በመዋዕለ፡ ዕድሜሁ፡ Jes. 30,8; Tob. 10,1; በዕድሜ፡ መዋዕሊሁ፡ εἰς χρόνον τακτόν Job 12,5; አኮ፡ ለዕድሜ፡ መዋዕል፡ Org.; በበ፡ ዕድሜሁ፡ Jer. 5,24; Jes. 60,22; በጽሐ፡ ዕድሜሁ፡ Dan. 7,22; Jer. 27,26; Ps. 101,14; Jes. 8,22; ወሀብክዎ፡ ዕድሜ፡ 2 Esr. 12,6; Ex. 9,5; Job 14,5; ለጽልመት፡ አዘዘ፡ ዕድሜሁ፡ Job 28,3; አዝዝ፡ ዕድሜከ፡ στῆσον τὸν ὁρισμόν Dan. 6,8; ዐቀሙ፡ ዕድሜ፡ መዋዕል፡ Act. 28,23 rom.; ኢኀልቀ፡ ዕድሜሁ፡ ለራእይ፡ Dan. 8,19; ያነውኅ፡ ለከ፡ ዕድሜከ፡ et ያስተኀልፍ፡ ዕድሜሁ፡ Sir. 29,5; ወርኅ፡ ዕድሜሁ፡ ውእቱ፡ ለኵሉ፡ Sir. 43,6; ዕድሜ፡ ሐዘን፡ (tempus luctus constitutum) F.N. 24,2. a finis, πέρας Hez. 7,2; Hez. 7,6. b ዕድሜያት፡ dies festi (מוֹעֲדִים) Hez. 46,11 vers. nov.

woorden.betekenis: validum, robustum, fortem esse, robur
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., quae significasse videtur validum, robustum, fortem esse, coll. أَادَ (أَيْدٌ), أَدٌّ vel أُدٌّ robur, nec non أَدَا et أَدَى.

woorden.betekenis: transire, transgredi, transscendere, transilire, pertransire
woorden.definitie: (ተዐድወ፡ Jer. 41,18 var.) III,1 1 transire, transgredi, transscendere, transilire: እትዐደዋ፡ ለአረፍት፡ Ps. 17,32; gradum 1 Reg. 5,5; fluvium Kuf. p. 106; ዘይትዐዶ፡ ወሰነ፡ Hos. 5,10; aliquem: ድነኒ፡ ወንትዐደውኪ፡ Jes. 51,23; Kuf. p. 106. a pertransire: ጸሎተ፡ ነዳይ፡ ትትዐዶ፡ እምደመና፡ νεφέλας διῆλθε Sir. 32,21. b litora transire, redundare, de mari: ኢትትዐደዊ፡ እምወሰንኪ፡ Job 38,11; ኢይትዐደው፡ Jer. 5,22. c superare ( übertreffen ): ተዐደውኪ፡ ኵሎን፡ ὑπερῆρας πάσας Prov. 29,47; ንጹሕ፡ ዘንጽሐ፡ ሐሊብ፡ ይትዐዶ፡ Sx. Ter 15 Enc. (Lud.: 16); ዘስብሐቲሁ፡ ይትዐደው፡ እምኵሉ፡ Asc. Jes. 9,27. d transgredi vel superare vivendo annum ( überleben, überschreiten ): ኢይትዐደው፡ ዘንተ፡ ዓመተ፡ በሕይወት፡ Kuf. 35; ዘተዐደወ፡ ፴ ዓመተ፡ F.N. 5. e transgredi, migrare terminum statutum, leges, praecepta al.; c.c. እምነ፡, ut: ተዐደዉ፡ ኃጥኣን፡ እምወሰኖሙ፡ Job 24,2; ተዐደዉ፡ እምፍኖቱ፡ Kuf. 5; Kuf. 20; Hen. 2,1; ዘተዐደወ፡ እምሥርዐትነ፡ Clem. f. 204; c. Acc.: Matth. 15,2; Num. 14,41; Num. 24,13; እለ፡ ተዐደዉ፡ ኪዳንየ፡ Jer. 41,18; abs.: Hen. 5,4. f inique tractare, injuriam facere, offendere ( sich vergehen an einem ), c. Acc. pers.: καταδικάζειν Jac. 5,6; c. ላዕለ፡ pers., ut: እመቦ፡ ዘተዐደወ፡ ላዕለ፡ ንጉሥ፡ እመኒ፡ በቃል፡ ወእመኒ፡ በምግባር፡ Clem. f. 251. 2 praeterire, praetergredi, Ex. 23,5; Kuf. 49; c. Acc.: Ex. 12,23; Deut. 2,8; Job 9,11. a impune transmittere, remittere peccatum, παραβιβάζειν 2 Reg. 12,13; ይትዐዶ፡ አበሳሆሙ፡ ὑπερβαίνειν Mich. 7,18; Lit. Epiph.; Lud. ex Sx. Nah. 22 Enc. b currendo praetergredi i.e. antevenire aliquem, 2 Reg. 18,23.

woorden.betekenis: transitus, bivium
woorden.definitie: vel ዕዶ፡ subst., ut videtur transitus; nonnisi in Pl. ዕደዋት፡ τὸ ἄμφοδον bivium (sec. Lud.) Marc. 11,4 repertum.

woorden.betekenis: proles
woorden.definitie: proles vid. sub እጓል፡

woorden.betekenis: quidam
woorden.definitie: quidam vid. sub እገሌ፡

woorden.betekenis: fraudatio, defraudatio, lucrum iniquum, lucri iniqui cupidit
woorden.definitie: subst., fem. et m., 1 fraudatio, defraudatio, lucrum iniquum, lucri iniqui cupiditas, avaritia, συκοφαντία Ps. 118,134; Koh. 4,1; Koh. 5,7; Koh. 7,7; ወይነ፡ ትዕግልት፡ Am. 2,8; πλεονεξία Jer. 22,17; Ps. 118,36; ዘይትዔገል፡ ትዕግልተ፡ እኩየ፡ Hab. 2,9; Rom. 1,29; Eph. 5,3; 2 Petr. 2,14; Luc. 12,15; Marc. 7,22; በትዕግልት፡ Jud. 5,19; Org. 1. 2 oppressio, violentia, injuria, exactio violenta, καταδυναστεία: ኵሉ፡ ትዕግልት፡ ውስቴታ፡ Jer. 6,6; Am. 3,9; Hez. 22,12; ἀδικία Ps. 71,14; βία 2 Esr. 5,18; F.N. 35.

woorden.betekenis: retinuit, remoratus est, continenter petiit et prosecutus es
woorden.definitie: (etiam ዐገሰ፡) rad. inus., عَجَسَ retinuit, remoratus est; V continenter petiit et prosecutus est rem, continenter decidit pluvia (anhalten).

woorden.betekenis: se continere, abstinere, continentia, abstinentia, se tenere
woorden.definitie: III,2 1 se continere, abstinere, abs.: ለእመ፡ ኢይክላ፡ ተዐግሦ፡ εἰ οὐκ ἐγκρατεύονται 1 Cor. 7,9; 1 Cor. 9,25; ዘይኄሊ፡ ከመ፡ ይትዐገሥ፡ Clem. f. 118; ደናግል፡ ወመዓስብ፡ ይትዔገሣ፡ ወእመሰ፡ ኢክህላ፡ ተዐግሦ፡ ለያውስባ፡ Clem. f. 136; ተዐግሦ፡ continentia, abstinentia Did. 14; c. እምነ፡ rei: ተዐገሥ፡ እምፍትወተ፡ እኩይ፡ ἀπὸ τῶν ὀρέξεών σου κωλύου Sir. 18,30; ἐγκρατεύεσθαι ἐπί τινος Herm. p. 35 seq. a se tenere vel continere (vim sibi facere): ተዐጊሦ፡ Gen. 43,31; Gen. 45,1; Kuf. 43; እትዔገሥ፡ ἀνέξομαι Jes. 42,14. b seq. Acc. vel በ፡ affectus, membri: continere, cohibere, ut: ተዐገሣ፡ ለመዐት፡ Sir. 1,23; ዘኢይትዔገሥ፡ በከናፍሪሁ፡ ἄστεγος χείλεσιν Prov. 10,8. 2 perdurare, perseverare, constantem esse: ተዐገሥ፡ καρτέρησον Sir. 2,2; Job 2,9; ተዐገሥ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ διάμενε αὐτῷ Job 22,23; Job 6,8; Job 12,15; Hen. 5,4; ተዐገሡ፡ ዓዲ፡ ኀሙሰ፡ መዋዕለ፡ διακαρτερήσωμεν Judith 7,30; አልቦ፡ ዘይትዔገሥ፡ ወይነብር፡ ለዝሉፉ፡ οὐκ ἔστιν ὑπομονή 1 Par. 29,15; c. በ፡ in re: እመ፡ ተዐገሡ፡ በሥርዐትየ፡ Jes. 56,4; Jes. 56,6; Rom. 2,7; c. Acc. pers. ( alicui vel cum aliquo): እለ፡ ይትዔገሡኒ፡ οἱ ἀντεχόμενοί μου Jes. 57,13. 3 manere, ( patienter ) exspectare: ተዐጊሦ፡ ἐπισχών Gen. 8,10; Gen. 8,12; ተዐገሥ፡ እንከ፡ እንግርከ፡ ἐπίσχες Job 18,2; Act. 12,15; c. Acc.: ተዐገሠኒ፡ στῆθι κατ’ ἐμέ Job 33,5; μεῖνόν με Job 36,2; እለ፡ ይትዔገሥዎ፡ οἱ ἐμμένοντες αὐτῷ Jes. 30,18; ὑπομένοντες αὐτόν Thren. 3,25; Ps. 36,9; Ps. 36,36; Ps. 144,9; ዘይትዔገሦ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ Sir. 28,1; c. በ፡ Ps. 129,5. a cunctari Hen. 93,3. b morari, differre: ቀኖና፡ ይቤ፡ ሶበ፡ ተወልደ፡ ሕፃን፡ ጥዑየ፡ ይትዐገሡ፡ አጥምቆቶ፡ F.M. 27,3; ይትዐገሥዎ፡ ለወልድ፡ (baptizandum) እስከ፡ ፵ ወለወለት፡ እስከ፡ ፹ መዋዕል፡ F.M. 27,2. 4 patientem ( longanimem ) esse, patienter ferre, tolerare: ይትዔገሥ፡ መንፈሱ፡ Kuf. 19; ὑπομένειν Job 6,11; Job 7,3; Job 14,14; μακροθυμεῖν Job 7,16; Sir. 2,4; Hebr. 6,15; Jac. 5,8; Lit. Orth.; c. ለ፡ rei: ለሕማምክሙ፡ ተዐገሡ፡ Rom. 12,12; Hebr. 12,7; c. ለ፡ pers.: Col. 3,13 rom.; c. Acc. pers.: ይትዔገሦሙ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ἐμακροθύμησεν ἐπ’ αὐτοῖς Sir. 18,11; ለነዳይ፡ ተዐገሦ፡ Sir. 29,8; 1 Thess. 5,14; Matth. 18,26; ἀνέχεσθαί τινος Matth. 17,17; Jes. 46,4; 4 Esr. 7,38; ተዐገሥኮሙ፡ ዓመታተ፡ ብዙኀ፡ εἵλκυσας ἐπ’ αὐτούς 2 Esr. 19,30. a sustinere rem molestam: 1 Thess. 3,1; Hen. 60,4; c. Acc. rei: መኑ፡ ይትዔገሣ፡ ለዕለተ፡ ምጽአቱ፡ Mal. 3,2; ተዐግሦት፡ Hen. 68,2; Hen. 90,41; c. በ፡ rei: ኢይክል፡ ተዐግሦ፡ በፍኖት፡ Kuf. 31. b perferre, sufferre, pati, perpeti dolores, mala, al.: 4 Esr. 5,18; 4 Esr. 6,63; 4 Esr. 6,70; Ps. 68,10; Ps. 119,6; Prov. 14,17; Hebr. 12,2; Hebr. 12,3; 1 Petr. 2,19; 1 Cor. 10,13; 2 Tim. 3,11; Jac. 1,12. taʿaggaśa verb ‘ bei sich behalten, bewahren (ein Geheimnis)’ xxxib Kebr. Nag. 53,7 57b l. 22 (ed.)

woorden.betekenis: abstinentia, continentia, temperantia, exspectatio, mora, co
woorden.definitie: subst., fem. et m., Pl. ትዕግሥታት፡ 1 abstinentia, continentia, temperantia, ἐγκράτεια Herm. p. 6; Herm. p. 15; እመቦን፡ ትዕግሥት፡ Did. 14; Clem. f. 118; ዘይገብር፡ ትዕግሥተ፡ Clem. f. 238. 2 exspectatio, mora, F.M. 27,2; ዕድሜ፡ ዘትዕግሥት፡ F.N. 40; (vid. Rom. 2,4; Rom. 3,26 ἀνοχή). 3 constantia, patientia, ( longanimitas ), tolerantia ὑπομονή Job 14,19; Sir. 16,13; Ps. 38,11; Jac. 1,3; Jac. 1,4; Apoc. 14,12; Rom. 5,3; Hebr. 6,12; Matth. 10,22; Luc. 21,19; 4 Esr. 5,37; 4 Esr. 7,30; 4 Esr. 9,12; ትዕግሥተ፡ መንፈስ፡ καρδία εὐγενείας αὐτοῦ Koh. 7,7; μακροθυμία Jes. 57,15; Prov. 25,15; Hebr. 6,12; Rom. 9,22; Gal. 5,22; 1 Tim. 1,16; ἀνοχή (Dei) Rom. 2,4; Rom. 3,26; በእንተ፡ ትዕግሥታተ፡ ነፍሳት፡ ናስተበቍዕ፡ ከመ፡ … Kid. f. 18; constantia martyris Sx. Hed. 4. (Job 34,7 ዘይሰትያ፡ ለትዕግሥት፡ ከመ፡ ማይ፡ πίνων μυκτηρισμὸν ὥσπερ ὕδωρ est locus corruptus, sive errore interpretis sive lectione mala).

woorden.betekenis: continens, abstinens, sibi temperans, patiens, longanimis
woorden.definitie: part. (IV,2) 1 continens, abstinens, sibi temperans: ἐγκρατής Tit. 1,8: ነፍስ፡ መስተዐግሥት፡ Sir. 26,15; Herm. p. 3; መስተዐግሣን፡ መሃይምናን፡ (distinguuntur a ሕዝባውያን፡ et ደናግል፡ ecclesiae) Kid. f. 18. 2 patiens, ( longanimis ), μακρόθυμος Koh. 7,8; Prov. 14,29; Prov. 15,18; Prov. 17,27; fem. መስተዐግሥት፡ 4 Esr. 10,23; seq. ለ፡ rei 4 Esr. 10,21; Kid. f. 4; de Deo Nah. 1,3; 4 Esr. 7,38; Ps. 7,12.

woorden.betekenis: suffire, suffimentum adolere, suffumigare
woorden.definitie: I,1 [עָתַר ܥܛܰܪ عَطِرَ; vicinum קָטַר قطر, II ቀተረ፡] Subj. ይዕጥን፡ (raro ይዕጠን፡ ut Jer. 11,13 var.) suffire, suffimentum adolere, suffumigare, Ex. 30,7; Ex. 30,8; Jer. 51,15; Luc. 1,9; Lit. 161,3 seq.; c. ለ፡ numinis: ሦዑ፡ ወዐጠኑ፡ ለአጋንንት፡ Jes. 65,3; Jes. 65,7; Jer. 7,9; Jer. 11,12; Jer. 11,13; Jer. 51,3; ሶበ፡ ኀደግነ፡ ዐጢነ፡ ለንግሥተ፡ ሰማይ፡ Jer. 51,18; 3 Reg. 11,7; c. Acc. suffimenti: Kuf. 3; Kuf. 4; Kuf. 16; ዐጢነ፡ ዕጣን፡ Kuf. 50; Ex. 40,25; 1 Reg. 2,28; ከመ፡ ይዕጥን፡ ዕጣነ፡ 2 Par. 2,4; 2 Par. 26,16; 2 Par. 26,18; c. Acc. loci vel rei odoribus suffitae (beräuchern): ተዐጥን፡ መቃብረ፡ በትእምርተ፡ መስቀል፡ Genz. f. 40; መንበረ፡ ልዑል፡ የዐጥኑ፤ ወቃለ፡ ፈጣሪ፡ ይሰምዑ፤ ብፁዓን፡ ካህናት፡ ጽርሐ፡ አርያም፡ የኀድሩ፡ Mavâs. n. 20; Lit. 161,1; ካህን፡ ይዕጥን፡ ወንጌለ፡ ፫ ጊዜ፡ Lit. 162,4.

woorden.betekenis: suffimentum, odoramentum, incensum, thus, suffitio, suffitus
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., Pl. ዕጣናት፡ 1 suffimentum, odoramentum, in specie (incensum), thus: θυμίαμα Gen. 43,11; Prov. 27,9; Lev. 10,1; Lev. 16,12; Num. 16,7; Ps. 140,2; Jes. 1,13; Jes. 43,24; Jer. 51,21; Mal. 1,11; Kuf. 3; Kuf. 4; Apoc. 8,4; ዕጣን፡ ዘቅታሬ፡ Ex. 30,7; ዕጣን፡ ቅድው፡ Ex. 30,35; ዕጣናት፡ Jes. 39,2; 1 Par. 28,18; Apoc. 8,3; አፈው፡ ወዕጣን፡ λιβανωτὸς καὶ ἀρώματα 1 Par. 9,29; ገበርተ፡ ዕጣን፡ ወአፈው፡ 1 Par. 9,30; Lit. 164,3; vid. ወገረ፡ ዕጣነ፡ sub ወገረ፡; ጸሎተ፡ ዕጣን፡ (oratio incensi) Lit. 161,1 (vid. Renaudot liturg. I. p. 200 seq.); 59; 85; ዕጣነ፡ ሞገር፡ vid. sub ሞገር፡ (col. 937). 2 suffitio, suffitus: በጊዜ፡ ሰዓተ፡ ዕጣን፡ Luc. 1,10; መሥዋዕት፡ ዘዕጣን፡ Ex. 30,1; Luc. 1,11. ዕጣን፡ ዞሬ፡ ʿǝṭān zore possibly allotment of neighbouring fields to the church; the filelds are cultivated by peasants who pay one third or one fifth from their harvest to the clergy; alternatively it might be a place name (based on Bausi’s comment below) አዲ፡ እዬ፡ አዲ፡ ተግባ፡ አዲ፡ ማሪሂ፡ አዲ፡ ሐንስ፡ እስከ፡ ዋሪ፡ ዘሀሎ፡ በረ፡ ደብረ፡ ማርያም፡ በክሳድ፡ ቋረ፡ በምሕላፍ፡ በማይ፡ አይኒ፡ በጸባብ፡ እስከ፡ እጉድ፡ ሐርማዝ፡ ይትከአላ፡ እስከ፡ ዋ[sopra ልታ] [cancellato ላ]፡ ዕብን፡ እስከ፡ ዕጣን፡ ዞሬ፡ ‘Addi Eyē, Addi Tagbā, Addi Mārihi, Addi Ḥanes fino a Wāri, ciò che è nello Šara; Dabra Māryām a Kesād Qʷārā, al passaggio a Māy Ayni, a Ṣabbāb fino a Egud Ḥarmāz le è permesso, fino a Wāltā ‘Ebn, † fino a ‘eṭān zorē †’ 42–43 Ms. 4 § 19a (ed.), 34 Ms. 4 § 19a (tr.); አዲ፡ አዬ፡ አድ፡ ተገባ፡ አዲ መራሂ፡ አድ፡ ሕንሴ፡ እስከ፡ ዋሪ። ዝ፡ ዘሀሎ፡ በሽሬ። ደብረ፡ ማርያም[፡] በክሳድ፡ ቋሬ፡ በምሕላፍ፡ በማይ፡ ዓይኒ፡ በጸባብ፡ እስከ፡ እጕድ፡ ሐርማዝ፡ አይት[illeggibile ክ]እላ፡ [sic] እስከ፡ ዋልታ፡ እብኒ ዕጣን፡ ዞሬ፡ ‘Addi Ayē, Ad Tagabā, Addi Marāhi, Ad Ḥensē fino a Wāri, questo è ciò che è nello Šerē; Dabra Māryām a Kesād Qʷarē, al passaggio a Māy ‘Ayni, a Ṣabbāb fino a Egʷed Ḥarmāz non le è permesso, fino a Wāltā Ebni: (quanto precede è) lo ‘eṭān zorē’ 42–43 Ms. 1 § 19b (ed.), 34 Ms. 1 § 19b (tr.) (‘Il testo del ms. 4 è forse corrotto: premette እስከ፡ «fino a» ዕጣን፡ ዞሬ፡ da interpretare perciò, nel contesto, come un toponimo. Il testo del ms. 1 non presenta እስከ፡ e potrebbe intendere ዕጣነ፡ ዞሬ፡ quale «assegnazione alla chiesa di campi, generalmente nelle sue vicinanze, campi che gli stessi paesani coltivano, corrispondendo poi al clero lo ḥamšò o il sisò del raccolto», si veda 89–112, ma si cita dalla rist. in 109–131, spec. 120. Un toponimo ʿEṭān Zorē risulterebbe d’altra parte attestato in Huntingford, Land Charters 33.’ 34 n. 80), vid. ዞሬ፡

woorden.betekenis: locus suffitus
woorden.definitie: subst. locus suffitus (suffitionis): ምሥዋዕ፡ ዘምዕጣን፡ Lev. 4,7.

woorden.betekenis: thuribulum, altare suffitus, māʿǝṭant, 16 croci, 20 turiboli
woorden.definitie: (raro ማዕጠን፡), subst., m. et fem., Pl. መዓጥን፡, መዓጥንት፡ et ማዕጠንታት፡ 1 thuribulum, πυρεῖον Lev. 10,1; Lev. 16,12; መዓጥንት፡ Num. 4,14; Num. 16,6 seq.; Sir. 50,9; መዓጥን፡ 4 Reg. 25,15; θυμιατήριον Hez. 8,11; 2 Par. 26,19; ማዕጠንተ፡ ወርቅ፡ Apoc. 8,3; መዓጥን፡ Org. 3; M.M. f. 1; ማዕጠንታት፡ Sx. Ter 21; Sx. Mij. 10; Ssal. Req. 2 altare suffitus, Ex. 40,5; Ex. 40,24; Hebr. 9,4. māʿǝṭant 1 ፲ወ፪ መሳቅል፡ ፲ወ፮ መዓጥንት፡ ፳ ‘16 croci, 20 turiboli,’ 43 VI 25–26 (ed.), 36 l. 23 (tr.); መስቀል፡ ፲ወ፮። ወማዕጠንት፡ ፲ወ፭። ‘16 croci, 15 turiboli,’ 64 l. 11 (ed.), 53 l. 18 (tr.) 2 meaning unknown (but see Conti Rossini’s comment below) ማዕጠንተ፡ ገዛ፡ መነኵሲ፡ ተወልዴ፡ ዘይቤ፡ ዮዲት። ‘Māʿeṭant de la peuplade des moines (gazā manakuesi): Tawaldē, c’est-à-dire Yodit.’ 14 l. 8 (ed.), 15 l. 1–2 (tr.); ማዕጠንተ፡ ገዛ፡ ቀሳውስት፡ እዳ፡ ቀሲስ፡ ቈልዓ፡ ዘይቤ፡ መርቆሬዎስ። ‘Māʿeṭant de la peuplade des prêtres (gazā qasāwest). Edda qasis Qualʿā, c’est-à-dire Marqorēwos.’ 14 l. 14 l. 20–21 (ed.), 15 l. 15–16 (tr.); ማዕጠንተ፡ ገዛ፡ ደጌ፡ ሰላም፡ እዳ፡ ሕዱግ፡ ተወልደ፡ መድኅን፡ ዘይቤ፡ ቀሲስ፡ ክፍል። ‘Māʿeṭant de la peuplade Dagē Salām (gazā dagē salām). Eddā ḥedug Tawalda Madḫen, c’est-à-dire le prêtre Kefel.’ 14 l. 33–15 l. 1 (ed.), 15 l. 29–30 (tr.); ማዕጠንተ፡ ገዛ፡ ጠፈኖት፡ እዳ፡ ቀሲስ፡ ደበስ፡ ዘይቤ፡ ገዛኢ፡ ዝክሬ። ‘Māʿeṭant de la peuplade Ṭafanot (gazā ṭafanot). Le prêtre Dabas, c’est-à-dire le gazāʾi Zekrē.’ 15 l. 10–11 (ed.), 16 l. 8–9 (tr.) (‘Māʿeṭant est “thuribulum”; mais cette signification n’est pas claire ici. En considérant que les charges ecclésiastiques à Aksoum étaient héréditaires dans la population de la ville; que la population ecclésiastiques d’Aksoum se divisait en quatre peuplades; que se document de quatre peuplades (gazā manakuesi, gazā qasāwest, gazā dagē salām, et gazā ṭafanot), etc.; on outre, comme le document, n° V parles des dabtarā māʿeṭant, j’avais supposé d’abord que ce texte contenait l’indication des représentants des familles de chaque peuplade officiellement admis au service ecclésiastique de la cathédrale. Mail l’hypothèse se heurte à quelques difficultés; par exemple, quelquefois, au nom d’une famille, correspond un nom de femme. 16 n. 1) L ማዕጠንት māʿǝṭant, Pl. መዓጥን maʿāṭǝn, መዓጥንት maʿāṭǝnt censer, thurible, (Literature) fumigation with incense 76b C for ደብተራ፡ ማዕጠንት፡ vid. ደብተራ፡ (TraCES)

woorden.betekenis: ramus, ramulus, sarmentum, palmes, rami arte facti, brachia,
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. አዕጹቅ፡ { Pl. etiam አዕጽቅት፡ Sap. 13,13 in Abb. LV}, Pl. Pl. አዕጹቃት፡ [ܥܶܕܩܳܐ عِذْقٌ; semel scriptum inveni ዐስቅ፡ Jes. 24,2 var.] 1 ramus, ramulus, sarmentum, palmes, ኢሥርዎሙ፡ ወኢዐጽቆሙ፡ κλῆμα Mal. 3,19; ዐጽቀ፡ ቈጽል፡ Kuf. 16; κλάδος Matth. 24,32; κλῆμα Joh. 15,2 seq.; አዕጹቅ፡ στέλεχος Job 14,8; Dan. 4,8; Dan. 4,9; Hez. 17,6; Kuf. 16; Gen. 40,10; Sir. 1,20; አዕጹቂሃ፡ ኢይፈርዩ፡ Sir. 23,25; ኖኃ፡ አዕጹቂየ፡ Sir. 24,16; Sir. 14,26; Sir. 40,15; ውስተ፡ አዕጹቂሃ፡ Jes. 17,6; Jes. 55,12; Jer. 11,16; Matth. 21,8; Sx. Masc. 14; አዕጹቃት፡ Sx. Genb. 19; Sx. Masc. 14; አዕጹቃተ፡ ወይን፡ Sx. Masc. 1. 2 rami arte facti, i.e. brachia candelabri Ex. 38,14; Ex. 38,15, vel scapus cum brachiis, Num. 8,4. 3 racemus, uvarum: ቈላተ፡ ዐጽቅ፡ φάραγξ βότρυος Num. 13,23; Deut. 1,24. a racemus uvarum passarum: ፻ ዐጽቀ፡ ዘቢብ፡ σταφίδες 2 Reg. 16,1. b fasciculus (aliâs: massa ) ficuum (aridarum): ንሣእ፡ ዐጽቀ፡ በለስ፡ παλάθην ἐκ συκῶν Jes. 38,21; 4 Reg. 20,7; ክልኤ፡ አዕጹቀ፡ በለስ፡ δύο καλάθους συκῶν Jer. 24,1. (Legitne interpres παλάθας an κλάδους ? ).

woorden.betekenis: palmites agere, germinare, se applicare, adhaerescere
woorden.definitie: II,1 (denom.) palmites agere vel germinare, Herm. p. 50 (at nescio an ተዐጽቀ፡ se applicare, adhaerescere legendum sit, Zeitschrift der Deutschen morg. Gesellschaft Bd. XV, p. 118).

woorden.betekenis: labor gravis et molestus, dolor, duritia, firmitate, durum,
woorden.definitie: , rarius ዐጽበ፡ (Gen. 35,16) I,1, etiam per ፀ, [עָצַב; עָצָב labor gravis et molestus, dolor; عصب VII; origo est in duritia et firmitate, cfr. radices permultas ab עץ ܥܨ عص غص ዐጽ et ዐፅ፡ incipientes; at صَعُبَ vid. sub ጽሕበ፡] Subj. ይዕጽብ፡ et ይዕጸብ፡ 1 durum, difficilem, arduum, molestum esse vel difficiliorem al. esse: ዘየዐጽብ፡ (opp. ዘይቀልል፡) Luc. 12,26; c. pron. suff. (pro Dat.): Ex. 18,22; ኢይዕጸብከ፡ (v. ኢይዕጽብከ፡) ዝንቱ፡ ነገር፡ ቅድመ፡ አዕይንቲከ፡ 2 Reg. 11,25; የዐጽባ፡ ወሊድ፡ Hen. 62,4; ወዐጸቦ፡ ለሐማን፡ ዝንቱ፡ ኵሉ፡ (Amano molestum vel ingratum erat) Jsp. p. 277; ዐጸቦሙ፡ ጽምአ፡ ማይ፡ Jsp. p. 349. 2 molestiis vel doloribus laborare: ሶበ፡ የዐጽብ፡ ሙሴ፡ ያወርድ፡ እደዊሁ፡ Ex. 17,11; ዐጸበት፡ ሶበ፡ ትወልድ፡ Kuf. p. 119; Gen. 35,16; Hen. 62,4. 3 gravem vel graviorem i.e. majoris momenti esse Luc. 12,23. 4 durum i.e. mirum esse vel { videri } alicui, c. Acc. pers., Act. 25,27 rom. 5 opus, necesse, necessarium esse, c. pron. suff. (pro Dat.) alicui: Act. 28,10 rom.; ሶበ፡ ዐጸቦሙ፡ ለሰትየ፡ ማይ፡ Sx. Nah. 3; Gad. Ad. f. 43; Gad. Ad. f. 44; Gad. Ad. f. 77.

woorden.betekenis: durior, satis durus, dure locutus est
woorden.definitie: adj. durior; satis durus: ተናገረ፡ ምስሌሆሙ፡ ዐጸብጺበ፡ Kuf. p. 145 ann. 2 (Vers. Lat.: dure locutus est ). – Voc. Ae.: ዐጸብጺብ፡ ዘ፡ ቀጠና።

woorden.betekenis: firmitatis, ligare, constringere, claudere, occludere, obser
woorden.definitie: I,1 [עָצָה Ges. thes. p. 1057, et variae aliae radices, ab עץ incipientes, quae e significatu firmitatis ductae vel ligare, constringere (ut ܥܨܰܒ עָצַס عَصَبَ) vel claudere (ut עָצַר עֲצַס) significant] Subj. ይዕጹ፡, rarius ይዕጸው፡ 1 claudere, occludere, obserare januam, portam Gen. 19,6; Gen. 19,10; Jud. 3,23; Kuf. 37; ዕጸዊ፡ ኆኅተ፡ ላዕሌኪ፡ 4 Reg. 4,4; 4 Reg. 4,33; ዕጽዉ፡ (v. ዕጸዉ፡) ወቀትሩ፡ ኆኃቲሃ፡ 2 Esr. 17,3; ይዕጽዋ፡ ኆኅተ፡ ገነት፡ Dan. apocr. 1,17; Dan. apocr. 1,18; Job 3,10; ዕጹ፡ ኆኅተከ፡ Jes. 26,20; Matth. 6,6; Luc. 13,25; አልቦ፡ ዘይክል፡ ዐጺዎታ፡ Apoc. 3,8; arcam Gen. 7,16; Kuf. 5; tabernaculum Judith 13,1; omisso Acc.: እመ፡ ዐጸወ፡ ላዕለ፡ ሰብእ፡ መኑ፡ ያርኁ፡ Job 12,14; ለእመ፡ ዐጸወ፡ ውእቱ፡ አልቦ፡ ዘያርኁ፡ Jes. 22,22; Apoc. 3,7; aditum Judith 5,1; coelum Deut. 11,17; Apoc. 11,6; os: እምቅድመ፡ ይዕጽወኒ፡ ሞት፡ አፉየ፡ Genz. f. 139; Dan. 6,18; uterum: ዐጸዋ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ማሕፀና፡ 1 Reg. 1,5; Gen. 20,18, et omisso ማሕፀነ፡ Gen. 16,2 (ዐጸወኒ፡); መንግሥተ፡ ሰማያት፡ Matth. 23,14; c. ላዕለ፡ post aliquem Jud. 3,23; Jud. 9,51; 4 Reg. 4,4; 4 Reg. 4,23; Job 12,14; vel super aliquo: ዐጸወ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ በማኅተም፡ (rom.: ማኅተመ፡) Apoc. 20,3; c. እምነ፡ ante aliquem vel praecludere alicui: Job 3,23; የዐጹ፡ ምሕረቶ፡ እምኔሁ፡ 1 Joh. 3,17. a praecludere, obstruere: ዐጸዉ፡ አፍላገ፡ በብዝኆሙ፡ ἐνέφραξε Judith 16,3; ሐነጸ፡ ወዐጸወ፡ ፍኖትየ፡ Thren. 3,9. b includere vel concludere: ዕጽዎ፡ ለዝ፡ ነገር፡ Dan. 12,4; 2 Reg. 6,10; in specie: in carcerem vel in custodiam tradere: Kuf. 10; Kuf. 42; ከመ፡ ትዕጽዎ፡ δώσεις αὐτὸν εἰς τὸ ἀπόκλεισμα Jer. 36,26; Ep. Jer. 17; Am. 1,6; Hen. 67,4; Luc. 3,20; in manus alicujus includere i.e. tradere in potestatem ejus, 1 Reg. 17,46; 1 Reg. 26,8; Ps. 77,55; Ps. 77,68. c excludere: virgines stultae fores pulsabant እስመ፡ ዐጸዎን፡ (e Matth. 25,10) Kid. f. 41. – (Luc. 4,25 rom. ዐጽወ፡ ሰማይ፡ lapsu calami pro ተዐጽወ፡ scriptum videtur).

woorden.betekenis: se includere, claudi, occludi, concludi, includi, excludi, p
woorden.definitie: III,1 (raro ተዐጸወ፡ ut Kuf. p. 42 ann. 11) 1 reflex. se includere: ተዐጸው፡ ማእከለ፡ ቤትከ፡ Hez. 3,24. 2 pass. claudi, occludi, ይትዐጸው፡ ኆኅት፡ Koh. 12,4; Jes. 60,11; Mal. 1,10; Matth. 25,10; Apoc. 21,25; ተዐጽወ፡ አናቅጸ፡ ግብጽ፡ Kuf. 46; ተዐጽወ፡ አብያት፡ Jes. 24,10; ተዐጽዉ፡ አህጉር፡ Jer. 13,19. a concludi, includi: 1 Reg. 23,7; ሶበ፡ ተዐጽዉ፡ ክልኤሆሙ፡ Tob. 8,4; ኢይትዐጸው፡ አሠርከ፡ Prov. 4,12; Ps. 67,33; Hen. 10,13; Hen. 69,28; Kuf. 10; Jes. 24,22. b excludi: virgines stultae flebant እስመ፡ ተዐጽዋ፡ Kid. f. 41. c praecludi, c. pron. suff. (pro Dat.): ኢተዐጽወተኒ፡ ዛቲ፡ ፍሥሓ፡ 2 Cor. 11,10; c. ላዕለ፡ pers.: Hen. 80,7. – Voc. Ae.: ተዐጽወ፡ ዘ፡ ተዘጋ።

woorden.betekenis: janua, fores, valvae, sera, claustrum, clausura, pericardia,
woorden.definitie: , rarius ማዕጹት፡, et ማዕጾት፡ (Lud. e Mss. Colb.), subst., m. et fem., Pl. መዓጹት፡; rarius መዓጽው፡ (M.M. f. 312; Org.), Pl. Pl. መዓጽዋት፡ (Lud. e Mss. Colb.) 1 janua, fores, valvae: ማዕጾ፡ θύρα Ep. Jer. 58; ከመ፡ ማዕጾ፡ እንተ፡ ተዐውድ፡ ውስተ፡ ድርኵኵታ፡ Prov. 26,14; ድርኵኵተ፡ ማዕጾ፡ Zach. 12,2; Sir. 28,25; ድኅረ፡ ማዕጾ፡ Jes. 57,8; Jer. 30,9; Ps. 140,3; ቦአ፡ እንዘ፡ ዕጽው፡ ማዕጹት፡ Cyr. f. 120; ማዕጾ፡ ዐቢያን፡ ዘአናቅጽ፡ Chron. Ax. f. 89; መዓጹት፡ 1 Reg. 23,7; 3 Reg. 6,29; 3 Reg. 7,36; 4 Reg. 12,13; Hez. 38,11; Hez. 41,23 seq.; መዓጹት፡ (v. ማዕጹት፡) ወመናስግት፡ Job 38,10; መዓጹት፡ ዘቅድመ፡ ገጹ፡ Job 41,5. 2 sera, claustrum: ሰበረ፡ ማዕጾ፡ Kuf. 39; σανίς Cant. 8,9; በከናፍሪሁ፡ ማዕጾ፡ እብን፡ ወደየ፡ Sx. Masc. 16Enc.; መዓጹት፡ κλεῖθρα 2 Esr. 13,3; 2 Esr. 13,13. 3 clausura cordis i.e. pericardia: እሠጥቅ፡ ማዕጾ፡ ልቦሙ፡ Hos. 13,8 (vers. nov., סְגִוֹר); oculorum i.e. nictus: ማዕጾተ፡ ዐይን፡ („dum oculi vicissim clauduntur et aperiuntur“) Lud. e Mss. Colb. – Voc. Ae.: ማዕጾ፡ ዘ፡ መዝግያ፡ መቆለፍያሂ፡; aliud: ዘ፡ ሳንቃ።

woorden.betekenis: metere
woorden.definitie: metere vid. sub ዐፀደ፡

woorden.betekenis: area anteliminaris, caula, septum, cortina, velamen, in cing
woorden.definitie: subst. m. et fem. [أَصِيدٌ et وَصِيدٌ area anteliminaris, وَصِيدَةٌ et أَصِيدَةٌ et أَسِدَةٌ caula, septum, مُوَصَّدٌ cortina, velamen; potestas radicis prima in cingendofuisse videtur, coll. ኀጸደ፡, عَصَدَ عَسَدَ inflexit, torsit,] Pl. አዕጻድ፡, Pl. Pl. አዕጻዳት፡ 1 areaquaevis circumsepta a area, impluvium, chors, αὐλή 2 Reg. 17,18; ኀበ፡ አረፍተ፡ ዐጸድ፡ Tob. 2,9; በዐጸደ፡ ሞቅሕ፡ Jer. 39,2; Jer. 40,1; ውስተ፡ አዕጻዳቲሆሙ፡ 2 Esr. 18,16. b vestibulum, atrium, α tabernaculi sacri, templi: Ex. 27,9 seq.; Ex. 37,7 seq.; 3 Reg. 6,33; 4 Reg. 21,5; Kuf. 49; Jes. 1,12; Jer. 19,14; Jer. 33,2; Hez. 8,7; Ps. 28,2; Ps. 83,1; Ps. 95,8; Apoc. 11,2; αἴθριον Hez. 40,14; Hez. 40,15. β regiae vel palatii, 3 Reg. 7,45; 3 Reg. 7,46; ውስተ፡ ዐጸደ፡ ቤተ፡ መንግሥት፡ Esth. 1,5; Marc. 14,66; Marc. 14,68; quare γ aularegum vel principum: አብአከ፡ ውስተ፡ ዐጸደ፡ መንግሥት፡ Kuf. 47; በውስተ፡ ዐጸዱ፡ Esth. 2,19; እለ፡ ውስተ፡ ዐጸደ፡ ንጉሥ፡ Esth. 3,1; Dan. 2,49; Matth. 26,3; Matth. 26,58; Sx. Sen. 5Enc.; አዕጻደ፡ ነጉሥት፡ M.M. f. 185 (vid. sub ተዋሕውሐ፡). c villa, vicus, pagus, tentorianomadum, quaevis habitatiocircumsepta (cum possessione): κώμη Jer. 30,14; ትስዑ፡ አህጉር፡ ወአዕጻዳቲሆን፡ κῶμαι Jos. 15,32 seq.; Jos. 21,12; Num. 32,42; 2 Esr. 16,2; 1 Esr. 4,50; 1 Esr. 5,45; 1 Par. 27,25; 2 Par. 13,19; 2 Par. 28,18; Matth. 10,11; ἐπαύλεις Num. 31,10; Num. 32,16; Judith 15,7; 2 Esr. 22,28; 2 Esr. 22,29; σκηνή Gen. 12,8; Gen. 13,3; Gen. 26,25; σκηνώματα Ps. 119,5; በበ፡ አዕጻዲሆሙ፡ πανοικί Ex. 1,1. d septum, caula, pascuum, habitatiobestiarum: አዕጻዳተ፡ መራዕይ፡ ἐπαύλεις ποιμνίων Jes. 65,10; አዕጻደ፡ አባግዕ፡ Jer. 40,12; አዕጻደ፡ ላህም፡ βουκόλια βοῶν Joel 1,18; Deut. 7,13; Deut. 28,4; Sx. Masc. 30(vid. sub ዳቤላ፡); አዕጻዳተ፡ ወፍር፡ βουκόλια Am. 6,4; Joh. 10,1; ዐጸደ፡ ሰገኖ፡ αὐλὴ στρουθῶν Jes. 34,13. e ager, praedium, rus, fundus: አዕጻዳት፡ ἀφορίσματα Num. 35,3 seq.; ἀγροί 4 Reg. 8,3; 2 Esr. 23,10; Marc. 5,14; ἀγρός ዐጸድ፡ Judith 8,3; 4 Esr. 9,17; crebro ዐጸደ፡ ወፍር፡, ut Jes. 65,10; 1 Reg. 22,6; 1 Reg. 22,7 (vid. ወፍር፡); in specie α ዐጸደ፡ ወይን፡ vinea Koh. 2,4; Prov. 9,12; Jes. 5,1; Jer. 39,15; Job 24,6; Sir. 24,17; Matth. 20,1; Marc. 14,32 (vid. ወይን፡); quod passim pro ἄμπελος (vitis) ponitur Gen. 49,11; Ps. 79,9; Ps. 79,15. β ዐጸደ፡ ሐምል፡ hortus, viridarium: 3 Reg. 21,2; Koh. 2,4; Joh. 18,1; πρασιά Sir. 24,31 (plura vid. sub ሐምል፡). γ ዐጸደ፡ ቅብእ፡ olivetum 4 Reg. 5,26; 2 Esr. 15,11; 2 Esr. 19,25; vel ዐጸደ፡ ዘይት፡ Deut. 6,11. f ዐጸደ፡ እክል፡ area frumentaria, ἅλων 4 Reg. 6,27 (aliâs ዐውደ፡እክል፡). g area i.e. circus, arena, campus, ubi aliquid agitur: ዝዓለም፡ ውእቱ፡ ዐጸደ፡ ገቢር፡ ወዘይመጽእሰ፡ ዐጸደ፡ ዕሤት፤ ዓለምኒ፡ ዐጸደ፡ ጻማ፡ ወድካም፡ ወዘይመጽእኒ፡ ዐጸደ፡ ፍግዓ፡ ወዕረፍት፡ Jsp. p. 380; ዐጸደ፡ ስምዕ፡ Sx. Mij. 30Enc. (vid. sub ዳቤላ፡). 2 velum, aulaeum, cortina; de aulaeis quibus atrium tentorii sacri cinctum erat, ἱστίον Ex. 27,9 seq.; Ex. 37,7 seq. (aliâs አልባሰ፡ ዐጸድ፡ Num. 3,26; Num. 4,26); de velis tabernaculi sacri, αὐλαία Ex. 26,1 seq. Ex. 37,1; Ex. 37,2; Ex. 40,17; in C Ex. 36,8 seq. (Oct. P. II. p. 90); vel cujusvis tentorii Jes. 54,2 (vid. supra n. 1,c ዐጸድ፡ tentorium); Judith 14,14. – Voc. Ae.: ዐጸድ፡ ዘበ፪ ቤታ፡ (an ቦታ፡?) ዙርያ፡; aliud: አዕጻዳት፡ ብ፡ ፈርጅ፡ ʿaṣad L ዐጸደ፡ ቅብእ ʿaṣada qǝbʾ olive grove, vid. ቅብእ፡ 418a

woorden.betekenis: os, cranium, calvaria, costa, spina dorsi, os maxillae, mand
woorden.definitie: subst. (etiam ዐጽም፡), m. et fem., Pl. አዕፅምት፡ [עֶצֶם عَظْمٌ; amh. አጽንት፡ et አጥንት፡] os (ossis): Gen. 2,23; Ex. 12,46; Num. 9,12; Luc. 24,39; Joh. 19,36; ዐፅመ፡ ሰብእ፡ Num. 19,16; Hez. 39,15; አዕፅምት፡ vivi Job 2,5; Job 19,11; Job 30,17; Job 33,19; Job 33,21; Ps. 6,2; Ps. 31,3; Ps. 21,14; Ps. 21,18; አንቀልቀለ፡ ኵሉ፡ አዕፅምትየ፡ Jer. 23,9; Sir. 28,17; Hen. 25,6; mortui Ex. 13,19; Jos. 24,32; Kuf. 35; Kuf. 46; Jer. 8,1; Hez. 37,1 seq.; Sir. 49,10; Sir. 49,15. a ዐፅመ፡ ርእስ፡ cranium, calvaria, ut: ዐፅመ፡ ርእሰ፡ ምዉት፡ Sx. Ter 29Enc. b ዐፅመ፡ ገቦ፡ costa Gen. 2,21; Kuf. 3; አዕፅምተ፡ ገበዋቲሁ፡ Job 40,13; Sir. 30,12; Org. c ዐፅመ፡ ዘባን፡ spina dorsi 1 Reg. 4,18 var.; Ps. 128,3 var.; vel አዕፅምተ፡ ዘባን፡ Job 40,13. d ዐፅመ፡ መንከስ፡ os maxillae vel mandibulae Jud. 15,15; sec. Lud. etiam ዐፅመ፡ አፍ፡ e ዐፅመ፡ እግር፡ tibia, Lud. ex Sx. Enc. f ዐፅመ፡ እንግድዓ፡ sternum, os pectorale, Lud. ex Sx. Enc. g ዐፅመ፡ ሥጋ፡ sceletum Sx. Teq. 6Enc.

woorden.betekenis: duritiei, firmitatis
woorden.definitie: (etiam ዐጸወ፡) rad. inus., cui potestas duritiei et firmitatis inerat, vid. Ges. thes. p. 1056.

woorden.betekenis: arbor, frutex, arbuscula, patibulum, crux, fustis, pertica,
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. ዕፀው፡ (raro አዕፀው፡ Lud.), Pl. Pl. ዕፀዋት፡ (de ዕፃት፡ vid. ዕፀት፡) [עֵץ, אָע, عَصًا عِضَاهٌ عِضٌّ عَضَاضٌ عِيصٌ, probabiliter etiam عُودٌ]1 arbor, Gen. 18,4; Gen. 18,8; Kuf. 3; Koh. 11,3; Job 14,7; Job 24,20; Ps. 1,3; Ps. 1,4; Jer. 17,8; Dan. 4,7; Dan. 4,11; Hen. 24,4; Matth. 3,10; Matth. 7,17; Matth. 12,33; ἐλάτη Gen. 21,15; δρῦς 2 Reg. 18,9; 3 Reg. 13,14; ዕፅ፡ ይቡስ፡ Sir. 6,3; Jes. 56,3; ዕፀ፡ ሕይወት፡ Gen. 2,9; Jes. 65,22; 4 Esr. 8,62; Apoc. 22,2; ዕፀ፡ ዘይት፡ Sir. 24,14; Sir. 50,10; Ps. 51,8; ዕፀ፡ ጤርባንጦስ፡ Sir. 24,16; ዕፀ፡ ቄድሮስ፡ et ቄጵሮስ፡ Sir. 24,13; Sir. 50,10; ዕፀ፡ ቄጵርስስ፡ Job 40,12; ዕፀው፡ Hen. 3; Gen. 1,12; Gen. 1,29; Jud. 9,8 seq.; Ps. 103,18; ዕፀወ፡ መዐዛ፡ Hen. 24,3; ዕፀወ፡ ገዳም፡ Kuf. 13; ዕፀው፡ ዘይፈርዩ፡ Koh. 2,5; ዕፀወ፡ ዖም፡ Jer. 3,6; Jer. 3,13; ዕፀዋተ፡ ዘይት፡ Deut. 28,40; Deut. 28,42; Judae 12. 2 frutex, arbuscula, Job 30,4; Deut. 33,16; Marc. 12,26; Luc. 20,37; ኀበ፡ አልቦ፡ ዕፅ፡ ἄβατος Job 38,27; Jer. 2,6; ዕፀው፡ φυτά Sap. 7,20. 3 patibulum, crux, Deut. 21,22; Deut. 21,23; Gen. 40,19; Jos. 10,26; Esth. 7,9; Esth. 7,10; Gal. 3,13; Act. 5,30; Act. 10,39; ዕፀ፡ መስቀል፡ Clem. (crebro); ዕፅ፡ Lit. 4 fustis, pertica, contus: 1 Reg. 14,14; Matth. 26,47; Luc. 22,52; ዘይተክል፡ ዕፀ፡ ዲበ፡ ፍጽሙ፡ ወያነብር፡ ሕፃነ፡ መልዕልቴሃ፡ (κοντός) Chrys. Ta. 16; hastile: ዕፀ፡ ኲናት፡ 1 Reg. 17,7; 2 Reg. 21,19; ዕፀ፡ ረምሑ፡ 1 Par. 20,5. 5 lignum, Jes. 60,17; Jer. 3,9; 1 Cor. 3,12; ዕፅ፡ ዘኢይነቅዝ፡ Ex. 25,10; Ex. 25,13 seq.; ዕፀ፡ ጽኍድ፡ Lev. 14,4; ዕፀ፡ መሥዋዕት፡ Kuf. 21; በአምጣነ፡ ዕፁ፡ ለእሳት፡ የዐቢ፡ ነዱ፡ Sir. 28,10; Gen. 22,9; Deut. 19,5; ዕፀ፡ ወይን፡ φρύγανα Act. 28,3 rom.; ዕፀ፡ ዕቅፍት፡ ξύλον προσκόμματος Sir. 34,7; ዕፀው፡ Deut. 4,28. a statui constr. subjunctum vel ዘዕፅ፡ ligneus: ንዋየ፡ ዕፅ፡ Lev. 11,32; ጋጋ፡ ዘዕፅ፡ Jer. 35,13; Apoc. 9,20; 2 Tim. 2,20. b in specie ዕፀው፡ lignaad comburendum caesa: ዕፀው፡ ውጡሕ፡ Jes. 30,33; Koh. 10,9; ወጣሕከ፡ ዕፀወ፡ ዲበ፡ እሳት፡ Sir. 8,3; Jer. 5,14; ዕፀው፡ ጽኑዓን፡ Kuf. 21; Gen. 22,3; Lev. 1,7; vel ad aedificandum Hen. 67,2. c instrumentum ligneum: πάσσαλος Deut. 23,14; ዕፀዊሆሙ፡ ለአልህምት፡ τὰ σκεύη τῶν βοῶν 2 Reg. 24,22; ዕፀ፡ ኀጺን፡ manubriumsecuris Deut. 19,5; in specie d i.q. أَلْعُودُ cithara, lyra, F.M. 32,7 (vid. sub ተላሀየ፡). 6 sors(„quia lignis vel surculis per notas quasdam discretis certoque modo dispositis sortem legere solebant“ Lud.): ዛቲ፡ መክፈልት፡ ወፅአት፡ በዕፁ፡ ለሴም፡ Kuf. 8; Kuf. 10; ወረደ፡ ዕፁ፡ ላዕለ፡ ፲ወ፬ ለሠርቀ፡ ወርኀ፡ አዳር፡ Esth. 3,7; Jon. 1,7 var.; እስመ፡ ሎሙ፡ ረከቦሙ፡ ዕፅ፡ 1 Par. 6,54; 1 Par. 24,5; 1 Par. 24,7; 1 Par. 25,9; Lev. 16,8; Lev. 16,9; Lev. 16,10; Num. 26,55. – Voc. Ae.: ዕፅ፡ ብ፡ ዱር፡ ʿǝḍ L ዕፀ፡ ራምኖን፡ ʿǝḍa rāmnon bramble, vid. ራምኖን፡ 471b

woorden.betekenis: arborem fieri
woorden.definitie: ዘ፡ እንጨት፡ ሆነ፡ i.e. arborem fieri, Rad. Abb.

woorden.betekenis: sors
woorden.definitie: subst. sors: መክፈልት፡ ዘኢወፅአ፡ በዕፃሁ፡ Kuf. 9; 1 Par. 24,6; 1 Par. 24,31; 1 Par. 25,8; 1 Reg. 14,42; 1 Reg. 14,40 ann.; Prov. 18,18 var.; ወወረደ፡ ዕፃ፡ (v. ዕፅ፡) ላዕለ፡ ዮናስ፡ Jon. 1,7; ወበጽሐ፡ ዕፃ፡ ዲበ፡ ማትያስ፡ Act. 1,26; Act. 8,21 rom.

woorden.betekenis: sortitio
woorden.definitie: et ዕፃዌ፡ subst. (n. act.) sortitio, Kuf. 8; Kuf. 9; Kuf. 10; መጽሐፈ፡ ዑፃዌ፡ Kuf. 9; በጽሖ፡ በዑፃዌ፡ M.M. f. 102; አመ፡ አንበሩ፡ ዑፃዌ፡ (als sie eine Verlobung anstellten) Sx. Mij. 3; Org. 1.

woorden.betekenis: tinea, vermis, vermiculus, teredo, eruca, aliud
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., Sing. et coll., Pl. ዕፄያት፡ et ዕፀያት፡ [עָשׁ, عُثَّةٌ tinea ] vermis, vermiculus cujusvis generis a qualis in putredine crescit: Ex. 16,24; Sir. 10,11; ፍዳሆሙ፡ ለኃጥኣን፡ ዕፄ፡ Sir. 7,17; ይፌኑ፡ እሳተ፡ ወዕፄ፡ ውስተ፡ ሥጋሆሙ፡ Judith 16,17; ዕፄሆሙ፡ ዘኢይነውም፡ Jes. 66,24; Marc. 9,44 seq.; ዕፄያት፡ vel ዕፀያት፡ Job 2,9; Job 7,5; Job 17,14; Job 21,26; Jes. 14,11; Hen. 46,6. b in stercore et fimo: በልዑ፡ ኅጠተ፡ ወዕፄ፡ ዘሀሎ፡ ውስተ፡ ኵስሐ፡ አፍራስ፡ Jsp. p. 368. c qualis plantas arrodit: Jon. 4,7; Deut. 28,39. d teredo: Prov. 12,4. e tinea, σής, ብልዐተ፡ ዕፄ፡ Job 4,19; ዕፄ፡ ወሙስና፡ σῆτες καὶ σκώληκες Sir. 19,3. f eruca: ዘአትረፈ፡ ዕፄ፡ በልዐ፡ አንበጣ፡ κάμπη Joel 1,4; Joel 2,25; Sx. Genb. 11Enc. g de „fetu apium, dum favis adhuc continetur“, Lud. ex Org. 5. h vermis auricularius: ዕፄ፡ ሶበ፡ ይበውእ፡ በእዝን፡ M.F. i transl., de homine contemto et infirmo: Job 25,6; Ps. 21,6. – Voc. Ae.: ዕፄ፡ ዘ፡ ትል፡; aliud: ዕፄ፡ ብ፡ ትል፤ ፃፄ፡ ብ፡ ብል።

woorden.betekenis: secuit, cecidit, messuit, metere, demetere, messor
woorden.definitie: et ዐጸደ፡ I,1 [עָצַד عَضَدَ secuit, cecidit; ܚܨܰܕ حَصَدَ messuit ] Subj. ይዕፅድ፡ metere, demetere, c. Acc., gramen: ዕፅድ፡ ሣዕረ፡ Prov. 27,24; Ps. 128,6; frumentum, messem: የዐፅዱ፡ ሥርናየ፡ 1 Reg. 6,13; ማእረር፡ በጽሐ፡ ለዐፂድ፡ 1 Reg. 13,21; Ex. 23,16; Ex. 34,22; Lev. 23,10; Lev. 25,5; c. Acc. agri Lev. 19,9; absol.: Ruth 2,9; Deut. 16,9; Ex. 34,21; Koh. 11,4; Apoc. 14,15; ማእከለ፡ ሐሪስ፡ ወለዐፂድ፡ Kuf. 29; ዘየዐፅድ፡ messor Joh. 4,36; Ruth 2,3 seq.; Jer. 9,22; Dan. apocr.13,33; ዐፂድ፡ 4 Esr. 9,17 var. – Voc. Ae.: አረረ፡ ዐፀደ፡ ብ፡ አጨደ።

woorden.definitie: area vid. sub ዐጸድ፡

woorden.betekenis: litera alphabeti Aethiopici decima septima, quae ዘ
woorden.definitie: litera alphabeti Aethiopici decima septima, quae ዘይ፡ nominatur, cuique respondet ز et ذ.

woorden.betekenis: mei, tui, sui, ejus, meus, tuus, noster, vester, suus, eorum
woorden.definitie: , ዚአከ፡, ዚአሁ፡ al., እንቲአየ፡, እንቲአከ፡ al., እሊአየ፡ al. sunt tres formae notae Genitivi, cum suffixis pron. pers., proprie mei (ad Sing. m. relatum ዚአየ፡, ad fem. እንቲአየ፡, ad Pl. እሊአየ፡), tui, sui vel ejus (gramm. § 105,b); vice pronominum possessivorum funguntur: meus, tuus, noster, vester, suus vel ejus, eorum, nonnumquam proprius, et crebro usurpantur, cum ubi Genitivus pronominum personalium postulatur separatus neque alii nomini subjunctus, tum pro pron. suff., si quidem orationis vis quaedam in pronomen intenta est. 1 Formae dictae plerumque ponuntur nudae, a ubi pron. poss. Subjectum (Joh. 3,30; Marc. 4,10) vel Praedicatum enunciationis est: ኵሉ፡ ዘታሕተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ዚአየ፡ ውእቱ፡ Job 41,2; እንተ፡ ኢኮነት፡ እንቲአከ፡ quae non tua est Kuf. 10; ዚአየ፡ ውእቱ፡ አፍላግ፡ Hez. 29,3; Hez. 18,4; Hez. 35,10; Jes. 29,2; Jes. 43,1; ከመ፡ እሊአከ፡ ንሕነ፡ Sap. 15,2; Hab. 2,8; Ps. 59,7; Ex. 19,5; Matth. 6,13; Rom. 8,9. b ubi statui constructo vel praepositioni subjunctum est: ኀዲገ፡ ዚአየ፡ τὸ καταλιπεῖν σε ἐμέ Prov. 2,16; Prov. 2,19; በእበደ፡ ዚአሁ፡ Sir. 8,15; ለሊሁ፡ ደረግም፡ ነፍሰ፡ እንቲአሁ፡ Sir. 21,27; Prov. 4,2; Prov. 4,20; Prov. 5,1; Prov. 5,10; አዐቅብ፡ ነፍሰ፡ እንቲአሁ፡ Prov. 16,17; Hen. 5,4; Hen. 10,11; Matth. 2,2; Matth. 6,33; Jac. 1,14 Platt; ዐውደ፡ ዚአሁ፡ Hen. 47,3; ወኮነ፡ ስብሓቲነ፡ ከመ፡ ዚአሆሙ፡ Asc. Jes. 8,17; እምዚአየ፡ ἐκ τοῦ ἐμοῦ Joh. 16,14; ውስተ፡ ዚአሁ፡ εἰς τὰ ἴδια Joh. 1,11; ዐቢይ፡ እምነ፡ ዚአሆሙ፡ μείζων τῆς αὐτῶν Jos. 19,9; ለእሊአሁ፡ Gen. 14,14; Num. 16,5; Joh. 13,1. c nec non α ubi suo nomini ad quod pertinet praemissum est: እንቲአየ፡ ልብ፡ ἐμὴ καρδία Prov. 23,14; እንቲአሆሙ፡ ሕይወቶሙ፡ Hen. 38,6. β vel post nomen pronomine suff. praeditum, ubi hoc pronomen emphaseos causa repetendum est: ወዓዲ፡ ነፍሶሂ፡ እንቲአሁ፡ vitam suam sui ipsius Luc. 14,26; Luc. 5,23. γ aliâs quoque, ut: በአተ፡ ካዕበት፡ እንቲአሁ፡ (pro በአተ፡ ካዕበት፡ በአተ፡ እንቲአሁ፡) Gen. 23,9. 2 Rarius formae ዚአየ፡, ዚአከ፡ al. pron. rel. ዘ፡ praemittitur: qui mei, tui al. est i.e. meus, tuus, ut: ዘዚአየ፡ ምክር፡ ἐμαὶ βουλαί Prov. 1,30; እወቅስ፡ ዘዚአየሂ፡ ጽድቅየ፡ ወዘዚአኪሂ፡ ጌጋየኪ፡ Jes. 57,12; ዝሰ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘዚአየ፡ Jes. 66,2; 4 Esr. 9,34; Gen. 31,43; maxime ubi neutro meum, tuum al. exponendum est, ut: እለ፡ ዘዚአሆሙ፡ ይዘርዑ፡ τὰ ἴδια σπείροντες Prov. 11,24; ዘዚአከ፡ τὰ σά Gen. 33,9; Sir. 13,5. 3 ዚአሁ፡, ዚአሃ፡ al. a praemisso ለለ፡ vel ዘዘ፡ vim distributivam nanciscitur: suus cujusque vel cuique, varius, multimodus, varii generis, ዘለለ፡ ዚአሁ፡ ሕማሞሙ፡ quorum morbi sui cujusvis i.e. varii erant Matth. 4,24; አልበሶሙ፡ ኀይለ፡ ዘዘዚአሆሙ፡ καθʼ ἑαυτούς Sir. 17,3; በበአምሳለ፡ ገጹ፡ ያርእየከ፡ ዘዘ፡ ዚአሁ፡ Sir. 31,3; ብእሲ፡ ዘዘዚአሁ፡ ሖረ፡ በፍኖቱ፡ Jes. 53,6; Act. 2,4; ውስተ፡ መለያልዩ፡ ዘዘዚአሆሙ፡ Hez. 37,7; ቃሎሙ፡ ዘዘዚአሆሙ፡ 1 Esr. 3,8; 4 Esr. 4,48; 4 Esr. 4,49; 4 Esr. 4, 50; 4 Esr. 4,51; Gen. 34,25; ዘዘ፡ ዚአነ፡ Gen. 43,21; ዘዘዚአክሙ፡ Gen. 37,7; Rom. 12,4; διάφορος Lev. 19,19; Rom. 12,6; Hebr. 9,10; ποικίλος Tit. 3,3; Hebr. 2,4; Jac. 1,2; 1 Petr. 1,6; Ex. 35,35; ዘዘዚአሁ፡ ትምህርት፡ ποικιλτικὴ ἐπιστήμη Job 38,36. b praemisso ዘዘ፡ (sc. nota Genitivi duplicata) vim reciprocationis nanciscitur, et cum verbis dirimendi junctum significat: ab invicem, alius ab alio, ይፈልጦሙ፡ ዘዘዚአሆሙ፡ Matth. 25,32; ተፋለጡ፡ ዘዘዚአሆሙ፡ Act. 15,39; አስተራሕቅዎሙ፡ ዘዘዚአሆሙ፡ Dan. apocr. 1,51.

woorden.betekenis: scabie ulcerosa, elephantiasi corripi, laborare
woorden.definitie: quadril. I scabie ulcerosa, in specie elephantiasi corripi vel laborare: Diocletianus ዘልገሰ፡ ኵለንታሁ፡ ወዐፅየ፡ ልሳኑ፡ M.M. f. 19.

woorden.betekenis: stillavit
woorden.definitie: inus. i.q. דָּלַף זְלַף ܕܠܰܦ (ذرف) stillavit.

woorden.betekenis: stillans, stacte
woorden.definitie: part. stillans (liquor) i.e. στακτὴ stacte, Hez. 27,16.

woorden.betekenis: continuare, pergere, perseverare, perpetuare
woorden.definitie: II,1, rarius አዘለፈ፡ II,2 continuare, pergere, perseverare, perpetuare, c.c. Acc. rei vel Infin.: ዘአዝለፈ፡ ትዕግሥቶ፡ ὁ ὑπομείνας εἰς τέλος Matth. 10,22; Matth. 24;13; Marc. 13,13 (ubi ed. rom. አዘለፈ፡ habet); ዘያዘልፍ፡ ሐሰተ፡ (pertinax mendacii) F.M. 23,1; ሶበ፡ አዝለፈ፡ ጸሎተ፡ Phlx. 51; ዘአዝለፈ፡ ዘንተ፡ ኀጢአተ፡ F.M. 10,3; ለእመ፡ አዝለፍነ፡ ዐቂበ፡ Hebr. 3,14; ከመ፡ ያዝልፉ፡ ገቢረ፡ ትሩፋት፡ F.M. 2,2; ኢያዝልፍ፡ ምሂረ፡ በቃል፡ ባሕቲቱ፡ አላ፡ ይኩኖሙ፡ አርአያ፡ F.M. 2,11; አዘለፍነ፡ ነጽሮታ፡ Chrys. Ta. 8; c. ላዕለ፡ seq. Infin., ut: አዝለፈ፡ ላዕለ፡ ገቢረ፡ እኩይ፡ Chrys. Ta. 7; seq. እንዘ፡, Phlx. 63(vid. sub ደፍዐ፡). (Job 39,13: ሰገኖ፡ ዘታዘልፍ፡ ወትነብር፡ absque auctoritate Graeci et sine sensu bono). – Voc. Ae.: አውተረ፡ ወአዝለፈ፡ ዘ፡ አረዘመ።

woorden.betekenis: reprehensio, objurgatio, correctio, admonitio, redargutio, r
woorden.definitie: subst. (sec. Lud. passim ዘላፋ፡ scriptum), m. et fem., 1 reprehensio, objurgatio, correctio, admonitio, Num. 5,18; Ps. 72,14; Prov. 1,23; ዘለፋ፡ ክሡት፡ Prov. 27,5; ἔλεγξις Job 23,2; Sir. 41,4; Hen. 14,1; Joh. 8,9; አነብብ፡ ዘለፋ፡ ርእስየ፡ Org.; ዘለፋ፡ ኀጣውእ፡ Org. 2 redargutio, refutatio, γαυρίαμα ( argutiae? ) Job 13,12; ንጽሕፍ፡ እንከ፡ ዘለፋሁ፡ ለንስጥኖስ፡ M.M. f. 27.

woorden.betekenis: rad. cognata cum ዜመ፡ زَمْزَمَ al. (vid. Hupfeld in
woorden.definitie: rad. cognata cum ዜመ፡ زَمْزَمَ al. (vid. Hupfeld in Zeitschrift für die Kunde des Morgenlandes Bd. III. 1840. p. 394 seq.); in specie cfr. זמר ܙܡܪ زمر, etiam ذبر et زبر.

woorden.betekenis: psaltes, psalmicen, cantor ecclesiasticus, psalmista
woorden.definitie: part. (I,2), Pl. m. መዘምራን፡, fem. መዘምራት፡, psaltes, psalmicen, cantor ecclesiasticus, psalmista: መዘምራን፡ ψαλτῳδοί 1 Par. 15,27; Sir. 47,9; Sir. 50,18; ψάλλοντες Ps. 67,27; መዘምራን፡ ወመዘምራት፡ ᾄδοντες καὶ ᾄδουσαι 2 Esr. 2,65; 2 Esr. 17,1; 2 Esr. 17,68; በከመ፡ ይቤ፡ መዘምር፡ (auctor psalmi) M.M. f. 196; ψάλται ecclesiae christianae: II Can. Ap. 64; F.N. 8; Did. 16; F.M. 15,3; Jared መዘምር፡ Deg.

woorden.betekenis: psalmus, psalmi, hymnus, oda sacra, liber psalmorum, psalter
woorden.definitie: (ምዝሙር፡ Act. 13,1 rom.) subst. (m.), [מִזְמוֹר ܡܰܙܡܰܘܪܳܐ مَزْمُورٌ], coll. et Sing., Pl. መዝሙራት፡, sed etiam መዛሙር፡ (Phlx. 237al.; et መዘምርት፡ Asc. Jes. 4,21 bis, si quidem lectio sana est), 1 psalmus, psalmi, hymnus vel oda sacra, ψαλμός in titulis singulorum Psalmorum; Job 30,31; Judith 16,1; መዝሙረ፡ መሰንቆክሙ፡ Am. 5,23; Act. 13,33; ᾠδή Apoc. 5,9; ψαλμοί በመዝሙር፡ Jes. 66,20; Ps. 94,2; 1 Cor. 14,26; Eph. 5,19; ᾠδαί Sir. 47,17; 2 Esr. 22,36; መዝሙረ፡ጽባሕ፡ Genz. f. 72; Genz. f. 73; መጽሐፈ፡ መዝሙር፡ liber psalmorum vel psalterium Luc. 20,42; Act. 1,20 vel መዝሙር፡ Luc. 24,44; vel መጽሐፈ፡ መዝሙራት፡ ዘዳዊት፡ vid. editionem Psalm. Lud. 2 psalterium, instrumentum quo psallitur: Sir. 40,21; Ps. 32,2; Ps. 48,4; Ps. 80,2; Ps. 91,3; Ps. 149,3; Ps. 150,3; Ps. 151,2; Hez. 33,32; Sap. 19,17; (ubi var. መዝመር፡ invenitur); መዝሙር፡ νάβλαι 3 Reg. 10,12; 4 Esr. 10,28. 3 chorus psallentium, οἱ ἱεροψάλται መዝሙር፡ 1 Esr. 5,27; 1 Esr. 5,45 (at ካህናተ፡ መዝሙር፡ 1 Esr. 8,5; 1 Esr. 8,22); መዝሙረ፡ ነቢያት፡ χορός 1 Reg. 10,5; 1 Reg. 10,10.

woorden.betekenis: tempora anni, tempus, tempus statutum, ad, tempus quoddam, a
woorden.definitie: subst. (m.), Pl. አዝማን፡, rarius ዘመናት፡ ( tempora anni ), Pl. Pl. አዝማናት፡ [זְמָן زَمَنٌ et زَمَانٌ ܙܒܰܢ] tempus, tempus statutum, χρόνος Koh. 3,1; Act. 27,9; καιρός Gen. 1,14; Hen. 72,1; Apoc. 11,18; Apoc. 22,10; ዘመን፡ ወአዝማን፡ ወመንፈቀ፡ ዘመን፡ Apoc. 12,14; መዋዕል፡ ወአዝማን፡ Act. 1,7; እምቅድመ፡ መዋዕል፡ ወኵሉ፡ አዝማን፡ Clem. f. 48; እምቅድመ፡ መዋዕል፡ ወአዝማናት፡ Lit. Chrys.; ደኃሪ፡ ዘመን፡ 4 Esr. 14,4; በአዝማን፡ እለ፡ እሙራን፡ Hen. 75,4; Hen, 75,5; በውእቱ፡ አዝማን፡ Hen. 80,3; Hen. 80,6; ዘመነ፡ ኦሪት፡, ዘመነ፡ ወንጌል፡ Lud.; እስከ፡ ዘመኑ፡ ad tempus quoddam, aliquamdiu Tob. 14,4, vel እስከ፡ ዘመን፡ Hen. 90,1; Hen. 90,5; በዘመኑ፡ tempore suo Ex. 34,18; Lev. 26,4; ኵሉ፡ በበ፡ ዘመኑ፡ Hen. 2,1; እጸንሕ፡ አነ፡ እምዘመን፡ ዘመነ፡ de die in diem Sx. Sen. 11Enc. a vices: ሠለስተ፡ ዘመነ፡ τρεῖς καιρούς Ex. 23,17; Ex. 34,23; Deut. 16,16. b aetas hominis (Lebenszeit) Sx. Nah. 4Enc. c aevum, saeculum: ሰብአ፡ ዘመኑ፡ homines temporis illius Jsp. p. 308; ሰብአ፡ አዝማና፡ Jsp. p. 273; ሊቃውንተ፡ ዘመን፡ seniores qui posthac suo quisque tempore erunt F.M. 13. d tempora anni: ዘመናት Abush. 4,6 al. (vid. sub ሐጋይ፡). e tempestas: ለእመ፡ ዘመን፡ አንሥአት፡ ሞገዳ፡ Sx. Pag. 1 Enc. – (2 Reg. 22,3 interpres καιρός pro κέρας legisse videtur).

woorden.betekenis: scortari, fornicari, stuprum facere, moechari, adulterare, c
woorden.definitie: I,2 (ይዘምዉ፡ I,1 Sx. Mij. 25lapsu calami scriptum videtur); semel inveni ዘነወ፡ (Kuf. p. 121 ann. 18) [vid. ዘነየ፡, זָנָה ܙܢܳܐ زَنَى; amh. ዘማ፡] scortari, fornicari, stuprum facere, moechari, adulterare, πορνεύειν, ἐκπορνεύειν Gen. 38,24; Jer. 3,6; 1 Cor. 6,18; 1 Cor. 10,8; μοιχεύειν, μοιχᾶσθαι Ex. 20,13; Jer. 5,7; Jer. 7,9; Hez. 23,43; Matth. 5,28; Matth. 19,9; Luc. 16,18; Rom. 2,22; c. ምስለ፡ pers.: Jer. 3,8; Hez. 16,26; Hez. 16,30; F.M. 5,3; c. በ፡ pers.: Lev. 20,10; Num. 25,1; Kuf. 39; Jer. 36,23; Hez. 16,16; c. በድኅረ፡ Kuf. 7; ዝሙት፡ ዘዘመዉ፡ ትጉሃን፡ Kuf. 7; ኢዘምዎ፡ ἐγκράτεια castitas 2 Petr. 1,6; ኢዘምዎት፡ Gal. 5,23. a usurpatur de omnibus libidinibus naturae repugnantibus: ዘምዎተ፡ ብእሲ፡ ምስለ፡ ብእሲ፡ F.M. 7,1; እለ፡ ይዜምዉ፡ ተባዕት፡ ምስለ፡ ተባዕት፡ ወአንስት፡ ምስለ፡ አንስት፡ F.M. 7,4; ዘዘመወ፡ በእንስሳ፡ F.M. 7,1; F.M. 7,2; ብእሲ፡ ዘይዜሙ፡ በነፍስተ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ Sir. 23,16; c. Acc.: ዘዘመወ፡ ተባዕተ፡ F.M. 7,1; F.M. 7,3. b transfertur (ex usu loquendi biblico) α ad idololatriam: c. በ፡ numinis: ዘመወት፡ በዕፀው፡ ወበእብን፡ Jer. 3,9 vel gentilium: አንቲሂኬ፡ ዘመውኪ፡ በብዙኃን፡ ኖሎት፡ Jer. 3,1; c. ድኅረ፡ numinis quod sectantur: Ex. 34,16; Lev. 17,7; c. እምነ፡ Dei a quo deficiunt: Ps. 72,26; Hos. 4,12; Hos. 9,1; Hez. 23,5; vel እምድኅረ፡ Hos. 1,2; abs.: ኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ ኢዘመወ፡ ልቦሙ፡ Sir. 46,11; Apoc. 2,14. β ad commercia populorum gentilium inter se: Apoc. 17,2.

woorden.betekenis: scortatio, fornicatio, stupra, adulterium, impudicitia, libi
woorden.definitie: subst., fem. et m., scortatio, fornicatio, stupra, adulterium, impudicitia, libidines: πορνεία Gen. 38,24; Kuf. 7; Sir. 26,9; Matth. 15,19; 1 Thess. 4,3; Act. 15,20; ዝሙተ፡ ብእሲት፡ ምስለ፡ ብእሲት፡ F.M. 7,1; ዝሙተ፡ ብእሲ፡ ምስለ፡ ብእሲ፡ ወበእንስሳ፡ F.M. 7,1; ቤተ፡ ዝሙት፡ πορνεῖον ( domus meretricia, lupanar ) Hez. 16,39; ትርሲተ፡ ዝሙት፡ εἶδος πορνικόν (ornatus meretricius ) Prov. 7,10; incestus 1 Cor. 5,1; adulterium Matth. 19,9; Joh. 8,3; Rom. 7,3; ἀσέλγειαι 1 Petr. 4,3; 2 Petr. 2,2; Judae 4; transl. de idololatria: Jes. 47,10; Jes. 57,9; Jer. 2,20; Jer. 3,2; Jer. 3,9; Hez. 16; Hez. 23,8; Apoc. 2,21; de commercio cum populis gentilibus: Nah. 3,3; Nah. 3,4; Apoc. 17,2.

woorden.betekenis: scortum, meretrix, adultera, moecha
woorden.definitie: subst. fem., Pl. ዘማት፡ scortum, meretrix, adultera, moecha, πόρνη Gen. 34,31; Gen. 38,15; Lev. 21,14; Deut. 23,18; Jer. 3,3; Hez. 23,43; Sir. 9,6; Sir. 19,2; ብእሲት፡ ዘማ፡ Prov. 5,3; Hos. 1,2; Hebr. 11,31; ፪ አንስት፡ ዘማት፡ 3 Reg. 3 b,16; 3 Reg. 22,38; Prov. 29,3; Joel 4,3; ከመ፡ ማሕሌት፡ ዘዘማት፡ Jes. 23,15; ዘርአ፡ ዘማውያን፡ ወዘማት፡ Jes. 57,3; ኀደሩ፡ ቤተ፡ ዘማት፡ Jer. 5,7; Luc. 15,30; በከመ፡ ይገብራ፡ አንስት፡ ዘማት፡ Did. 3; Clem. f. 163; μοιχαλίς በቀለ፡ ዘማት፡ Hez. 16,38; Hez. 23,45; transl.: Jes. 1,21; ዛቲ፡ ትውልድ፡ ዘማ፡ ወኃጥእት፡ Marc. 8,38; ዘማ፡ ሠናይት፡ ወፍሥሕት፡ Nah. 3,4; ዘማ፡ ዐባይ፡ Apoc. 17,1; Apoc. 17,5; Apoc. 17,15.

woorden.betekenis: scortator, fornicator, adulter, moechus, libidine percitus,
woorden.definitie: n. ag., fem. ዘማዊት፡, Pl. m. ዘማውያን፡, fem. ዘማውያት፡ 1 m. scortator, fornicator, adulter, moechus: ብእሲ፡ ዘማዊ፡ πόρνος Sir. 23,17; κύων Deut. 23,18; F.M. 5,1; ዘማውያን፡ 1 Cor. 5,9; 1 Tim. 1,10; Apoc. 22,15; F.M. 5,8; F.M. 5,9; F.M. 5,10; μοιχός Job 24,15; አረጋዊ፡ ዘማዊ፡ Sir. 25,2; ዘማውያን፡ Jer. 57,3; Sap. 3,16; Jac. 4,4; etiam libidine percitus vel insaniens, θηλυμανής, de equis; አፍራስ፡ ዘማውያን፡ Jer. 5,7. 2 fem. meretrix, fornicatrix, moecha, adultera, impudica Prov. 5,20; Kuf. 41; Kid. f. 23; F.M. 5,1; ዘማውያት፡ Matth. 21,31; F.M. 34,8; μοιχαλίς Prov. 18,22; Rom. 7,3; Joh. 8,3; ትውልድ፡ ዘማዊት፡ Matth. 12,39.

woorden.betekenis: propinquitatis vinculis conjunctum, cognatum esse, cognatio
woorden.definitie: III,1 propinquitatis vinculis conjunctum vel cognatum esse: እሉ፡ እለ፡ ይዘመዱ፡ ወይሰናሰሉ፡ እስመ፡ ተወልዱ፡ እምአበው፡ ወእምሔውያን፡ F.N. 24,2; ለእመ፡ ዘመወ፡ ምስለ፡ ካልኣት፡ ዘትዘመድ፡ cum aliis quae (ei) cognatae sunt F.M. 5,3; ተዘምዶት፡ cognatio F.N. 10,6, vel ተዘምዶ፡, ut: ኮነ፡ ተዘምዶ፡ መንፈሳዊ፡ ማእከሌሆሙ፡ F.N. 24,2.

woorden.betekenis: cognatio, familia, stirps, genus, cognatus, cognati, consang
woorden.definitie: subst. (m.), Pl. አዝማድ፡ cognatio, familia, stirps, genus, cognatus, cognati, consanguinei, proximi, συγγένεια ዘመድ፡ Gen. 12,1; Ex. 6,16; Ex. 6,19; Ruth 2,3; Jes. 38,12; vel አዝማድ፡ Ruth 2,1; Luc. 1,61; Act. 7,14; τὸ γένος ዘመድ፡ Tob. 5,12; Act. 17,29; vel አዝማድ፡ Jer. 36,32; Jer. 43,31; Tob. 6,12; Act. 7,13; γενεά አዝማድ፡ Gen. 31,3; συγγενής ዘመደ፡ ዚአየ፡ ትከውን፡ 1 Esr. 4,42; ዘመድከ፡ ይእቲ፡ Lev. 18,14; Lev. 20,20; አዝማዲከ፡ ውእቱ፡ Tob. 6,11; Luc. 1,36; Joannes Bapt. fuit አዝማዱ፡ ለክርስቶስ፡ በሥጋ፡ Lud. e Vit. Theoph.; συγγενεῖς አዝማድ፡ Rom. 9,3; Rom. 16,7; Rom. 16,11; Dan. apocr. 1,63; οἱ ἐγγύτατοί μου አዝማድየ፡ Job 6,15; Job 19,14; Ps. 14,4; Ps. 37,12; οἰκεῖοι 1 Tim. 5,8; ዘእምባዕድ፡ ዘመድ፡ ἀλλογενής alienigena Lev. 22,12; Lev. 22,13. Cognatorum varia genera haec sunt: አዝማድ፡ ዘበሥጋ፡ vel እምከዊነ፡ ትውልድ፡ (consanguinei); አዝማድ፡ እመንገለ፡ ተዋስቦ፡ (affines); አዝማድ፡ እመንገለ፡ ሕግ፡ (spirituales); አዝማድ፡ ዘበንብረት፡ (q.v.) F.N. 24,2. a οἱ γονεῖς parentes አዝማድ፡ Matth. 10,21; Joh. 9,18; Joh. 9,19; Joh. 9,20; Joh. 9,21; Joh. 9,22; Col. 3,20; Dan. apocr. 1,3; ዘመዶ፡ ያስተኀፍር፡ Prov. 29,15; socer et socrus እምይእዜሰ፡ ዘመድኪ፡ Tob. 10,12. b majores, patres: γονεῖς አዝማድ፡ Judith 5,8; πρόγονοι Sir. 8,4; 1 Tim. 5,4. c progenies Sir. 45,13. d genus ejusdem aetatis (Geschlecht, Generation), γενεά Ex. 17,16. e gens, ἔθνη Gen. 10,32; ኵሉ፡ ዘመደ፡ እስራኤል፡ γένος Jos. 4,14. f genus humanum: ዘመደ፡ እጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ 4 Esr. 7,42; ዘመደ፡ መዋቲ፡ 4 Esr. 8,40; coll. Gen. 11,6. g genus vel species (Gattung, Art), animatorum et inanimatorum: γένος በበዘመዱ፡ Gen. 1,11; Gen. 1,12; Gen. 1,21; Gen. 1,24; Gen. 1,25; Gen. 7,14; Kuf. 3; ዘንተ፡ ዘመደ፡ ፫ ገብረ፡ Kuf. 2; እንስሳ፡ በበዘመዱ፡ Sir. 43,25; እምኵሉ፡ ዘመደ፡ ዓሣ፡ Matth. 13,47; ኵሉ፡ ዘመደ፡ መብልዕ፡ Gen. 40,17; ክልኤ፡ ዘመድ፡ ዛቲ፡ በዓል፡ (duplicis generis) Kuf. 6; quod ejusdem generis vel speciei est: አዕዋፍ፡ ምስለ፡ ዘመዱ፡ የኀድር፡ πρὸς τὰ ὅμοια αὐτοις Sir. 27,9; ኵሉ፡ እንስሳ፡ ያፈቅር፡ ዘመዶ፡ τὸ ὅμοιον αὐτῷ Sir. 13,15. h genus vel familia i.e. ordo: Act. 4,6; ኢይኩን፡ ፩ እምዘመደ፡ ካህናት፡ መዐትመ፡ F.M. 21,3. zamad, Pl. ʾazmād L አዝማድ፡ ሥጋውያን ʾazmād śǝgāwǝyān blood relatives, vid. ሥጋዊ፡ 526b

woorden.betekenis: semen spargere, seminare, serere, conserere, sator, semen im
