woorden.betekenis: satio, sementis, semen, satum, seges, olus, viride, herba, s
woorden.definitie: subst. (m.), Pl. አዝርእት፡ 1 satio, sementis: Ex. 34,21; በጽሐ፡ ጊዜ፡ ዘርእ፡ Kuf. 11; Gen. 8,22; Lev. 26,5; Am. 9,13; ዘርእ፡ ወማእረር፡ Kuf. 6. 2 semen cujusvis generis: Gen. 1,11; Gen. 1,12; Gen. 1,29; Gen. 47,19; Gen. 47,23; Lev. 11,37; Lev. 26,16; Ps. 125,7; Koh. 11,6; 4 Esr. 9,35; Matth. 13,24 seq.; 1 Cor. 15,38. 3 quae ex semine oriuntur, satum, seges, olus, viride, herba sativa: ዘርአ፡ ምድር፡ σπέρματα Dan. 1,16; γεννήματα Cant. 6,11; ሐመልማለ፡ ዘርእ፡ χλοὴ σπόρου Sir. 40,22; Hen. 80,2; 1 Reg. 8,15; Lev. 27,30; አዝርእት፡ σπέρματα Matth. 13,32; ፍሬያተ፡ አዝርእት፡ καρποί Sap. 16,22; ርኢ፡ ከመ፡ ሠርፀ፡ አዝርእቲሃ፡ (ለገራውህ፡) Rel. Bar. 4 a semen virile, sperma, Dan. 2,43; Lev. 15,3; Lev. 18,20; Lev. 18,23; ከዐወ፡ ዘርአ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ Kuf. 41; F.M. 13. b proles, soboles Kuf. 41; Gen. 3,15; Gen. 4,25; Gen. 17,7; Gen. 17,8; Gen. 38,8; Gen. 38,9; Jes. 43,5; Jes. 61,9; Ps. 36,30; Ps. 111,2; አንሥእ፡ ዘርአ፡ ለእኁከ፡ Kuf. 41; ዘርእ፡ ብእሲ፡ 1 Reg. 1,11; Pl. አዝርእት፡ posteri Act. 7,6 rom.; Gal. 3,16; F.N. 42,10; Epil. Evang. Joh. in N.T. rom. α stirps, gens, genus: Ps. 68,42; እምዘርአ፡ ሜዶን፡ Dan. 9,1; ዘርእ፡ ቅዱስ፡ 2 Esr. 9,2. β proles singularum aetatum sese excipientium, aetas: ፲ወ፬ አዝርእት፡ (14 Generationen) M.M. f. 161.

woorden.betekenis: spargere, dispergere, dissipare, dispersisti vias tuas, circ
woorden.definitie: I,1, rarius I,2 [זָרָה ܕܪܳܐ ذرا; vicinum ዘርአ፡ et ዘርዘረ፡] Subj. I,1 ይዝሩ፡ 1 spargere, dispergere, dissipare, Matth. 25,24; Matth. 25,26; ዘረዎ፡ (ለሐመድ፡) ውስተ፡ ሰማይ፡ Ex. 9,10; እዘሩ፡ ኀፍረተ፡ ውስተ፡ ገጽክሙ፡ Mal. 2,3; እዘሩ፡ (v. እዜሩ፡) አብድንቲክሙ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምስለ፡ አማልክት፡ Lev. 26,30; 2 Reg. 16,13; ይዘርዎ፡ ለበረድ፡ πάσσει Sir. 43,17; διασπείρειν, διασκορπίζειν, c. Acc. rei vel pers.: Gen. 11,9; Jes. 24,1; Jes. 41,46; Ps. 52,7; Job 18,15; nubem Job 37,10; ዝርዉ፡ Dan. 4,11; Jer. 13,14; Jer. 23,1; Jer. 23,2; Jer. 28,20 seq.; Zach. 1,21; Joh. 10,12; Luc. 1,51; እዘሩ፡ አብድንቲሆሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ፍናው፡ Jer. 14,16; ከመ፡ እዝርዎሙ፡ ውስተ፡ አሕዛብ፡ Hez. 20,23; Jer. 9,16; Lev. 26,33; እዘርዎሙ፡ ማእከለ፡ አሕዛብ፡ Kuf. 1; እዘርዎሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ነፋሳት፡ Hez. 5,10; ራብዕቶ፡ ትዘሩ፡ በነፋስ፡ Hez. 5,2. a ዘሮኪ፡ ፍናዊኪ፡ διέχεας dispersisti vias tuas i.e. circumvagata es Jer. 3,13. b ዘረዎሙ፡ ለአሕዛብ፡ ውስተ፡ ትዕይንቶሙ፡ ወውስተ፡ ማኅፈዶሙ፡ al. dispersit i.e. huc illuc dimisit Judith 7,32. 2 dissipare opes a in malam partem: prodigere, disperdere, ዘሮኪ፡ ውርቅየ፡ Hez. 16,36; Luc. 15,13; Luc. 16,1; Did. 10; ዘሪዎቱ፡ ንዋየ፡ ለመብልዕ፡ ወመስቴ፡ F.M. 17,4; ዘኢይዘሩ፡ ንዋየ፡ ቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ ለወፍረ፡ ቤቱ፡ Clem. f. 86. b in bonam partem: effundere, liberaliter erogare, dilargiri, ዝሩ፡ እክለከ፡ ላዕለ፡ መቃብረ፡ ጻድቃን፡ Tob. 4,17; ዘረወ፡ መክፈልተ፡ ንዋዩ፡ ላዕለ፡ አብያተ፡ ክርስቲያናት፡ Phlx. 1; 2 Cor. 9,9; ለነዳያን፡ ዘረወ፡ (ንዋዮ፡) Sx. Ter 11 Enc.; Sx. Ter 26 Enc. 3 ventilare, ventilando segregare: ዘረወ፡ ኢምእመናነ፡ እምነ፡ ጉባኤ፡ Sx. Haml. 5 Enc. – Voc. Ae.: ዘረወ፡ ዘ፡ በተነ።

woorden.betekenis: se dispergere, dispergi, dissipari, diffundi
woorden.definitie: III,1 se dispergere, dispergi, dissipari, diffundi, Jes. 11,12; Jes. 33,3; Tob. 14,4; Gen. 10,18; Ps. 21,14; Ps. 67,1; Joh. 16,32; Matth. 26,31; ጽጌያት፡ ዘተዘርወ፡ 4 Esr. 3,47; እምህየ፡ ተዘርዉ፡ ውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ አህጉሪሆሙ፡ Kuf. 10; Kuf. 3; Sir. 48,15; Esth. 9,19; ተዘርዉ፡ በውስተ፡ አሕዛብ፡ Joel 4,2; Hez. 34,6 seq.; ወርቆሙ፡ ይዘሮ፡ ውስተ፡ መርሕብ፡ Hez. 7,19; de lepra quae se diffundit, Lev. 13,55; Lev. 14,39; de pugna 1 Reg. 14,23; 2 Reg. 18,8.

woorden.betekenis: serere
woorden.definitie: serere vid. sub ዘርአ፡

woorden.betekenis: brachium, lacertus, cum humero, armus, manica, Aermel, fulcr
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., nonnumquam coll., Pl. መዛርዕ፡, [זְרוֹעַ אֶזְרוֹעַ ܕܪܳܥܳܐ ذِرَاعٌ] brachium, ( lacertus, brachium cum humero ): βραχίων Jes. 9,22; Jes. 15,2; Jes. 40,11; Dan. 2,32; ተመጠውክዎ፡ ዲበ፡ መዝራዕትየ፡ Hos. 11,3; ታጸንዕ፡ መዝራዕተከ፡ Hez. 4,7; Ps. 17,37; Ps. 88,11; Ps. 88,21; መዝራዕተ፡ እደዊሆሙ፡ Gen. 49,24; Cant. 8,6; ሰላም፡ ለመዛርዒኪ፡ ወለኵርናዕኪ፡ I Sal. Mar. 22; መዛርዕ፡ እለ፡ ሥጋ፡ 2 Par. 32,8; ὦμος Job 31,22 (ubi βραχίων እድ፡ versum est); imago roboris et potentiae satis frequens: Ex. 6,1; Ex. 6,6; Ps. 97,2; Hez. 30,20; Hez. 30,21; Hez. 30,22; Hez. 30,23; Hez. 30,24; Hez. 30,25; በመዝራዕት፡ ልዑል፡ v. ልዕልት፡ Jer. 21,5; ልዑል፡ መዝራዕትከ፡ Jes. 26,11; Jes. 51,5; Jes. 52,10; Jes. 63,5; ዘዐቢይ፡ መዝራዕቱ፡ Job 26,2; Job 35,9; Job 38,15; Job 40,4; Luc. 1,51. a armus bestiarum: βραχίων Ex. 29,27; Num. 6,19; Deut. 18,3; ὦμος Hez. 24,4. b manica ( Aermel ) vestis: መዛርዐ፡ ቀሚሱ፡ F.M. 31,5 (vid. sub መንዲል፡ col. 195). c ምዕራፈ፡ መዛርዕ፡ fulcra brachiorum, ἀγκῶνες sellae 2 Par. 9,18. d brachium i.e. sinus maris, Act. 27,39 rom. – Voc. Ae.: መዝራዕት፡ ብ፡ ማኸል፡ አገዳ፡; aliud: ብ፡ ወርች።

woorden.betekenis: dispergi, dissipari, discuti, dispelli, disjici, discerpi, e
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 dispergi, dissipari: Hen. 89,75; Hen. 90,33; discipuli de resurrectione colloquentes aiunt: ይትከሀልኑ፡ ዘማሰነ፡ ወዘተዘርዘረ፡ ሐይወ፡ Kid. f. 36. 2 discuti, dispelli, disjici: ይዘርዘር፡ ኵሉ፡ ፍጥረታተ፡ (genera) ሕምዝ፡ Lit. 169,1; Kid. f. 9; de morbis, Lud. e Ssal. Req.; ሶበ፡ ጸለየ፡ ቅዱስ፡ ማእከለ፡ እሳት፡ ተዘርዘረ፡ ውእቱ፡ እሳት፡ ወወፅአ፡ ቅዱስ፡ እምኔሁ፡ Sx. Hed. 19. 3 discerpi (coll. شَرْشَرَ): አዘዘ፡ ይሥትርዎሙ፡ በአጽፋረ፡ ኀጺን፡ ከመ፡ ይዘርዘር፡ ሥጋሆሙ፡ Sx. Tachs. 12. (Quas Lud. statuit significationes enervari, hebescere, irritum esse, impropriae sunt).

woorden.betekenis: uter, scorteus, culeus
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., Pl. ዝቃት፡ [زِقٌّ] uter ( scorteus ), culeus: Job 13,28; Ps. 32,7; Ps. 77,16; Ps. 118,83; ዝቀ፡ ማይ፡ Kuf. 17; ዝቀ፡ ወይን፡ 1 Reg. 10,3; 1 Reg. 16,20; Jos. 9,2; Job 32,18; Jer. 13,12; ዝቃት፡ Jos. 9,11; Matth. 9,17; ይመልኡ፡ ኆፃ፡ ውስተ፡ ዝቃት፡ θυλάκους ἄμμου πληρώσαντες Chrys. Ta. 19. – Voc. Ae.: ዝቅ፡ ዘ፡ ሰን፡ ረወታት፡; aliud: ዝቅ፡ ብ፡ የማስ፡ ጋን፡; aliud: ዝቅ፡ ዘ፡ የወሀ፡ አቆማዳ።

woorden.betekenis: fimus, stercus, instrumentum, ferreum, aeneum, squama ferri
woorden.definitie: subst. [ܙܶܒܠܳܐ זֶבֶל زِبْلٌ] fimus, stercus: contaminabant urbem እንዘ፡ ይገብሩ፡ ውስቴታ፡ ኵስሐ፡ ወዝብለ፡ ወኵሎ፡ ምግባረ፡ ፁግ፡ Macc. f. 14(Secundum Ludolfi Gregorium significat ዝብል፡ 1 omne instrumentum sive ferreum sive aeneum. 2 squama ferri.) – Voc. Ae.: ዝብል፡ ዘ፡ ፈስ።

woorden.betekenis: mactare, ad sacrificandum, immolare, sacrificare
woorden.definitie: I,1 [זבח ܕܒܚ ذبح; vid. ጠብሐ፡] Subj. ይዝባሕ፡ 1 mactare: ዘብሑ፡ ዳቤላ፡ ጠሊ፡ Kuf. 34. 2 in specie mactare ad sacrificandum, immolare, sacrificare, rarius in bonam partem (de hostiis Deo oblatis, vid. ሦዐ፡): Ex. 29,28; Ex. 34,25; ዘብሐት፡ ዘዚአሃ፡ ጥብሐ፡ Prov. 9,2; Lit. Epiph.; ዘቢሐ፡ መሥዋዕት፡ Prov. 16,5; crebrius in malam partem: Hos. 4,13; ይዘብሑ፡ ውሉዶሙ፡ ለአጋንንት፡ Kuf. 1; Ps. 105,35; Jes. 57,5; Hez. 23,39; Clem. f. 246; መሥዋዕቶሙ፡ ለአብዳን፡ ይዘብሑ፡ Kuf. 22; 1 Cor. 8,1; Clem. f. 249; ዘብሑ፡ በህየ፡ ለአማልክት፡ Hez. 20,28; F.M. 16,5.

woorden.betekenis: immolatus, quod, Diis, idolisve, immolatum, est, idolothytum
woorden.definitie: part. immolatus, in specie quod Diis idolisve immolatum est, idolothytum, sive adjecto ለአማልክት፡ vel ለጣዖት፡, ut Act. 15,29; 1 Cor. 8,10; 1 Cor. 10,28; Apoc. 2,14; Did. 33, sive omisso: Macc. f. 8; qui fidem suam abnegaverit ወበልዐ፡ ዝቡሓቲሆሙ፡ (sc. gentilium) ወዘብሐ፡ ምስሌሆሙ፡ F.M. 16,5; Ananias Azarias Misael ኢፈቀዱ፡ ከመ፡ ይብልዑ፡ እምዝቡሓት፡ ባዕዳን፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ዝቡሓተ፡ ደቂቀ፡ እስራኤል፡ Sx. Genb. 10.

woorden.betekenis: fragmentum, segmentum
woorden.definitie: subst., Pl. ዘብርታት፡ [زُبْرَةٌ] fragmentum, segmentum: ዘብርታተ፡ ኀዲን፡ βῶλοι σιδήρου Sir. 12,15.

woorden.betekenis: eminendo, collis, collum, locus terrae altior, portandum sus
woorden.definitie: subst. (m.) Pl. ዘባናት፡ [dictum ab eminendo: زَابِنَةٌ collis in valle; زَبُّونَةٌ collum, coll. ዲበ፡, ደብር፡, زُبْيَةٌ locus terrae altior; زَبَا portandum suscepit; زُبْرَةٌ dorsi pars inter scapulas, دُبْرٌ دُبُرٌ tergum, postica pars ] 1 dorsum, tergum, νῶτος, νῶτον, ተሰብረ፡ ዘባኑ፡ (v. ዐፅመ፡ ዘባኑ፡) 1 Reg. 4,18; አዕፅምተ፡ ዘባኑ፡ Job 40,13; መጠውኩ፡ ዘባንየ፡ ለመቅሠፍት፡ Jes. 50,6; Hez. 1,18; Job 15,26; Gen. 49,8; ሰላም፡ ለዘባንኪ፡ I Sal. Mar. 20; ያገብኦ፡ ድኅረ፡ ዘባኑ፡ Sir. 21,15; ሜጡ፡ ዘባኖሙ፡ Zach. 7,11; Jer. 31,39; Ps. 80,6; ሜጡ፡ ዘባኖሙ፡ ኀቤየ፡ Jer. 2,27; Jer. 39,33; እመይጠክሙ፡ ዘባነክሙ፡ Mal. 2,3; ዘባኖሙ፡ መንገለ፡ ቤተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ τὰ ὀπίσθια Hez. 8,16; ዘባናት፡ Gen. 9,23; Ps. 68,28; Hez. 10,12; Rom. 11,10; Lit. 171,2. a de inanimatis: በዘባነ፡ ባሕር፡ እንዘ፡ ይሰፍሕ፡ ልብሶ፡ Sx. Masc. 18 Enc. b latus: በዘባነ፡ ባሕር፡ ἐπί νώτου θαλάσσης Num. 34,11; Num. 34,15; Jos. 18,16; Jos. 18,18. 2 cauda, οὐρά Job 40,12; ማእሰ፡ ዘባኑ፡ Job 40,26. 3 limbus vestis [coll. زَوْبَرٌ زِٸْبِرٌ]: ዘባኑ፡ ለልብስ፡ λῶμα ὑποδύτου Ex. 36,32. – Voc. Ae.: ዘባን፡ ዘ፡ ጄርባ።

woorden.betekenis: verberare, percutere, plagas infligere, ferire, pulsare, cae
woorden.definitie: I,1 [cfr. ኀፈጠ፡ et radices sub ኀፈጠ፡ comparatas; dubium an etiam שׁבט ܫܒܛ huc referendum sit] Subj. ይዝብጥ፡ verberare, percutere, plagas infligere, ferire, pulsare, c. Acc.: ለአድግ፡ ዝብጦ፡ ῥάβδος ὄνῳ Sir. 30,33; Num. 22,23 seq.; በበትር፡ ይዘብጠከ፡ Jes. 10,24; Prov. 23,13; Prov. 23,14; ዝብጦ፡ ለወልድከ፡ παίδευε Prov. 19,18; ዘይዘብጥ፡ አባሁ፡ ወእሞ፡ Ex. 21,15; Ex. 2,11; Kuf. 4; Kuf. 47; Jes. 58,4; Jer. 44,15; Matth. 21,35; Matth. 24,49; Act. 18,17; avis illa ይዘብጥ፡ ገበዋቲሁ፡ በክነፊሁ፡ Clem. f. 225; c. Acc. et ላዕለ፡ vel ውስተ፡ vel ዲበ፡ membri: ዘበጦ፡ ላዕለ፡ ቍየጹ፡ Jsp. p. 328; ይዘብጡክሙ፡ ውስተ፡ መላትሒክሙ፡ Mich. 4,14; ነሥአ፡ እብነ፡ ወዘበጦ፡ ዲበ፡ ድማሑ፡ ወቀተሎ፡ Clem. f. 9; omisso Accusativo c. ዲበ፡ vel ውስተ፡, ut Ps. 128,3; ዝብጥ፡ ዲበ፡ … Am. 9,1; Judith 13,8; absol.: ዘአፍጠነ፡ እዴሁ፡ ለዘቢጥ፡ Kedr f. 79; 1 Tim. 3,3 Platt; ዘኢይዘብጥ፡ μὴ πλήκτης Tit. 1,7; ካህን፡ ዘይዘብጥ፡ Syn. vid. . 311. a caedere, ferire gladio Matth. 26,51; Luc. 22,50; ዘበጠት፡ ውስተ፡ ክሣዱ፡ ካዕበ፡ በኀይላ፡ ወመተረት፡ ርእሶ፡ Judith 13,8. b baculo excutere ( triturare ) frumentum vel legumina: ῥαβδίζειν Ruth 2,17; Jud. 6,11; τινάσσειν Jes. 28,27. c pulsare vel tundere, malleo: ዘይዘብጥ፡ በሰፌልያሁ፡ Jes. 41,7; ariete: ተከሉ፡ መዋግዐ፡ ዘነፍጥ፡ ከመ፡ ይዝብጡ፡ ቦቶን፡ ቅጽረ፡ Jsp. p. 365. d malleo percutere et ducere metallum, ἐλαύνειν Ex. 25,12; Jes. 41,7. e transl.: verberare i.e. agitare, concutere, ut: ሐመር፡ ዘይዘብጥዋ፡ መዋግድ፡ ወነፋሳት፡ Clem. f. 128; Apoc. 6,13; Jac. 1,6. f excutere ignem, ἐκτινάσσειν Dan. apocr. 3,25. g decutere fructus arboris: ወፍሬ፡ ዘይጦን፡ ዘበጦ፡ Lud. ex Sx. Masc. 3Enc. h pulsare tympanum 1 Reg. 21,13; chordas plectro: ትንሥእ፡ መሰንቆ፡ ወትዘብጥ፡ Jes. 23,16; Gen. 4,21; ይቤ፡ ለመሰንቃዊ፡ ዝብጥ፡ መሰንቆከ፡ Fal. f. 54.

woorden.betekenis: verberari, percuti, pulsari, percelli
woorden.definitie: III,1 verberari, percuti, pulsari, percelli: ሥልሰ፡ ተዘበጥኩ፡ በአብትር፡ (ait Paulus) ho. Severiani in Cyr. f. 123; ስገም፡ ተዘብጠ፡ (sc. grandine) Ex. 9,31; Ex. 9,32; ከበሮ፡ ዘይዘበጥ፡ 1 Cor. 13,1 Platt; ኅሊና፡ ይዘበጥ፡ mens percellitur, Lit. Chrys.

woorden.betekenis: verberatio, percussio, verber, plaga, ictus, pulsus mallei,
woorden.definitie: n. ag. et subst., fem. et m., Pl. ዝብጠታት፡ 1 verberatio, percussio, verber, plaga, ictus, F.N. 47; ዝብጠት፡ ወቅጥቃጤ፡ διακοπὴ καὶ συντριβή Prov. 6,15; πληγαί Prov. 20,30; Prov. 29,15; ሞተ፡ ፊልጶስ፡ በውእቱ፡ ዝብጠት፡ Jsp. p. 280; ዘበጦ፡ በሰይፍ፡ አሐተ፡ ዝብጠተ፡ Jsp. p. 292; ይደልዎ፡ ፵ ዝብጠት፡ Jsp. p. 301; ተዘከር፡ ዘንተ፡ ዝብጠተ፡ ዘዘበጥኩከ፡ Jsp. p. 328; አንብር፡ አፉየ፡ ላዕለ፡ ዝብጠታቲሆሙ፡ (sc. vulneratorum) Jsp. p. 367; Hen. 69,6; Hen. 69,12; Org. 4; Phlx. 191. 2 ictus vel pulsus mallei, Fid. Jac. Bar. 3 pulsatio instrumenti musici: ከመ፡ ዝብጠተ፡ መሰንቆ፡ ወዕንዚራ፡ Macc. f. 20; Org. 3.

woorden.betekenis: haec, hanc
woorden.definitie: , ዛተ፡ haec, hanc fem. sing. pronominis ዝንቱ፡, q.v.

woorden.betekenis: elatus fuit et multum se extendit, exundavit, bullivit, glor
woorden.definitie: I,1 [زَخَرَ elatus fuit et multum se extendit, exundavit, bullivit; gloriatus est; Lud. scripsit ዘሀረ፡, quare Ges. in thes. p. 408 זהר زهر comparandum censet, at scriptio ዘኀረ፡ et in libris Mss. frequentior et rectior est] gloriari: ኢይዝኀር፡ ኀያል፡ በኀይሉ፡ Jer. 9,23 var.; Rom. 11,18 var; Sir. 11,4 var.

woorden.betekenis: gloriatio, jactantia, fastus, insolentia, ambitio, nimia sui
woorden.definitie: subst., fem. et m., 1 gloriatio, jactantia, fastus, insolentia, ambitio, nimia sui admiratio: ትዕቢት፡ ወምክሕ፡ ወትዝኅርት፡ ያማስኖ፡ ለባዕል፡ Sir. 21,4; καύχημα Zach. 12,7; 1 Cor. 5,6; ὕβρις Jes. 9,9; Jes. 13,11; ὑπερηφανία 1 Reg. 17,28; Ps. 73,24; Hez. 7,20; Am. 8,7; Rom. 12,3; ለብዙኃን፡ አስሐቶሙ፡ ትዝኅርቶሙ፡ ἡ ὑπόληψις αὐτῶν Sir. 3,24; αὐθαδία Jes. 24,8. 2 rixa, contentio, certandi libido, Sir. 28,11; ἔρις Sir. 40,9; ἐριθεία Phil. 1,17.

woorden.betekenis: pluit, grandinat, ningit, fundere pluviam, pluvia rigare
woorden.definitie: I,1 (semel inveni ዘነመ፡ Macc. f. 5 a) Subj. ይዝንም፡ [referendum videtur ad זָרַם, זֶרֶם, vid. § 32, d; vid. etiam ሠረመ፡] pluit: ሶበ፡ ይዘንም፡ Sir. 40,13; Jes. 30,23; Matth. 16,3; Jac. 5,18; ዝናም፡ ኢዘንመ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ 3 Reg. 17,7; Apoc. 11,6; Jac. 5,17; Kedr f. 41; ዘንመ፡ በይእቲ፡ ሌሊት፡ ዐቢይ፡ ዝናም፡ Jsp. p. 318; ዝናም፡ ኢዘንመ፡ በውእቱ፡ ዓመት፡ Jsp. p. 330; ኢዘንመ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ዝናም፡ Macc. 5 b. a de rore: ለእመ፡ ኢዘነመ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ጠለ፡ አርሞንኤም፡ Macc. f. 5 a, et de aliis rebus, quae pluviae instar cadunt: ዘንመ፡ እሳት፡ Luc. 17,29; ይዘንም፡ መሣግር፡ ላዕለ፡ ኃጥኣን፡ Ps. 10,7. b de grandine: በረድ፡ ይዘንም፡ grandinat Ps. 67,15, et nive: ይዘንም፡ በረድ፡ ningit Sir. 43,13. c fundere pluviam: ወትዘንም፡ (ደመና፡) ዐቢየ፡ ዝናመ፡ 4 Esr. 2,57; Jes. 5,6 var. d pluvia rigare: ከመ፡ ይዝንም፡ ዝናም፡ ብሔረ፡ ኀበ፡ አልቦ፡ ሰብእ፡ Jes. 38,26. { Cfr. etiam ዘነመ፡ et ዘለመ፡ in }

woorden.betekenis: pluere facere, jubere, grandinare facere, pluviae instar dem
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 pluere facere vel jubere, de Deo: ኢያዝነመ፡ ዲበ፡ ምድር፡ Gen. 2,5; Kuf. 12; ያዘንም፡ ከመ፡ ዝናም፡ ኀያል፡ Jes. 30,30; Jer. 14,22; Ep. Jer. 52; ኣዘንም፡ ውስተ፡ ገጸ፡ አሐቲ፡ ሀገር፡ Am. 4,7; ያዘንም፡ ለክሙ፡ ጸዳየ፡ ወመፀወ፡ Joel 2,23; seq. ዝናመ፡ Matth. 5,45. a grandinare facere: ኣዘንም፡ በረደ፡ Ex. 9,18; አዝነመ፡ ላዕለ፡ ሕዝብ፡ Sir. 46,6. b alias res pluviae instar demittere: እሳተ፡ ወትየ፡ Gen. 19,24; Hez. 38,22; መና፡ Ps. 77,28. 2 pluviam demittere vel fundere, de nube: እኤዝዝ፡ ደመና፡ ከመ፡ ኢያዝንም፡ (v. ኢይዝንም፡) ላዕሌሁ፡ Jes. 5,6.

woorden.betekenis: pluvia, imber, tempus pluvium, hiems, casus nivis, ningor, r
woorden.definitie: subst. m. et fem. (ut 2 Par. 6,26; Hen. 100,12), Pl. ዝናማት፡ pluvia: Gen. 7,4; Ex. 9,33; Deut. 11,17; 1 Reg. 12,17; 1 Reg. 12,18; Ps. 104,30; Koh. 11,3; Prov. 5,10; 4 Esr. 2,58; Hen. 2,3; Jer. 14,4; Judith 8,31; Act. 14,17; Hebr. 6,7; ዝናመ፡ ክረምት፡ Hez. 34,26; Job 37,5; ይትከዐው፡ ዝናም፡ እምውስተ፡ ደመና፡ Job 36,27; ደመና፡ ዝናም፡ Sir. 32,26; Jes. 18,4; ሶበ፡ ይወርድ፡ ዝናም፡ እምሰማይ፡ Jes. 55,10; ዝናመ፡ ረከበ፡ 4 Esr. 8,49; ዝናመ፡ ተወን፡ ወመፀው፡ ὑετὸς πρώϊμος καὶ ὄψιμος Jer. 5,24; ዝናመ፡ ክረምት፡ ዘቀዳሚ፡ ወዘደኃሪ፡ Hos. 6,3; ዝናመ፡ ጸዳይ፡ ወመፀው፡ Zach. 10,1; ዝናም፡ ብዙኅ፡ Sx. Hed. 25Enc.; ዝናማት፡ Kuf. 12; ወረዱ፡ ዝናማት፡ Clem. f. 24; ዝናማት፡ እሙራት፡ Prov. 25,14; ባርክ፡ ነፋሳት፡ ሰማይ፡ወዝናማት፡ Lit. 164,4; Kedr f. 14; Sx. Haml. 10Enc. a imber: ኀያል፡ ዝናም፡ Job 38,25; Job 38,26; Job 38,27; Job 38,28; ዝናመ፡ ሞገድ፡ Prov. 28,3; ዝናም፡ ከመ፡ አይኅ፡ Hez. 13,11; Matth. 7,25; Matth. 7,27; ዝናመ፡ ድምሳሴ፡ (sc. diluvii) Sx. Ter 6 Enc. b tempus pluvium ( hiems ): ስድስተ፡ ወርኀ፡ ዝናም፡ Kuf. 12; ማእከለ፡ ጸዳይ፡ ወዝናም፡ Kuf. 29. c casus nivis, ningor: ነኪር፡ ለልብ፡ ዝናሙ፡ Sir. 43,18. d ros, δρόσος, አኮኑ፡ ዝናም፡ ያቈርሮ፡ ለመርቄ፡ Sir. 18,16; ዝናም፡ እምከመ፡ ወረደ፡ Sir. 43,22.

woorden.betekenis: cauda
woorden.definitie: subst., Pl. አዝናብ፡ [זָנָב ܕܰܘܢܒܳܐ ذَنَبٌ] cauda, animalium Ex. 4,4; ዘነበ፡ ከልብ፡ Prov. 26,17; Apoc. 9,10; Apoc.12,4; ዘነበ፡ አፍራስ፡ Sx. Masc. 22; አዝናብ፡ Apoc. 9,19; Jud. 15,4; ሞቱረ፡ ዘነብ፡ Lev. 22,23; cometae, Chr. L. Atq. f. 23; transl.: ርእስ፡ ወዘነብ፡ Jes. 9,14; Jes. 19,15; Deut. 28,13. – Voc. Ae.: ዘነብ፡ ዘ፡ ዥራት፡ (v. ጅራት፡).

woorden.betekenis: crabrones, vespae
woorden.definitie: subst., Pl. (i.q. زَنَابِيرُ a زُنْبُورٌ vel زِنْبَارٌ) crabrones, vespae: አመ፡ መጽአ፡ ንጉሠ፡ ፋርስ፡ ኀበ፡ ሀገረ፡ ንጽቢን፡ ወዐገታ፡ አምጽአ፡ ቅዱስ፡ (sc. Jacobus Nisibensis) ላዕለ፡ ሰራዊቱ፡ ደመና፡ ዘናቢር፡ ወትንንያ፡ ወነደፍዎሙ፡ ለአፍራሲሆሙ፡ Sx. Ter 18.

woorden.betekenis: hic haec hoc, hicce, iste, jam, ecce jam decima vice, hic, i
woorden.definitie: pron. demonstr. (vid. ዝ፡), fem. ዛቲ፡, Acc. m. ዘንተ፡, fem. ዛተ፡, Pl. m. እሎንቱ፡ fem. እላንቱ፡, Acc. m. እሎንተ፡ fem. እላንተ፡ (gramm. § 146,1,a), rariores sunt formae Pl. m. እሉንቱ፡ (Jer. 49,2 Cod. Abb. LV; Luc. 3,8 rom.; Herm. p. 69 a), Acc. እሉንተ፡ (Jes. 49,21; Did. ed. Platt p. 5); Pl. fem. እላንቲ፡ (Cyr. f. 106; Cyr. f. 109), hic haec hoc: ዝንቱ፡ ሕልም፡ Gen. 37,6; ዝንቱ፡ ሕዝብ፡ Marc. 7,6; ይፀርፍ፡ ዝንቱሰ፡ Matth. 9,3; ዝንቱ፡ ውእቱ፡ ኦሪት፡ Matth. 7,12; ዛቲ፡ ትውልድ፡ Marc. 8,12; Marc. 12,43; አኮ፡ ዘንተ፡ Joh. 18,40; ዘንተ፡ ነገረ፡ Joh. 19,8; ዛተ፡ ሌሊተ፡ Ruth 3,13; Marc. 4,13; እሎንቱ፡ Gen. 31,38; Hen. 5,8; እሎንተ፡ 1 Par. 9,22; Jes. 49,21; Matth. 10,5; Matth. 13,53; እላንቱ፡ ግብ፡ Gen. 37,20; Zach. 5,10; እላንቱ፡ ኵሎን፡ Hez. 16,5; እላንተ፡ Gen. 21,30; Ruth 3,17; Jes. 10,10; Asc. Jes. 11,39. a monstrando: hicce, iste, ut: ዝንቱ፡ ይስማዔል፡ Gen. 17,18; Gen. 24,65; Gen. 38,28; Ex. 32,31; Jud. 5,5; Ps. 103,26; Cant. 8,5; Jes. 63,1; Luc. 7,44; Luc. 22,59. b contemtim: iste, ut 1 Reg. 10,27; ምንትኑ፡ ዝንቱ፡ Sir. 13,23. c crebro usurpatur pro neutro Latinorum: ምንት፡ ዝንቱ፡ Ruth 3,16; Jes. 47,7; Jes. 48,1; Jer. 9,12; Ps. 41,4; 4 Esr. 6,23; 4 Esr. 13,33; 4 Esr. 13,34; 4 Esr. 13,35; 4 Esr. 13,36; 4 Esr. 13,42; Luc. 24,21; 1 Joh. 1,4; እሎንተ፡ ταῦτα Jer. 5,25; Hen. 5,1; እላንተ፡ Asc. Jes. 11,36; Hen. 82,1. d ubi de tempore agitur, passim jam vertere licet: ናሁ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ፪ ዓመት፡ 1 Reg. 29,3; ናሁ፡ ዓሥር፡ ዝንቱ፡ ecce jam decima vice Num. 14,22; Num. 22,32; Jud. 16,15; ናሁ፡ ሣልስከ፡ ዝንቱ፡ Num. 22,28; Num. 24,10; 2 Cor. 13,1. e hic – ille, unus – alter, alius – alius: ዝንቱ፡ – ዝንቱ፡ Ps. 74,7; Ps. 74,8; እምዝንቱ፡ ውስተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ይትፋለስ፡ ሕልም፡ Sir. 31,3; ዝንቱ፡ ቡሩክ፡ ወውእቱኒ፡ ቡሩክ፡ ወዝንቱ፡ ምስለ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ኮነ፡ ለቅዳሴ፡ Kuf. 2; ዝንቱ፡ ምስለ፡ ዝንቱ፡ alius cum alio Kuf. 3; ይትቃተሉ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ Kuf. 5; vel ዝንቱ፡ – ዝኩ፡ sive ዝክቱ፡ hic – ille Sir. 39,16; Sir. 39,21; Sir. 39,34; Dan. 2,43 (vid. ዝኩ፡). f cum praepositionibus: α በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ideo, hanc ob causam, propterea Jes. 49,4; Jes. 50,7; Jes. 59,9; Zach. 1,16, (vid. በእንተ፡), vel እንበይነ፡ ዝንቱ፡, vel በበይነ፡ ዝንቱ፡ (vid. col. 537). β በዝንቱ፡ hoc in loco, hic Sx. woorden.definitie: et ዝክቱ፡ pron. demonstr. ille, iste (gramm. § 146,1,b). Compositum est ex ዝ፡ et ኩ፡, quare nonnumquam particula brevissima ሰ፡ inter ዝ፡ et ኩ፡ inseritur, ut: ዳኅንኑ፡ ዝሰኩ፡ አቡክሙ፡ Gad. Za Mich.; ዝሰኩ፡ ዘምስሌከ፡ Deg. – 1 Ejus formae sunt a α Sing. ዝኩ፡ m., raro fem. (Ex. 1,17; ዝኩ፡ አንስት፡ Herm. p. 84 b); Acc. ዝኰ፡ (Apoc. 1,12 Platt; Rom. 7,15 Platt; Rom. 7,19 Platt; Hen. 89,44; Hen. 89,51; Gen. 27,17 var; Hez. 23,32 var; 1 Reg. 9,24; Zach. 11,13; Tob. 9,5 var; Dan. 8,16; Jer. 13,4), vel ዝኩ፡ (Gen. 27,17; 4 Reg. 2,21; Hez. 23,32; Tob. 9,5); fem. እንትኩ፡ (Hen. 85,5; Marc. 11,21 rom.; እንትኩ፡ ራእይ፡ እንተ፡ ርእየ፡ Gad. Kar. ); Acc. እንትኩ፡ vel እንትኰ፡ vel እንተኩ፡ Prov. 15,18. β Pl. c. እልኩ፡ (Hen. 9,8; Hen. 89,1; Ex. 7,12; Matth. 25,7; Matth. 25,8; 1 Thess. 5,6; 1 Cor. 14,28). b α Sing. ዝኵቱ፡ et plerumque ዝክቱ፡ m. (Luc. 20,35 rom.; Gen. 9,6; Ex. 32,1; Ruth 4,1; 1 Reg. 2,26 al. crebro), Acc. ዝኵተ፡ vel ዝክተ፡ (Gen. 27,16; Ex. 34,1; Lev. 1,8; Lev. 14,7; Num. 5,18; Num. 5,25; Deut. 1,19; Jos. 21,40; Sir. 39,34; Jac. 4,15; ዝኵተ፡ Org.); fem. እንታክቲ፡ Hen. 85,6; Ruth 2,6; Ex. 2,8; 1 Reg. 1,26; Hez. 36,35; Hez. 38,14; 4 Esr. 3,38; Marc. 11,21; Jac. 4,13; Rom. 8,18), Acc. እንታክተ፡ nondum reperi. β Pl. c. እልኵቱ፡ vel እልክቱ፡ (Luc. 13,4 rom.; fem. etiam እላክቱ፡ Jos. 4,11. 2 Usurpatur a ad demonstranda remotiora: ille, iste, ἐκεῖνος, ut: እንታክቲ፡ ምድር፡ Hez. 36,35; በእንታክቲ፡ ዕለት፡ Hez. 38,14; Zach. 2,4; Dan. 8,16; አብትረ፡ እልኩ፡ Ex. 7,12; Gen. 19,9; Deut. 1,19; 2 Reg. 19,7; 3 Reg. 3 b,25; Jes. 44,5; Dan. 2,43; Hez. 33,5; Sir. 39,16; Sir. 39,21; Sir. 39,34; 4 Esr. 8,54; 4 Esr. 8,55; Jac. 4,15; vel እልክቱ፡ – እሉ፡ Jos. 8,22; rarius ዝክቱ፡ – ዝክቱ፡ ἡ μὲν – ἑτέρα δέ Sir. 14,18; ዝኵቱ፡ – ውእቱ፡ iste – ille Org. 2. β ille i.e. futurus, venturus: አንተኩ፡ τὴν μέλλουσαν Prov. 15,18; Rom. 8,18; Luc. 20,35; 4 Esr. 8,55. γ contemtim: Gen. 37,19; Ex. 32,1; Jud. 9,38. b ad demonstrandam personam vel rem modo memoratam et notam: is, ut: ህየንተ፡ ደመ፡ ዝክቱ፡ ἀντὶ τοῦ αἵματος αὐτοῦ Gen. 9,6;
