woorden.betekenis: circumeundi, circumagendi, conglobare, in unum, cogere
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., quae, cognata cum دال a significatu circumeundi et circumagendi profecta deinde significat conglobare ut buccellam, placentam (Ges. thes. p. 311 sub דבל), denique in unum cogere, colligere (دبل).

woorden.betekenis: hircus, caper, hirci, hircos, aries, agni masculi, taurus, V
woorden.definitie: et ደቤላ፡ subst., m., Pl. ዳቤላት፡ et ደቤላት፡ 1 mas pecoris caprini et ovilli, a hircus, caper: ደቤላ፡ ዘጠሊ፡ τράγος αἰγῶν Dan. 8,5 seq., ዳቤላ፡ ጠሊ፡ Kuf. p. 123(coll. Gen. 37,31); ማእከለ፡ በግዕ፡ ወበግዕ፡ ወማእከለ፡ በሐኵ፡ ወዳቤላ፡ (v. ደቤላ፡) κριῶν καὶ τράγων Hez. 34,17; ፯ ደቤላት፡ Kuf. p. 64 (Vers. Lat.: hirci ); አብሓኰ፡ ወአባግዐ፡ ወደቤላተ፡ (Vers. Lat.: arietes et oves et hircos ) Kuf. p. 119; Kuf. p. 116(ubi Vers. Lat. deest); aries autem in libro Kuf. exponitur በሐኵ፡ (quod nunc, Versione Latina inspecta, ad በሐኵ፡ col. 499 annotare juvat). b aries, Hen. 90,10; Hen. 90,11; Hen. 90,12; Hen. 90,13; Hen. 90,14; Hen. 90,15; Hen. 90,16; Hen. 90,31 (ubi ex አባግዕ፡ nascuntur መሓስዕ፡ agni masculi, qui inde a commate 10 ዳቤላት፡ nominantur). — Dubia est significatio in his loci: ደቤላተ፡ (v. ዳቤላተ፡) ወአብሓኰ፡ ወአስዋረ፡ κριοὺς καὶ μόσχους καὶ τράγους Hez. 39,18 (at ex Hez. 34,17 sequi videtur, interpretem non κριοὺς sed τράγους ዳቤላት፡ vertisse); ናሁ፡ አነ፡ እፈትሕ፡ ማእከለ፡ ደቤላ፡ ወጠሊ፡ Did. 6(ed. Platt p. 40) ex Hez. 34,17 (ubi quid Vers. Aeth. habeat, videas supra sub Nr. a). 2 mas pecoris bubuli, taurus, Sx. Mij. 30, ubi refertur, Christianos ecclesiae primitivae Alexandriae aedificasse ecclesiam satis notam ውስተ፡ ዐጸደ፡ አልህምት፡ ኀበ፡ ጽንፈ፡ ባሕር፡; in eam irruptione facta Alexandrinos ethnicos Marcum Evangelistam cepisse et laqueum collo ejus injecisse ወሰሐብዎ፡ ውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሀገር፡ እንዘ፡ ይብሉ፡ ንስሐቦ፡ ለዳቤላ፡ ውስተ፡ ዐጸደ፡ ላህም፡; deinde in Sx. Enc.: ሰሐብዎ፡ በአሕባል፡ ውስተ፡ ዐጸደ፡ ስምዕ፡ ከመ፡ ዳቤላ፡; praeterea M.M. f. 43, ubi legitur: ማርቆስ፡ ወንጌላዊ፡ ሰበከ፡ በአድያመ፡ ግብጽ፡ ወለእስክንድርያ፡ ሰሐብዎ፡ ውስተ፡ ኰኵሕ፡ እንዘ፡ ይብሉ፡ ንስሐቦ፡ ለዳቤላ፡ ዘላህም፡ ወተክዕወ፡ ደሙ፡ ውስተ፡ አስኳት፡ — Voc. Ae.: ዳቤላ፡ ዘ፡ የፍየል፡ አውራ፡; በሐኵ፡ ዘ፡ የበግዕ፡ አውራ፡ [Hoc vocabulum quondam in libro das Buch Henoch, übersetzt und erklärt 1853 p. 279 cum amh. ዳቦል፡ c atulus (Isenb. p. 165) composui, et collatis دُبْلٌ دَوْبَلٌ دُوَيْلٌ asellus, دَوْبَلٌ porculus nefrens proprie fetum et pullos bestiarum significare censui, a ደበለ፡ vel دال eodem fere modo ductum, quo እጕል፡; እጓል፡ עֵגֶל a גלל. At usus loquendi supra descriptus non pullum vel juvencum sed marem indicat, quare videas, annon ዳቤላ፡ a coëundo dictus sit (coll. זבל de hominibus Gen. 30,20). Plane reprobandum est, quod nonnulli conjecerunt, ዳቤላ፡ a δάμαλις ductum esse].

woorden.betekenis: mons, locus editus, umbilicus, tergum, eminendo, pone esse,
woorden.definitie: subst. m., rarius fem. (ut 3 Reg. 16,24 var.) [huic nomini plerique conferunt samar. טבר mons, טַבּוּר locus editus, טִיבוּר umbilicus; sed etiam arab. دُبْرٌ tergum ab eminendo dictum videtur, et significationes radicum دبر et דבר pone esse al. secundariae sunt; vicinum est I ደበበ፡] Pl. አድባር፡, Pl. Pl. አድባራት፡ 1 mons Gen. 22,14; Ex. 19,2 seq.; Ex. 24, 2 seq.; Deut. 4,16; Ps. 2,6; Ps. 14,1; Ps. 23,3; ደብር፡ ነዋኅ፡ Job 40,15; Jes. 14,13; Jes. 25,6; ደብር፡ ዐቢይ፡ ወነዋኅ፡ Jes. 57,7; Jer. 3,6; ደብረ፡ ዘይት፡ Zach. 14,4; ደብረ፡ ቅብእ፡ 2 Reg. 15,30; Matth. 4,8; Matth. 5,1; Matth. 5,14; Matth. 17,20; Matth. 21,21 al. crebro; ደብር፡ ብዱት፡ (fem.) Sx. Nah. 13; አድባር፡ ነዋኃት፡ Gen. 7,19; Ps. 94,4; Jer. 2,20; Deut. 12,2; አድባር፡ ነዋኃን፡ Hen. 1,6; አድባር፡ ነዋኅ፡ Jes. 14,13; Jes. 30,25; Job 9,5; Job 28,9; Sir. 43,16; አድባረ፡ እስራኤል፡ Hez. 6,2; 2 Reg. 1,21; 4 Reg. 17,10; Hen. 18,6; Hen. 24,2; Apoc. 17,9 al.; de montibus ignivomis vid. Clem. f. 32. a in Gen.: montanus: ut: ሣዕረ፡ ደብር፡ χόρτος ὀρεινός Ρrov. 27,24. b ደብር፡ nonnumquam montes, montanum, regio montana, ut Deut. 33,2; Jos. 17,16; Jos. 20,7; Jos. 21,11; Jud. 1,19; 1 Reg. 22,14; ደብረ፡ አሱር፡ Kuf. 8, et crebrius አድባር፡ Jos. 11,21; አድባረ፡ አርሞን፡ Sir. 24,13; አድባረ፡ አራራት፡ Kuf. 8; Gen. 8,4; ἡ ὀρεινή Jud. 1,9; Jos. 2,16; አሕጉረ፡ አድባር፡ Jer. 40,13; Judith 1,6; Judith 2,22; Judith 5,3. c ደብረ፡ ሀገር፡ 2 Reg. 20,19 et ደብረ፡ አህጉር፡ metropolis Jos. 14,15; Jos. 15,13; Jos. 21,11; Jes. 1,26. d (በዓል፡) ዘደብረ፡ ታቦር፡ festum transfigurationis vid. sub ታቦር፡; ዘደብረ፡ ዘይት፡ dominica montis oliveti est dominica jejunii quadragesimalis quarta, Cod. Mus. Brit. XXXII (Catal. p. 38); cfr. Lud. Comm. hist. p. 386. 2 finis, terminus (cfr. etiam amh. ድምብር፡ nec non aeth. ደወል፡) terrae, regionis: ደብር፡ Gad. Ad. f. 167; አድባር፡ ὅρια fines Gen. 10,19; Gen. 47,21; Ex. 7,27; Ex. 10,4; Ex. 10,14; Ex. 13,7; Ex. 23,31; Num. 32,33; Deut. 3,16; Mich. 5,5; Matth. 4,13; in specie አድባራት፡ dioecesis episcopi, F.M. 31,1 al. crebro; Sx. Masc. 13. 3 a monasterium sive coenobium (vid. . III,3,40): Reg. Pach.; Sx. Masc. 7; Sx. Teq. 1; Sx. Mag. 27; ደብረ፡ ሊባኖስ፡ monasterium Abyssiniae celeberrimum; nomina multorum aliorum recenset Lud. lex. Aeth. col. 503; Pl. አድባር፡, ut: አድባረ፡ ገዳም፡ Lud. ex Sx. Jac. 14Enc.; plerumque አድባራት፡ Gad. T.H.; Abush. 50; Sx. Masc. 7al. b regio monasteriorum, ubi plura vel multa coenobia sunt, ut: መዳልወ፡ አልባብ፡ ተሰምየት፡ እስከ፡ ዮም፡ ደብሩ፡ Sx. Mag. 27Enc. (vid. መድሎት፡); አባ፡ መቃርስ፡ ዘደብረ፡ አስቄጥስ፡ Sx. Masc. 10. 4 ደብር፡, Pl. ደብራት፡ vid. sub ዳብር፡ dabr C a part of n. pr. (place name) vid. e.g. ደብረ፡ መክዳ፡ b for ሊቀ፡ ደብር፡ vid. ሊቅ፡ (TraCES) c for ምሳሐ፡ ደብረ፡ ጽዮን vid. ምሳሕ፡ (TraCES)

woorden.betekenis: eminere, superiorem esse, Rad, Abb
woorden.definitie: inus., cui significationem eminere vel superiorem esse infuisse ipsa vocabula derivata ostendunt; vicinum est ደብር፡ — Rad. Abb.: ደበበ፡ ዘ፡ ዘረጋ።

woorden.betekenis: regio elata, alta, septentrio, plaga septentrionalis, septen
woorden.definitie: subst. (m.) [sec. Lud. „fortassis a sidere ursae (ἄρκτος ድብ፡) dictum“; at etiam Abyssinis ድብ፡ nomen astri coelestis fuisse, nondum probatum est. Nescio an rectius a I ደበበ፡ ducere liceat vocabulum, ut proprie sit regio elata vel alta (perantiquum enim videtur nomen et ex antiquis Geez populi sedibus traditum). Sed omnia incerta sunt, quare nomen seorsum ponendum videbatur] 1 septentrio, plaga septentrionalis, βοῤῥᾶς 4 Reg. 16,14; 2 Par. 14,10; Koh. 11,3; Jes. 14,13; Jes. 14,31; Jes. 41,25; Jes. 49,12; Jer. 3,18; Jer. 4,6; Jer. 6,22; Jer. 10,22; Jer. 13,20; Jer. 26,6; Jer. 26,10; Jer. 26,20; Jer. 26,24; Jer. 27,3; Jer. 27,41; Jer. 29,2; Dan. 8,4; Hez. 8,3; Hez. 8,5; Hez. 9,2; Hez. 26,7; Hez. 32,30; Joel 2,20; Zeph. 2,13; Am. 8,12; Zach. 2,6; Zach. 6,8; Luc. 13,29 rom.; Lit. 175,4; ደቡበ፡ septentrionem versus Lit. 170,3. (In Oct., Ps. aliisque libris መስዕ፡ vel ምዕዋን፡ frequentari solet). 2 aquilo Cant. 4,16. 3 Abyssinis horum saecolorum sicut ሰሜን፡ (vid. col. 334) in significatum septentrionalis, ita ደቡብ፡ in significatum meridionalis plagae abiit (vid. etiam Isenb. sub ሰሜን፡ et ደቡብ፡), quae significationum permutatio etiam in libros Bibliorum recentiores passim intrusa est, vid. praeter locos sub ሰሜን፡ allegatos etiam Luc. 13,29 Platt; Dan. 8,5 (λίψ); νότος Hez. 40,24; Hez. 40,27; Hez. 40,44.

woorden.betekenis: tabernaculum, tentorium, Voc, Ae, aliud, Canonicus, debtera,
woorden.definitie: subst., fem., rarius m., Pl. raro ደብተራት፡, plerumque ደባትር፡ [ni fallor, est nomen a Graecis petitum, sc. ἡ διφθέρα] 1 tabernaculum, tentorium: Jes. 33,20; Jer. 10,20; Judith 6,10; Judith 10,20; Judith 14,13; Sx. Haml. 5; ተከለ፡ አብራም፡ ደብተራሁ፡ Kuf. 13; Gen. 31,25; Jes. 38,12; ይተክሉ፡ ምጽላሎሙ፡ (v. ደብተራሆሙ፡) Jer. 6,3; ከመ፡ ትትሐነጽ፡ ደብተራሁ፡ Tob. 13,10; ዘያቀውም፡ ደብተራሁ፡ Sir. 14,25; ተነሥተ፡ ደብተራየ፡ (v. ደባትር፡) αἱ δέῤῥεις μου Jer. 4,20 በደብተራ፡ (v. በደባትር፡) ተኀድሩ፡ Jer. 42,7 seq.; መትሕተ፡ ደብተራ፡ ሠቅ፡ ὑποκάτω δέῤῥεων 1 Par. 17,1; de tabernaculo foederis sacro: Ex. 26,1 seq.; Ex. 33,7; Lev. 1; Lev. 4al.; Jos. 18,1; Kuf. 49; Ps. 26,11; Ps. 77,66; በውስተ፡ ደብተራሁ፡ ቅዱስ፡ Sir. 24,10; Sir. 24,15; Hebr. 9,11; Pl. ደብተራት፡ Macc. f. 1; Macc. f. 15; ደባትር፡ Ex. 33,10; Lev. 23,43; Hez. 25,4; Ps. 77,32; 2 Reg. 11,11. — Voc. Ae.: ደብተራ፡ ዘ፡ ደበና፡ (i.e. tentorium regis, vid. Lud. lex. amh. col. 83); aliud: ደብተራ፡ ብ፡ እንደ፡ ሰቀላ፡ ያለ፡ ድንኳን። 2 „Vulgo etiam sic vocatur Canonicus, qui ex Levitis originem ducit, ut putant, quorum officium in templis Aethiopicis est cantare et crotala pulsare“ Lud. e Tellez. L. I. col. 39 f. 95; at sec. Isenb. in lex. p. 166, et sec. Harris I p. 269; Harris I p. 360; Harris II p. 104(ubi modo debtera modo deftera scriptum est) homo literatus, qui nominis significatus et ipse a διφθέραι ductus est (sicut دفتر, دفتردار). dabtarā, Pl. dabtarāt, dabātǝr 1 አስቃቀ፡ ደብተራ፡ ፰ ‘8 tele per il tabernacolo,’ 43 VI l. 29 (ed.), 36 l. 30 (tr.); ወአስቀቀ፡ ደብተራ፡ ፯፡ ‘7 tele da sacco per il tabernacolo,’ 64 l. 15 (ed.), 53 l. 22 (tr.) X ደብተራ፡ መንግሥት፡ dabtarā mangǝśt royal tent ወአብሖ፡ ከመ፡ ይፀዓን፡ በዘይፄዓን፡ ለሊሁ፡ ወይፃእ፡ ፅዑነ፡ እምደብተራ፡ መንግሥት፡ ጊዜ፡ ፀአተ፡ ታቦት። ‘And he allowed him to ride on what he himself rides and to get out sitting out of the royal tent at the time the Tabot comes out’ 58 § 108 (ed.), 33 § 108 (tr.), vid. መንግሥት፡ 2 ወአቃጽንሂ፡ ይሠይም፡ ንቡረ፡ እድ፡ እምደብተራ፡ ‘Le ʾaqāṣen élira le nebura ed en le choisissant parmi les dabtarā’ 9 l. 21–22 (ed.), 9 l. 30–31 (tr.); ወደብተራሂ፡ ዓቅባ፡ ክርስቶስ። ‘et le dabtarā ʿĀqbā Krestos’ 30 l. 16–17 (ed.), 35 l. 7 (tr.); ወደብተራ፡ አስጐላች፡ ፋሲለደስ፡ ‘le dabtarā, qui a obtenu la concession du fief (?asgualāč), Fāsiladas’ 36 l. 17–18 (ed.), 43 l. 5–6 (tr.); በእደ፡ ፍታው፡ የተሰሩ፡ እጨጌ፡ ብላታ፡ ገብረ፡ ሕይወት፡ ደ[ብተራ]፡ ምናሴ፡ ደ[ብተራ]፡ ጐሹ፡ ደ[ብተራ]፡ ገብረ፡ እግዚእ። ‘Dans Eddā Fetāw, ont été nommés: l’eč̣č̣agē, le belāttā Gabra Ḥeywat, le dabtarā Menāsē, le dabtarā Guašu, le dabtarā Gabra Madḫen.’ 61 l. 15–17 (ed.), 73 l. 24–26 (tr.) X ደብተራ፡ ማዕጠንት፡ dabtarā māʿṭant unordained member of the clergy responsible for performing incensation ግብሮሙ፡ ለደብተራ፡ ማዕጠንት፡ ‘Les dabtarā de l’encensoir (qui font le service de l’encens) donneront (ou soigneront)’ 10 l. 24 (ed.), 11 l. 7–8 (tr.); ወማእከላዊ፡ አክሱም፡ ፸፡ ወ፬፡ ቤተ፡ ማዕጠንት፡ ደብተራ፡ ይነድቁ። ‘l’enceinte moyenne doit être bâtie par les 74 familles des dabtarā de l’encensoir’ 11 p. 20–21 (ed.), 12 l. 7–8 (tr.), vid. ማዕጠንት፡ C ● for ሊቀ፡ ደብተራ፡ vid. ደብተራ፡ (TraCES) L ደብተራ dabtarā (pl. dabtarāt, dabātǝr) tabernacle, (royal) tent, hut, pavillon, sanctuary, (by extension) unordained memeber of the clergy who is well-versed in traditional church learning and who performs hymns and sacred dances during the Mass, cantor, chorister 122a ደብተራ፡ ዘመርጡር dabtarā zamarṭur tabernacle of the testimony, vid. መርጡር 361b

woorden.betekenis: obrepere, ex improviso supervenire, repente invadere, irruer
woorden.definitie: I,1 [vic. ደበወ፡ et II ደበበ፡ et ዴፐ፡] Subj. ይድቢ፡ 1 obrepere, ex improviso supervenire (überraschen), c. Acc.: ይበውኡ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ወይደብይዎሙ፡ εἰσελεύσονται εἰς αὐτὰ ἀφυλάκτως Hez. 7,22. 2 repente invadere, irruere, insilire, irrumpere in aliquem (überfallen, einbrechen), c. Acc.: ይበዩኒ፡ እለ፡ አልቦሙ፡ ምሕረት፡ ἐπέβησάν μοι Job 30,21; Ps. 37,11; ንድብዮ፡ 2 Esr. 16,10 var.; ይደቢ፡ አብያተ፡ ሰብእ፡ Act. 8,3 Platt; Act. 17,5; ኢይከውኖ፡ ኀዲጎ፡ ዘዘዚአሁ፡ በሓውርተ፡ ባዕደ፡ ይደቢ፡ (sic) καταλείψαντα τὴν ἑαυτοῦ παροικίαν ἑτέρᾳ ἐπιπηδᾶν, II Can. Ap. 12; ከመ፡ ኢይድብያ፡ ለቤተ፡ ክር ስቲያን፡ M.M. f. 78; etiam de inanimatis praedicatur, ut: እፎ፡ ዘኢያንቀልቀሉ፡ (Perf.) መሠረታተ፡ አውግር፡ ከመ፡ ይድብዩከ፡ M.M. f. 31. — Voc. Ae.: ደበይዎ፡ ዘ፡ አስፈገምዎ፡; aliud: ይደቢ፡ ብ፡ ይበረብራል፡; Rad. Abb.: ደበየ፡ ዘ፡ ዘረፈ።

woorden.betekenis: parvus vilisque fuit, in usum futuri temporis paravit
woorden.definitie: vel ድኅረ፡ rad. eadem, quae אחר, ܐܚܪ ܐܘܚܪ et ܝܘܚܪ, اخر, አኀረ፡ (vid. 91); vicina sunt دَخَرَ posthabitus i.e. parvus vilisque fuit, ذَخَرَ in usum futuri temporis paravit (etiam دخر VIII), ደሐረ፡

woorden.betekenis: pone, post, retro, a parte posteriori, partem posteriorem, v
woorden.definitie: cum compositis, praep. et conj. I Praep. 1 loci: a ድኅረ፡ pone, post, (et c. pron. suff. reflex. retro): አግባእክኒ፡ ድኅረ፡ ዘባንኪ፡ Hez. 23,35; Sir. 21,15; ድኅረ፡ ማዕጾ፡ Jes. 57,8; Gen. 9,23; Gen. 18,10; Gen. 19,26; Gen. 33,2; Num. 10,25; ያገብኦሙ፡ ድኅሬሆሙ፡ ለጠቢባን፡ Jes. 44,25; ገብኡ፡ ድኅሬሆሙ፡ Jer. 7,24; Jer. 26,5; Thren. 1,13; Joel 2,14; Prov. 25,9; Ps. 6,10; Matth. 4,19; Matth. 10,38; Phil. 3,14; የሐውር፡ ድኅሬሆሙ፡ Lit. Chrys. b እንተ፡ ድኅረ፡ pone, a parte posteriori: Cant. 2,9; Matth. 9,20; Luc. 8,44; Apoc. 12,15. c በድኅረ፡ pone, post: በድኅሬየ፡ Hez. 3,12; Zach. 7,14; Jer. 12,6; Matth. 15,23; Marc. 5,27; ዘመዉ፡ በድኅረ፡ አዋልደ፡ ሰብእ፡ post filias i.e. eas secuti Kuf. p. 31. d መንገለ፡ ድኅረ፡ partem posteriorem alicujus versus Jud. 18,12. e እምድኅረ፡ α a post, ne sit (amplius) post 2 Reg. 2,21; Ps. 77,76; Matth. 4,10; Matth. 16,23; ትዜሙ፡ ምድር፡ እምድኅረ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Hos. 1,2. β a parte posteriori alicujus, Apoc. 1,10; Ex. 14,9; Ex. 14,19. Nota Ex. 25,38, ubi interpres τὸν ἐπαρυστῆρα vertit ዘእምድኅሬሃ፡ pars ejus posterior („tamquam ab ὕστερος“ Lud.). 2 temporis: a rarius ድኅረ፡ post: ድኅሬሁ፡ 4 Esr. 4,l; Sx. Sen. 4 Enc.; postremo post Marc. 12,5; 1 Cor. 15,6; et b rarissime በድኅረ፡ Hen. 65,4. c creberrime እምድኅረ፡ post: Gen. 7,10; Gen. 8,3; Gen. 8,6; Gen. 9,28; Gen. 10,1; Gen. 16,3; Ex. 12,41; Num. 26,1; 1 Reg. 11,1; Matth. 1,12; Matth. 3,11; Matth. 17,1; Matth. 22,27; Matth. 24,29; Matth. 25,19; Matth. 27,62; Marc. 1,8; Luc. 1,24; Luc. 9,28; Luc. 15,13 al. sexcenties; እምድኅረዝ፡ vel እምድኅረ፡ ዝንቱ፡ post haec, postea Matth. 4,2; Matth. 21,29; Marc. 16,14; Joh. 5,1; Ex. 5,1; Joh. 2,12; Joh. 6,1 al.; እምድኅረ፡ ሕቅ፡ Marc. 14,70 et ሕቀ፡ Herm. p. 80 paulo post; እለ፡ እምድኅሬከ፡ posteri tui Sir. 41,3; እስከ፡ እምድኅሬሁ፡ Gen. 17,19. <II< Conj. 1 Raro ድኅረ፡ postquam: Sx. Genb. 21 Enc.; Sx. Hed. 7 Enc.; Sx. Ter 21 Enc. al. 2 plerumque እምድኅረ፡ seq. Perf.: Gen. 5,4; Gen. 27,1; Gen. 39,5; Num. 6,19; Deut. 12,30; Kuf. 7; Jer. 36,2; Judith 16,25; 4 Esr. 9,13; Matth. 27,53; Marc. 1,14; Marc. 16,19 al. creberrime. >II> <III< adv. ወይትነሣእ፡ ወየሐውር፡ ይምነ፡ ወፅግመ፡ ቅድመ፡ ወድኅረ፡ Er pflegte sich zu erheben, nach rechts und links, nach vorn und hinten zu gehn. Kebr. Nag. 25,12 17b l. 22 (ed.), 15 (tr.); ከማሁ፡ ይረውጹ፡ በሰረገላ፡ ዘአልቦ፡ ቅድመ፡ ወድኅረ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ተሀውኮ፡ ይምነ፡ ወፅግመ። So eilten sie auf dem Wagen dahin, ohne nach vorn oder nach hinten, nach rechts oder nach links zu schwanken Kebr. Nag. 52,18 57a l. 24 (ed.), 46 (tr.) see also ድኅር >III>

woorden.betekenis: retro, retrorsum, rursum, retroversus, a tergo, pone
woorden.definitie: adv. (Acc. a ድኅሪት፡) 1 retro, retrorsum, rursum: 1 Reg. 4,18; ከመ፡ ይደቁ፡ ድኅሪተ፡ Jes. 28,13; Thren. 1,8; Gen. 9,23; Jer. 15,6 gloss.; ኢገብኡ፡ ድኅሪተ፡ Lud. ex Sx. Haml. 25Enc. Passim latine adjectivo retroversus interpretandum est, ut: የሐርስ፡ ድኅሪተ፡ Luc. 9,62; ገጾሙ፡ ድኅሪተ፡ Kuf. 7; እንዘ፡ እሱራን፡ እሙንቱ፤ እደዊሆሙ፡ ድኅሪተ፡ Mavâs. 22. 2 retro i.e. a tergo, pone, 1 Reg. 29,3 (coll. 2.).

woorden.betekenis: posterior, postremus, ultimus, novissimus, dies novissimus,
woorden.definitie: adj., fem. ደኃሪት፡, Pl. m. ደኃርያን፡ fem. ደኃርያት፡, c. ደኀርት፡ 1 Adj. a posterior (opp. priori), de loco: Deut. 34,2; Zach. 14,8 var.; Joel 2,20; de ordine et tempore: Ruth 3,10; Deut. 24,3; Apoc. 2,19; እለ፡ ተርፉ፡ ቃላተ፡ አዝያስ፡ ደኀርት፡ ወቀደምት፡ 2 Par. 26,22 al.; ደኃርያን፡ Hen. 37,2; Hen. 37,3; መጻሕፍት፡ ዘቀዳሚ፡ ወዘደኃሪ፡ i.e. V. et N. Testamenti, Syn. in 313. b postremus, ultimus, novissimus, de loco: ደኃርያን፡ Num. 2,31; de ordine: ደኀርት፡ Matth. 19,30; Matth. 20,8; Matth. 20,14; ደኃርያት፡ Apoc. 21,9; de tempore: Jes. 41,4; Ps. 138,4; አግሪጳስ፡ ውእቱ፡ ደኃሪ፡ እምእለ፡ ነግሡ፡ ላዕለ፡ አይሁድ፡ Jsp. p. 342; ድኃሪት፡ ዕለት፡ dies novissimus Clem. f. 97; Clem. f. 105; Joh. 6,39; Joh. 11,24; እስትንፋስ፡ ደኃሪት፡ Lit. 164,3; በደኃሪት፡ ትውልድ፡ Asc. Jes. 11,38; 1 Joh. 2,18; በደኃሪ፡ መዋዕል፡ Jes. 2,2; Jer. 23,20; Jer. 25,18; Jer. 37,24; Dan. 2,28; 1 Tim. 4,1; 2 Tim. 3,1; 2 Petr. 3,3; 4 Esr. 8,60; 4 Esr. 8,71; እስከ፡ ደኃሪ፡ መዋዕል፡ 4 Esr. 6,50; ደኀርት፡ Koh. 1,11; Koh. 4,16; 2 Esr. 8,13. 2 Pro Subst. usurpatur a rarius m. ደኃሪ፡ novissimum, finis, exitus: 4 Esr. 9,5; 4 Esr. 9,7 var.; ደኃሪሃ፡ ለፍርሀተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ጥበብ፡ συντέλεια Sir. 21,11; ወዘሂ፡ ይከውን፡ በደኃሪ፡ Jes. 46,10; ትዘከር፡ ዘደኃሪ፡ Lud. e Vit. Barb.; አመ፡ ደኃሪ፡ postremo Sx. Pag. 5 Enc. b crebro fem. ደኃሪት፡ novissimum, finis, exitus: ደኃሪት፡ τὰ ἔσχατα Jes. 41,22; በደኃሪት፡ ἐπʼ ἐσχάτου Jes. 41,23; ደኃሪታ፡ (ለፍኖት፡) τὰ τελευταῖα αὐτῆς Prov. 14,12; 4 Esr. 1,30; Job 23,8; ደኃሪታ፡ (ለሐሰት፡) Sir. 7,13; ደኃሪቱ፡ ለስም፡ እኩይ፡ ኀሳር፡ Sir. 6,1; sermonis Koh. 10,13; in specie α tempus posterius, sors posterior, finis vitae: Job 8,7; Job 42,12; 4 Esr. 10,43; በደኃሪቱ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ይትዐወቅ፡ ምግባሩ፡ Sir. 11,27; ተዘከራ፡ ለደኃሪትከ፡ Sir. 7,36; አመ፡ ትበጽሕ፡ ደኃሪትከ፡ Sir. 30,32; Sir. 19,3; Sir. 18,12; Sir. 6,28; Sir. 3,31; Sir. 2,3; Koh. 7,3; Jes. 47,7; Jer. 17,11; Ps. 38,5. β posteritas, posteri: ኢይተርፍ፡ ዘርእ፡ ሎቱ፡ ወደኃሪት፡ Kuf. 7.

woorden.betekenis: postremus, ultimus, posterior
woorden.definitie: vel ዳኅራይ፡ adj. rel., fem. ዳኅሪት፡ postremus, ultimus Jes. 44,6 (v. ደኃራዊ፡); Org.; posterior: Hebr. 10,9 rom.; ባሕር፡ ዳኅሪት፡ Zach. 14,8 in Cod. Laur.

woorden.betekenis: posterior, ultimus, postremus, novissimus
woorden.definitie: et ደኃራይ፡ adj. rel. 1 posterior: Hebr. 10,9 Platt; 1 Cor. 15,48; ህርቃኖስ፡ ደኃራዊ፡ Jsp. p. 321. 2 ultimus, postremus, novissimus: Sir. 24,28; Jes. 41,4 var.; Jes. 44,6 var.; Apoc. 1,17; Apoc. 22,13.

woorden.betekenis: salvum evadere, elabi, salvum, incolumem fieri, servari, lib
woorden.definitie: I,1 [amh. ዳነ፡; ni fallor, cum ደሐለ፡ et radicibus sub ደሐለ፡ laudatis componendum] Subj. ይድኀን፡ 1 salvum evadere vel elabi; 1 Reg. 30,17; 2 Reg. 1,3; Job 1,15; Jer. 48,15; Gen. 14,13; Gen. 32,9; Ps. 123,7; Hen. 52,7; ድኂኖ፡ እምባሕር፡ Act. 28,4; ድኅነ፡ ጢጦስ፡ በይእቲ፡ ዕለት፡ እምቀትል፡ ፫ ጊዜያተ፡ Jsp. p. 357. 2 salvum vel incolumem fieri, servari, liberari: Hen. 48,7; Hen. 50,3; 4 Reg. 23,18; Jer. 8,20; Jes. 1,27; እለ፡ ድኅኑ፡ Jes. 10,20; እለ፡ ድኅንክሙ፡ Jes. 45,20; Sap. 16,7; Job 18,19; Job 21,10; Job 22,30; Sir. 31,15; Sir. 46,8; Ps. 21,5; Ps. 32,16; Ps. 79,4; Ps. 79,8; ከመ፡ ይድኀኑ፡ Kuf. p. 161; አልቦ፡ ድኂን፡ Kuf. p. 145; ደኀን፡ Gen. 19,17; ብፁዕ፡ ዘድኅነ፡ እምኔሃ፡ σκεπασθεὶς ἀπʼ αὐτῆς Sir. 28,19; ከመ፡ እድኀን፡ እሞት፡ Sir. 51,9; Prov. 15,24; ከመ፡ ይድኀኑ፡ እምእደ፡ ኃጥኣን፡ Kuf. p. 86; 2 Esr. 9,8; እምዕጹብ፡ ይድኅን፡ ሠያጢ፡ እምኀጢአት፡ Sir. 26,29; Hen. 103,13; Sx. Mij. 23Enc.; ልደተ፡ ዓለም፡ ለድኂን፡ σωτήριοι αἱ γενέσεις τοῦ κόσμου Sap. 1,14; መዋዕለ፡ ድኂን፡ ἡμέραι φρουραί Esth. 9,26 seq.; Esth. 10apocr. a liberum vel immunem esse a culpa et poena: ይድኅን፡ እምኀጢአት፡ Ex. 21,18; 4 Reg. 10,9; 1 Petr. 4,1. b sensu theologico: salvari, salutem adipisci divinam et aeternam, Matth. 10,22; Matth. 19,25; Matth. 24,13; Joh. 5,34; Rom. 8,24; 1 Cor. 1,18; Eph. 2,5; Eph. 2,8 al. 3 incolumem vel salvum esse vel manere: ይእቲ፡ ዕፅ፡ ድኅነት፡ Herm. p. 62.

woorden.betekenis: liberare, servare, eripere, salvare, salus, libertati restit
woorden.definitie: II,1 liberare, servare, eripere, salvare: ያድኅን፡ በዕለተ፡ ምንዳቤ፡ Sir. 2,11; ስእኑ፡ አድኅኖ፡ Job 4,20; c. Acc.: Jud. 10,14; Mich. 4,10; Jer. 1,8; Jer. 2,27; Jer. 2,28; Koh. 9,15; Sir. 29,17; Sir. 31,13; አድኅኑ፡ ግፉዐ፡ Jes. 1,17; Jes. 19,20; Jes. 36,14; Jes. 36,15; ያድኀኖ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለእስራኤል፡ መድኀኒተ፡ ዘለዓለም፡ Jes. 45,17; Ps. 53,1; Ps. 53,4; Matth. 8,25; Matth. 14,30; አድኅን፡ ርእሰከ፡ Matth. 27,40; Gen. 19,19; ነፍሰከ፡ Gen. 19,17; Jer. 31,6; Hez. 3,19; Hez. 3,21; Hez. 33,9; c. እምነ፡, እምውስተ፡ Ps. 17,20; Ps. 33,5; Ps. 53,7; Ps. 58,1; Ps. 58,2; Ps. 68,18; Ex. 14,30; Ex. 18,9; Ex. 18,10; አድኀነኒ፡ እምነ፡ ማየ፡ አይኅ፡ Kuf. 7; Job 5,19; Job 29,2; Job 33,30; Jer. 20,13; Sap. 16,8; Joh. 12,27; Hebr. 5,7; አድኅኖ፡ vel አድኅኖት፡ salus: Ps. 3,8; Ps. 9,15; Ps. 97,5. a libertati restituere, redimere, Ex. 21,8; Jes. 41,14; Jes. 43,1; Jes. 44,23. b servare vel reservare 4 Esr. 9,24. c sensu theologico: salvare, salvum reddere, Matth. 18,11; Joh. 12,47; Rom. 11,14; 1 Cor. 1,21; 1 Cor. 7,16; 1 Cor. 9,22 al.; እምኀጣውእ፡ Matth. 1,21. d culpa liberare vel excusare, Lud. e Vit. Barbarae. e sensu forensi: fide interposita liberare aliquem i.e. vadem fieri vel vadimonium facere (vid. ተድኅነ፡ et መድኅን፡): በእንተ፡ ሕቢት፡ ወአድኅኖ፤ ሎሙ፡ ፪ ፍናዋት፤ አድኅኖሰ፡ ዘነፍስ፡ ውእቱ፡ ወተሐብዮ፡ ዘንዋይ፡ F.N. 27.

woorden.betekenis: se vadem dare, vadimonium obire, vadimonium pro N.N. meum es
woorden.definitie: III,1 se vadem dare, vadimonium obire, c. Acc. pers. pro qua quis vas est, c. ለ፡ ejus cui vadimonium promittit, et c. ለ፡ seq. Infin. verbi: ወመድኅነ፡ ነፍስኒ፡ ይደልዎ፡ ከመ፡ ያምጽእ፡ ዘተድኅነ፡ (eum pro quo se vadem dedit) ወይኩን፡ ቃለ፡ ዛቲ፡ ተድኅኖ፡ ከመ፡ ይበል፡ ተድኅንኩ፡ ለአብጽሖተ፡ እገሌ፡ ለእገሌ፡ አው፡ ተድኅንኩ፡ ለእገሌ፡ ገጸ፡ እገሌ፡ (pro persona N.N.) አው፡ ተድኅኖተ፡ እገሌ፡ ላዕሌየ፡ (vel: „ vadimonium pro N.N. meum est “) F.N. 27; ኢይደሉ፡ ተድኅኖቱ፡ ለዘ፡ ይደሉ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ቀትል፡ F.N. 27.

woorden.betekenis: incolumes
woorden.definitie: subst. et adj., i.q. ዳኅን፡, ut: ትነብር፡ ድኅነ፡ (var. ዳኅነ፡) Job 11,18; ድኅናን፡ incolumes Jos. 10,21.

woorden.betekenis: servator, liberator, salvificus, salutifer
woorden.definitie: part. c. term. adj., fem. መድኀኒት፡ servator, liberator, salvificus, salutifer, Jes. 17,10; Jes. 44,6; Jes. 44,7; መድኀኔ፡ ኵሉ፡ Sap. 16,7; Ps. 41,7; Ps. 41,16; መድኀኒየ፡ et መድኀንየ፡ Sir. 51,1; Jes. 12,2; Ps. 17,1; Ps. 18,16; Ps. 68,17; Ps. 88,26 al.; መድኀኒነ፡ ኢየሱስ፡ Phil. 3,20; 1 Tim. 1,1; 1 Tim. 2,3; 2 Tim. 1,10; 2 Petr. 1,11; Christus መድኀኔ፡ ዓለም፡ Clem. f. 202; በሕማማቲሁ፡ መድኀኒት፡ Lit. 160,2.

woorden.betekenis: conservatio, liberatio, redemtio, salus, sacrificium pro sal
woorden.definitie: subst., fem.et m., Pl. መድኀኒታት፡ 1 conservatio, liberatio, redemtio, salus, 1 Reg. 11,9 (σωτηρία); Jes. 33,2; Jes. 33,6; Jes. 33,20; Jes. 40,5; Jes. 46,13; Jes. 51,6; Jes. 52,10; ጌራ፡ መድኀኒት፡ Jes. 59,17; Jes. 60,6; Jes. 60,18; ትረክቡ፡ መድኀኒተ፡ ለነፍስክሙ፡ Jer. 6,16; Job 11,20; Prov. 2,7; Prov. 11,14; Ps. 11,6; Ps. 13,11; Ps. 87,1; Ps. 110,8 al.; Judith 8,17; ብከ፡ ትትረከብ፡ መድኀኒቱ፡ ለእስራኤል፡ Kuf. 31; Luc. 1,69; Joh. 4,22; Act. 7,25; መድኀኒተ፡ ነፍስክሙ፡ 1 Petr. 1,9; ተጋደል፡ በእንተ፡ መድኀኒተ፡ ነፍስከ፡ Sx. Hed. 13; ἀπολύτρωσις Eph. 1,7; Eph. 1,14; λύτρωσις Luc. 1,68; ዘይፈቅድ፡ መድኀኒተ፡ እምኀጣውኢሁ፡ F.M. 2,5; መድኀኒታት፡ Genz. f. 89(vid. sub ርክበት፡). a መሥዋዕተ፡ መድኀኒት፡ sacrificium pro salute vel eucharisticum, σωτήριον vel θυσία σωτηρίου, Am. 5,22; Kuf. 16; Kuf. 22, nec non መድኀኒት፡ 1 Par. 21,26; 2 Par. 7,7; ይሠውዕ፡ ለመድኀኒቱ፡ Sir. 32,2; Sir. 47,2. b pro concr. σωτήρ, Jud. 3,9; Jud. 3,15. 2 remedium salutare, φάρμακον σωτήριον Chrys. Ta. 27(vid. sub አሰሳሊ፡); መድኀኒት፡ በዘይትፌወስ፡ ቍስል፡ Org.

woorden.betekenis: labi, lapsare in lubrico, pede falli, fallente vestigio cade
woorden.definitie: I,1 [دَحَضَ] Subj. ይድኀፅ፡, labi vel lapsare in lubrico, pede falli, fallente vestigio cadere (gleiten, ausgleiten), et in genere: labi, lapsare: Jsp. p. 356; ὀλισθαίνειν Prov. 14,19; ይኄይስ፡ ትድኀፅ፡ ወትደቅ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ እምትድኀፅ፡ በአፉከ፡ ወትደቅ፡ በልሳንከ፡ Sir. 20,18; Sir. 14,1; ከመ፡ ኢትድኀፅ፡ መንፈስከ፡ ውስተ፡ ሞት፡ Sir. 9,9; Dan. 11,34; σφάλλεσθαι Deut. 32,35; Sir. 13,22; σαλεύεσθαι de pedibus, vestigiis: Ps. 16,6; Ps. 37,17; Ps. 93,18; ὑποσκελίζεσθαι Ps. 36,33; አመ፡ ዕለተ፡ ይድኅፅ፡ πτῶσις Sir. 3,31; Mich. 7,8; transl.: ትድኅፅ፡ ምክሩ፡ Job 18,7. a illabi i.e. incidere: ወኢንድኀፅ፡ ውስተ፡ ኀጢአት፡ Did. 4. b elabi i.e. excidere e re: ከመ፡ ኢንድኀፅ፡ እምርትዕት፡ ሃይማኖት፡ Did. 25. c labare Job 26,11. d in parturiendo i.e. abortum pati: ወፅኑሳቲሆሙ፡ ኢይድኅፃ፡ ወይድኅና፡ በኅርሶን፡ Job 21,10.

woorden.betekenis: spurcitia, sordes, impudicitia, turpitudo, merces meretricia
woorden.definitie: subst., Pl. ደነሳት፡ 1 spurcitia, sordes, impudicitia, turpitudo: አንጽሐነ፡ እምኵሉ፡ ደነስ፡ ወእምኵሉ፡ ርኵስ፡ Lit. 164,1; በፍትወተ፡ ደነስ፡ (impressum est ደንስ፡) Lit. 170,4; Lud. e Cant. Mar.; ያነጽሕ፡ ልቦ፡ እምደነሳት፡ Phlx. 211. 2 merces meretricia, quaestus meretricius, pretium stupri: ሀበኒ፡ ደነስየ፡ Kuf. 41; Hos. 2,14; Mich. 1,7; Hez. 16,31; Hez. 27,15; ደነሰ፡ ዘማ፡ Deut. 23,19; ደነሰ፡ ዝሙት፡ Mich. 1,7. — Voc. Ae.: ደነስ፡ ዘ፡ አደፍ፡; aliud: ደነስ፡ ዘ፡ ዐስበ፡ ዝሙት።

woorden.betekenis: depresso pectore, collo, dorso fuit, gibboso tergo praeditus
woorden.definitie: I,1 [دَنِنَ depresso pectore, collo, dorso fuit, دَنِىَٔ gibboso tergo praeditus fuit, دَنَا IV depressit, vic. دان, nec non ጸነነ፡] Subj. ይድንን፡, etiam ይድነን፡ se inclinare vel demittere, corpus incurvare, pronum esse (sich bücken): ደነነ፡ ኀበ፡ ምድር፡ Joh. 8,8; እድንን፡ Marc. 1,7; ተለዋ፡ ደኒኖ፡ Prov. 7,22; ድነኒ፡ (v. ድንኒ፡) ወንትዐደውኪ፡ Jes. 51,23; honoris et reverentiae causa: ትደንኑ፡ ወትሰግዱ፡ ሎቱ፡ Jes. 46,6; Judith 13,17; 2 Esr. 18,6; 1 Reg. 28,14; ደነነት፡ በገጻ፡ ወሰገደት፡ 3 Reg. 1,31; Ex. 12,27; Num. 22,31; ደነነ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ወሰገደ፡ Ex. 34,8; ደኒኖ፡ ሰዐሞ፡ Kuf. p. 112. a se proclinare spectandi causa per fenestram, Cant. 2,9. b demittere oculos ob pudorem, de femina, Lud. ex Hom. Mar. — Voc. Ae.: ደነነ፡ ብ፡ ዝቅ፡ አለ።

woorden.betekenis: incurvare, demittere, deorsum flectere, se incurvare, inclin
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 incurvare, demittere, deorsum flectere: ፀሚደ፡ አርዑት፡ ያደንኖ፡ ለክሳድ፡ Sir. 30,35; ኣደንን፡ ቀፈተ፡ ልብየ፡ Org. 7; feminae እንዘ፡ የሐውራ፡ በፍኖት፡ ያድንና፡ ርእሶን፡ እንዘ፡ ግልቡባት፡ እማንቱ፡ Did. 3; እለ፡ ያደንኑ፡ ርእሶሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ Did. 33; bestiae አድነኑ፡ አርእስቲሆሙ፡ ወሰገዱ፡ ለአዳም፡ reverentiae causa Clem. f. 4; Lit. 160,3. 2 omisso objecto: corpus i.e. se incurvare vel inclinare, de terra Hen. 65,1; reverentiae causa: አድነኑ፡ ሎቱ፡ Gad. Ad. f. 8; Sx. Hed. 7; Lit. Orth.

woorden.betekenis: hebes, segnis, socors, tardus, stupens, attonitus
woorden.definitie: part. (a ደንዘዘ፡) 1 hebes, segnis, socors, tardus, νωθρός Hebr. 5,11; Hebr. 6,12; ወሀቦሙ፡ እግዚ አብሔር፡ መንፈሰ፡ ድንዙዘ፡ πνεῦμα κατανύξεως Rom. 11,8; ድንዙዛነ፡ ልብ፡ Kid. f. 39; Macc. f. 18 (vid. sub ድንጽው፡); ፍካሬሁ፡ (sc. historiae Melchisedeci) ኢኮነ፡ ቀሊለ፡ ወፈድፋደሰ፡ ለእለ፡ ኢይሌብዉ፡ ወኮኑ፡ ድንዙዛነ፡ ለሰሚዕ፡ Cyr. f. 127. 2 stupens, attonitus: discipulis terrore humi prostratis ait Christus ኢትኩኑ፡ ድንጉፃነ፡ ወድንዙዛነ፡ Kid. f. 3.

woorden.betekenis: tegendi, occulendi, prohibuit, interdixit, absconditus fuit,
woorden.definitie: subst., Pl. ደናግል፡ [radicibus دجّ دجل ܕܓܠ دحّ دغل omnibus vis primaria tegendi et occulendi inest; in specie cfr. دَقَلَ prohibuit, interdixit et absconditus fuit ] 1 fem. virgo Gen. 24,16; Ex. 22,15; Ex. 22,16; Jud. 19,24; 2 Reg. 13,2; Job 31,1; Jes. 7,14; Jes. 62,5; Jer. 2,32; Hez. 9,6; Sir. 9,5; Matth. 1,23; 2 Cor. 11,2; creberrime de Maria virgine; ድንግለ፡ እስራኤል፡ Jer. 18,13; ድንግል፡ ወለተ፡ ባቢሎን፡ Jes. 47,1; ብእሲት፡ ድንግል፡ Lev. 21,13; Sir. 15,2; ወለት፡ ድንግል፡ Deut. 22,23; Sir. 20,4; ደናግል፡ Jer. 38,13; Thren. 1,4; Hez. 23,3 (ἐν τῇ νεότητι αὐτῶν); Cant. 1,3; Ps. 44,16; Matth. 25,1; 1 Cor. 7,25 seq.; አዋልድ፡ ደናግል፡ Jud. 21,12; 2 Reg. 13,18; Esth. 2,2 (κοράσια ἄφθορα). 2 m. de viris castus, coelebs: ዮሐንስ፡ ድንግል፡ (Apostolus) Deg.; ብእሲ፡ ድንግል፡ ወብእሲት፡ ድንግልት፡ F.N. 24,5. 3 c. virginitatem professus vel professa, vir devotus, virgo devota vel monialis: ለደናግል፡ መሀሮሙ፡ (Imperat.) ለእለ፡ ኢያውሰቡ፡ ከመ፡ ይዕቀቡ፡ ደናግሌሆሙ፡ (sic) ከመ፡ ብንተ፡ ዐይን፡ Clem. f. 89; በእንተ፡ ደናግል፡ ዕደው፡ Const. Ap. 55; Sx. Teq. 16 Enc.; ደናግል፡ ንጹሓን፡ Org. 5; ወራዙት፡ ደናግል፡ Lit. 170,4; Kid. f. 22. dǝngǝl part of n. pr. (personal name) vid. ልብነ፡ ድንግል፡

woorden.betekenis: virginitas, signa vi, rginitatis, castitas, coelibatus, vita
woorden.definitie: subst., fem. et m., virginitas Jud. 11,37; Jud. 11,38; በእንተ፡ ምታ፡ ዘድንግልናሃ፡ Joel 1,8; Luc. 2,36; 1 Cor. 7,37; አርኰሰ፡ ድንግልናሃ፡ F.M. 6,8; Chrys. Ta. 28(vid. sub አማናዊ፡) a signa vi rginitatis Deut. 22,14; Deut. 22,15. b castitas vel coelibatus viri: ዮሐንስ፡ ቅኑት፡ በድንግልና፡ Deg.; ዐቀበ፡ ኖኅ፡ ርእሶ፡ በድንግልና፡ ፭፻ ዓመተ፡ Clem. f. 19. c vita vel status hominum (sive virorum sive feminarum) virginitatem professarum, Kid. f. 28; Kedr f. 61.

woorden.betekenis: ora, crepido, ripa, litus, ora litoris, terminus, limes, ali
woorden.definitie: subst. [etymon perobscurum est; videas annon cum ጠቃ፡ vel ጥቃ፡ componendum sit, si quidem ደቀቀ፡ ደገገ፡ ደግደገ፡ ጠቀቀ፡ ጠንቀቀ፡ ejusdem familiae sunt] 1 ora, crepido, ripa, litus, fluminis Kuf. 8; Kuf. 45; Jos. 3,15; Jos. 4,18; 4 Reg. 2,13 (v. ድጋግ፡); Dan. 12,5; Hez. 47,6 seq.; Jes. 19,7 var., ኀበ፡ ድንጋገ፡ ማይ፡ Sir. 24,14; maris: Kuf. 49; Gen. 22,17; Ex. 14,30; Act. 27,40 rom.; ድንጋግ፡ ዘሐይቅ፡ ora litoris Org. 2 terminus, limes: quae cogitatio pervenire potest ውስተ፡ ድንጋገ፡ ውዳሴኪ፡ Org. — Voc. Ae.: አድያም፡ ከንፊፍ፡ ደወል፡ ሐይቅ፡ ድንጋግ፡ ጽንፍ፡ ወሰን፡ ገበዝ፡ ብ፡ ዳር፡; aliud: ድንጋግ፡ ጽንፍ፡ ሐይቅ፡ ክንፊፍ፡ ዘ፡ ፬ ዳር።

woorden.betekenis: collidi, concuti, commoveri, contremiscere, contremere, ment
woorden.definitie: vel ደንገጸ፡ quadril. I [amh. ደነገጸ፡ et ደነገጠ፡ id.; etymon haud satis conspicuum est; conjeceris si quidem ደ formativum est, collidi, concuti a נְקַשׁ ܢܩܰܫ, vel commoveri, contremiscere a نغش vel نغض] 1 concuti, contremere, ἐῤῥάγη 3 Reg. 1,40; ᾔχησε 1 Reg. 4,5; Hen. 1,6; ἐθάμβησεν 1 Reg. 14,15. 2 mente percelli, attonitum esse, obstupescere, stupere, perturbari animo, θαμβεῖν Marc. 1,27; Marc. 10,32; ደንገፁ፡ ዐቢየ፡ ድንጋፄ፡ ἐξέστησαν Marc. 5,42; Act. 10,45; Judith 13,17; ደንገፀ፡ ነፍሱ፡ ἐξελύθη τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτοῦ Judith 14,6; ደንገፀት፡ ሰማይ፡ Jer. 2,12; Job 26,11; ይደነግፀኪ፡ ልብኪ፡ Jes. 60,5; Ps. 142,4; c. በ፡ ob: Ex. 18,9; vel c. እምነ፡ Luc. 1,29; 2 Par. 9,4; Judith 16,10; vel c. በእንተ፡ et በበይነ፡, ut: ደንገፁ፡ በበይነ፡ ዘኮነ፡ Judith 15,1. 3 terrore vel pavore percelli, perterreri, consternari, expavescere, trepidare: ደንገፀ፡ ድንጋፄ፡ ዐቢየ፡ ἐξέστη Gen. 27,33; Ex. 19,18; 1 Reg. 21,1; Hez. 26,16; Dan. 2,1; Dan. 2,3; Jes. 7,2; ደንጊፆሙ፡ ጐዩ፡ Judith 15,2; ἐταράχθη Ps. 54,2; Ps. 54,4; Ruth 3,8; Esth. 4,4; Thren. 2,11; ኢትደንግፁ፡ Jes. 8,12; Jes. 24,19; Joh. 14,27; κατενύχθη Lev. 10,3; Jes. 6,5; ኢትደንግፁ፡ μὴ θροεῖσθε Matth. 24,6; Marc. 13,7; ደንገፀኒ፡ ነፍስየ፡ ἐφέστηκεν εἰς φόβον Jes. 21,4; ኵሉ፡ ነፍስ፡ ይደነግፅ፡ δειλιάσει Jes. 13,7; Hez. 5,15; ἔπτηξαν Job 38,17; ኢትደንግፅ፡ μὴ πτοηθῇς Jer. 1,17; Jer. 17,18; Jer. 23,4; Am. 3,6; Ex. 19,16; de avibus Jer. 4,25; φοβεῖσθαι Jer. 29,22; εὐλαβεῖσθαι Jer. 5,22; Sir. 26,5; ኢትደንግፅ፡ ነፍስከ፡ μὴ ἀσθενείτω ἡ ψυχή σου Jes. 7,4, al.; 4 Esr. 9,4; 4 Esr. 10,39; Hen. 62,5; Kuf. 18; Kuf. 22; ደንገፀ፡ በኅሊናሁ፡ Kuf. 43; c. በእንተ፡ Job 36,34; Job 37,4; vel c. እምነ፡ pers. et rei: Ps. 32,8 (σαλεύεσθαι); እምእሉ፡ ሠለስቱ፡ ደንገፀኒ፡ ልብየ፡ Sir. 26,5; Jer. 29,22; Hez. 2,6; vel እምቅድመ፡ et በቅድመ፡ Jer. 1,17; Jer. 5,22; Jes. 64,2; seq. ከመ፡ c. Subj.: 2 Petr. 2,10; de stupore animi in ecstasi Act. 11,5; Act. 22,17 Platt.

woorden.betekenis: stupor, pavor, terror repentinus, consternatio, perturbatio,
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., stupor, pavor vel terror repentinus, consternatio, perturbatio, ecstasis: θάμβος Luc. 5,9; 1 Reg. 26,12; Koh. 12,5; Hez. 7,18; φρίκη Job 4,14; ድንጋፄ፡ ወድቀ፡ ላዕለ፡ አብራም፡ Kuf. 14; Kuf. 30; ዐቢይ፡ ድንጋፄ፡ አኀዞሙ፡ ἔκστασις Dan. 10,7; 1 Reg. 14,15; Jer. 5,30; 2 Par. 29,8; Marc. 5,42; Marc. 16,8; ያመጽእ፡ ድንጋፄ፡ ላዕለ፡ አሕዛብ፡ Jes. 41,2; Rel. Bar.; Sir. 40,2; φόβος Job 33,15; Jer. 30,5; δειλία Ps. 54,4; πτόησις 1 Petr. 3,6; ድንጋፄ፡ ልብ፡ θραυσμὸς καρδίας Nah. 2,10; ዘእንበለ፡ ድንጋፄ፡ ἀφόβως impavide Prov. 1,33; ecstasis Act. 10,10.

woorden.betekenis: fulcire, profecto, re vera, nonnisi, tantummodo, solum, tant
woorden.definitie: (etiam ዳዕሙ፡) particula [gramm. § 163,2; دَأَمَ et دَعَمَ fulcire ] 1 adseverandi: profecto, re vera: ወበኀቤክሙ፡ ዳእሙ፡ ጠፍአት፡ ጥበብ፡ Job 12,2; εἰ μήν Hez. 36,5; ዳእሙ፡ እመ፡ ኢይባርከከ፡ ἦ μήν Job 1,11; Job 2,5; Joh. 9,27 rom. (ubi Gr. ἤδη habet). 2 restringendi: nonnisi, tantummodo, solum, tantum (sive ante sive post eam vocem, ad quam pertinet, positum): እሉኑ፡ ዳእሙ፡ ደቂቅከ፡ 1 Reg. 16,11; ዳእሙ፡ ኪያክሙ፡ አእመርኩ፡ Am. 3,2; ሶበ፡ ያሤኒ፡ አመ፡ ረስዐ፡ ዳእሙ፡ ያሤኒ፡ Sir. 14,7; Sir. 49,4; Judith 4,7; 4 Esr. 2,30; አእምሩ፡ ዳእሙ፡ γνῶτε μόνον Job 19,3; Job 19,6; Job 17,13; ውእቱ፡ ዳእሙ፡ ባሕቲቱ፡ Sir. 43,27; ውኁድ፡ ዳእሙ፡ ዘርኢነ፡ ግብሩ፡ Sir. 43,32; ወእሙንቱሰ፡ ዳእሙ፡ ክልኤሆሙ፡ እለ፡ ድኅኑ፡ Sir. 46,8; Marc. 5,36; Luc. 12,41 rom.; Rom. 3,30; አኮ፡ – ዳእሙ፡ non tantum (seq. sed etiam ) Rom. 13,5; Phil. 1,29; Phil. 2,12; 1 Petr. 2,18; 2 Cor. 7,7 rom. 3 adversandi a post sententiam negativam: sed (ab initio sententiae positum), 4 Esr. 8,31; 4 Esr. 8,32; 4 Esr. 8,33; 4 Esr. 8,34; 4 Esr. 8,35; 4 Esr. 10,6; 4 Esr. 10,7; 4 Esr. 10,25; Job 32,9; Jes. 7,8; Jes. 10,7; Jes. 10,20; Jes. 11,4; Jes. 32,3; Jes. 42,3; Jes. 49,10; Jes. 58,6; Jes. 62,9; Jer. 2,34; Jer. 15,17; Jer. 22,17; Dan. 2,30; Dan. 9,18; Judith 10,16; Gen. 35,10; Joh. 1,8; 1 Thess. 2,4; 2 Thess. 3,9; 2 Tim. 1,9 al. crebro; ዳእሙ፡ ዓዲ፡ verum etiam (praemisso non tantum ) Joh. 5,18. b contra, potius, immo vero, (vielmehr; plerumque post eam vocem, ad quam pertinet, positum): ትልዎ፡ ዳእሙ፡ Sir. 2,3; ተአመን፡ ዳእሙ፡ Sir. 2,6; ኀሊ፡ ዳእሙ፡ Sir. 3,22; ፈንዎሙ፡ ዳእሙ፡ Jer. 15,1; ዝንቱ፡ ዳእሙ፡ ግብርከ፡ Jer. 22,17; ወይቤሎ፡ አልቦ፤ ዳእሙ፡ ፈንወኒ፡ Tob. 10,9; δὴ 4 Reg. 9,12; ቦኑ፡ እፈቅድ፡ ከመ፡ ይሙት፡ ኃጥእ፤ ዳእሙ፡ ከመ፡ ይትመየጥ፡ Hez. 18,23; Hez. 33,11; Rom. 9,7; Marc. 4,17; μᾶλλον Rom. 14,13; Rom. 14,14. α crebro ዳእሙ፡ ἀλλʼ ἤ sed tantum, sed potius, quin potius: Gen. 24,4; Hez. 36,22; Jer. 7,23; Jer. 38,30; Ps. 1,2; Ps. 1,5; Job 14,22; vel β ዘእንበለ፡ ዳእሙ፡ Hez. 15,4; 4 Esr. 13,11; Jer. 9,24; Kuf. 41. c at, tamen, verum: ἀλλά Job 1,12; πλήν Jer. 3,13; Jer. 3,23; Dan. 2,6; Dan. 4,12; ዘእንበለ፡ ዘበልዑ፡ ዳእሙ፡ ወራዙት፡ Kuf. p. 55; 2 Reg. 2,10; δέ Phil. 3,12; ወዳእሙ፡ Jos. 6,15; Job 36,10; Gal. 1,23; 4 Esr. 10,49; ante Imperativum: ወይቤሎ፡ ዳእሙ፡ ቅንት፡ ሐቌከ፡ Job 40,2.

woorden.betekenis: tenuem, tenerum esse, lassum, fessum esse, fieri, defatigari
woorden.definitie: I,1 [amh. ደከመ፡ et ደኸመ፡; ut videtur, proprie: tenuem et tenerum esse (vid. II,1), si quidem e ደቀቀ፡ et ደግደገ፡ eodem modo propagatum est, quo רהם ex رخّ et רכך]. Subj. ይድከም፡ et ይድክም፡ 1 lassum, fessum esse vel fieri, defatigari: ኢይደክሙ፡ οὐ κοπιάσουσι Jes. 5,27; Jes. 31,3; Jes. 33,24; Jes. 40,28; Jes. 40,30; Jes. 44,12; Jes. 63,13; እገሪከ፡ ይረውጻ፡ ወይደክማከ፡ (v. ወያደክማከ፡) Jer. 12,5; ኢደከምኩ፡ እንዘ፡ እተልወከ፡ Jer. 17,16; Jer. 18,15; Prov. 4,12; ደኪሞ፡ በሐዊረ፡ ፍኖት፡ ነበረ፡ Joh. 4,6. 2 infirmum, imbecillum, debilem, languidum, remissum esse vel fieri, viribus deficere: Jud. 16,6 seq.; አኀዘ፡ ይድከም፡ (v. ይድክም፡) Jud. 16,19; ይደክሙ፡ ብዙኃን፡ ἀδυνατήσουσι Jes. 8,15; Jes. 29,4; Jer. 16,12; Jer. 16,16; Job 28,4; Ps. 25,1; Matth. 26,41; ነፍስየ፡ ሰርሐት፡ እስከ፡ እደክም፡ 4 Esr. 3,22; 4 Esr. 10,35; ይድክም፡ ἐκλιπέτω Zach. 11,9; Jes. 46,2; ኢትድክም፡ እምኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ በተዛልፎቱ፡ μὴ ἐκλύου Prov. 3,11; እመ፡ ደክመ፡ ኀይሉ፡ Sir. 19,28; Thren. 1,14; Ps. 30,13; ኵሉ፡ እድ፡ ይደክም፡ Jes. 13,7; Jer. 6,24; Jer. 27,15; Jer. 29,3; Zeph. 3,16; 2 Reg. 4,1; ደክመ፡ አዕይንትየ፡ በአንብዕ፡ ἐξέλιπον Thren. 2,11; Jer. 14,6; Jes. 38,14; ቃለ፡ ወለተ፡ ጽዮን፡ ደክመ፡ Jer. 4,31; ደክመት፡ ነፍስየ፡ 4 Esr. 12,8; ደክሙ፡ ለዐቂበ፡ ቅጽር፡ (infirmiores quam qui custodirent) Jsp. p. 349; ኢደክመት፡ እምኀይላ፡ Kuf. p. 126. 3 infirmum i.e. aegrotum esse vel fieri: ἐνοχλεῖται Gen. 48,1; ዘእንበለ፡ ትድክም፡ (v. ትድከም፡) πρὶν ἀῤῥωστῆσαί σε Sir. 18,21.

woorden.betekenis: tenuem facere, comminuere, tenerum reddere, fatigare, defati
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 tenuem facere, comminuere: ያደክም፡ አድባረ፡ ወየሐርፅ፡ አውግረ፡ ἁλοήσεις ὄρη καὶ λεπτυνεῖς βουνούς Jes. 41,15; δαμάζει Dan. 2,40. 2 tenerum reddere (vid. ድኩም፡): ያደክሞ፡ ለሥጋሁ፡ ከመ፡ ዘሕፃን፡ ἁπαλυνεῖ (v. ያለመልሞ፡) Job 33,25; ያደክም፡ ቃለ፡ ወይዬውሀከ፡ Sir. 29,5. 3 fatigare, defatigare, lassare: ከመ፡ ያደክሞሙ፡ ዐቀበ፡ ኆጻ፡ እገሪሆሙ፡ ለአእሩግ፡ ከማሁ፡ ታደክሞ፡ ብእሲት፡ ነባቢት፡ ለብእሲ፡ የዋህ፡ Sir. 25,20; Jer. 12,5 var.; ያደክም፡ ኀይሎ፡ እንዘ፡ ይትቀነይ፡ Sir. 38,30. 4 infirmare, debilitare, languidum reddere, infringere, hominem Jud. 16,5; እግዚአብሔር፡ አድከሞ፡ Jer. 26,15; ያደክም፡ እደወ፡ ሰብእ፡ Jer. 45,4 var.; ስካር፡ ያደክም፡ ኅሊና፡ Clem. f. 119; aliquid, ut arcum 1 Reg. 2,4. a domare Marc. 5,3. b comprimere virginem 2 Reg. 13,14.

woorden.betekenis: tener, mollis, delicatus, lassus, fessus, languidus, infirmu
woorden.definitie: part. (passim ድኵም፡) 1 tener, mollis: ድኩማን፡ ደቂቅ፡ ἁπαλώτερα Gen. 33,13; de ramo arboris Matth. 24,32; ልሳን፡ ድክምት፡ μαλακή Prov. 25,15; τρυφερός delicatus ድክምት፡ Deut. 28,56 (vid. ለምለም፡ Deut. 28,54). 2 lassus, fessus, languidus, infirmus, debilis, imbecillus, invalidus: እስመ፡ ድኩማን፡ እሙንቱ፡ እስመ፡ ፈድፋደ፡ ሰትዩ፡ Judith 13,1; νωθρός Sir. 11,12; ድኩማን፡ እምኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ἐκλελυμένοι Jes. 51,20; ἀδύνατοι ድኩማን፡ Job 24,4; Joel 4,10; ሖሩ፡ ድኩማኒሆሙ፡ ἐν οὐκ ἰσχύϊ Thren. 1,6; ἀσθενής Job 4,3; Job 5,15; 1 Reg. 2,4; Prov. 24,73; Matth. 26,41; Rom. 6,19; 4 Esr. 7,11; 1 Petr. 2,11 (gloss.); ላእከ፡ ዚአሁ፡ ድኩም፡ Sx. Ter 16Enc.; ልደትኪ፡ እማሕፀነ፡ ድክምት፡ ሥጋ፡ Sx. Genb. 1Enc.; መንግሥት፡ ድኩም፡ Hez. 17,14; de fide: ዘድኩም፡ ሃይማኖት፡ Rom. 14,1; τὰ ἀσθενῆ στοιχεῖα Gal. 4,9; de oculis: አዕይንቲሃ፡ ድኩም፡ Kuf. 28; de medicamento minus efficace: ፈውስ፡ ድኩም፡ Chrys. ho. 17. dǝkum G ድኩመ፡ ልብ፡ dǝkuma lǝbb «découragé» ወዓዲ፡ ሮምሎስ፡ ፈርሀ፡ ወኮነ፡ ድኩመ፡ ልብ፡ ወእምብዝኀ፡ ፍርሃቱ፡ ተጠየቀ፡ እምኀበ፡ ማእምራን፡ ወመናፍስት፡ ርኩሳን። 175, vid. ልብ፡ 33

woorden.betekenis: lassitudo, fatigatio, indefessus, infirmitas, imbecillitas,
woorden.definitie: subst., Pl. ድካማት፡ 1 lassitudo, fatigatio, currentis Sx. Nah. 6Enc.; እንበለ፡ ድካም፡ indefessus Sx. Pag. 2Enc. 2 infirmitas, imbecillitas, debilitas: ከመ፡ ያእምር፡ ድካሞ፡ Job 37,6; Rom. 8,26; 1 Cor. 15,43; ድካመ፡ ፍጥረቱ፡ ወአእምሮቱ፡ Phlx. 170; ድካመ፡ ሃይማኖት፡ (i.q. ኑፋቄ፡) F.N. 9,1; legis Hebr. 7,18; Dei 1 Cor. 1,25; ἀσθενήματα Rom. 15,1; debilitatio, enervatio: ሑጻጼ፡ ወድካም፡ Jsp. p. 359. 3 labor, aerumna ( Mühsal ): ዕሤተ፡ ገድላቲሆሙ፡ ወድካማቲሆሙ፡ F.M. 1,2; fortasse etiam Asc. Jes. 7,26.

woorden.betekenis: status infirmi, imbecillitas, debilitas
woorden.definitie: subst. status infirmi, imbecillitas, debilitas: እንዘ፡ ሀለውክኒ፡ አንቲ፡ ለድክምናየ፡ መጽንዔ፡ Cod. Mus. Brit. LVII Nr. 6str. 2.

woorden.betekenis: orbis, circuitus, tractus, regio circumjacens, territorium,
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., Pl. አድዋል፡ [proprie: orbis, circuitus, coll. دال et دار cum derivatis] 1 tractus vel regio circumjacens, territorium, fines (Bezirk, Gebiet): በደወለ፡ ዮርዳኖስ፡ ἐν τῇ περιχώρῳ 2 Par. 4,17; በደወለ፡ (v. አንጻረ፡) ቤቱ፡ ἐξεναντίας οἴκου 2 Esr. 13,28; 2 Esr. 13,29; τὰ ὅρια Job 38,20; Judith 1,5; ኵሉ፡ ደወሉ፡ ዘዐውዱ፡ Hez. 45,1; ደወለ፡ ቤተ፡ ሳሚስ፡ 1 Reg. 6,12; 1 Reg. 10,2; Matth. 8,34; Matth. 15,39; Marc. 5,17; ደወለ፡ ጢሮስ፡ Zach. 9,2; ደወለ፡ ኢትዮጵያ፡ Hez. 29,10; Jos. 15,1 seq.; 4 Esr. 9,9; ውስተ፡ ደወለ፡ ብሔርከ፡ ἐκ μέρους τῶν ὁρίων σου Num. 20,16; μέρη Matth. 2,22; Act. 2,10; ὅριον Judith 15,4; ደወሎሙ፡ κατασχέσεις αὐτῶν 1 Par. 9,2; አድዋል፡ Jer. 17,3 vers. nov.; Ex. 34,24; Num. 35,26; Num. 35,27; Deut. 2,18; Matth. 15,22; እምነ፡ አድዋለ፡ ብሔሮሙ፡ ዘኢየሩሳሌም፡ ἀπὸ τῆς περιχώρου κυκλόθεν εἰς Ἱερουσαλήμ 2 Esr. 22,28. a ditio: ኵሎሙ፡ አይሁድ፡ እለ፡ ደወለ፡ መንግሥቱ፡ οἱ ὑπὸ τὴν αὐτοῦ βασιλείαν Esth. 3,6; ውስተ፡ ደወለ፡ መንግሥቱ፡ Esth. 3,13. b regio, terra: ደወለ፡ ፋርስ፡ χώρα Ἀσσυρίων Jes. 7,18; ደወለ፡ ቴማን፡ Jes. 37,12. c de agro certis finibus circumscripto: አኀዘ፡ ደወለ፡ ገራህት፡ τὴν μερίδα τοῦ ἀγροῦ Gen. 33,19. d Pluribus in locis respondet ὄρος, ὄρη, ὀρεινή quatenus regiones vel terrae tractus montibus tamquam finibus circumscripta sunt (vid. ደብር፡): እንተ፡ ደወለ፡ ኤፍሬም፡ διʼ ὄρους Ἐφραΐμ 1 Reg. 9,4; በደወለ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ἐν ὄρει θεοῦ Hez. 28,14; እምደወልየ፡ ወእምድርየ፡ ἐκ τῆς γῆς ἐμῆς καὶ ἐκ τῶν ὀρέων μου Jes. 14,25; ἡ ὀρεινή Luc. 1,65; Luc. 1,39. 2 terminus, limes: Deut. 19,14; ኢታፍልስ፡ ደወለ፡ ገራህት፡ ዘአንበሩ፡ አበው፡ Prov. 23,10; ዘይሰርቅ፡ ደወለ፡ ቢጹ፡ Clem. f. 161; Jes. 19,19; 4 Reg. 14,25; አድዋል፡ 1 Par. 13,5 (Ex. 34,24). — Voc. Ae.: አድያም፡ ደወል፡ ክንፊፍ፡ ዘ፡ ወሰን።

woorden.betekenis: David, psalterium, dāwit, Dāwit
woorden.definitie: 1 n. pr. regis Israelitarum David. 2 psalterium, liber biblicus (ab auctore psalmorum potissimo dictus); ተፈጸመ፡ ዳዊት፡ (explicit psalterium) Ps. in subscr. (in ed. Lud. p. 318); ወትደግም፡ ፻ወ፶ ዳዊት፡ Genz. f. 13; ወእምዝ፡ ትብል፡ ጸሎተ፡ ቅዳሕ፡ ዘእምዳዊት፡ በዜማ፡ ግዕዝ፡ Genz. f. 123; በዳዊት፡ Clem. f. 125; Gad. Joh.; Gad. Kar., al. 1 dāwit n. pr. m. (personal name) e.g. Dāwit king of the Israelite kingdom 54:2 (ed.); 60:7 (ed.) Chron. Am. 12 Chron. Am. 28 2 Dāwit book of the Bible 70:11 (ed.); 76:4 (ed.) Chron. Am. 62 Chron. Am. 79

woorden.betekenis: acgrotare, morbo affici, morbo laborare, laborare, affligi,
woorden.definitie: I,1 [دَوِىَ دَاءَ, דוה ܕܘܺܝ] Subj. ይድወይ፡ acgrotare, morbo affici, morbo laborare: Jes. 38,1; Jes. 38,9; እመሂ፡ ደወየ፡ ኢይሴፎ፡ ሐይወ፡ Job 24,23; ደወይኩ፡ Dan. 8,27; 1 Reg. 30,13; 2 Reg. 12,15; ደወየ፡ እገሪሁ፡ 3 Reg. 15,23; 4 Reg. 1,2; 2 Par. 16,12; Gen. 42,38; Kuf. 42; Ps. 106,12; Joh. 4,46; Phil. 2,26; Jac. 5,14; Clem. f. 112; ይድወይ፡ 4 Esr. 6,80; Ps. 9,3; Gen. 42,4; c. Acc. morbi: ደወየ፡ ደዌሁ፡ እንተ፡ ባቲ፡ ይመውት፡ 4 Reg. 13,4; ደወየ፡ ደዌ፡ ንስቲተ፡ Sx. Ter 16; c. ውስተ፡ morbi: ይደውዩ፡ ውስቴታ፡ (sc. ለደዌ፡) Jer. 6,21. a transl.: ደወየ፡ ልብነ፡ ἐγενήθη ὀδυνηρά Thren. 5,17; ደወየት፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፡ Jes. 3,8 var.; de morbo incredulitatis: እለ፡ ደወዩ፡ ካሕደ፡ τοῖς νοσοῦσιν ἀπαιδευσίαν Cyr. ad Theod. f. 22. b laborare: ልያ፡ ትደዊ፡ አዕይንቲሃ፡ Gen. 29,17. c affligi, male haberi: ልብ፡ እኩይ፡ ይደዊ፡ κακωθήσεται Sir. 3,26; ደወዩ፡ ከመ፡ አባግዕ፡ ἐκακώθησαν Zach. 10,2.

woorden.betekenis: aegrotum reddere, morbo afficere, morbum afferre, acerbum do
woorden.definitie: II,1 aegrotum reddere, morbo afficere, morbum afferre, c. Acc. pers.: እንተ፡ አድወያ፡ ጋኔን፡ Luc. 13,11; መጽአ፡ ላዕለ፡ ርእሱ፡ ሐሩር፡ ወአድወዮ፡ ወሞተ፡ Judith 8,3; ለእሉ፡ አድወዮሙ፡ ፍርሀት፡ Sap. 17,8; omisso Acc.: ያደዊ፡ ብዙኅ፡ በሊዕ፡ Sir. 37,30; 1 Reg. 2,10; Deus ያደዊ፡ ወያሐዩ፡ Clem. f. 271. a acerbum dolorem efficere: ይኰንንዎ፡ ኵነኔ፡ ዘያደዊ፡ F.M. 20,3. b morbiferum vel insalubrem esse: ምርዓይ፡ ማዩ፡ ዘያደዊ፡ F.N. 36.

woorden.betekenis: aegrotatio, morbus, valetudo adversa, labes, morbifer, insal
woorden.definitie: subst., fem. et m., Pl. ደዌያት፡ aegrotatio, morbus, valetudo adversa, Ex. 15,26; Deut. 7,15; ደዌ፡ እኩይ፡ ውስተ፡ ብረኪከ፡ Deut. 28,35; { ከብደ፡} ደዌሁ፡ 3 Reg. 17,17; ለእመ፡ አሐዩ፡ እምዛቲ፡ ደዌ፡ 4 Reg. 1,2; 4 Reg. 8,8; ደዌ፡ መሪር፡ ወእኩይ፡ ደዌ፡ ከርሥ፡ 2 Par. 21,15; እሁብ፡ ደዌ፡ ላዕለ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ሕዝብ፡ Jer. 6,21; ሐይወ፡ እምደዌሁ፡ Jes. 38,9; Ps. 15,3; Ps. 40,3; Koh. 5,12; Koh. 5,15; Koh. 6,2; Job 33,19; ደዌ፡ ሲሕ፡ Sir. 30,17; Sir. 34,20; 4 Esr. 7,24; 4 Esr. 8,63; በደዌሁ፡ Asc. Jes. 1,4; Asc. Jes. 2,14; Matth. 4,23; Matth. 8,17; Matth. 9,35; Matth. 10,1; ደዌ፡ ውሳጣዊ፡ M.F.; ደዌያት፡ F.M. 10,1; Fal. f. 57. a morbus vel labes animi: ነበረት፡ ይእቲ፡ ደዌ፡ ውስተ፡ ልብ፡ 4 Esr. 1,22; ደዌ፡ ጌጋይ፡ Sx. Mij. 2 Enc. (in cod. Tubing.). b statui constr. subjunctum: morbifer, insaluber, ነፋሰ፡ ደዌ፡ ἀνεμοφθορία 2 Par. 6,28. c „affectus quivis malus vel malum“, ut: ደዌ፡ ዕርቃን፡ Lud. ex Sx. Mij. 2 Enc. dawe C for ሕማመ፡ ደዌ፡ vid. ሕማም፡ (TraCES)

woorden.betekenis: verum, sed
woorden.definitie: verum, sed vid. sub ዳእሙ፡

woorden.betekenis: diabolus, Voc, Ae
woorden.definitie: n. peregr., sc. διάβολος diabolus, Sap. 2,24; Matth. 4,1; Matth. 13,39 al. — Voc. Ae.: ዲያብሎስ፡ ብ፡ ግም፡ (v. ግምዕ፡).

woorden.betekenis: judicare, punire
woorden.definitie: I,2 [דִּין ܕܳܢ دان; Amharenses etiam verbum ዳነየ፡ frequentant, ut: ይዳንየነ፡ ንጉሥ፡ Chr. L. Atq. f. 29] judicare, punire, 4 Esr. 13,41.

woorden.betekenis: judicium, damnatio, condemnatio, poena post mortem futura, i
woorden.definitie: subst., m.et fem. 1 judicium, damnatio, condemnatio: ደይነ፡ ንነሥእ፡ ለርእስነ፡ κρίσιν ἑλώμεθα ἑαυτοῖς Job 34,4; plerumque de judicio Dei, quo homines judicat vel condemnat: Ps. 1,6; ኢትግበር፡ ዘንተ፡ ደይነ፡ Gen. 18,25; Org. 6; Jac. 2,13; እንተ፡ ተዐቢ፡ ደይን፡ Jac. 3,1; Jac. 5,12; Joh. 5,24; Apoc. 17,1; Judae 6; Judae 7; 2 Petr. 2,3; Hebr. 9,27; 1 Tim. 5,12; Rom. 3,8; 1 Cor. 11,29; ሄኖክ፡ ይጽሕፍ፡ ደይነ፡ ወኵነኔ፡ ዓለም፡ Kuf. 4; ቀደመ፡ ገቢረ፡ ደይን፡ ወኵነኔሁ፡ 4 Esr. 6,45; 4 Esr. 8,43; 4 Esr. 8,70; ደይን፡ እምድኅረ፡ ሞት፡ ይመጽእ፡ 4 Esr. 14,37; ትንሣኤ፡ ዘለደይን፡ Joh. 5,29; ትንሣኤ፡ ደይን፡ (opp. ትንሣኤ፡ ሕይወት፡) Macc. f. 20; ዕለተ፡ ደይን፡ Judith 16,17; Kuf. 4; Matth. 10,15; Matth. 11,22; 2 Petr. 3,7; Clem. f. 120, al. 2 poena post mortem futura vel infernalis, cruciatus infernus, infernum: ጢሰ፡ ደይኖሙ፡ ὁ καπνὸς τοῦ βασανισμοῦ αὐτῶν Apoc. 14,11; መካን፡ ዘደይን፡ Kuf. 7; ዐዘቅተ፡ ደይን፡ 4 Esr. 6,1; ደይን፡ ወእሳት፡ 4 Esr. 6,3; ይጼዐሩ፡ ውስተ፡ ደይን፡ 4 Esr. 9,10; Clem. f. 92; Clem. f. 115al; አንቀጸ፡ ደይን፡ Org. 4.

woorden.betekenis: persequi, insequi, sectari, sequi, studere, studiose appeter
woorden.definitie: quadril. I 1 persequi, insequi, hostili modo, Matth. 26,55; ዴጊንየ፡ Ex. 15,9; c.c. Acc. pers.: Gen. 14,14; Gen. 31,23; Lev. 26,17; Jos. 11,8; Jud. 4,16; Jud. 4,22; Jud. 7,25; 1 Reg. 17,52; 1 Reg. 23,25; 1 Reg. 24,15; 1 Reg. 26,18; 2 Reg. 2,24; 2 Reg. 17,1; 2 Reg. 20,6; 2 Reg. 24,13; ዴገኑ፡ ወተለውዎ፡ 2 Reg. 20,7; Jes. 30,16; Thren. 3,11; Thren. 5,5; Ps. 7,5; Ps. 17,41; Subj. ይዴግን፡ Chrys. ho. 11; ዴግኖሙ፡ Kuf. 43; Gen. 44,4; Jos. 2,5; Jos. 10,19; 1 Reg. 30,8; ዴግኖቶ፡ 1 Reg. 23,28; እለ፡ ይኤብሱ፡ ይዴግኖሙ፡ እኩይ፡ Prov. 12,26; Prov. 13,21; seq. ድኅረ፡ vel እምድኅረ፡, ut: ዴገነ፡ ድኅሬሆሙ፡ Ex. 14,8; c. Acc. et c. ድኅረ፡ conjunctim: ዴገኖ፡ ድኅሬሁ፡ Kuf. 29; Ex. 14,4; Ex. 14,9. 2 sectari, sequi quaerendi causa, Luc. 17,23; Phil. 3,12; Phil. 3,14; c. Acc. pers.: ሖረ፡ ወዴገኖ፡ 3 Reg. 13,14; ዴገኖ፡ ወተለዎ፡ 4 Reg. 5,21; ኢትዴግኖ፡ እንከ፡ ወኢትትልዎ፡ ድኅሬሁ፡ Sir. 27,17; Sir. 27,20; Marc. 1,36; c. Acc. rei ( studere, studiose appetere ): ለእመ፡ ዴገንካ፡ ለጽድቅ፡ ትረክባ፡ Sir. 27,8; Jes, 16,5; Jes. 51,1; Prov. 15,9; 1 Tim. 6,11; ዴግና፡ ለሰላም፡ Ps. 33,15; ዘይዴግን፡ ነፋሰ፡ Sir. 31,2; ይዴግንዋ፡ ለኦሪቶሙ፡ Rom. 9,31; ዴግንዋ፡ ለተፋቅሮ፡ 1 Cor. 14,1; beatus qui ዴገነ፡ አሠረ፡ ወንጌል፡ Org.; c. ኀበ፡ rei: ይዴግን፡ ኀበ፡ ሐመልማል፡ ζητεῖ ὀπίσω παντὸς χλωροῦ Job 39,8; sectari aliquem i.e. imitari Sx. Genb. 17Enc. — Voc. Ae.: ዴገነ፡ ወተለወ፡ ዘ፡ ተከተለ።

woorden.betekenis: frigus, aura frigidula, regio temperata et elatior, aliud
woorden.definitie: subst. frigus recreans vel temperatius, (mitius quam ቍር፡ sec. Lud.), aura frigidula (Kühle): አስሐትያ፡ ወቍር፡ ወሐመዳ፡ ወደደክ፡ Hen. 76,12; ዘየዐርግ፡ እምኔሁ፡ ከመ፡ ጢስ፡ ውእቱ፡ ወስሙ፡ ደደክ፡ Hen. 60,18 [vapor congelatus pruinae similis intelligendus videtur]; plerumque opponuntur ደደክ፡ ወመርቄ፡ Kuf. 6; Dan. apocr. 3,48; ገነት፡ ዘኢያይበሳ፡ ነፋሰ፡ መርቄ፡ ወደደክ፡ Sx. Teq. 21Enc.; ወምድረ፡ ሴምሰ፡ ኢመርቄ፡ ወኢደደክ፡ Kuf. 8. Ab Abyssinis exponitur regio temperata et elatior, ubi aurae frigidulae spirant (Lud.), opp. መርቄ፡ (Schwüle, Niederung).— Voc. Ae.: ደደክ፡ ብ፡ ደጋ፡; aliud: ደደክ፡ ዘ፡ ደግዓ፤ መርቄ፡ ዘ፡ ቄላ፡ አደጎ።

woorden.betekenis: vox dubia, vid. sub ደጋን፡
woorden.definitie: vox dubia, vid. sub ደጋን፡

woorden.betekenis: brachiale, armilla, inauris, annulus, monile, aliud
woorden.definitie: et ድልጕማ፡, subst. [sine dubio i.q. دُمْلُجٌ brachiale ] 1 armilla, brachiale, χλιδών ድጕልማ፡ et ድልጕማ፡ Sir. 21,21. 2 ornamenta corporis alia, ut inauris, annulus, monile al.: ሕልቀትየ፡ ዘአጽባዕትየ፡ ወድጕልማየ፡ Kuf. p. 142(ubi Vers. Lat. monile habet); ከመ፡ ባዝግና፡ ወርቅ፡ ውስተ፡ ክሳድ፡ ወከመ፡ ድልጕማ፡ ዘውስተ፡ አጻብዕ፡ Fal. f. 18. — Lud. interpretatur inauris. — Voc. Ae.: አዕኑግ፡ ድጉልማ፡ (sic) ብ፡ ንፎ፡; aliud: የዠሮ፡ (sic) ንፎ።

woorden.betekenis: inserendi, duplicare, repetere, iterare, iterum, rursus face
woorden.definitie: I,1 [amh. id.; de etymo conjecturam habes Gesenii in thes. p. 1490 sub תאם; videas annon verbum referendum sit ad radd. دمج دمق دغم (coll. دِمْجٌ cum دِجْمَةٌ), quibus vis inserendi inest, unde duplicare facile propagatur] Subj. ይድግም፡, repetere, iterare, iterum vel rursus facere aliquid, c. Acc.: ኢይደግሙ፡ አበሳ፡ Hen. 5,8; ኢታውጽእ፡ ቃለ፡ ዘሰማዕከ፡ ወኢትድግም፡ Sir. 19,7; ወትደግም፡ ፻ወ፶ ዳዊት፡ Genz. f. 13; plerumque seq. verbo, sive finito asyndeto: ደገመ፡ ያዕቆብ፡ ቦአ፡ Kuf. 28; Gen. 4,2; Gen. 25,1; Num. 22,15; Luc. 20,11 rom., vel copula ወ conjuncto: ወደገሙ፡ ዓዲ፡ ወአበሱ፡ Ps. 77,20; Hen. 91,6, sive Acc. Infinitivi: Gen. 8,12; Ex. 8,25; Num. 22,25; Jud. 3,12; Jud. 8,28; Jud. 9,37; 1 Reg. 3,6; 1 Reg. 7,13; 1 Reg. 15,35; 1 Reg. 27,4; Jes. 11,11; Jes. 29,14; Thren. 4,16; Thren. 4,22; 4 Esr. 8,65; 4 Esr. 10,26 al. crebro; nec non seq. ከመ፡ c. Subj.: Hen. 10,22; passim omisso Objecto; 3 Reg. 18,34; ገሥጾ፡ ለዐርክከ፡ ዮጊ፡ ኢገብረ፡ ወእመኒ፡ ገብረ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይድግም፡ Sir. 19,13; Sir. 19,14; ለእመቦ፡ ዘአበስከ፡ ኢትድግም፡ Sir. 21,1; ለእመ፡ ደገምክሙ፡ 2 Esr. 23,21; 4 Esr. 3,39. a adjicere, addere c. Acc. et በዲበ፡, ut: ኢደገሙ፡ ነገረ፡ በዲበ፡ ነገርየ፡ Job 29,22. b transscribere: ደገሞን፡ (ለመጻሕፍት፡) Kuf. p. 51. c iterum fieri vel esse: ዘኢኮነ፡ ከማሁ፡ እምፍጥረተ፡ ዓለም፡ ወኢይደግም፡ እንከ፡ እምድኅሬሁ፡ Joel 2,2.

woorden.betekenis: iteratus, secundus, alter, Deuteronomii, successor, secundum
woorden.definitie: (part.) adj., fem. ዳግምት፡ iteratus, secundus, alter: ዳግም፡ ልደት፡ παλιγγενεσία Matth. 19,28; Tit. 3,5; Rom. 8,39; ዳግም፡ ኦሪት፡ δευτερονόμιον Deut. 17,18; Jos. 8,34; ኦሪት፡ ዘዳግም፡ titulus Deuteronomii libri biblici; ዳግም፡ ሞት፡ Apoc. 2,11; Apoc. 20,14; Apoc. 21,8; ዳግም፡ ብእሲ፡ 1 Cor. 15,47; Ex. 25,12; Ex. 26,5; Asc. Jes. 7,18; Asc. Jes. 7,19; Asc. Jes. 7,20; Jes. 9,35; Jes. 9,36; ዘይነግሥ፡ ዳግመ፡ (qui regnabit secundus) 4 Esr. 12,18; pron. suff. admittit sicut alia adj. numeralia: 1 Reg. 17,13; Job 4,54; አዕቀጸኒ፡ ናሁ፡ ዳግም፡ ዮም፡ Gen. 27,36; „nomini proprio additum distinguit homines ejusdem nominis“ (Lud.), ut: ሚናስ፡ ዳግም፡ i.e. Minas alter vel secundus (Alexandriae Patriarcha LXI) Sx. Hed. 15Enc.; nonnumquam c. pron. suff. successor alicujus, ut: ሰላም፡ ለክልስትያኖስ፡ ለዮናክንዲስ፡ ዳግሙ፡ Sx. Haml. 3Enc. (nam ክልስትያኖስ፡ ሊቀ፡ ጳጳሳት፡ ዘሮሜ፡ ኮነ፡ ረድኦ፡ ለዮናክንዲኖስ፡ ሊቀ፡ ጳጳሳት፡ ዘእምቅድሜሁ፡ Sx. Haml. 3). Adv. a በዳግም፡ α secundum, iterum, secunda vice: ἐκ δευτέρου Hagg. 2,20; τὸ δεύτερον Judae 5; ἐν τῷ δευτέρῳ Act. 7,13 rom.; ἔτι Matth. 18,16. β secundo loco Num. 2,16. b ዳግመ፡ iterum, denuo, rursus, secundo Joh. 3,3; Joh. 3,4; Joh. 9,24; Act. 10,15; Act. 11,9; Hebr. 9,28 (ዳግም፡ rom.); Apoc. 19,3; Matth. 22,1; Matth. 22,4; Gen. 22,15; Ex. 10,28; Ex. 14,13; 1 Reg. 19,8; Jer. 13,3; Jer. 40,1; Dan. 2,7; Hen. 4; δίς Sir. 35,7; እንከ፡ ዳግመ፡ Jer. 3,1; ዓዲ፡ ዳግመ፡ Jud. 13,9; ዳግመ፡ ካዕበ፡ Joh. 8,8; Joh. 21,16; Matth. 26,42; ወካዕበ፡ የሐውር፡ ዳግመ፡ የአብስ፡ Sir. 31,31; ኢ — ዳግመ፡ οὐκέτι non amplius Jer. 49,18; ከመ፡ ኢይኩን፡ ዳግመ፡ አይኅ፡ Kuf. 6; ኢዳግመ፡ እንከ፡ 1 Reg. 28,15.

woorden.betekenis: bura, lignum super quo vomer alligatur
woorden.definitie: subst. pars aratri, e.q. دَجْرٌ bura, lignum super quo vomer alligatur: ድጕረ፡ ዕርፍ፡ Kuf. p. 48(pluries); Egregori homines docuerent አርዑተ፡ ብዕራ፡ ወጸሪበ፡ ድጕር፡ Lud. e Libr. Myst.

woorden.betekenis: cupressus, abies
woorden.definitie: vel ዴፍራን፡ subst., [ܕܰܦܪܳܢܳܐ cupressus ] abies vel similis quaedam arbor, Kuf. p. 77.

woorden.betekenis: operire, cooperire, obtegere, obruere, obstruere, occultare,
woorden.definitie: I,1 [دَفَنَ id.; vic. צָפַן ጽፍነት፡ טמן] Subj. ይድፍን፡ 1 operire, cooperire, obtegere, obruere (καλύπτειν, κατακαλύπτειν, ἐπικαλύπτειν): ጽልመት፡ ደፈና፡ ለምድር፡ Jes. 60,2; Clem. f. 218; ደፈነኒ፡ ቆባር፡ Job 23,17; ይደፍነኪ፡ ጸበል፡ Hez. 26,10; Ps. 43,21; ይደፍኖሙ፡ ዕፄያት፡ Job 21,26; Jes. 11,9; እደፍና፡ ለምድር፡ Jer. 26,8; ደፈነቶ፡ ለምድር፡ ነፍስከ፡ Sir. 47,15; Ps. 139,10; ደፈንክምዎ፡ በአንብዕ፡ ለምሥዋዐ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Mal. 2,13; ደፈና፡ ለጽልመት፡ Lud. e Lit. Jac. Sar. (at vid. ደፍዐ፡); Sx. Mag. 8Enc.; de aquis quae obruunt aliquem Ex. 15,10; ደፈነከ፡ ማይ፡ እንዘ፡ ትነውም፡ Job 22,11; κατακλύζειν Jer. 29,2; transl.: ደፈነኒ፡ ኀጢአት፡ ἡ ἀνομία με βαπτίζει Jes. 21,4. a obruere vel obstruere puteum, foveam: Kuf. 24; Gen. 26,15; ዘይደፍን፡ ዐዘቅተ፡ Prov. 25,26; አዘዞሙ፡ ይድፍኑ፡ ውእተ፡ መቃብረ፡ Tob. 8,18; አዘዘ፡ ይድፍኑ፡ ግበባተ፡ Jsp. p. 358. b occultare Ps. 76,9. 2 defodere sub humo, abscondere, obruere: ድፍኑ፡ ደመ፡ Kuf. 7; በደፊኖቱ፡ (ለደም፡)Kuf. 7; በመሬት፡ ይደፍኖ፡ Lev. 17,13; ንድፍን፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ብእሴ፡ Prov. 1,11; Jer. 13,7; እመ፡ ደፈንኩ፡ ወርቅየ፡ ውስተ፡ መሬት፡ Job 31,24; Matth. 25,18; ደፈነቶ፡ (ለብሑእ፡) ውስተ፡ ሐሪፅ፡ Luc. 13,21; mortuum Ex. 2,12. 3 recondere (in foveis subterraneis) frumentum: Gen. 41,34. 4) condere sub cinere panem, placentam coquendi causa i.e. panem subcinericium coquere: ደፈነት፡ ናእት፡ ἔπεψεν ἄζυμα 1 Reg. 28,24 (vid. ዳፍንት፡).

woorden.betekenis: sepultura, humatio, fornix
woorden.definitie: n. act. 1 sepultura, humatio, Genz. f. 84; ድፍነተ፡ ምውት፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ከመ፡ ዘዘርአ፡ ውስቴታ፡ Genz. f. 85; እምቅድመ፡ ድፍነተ፡ ምውታን፡ Genz. f. 97. 2 fornix, Lud. auct. Greg.

woorden.betekenis: litera alphabeti Aethiopici XXa, quae ገምል፡ vocatur
woorden.definitie: litera alphabeti Aethiopici XXa, quae ገምል፡ vocatur.

woorden.betekenis: gehenna, infernum, tartarus
woorden.definitie: vel ገሀነም፡ n. peregr., sc. (γέεννα, גֵּי הִנֹּם) גְּהִנָּם جَهَنَّم gehenna, infernum, tartarus: ሥቃያት፡ ዘገሀነም፡ Asc. Jes. 1,3; Asc. Jes. 4,14; እቶነ፡ ገሃነም፡ 4 Esr. 6,1; ᾅδης Prov. 1,12; Prov. 15,11; Koh. 9,10; γέεννα Matth. 5,22; Matth. 23,15; Marc. 9,43; Jac. 3,6; Apoc. 20,14; Apoc. 21,8.

woorden.betekenis: apparuit, palam fuit, vulgavit, revelavit, palam, aperte, pu
woorden.definitie: I,1 [جهد IV apparuit, جَهَرَ palam fuit; vulgavit, revelavit ] manifestum esse, deinde palam, aperte, publice vel libere loqui vel agere, παῤῥησιάζεσθαι, እግህድ፡ ቦቱ፡ (v. ኣግህድ፡) Ps. 11,6; Ps. 93,1.

woorden.betekenis: publicare, evulgare, divulgare, palam facere, apertum, notum
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 publicare, evulgare vel divulgare, palam facere, apertum vel notum vel publicum facere, manifestare: Matth. 12,16; Hen. 9,6; Hen. 9,8; አግህድ፡ ሎቱ፡ ፍጻሜ፡ ዘይመጽእ፡ Hen. 10,2; እስመ፡ በዛቲ፡ ዕለት፡ (sc. epiphaniorum) አግሀደ፡ እግዚእነ፡ ኢየሱስ፡ ክርስቶስ፡ ርእሶ፡ እስመ፡ ውእቱ፡ ኢያግሀደ፡ ርእሶ፡ ለመኑሂ፡ መጠነ፡ ፴ ዓም፡ Sx. Ter 11; Simon Magus ያግህድ፡ ሕገ፡ ዘስሙ፡ ሲሞናዊ፡ (i.e. Simoniam) Clem. f. 67; Constantinus M. ያግህድ፡ ርትዕት፡ ሃይማኖተ፡ Clem. f. 74; F.N. 31 (vid. sub ግዕዛን፡). 2 dilucidare, perspicuum facere, demonstrare: ጳውሎስ፡ ያግህድ፡ ለነ፡ ምስጢረ፡ (διατρανοῦν) Cyr. c. Pall. f. 82; ወይእዜሰ፡ አግሀደ፡ (sc. hoc) በብሂሎቱ፡ Chrys. ho. 3; ያግህድ፡ ሎሙ፡ እምውስተ፡ ዘተአምነ፡ በኀቤሆሙ፡ ἀπόδειξις γίγνεται ἀπὸ τῶν ἤδη πεπιστευμένων Chrys. ho. 13; al. crebro. 3 palam, publice, aperte, libere agere vel facere aliquid vel loqui vel profiteri: በኀበ፡ አስተርአየ፡ ወአግሀደ፡ ብርያል፡ Asc. Jes. 4,18; παῤῥησιάζεσθαι Ps. 11,6 var.; coepit scortari በኅቡእ፡ ወሶበ፡ ተከሥተ፡ ግብራ፡ አግሀደት፡ ገቢረ፡ ርኵስና፡ ወኮነት፡ ትዜሙ፡ በገሃድ፡ Sx. Sen. 3; oculi ነጽሮ፡ እለ፡ አግሀዳ፡ qui libere aspexerunt, Lud. e Syn.; ስመ፡ ክርስቶስ፡ አግሀዱ፡ (publice professi sunt) Sx. Masc. 28Enc.

woorden.betekenis: manifestus, apertus, illustris, evidens, omnibus notus et pe
woorden.definitie: part., fem. ግህድ፡, manifestus, apertus, illustris, evidens, omnibus notus et perspectus: ኵሉ፡ ክሡት፡ ቅድሜከ፡ ወግሁድ፡ Hen. 9,5; ምግባርየ፡ ዘዐመፃ፡ ግሁድ፡ ቅድሜየ፡ Genz. f. 125; σαφής Cyr. ad Theod. f. 9; ለኵሉ፡ ዕዉቅ፡ ወግሁድ፡ ከመ፡ … πᾶσιν ἐναργές Cyr. ad Theod. f. 24; ከመ፡ ይሢም፡ በላዕሌሁ፡ ስመ፡ ዐቢየ፡ ወግሁደ፡ ὄνομα μέγα καὶ ἐπιφανές 1 Par. 17,21; Maria post partum virgo mansit ወበእንተዝ፡ ግህደ፡ ኮነት፡ ከመ፡ ወላዲተ፡ አምላክ፡ ይእቲ፡ Laud. Mar.

woorden.betekenis: traxit, piscari
woorden.definitie: I,1 [جَلَبَ traxit ] piscari: Christus ad nos venit እንዘ፡ ንገልብ፡ Kid. f. 34.

woorden.betekenis: induit amiculum, velare, velamento operire, obvolvere, obteg
woorden.definitie: quadril. I [جَلْبَبَ induit amiculum, vid. ገለወ፡] 1 velare, velamento operire, obvolvere, obtegere: ገልበቡ፡ ርእሶሙ፡ Jer. 14,4; ይገልብብ፡ አፉሁ፡ Lev. 13,45; ይገለብብዎ፡ ገጾ፡ Luc. 22,64; ሥብሕ፡ ዘይገለብብ፡ ከርሦ፡ Ex. 29,22; Lev. 3,3; Lev. 3,9; Lev. 3,14; (አስሐትያ፡) ይገለብባ፡ (ለማይ፡) Sir. 43,20; c. በ፡ rei: እገለብባ፡ ለፀሓይ፡ በደመና፡ Hez. 32,7; Ps. 146,8; እገልብባ፡ ለሰማይ፡ በጽልመት፡ Jes. 50,3. 2 obducere aliquid re, illinere, c. Acc. et በ፡, vel c. dupl. Acc.: ወገልበቡ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘውስቴቱ፡ እምዕፅ፡ በነፍጥ፡ ብዙኅ፡ Jsp. p. 375; ገልበበታ፡ ለንፍቅ፡ ፒሳ፡ Kuf. 47.

woorden.betekenis: sculpere, exsculpere, insculpere, caelare, acu pingere
woorden.definitie: I,1 [ܓܠܰܦ גְּלַף] Subj. ይግልፍ፡ 1 sculpere, exsculpere, insculpere, caelare, γλύφειν, እለ፡ ይገልፉ፡ Jes. 44,9; ዘይክል፡ ገሊፈ፡ 2 Par. 2,7; c. Acc. materiae: እለ፡ ይገልፍዎ፡ ለዕፅ፡ Jes. 45,20; Sap. 13,13; c. Acc. imaginis et ውስተ፡ vel ላዕለ፡ vel በላዕለ፡ materiae: ይክል፡ ገሊፈ፡ አምሳል፡ 2 Par. 2,14; እለ፡ ይገልፉ፡ ወየኀርዉ፡ ዐይነ፡ ማኅተም፡ Sir. 38,27; Hen. 99,7; ግልፍ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ አስማተ፡ Ex. 28,9 C; ይግልፍዎ፡ ውስተ፡ ኰኵሕ፡ Job 19,24; ገለፈ፡ በላዕሌሁ፡ በቀልተ፡ ወአክሊላተ፡ 2 Par. 3,5; 2 Par. 3,7; vel c. dupl. Acc.: Ex. 28,11; 2 acu pingere: ቀጠንት፡ ዘያሰረግዎሙ፡ በሐብራት፡ ዘገለፉ፡ ቦሙ፡ F.N. 23 (vid. ግልፈት፡).

woorden.betekenis: opus sculptum, sculptile, idolum sculptum, simulacrum, statu
woorden.definitie: subst. (m.), Pl. ግልፍዋት፡ et ግልፈዋት፡ 1 opus sculptum, sculptile: ዕንቈ፡ ግልፎ፡ Ex. 35,8; አማልክተ፡ ግልፎ፡ Jes. 44,17; አርእስተ፡ አዕማድ፡ ዘግልፎ፡ 3 Reg. 7,27. 2 idolum sculptum, simulacrum (Dei vel deorum sculptile), statua, sing. et coll., Kuf. 1; Kuf. 11; Lev. 26,1; Deut. 4,16; Jes. 10,10; Jes. 42,8; Jes. 42,17; Jes. 46,1; አማልክትየ፡ ወግልፎየ፡ ገብሩ፡ Jes. 48,5; በግልፎሆሙ፡ Jer. 8,19; Jer. 10,14; ኵሉ፡ ግልፎሃ፡ Mich. 1,7; Nah. 1,14; Ps. 77,64; Ps. 96,7; ኵሎ፡ ግልፎሆሙ፡ στήλη 2 Par. 14,3; ግልፍዋተ፡ ኢትግበሩ፡ Kuf. 20; Jes. 10,10 var.; Sap. 14,16; ምድረ፡ ግልፈዋት፡ ይእቲ፡ Jer. 27,38; ግልፈዋተ፡ ጣዖት፡ Org. 4. – Voc. Ae.: ግልፎ፡ ብ፡ የተቀረጸ፡ ጣዖት።

woorden.betekenis: cuniculus, hyrax, Abyssinicus, mus jaculus, Voc. Ae., mus ma
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. ግሔያት፡, nomen animalis, quod Lud. cuniculus interpretatus est, sed rectius hyrax (sorex) Abyssinicus exponendum videtur (שׇׁפׇן وَبْرٌ, Klippdachs); ግሔያት፡ χοιρογρύλλιοι ( mus jaculus ) Ps. 103,19; Prov. 24,61; ግሔ፡ Hen. 96,2; ግሔያት፡ Hen. 89,10 (ubi populum Aethiopum intelligendum esse, in Voc. Ae. annotatur); ግሔያት፡ unâ cum ቅራዲናት፡ et አክሪግልዮን፡ inter animalia olera et herbas derodentia memorantur in Gad. T.H. – Voc. Ae.: ግሔ፡ ብ፡ ሽኮኮ፡ v. አሽኮኮ፡ de quo vid. Bruce V. p. 145-152; Harris II p. 302et Anh. p. 50; Lud. lex. amh. p. 103; Isenb. p. 122(qui minus recte አሽቆቆ፡ scribit); praeterea vid. de שׇׁפׇן Ges. thes. p. 1467 et libros ibi laudatos; etiam supra col. 605 sub ኀንገረ፡ [De etymo nihil constat, quare nomen sub rad. ገሐየ፡ ponere noluimus, quamquam cum animal pavidum sit, nescio an a ܓܗܳܐ جَحْجَحَ derivari possit].{ Etiam formam ጊሔ፡ inveni Hen. 96,2 in Abb. XXXV. Conferendum est ገሐይ፡ mus marmota in Munzingeri Vocab. Tigr.}

woorden.betekenis: conjecit in terram, fucus, dolosus, fallax, glaber, ars, cal
woorden.definitie: subst., fem. et m., [hoc verbum F. Tuch de Aeth. linguae sonorum proprietatibus p. 17 cum جَحَلَ conjecit in terram, E. Schrader de linguae Aeth. indole p. 14 cum ኵሕል፡ fucus composuerunt. At cum etiam forma ጐልሐ፡ (vid. ተጓሕለወ፡) et አስተጓልሐወ፡ occurrat, quaeritur, annon dolosus, fallax proprie sit glaber, coll. גלח جلِح חלק al.] 1 rarissime in bonam partem: ars, callidum inventum, ut: ገብረ፡ ኢዮአብ፡ ዘንተ፡ ጕሕሉተ፡ 2 Reg. 14,20. 2 plerumque in malam partem: dolus, fraus, fraudulentia, fallacia, astutia malitiosa: Hen. 93,4; Hen. 94,6; 4 Esr. 4,32; 4 Esr. 5,22; δόλος Sir. 1,30; Sir. 19,26; Dan. 8,25; Ps. 33,14; Ps. 54,11; Lev. 19,16; ታየድዑ፡ ጕሕሉተ፡ Job 12,7; ትመልእ፡ ከርሦሙ፡ ጕሕሉተ፡ Job 15,35; Jer. 5,27; ጕሕሉት፡ ቃለ፡ አፉሆሙ፡ Jer. 9,8; Prov. 12,6; 1 Petr. 3,10 rom.; ጕሕሉት፡ ወጽልሑት፡ Marc. 7,22; እለ፡ በጕሕሉት፡ πανοῦργοι Job 5,12; Jos. 9,2; ὑπόκρισις Marc. 12,15; τὰ βαθέα τοῦ σατανᾶ Apoc. 2,24. a in Genitivo: dolosus, fraudulentus, fallax, Ps. 11,2; Ps. 119,3; ልሳኖሙ፡ ዘጕሕሉት፡ ውስተ፡ አፉሆሙ፡ Mich. 6,12. b በጕሕሉት፡ dolo, dolose: Ps. 23,4; Jes. 9,5; Gen. 27,35; Gen. 34,13; Num. 25,18; Deut. 27,24; F.N. crebro; ክዒወ፡ ደመ፡ ሰብእ፡ በጕሕሉት፡ Clem. f. 118; Clem. f. 161. – Voc. Ae.: ጕሕሉት፡ ዘ፡ እከየ፡ ልብ፡ ሽንግላሂ፡ ይ፡

woorden.betekenis: excedere, declinare, deflectere, recedere, deficere, abhorre
woorden.definitie: III,1, Perf. II pers. ተግሕሥከ፡ et ተገሐሥከ፡: Infin. verb. ተግሒሥ፡, Infin. nom. ተግሕሦ፡ vel ተግሕሦት፡, Imperat. ተገሐሥ፡, sed in Pl. etiam ተግሐሡ፡ (Num. 16,21; Num. 16,26; Num. 17,10 F), A Reflex. 1 excedere via, declinare, deflectere, recedere: አንትሙ፡ ተገሐሥክሙ፡ (v. ተግሕሥክሙ፡) እምፍኖቱ፡ Mal. 2,8; Job 31,5; Job 31,7; Num. 22,23; Kuf. 27; ኢተግሕሣ፡ ኢለየማን፡ ወኢለፀጋም፡ 1 Reg. 6,12; 2 Reg. 2,19; አልቦሙ፡ ተግሕሦ፡ የማነ፡ ወፀጋመ፡ Kuf. 23; c. እምነ፡ pers. Num. 22,32; 2 Reg. 2,22; c. እምድኅረ፡ 2 Reg. 2,21; c. እምቅድመ፡ 1 Reg. 19,10; c. እምኀበ፡ Gen. 42,24. a recedere a lege vel praeceptis: ተግሕሥነ፡ እምትእዛዝከ፡ Dan. 9,5; Job 23,11; Job 34,27; Ps. 118,51. b declinare vel recedere ab alqo i.e. deficere: ኢትትገሐሡ፡ እምኔሁ፡ Sir. 2,7; ተግሕሠ፡ ወተፈልጠ፡ እምእግዚኡ፡ ἀπέστη 2 Par. 13,6. c recedere a peccato i.e. abhorrere, abstinere: ይትገሐሥ፡ እምኵሉ፡ እኩይ፡ Job 1,1; Prov. 3,7; 1 Petr. 3,11; ተገሐሥ፡ እምነ፡ ዐመፃ፡ ወይትገሐሥ፡ እምኔከ፡ Sir. 7,2; ἀπέχεσθαι 1 Thess. 5,22; ተግሕሦ፡ እምእኩይ፡ አእምሮ፡ ውእቱ፡ Job 28,28. d vitare, evitare, fugere aliquem vel aliquid: Rom. 16,17; Rom. 16,19; 1 Tim. 6,20; περιΐστασο Tit. 3,9; παραιτεῖσθαι 1 Tim. 5,11; ከመ፡ ይትገሐሡከ፡ Lud. e Vit. Sam. e devitare, effugere periculum: እመ፡ ኢተግሕሠ፡ ἐὰν μὴ φυλάξηται Hez. 33,4; Hez. 33,5; ተግሒሦ፡ ἐκκλίνας Prov. 10,25; Prov. 15,24. 2 devertere: (vid. ግሕሠ፡) apud aliquem: ተግሕሠት፡ ኀቤሃ፡ እምውስተ፡ ፍኖት፡ Gen. 38,16. 3 abscedere, discedere, secedere, 3 Reg. 18,29; 4 Reg. 5,12; Num. 16,21; Num. 16,26; Num. 17,10; Ps. 100,5; ይትገሐሥ፡ መንፈስ፡ ቅዱስ፡ እምብዙኃን፡ Asc. Jes. 3,26; Matth. 2,22; Matth. 4,12; Matth. 9,24; Matth. 12,15; Joh. 6,15; Act. 26,30; Luc. 20,20; Asc. Jes. 2,7; Asc. Jes. 2,8. a se subducere Joh. 5,13; c. እምነ፡ (alicui) Hebr. 12,5. b secedere in desertum i.e. anachoretam fieri, Lud. e Vit. Sam. c cedere i.e. dilabi, transire: ተግሕሡ፡ ማያት፡ እምዲበ፡ ገጻ፡ ለምድር፡ ውስተ፡ መካን፡ ፩ Kuf. p. 7; ተግሕሠት፡ ጽልመት፡ Hen. 89,8. B Pass. removeri, semoveri: ተግሕሠት፡ አፍአ፡ እምትዕይንት፡ ἀφωρίσθη Num. 12,15; ቦቱ፡ ይትገሐሥ፡ ማእድ፡ ἀρθήσεται Ex. 25,28.

woorden.betekenis: torques, monile
woorden.definitie: subst. i.q. ቃማ፡, torques, monile: ቀጸላ፡ ወርቅ፤ ሽፍሽፍት፡ ዘወርቅ፤ ገማ፡ ጸዐዳ፡ Lud. e Libr. Myst. (si quidem lectio bona est).

woorden.betekenis: nebula
woorden.definitie: nebula vid. sub ጌመ፡

woorden.betekenis: camelus
woorden.definitie: (raro ገምል፡ ut 4 Reg. 8,9 var.); m., [גָּמָל ܓܰܡܠܳܐ جَمْلٌ] sing. et coll., Pl. አግማል፡ et ገመላት፡ (Matth. 23,24 rom.), Pl. Pl. አግማላት፡ camelus, Lev. 11,4; Deut. 14,7; Gen. 24,64; Gen. 31,34; Jes. 21,7; Marc. 10,25; coll. 1 Par. 5,21; 4 Reg. 8,9; ጸጕረ፡ ገመል፡ Matth. 3,4; Deg.; አግማል፡ Gen. 24,10; Gen. 24,19; Gen. 24,32; Gen. 37,25; Ex. 9,3; Jud. 7,12; 1 Reg. 15,3; 1 Reg. 27,9; 3 Reg. 10,2; 1 Par. 27,30; Jes. 30,6; Jes. 60,6; Jer. 30,7; Hez. 27,21; Judith 2,17; Job 1,3; Job 42,12; አግማላት፡ Jud. 6,5; Jud. 8,21; camelina carne frui vetantur Christiani Clem. f. 249.

woorden.betekenis: integrum et perfectum esse
woorden.definitie: rad. inus. e.q., ܓܡܰܪ גׇּמַר (vic. גׇּמַל كَمَلَ), primitus: integrum et perfectum esse.

woorden.betekenis: prorsus, plane, omnino, summatim, in universum, überhaupt, i
woorden.definitie: adv. (gramm. § 163,2), 1 ግሙራ፡ a prorsus, plane, omnino, Did. ed. Platt p. 81l. 8; Did. ed. Platt p. 81l. 14. α omnino i.e. summatim, in universum ( überhaupt, im Allgemeinen ): ዘከረ፡ መሥዋዕተ፡ ግሙራ፡ (non ejus species et modos) F.M. 23,5. β c. negatione: prorsus non, plane non, Matth. 5,34; Rom. 7,7; Hen. 90,4; ዘኢርእዩ፡ ግሙራ፡ τὸ καθόλου μὴ βλέπουσιν Hez. 13,3; Job 34,8. b semper, Act. 14,8 Platt. c umquam: መኑ፡ ግሙራ፡ ርእየ፡ Lud. e Vit. S.; c. negatione: ግሙራ፡ – ኢ፡, ኢ፡ vel አልቦ፡ – ግሙራ፡ numquam, 4 Esr. 2,17; 4 Esr. 2,18; 4 Esr. 3,49; Dan. apocr. 1,27; Dan. apocr. 13,7; 3 Reg. 1,6; Hen. 24,4; Matth. 7,23; Matth. 9,33; Matth. 26,33; 2 Tim. 3,7; 1 Joh. 4,12; Joh. 7,46. 2 ለግሙራ፡ (ܠܰܓܡܳܪ) prorsus, in perpetuum, semper, εἰς τέλος Am. 9,8; Hez. 20,40; Ps. 9,34; Ps. 12,1; Ps. 73,12; ቦኑ፡ ለግሙራ፡ ኣርምም፡ እንከ፡ μὴ καὶ ἀεὶ σιωπήσομαι Jes. 42,14; εἰς νῖκος Thren. 5,20; εἰς τὸ διηνεκές Hebr. 10,12; Hebr. 10,14.

woorden.betekenis: mensura
woorden.definitie: n. peregr., sc. γομόρ (עֺמֶר), mensura aridorum decimam Ephae partem contines, Ex. 16,18; Ex. 16,22; Ex. 16,23; Ex. 16,24; Ex. 16,25; Ex. 16,26; Ex. 16,27; Ex. 16,28; Ex. 16,29; Ex. 16,30; Ex. 16,31; Ex. 16,32; Ex. 16,33; Ex. 16,34; Ex. 16,35; Ex. 16,36; 4 Reg. 5,17. – Voc. Ae.: ጎሞር፡ ዘ፡ ቍና፡ (v. ቍኒና፡).

woorden.betekenis: Gomorrhae, auctores libidinum naturae, repugnantium, gemorā,
woorden.definitie: , etiam ጎሞራ፡, ጎሞር፡, ጎምራ፡ 1 n. propr. urbis Gomorrhae Gen. 10,19; Gen. 13,10; Gen. 14,2; Gen. 14,8; Gen. 14,10; Gen. 18,20 al. 2 Gomorrhaei i.e. auctores libidinum naturae repugnantium: ዘይገብሩ፡ ግብረ፡ ገሞራ፡ F.N. 48. gemorā, gomorā, gomor, gomrā n. pr. (place name); ግሙራ፡ gǝmurā 3b l. 22, 102 n. 16 (ed.); ገሙራ፡ gamurā 102 n. 16 (ed.)

woorden.betekenis: immergendi, intingendi, linimenti genus, contaminare, inquin
woorden.definitie: I,2 [vicinum videtur verbis, quibus potestas immergendi vel intingendi inest, ut غَمَرَ غَمَسَ al.; in specie cfr. غُمْنَةٌ i.q. غُمْرَةٌ linimenti genus ] contaminare, inquinare, polluere: ተኀፀብኩ፡ እገርየ፡ እፎኑ፡ እጌምኖን፡ Cant. 5,3; ኢገመኑ፡ አልባሲሆሙ፡ Apoc. 3,4; ለሊሁ፡ ነፍሶ፡ ይጌምን፡ (v. ያጌምን፡) Sir. 21,28; Num. 5,19; ገመንከ፡ ዘርአከ፡ Sir. 47,20; ስምየ፡ Tob. 3,15. a profanare: ዘይጌምና፡ ለዛ፡ ዕለት፡ (v. ዘያጌምና፡) Kuf. 50; እለ፡ ይጌምኑ፡ ስመ፡ ቅዱሰ፡ Kuf. 30; 4 Esr. 8,69; ገመነ፡ ይሁዳ፡ መቅደስየ፡ Mal. 2,11; ምድረ፡ Lev. 18,25; Num. 35,34. b violare fidem: ኢይገምን፡ ቃሎ፡ Num. 30,3. c vitiare virginem: Kuf. p. 108. – Voc. Ae.: ረስሐ፡ ገመነ፡ ዘ፡ አደፈ፡

woorden.betekenis: contaminatio, pollutio, immunditia, res impura
woorden.definitie: n. act. et subst. contaminatio, pollutio, immunditia, res impura: እምኵሉ፡ ግማኔ፡ ኀጢአት፡ Kuf. 20; ምናኔ፡ ወግማኔ፡ Kuf. 21; Kuf. 23; ግማኔ፡ ዛቲ፡ Kuf. 30; Kuf. 50; ግማኔ፡ ነፍስ፡ Sap. 14,26; በግማኔሆሙ፡ ዘገብሩ፡ Hez. 43,8; Hez. 44,7; Apoc. 17,4; Apoc. 21,27; c. pron. suff. በግማኖሙ፡ (v. በግምኖሙ፡) 2 Esr. 9,11.

woorden.betekenis: castigare, objurgare, increpare, redarguere, reprehendere, g
woorden.definitie: I,2 [rad. in Geez tritissima, etiam in lingua amh. obvia; eam Ges. in thes. cum יָסַר composuit, sed miro errore ገሠረ፡ pro ገሠጸ፡ scripsit p. 557. 604 et in Additam. p. 77] castigare: መኑ፡ ይጌሥጾ፡ ሊተ፡ ለልብየ፡ ἐπιστήσει μάστιγας Sir. 23,2; ገሠጸ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ Lud. e Vit. S. a objurgare, increpare, redarguere, reprehendere, ἐπιτιμᾶν Ruth 2,16; Gen. 37,10; Ps. 9,5; ቅድመ፡ ጠይቅ፡ ወድኅረ፡ ትጌሥጽ፡ Sir. 11,7; Matth. 9,30; Matth. 16,22; Matth. 17,18; ἐγκαλεῖν Zach. 1,4; ὠνείδισα Jes. 43,12; ትገሥጾሙ፡ (Subj.) በቃልየ፡ διαπειλήσῃ αὐτοῦ Hez. 3,17; ἐλέγχειν Job 32,12; Sir. 21,6; Matth. 18,15; Luc. 3,19; Eph. 5,11; ἐπιτιμᾶν increpare mare Ps. 105,10; ventos Matth. 8,26; Marc. 4,39. b graviter monere, admonere, hortari, dehortari, ἐλέγχειν, ገሥጾ፡ ለዐርክከ፡ Sir. 19,13; Sir. 19,14; ይኄይስ፡ ትገሥጽ፡ እምትኂስ፡ Sir. 20,2; νουθετεῖν Job 4,3; 1 Reg. 3,13; 1 Cor. 4,14; Col. 1,28; Col. 3,16; Tit. 3,10; παρακαλεῖν, ለምንት፡ በከ፡ ትጌሥጹኒ፡ Job 21,34; Jes. 40,1; Jes. 40,2; Luc. 3,18; Tit. 2,15; ገሥጾ፡ 1 Tim. 4,13; Kuf. 27; Kuf. 35; ገሥጾትየ፡ 4 Esr. 10,5; seq. ከመ፡ c. Subj.: Matth. 12,16; Matth. 20,31; Marc. 3,12; seq. እምነ፡ c. Infin.: ይጌሥጸኒ፡ እምሐዊር፡ ውስተ፡ ፍኖተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ሕዝብ፡ Jes. 8,11 var. c corrigere, disciplinam adhibere, instituere, erudire, παιδεύειν, እመ፡ ብከ፡ ውሉደ፡ ገሥጾ፡ ወመሀሮ፡ Sir. 7,23; ንጉሥ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ይጌሥጽ፡ አሕዛቢሁ፡ Sir. 10,1; ይጌሥጽ፡ ወይሜህር፡ ወይመይጥ፡ Sir. 18,13; servos Sir. 30,34; ይገሥጽኪ፡ ተራሕቆትኪ፡ Jer. 2,19; ገሠጽከኒ፡ ወተገሠጽኩ፡ Jer. 38,18; በእንተ፡ ገሥጾቱ፡ ለአብድ፡ Sir. 42,8; Deut. 8,5; Ps. 15,7; Ps. 93,12; Hebr. 12,6; Hebr. 12,9; Eph. 6,4; 2 Tim. 2,25 (c. ለ፡ Platt); 4 Esr. 8,15; ለምሂር፡ ወለገሥጾ፡ Sx. Nah. 7Enc.; ἐλέγχειν (de disciplina, quam Deus hominibus adhibet inflictis malis) Job 5,17; Prov. 3,12.

woorden.betekenis: castigari, admoneri, corrigi, disciplinam admittere
woorden.definitie: III,2 castigari, admoneri, corrigi, disciplinam admittere: ዘእምንእስከ፡ ኢተገሠጽከ፡ Sir. 25,3; ወልድ፡ ዘኢተገሠጸ፡ Sir. 30,8; በምሕረት፡ ተገሠጹ፡ Sap. 11,10; Ps. 89,12; ተገሢጽየ፡ νουθετούμενος Job 23,14; Jer. 38,18; Jes. 46,3; ተገሠጽ፡ Job 34,16; Job 37,13; Ps. 2,10; Hebr. 10,25; ዘይትጌሠጹ፡ በሥርዐታ፡ ለቅድስት፡ ቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ Clem. f. 196; episcopus ገሠጾ፡ ወኢተገሠጸ፡ Sx. Tachs. 12; ከመ፡ ይትገሠጽ፡ ἵνα ἄρτιος ᾖ 2 Tim. 3,17.

woorden.betekenis: fodiendi, cavandi, favus, cera, gǝrā, gâteau ou gaufre de mi
woorden.definitie: subst. [fortasse pro ግራው፡, referendum ad radd. חוּר (ኀረወ፡), כּוּר (ኮረ፡), עוּר غار (ዖረ፡), קוּר, quibus potestas fodiendi et cavandi inest] favus; semper conjunctum cum መዓር፡, sc. መዓረ፡ ግራ፡ et usurpatum pro κηρός cera: Jes. 64,2; Judith 16,15; 4 Esr. 13,5; Hen. 1,6; Hen. 52,6; II Can. Ap. 66; etiam መዓረግራ፡, ut: በከመ፡ መዓረግራ፡ የኀትም፡ ሰብእ፡ በማኅተመ፡ ወርቅ፡ ὥσπερ εἰ κηρῷ τις ἐμπήξει σφραγῖδα χρυσῆν, Cyr. de r. fid. f. 51. – Voc. Ae.: መዓረ፡ ግራ፡ ዘ፡ ሠምዕ፡ ምስለ፡ መዓርሂ፡ ይ፡ gǝrā G ግራ፡ gǝrā favus, gâteau ou gaufre de miel Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 135. 332 L ግራ gǝrā honeycomb መዓረ፡ ግራ maʿāra gǝrā beeswax lit. ‘sweetness of the honeycomb’, vid. መዓር፡ 200

woorden.betekenis: galea
woorden.definitie: galea vid. sub ገየረ፡

woorden.betekenis: terra in qua neque aqua neque arbores, sunt, campus ad seren
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. ገራውህ፡ [ni fallor i.q. قَرَاحٌ قِرْوَاحٌ terra in qua neque aqua neque arbores sunt; campus ad serendum purus redditus ] ager vel campus arabilis, terra arva, arvum, rus: Gen. 23,13; Gen. 23,17; Gen. 33,19; Gen. 49,32; Ex. 22,4 seq.; Ex. 23,10; Lev. 25,3 seq.; Lev. 27,16 seq.; Deut. 23,25; Ruth 2,2 seq.; Ruth 4,5; 2 Reg. 14,30; Job 24,6; Jes. 5,8; Jes. 28,25; Jes. 36,2; Jes. 61,11; Jer. 6,12; Jer. 39,7 seq.; Matth. 13,24 seq.; Matth. 22,5; Matth. 24,18; Luc. 13,19 (κῆπος); ገራውህ፡ Gen. 26,14; Kuf. 11; 2 Esr. 15,3; 1 Par. 6,57 seq. (περισπόρια); Ps. 106,37; Job 39,10; Jes. 32,13; Jer. 8,10; Jer. 39,15; Joel 1,10 (πεδία); Hez. 36,30; Judith 2,27; Judith 8,7; Matth. 12,1; Matth. 19,29; Marc. 2,23; episcopus እመቦ፡ ውስተ፡ ካልእ፡ ብሔር፡ ገራውህ፡ (scriptum est በራውኅ፡) Can. Sard. 12. (De Apoc. 18,11 vid. sub I ገርሕ፡) – Voc. Ae.: ገራህት፡ ጉርን፡ ብ፡ እርሻ።

woorden.betekenis: verendum, terribilem, formidabilem esse, terrere
woorden.definitie: I,1 [quod equidem non cum كرم (Isenb. lex. p. 172) sed cum גּוּר יָגֺר وجِر composuerim] Subj. ይግርም፡, verendum, terribilem, formidabilem esse, terrere, እስመ፡ ብዙኅ፡ ዘይገርም፡ (v. ዘይጌርም፡) ቀቲሎቱ፡ (v. ቀቲሎቶ፡) 1 Par. 10,4; a c. እምነ፡ comparationis: ዘይገርም፡ (v. pro ዘይጌርም፡) እምዝ፡ Hen. 21,7; 4 Esr. 12,17; Ps. 75,12; ብክሙ፡ (habetis eum qui) ዘይገርም፡ እምነገሥት፡ Clem. f. 121. b impers. c. Acc. pers. (es graut einem): ነገሥቶሙ፡ ይደነግፁ፡ ወይገርሞሙ፡ Hez. 32,10; ገረሞሙ፡ ለዐይኖሙ፡ 2 Esr. 16,16; ኢትፍርህዎሙ፡ ወኢይግርምክሙ፡ Jsp. p. 347.

woorden.betekenis: terribilis, formidabilis, timendus, terribile, res formidabi
woorden.definitie: part. 1 terribilis, formidabilis, timendus, φοβερός Deut. 1,19; Deut. 8,15; Jes. 21,1; Hab. 1,7; Dan. 2,31; Dan. 7,7; Hen. 21,1 seq.; 4 Esr. 10,39; Hebr. 10,27; Hebr. 10,31; ኵነኔ፡ ግሩም፡ Sx. Hed. 22Enc.; ግሩመ፡ ኮንክዎሙ፡ ለአዝማድየ፡ Ps. 30,14; ግርምተ፡ ረሰይዋ፡ ለመድር፡ Num. 13,32; ግሩመ፡ ገጽ፡ ἀναιδὴς προσώπῳ Deut. 28,50; ግሩም፡ ውእቱ፡ ብእሲ፡ ነባቢ፡ በውስተ፡ ሀገሩ፡ Sir. 9,18; ግሩመ፡ ኮነ፡ (ሙሴ፡) ላዕለ፡ ፀር፡ Sir. 45,2; ኢኮኑ፡ ግሩማነ፡ ለዘይገብር፡ ሠናየ፡ Rom. 13,3; nonnumquam neutraliter: terribile, res formidabilis, formido: በእንተ፡ ግሩም፡ ዘረከበኒ፡ Job 3,24; ግሩም፡ (v. ግርማ፡) እምኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ὁ φόβος Job 13,11; ነበብኩ፡ ግሩመ፡ Lud. Comm.p. 503 n. 41. 2 verendus, venerandus, augustus, majestate praeditus, de Deo; Ps. 46,2; Ps. 75,7; Ps. 75,11; Ps. 95,4; 2 Esr. 11,5; 2 Esr. 14,14; Deut. 10,17; Sir. 43,29; de verbo Dei 4 Esr. 8,27; de specie divina Jud. 13,6; de rege vel regina: ወለብሰት፡ አልባሰ፡ ክብራ፡ ወኮነት፡ ግርምተ፡ ἐπιφανής Esth. 5apocr.; ግሩም፡ ውእቱ፡ ጥቀ፡ φοβερὸς Esth. 5apocr.; de loco sacrosancto Gen. 28,17; Kuf. 27; de colloquio quod horrore sacro percellit aliquem 4 Esr. 1,4; ምእናም፡ ግሩም፡ Lit. 160,4. – Adv. ግሩመ፡ auguste Ps. 138,13.

woorden.betekenis: terror, pavor, horror, causa terroris, formido, terriculamen
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., 1 terror, pavor, horror, etiam causa terroris, formido, terriculamentum: እግዚአብሔር፡ አንበረ፡ ግርማሁ፡ ዲበ፡ ኵሉ፡ አሕዛብ፡ 1 Par. 14,17; 2 Par. 20,29; Sap. 17,6; Sap. 17,17; ግርማ፡ ዐቢይ፡ ወድቀ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ Kuf. 14; Kuf. 30; Job 39,19; Job 41,5; ግርማ፡ ሌሊት፡ Job 4,13; Ps. 90,5; ግርማ፡ መዐትከ፡ Ps. 89,13; እምግርማ፡ ቃሉ፡ ደንገፁ፡ አሕዛብ፡ Jes. 33,3; φοβερισμοί Ps. 87,17; በግርማ፡ ዐቢይ፡ ἐν ὁράμασι μεγάλοις Jer. 39,22; ከመ፡ ይርአይ፡ ግርማ፡ Job 33,16; ድምፀ፡ ግርማ፡ Jer. 37,5; Deus ይከውነክሙ፡ ግርማክሙ፡ Jes. 8,13; c. Gen. ejus, qui terrorem injicit: ምስለ፡ ግርማሆሙ፡ Hez. 32,30; Job 9,34; Ps. 144,6; ግርማ፡ አክይስት፡ γαυρίαμα δρακόντων Job 4,10; Matth. 14,26. 2 majestas verenda Dei regisve, magnificentia veneranda vel formidabilis: ግርማከ፡ Job 13,21; Job 25,2; Job 31,23; እምገጸ፡ ግርማ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Jes. 2,10; Jes. 2,19 var.; ኣመጽእ፡ ግርማየ፡ ላዕሌከ፡ τὰ ἔνδοξά μου Jes. 48,9; δόξα regis Dan. 5,18; ልቡስ፡ ውእቱ፡ ኵሎ፡ አልባሰ፡ ግርማሁ፡ ἐπιφανείας Esth. 5apocr.; ግርማ፡ መብረቅ፡ δόξα Act. 22,11. 3 dignitas, gravitas; ግርማ፡ sacerdotii II Can. Nic. 31; Sx. Nah. 30Enc.; Mariae virginis, Lud. e Ssal. Req.; ዘበዝኀ፡ ሠሐቁ፡ የሐጽጽ፡ ግርማሁ፡ Fal. f. 21. gǝrmā part of n. pr. (personal name) vid. e.g. ግርማ፡ አስፋ፡, ግርማ፡ ሰፍር፡

woorden.betekenis: subjicere imperio, subjungere sub potestatem, subigere, perd
woorden.definitie: II,1 subjicere imperio alicujus vel suo, subjungere sub potestatem alicujus vel suam, subigere, perdomare, domare: ኵሎ፡ በሓውርተ፡ አግሪርየ፡ ἐπικρατήσας Esth. 3apocr.; 4 Esr. 11,7; 4 Esr. 14,37; Dan. 2,40; Dan. 2,44; 2 Par. 11,1; ኵሎ፡ አግረርከ፡ ሎቱ፡ Ps. 8,7; Ps. 17,51; Ps. 46,3; Ps. 143,3; Eph. 1,22; አግሪሮ፡ Hebr. 2,8; አግረሮሙ፡ ἐτροπώσατο αὐτούς 2 Reg. 8,1; ታገርረከ፡ ምሕረተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ εἰς μετανοήν σε ἄγει Rom. 2,4 rom.; እስከ፡ ታገርራ፡ ለነፍሱ፡ Sir. 4,17; ለልሳን፡ አልቦ፡ ዘይክል፡ አግርሮታ፡ δαμάσαι Jac. 3,8; ይሰርሕ፡ እስከ፡ ያገርር፡ ተያፍኒሁ፡ Sir. 38,26; exercere aliquem ad aliquid, γυμνάζειν, አግርር፡ ርእሳከ፡ ለጽድቅ፡ 1 Tim. 4,7.

woorden.betekenis: murmurare, fremere, queritari, indignabundum, esse, stomacha
woorden.definitie: V murmurare, fremere prae impatientia vel indignatione, queritari, indignabundum esse, stomachari: እለ፡ ያንጐረጕሩ፡ οἱ γογγύζοντες Jes. 29,24; Jes. 30,12; ለምንት፡ ያንጐረጕር፡ ሰብእ፡ Thren. 3,38; Judith 5,22; Ps. 58,17; Ps. 105,25; Ex. 15,24; Num. 11,1; Judae 16; διαγογγύζειν Deut. 1,27; Luc. 15,2; አንጐርጐሩ፡ ወተአንተሉ፡ ἠγανάκτουν Sap. 12,27; c. በእንተ፡ rei vel pers.: Num. 14,36; Matth. 13,57 (σκανδαλίζεσθαι); Joh. 7,12; c. ላዕለ፡ pers.: Num. 14,2; Num. 14,27; Matth. 20,11, vel በላዕለ፡ Num. 17,20; Ex. 16,8, vel ዲበ፡ Ex. 17,3 var.; c. ላዕለ፡ rei: ኢታንጐርጕር፡ ላዕለ፡ ጸጋ፡ ዘወሀብከ፡ Fal. f. 57; c. Acc. pers.: Ex. 17,3.

Acc. pers. vel rei: ሕዝበኒ፡ ግበር፡ ዘከመ፡ ፈቀድከ፡ Esth. 3,11; Gen. 19,8; Gen. 27,45; Lev. 16,15; Deut. 31,4; Jos. 8,2. n facere vel reddere aliquem vel aliquid, c. dupl. Acc., ut: ጽኑዐ፡ ይገብር፡ መሠረታተ፡ ምድር፡ Prov. 8,28; Prov. 8,29; Apoc. 21,5; coll. Hen. 6,4; vel c. Acc. et ውስተ፡ Deut. 9,14. o adhibere: ይደሉ፡ ከመ፡ ይግበሩ፡ ሎቱ፡ (sc. ለደዌ፡) ፈውሳተ፡ ልምሉማተ፡ F.M. 3,3; ንሣእ፡ ኵሎ፡ ንዋየ፡ ዘውስቴቶን፡ ወግበር፡ ለሕንጸተ፡ አብያተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ Lud. e Vit. Theoph. p nonnumquam c. praep. substituitur aliis verbis specialioribus, ut: ወይግበሩ፡ ውስተ፡ ማኅቶት፡ ቅብአ፡ (pro ይደዩ፡) Sx. Teq. 20; ግበር፡ እዴከ፡ ዲበ፡ ዛቲ፡ ጻሕል፡ Lit. 158,4; Lit. 159,1; F.M. 14,10 (vid. sub ምራቅ፡ col. 898).

woorden.betekenis: facere, conficere, perficere jubere, curare, sinere, ad faci
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 facere vel conficere vel perficere jubere vel curare vel sinere, ad faciendum adducere, አግበሩነ፡ ዕጹበ፡ ግብረ፡ Deut. 26,6; እምእለ፡ ይቀውሙ፡ ወያገብሩ፡ ወያስተፋጥኑ፡ ግብረ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ἀπὸ τῶν ἐργοδιωκτῶν 1 Par. 23,4; ፍቅር፡ ኢታገብር፡ እኩየ፡ ወኢታኄሊ፡ ሕሡመ፡ ላዕለ፡ ቢጽ፡ Chrys. Ta. 19(cfr. 1 Cor. 13,5); Rom. 1,32 Platt; conficere curare: Ex. 26,14; Ex. 26,15; Ex. 27,1; Ex. 30,38; 1 Reg. 8,12; 2 Reg. 1,25; 3 Reg. 7,34; 1 Par. 18,8; 2 Par. 4,8; አግቢሮ፡ ኀጻውንተ፡ Gad. Lalib.; liber aureus ዘአግበረ፡ ሎቱ፡ አቡሁ፡ Sx. Haml. 16Enc.; c. Acc. confecti et Acc. materiae: ማሕረሰክሙ፡ አግብሩ፡ ኰያንወ፡ ወማዕፀደክሙ፡ አግብሩ፡ ረምሐ፡ Joel 4,10. 2 passim i.q. II,2 cogere, ut Kuf. p. 4 ann. 4.

woorden.betekenis: fieri, creari, gigni, confici, parari, apparari, ornari, per
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 fieri a creari Kuf. 2; ተገቢሮ፡ ሠሐቅዎ፡ መላእክት፡ Job 40,14; Hen. 72,1; ቃል፡ (ὁ Λόγος) ዘበአማን፡ ተወልደ፡ ወኢተገብረ፡ Cyr. f. 119; Exp. Fid. Nic. b gigni: ኀጺን፡ እምውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ይትገበር፡ γίνεται (v. ይትጌበር፡) Job 28,2; Jac. 4,1. c confici: ዘይትገበር፡ እምአስካል፡ Num. 6,3; ኵሉ፡ ዘይትገበር፡ በእሳት፡ ንዋይ፡ Num. 31,23; Ex. 25,31 seq.; Ex. 26,10; Ex. 30,2; Ex. 30,3; Ex. 39,23; ኵሉ፡ ወርቅ፡ ዘተገብረ፡ ለግብረ፡ ቅዱሳን፡ Ex. 39,1; Ex. 39,4. d parari, apparari: ወዘይትገበር፡ ሲሳይነ፡ ዘለለዕለትነ፡ 2 Esr. 15,18; 1 Reg. 21,6; በጼው፡ ይትገበር፡ Lev. 2,13; ornari: እንተ፡ ተገብረት፡ በወርቅ፡ ወበዕንቍ፡ Apoc. 18,16; e perfici, perpetrari, agi: ተገብረ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ኵሉ፡ በእዴኪ፡ Judith 15,10; ትዕግልት፡ ዘይትገበር፡ Koh. 4,1; Mal. 1,9; ይትገበር፡ ግብረ፡ 4 Esr. 4,47; Hen. 2,2; Hen. 5,2; Hen. 6,3; Hen. 15,5; Hen. 91,15; Hen. 106,6; Matth. 18,19. f agi, peragi, haberi, de festis: ተገብረ፡ ፋሲካ፡ 4 Reg. 23,22; Kuf. p. 26; ይትገበር፡ ሎቱ፡ በዓል፡ ዐቢይ፡ Sx. Mij. 24; ሲኖዶስ፡ ይትገበር፡ II Can. Ap. 35. 2 coli, de agris Hen. 10,18. 3 efficacem fieri vel esse: ተገብረ፡ ወተሰልጠ፡ እሳት፡ ውስቴቱ፡ (ለማይ፡) Sap. 16,17; Matth. 14,2 (; Jac. 4,1)

woorden.betekenis: factus, creatus, confectus, fabricatus, formatus, paratus, p
woorden.definitie: part. factus a creatus: philosophi ለግቡራንሂ፡ ይቤልዎሙ፡ ኢኮኑ፡ ግቡራነ፡ ኢተፈጥሩሂ፡ አላ፡ ሀለዉ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ጥንት፡ Chrys. ho. 22. b confectus, fabricatus, formatus: πεπλασμένος Jer. 19,1; ኀጺን፡ ግቡር፡ σίδηρος εἰργασμένος Hez. 27,19; ማእሰ፡ በግዕ፡ ግቡረ፡ መሃን፡ Ex. 35,7; Ex. 39,21. c paratus, praeparatus: Lev. 7,10; Lev. 7,12; Lev. 23,13; Num. 7,13 seq.; Num. 8,8; Num. 28et Num. 29; 1 Reg. 25,18. d ornatus Ps. 67,14. e perfectus, peractus Ps. 110,7. f vid. sub ግዑር፡

woorden.betekenis: actio, efficacia, labor, operatio, opera, opus, Arbeit, nego
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. ግበር፡ et ግብራት፡ 1 actio, efficacia, ἐνέργεια Sap. 7,26. 2 labor, operatio, opera, opus (Arbeit): ሀቦ፡ ግብሮ፡ በአምጣነ፡ ኀይሉ፡ Sir. 30,38; ኢትትማከር፡ ምስለ፡ ሀካይ፡ በእንተ፡ ግብር፡ Sir. 37,11; materfamilias ትሁቦን፡ ግብሮን፡ ለአእማቲሃ፡ Clem. f. 190; Ex. 1,11; ግብረ፡ ሐቅል፡ Ex. 1,14; Ex. 5,13 seq.; Hagg. 1,14; ስድስተ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ግብር፡ Hez. 46,1; Kuf. 50; Ex. 20,9; Hen. 10,16; Hen. 11,1; ጳውሎስ፡ ይሴሰይ፡ እምግብረ፡ እደዊሁ፡ F.M. 2,11; ይሴሰዩ፡ በግብረ፡ እደዊሆሙ፡ Sx. Jac. 2; አብሕርት፡ ወአፍላግ፡ ይፌጽሙ፡ ግብሮሙ፡ Hen. 5,3. a negotium: Dan. 8,27; ኢኮነ፡ ግብረ፡ አሐቲ፡ ዕለት፡ ወኢኮነ፡ ግብረ፡ ሰኑይ፡ 2 Esr. 10,13; ኵሉ፡ እለ፡ ይገብሩ፡ ግብረ፡ ንጉሥ፡ Kuf. 40, Eph. 4,12; ብየ፡ ግብር፡ በዘ፡ አሐውር፡ Lud. e Vit. Sam. b officium, munus: አግብኦ፡ ውስተ፡ ግብሩ፡ Kuf. 39; ኢይግበር፡ ሕዝባዊ፡ ግብረ፡ ክህነት፡ Did. 16; ግብረ፡ ዲያቆን፡ . p. 314. c opus vel ministerium sacrum: ንዋየ፡ ግበሪሆሙ፡ τὰ σκεύη τῆς λειτουργίας Hebr. 9,21; Ex. 39,1; Act. 13,2; ግበር፡ Hez. 44,14; እለ፡ ይገብሩ፡ ግብረ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Judith 4,14. d opificium, ars: ተምህሮ፡ ግብረ፡ እድ፡ F.N. 32; F.N. 40; Sx. Genb. 19; Sx. Haml. 10; ይትሜሀር፡ ግብረ፡ ኀጺን፡ Sir. 38,28; እለ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ይጠብቡ፡ በግብሮሙ፡ Sir. 38,31; figuli Sir. 38,29. 3 opus (Werk) quod quis producit, a Dei, creatura, res creata: ኵሉ፡ ግብረ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Dan. apocr. 3,34; Ps. 8,4; Ps. 8,6; Ps. 18,2; Ps. 27,7; Ps. 103,25; Act. 7,41; ποίημα Koh. 3,17; Jes. 29,16; ግብር፡ ዐበይት፡ Kuf. 2; Hen. 2,1; ኵሉ፡ ግብራተ፡ ሰማይ፡ Hen. 75,6; እስከ፡ ይትገበር፡ ሐዲስ፡ ግብር፡ Hen. 72,1. b hominum, artificium, opificium: ኮነ፡ ይገብር፡ ግብረ፡ ብርት፡ ወኀጺን፡ Gen. 4,22; ግብረ፡ ማእነም፡ Ex. 26,1; ግብረ፡ እብን፡ Ex. 31,5; Ex. 38,28; ግብረ፡ ብርት፡ 3 Reg. 7,2; ግብረ፡ ኬንያ፡ Sir. 9,17; Sir. 14,19; Sir. 45,11; πλάσμα figmentum Rom. 9,20; poëma Ps. 44,1; idola ግብረ፡ እደው፡ Kuf. 12; Kuf. 20; Jes. 17,8; Jes. 19,1; Jer. 1,16 al. c quae labore parta est merces Ps. 108,19, vel qui a planta producitur fructus: ሐሰት፡ ግብራ፡ ለዘይት፡ Hab. 3,17. 4 actio, factum, facinus, opus, agendi ratio, facinora, opera: ዛቲ፡ ግብር፡ haec actio F.M. 24,1; ኵሉ፡ ግብሩ፡ ድሩክ፡ Kuf. 19; Hen. 12,2; ቀዳሜ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብር፡ ምክር፡ Sir. 37,16; τὸ πραχθέν Sap. 14,10; ነኪር፡ ግብሩ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ Sir. 11,4; Jes. 5,12; Tob. 12,7; Ps. 43,2; Ps. 63,10; Ps. 76,12; ግብረ፡ ጽድቅ፡ Sir. 16,22; ግብረ፡ ዐመፃ፡ ምግባሮሙ፡ Jes. 59,6; ከመ፡ ይግበሩ፡ ግብረ፡ ሠናየ፡ 1 Tim. 6,18 Platt; ዐቢየ፡ ግብረ፡ ፈጸምከ፡ Sir. 7,25; ግብረ፡ እደዊሆሙ፡ Ps. 27,6; τὰ ἔργα Jac. 1,4; Apoc. 2,2; Apoc. 14,13; Joh. 5,36; Joh. 10,25; Joh. 17,4; Phil. 2,30; ሠናየ፡ ግብረ፡ ገብረት፡ ላዕሌየ፡ Matth. 26,10. a peractio: ለግብረ፡ ጌጋይ፡ ወኀጢአት፡ Kuf. p. 46, ann. 5. b factum, oppos. verbo et consilio: ከመ፡ ንግበራ፡ ለዛቲ፡ ምክር፡ ግብረ፡ Hen. 6,4; 4 Esr. 4,47; በግብር፡ de facto, re, revera (aliâs በአማን፡) Chrys. crebro. c res agenda vel gerenda, res gesta, acta: Hen. 15,5; Koh. 8,6; Matth. 18,19; Luc. 1,1; ግብረ፡ ልኡካን፡ vel ሐዋርያት፡ inscriptus est liber πράξεις τῶν ἀποστόλων Acta Apostolorum; nonnumquam ግብር፡ nudum, ut Lit. 162,2. 5 res: ለዝ፡ ግብር፡ εἰς αὐτὸ τοῦτο Rom. 13,6; ኵሉ፡ ግብራ፡ ለገነት፡ መንክር፡ ወመድምም፡ Clem. f. 65; ሠለስቱ፡ ግብራት፡ τρία 2 Reg. 24,12; ነኪር፡ ግብር፡ ξένον τι 1 Petr. 4,12 Platt; ግብራቲሁ፡ ለዝ፡ ዓለም፡ Phlx. 3; ግብራት፡ ዓለማውያት፡ F.N. p. 10; Phlx. 3. a causa: በእንተ፡ ሠላስ፡ ግብራት፡ Phlx. 11; Lud. e Mss. Colb. b ratio, modus: ምንት፡ ግብረ፡ ዓመት፡ በዝናማት፡ Kuf. 12; በአይ፡ ግብር፡ Lud.; docuit eum ኵሎ፡ ግብረ፡ ምንኵስና፡ Lud. e Vit. S.; ግብረ፡ አናቅጽ፡ . p. 305 n. 16. 6 necessitas: እስመ፡ ግብሩ፡ ውእቱ፡ ከመ፡ ያብእ፡ መሥዋዕተ፡ Hebr. 8,3; de necessitate corporis, euphemistice: ወረደ፡ እምገመል፡ በእንተ፡ ግብረ፡ ሥጋ፡ Sx. Hed. 25. Adv. a በግብር፡ α per vim vel per necessitatem, Jes. 52,4; Luc. 14,23; Act. 15,29; Philem. 14; Abush. 50; በግብር፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ፈቃዱ፡ F.M. 5,12. β necessario, omnino, utique (jedenfalls): በግብር፡ ይከውን፡ ዘነበበ፡ ዮናስ፡ πάντως Tob. 14,8. b ግብር፡ α necessario vel ad significandum oportet, necesse est: ግብር፡ ይመጽእ፡ መንሱት፡ (necessario veniet i.e. necesse est veniat) Luc. 17,1; Matth. 18,7; Matth. 24,6; Hebr. 9,16; Chrys. Ta. 4. β omnino, sane, πάντως Luc. 4,23. 7 opus praestandum i.e. a tributum, vectigal τέλος Deut. 23,18; φόρος, ከመ፡ የሀቡ፡ ግብረ፡ 2 Par. 8,8; ርኡሰ፡ ግብር፡ 2 Par. 10,18; ይሁብዎ፡ ግብረ፡ በበዓመት፡ 2 Par. 27,5. α collatio, λογία 1 Cor. 16,1 rom. β reditus: p. 303 n. 10. b opera serva, angaria: እለ፡ ይቀውሙ፡ ላዕለ፡ ግብር፡ ἐργοδιωκτοῦντες 2 Par. 8,10. gǝbr, Pl. gǝbar, gǝbrāt 1 ግብረ፡ እስላም፡ gǝbra ʾǝslām lit. ‘tax of Muslims’, meaning unknown (see Conti Rossini’s comment below) ነበረ፡ ፮ግብር፡ ፩ቅዴታ፡ ወ፩ጸማጅ፡ ወ፩ግብረ፡ እስላም፡ ‘il y avait 6 impôts: un était le qedētā; un était le ṣamāǧ; un le gebra eslām’ 75 l. 27–28 (ed.), 91 l. 4–5 (tr.) (‘Mot à mot: impôt des Musulmans; je n’en sais pas le véritable caractère, ni s’il s’agit d’un impôt particulier sur les Islamites.’ 92 n. 10), vid. እስላም፡ L ግብረ፡ ሕማማት፡ gǝbra ḥǝmāmāt the Rite of Passion Week see Hammerschmidt in 117, 233a–b, vid. ሕማም፡ C a for ቤተ፡ ግብር፡ vid. ቤት፡ (TraCES) b for ዓቃቤ፡ ንዋየ፡ ግበር፡ vid. ዐቃቢ፡ (TraCES)

woorden.betekenis: servus, mancipium, minister, famulus, conservus, Voc. Ae., g
woorden.definitie: subst.; m., Pl. አግብርት፡ servus (mancipium, minister, famulus), παῖς Gen. 39,17; Gen. 44,10; Ex. 21; ገብር፡ ከመ፡ እግዚኡ፡ Jes. 24,2; Sir. 30,33 seq.; Matth. 14,2; δοῦλος Lev. 25,44; 1 Reg. 27,12; 1 Reg. 30,13; ገብር፡ ይፈርህ፡ እግዚኦ፡ Mal. 1,6; ቦኑ፡ ውእቱ፡ ገብር፡ ያዕቆብ፡ አው፡ ልደ፡ ቤት፡ ውእቱ፡ Jer. 2,14; Koh. 5,11; Matth. 8,9; 1 Cor. 7,21; 1 Cor. 7,22; Gal. 4,7; Phil. 2,7; Apoc. 19,18; οἰκέτης Gen. 9,25; Gen. 9,26; Ex. 12,44; Lev. 25,39; Prov. 24,33; Sir. 23,10; Luc. 16,13; θεράπων Job 31,13; Gen. 24,44; Gen. 50,17; al. creberrime; ገብረ፡ አጋእዝቲከ፡ ὁ σύνδουλός σου conservus Apoc. 22,9; 2 Esr. 4,7; 2 Esr. 5,3; Pl. አግብርት፡ ex. gr. Gen. 12,16; Lev. 26,13; 2 Reg. 9,12; አግብርት፡ ብዙኅ፡ Job 1,3; Job 29,5; Jes. 14,2; Jes. 56,6 al.; Did. 23; F.N. 42,12. Sicut Hebraeorum עֶבֶד dicitur de cultoribus vel ministris Dei, Deut. 32,36; Jud. 2,8; Ps. 33,23; Ps. 68,42; Ps. 133,1; Ps. 134,1; Jes. 41,8; Jes. 41,9; Jes. 48,20; Jer. 26,27; Jer. 26,28; Jer. 3,22; ኵሉ፡ አግብርትየ፡ ነቢያት፡ Jer. 51,4; Luc. 2,29; Apoc. 10,7; de ministris regum Gen. 41,10; 1 Reg. 29,3; de populis subjectis et stipendiariis 2 Reg. 8,2; 2 Reg. 8,6; 4 Reg. 17,3; Deut. 5,15; Deut. 15,15; de quovis qui alicujus potestati subjectus est, ut አግብርተ፡ ኀጢአት፡ Rom. 6,17; Joh. 8,34; in colloquio cum nobilioribus: Gen. 18,5; Gen. 33,5; 1 Reg. 3,9; 1 Reg. 17,32; 1 Reg. 17,34; 1 Reg. 20,8; 2 Reg. 7,20; 2 Reg. 7,21; Luc. 2,29 al. – Voc. Ae.: ገብር፡ ዘ፡ ወንድ፡ ባርያ። gabr 1 part of n. pr. (personal name) vid. e.g. ገብረ፡ መስቀል፡ G ዘሳድስ፡ zasādǝs ou ዘገብር፡ ኄር፡ zagabr ḫer sixième semaine du Carême ou dimanche dit du Bon Serviteur 454 C vid. also ሳድስ፡

woorden.betekenis: confectio, factura, figura et modus, opus, agendi ratio, nat
woorden.definitie: n. act. et subst. 1 confectio, factura, figura et modus quo quid factum est, opus: Ex. 28,7; ποίησις Ex. 28,8; 4 Reg. 16,10; ἔργον, ut: ከመ፡ ግብረተ፡ ግንፋል፡ Ex. 24,10; ግብረተ፡ ዕጣን፡ Ex. 30,35; ግብረተ፡ ፍትሎ፡ Ex. 36,22; ለኵሉ፡ ግብረቱ፡ ለደብተራ፡ Ex. 35,21; Ex. 36,18; Apoc. 21,18; arbor aurea ወሠናይ፡ ግብረቱ፡ Jsp. p. 312; tabulae decalogi ግብረተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Org. 3. 2 agendi ratio, natura vel indoles, Hen. 101,6. 3 res gestae, Kuf. p. 1(in tit.).

woorden.betekenis: operarius, operarii
woorden.definitie: subst., operarius, sed plerumque collective usurpatur, operarii: ἐργάται Matth. 9,37; Matth. 9,38; Luc. 10,2; Jac. 5,4; 1 Cor. 3,9; ነዳእተ፡ ገባር፡ ἐργοδιῶκται Ex. 3,7; ሊቃነ፡ ገባር፡ Ex. 1,11; 3 Reg. 5,16; ሊቃናተ፡ ገባር፡ Kuf. 46. Pluralis forma ገባራት፡ legitur Sx. Nah. 1, sc. አምጽአ፡ ገባራተ፡ ከመ፡ ያንኅሉ፡ አረፍተ፡ ቤት፡ (si quidem lectio ex aliis codicibus firmatur nec ገበርት፡ emendandum est).

woorden.betekenis: operarius, agricola
woorden.definitie: adj. rel. (n. unitatis a coll. ገባር፡) operarius, ἐργάτης 2 Tim. 2,15; Kebr. Nag. n. 27; Sx. Hed. 10; agricola Jsp. p. 371; Lud. e V. S.

woorden.betekenis: instrumentum
