woorden.definitie: (Lud.) subst., Pl. መጋብርት፡ instrumentum, quo quis ad opus faciendum utitur: መጋብርት፡ ἐργαλεῖα Ex. 27,19; Ex. 39,10; Ex. 39,21; ለመጋብርት፡ εἰς ἐργασίαν Hez. 15,3.

woorden.betekenis: actio, agendi ratio, institutum vitae, facinora, facta, oper
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., Pl. ምግባራት፡ 1 actio, agendi ratio, institutum vitae, facinora, facta vel opera quae quis facere solet, πρᾶγμα Koh. 3,1; Koh. 3,17; ለኵሉ፡ ሰብእ፡ ይፈድዮ፡ በከመ፡ ምግባሩ፡ κατὰ τὰς πράξεις Sir. 32,24; Ps. 27,5; Matth. 16,27; Luc. 23,51; Rom. 8,13; Col. 3,9; ποιήματα Ps. 63,10; Koh. 9,7; ἐργασίαι Koh. 9,1; Jes. 1,31; ὁδούς Sir. 23,19; ምግባርኪ፡ τὰ ἐπιτηδεύματά σου Jer. 4,18; Jer. 7,3; Jer. 23,2; ኵሉ፡ ምግባሮሙ፡ ርኵስ፡ Kuf. p. 78; 4 Esr. 8,34; 4 Esr. 9,8; 4 Esr. 9,16; ἀναστροφή 1 Petr. 1,18; τὰ ἔργα, Ps. 76,12; Ps. 85,7; Ps. 104,1; Hebr. 3,9; ንጹሕ፡ አነ፡ በምግባርየ፡ Job 11,4; Job 21,16; Jes. 19,14; Ex. 23,24; በደኃሪቱ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ይትዐወቅ፡ ምግባሩ፡ Sir. 11,27; Matth. 11,2; Matth. 23,5; Jac. 2,22; Jac. 2,24; Jac. 3,13; Rom. 2,9; Rom. 2,10; ሶበ፡ አብርሃም፡ በምግባሩ፡ ጸድቀ፡ Rom. 4,2; opp. ጸጋ፡ Rom. 11,6; ኵሉ፡ እከየ፡ ምግባር፡ πᾶν φαῦλον πρᾶγμα Jac. 3,16; Deut. 28,20; ምግባረ፡ ሠናይ፡ Jac. 2,14; Jac. 2,26; 4 Esr. 8,38; 4 Esr. 8,42; ምግባር፡ ሠናይ፡ Sx. Mag. 20; ምግባረ፡ እኩይ፡ Job 1,1; ምግባር፡ እኩይ፡ Job 1,18; ዘሠናይ፡ ምግባሩ፡ φιλάγαθος Tit. 1,8; ἡ ποίησις Jac. 1,25; በምግባር፡ ἐν ἔργῳ (opp. በቃል፡) 1 Joh. 3,18; 4 Esr. 9,7; በቃልከኒ፡ ወበምግባርከኒ፡ አክብሮ፡ ለአቡከ፡ Sir. 3,8; ምግባራት፡ Asc. Jes. 9,22; Lit. 170,3. 2 effectus, efficacitas, ἐνέργεια Sap. 7,17; ἐνεργήματα 1 Cor. 12,6; ኀይለ፡ ምግባረ፡ አሥራው፡ δυνάμεις ῥιζῶν Sap. 7,20. 3 negotium, officium, munus, res agenda, ምግባረ፡ ወሀብናሁ፡ Kuf. p. 13; πρᾶξις Rom. 12,4; ምግባራት፡ Num. 3,7; Num. 3,8; ውእቱ፡ ይበቍዕ፡ ለምግበ፡ ምግባራቲሁ፡ ወንዋዩ፡ F.N. 32. a quaestus Kid. f. 24. b opus vel ministerium sacrum: ለምግባረ፡ ደብተራ፡ ዘመርጡር፡ Ex. 30,16. c res: በኵሉ፡ ምግባር፡ κατὰ πάντα τρόπον Rom. 3,2; cura ምግባራ፡ ለነፍስ፡ Lud. ex Sx. Hed. 29 Enc. 4 opera quae quis produxit, a a Deo creata: Hen. 5,2. b ad hominibus confecta: Hen. 8,1; ኵሉ፡ ምግባረ፡ ማእስ፡ Lev. 13,48. c merces labore parta, Jes. 40,10; Jes. 62,11 (vid. ግብር፡ n. 3,c et ተግባር፡ n. 3). mǝgbār, mǝgbārāt G ምግባረ፡ ሥራይ፡ mǝgbāra śǝrāy L’expression ምግባረ፡ ሥራይ፡ se substitue parfois au pluriel ሥራያት፡ pour désigner les procédés magiques» በውእቱ፡ መዋዕል፡ አስተርአየት፡ አሐቲ፡ ብእሲት፡ ሐነፋዊት፡ ፍልስፍት፡ በሀገረ፡ እስክንድርያ፡ ዘስማ፡ አንባድያ፡ ወይእቲሰ፡ ተፀምደት፡ ለምግባረ፡ ሥራይ። , fol. 235. 128

woorden.betekenis: opus, res creata, creatura, fructus, labor, labor operosus,
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., sing. et coll., 1 opus a quod quis produxit, in specie Deus, res creata, creatura: Ps. 102,22; Ps. 103,32; Ps. 144,9; Ps. 144,10; Job 37,14; 4 Esr. 7,43; 4 Esr. 8,28; 4 Esr. 8,53; 4 Esr. 8,56; Prov. 8,22; ተግባረ፡ እደዊሁ፡ Job 10,3; Jes. 64,8; κτίσμα 1 Tim. 4,4; κτίσις Rom. 1,25; ንጉሥ፡ አንተ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ተግባርከ፡ Judith 9,12; Judith 16,14; ቀዳሜ፡ ተግባሩ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ πλάσματος Job 40,14; ποίημα Eph. 2,10; Koh. 7,14; opus arte factum, Gen. 6,16. b quod quis peragit vel facit: ኢርእዩ፡ ተግባረ፡ እደዊሁ፡ Jes. 5,12; Ps. 103,14; Hen. 100,9; Koh. 3,22. c fructus a terra productus: ተግባረ፡ ምድር፡ Jer. 14,4. 2 labor, labor operosus, opera: ተግባረ፡ እደው፡ ἐπίπονος ἐργασία Sir. 7,15; Sir. 38,31; ይረሥኡ፡ ውስተ፡ ተግባረ፡ እደዊሆሙ፡ Jes. 65,22; Gen. 3,17; Kuf. p. 14. In specie a agricultura Ps. 103,24; ተግባረ፡ ዘርእ፡ γεωργία Sir. 7,15; Luc. 12,16. b mercatura, negotiatio: ἐμπορία በንዋየ፡ ብርት፡ ረሰዩ፡ ተግባረኪ፡ Hez. 27,13; Hez. 28,5; Hez. 28,16; ἐργασία Ps. 106,23; πράσις Sir. 37,11; ሤጥ፡ ወተግባር፡ πράσις καὶ ἀγορασμός Sir. 27,2; πραγματεία Ps. 70,17. c negotium, munus, quaestus, opificium, modus quivis se alendi et sustentandi (Geschäft, Beruf, Gewerbe): ምንት፡ ተግባርክሙ፡ ἔργον Gen. 46,33; ርሣእ፡ በተግባርከ፡ Sir. 11,20; ἐργασία Jon. 1,8; ኢታብዝኅ፡ ተግባረከ፡ πράξεις Sir. 11,10; ይባርክ፡ ኵሎ፡ ተግባረክሙ፡ ዘተገበርክሙ፡ በዲበ፡ ምድር፡ Kuf. 20; πορισμός 1 Tim. 6,5; 1 Tim. 6,6; ዘኢያበዝኅ፡ ኪነ፡ ወተግባረ፡ Kid. f. 17; Const. Ap. 62(Const. Ap. 63). 3 res labore vel operâ parta a proventus, fructus, quaestus, merces, lucrum: ኵሉ፡ ተግባረ፡ እደዊክሙ፡ Hagg. 1,11; Job 1,10; Jes. 60,21; ጻማኪ፡ ወተግባርኪ፡ πόνοι καὶ μόχθοι Hez. 23,29; ማሰነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ተግባሮሙ፡ ወጸማሆሙ፡ Jer. 23,10; ἔργα Job 39,11; ተግባረ፡ ማእረርከ፡ Job 39,12; οἱ κόποι Sir. 14,15; ቀጻሚ፡ ተግባርከ፡ ἀπαρχὴ χειρῶν σου Sir. 32,10; ዓሥራቲሁ፡ ለተግባርከ፡ Sir. 32,11; μόχθος Jes. 61,8; Jer. 3,24; ἐμπορία Jes. 23,18. b res, opes, bona quae quis possidet, τὰ ἔργα Job 1,3; ዮዲት፡ አተወት፡ ወነበረት፡ ውስተ፡ ተግባራ፡ ἐπὶ τῆς ὑπάρξεως αὐτῆς Judith 16,21; እምብዝኀ፡ ተግባርኪ፡ δυνάμεως σου Hez. 27,18. 4 res qua mercatura fit, merx: አምጽኡ፡ ዓሣኒ፡ ወባዕደኒ፡ ኵሎ፡ ተግባሮሙ፡ 2 Esr. 23,16; ያመጽኡ፡ ተግባሮሙ፡ ደርከኖ፡ … Hez. 27,24.

woorden.betekenis: res labore parta, proventus, fructus
woorden.definitie: (et ተግብርት፡) subst. res labore parta, proventus, fructus: ትግብርቶሙ፡ Kuf. 11; ተግብርተ፡ vel ትግብርተ፡ እክልነ፡ Am. 8,6; ትግብርተ፡ ንህብ፡ Prov. 6,8; Did. 13.

woorden.betekenis: se recipere, colligere, zusammenziehen, recedere, reverti, r
woorden.definitie: I, 1 [proprie: se recipere, sich zurückziehen جَبَأَ; deinde colligere, zusammenziehen, جَبَا ܓܒܳܐ] Subj. ይግባእ፡ 1 recedere, reverti, redire: ድኅረ፡ ኀለፈ፡ ክረምት፡ ወገብአ፡ ዝናም፡ (sc. in suum locum, unde venerat) Sx. Masc. 25 Enc.; ኢይገብእ፡ እንከ፡ Jer. 22,10; Job 10,21; Gen. 18,10; ሑር፡ ወግባእ፡ Prov. 3,28; Hen. 61,5; Hen. 72,5; Act. 18,21; ገቢኦ፡ Marc. 14,40; ይትመየጥ፡ ለገቢእ፡ Koh. 5,14; ብሔረ፡ ኢገቢእ፡ (regio unde non est reversio) Sx. Genb. 28 Enc.; ገብኦ፡ ልቡ፡ (rediit ei animus) Luc. 8,35; Marc. 5,15; c.c. Acc. loci: ገብአ፡ ቤቶ፡ Tob. 8,11; Gen. 18,33; Ex. 4,20; Ex. 4,21; c. Acc. viae Gen. 33,16; Deut. 17,16; c. praep. loci: እመ፡ ገብአ፡ ውስተ፡ ቤቱ፡ Prov. 7,20; Hez. 37,14; ገቢኦትከ፡ ውስተ፡ ሥጋ፡ Asc. Jes. 8,27; Gen. 32,2; Ex. 33,11; Lev. 25,41; Num. 24,25; Deut. 20,5; እገብእ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ Job 1,21; Job 34,15; Gen. 3,19; Kuf. 3; Ps. 103,30; ኵሉ፡ አፍላግ፡ ውስተ፡ ባሕር፡ ይገብእ፡ ማዩ፡ Sir. 40,11; Hen. 42,2; c. ኀበ፡ Gen. 37,29; Hebr. 11,15; c. ለ፡ loci Hen. 89,34; አይቴ፡ ይገብኡ፡ Hen. 41,5; c. ዲበ፡ Hen. 72,29; c. እምነ፡ Ruth 2,6; c. ኀበ፡ pers.: Matth. 2,12; Gen. 8,12; Gen. 16,9; Gen. 18,14; 2 Reg. 17,3; Jer. 3,1; Jer. 3,7; c. ላዕለ፡ pers. Luc. 10,6; Deut. 28,60; ይግብኡ፡ ድኅሬሆሙ፡ Ps. 39,20; Joh. 6,66; Joh. 18,6; c. ዲበ፡ rei Prov. 26,11; 2 Petr. 2,22; c. ውስተ፡ rei vel conditionis, ad quam quis revertitur: Act. 13,34; ይገብእ፡ ውስተ፡ ኀጢአት፡ Sir. 26,28; ገብኡ፡ እምነ፡ ላሕ፡ ውስተ፡ ፍሥሓ፡ Esth. 9,22; reflecti, de finium tractu Jos. 19,27; Jos. 19,29; Jos. 19,34. a recedere, desistere a re: ገብኡ፡ ፩፩፡ እምፍኖት፡ እኩይ፡ Jer. 42,15; Jer. 43,7. b se convertere c. ኀበ፡ 3 Reg. 2,15; ad Deum 1 Reg. 7,3, vel resipiscere: Jer. 4,1; Clem. f. 245; ለእመ፡ ተመይጡ፡ ወገብኡ፡ ውስተ፡ ንስሓ፡ Clem. f. 247; Clem. f. 248. c recĭdere in consuetudinem malam: Jer. 41,16; Clem. f. 245. d seq. alio verbo i.q. α iterum facere aliquid: ግባእ፡ ስክብ፡ 1 Reg. 3,5; ገብአ፡ ወገብረ፡ 3 Reg. 13,33; ኢይገብእ፡ ይርአይ፡ Job 7,7; ተዐንብዝ፡ ገባእከ፡ Job 4,5. β denique vel postremo facere aliquid: ይገብእ፡ ይትኀየልከ፡ et ይገብእ፡ ያሕምምከ፡ Sir. 30,9. e reddi, restitui alicui, 1 Reg. 7,14; Gen. 42,28; Gen. 43,18; vel redire ad possessorem vel dominum pristinum (zurückfallen): ይገብእ፡ ሎቱ፡ ገራህቱ፡ Lev. 25,27; Lev. 27,24; 3 Reg. 12,26. f retrahi, ገብአት፡ እዴሁ፡ ኀቤሁ፡ ወኮነት፡ ከመ፡ ቀዳሚ፡ 3 Reg. 13,6. g restitui in statum pristinum, iterum fieri (id quod aliquid antea fuerat): Gen. 41,13; ሐይወት፡ ወገብአት፡ ከመ፡ ካልእታ፡ Matth. 12,13; Ex. 4,7; ወትገብእ፡ ካዕበ፡ ከመ፡ ትካት፡ Jes. 23,16. h reduci vel redigi in statum vel conditionem: ይገብእ፡ ውስተ፡ ስኢል፡ ἐπιδεὴς γίνεται Sir. 34,4; ገብኡ፡ ይብልዑ፡ እንስሳሆሙ፡ Judith 11,12; ከመ፡ ኢትግባእ፡ ታስተበቍዖሙ፡ Sir. 30,28. i converti vel transmutari in aliquid vel fieri aliquid: መዋቅሕቲሃ፡ ወልታ፡ ጽኑዕ፡ ይከውነከ፡ ወጋጋሃ፡ አልባሰ፡ ክብር፡ ይገብአከ፡ Sir. 6,29; ገብኡ፡ ከመ፡ ዘኢተወልዱ፡ Sir. 44,9; ደኀርት፡ ይገብኡ፡ ቅድመ፡ Marc. 10,31; መዝሙረ፡ ገብአኒ፡ ብካይየ፡ Job 30,31. 2 devenire vel transire in vel ad aliquid vel aliquem, a cedere alicui: res domino vacua ለይግባእ፡ ለቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ F.N. 18; de terra expugnata Num. 21,24. b incĭdere in aliquid, c. ውስተ፡, 4 Esr. 10,43; 2 Reg. 16,8. c se convertere ad aliquem, se adjungere alicui: ገብአ፡ ልቦሙ፡ ኀበ፡ አቤሴሎም፡ 2 Reg. 15,13; ፈላሲ፡ ዘገብአ፡ ኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ὁ προσκείμενος πρὸς θεόν Jes. 56,3; Jes. 56,6; 1 Reg. 29,3; c. ውስተ፡ Jos. 23,12 (προσθῆσθε). d se dedere vel tradere in fidem, ditionem alicujus: ገብኡ፡ ለሊሆሙ፡ ኀበ፡ ኢየሱስ፡ ηὐτομόλησαν Jos. 10,4. e se subjicere vel submittere: ዘኢገብአ፡ ታሕተ፡ ዘየአክዮ፡ ἐδούλευσεν Sir. 25,28. f tradi: ገባእነ፡ ውስተ፡ እደ፡ ጸላእትነ፡ 4 Esr. 10,36; 4 Esr. 4,65; Jes. 36,15; Jes. 37,10; Jer. 21,10; Jer. 26,24; Jer. 39,4; Luc. 24,7; seq. ለ፡ pers. Deut. 28,31; Deut. 28,32; ሀብተ፡ ገብኡ፡ ሊተ፡ እሙንቱ፡ Num. 8,16. g subjici, submitti: ገብኡ፡ ታሕተ፡ እደ፡ ትሑት፡ Sir. 11,6; ገባእነ፡ ውስተ፡ ጸጋ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ἐσμὲν ὑπὸ χάριν Rom. 6,14; Rom. 6,15.

woorden.betekenis: revertere, avertere, convertere, deflectere, declinare facer
woorden.definitie: II, 1 1 revertere a avertere, convertere: ከመ፡ ያግብእዎሙ፡ ለአሕዛብ፡ ኀቤሆሙ፡ Act. 20,30. b deflectere, declinare facere: ከመ፡ እንተ፡ ታገብእ፡ ዐይነ፡ መዳልው፡ Jes. 40,15; 4 Esr. 1,35. c retro vertere: ያገብኦሙ፡ ድኅሬሆሙ፡ ለጠቢባን፡ Jes. 44,25; Ps. 20,12; Ps. 43,12. d rejicere: ያገብኦ፡ ድኅረ፡ ዘባኑ፡ Sir. 21,15; Ps. 49,18. e retrahere Hen. 60,16. 2 redire facere, a reducere, aliquem vel aliquid: እመ፡ አእተተ፡ መኑ፡ ያገብእ፡ Job 9,12; ቦኑ፡ እክል፡ አግብኦቶ፡ 2 Reg. 12,23; ዕራቅየ፡ አግብአኒ፡ Ruth 1,21; ያገብእ፡ ሌሊተ፡ Job 34,25; c. Acc. seq. ውስተ፡ loci Gen. 28,15; Gen. 48,21; Num. 22,23; ታገብአኒ፡ ውስተ፡ መሬት፡ Job 10,9; Sir. 17,1; Jer. 23,3; Jer. 37,3; አልቦ፡ ዘያገብኦ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ውስተ፡ ሕዝቡ፡ συνάγων Jes. 13,14; seq. Acc. loci: አግብኦ፡ ብሔሮ፡ Dan. apocr. 13,39; seq. ኀበ፡ pers.: Gen. 42,37; ከመ፡ ያግብእ፡ ልበ፡ አብ፡ ኀበ፡ ውሉድ፡ Sir. 48,10. b reportare vel referre aliquid: ያገብኡ፡ ለክሙ፡ ንዋየ፡ ቤተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ እምባቢሎን፡ Jer. 34,13; Gen. 44,8; ርግብ፡ ዘሥልሰ፡ አግብአት፡ ቃለ፡ ለኖኅ፡ Rel. Bar. c remittere, 1 Reg. 29,4; አግብአቶ፡ አስቴር፡ ለዝኩ፡ ዘመጽአ፡ Esth. 4,15. d restituere aliquid vel aliquem in locum vel statum pristinum: አግብእ፡ መጥባሕተከ፡ ውስተ፡ ቤቱ፡ Matth. 26,52; 1 Par. 21,27; አግብኦ፡ ውስተ፡ ግብሩ፡ Kuf. 39; Gen. 40,13; Ps. 15,5; Sx. Ter 5 Enc. (vid. sub ህላዌ፡); animam i.e. recreare: ዘያገብኣ፡ ለነፍስየ፡ Thren. 1,16; Ruth 4,15. e reddere, c. Acc. rei et ለ፡ pers., ut rem vi vel furto ablatam Deut. 28,31; Jud. 17,3; Lev. 5,23; Num. 5,7; 2 Reg. 9,7; Tob. 2,13; amissam Ex. 23,4; Deut. 22,2; pignus Ex. 22,25; Deut. 24,13; Hez. 18,7; alia 2 Esr. 15,11; በርበረ፡ ማኅፈደ፡ ወኢያግብአ፡ Job 20,19; አግብአ፡ ፈርዖን፡ ሳራሃ፡ ለአብራም፡ Kuf. 13; 4 Esr. 5,33; Apoc. 20,13; Hen. 51,1; Matth. 27,3; reddere responsum p. 484. α referre opus imperatum, postquam perfectum est, Ex. 5,18. β redire facere possessionem ad possessorem pristinum Lev. 25,28; Lev. 25,31. γ retribuere, referre, rependere, c. Acc. rei et ላዕለ፡ pers. Hez. 7,3; Hez. 7,4; ኣገብእ፡ ፍኖተኪ፡ ላዕለ፡ ርእስኪ፡ Hez. 16,43; 1 Reg. 25,39; ከመ፡ ያግብእ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ዐውያተ፡ ነዳያን፡ Job 34,28; c. Acc. et ለ፡ Gen. 50,15; Jes. 65,6; c. Acc. rei: እግዚአብሔር፡ ያገብእ፡ ዕስየተ፡ Sir. 32,13; እግዚአብሔር፡ ያገብእ፡ ፍትሐ፡ Jes. 35,4. δ reddere rationem, seq. ሐሳበ፡ vel ቃለ፡, ut: ያገብእ፡ ሐሳበ፡ ለዘይኴንን፡ 1 Petr. 4,5; በእንቲአሁ፡ Matth. 12,36; ኣገብእ፡ ቃለ፡ በእንተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘገበርኩ፡ Genz. f. 125; etiam omisso ቃለ፡, ut: ከመ፡ ያግብኡ፡ ኀቤሆሙ፡ ነገሥት፡ Dan. 6,2. ε reddere i.e. ferre sententiam, seq. ፍትሐ፡ Marc. 14,64; በጽድቅ፡ ያገብእ፡ ፍትሐ፡ Jes. 42,3; Jes. 42,4; ያገብኡ፡ ሎቱ፡ ፍትሐ፡ Sir. 8,14; አግብአ፡ ፍትሐ፡ ለዘሩባቤል፡ Lud. ex Org. Edz. f reposcere, c. Acc. rei et እምነ፡ pers., F.N. 24,3 (vid. sub ሕፄ፡ col. 140). g referre tributa, vectigalia, i.e. pendere: እለ፡ ያገብኡ፡ ጸባሕተ፡ 2 Reg. 8,2; Gen. 47,24 (ubi F ታጋብኡ፡ II, 3 exhibet); Gen. 47,26; አልብከ፡ ጸባሕት፡ ወኢያገብኡ፡ ለከ፡ 2 Esr. 4,13; Rom. 13,6. h redigere α aliquid in ditionem alicujus: አግብአ፡ ለፈርዖን፡ ኵሎ፡ ምድሮሙ፡ Gen. 47,20. β aliquem i.e. adigere, seq. Subj.: ፍቅረ፡ ክርስቶስ፡ ያገብአነ፡ (Platt ያጌብረነ፡) ናጥብዕ፡ 2 Cor. 5,13. i transmutare aliquid in aliquid (vid. ገብአ፡ Nr. 1, i): ትፍሥሕተክሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ትካዝ፡ አግብእዎ፡ Jac. 4,9. 3 facere ut aliquid veniat ad aliquem i.e. tradere: አግብኡ፡ ቀርኖሙ፡ ለባዕድ፡ ወክብሮሙኒ፡ ለካልእ፡ Sir. 49,5; 1 Reg. 18,8; seq. ቅድመ፡ pers.: Jud. 11,9, vel ውስተ፡ እደ፡ Matth. 26,45; 1 Reg. 23,4; Deut. 3,2; Deut. 3,3; Dan. 1,2; Jes. 19,4; Jes. 51,23; Jer. 39,3; Hen. 95,3; vel seq. ውስተ፡, ut: ኣገብኦሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ኲናት፡ Jer. 15,9. a urbem hosti Judith 7,13; Judith 7,26; Judith 10,12; vel dedere aliquem captivum: ያገብኡ፡ ርእሶሙ፡ ኀቤከ፡ Judith 2,10. b dedere: እለ፡ አግብኡ፡ ነፍሶሙ፡ ለከ፡ Lit. Joh. c prodere Prov. 28,21; Matth. 10,4; Matth. 26,21; Matth. 27,3. d subjicere, seq. Acc. et ታሕተ፡ Ps. 109,2. e permittere res suas alicui, 1 Petr. 2,23.

woorden.betekenis: in unum redire, iterum cogi, colligi
woorden.definitie: III, 1 in unum redire, iterum cogi vel colligi, de rebus quae post separationem in pristinum statum redeunt: ማይ፡ እምከመ፡ ተክዕወ፡ ኢይትገባእ፡ (v. ኢይትጋባእ፡) እንከ፡ 2 Reg. 14,14; ይትገባእ፡ (v. ይትጋባእ፡) ማይ፡ ዲበ፡ ግብጽ፡ Ex. 14,26; ይትነፈቅ፡ እስራኤል፡ ወኢይትገባእ፡ እንከ፡ 1 Reg. 15,29 (var. pro ወኢይትጋባእ፡).

woorden.betekenis: se contrahere, contrahi, coire, claudi, desistere, confluere
woorden.definitie: III, 3 se contrahere vel contrahi i.e. a coire, claudi, de rebus apertis: ትትጋባእኑ፡ መሥገርት፡ Am. 3,5; አብቂዎ፡ አፉየ፡ ኢተጋብአ፡ እንከ፡ Hez. 33,22; 4 Esr. 14,44 (ubi Laur., Ludolfum secutus, male desistere interpretatus est); Org. 2; de rebus separatis 1 Reg. 15,29. b confluere, de fluidis, Gen. 1,9; Hen. 18,10; Ex. 14,26 var. c comprehendi: ፀነስኪዮ፡ እንዘ፡ ኢይትጋባእ፡ Lit. 171,1; Org. 1; d cogi, colligi, de inanimatis Jes. 33,4; ወተጋብኡ፡ ፬ ሙስናት፡ ዘውእቶሙ፡ ቀትል፡ ወዋዕይ፡ ወፀብእ፡ ወረኃብ፡ ( concurrere ) Jsp. p. 356; de ovibus Jes. 60,7; de exercitu 1 Reg. 17,1; 1 Reg. 28,1; de hominibus Matth. 25,32; Hen. 27,2. e se congregare, congregari, convenire, Gen. 29,3; Gen. 49,2; Jud. 16,23; 1 Reg. 25,1; Jes. 35,10; ተጋብኡ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ኅብረ፡ Jes. 43,9; Jes. 45,20; Jes. 49,18; Jes. 60,4; ህየ፡ ይትጋብኡ፡ አንስርት፡ Matth. 24,28; Matth. 26,57; Matth. 28,12; Marc. 2,2; Luc. 22,66; Act. 13,44; Hen. 56,5; al. creberrime; ተጋብኦት፡ congregatio, conventus, Lit. Epiph.; c. ውስተ፡ loci Jer. 3,17; 1 Reg. 7,6; Matth. 26,3 vel rei Apoc. 19,17; c. ዲበ፡ Hen. 22,3; c. ላዕለ፡ vel ኀበ፡ pers. Judith 7,23; ተጋብኡ፡ ኀቤሁ፡ 2 Esr. 10,1; 2 Esr. 18,13; 1 Par. 11,1; Ex. 32,26; Matth. 13,2; Matth. 22,34; c. ምስለ፡ Ps. 2,2; Matth. 12,30 rom.; Apoc. 19,19 al. f se recipere (e medio tolli) Hen. 81,9. g in arithmetica: colligi in unam summam, ut: ዘተጋብአ፡ i.e. summa Abush. 11 seq. – (Rom. 13, 6 rom. pro ተጋብኡ፡ legendum est ታገብኡ፡, neque est quod cum Lud. significationem stirpis III, 3 transitivam statuamus).

woorden.betekenis: ad se recipere, contrahere, ad se rapere, traducere, apud se
woorden.definitie: IV,3 rarius አስተግብአ፡ et አስተገብአ፡ III,1 (Num. 21,32; Jud. 1,8 var.; 1 Reg. 30,8 var.; Act. 28,17 rom.) 1 ad se recipere, i.e. a contrahere, ut alas: ያስተጋብኡ፡ ክነፊሆሙ፡ Hez. 1,24; manus: ታስተጋብእ፡ እዴከ፡ ዲበ፡ እንግድዓከ፡ Prov. 6,10; Prov. 24,48. b ad se rapere vel traducere: መራዕየከ፡ አስተጋብአ፡ Kuf. 35. c apud se recipere, tutelae causa: Deut. 22,2; ኢይሌብዉ፡ ለምንት፡ አስተጋብኦ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ἠσφαλίσατο αὐτόν Sap. 4,17. d recuperare amissa 1 Reg. 7,14; 1 Reg. 30,8; 1 Reg. 30,19; 4 Reg. 14,22. 2 facere ut res se contrahant, coeant, redeant in pristinum statum, a iterum confluere facere aquas (antea diremtas), Ex. 15,19. b adjungere rem rei: አስተጋብኦሙ፡ ለአዕፅምት፡ ውስተ፡ መለያልዩ፡ ዘዚአሆሙ፡ Hez. 37,7. c claudere, ut structuram aedificii Gen. 6,16; agmen Jes. 52,12. 3 comprehendere: complecti: ኣስተጋብእ፡ ሥጋየ፡ በስነንየ፡ Job 13,14; ያስተጋብእ፡ አባግዒሁ፡ በመዝራዕቱ፡ Jes. 40,11; Deut. 32,11; transl.: ኢያስተጋብኡ፡ ውስተ፡ ኅሊናሆሙ፡ ፍካሬሁ፡ ለዝ፡ Sap. 4,15. 4 a cogere, colligere copias, exercitum: 1 Reg. 17,1; 1 Reg. 28,4; homines, populos Joel 4,2; Jes. 11,12; Jes. 27,12; Jes. 43,5; Jes. 60,22; Jes. 66,18; Jer. 23,3; Jer. 37,21; Deut. 30,3; Ps. 106,2; Sir. 33,13; Matth. 22,10; al.; አስተጋብኦሙ፡ ውስተ፡ እደኲናት፡ Jer. 18,21; bestias: አስተጋብአ፡ እንስሳሁ፡ ውስተ፡ አብያት፡ Ex. 9,20; Jes. 34,16. b congregare, 1 Par. 28,1; Esth. 4,16; Ex. 3,16; Num. 21,16; 1 Reg. 14,52; 1 Reg. 22,2; 2 Reg. 12,28; Hen. 22,3; Hen. 91,1; Matth. 2,4; Matth. 27,27; Joh. 11,47; Act. 14,27; al. crebro. c colligere, congerere, Koh. 2,9; Koh. 2,25; ለአስተጋብኦ፡ እብን፡ Koh. 3,5; spicas Ruth 2,8; Ruth 2,17; fruges, fructus Kuf. 3; Jes. 17,5; Jes. 29,1; Jes. 62,9; Jer. 47,10; Ex. 23,10; Lev. 23,39; commeatum Kuf. 40; Gen. 6,21; Gen. 41,48; frusta, fragmenta Joh. 6,12; spolia Deut. 13,17; stipulas Ex. 5,7; sarmenta Joh. 15,6; ligna Jer. 7,18; locustas Jes. 33,4; aquas Ps. 32,7; pecuniam, opes 4 Reg. 22,4; Job 27,16; Prov. 13,11; አስተጋብአ፡ ንዋየ፡ ብዙኀ፡ Sx. Sen. 13, al.; res suas Luc. 15,13; transl.: አስተጋብአ፡ ኅሊናሁ፡ collegit animum suum, Lud. ex Hom. Jac. Sar. d conjungere vel simul obtinere plures res: Hyrcanus አስተጋብአ፡ ሢመተ፡ ክህነት፡ ወመንግሥት፡ Jsp. p. 300. e cumulare, Ruth 2,14. f breviter complecti vel colligere orationem ( zusammenfassen ) Phlx. 4(vid. sub ክፍል፡ col. 878). g in arithmetica: addere numerum numero, c. Acc. et ኀበ፡, vel c. Acc. utriusque numeri ( consummare ), Abush. 11. h compilare librum: F.M. 1,2 (vid. sub ክፍል፡); አስተጋብአ፡ አሐተኔ፡ (sc. in unum librum) ምግባረ፡ ጻድቃን፡ Sx. Teq. 25 Enc. 5 in suam ditionem redigere, expugnare, capere, Num. 21,32; Deut. 3,4; Jud. 1,8; Jud. 1,12; Jud. 1,13; 2 Reg. 5,7; 1 Par. 11,8; Jes. 10,14; Jes. 20,1; Jes. 36,1; Jer. 28,31; Judith 1,14; Judith 10,13; transl.: suum facere, lucrifacere aliquem, κερδαίνειν 1 Cor. 9,19 seq.

woorden.betekenis: reditus, reditio, reversio, conversio, proditio, gǝbʾat, gǝb
woorden.definitie: n. act., fem. et m., 1 reditus, reditio, reversio: ሑረት፡ ወግብአት፡ Zach. 7,14; ግብአትከ፡ ውስተ፡ ርስትከ፡ Clem. f. 7; Hen. 41,5; Jsp. p. 319; ዜና፡ ግብአቱ፡ ለአግሪጳስ፡ ኀበ፡ ሮሜ፡ Jsp. p. 346; በግብአቱ፡ ἐν τῷ ἀνακάμπτειν αὐτόν 2 Reg. 8,13; in Acc. temporis: ግብአትየ፡ ἐν τῷ ἐπανέρχεσθαί με Luc. 10,35. 2 conversio peccatoris, Kedr f. 33; Kedr f. 83; Lud. e Vit. Pach. 3 proditio: በእንተ፡ ግብአቱ፡ ለክርስቶስ፡ Matth. 26,47 in tit.; Org. 5. gǝbʾat, ግባት፡ gǝbāt 1 royal reception ወእምዝ፡ ቦአ፡ ግባት፡ በከመ፡ ሕጉ። ‘Alors il entra à la réception royale, selon sa loi’ 38 l. 14 (ed.), 44 l. 21-22 (tr.) 2 a military inspection conducted when soldiers stand in ranks (224 notes that in the example above (4) ግባት፡ ‘è il ricevimento presso il re, ma qui sembra riferirsi direttamente a Sepenhi che vi andò con i soldati in bell’ordine «come porta la regola»’. Alternatively, the word ‘risponde... ad una specie di rivista, vale a dire quando le truppe sono in fila e in bell’ordine, ma non in ordine di battaglia’.)

woorden.betekenis: locus quo quis se convertit, recipit, refugium, receptus, re
woorden.definitie: subst. 1 locus quo quis se convertit vel recipit, refugium, receptus, ἐπιστροφή, ἀποστροφή: ኀቤየ፡ ምግባኢሁ፡ Cant. 7,11; Gen. 3,16; Gen. 4,7; Kuf. 3; 1 Petr. 2,4; Hen. 65,11. 2 reditus: እስመ፡ አልቦ፡ ምግባኣ፡ Sir. 22,11; ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ምግባኢሆሙ፡ Sir. 16,30; Sir. 41,10; ምግባኡ፡ Hen. 72,35; ሎቱ፡ (ለሞት፡) ተፈጠርነ፡ ወኀቤሁ፡ ምግባኢነ፡ Jsp. p. 382; የሐውር፡ ውስተ፡ ፍኖት፡ እንተ፡ አልቦቲ፡ ምግባአ፡ ለዓለም፡ Genz. f. 119.

woorden.betekenis: congregatus, locus congregationis, conventus, spatium contra
woorden.definitie: 1 part. congregatus: ምስትጉቡኣት፡ አእላፍ፡ እምነ፡ መላእክት፡ Chrys. ho. 32; Hen. 46,8 var. 2 subst. a locus congregationis, conventus: ቤተ፡ ምስትጉቡአ፡ ዚአሁ፡ Hen. 53,6; Hen. 46,8. b spatium contractum vel angustius: non est in divinitate ምስፋሕ፡ ወምስትጉቡእ፡ Lud. e Mss. Colb.

woorden.betekenis: buccina minor, gantā, 18 agrafes en or, zagantā
woorden.definitie: subst., buccina minor (quam ቀንድ፡ i.e. ቀርን፡): ዐዊዶሙ፡ ምስለ፡ ገንታ፡ ወግርጣጥ፡ በከበሮ፡ ወጸናጽል፡ Chron. Ax. f. 94. – Voc. Ae.: ቀርን፡ ገንታ፡ ዘ፡ ነጋሪት፡ – De ገንታ፡ vid. Description de l’Egypte, éd. II, t. XIII p. 542. gantā ዘገንታ፡ ግትዕ፡ ወርቅ፡ ፲ወ፰። ‘18 agrafes en or, zagantā’ 71 l. 22 (ed.), 86 l. 4 (tr.) (Zagantā: ‘Mot à mot: «de trompette» 86 n. 6) C for ነፋሕ፡ ገንታ፡ vid. ነፋሕ፡

woorden.betekenis: hortus, hortulanus, terram paradisiacam, paradisus
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque fem., Pl. ገነታተ፡ [גַּן ܓܰܢܬܳܐ جَنَّةٌ] hortus, παράδεισος Koh. 2,4; Jes. 1,30; Sir. 24,30; ገነተ፡ አቅማሕ፡ Dan. apocr. 1,7 seq.; κῆπος ገነት፡ ዕፅውት፡ Cant. 4,12; Cant. 4,16; Cant. 6,2; ገነት፡ ርውይት፡ Jes. 58,11; Jes. 61,11; Sir. 24,31; Joh. 19,41; Joh. 18,1; Joh. 18,26; ገነተ፡ ጽጌ፡ Sx. Teq. 4Enc.; ዐቃቤ፡ ገነት፡ κηπουρός hortulanus Joh. 20,15; Pl. ገነታት፡ Jsp. p. 323. In specie a hortus ille in regione Eden a Deo plantatus: Gen. 2,8 seq.; 4 Esr. 1,7; ገነተ፡ ተድላ፡ Gen. 3,23; ገነተ፡ ትፍሥሕት፡ Gen. 3,24; ገነተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Gen. 13,10; Jes. 51,3; Hez. 31,8; Sir. 40,17; Apoc. 2,7; ገነተ፡ ጽድቅ፡ Hen. 32,3; ገነተ፡ ጻድቃን፡ Hen. 60,23; ምድረ፡ ገነት፡ terram paradisiacam Aethiopum nonnulli vocant patriam suam, Th. P. b sedes beatorum ( paradisus ): Luc. 23,43; 2 Cor. 12,4; 4 Esr. 8,62; Clem. f. 6; ገነተ፡ ትፍሥሕት፡ 4 Esr. 6,1; Clem. f. 14; Clem. f. 92al.; ገነተ፡ ተድላ፡ Lit. Chrys.; ገነተ፡ ሕይወት፡ Hen. 61,12; ገነት፡ est ሰማይ፡ ሣልሲት፡ ubi recipientur monachi fideles, Phlx. 8. c ገነት፡ inscriptus est liber de rebus monasticis a Palladio conscriptus: መጽሐፈ፡ ገነት፡ ዘጸሐፈ፡ ጰላድዮስ፡ Phlx. 43; ጸሓፌ፡ ገነት፡ ይቤ፡ Phlx. 16, al.

woorden.betekenis: pronum se inclinavit, decubuit, pronum se inclinare, procumb
woorden.definitie: I,1 [جَنَأَ pronum se inclinavit, ܓܢܳܐ decubuit, vic. قنع, כנע, צנע] Subj. ይግነይ፡ 1 pronum se inclinare, procumbere: ግነዩ፡ ወስግዱ፡ πίπτοντες προσκυνεῖτε Dan. 3,5. 2 se submittere vel subjicere, obsequium praestare, ( servire ) alicui, c. ለ፡ pers.: ὑποταγῆναι Ps. 61,5; Hebr. 12,9; 1 Cor. 15,28; Luc. 10,20; ለጽድቀ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ስእኑ፡ ገኒየ፡ Rom. 10,3; ለከ፡ ይገንዩ፡ ኵሉ፡ ተግባርከ፡ δουλευσάτω Judith 16,14; እፎ፡ ሠመርክሙ፡ ከመ፡ ትግነዩ፡ ለአቢባል፡ (Hannibali) Jsp. p. 295; Jsp. p. 350; Jsp. p. 381; ruri vixit እንዘ፡ ለሊቁ፡ ይገኒ፡ Sx. Tachs. 10Enc.; Org. 3 demittere animum, submisse se gerere, Hen. 5,8. a demisso animo pati: ግነዩ፡ ταλαιπωρῆσατε Jac. 4,9. b demisso animo accipere vel admittere aliquid, c. ለ፡, ut: ዘይፈርሆ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ይገኒ፡ ለተግሣጹ፡ ἐκδέξεται Sir. 35,14. c demisso animo confidere, c. በ፡, ut: ብእሲ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ይትአመን፡ ወይገኒ፡ በሕጉ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ἐμπιστεύσει Sir. 36,3. d humiliter adorare, c. ለ፡, προσκυνεῖν Sir. 50,17. e humiliter rogare, supplicare: ውእቱ፡ ይገኒ፡ προσδεηθήσεται Sir. 13,3; c. ለ፡ pers.: ገነይኩ፡ ለከ፡ δέομαι Jos. 7,7; ይገንዩ፡ ለከ፡ Job 11,19. f humiles gratias agere, humili et grato animo celebrare vel laudare Deum: ἐξομολογεῖσθαι, Dan. 9,4; c. ለ፡ Kuf. 16; እግነይ፡ ለከ፡ አምላኪየ፡ Kuf. 22; Sir. 39,6; Sir. 51,1; Tob. 11,16; ሎቱ፡ ግነዩ፡ Tob. 12,6; ኢትትሀከዩ፡ ገኒየ፡ ሎቱ፡ Tob. 12,6; Tob. 13,3; Dan. 2,23; Ps. 7,18; Ps. 9,1; Ps. 74,1; ኵሉ፡ ልሳን፡ ይገኒ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ὀμεῖται τὸν θεὸν Jes. 45,23; Rom. 14,11; Luc. 2,38. g humili animo confiteri, seq. ከመ፡ Phil. 2,11; seq. ለ፡ peccati, Lev. 26,41. – Voc. Ae.: ገረረ፡ ገነየ፡ ተኰነነ፡ ተቀንየ፡ ብ፡ ተገዛ፡ ገነየሰ፡ አመነሂ፡; aliud: ገነየ፡ በ፪ ለመነ፡ ተለማመጠ።

woorden.betekenis: se submittere coram, supplicare, confiteri, poenitentiam age
woorden.definitie: III,3 se submittere coram aliquo, ut: ነገር፡ ዘይትጋነይ፡ ὑποπίπτουσα (submissa) Prov. 15,1. a supplicare, c. Acc. vel ለ፡ pers.: እትጋነያ፡ ለብእሲትየ፡ ἱκέτευον Job 19,17; እንዘ፡ ይትጋነይ፡ ለከ፡ ወይየውሀከ፡ Job 40,22; Hos. 12,4; 1 Tim. 2,1. b confiteri: peccatum, culpam, ἐξαγορεύειν 2 Esr. 10,1; በእንተ፡ ኀጢአት፡ 2 Esr. 11,6; 2 Esr. 19,2; Trinitatem, c. በ፡ M.M. f. 11 (vid. ግጻዌ፡). c poenitentiam agere, veniam delicti petere, gratiam alicujus supplicare: ተጋነይ፡ ሶበ፡ ትኤብስ፡ ἐπιστροφήν Sir. 18,21; ነስሕ፡ ወተጋነይ፡ Sir. 18,24; እምከመ፡ ተጋነይከ፡ ይሰሪ፡ ለከ፡ ኀጢአተከ፡ δεηθέντος σου Sir. 28,2; ተጋነዩ፡ συδέθητε Zeph. 2,1; Luc. 17,4; c. በእንተ፡ vel እንበይነ፡ peccati: ተጋነይ፡ በእንተ፡ ዘስሕትከ፡ ἐντράπηθι Sir. 4,25; ዘይትጋነይ፡ በእንተ፡ ጌጋዩ፡ ἀποστρέφων ἀπό Sir. 8,5; ተጋነይ፡ እንበይነ፡ ዘቅድም፡ ጌጋይከ፡ δεήθητι Sir. 26,1; Sir. 39,5; Lit. Chrys.; c. ለ፡ ejus, cujus gratia petitur: ተጋነየ፡ ለገጸ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ 4 Reg. 13,4; እለ፡ ይትጋነዩ፡ ሎቱ፡ οἱ ἐπιστρέφοντες ἐπ᾿ αὐτόν Sir. 17,29; Zach. 8,21; Bar. 2,8; እንዘ፡ ይትጋነይ፡ ላቲ፡ Esth. 7,8; vel c. ኀበ፡ vel ቅድመ፡ pers.: ተጋነየ፡ ኀቤሆሙ፡ Clem. f. 161; ተጋነዩ፡ ወሰገዱ፡ ቅድሜሆሙ፡ Clem. f. 230; Sir. 17,25. d humiles gratias agere, humili et grato animo celebrare Deum: ተጋንዮ፡ 1 Tim. 2,1; ἐξομολογεῖσθαι Ps. 99,4; Dan. 6,10; Sir. 17,27. – Voc. Ae: ተጋነየ፡ ዘ፡ አሠመረ።

woorden.betekenis: rigidi, crassi, robusti, stirps, stipes, truncus, caudex, ra
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. አጕናድ፡ et ጕንዳት፡ [quamquam a ገመደ፡ derivari posse videtur, sicut גֶּזַע جِذْعٌ a גָּזַע, tamen aliud etymon facile se praebet sc. in جمد et قمد quibus significatus rigidi ( crassi, robusti ) inest, vid. quae Rödiger in Additamentis ad Ges. thes. p. 80 de גֹּמֶר annotavit] 1 stirps, stipes, truncus, caudex: እምጕንድ፡ ἐκ τῆς ῥίζης Jes. 11,1; ጕንዱሂ፡ ዘታሕቴሁ፡ ῥίζαι Hez. 17,6; Hez. 17,7; ጕንደ፡ ዕፀው፡ Matth. 3,10; Luc. 3,9; Dan. 2,41; ሥርዎ፡ ወጕንዶ፡ τὴν φυὴν τῶν ῥιζῶν αὐτοῦ Dan. 4,12; ጕንዱ፡ στελέχη Hez. 31,13; ጕንደ፡ ወይን፡ Joh. 15,4; ለለአሐቲ፡ ጕንድ፡ በበ፡ ፴ ወ ፩፼ አዕጹቂሃ፡ Clem. f. 256; ጕንዳት፡ Hen. 83,4; አጕናደ፡ በቀልት፡ Sx. Mij. 23Enc. (Sx. Mij. 27Enc. sec. Lud.); ጕንደ፡ መስቀል፡ M.M. f. 106; አጕናድ፡ (sc. duo ligna crucis, erectum et transversarium) M.M. f. 102. a radix linguae: አዘዘ፡ ያውቅዩ፡ ልሳና፡ እምጕንዱ፡ Sx. Masc. 5; Sx. Teq. 18. b radix vel infima pars, montis: እምነ፡ ጕንደ፡ ደብር፡ Judith 7,12; Gad. Za Mich.; in Acc. et st. c. juxta radicem, ad infimam partem rei, infra: አስርዎ፡ ጕንደ፡ ደብር፡ Judith 6,13; ጕንደ፡ ደብር፡ ἐπ᾽ ὄρους Ex. 18,3; ጕንደ፡ ማኅፈድ፡ παρὰ τὸν πύργον Herm. p. 81. c stirps i.e. genus: ጕንደ፡ ዳዊት፡ Lud. ex Org. 1. 2 cippus vel truncus, quo captivorum pedes conclusi tenentur: τὸ ξύλον Act. 16,24; ጕንደ፡ ማእስር፡ Lud. ex Sx. Enc.

woorden.betekenis: stabilem esse, manere, durare, perseverare, diu manere, mora
woorden.definitie: quadril. I [videtur denominatum a ጕንድ፡] 1 stabilem esse, manere, durare, perseverare: ኢይጐነዲ፡ ንዋዩ፡ οὐ μὴ μείνῃ Job 15,29; ከመ፡ ልብስ፡ ዘኢይጐነዲ፡ ፍጡነ፡ ይበልዩ፡ Jes. 51,8; ጐንደየ፡ እንዘ፡ ይጐደጕድ፡ ἐπέμενε κρούων Act. 12,16; ስፍነ፡ ዘመነ፡ ጐንደየት፡ . p. 498 Nr. 18. 2 diu manere, moram facere vel trahere, morari, Deut. 4,26; Lev. 13,10; እመሂ፡ ጐንደይኩ፡ ἐὰν ὑπομείνω Job 17,13. a c. Acc. Infin.: diu vel dudum facere aliquid, ut: ኢትጐንዲ፡ ርሒቆቶ፡ Sir. 30,10; ጐንደየ፡ ግሒሠ፡ ህየ፡ 4 Reg. 4,8. b commorari: ኀበ፡ ዘአልቦ፡ ልብ፡ ኢትጐነዲ፡ οὐκ ἐμμενεῖ Sir. 6,20; ኢትጐንዲ፡ ውስተ፡ መካና፡ Prov. 9,18; Act. 20,16; c. Acc. loci: ጐንደዩ፡ አንጾኪያ፡ Act. 15,35. c immorari rei: እለ፡ ይጐነድዩ፡ ውስተ፡ ስታየ፡ ወይን፡ Prov. 23,30. d aliquantum temporis manere, quare Infin. verb. nonnunquam vertere licet: tempore interjecto, ut: ወጐንዲዮ፡ (v. ወጐንድዮ፡) የብሰ፡ μετὰ χρόνον Jes. 27,11; Marc. 2,1. e longinquum esse, de tempore (apud poëtam): ኢይሴአል፡ ዘቅሩብ፡ ወኢየሐትት፡ ዘይጐነዲ፡ Sx. Sen. 17Enc. (Lud. 18). 3 cunctari, morari, tardare: χρονίζειν ጐንደየ፡ እምነ፡ ዕድሜሁ፡ 2 Reg. 20,5; 4 Esr. 3,53; ተዘከር፡ ከመ፡ ኢይጐነዲ፡ መንሱት፡ Sir. 7,16; Sir. 14,12; ዝኵሉ፡ ይከውን፡ ፍጡነ፡ ወኢይጐነዲ፡ Jes. 14,1; Jes. 51,14; እመ፡ ጐንደይኩ፡ ጥቀ፡ Tob. 9,4; መዐት፡ ኢጐንደየ፡ Sap. 18,20; Hab. 2,3; Hebr. 10,37; βραδύνειν 1 Tim. 3,15; 2 Petr. 3,9; ሶበ፡ ጐንደየ፡ ምጽአቱ፡ Sx. Masc.; c. Acc. Infin.: Gen. 34,19; Ex. 32,1; Kuf. 17; ኢትጐንዲ፡ (v. ኢታጐንዲ፡) ገቢሮቶ፡ Judith 2,13; ኢይጐነዲ፡ ተገፍትኦ፡ ቤቱ፡ Sir. 27,3; vel c. ለ፡ et. Infin.: ይጐነዲያ፡ ለተገብሮ፡ βραδέως ἐγένοντο Herm. p. 81. – Voc. Ae.: ጐንደየ፡ ዘ፡ ዘገየ።

woorden.betekenis: tardare, morari, differre, tardum, cunctabundum esse, produc
woorden.definitie: II, 1 tardare, morari, differre aliquid, tardum, cunctabundum esse in aliqua re, c. Acc. rei vel c. Acc. Infin.: ኢታጐንዲ፡ ጸሎተከ፡ Kuf. 31; ኢያርሕቃ፡ (ለጽድቅየ፡) ወኢያጐነዲ፡ መድኀኒትየ፡ Jes. 46,13; 2 Petr. 3,9; አንከርኩ፡ አጐንድዮተክሙ፡ ትእዛዘ፡ ንጉሥ፡ Jsp. p. 291; ኢታጐንዲ፡ ውሂቦተ፡ Koh. 5,3; Sir. 18,22; ኢያጐነዲ፡ ፈቲሐ፡ ለጻድቅ፡ Job 36,17; Deut. 7,10; omisso Acc.: እመ፡ ብዙኀ፡ አጐንደየ፡ Lev. 25,36; ያጐነዲ፡ ከመ፡ ዘኢይሁብ፡ Lit. Orth. 2 morari, differre, producere aliquem (warten lassen), c. Acc. pers.: አበያ፡ ወአጐንደያ፡ Luc. 18,4; c. Acc. pers. et Acc. Infin.: ሕፃን፡ ይበኪ፡ እመ፡ አጐንደየቶ፡ እሙ፡ አጥብዎ፡ M.M. f. 98. 3 diu manere, Deut. 4,26 var.

woorden.betekenis: finxit, coagulavit, formavit, later, lapis coctus, farina la
woorden.definitie: subst., (m.), sing. et coll., [an a גְּבַל ܓܒܰܠ (جبل) finxit, coagulavit, formavit ?] 1 later, lapis coctus: πλίνθος Hez. 4,1; πλίνθοι, ንጥፋሕ፡ ግንፋለ፡ ወናበስሎ፡ በእሳት፡ Gen. 11,3; Ex. 1,14; Ex. 5,7; Ex. 5,14 seq.; Ex. 24,10; Kuf. 10; ግንፋል፡ ወድቀ፡ Jes. 9,10; Nah. 3,14; Judith 5,11; Hen. 99,13; Macc. f. 11(ubi ter ግልፋል፡ scriptum est). 2 ut videtur: farina latericia, pulvis laterum: በቍስሉ፡ ወደዩ፡ ግንፋለ፡ Sx. Genb. 6Enc.; ደመረ፡ ፄወ፡ ምስለ፡ ግንፋል፡ ወፍልፍል፡ ወብሒእ፡ ወከዐወ፡ ውስተ፡ አንፎሙ፡ Sx. Haml. 8; ወውስጠ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ ከመ፡ ይቅብእዎ፡ በፄው፡ ወብሒእ፡ ወግንፋል፡ Sx. Genb. 26. – Voc. Ae. ad Jes.: ግንፋል፡ ዘ፡ ግምብ፡

woorden.betekenis: fastidire, indignari, improbare, vituperare, reprehendere, e
woorden.definitie: (etiam ግዕዘ፡) I,1 [ni fallor, emollitum e קוּץ קוּט ቈጥዐ፡, sicut ܓܥܰܨ ܓܥܻܝܙܳܐ; vid. etiam, ገየጸ፡] Subj. ይግአዝ፡ 1 fastidire, indignari, c. Acc.: ገአዝኩ፡ ሕይወትየ፡ Kuf. p. 98(קצתי apud Hebr., προσώχθικα apud LXX Gen. 27,46); χολᾶν τινί Joh. 7,23 rom.; πικραίνεσθαι Col. 3,19 Platt. 2 improbare, vituperare, reprehendere, c. Acc. rei vel pers.: ለምንት፡ እንከ፡ ትግእዝ፡ ፈቃደ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ἀπαναίνῃ Sir. 41,4; κρίνειν Rom. 2,1; ግእዝናሆሙ፡ Rom. 3,9; Rom. 14,3; Rom. 14,4; Rom. 14,13; Jac. 4,11; Col. 2,16; ምንተ፡ ረከቡ፡ በላዕሌየ፡ በዘይግእዙኒ፡ Jer. 2,5; ወአልቦ፡ እምውስቴቶሙ፡ ዘግእዘ፡ ἐνεκάλεσεν Sir. 46,19; c. Acc. rei et በላዕለ፡ pers. Rom. 2,1. 3 exprobrare, conviciari, c. Acc.: ግእዘ፡ ጽንዐ፡ ልቦሙ፡ ὠνείδισε Marc. 16,14; ሶበ፡ ይግእዘከ፡ ዐርክከ፡ Prov. 25,8; ግእዞ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ለሙሴ፡ ἐλοιδορεῖτο Ex. 17,2; Ex. 17,7.

woorden.betekenis: stomachari, irasci, altercari, rixari, jurgare, litigare, ob
woorden.definitie: III,3 (crebro ተገዓዘ፡ scriptum) 1 stomachari, irasci (sibi invicem): አልቦ፡ ዘትትጋአዙ፡ በፍኖት፡ ὀργίζεσθε Gen. 45,24; ደናግለ፡ ቀተለ፡ ዮልያኖስ፡ በተጋእዞ፡ Sx. Hed. 10Enc.; c. Acc. pers. (alicui), πικραίνεσθαι Col. 3,19 rom. 2 altercari, rixari, jurgare, litigare: እለ፡ ይትጋአዙ፡ οἱ φιλονεικοῦντες Prov. 10,12; μάχεσθαι Tit. 3,2; 2 Tim. 2,24; Jes. 58,4; ἀντιλογία Ex. 18,16; በበይናቲሆሙ፡ Joh. 6,52; seq. ምስለ፡ Kuf. 24; Kuf. 37; ተጋአዝኩ፡ ምስሌሃ፡ ἠρυθρίων πρὸς αὐτήν Tob. 2,14; διαμάχεσθαι Sir. 8,1; Sir. 8,16; ኢይክል፡ ተጋእዞ፡ ምስለ፡ ዘይጸንዕ፡ Koh. 6,10; διεκρίνοντο πρός Act. 11,2 rom. 3 objurgare, conviciis consectari aliquem, c. Acc., Kuf. p. 92; Kuf. p. 147.

woorden.betekenis: altercatio
woorden.definitie: subst. altercatio, Act. 15,7 Platt.

woorden.betekenis: domini
woorden.definitie: domini vid. sub እግዚእ፡ sub ገዝአ፡

woorden.betekenis: illucescere
woorden.definitie: illucescere vid. sub ጎሐ፡

woorden.betekenis: prorumpere, erumpere, oriri, dilucescere, illucescere
woorden.definitie: (et ጎሀ፡) I,1 [cum Ges. in thes. p. 281; Ges. in thes. p. 1392 ad גִּיחַ prorumpere referendum videtur, non ad ገሀህ፡ ነግሀ፡] erumpere, oriri de luce, dilucescere, illucescere: ወይገውሕ፡ ሶቤሃ፡ ብርሃንከ፡ ῥαγήσεται πρώϊμον τό φῶς Jes. 58,8; de diluculo vel prima luce: ሶበ፡ ጎሐ፡ ጽባሕ፡ διέφαυσε Gen. 44,3; 1 Reg. 25,34; Judith 14,2; Judith 14,11; ጎሐ፡ ጽባሕ፡ ἀνέβη Gen. 32,27; ሶበ፡ ይገውሕ፡ ጽባሕ፡ ὄρθρου Jos. 6,15; impers.: ሶበ፡ ጎሐ፡ 1 Reg. 9,26; እንዘ፡ ይገውሕ፡ ጽባሐ፡ (v. ጽባሕ፡) 2 Reg. 17,22; ኮከበ፡ ጽባሕ፡ ዘይሠርቅ፡ ሶበ፡ ይገውሕ፡ ὁ πρωῒ ἀνατέλλων Jes. 14,12.

woorden.betekenis: diluculum, aurora
woorden.definitie: subst. (m.) diluculum, aurora: Kuf. 2; ὄρθρος Cant. 6,10; Sir. 24,32; Hos. 6,3; እስከ፡ ጎሕ፡ ἄχρις αὐγῆς Act. 20,11; ጎሐ፡ ጽባሕ፡ φέγγος πρώϊνον Job 38,12; እምጎሕ፡ Hen. 100,2; ቅድመ፡ ጎሕ፡ ἐν τῷ φωτί Dan. 6,19; ሶበ፡ ዐርገ፡ ጎሕ፡ Jud. 19,25; እምጊዜ፡ የዐርግ፡ ጎሕ፡ (ὄρθρος) 2 Esr. 14,21; ጎሐ፡ ጽባሕ፡ Lud. ex Lit. Epiph.; ጎሕ፡ (Maria) ድልው፡ ለወሊደ፡ ፀሓይ፡ (Christum) Org. 2; ርእየ፡ ጎሐ፡ ወኢርእየ፡ ጽባሐ፡ Org. 4.

woorden.betekenis: nux, juglans
woorden.definitie: subst. [אֱגוֹז ܓܰܘܙܳܐ جَوْزٌ] nux, juglans: ገውዝ፡ ወለውዝ፡ Hos. 4,13; እመ፡ ተከልከ፡ ገውዘ፡ ይበቍልኑ፡ ወይን፡ Macc. f. 5; ገውዝ፡ ወለውዝ፡ Vis. Bar. – Voc. Ae.: ገውዝ፡ ዘ፡ ለውዝ፡ ዘሀሎ፡ በግብጽ።

woorden.betekenis: increpuit, clamare, vociferari, plorare, ejulare, gemere, ob
woorden.definitie: et ገዐረ፡ I, 1 [جَأَرَ; at גָּעַר ܓܥܰܪ increpuit ] Subj. ይግዐር፡, clamare, vociferari, plorare, ejulare, gemere, de dolentibus, querentibus, opem implorantibus: βοᾶν, ይግዕሩ፡ እመዝራዕተ፡ ብዙኃን፡ Job 35,9; Jes. 15,4; Marc. 15,34; Marc. 15,37; ግዒሮ፡ Marc. 15,39; κράζειν ገዐሩ፡ (Imperat.) Jes. 65,14; ἀλαλαζειν የዐወይዉ፡ ወይግዕሩ፡ Jer. 29,2; እንዘ፡ ይግዕር፡ ὀδυρομένου Jer. 38,18; ይግዕሩ፡ καταστενάζουσι Thren. 1,11; Thren. 1,21; እንዘ፡ ይግዕር፡ μετὰ στεναγμοῦ Judith 14,16; Prov. 28,28; c. በእንተ፡ vel እምነ፡ ob: ገዐረ፡ (v. ግዕረ፡) ነዳይ፡ በእንቲአሁ፡ Job 18,20; ግዕሩ፡ እምግብሮሙ፡ Ex. 2,23; Job 35,9; vel ዲበ፡ Hen. 12,6; vel ላዕለ፡ Jac. 5,1; Jac. 5,9; Zach. 11,8 (ἐπωρύοντα ἐπ᾽ ἐμέ); c. ኀበ፡ ejus, cujus auxilium imploratur: ገዐርኩ፡ ኀቤከ፡ Job 30,19; Ex. 22,26; Deut. 24,15; 1 Reg. 12,8; Jud. 3,9 c. ann.; Jud. 3,15; Jud. 4,3; Jud. 6,6; Jud. 10,10; Jud. 10,12; Luc. 18,7.

woorden.betekenis: abscidendo, abrumpendo, castra movere, proficisci, migrare,
woorden.definitie: , rarius ገዐዘ፡ (Num. 10,33; Num. 33,11 F; 4 Reg. 19,36), etiam per አ, [cui Lud. et Ges. in thes. جاز composuerunt; adde جَزَعَ; potestas radicis prima in abscidendo vel abrumpendo fuisse videtur] Subj. ይግዐዝ፡ 1 castra movere, proficisci, migrare, c. እምነ፡ loci unde et ውስተ፡ loci quorsum pergitur: Gen. 12,8; Gen. 26,21; Ex. 12,37; Ex. 14,10; Ex. 40,30; Num. 10,6 (ለግዒዝ፡); Num. 10,33; Num. 33,3 seq.; Deut. 1,19; Deut. 1,40; Jos. 3,3; Kuf. 16; Jes. 37,8; ግዕዙ፡ አሕዛብኪ፡ ውስተ፡ አድባር፡ Nah. 3,18; 2 Esr. 8,31; ከመ፡ ይግዐዙ፡ (ውስተ፡) ቤጤልዋ፡ Judith 7,1; Judith 7,17. a castra metari, στρατοπεδεύειν Num. 24,2; Prov. 4,15 (coll. Ex. 14,10; Deut. 1,40, ubi Hebr. quidem נסע, Graecus autem στρατοπεδεύειν habet). b migrare vel excedere e vita: በዋዕየ፡ እሳት፡ እምዓለም፡ ግዕዘ፡ Sx. Tachs. 21Enc.; ውስተ፡ ቤተ፡ ሙታን፡ ግዕዘ፡ Sx. Jac. 8Enc. 2 liberum fieri, manumitti, libertatem adipisci, de servis: ἐξελεύσεται Ex. 21,4 c. ann.; ግዕዝክሙ፡ እምግብርናት፡ Did. 33; ገብር፡ ለእመ፡ ግዕዘ፡ እምግብርናቲሁ፡ Jsp. p. 381; ይግዐዝ፡ ገብር፡ እምእግዚኡ፡ F.N. 31; de uxore: marito mortuo ትግዕዝ፡ F.N. 24,5.

woorden.betekenis: gaza
woorden.definitie: , ጋዝ፡, ጊዛን፡ n. peregr. sc. γάζα gaza: ቤተ፡ ጋዝ፡ v. ጋዛ፡ v. ጊዛን፡ Jes. 39,2; ቤት፡ ዘጋዛ፡ 2 Esr. 5,17; መጻሕፍተ፡ ኖብያት፡ ዘጋዛ፡ 2 Esr. 6,1; እምነ፡ ቤተ፡ መንግሥትየ፡ ዘጋዛ፡ 2 Esr. 7,20; ለኵሉ፡ ጋዛ፡ 2 Esr. 7,21; ጉዘ፡ (Acc.) glossa ad ኒቆታ፡ 4 Reg. 20,13. – Voc. Ae.: ጊዛን፡ (v. ገሪዛን፡) ዘ፡ ቤተ፡ ባዕል፡ (v. ልዕል፡).

woorden.betekenis: caedi, abscidi, succidi
woorden.definitie: III,1 caedi, abscidi, succidi: ተገዚሞ፡ ዳግመ፡ ይፈሪ፡ Job 14,7; Zach. 11,2; Matth. 3,10; ዕፅ፡ እንተ፡ ተገዝመት፡ Did. 25; ዕፀው፡ ነዊኃን፡ ይትገዘሙ፡ Hen. 83,4; ትትገዘም፡ እምሥረዊሃ፡ Hen. 91,5; Hen. 91,8.

woorden.betekenis: dominari, acquirere, possidere, distribuit, retribuit, dispe
woorden.definitie: inus., amh. ገዛ፡ (pro ገዝአ፡) dominari, acquirere, possidere (an etiam Himjaricum ገዘአ፡ idem significet, perdubium est, vid. J. R. Wellsted’s Reisen Deutsch von E. Rödiger, 1842. Bd. 2p. 398). Hoc verbum Ges. in thes. p. 276 cum جَزَأَ distribuit, جَزَا retribuit (coll. ταμίας i.e. dispensator, dux, dominus ) componere conatus est. At significatio verbi amharica denominationis suspicionem movet, et እግዚእ፡ nonnisi variatione verbi { ግዕዘ፡} vel አግዐዘ፡ ortum esse et primitus liberum (opp. servo ) significasse, ut forma Pluralis አጋእዝት፡ constantissime usitata ita significatio verbi አግዐዘ፡ dominum facere probare videntur.

woorden.betekenis: dominatus, dominium, domino
woorden.definitie: subst. dominatus, dominium (jus vel dignitas domini): ዝንቱ፡ ውእቱ፡ ሥልጣን፡ ወመንግሥት፡ ወእግዚእና፡ ho. Severiani in Cyr. f. 126; ጸሎት፡ ይእቲ፡ ተናግሮተ፡ ሰብእ፡ ኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ልዑል፡ እንዘ፡ ያአኵቶ፡ ወይሴብሖ፡ ወይትአመን፡ በእግዚእናሁ፡ F.N. 14; እግዚእናሁ፡ (ለብእሲ፡) ላዕሌሃ፡ (ለብእሲት፡), et paulo post በላዕሌሃ፡ F.N. 51. In Gregorii Epist. honoris causa usurpatur pro domino, Lud.

woorden.betekenis: dominus, universi, Dei
woorden.definitie: (raro እግዚአ፡ ብሔር፡) subst., proprie dominus terrae vel regionum i.e. universi, Aethiopibus pro ὁ Κύριος (יהוה, אֲדֺנָי) receptum, in nomen proprium Dei S.S. abiit. In libris Graecis respondent ὁ Κύριος, ut Ex. 20,1 seq., አዶናይ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Ἀδωναὶ Κύριος Hez. 7,2; et ὁ θεός Gen. 1,1 seq., እግዚአብሔር፡ አቡነ፡ θεὸς πατήρ Phil. 1,2 al.; raro alia supremi numinis nomina, ut ὕψιστος Sir. 19,17. Componuntur እግዚአብሔር፡ አምላክ፡ Κύριος ὁ θεός, ut Gen. 6,13; Gen. 6,22, et እግዚእ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ vel እግዚአብሔር፡ እግዚእ፡ Κύριος ὁ θεός Gen. 7,16; Am. 4,13; Κύριος Κύριος Jes. 50,7. Raro usurpatur pro (አምላክ፡) nomine Dei appellativo, ut: ካልእ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ἄλλος θεός Jes. 43,10; ከመ፡ ይበልዎ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Judith 3,8; Judith 6,2 (ὁ θεός); Hez. 28,2. Passim repereris Accusativi formam እግዚአብሔረ፡, ut: እንዘ፡ ሰብእ፡ አንተ፡ ወኢኮንከ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ v. እግዚአብሔረ፡ Hez. 28,9 (cfr. ቤተ፡ ክርስቲያኖ፡ col. 836.). – De libro እግዚአብሔር፡ ነግሠ፡ inscripto vid. Zeitschrift der deutschen morgenld. Gesellschaft Bd. I p. 37; 149; 208>; Catal. Cod. Mss. Ae. Musei Britann. p. 36.

woorden.betekenis: majestas Dei, S.S.
woorden.definitie: subst. majestas Dei S.S.: አመ፡ ጽሕቀ፡ (Christus) ለከዊነ፡ እጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ ኢኀደገ፡ እግዚአብሔርናሁ፡ M.M. f. 165.

woorden.betekenis: convivium, epulae
woorden.definitie: vel ገዝእ፡ subst. convivium, epulae: ገብረ፡ ግዝአ፡ (v. ገዝአ፡) ዐቢየ፡ Kuf. p. 65; Kuf. p. 79; Kuf. p. 101; Kuf. p. 102; Kuf. p. 105; መዋዕለ፡ ግዝእ፡ τοῦ πότου Job 1,5; ቤተ፡ ግዝእ፡ πότου Koh. 7,2; ገቢረ፡ ግዝአ፡ Org. 4. – Voc. Ae.: ግዝእ፡ ዘ፡ ጋሬዳ።

woorden.betekenis: crassum, spissum, densum, esse, fieri, crassescere, contumac
woorden.definitie: I,1 [كَثَّ كَثُفَ] Subj. ይግዝፍ፡, crassum, spissum ( densum ) esse vel fieri, crassescere: አጽባዕትየ፡ ይገዝፍ፡ ወትጸንዕ፡ እምሐቌ፡ አቡየ፡ παχύτερος 2 Par. 10,10; 3 Reg. 12 a,10; παχύνεσθαι Deut. 32,15; Jer. 5,28 var.; Koh. 12,5; transl. de corde hominis contumacis vel obfirmati: Act. 28,27 rom.; Matth. 13,15; ይገዝፉ፡ አልባቢሆሙ፡ Macc. f. 5; ናሁ፡ ገዝፈ፡ አልባቢክሙ፡ ወኮነ፡ ከመ፡ አእባን፡ Jsp. p. 364; ከመ፡ ኢይግዝፍ፡ ልቡ፡ ወኢይጽልም፡ አእምሮቱ፡ F.N. 5. – Voc. Ae.: ገዝፈ፡ ዘ፡ ደነደነ።

woorden.betekenis: crassum, spissum reddere, crassificare, obfirmare, rigidum f
woorden.definitie: II,1 crassum, spissum reddere, crassificare: አግዝፎ፡ ሥጋ፡ ወአሥብሖቱ፡ ድካም፡ ውእቱ፡ τὸ στέαρ χαυνότης ἐστὶ τῷ σώματι, οὐκ ἰσχύς Chrys. Ta. 29; ፬ ግብር፡ ያገዝፉ፡ አባለ፤ በሊዐ፡ ሥጋ፡ ወሰትየ፡ ወይን፡ ወነዊም፡ በሐሩረ፡ ፀሓይ፡ ወለቢሰ፡ ክታን፤ ወ፬ ያደገድጉ፡ … Fal. f. 67; አግዘፈ፡ ጽልመተ፡ 2 Reg. 22,12. a obfirmare, rigidum facere cor, collum suum i.e. obstinatum, contumacem, obduratum animo esse: አግዘፉ፡ ልቦሙ፡ Jer. 5,10; Act. 7,54 rom.; አግዘፈ፡ ክሳዶ፡ Gen. 49,3; Ex. 33,3; Deut. 9,6; Deut. 10,16; 2 Esr. 19,16; 2 Esr. 19,17; Jer. 5,26; Jer. 17,23; Rel. Bar.; Sir. 16,11; ἐτραχηλίασεν Job 15,25; የሐውራ፡ እንዘ፡ ያገዝፋ፡ ክሳዶን፡ ὑψηλῷ τραχήλῳ Jes. 3,16. b crassiorem i.e. copiosiorem et graviorem facere orationem: ab iis ignominia affectus ob orationem antea habitam አግዘፈ፡ ሎሙ፡ ነገረ፡ Jsp. p. 360.

woorden.betekenis: n. act. id.: በግዝፈተ፡ ልብከ፡ Macc. f. 6; Sx. Tachs. 6E
woorden.definitie: n. act. id.: በግዝፈተ፡ ልብከ፡ Macc. f. 6; Sx. Tachs. 6Enc.; በግዝፈተ፡ ክሳድከ፡ Macc. f. 14.

woorden.betekenis: nubilosum fuit coelum
woorden.definitie: inus. i.q. غام nubilosum fuit coelum (ܐܷܬܥܰܝܰܡ).

woorden.betekenis: mane surgere
woorden.definitie: mane surgere vid. sub ጌሰ፡

woorden.betekenis: advena, hospes peregrinus, peregrinus, rudis in
woorden.definitie: part. [גֵּר, ܓܺܝܰܘܪܳܐ, vic. ጎር፡] advena, hospes peregrinus, γειώρας, προσήλυτος, Ex. 12,19; Ex. 12,48; Ex. 22,20; Ex. 23,9; Ex. 23,12; Lev. 16,29; ግዩራን፡ Lev. 17,8 seq.; Lev. 18,26; Lev. 19,10; Lev. 19,33; Lev. 19,34; Lev. 24,22; ግዩራን፡ ወፈላስያን፡ προσήλυτοι καὶ πάροικοι Lev. 25,23; Lev. 25,35; Lev. 25,47; Num. 9,14; Num. 15,14; Num. 15,15; Num. 15,16; Num. 35,15; Deut. 5,14; Deut. 10,18; Deut. 10,19; Deut. 24,17; Deut. 24,20; Deut. 27,19; Macc. f. 10; Maria in Aegypto semet vocat ግይርተ፡ Ssal. Req.; transl.: peregrinus vel rudis in re: sunt ግዩራን፡ በሕገ፡ ኦሪት፡ M.M. f. 13. – Voc. Ae.: ግዩር፡ ዘ፡ መጻተኛ።

woorden.betekenis: conditio, status advenae
woorden.definitie: subst. conditio sive status advenae, Org.

woorden.betekenis: mane surgere, mane agere, mane venire, mane pergere, mane pr
woorden.definitie: et ጌሠ፡ I,1 [غَدَا] Subj. ይጊስ፡ mane surgere, mane agere aliquid, mane venire, mane pergere vel mane proficisci: ὀρθρίζειν Gen. 19,2; Ex. 8,16; ገይሰክሙ፡ በጽባሕ፡ Ex. 19,16; ገይሶ፡ በጽባሕ፡ ሐነጸ፡ Ex. 24,4; Ex. 32, 6; 1 Reg. 5,3; 1 Reg. 5,4; 1 Reg. 15,12; 1 Reg. 29,10; 1 Reg. 29,11; 2 Reg. 15,2; Kuf. 17; Kuf. 27; Kuf. 32; ጌስኩ፡ በሌሊት፡ 2 Esr. 12,12; Job 1,5; Job 8,5; ለገዪስ፡ Ps. 118,148; ከንቱ፡ ገይሶትክሙ፡ Ps. 126,3; ዘይገይስ፡ Sir. 40,7; Tob. 9,6; Dan. 6,19; አሌለያ፡ ገይሰ፡ Luc. 24,1; Act. 5,21. a c.c. Acc. loci, quo quis mane pergit: Luc. 21, 38; ጌሰ፡ ገዳመ፡ Kuf. 26; Job 29,7; እለ፡ ይገይሱ፡ በጽባሕ፡ ቤተ፡ መያሲ፡ Jes. 5,11; ነቂሀነ፡ እምንዋም፡ ንጊሳ፡ ለቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ Deg.; c. praep. ut ውስተ፡ loci Cant. 7,13; ኀበ፡ loci vel pers.: Luc. 21,38; Luc. 24,22; ጊስ፡ ኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወጸሊ፡ Job 8,5; ዘይገይስ፡ ኀቤሃ፡ Sir. 4,12; Sir. 6,36; Sir. 35,14; Sir. 39,5; Jes. 26,9; ጌስኩ፡ ኀቤክሙ፡ ወነገርኩ፡ Jer. 25,3; Sap. 6,15; Ps. 62,1. b in genere: proficisci, pergere, venire: ጌሰ፡ ወመጽአ፡ ᾤχετο Jer. 48,10; አዘዞሙ፡ ይጊሱ፡ ኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ 1 Reg. 10,17; Sx. Haml. 15Enc.; ገይስ፡ profectio: ከመ፡ ይግበር፡ ገይሰ፡ Kuf. p. 165.

woorden.betekenis: qui mane pergit, proficiscitur
woorden.definitie: n. ag. qui mane pergit vel proficiscitur, Lud. sine auct.

woorden.betekenis: ê, transiit, secare, dividere, definire, tempus, definitum,
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. ጊዜያት፡ [adjecta vocali ê formatum sicut ዕድሜ፡, sive etymon cum Ges. in thes. p. 991 a جاز transiit, sive a גזז גזה al. secare, dividere, definire petieris] 1 tempus a definitum, statutum, certum, καιρός Koh. 3,1-9; Koh. 7,17; Koh. 8,5; Koh. 8,6; እስከ፡ ተኀልፍ፡ ጊዜሃ፡ (ለመዐት፡) Sir. 1,23; ዘእንበለ፡ ይብጻሕ፡ ጊዜሁ፡ Sir. 30,24; ቀርበ፡ ጊዜነ፡ Thren. 4,19; Gen. 6,13; Matth. 26,18; መዋዕለ፡ ጊዜሁ፡ Marc. 13,33; በዝንቱ፡ ጊዜ፡ በካልእት፡ ዓመት፡ Gen. 17,21; Gen. 18,14; ጊዜ፡ ዘርእ፡ ለዘሪእ፡ በጽሐ፡ Kuf. 11; ጊዜ፡ ገሚድ፡ Cant. 2,12; Job 38,32; በበ፡ ጊዜ፡ Kuf. 6; 4 Esr. 8,14; 4 Esr. 9,37; c. pron. suff. sive pers. sive neutr.: ጊዜሁ፡ tempus ejus i.e. ei definitum: 4 Esr. 8,47; Ps. 1,3; Ps. 103,28; Matth. 8,29; Matth. 24,45; Marc. 1,15; Luc. 4,13; Luc. 12,42; Rom. 13,11; 1 Cor. 4,5. α diei i.e. hora, horae, (vigilia): በጊዜ፡ መሥዋዕተ፡ ሰርክ፡ Dan. 9,21; 2 Esr. 9,5; ጊዜ፡ ምሳሕ፡ Ruth 2,14; Dan. apocr. 1,13; ውእተ፡ ጊዜ፡ αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ Dan. 4,30; Deut. 18,6; ጊዜ፡ ብርሃን፡, ጊዜ፡ ምሴት፡ Kuf. 49; እስመ፡ ጊዜ፡ ቀትር፡ ውእቱ፡ Rel. Bar.; Dan. apocr. 1,7; ዘጊዜ፡ 1 Reg. 9,16; 3 Reg. 20,6; Ex. 9,18; Ex. 10,4; በጊዜ፡ ጽባሕ፡ ἐν φυλακῇ τῇ ἑωθινῇ 1 Reg. 11,11; Joh. 4,52 rom.; መጽሐፈ፡ ጊዜያት፡ horarium Cod. Mus. Brit. XXXIV. β anni tempus, tempus festum: ጊዜያቲሆሙ፡ ለአውራኅ፡ Kuf. 29; ኵሉ፡ ጊዜያት፡ ለዓመታት፡ Kuf. 2; ከመ፡ ያእምሩ፡ ጊዜ፡ ዓመታት፡ Kuf. 4; ጊዜ፡ በዓላቲሁ፡ Sir. 36,8; Hen. 82,10. b justum, idoneum,opportunum: ኢኮነ፡ ጊዜሁ፡ ለሐኒጸ፡ ቤተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Hagg. 1,2; Hagg. 1,4 (seq. ከመ፡ c. Subj.); በጊዜ፡ πρὸς καιρόν Koh. 10,17; እስከ፡ ትረክብ፡ ጊዜሁ፡ Sir. 1,24; Sir. 20,6; ኵሎ፡ በጊዜሁ፡ ወበዐቅሙ፡ ግበር፡ Sir. 35,11; በጽሐ፡ ጊዜሁ፡ በዘታነሥእ፡ ርስተከ፡ Judith 13,5. c tempus in genere vel temporis pars quaedam: Hen. 90,5; ጊዜ፡ ወድድቅ፡ Koh. 9,11; ጊዜ፡ ምንዳቤ፡ Sir. 18,20; ጊዜ፡ እኩይ፡ Koh. 9,12; ጊዜያት፡ Sap. 7,18; Sap. 8,8. በጊዜ፡ ሰዓት፡ Kuf. p. 62; በጊዜሃ፡ ለይእቲ፡ ዕለት፡ Gen. 17,26. – Crebro nomini ጊዜ፡ in st.c. posito tota enunciatio subjungitur; latine: tempus quo, ut: እስከ፡ ጊዜ፡ ያሰፍጣ፡ καιρὸν τοῦ ἀπατῆσαι αὐτήν Judith 12,16; እምጊዜ፡ የዐርግ፡ ጎሕ፡ ἀπὸ ἀναβάσεως τοῦ ὄρθρου 2 Esr. 14,21; 2 Esr. 18,3; ያአምሩ፡ ጊዜ፡ ይወጽኡ፡ ወይበውኡ፡ Jer. 8,7; በጽሐት፡ ዕለቶሙ፡ ወጊዜ፡ ይትቤቀልዎሙ፡ Jer. 27,27; 1 Reg. 30,17; ሶበ፡ ኮነ፡ ጊዜ፡ ይዕረብ፡ ፀሓይ፡ Gen. 15,17; አይ፡ ጊዜ፡ ሐይወ፡ Joh. 4,52 rom. (vid. etiam Nr. 2, f). – 2 Usurpatur ad exprimenda varia adverbia et particulas: a በኵሉ፡ ጊዜ፡ omni tempore, semper: Lev. 25,31; Lev. 25,32; Koh. 9,8; Prov. 18,1; Ps. 33,1; Ps. 49,9; Sir. 6,37; Sir. 17,15; Kuf. 20; 4 Esr. 9,27; Jes. 60,11; Jer. 6,7; Judith 16,16 al. b ውእተ፡ ጊዜ፡ vel ይእተ፡ ጊዜ፡ eo tempore α tunc, tum, τότε, Ex. 12,44; Ex. 12,48; Prov. 23,33; Ps. 18,14; Sir. 28,2; Tob. 12,6; Tob. 13,6; Kuf. 25; Hen. 24,6; Hen. 25,2; Hebr. 10,7. β statim, illico (vid. Dan. 4,30), εὐθέως Matth. 13,5; Matth. 21,2; Matth. 27,48 al. c ጊዜ፡ in Acc. et st.c. vice praepositionis temporalis fungitur (pro Abl. Latinorum), ut: ጊዜ፡ ስሱ፡ ሰዓት፡ Luc. 23,44; Joh. 4,52; Joh. 4,53. d በጊዜሃ፡ horâ ejus i.e. statim, illico,confestim, εὐθύς, εὐθέως Gen. 15,4; Job 5,3; Matth. 4,20; Matth. 4,22; Matth. 8,3; Matth. 14,27; Matth. 20,34; Matth. 24,29; Matth. 25,15; Apoc. 4,2; παραχρῆμα Job 40,7; Jes. 29,5; Jes. 30,13; Matth. 21,19; Matth. 21,20; παραυτίκα Ps. 69,4; አኮ፡ በጊዜሃ፡ οὔπω Matth. 24,6. e ለጊዜሁ፡ vel ለጊዜሃ፡ in praesens, in tempus vel ad tempus, temporarius: ለጊዜሁ፡ εἰς τὸ παρόν Hebr. 12,11; πρὸς καιρόν (opp. እምድኅሬሁ፡) Prov. 5,3; ለጊዜሃ፡ πρόσκαιρος Matth. 13,21; Marc. 4,17. f Relative usurpatur (vid. Nr. 1): α ጊዜ፡ vel በጊዜ፡ quo tempore, quum, quandocumque, simulac: ጊዜ፡ ጸዋዕከኒ፡ Job 14,15; ጊዜ፡ ይገብር፡ ὁπότε Job 26,14; ጊዜ፡ ይሰክብ፡ Sir. 40,5; ጊዜ፡ ይወፅኣ፡ ἡνίκα Gen. 24,11; ὅταν Marc. 14,7; ጊዜ፡ ሠርዐ፡ ሕገ፡ F.M. 8,1; ጊዜ፡ ፈቀደ፡ Sx. Ter 5 Enc.; በጊዜ፡ ሰምዐት፡ Kuf. p. 112; በጊዜ፡ ይትመዓዕ፡ ይከውኖ፡ ድቀቱ፡ Sir. 1,22; Joh. 5,4 Platt. β እንተ፡ ጊዜ፡ (sec. Lud. etiam አመ፡ ጊዜ፡) quo tempore, quum: እንተ፡ ጊዜ፡ ያዐርፍ፡ Sir. 34,3; Ps. 123,2. g በአሐዱ፡ ጊዜ፡ quodam tempore, aliquando, Lud. h ጊዜ፡ – ጊዜ፡ tum – tum, modo – modo, aliâs – aliâs, Phlx. 32; Phlx. 59; quater repetitum Phlx. 72; etiam ጊዜያተ፡ – ጊዜያተ፡ id., Phlx. 178. 3 tempus i.e. vicis, vices: ጊዜ፡ ፫ ሰዓት፡ καιροὺς τρεῖς (ternis horis quotidie) Dan. 6,10; በዝ፡ ጊዜ፡ hac in re, hac in vice Ex. 9,14; Ex. 8,28; ካልአ፡ ጊዜ፡ alio tempore, iterum Act. 17,32 Platt; ፬ ጊዜያተ፡ quater 2 Esr. 16,4 var.; ከመዝ፡ ገብረ፡ ሠለስተ፡ ጊዜ፡ ter Did. 29; Lit. 159,4; ይትነፋሕ፡ ቀርን፡ ፫ ጊዜ፡ Clem. f. 156; ፭ ጊዜያተ፡ quinquies Chrys. ho. 28; ፵ ጊዜ፡ Clem. f. 46; በዙኀ፡ ጊዜ፡ Sx. Tachs. 24; ብዙኀ፡ ጊዜያተ፡ saepenumero F.M. 24,1; Chrys. ho. 26; በ፩ ጊዜ፡ una vice, semel Chrys. ho. 17; አየ፡ ጊዜ፡ ወስፍነ፡ ጊዜ፡ quando et quoties? Phlx. 238; በጊዜ፡ እምጊዜያት፡ aliquando Jsp. p. 326(ex Arabismo). gize G ጊዜ፡ ሕማማት፡ gize ḥǝmāmāt La Semaine Sainte, vid. ሕማም፡ (Grébaut) 45

woorden.betekenis: timidus recessit, pavidus fuit, fugit, fugere, aufugere, gʷa
woorden.definitie: , rarissime ጐየየ፡ I,1 [جَأْجَأَ كَأْكَأَ كَاءَ timidus recessit, pavidus fuit, fugit ] ይጕየይ፡ et ይጕይይ፡, fugere, aufugere: ጐየ፡ Gen. 39,12; Gen. 39,15; Gen. 39,18; Jud. 1,6; Jud. 4,15; Jud. 4,17; Jud. 9,21; 1 Reg. 4,16; 1 Reg. 4,17; 2 Reg. 1,4; 2 Reg. 10,14; 2 Reg. 19,9; 2 Reg. 23,11; Ps. 113,3; ጐየይኪ፡ Ps. 113,5; Kuf. 47; 4 Esr. 10,5; Jes. 22,3; Marc. 5,14; Marc. 14,50; Marc. 16,8; formam ጐየየ፡ Lud. affert ex Sx. Jac. 2Enc. et Sx. Jac. 3Enc. (at Cod. Tubing. habet ጐየ፡); ይጐይይ፡ Sir. 22,22; Jes. 10,29; Jes. 48,20; Prov. 28,1; Tob. 1,18; Jac. 4,7; ይጐይያ፡ Joh. 10,5; ይጐዩ፡ et ይጐይዩ፡ Jes. 22,5; Judith 14,3; Matth. 24, 16; ከመ፡ ይጕየዩ፡ Hen. 89,26; Ps. 67,1; ይጕየዩ፡ et ይጕይዩ፡ Ex. 23,27; Num. 10,34; Deut. 32,24; Matth. 3,7; ጕይይ፡ et ጕየይ፡ Sir. 21,2; Matth. 2,13; Cant. 8,14; 1 Tim. 6,11; ጕይዩ፡ 2 Par. 10,16; ጕዩ፡ Jer. 28,6; Zach. 2,6; ጕየዩ፡ Jer. 30,8; Jer. 31,6; Matth. 10,23; 1 Cor. 6,18; 1 Cor. 10,14; Infin. ጐይይ፡ Hen. 52,7; 1 Reg. 4,16 var.; c.c. እምነ፡ rei vel pers.: ከመ፡ ዘይጐይይ፡ እምአርዌ፡ እኩይ፡ ከማሁ፡ ጕይይ፡ እምኀጢአት፡ Sir. 21,2; Jes. 10,18; Ps. 103,8; Ex. 4,3; Matth. 3,7; Jac. 4,7; 1 Tim. 6,11; ጐየ፡ እምገጸ፡ ዔሳው፡ Kuf. 31; vel c. እምቅድመ፡ Jos. 7,4; Jos. 8,5; Jos. 8,6; Jud. 9,40; 2 Reg. 10,18; vel c. Acc. rei vel pers.: ጕይያ፡ (v. ጕየያ፡) ለፍትወት፡ 2 Tim. 2,22; 2 Petr. 1,4; እለ፡ ይጐይይዋ፡ ለጸባብ፡ አንቀጽ፡ Kid. f. 4; Ex. 23,27; c.c. praep. vel adverbiis loci: ጕዩ፡ እማእከለ፡ ባቢሎን፡ Jer. 28,6; ጕዩ፡ እምብሔረ፡ ደቡብ፡ Zach. 2,6 var.; ጐዩ፡ እስከ፡ በሴጣ፡ Jud. 7,22; ውስተ፡ 2 Par. 10,16; Matth. 2,13; Matth. 10,23; ጕየይ፡ ኀበ፡ ላባ፡ Kuf. 27; ጐየ፡ አፍአ፡ Gen. 39,18; አይቴ፡ ትጐይዩ፡ Hen. 97,3; Hen. 103,13. gʷayya run ወሶበ፡ ሰምዑ፡ ዘንተ፡ ጐዩ፡ ኀበ፡ ቤተ፡ መስፍን፡ ʻ Quand ils eurent entendu cela, ils coururent à la maison du gouverneur ʼ 14 (626) (ed.); 15 (627) (tr.) (ʻÉthiopien ጐየ፡ «sʼenfuirent», d’après Dillmann, Lexicon c. 1198. Mais 209b a bien le sens de «run» attesté dans les textes éthiopiens relatifs à Mercure de Césarée.ʼ 15 (627) n. 5/1)

woorden.betekenis: fugiens, fugitivus
woorden.definitie: part. fugiens, fugitivus: ተረክቡ፡ ጕዩያነ፡ እምሥርዐተ፡ መልእክት፡ φυγάδες; Lud. e Mss. Colb.

woorden.betekenis: errare, aberrare, deerrasse, non invenire, in errorem induci
woorden.definitie: quadril. I [غوى עוה ጎገወ፡] 1 errare a aberrare a via, deerrasse itinere: ዮጊ፡ እጌጊ፡ እስመ፡ እንተ፡ ፍኖተ፡ ደብር፡ መጻእኩ፡ Rel. Bar.; aberrare a vero i.e. non invenire, c. Acc.: ይጌግዩ፡ ኵሎ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ዘዓመታት፡ Kuf. 6; Hen. 82,5. b in errorem induci, in errore versari, falli, titubare mente errabunda: Marc. 12,27; Joh. 7,47; ትጌጊ፡ πλανηθήσῃ Jes. 17,11; ጌገዩ፡ በስካር፡ ἐσείσθησαν Jes. 28,7; ይጌግዩ፡ Jes. 44,20; በፍትሕ፡ ኢይጌጊ፡ አፉሁ፡ Prov. 16,10; Hen. 75,2; ትጌጊ፡ ἐκπλαγῇς Koh. 7,16; ንጌጊ፡ ለርእስነ፡ ἑαυτοὺς πλανῶμεν 1 Joh. 1,8. c ignorare, seq. ለ፡, ut: ኢጌገይኩ፡ ለእለ፡ ይትዋክሑ፡ ብሂሎሙ፡ οὐκ ἀγνοῶ Cyr. ad Theod. f. 17. d ethice: errorem committere, delinquere, peccare, culpam committere (inconsiderate, per imprudentiam): ἐσπούδακα Jes. 21,3; ይስሕት፡ ወይጌጊ፡ Sir. 34,30 var.; ይወድቅ፡ ወይጌጊ፡ Sir. 35,15; πλανᾶσθαι Hez. 33,12; አበሱ፡ ወጌገዩ፡ ἐπλημμέλησαν Sir. 48,6; አበስነ፡ ጌገይነ፡ ἡμαρτήσαμεν ἠσεβήσαμεν Thren. 3,41; Job 34,8; ጌጎይከ፡ ἠνόμησας Job 35,6; Dan. 9,5; ἠδικήσαμεν Ps. 105,6; ὀφείλει Matth. 23,18; ᾑμάρτομεν Thren. 5,16; c. ላዕለ፡ pers.: Prov. 8,36; c. Acc. peccati: Ex. 32,30; አበሳ፡ ዘበኢያእምሮ፡ ጌገይከ፡ Kuf. 22.

woorden.betekenis: error, fraus, destitutio, delictum, delicta, peccatum, pecca
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., Pl. ጌጋያት፡, 1 error, fraus, destitutio, πλάνη Judae 11; Rom. 1,27; በጌጋየ፡ ልቦሙ፡ Jer. 23,17; πλάνησις Jes. 30,10; በጌጋዮሙ፡ ἐν τοῖς πλάνοις αὐτῶν Jer. 23,32; Matth. 27,64. 2 delictum, delicta, peccatum, peccata, impietas, improbitas, scelus (creberrime usitatum), Kuf. 5; 4 Esr. 7,27; ἄγνοιαι Sir. 23,3; ἁμαρτία Job 7,21; Job 10,6; Jes. 44,22; 1 Joh. 5,17; ἁαμαρτίαι Sir. 4,26; ኵሉ፡ ጌጋዮሙ፡ Sir. 17,20; Jes. 13,11; Hez. 28,18; ἀδίκημα, ἀδικία 1 Reg. 26,18; ምንት፡ ጌጋይነ፡ Jer. 16,10; Thren. 2,14; Mal. 2,6; Hez. 3,19; ἀδικίαι Jes. 43,24; Jer. 14,20; ἀνομία, ἀνομίαι Ps. 37,4; Ps. 68,32; Job 14,17; Job 20,27; Jes. 50,1; Jes. 53,5; Jes. 58,1; Hez. 33,12 seq.; παράπτωμα Rom. 5,15; ἐπιθυμίαι 1 Petr. 1,14; ጌጋያት፡ Chrys. ho. 9al. a scandalum: እብነ፡ ጌጋይ፡ Rom. 9,33; ከመ፡ ኢይኩነኒ፡ ጌጋየ፡ Judith 12,2; b crimen, culpa, reatus: ዘጌጋዩ፡ ለመዊት፡ Num. 35,31; ጌጋየ፡ ይከውኖ፡ Lev. 24,15; Matth. 12,5; ኢይመውቱ፡ አበው፡ በጌጋየ፡ ውሉዶሙ፡ 4 Reg. 14,6; Rom. 5,12; አልቦ፡ ጌጋየ፡ οὐκ ἔνοχός ἐστιν Num. 35,27; ዘአልቦ፡ ጌጋየ፡ ἀθῶος Ex. 23,7; መጽሐፈ፡ ጌጋዩ፡ τῆς αἰτίας Marc. 15,26.

woorden.betekenis: munus
woorden.definitie: munus vid. sub ገደወ፡

woorden.betekenis: luctari, colluctari, conflictari, certare, agonista, athleta
woorden.definitie: III,3 luctari, colluctari, conflictari, certare, c. Acc. vel ምስለ፡ pers.: Gen. 32, 25; Gen. 32,26; Hen. 90,12; ይትጋደሉ፡ (v. ይትቃተሉ፡) Esth. apocr. 1(παλαίειν); ኢይመጽኡ፡ ይትጋደሉከ፡ εἰς παλαίωσιν Nah. 2,1; ተጋድሎ፡ Job 37,17; ዘይትጋደል፡ agonista, athleta 1 Cor. 9,25; 2 Tim. 2,5 Platt; እንዘ፡ ይትጋደሉ፡ διαπληκτιζόμενοι Ex. 2,13; አዘዞሙ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ተጋድሎቶሙ፡ (sc. feras in theatro) Jsp. p. 328. a Transfertur in luctam vel certamen Christianorum contra peccatum, tentationes, cupiditates, difficultates, in agomen martyrum, in disciplinam vel exercitationes ascetarum: Phil. 1,27; Phil. 1,30; ከመ፡ ትትጋደል፡ ሠናየ፡ ገድለ፡ 1 Tim. 1,18; 1 Tim. 6,12; 2 Tim. 4,7; Col. 1,29; Col. 2,1; ተጋደለ፡ በንስሓ፡ Macc. f. 15; እለ፡ ይትጋደሉ፡ ምስለ፡ ሕማማት፡ Phlx. 204; ምስለ፡ ንዋም፡ Sx. Jac. 24Enc. (vide sub ተርሙስ፡); ተጋደልዋ፡ ለኀጢአት፡ Hebr. 12,4; ተጋድሎታ፡ ለፍትወት፡ F.N. 24,5; Sx. Mag. 15Enc.; ነበረት፡ ፲ወ፪ ዓመተ፡ እንዘ፡ ትትጋደሎ፡ ለንዋም፡ Sx. Ter 24; እምብዝኀ፡ ተጋድሎ፡ ገድለ፤ በአምሳለ፡ ነፋስ፡ ኮነ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ ቀሊለ፡ Sx. Sen. 17Enc; Sx. Sen. 6; Nah. 26(vid. sub ተፀምደ፡); ተጋደሉ፡ ሰማዕት፡ በጻማ፡ ወበምንዳቤ፡ Mavâs. 9, al. crebro. b de certamine bellico: Hebr. 11,33; Jsp. p. 325; ንትጋደል፡ ለፀቢኦቶሙ፡ እስከ፡ ንመውት፡ Jsp. p. 349; reges ይትጋደልዎ፡ ለጸላኢ፡ Lud. e Vit. Sanct. c contendere, vires intendere: monachum insectationibus obnoxium ይትጋደል፡ አበ፡ ምኔት፡ ለአድኅኖቱ፡ F.N. 10.

woorden.betekenis: latus transversum, in transversum, latus, latitudo, longitud
woorden.definitie: subst., Pl. ግደም፡ 1 latus transversum, a Acc. adv. ግድመ፡ in transversum: ሖርክሙ፡ ግድመ፡ Lev. 26,21; Lev. 26,23; Lev. 26,24; Lev. 26,27; Lev. 26,28; Lev. 26,40; Lev. 26,41. b latus in genere: እምግደሚሁ፡ (v. እምገዳሚሁ፡) ἐπὶ τὰ πλάγια Ex. 26,13. 2 latitudo: εὖρος Deut. 3,11; ግድሙ፡ ፮ በእመት፡ Dan. 3,1; Hez. 40,21; Hez. 40,25; Hez. 40,47; Hez. 41,2 seq.; Hez. 42,20; Hez. 48,8 seq.; ረሐበ፡ ግድሙ፡ (amplitudo latitudinis seu lateris transversi ejus) Ex. 37,16; πλάτος 3 Reg. 7,39; Hez. 40,7; Apoc. 21,16; አልብነ፡ ኑኅ፡ ወግድም፡ (Deus Trinus loquitur) Clem. f. 47; Clem. f. 55; ኢይትዐወቅ፡ ኑኃ፡ ወግድማ፡ ወኢቆማ፡ Clem. f. 50. a longitudo, μῆκος Judith 1,2 (ubi ጽፍሕ፡ εὖρος); Judith 7,3 (ubi ኑኅ፡ εὖρος) si quidem lectio sana est. b altitudo, ὕψος 2 Par. 6,12. [Amh. ገደመ፡ to be side-ways; ተጋደመ፡ to go out of the way, to go apart, Isenb. p. 178, coll. Lud. lex. amh. col. 91.]

woorden.betekenis: tractus lateralis, planities, campus, regio campestris, agri
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., Pl. ገዳማት፡ 1 raro: tractus lateralis, Judith 1,2 var., ubi ዘመንገለ፡ ገዳማ፡ ለሀገር፡ opponitur τῷ ዘመንገለ፡ ገጸ፡ ሀገር፡; እምገዳሚሁ፡ (v. pro እምግደሚሁ፡) Ex. 26,13. 2 plerumque: planities, campus, regio campestris, πεδίον, πεδινή Gen. 4,8; Gen. 11,2; Gen. 14,17; Gen. 24,65; Gen. 29,2; Lev. 14,6; Deut. 1,7; Deut. 8,7; Job 39,21; Sir. 24,14; አድባረ፡ ገዳም፡ ὄρη πεδινοῦ Jes. 13,2; Jes. 41,18; Jer. 9,22; Jer. 14,18; Jer. 21,13; Hez. 3,23; Hez. 7,15; Hez. 37,1 seq.; Mich. 4,10; ውስተ፡ ገዳም፡ ዐቢይ፡ Judith 1,5; Judith 1,8; Judith 2,27; Judith 6,11; Judith 7,18; Ps. 103,9; 4 Esr. 9,27; 4 Esr. 9,28; Hen. 28,1; ዕፀወ፡ ገዳም፡ Lev. 26,4; ሣዕር፡ ዘውስተ፡ ገዳም፡ Ex. 9,25; Num. 22,4. a agri, rus, ἀγρός, ሣዕረ፡ ገዳም፡ Gen. 3,18; Ps. 49,12; Ps. 102,14; Cant. 2,7; Sir. 39,13; Jes. 33,12; ዕፀወ፡ ገዳም፡ Jes. 55,12; Kuf. 13; Jer. 13,27; Jer. 14,5; ጽጌያተ፡ ገዳም፡ Matth. 6,28. b silva, saltus, δρυμός, ዕፀ፡ ገዳም፡ Jes. 7,2; Jes. 44,14; Jer. 10,3; Jer. 12,8; Ps. 131,6; 2 Reg. 18,17; 4 Reg. 2,24. c እንስሳ፡ ገዳም፡ vel አራዊተ፡ ገዳም፡ animalia agrestia, silvestria, fera Gen. 2,20; Ps. 8,7; Ps. 79,14; Ps. 103,12; Dan. 4,22; al.; አድገ፡ ገዳም፡ Job 24,5. 3 locus incultus, eremus, desertum, ἔρημος Gen. 21,20; ገዳም፡ ዘሲና፡ Ex. 19,1; Num. 1,1; Job 39,6; Cant. 3,6; Sir. 43,21; Sir. 45,18; 4 Esr. 7,2; 4 Esr. 9,29; Hez. 20,13 seq.; Jer. 4,11; Jer. 31,6; Thren. 4,19; ኰኵሐ፡ ገዳም፡ Jes. 16,1; Jes. 21,1; Jes. 35,1; Jes. 40,3; Jes. 63,13; ገዳማቲሃ፡ (v. pro አሕቁሊሃ፡) Jes. 44,26; Matth. 3,1; Matth. 4,1; Matth. 24,26; ገዳም፡ ውእቱ፡ ብሔር፡ ἔρημός ἐστι ὁ τόπος Matth. 14,15; ገዳማት፡ ወአድባራት፡ Sx. Ter 22; ቦአ፡ ውስተ፡ ውሳጤ፡ ገዳማተ፡ በድው፡ Sx. Jac. 15; al. crebro in Sx. gadām C for መዓረ፡ ገዳም፡ vid. መዓር፡ (Leslau)

woorden.betekenis: percutere, pulsare, pulsando intrudere, ferire, quatere, att
woorden.definitie: vel ጐድዐ፡ I,1 [vid. ጐድጐደ፡; non tam ad גדע quam ad כדד (vid. ኬደ፡) כתת وقط al. referendum videtur] Subj. ይጕዳእ፡ percutere, pulsare, c. Acc.: ጕድኦ፡ ገቦሁ፡ Act. 12,7; ጐድአ፡ እንግድኣሁ፡ Luc. 18,13; Luc. 23,48; ንጕዳእ፡ እንግድኣቲነ፡ Phlx. 110; በጐዲአ፡ እንግድኣ፡ Chrys. Ta. 27; gladio Hen. 88,2; omisso Acc.: ዘእንበለ፡ ይጕዳእ፡ (πλήττειν) Chrys. ho. 10. a pulsare citharam: ጐድአ፡ መሰንቆ፡ Org. b pulsando intrudere clavum Jud. 4,21; Jud. 5,26. c ferire, cornu Hen. 85,4; Hen. 89,44; ኢይጐድኦ፡ ዐይነ፡ እኩይ፡ Saal. Req. α quatere: ጐድኦ፡ ነፋስ፡ ለቤት፡ Job 1,19. β attingere, seq. እስከ፡ Hen. 18,8; 3 Reg. 6,25 (var. Acc.). d trudere, protrudere: ከመ፡ ኢይጕዳእከ፡ (ἀνατρέψας) Sir. 12,12. e allidere: ለሊሃ፡ ትጐድእ፡ προσκρούει Sir. 13,2.

woorden.betekenis: murus, maceria ambiens, septum
woorden.definitie: et ገደገድ፡ subst. [vid. ገዘዘ፡; amh. ግድግዳ፡ murus ] murus vel maceria ambiens, septum: rex fecit ደብተራተ፡ በዐውደ፡ ገድገደ፡ ቤቱ፡ Macc. f. 1; በዐጸደ፡ ገደገዱኒ፡ ለደብተራ፡ Macc. f. 18. – Voc. Ae.: ገደገዱ፡ ዘ፡ በቁሙ፡

woorden.betekenis: tonare, intonare, verba tonare, tumultuari
woorden.definitie: V tonare, intonare, de Deo: 1 Reg. 7,10; Ps. 17,15; Ps. 28,3; ያንጐደጕድ፡ ኀያል፡ በፀዓዕ፡ መደንግፅ፡ Job 37,4; ያንጐደጕድ፡ በቃለ፡ መዐቱ፡ Job 37,3; Sir. 46,17; Clem. f. 83; transl.: verba tonare, tumultuari in aliquem: አንጐድጐዱ፡ ኅቡረ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ Act. 7,57.

woorden.betekenis: jacere, conjicere, projicere, ejicere, movere, rejicere, abj
woorden.definitie: I,1 [جَدَفَ et قَذَفَ] Subj. ይግድፍ፡ (quamquam Rom. 13,12 ይግደፍ፡). 1 jacere, conjicere, projicere: c. Acc. Ex. 7,10; seq. variis praep.: ገደፈቶ፡ ለሕፃን፡ ታሕተ፡ ዕፅ፡ Gen. 21,15; Kuf. 17; ንግድፎ፡ ውስተ፡ ግብ፡ Gen. 37,20; ይግድፉ፡ ውሉዶሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ፈለግ፡ Kuf. 47; ግድፋ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ Ex. 4,3; Matth. 27,5; Jer. 45,6; ይገድፈከ፡ ውስተ፡ ብሔር፡ ዐቢይ፡ Jes. 22,18; Jes. 14,19; Hez. 16,5; ገደፈኒ፡ ለፀዋጋን፡ Job 16,11; እገድፍ፡ ላዕሌኪ፡ ርኵሰ፡ Nah. 3,6; ገደፈ፡ ነፍሶ፡ ኀበ፡ እግረ፡ አቡሁ፡ Jsp. p. 337; Matth. 15,30; ግድፍ፡ ላዕለ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ኅሊናከ፡ Ps. 54,25; 1 Petr. 5,7. 2 ejicere: አስተዋፅኡ፡ ወገደፉ፡ ውስተ፡ ባሕር፡ ንዋዮሙ፡ Jon. 1,5; ገደፍዎ፡ ወወረውዎ፡ ሎቱ፡ ውስተ፡ ብሔር፡ ἐξεῤῥίφη καὶ ἐξεβλήθη εἰς Jer. 22,28; ገደፍዎ፡ አፍአ፡ እምአንቀጸ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፡ Jer. 22,19; ገደፋ፡ ለዐጽም፡ እምነ፡ እዴሁ፡ Jud. 15,17; Matth. 5,13; Act. 27,19; እገድፎሙ፡ ውስተ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ἀπώσομαι Hez. 11,16; transl. movere aliquem officio vel dignitate, Lud. e Can. Ancyr. 3. 3 rejicere, abjicere, c. Acc. 4 Reg. 7,15; Sir. 6,21; Jer. 7,29; Zach. 11,10; Hez. 20,7; ገደፍከ፡ ድኅሬየ፡ ኵሎ፡ ኀጢአትየ፡ Jes. 38,17; ግድፉ፡ እምላዕሌክሙ፡ ጌጋየ፡ Hez. 18,31; 4 Esr. 10,37; 4 Esr. 14,12; ግድፍ፡ ጋጋ፡ እምክሳድኪ፡ Jes. 52,2; Ps. 2,3; Hebr. 12,1; Rom. 13,12. a repudiare, reprobare, aliquem, ἀποῤῥίπτειν Ps. 50,12; Ps. 70,10; Ps. 94,3; Jer. 8,14; እገድፈክሙ፡ እምቅድመ፡ ገጽየ፡ Jer. 7,15; ἀπωθεῖσθαι 1 Reg. 12,22; Thren. 3,30; Hez. 5,11; Rom. 11,1; διασκεδάζειν Job 16,12; Jer. 14,21; ἀποποιεῖσθαι Job 8,20; Job 36,5; 503 Nr. 42. b derelinquere, negligere, ἐγκαταλείπειν Ps. 26,16; ኢትግድፈኒ፡ በምክረ፡ ዚአሆሙ፡ Sir. 23,1; Sir. 2,10; ዘይገድፎ፡ ለአቡሁ፡ Sir. 3,16; 4 Esr. 10,46; 3 Reg. 8,57; 1 Tim. 5,8. c abjicere i.e. dimittere, missum facere: Hebr. 10,35; ግድፋ፡ ለጽልእ፡ (v. ኅድጋ፡) Sir. 28,6; ዘገደፎ፡ ለሐውዘ፡ ዓለም፡ Sx. Jac. 12Enc.; Sx. Masc. 24Enc.; sponsus እመ፡ ገደፋ፡ ለተሰናእዎ፡ (sc. cum sponsa) F.N. 24,3. d amittere, perdere: ከመ፡ ኢትግድፍ፡ ሕይወተከ፡ Sir. 9,13; በእበዲሁ፡ ይገድፍ፡ ነፍሶ፡ ἀπολεῖ Sir. 20,22; Deut. 22,3; Lev. 5,22; Ex. 22,8; Matth. 10,39; ገደፍኩ፡ ኵሎ፡ τὰ πάντα ἐζημιώθην Phil. 3,8. e deserere: አባግዕ፡ ዘገደፎሙ፡ ኖላዊሆሙ፡ Judith 11,19; Sx. Jac. 5Enc.; ትገድፍ፡ ነፍሳ፡ ከመ፡ ዘኖመ፡ (i.e. deliquium animi patitur) Lud. e Vit. Dan. f in arithmetica: abjicere i.e. α detrahere, deducere, subtrahere, Lev. 27,18; ትገድፍ፡ እም፴፫፴፩ ይተርፍ፡ ፪ Abush. 30; Comp. Eccl. β seq. በበ፡ dividere: ግድፍ፡ በበ፯ (divide per septem) Abush. 11 al.; p. 386. γ missum facere, omittere numerum: ለእመ፡ ይውኅድ፡ እም፴ ግድፎ፡ ውኢተአኀዞ፡ Abush. 11.

woorden.betekenis: projici, conjici, dejici, ejici, abjici, rejici, derelinqui,
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 projici, conjici: ይትገደፍ፡ አብድንቲሆሙ፡ Jes. 34,3; ምዉት፡ ውእቱ፡ ተገድፈ፡ በላህበ፡ መዓልት፡ ወበቍረ፡ ሌሊት፡ Jer. 43,30; ላዕሌከ፡ ተገድፈ፡ ነዳይ፡ Ps. 9,38; Ps. 21,9; እትገደፍ፡ ውስተ፡ ቤተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Ps. 83,11; Hen. 21,4; Hen. 91,9. 2 dejici: ተገድፈ፡ (v. ተነግፈ፡) ቈጽሉ፡ Jer. 8,13; ተገድፈ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ Dan. 8,12; Hen. 83,4. 3 ejici: እምብዝኀ፡ ሕይወቱ፡ ተገድፈ፡ Prov. 5,23; Matth. 15,17; transl.: ተገድፈ፡ እምሢመቱ፡ (motus fuit officio)Lud. Comm. hist. p. 331. 4 abjici, rejici: ተገድፈት፡ አስቃሎን፡ Jer. 29,5. a derelinqui, negligi, Ps. 36,26; 2 Cor. 4,9. b amitti, perdi, perire: በግዕ፡ ዘተገድፈ፡ πλανώμενον Jer. 27,17; ከመ፡ አባግዕ፡ ተገደፍነ፡ Jes. 53,6; Hez. 34,4; 1 Reg. 9,3; Deut. 22,1; Deut. 22,3; Matth. 15,24; Matth. 18,12; Luc. 15,4 seq.; በእንተ፡ ረኪበ፡ ዘተገድፈ፡ F.N. 40; ተገድፈ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘተረክበ፡ Kuf. 43; ትትገደፍ፡ ኦሪት፡ እምካህን፡ Hez. 7,26. c in arithmetica: detrahi, subtrahi, et seq. በበ፡ dividi, Abush.

woorden.betekenis: abjectio, omissio, mendum
woorden.definitie: n. act. et subst. abjectio i.e. omissio vel mendum: ግድፈተ፡ ቃል፡ F.N. in Epil. (Catal. Cod. Ae. Bibl. Bodl. p. 29); N.T. rom. in Proleg.

woorden.betekenis: nycticorax, corvus nocturnus, noctua, aliud
woorden.definitie: , ጕጋ, ጉጓ፡, ጕጓ፡ subst. [onomatopoët.; vid. ቋዕ፡ col. 456] nycticorax, corvus nocturnus, noctua, 1 Reg. 26,20; Lev. 11,17; Deut. 14,17; Ps. 101,7. – Voc. Ae.: ጉጓ፡ ዘ፡ ጉጉት፡; aliud: ብ፡ ቍንጫ፡; aliud: ጕጓ፡ ዘ፡ ቁንጫ፡ ጕጔ፡ ዘ፡ ጕጉት፡

woorden.betekenis: facies, vultus, oculi, aspectus, conspectus, coram, ante, e
woorden.definitie: subst., fere ubique m., sing. et coll., Pl. ገጻት፡ [etymon non liquet; quaeritur annon cum ܚܙܳܐ חָזָה componendum sit, quamquam etiam ea, quae Arabum lexicographi de غَضَاضٌ notant, respiciendum videtur] 1 facies, bestiarum Job 41,4; Job 41,5; Hez. 1,10; hominum, angelorum, Dei: Gen. 2,7; Gen. 3,19; Gen. 20,16; Gen. 50,1; ይከድኑ፡ ገጾሙ፡ Jes. 6,2; እምኵሉ፡ ገጽ፡ Jes. 25,8; Jer. 5,3; ገጽ፡ et ገጻት፡ Prov. 27,19; ከመ፡ ኣስሕቶ፡ በገጽየ፡ Judith 13,16; ከደነኒ፡ ኀፍረት፡ ገጽየ፡ Ps. 68,10; Ps. 103,17; Job 6,28; Ex. 33,23; Num. 6,26; Matth. 6,17; Matth. 17,2; Matth. 26,68; Jac. 1,23; 2 Cor. 4,6; Joh. 11,44; Apoc. 1,16; ወድቀት፡ በገጻ፡ Ruth 2,10; Judith 9,1; Matth. 17,6; ሰገደ፡ በገጹ፡ Matth. 26,39; ይወድቁ፡ በገጻቲሆሙ፡ Phlx. 60; ይትኀፀቡ፡ ገጻቲሆሙ፡ ወእገሪሆሙ፡ Phlx. 129. a vultus: Gen. 31,2; Gen. 31,5; Gen. 40,7; ግሩመ፡ ገጽ፡ Deut. 28,50; ልቡ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ይዌልጦ፡ ገጾ፡ Sir. 13,25; ይመይጥ፡ ገጾ፡ Sir. 12,18; እምገጹ፡ ይትዐወቅ፡ ጠቢብ፡ Sir. 19,29; Sir. 25,17; በገጽ፡ ንጹሕ፡ Job 33,26; ገጽ፡ ብሩህ፡ Sir. 13,26; ዘይገብር፡ ምጽዋተ፡ እንዘ፡ ይበርህ፡ ገጹ፡ Clem. f. 174; ብርሃነ፡ ገጽከ፡ Ps. 4,7; ወድቀ፡ ገጽከ፡ Gen. 4,6; ወድቀ፡ ገጽየ፡ በገዓር፡ Job 9,27; ኢትወድቅ፡ ገጽከ፡ Judith 6,9; 1 Reg. 1,18; Matth. 6,16. b oculi, aspectus, conspectus: ይሢም፡ ገጾ፡ ኀቤከ፡ Num. 6,27; ኢያጸንዕ፡ ገጽየ፡ ላዕሌክሙ፡ Jer. 3,12; Luc. 9,51; Luc. 9,53; ሜጠ፡ ገጸ፡ እምነ፡ Sir. 4,4; Ex. 3,6; Num. 24,1; Ps. 103,30; ኀቤየ፡ ገብአ፡ ገጾሙ፡ 3 Reg. 2,15; ኣቀውም፡ ገጽየ፡ ላዕለ፡ ብእሲ፡ Lev. 20,5; Lev. 20,6; ገጸ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ኀበ፡ እለ፡ ይገብሩ፡ እኩየ፡ Ps. 33,17; 1 Petr. 3,12; እፎ፡ ኣሌዕል፡ ገጽየ፡ ቅድመ፡ ኢዮአብ፡ 2 Reg. 2,22; አትሐታ፡ ገጾን፡ Luc. 24,5; ለጊዜ፡ ገጽከ፡ Ps. 20,9; Thren. 4,16; Ps. 88,15; ለርእየ፡ ገጽ፡ Hen. 24,5. α coram, sive: በገጸ፡ ኵሎን፡ Matth. 26,70; sive: ውስተ፡ ገጹ፡ ለሰብእ፡ Matth. 23,14, sive ቅድመ፡ vel በቅድመ፡ ገጸ፡ ጲላጦስ፡ Act. 3,13; Gal. 2,11; Zach. 3,1; al. β ቅድመ፡ ገጸ፡ … ante Matth. 11,10; Luc. 9,52. γ እምነ፡ ገጸ፡ (ex Hebraismo i.q. מִפְּנֵי) vel እምቅድመ፡ ገጸ፡ sive e conspectu Gen. 16,8; Ps. 9,3; Apoc. 20,11; 2 Thess. 1,9; vel procul a conspectu Apoc. 12,14; Jud. 9,21; sive ab Gen. 4,14; Gen. 32,21; እምገጸ፡ እዴከ፡ Jer. 15,17; sive a parte Act. 3,19 vel ante Act. 7,45; sive prae, ob, propter: እምገጸ፡ ዐመፃ፡ Jes. 57,1; እምገጸ፡ እሳት፡ Jes. 64,2. c species, forma, aspectus, hominis, ut: ሜጠ፡ ገጾ፡ 1 Reg. 21,13; ὄψις 1 Reg. 16,7; ገጸ፡ ዘማ፡ ኮንኪ፡ Jer. 3,3; ለገጽ፡ 2 Cor. 5,12; rerum: Ps. 103,31; Matth. 16,3; Luc. 12,56; እምነ፡ ከንቱ፡ ዘአልቦቱ፡ ገጸ፡ ἐξ ἀμόρφου ὕλης Sap. 11,18; species opp. vero: በገጸ፡ ጽድቅ፡ sub specie veri Jsp. p. 338(vid. sub አገጸወ፡); etiam speciesi.e. res visa: ὄψις Sap. 17,6. α effigies, imago: ዘውእቱ፡ ገጹ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ Phil. 2,6 rom.; Christus est ገጹ፡ ወአርአያሁ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ χαρακτὴρ καὶ ἀπαύγασμα τῆς ὑποστάσεως αὐτοῦ Cyr. ad Reg. f. 26. β species vel facies alicujus respicienda vel reverenda: ዘያከብር፡ ገጸ፡ ልሂቅ፡ Deut. 28,50; Lev. 19,32; ይትቄበሎ፡ ለገጽየ፡ Gen. 32,21; in malam partem: ኢትኩን፡ ለገጸ፡ ሰብእ፡ ሃይማኖትክሙ፡ Jac. 2,1; ፍርሀተ፡ ገጽ፡ (i. fere q. ነሢአ፡ ገጽ፡) F.N. 43,3; ነሢአ፡ ገጽ፡ faciem vel personam alicujus admittere i.e. respicere, rationem habere alicujus, (temere) favere alicui, partium studio duci: Asc. Jes. 3,25; ኢትንሣእ፡ ገጸ፡ በፍትሕ፡ Deut. 1,17; Job 13,10 al. (vid. sub ነሥአ፡), vel አድልዎ፡ ለገጽ፡ Joh. 7,24; አልቦ፡ ነሢአ፡ ገጽ፡ ወአልቦ፡ አድልዎ፡ ለገጽ፡ Kuf. 30al. (vid. sub አድለወ፡). γ respectus qui habetur alicujus, gratia vel auctoritas qua quis valet apud aliquem: ወሀበኒ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ገጸ፡ ወሞገሰ፡ ቅድመ፡ … χάριν καὶ μορφήν Tob. 1,13; ገጸ፡ ብነ፡ ኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ παῤῥησίαν 1 Joh. 3,21; 1 Joh. 5,14; ከመ፡ ንርከብ፡ ገጸ፡ 1 Joh. 2,28; 1 Joh. 4,17. 2 facies alicujus i.e. a is ipse, aliquis praesens: ገጽከ፡ የሐውር፡ ምስሌሆሙ፡ 2 Reg. 17,11; እሬኢ፡ ገጸከ፡ Gen. 33,10; Gen. 44,26; Gen. 46,30; Ex. 10,28; Ex. 33,20; 2 Reg. 3,13; 2 Reg. 14,28; Ps. 16,16; Matth. 18,10; Act. 20,25; Act. 20,38; Col. 2,1; 1 Thess. 2,17; አነ፡ በገጽ፡ 2 Cor. 10,1; ኢያአምሩኒ፡ በገጽየ፡ non norunt me de facie Gal. 1,22; ለገጽ፡ 1 Thess. 2,17; ዘእንበለ፡ ኀፍረት፡ ትቤሎ፡ በገጽ፡ Prov. 7,13; ገጸ፡ በገጽ፡ facie ad faciem, de facie Gen. 32,31; Ex. 33,11; Deut. 34,10; Jud. 6,22; Jes. 34,15; Hez. 20,35; 2 Par. 25,17; 1 Cor. 13,12; መልአከ፡ ገጽ፡ angelus faciei (qui coram Deo ipso stat) Kuf. 1; Kuf. 31. b persona: መድኀኔ፡ ገጽየ፡ Ps. 41,7; Ps. 41,16; Ps. 42,6; Gen. 48,11; እምተግሣጸ፡ ገጽከ፡ ይትሀጐሉ፡ Ps. 79,17; አርአያ፡ ገጹ፡ ὑποστάσεως Hebr. 1,3 rom.; ገጸ፡ እገሌ፡ F.N. 27 (vid. sub ተድኅነ፡); አኮ፡ ፍልጣን፡ በገጻት፡ አላ፡ በሀብታት፡ Chrys. ho. 32; አስተርአየ፡ በመዋዕሊሁ፡ (sc. Dionysii Patriarchae Alx.) ገጻት፡ ብዙኃት፡ በእንተ፡ ሃይማኖት፡ (ut Thnetopsychitae, Origenistae, Sabelliani al.) Sx. Mag. 13. α de angelis: Hen. 4,2; ገጻት፡ Hen. 64,1; እለ፡ ቅዉማን፡ ገጻት፡ Sx. Mag. 12 Enc. β persona Christi (e duabus naturis unita): በገጸ፡ ክርስቶስ፡ ἐν προσώπῳ Χριστοῦ Cyr. ad Theod. f. 19; ፩ ገጸ፡ ነአምኖ፡ ለእግዚእነ፡ ኢያሱስ፡ ክርስቶስ፡ ἐν ἑνὶ προσώπῳ νοούμενον τὸν Κύριον ἡμῶν πιστεύομεν Cyr. c. Pall. f. 98; falluntur qui docent ከመ፡ ሰብእ፡ ፍሉጥ፡ ውእቱ፡ ክርስቶስ፡ ወኀደረ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ቃል፡ ወቦቱ፡ ድማሬ፡ ባሕቲታ፡ ለገጸ፡ ሰብእ፡ በኀበ፡ ቃለ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ μόνην ἔχων τὴν ἐν προσώποις ἕνωσιν πρὸς τὸν ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ λόγον Cyr. de r. fid. f. 54. γ personae SS. Trinitatis: ፪ ገጽ፡ በበአካሎሙ፡ δύο πρόσωπα διῃρημένα κατὰ τὴν ὑπόστασιν Chrys. ho. 3; ገጻተ፡ ሥላሴ፡ Sx. Patr. Enc.; al. 3 Facies rei i.q. a superficies: Gen. 8,7; Gen. 8,8; Ex. 10,5; Ex. 10,15; Num. 22,5; Kuf. 4al.; Koh. 11,1; Act. 17,26. b forma, species vid. sub Nr. 1, c. c pars anterior, Jer. 1,13. α acies ferri Koh. 10,10. β እምገጸ፡ … ex adverso, ut: ነፋስ፡ እምገጾሙ፡ ውእቱ፡ ἐναντίος Marc. 6,48; vel እንተ፡ ገጸ፡, ut: እንተ፡ ገጸ፡ አረፍት፡ አፍአ፡ 2 Esr. 23,21. d ratio, modus, respectus (Hinsicht, Rücksicht, Gesichtspunkt): በምንትኒ፡ ገጽ፡ ዘኮነ፡ (in irgend welcher Rücksicht oder Weise) F.M. 10,5; በዝንቱ፡ ገጽ፡ Sap. 13,9; በእንተ፡ ገጻተ፡ ተዋስቦ፡ ወውእቱ፡ ፲ወ፩ ገጽ፡ F.N. 24,4; በቍዔታ፡ ለምጽዋት፡ በብዙኅ፡ ገጻት፡ F.N. 16. e latus, pars (Richtung, Seite): ክልኤሆሙ፡ ገጻት፡ Ex. 36, 24 in C sec. text. hebr.; እምገጸ፡ ላዕሉ፡ Ex. 26,14; Ex. 26,18-23; ውስተ፡ ገጸ፡ አፍአ፡ Ex. 26,4; መንገለ፡ ገጽ፡ ዘአፍአ፡ Lit. Greg.; እምገጸ፡ ደቡብ፡ Jer. 1,14; μέρος Jes. 17,24; እምአርባዕቱ፡ ገጹ፡ Hez. 40,47; እንተ፡ ካልእ፡ ገጽ፡ ἀλλαχόθεν Joh. 10,1; ወሖረ፡ እንተ፡ ካልእ፡ ገጽ፡ Gad. T.H.; ፬ ገጸ፡ ምድር፡ quatuor plagae mundi, Lud.; Acc. et st.c. ገጸ፡ i.q. versus: Ex. 26,18; Ex. 26,22. f locus, τόπος Luc. 10,32 rom.; Luc. 14,9; በውስተ፡ ብዙኅ፡ ገጽ፡ πολλαχόθεν (sc. hoc elucet) Chrys. f. 5; በብዙኅ፡ ገጽ፡ πολλαχοῦ Chrys. ho. 3; በብዙኅ፡ ገጸ፡ መካን፡ multis in locis Chrys. ho. 10; locus libri vel scripti, Lud. Comm. hist. p. 502 Nr.|37. g pars (Teil), μέρος Act. 23,6; እም፩ ገጽ፡ ex(una) parte 4 Esr. 2,61; 4 Esr. 4,18; Rom. 15,15; በበ፡ ገጹ፡ per singulas ejus partes Hebr. 9,5; ፈጻሚተ፡ ገድል፡ ዘበበገጹ፡ Sx. Teq. 24 Enc. – Voc. Ae.: ገጽ፡ ዘ፡ ግምባር፡ gaṣṣ L አመጽለወ፡ ገጾ ʾamaṣlawa gaṣṣo he had a sad countenance, vid. አመጽለወ፡ 370a አሠነየ፡ ገጾ፡ ʾaśannaya gaṣṣo he was friendly, vid. አሠነየ፡ 531b ገጸ፡ በረከት gaṣṣa barakat gift, vid. በረከት፡ 105a C for መስተቃትላነ፡ ገጽ፡ vid. መስተቃትል፡ (TraCES)

woorden.betekenis: vertit, invertit, vertere, invertere, avertere, pervertere,
woorden.definitie: quadril. I [جَفَأَ et كَفَأَ vertit vel invertit vas et effudit (كَفْتٌ); 1 Reg. 31,3 in uno codice inveni ገብትአ፡] 1 vertere, invertere, 1 Reg. 31,9. 2 avertere: ገፍትኡ፡ አዕይንቲሆሙ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይነጽሩ፡ Dan. apocr. 1,9; ትገፈትእዎ፡ ለሕዝብ፡ እምግብሩ፡ Ex. 5,4. 3 pervertere, እለ፡ ትገፈትእዋ፡ ለርትዕ፡ Mich. 3,9; ከመ፡ ይገፍትእ፡ ፍትሐ፡ ምስኪን፡ Jes. 32,7; ፍትወት፡ ገፍትአ፡ ልበከ፡ Dan. apocr. 1,56; Num. 32,7; Hez. 13,18; 3 Reg. 18,18; 2 Tim. 2,18; Tit. 1,11. 4 evertere, subvertere: mensam Marc. 11,15; Matth. 21,12; መናብርተ፡ Sap. 5,24; እገፈትእ፡ መናብርተ፡ ነገሥት፡ ወእገፈትእ፡ ሰረገላ፡ ወመስተጽእናነ፡ Hagg. 2,22; tentorium Jud. 7,13; urbes Gen. 13,10; Gen. 19,21; Gen. 19,25; Deut. 29,22; Am. 4,11; Jer. 20,16; Jer. 27,40; Jes. 13,19; 2 Petr. 2,6; turrim Kuf. 10; misit Deus ዐቢየ፡ ነፋሰ፡ ወገፍትአ፡ አማልክቲሆሙ፡ ወደፈኖሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ Clem. f. 32; montes Job 9,5; ገፍትኦሙ፡ ለአድባር፡ እመሠረቶሙ፡ Job 28,9; እመ፡ ገፍትኦ፡ ለኵሉ፡ Job 11,10; homines: ይገፈትኦሙ፡ ለኀያላነ፡ ምድር፡ Job 12,19; Sir. 10,13; Hen. 94,10; Jer. 23,19; Am. 4,11. a subvertere et dejicere aliquem a sede, Hen. 46,5. b evertere i.e. ejicere: ገፍታእኩ፡ ኵሎ፡ ንዋዮ፡ አፍአ፡ እምነ፡ … 2 Esr. 23,8 (at legendum videtur ገደፍኩ፡).

woorden.betekenis: subversio, eversio
woorden.definitie: subst. subversio, eversio: ግፍታኤ፡ ሰዶም፡ M.M. f. 229; Kuf. 16; Org.

woorden.betekenis: duriter et inique tractavit, injuria affecit, comprimere, ar
woorden.definitie: vel ገፍአ፡ I,1 [جَفَا duriter et inique tractavit; injuria affecit ] Subj. ይግፋዕ፡ 1 comprimere, arcte complecti, Jud. 16,29. 2 reprimere: ሀብት፡ ዘበጽሚት፡ ይገፍዕ፡ (v. ያጠፍእ፡) መዐተ፡ ἀνατρέπει (יִכְפֶּה de quo vid. Ges. thes. p. 704) Prov. 21,14; repulit instantem Lud. e Vit. Baam. 3 opprimere, injuria afficere, vim inferre, injuriam facere: ይገፍዕ፡ ἄτοπα ποιεῖν Job 34,12; ለሊሁ፡ ይገፍዕ፡ ἠδίκησε Sir. 13,3; Hez. 22,7; Ex. 2,13; c. Acc. pers.: Ex. 23,9; 1 Reg. 12,3; 1 Reg. 12,4; Ps. 34,1; Kuf. 28; Job 24,10; Jes. 3,15; Jes. 51,23; Ep. Jer. 13; 4 Esr. 12,46; Prov. 24,44; Hez. 22,29; Hen. 10,15; Hen. 15,11; Matth. 20,13; Luc. 19,8; ግፍዕክሙ፡ ዘትገፍዑ፡ Hen. 98,8. a impetum facere, irruere in aliquem vel aliquid Matth. 7,25; Luc. 6,48. b vim facere in aliquid, violenter rapere aliquid, አባ፡ ሙሴ፡ ጸሊም፡ ገፍዓ፡ ለመንግሥተ፡ ሰማያት፡ በከመ፡ ይቤ፡ ወንጌል፡ (Matth. 11,12; Luc. 16,16) Sx. Sen. 24.

woorden.betekenis: oppressus, injuria affectus, vim passus, vim faciens, violen
woorden.definitie: part. 1 oppressus, injuria affectus, vim passus, Ps. 81,3; Ps. 102,6; Ps. 145,5; አድኅኑ፡ ግፉዐ፡ Jes. 1,17; ሰብእ፡ ግፉዓን፡ Jes. 25,3; አውያተ፡ ግፉዕ፡ Sir. 32,16; Sir. 4,9; sine dubio etiam Jud. 12,2. 2 vim faciens, violentus, βιαστής Matth. 11,12.

woorden.betekenis: oppressio, vis, violentia, injuria, injuriâ, praeter jus, im
woorden.definitie: subst. m. et fem. (ut Hen. 99,15) oppressio, vis, violentia, injuria: ዐመፃ፡ ወግፍዕ፡ Kuf. 35; Jer. 6,7; Hen. 10,16; Hen. 10,20; Hen. 13,2; Hen. 91,5; Hen. 91,6; Hen. 98,8; Hen. 99,15; ἀδικία Jes. 33,15; ከመ፡ ትግበሩ፡ ላዕሌነ፡ ዐቢየ፡ ግፍዐ፡ Judith 7,24; ἀδικήματα Jer. 22,17; injuria quam quis patitur: ግፍዕክሙ፡ 1 Petr. 2,20. a injuria verbis facta: ነገረ፡ ግፍዕ፡ λόγος ἄδικος Prov. 29,12; ወባሕቱ፡ እነግረከ፡ ግፍዐከ፡ Job 33,8. b በግፍዕ፡ injuriâ, praeter jus, immerito: አሕመመኒ፡ በግፍዕ፡ Job 34,6; ἀδίκως Prov. 19,5; የሐምም፡ በግፍዕ፡ 1 Petr. 2,19.

woorden.betekenis: caper, capra, ṭali
woorden.definitie: , ጠሊት፡ caper, capra vid. sub ጠለየ፡ ṭali C for ማሕስዕ፡ ጠሊ vid. ማሕስዕ፡

woorden.betekenis: ros, leviter, humectavit, humere, madere, pinguem esse, ping
woorden.definitie: I,1 [טַל ܛܰܠܳܐ ros, طَلَّ leviter terram humectavit ros] humere, madere, pinguem esse, pinguefieri: ትጠልል፡ ምድር፡ እምሥብሖሙ፡ (ἐμπλησθήσεται, יְדֻשַּׁן) var. pro ይጠልቅ፡ Jes. 34,7; ትጠልል፡ በቅብእ፡ ሢበትየ፡ Ps. 91,10; ኵሉ፡ ነፍስ፡ እንተ፡ ትባርክ፡ (v. ትትባረክ፡) ትጠልል፡ (v. pro ስፍሕት፡) Prov. 11,25. – (Quod Lud. e Lit. Epiph. affert ረሰየ፡ ላቲ፡ ደመና፡ ልብሰ፡ ወበጊሜ፡ ጠለላ፡ manifesto errore pro ጠብለላ፡ scriptum est nec significatus madidare inde probari potest). – Rad. Abb.: ጠለ፡ ዘ፡ ለመለመ።

woorden.betekenis: ros, pluvia tenuior, guttae roris, pinguedo, liquor pinguis
woorden.definitie: subst., m., raro fem. (ut Hos. 6,4), Pl. ጠላት፡ 1 ros, pluvia tenuior: δρόσος Gen. 27,28; Num. 11,9; Deut. 32,2; Jud. 6,37; 2 Reg. 1,21; Cant. 5,2; Job 29,19; Ps. 132,3; Dan. 4,12; Hos. 6,4; Hos. 13,3; Mich. 5,6; Hen. 2,3; Hen. 60,20; Hen. 76,8; Hen. 76,9; ὑετός Hez. 22,24; Pl.: guttae roris: ደመናት፡ ያውሕዙ፡ ጠላተ፡ δρόσους Prov. 3,20; ጠለ፡ ገዳም፡ ψεκάδες ὄρεων Job 24,8. De rore resurrectionis (Jes. 26,19) vid. Clem. f. 157. 2 pinguedo, liquor pinguis, πιότης Gen. 27,28; Ps. 35,9; Hez. 25,4; ጠላት፡ Ps. 64,12; እሉኬ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ጠላት፡ እሙንቱ፡ Zach. 4,14.

woorden.betekenis: residěre, subsiděre
woorden.definitie: (an ጥሕለ፡?) I,1 residěre, subsiděre in excernendo, percolando: ውስተ፡ መንጠፍት፡ ይጥሕል፡ ሐሠር፡ ἐν σείσματι κοσκίνου διαμένει κοπρία Sir. 27,4. – Rad. Abb.: ጥሕለ፡ ዘ፡ አተላ፡ ሆነ።

woorden.betekenis: intingere, abluendi, baptizare, illuminare, adspergendi
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 intingere: አጥመቁ፡ አፅርቅተ፡ ዘሠቀ፡ ጸጕር፡ ውስተ፡ ብሒእ፡ Sx. Nah. 1; abluendi causa: Marc. 7,4; Did. 31. 2 baptizare, et abs. et c. Acc.; de baptismo Johannis Matth. 3,11; Act. 1,5; Act. 19,4; Judaeorum Matth. 23,15; Christianorum Matth. 28,19; Joh. 4,1; Joh. 4,2; 1 Cor. 1,14; 1 Cor. 1,17; 1 Cor. 15,29; φωτίζειν ( illuminare i.e. baptizare ) Hebr. 10,32; አጥመቆሙ፡ በስመ፡ አብ፡ ወወልድ፡ ወመንፈስ፡ ቅዱስ፡ Clem. f. 234; Did. 39; ግሙራ፡ ኢመፍትው፡ ያጥምቃ፡ አንስት፡ Did. 15; Kid. f. 24; ለእመ፡ ተዳደቆ፡ ግብተ፡ ደዌ፡ ያጥምቅዎ፡ ፍጡነ፡ F.M. 27,3; ሶበ፡ ተወልደ፡ ሕፃን፡ ጥዑየ፡ ይትዐገሡ፡ አጥምቆቶ፡ F.M. 27,3; በእንተ፡ ዘይደሉ፡ ያጥምቅዎ፡ ዳግመ፡ F.M. 27,7; etiam c. Acc. baptismi: ከመ፡ ያጥምቆሙ፡ ጥምቀተ፡ ክርስትና፡ Sx. Mij. 25; transl.: Matth. 3,11; Act. 1,5; 1 Cor. 10,2; Deus አጥመቃ፡ ለምድር፡ በማየ፡ አይኅ፡ ወኀፀባ፡ እምኵሉ፡ ርስሐት፡ Macc. f. 7; etiam de ritu adspergendi: si quis iterum in ecclesiam recipitur ይግበር፡ ሎቱ፡ ካህን፡ ጸሎተ፡ ቄድር፡ በማይ፡ ወበዘይት፡ ወያጥምቆ፡ ወያስተስሪ፡ ሎቱ፡ Kedr f. 81.

woorden.betekenis: intingere, tingere, imbuere, immergere
woorden.definitie: I,1 [vic. ጠመቀ፡ et ጸብኀ፡ טָבַע צׇבַע טְמַע טׇבַל ܛܡܰܝ صبغ ثمغ al.] Subj. ይጥማዕ፡ intingere, tingere, imbuere, immergere, c. Acc. et ውስተ፡ Lev. 4,6; Lev. 4,17; Lev. 9,9; Lev. 11,32; ጠሚዖ፡ Lev. 14,6; Lev. 14,7; Num. 19,18; Num. 31,23; 1 Reg. 14,27; 4 Reg. 8,15; ኢትጥምዖ፡ ውስተ፡ ማይ፡ Jer. 13,1; ውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘርኢከ፡ ኢትጥማዕ፡ እዴከ፡ Sir. 34,14; ትጠምዐኒ፡ ውስተ፡ ርስሐት፡ Job 9,31; sederunt ad fluvium ወጠምዐ፡ ፩ እምኔሆሙ፡ ጳኵሲማሁ፡ ወይቤሎ፡ ፩ ለካልኡ፡ ለምንት፡ ታርሕሳ፡ Phlx. 78; ጠምዖ፡ ለቤት፡ (ni ጦሞ፡ emendandum fuerit) Hen. 90,28; c. dupl. Acc.: Luc. 16,24. – Voc. Ae.: ጠምዐ፡ ዘ፡ ዘፈቀ።

woorden.betekenis: , sec. Lud. etiam ጠር፡, nomen mensis Abyssinorum qu
woorden.definitie: , sec. Lud. etiam ጠር፡, nomen mensis Abyssinorum quinti, qui XXVII° Decembris sec. Cal. Jul., VIII° Januarii sec. Cal. Greg. incipit et mensi Aegyptiorum ⲧⲱⲃⲓ respondet.

woorden.betekenis: stupere, stupidum fieri, stupidos habere dentes
woorden.definitie: I,1 [i.q. ፀርሰ፡ ضَرِسَ] stupere, stupidum fieri de dentibus, vel stupidos habere dentes, ex rei acidae usu, ወደቂቅ፡ ይጠርሱ፡ (v. ፀርሱ፡) ስነኒሆሙ፡ Jer. 38,29; ለሊሁ፡ ይጠርስ፡ (v. ይፀርስ፡) ስነኒሁ፡ Jer. 38,30; ደቂቅ፡ ጠርሱ፡ (v. ፀርሱ፡) ስነኒሆሙ፡ Hez. 18,2.

woorden.betekenis: terebinthus
woorden.definitie: ጤርቤንጦስ፡ ጤርባንቶስ፡ ጤሬብንቶስ፡ ጤቤሬኖቶስ፡ ጠርቤንቶ፡ al., n. peregr. sc. τερέβινθος, terebinthus a arbor Jos. 24,26; Sir. 24,16; Jes. 1,30; Jes. 6,13; Kuf. 13. b fructus seu nuces terebinthinae, ut videtur, Gen. 43,11; Kuf. 42. – Voc. Ae.: ተነካ፡ ወዳዕሮ፡ ወጠርቤንቶ፡ ዘ፡ ወርካ።

woorden.betekenis: multus ac numerosus evasit, multis opibus polluit
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., cui comparanda videtur ثَرَا multus ac numerosus evasit; ثَرِىَ multis opibus polluit, (nequaquam יָרַשׁ i.e. ወረሰ፡ Schrader de linguae Aethiop. indole p. 15).

woorden.betekenis: acquirere, sibi comparare, acquirere peculium, quaestum face
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 acquirere, sibi comparare, opes, bona: Gen. 12,5; Gen. 26,14; Gen. 31,18; Gen. 36,6; Gen. 46,6; Kuf. 28; Koh. 2,7; ንዋይ፡ ዘአጥረየ፡ Job 20,29; Job 2,4; አጥረይኩ፡ ሠናየ፡ ጥሪተ፡ Sir. 51,21; አንተ፡ ርቱዕ፡ ታጥርያ፡ Jer. 39,7; ታጠርዩ፡ በዝ፡ ብሔር፡ አብያተ፡ Jer. 39,15; Matth. 10,9; Matth. 19,21; Luc. 18,12; Hen. 91,13; Hen. 97,8; አጥርዮ፡ ጥሪታት፡ F.N. 24,4; servos Ex. 21,2; Lev. 25,44; Lev. 25,45; አጥርየነ፡ Jes. 26,13; Gen. 47,19; homines tamquam peculium: ኅሩያንየ፡ እለ፡ አጥረይኩ፡ Jes. 43,21; amicum: አጥሪ፡ ዐርከ፡ Prov. 17,17; filium Gen. 4,1; res varias, ut arma Kuf. 11; ልብነ፡ እምከመ፡ አጥረየ፡ ክንፈ፡ ወርሕቀ፡ እምግባራተ፡ ዓለም፡ Chrys. Ta. 22; ንጽሀቅ፡ ለአጥርዮተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ Chrys. Ta. 34; sapientiam Prov. 16,22. a abs.: acquirere peculium: አጥረይኩ፡ በውስተ፡ አሕዛብ፡ Sir. 24,6. b quaestum facere, Sx. Teq. 11. 2 possidere: Koh. 7,12; ዘአጥረዮ፡ Jes. 1,3; Gen. 13,5; Lev. 14,34; Lev. 20,24; እለ፡ ያጠርዩነ፡ Judith 8,22; ነፍስ፡ ፀዋግ፡ ታሀጕሎ፡ ለዘአጥረያ፡ Sir. 6,4; አመ፡ አጥረይኩ፡ ኪያኪ፡ ማርያም፡ Sx. Haml. 20 Enc.; passim habere, uti: እለ፡ አጥረይዋ፡ ለኀጢአት፡ χρωμένοις αὐτῇ Prov. 10,26; Prov. 17,8; አጥረይክዋ፡ ለኀጢአት፡ ባሕቲትየ፡ Lud. e Vit. Dan.; 1 Thess. 4,4.

woorden.betekenis: acquiri, comparari
woorden.definitie: III,1 acquiri, comparari: አንተ፡ ኀለይከ፡ ከመ፡ ጸጋ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ትጠረይ፡ በብሩር፡ F.M. 25,1 (vid. Act. 8,20); F.N. 5; ዘይጠረይ፡ (mercaturâ) F.N. 34; ጸጋ፡ መንፈስ፡ ቅዱስ፡ እንተ፡ ትጠረይ፡ በጥምቀት፡ Phlx. 20; ትሩፋት፡ (virtutes) እንተ፡ እምኔሃ፡ ትጠረይ፡ ንጽሐ፡ ልብ፡ Phlx. 4; N.T. rom. t. I p. 100b.

woorden.betekenis: res quaestu partae, possessio, opes, bona, facultates, pecul
woorden.definitie: subst. (proprie part. fem.), fem. et m., Pl. ጥሪታት፡, res quaestu partae, possessio, opes, bona, facultates, peculium: πόνοι Prov. 3,9; κτῆσις Gen. 46,6; Lev. 25,10; Lev. 25,13; Kuf. 13; ጥሪት፡ ብዙኅ፡ Prov. 1,13; Prov. 8,18; Sir. 42,4; Koh. 2,7; Koh. 2,8; κτῆμα ጥሪት፡ ክቡር፡ Prov. 12,27; Hos. 2,17; Matth. 19,22; Marc. 10,22; Act. 2,45; ὑπάρχοντα Prov. 6,31; Matth. 19,21; ብዙኅ፡ ጥሪት፡ πλῆθος ἀγαθωσύνης Koh. 5,10; ለጥሪትክሙ፡ Lev. 25,45; Lev. 25,46; Ex. 25,2 al.; θρέμματα Joh. 4,12; Kuf. 45; 4 Reg. 3,17; ሕዝበ፡ ክህነት፡ ወመንግሥት፡ ውእቱ፡ ወጥሪት፡ ውእቱ፡ (סְגֻלָּה) Kuf. p. 121; Chrys. crebro; ዛቲ፡ ጥሪታት፡ Phlx. 28; Chrys. Ta. 28; አጥርዮ፡ ጥሪታት፡ F.N. 24,4.

woorden.betekenis: res acquisitae, possessiones
woorden.definitie: subst., Pl. መጥርያት፡, Pl. Pl. መጥርያታት፡ (quae forma sola hucusque reperta est) res acquisitae, possessiones varii generis: በእንተ፡ አንስቲያሆሙ፡ ወውሉዶሙ፡ ወመጥርያታቲሆሙ፡ ወኪነታቲሆሙ፡ Phlx. 3.

woorden.betekenis: tenebrae, obscura fuit, caligo
woorden.definitie: subst. [طُخَاطِخٌ tenebrae, طَخَا obscura fuit nox] caligo nubium, γνόφος Ex. 20,21; Deut. 4,11; Deut. 5,19; Hebr. 12,18. – Voc. Ae.: ጣቃ፡ ዘ፡ ጽልመት።

woorden.betekenis: valde, juxta
woorden.definitie: valde, ጥቃ፡ et ጠቃ፡ juxta vid. sub ጠቀቀ፡

woorden.betekenis: limitavit, terminum posuit, limes, muro cingere, muro circum
woorden.definitie: I,1 [ܬܚܶܡ ܬܰܚܶܡ تَخَمَ limitavit, terminum posuit; تَخْمٌ (etiam طخم) limes ] Subj. ይጥቅም፡, muro cingere locum, muro circumdato limitare vel munire, c. Acc. loci: ከመ፡ ይሕንጽ፡ ውእተ፡ መካነ፡ ወይጥቅም፡ ዐጸደ፡ Kuf. p. 117; Timotheus patriarcha Alex. XXII ሐነጸ፡ አብያተ፡ ክርስቲያናት፡ ብዙኃተ፡ ወጠቀመ፡ ወሐደሰ፡ ብዙኃነ፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ Sx. Haml. 26; c. Acc. muri: እለ፡ ያፈቅሩ፡ ሕገ፡ ይጠቅሙ፡ ለርእሶሙ፡ ቅጽረ፡ Prov. 28,4.

woorden.betekenis: moenia, murus, muri, urbes, moenibus, munitae, Voc. Ae.
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem. (ut Jes. 15,1; Hen. 14,9) {, Pl. ትቀም፡ Prov. 25,28 var.}, moenia, murus ambiens vel muri: አረፋት፡ ወጥቅም፡ τεῖχος καὶ περίτειχος Jes. 26,1; Kuf. p. 156; προτείχισμα Thren. 2,8; አነ፡ እከውና፡ ጥቅመ፡ እሳት፡ ዐውዳ፡ Zach. 2,5; የሐንጽ፡ ጥቅመ፡ ዐውደኪ፡ Hez. 26,8; φραγμός Ps. 61,3; Sir. 36,30; χάρακες Koh. 9,14; ኣአትት፡ ጥቅሞ፡ τοῖχον Jes. 5,5; ወድቀ፡ ጥቅማ፡ ἐπάλξεις Jer. 27,15; τεῖχος, τείχη Jes. 21,4; Jes. 52,14; ውስተ፡ አርእስተ፡ ጥቅም፡ Prov. 1,21; ሀገር፡ ዘንኅለ፡ ጥቅማ፡ Prov. 25,28; Jos. 2,15; Jes. 15,1; Apoc. 21,12 al. crebro; አረፍተ፡ ጥቅመ፡ ሀገር፡ ὀχυρώματα τείχους Jes. 22,10; 4 Reg. 25,10; አህጉረ፡ ጥቅም፡ urbes ( moenibus ) munitae Jer. 4,6; Hos. 8,14; Ps. 59,10; vel አህጉር፡ እለ፡ ቦን፡ ጥቅመ፡ Jes. 36,1; Deut. 1,28; Deut. 3,5 al.; ኢያሪኮ፡ ዕጹት፡ ይእቲ፡ ወጥቅም፡ ዘላዕሌሃ፡ Jos. 6,1; ሀገር፡ ዘአልባ፡ ጥቅመ፡ Prov. 25,28. – Voc. Ae.: ጥቅም፡ ዘ፡ ግምብ፡

woorden.betekenis: sutor, ., perforavit, suere, assuere, insuere, consuere
woorden.definitie: I,1 [amh. ጠቀመ፡; إِسْكَافٌ ܐܶܫܟܳܦܳܐ אוּשְׁכְּפָא sutor, coll . ثَقَبَ perforavit: Lud. ጠበቀ፡ conferendum censet], suere, assuere, insuere, consuere: አልቦ፡ ዘይጠቅብ፡ ድርግሓ፡ ፀርቀ፡ ውስተ፡ ልብስ፡ ብሉይ፡ Matth. 9,16; Marc. 2,21; Kuf. 14.

woorden.betekenis: mamma
woorden.definitie: mamma vid. sub ጠበወ፡

woorden.betekenis: involvi, obvolvi, convolvi, complicari, circumvolvi, circump
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 involvi, obvolvi, fasciis (de Jesulo) Kid. f. 33; Lit. 173,4; በአፅርቅት፡ ዘተጠብለልከ፡ Cod. Mus. Brit. LX, Nr. 1; linteis (de corpore exanimi) Ssal. Req. 2 convolvi, complicari: Hen. 90,29; ሰማያት፡ ይጠበለሉ፡ Kid. f. 32; de velis navis Chrys. Ta. 34(vid. sub ላኅልኀ፡). 3 circumvolvi, circumplicari: ከይሲ፡ ተጠብለለ፡ ውስተ፡ ክሳዱ፡ Sx. Haml. 24.

woorden.betekenis: mactavit, secare, incidere, scarificare, dissecare, abscinde
woorden.definitie: I,1 [טָבַח ܛܒܰܚ mactavit, vic. ዘብሐ፡] Subj. ይጥባሕ፡ 1 cultro vel scalpello secare, incidere, scarificare: κατετέμνοντο 3 Reg. 18,28; ከመ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ዐቃቤ፡ ሥራይ፡ ዘይጠብሕ፡ በመላጺ፡ (sc. corpus aegroti) Did. 10. a dissecare: ትጠብሖ፡ በበ፡ መሌሊቱ፡ διχοτομεῖν Ex. 29,17. b abscindere i.e. scalpello deglubere, detrahere cutem: ጠብሑ፡ አነዳ፡ ርእሱ፡ Sx. Haml. 13; አነዳ፡ ድማሑ፡ በመጥባሕት፡ ጠብሑ፡ Sx. Haml. 13Enc.; ጠብሕዎ፡ ማእሶ፡ Sx. Ter 11Enc. 2 mactare, jugulare ad esum Gen. 43,16; Ex. 21,37; Lev. 17,3; Deut. 12,15; Deut. 28,31; 1 Reg. 25,11; 1 Reg. 28,24; 3 Reg. 19,21; ጠብሑ፡ አልህምተ፡ Jes. 22,13; Hez. 34,3; በግዕ፡ ዘይወስድዎ፡ ይጥብሕዎ፡ Jer. 11,19; Jer. 28,40; Ps. 43,24; Tob. 7,9; Rom. 8,36; in specie ad sacrificium: Lev. 17,3 seq.; Lev. 1,5; Lev. 1,11; Lev. 3,2 al.; 1 Reg. 1,25; ከመ፡ ዘይጠብሕ፡ ሊተ፡ ከልበ፡ Jes. 66,3; ከመ፡ ይጥብሖ፡ ለይስሐቅ፡ Kuf. 18; ትጠብሕ፡ ፋሲካሁ፡ Deut. 16,2; Kuf. 22; Kuf. 49.

woorden.betekenis: incidi, mactari, jugulari
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 incidi: ይጠባሕ፡ ገጾሙ፡ Hez. 6,9. 2 mactari, jugulari: ለተጠብሖ፡ Jer. 12,3; Prov. 7,22; መጽአ፡ ይጠባሕ፡ ከመ፡ በግዕ፡ Jes. 53,7; Num. 11,22; Chrys. ho. 25.

woorden.betekenis: mactatio
woorden.definitie: n. act. mactatio: ዕለተ፡ ጥብሐት፡ Jac. 5,5 Platt.

woorden.betekenis: culter, cultellus, scalpellum, pugio, sica, sicarii, gladius
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. መጣብሕ፡, (raro መጣብሕት፡ ut 3 Reg. 19,1 var.), 1 culter, μάχαιρα Gen. 22,6; Gen. 22,10; Kuf. 18; ῥομφαία Jud. 19,29; Hen. 8,1; 3 Reg. 18,28; መጣብሕ፡ ዘእብን፡ Jos. 5,2; sculptoris Jes. 41,7 var.; መጥባሕት፡ ዘጠባሕያነ፡ አልህምት፡ Lud. e Mss. Colb.; ad decorticandum pomum Jsp. p. 340(vid. sub ዘሐቀ፡). a cultellus scribae: መጥባሕተ፡ ጸሓፊ፡ Jer. 43,23. b scalpellum: አነዳ፡ ድማሑ፡ በመጥባሕት፡ ጠብሑ፡ Sx. Haml. 13Enc. c pugio, sica: ሰብአ፡ መጥባሕት፡ sicarii Jsp. p. 343; ይጸውሩ፡ መጥባሕተ፡ ንኡሳነ፡ ወበሊኃነ፡ ወየኀብእዎሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ልብሶሙ፡ Jsp. p. 342. 2 gladius, ensis, ferrum: Gen. 27,40; Kuf. 23; Ps. 56,6; Job 1,15; Job 39,23; Sir. 22,21; Jes. 1,20; Jes. 10,34; Jes. 27,1; Jes. 31,8; Jes. 34,5; Jer. 5,12; Jer. 24,10; Jer. 25,16, Jer. 26,10; Dan. apocr. 13,26; ἐγχειρίδιον Hez. 21,3; Prov. 25,18; መጥባሕት፡ ዘክልኤ፡ አፉሁ፡ Prov. 5,4; Rom. 8,35; Sx. Jac. 6 Enc., al.; መጣብሕ፡ Gen. 34,25; Jes. 2,4; Hez. 16,40; Hez. 23,47; Matth. 26,47 al. 3 Pl. መጣብሕት፡ τρυβλία tryblia legitur 3 Reg. 7,36 (sive forma variata vocis መዳምኅት፡, sive patera sacrifica a ጠብሐ፡, sive i.q. مِطْبَخٌ). – Voc. Ae.: መጥባሕት፡ ዘ፡ ወቀርያ።

woorden.betekenis: assare, torrere
woorden.definitie: I,1 (ጠብሰ፡ Jsp. p. 369lectio prava videtur) [ܛܘܳܐ טְוָא طها, ضبا?] Subj. ይጥብስ፡ assare, torrere igne carnem: ይጠብሱ፡ ሥጋ፡ ወይበልዑ፡ ጠቢሶሙ፡ ጥብሶ፡ Jes. 44,16; Jes. 44,19; ዓሣሁኒ፡ ጠበሱ፡ ወበልዑ፡ Tob. 6,6; ጠብሰቶ፡ (sic) በእሳት፡ Jsp. p. 369; ይጠብሱ፡ ፍሥሐ፡ በእሳት፡ 2 Par. 35,13; 1 Reg. 2,15; ይጥብስዎ፡ በእሳት፡ Kuf. 49; Sx. Sen. 12.

woorden.betekenis: sapientem, prudentem reddere, sapientia, intelligentia, disc
woorden.definitie: II,1 sapientem vel prudentem reddere, sapientia vel intelligentia vel disciplina imbuere, erudire, instituere: ልበ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ያጠብብ፡ አፉሁ፡ Prov. 16,23; Ps. 18,8; Ps. 104,20; Ps. 118,98; Ps. 118,130; Ps. 145,7; ያጥብቦሙ፡ φωτίζειν 2 Esr. 19,20; 1 Petr. 5,8; መቅሠፍት፡ ወተግሣጽ፡ በኵለሄ፡ ያጠብብ፡ Sir. 22,6; አብዳነ፡ አጥብብ፡ Kid. f. 12; interroga መጽሐፈ፡ ወታየድዐከ፤ አፍቅራ፡ ወታጠብበከ፡ Phlx. in Epil.; c. በ፡ ( in re): አጥበበታ፡ ለለዕለት፡ ወለለሌሊት፡ በትምህርተ፡ ቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ Sx. Tachs. 26; c. dupl. Acc.: Christus አጥበበነ፡ አእምሮ፡ ዚአሁ፡ Clem. f. 81.

woorden.betekenis: sapiens, prudens, intelligens, scientia et disciplina imbutu
woorden.definitie: adj. et subst., fem. ጠባብ፡, Pl. m. ጠቢባን፡ fem. ጠባባት፡ et ጠቢባት፡ c. ጠበብት፡ 1 sapiens, prudens, intelligens, scientia et disciplina imbutus, eruditus: σοφός Koh. 7,19; ንጉሥ፡ ጠቢብ፡ Sir. 10,1; ብእሲ፡ ጠቢብ፡ Sir. 18,27; ጠቢበ፡ ምክር፡ Job 9,4; ሕዝብ፡ ጠቢብ፡ Deut. 4,6; Deut. 32,6; 2 Reg. 13,3; 1 Cor. 1,20; 1 Cor. 3,18; 1 Cor. 6,5; Jac. 3,13 al.; በኵሉ፡ ጠቢብ፡ πολύσοφος (Paulus) Cyr. c.
