Acc. rei et ለ፡ pers.: Hen. 71,15. g appellare, nominare, nuncupare: Hen. 6,6; Hen. 106,18; ወበከመ፡ ጸውዖሙ፡ ከማሁ፡ ኮነ፡ ስሞሙ፡ Kuf. 3; ወጸውዖ፡ ስሞ፡ ሮቤል፡ Kuf. 28; ወጸውዐት፡ ስሞ፡ ዳን፡ Kuf. 28; Matth. 1,21; Matth. 1,23; Matth. 1,25 al. – Voc. Ae.: ጸውዐ፡ ዘ፡ ጸራ፡

woorden.betekenis: vocari, invitari, appellari, nominari
woorden.definitie: III,2 vocari, a aliquid suspiciendum: ዘሎቱ፡ ተጸዋዕከ፡ 1 Tim. 6,12; Gal. 5,13; Eph. 4,4; መልእክት፡ ዘተጸዋዕከ፡ ላቲ፡ Vit. Joh. Camae. b invitari: 1 Reg. 9,13; Apoc. 19,9; Kid. f. 28. c appellari, nominari: Hen. 48,2; Kuf. 11; Kuf. 16; ተጸውዐ፡ ስሞሙ፡ ዐረብ፡ Kuf. 20; Kuf. 32.

woorden.betekenis: calix, poculum, phiala, ṣǝwwāʿ, chalice, 1 calice d’oro, 1 c
woorden.definitie: subst. m., raro fem. (ut F.N. 13), Pl. ጽዋዓት፡ [صُوَاعٌ] 1 calix, poculum, ποτήριον Gen. 40,11; Gen. 40,13; Gen. 40,21; ጽዋዕ፡ ዘብሩር፡ Kuf. 43; 2 Reg. 12,3; Prov. 20,1; Ps. 15,5; Ps. 22,7; ጽዋዐ፡ ኢያሰትይዎሙ፡ Jer. 16,7; ጽዋዐ፡ ወርቅ፡ Jer. 28,7; ንሣእ፡ ጽዋዐ፡ ወይን፡ Jer. 32,1 seq.; 4 Esr. 14,41; Matth. 10,42; ጽዋዐ፡ ማይ፡ ቈሪር፡ Clem. f. 269; Matth. 23,25; Matth. 23,26; Matth. 26,27; Apoc. 17,4; ኢይምላእ፡ ጽዋዐ፡ ውስተ፡ ከንፈራ፡ F.N. 13; ጽዋዓት፡ ዘወርቅ፡ Esth. 1,7; Jer. 42,5; Prov. 23,31; Marc. 7,4; Marc. 7,8. a transl.: de poenis vel calamitatibus a Deo immissis; ጽዋዐ፡ መዐቱ፡ Jes. 51,7; ጽዋዐ፡ ድቀትኪ፡ ወጽዋዐ፡ መዐትየ፡ Jes. 51,22; ጽዋዐ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Thren. 4,21; Hez. 23,31; Hez. 23,32; Asc. Jes. 5,13; Matth. 20,22; Matth. 20,23; Matth. 26,39; Matth. 26,42; Joh. 18,11; Apoc. 14,10; Apoc. 16,19; Lud. Comm. hist. p. 41 n. 44. b cujus in eucharistia usus est: 1 Cor. 10,16 seq.; 1 Cor. 11,26; 1 Cor. 11,27; Lit. 158,2 seq.; ኅብስት፡ ወጽዋዕ፡ Clem. f. 159 al.; ጽዋዕ፡ ዘቍርባን፡ Lud. ex Sx. Ter 21 Enc. 2 phiala: ጽዋዓት፡ φιάλαι 1 Par. 28,17; 2 Par. 4,8; Apoc. 5,8; Apoc. 15,7; Apoc. 16,1 seq. ṣǝwwāʿ chalice ጽዋዕ፡ ዘወርቅ፡ ፩፡ ዕርፈ፡ መስቀል፡ ዘወርቅ፩፡ ‘1 calice d’oro, 1 cucchiaio eucaristico d’oro,’ 44 VII l. 3 (ed.), 38 VII l. 4–5 (tr.); ጽዋዕ፡ ዘማህዉ፡ ፭፡ ‘5 calici di vetro,’ 44 VII l. 4 (ed.), 38 VII l. 5–6 (tr.); ፩ወጽዋዕ፡ ዘወርቅ፡ ፩ጻሕል፡ ዘማህው፡ ፪[፡] ወጽዋዕ፡ ዘማህው፡ ፬[፡] ጻሕል፡ ዘብርት፡ ፫[፡] ወጽዋዕ፡ ዘብርተ፡ ፩[፡] ‘1 calice d’oro, 2 vassoi di vetro, 4 calici di vetro, 3 vassoi di metallo, 1 calice di metallo,’ 64 l. 9–10 (ed.), 53 l. 15–16 (tr.) L ጽዋዕ ṣǝwwāʿ cup, goblet, chalice used in service of the Eucharist 566a

woorden.betekenis: contumelia, ignominia, convicium, maledictio, probrum, oppro
woorden.definitie: n. act. et subst., fem. et m., Pl. ጽዕለታት፡ contumelia, ignominia, convicium, maledictio, probrum, opprobrium: ὕβρις Lev. 26,19; እምጽዕለተ፡ እኩያን፡ Job 35,12; Jes. 16,6; Jes. 23,9; Jes. 28,3; Jer. 13,9; Jer. 31,29; Zeph. 2,10; Nah. 2,3; Prov. 1,22; Hez. 33,28; ὀνειδισμός Ps. 68,10; Jes. 4,1; Jes. 51,7; Jer. 6,10; Jer. 29,14; Jer. 51,8; Thren. 3,60; Joel 2,19; Zeph. 2,8; Hez. 22,4; 1 Tim. 3,7; ὀνείδισμα ኮንክሙ፡ ጽዕለተ፡ ለአሕዛብ፡ Hez. 36,3; ὄνειδος Gen. 34,14; Lev. 20,17; Prov. 6,33; Ps. 78,4; Ps. 88,40; ኀሳር፡ ወጽዕለት፡ Sir. 6,1; Jes. 25,8; Jes. 30,5; Jes. 54,4; λοιδορία Prov. 20,3; Sir. 29,6; ከመ፡ ኢይግበር፡ ጽዕለተ፡ ላዕሌከ፡ μή ποτε μῶμον δῷ σοι Sir. 11,33; ወዕለታት፡ Chrys. ho. 28.

woorden.betekenis: distorquere, se contorsit, dolore cruciari, dolores sentire
woorden.definitie: I,1 [aram. צער, amh. ጻረ፡, hebr. צִיר; arab. صعر II distorquere, ضار V se contorsit; vid. etiam አንፆረረ፡] dolore cruciari, dolores sentire, de aegroto: እስመ፡ ጽዕረ፡ ፈድፋደ፡ Sx. Haml. 8; ትጽዕረኒ፡ ልብየ፡ Ps. 12,2 var.

woorden.betekenis: torquere, cruciare, excruciare, graviter affligere, vexare,
woorden.definitie: II,2 et አጽዐረ፡ II,1 torquere, cruciare, excruciare, graviter affligere vel vexare, dolore afficere: አጸዐርዋ፡ ለነፍሶሙ፡ ἐκάκωσαν Act. 14,2; አጽዐርኮሙ፡ Job 22,9; ያጼዕረኒ፡ ዘያወፅኣ፡ ለነፍስየ፡ Job 17,1; እስከ፡ ምንትኑ፡ ታጼዕርዋ፡ ለነፍስየ፡ ἔγκοπον ποιήσετε Job 19,2; ταπεινώσουσι Gen. 15,13; κατωδύνων Ex. 1,14; βασανίζειν 2 Petr. 2,8; እስመ፡ ጥቀ፡ ያጽዕሮን፡ Herm. p. 58; ፈቀደ፡ ያጽዕራ፡ (eam) Sx. Hed. 7Enc.

woorden.betekenis: cruciatus, tormentum, dolor acerbus, vehemens, dolores, affl
woorden.definitie: subst. m. et fem. (ut Hen. 22,11; Hos. 5,13), Pl. ጻዕራት፡ cruciatus, tormentum, dolor acerbus vel vehemens, dolores, afflictio gravis, ὀδύνη, ὀδύναι Job 7,3; Ex. 3,7; Hos. 5,13; ὠδῖνες Marc. 13,8; parturientes: Gen. 35,18; Kuf. 3; 4 Esr. 10,17; Lit. 174,3; ጻዕረ፡ ሞት፡ 2 Reg. 22,6; Ps. 17,5; Ps. 114,3; ዛቲ፡ ዐባይ፡ ጻዕር፡ Hen. 22,11; ጻዕረ፡ ደይን፡ 2 Petr. 2,4; ዐቢይ፡ ጻዕር፡ 4 Esr. 13,25; πόνος Ps. 7,15; Job 15,2; ጻዕረ፡ ሕማም፡ dolores morbi, Jsp. p. 340; κίνδυνος Rom. 8,35; Hen. 10,22; ἀνάγκαι Jer. 9,15; ዕለተ፡ ምንዳቤ፡ ወጻዕር፡ Sx. Nah. 16Enc.; በጻዕር፡ Gen. 44,31; Tob. 3,10; Hen. 34,5; ጻዕራት፡ Hen. 100,13. ṣāʿr G ጻዕረ፡ ሞት፡ ṣāʿra mot «agonie» ― ጦረ፡ ሞት፡ Ms. BNFabb217, fol. 43v., vid. ሞት፡ 105 L ጻዕረ፡ ሞት ṣāʿra mot agony, vid. ሞት፡ 375b

woorden.betekenis: angustum esse, coangustare
woorden.definitie: vel ጸዐቀ፡ (Perf. nondum repertum) I,1 [vic. ጦቀ፡ ጠዐቀ፡ ዐጠቀ፡ q.v.] angustum esse, coangustare: ለትጽዐቆ፡ ut premas eum, Lud. ex Org. 3.

woorden.betekenis: imponere, onerare, jungere
woorden.definitie: I,1 rarius I,2 [טָעַן ܛܥܶܢ ظَعَنَ VIII; צָעַן ظَعَنَ; amh. ጫነ፡] Subj. I,1 ይጽዐን፡ 1 imponere onera jumentis, curribus, navibus, c. Acc. oneris: ጸዐነ፡ አንስቲያሁ፡ Kuf. 29; ጸዐና፡ (Imperat.) ለእምከ፡ Kuf. 31; c. ዲበ፡ jumenti, currus Jud. 19,28; Kuf. 31; 2 Reg. 6,3; c. ላዕለ፡ 1 Reg. 25,18; ይጽዕኑ፡ ላዕለ፡ አእዱግ፡ ወይነ፡ 2 Esr. 23,15; c. ውስተ፡ Gen. 42,26; Gen. 46,5; c. በ፡ Gen. 31,17; 2 Reg. 16,2; ይጼዕኑ፡ (v. ይጽዕኑ፡) በአግማል፡ ብዕሎሙ፡ Jes. 30,6; አዘዞሙ፡ ይሣየጡ፡ በውእቱ፡ ንዋይ፡ እክለ፡ ወይጽዐንዎ፡ በአሕማር፡ Jsp. p. 329. 2 onerare jumentum, vehiculum Kuf. 18; ጸዐኑ፡ አእዱጊሆሙ፡ Kuf. 43; ለአድግሰ፡ ጸዐኖ፡ φορτία ὄνῳ Sir. 30,33; ወነሥአት፡ ወጸዐነት፡ አብቅሊሃ፡ Judith 15,11. 3 jungere plaustrum jumento, ut videtur: ወእጼዕን፡ ሰረገላ፡ ዲበ፡ መሠንየ፡ ክሳዱ፡ Hos. 10,11 var.

woorden.betekenis: equitare facere, jubere, invehi facere, onerare, sternere
woorden.definitie: II,1 et II,2 1 insidere facere i.e. a equitare facere vel jubere: Marc. 11,7; ውስተ፡ ፈረስ፡ Gen. 41,43; ዲበ፡ በቅል፡ 3 Reg. 1,33; ያጽዕንዎ፡ (Subj.) ዲበ፡ ፈረሱ፡ Esth. 6,9; Esth. 6,11. b invehi facere vel jubere: ዲበ፡ ሰረገላ፡ Kuf. 40; Kuf. 44; transl.: Ps. 65,10; ወዲበ፡ ልዑላት፡ ያጼዕነኒ፡ Hebr. 3,19 var. 2 onerare jumentum (si non: sternere ) Kuf. p. 68 var.

woorden.betekenis: i.q. ጽሕደ፡
woorden.definitie: i.q. ጽሕደ፡

woorden.betekenis: albus
woorden.definitie: albus vid. sub ጻዕደወ፡

woorden.betekenis: calx, candidum, album esse, fieri, albere, ,, albescere, can
woorden.definitie: quadril. I [a Ges. in thes. p. 1328 relatum ad שׂיר calx; at quaeritur, annon sicut صخد et صهد cum radicibus late propagatis, a צח, צה, זה incipientibus (Ges. p. 1162) componendum sit] candidum, album esse vel fieri, albere , albescere, ( canescere ): ጻዕደዉ፡ እምበረድ፡ Thren. 4,7; Hen. 14,20; Hen. 106,10; Num. 12,10; Lev. 13,2 (τηλαυγής); Marc. 9,3; Joh. 4,35; μεταβάλλει λευκή Lev. 13,3 seq.; Ps. 50,8; ይጸዐዱ፡ አርእስተ፡ ደቂቆሙ፡ በሢበት፡ Kuf. 23; እመ፡ ጻዕደወ፡ ቋዕ፡ ከመ፡ ራዛ፡ Kuf. 23; ለእመ፡ ጻዕደወ፡ ቋዕ፡ ከመ፡ በረድ፡ ይከውን፡ አብድ፡ ጠቢበ፡ Fal. f. 66; M.M. f. 44 (vid. ነጸፍጻፍ፡); ጻዕድዎት፡ Sir. 43,18 var. – Voc. Ae.: ጻዕደወ፡ ዘ፡ ነጻ።

woorden.betekenis: verrendo removit, terra plana, aequare, complanare, sternere
woorden.definitie: I,1 [סָחָה סוּהַ سَحَا verrendo removit; an etiam صَاعٌ صَاعَةٌ terra plana ?] Subj. ይጺሕ፡, (purgare), aequare, complanare, a viam, sternere, munire: ጺሑ፡ ፍኖተ፡ ቅድመ፡ ገጹ፡ (καθαρίσατε) Jes. 57,14; ጺሑ፡ ፍኖተ፡ ለሕዝብ፡ Jes. 62,10; Jes. 40,3; Ps. 77,55; ጼሕከ፡ ፍኖተ፡ Ps. 79,10; Matth. 11,10 ኢጼሐ፡ መንገደ፡ Jer. 10,23; Jsp. p. 358(vid. sub ኰስተረ፡); ንጸይሕ፡ ፍኖተ፡ ለሐመርነ፡ Clem. f. 129; omisso ፍኖተ፡, Sx. Hed. 17Enc. b alia, ut colles, tumulos, salebrosa: እጸይሕ፡ ሎሙ፡ አድባረ፡ ወኵሎ፡ ፍኖተ፡ Jes. 49,11; መብእሰ፡ Jes. 42,16; cineres busti: ዘጼሑ፡ ሐመደ፡ Sx. Hed. 7Enc. – Voc. Ae.: ጼሐ፡ ኰስተረ፡ ቀጽዐ፡ ዘ፡ ጸረገ፡; aliud: ጼሐ፡ ዘ፡ ጸረገ፡ መንጸረሂ፡ ይ፡ ቈለዘሂ፡ ይ፡

woorden.betekenis: locus complanatus, pervius, via trita, strata, munita, publi
woorden.definitie: subst. locus complanatus, pervius, in specie via trita, strata, munita, publica: ይኩን፡ ኵሉ፡ መብእስ፡ መጽያሕተ፡ εἰς εὐθεῖαν Jes. 40,4; ስእኑ፡ ሐዊረ፡ መጽያሕት፡ Jes. 59,14; ፍኖተ፡ ጽኑዓን፡ መጽያሕት፡ τετριμμένα Prov. 15,19; ወይከውን፡ መጽያሕተ፡ δίοδος Jes. 11,16; ዐርዩ፡ መጽያሕቶ፡ τὰς τρίβους Jes. 40,3; Jes. 42,16; Jes. 43,16; ከመ፡ ይሖር፡ መጽያሕተ፡ Bar. 5,7; 1 Reg. 6,12; Matth. 3,3; Luc. 3,5; ፍኖት፡ መጽያሕት፡ et ፍኖተ፡ መጽያሕት፡ Num. 20,17; Num. 21,22; Jer. 38,9; Jes. 51,10; Jes. 49,9 var.; Org. 2.

woorden.betekenis: perditor, corruptor, oppressor, strangulator
woorden.definitie: n. ag. est epitheton Satanae, quod Lud. exponit perditor, corruptor; nescio an rectius interpretandum fuerit oppressor vel strangulator [ضاق ጸዐቀ፡ ጦቀ፡] Lit. 175,4; Syn. p. 310; እስመ፡ ጸያቂ፡ ውእቱ፡ ከመ፡ አቡሁ፡ ዲያብሎስ፡ Macc. f. 16.

woorden.betekenis: olfacere, odorari, olfactus, odoratus, odoratu explorare, pr
woorden.definitie: II olfacere, odorari, c. Acc.: Gen. 8,21; Kuf. 6; Kuf. 26; Lev. 26,31; Am. 5,21; ኢአንፎሙ፡ ለአጼንዎ፡ ነፋስ፡ Sap. 15,15; Ex. 30,38. a abs.: Deut. 4,28; Ps. 113,14; Ps. 134,17; ኢእሙንቱ፡ ያጼንዉ፡ Sir. 30,19; አጼንዎ፡ olfactus, odoratus vid. ሕዋስ፡ b odorari i.e. odoratu explorare, c. Acc.: Gen. 27,27; abs.: Lit. 170,3. c praesagire: እምርሑቅ፡ ያጼንዎ፡ ለቀትል፡ ὀσφαίνεται Job 39,25. d transl.: sentire, ፈትል፡ ሶበ፡ ያጼኑ፡ እሳተ፡ Jud. 16,9; Jud. 15,14.

woorden.betekenis: odor, fama bona, odore
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., odor, quem aliquid exhalat: Gen. 27,27; Cant. 4,11; Tob. 8,3; አልቦ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ጼና፡ ዘእሳት፡ Dan. 3,27; ጼና፡ ተይ፡ Hen. 67,6; ጼና፡ ዕፍረት፡ Sx. Jac. 5; ጼና፡ መዐዛ፡ Kuf. 21; Kuf. 26; ጼና፡ ሠናይ፡ Hen. 32,3; ጼና፡ ሠናይ፡ መዐዛ፡ Lit. 163,2; ጼና፡ ምዑዝ፡ Sx. Teq. 20; ጥዑም፡ ጼና፡ Lud. e Sx. Nah. 16Enc.; ጥዑም፡ ጼና፡ መዐዛሁ፡ Mavâs. n. 12; ጼና፡ ሕሡም፡ ወጽዩእ፡ ወፍጉግ፡ ጥቀ፡ Genz. f. 156; ጼና፡ ጽዩእ፡ Sx. Nah. 3; Sx. Mag. 14Enc.; transl. ንኩን፡ ንጹሓነ፡ እምኵሉ፡ ጼና፡ ኀጢአት፡ Lit. 163,2; de fama bona, quatenus cum odore comparatur, Lud. e Vit. Sam.; Sx. Teq. 6Enc.

woorden.betekenis: excrementa, sordidus, foedavit, foetere, putrescere, computr
woorden.definitie: et ፄአ፡ I,1 [צֵאָה et צוֹאָה excrementa, צוֹא sordidus, ܨܰܐܰܐ foedavit; Gesenio aliisque propagata videntur a ወፅአ፡ יָצָא, Ges. thes. p. 616, at vid. quae opposuit P. de Lagarde Anmerkungen zur griech. Uebersetzung der Proverbien p. 90] 1 foetere, ὄζειν ይጸይእ፡ ተከዚ፡ Ex. 7,18; Ex. 7,21; ጼአት፡ ምድር፡ Ex. 8,10; cadaver ወድአ፡ ጼአ፡ Joh. 11,39; de ossibus Ps. 37,5; ulceribus: ጼአ፡ ቍሰሊሁ፡ Jsp. p. 293; Sx. Nah. 21Enc. (vid. sub በኍበኈ፡); ዘይጸይእ፡ አፉሁ፡ M.F.; Imperf. ይጼኤ፡ (pro ይጸይእ፡) scriptum est Phlx. 208. 2 putrescere, computrescere, manna ዐፅየ፡ ወጼአ፡ Ex. 16,20; Ex. 16,24; fici ኢማሰኑ፡ ወኢጼኡ፡ Rel. Bar.; de cadaveribus: Gad. T.H.; ይጸይኡ፡ ወየዐፅዩ፡ Jer. 15,3; ሰብእ፡ እምከመ፡ ሞተ፡ ይጸይእ፡ Job 14,10; እንዘ፡ ሕያው፡ ውእቱ፡ ትጸይእ፡ ነፍስቱ፡ Sir. 10,9. – Voc. Ae.: ጼአ፡ ዘ፡ ገማ፡; aliud: ጼአ፡ ዘ፡ ፈረፈረ፡; Rad. Abb.: ፄአ፡ ዘ፡ ተላ፡ (at vid. scholion ad ዐፅየ፡).

woorden.betekenis: foetor, putor, excrementa, scoria
woorden.definitie: n. act. et subst. 1 foetor, putor: የዐርግ፡ ጺአቱ፡ Joel 2,20; ይጼኑ፡ ጺአቶሙ፡ Jes. 34,3; mortuus in sepulchro mutatur in መሬት፡ ወሐመድ፡ ወዕፄ፡ ወጺአት፡ Macc. f. 17; Clem. f. 272; foetor ulcerum Jsp. p. 293; Org. 5; ጼና፡ ጺአቱ፡ Mavâs. 10. 2 a excrementa, Gad. Ad. f. 76. b scoria: ወርቅ፡ ዘይጸሪ፡ እምጺአቱ፡ (sic legas) Herm. p. 22.

woorden.betekenis: pratum, pascuum
woorden.definitie: pratum, pascuum vid. sub ፂዖት፡

woorden.betekenis: justum esse, rectum, probum, pium, insontem esse, justificar
woorden.definitie: I,1 [צָדַק ܙܕܰܩ صَدَقَ] Subj. ይጽደቅ፡, (passim ይጽድቅ፡) 1 justum esse, Ps. 17,28; Ps. 50,5. a rectum, probum, pium, insontem esse: Job 4,17; Job 10,15; Jes. 60,21; Ps. 142,2; Kuf. 5; Kuf. 7; Kuf. 28; Hen. 81,5; Apoc. 22,11 rom.; Sir. 7,5 var. et Prov. 25,6 var. (vid. ተጸደቀ፡); ጸዲቅ፡ εὐσέβεια 1 Tim. 6,6 ant. b justificari i.e. justum declarari vel haberi, δικαιοῦσθαι, ኢይክል፡ መዐትም፡ ወዐማፂ፡ ጸዲቀ፡ Sir. 1,22; Sir. 9,12; Sir. 23,11; ኢይጸድቅ፡ መያሲ፡ እምዐምፆት፡ Sir. 26,29; Sir. 34,5; ይጽደቅ፡ Jes. 42,21; ይጸድቅ፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Jes. 45,25; Hez. 21,13; Matth. 11,19; Luc. 18,14; Act. 13,39; Rom. 2,13; Rom. 3,22; Rom. 3,28; Rom. 4,9; Rom. 4,16; Rom. 5,1; 1 Tim. 3,16; Tit. 3,7; Jac. 2,21. c justam causam habere vel causam obtinere: ጸድቀት፡ ትዕማር፡ እምኔየ፡ Kuf. 41; Gen. 38,26; Job 11,2; እፈቅድ፡ ጥቀ፡ ከመ፡ ትጽደቅ፡ Job 33,32; Jes. 43,9. 2 verum esse, verum dicere: ἀληθεύειν Eph. 4,15; ለእመ፡ ይጸድቅ፡ ጳውሎስ፡ እንዘ፡ ይነግር፡ ἀληθής ἐστιν Cyr. c. Pall. f. 92.

woorden.betekenis: justum, reddere, probum, integrum, pium, praebere, facere ut
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 justum a reddere aliquem i.e. probum, integrum, pium: Ps. 72,13; አጽድቅዎን፡ ለጻድቃን፡ Clem. f. 108. α seq. pron. refl.: praebere se justum: አጽደቀት፡ ነፍሳ፡ ዕሉተ፡ እስራኤል፡ እምነ፡ ኅስርት፡ ይሁዳ፡ Jer. 3,11. β facere ut videatur aliquis justum: አጽደቂዮን፡ ለአኃትኪ፡ በኀጢአትኪ፡ Hez. 16,51; Hez. 16,52 b habere vel declarare, Deum 4 Esr. 10,22; Luc. 7,29. α insontem declarare, se ipsum 1 Cor. 4,4; Luc. 10,29; Luc. 18,9; እለ፡ ያጸድቁ፡ ርእሶሙ፡ በዝ፡ ዓለም፡ ኃጥኣን፡ እሙንቱ፡ በቅድመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Clem. f. 242. β absolvere in judicio: Ps. 81,3; እለ፡ ያጸድቅዎ፡ ለኃጥእ፡ Jes. 5,23; ከመ፡ ታጽድቆ፡ ለጻድቅ፡ 2 Par. 6,23; 3 Reg. 8,32. γ justificare, sensu theologico: Rom. 3,26; Rom. 4,5; Rom. 8,4; Rom. 8,30 al. c jus alicujus vindicare, c. Acc. pers.: አጽድቁ፡ እቤረ፡ Jes. 1,17; አልጸቀ፡ ዘያጸድቀኒ፡ Jes. 50,8; c. Acc. juris: ያጸድቀኒ፡ (mihi) ፍትሕየ፡ Mich. 7,9. d sanctum habere vel sanctificare, ἁγιάζειν, Ex. 20,8; Ex. 20,11. 2 verum a habere: ነፍስ፡ እንተ፡ ታጸድቅ፡ ቃለ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Chrys. ho. 23. b reddere exitu (vulgo: verificare ): ያጸድቅ፡ ምክረ፡ መላእክቲሁ፡ ἀληθεύων Jes. 44,26. c esse comprobare aliquid: ለአጽድቆተ፡ ቃል፡ ዘንቤ፡ Abush. 31al.

woorden.betekenis: sibi justum videri, se justum simulare, probum, rectum, pium
woorden.definitie: III,2 1 sibi justum videri, se justum simulare (vel probum, rectum, pium ): እስመ፡ ይጼደቅ፡ ኢዮብ፡ በቅድሜሆሙ፡ Job 32,1; Job 32,2; ኢትጸደቅ፡ (v. ኢትጽደቅ፡) በቅድመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Sir. 7,5; Prov. 25,6 (v. ትጽደቅ፡); Luc. 16,15; Matth. 23,28. 2 justum se praebere, Ps. 50,5 var.; Apoc. 22,11 Platt (si quidem lectio sana est).

woorden.betekenis: rectum, jus, fas, justus, jure, merito, justitia, innocentia
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. ጽድቃት፡ 1 rectum, jus et fas: ግበሩ፡ ርትዐ፡ ወጽድቀ፡ Kuf. 7; Ps. 14,2; Sir. 18,22; Sir. 27,8; Jes. 5,7; Jes. 51,1; Prov. 18,5; ኰንን፡ ጽድቀ፡ Prov. 24,77; ኢኮነ፡ ጽድቀ፡ በሊዕ፡ ዘስርቅ፡ οὐ θεμιτόν ἐστι Tob. 2,13; ጽድቅ፡ ወፍትሕ፡ δικαιώματα καὶ κρίσεις Ex. 15,25; Luc. 12,57; Joh. 5,30; Rom. 7,12; ጽሒፈ፡ ጽድቅ፡ jus edicere, Lud. e Lit. Mss.; ኢዐቀብክሙ፡ ኵሎ፡ ጽድቃቲሁ፡ አላ፡ አግዘፍክሙ፡ ክሳደክሙ፡ Rel. Bar. a statui constructo subjunctum vel ዘጽድቅ፡ vel ዘበጽድቅ፡ vel ubi praedicati vice fungitur, justus: Deut. 4,8; ኵነኔ፡ ጽድቅ፡ Deut. 16,18; ቃለ፡ ጽድቅ፡ Deut. 16,19; ፍትሐ፡ ጽድቅ፡ κρίσις δικαία Jes. 58,2; Ps. 2,12; Ps. 7,12; Kuf. p. 75; መዳልዊከ፡ ዘጽድቅ፡ ይኩን፡ Lev. 19,36; ኵነኔ፡ ዘበጽድቅ፡ Hen. 27,3; ጽድቅ፡ ኵነኔከ፡ Ps. 118,75; Ps. 144al. b በጽድቅ፡ jure, merito, Gen. 27,36; Sx. Masc. 17 Enc. 2 justitia Ps. 7,9; Ps. 34,27; Ps. 44,9; Ps. 49,7; Ps. 71,1 seq.; Ps. 95,13; Jer. 23,5; Jes. 10,22; Jes. 11,5; Jes. 16,5; Jes. 32,1 al. a innocentia: ከመ፡ ታስተርኢ፡ ጽድቅየ፡ Job 13,18; Jes. 5,23; Ps. 17,23; Ps. 17,27. b probitas, pietas, virtus, vitae sanctitas: Ps. 22,3; Job 29,14; Job 35,8; Prov. 14,34; Sap. 1,15; Sap. 8,7; Jes. 1,21; Matth. 5,20; Rom. 1,18; Rom. 10,3 al. crebro; δικαιοσύναι Sir. 44,10; εὐθύτης Sir. 7,6; εὐσέβεια Jes. 11,2; 1 Tim. 4,7; 2 Tim. 3,5; ውፁኣን፡ እምጽድቅ፡ οὐχ ὅσιοι Ps. 42,1; 1 Tim. 1,9; 2 Tim. 3,2. c justitia imputata, justificatio: Gen. 15,6; Ps. 105,31; Dan. 9,24; Rom. 3,24; Rom. 4,3; Rom. 4,5; Rom. 9,30; Rom. 10,6; Phil. 3,9; Hebr. 11,7. d beneficentia, misericordia: በምጽዋት፡ ትሰረይ፡ ኀጢአትከ፡ ወበጽድቅ፡ ትድኅን፡ Dan. 4,24; ምጽዋትከ፡ ወጽድቅከ፡ (v. ወጸሎትከ፡) Tob. 2,14; Tob. 12,8; Tob. 12,9; ለነዳያን፡ ዘረወ፡ ወለምስኪናን፡ በጽድቅ፡ Sx. Ter 11 Enc.; Pl. ጽድቃት፡ eleemosynae: ሀበኒ፡ ለዘአልብየ፡ እምጽድቃቲከ፡ አሐደ፤ በከመ፡ ወሀብከ፡ ለመካን፡ ወልደ፡ Sx. Mij. 17 Enc. e restitutio juris, absolutio: Jes. 41,2; Jes. 58,8 al. f በጽድቅ፡ juste: Deut. 1,16; Lev. 19,15; Ps. 9,9; Prov. 28,18 al. 3 salus: ከመ፡ ይኩንከ፡ ጽድቀ፡ ἵνα εὖ σοι γένηται Ex. 20,12. (Qui usus loquendi huic interpreti proprius videtur, vid. ጻድቅ፡ n. 1, et አጽደቀ፡ n. 1,d). 4 veritas, ἀλήθεια, Sir. 27,9; Sir. 31,4; Sir. 45,10; Ps. 14,2; Ps. 56,13; Ps. 88,2; Ps. 88,15; Jes. 42,3; Jes. 48,1; Jes. 59,14; Jer. 23,28; Dan. 9,13; Tob. 7,10; Prov. 8,7; Prov. 14,22; 2 Reg. 7,28; 1 Esr. 3,12; 3 Esr. 4,37 seq.; Marc. 5,33; Joh. 5,32; Joh. 8,32; Joh. 16,13; Joh. 18,38; Rom. 1,25; Jac. 1,18; 1 Tim. 6,5; ኢውፁእኑ፡ ነገሮሙ፡ እምጽድቅ፡ Cyr. c. Pall. f. 84. a verum: ኢተናገርክሙ፡ ጽድቀ፡ ἀληθές Job 42,7; Hen. 106,12; እመ፡ ነገርክዎሙ፡ ጽድቀ፡ ይቀትሉኒ፡ Kuf. 12; Kuf. 35; Jes. 43,9; Jer. 9,5; ጽድቀ፡ ትቤ፡ Tob. 12,4; ኢኮነ፡ ጽድቀ፡ ቃልክሙ፡ ዘነበብክሙ፡ Judith 8,11; አሐተ፡ ጽድቀ፡ τὶ ῥῆμα ἀληθινόν Job 4,12. b Statui constructo subjunctum vel ዘጽድቅ፡ vel ዘበጽድቅ፡, vel ubi praedicati vice fungitur, verus: Hebr. 8,2; Joh. 1,9; Joh. 6,32; ፍሥሓ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ἀληθινή Jes. 57,18; ወይን፡ ዘጽድቅ፡ Joh. 15,1; ዘበጽድቅ፡ 3 Reg. 17,24; 1 Joh. 5,20; Joh. 8,13; Joh. 19,35; Joh. 21,24 c በጽድቅ፡ vere, recte, revera Jes. 10,20; 2 Petr. 2,22; Matth. 22,16; *Lit. Joh.*; eodem pertinet: ጽድቀ፡ ፈከረ፡ ὀρθῶς συνέκρινεν Gen. 40,16. – Voc. Ae.: ጽድቀ፡ ዘ፡ ዕውነት።

woorden.betekenis: bonus, justus, innocens, insons, integer, probus, sanctus, p
woorden.definitie: adj. (part.), fem. ጻድቅት፡ 1 bonus, physice: ምድር፡ ዘጻድቅት፡ Ex. 20,12 (qui vocis usus huic interpreti proprius est, vid. ጽድቅ፡ n. 3 et አጽደቀ፡ n. 1,d). 2 justus, Prov. 29,7; Zach. 9,9; Ex. 18,21; de Deo Ex. 9,27; Deut. 32,4; Ps. 10,7; Ps. 118,137; Ps. 128,4; Ps. 144,17; Job 34,17; Jer. 12,1; Apoc. 16,5; Joh. 17,25; Rom. 3,26 al. a innocens, insons: Gen. 18,23; Gen. 18,25; Ex. 23,7; 2 Reg. 4,11; 3 Reg. 8,32; Job 34,5; Ps. 93,21; Matth. 27,24. b integer, probus, sanctus, pius: δίκαιος Gen. 6,9; Gen. 7,1; Job 1,1; Ps. 5,14; Ps. 7,10; Ps. 10,6; Ps. 13,10; Ps. 36,26; Ps. 63,11; Ps. 145,7; Koh. 3,16; Koh. 7,15; ነፍስ፡ ጻድቅት፡ Prov. 10,3; ፍጥረት፡ ሐዳስ፡ ወጻድቅት፡ Kuf. p. 21; ጻድቅት፡ ልቡ፡ Kuf. p. 22; Matth. 1,19; Matth. 5,45; Matth. 9,13; Matth. 10,41; Matth. 13,43; Matth. 13,49; Marc. 6,20; al. sexcenties; εὐσεβής Sir. 11,17; Sir. 11,22; Sir. 12,4; Sir. 27,11; Sir. 27,29; Jes. 24,16; Jes. 32,8; 2 Tim. 3,5; ἅγιος 1 Tim. 5,10; εὐθύς 1 Reg. 29,6. 3 verus, verax, fidus, de personis: ἀληθής, ἀληθινός, Ex. 34,6; Job 2,3; Job 4,7; Marc. 12,14; Joh. 3,33; Joh. 7,18; Joh. 8,26; Rom. 3,4; 2 Cor. 6,8; 1 Thess. 1,9; Apoc. 3,7; Apoc. 19,11; Herm. p. 26a et Herm. p. 26b; πιστός 1 Cor. 1,9; 1 Thess. 5,24.

woorden.betekenis: vid. sub ጽድቅ፡
woorden.definitie: vid. sub ጽድቅ፡

woorden.betekenis: tempus messis, aestas, auctumnus, ver, auctumnalem, aliud
woorden.definitie: (raro ጸደይ፡) subst. [radix ጸደየ፡ vicina est radici ዐፀደ፡, quam vid. supra col. 1027; praeterea vid. quae de צָדָה annotavit Ges. in thes. p. 1149 et Ges. thes. p.1143] tempus messis, et ubi de anni temporibus agitur, modo aestas, modo auctumnus, (nec non ver, vid. ጸዳያዊ፡): ማእከለ፡ ጻዳይ፡ ወዐፂድ፡ Kuf. p. 107; ያዘንም፡ ለክሙ፡ ጸዳየ፡ ወመፀወ፡ βρέζει ὑετὸν πρώϊμον (καὶ ὄψιμον) i.e. pluviam auctumnalem (et vernam) Joel 2,23; ዝናመ፡ ጸዳይ፡ ወመፀው፡ Zach. 10,1 (vid. quae sub ተወን፡ col. 570 annotavimus); እግዚአብሔር፡ አዘዘ፡ ጸዳየ፡ ወመፀወ፡ Clem. f. 171. Locos quosdam libri Abushakeriani vid. sub ሐጋይ፡ col. 131, ubi hanc quaestionem uberius tractavimus. (Cfr. etiam Isenb. lex. p. 190 sub voce ጸዳይ፡). – Voc. Ae.: ጸዳይ፡ ዘ፡ ዘመነ፡ ማእረር፡; aliud: ዘ፡ ዘመነ፡ መከር፡; aliud: ዘ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ጰንጠቈስጤ።

woorden.betekenis: pars montis abrupta, declinavit, avertit, in praeceps ruere,
woorden.definitie: I,1 [صَدَفٌ pars montis abrupta, صَدَفَ declinavit, avertit ] in praeceps ruere, praecipitari, decidere, devolvi: ጸድፈ፡ እምተሥላስ፡ Act. 20,9; Luc. 8,33 rom.; ጸድፉ፡ ውስተ፡ ባሕር፡ Marc. 5,13; Matth. 8,32 Platt; Ex. 21,33; ትጸድፍ፡ ውስተ፡ ሲኦል፡ καταβήσῃ Jes. 14,15; ይጸድፍ፡ ኀይላ፡ καταβήσεται Hez. 30,6.

woorden.betekenis: locus praeceps, praeruptus, praecipitium, hiatus, vorago, ab
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., Pl. አጽዳፍ፡, locus praeceps vel praeruptus, praecipitium, hiatus, vorago, abyssus: እስመ፡ ጸድፍ፡ ብሔሩ፡ ወንቁዕ፡ ምድሩ፡ Herm. p. 1; Herm. p. 32; Herm. p. 57; 4 Esr. 5,4; Macc. f. 20(vid. ጐጻጕጽ፡); χάσμα 2 Reg. 18,17; Luc. 16,26; ወይከውን፡ ዐቢየ፡ ጥቀ፡ ጸድፈ፡ χάος Zach. 14,4; በውስተ፡ ጸድፍ፡ አጥፍኦሙ፡ ἐν καταβάσει Sir. 46,6; ጸድፍ፡ ሙፃእታ፡ (ለፍኖት፡) βόθρος ᾅδου Sir. 21,10; ፍርሀት፡ ወጸድፍ፡ ወመሥገርት፡ βόθυνος Jes. 24,17; Jer. 31,43; Jer. 31,44 (פַּחַת); βάθος Rom. 8,39; እግዚአብሔር፡ አውደቆ፡ ለሰይጣን፡ ውስተ፡ ጸድፈ፡ ገሃነም፡ F.M. 3,1; አጽዳፍ፡ κρεμαστά Jud. 6,2; Syn. p. 314(vid. sub ጐጻጕጽ፡).

woorden.betekenis: pili, capillus, vellus, villi, pellis, setae, cilicinus, vil
woorden.definitie: (passim ጸጉር፡ scriptum) subst., m. et fem. [vic. ሥዕርት፡ שֵׂעָר شَعْرٌ, vid. Ges. thes. p. 1335; Tuch. de Aeth. linguae sonorum sibil. natura p. 10 coparandum censet شجر stirpem; parum congrua sunt quae Dietrich Semit. Wortforschung p. 128 conjecit] 1 pili corporis animalium: a hominum α ጸጕረ፡ ርእስ፡ capillus Hen. 106,2; Macc. f. 20; ጸጕረ፡ ርእስክሙ፡ ኵሎን፡ ኍሉቃት፡ Matth. 10,30. β barbae: ኢትንሣእ፡ እምጸጕረ፡ ጽሕምከ፡ F.N. 11. γ oculorum: monachus sibi evellebat ጸጕረ፡ ቀራንብቲሁ፡ Sx. Genb. 13. δ corporis: ርእሶሂ፡ ወጸጕሮሂ፡ Jes. 7,20. b bestiarum: pili, vellus, villi, pellis, setae, ovium et caprarum Gen. 30,32; Ex. 25,4; Ex. 35,6; Job 31,20 var.; Hen. 90,32; cameli Matth. 3,4; suis Kuf. 37; ዘጸጕር፡ cilicinus, villosus: ሠቅ፡ ዘጸጕር፡ τριχίνη Zach. 13,4; ልብሰ፡ ጸጕር፡ (poenitentium) Sx. Sen. 3; አፅርቅተ፡ ጸጕር፡ Sx. Haml. 10Enc. 2 pennae et plumae avium: Lev. 1,16; aquila ምሉአ፡ ጸጕር፡ Hez. 17,3 var.; ጸጕረ፡ ጣዎስ፡ Const. Ap. 52. 3 fibrae palmae: አባ፡ ጳውሊ፡ indutus erat ልብሰ፡ ዘጸጕረ፡ በቀልት፡ Sx. Jac. 2; አበዊነ፡ (monachi) ይለብሱ፡ አልባሰ፡ ጸጕር፡ ዘብቍልት፡ (sic) Sx. Genb. 19.

woorden.betekenis: pilosus, hirsutus
woorden.definitie: adj. pilosus, hirsutus, Gen. 25,25; Gen. 27,11; Gen. 27,23; Kuf. 19; 4 Reg. 1,8; ወኮነ፡ አርአያሁ፡ ለዮሐንስ፡ መጥምቅ፡ ጸጓረ፡ ኵለንታሁ፡ Sx. Sen. 2.

woorden.betekenis: satiari, saturari, satiatum, saturum esse, insatiabilis, nau
woorden.definitie: I,1 [שָׂבֵעַ ܣܒܰܥ شَبِعَ, amh. ጸገበ፡] Subj. ይጽገብ፡, passim ይጽግብ፡, 1 satiari, saturari, satiatum vel saturum esse, cibo: እስከ፡ ንጸግብ፡ Ex. 16,3; Ex. 16,8; Kuf. 24; ትበልዑ፡ ወትጸግቡ፡ Lev. 25,19; Deut. 6,11; Deut. 8,10; Deut. 8,12; Deut. 26,12; Ruth 2,14; Ps. 21,28; Ps. 36,20; Jes. 44,16; 2 Esr. 19,25; Luc. 6,25; Matth. 5,6; Matth. 14,20; Marc. 6,42; Marc. 7,27; Jac. 2,16; ወጸጊቦሙ፡ Joh. 6,12; ኢትኩን፡ ከመ፡ ዘኢይጸግብ፡ insatiabilis Sir. 34,17; አሶር፡ በልዐነ፡ ለጸጊብ፡ Thren. 5,6; potu Act. 2,13; Ps. 103,18; transl.: scortatione Hez. 16,28; Hez. 16,29; pecunia Hen. 63,10; Koh. 5,9; doloribus Job 7,4; ignominia Thren. 3,29; Ps. 122,4; gaudio Sir. 4,12; bonis Jer. 38,14; Sir. 37,24; Prov. 5,10; aspectu pulchritudinis Dan. ap. 1,32; vita Kuf. 21, al.; etiam de oculis praedicatur Koh. 1,8; Prov. 27,20, de ventre, anima, nec non de inanimatis ut gladio Jer. 26,10, orco Prov. 27,20, al.; c.c. Acc.: Ex. 16,12; ይጽግቡ፡ (v. ይጽገቡ፡) ኅብስተ፡ ኀጢአቶሙ፡ Prov. 1,31; ጽገብ፡ ኅብስተ፡ Prov. 20,13; Prov. 24,57; ከመ፡ ኢይጽገቡ፡ ነኪራን፡ ኀይለከ፡ Prov. 5,10; Koh. 5,9; Job 7,4; Thren. 3,29; Ps. 37,7; Ps. 122,4; ጸገብክዎ፡ ለዕጕሥታር፡ Jer. 15,17; ጸገብኩ፡ መዋዕልየ፡ Kuf. 21; ይጸግብ፡ ትፍሥሕተ፡ Sir. 4,12; ምሕረተ፡ Ps. 89,16; እለ፡ ይበልዑኒ፡ ኢይጸግቡኒ፡ Ps. 24,20; Act. 2,13; c. እምነ፡, ut: Apoc. 19,21; Luc. 15,16; Luc. 16,21; እምኅቡኣቲከ፡ ጸግበት፡ ከርሦሙ፡ Ps. 16,14; Koh. 6,3; Hen. 63,10; ይጸግቡ፡ እምበረከትየ፡ Jer. 38,14; Sir. 37,24; ለምንት፡ ኢትጸግቡኒ፡ እምሥጋየ፡ Job 19,21; ኢይጸግብ፡ እምደምከ፡ Sir. 12,16; ከመ፡ ትጽገቡ፡ እምአጥባተ፡ ትፍሥሕታ፡ Jes. 66,11; ከመ፡ ትጽገብዋ፡ (v. ይጽግብዋ፡) እምነ፡ ላሕያ፡ Dan. ap. 1,32; c. በ፡ et Infin.: Ps. 16,16; Koh. 1,8 (var. ለ፡ vel እምነ፡). 2 satiatum i.e. nausea vel taedio captum esse, fastidire: ከመ፡ ኢትጽገብ፡ ወኢትቂእ፡ Prov. 25,16; ከመ፡ ኢይጽገብከ፡ ወኢይጽላእከ፡ Prov. 25,17; እንተ፡ ጸግበቶ፡ ለምታ፡ Hez. 16,45.

woorden.betekenis: saturatio, satietas, saturitas, abundantia, ubertas
woorden.definitie: subst. (semel reperi ጽገብ፡) 1 saturatio (i.e. epulatio ad satietatem), εὐφροσύνη Esth. 9,18; Esth. 9,22. 2 satietas, saturitas: ጽጋበ፡ ከርሥ፡ Prov. 24,15; እለ፡ ኢያአምሩ፡ ጽጋበ፡ Jes. 56,11; ኢይከውነክሙ፡ ለጽጋብ፡ (v. ለጽገብ፡) Jes. 55,2; Lev. 26,5; Ps. 105,16; Hez. 16,49; ይከሪ፡ ጽጋብ፡ Sir. 11,27; ጽጋብ፡ ኢይምጽአኒ፡ κοιλίας ὄρεχις Sir. 23,6. 3 abundantia, ubertas frugum: ዓመተ፡ ጽጋብ፡ (opp. ዐባር፡) Kuf. 40; Gen. 41,29; መዋዕለ፡ ጽጋብ፡ (opp. ረኃብ፡) Sir. 18,25; Sx. Sen. 26Enc.

woorden.betekenis: puritatis, puritate, pietas, benignitas, beneficia, gratiam
woorden.definitie: I,2 [non ad شكد شكم (ዘገነ፡), sed ad זגג et זכך זכה, quibus vis puritatis inest, referendum videtur, a puritate facile derivatur pietas et benignitas, cfr. زكا et برّ] beneficia vel gratiam exhibere, gratificari, donare, dono dare, c. ለ፡ pers.: ለዘሞተ፡ ኢትኅድግ፡ ጸግዎ፡ μὴ ἀποκωλύσῃς χάριν Sir. 7,33; ለነፍሱ፡ ይጠውዕ፡ ለመኑ፡ ሀለዎ፡ ይጸጉ፡ τίνι ἀγαθὸς ἔσται Sir. 14,5; Asc. Jes. 6,9; c. Acc. pers. ( alicui ): 4 Esr. 7,39; እምድኅረ፡ ጸገወከ፡ μετὰ τὸ δοῦναι Sir. 41,22; Sir. 32,11; Eph. 4,32; Col. 3,13; c. dupl. Acc. Gen. 47,22; Lev. 6,13; Jud. 1,14; 3 Reg. 10,13; ጸገዋ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ለአስቴር፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘቦ፡ ለሐማ፡ Esth. 8,1; ጸገወኒዮ፡ ህየንተ፡ ዐስብየ፡ Tob. 2,14; 1 Esr. 1,7; ጸግወነ፡ ነፍሰ፡ እለ፡ ባላሕከ፡ Kuf. 13; Sir. 20,14; እስመ፡ ሠናየ፡ ጸጋ፡ እጼግወክሙ፡ Prov. 4,2; Marc. 15,45; Rom. 8,32; Phil. 1,29; Phil. 2,9; እመ፡ ኢጸገወ፡ (v. ኢጸገዎሙ፡) እምሠናይቱ፡ 4 Esr. 7,42; ለብዙኃን፡ ዕዉራን፡ ጸገዎሙ፡ ይርአዩ፡ Luc. 7,21. a condonare, largiri: ጸግዉኒያ፡ ለዛቲ፡ አበሳየ፡ 2 Cor. 12,13. b munificum esse erga aliquem, Lud. ex Hom. Greg.

woorden.betekenis: gratia, favor, benignitas, suavitas, venustas, donum gratiae
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. ጸጋት፡ 1 gratia, a favor, benignitas, χάρις, Koh. 9,11; ዕሴተ፡ ጸጋከ፡ ትረክብ፡ Sir. 7,33; Sir. 40,17; Luc. 2,40; Joh. 1,16; Rom. 1,5; Rom. 1,7; Rom. 3,24; Rom. 5,2; Rom. 6,1; Rom. 11,6; 2 Cor. 6,1; Hebr. 4,16; 2 Tim. 1,9; Judae 4al.; ጸጋ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ የሀሉ፡ ምስሌክሙ፡ Rom. 16,20; Kid. f. 12; ሀብተ፡ ጸጋ፡ Clem. f. 5. b suavitas, venustas: Hen. 46,1. 2 donum gratiae, beneficium, donum, munus, dona: δῶρον Prov. 4,2; እስመ፡ ሠናይ፡ ጸጋ፡ ይእቲ፡ ምጽዋት፡ Tob. 4,11; ጸጋሁ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ትዜውሮሙ፡ ለጻድቃን፡ δόσις Sir. 11,17; ጸጋሆሙ፡ ለአብዳን፡ አልባቲ፡ ሞገስ፡ χάριτες Sir. 20,13; ጸጋ፡ ሃይማኖት፡ ኅሪት፡ Sap. 3,14; በጸጋ፡ εἰς δόματα 2 Par. 2,10; Ps. 69,19; Ps. 126,4; Fal. f. 57(vid. sub አንጐርጐረ፡ χάρισμα, χαρίσματα Rom. 1,11; Rom. 5,15; Rom. 6,23; Rom. 11,29; Rom. 12,6; 1 Cor. 1,7; 1 Cor. 12,30; 1 Cor. 12,31 al.; ጸጋት፡ Kid. f. 87; Const. Ap. 48; Const. Ap. 49; Lit. 175,3. a በጸጋ፡ gratis, Matth. 10,8; በጸጋ፡ ወሀብኩክሙ፡ ሠናያተ፡ ሀብተ፡ ወአንትሙኒ፡ በጸጋ፡ ሀቡ፡ Clem. f. 45. b Dei munera i.e. bona, opes: mulier ዘባቲ፡ ብዕል፡ ወጸጋ፡ ስፉሕ፡ ወአግብርት፡ ወአእማት፡ Jsp. p. 368; ሰብአ፡ ጸጋ፡ locupletes, fortunati (adjectum est: ኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ ቦሙ፡ ንዋይ፡) Jsp. p. 354. ṣaggā part of n. pr. (personal name) vid. e.g. ጸጋ፡ ክርስቶስ፡ C for ልቡሳነ፡ ጸጋ፡ vid. ልቡስ፡ (Grébaut)

woorden.betekenis: liberalis, munificus, donator, largitor
woorden.definitie: n. ag., fem. ጸጋዊት፡, Pl. m. ጸጋውያን፡, liberalis, munificus, donator, largitor: ብእሲ፡ ጸጋዊ፡ ወመሓሪ፡ Kuf. p. 134; ለጸጋዊ፡ ይድኅርዎ፡ በሥነ፡ ምግባሩ፡ Sir. 34,23; 4 Esr. 7,39; 4 Esr. 7,42; ጸጋውያን፡ εὐμετάδοτοι 1 Tim. 6,18; Deus ጸጋዌ፡ ጸጋ፡ Lit. 173,4; Kedr f. 87; ጸጋዌ፡ መንፈስ፡ ቅዱስ፡ Kid. f. 11; Prec. Mat.; Maria ጸጋዊተ፡ ሰላም፡ ወተስፋ፡ III Sal. Mar. 22; እዴሁ፡ ጸጋዊተ፡ ምጽዋት፡ Sx. Genb. 8Enc.

woorden.betekenis: flos, flores arte facti, praestantissimum, pascha florum, do
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., Pl. ጽጌያት፡, etiam ጽገያት፡ (maxime in antiquioribus codicibus), flos, ἄνθος Job 14,2; Jes. 11,1 var.; ኀሊቆ፡ ጽጌ፡ Jes. 18,5; Jes. 28,1; ጽጌ፡ ይቡስ፡ Zeph. 2,2; ጽጌ፡ ገዳም፡ Cant. 2,1; Ps. 102,14; ጽጌየኒ፡ ፍሬ፡ ክብር፡ ወስብሐት፡ Sir. 24,17; ጽጌ፡ ረዳ፡ Sir. 24,14; Sir. 39,14; (κρίνον); Org. 2; ጽጌ፡ ደንጐላት፡ Cant. 2,2; ጽጌ፡ ዘሐይቅ፡ Sx. Teq. 6 Enc. (vid. sub ስግላጥ፡); ጽጌ፡ κρίνον Jes. 35,1; ῥόδον Sir. 39,13; coll. ጽጌ፡ τὰ ἄνθη Cant. 2,12; κρίνα Cant. 5,13; ጽጌያት፡ 4 Esr. 3,47; v. ጽገያት፡ 4 Esr. 4,8; κρίνα Cant. 2,16; Cant. 4,5; Cant. 6,3; Matth. 6,28; ጽጌያት፡ (ጽገያት፡ rom.) Luc. 12,27. a flores arte facti: Ex. 25,31; Ex. 25,34; Num. 8,4 (v. ጸጋያት፡ et ጽጋያት፡); 3 Reg. 7,11; ῥοΐσκοι Sir. 45,9. b flos i.e. praestantissimum rei: ጽጌ፡ ዘከርቤ፡ Ex. 30,23. c ሰንበት፡ ዘጽገያት፡ (v. ዘጽጌያት፡) sabbatum florum i.e. pascha florum vel dominica palmarum (alias ዘሆሳዕና፡) Luc. 13,6 rom.; Marc. 4,26 rom. ṣǝge G ጽጌ፡ ረዳ፡ ṣǝge radā rosa flos, rose Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 40, vid. ረዳ፡ 159 L ጽጌ፡ ረዳ ṣǝge radā rose, vid. ረዳ፡ 551a

woorden.betekenis: subst. [i.q. ስፍሕ፡ col. 403 q.v.] latitudo, πλάτος,
woorden.definitie: subst. [i.q. ስፍሕ፡ col. 403 q.v.] latitudo, πλάτος, εὖρος Ex. 25,10; Ex. 25,17; Ex. 25,23; Ex. 26,2; Ex. 26,8; Ex. 26,16; Ex. 27,1; Ex. 27,12; Ex. 30,2; ጽፍሐ፡ መሠረቱ፡ ፴ በእመት፡ Judith 1,2; ጽፍሑ፡ ዕሥር፡ በእመት፡ Zach. 5,2; Hez. 41,6.

woorden.betekenis: plectere
woorden.definitie: plectere vid. sub ፀፈረ፡

woorden.betekenis: condensari, confertiri, constipari, spissari, claudi, spisse
woorden.definitie: et ተጸፈቀ፡ III,1 condensari, a confertiri, constipari: እስመ፡ ለሃይማኖት፡ ፪ ግብር፡ ዕጹባት፤ ፩ እምኔሆሙ፡ ይፌጽም፡ ግብረ፡ ዐቢየ፡ ወካልኡኒ፡ ነዋ፡ ተጸፈቁ፡ ቦቱ፡ ምንዳቤያት፡ ብዙኃት፡ (duo sunt miracula fidei, quod et magna efficiat et multa patiatur) Chrys. ho. 27. b spissari vel claudi: ማሕፀነ፡ ራሔል፡ ተጸፍቀ፡ Kuf. p. 102. c spisse coaptari: ይጸፈቃ፡ ድዶን፡ συμφωνοῦντες ταῖς ἁρμογαῖς αὐτῶν Herm. p. 11.

woorden.betekenis: pavire, sternere lapidibus
woorden.definitie: quadril. I [etiam per ፀ; vicinum ነጸፈ፡ q.v.] pavire, sternere lapidibus viam: ወጸፍጸፉ፡ ኵሎ፡ ምድረ፡ ፈለግ፡ በብርት፡ Jsp. p. 274; Chron. Ax. f. 89; Chron. Ax. f. 93.

woorden.betekenis: sol, Heliopolis, in sole, im Sonnenschein, ḍaḥāy
woorden.definitie: (vel ፀሐይ፡) subst. [ضُحىً et ضُحىَ; vid. etiam ጸሐየ፡] m. et fem., Pl. ፀሓያት፡, sol, m. Joel 3,4; Jes. 60,19; Koh. 1,5; Koh. 12,2; Ps. 18,5; Ps. 135,8; Sir. 3,15; Sir. 17,31; Sir. 43,2; Sir. 43,3; Sir. 43,4; Sir. 43,5; 1 Esr. 4,34 seq.; Apoc. 16,8; Marc. 1,32; al.; fem. Sir. 43,4; Sir. 46,5; Sir. 48,23; Sir. 50,7; Jes. 13,10; Hez. 32,7; Jos. 8,29; Jos. 10,12; Jos. 10,27; Apoc. 8,12, al.; Hen. 72,3 seq.; ብርሃነ፡ ፀሓይ፡ Jes. 30,26; ፀሓየ፡ ቀትር፡ Sir. 31,19; ፀሓይ፡ ዘያበርህ፡ ወይጠፍእ፡ Job 31,26; ያበርቅ፡ ሕብረ፡ ገጹ፡ ከመ፡ እግረ፡ ፀሓይ፡ Org. 4; እልፈ፡ አእላፈ፡ ፀሓይ፡ Sir. 23,19; መልአከ፡ ፀሓይ፡ Asc. Jes. 4,18; ሀገረ፡ ፀሓይ፡ Heliopolis Jer. 50,13; ፀሓያት፡ Vis. Bar.; p. 494 n. 5. a ነበሩ፡ ውስተ፡ ፀሓይ፡ in sole (im Sonnenschein) Sx. Masc. 27. b transl.: S. Georgius ፀሓየ፡ ጽድቅ፡ Mavâs. n. 51. ḍaḥāy C a for ለባሲተ፡ ፀሓይ፡ vid. ለባሲ፡ (Grébaut) b for ቀርነ፡ ፀሓይ፡ vid. ቀርን፡ (Leslau) c for ቀይሰ፡ ፀሐይ፡ vid. ቀይስ፡

woorden.betekenis: surdum esse
woorden.definitie: surdum esse vid. sub I ጸመ፡

woorden.betekenis: clavis configere, adjecit, affigere, configere, connectere
woorden.definitie: I,1 et I,2 [cui Lud. et Ges. סַמֵּר سَمَّرَ clavis configere comparaverunt, at quaeritur, annon cum ፀመመ፡, ፀመደ፡ componendum sit; amh. ጨመረ፡ adjecit ] Subj. I,1 ይፅምር፡, affigere, configere, connectere: እፀምሮ፡ (v. እፅምሮ፡) በምድር፡ በምዕር፡ 1 Reg. 26,8; እፄምሮ፡ ውስተ፡ አረፍት፡ 1 Reg. 18,11 vers. nov.; ፀመረቶ፡ ምስለ፡ ምድር፡ Jud. 4,21; ትፄምሮን፡ (v. ትፀምሮን፡ et ትዴምሮን፡) ለክልኤሆን፡ συνάψεις Hez. 37,17; ኢትፀምር፡ አሰረ፡ (v. አስረ፡ et አሲረ፡) ክልኤቲ፡ ኀጣይእ፡ ኅቡረ፡ ኢታድርግ፡ μὴ καταδεσμεύσῃς δὶς ἁμαρτίαν Sir. 7,8; συνέζευξεν Matth. 19,6 Platt.

woorden.betekenis: lana, vestis lanea, vellus, aliud
woorden.definitie: subst. m. et fem. (ut Sx. Tachs. 16) [צֶמֶר ܥܰܡܪܳܐ] lana: እምፀምረ፡ አባግዕየ፡ Job 31,20; Jes. 1,18; Dan. 7,9; Apoc. 1,14; Ps. 147,5; Hez. 27,18; Prov. 29,31; Deut. 22,11; ዕጡፈ፡ ፀምር፡ Jes. 38,12; አባግዐ፡ ፀምር፡ 4 Reg. 3,4; ልብሰ፡ ፀምር፡ Lev. 13,47; Lev. 13,52. a vestis lanea: Hez. 34,3; ኢየሀሉ፡ ዲቤሆሙ፡ ፀምር፡ Hez. 44,17; Lev. 13,48; እምሤጠ፡ ፀምር፡ ግብረ፡ እዱ፡ ወሀበ፡ ምጽዋተ፡ Sx. Mag. 18 Enc. (in Actis ejusdem diei refertur: የአንም፡ አልባሳተ፡ ፀምር፡). b vellus: πόκος, Jud. 6,37 seq. – Voc. Ae.: ፀምር፡ ብ፡ ብዝት፡ ወቦ፡ ሣዕር፡; aliud: ፀምር፡ ብ፡ ነጭ።

woorden.betekenis: admovere, praebere aurem, auscultare, attendere, audire, exa
woorden.definitie: II,1 audire facere, i.e. admovere vel praebere aurem, auscultare, attendere, audire, sive adjecto Acc. እዝነ፡, ut: ለእመ፡ አፅማእከ፡ እዝነከ፡ κλίνῃς τὸ οὖς Sir. 6,33; ኢያፅማእክሙ፡ እዘኒክሙ፡ Jer. 25,4; Jer. 41,15; Jer. 42,15; አፅምእ፡ እዝነከ፡ ወስምዐኒ፡ 4 Reg. 19,16; Ps. 44,12; አፅምእ፡ እዝነከ፡ ኀቤየ፡ Ps. 16,7; Ps. 30,2; Ps. 114,2; sive omisso: አፅምኡ፡ አሕዛብ፡ Jes. 49,1; Jer. 13,15; ዘያፀምእ፡ በውስተ፡ አናቅጺሃ፡ Sir. 14,23; አፅምኦ፡ Koh. 1,8; c.c. Acc. pers. vel rei: ኣፅምእክሙ፡ Job 13,5; Job 6,24; እንዘ፡ ታፀምኡኒ፡ Job 13,17; Sir. 30,27; Marc. 12,37; Luc. 2,46; ዘያፀምእ፡ ትእዛዞ፡ Sir. 32,2; Ps. 5,1; simul adjecto pron. suff. pers.: አፅምአኒ፡ ቃልየ፡ 4 Esr. 9,30; አፅምኡኒ፡ ፍትሐ፡ ከናፍርየ፡ Job 13,6; Job 21,2; c. ለ፡ rei: አፅምእ፡ እምልብከ፡ ለነገርየ፡ Sir. 16,24; c. ኀበ፡ rei, Chrys. ho. 10; etiam በእዝን፡ additur, ut: አፅማእኩ፡ ሕቀ፡ በእዝንየ፡ ἔκλινα ὀλίγον τὸ οὖς μου Sir. 51,16; Dan. 9,18; ለነዳይ፡ አፅምኦ፡ በእዝንከ፡ Sir. 4,8; ያፀምኡ፡ በእዝኖሙ፡ Jes. 32,3; ኢያፅምኡኒ፡ በእዝኖሙ፡ (v. እዝኖሙ፡) Jer. 7,24; nec non de aure ipsa praedicatur: እዝን፡ ያፀምእ፡ ኵሎ፡ ምሳሌ፡ Koh. 12,9; Ps. 9,41. a exaudire: አፅምአኒ፡ ስእለትየ፡ 4 Esr. 8,23; Ps. 5,2; Ps. 16,1; Ps. 16,2; Ps. 60,1; Dan. 9,18. b obedire, Ex. 15,26; Jer. 7,24 al. c c. ማእከለ፡ utriusque partis audiendae: ያፀምእ፡ ማእከሌነ፡ διακούων Job 9,33.

woorden.betekenis: jungere, alligare, subjungere, subjicere
woorden.definitie: I,1 [צָמַד ܨܡܰܕ ضَمَدَ, vic. ዘመደ፡] Subj. ይፅምድ፡ 1 jungere curru jumenta, alligare vel subjungere jugo: አዘዘ፡ ይፅምድዎ፡ ለአፍራስ፡ በሰረገላ፡ Sx. Hed. 18; ፀመደከ፡ (o Photine) ሰይጣን፡ ከመ፡ አባዕር፡ ወአንበረ፡ አርዑቶ፡ ውስተ፡ ክሳድከ፡ M.M. f. 42; ፀሚደ፡ አርዑት፡ ያደንኖ፡ ለክሳድ፡ ζυγὸς καὶ ἱμάς Sir. 30,35; ይፅምዱኒ፡ በአርዑቶሙ፡ ወይቅንዩኒ፡ ለግሙራ፤ ከመ፡ ይፀመዱ፡ ተያፍን፡ ወብዕራ፡ Lud. ex Sx. Genb. 11Enc. 2 subjungere sub imperium, subjicere: Christus jussit apostolos ከመ፡ ይፅምዱ፡ ሰብአ፡ ለሃይማኖት፡ Phlx. 41.

woorden.betekenis: jungi, alligari, subjungi, se adjungere, addicere, adhaerere
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 jungi curru, alligari, subjungi jugo, c. በ፡ jugi Kuf. p. 135; ተፀምደ፡ ታሕተ፡ አርዑተ፡ ኀጢአት፡ Org. 1; Lud. ex Sx. Genb. 11 Enc. (vid. ፀመደ፡); ምስሌሁ፡ በአርዑተ፡ ሥቃይ፡ ተፀምደ፡ Sx. Nah. 14 Enc. 2 se adjungere vel addicere alicui, ei adhaerere, eum sectari, c. ኀበ፡ pers., ἐκολλήθη Luc. 15,15; c. Acc. pers.: ይፀመድዎ፡ συνεστράφησαν Jud. 11,3; Asc. Jes. 3,1; ተፀመድ፡ መኳንንቲከ፡ συνεδρεύεις Sir. 23,14; ὁ ἀρέσκων … Sir. 20,28; πεπολίτευμαι τῷ θεῷ Act. 23,1; ኢትፀመዶ፡ በክልኤቱ፡ ልብ፡ μὴ προσέλθῃς αὐτῷ Sir. 1,28; Sir. 12,10. a in specie: disciplinae causa, i.e. discipulum esse alicujus, vel magistrum sectari aliquem, c. Acc. magistri: μαθητευείν Matth. 27,57; Luc. 14,27 rom.; ዘይፈቅድ፡ ይፀመደኒ፡ ὀπίσω μου ἐλθεῖν Marc. 8,34; ኵሉ፡ ጸሓፊ፡ ዘይፀመድ፡ ለመንግሥተ፡ ሰማይ፡ μαθητευθείς Matth. 13,52. b frequentare, domum alicujus: እሙንቱ፡ ይፀመዱ፡ ቤተ፡ ኢዮአቄም፡ προσεκαρτέρουν Dan. apocr. 1,6; cauponam: ተፀምዶ፡ ቤተ፡ መያሲ፡ Chrys. Ta. 28. c assidere, assiduum esse vel permanere, c. ውስተ፡ loci: ጥበብ፡ ውስተ፡ አናቅጽ፡ ትፀመድ፡ παρεδρεύει Prov. 1,21; ἐπισκέπτεσθαι Ps. 26,8; in specie: in re tractanda, c. προσκαρτερεῖν, c. ለ፡ rei Rom. 12,12; ተፀምዶ፡ ለተድላ፡ ዝዓለም፡ ያማስን፡ ነፍሰ፡ Chrys. Ta. 28; c. በ፡ Eph. 6,18; c. Acc. rei: ይፀመዱ፡ ጸሎተ፡ Act. 1,14; ትምህርተ፡ Act. 2,42; 1 Tim. 5,5; ተፀምዶ፡ ጸሎት፡ Chrys.; ይፀመድ፡ ጸሎታተ፡ ወአጽዋመ፡ Phlx. 7; ሐና፡ ነቢይት፡ እንተ፡ ተፀምደት፡ ጾመ፡ ወጸሎተ፡ Phlx. 54. d in specie: assiduum esse in cultu divino et exercitiationibus sacris, devotum vel ascesi deditum esse, ኮነ፡ መሃይምነ፡ ወንጹሐ፡ ወተፀምደ፡ ወተጋደለ፡ ተጋድሎ፡ መለኮታዌ፡ Sx. Sen. 6; ቦአ፡ ውስተ፡ ደብረ፡ መነኮሳት፡ ወተፀምደ፡ ወተጋደለ፡ ተጋድሎ፡ ዐቢየ፡ Sx. Nah. 26; ዘይሰድዳ፡ ለብእሲቱ፡ በምክንያተ፡ መንኖ፡ ዓለም፡ ወተፀምዶ፡ F.M. 12,1. 3 se subjungere, submittere vel subdere alicui, submisse se gerere, ተፀመድ፡ ኀበ፡ መኳንንት፡ μεγιστᾶνι ταπείνου τὴν κεφαλήν σου Sir. 4,7; c. Acc. pers. vel rei: ὑποτάγηθι Ps. 36,6; ተፀመዱ፡ ኵሎ፡ ትእዛዘ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Kuf. p. 74(Vers. Lat.: adhaerete ). a famulari, servire: አዘዞ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ይፀመድ፡ ውስተ፡ ዐጸድ፡ θεραπεύειν Esth. apocr. 1; Esth. 2,19; 1 Cor. 9,7; c. Acc.: ተፀመድ፡ መኳንንተ፡ λειτουργῆσαι Sir. 8,8; ተፀምዶተ፡ ንዋይ፡ Luc. 16,13 rom.; ሐና፡ ትፀመድ፡ ቤተ፡ አንስት፡ Tob. 2,11. b in specie: Deo ministrare, Deum vel sacra colere, c. Acc.: λειτουργεῖν, ኢትኅድጎሙ፡ ለእለ፡ ይፀመድዎ፡ Sir. 7,30; Sir. 7,31; እለ፡ ኪያሃ፡ ተፀምዱ፡ ተፀምድዎ፡ ለቅዱስ፡ Sir. 4,14; λατρεύειν Ex. 3,12; Ex. 9,1; Ex. 10,24; Hebr. 8,5; θεραπεύειν Tob. 1,7; ዘይፀመዶ፡ በጽድቅ፡ Sir. 32,20; Jud. 11,17; φοβεῖσθαι 4 Reg. 17,32; Lev. 20,3. c assiduum esse in cultu divino vid. sub n. 2,d.

woorden.betekenis: inimicus, adversarius, hostis, ḍar
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., sing. et coll., Pl. አፅራር፡ inimicus, adversarius, hostis: ይከውነከ፡ ፀረከ፡ Sir. 37,4; ኮኖሙ፡ ፀሮሙ፡ Jes. 63,10; ፀርየ፡ Thren. 1,9; Thren. 2,4; ወፀር፡ ይእቲ፡ ሀገር፡ 2 Esr. 4,19; coll.: Gen. 22,17; Ps. 42,2; Ps. 58,1; Ps. 68,6; ከመ፡ ኢይደቅ፡ ቅድሜሆሙ፡ ለፀርየ፡ Sir. 23,3; Sir. 45,2; Jes. 1,24; Jes. 26,11; Jes. 42,13; Jes. 59,18; Jes. 66,6; Dan. 4,16; Nah. 1,2; Matth. 10,36; እንዘ፡ ፀሩ፡ ንሕነ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ Rom. 5,10; Num. 10,9; Num. 24,8; Deut. 23,10; 2 Reg. 24,13; Ps. 9,6; Ps. 43,7; Ps. 104,22; ኵሎሙ፡ ፀርነ፡ 2 Esr. 16,1; መላእክተ፡ ፀር፡ Sir. 33,12; ሶበ፡ አመንደብዎ፡ ፀሩ፡ Sir. 46,5; Jes. 11,13; Jer. 6,25; Jer. 27,7; Judith 8,33; Judith 13,14, al. crebro; አፅራሪሁ፡ Sap. 10,12; አፅራሪከ፡ Jsp. p. 350; Sx. Haml. 27Enc. ḍar part of n. pr. (personal name) vid. ድብ፡ ፀር፡

woorden.betekenis: hostilis, inimicus, adversarius
woorden.definitie: , rarius ፀራይ፡, adj. rel. et subst. (nomen unitatis a ፀር፡), hostilis, inimicus, adversarius: ብእሲ፡ ፀራዊ፡ Matth. 13,28; Matth. 13,39; Ps. 7,5; Ps. 43,18; Ps. 73,4; Ps. 73,19; Kuf. 38; ቀጥቅጦ፡ ለፀራዊ፡ Sir. 33,9; ፀራይ፡ et ፀራዊ፡ ἀλλότριος Sir. 35,18; ኮንከ፡ ለነ፡ ፀራዌ፡ ጽኑዐ፡ Jsp. p. 465.

woorden.betekenis: panniculus, panni, pars vestis lacerae, pannosus
woorden.definitie: subst., Pl. አፅርቅት፡ [amh. ጭርቅ፡; vic. II ጠረቀ፡; Lud. comparavit صَرَقٌ i.e. ጸሪቅ፡; Ewald Jahrb. der bibl. Wissensch. VIII p. 192 ܪܽܘܩܥܳܐ רְקַע رقع; at vid. ድርግሓ፡] panniculus, panni, pars vestis lacerae: ῥάκος Matth. 9,16 rom.; ፀርቀ፡ ትክቶ፡ Jes. 64,6; ῥάκος καταμηνίων Esth. 4apocr.; Org.; ይከድን፡ ሥጋሁ፡ በፀርቅ፡ ብሉይ፡ Sx. Teq. 30 Enc.; ዘፀርቅ፡ pannosus ῥακά Matth. 5,22; ወነሥአ፡ እምህየ፡ አፅርቅተ፡ ብሉየ፡ Jer. 45,11; ይለብስ፡ ሥጡጠ፡ ወአፅርቅተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ነዋሚ፡ Prov. 23,21; Jer. 13,7 (vid. sub ብጻል፡); ለብሰ፡ አልባሰ፡ አፅርቅት፡ ከመ፡ ነዳያን፡ Sx. Teq. 14; ፈሐቁ፡ ቍስሎ፡ በአፅርቅተ፡ ጸጕር፡ Sx. Haml. 10 Enc.; አፅርቅተ፡ ሠቅ፡ Lud. e Vit. Theoph.; በአፅርቅት፡ ልህቁ፡ ἐν σπαργάνοις Sap. 7,4; ጠብለልዎ፡ (sc. Eliam infantem) በእሳት፡ ህየንተ፡ አፅርቅት፡ ዘይጠበልሉ፡ ባቲ፡ ሕፃናተ፡ Sx. Tachs. 1; Lit. 173,4; Org. 3.

woorden.betekenis: carpendo, conviciari, maledicere, blasphemare
woorden.definitie: et ፀርፈ፡ I,1 [vicina videntur חרף et טרף, quorum potestas prima in carpendo est] Subj. ይፅርፍ፡ conviciari, maledicere, in specie blasphemare, abs.: Matth. 9,3; Matth. 26,65; Kuf. 15; Lev. 24,23; በእንተ፡ ፀሪፍ፡ ወጽዒል፡ F.M. 20; ኢትፅርፍ፡ F.M. 20,5; c.c. ላዕለ፡, ut: ይፀርፉ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ላዕለ፡ ስምየ፡ Jes. 52,5; Dan. 3,29; Dan. apocr. 13,9; Rom. 2,8; Rom. 3,8; Rom. 14,16; Tit. 2,5; 2 Petr. 2,10; 2 Petr. 2,12; ዘይፀርፍ፡ ላዕለ፡ ካህናት፡ Clem. f. 162; ፀረፈት፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ (maledixit ei) Clem. f. 221; ፀረፈ፡ ላዕለ፡ መንፈስ፡ ቅዱስ፡ Clem. f. 249; Clem. f. 252; F.M. 23,9; ዘፀረፈ፡ በኅሊናሁ፡ ላዕለ፡ ሕገ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Clem. f. 252; c. ለ፡ Matth. 12,31; c. Acc.: ዘፀረፈ፡ ኤጲስ፡ ቆጶሰ፡ F.M. 20,1; ቀሲሰ፡, ዲያቆነ፡, ንጉሠ፡, አባሁ፡ F.M. 20,2; F.M. 20,3; F.M. 20,4; F.N. 42,13; qui feminam false impudicitiae accusat, ፀረፋ፡ በሐሰት፡ F.N. 24. – Voc. Ae.: ፀረፈ፡ ዘ፡ ሰደበ፡ (v. ተሳደበ፡).

woorden.betekenis: subigere lutum
woorden.definitie: subigere lutum vid. sub ጸበረ፡

woorden.betekenis: angustum esse
woorden.definitie: angustum esse vid. sub I ጸበበ፡

woorden.betekenis: bellare
woorden.definitie: bellare vid. sub I ጸብአ፡

woorden.betekenis: ad egestatem redigi
woorden.definitie: , ተፀነሰ፡ ad egestatem redigi vid. sub ጸነሰ፡

woorden.betekenis: foecunda fuit, multos liberos habuit, gravidam, praegnantem
woorden.definitie: I,1 [ضَنَأَ, ضَنِئَ, ضَنِيَ foecunda fuit, multos liberos habuit mulier], Subj. ይፅነስ፡ et ይፅንስ፡ gravidam vel praegnantem esse vel fieri, concipere vel concepisse, Gen. 4,1; Gen. 4,17; Gen. 4,25; Gen. 16,4; Gen. 21,2; Gen. 29,32 seq.; Gen. 30,5 seq.; Ex. 2,2; 1 Reg. 1,19; 2 Reg. 11,5; Matth. 1,23; Luc. 1,31; Luc. 1,36 al.; ወትፅነስ፡ ወትለድ፡ Kuf. p. 103; ፀኒስ፡ Koh. 3,2 var.; ፀነስነ፡ Jes. 26,18; Jac. 1,15; ፀንሰት፡ በዝሙት፡ Kuf. p. 143; Gen. 38,24; de bestiis: Hen. 82,19; Gen. 30,38; Gen. 30,39; Gen. 30,40; Gen. 30,41; Gen. 31,10; ከመ፡ ይፅነሳ፡ v. ይፅንሳ፡ Gen. 30,41; c. እምነ፡ viri, Gen. 19,36; Sx. Mag. 27; c. ለ፡ viri, Kuf. p. 142; Kuf. p. 143; Rom. 9,10 Platt; c. Acc. fetus vel infantis, quem quae concepit vel alvo continet: Num. 11,12; ዘእንበለ፡ ትፅንስ፡ ወልደ፡ Kuf. p. 47; Kuf. p. 63; Asc. Jes. 11,9; ዘእንበለ፡ ትፅነሶ፡ በከርሣ፡ Luc. 2,21; Rom. 9,10 Platt; transl. ( concipere animo vel moliri aliquid): በከርሦሙ፡ ይፀንሱ፡ ጻዕረ፡ Job 15,35; Ps. 7,15; ፀነስነ፡ ወኀለይነ፡ በልብነ፡ ነገረ፡ ኀጢአት፡ Jes. 59,13; ፀነስክሙ፡ በሕማም፡ (v. ኀጢአተ፡) Jes. 59,4.

woorden.betekenis: graviditas, praegnatus, fetus
woorden.definitie: subst. 1 graviditas, praegnatus: ዘአይኑ፡ ብእሲ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ፅንስ፡ Gen. 38,25; F.M. 6,14; እምቅድመ፡ ፅንሶን፡ F.M. 10,1; F.N. 24,1; ፅንስ፡ እንበለ፡ ሩካቤ፡ Lit. 172,1; Sx. Nah. 7Enc.; c.c. Acc. ejus, quem quae alvo continet: መዋዕለ፡ ፅንሳ፡ ኪያሁ፡ F.N. 33,4. 2 fetus: ne vendas ፅንሰ፡ F.N. 33,4; ፅንሰ፡ እንዘ፡ ባቲ፡ Asc. Jes. 11,5.

woorden.betekenis: conceptio, graviditas
woorden.definitie: n. act. conceptio, graviditas: Sx. Nah. 7Enc.; መዋዕለ፡ ፅንሰታ፡ Sx. Sen. 30.

woorden.betekenis: curvitate, perversum, pravum, malignum, noxium, trucem esse,
woorden.definitie: (sec. Lud. ፀወገ፡) I,1 [significatus primarius in curvitate esse videtur, coll. ضاج] perversum, pravum, malignum, noxium, trucem esse: ዘይፀውግ፡ ὁ ἀσεβής Deut. 25,1; Deut. 25,2; እለ፡ ይፀውጉ፡ አምኔሁ፡ πονηρότερα ἑαυτοῦ Matth.12,45; in specie truculentum vel tetra facie esse, Lud. sine auct.

woorden.betekenis: malignum, trucem, saevum esse, truculentia, saevitia
woorden.definitie: III,1 malignum, trucem, saevum esse: እኩያን፡ እለ፡ ይፀወጉ፡ Kuf. p. 42; M.M. f. 198 (vid. sub ደረከ፡); ተፀውጎ፡ truculentia, saevitia, ut: ዲዮቅልጥያኖስ፡ ቢጸ፡ አራዊት፡ በተፀውጎ፡ Sx. Mag. 8 Enc.

woorden.betekenis: perversitas, pravitas, malitia, truculentia
woorden.definitie: subst. perversitas, pravitas, malitia, truculentia: እለ፡ ይትመየጡ፡ ውስተ፡ ፁግ፡ τὰς στραγγαλιάς Ps. 124,5; እሙንቱ፡ ኮንዎ፡ ለፁግ፡ εἰς σκῶλον (legisse videtur interpres εἰς σκολιόν) 2 Par. 28,23; πονηρία Sap. 4,14; Rom. 1,29; ሰብእ፡ ኮኑ፡ እኩያነ፡ በምክረ፡ ፁግ፡ Kuf. p. 43; ከመ፡ ኢትግበር፡ ፁገ፡ Kuf. p. 131; ኵሉ፡ ምግባረ፡ ፁግ፡ Clem. f. 115; Clem. f. 197; ዐመፃ፡ ወፁግ፡ Macc. f. 6; ፁጋ፡ ለማዕበለ፡ ባሕር፡ Sx. Masc. 12Enc.

woorden.betekenis: pravus, perversus, malus, malignus, trux, truculentus, saevu
woorden.definitie: adj. m. et fem., pravus, perversus, malus, malignus, trux, truculentus, saevus: ፍኖት፡ ፀዋግ፡ σκολιά Prov. 22,14; πονηρός, de rebus: Ps. 33,22; Koh. 10,13; Matth. 6,23; de personis: ነፍስ፡ ፀዋግ፡ ታሀጕሎ፡ ለዘአጥረያ፡ Sir. 6,4; ፀዋጋን፡ Matth. 13,49 rom.; Sap. 3,12; χαλεποί Matth. 8,28 rom.; ἀσεβεῖς Job 16,11; ἄνομοι Prov. 29,8; ገብር፡ ፀዋግ፡ σκληρός Prov. 29,19; παράνομος Prov. 23,28; ἀκόλαστος Prov. 21,11; ἀκάθαρτος Luc. 8,29 rom. (gloss.); daemones ፀዋጋን፡ Kuf. 10; Kuf. 11; homines Kuf. 16(Lat.: iniqui ); Kuf. 35(Lat.: malignus ); gigantes (Lat. maligni ) Kuf. 29; አርዌ፡ ፀዋግ፡ Kuf. 34; ዐሥሩ፡ ኵነኔ፡ ዐበይት፡ ወፀዋጋት፡ Kuf. 48; ፀዋጋን፡ መላእክት፡ (opp. angelis bonis) Genz. f. 19; ፀዋጋት፡ ሞገዳት፡ ἄγρια Sap. 14,1. – (Sir. 2,12 pro ዕደው፡ ፀዋጋት፡ legendum videtur እደው፡ ፅዉሳት፡ χεῖρες παρειμέναι).

woorden.betekenis: foetere, putescere
woorden.definitie: foetere, putescere vid. sub ጼአ፡

woorden.betekenis: capere, captivum facere, ducere, tenere, abigere, praedari,
woorden.definitie: quadril. I [שָׁבָה ܫܒܳܐ سَبَا; vid. ፄወየ፡] capere armis vel bello, captivum facere vel ducere vel tenere, Gen. 34,29; Num. 24,22; Deut. 21,10; Jud. 5,12; 1 Reg. 30,2; Jes. 14,2; Jes. 20,4; Jes. 42,24; Jer. 20,6; በብሔር፡ ኀበ፡ ፄወውዎ፡ Jer. 22,12; Jer. 22,22; Jer. 26,17; ፄወውክምዎሙ፡ ለርስትየ፡ Jer. 27,11; Thren. 1,18; Hez. 17,12; Am. 1,15; Ob. 11; Ps. 136,3; ፄዊወከ፡ ፄዋ፡ Ps. 67,19; Eph. 4,8; Mavâs. 24; abs.: እለ፡ ይፄውዉ፡ αἰχμαλωτεύοντες Job 1,15; ማህርክ፡ ወፄውው፡ (v. ወፄው፡) Jes. 8,1. a greges, opes abigere, praedari, Kuf. 30; Num. 31,9. b urbes i.e. expugnare (et incolas in exilium abducere ): አኀዙ፡ ይፄውዉ፡ ሀገረ፡ Kuf. 11; Asc. Jes. 3,2; Ps. 2in tit. (vid. Ludolfi editionem Psalt. p. 345). c transl.: capere, devincire: ላሕያ፡ ፄወዋ፡ ለነፍሱ፡ Judith 16,9; p. 302 n. 5; ፄወወኒ፡ መንገሌሁ፡ Rom. 7,23; Org.; 2 Tim. 3,6; Herm. p. 109.

woorden.betekenis: capi, captivum fieri, duci, esse, expugnari, in exilium abdu
woorden.definitie: III,1 capi armis vel bello, captivum fieri vel duci vel esse, Kuf. 13; Deut. 21,13; ተፄወዉ፡ ሕዝብየ፡ Jes. 5,13; Jes. 22,3; Jes. 42,22; Hez. 25,3; Thren. 1,4; Tob. 1,2; ከመ፡ ኢይፄወዋ፡ አንስቲያሆሙ፡ Judith 4,12; 4 Esr. 10,23; እምድኅረዝ፡ ተፄወዉ፡ ወፈለሱ፡ ብሔረ፡ ባቢሎን፡ 1 Par. 9,1; እስከ፡ ተፄወዉ፡ እምነ፡ ብሔሮሙ፡ Sir. 48,15; ይሬስዮሙ፡ ለመካርያን፡ ይፄወዉ፡ Job 12,17; Luc. 21,24; ተፄዊወክሙ፡ Jsp. p. 380; ተፄውዎ፡ αἰχμαλωσία captivitas Jer. 15,2; Ps. 77,67; Tob. 3,4. a expugnari et in exilium abduci, de urbibus, civitatibus: እስከ፡ አመ፡ ተፄወወት፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፡ Jer. 1,3; Hez. 40,1; ተፄውዎ፡ πολιορκία Prov. 1,27. b ut videtur, refl.: se invicem captivos facere, Kuf. p. 45 ann. 10. c transl.: 2 Cor. 10,5 Platt; ተፄወወኒ፡ ኅሊናየ፡ Apoc. 13,10; Sx. Ter 30 Enc.

woorden.betekenis: captivitas, exilium, captivi, exsules, mancipia, ḍewā, ṣewā,
woorden.definitie: subst. 1 captivitas, exilium: ነሥአ፡ ሕዝበ፡ በፄዋ፡ Asc. Jes. 3,2; የሐውር፡ በፄዋ፡ Asc. Jes. 3,6; ይመይጥ፡ ፄዋ፡ ሕዝብየ፡ αἰχμαλωσίαν Jes. 45,13; Jer. 25,18; Jer. 31,47; (Hebr.: Jer. 48,47); Jer. 36,14; Thren. 2,14; Joel 4,1; Ps. 13,11; Ps. 84,1; Ps. 125,1 (quamquam hos locos omnes etiam e n. 2 interpretari licet); ለምንት፡ ኮነ፡ ለፄዋ፡ εἰς προνομήν Jer. 2,14. 2 concr.: captivi, Num. 21,1; ፄዋ፡ ወምህርካ፡ Num. 31,11; Num. 31,12; Num. 31,19; Deut. 21,10 seq.; ነሥኡ፡ ብዙኀ፡ ፄዋ፡ 2 Par. 28,17; Judith 2,9; Jes. 1,27; ይከውኑ፡ ፄዋ፡ Jes. 14,2; ትከውን፡ ነፍሱ፡ ፄዋ፡ εἰς σκῦλα Jer. 21,9; እምሕሮሙ፡ ለፄዋሁ፡ Jer. 37,18; ወነሥኡ፡ ፄዋ፡ ወምህርካ፡ ዘማህረኩ፡ Macc. f. 14; a exsules: Hez. 1,1; እምደቂቀ፡ ፄዋ፡ ይሁዳ፡ Dan. 5,13; ወለተ፡ ጽዮን፡ ፄዋ፡ (v. ፂውውት፡) Jes. 52,2. b mancipia, σώματα Apoc. 18,13. ḍewā, ጼዋ፡ ṣewā, ጨዋ፡ č̣awā troop ወዘነገረቶሰ፡ በእንተ፡ ፄዋ፡ እለ፡ ይብልዎሙ፡ ማያ፡ እስመ፡ በምጽአቶሙ፡ ደንገጸት፡ ምድር፡ ወተሀውኩ፡ እለ፡ ይነብሩ፡ ውስቴታ። ʻThe matter she told him was about the ḍewa whom they call Maya, for the land was dismayed because of their coming, and those living in it were disturbed.ʼ 88 (384) l. 5–6 (ed.), 89 (385) l. 5–6 (tr.); ጨዋ፡ ብዙኅ፡ እለ፡ ይሰመዩ፡ አርቋይ፡ በፀር፡ ዋጀት፤ በድል፡ ጸገና፤ በዓደል፡ አምባ፤ በድል፡ ድብ፤ በድል፡ ነድ፤ በዓደል፡ መንረቅ፤ ደረቆ፡ በፀር፡ ዋጀት፤ ዣን፡ ገደብ፡ ወካልኣንሂ፡ ብዙኃን፡ ሀለዉ፡ እለ፡ ኢያእመርኩ፡ ስሞሙ። 17 n. 1, ተስፋኒ፡ ዘአሰፈዎሙ፡ ለጽዋ (should be ጼዋ)፡ ተፈጸመ፡ በይእቲ፡ ዕለት፡ እስመ፡ ረከቡ፡ ብዙኃ፡ ምህርክ፡ ‘En ce jour, la promesse qu’il avait faite aux Č̣awā s’accomplit, car on trouva un grand butin’ 84 l. 16 (ed.), 96 l. 19–20 (tr.), ወእምዝ፡ ውዒሎ፡ በዐለ፡ ፋሲካ፡ ተንሥአ፡ ሠሉስ፡ አስተጋቢኦ፡ ጨዋ፡ ዘባሊ፡ ዘሽርካ፡ ወአርእኝ፡ ዘወጅ፡ ወሸዋ፡ ወዳሞት። ‘Ayant donc passé la fête de Pâques, il partit le mardi, aprés avoir réuni les Č̣awā du Bali, de Šerkā, d’Arʾeñ, du Waǧ, du Schoa et du Dāmot’ 53 l. 3–5 (ed.), 62 l. 3–5 (tr.) L ḍewā I, ṣewā ፄዋ, ጼዋ (Lt) ʻarmy unitʼ 153a E ‘Das Geez-Wort, das schon in den Aksûmer Inschriften vorkommt, bedeutet »Gefangene«; daraus entsprang wohl die Bedeutung »Sklaven«, und als Sklaven (des Königs) mochten speciell die Soldanten bezeichnet werden wie die Janitscharen als besondere Auszeichnung den Namen »Sklaven« (des Pâdischâh) führten.’ 580; ‘ጨዋ፡ è dalla forma letteraria ጼዋ፡; ma qual è l’etimologia? forse da ጼዋ፡ ለምድር፡ sal terrae (Mt. 5, 13) nel senso di parte scelta e difesa di una data regione? L’uso di porre strani nomi biblici (cf. p. es. 30 n. 3) mi pare che renderebbe quest’etimologia non improbabile; vero è che sebben ምድር፡ sia per lo più fem., in Mt. 5, 13 dicesi ጼው፡.’ 12 n. 1; ‘In Amharic č̣äwa has various meanings: “person of high social status; person of free status (as opposed to slave)”; “ignorant, layman”, “conciliator”, cf. 2236. In Tǝgrǝñña, č̣ǝwa has the same range of meanings as in Amharic, cf. 940. For this context, Conti Rossini has correctly rendered ṩewa with “milizie regie”, 259, during the so-called “Salomonic” dynasty was the name of part of the land’s army that was deployed in areas far off from the royal court, cf. 48.’ 89 (385) n. 160,

woorden.betekenis: captivitas, praedatio
woorden.definitie: , crebrius ፄዋዌ፡ scriptum, subst. captivitas, praedatio: Kuf. 1; Kuf. 23; Kuf. 24; Ps. 95in tit.; ለፂዋዌ፡ (ለፄዋዌ፡) ትከውን፡ ባቢሎን፡ Jer. 28,37 var.; Judith 2,9 var.; προνομή Prov. 12,24; Jsp. p. 278; Jsp. p. 330; Jsp. p. 364; Jsp. p. 381al.; Lit. 164,4.

woorden.betekenis: locus graminosus, pratum, pascuum
woorden.definitie: (etiam ጺኦት፡) subst. m. et fem., Pl. ፂዖታት፡, vallis, campus, locus graminosus, pratum, pascuum, ከመ፡ ሣዕረ፡ ፂዖት፡ ስሙር፡ τὸ παμβότανον τοῦ ἀγροῦ Job 5,25; አክብር፡ ፂዖተ፡ ከመ፡ ይብዝኃ፡ መራዕይከ፡ πεδίον Prov. 27,24; ፂዖተ፡ ሐመልማል፡ Sap. 19,7; ከመ፡ አባግዕ፡ ውስተ፡ ፂዖት፡ ἐν εὐρυχώρῳ Hos. 4,16; νομή Jes. 23,3; Jes. 27,19; Jes. 5,17 var.; Zeph. 2,6; ውስተ፡ ፂዖት፡ ሠናይ፡ Hez. 34,14; ፂዖት፡ ጥሉል፡ Hez. 34,14; κοιλάς Jos. 8,11; Jos. 8,13; ፂዖት፡ ሰቂሞን፡ Kuf. 34; ረከቡ፡ ፂዖታተ፡ ብዙኃተ፡ ወስሙራተ፡ νομάς 1 Par. 4,40; περισπόρια Jos. 21,2 seq.; Jud. 1,18. [Ges. in thes. p. 616 hoc nomen a יָצָא ወፅአ፡ repetendum conjecit, at rectius comparandum videtur ضَيْعَةٌ et وَاضِعَةٌ]. – Voc. Ae.: ፂዖት፡ ዘ፡ መስክ፡

woorden.betekenis: obliquus, curvus, distortus fuit
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., quae arabice ضَحِمَ obliquus, curvus, distortus fuit significat (etiam شأم et שׂמאל vicina videntur, vid. 238).

woorden.betekenis: sinister, laevus, linkshändig, manus sinistra, latus sinistr
woorden.definitie: adj., m. et fem., et subst., sinister, laevus: ብእሲ፡ እመ፡ ኮነ፡ ፀጋመ፡ እድ፡ (linkshändig) F.N. 9,1. a manus sinistra, addito እድ፡, ut: በፀጋሙ፡ እዴሁ፡ Kuf. p. 112; plerumque omisso እድ፡, ut: ልቡ፡ ለአብድ፡ ውስተ፡ ፀጋሙ፡ Koh. 10,2; Jud. 16,29; Cant. 2,6; Jon. 4,11; Dan. 12,7; Matth. 6,3. b latus sinistrum, pars sinistra, Asc. Jes. 7,30. α እድ፡ እንተ፡ ፀጋም፡ manus sinistra Gen. 48,14; Lev. 14,15; Jud. 3,21; vel እዴሁ፡ ዘፀጋም፡ Hez. 39,3. β በፀጋም፡ a sinistra vel በፀጋመ፡ a sinistra alicujus Asc. Jes. 7,27 seq.; Asc. Jes. 9,36; Ges. 48,13; Ex. 14,22; 2 Par. 18,18; Kuf. p. 132; Luc. 23,33; Marc. 10,37; Matth. 20,21; Matth. 20,23; Matth. 27,38 Platt; vel እምፀጋመ፡ 2 Reg. 16,6; 3 Reg. 22,19; 2 Esr. 18,4; እምፀጋም፡ 2 Cor. 6,7. γ ኀበ፡ ፀጋመ፡ ad sinistram alicujus Gen. 48,13; ለፀጋም፡ sinistrorsum: Jes. 54,3; Deut. 2,27; Deut. 5,29; Deut. 28,14; Num. 20,17; Jos. 23,6; 1 Reg. 6,12, vel ፀጋመ፡ Gen. 13,9; Gen. 24,49. ḍagām C for ብሕት፡ ወደድ፡ ዘፀጋም፡ vid. ቢትወደድ፡

woorden.betekenis: laevus, sinister, qui sinistra utitur
woorden.definitie: et ፀጋማይ፡ adj. rel. 1 laevus, sinister: ፀገማዊ፡ ጥቡ፡ Kuf. 38; ፀጋማይ፡ Haim. Ab. 1; ዐይኑ፡ ፀጋማይ፡ Kid. f. 5; ዐይን፡ የማኒት፡ ወፀጋሚት፡ Clem. 153f. 2 qui sinistra utitur pro dextra Clem. f. 85(vid. sub የማናይ፡); F.N. 9 (vid. sub ተዐየረ፡).

woorden.betekenis: blatta, tinea, erucam
woorden.definitie: subst. [סָס ܣܳܣܳܐ سُوسٌ] blatta, tinea, σής, ከመ፡ ልብስ፡ ትበልዩ፡ ወከመ፡ ፃፄ፡ ትትበልዑ፡ Jes. 50,9; Mich. 7,4; Matth. 6,19; Matth. 6,20; ከመ፡ ብልዐ፡ ፃፄ፡ Nah. 1,10 (recedit a Gr.); አብትር፡ ከመ፡ ዘፃፄ፡ በልዓሙ፡ Herm. p. 62; Chrys. Ta. 20(vid. sub አምዐዘ፡). – Sx. Genb. 11, ubi ዕፄ፡occurrit, erucam significare videtur, at Sx. Enc. ejusdem diei meliorem lectionem ዕፄ፡praebet. – Schol. Voc. Ae. vid. sub ዕፄ፡

woorden.betekenis: scaturiendi, bulliendi, bullire, ebullire, aestuare, exaestu
woorden.definitie: I,1 [amh. ፈላ፡; vicinum videtur ፈልፈለ፡ (coll. فار cui et scaturiendi et bulliendi vis inest); alia censet Ges. in thes. p. 1103] Subj. ይፍላሕ፡, bullire, ebullire, aestuare, exaestuare, effervescere: ወይፍላሕ፡ በሕቁ፡ Hez. 24,5; 4 Esr. 6,37; transl. de rebus, quae cum aquis fervidis comparantur: ትፈልሕ፡ ከርሥየ፡ ወኢያረምም፡ ἐξέζεσε Job 30,27; (ከርሥየ፡) ትፈልሕ፡ ውዑየ፡ Job 32,19; በአምጣነ፡ ዕበየ፡ ጋእዙ፡ ይፈልሕ፡ ላኳሁ፡ Sir. 28,10; vel hominibus: ፈልሐ፡ (Abba Elias) በአፍቅሮ፡ መንፈሳዊ፡ Phlx. 11; Org. 6; de ulceribus inflammatis quae prorumpunt: Ex. 9,9; Ex. 9,10; Kuf. p. 158; et de rebus similibus: ወይፈልሕ፡ ርኵስኪ፡ Hez. 24,13; de aquis undantibus et scaturientibus: Judae 13; Hen. 89,3; እምቅድመ፡ ይፍልሑ፡ አንቅዕተ፡ ማያት፡ Lit. Chrys.; cum Christus in Jordanem descenderet ፈልሑ፡ ማያት፡ ላዕለ፡ ዲበ፡ ርእሱ፡ Deg.

woorden.betekenis: migrare, transire, huc illuc migrare, vagari, transire ad pa
woorden.definitie: I,1 [amh. id.; vic. ፈለጠ፡; vid. etiam Ges. thes. p. 1107] Subj. ይፍልስ፡ 1 de animatis: migrare, a transire: ፈለሰ፡ እምህየ፡ μετέβη Matth. 11,1 rom.; ወፈሊሶ፡ እምህየ፡ ሖረ፡ Matth. 12,9; ፍልስ፡ እምዝየ፡ Joh. 7,3; ኢትፍልሱ፡ እምቤት፡ ለቤት፡ Luc. 10,7; ሖር፡ ፍልስ፡ ብሔረ፡ ይሁዳ፡ ἐκχώρησον Am. 7,12. α huc illuc migrare, vagari, Ps. 108,9. β transire ad partes alicujus: ፈለሱ፡ ኀበ፡ ዳዊት፡ 1 Par. 12,8; Hyrcanus ፈለሰ፡ ኀበ፡ ሰዱቃዊያን፡ Jsp. p. 300; ዘፈለሰ፡ እምአይሁድ፡ ኀበ፡ እስላም፡ Abush. 50. b secedere: ቅዱሳን፡ ፈለሱ፡ ገዳመ፡ ወመነኑ፡ ዓለመ፡ Clem. f. 153. c excedere, recedere: astra ኢይስሕቱ፡ ወኢይፈልሱ፡ እምነ፡ ዐቅሞሙ፡ Sir. 43,10; ከመ፡ ኢይፍልሱ፡ እምዝንቱ፡ ግብር፡ Esth. 9,27. d emigrare, demigrare, Kuf. 10; 4 Esr. 3,11; in specie e deportari, exsulare: ይሁዳ፡ ፈለሰ፡ (ፍጹመ፡ ፍልሰተ፡) Jer. 13,19; Jer. 24,5; Jer. 31,11; Thren. 1,3; 4 Reg. 17,23; 4 Reg. 25,27. f peregrinari: ፍልስ፡ ውስተ፡ ይእቲ፡ ምድር፡ Kuf. 24; Num. 15,14; ፈላስያን፡ እለ፡ ፈለሱ፡ ውስተ፡ እስራኤል፡ Hez. 14,7; ነገድ፡ ዘፈለሰ፡ ፈላሲ፡ ኀቤሁ፡ Hez. 47,23; ኀበ፡ ፈለሱ፡ ἡ παροικία αὐτῶν Judith 5,9; Hebr. 11,9. g decedere e vita, obire: Joh. 13,1; Phil. 1,23; ሀቦ፡ አክሊለ፡ ምክሕ፡ አመ፡ ይፈልስ፡ እምዝንቱ፡ ዓለም፡ Did. 17; Lud. ex Sx. Teq. 6 Enc. 2 de inanimatis et animatis, a transferri: μετῆλθε 1 Reg. 5,8; μετατίθεσθαι Ps. 45,2; Hebr. 7,12; ፍልስ፡ μετάβηθι (de monte) Matth. 17,20; Henoch ፈለሰ፡ οὐχ εὑρίσκετο Gen. 5,24; Hebr. 11,5; μετετέθη Sap. 4,10. b mutari: ከመ፡ የሀሉ፡ ዝክርከ፡ እንበለ፡ ፈሊስ፡ Sx. Hed. 12 Enc.

woorden.betekenis: migrare facere, jubere, expellere, ejicere, deportare, in ex
woorden.definitie: II,1 migrare facere vel jubere i.e. a expellere, ejicere aliquem e sede: አፍለሶ፡ እምድረ፡ ግብጽ፡ Kuf. 13; አፍለሶሙ፡ ውስተ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ባዕድ፡ Sir. 29,18; ያፈልስዎ፡ ነዋኀ፡ እምብርሃን፡ ውስተ፡ ጽልመት፡ ἀπώσειαν Job 18,18; Ps. 51,5. b deportare, in exsilium abducere: አነ፡ ኣፈልሰከ፡ Jer. 20,4; Jer. 24,1; Jer. 31,7; Jer. 36,1; Jer. 50,12; Jer. 52,28; Jer. 52,29 var.; በኀበ፡ አፍለሱነ፡ Bar. 3,7; ኢይደግም፡ እንከ፡ አፍልሶተኪ፡ Thren. 4,22; Hez. 21,12; 4 Reg. 16,9; 4 Reg. 17,6; Act. 7,4; Act. 7,43. c transferre: እደግም፡ አፍልሶቶሙ፡ μεταθεῖναι Jes. 29,14; Henochum Hebr. 11,5; montes Jes. 54,10; 1 Cor. 13,2; plantam Ps. 79,9; Kuf. 1; corpus Sancti: ሶበ፡ ፈቀዱ፡ ያፍልስዎ፡ (ለሥጋሁ፡ e Cypro Constantinopolim) Sx. Teq. 21al. α convertere: μεταβάλλεις με Job 10,8; ያፈልስ፡ ልበ፡ የዋህ፡ μεταλλεύει Sap. 4,12; ያፈልስዋ፡ ለጸጋ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ውስተ፡ ዝሙት፡ Judae 4. β dimovere: ኢታፍልስ፡ ደወለ፡ ገራህት፡ Prov. 23,10; ኢይደግም፡ አፍልሶተ፡ እግረ፡ እስራኤል፡ እምዛቲ፡ ምድር፡ 2 Par. 33,8; ( amoliri ) ናሁ፡ አፍለስኩ፡ ኰኵሐ፡ ወጾርኩ፡ ኆጻ፡ ወኢረከብኩ፡ ዘይከብድ፡ እምነቢር፡ በቤተ፡ አብዳን፡ Fal. f. 65. d removere, amovere: ἀποσκευάσαι Lev. 14,36. e e tempore certo in aliud tempus ( verlegen ): ጾመ፡ Abush. 38; እስክንድር፡ አፍለሰ፡ ጥንተ፡ ዓመቶሙ፡ ኀበ፡ ጥንተ፡ ዓመተ፡ መንግሥቱ፡ ዘውእቱ፡ ተስሪን፡ ቀዳማይ፡ Abush. 39. f in alteram vitam (morte), Sx. Hed. 16 Enc. (coll. Hebr. 11,5).

woorden.betekenis: migratio, peregrinatio, exsilium, transitio, decessus, obitu
woorden.definitie: n. act. et subst. migratio a peregrinatio: ምድረ፡ ፍልሰትከ፡ Kuf. 27; Kuf. 36. b exsilium: እሬስያ፡ ለኢየሩሳሌም፡ ለፍልሰት፡ Jer. 9,11; Jer. 13,19; እለ፡ ኢወፅኡ፡ ውስተ፡ ፍልሰት፡ Jer. 36,16 vers. alt.; እስከ፡ አመ፡ ፍልሰት፡ 1 Par. 5,22; Matth. 1,12; Matth. 1,17. c transitio: ፍልሰተ፡ ህርቃኖስ፡ ኀበ፡ ሰዱቃዊያን፡ Jsp. p. 301. d decessus ex hac vita, obitus: ሶበ፡ በጽሐ፡ ጊዜ፡ ፍልሰትከ፡ እምዝንቱ፡ ዓለም፡ Clem. f. 9; Clem. f. 18; ጊዜ፡ ፍልሰቱ፡ Phlx. 17; ፍልሰት፡ እምሥጋ፡ Phlx. 98; Sx. Masc. 18. e assumtio, Mariae: ሰላም፡ ለፍልሰተ፡ ሥጋኪ፡ ኀበ፡ መካነ፡ ሕይወት፡ I Sal. Mar. 41; Sx. Ter 21; Sx. Nah. 16;Lud. Comm. hist. p. 303 n. 10; ፍልሰተ፡ ኤልያስ፡ in coelum, Lud. f translatio corporis, ossium, reliquiarum Sanctorum, ut: ፍልሰተ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ ለቅዱስ፡ አልዐዛር፡ Sx. Teq. 21; Sx. Hed. 17; Sx. Masc. 15; Sx. Ter 27; ፍልሰተ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ ለመቃርስ፡ ኀበ፡ ገዳመ፡ አስቄጥስ፡ Sx. Nah. 19al. g mobilitas, mutabilitas, inconstantia: ለእመ፡ ሞእከ፡ ፍልሰተ፡ ኅሊናት፡ Phlx. 29; ኢፍልሰተ፡ (constantia) ኅሊና፡ Phlx. 44.

woorden.betekenis: unum e septem coelis, infimum
woorden.definitie: n. peregr. (i.q. ፈለክ፡) unum e septem coelis idque infimum, Clem. f. 3; Clem. f. 49; Chrys. ho. 1(vid. sub አድሐከ፡).

woorden.betekenis: rivus, findendo, dividendo, vallis, torrens, canalis, flumen
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., Pl. አፍላግ፡, Pl. Pl. አፍላጋት፡ [פֶּלֶג فَلَجٌ فَلْجٌ rivus, a פלג فلج findendo vel dividendo dictus; aliud etymon proposuit Gesenius in thes. p. 1103] 1 vallis: φάραγξ 2 Par. 14,10; ሰብዐተ፡ አፍላጋተ፡ (v. pro ቈላተ፡) Jes. 11,15; κοιλάς 2 Par. 20,26; 2 Par. 25,11 al. 2 rivus, torrens, canalis, χειμάρρους Joh. 18,1; Lev. 23,40; Deut. 3,12; Deut. 3,16; 1 Reg. 17,40; 2 Reg. 17,13; Job 21,33; Job 22,24; ፈለገ፡ ግብጽ፡ (in confiniis Palaestinae et Aegypti) Num. 34,5; Jos. 15,47; አፍላግ፡ Lev. 11,9; Lev. 11,10; Judith 2,8; Judith 16,3; ἀπώρυγες አፍላጊሁ፡ (v. pro አዕጹቂሁ፡) Hez. 17,6. 3 plerumque: flumen, fluvius, amnis, ποταμός Gen. 2,10; Gen. 15,18; Gen. 41,1; Gen. 41,2; Num. 24,6; Deut. 1,7; Job 22,16; Ps. 45,4; Ps. 64,10; Sir. 24,31; 4 Reg. 5,14; Marc. 1,5; Apoc. 9,14; al.; ፈለገ፡ ግብጽ፡ (Nilus) Jes. 7,18; አፍላግ፡ Ps. 23,2; Ps. 71,8; Ps. 136,1; Hez. 29,3; Jes. 18,1; Gen. 31,18; Ex. 8,1; Hen. 5,3; Hen. 17,6; Hen. 77,5; Joh. 7,38; ፈለገ፡ እሳት፡ Dan. 4,10; Hen. 17,5.

woorden.betekenis: separare, disjungere, dirimere, dividere, dissecare, dissoci
woorden.definitie: I,1 [amh. id.; vic. ፈለየ፡, sine dubio etiam ፈለሰ፡; in caeteris linguis frequentantur radices a פר incipientes, ut פרד פרז פרט ܦܪܰܫ] Subj. ይፍልጥ፡ 1 separare, disjungere, dirimere, c. Acc.: Gen. 30,40; Ex. 26,33; Jos. 17,47; Sir. 47,2; Hen. 22,9; Hen. 82,11; Hen. 82,12; Matth. 19,6; Marc. 10,9; c. Acc. et እምነ፡, ut: ዘፈለጠ፡ ብእሴ፡ እምብእሲቱ፡ Sir. 31,26; Ruth 1,17; c. Acc. et በበይናት፡ 4 Esr. 4,58; ይፍልጥዎሙ፡ በበይናቲሆሙ፡ F.M. 5,10; c. dupl. ማእከለ፡ Gen. 1,4; Gen. 1,6; Gen. 1,7; Gen. 1,14; Gen. 1,18; Kuf. 2. a dividere, dissecare: Hebr. 4,12; Lev. 1,6. b dissociare, διχάζειν, c. Acc. et እምነ፡ Matth. 10,35. 2 sejungere, segregare, secernere, c. Acc.: ወፈለጠ፡ ዕዝራ፡ ዕደወ፡ 2 Esr. 10,16; Deut. 4,41; Deut. 10,8; Deut. 19,7; c. Acc. et እምነ፡ Matth. 25,32; Lev. 20,24; Lev. 20,26; Kuf. 2; vel እምውስተ፡ Gen. 30,32; vel እማእከለ፡ Matth. 13,49; Num. 8,14; vel ዘዘዚአሆሙ፡ Matth. 25,32. a seligere, 1 Esr. 5,1. b secludere, Lev. 20,25 sub. fin.; Deut. 29,20; Jes. 56,3; Luc. 6,22. c consecrare, ἀφαιρεῖν, ἀφορίζειν Ex. 13,12; ትፈልጦሙ፡ ፍልጠተ፡ Ex. 29,24; vel ፍልጣነ፡ Ex. 29,26; Lev. 10,15; Lev. 14,12; Num. 8,11; Num. 15,20; coll. Ps. 67,10. d ejurare, devovere aliquid (i.e. voto abstinentiam a rei cujusdam usu promittere): እመ፡ ፈለጠ፡ ፍሉጠ፡ በእንተ፡ ነፍሱ፡ Num. 30,3; Num. 30,4. 3 discernere, distinguere, dignoscere, internoscere: Rom. 2,18; Rom. 3,23; Rom. 10,12; እዝን፡ ነገረ፡ ይፈልጥ፡ Job 12,11; Job 15,5; ፈለጦሙ፡ ሥርዐቶሙ፡ በበ፡ በሓውርቲሆሙ፡ Sir. 16,26; ጕርዔ፡ ይፈልጦ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ጣዕመ፡ እክል፡ Sir. 36,24; ፈሊጠ፡ ዕፀው፡ διαφοραὶ Sap. 7,20; c. Acc. et እምነ፡, Chrys. crebro; እለ፡ ኢፈለጡ፡ ፀጋሞሙ፡ እምየማኖሙ፡ Jon. 4,11; Rom. 7,13; c. dupl. ማእከለ፡ Lev. 11,47; Lev. 20,25; Chrys. crebro. a discrimen facere vel statuere inter plures, Ex. 8,19. b dicere quid intersit inter duas res: ይቤሉ፡ ፍልጥ፡ ለነ፡ ማእከለ፡ ሰይጣን፡ ወስሒት፡ Phlx. 110. c dispicere, ἔκριναν Sap. 2,22; ἐπεγίγνωσκον Act. 27,39 Platt. d distincte dicere, nominatim sigillatim designare, c. Acc.: διάστειλον Gen. 30,28; λάβε τὸ κεφάλαιον Num. 4,2.

woorden.betekenis: distinctionem facere, distincte dicere
woorden.definitie: II,1 distinctionem facere, distincte dicere: ለሊሁ፡ ጳውሎስ፡ አፍለጠ፡ ወአርአየ፡ ከመ፡ በአምሳሉ፡ ወበአርአያ፡ ክህነቱ፡ ለክርስቶስ፡ ውእቱ፡ መልከ፡ ጼዴቅ፡ Cyr. f. 129.

woorden.betekenis: se sejungere, secernere, secedere, discedere, se dividere, s
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 a refl. se sejungere vel secernere ab aliquo: ተፈለጥ፡ እምአሕዛብ፡ Kuf. 22; 2 Esr. 9,1; 2 Esr. 10,11; ተፈልጡ፡ እምኵሉ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ነኪር፡ 2 Esr. 19,2; Jud. 4,11; ኢይትፈለጥ፡ እምኔሁ፡ Prov. 8,30; ዘይፈቅድ፡ ይትፈለጥ፡ እምአዕርክት፡ Prov. 18,1; Luc. 12,53; 2 Cor. 6,17; abs.: ተፈለጡ፡ ἀφορίσθητε Jes. 52,11; ተፈልጡ፡ በበነገዶሙ፡ Jos. 7,17; Jos. 7,18. α secedere, discedere: ተፈልጠ፡ እምአቡሁ፡ Kuf. 7; Kuf. 11; in malam partem: ተግሕሠ፡ ወተፈልጠ፡ እምእግዚኡ፡ ἀπέστη 2 Par. 13,6. β se dividere, Gen. 2,10. γ se dispergere vel diffundere: Gen. 10,5; ተፈልጡ፡ አርድእት፡ እስከ፡ አጽናፈ፡ ዓለም፡ ከመ፡ ይስብኩ፡ ዜና፡ ወንጌል፡ Clem. f. 1. δ se abstinere: በሌሊት፡ ዘባቲ፡ ይጠመቅ፡ ወልዶሙ፡ ይደሉ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ (parentibus) ተፈልጦ፡ F.M. 10,2. ε divortium facere cum aliquo vel aliqua: እስከ፡ ይትፈለጡ፡ F.M. 5,2; እመ፡ ፈቀደት፡ ከመ፡ ትትፈለጥ፡ እምታ፡ F.M. 5,5; F.M. 12,1; F.M. 12,2. b pass. separari, sejungi, dirimi: ነፍስ፡ እመ፡ ተፈልጠት፡ እምሥጋ፡ Jsp. p. 381; ብእሲ፡ ይትፈለጥ፡ እምእኁሁ፡ Jer. 13,14; Hen. 22,8; Hen. 22,9; Hen. 22,11. α ተፈልጠ፡ intervallum interpositum est Hen. 22,12. β dividi: በትእዛዘ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ይትፈለጥ፡ ኵሉ፡ መዋዕል፡ Sir. 36,8. γ privari Gen. 48,11. δ dispergi: አባግዒሁ፡ ዘተፈልጠ፡ Hez. 34,12. ε de conjugibus: ተፈልጠት፡ እምኔሁ፡ (ለምታ፡) በሞት፡ Did. 14. 2 segregari, a secludi: 2 Thess. 3,14 Platt; ለይትፈለጥ፡ ἀφοριζέσθω Syn., ex. gr. Can. Ap. 5. b seligi, Rom. 1,1. 3 secerni, distingui: ባቲ፡ (ለወርኅ፡) ይትፈለጥ፡ መዋዕል፡ Sir. 43,7; c. dupl. ማእከለ፡ Lev. 10,10; Sx. Sen. 26 Enc.

woorden.betekenis: rumpendi, erumpere, prorumpere, scaturire, scaturigo est, es
woorden.definitie: quadril. I [componendum videtur cum فلّ i.e. פרר, quibus significatus rumpendi inest; vicinum videtur ፈልሐ፡] erumpere, prorumpere, i.e. scaturire, de fonte: ይፈለፍል፡ ነቅዕ፡ እምቤተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Joel 4,18; de aqua Hen. 28,2; Joh. 4,14; de fluvio ፈለግ፡ ዘይፈለፍል፡ Prov. 18,4; አፍላግ፡ እለ፡ ይፈለፍሉ፡ እማይ፡ ዘእምታሕተ፡ መንበረ፡ ስብሐቲየ፡ Clem. f. 63. a impers. α scaturigo est ( es quillt ): ይፈለፍል፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ጽምእት፡ πηγὴ ἔσται Jes. 35,7. β scaturit aliquid, c. Acc.: ይፈለፍል፡ ትፍሥሕት፡ እምድር፡ ወእምአድባር፡ ῥηξάτωσαν Jes. 49,13. b scaturiendo perrumpere aliquid vel superfundi rei: ይፈለፍል፡ ሐሤት፡ ኅቡረ፡ በድዋ፡ ለኢየሩሰሌም፡ ῥηξάτω Jes. 52,9.

woorden.betekenis: admissarius, lascivum, salacem, petulantem, protervum esse
woorden.definitie: I,1 [فَحْلٌ admissarius, sed etiam ܦܚܶܙ פָּחַז al. (vid. sub መሐዘ፡) vicina videntur; in aliam sententiam abit Ges. in thes. p. 1090] lascivum, salacem, petulantem, protervum esse: ፈሐልክሙ፡ ከመ፡ አልህምት፡ ἐσκιρτᾶτε Jer. 27,11; ውእቱ፡ አርዌ፡ ይመጽእ፡ እንዘ፡ ይፍሕል፡ (ῥοίζῳ) Herm. p. 21; ፍሒሎትከ፡ τὸ στρῆνός σου 4 Reg. 19,28; እንዘ፡ ይጠብዕ፡ ለፍሒል፡ ἐπιμένων τῇ ἀταξίᾳ II Can. Ap. 13. – Voc. Ae.: ፍሒል፡ ዘ፡ ዘምዎ፡ ስካርሂ፡ ይ፡

woorden.betekenis: rupit, fregit, erupit in jubila, hilaris, laetus fuit, amplu
woorden.definitie: rad. inus., cui Lud. פָּצַח rupit, fregit, seq. רִגָּה erupit in jubila comparavit (at vid. ፈጽሐ፡); propius ad nostram radicem accedit ܦܨܰܚ hilaris, laetus fuit, quod alii cum فَسَحَ amplus, spatiosus fuit, VII gaudio dilatatus fuit, alii cum فصح cui vis claritatis et serenitatis inest, componunt. Radicem semel sc. Jes. 24,7 in Cod. Laur. ፈጽሐ፡ scriptam inveni.

woorden.betekenis: hilarem, laetum esse, fieri, gaudere, laetari, laetitiam, ga
woorden.definitie: III,2 1 hilarem, laetum esse vel fieri, gaudere, laetari, ተፈሣሕ፡ ἡδέως γίνου Tob. 7,10; Esth. 1,10; ተፈሢሐከ፡ ἱλαρῶς Job 22,26; ተፈሥሐ፡ ወሰትየ፡ Kuf. 7; ተፈሥሐ፡ ልቡ፡ ἠγαθύνθη Ruth 3,7; Jud. 19,6; Jud. 19,9; ተፈሣሕ፡ εὐψύχει Herm. p. 3; Phil. 2,19; ውስተ፡ ቤት፡ ንጹሕ፡ እንዘ፡ ይትፌሥሓ፡ የኀድራ፡ Herm. p. 107; εὐθυμεῖν Jac. 5,13; Act. 27,25; εὐφραίνεσθαι, χαίρειν al. Koh. 3,12; Koh. 11,9; Ps. 66,4; Ps. 67,3; Ps. 69,5; Jes. 24,7; Jes. 65,13; Jes. 65,14; Jes. 66,10 (ተፈሥሑ፡ ትፍሥሕተ፡); Jer. 38,13; Gen. 45,16; Ex. 4,14; Lev. 23,40; Deut. 14,26; 1 Reg. 11,15; 2 Esr. 22,43; Matth. 5,12; ተፈሥሑ፡ ፍሥሓ፡ ዐቢየ፡ Matth. 2,10; Marc. 14,11; Luc. 6,23; Luc. 12,19; Luc. 15,23; Luc. 16,19; 1 Thess. 5,16; 1 Cor. 12,26; ተፈሥሐ፡ ልብየ፡ Ps. 15,9; Ps. 32,21; de inanimatis Hen. 51,5; Ps. 47,10; Ps. 95,11; ይትፈሣሕ፡ አዕፅምቲሆሙ፡ በኀበ፡ ሀለዉ፡ ἀναθάλοι Sir. 46,12; c.c. በ፡ rei Koh. 3,22; Koh. 4,16; Job 21,12; Job 31,25; Job 31,29; እለ፡ ይትፌሥሑ፡ በድቀቱ፡ ለጻድቅ፡ Sir. 27,29; Prov. 2,14; Jes. 65,19; Ps. 20,1; Ps. 103,32; Luc. 10,20; vel pers. Jud. 9,19; Sir. 16,1; Sir. 16,2; Sir. 25,7; Ps. 9,2; Ps. 31,14; Ps. 149,2; Phil. 3,1; Phil. 4,4; c. በእንተ፡ rei vel pers.: Matth. 18,13; Joh. 11,15; 4 Esr. 8,44; c. ለ፡ rei Rom. 12,12 Platt; c. ላዕለ፡ Deut. 30,9; seq. እስመ፡ Kuf. 8; Kuf. 17; Kuf. 22; Luc. 10,20; 2 Joh. 4; seq. እፎ፡ 4 Esr. 6,69; seq. Subj. verbi: ተፈሣሕከ፡ ትረሶሙ፡ ለቤተ፡ እስራኤል፡ Hez. 35,14; seq. ከመ፡ c. Subj. vel Imperf.: Deut. 28,63. a laetitiam, gaudium percipere ex aliquo, seq. በ፡, ut: Sir. 3,5; Hen. 12,5; c. እምነ፡ Koh. 2,10; Koh. 5,18; c. እምውስተ፡ Deut. 20,6. b se oblectare vel cum gaudio frui aliqua re, c. በ፡, ut: ዘኢይትፌሣሕ፡ በንዋዩ፡ Sir. 14,5; Deut. 12,7; Deut. 12,18; Ps. 36,11; ትትፌሣሕ፡ በበረከት፡ ነፍስክሙ፡ Jes. 55,2. c gaudere casu, infortunio alicujus, c. ዲበ፡ vel ላዕለ፡ rei vel pers.: Hen. 97,2; ἐπιχαίρειν, c. ዲበ፡ Sir. 23,3; c. ላዕለ፡ Sir. 8,7; Ps. 34,22; Ps. 34,27; Apoc. 11,10; Apoc. 18,20; c. በ፡ Hen. 62,12. d collaetari, congratulari, c. ለ፡ pers.: Luc. 1,58; Luc. 15,6; Luc. 15,9; Phil. 2,17; Phil. 2,18; 2 nonnumquam pass.: jucundari, exhilarari, gaudio vel solatio affici, 4 Esr. 9,44; εὐαγγελίζεσθαι Luc. 7,22; παρακαλεῖσθαι, c. እምነ፡ vel በእንተ፡ 1 Thess. 3,7.

woorden.betekenis: laetus, hilaris, laetans, gaudens, solatio, affectus, lubens
woorden.definitie: part. laetus a hilaris, laetans, gaudens: ወኢኮንከ፡ ፍሡሐ፡ 2 Esr. 12,2; opp. ትኩዝ፡ Sir. 13,25; በፍሡሕ፡ ዐይን፡ ἐν ἀγαθῷ ὀφθαλμῷ Sir. 32,10; ἱλαρός Prov. 22,8; እንዘ፡ ፍሡሕ፡ ገጽከ፡ Sir. 32,11; ወኮነ፡ ፍሡሐ፡ ገጻ፡ (v. ወኮነት፡ ፍሥሕተ፡ ገጽ፡) Esth. apocr. 5; Herm. p. 85; ልብ፡ ፍሥሕት፡ εὐφραινομένη Prov. 17,22; ከመ፡ ፍሡሓን፡ Jes. 30,29; Ps. 86,7; ከናፍርየ፡ ፍሡሓት፡ ἀγαλλιάσεως Ps. 62,6; ፍሡሓኒክሙ፡ 1 Petr. 4,13; ፍሡሓት፡ እምወይን፡ አዕይንቲሁ፡ Gen. 49,12; 4 Esr. 1,34; 4 Esr. 13,19 (deest apud Laur.); እንዘ፡ ፍሡሕ፡ ውእቱ፡ ልቡ፡ εὐφροσύνη Sir. 34,31. b solatio affectus, Ps. 125,1. c lubens, promtus, de animo: አሠሩ፡ ለልብ፡ ፍሡሕ፡ ገጽ፡ ብሩህ፡ Sir. 13,26; ዘይገብር፡ ምጽዋተ፡ በፍሡሕ፡ ልብ፡ Clem. f. 174. d delicatus, τρυφερός Herm. p. 33. e ፍሥሕት፡ hilaritas, ἱλαρότης Herm. p. 91. f laetabilis, gratus, jucundus: Hen. 32,5; ዘማ፡ ሠናይት፡ ወፍሥሕት፡ ἐπίχαρις Nah. 3,4. fǝśśuḥ G ፍሡሐ፡ ልብ፡ fǝśśuḥa lǝbb «(ayant) le cœur satisfait» ቅንአ፡ ላዕለ፡ ሑረቶሙ፡ እኩይ፡ ወኢኮነ፡ ፍሡሐ፡ ልብ፡ ከመ፡ ቀዳሚ፡ 200, vid. ልብ፡ 33

woorden.betekenis: laetitia, gaudium, solatium, consolatio, salus
woorden.definitie: subst., fem. et m., laetitia, gaudium, εὐφροσύνη Koh. 2,1; Koh. 9,7; Job 20,5; Prov. 14,13; ቃለ፡ ፍሥሓ፡ ወቃለ፡ ሐሤት፡ Jer. 40,11; Thren. 2,15; ተፈሥሐ፡ ዐቢየ፡ ፍሥሓ፡ χαράν Jes. 39,2; Jer. 15,16; Ps. 125,2; Matth. 2,10; እምፍሥሓሁ፡ Matth. 13,44; በፍሥሓ፡ Matth. 13,20; Matth. 25,23; Matth. 28,8; Luc. 2,10; Luc. 15,7; Joh. 3,29; Joh. 16,24; Rom. 15,13; Phil. 2,2; Jac. 1,2; እሴስዮ፡ ለላሖሙ፡ ፍሥሓ፡ χαρμονή Jer. 38,13; Hen. 5,7; Hen. 25,6; ሕየው፡ በፍሥሓ፡ ἐν ἀγαθῷ Koh. 7,14; ገብረ፡ በዓለ፡ ፍሥሓ፡ ዐቢየ፡ Kuf. 16; በፍሥሓ፡ Kuf. 7. a solatium, consolatio, παράκλησις, ወሀብክዎ፡ ፍሥሓ፡ ጽድቅ፡ Jes. 57,18; ነገረ፡ ፍሥሓ፡ Zach. 1,13; Hebr. 6,18; Act. 4,36; Luc. 2,25. b salus: አልቦ፡ ፍሥሓ፡ ለኃጥኣን፡ χαίρειν Jes. 48,22; ለዮሐንስ፡ ቄርሎስ፡ ፍሥሓ፡ Ἰωάννῃ Κύριλλος χαίρειν Epist. Cyr. (in praescr.), Cyr. f. 114.

woorden.betekenis: laetitia, gaudium, deliciae, voluptas, solatium, res laetae,
woorden.definitie: subst., fem. et m., Pl. ትፍሥሕታት፡, laetitia, gaudium, εὐφροσύνη, χαρά al., Gen. 31,27; Ps. 4,8; Ps. 44,17; Ps. 150,4 (χορός); Prov. 10,28; Koh. 5,19; Sir. 2,9; Sir. 6,28; በትፍሥሕት፡ Sir. 9,10; አልቦ፡ ትፍሥሕት፡ ዘይኄይስ፡ እምሐሤተ፡ ልብ፡ Sir. 30,16; ወይን፡ ለትፍሥሕተ፡ እጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ ተፈጥረ፡ Sir. 34,27; Jes. 14,7; Jes. 16,10; Jes. 24,8; Jes. 48,20; ትፍሥሕት፡ ወሐሤት፡ Jes. 51,3; Jes. 65,18; Jes. 66,9; (προσδοκία); Jer. 16,9; Jes. 31,33; ለብሰት፡ አልባሰ፡ ትፍሥሕታ፡ Judith 10,3; 2 Esr. 22,43; 4 Esr. 7,28; 4 Esr. 8,62; Matth. 25,21 rom.; Hebr. 12,11; 1 Petr. 1,13 (ubi χαράν legisse videntur); ἀγαλλίαμα Sir. 6,31; Jes. 60,15; ይከውነኒ፡ ትፍሥሕተ፡ እስከ፡ አመ፡ እመውት፡ Judith 12,14; ባቲ፡ ይሰልጥ፡ ትፍሥሕቶ፡ αὕτη ἡ μερὶς τοῦ μισθοῦ αὐτοῦ Sir. 11,18; ትፍሥሕታተ፡ ሰማይ፡ Sx. Haml. 25 Enc.; Sx. Mij. 3 Enc. a deliciae, voluptas, τρυφή Sir. 14,16; Ps. 35,9; Hez. 34,14; ኵሉ፡ ዕፀ፡ ትፍሥሕት፡ Hez. 31,16; ከመ፡ ገነተ፡ ትፍሥሕት፡ Hez. 36,35; 4 Esr. 6,1; እመ፡ ትሬስዮን፡ ትፍሥሕተ፡ ለሰንበታት፡ τρυφερά Jes. 58,3. b solatium, παράκλησις Jes. 66,11; Ps. 76,3. c res laetae vel secundae, dies laeti: በትፍሥሕት፡ ἐν ἀγαθοῖς Sir. 12,8; Sir. 12,9; Judith 8,6. d በትፍሥሕት፡ προθύμως promte, alacriter, libenter, Tob. 7,8; 1 Petr. 5,2; φιλοφρόνως Act. 28,7 Platt. e alacritas, confidentia laeta ( Freudigkeit ), ἔντευξις Herm. p. 40; Herm. p. 41; Herm. p. 42; Herm. p. 43.

woorden.betekenis: fugit, fugax, pavidus fuit, timere, metuere, cui, de, ne, ve
woorden.definitie: I,1 [amh. ፈራ፡; ei Ges. in thes. p. 1122 comparavit فَرّ, نَفَر fugit, fugax, pavidus fuit, sed etiam יָרֵא et وَرُعَ cognata videntur] Subj. ይፍራህ፡ 1 timere, metuere, Gen. 3,10; Gen. 15,1; Gen. 18,15; Gen. 21,17; Gen. 26,24; Deut. 1,21; Jos. 8,1; Jud. 7,3; Jud. 8,20; Ruth 3,11; Ps. 45,2; Ps. 51,6; Ps. 55,4; Job 9,35; ኢይፍራህኪ፡ (suff. Dat.) ልብኪ፡ Judith 10,16; Judith 11,1; Deut. 20,8; Matth. 10,31; Matth. 14,30; Matth. 17,6; Matth. 17,7; ፈሪህየ፡ ሖርኩ፡ Matth. 25,25; Matth. 28,5; Matth. 28,10 al.; 1 Tim. 5,20; ፈርሁ፡ ዐቢየ፡ ፍርሀተ፡ Marc. 4,41; Luc. 2,9; c.c. Acc. rei vel pers.: Gen. 9,2; Num. 14,9; Num. 21,34; ፈርህዎ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ዐቢየ፡ ፍርሀተ፡ Jon. 1,16; Ps. 22,4; ምንተ፡ እፈርህ፡ እንከ፡ Sir. 23,18; 1 Petr. 3,6; 1 Petr. 3,14; Apoc. 2,10; Hebr. 11,23; ኢፈሪሆ፡ መዐተ፡ ንጉሥ፡ Hebr. 11,27; vel c. እምነ፡ Lev. 26,1; Deut. 3,22; Jos. 10,2; Job 5,21; Job 5,22; Ps. 3,6; Ps. 48,5; Jes. 37,6; Jer. 1,8; vel c. እምቅድመ፡ Koh. 3,15; Judith 4,2; 1 Reg. 18,12. a c.c. ለ፡ ejus, cui timemus: Genz. f. 156; vel c. ላዕለ፡ Gen. 32,12; ፈርሀ፡ ላዕለ፡ ነፍሱ፡ እምእኁሁ፡ Jsp. p. 333; Jsp. p. 355; ለእመ፡ ፈርሀት፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ በእንተ፡ ደዌ፡ F.M. 27,3; vel c. በእንተ፡ de aliquo: ለእመ፡ ይፈርሁ፡ በእንቲአሁ፡ ሞተ፡ F.N. 3. b c.c. Acc. Infin.: Gen. 19,30; Gen. 26,7; Gen. 46,3; Ex. 3,6; Ex. 34,30; Num. 12,8; 1 Reg. 3,15; Kuf. 44; 4 Esr. 10,39; Matth. 1,20; Marc. 9,32; Luc. 9,45; vel c. ከመ፡ seq. Subj.: አርመምኩ፡ ፈሪህየ፡ ከመ፡ እንግር፡ ዘእኄሊ፡ Job 32,7. c ubi Latine sequitur ne, Aethiopice sequitur ከመ፡ ኢ፡ c. Subj.: Hen. 106,6; Act. 27,29; Gen. 32,12; Chrys. passim; raro c. Imperf.: እፈርህ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይሌቡ፡ Kuf. p. 95; vel ኢ፡ c. Subj.: እፈርህ፡ ኢይሙት፡ Tob. 6,15; ብዙኃን፡ እለ፡ ኢይሌቅሑ፡ በፈሪህ፡ (v. በፈሪሀ፡) ኢይህጐሉ፡ ወኢይጸዐሉ፡ Sir. 29,7; Herm. p. 48; vel ከመ፡ c. Subj.: እፈርህ፡ በእንቲአክሙ፡ ከመ፡ ትክዐዉ፡ ደመ፡ Kuf. p. 32; vel እንዳዒ፡ ለእመ፡ Gal. 4,11; praemisso ዮጊ፡ 2 Cor. 11,3; vel ዮጊ፡ ኢ፡ Hen. 6,3. 2 vereri, revereri, c. Acc.: ገብር፡ ይፈርህ፡ እግዚኦ፡ Mal. 1,6; አባሁ፡ Lev. 19,3; Jos. 4,14; 1 Reg. 12,18; 1 Reg. 14,26; Marc. 6,20; Eph. 5,33; in specie Deum: ሥርዋ፡ ለጥበብ፡ ፈሪሀ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ (timor vel reverentia Dei i.e. pietas) Sir. 1,20; Sir. 1,27; Sir. 25,6; Sir. 25,11; Sir. 31,14; Sir. 31,16; Sir. 40,26; Koh. 5,6; Koh. 7,18; Prov. 1,7; Job 28,28; በእንተ፡ ፈሪሆትከ፡ Jes. 26,18; Deut. 4,10; Ps. 5,8; Ps. 18,10; Ps. 118,120; Ps. 144,20; Luc. 1,50; Luc. 18,2; Luc. 18,4 al.

woorden.betekenis: timorem, metum, injicere, terrere, deterrere, pavidum, redde
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 timere facere i.e. timorem vel metum injicere, terrere, c. Acc. pers.: አኮኑ፡ ኀይሉ፡ ያፈርሀክሙ፡ Job 13,11; ቃለ፡ ፀዓዑ፡ ያፈርሃ፡ ለምድር፡ Sir. 43,17; Sap. 17,9; Hez. 26,17; ራብዕሰ፡ አፍርሀኒ፡ ገጽየ፡ Sir. 26,5; Ps. 26,1; Marc. 4,40; Hen. 14,9; ኢያፈርሀኒ፡ መዊት፡ በእንተ፡ ትእዛዘ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Jsp. p. 350. a deterrere: ፈቀደ፡ በዝንቱ፡ አፍርሆተ፡ እሙ፡ Jsp. p. 289; Chrys. passim. b pavidum reddere aliquem, Deut. 20,8. c minari: በአፍርሆ፡ ስቅለት፡ ( durch Androhung der Kreuzigung ) Sx. Masc. 21. 2 vereri vel revereri facere: ለዘረከባ፡ (sc. ለጥበብ፡) ታአምኖ፡ ወታፍርሆ፡ Sir. 18,28.

woorden.betekenis: timeri, metui, reverenter, coli
woorden.definitie: III,1 timeri, metui, reverenter coli: babtizent eum, ዘይትፈራህ፡ በእንቲአሁ፡ ሞት፡ F.N. 15; Christus ይትፈቀር፡ እስመ፡ መሓሪ፤ ይትፈራህ፡ እስመ፡ እግዚእ፡ Mavâs. 28; አባ፡ ገሪማ፤ ተፈርሀ፡ ግርማከ፤ ተሰምዐ፡ ዜናከ፡ ውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ Mavâs. 64.

woorden.betekenis: timor, metus, terror, formido, reverentia, id quod timetur,
woorden.definitie: (etiam ፍርሃት፡) n. act. et subst., fem. et m., Pl. ፍርሀታት፡ timor, metus, ( terror ), formido, Marc. 4,41; Luc. 2,9; Jon. 1,16; Ps. 2,11; Ps. 54,6; Ex. 15,16; Ex. 23,27; Jes. 7,25; Jes. 19,16; ፍርሀተ፡ ልብ፡ Sir. 40,5; Hen. 1,5; Hen. 13,3; Matth. 28,8; 1 Joh. 4,18; 2 Cor. 7,5; 2 Cor. 7,15; በእንተ፡ ፍርሀት፡ Apoc. 18,15, al. crebro; c.c. እምነ፡, ut: ፍርሀት፡ እምንዴት፡ δέος πενίας Chrys. Ta. 34, c. እምቅድመ፡ Deut. 2,25; vel per st. constr.: ፍርሀተ፡ ሞት፡ Sir. 40,5; Hebr. 2,15; እምፍርሀቱ፡ ተሀውኩ፡ Matth. 28,4; Joh. 7,13; Joh. 19,38; ፈኑ፡ ፍርሀተከ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ አሕዛብ፡ Sir. 33,2; ፍርሀተ፡ ዚአሁ፡ Judith 2,28; Hez. 32,23; Gen. 35,5; Deut. 11,25; Jos. 2,9. a timor vel reverentia, Dei: ፍርሀተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ (i.q. ፈሪሀ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡) Sir. 9,16; Sir. 16,2; Sir. 27,3; መንፈሰ፡ ፍርሀተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Jes. 11,3; እወዲ፡ ፍርሀትየ፡ ውስተ፡ ልቦሙ፡ Jes. 39,40; Gen. 20,11; Ex. 20,20; Rom. 3,18 al.; hominum: Rom. 13,7; ፍርሀተ፡ ገጽ፡ (>deMenschenfurcht>) F.N. 43,3. b id quod timetur, formido: Gen. 31,53; እሬስየኪ፡ ፍርሀተ፡ ለዘ፡ ርእየኪ፡ Lud. e Vit. Barb. c Pl. ፍርሀታት፡ terrores, pericula: Phlx. 4; ፍርሀታት፡ ወምንዳቤያት፡ Phlx. 46.

woorden.betekenis: timendus, metuendus, terribilis, formidabilis
woorden.definitie: part., fem. መፍርህት፡, is qui timorem injicit i.e. timendus, metuendus, terribilis, formidabilis: ባሕር፡ መፍርህ፡ Sap. 10,18; መንበርከ፡ መፍርህ፡ Lit. 164,4; Herodes M. erat መፍርህ፡ ጥቀ፡ ወግሩም፡ Jsp. p. 340; urbs vastata est ወኮነት፡ መፍርህተ፡ ለእለ፡ የኀልፉ፡ ውስቴታ፡ Macc. f. 13; ዕለተ፡ ትንሣኤ፡ መፍርህት፡ ወግርምት፡ Can. Ancyr. 4; መፍርሃን፡ Org. 6.

woorden.betekenis: vid. በርሙዳ፡
woorden.definitie: vid. በርሙዳ፡

woorden.betekenis: rad., quae cum פרס et פרץ convenit; amh. ፈረሰ፡ „to
woorden.definitie: rad., quae cum פרס et פרץ convenit; amh. ፈረሰ፡ „to break, to burst, to be destroyed“ (193).

woorden.betekenis: diruere, destruere, demoliri
woorden.definitie: II,1 diruere, destruere, demoliri aedificium; ዘሐነጸ ፡ ቤተ፡ ወያፈርስ፡ Phlx. 165; transl. ይቤ፡ አባ፡ ሎኒስ፡ ሶበ፡ ኢያፍረስኩ፡ ርእስየ፡ እምኢክህልኩ፡ እሕንጻ፡ ለነፍስየ፡ Phlx. 220; ያፈረሱ፡ ኅሊናተ፡ ኀጢአት፡ Phlx. 31.

woorden.betekenis: equus, equa;, equus cum equite, eques, equites, faras, ʾafrā
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. አፍራስ፡ [amh. id.; פָּרָשׁ, فَرَسٌ] equus, equa; m. Gen. 49,17; Ex. 14,9; Ex. 15,1; Ex. 15,21; Ps. 31,11; Ps. 32,17; Ps. 146,11; Job 39,19 seq.; Cant. 1,9; ፈረስ፡ ዘኢተረየፀ፡ ይወፅእ፡ እኩየ፡ Sir. 30,8; ረዋጺ፡ ፈረስ፡ Jes. 30,16; ጸዐዳ፡ ፈረስ፡ Apoc. 6,2; Apoc. 19,11; equus a magis divino honore cultus Clem. f. 33; ፈረስ፡ ገይድ፡ Sir. 36,6; fem.: ፈረስ፡ እንተ፡ ይጼዐን፡ ንጉሥ፡ Esth. 6,8; አፍራስ፡ Ex. 14,7; Ex. 14,23; Deut. 17,16; Deut. 20,1; Jos. 11,4; 4 Reg. 7,6; Jes. 2,7; Jes. 31,1; Zach. 1,8; Zach. 6,3; Zach. 6,6; Ps. 19,8; አፍራስ፡ ረዋጽያን፡ Am. 6,7; fem.: Jos. 11,6; Jos. 11,9; Jac. 3,3; አፍራስ፡ አእኑስ፡ (et አትቡዕ፡) 2 Par. 9,25; አፍራስ፡ አንስት፡ 3 Reg. 10,26; distinguuntur አፍራሰ፡ ጽብእ፡ 3 Reg. 10,26 vel አፍራሰ፡ መራድ፡ et አፍራስ፡ እለ፡ ይስሕቡ፡ ሰረ ገላተ፡ 3 Reg. 3a,21. a crebro: equus cum equite: ድምፀ፡ ሰረገላ፡ ወአፍራስ፡ ἱππευόντων Mich. 1,13; አፍራስ፡ ἱππεῖς Jes. 22,7; ኵሎ፡ አፍራሲሁ፡ πᾶσαν τὴν ἵππον αὐτοῦ Judith 1,13; Judith 7,6. b ዘበአፍራስ፡ Judith 7,2 vel ሰብአ፡ አፍራስ፡ eques, equites Jer. 4,29; 1 Esr. 5,2; 2 Reg. 8,4; 2 Reg. 10,18; Act. 23,23. faras 1 አፍራስ፡ ʾafrās horsemen, ‘cavalieri’ ወወረደ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ መቅሠፍት፡ ወሞቱ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ወአፍራሲሆሙ፡ እለ፡ ቅደሙ፡ ማኅረኩ፡ ወድኅረ፡ ማኅረኩ፡ ‘Su di loro si abbattè il castigo e morirono tutti, e dei loro cavalieri, che prima e dopo si erano dati al saccheggio’ 180 § 466 (ed.), 104 § 466 (tr.) (‘«cavalieri»: letteralmente «cavalli», probabilmente nel senso, attestato nel Liber Axumae, di «cavaliere», vd. 342.’ 104 n. 86) C a for ሊቀ፡ ሐራ፡ ለአፍራስ፡ vid. ሊቅ፡ (Grébaut) b for አርውጾ፡ አፍራስ፡ vid. አሮጸ፡

woorden.betekenis: equester, eques
woorden.definitie: adj. rel. et subst. equester, eques: Sx. Masc. 18; M.M. f. 31 (vid. ሰረገላዊ፡); Julianus ፈረሳዊ፡, Catal. Cod. Mus. Brit. p. 17; ፈረሳዊ፡ መስተቃትል፡ Lud. e Vit. Theoph.

woorden.betekenis: equester, eques
woorden.definitie: adj. rel. (ab አፍራስ፡), equester, eques: Phlx. 100.

woorden.betekenis: gemmas, et, flores, emittere, florescere, florere, provenire
woorden.definitie: et ፈረየ፡ I,1 [פָּרָה et פָּרַח, ܦܪܳܐ; vic. ፈርኀ፡] Subj. ይፍረይ፡ 1 gemmas et flores emittere, florescere, florere, ἐξανθεῖν, ἀνθεῖν, ዕፅ፡ ዳግመ፡ ይፈሪ፡ ወይሠርጽ፡ Job 14,7; Job 14,9; ይፈሪ፡ ከመ፡ ጽጌ፡ Job 14,2; ይፍረይ፡ ከመ፡ ጽጌ፡ Jes. 35,1; Jes. 17,11; Ps. 91,12; ከመ፡ ዘይፈሪ፡ ኀበ፡ ሙሓዘ፡ ማይ፡ ὡς κρίνα Sir. 50,8; Ps. 102,14; ፈረየ፡ ሮማን፡ Cant. 6,11; Cant. 7,13; ይሠርጽ፡ ወይፈሪ፡ እስራኤል፡ Jes. 27,6; Jes. 35,2. 2 provenire, de fructu: ፈርየት፡ ከርካዕ፡ Num. 17,23; ወይሠርጽ፡ ሥርዎሙ፡ ለእለ፡ ተረፉ፡ ወይፈሪ፡ ዘርኦሙ፡ በላዕሉ፡ Jes. 37,31; ከመ፡ ይፍረይ፡ ለነ፡ 4 Esr. 8,9. 3 fructum ferre, fructificare, proprie de plantis: ሠረጸት፡ ወፈረየት፡ እምብዝኀ፡ ማይ፡ Hez. 19,10; ከመ፡ ትሥርጽ፡ ወትፍረይ፡ Hez. 17,8; አዕጹቂሃ፡ ኢይፈርዩ፡ Sir. 23,25; Marc. 4,7; Marc. 4,8; ዘይፈሪ፡ fructifer Ps. 148,9; Gen. 1,11; Gen. 1,12; Gen. 3,2; Kuf. 2; Deut. 20,20; c.c. Acc. fructus: ይፍረይ፡ አስካለ፡ Jes. 5,2; Jes. 5,4; ወፈረየ፡ (v. ወፈርየ፡) አስዋከ፡ Jes. 5,2; ፈረየት፡ ከርካዐ፡ Num. 17,23 in CG; Matth. 3,10; Matth. 7,17; Matth. 7,18; Matth. 13,26; Jac. 3,12; Herm. p. 50. a transl.: ፈረይክሙ፡ ለቅድሳት፡ Rom. 6,22; ከመ፡ ንፍረይ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ Rom. 7,4; ትፈሪ፡ ሰላመ፡ Hebr. 12,11; ዘኢይፈሪ፡ በቍዔተ፡ ἄκαρπος infructuosus Sap. 15,4; ዘኢይፈሪ፡ ἀκαρπία Prov. 9,12. b de terra, agris: ፈረየት፡ ምድረ፡ ግብጽ፡ ብዙኀ፡ Kuf. 40; ፈረየ፡ (ምድር፡) ብዙኀ፡ ሥርናየ፡ Kuf. 45; ፈረየተከ፡ ግዕዝ፡ Sx. Haml. 5 Enc. (vid. sub ግዕዝ፡); cor meum ከመ፡ ኢይፍረይ፡ ሦከ፡ Org. 6. c fecundam fieri, de muliere: መካን፡ እንተ፡ ፈረየት፡ Lud. ex Org. 4 fructum vel fertum offerre, καρποῦν, ወኢብሔር፡ ኀበ፡ ይፈርዩ፡ Dan. apocr. 3,14 (Orat. Azar., in Lud. editione Psalt. p. 529).

woorden.betekenis: flos, surculus, germen, fructus, fruges, proventus, soboles,
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., (fem., ut Org. 4), Sing. et coll., Pl. ፍሬያት፡, rarius ፍርያት፡ (ፍረያት፡ Sap. 10,7 in Abb. LV; Marc. 4,29 rom.), 1 flos, surculus, germen, ἄνθος Job 15,30; ፍሬ፡ ዘይት፡ Job 15,33; Jes. 11,1; ፍሬ፡ ሣዕር፡ Jes. 40,6; Jes. 40,7; 1 Petr. 1,24; Jac. 1,10; Jac. 1,11; ፍሬ፡ ሥርዋ፡ Dan. 11,7. 2 fructus, plantarum, arborum: Gen. 3,3; Hen. 24,4; Ex. 10,15; Lev. 23,40; Hos. 14,9; Cant. 2,3; ፍሬ፡ አቅማሕ፡ Cant. 4,13; Cant. 4,16; Cant. 8,12; Matth. 7,17; Matth. 7,18; Matth. 12,33; Matth. 21,19; Matth. 21,41; ገብረ፡ ፍሬ፡ Gen. 1,11; Gen. 1,12; Apoc. 22,2; ወሀበ፡ ፍሬ፡ Ps. 1,3; Marc. 4,8; ፍሬያተ፡ አዝርእት፡ καρποί Sap. 16,22. a terrae fructus, fruges, proventus: Gen. 4,3; Num. 13,20; Num. 13,26; Deut. 1,25; Deut. 7,13; Deut. 26,2; Ps. 104,33; ፍሬ፡ ምድር፡ σπέρματα Dan. 1,12; (ዘርአ፡ ምድር፡ Dan. 1,16); ፍሬያተ፡ ምድር፡ γεννήματα Jer. 7,20; terra progignit ፍሬያተ፡ ዘበበዘመዱ፡ ዘበበ፡ ጣዕሙ፡ Clem. f. 171; ፍርያተ፡ ምድር፡ Lit. 164,4; Macc. f. 3. b uteri, i.e. soboles, proles, fetus: ፍሬ፡ ከርሥ፡ Gen. 30,2; Deut. 7,13; Kuf. 28; Thren. 2,20; (Jer. 12,2); Ps. 131,11; Luc. 1,42; Act. 2,30; etiam ፍሬ፡ nudum, ut: σπέρμα Ex. 28,39; አቤል፡ ወሴት፡ ወሄኖክ፡ አርእስተ፡ አበው፡ ምስለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ፍሬሆሙ፡ Lit. Orth. c transl.: fructus laboris, facinoris, vel quidquid paritur vel efficitur aliqua re: ፍሬሃ፡ ለንህብ፡ i.e. mel Sir. 11,3; ፍሬ፡ ምግባሮሙ፡ Jer. 6,19; Jer. 17,10; Prov. 1,31; ፍሬ፡ ጻማከ፡ ትሴሰይ፡ Ps. 127,2; manuum Prov. 29,34; oris Prov. 12,14; labiorum Prov. 18,20; Prov. 18,21; Hebr. 13,15; justitiae Prov. 13,2; Jac. 3,18; Phil. 4,17; sapientiae Sir. 6,19; Prov. 8,19; ቦኑ፡ ፍሬ፡ ለጻድቅ፡ Ps. 57,11; poenitentiae Matth. 3,8; lucis Eph. 5,9; Spiritus S. Gal. 5,22; legis 4 Esr. 9,31; al. d ዘእንበለ፡ ፍሬ፡ 2 Petr. 1,8 vel ዘአልቦ፡ ፍሬ፡ Jer. 2,6 i.e. infructuosus vel infecundus. 3 fructus oblati, fertum, κάρπωμα, Ex. 30,9; Num. 15,3.

woorden.betekenis: flores, formatio, fructus, fructuum, oblatio, fertum
woorden.definitie: n. act. et subst. 1 floritio i.e. flores: ከመ፡ ፍርየተ፡ ሮማን፡ Ex. 28,29. 2 fructificatio i.e. formatio fructus ejusque perductio ad maturitatem: Marc. 4,29 Platt. 3 fructuum oblatio, fertum, κάρπωμα Ex. 29,25; Ex. 29,38; Ex. 29,41.

woorden.betekenis: pascha, agnus, paschalis, festum, tempus, paschatis
woorden.definitie: , rarius ፋስካ፡ n. peregr., sc. πάσχα, φασέκ (vid. etiam ጳሲካ፡ et ፍሥሕ፡) pascha, 1 agnus paschalis Judaeorum: ወጠብሑ፡ ፋሲካ፡ 2 Esr. 6,20; 1 Esr. 1,1; Ex. 12,11; Ex; 12,27 seq.; Num. 9,2 seq.; Deut. 16,1 seq.; Jos. 5,10 (ፋስካ፡); Matth. 26,18. 2 festum vel tempus paschatis, a Judaeorum: Ex. 34,25; Lev. 23,5; Num. 28,16; Num. 33,3 (ፋስካ፡); 4 Reg. 23,22 seq.; 2 Esr. 6,19; 1 Esr. 1,16; 1 Esr. 1,17; Jer. 38,8; Hez. 45,21; Matth. 26,2; Marc. 14,1; Joh. 13,1; Joh. 19,14 al.; ፋሲካ፡ አይሁድ፡ Joh. 2,13. b Christianorum α πάσχα σταυρώσιμον, ሰቡዐ፡ ፋሲካ፡ Const. Ap. 66(67). β plerumque πάσχα ἀναστάσιμον, ሰሙነ፡ ፋሲካ፡ Const. Ap. 66(67); ዕለተ፡ ፋሲካ፡ (dies resurrectionis) Did. 29; Did. 30; Deg.; በፋሲካ፡ ኦሪት፡ ኢይግበሩ፡ ፋሲካ፡ ወንጌል፡ Sx. Mag. 4Enc.; vid. etiam ጾም፡; in Computo Eccl. ፍሥሕ፡ σταυρώσιμον et ፋሲካ፡ ἀναστάσιμον distingui solet.

woorden.betekenis: gravem, esse, honorati, pretiosi, cari.
woorden.definitie: inus., videtur i.q. יקר (ܝܩܪ وقر) gravem esse, unde propagantur significationes honorati, pretiosi, cari.

woorden.betekenis: carum, habere, diligere, amare, delectari, hospitalitas, ido
woorden.definitie: II,1 carum habere, diligere, amare, ἀγαπᾶν et φιλεῖν, Koh. 3,8; Luc. 7,47; raro c. ለ፡ pers., ut 1 Petr. 2,17 rom.; plerumque c. Acc. pers. vel rei, consanguineos, propinquos: Matth. 10,37; Gen. 22,2; Gen. 37,3; Gen. 37,4; Gen. 44,20; Ruth 4,15; feminam, virum, conjugem: Hos. 3,1; Gen. 29,18; Gen. 34,8; Jud. 14,16; Jud. 16,4; 1 Reg. 1,5; 1 Reg. 18,20; 2 Reg. 13,1; እምነ፡ ፍቅር፡ ዘአፍቀራ፡ 2 Reg. 13,15; Koh. 9,9; Cant. 1,7 seq.; Herm. p. 1; Eph. 5,25; Eph. 5,28; amicos 1 Reg. 20,17; Joh. 11,3; Joh. 11,36; herum Ex. 21,5; Matth. 6,24; homines Kuf. 20; Lev. 19,18; Lev. 19,34; Marc. 12,31; 1 Joh. 4,20; 1 Joh. 4,21; Matth. 5,44; Matth. 5,46; አፍቅሮ፡ ቢጹ፡ Rom. 13,8; Thren. 1,2; 1 Reg. 18,28; de amore Dei Christive in homines: Deut. 4,37; Deut. 7,13; 2 Reg. 12,24; Ps. 46,4; Jes. 43,4; በአፍቅሮ፡ ዚአከ፡ Jes. 48,14; Rom. 9,13; ቀደመ፡ አፍቅሮተነ፡ 1 Joh. 4,19; Joh. 3,16; Joh. 13,34; Joh. 14,21; ፍቅር፡ ዘአፍቀርከኒ፡ Joh. 17,26 al.; et hominum in Deum Christumve: Deut. 6,5; Deut. 11,1; Marc. 12,30; Joh. 16,27; Rom. 8,28; Hebr. 13,5 al.; res varias, ut ነፍሶ፡ Joh. 12,25; ኢታፍቅርዎ፡ ለዓለም፡ 1 Joh. 2,15; ከመ፡ ታፈድፍድ፡ አፍቅሮቶ፡ ለተግባርየ፡ እምኔየ፡ 4 Esr. 8,56; templum Ps. 25,8; Ps. 83,1 al. a de amore inhonesto: እለ፡ ያፈቅሩኪ፡ Jer. 22,22; Hez. 23,12 seq.; Kuf. 33; Kuf. 39; Dan. apocr. 1,10; etiam de bestiis Sir. 13,15. b amare rem i.e. delectari re: አፍቅሮታ፡ ለጥበብ፡ Sir. 40,20; ጽድቀ፡ Ps. 10,8; Ps. 98,3; verbum Dei Ps. 118,140; ዘያፈቅር፡ ንዋየ፡ Sir. 34,5; Koh. 5,9; Hebr. 13,5; አፍቅሮ፡ ንዋይ፡ φιλαργυρία 1 Tim. 6,10; አፍቀረ፡ ትዕግልተ፡ Hos. 12,7; ሀብተ፡ Hos. 9,1; ርኵሶሙ፡ አፍቀረት፡ ነፍሶሙ፡ Jes. 66,3; ሕዝብየ፡ አፍቀሩ፡ ዘንተ፡ Jer. 5,31; Jer. 8,2; ምጽዋተ፡ Mich. 6,8; መባልዕተ፡ Kuf. 26; Gen. 27,4; Gen. 9,14; seq. እስመ፡ Ps. 114,1; c. በ፡ pers.: Kuf. p. 94. c አፍቅሮ፡ ነግድ፡ hospitalitas Rom. 12,13; አፍቅሮ፡ ጣዖት፡ idol ol atria 1 Petr. 4,3. d amare seq. Infin. vel libenter facere aliquid; c.c. Acc. Infin.: Matth. 6,5; Luc. 11,43; Luc. 20,46; ያፈቅር፡ ሰሚዐ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ Sir. 36,2; ኢታፍቅር፡ ሐሚየ፡ Prov. 20,13; ኢታፍቅሩ፡ ምሒለ፡ መሐላ፡ Zach. 8,17; vel c. ለ፡ et Infin.: ኵሎ፡ ነገረ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ አፍቅር፡ ለሰሚዕ፡ Sir. 6,35; c. Subj. verbi: አፍቀረ፡ ይግበር፡ libenter fecit; Lud. e Vit. Barb.; በአፍቅሮ፡ benevole Lud. Comm. hist. p. 501 n. 33. e velle, cupere, c. Acc.: 2 Tim. 4,8; Matth. 23,6; c. ኀበ፡ Ps. 41,1 (ἐπιποθεῖν); seq. Subj. verbi: Ps. 33,13. f malle, sive seq. እምነ፡ comparative: አፍቀረ፡ ተሴስዮ፡ ሣዕር፡ እምበሊዐ፡ ኅብስት፡ Lud. ex Sx. Masc. 5Enc.; sive omisso እምነ፡ ut 2 Tim. 4,10.

woorden.betekenis: diligi, amari, ab, alicui, amorem, benevolentiam, sibi, conc
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 diligi, amari: Kuf. p. 103; Prov. 28,13; ይትፈቀሩ፡ በእንቲአኪ፡ ጽሉኣን፡ Tob. 13,10; ኮንኩ፡ እትፈቀር፡ በገጸ፡ እምየ፡ Prov. 4,3; Mavâs. 28 (vid. ተፈርሀ፡); c. በኀበ፡ ab aliquo vel alicui: ወተፈቅሩ፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወበኀበ፡ ሰብእ፡ Sir. 45,1 (Sir. 44,23); 1 Par. 29,23; ሚመ፡ መጠነ፡ ይትፈቀር፡ quanto amabilior, Lud. ex Org. 3. 2 amorem vel benevolentiam alicujus sibi conciliare: ተፈቀር፡ በኀበ፡ ብዙኃን፡ προσφιλῆ σεαυτὸν ποίει Sir. 4,7; ፈቀደ፡ ይግበር፡ ግብረ፡ ዘይትፈቀር፡ ቦቱ፡ ኀበ፡ ቄሳር፡ Jsp. p. 313.

woorden.betekenis: carus, dilectus, amatus, amicus, amasius, amator
