woorden.definitie: part. carus, dilectus, amatus, ( amicus ), de rebus Ps. 83,1; de personis: እንተ፡ ኢኮነት፡ ፍቅርተ፡ Hos. 2,25; Jer. 11,15; Eph. 5,1; Phil. 4,1; Jac. 1,16; c.c. በኀበ፡ Judith 9,4; ጽሉእ፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወፍቁር፡ በኀበ፡ አጋንንት፡ Did. 4; ኮነ፡ ፍቁረ፡ በኀቤሆሙ፡ Sx. Ter 27; per st. constr.: ፍቁሩ፡ ለዝ፡ ዓለም፡ Jac. 4,4; Deut. 33,12; Cant. 5,16; Ps. 59,5; Ps. 107,5; Ps. 126,3; Jes. 5,1; Jes. 44,2; Matth. 12,18; Col. 4,14; 1 Cor. 4,14; Rom. 1,7; ፍቁራኒሃ፡ οἱ φιλοῦντες αὐτήν Thren. 1,2; ኦፍቁረ፡ ክርስቶስ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ὦ φιλόχριστε βασιλεῦ Cyr. ad Theod. f. 23; ኦፍቁራንየ፡ compellantur auditores in concionibus sacris, Genz. f. 120al.; በአሐዱ፡ ፍቁር፡ ይሰሐብ፡ ካልእ፡ Prov. Th. Petr. p. 17. a epitheton Messiae, Asc. Jes. 1,5; Asc. Jes. 3,13; Asc. Jes. 3,17; Asc. Jes. 4,18; b amasius, amator, Lud. Comm.p. 496 n. 12.

woorden.betekenis: amor, dilectio, caritas, amicitia, caritate, mutua, in, erga
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem. (ut Cant. 8,6; Prov. 5,19; Matth. 24,12), amor, viri et feminae: ይነድድ፡ ፍቅር፡ ከመ፡ እሳት፡ Sir. 9,8; Cant. 2,5; Cant. 5,8; Cant. 8,6; Cant. 8,7; Prov. 5,19; በዛቲ፡ ፍቅር፡ እንዘ፡ ንትፋቀር፡ Prov. 5,19; ፍቅረ፡ ብእሲት፡ (ἔρως) Prov. 24,51; 2 Reg. 13,15; Jer. 2,2; Jer. 2,33; rerum: Jac. 4,4; ፍቅረ፡ ወርቅ፡ Asc. Jes. 3,28; ፍቅረ፡ ወይን፡ I Sal. Mar. 27 (vid. sub ዔረግ፡). a dilectio, caritas, Koh. 9,1; Koh. 9,6; Matth. 24,12; amicorum 2 Reg. 1,26; φιλία ( amicitia ) Prov. 10,12; Prov. 15,17; Prov. 27,5; ፍቅረ፡ ቢጽ፡ Did. 7(de caritate mutua ተፋቅሮ፡ frequentare solent); Dei in homines: ፍቅረ፡ ዘለዓለም፡ አፍቀርኩከ፡ Jer. 38,3; 2 Cor. 13,12; 2 Cor. 13,14; 1 Joh. 2,15; 1 Joh. 3,17; al.; እግዚአብሔር፡ ፍቅር፡ ውእቱ፡ 1 Joh. 4,8; hominum in Deum Christumve Luc. 11,42; Joh. 5,42; Joh. 15,9; Joh. 15,10; Rom. 8,35; 1 Joh. 2,5 al.; ገብሩ፡ ላዕሌየ፡ ፍቅረ፡ Cant. 2,4; c. etiam c. ለ፡ in vel erga, ut: ፍቅርየ፡ ለእጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ Sx. Pag. 3. b ፍቅረ፡ ነግዳን፡ Sx. Teq. 21vel ፍቅረ፡ እንግዳ፡ Kid. f. 16, hospitalitas. c epulum amoris Christiani, agape, Judae 12; 2 Petr. 2,13. d በፍቅር፡ amanter, benevole, libenter: Act. 28,7 rom.; Lit. Orth.; Lud. ex Sx. Ter 12Enc.

woorden.betekenis: amans, amator
woorden.definitie: part. amans, amator: Sap. 8,2 var.: መፍቅረ፡ ወርቅ፡ Asc. Jes. 3,25; መፍቀራነ፡ ክብር፡ ዘዝ፡ ዓለም፡ Asc. Jes. 3,25; መፍቅረ፡ (v. መፍቀሬ፡) ሀጕል፡ Sx. Sen. 17Enc.; መፍቅራነ፡ ሰብእ፡ φιλάνθρωποι Lud. e Vit. Theoph.

woorden.betekenis: amans, amator, studiosus, beneficus, hospitalis, officiosus
woorden.definitie: part. c. term. adj., amans, amator, studiosus: መፍቀሬ፡ አንስት፡ φιλογύνης 3 Reg. 11,1; መፍቀሬ፡ ኮንኩ፡ ለሥና፡ ἐραστής Sap. 8,2; መፍቀሬ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Kuf. 17; መፍቀሪት፡ Kuf. 19; መፍቀሬ፡ ሰብእ፡ φιλάνθρωπος Sap. 1,6; Clem. f. 268; Did. 6; Lit. 159,4 መፍቀሬ፡ ኂሩት፡ φιλάγαθος Sap. 7,22; መፍቀሬ፡ ምጽዋት፡ beneficus Sx. Masc. 16; መፍቀሬ፡ ነግድ፡ φιλόξενος hospitalis 1 Tim. 3,2; Tit. 1,8; መፍቀሪተ፡ ነግድ፡ Clem. f. 108; መፍቀሬ፡ እንግዳ፡ Kid. f. 6; መፍቀሬ፡ ተልእኮ፡ officiosus Gad. T.H.; መፍቀሬ፡ ሐረስት፡ φιλογεωργός 2 Par. 26,10; መፍቀሬ፡ ጋእዝ፡ φιλαμαρτήμων Prov. 17,19; መፍቀሪተ፡ ዝሙት፡ F.M. 8,7; መፍቀሪተ፡ ግፍዕ፡ Sx. Genb. 12Enc.; መፍቀርያነ፡ ዐመፃ፡ Rom. 2,8; መፍቀርያነ፡ ፈጊዕ፡, መፍቀርያነ፡ ንዋይ፡ φίλαυτοι, φιλάργυροι 2 Tim. 3,2; መፍቀርያነ፡ ሢመት፡ ወክብር፡ Kid. f. 4; አኃት፡ ክቡራት፡ ወመፍቀሬያተ፡ (sic pro ወመፍቀሪያተ፡ vel ወመፍቀርያተ፡) እግዚአብሔር፡ θεοφιλέσταται Cyr. ad Reg. f. 25.

woorden.betekenis: invisere, prospicere, respicere, reputare, aestimare, recens
woorden.definitie: I,1 [פקד ܦܩܕ فقد; vid. Ges. thes. p. 1120] Subj. ይፍቅድ፡ 1 invisere, curandi causa, prospicere, ኢትኅድግ፡ ዘልፈ፡ ፈቂደ፡ እንስሳከ፡ ἐπισκέπτου Sir. 7,22 (vid. III,3 et IV,3); አርትዕ፡ ወፍቅድ፡ ጽህቀቶሙ፡ Lud. e Ssal. Req. 2 respicere, reputare, aestimare: እለ፡ ኢይፈቅድዎ፡ ለወርቅ፡ ወኢይኄልይዎ፡ ለብሩር፡ οὐ λογίζονται Jes. 13,17; 4 Esr. 8,67. 3 lustrare i.e. recensere, numerare: ፩ እምቅዱሳን፡ ፱ እለ፡ ይፈቅዱ፡ (quos numerare solent) Sx. Hed. 28 Enc. (in Sx. Tubing.). 4 requirere, expetere, appetere, c. Acc. rei et እምነ፡ pers.: αἰτεῖται Deut. 10,12; c. በኀበ፡ pers. 2 Reg. 19,38 (aliter Ps. 72,24); c. Acc. rei: ζητεῖν Matth. 12,43 rom.; Hebr. 8,7; ሀገር፡ እንተ፡ ይፈቅዱ፡ ἐπιζητουμένη Jes. 62,12; ብዙኃን፡ እለ፡ ፈቀድዋ፡ ἐπεθύμησαν Judith 16,22; እለ፡ ትፈቅዱኒ፡ Sir. 24,19; ኢትፍቅድ፡ ብዙኀ፡ ውሉደ፡ Sir. 16,1; ዘፈቀዱ፡ ὧν ἀντείχοντο Jer. 8,2; seq. Subj. verbi Matth. 26,16. 5 velle, cupere, praemissa negatione nolle, c. Acc.: ዘውእቱ፡ ፈቀደ፡ ይገብር፡ Job 23,14; Jes. 56,4; Ps. 39,9; Ps. 113,11; Ps. 134,6; 1 Reg. 18,25; ብዙኃን፡ እለ፡ ኢይሌቅሑ፡ በኢፈቂደ፡ ጻሕብ፡ Sir. 29,7; Matth. 9,13; Matth. 12,7; Rom. 7,18; Rom. 7,19; abs.: በከመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ፈቀደ፡ Job 1,21; Cant. 2,7; Cant. 3,5; Hen. 17,1; Joh. 3,8; Matth. 17,4; Marc. 1,40; እንዘ፡ ኢይፈቅድ፡ ἀκουσίως invitus Lev. 4,22; seq. Subj. verbi: ኢትፍቅዱ፡ ተአብሱ፡ Job 34,10; መነ፡ ትፈቅድ፡ ትርዳእ፡ Job 26,2; Job 35,13; Jer. 5,3; Jer. 6,10; Jer. 9,6; ኢይፈቅድ፡ ይሙት፡ ኃጥእ፡ Hez. 33,11; 1 Reg. 2,25; 1 Reg. 28,11; Jud. 13,23; Ruth 3,13; Deut. 25,7; Deut. 25,8; Matth. 1,19; Matth. 13,28; Matth. 15,32; Matth. 20,32; Matth. 26,17; Marc. 6,19; Marc. 6,25; Marc. 10,35; Luc. 9,54; Luc. 18,13; Rom. 1,11 (ἐπιποθῶ); Rom. 1,13; እፈቅድ፡ ለክሙ፡ ታእምሩ፡ 1 Cor. 10,1; seq. ከመ፡ c. Subj.: ቦኑ፡ ፈቂደ፡ እፈቅድ፡ ከመ፡ ይሙት፡ ኃጥእ፡ Hez. 18,23; Joh. 17,24; Luc. 18,41; seq. Acc. Infin.: Deut. 25,8; 4 Esr. 8,34; ኢትፍቅድ፡ ከዊነ፡ መኰንነ፡ Sir. 7,6; Jer. 45,21. a vult aliquis i.e. placet, videtur, collibet ei: እመ፡ ፈቀደ፡ ንጉሥ፡ εἰ δοκεῖ τῷ βασιλεῖ Esth. 3,9; Jes. 53,10. b vult facere i.e. libenter facit vel solet facere: Luc. 20,46; Joh. 8,44. c facilem se praebere: ኢትፍቅድ፡ Prov. 1,10; Jes. 1,19; ኢትፍቅድ፡ አብሶ፡ Tob. 4,5; Deut. 12,30. d promtum esse: Marc. 14,38; 2 Cor. 8,11; 2 Cor. 8,12. e delectari aliquo, c. Acc.: Ps. 118,35; እግዚአብሔር፡ ኢይፈቅዶሙ፡ Jer. 14,10; Matth. 27,43. 6 desiderare, indigere, opus habere (alicui opus esse ), c. Acc. rei vel pers.: ምንተ፡ ትፈቅድ፡ τίς ἡ χρεία σου Sir. 13,6; ንፈቅድ፡ ቤተነ፡ Sir. 29,27; Sir. 38,12; Sir. 15,12; Sir. 20,16; ኢፈቀደ፡ ወኢአሐደ፡ መምክረ፡ Sir. 42,21; Sap. 13,16; Prov. 18,2; Ps. 15,1; Hen. 14,22; Hebr. 10,36; Apoc. 21,23; Marc. 2,17; Matth. 9,12; c. Acc. rei et Acc. pers. ( ab aliquo): እመቦ፡ ትካዘ፡ ዘይፈቅደከ፡ Sir. 13,6; vel c. በ፡ rei: ትካዝ፡ በዘይፈቅደከ፡ Sir. 37,8; abs.: ኢንፈቅድ፡ እንከ፡ τίς ἐστί μοι χρεία Sir. 11,23; seq. Subj. verbi: Matth. 3,14; 1 Thess. 4,9.

woorden.betekenis: facere, ut, velit, cupiat, adducere, commovere
woorden.definitie: II,1 facere ut velit vel cupiat aliquis aliquid i.e. adducere, commovere aliquem ad aliquid: ዘአፍቀደኒ፡ ለቀቲሎትከ፡ Jsp. p. 338, ዘአፍቀደ፡ ሄሮድስ፡ ለአስተዋስቦ፡ … Jsp. p. 335.

woorden.betekenis: aestimari, reputari, recenseri, numerari, inspici, explorari
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 aestimari, reputari, Hen. 52,8. 2 recenseri, numerari: Num. 14,29 var.; ሰላም፡ ለምልክያስ፡ ዘአድምዐ፡ ተፈቅዶ፤ ምስለ፡ ንኡሳን፡ ነቢያት፡ Sx. Ter 8; archangeli novem እለ፡ ይትፈቀዱ፡ Lud. ex Sx. Hed. 28Enc. 3 inspici, explorari: ዘኢይትፈቀድ፡ ነገር፡ ἀδιεξέταστοι Sir. 21,18. 4 requiri i.e. vindicari, Hen. 47,4. 5 desiderari, a expeti: እንተ፡ ትትፈቀድ፡ ይእቲ፡ በኵሉ፡ ποθεινὴ πᾶσιν Prov. 6,8; ግተት፡ ዘለምንትሂ፡ ኢይበቍዕ፡ ወኢይትፈቀድ፡ Jer. 22,28. b esse voluntatem alicujus, seq. ከመ፡ c. Subj., Matth. 18,14. c opus esse, necessarium esse (erforderlich sein): ዘይትፈቀድ፡ τὰ δέοντα Prov. 24,31; Rom. 15,27; ዘይትፈቀድ፡ ለሐኒጽ፡ Jsp. p. 276; Jsp. p. 330; ኢይትፈቀድ፡ በኀቤሁ፡ „non opus est ipsi“ Lud. ex Org. 6; F.N. 33,7.

woorden.betekenis: appetitus, desiderium, studium, voluntas, delectatio, approb
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem., Pl. ፈቃዳት፡ 1 appetitus, desiderium, studium: ኢትትሉ፡ ፈቃዳ፡ ለኀጢአት፡ Sir. 18,30; Gen. 6,5; Joh. 1,13; Eph. 2,3; ፈቃዱ፡ ተወርወት፡ ኀበ፡ ዐጸደ፡ ወይን፡ Sx. Tachs. 1Enc.; appetitus cibi, Lud. sine auct.; ፈቃዳት፡ Phlx. 198. 2 voluntas: Ps. 39,11; Ps. 144,20; ኵሎ፡ ፈቃድየ፡ ግበር፡ Jes. 44,28; Jes. 48,14; Jes. 58,3; Jes. 58,13; Jes. 62,4; እስመዝ፡ ውእቱ፡ ፈቃድየ፡ Jer. 9,24; Koh. 5,3; Koh. 12,1 var.; Sir. 1,27; ፈቃዱ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ከመ፡ ኢትግበር፡ እኩየ፡ Sir. 32,5; Sir. 41,4; Sir. 43,16; ግበር፡ ፈቃዳ፡ ለእምከ፡ Kuf. 25; በከመ፡ ፈቃዱ፡ Kuf. 22; 2 Tim. 1,9; ኵሉ፡ ኅሊና፡ ወፈቃዱ፡ ለሰብእ፡ Kuf. 7; Matth. 6,10; Matth. 7,21; Matth. 12,50; Matth. 26,39; Matth. 26,42; Joh. 4,34; Joh. 6,38; Rom. 1,10; Rom. 2,18; Rom. 10,1; 1 Thess. 5,18; Eph. 1,11; በፈቃደ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Deo volente Rom. 15,32; 1 Cor. 1,1; በሥምረተ፡ ፈቃዱ፡ Eph. 1,5. a delectatio, approbatio (Wohlgefallen): ኢኮነ፡ ቦቶን፡ ፈቃድየ፡ Koh. 12,1; ከመ፡ ይርከብ፡ ነገረ፡ ፈቃድ፡ Koh. 12,10. b benevolentia: የኀሥሡ፡ ፈቃዶ፡ εὐδοκίαν Sir. 2,16; ፈቃዱ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ታስተፌሥሖ፡ ለዓለም፡ Sir. 11,17. c voluntas promta: α c. praep. በ፡ voluntate sua, sponte, ultro: በፈቃድ፡ ወኢበኵርህ፡ F.M. 1,3; በፈቃዱ፡ Ps. 75,10; እለ፡ በፈቃዶሙ፡ ነበሩ፡ 2 Esr. 21,2; 2 Cor. 8,5; Clem. f. 162; በፈቃደ፡ ርእሱ፡ F.M. 33,3; F.M. 33,4. β ዘእንበለ፡ ፈቃዱ፡ invite, invitus, F.M. 6,8; Gad. T.H. (vid. አዘመወ፡). γ Statui constr. subjunctum vel in Gen. vel ዘበፈቃድ፡ vel ዘእምፈቃድ፡ voluntarius, spontaneus: መሥዋዕተ፡ ፈቃድ፡ Am. 4,5; ዘበፈቃዶሙ፡ τὰ ἑκούσια Judith 4,14; Lev. 7,16; Num. 15,3; (መሥዋዕት፡) ዘፈቃድክሙ፡ Lev. 23,28; ዘእምፈቃድየ፡ እሠውዕ፡ ለከ፡ Ps. 53,6. d ፈቃዳት፡ mandata, praecepta, Kuf. 2; Kuf. 21; Sx. Jac. 13Enc.

woorden.betekenis: torquere, nere, fila, deducere, contorquere
woorden.definitie: I,1 [פתל ܦܬܠ فتل] Subj. ይፍትል፡, torquere, nere, fila deducere vel contorquere, c. Acc.: ፈተላሁ፡ ለጸጕረ፡ ጠሊ፡ Ex. 35,26; Prov. 29,31 var. (vid. በዘተ፡); abs. እመታ፡ ታጸንዕ፡ ለፈቲል፡ Prov. 29,37; Ex. 35,25; Matth. 6,28; Luc. 12,27; Clem. f. 190; crinem: ኢታንኅ፡ ሥዕርተ፡ ርእስከ፤ ኢትፍትል፡ ወኢትፅፍር፡ Did. 1.

woorden.betekenis: filum, licium, funiculus, metallicum, ellychnium, textum, li
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., Pl. አፍታል፡ vel አፍትልት፡, filum, licium, funiculus, σπαρτίον Koh. 4,12; Gen. 14,23; Jos. 2,18; Jud. 16,12; ፈትል፡ ዘያክንት፡ Ex. 35,25; ልብሰት፡ እንተ፡ ክዑብ፡ ፈትሉ፡ (v. ፍትሉ፡) ዘለይ፡ Sir. 45,11; ክበበ፡ አፍትልት፡ Chron. Ax. f. 93. a filum metallicum: አፍታል፡ Ex. 36,10; ፈትለ፡ ብሩር፡ Ex. 35,25 var. b ellychnium: ፈትለ፡ ማኅቶት፡ Lud. ex Enc. Teq. 16; ይስቅሉ፡ ማኅቶተ፡ በቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ ወይግበሩ፡ ውስቴታ፡ ቅብአ፡ ወፈትለ፡ ዐጌ፡ Sx. Teq. 20; ፈትል፡ M.M. f. 110. c textum araneum: ፈትለ፡ ሣሬት፡ Jes. 59,5 var.; ፈትለ፡ ሣሬት፡ ኢይክል፡ ተዐግሦ፡ ንፍኀተ፡ ነፋስ፡ Chrys. Ta. 34. d transl.: ligamen, ፈትለ፡ ትሥልስት፡ „vinculum Trinitatis“, Lud. ex Org. 2. – Voc. Ae.: ፈትለ፡ ወርቅ፡ ዘ፡ ሽሕቦ። fatl L ፈትለ፡ ሣሬት፡ fatla śāret spiderweb, vid. ሣሬት፡ 535a

woorden.betekenis: aperire, solvere, exsolvere, resolvere, remissum reddere, di
woorden.definitie: I,1 [פתח ܦܬܚ فتح] Subj. ይፍታሕ፡ 1 aperire, saccum Gen. 42,27; Gen. 43,21; ፈትሐ፡ ኪሰ፡ Jsp. p. 370; uterum Gen. 29,31; Ex. 13,2; Ex. 13,13; Luc. 2,23; thesaurum Hen. 11,1; Deut. 28,12; os 4 Esr. 14,41; Hen. 56,8; Hen. 106,11; Jes. 52,15; aures: ፍታሕ፡ አፉሁ፡ ወእዘኒሁ፡ Kuf. 12; manus: ፈቲሐከ፡ እዴከ፡ Ps. 103,29; እደዊሃ፡ ፈትሐት፡ ለምስኪናን፡ Prov. 29,38; Deut. 15,8; oculos Gen. 21,19; librum Asc. Jes. 9,22; vomicam: ርጢናት፡ እለ፡ ይፈትሓ፡ ሕብጠተ፡ F.M. 3,3. 2 solvere, exsolvere, resolvere, vincula: መኑ፡ ፈትሐ፡ ማእሰሮ፡ Job 39,5; Jes. 58,6; Act. 22,30; cingulum: ኢይፈትሑ፡ ቅናቶሙ፡ (እምሐቌሆሙ፡) Jes. 5,27; frenum Hen. 46,4; vestes: ኢንፈትሕ፡ አልባሲነ፡ 2 Esr. 14,23; calceum: Ruth 4,7; sigillum Apoc. 5,2; Apoc. 6,3; crinem: አንስት፡ ሶበ፡ ይጠመቃ፡ ሥዕርቶን፡ ይፍትሓ፡ Kid. f. 26; corrigiam Marc. 1,7; ፍታሕ፡ አሣእኒከ፡ እምእገሪከ፡ Jes. 20,2; Ex. 3,5; Jos. 5,15; Act. 7,33; anathema, fascinum Matth. 16,19; Hen. 8,3; Hen. 95,4; vinctum vinculis: Kuf. 22; Kuf. 48; ናሁ፡ ፈታሕኩከ፡ እምነ፡ መዋቅሕቲከ፡ Jer. 47,4; Ps. 104,18; Jes. 14,17; Judith 6,14; Matth. 21,2; Joh. 11,44; ፈታሕኮኑ፡ እምሕማም፡ Job 39,2. a remissum reddere: ይፈትሕ፡ እደወ፡ ሰብእ፡ ἐκλύει Jer. 45,4. b solvere, dissolvere, resolvere, i.e. α discindere, dirumpere, irritum facere: ከመ፡ ይፍታሕ፡ ግብሮ፡ ለጋኔን፡ 1 Joh. 3,8 rom.; ፈቲሐ፡ ፍኅረት፡ F.N. 24,3; ብእሲት፡ ዘኀደገት፡ ምታ፡ ወትፈትሕ፡ ሰብሳበ፡ ዘሕግ፡ Kedr f. 78; praeceptum Matth. 5,19. β intermittere: ፍታሕ፡ ጾመከ፡ በሰንበት፡ Exp. Fid. Nic. c dimittere, α reum, captivum: Matth. 27,26; Act. 16,35; Act. 26,32. β populum congregatum Matth. 14,15; Matth. 14,23. d absolvere aliquem in judicio vel a peccato: ፍትሖሙ፡ ወስረይ፡ ኀጢአቶሙ፡ Genz. f. 68; Reg. Pach.; Lit. 160,3. 3 controversiam dirimere i.e. jus dicere, judicare, dijudicare, ፍትሑ፡ እስኩ፡ ለሊክሙ፡ Job 13,8; Joh. 7,24; c. ለ፡ litigantium: ዘይፈትሕ፡ ለነ፡ Job 9,33 (coll. Gen. 16,5); c. Acc. litigantium: Ex. 18,16; c. ማእከለ፡ Gen. 16,5; Gen. 31,53; Jud. 11,27; 1 Reg. 24,13; 1 Reg. 24,16; Jes. 5,3; c. Acc. sententiae: ፍትሑ፡ ፍትሐ፡ Jer. 21,12; Jes. 59,4; 3 Reg. 3,28; ይፈትሑ፡ ርቱዐ፡ Prov. 8,15; Luc. 7,43; Joh. 7,24. a jus dicere vel judicium facere alicui i.e. ei jus reddere, ejus jus tueri, c. ለ፡ pers.: አልቦ፡ ዘይፈትሕ፡ ሊተ፡ Job 19,7; ፈቲሕ፡ ለጻድቅ፡ Job 36,17; Sir. 32,22; Sir. 35,16; ፍትሑ፡ ለእጓለ፡ ማውታ፡ Jes. 1,17; Jes. 49,4; Jes. 51,22; Jer. 5,28; Dan. 7,22; Ps. 7,9; Ps. 53,1; Ps. 81,3; ፍታሕ፡ ሊተ፡ ፍትሕየ፡ Jer. 20,12; vel ፍትሐኪ፡ እፈትሕ፡ Jes. 49,25; c. እምነ፡ ab aliquo vindicare jus alicui: ፍታሕ፡ ሊተ፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ Jer. 11,20; 2 Reg. 18,19; 2 Reg. 18,31. b judicare i.e. punire sontem: Kuf. p. 56. c sententiam pronuntiare contra aliquem, c. ላዕለ፡, ut: ፈትሐ፡ ላዕሌሃ፡ Lud. ex Sx. Mag. 5 Enc. d decernere, sancire, de legislatore: እግዚአብሔር፡ ፈትሐ፡ በሕግ፡ ብሊት፡ ከመ፡ ይምሐል፡ ብእሲ፡ በጽድቅ፡ F.M. 22,1; nec non de lege ipsa: ሕግ፡ ብሊት፡ ፈትሐት፡ (lege Veteris Testamenti sancitum est) ከመ፡ ይቅትሉ፡ … ወሕግሰ፡ ሐዳስ፡ ኢፈትሐት፡ ከመዝ፡ F.M. 4,2.

woorden.betekenis: aperiendum, exsolvendum, curare, jus, dicendum, demandare
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 aperiendum vel exsolvendum curare sanguinem i.e. venam, sanguinis emittendi causa: ለእመ፡ ብእሲ፡ አፍትሐ፡ ደመ፡ ድኅረ፡ ቍርባን፡ (sic legendum videtur) Kedr f. 86. 2 jus dicendum demandare alicui, c. dupl. Acc.: ኢያፈትሕዎሙ፡ ፍትሐ፡ ኵነኔ፡ Sir. 38,33.

woorden.betekenis: aperiri, solvi, exsolvi, resolvi, dissolvi, remitti, dimitti
woorden.definitie: III,1 aperiri, de oculis: Gen. 3,5; Gen. 3,7; Hen. 32,6; Hen. 90,10; Marc. 7,34 rom.; መዓምቃት፡ ተፈትሑ፡ Hen. 89,7. 2 solvi, exsolvi, resolvi, Sir. 22,16; Job 41,8 var.; de vinculis: Marc. 7,35; ተፈትሐ፡ ማኅሜሁ፡ እምነ፡ መዝራዕቱ፡ Jud. 15,14; de ligatis vel vinctis ከመ፡ ጣዕዋ፡ ዘተፈትሐ፡ እማእሰሩ፡ Mal. 3,20; Luc. 13,16; ሕቡስ፡ ለእመ፡ ተፈትሐ፡ እሞቅሑ፡ Jsp. p. 381; Apoc. 20,3; Apoc. 20,7; de aqua, quae glacie solvitur: ወተፈትሐ፡ ማይ፡ (ዘረግዐ፡) Sx. Mij. 25; transl.: ወይትፈታሕ፡ ማእሰረ፡ ተዋስቦ፡ F.M. 12,5. a dissolvi: ተፈትሐ፡ መሌሊተ፡ ሐቌሁ፡ Dan. 5,6; Hen. 60,3. b remitti: ተፈትሐት፡ ኀጢአታ፡ Jes. 40,2. c dimitti, absolvi: ተፈቲሖሙ፡ Act. 4,23. 3 judicari, de personis: ይትፈትሑ፡ Can. Ant. 13. a dici vel pronuntiari, de sententia judicis: ተፈትሐ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ፍትሐ፡ ሞት፡ F.N. 34. b decerni, sanciri: ተወሰነ፡ ወተፈትሐ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ምእመናን፡ seq. ከመ፡ c. Subj., F.M. 10,3; F.M. 25,2.

woorden.betekenis: judicium, sententia, causa, forensis, lis, litigium, praemiu
woorden.definitie: subst., m. et fem. (ut Job 32,10), Pl. ፍትሓት፡ et አፍታሕ፡, 1 judicium, a actus judicandi: Ex. 23,3; Ex. 23,6; Lev. 19,15; Lev. 19,35; Deut. 1,17; Deut. 17,8; Jes. 11,3; Koh. 8,5; Sir. 42,2; ፍትሐ፡ ጽድቅ፡ Jes. 58,2; ይከውን፡ ፍትሕ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ Hen. 1,7; ከመ፡ ይግበር፡ ፍትሐ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ Hen. 1,9; Ps. 9,17; Ps. 139,13; Jer. 7,5; አድኀሩ፡ ፍትሐ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ Jsp. p. 315. b sententia judicis: Ex. 18,15; Deut. 17,9; Deut. 17,11; ሰምዑ፡ ዘንተ፡ ፍትሐ፡ ዘፈትሐ፡ ንጉሥ፡ 3 Reg. 3,28; Ps. 16,3; Ps. 18,10; Ps. 96,9; Sir. 38,33 (vid. አፍትሐ፡); ኰነንከ፡ ፍትሐ፡ ዐመፃ፡ Dan. apocr. 1,53; አግብኡ፡ ፍትሐ፡ Marc. 14,64; Joh. 7,24; ኢያቅልሉ፡ ፍትሓቲሁ፡ (ለፈታሒ፡) F.N. 43,2; c. ለ፡ seu Dat. comm.: እግዚአብሔር፡ ይሁብ፡ ፍትሐ፡ ለነዳያን፡ Job 36,6; ይገብር፡ ፍትሐ፡ ለግዩር፡ Deut. 10,18; Gen. 30,20; Jer. 20,12; በከመ፡ ክብሩ፡ ያገብኡ፡ ሎቱ፡ ፍትሐ፡ Sir. 8,14. c causa forensis, lis: በአፍታሒሆሙ፡ 3 Reg. 10,9; Did. 10(vid. sub ቅሥት፡); ፍትሐ፡ ከናፍርየ፡ κρίσις (litigium) Job 13,6. d „praemium ex sententia reportatum“: አንበሩ፡ ፍትሐ፡ ለዘ፡ ሞአ፡ በምሳሌሁ፡ Lud. ex Org. Edz. 2 jus, quod justum vel legitimum est, Gen. 18,19; Prov. 1,3; Job 32,10; Hab. 1,4; Jes. 1,21; Jes. 10,2; Jes. 16,5; Jes. 40,14; በርትዕ፡ ወፍትሕ፡ ወጽድቅ፡ Jer. 4,2; Jer. 5,1; Jer. 5,4; ዳዊት፡ ይገብር፡ ፍትሐ፡ ወጽድቀ፡ 2 Reg. 8,15; Jer. 5,1; Kuf. 4; Kuf. 20; Ps. 98,4; ወለጠ፡ ፍትሐ፡ Job 34,12. a causa justa: Job 9,15; ሜጠ፡ ፍትሐ፡ የዋሃን፡ Job 36,15; ዘይፈቱ፡ ያዕምፅ፡ ፍትሐ፡ Sir. 20,4; Ex. 23,6; Deut. 24,17; Deut. 27,19; ከመ፡ ያስተራትዕ፡ ፍትሖ፡ ለቢጹ፡ Sir. 19,25. b jus quatenus est norma judicandi et complectitur leges et statuta: ፍትሕየ፡ δικαιώματα καὶ κρίσεις Lev. 25,18; Kuf. 3; ፍትሐ፡ ሕግ፡ ያአምሩ፡ Kuf. 3; Dan. 9,5; ፍትሐ፡ ኵነኔየ፡ Num. 27,11; Num. 35,29; Deut. 4,1; Deut. 4,5; Deut. 4,8; Deut. 4,14; በከመ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ፍትሕ፡ Num. 35,24; ትእዛዝ፡ ወፍትሕ፡ . p. 305 n. 16; ፍትሓተ፡ ሕገጊሁ፡ Kuf. p. 165; ፍትሓት፡ F.N. in prol.; ፍትሐ፡ ነገሥት፡ inscriptus est Nomocanon Abyssinorum celeberrimus. c jus quatenus opponitur gratiae: አኮ፡ በፍትሕ፡ non jure (sed gratia), Org. 5.

woorden.betekenis: apertio, exordium, aditus, meatus, solutio, absolutio, dijud
woorden.definitie: n. act. et subst., Pl. ፍትሐታት፡ 1 apertio i.e. a exordium: በፍትሐተ፡ ቃል፡ Ex. 15,1. b aditus, meatus, Judith 4,7 var.; Judith 5,1 var.; Judith 7,7 var. (vid. sub ፍሥሐት፡ col. 1351). 2 solutio F.M. 2,11 (vid. እስረት፡). 3 absolutio: ጸግወነ፡ እግዚኦ፡ ንስሓ፡ ወፍትሐተ፡ እምነ፡ ኀጣውኢነ፡ Kedr f. 34; ጸሎተ፡ ፍትሐት፡ Genz. f. 25; ጸሎተ፡ ፍትሐት፡ ዘወልድ፡ vel ፍትሐት፡ ዘወልድ፡ inscripta est oratio quaedam absolutionis Genz. f. 52; Kedr f. 58; Lit. 160,2; ፍትሐታት፡ F.N. 15. 4 dijudicatio, judicium, F.N. 43,4; ፍትሐተ፡ ኵነኔ፡ F.N. 46; ፍትሐታት፡ F.N. in Prol.

woorden.betekenis: frustum, frustulum, portio, donum, datum, munus, aliud
woorden.definitie: subst. (m.), Pl. ፍተት፡ 1 frustum, frustulum rei esculentae, panis: ፍት፡ ጥዑም፡ ምስለ፡ ሰላም፡ ψωμός Prov. 17,1; ፍተ፡ ኅብስት፡ Prov. 28,21; 3 Reg. 17,11 var.; Jud. 19,5; ἄρτος εἷς 1 Reg. 2,36 var.; Pl. ፍተት፡ M.M. f. 332. 2 portio, Jer. 52,34 (vid. sub ፈተተ፡); hospiti data: ፍተ፡ ሐምል፡ ξενισμὸς μετὰ λαχάνων Prov. 15,17. 3 donum, datum, munus: ፍቱ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ብእሲት፡ የዋህ፡ δόσις Sir. 26,14; δόμα Sir. 38,2; ፍተክሙ፡ ትነሥኡ፡ Dan. 2,6; Dan. 2,48; ፍተ፡ መንግሥትከ፡ ሀብ፡ ለባዕድ፡ Dan. 5,17; Jac. 1,17; χάρισμα 1 Petr. 4,10; Lit. 161,4. – Voc. Ae.: ፍት፡ ዘ፡ ክፍል፡; aliud: ፍቶ፡ (sic) ዘ፡ ፈንታ።

woorden.betekenis: frustum, donum
woorden.definitie: subst. 1 frustum: ፍታ፡ (v. ፍተ፡, v. ፍታተ፡, Lud.: ፍተተ፡) ኅብስት፡ ψωμὸς ἄρτου 3 Reg. 17,11; Jud. 19,5 var. 2 donum, Lud. ex Org. Edz.

woorden.betekenis: scrutari, perscrutari, explorare, investigare, pervestigare,
woorden.definitie: I,1 [فتن] Subj. ይፍትን፡ 1 scrutari, perscrutari, explorare, investigare, pervestigare, ut domos, urbes, terram, thesauros, abscondita al.: እፈትና፡ ለኢየሩሳሌም፡ በማኅቶት፡ Zeph. 1,12; ፍትንዋ፡ ከመ፡ በአት፡ Jer. 27,26; Ob. 6; Jes. 22,8; Gen. 31,35; Gen. 31,37; Prov. 2,4; Prov. 20,27; 1 Reg. 23,23; 3 Reg. 20,6; እንዘ፡ ይፈትን፡ ንዋዮሙ፡ Kuf. 43; aliquem: Job 7,18; animum alicujus: Ps. 25,2; Sap. 6,4; ዘይፈትን፡ ልበ፡ ወኵልያተ፡ Jer. 11,20; Jer. 12,3; Jer. 17,10; Ps. 7,10; Ps. 16,4; Apoc. 2,23; abs.: ፍትን፡ Kuf. 43; Gen. 31,33; c. በእንተ፡, ut: ለኀሢሥ፡ ወለፈቲን፡ በእንተ፡ ኵሉ፡ (v. ለኵሉ፡) ዘተገብረ፡ Koh. 1,13; እስኩ፡ ፍትን፡ ለሊከ፡ በልብከ፡ በአይቴ፡ ይቀልል፡ አበሳ፡ በዲበ፡ ምድር፡ ወሚመ፡ … Clem. f. 266. a speculari, Lev. 13,36. b per speculatores explorare terram, urbem: 2 Reg. 10,3; ከመ፡ ይፍትን፡ ሀገረ፡ 1 Par. 19,3; Jud. 5,14 (?). c scrutando assequi Koh. 12,9. 2 tentare, probare, examinare, igne metalla aliasve res: Jes. 1,25; ኣረስኖሙ፡ ወእፈትኖሙ፡ Jer. 9,7; Zach. 13,9; Sx. Genb. 2; ለንዋየ፡ ለብሓ፡ እሳት፡ ይፈትኖ፡ Sir. 27,5; aliquem auri instar: ፈተነኒ፡ ከመ፡ ወርቅ፡ Job 23,10; Ps. 65,9; Ps. 16,4; scientiam alicujus: 3 Reg. 10,1; candidatum F.N. 5; c. dupl. Acc.: ይፍትንዎ፡ ሕገገ፡ (sc. num legum peritus sit necne) F.N. 4. a Deum tentare, Ps. 94,9; Hebr. 3,9. b experiri, experimentum facere rei: ትሡዕኑ፡ (ለጣዖታት፡) ወሚመ፡ ትፈትንኑ፡ ኵነኔየ፡ (interrogat judex martyrem) Sx. Mag. 17.

woorden.betekenis: explorari, investigari, tentari, probari
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 explorari, investigari: መንፈስ፡ ሕያው፡ ወቅዱስ፡ ዘኢይትፈተን፡ Lit. Joh. 2 tentari, probari: ወርቅ፡ ይትፈተን፡ በምንሃብ፡ Sap. 3,6; Prov. 17,3; ተፈትኑ፡ Sx. Hed. 24 Enc.; እለ፡ ተመከሩ፡ ወተፈትኑ፡ Chrys. Ta. 8; Sx. Genb. 2 (vid. sub ተነጥፈ፡).

woorden.betekenis: dilatando, aperiendo;, inhiare, cupire, concupiscere, appete
woorden.definitie: , rarius ፈትወ፡ (Act. 25,25 Platt; Deut. 14,26 al.) I,1 [פתה ܦܬܐ فتا; origo est in dilatando et aperiendo; inde derivatur inhiare ] Subj. ይፍተው፡ vel ይፍቶ፡ et ይፍትው፡ vel ይፍቱ፡, cupire, concupiscere, appetere, desiderare, exoptare, ἐπιθυμεῖν, c. Acc. Ex. 20,17; Ex. 34,24; ፈቲውየ፡ Num. 16,15 var.; Deut. 5,18; Deut. 7,25; Deut. 12,20; Deut. 14,26; Jos. 7,21; 1 Reg. 2,16; 2 Reg. 3,21; Ps. 44,13; Ps. 118,40; Koh. 6,2; ኢትፍቱ፡ መባልዕቲሁ፡ Prov. 23,6; እመ፡ ወሀብካሃ፡ ዘትፈቱ፡ ለነፍስከ፡ Sir. 18,31; Sap. 6,14; ዘይፈትዋ፡ ለመንሱት፡ ὁ ἀγαπῶν κίνδυνον Sir. 3,26; እዝነ፡ ማእምር፡ ትፈቱ፡ ጥበበ፡ Sir. 3,29; ኢፈተውኩ፡ መሥዋዕተከ፡ Jes. 43,24, ፈተውዋ፡ ἐγένοντο ἐν ἐπιθυμίᾳ αὐτῆς Dan. apocr. 1,8; Hen. 6,2; Hen. 39,8; 1 Tim. 3,1; Gal. 5,17; 1 Cor. 10,6; Matth. 5,28; ፈተዉ፡ ፍትወተ፡ Num. 11,4; Ps. 105,15; c. በ፡ Hen. 15,4; c. Acc. et Subj. verbi: ፈተዋ፡ በነፍሱ፡ ይስክብ፡ ምስሌሃ፡ Judith 12,16; Luc. 22,15; c. Subj. verbi: Matth. 13,17; Luc. 15,16; Luc. 16,21; Luc. 17,22; እምፈተውኩ፡ ለልየ፡ እትጐርዐይ፡ Job 30,24; ከመ፡ ይፈቱ፡ ኅጽው፡ ወለተ፡ ድንግለ፡ ከማሁ፡ ዘይፈቱ፡ ያዕምፅ፡ ፍትሐ፡ Sir. 20,4; ይፈትዉ፡ ያእምሩ፡ Jes. 58,2; seq. ከመ፡ c. Subj.: Deut. 18,6; c. Acc. Infin.: Act. 25,25; ኢትፍቱ፡ ሀልዎ፡ ምስሌሆሙ፡ Prov. 24,1. a abs.: concupiscere, Rom. 7,7; Rom. 13,9; እንበለ፡ ትፍተው፡ (de virgine) Sir. 42,9. b voluptatem percipere Cant. 2,3. c promtum esse Matth. 26,41. d delectari aliquo, c. ላዕለ፡ Kuf. p. 74; c. Acc., Kuf. p. 75. – Voc. Ae.: ፈተወ፡ ዘ፡ ቈለጠ፡ ወደደሂ፡ ይ፡

woorden.betekenis: cupiditas, concupiscentia, appetitus, libido, desiderium, re
woorden.definitie: (etiam ፍቶት፡ Lud. e Cant. Mar.), n. act. et subst., m. et fem., Pl. ፍትወታት፡ cupiditas a concupiscentia, appetitus, libido: Ps. 9,24; Ps. 77,33; Num. 11,34; Num. 11,35; Sir. 23,5, ተዐገሥ፡ እምፍትወተ፡ እኩይ፡ (v. እምፍትወት፡) ὀρέξεων Sir. 18,30; ፍትወተ፡ ልቡ፡ Sir. 27,6; እምኵሉ፡ ፍትወተ፡ ብእሲ፡ ይእቲ፡ ተዐቢ፡ Sir. 36,27; እኪት፡ ፍትወት፡ Sir. 37,3; Jer. 9,14; Jer. 16,12; ፍትወተ፡ ረሲዓን፡ Prov. 12,12; ፍትወት፡ (collect.) ይቀትላሁ፡ Prov. 21,25; ፍትወተ፡ ረባሕ፡ Sap. 14,2; ፍትወቱ፡ ለሥጋ፡ vel ለዐይን፡ 1 Joh. 2,16; 1 Petr. 2,11; Rom. 6,12; Rom. 7,7 seq.; Gal. 5,16; Gal. 5,24; Joh. 8,44; Marc. 4,19 al.; concupiscentia carnalis vel venerea Dan. apocr. 1,11; Dan. apocr. 1,56; Jer. 2,24;Lud. Comm. hist. p. 316; al.; ሕማመ፡ ፍትወተ፡ ዝሙት፡ Lud. e Vit. Dan.; ፍትወታቲሁ፡ ለዝ፡ ዓለም፡ Phlx. 3; Clem. f. 153; ለእመ፡ ፈተውነ፡ ፍትወታተ፡ ንሕነ፡ ንረክብ፡ Sx. Sen. 16. b desiderium et res desiderata: Ps. 9,41; Ps. 20,2; Ps. 37,9; Ps. 111,9; ኢያደምዕ፡ ፍትወቶ፡ Job 20,20; ያጸግበከ፡ እምፍትወተ፡ ነፍስከ፡ Jes. 58,11; ፍትወታ፡ ለጥበብ፡ Sap. 6,21. c deliciae: ፍትወተ፡ አዕይንቲሆሙ፡ ἐπιθυμήματα Hez. 24,25; Thren. 1,7; Thren. 1,10; እለ፡ ይገብሩ፡ ፍትወተ፡ ነፍሶሙ፡ καταθύμια Jes. 44,9; ኵሉ፡ ፍትወት፡ ὅλος ἐπιθυμία Cant. 5,16; ብእሴ፡ ፍትወት፡ አንተ፡ Dan. 9,23; Dan. 10,11; Dan. 10,19. d studium, προαίρεσις Koh. 1,14; Koh. 2,11; Koh. 2,22. e voluntas Dei, 1 Joh. 2,17.

woorden.betekenis: cupitor, cupidus, libidinosus
woorden.definitie: n. ag., Pl. ፈታውያን፡ 1 cupitor, cupidus: ፈታውያነ፡ ጽዕለት፡ ἐπιθυμηταί Prov. 1,22; ፈታውያነ፡ እከይ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ἐρασταί Sap. 15,6. 2 libidinosus: ኢትኩን፡ ፈታዌ፡ Lud. Comm.hist. p. 316 n. 52; ዕቡያን፡ ወፈታውያን፡ Clem. f. 232.

woorden.betekenis: desiderabilis, exoptatus, res, jucundus, amoenus, praestans,
woorden.definitie: part., passim subst., 1 desiderabilis, exoptatus, passim res desiderabilis, ግበር፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘመፍትው፡ ዘትፈቅድ፡ τὰ ἐνθυμήματά σου Sir. 35,12. a sive jucundus, amoenus, sive praestans, eximius, sive pretiosus, carus, ἐπιθυμητός, መፍትው፡ ለዐይን፡ ሰርጉ፡ Sir. 45,12; ኵሉ፡ ግብሩ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ሠናይ፡ ወመፍትው፡ Sir. 42,22; ወይን፡ መፍትው፡ Am. 5,11; Jes. 27,2; መዝገብ፡ መፍትው፡ Prov. 21,20; ይነሥቱ፡ አብያተኪ፡ መፍትወ፡ Hez. 26,12; በእንተ፡ ምድረ፡ ሕዝብየ፡ መፍትው፡ Jes. 32,12; Ps. 105,24; ኵሎ፡ ንዋየ፡ መፍትወ፡ (v. መፍትው፡) Dan. 11,8; መፍትወ፡ ኣየድዕ፡ σεμνὰ ἐρῶ Prov. 8,6. b necessarius: አስተዳለውኩ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ሕንጻ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘመፍትው፡ ἐπιτήδεια 1 Par. 28,2. c conveniens, decorus: ውስተ፡ ኢመፍትው፡ εἰς τὸ ἀπηχές (in absonum vel absurdum) Cyr. c. Pall. f. 85. d reus: ፀረ፡ ደቅከ፡ መፍትዋን፡ ለመዊት፡ ὀφειλομένους Sap. 12,20 in Abb. LV. Hinc propagatur tritissimum illud 2 መፍትው፡ decet, convenit, oportet (ينبغي), δεῖ, χρή, c.c. Infin., ut: ተግሕሦ፡ መፍትው፡ እምፍኖት፡ ፀዋግ፡ Prov. 22,14; plerumque c. Subj. verbi: Matth. 14,16; Matth. 18,33; Matth. 23,23; Hen. 9,11; Hen. 15,2; ቀሲስ፡ መፍትው፡ ያንሶሱ፡ ኀበ፡ አብያተ፡ ድውያን፡ Kid. f. 16; መፍትው፡ ኤጲስ፡ ቆጶስ፡ ይፍታሕ፡ በርትዕ፡ Did. 4; መፍትው፡ ለኤጲስ፡ ቆጶሳት፡ ይንበሩ፡ … Did. 4; creberrime in Chrys., F.M., F.N., Syn. al. a ኢመፍትው፡ non licet: እመ፡ ገብረ፡ ዘኢመፍትው፡ Clem. f. 255; . 307. b መፍትው፡ utinam! in exclamationibus, ut: መፍትው፡ ይሕየው፡ ይስማኤል፡ ቅድሜከ፡ Kuf. 15.

woorden.betekenis: via
woorden.definitie: via vid. sub ፈነወ፡

woorden.betekenis: , ፊንቆን፡ al. vid. sub ፊኒቃ፡
woorden.definitie: , ፊንቆን፡ al. vid. sub ፊኒቃ፡

woorden.betekenis: vertere, se, redire, mittere, super, contra, ad, per, cum, e
woorden.definitie: I,2 [פָּנָה vertere et se vertere, ܦܢܐ redire ] 1 mittere, a c. Acc. pers.: ፈንወኒ፡ Jes. 6,8; Jes. 48,16; Gen. 42,4; Gen. 43,8; Ex. 5,22; Num. 13,2; Num. 13,3; 1 Reg. 25,32; 3 Reg. 1,6; Act. 25,25; Joh. 4,34; Joh. 5,23 al.; omisso Acc.: Gen. 38,17; Matth. 14,35; ፈኒዋ፡ ርብቃ፡ ጸውዐት፡ ያዕቆብሃ፡ Kuf. 27; seq. verbo fin.: ፈነወ፡ ወቀተለ፡ Matth. 2,16; Marc. 6,17; Ps. 17,19; Ps. 56,4; seq. Subj. verbi: Matth. 22,7; Luc. 4,19; 4 Esr. 4,36; 4 Reg. 7,14; vel ከመ፡ c. Subj.: Num. 13,16; Num. 14,36; Deut. 34,11; Jos. 6,25; 1 Reg. 15,1; Luc. 16,24; c. ኀበ፡ pers. Gen. 32,4; Gen. 46,28; Ex. 3,13; Ex. 3,14; Ex. 3,15; Num. 20,14; Jud. 11,12; Jud. 14,1; 2 Reg. 2,5; Jes. 36,12; Jer. 32,3; Jer. 36,3; Matth. 11,2; Act. 23,30; Tit. 3,12; c. praep. loci: ፈነዉ፡ ኀበ፡ ኵሉ፡ አድያም፡ Matth. 14,35; c. ውስተ፡ Jud. 6,35; Jud. 7,24; Jer. 2,10; c. መንገለ፡ Jer. 14,3; c. ቅድመ፡ Gen. 45,5; Luc. 7,27; c. እምድኅረ፡ Gen. 8,8; al.; c. Acc. loci: Matth. 2,8; ፈነወ፡ ሐዋርያተ፡ ብሔረ፡ ግብጽ፡ Hez. 17,15; Gen. 32,4; እመ፡ ፈነዎሙ፡ ፀብአ፡ (in bellum) 1 Esr. 4,4; c. Acc. viae 1 Reg. 15,20. b c. Acc. rei: Gen. 38,23; Gen. 45,23; Gen. 45,27; Gen. 46,5; Ex. 9,14; Ex. 23,28; Jos. 24,12; Ps. 104,26; Koh. 11,1; Marc. 4,29; c. ለ፡ pers.: Gen. 32,19; Gen. 38,17; Gen. 38,20; Ps. 19,2; Ps. 77,29; Ps. 109,3; Ps. 110,8; c. ላዕለ፡ pers. ( super vel contra vel ad aliquem): ፈነወ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ሞተ፡ ላዕለ፡ ያዕቆብ፡ Jes. 9,8; Lev. 26,25; Deut. 7,20; Hez. 14,19; Hez. 14,21; ፈኑ፡ ላዕሌየ፡ መንፈሰ፡ ቅዱሰ፡ 4 Esr. 14,24; Luc. 24,49; c. በእደ፡ per aliquem, Kuf. 22; vel c. ምስለ፡ cum aliquo i.e. per aliquem: Gen. 38,20; 1 Reg. 16,20; 2 Reg. 11,14; Apoc. 1,1 Platt; ዘይፌኑ፡ አንቅዕተ፡ ውስተ፡ ቈላት፡ ( emittit ) Ps. 103,11. c passim: extendere, protendere manum, Ps. 143,8; Cant. 5,4; ኢትፈኑ፡ እዴከ፡ ዲበ፡ ሕፃን፡ Kuf. 18. d emittere, projicere sagittas: ፈኑ፡ አሕጻከ፡ Kuf. 38; Ps. 17,16; Ps. 143,7. 2 dimittere, missum facere: Kuf. 5; Kuf. 27; Kuf. 42; Gen. 24,54; Gen. 30,25; Gen. 32,27; Gen. 45,24; Ex. 3,20; Ex. 4,23; Lev. 14,53; Jos. 2,21; Jud. 2,6; Jud. 3,18; Jud. 7,8; Jud. 11,38; Jud. 15,5; 1 Reg. 6,6; 1 Reg. 9,19; 1 Reg. 10,25; 1 Reg. 13,2; 1 Reg. 24,20; Jer. 15,1; Tob. 10,7; 2 Esr. 12,6; Hen. 10,9; Matth. 14,22; Luc. 1,53; Luc. 20,10; Luc. 20,11 al. a abeuntem deducere, prosequi, Gen. 12,20; Gen. 18,16; Gen. 31,27; 1 Reg. 9,26; Act. 20,38 (vid. አስተፋነው፡). b manumittere servum, sive addito አግዓዜ፡ Jer. 41,9; Deut. 21,14; sive omisso Jer. 41,14. c dimittere vel expellere ( repudiare ) uxorem, feminam, Gen. 21,14; Kuf. 17; ፈነውክዋ፡ ለእምክሙ፡ Jes. 50,1; Mal. 2,16. – Voc. Ae.: ፈነወ፡ ዘ፡ በ፪ ለአከ፡ ሰደደ።

woorden.betekenis: mitti, dirigi, emitti, projici, propelli, dimitti, deduci
woorden.definitie: III,2 1 mitti: ተፈነወ፡ ኀቤየ፡ ፩ እምሱራፌን፡ Jes. 6,6; Jes. 37,21; Hen. 76,4; Asc. Jes. 7,4; Asc. Jes. 7,5; Asc. Jes. 7,8; Asc. Jes. 7,16; Asc. Jes. 7,17; 4 Esr. 2,1; Matth. 15,24; Matth. 23,37; Luc. 1,19; Luc. 1,26; Luc. 4,43; Luc. 19,32; Joh. 1,6; 1 Petr. 1,12; ተፈኒዎሙ፡ 2 Petr. 1,21. a dirigi: ጸሎት፡ እንተ፡ ትትፌኖ፡ ውስተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ መካን፡ 2 Par. 7,15; ለከ፡ ይትፌነው፡ ጸሎት፡ Ps. 64,1. b emitti, projici: ተፈነወ፡ ቃል፡ Sx. Sen. 17Enc.; ተፈነወ፡ ኲናት፡ ኀቤሁ፡ Chrys. Ta. 22 (vid. ደርበየ፡). c propelli Hen. 10,6. 2 dimitti Hebr. 13,23; deduci Rom. 15,24; Act. 15,3. 3 i.q. ተፋነወ፡, Act. 21,6 rom. et Platt.

woorden.betekenis: via, iter, meatus, aditus, exitus, transitus, plateae, orbit
woorden.definitie: subst., fem. et m., Pl. ፍናው፡ et ፍናዌ፡, Pl. Pl. ፍናዋት፡ (formam Pl. ፍንዋት፡ in Syn. p. 314 seq., formam ፍኖታት፡ Hen. 19,19 var. reperi) via, 1 iter, quod quis facit: ይሜርድ፡ ፍኖቶ፡ Ps. 18,6; ከመ፡ ጾር፡ ክቡድ፡ በውስተ፡ ፍኖት፡ ርሑቅ፡ Sir. 21,16; Jos. 9,11; ፍኖተ፡ የሐውር፡ Koh. 10,3; Gen. 24,40; Gen. 24,42; Gen. 28,20; ሥንቅ፡ ለፍኖት፡ Gen. 45,21; Jud. 19,9; Matth. 15,32; በፍኖት፡ Gen. 44,29; Gen. 45,24; Ex. 4,24; Ex. 23,20; 1 Reg. 24,4; 1 Reg. 26,3; Luc. 2,44; ውስተ፡ ፍኖት፡ Matth. 5,25. 2 via, qua inceditur: ቁሚ፡ ውስተ፡ ፍኖት፡ Jer. 31,19; Num. 22,23; Gen. 38,21; 1 Reg. 24,4; 1 Reg. 26,3; Matth. 2,12; Matth. 8,28; Matth. 13,4; Ps. 8,8; ሐዊር፡ ፍኖተ፡ ጠዋየ፡ ወመብእሰ፡ Jer. 18,15; ፍኖት፡ መብእስ፡ ወጐፃጕፅ፡ Clem. f. 200; ሖረ፡ ፍኖተ፡ Job 16,22; Deut. 1,31; Jud. 18,26; Jud. 19,9; ይሠወጥ፡ በፍኖት፡ እንተ፡ ባቲ፡ መጽአ፡ Jes. 37,34; Jud. 2,17; ኣመጽኦሙ፡ ለዕዉራን፡ በፍኖት፡ ዘኢያአምሩ፡ Jes. 42,16; Jes. 48,17; እንተ፡ አይ፡ ፍኖት፡ ነዐርግ፡ 4 Reg. 3,8; ፍኖት፡ እንተ፡ ትወስድ፡ ውስተ፡ ሀጕል፡ Matth. 7,13; Matth. 7,14; ፍኖተ፡ ግበሩ፡ ለዘዐርገ፡ Ps. 67,4; Hez. 21,19; አስተዳልዉ፡ ፍኖቶ፡ Matth. 3,3; ዘይጸይሕ፡ ፍኖተከ፡ Matth. 11,10; Marc. 2,23; ፍናው፡ ርቱዓት፡ Prov. 2,13; ፍናው፡ ዕጹባት፡ Ps. 16,6; ቁሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ፍናው፡ Jer. 6,16; ርእዪ፡ ኵሎ፡ ፍናወ፡ Jer. 3,2; ማእከለ፡ ፍናው፡ ቆመት፡ Prov. 8,2; ፍናወ፡ ዚአኪ፡ ἀποστολαί σου Cant. 4,13; ፍናዋት፡ Judith 5,1; 4 Esr. 6,55; በእንተ፡ ፍናዋት፡ ወጽጐጓት፡ ወመራሕብት፡ F.N. 37; ፍናዌ፡ 4 Reg. 11,6; Lev. 26,22; Deut. 28,7; Deut. 28,25; Jos. 2,22; Jud. 5,6; Judith 15,2; c. Gen. Subj.: ፍኖተ፡ መንፈስ፡ Koh. 11,5; Prov. 24,54; Hen. 18,5; c. Gen. loci, ad quem via ducit: Gen. 3,24; Gen. 25,19; Ex. 13,17; Deut. 1,2; Deut. 2,8; Deut. 3,1; Jos. 8,15; 2 Reg. 18,23; Matth. 10,5; Hebr. 9,8; 4 Esr. 5,6; 4 Esr. 5,7. a quivis meatus, aditus, exitus, transitus, plateae: ፍኖት፡ ኅቡእ፡ εἴσοδος Dan. apocr. 13,13; 2 Petr. 1,11; ውስተ፡ ፍኖተ፡ ባሕር፡ Hez. 27,3; 4 Esr. 5,3; 4 Esr. 5,4; ውስተ፡ ፍናወ፡ አናቅጽ፡ ἐν τοῖς διόδοις Judith 7,22; በፍናዋት፡ ἐν ἐξόδοις Prov. 1,20; በርእሰ፡ ኵሉ፡ ፍናዋት፡ Thren. 2,19; ውስተ፡ ፍናዌ፡ Thren. 2,21; ውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ፍናዋት፡ Jes. 51,20; ፍናዊሃ፡ ለጽዮን፡ ὁδοί Thren. 1,4; Jer. 5,1; ውስተ፡ ፍናወ፡ ሀገር፡ ἐν ῥύμαις πόλεως Sir. 9,7; Act. 9,11 rom.; ፍናወ፡ አህጉር፡ πλατεῖαι Judith 7,14. b orbita astrorum Hen. 2,1; Hen. 80,6. c ፍኖት፡ መጽያሕት፡ vel ፍኖተ፡ መጽያሕት፡ via publica (vid. sub መጽያሕት፡ col. 1309), et ፍኖተ፡ ንጉሥ፡ via regia, p. 238 n. 5. d ፍኖተ፡ Acc. loci et st. constr., passim i.q. versus: ጐዩ፡ በሌሊት፡ እምነ፡ ሀገር፡ ፍኖተ፡ ገነተ፡ ንጉሥ፡ Jer. 46,4 vers. nov., Deut. 1,40; Deut. 2,1; Matth. 4,15. 3 Transl.: a directio i.e. latus, pars (Seite), κλίτος Ex. 30,4; ዘክልኤቱ፡ ፍናዊሁ፡ Lit. Orth. (alias ፍና፡). b via i.e. locus tempusve opportunum: ወሀብኮሙ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ወፍኖተ፡ ከመ፡ ይድኀኑ፡ Sap. 12,20; Eph. 4,27; ግበር፡ ፍኖተ፡ (τόπον locum vel aditum) ለዐቃቤ፡ ሥራይ፡ Sir. 38,12; ኀጥአ፡ ፍኖተ፡ ይነስሕ፡ Hebr. 12,17 rom. c ratio, modus: በፍናው፡ ብዙኅ፡ (καθόδους) Koh. 7,22; በኅቡእ፡ ፍኖት፡ ἠρέμα Chrys. ho. 10(vid. ደጐጸ፡). d creberrime: vivendi agendique ratio (ex usu loquendi biblico), እኩይ፡ ፍኖትከ፡ Job 4,6; ፍናውየ፡ Job 29,6; Job 33,11; ዝፍናው፡ Prov. 1,19; Prov. 2,20; Prov. 2,22; Jes. 55,7; Jes. 55,8; Jes. 55,9; Jes. 58,2; እለ፡ ኢሖሩ፡ በፍኖተ፡ ጽድቅ፡ Jes. 65,2; Tob. 1,2; ኢያአምርዋ፡ ለፍኖተ፡ ሰላም፡ Jes. 59,8; Rom. 3,17; ፍኖተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Jer. 5,4; Jer. 5,5; Jer. 6,16; ፍናዊየ፡ Jer. 7,23; ኢትምሀሩ፡ ፍኖተ፡ አረማውያን፡ Jer. 10,1; አጽንዐ፡ ፍናዌ፡ ዳዊት፡ Sir. 48,22; አሜሃ፡ ይጸድቃ፡ ፍናዊከ፡ ወፍናዌ፡ ውሉድከ፡ Kuf. 22; ዕቀብ፡ ፍናዊሃ፡ Sir. 6,26; Sir. 2,15; ፍናዎሙ፡ (pro ፍናዊሆሙ፡) Sir. 49,9; ፍናዋት፡ ኄራት፡ Hen. 91,4; Hen. 91,18; Hen. 91,19; ፍኖተ፡ ሕይወት፡ ወፍኖተ፡ ሞት፡ Jer. 21,8; 4 Esr. 14,24. fǝnot, Pl. fǝnaw, fǝnāwe, Pl.Pl. fǝnāwāt L አመልዐ፡ ፍኖተ ʾamallǝʿa fǝnota he hastened along the road, vid. አመልዐ፡ 342ab አርትዐ፡ ፍኖቶ ʾartǝʿa fǝnoto he went toward, vid. አርትዐ፡ 475b

woorden.betekenis: cogitavit, attente, dispexit, interpretari, exponere, explic
woorden.definitie: I,2 [huic verbo Lud. فَكَر cogitavit, attente dispexit, Ges. in thes. p. 1141 פתר ܦܫܪ فسر compararunt] interpretari, exponere, explicare, explanare res occultas vel difficiles intellectu, ut somnium Gen. 40,8; Gen. 40,16; Gen. 41,8; Gen. 41,12; Gen. 41,15; Gen. 41,16; Kuf. 39; 4 Esr. 12,16; Dan. 2,16; aenigma 3 Reg. 10,3; parabolam Marc. 4,14; 4 Esr. 8,3; scripturam arcanam (ፈክሮቶ፡) Dan. 5,16; faciem coeli Matth. 16,3; scripturam sacram Luc. 24,32; mysteria spiritualia 1 Cor. 2,13; እፎኬ፡ ይሰምዐኒ፡ ቃልየ፡ ወይፌክሮ፡ διακρινεῖ Job 9,14; ለእመ፡ ትፌክር፡ (ምድር፡) ለከ፡ ἐάν σοι φράσῃ Job 12,8; መኑ፡ ያአምር፡ ፈክሮ፡ ቃሎሙ፡ (v. ፍካሬ፡ ቃሉ፡) Koh. 8,1; ዘኢይትከሀል፡ ይፈክርዎ፡ δυσερμήνευτος Hebr. 5,11. (Lud. addit: 2 „ vaticinari, ὁμιλεῖν, sacra loqui, concionari “ i.e. sine dubio: interpretari scripturam sacram).

woorden.betekenis: interpretatio, expositio, explicatio, tractatus, exegetici,
woorden.definitie: n. act. et subst., Pl. ፍካርያት፡, interpretatio, expositio, explicatio rerum arcanarum, arduarum, ut somnii Gen. 40,12; Gen. 40,18; Jud. 7,15; 4 Esr. 12,13; 4 Esr. 13,21; Dan. 2,4 seq.; Dan. 4,3 seq.; Kuf. 40; visionis Apoc. 1,20; similitudinis Herm. p. 73; 4 Esr. 2,54; 4 Esr. 10,52; ፍካሬ፡ አምሳል፡ Sir. 39,3; አብዛኅከ፡ አምሳሊከ፡ ወፍካሬ፡ ነገርከ፡ Sir. 47,15; ፍካሬ፡ ቃልከ፡ ἐν ἑρμηνείαις σου Sir. 47,17; scripturae arcanae Dan. 5,7 seq.; 2 Petr. 1,20 Platt; mysteriorum et linguarum peregrinarum 1 Cor. 12,10; ፍካሬ፡ ዘጻድቃን፡ ወዘኃጥኣን፡ Ps. 1in tit.; scripturae sacrae vel singulorum ejus locorum; Chrys. creberrime. a ፍካርያተ፡ ዮሐንስ፡ አፈ፡ ወርቅ፡ tractatus exegetici, Fid. Jac. Bar. b significationes „ dissertatio, facultas disserendi “ e Mss. Colb. et „ declaratio i.e. promissio, ut ምድረ፡ ፍካሬ፡“ ex Enc. Patr. affert Lud. c Libellum ፍካሬ፡ ኢየሱስ፡ inscriptum circumferunt Abyssini, vid. Cat. Cod. Ae. Mus. Brit. p. 22; 128; 141; 150; 191.

woorden.betekenis: interpres, fatidicus, hariolus
woorden.definitie: part., fem. መፈክርት፡ interpres, etiam fatidicus, hariolus: መፈክራነ፡ ሕልም፡ Kuf. 40; Gen. 41,8 seq; ልሳን፡ መፈክርት፡ ይእቲ፡ ዘትዜኑ፡ ዘውስተ፡ ኅሊና፡ Phlx. 9; መፈክራን፡ καθηγοῦντες (?) Jud. 5,7; χαλδαῖοι (?) Dan. 4,4; መፈክር፡ በሰዐታት፡ Lud. e Syn. (vid. sub አሠነየ፡).

woorden.betekenis: mederi, medicari, sanare, curare, salubrem, reddere
woorden.definitie: I,2 [شفا] mederi, medicari, sanare, curare, c. Acc. pers.: Gen. 20,17; Tob. 12,14; 4 Reg. 20,5; Ps. 6,2; Luc. 4,23; Luc. 9,2; Luc. 14,4; Matth. 8,16; Matth. 12,22; Marc. 3,15; c. ለ፡ pers.: Sir. 38,14; c. Acc. vulneris vel morbi: Kuf. p. 42; ለቍስል፡ ዐቢይ፡ ይፌውሶ፡ ዐቃቤ፡ ሥራይ፡ Sir. 10,10; Sir. 27,21; Jes. 30,26; Ps. 59,2; Matth. 4,23; Matth. 9,35; c. Acc. pers. et እምነ፡ vulneris vel morbi: ይፌውሰከ፡ እምቍስልከ፡ Jer. 37,17; Ps. 102,3; 4 Reg. 5,6; Luc. 7,21; c. dupl. Acc.: እፌውሰክሙ፡ ቍስለክሙ፡ Jer. 3,22; abs.; ፈውሶ፡ Koh. 3,3; Job 5,18; ይፌውስ፡ ወይሁብ፡ ሕይወተ፡ Sir. 31,20; Luc. 5,17; Matth. 12,10; c. በ፡ remedii Kuf. p. 42; Sir. 38,8. a transl.: Jes. 57,18; Job 19,25 (ἐκλύειν); Kuf. 23; ፈወስናሃ፡ ለባቢሎን፡ ወኢሐይወት፡ Jer. 28,9; መኑ፡ ይፌውሰኪ፡ Thren. 2,13. b sanare i.e. salubrem reddere aquam: ይፌውሶ፡ ለማይ፡ ὑγιάσει τὰ ὕδατα Hez. 47,8.

woorden.betekenis: medela, sanatio, curatio, insanabilis, medicamen, medicament
woorden.definitie: subst. (m.), Pl. ፈውሳት፡ 1 medela, sanatio, curatio: ፈውስ፡ ይከውነከ፡ ለሥጋከ፡ Prov. 3,8; Jer. 14,19; Ps. 37,3; ደዌ፡ ከርሥ፡ ዘኢተረክበ፡ ሎቱ፡ ፈውስ፡ 2 Par. 21,18; አልባቲ፡ ፈውስ፡ ለቍስላ፡ Sir. 21,3; ቈጽሉ፡ ይከውን፡ ለፈውስ፡ Hez. 47,12; Hen. 67,8; Hen. 67,13; ለገቢረ፡ ፈውስ፡ Chrys. Ta. 9(vid. sub ዐቃር፡); ዘአልቦ፡ ፈውሰ፡ insanabilis Deut. 28,27; transl.: አልባ፡ እንከ፡ ፈውሰ፡ ሞአብ፡ ἰατρεία Jer. 31,2; ይሁበኒ፡ ፈውሰ፡ Job 23,5; Koh. 10,4; ለፈውስ፡ ወለሰላም፡ ወለበረከት፡ Kuf. p. 5; Kuf. p. 87; Hen. 95,4. 2 medicamen, medicamentum, remedium, Kuf. 10; ፈውሰ፡ ደዌሆሙ፡ et ፈውሳት፡ Kuf. 10; አብዛኅኪ፡ ፈውሰኪ፡ Jer. 26,11; ፈውስ፡ ጽኑዕ፡ φάρμακον ἰσχυρόν Chrys. ho. 17; ፈውስ፡ መሪር፡ Chrys. ho. 30; ἰατρικὰ βοηθήματα Chrys. Ta. 9(vid. sub ዐቃር፡); Clem. f. 256; Org. 5; መጽሐፈ፡ ፈውስ፡ inscriptus est libellus Amh. Aethiopicus, in quo varia medicamenta variis morbis praecipiuntur; ፈውስ፡ መንፈሳዊ፡ inscriptus est liber de disciplina ecclesiastica, Cat. Bibl. Bodl. p. 30. a herba ( radix, fructus ) medicinalis: die creationis tertio creavit Deus ሣዕረ፡ ወሐመልማለ፡ ወዕፀወ፡ ወዘርአ፡ ወፈውሰ፡ Clem. f. 3; terram peragrabo ከመ፡ ኣእምር፡ ዕፀወ፡ ወፍሬያተ፡ ወፈውሳተ፡ ዘሀለወ፡ ሀየ፡ Clem. f. 28. b incantamentum: ዘይሰምዕ፡ ነገረ፡ ፈውሳት፡ ወይትአመን፡ ቦቱ፡ Clem. f. 162; ዘይገብር፡ ሥራየ፡ ወሰገለ፡ ወይሰምዕ፡ ነገረ፡ ፈውሳት፡ ወይትአመን፡ Clem. f. 239; Clem. f. 272. c abortivum (medicamentum) F.M. 4,4 (vid. sub አድኀፀ፡). d collyrium (medicamen) Apoc. 3,18; vid. እበነ፡ ፈውስ፡ stibium supra col. 759.

woorden.betekenis: soluto pretio redimere, solvere, persolvere, reddere, restit
woorden.definitie: I,1 [פָּדָה فَدَا soluto pretio redimere, quam significationem Aethiopes sub ቤዘወ፡ habent] Subj. ይፍዲ፡ (Imperat. ፍደይ፡ exhibet Platt 2 Cor. 6,13) 1 solvere, persolvere debitum: እመ፡ ተሐበይኮ፡ ኀሊ፡ እንከ፡ ዘከመ፡ ትፈዲ፡ ለሊከ፡ Sir. 8,13; c. Acc. debiti: ፍድዪ፡ ዕዳኪ፡ 4 Reg. 4,7; Matth. 18,25; voti: ፍዲ፡ ብፅዓቲከ፡ Nah. 2,1; c. Acc. pers. (alicui): Lev. 25,27; Lev. 25,28; c. dupl. Acc. (alicui aliquid): Matth. 18,26; Matth. 18,29; Luc. 7,42. 2 reddere, restituere, abs. vel c. Acc. pers. vel rei: mutuum Ps. 36,22; እምዕጹብ፡ መንፈቆ፡ ለእመ፡ ፈደየከ፡ Sir. 29,6; ፈድየ፡ (Infin.) ልቃሕ፡ F.N. 27; raptum: ፈደየ፡ ዘሄደ፡ Hez. 33,15; in specie compensando damno: Lev. 5,16; Gen. 31,39; Ex. 21,34; Ex. 21,36; Ex. 22,3; Ex. 22,5; Ex. 22,6; etiam c. በ፡ rei, qua damnum restituitur Ex. 22,4. 3 rependere, par pari referre, retribuere, c. Acc. pers. et Acc. rei quae rependitur et c. Acc. rei, pro qua rependitur: መኑ፡ ይፈድዮ፡ ዘለሊሁ፡ ገብረ፡ Job 21,31. a remunerari benefacta praemiis: ዘይፈዲ፡ ዕሴተ፡ Sir. 3,31; 1 Reg. 24,20; 2 Reg. 19,36; Ps. 17,23; Ps. 17,27; እፈድየክሙ፡ ህየንተ፡ ዓመት፡ Joel 2,25; Zach. 9,12. b pensare malefacta malis vel poenis: 1 Reg. 24,18; Gen. 44,4; Ps. 34,14; Jer. 18,20; ይፈድዮ፡ ለኵሉ፡ በከመ፡ ምግባሩ፡ Job 34,11; Jud. 1,7; Ps. 27,6; Thren. 3,63; Sir. 11,26; Sir. 16,12; Sir. 32,24; እፈድዮሙ፡ ምግባሮሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ሕፅኖሙ፡ Jes. 65,7; Jer. 39,18; እፈድየክሙ፡ ፍዳክሙ፡ ዲበ፡ ርእስክሙ፡ Joel 4,4; Joel 4,7; Ps. 27,6; Jud. 9,57; ይፈድያ፡ ውእቱ፡ ፍዳሃ፡ Jer. 28,6 var.; እፈድዮሙ፡ ካዕበተ፡ ዐመፃሆሙ፡ Jer. 16,18; Jud. 9,56; Ps. 7,4; Ps. 40,11; etiam c. ለ፡ pers. Ex. 20,5; Hen. 95,5; et c. በ፡ rei, cujus poena sumitur 2 Reg. 16,8. 4 solvendum habere aliquid i.e. debere alicui aliquid, c. dupl. Acc.: መጽሐፈ፡ ዕዳየ፡ ዘይፈድዩኒ፡ Job 31,35; ለመኑ፡ እፈዲ፡ ዕዳ፡ Jes. 50,1; Deut. 15,2; Deut. 24,10; Matth. 18,28; Matth. 18,34; Luc. 7,41; Luc. 16,5; Luc. 16,7; c. Acc. pers.: ዘይፈድዩኒ፡ debitores mei Job 31,37; c. Acc. rei: Matth. 18,24; Hen. 51,1; ዘይፈዲ፡ ዕዳሁ፡ obaeratus 1 Reg. 22,2; abs.: ዘይፈዲ፡ debitor Jer. 24,2. – Voc. Ae.: ፈደየ፡ ዘ፡ መለሰ፡

woorden.betekenis: jubere, cogere, ut, persolvat, reddat
woorden.definitie: II,1 jubere vel cogere aliquem, ut persolvat, reddat: ይዝብጥዎሙ፡ ወያፍድይዎሙ፡ (sc. fures) F.M. 17,7.

woorden.betekenis: repetere, exigere, sibi, petere, remunerationem, poenas, ulc
woorden.definitie: III,1 1 solvendum vel reddendum repetere, exigere ab aliquo aliquid, ἀπαιτεῖν Jes. 9,4; c. Acc. pers. a qua et rei quam quis repetit, ut mutuum: ἀπαιτεῖν Deut. 15,2; Deut. 15,3; ዮም፡ ለእመ፡ ወሀበከ፡ ጌሰመ፡ ይትፈደየከ፡ Sir. 20,15; እመ፡ ትትፈደዮ፡ Sir. 29,5; ትትፈደዩ፡ ዕዳክሙ፡ ወትሰክዩ፡ Jes. 58,3; Rom. 11,35; Luc. 6,34; raptum Ps. 68,6. a sibi petere remunerationem doni, c. dupl. Acc.: ቦ፡ ዘይሁበከ፡ ወካዕበቶ፡ ይትፈደየከ፡ Sir. 20,10. b poenas repetere ab aliquo, ulcisci, vindicare, c. Acc. pers. et Acc. poenae: Deut. 32,41; Deut. 32,43; c. Acc. peccati et ላዕለ፡ pers.: Num. 14,18; Deut. 5,9 vel እምነ፡ pers.: Hen. 62,11; c. Acc. pers.: እትፈደዮሙ፡ (v. እፈድዮሙ፡) በከመ፡ ምግባሮሙ፡ Hos. 4,9; abs.: Hebr. 10,30. 2 accipere a redditum, restitutum aliquid, ut mutuum: Luc. 6,34; Luc. 6,35. b repensum vel retributum aliquid, i.e. α praemium vel poenam reportare, praemio vel poena affici: κομίσασθαι 2 Cor. 5,10; Hen. 95,5; Hen. 96,6; ይትፈደይ፡ በከመ፡ ገብረ፡ Job 24,20; ውእቱ፡ ተፈድየ፡ (var. addit ፍዳሁ፡) Tob. 14,10; Lud. ex Sx. Mag. 28Enc.; c. Acc. praemii vel poenae: Ps. 39,21; ትትፈደዪ፡ ሞተ፡ Hez. 16,52; ተፈድየት፡ እምእደ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ካዕበተ፡ ኀጢአታ፡ Jes. 40,2; c. በ፡ pro: በእፎ፡ ኢይትፈደይ፡ ወልድ፡ በኀጢአተ፡ አቡሁ፡ Hez. 18,19; Luc. 23,41. β vindictam sumere vel nancisci, Gen. 4,15; Gen. 4,24.

woorden.betekenis: retributio, praemium, remuneratio, poena, vindicta, ultio, j
woorden.definitie: subst., plerumque m., retributio: ዓመተ፡ ፍዳ፡ ኵነኔሃ፡ ለጽዮን፡ Jes. 34,8. a praemium, remuneratio: የዐስየከ፡ ፍጡነ፡ ፍዳ፡ ጽድቅከ፡ Job 8,6; Job 22,28; ለምንት፡ ይፈድየኒ፡ ዘንተ፡ ፍዳ፡ 2 Reg. 19,36; Luc. 14,12. b poena, vindicta, ultio, judicium: ἀνταπόδοσις, ἀνταπόδομα Ps. 27,6; Ps. 90,8; Sir. 14,6; ፍዳ፡ ኀጢአቶሙ፡ ይገብእ፡ ላዕለ፡ ርእሶሙ፡ Sir. 17,23; Jes. 59,18; ዕለተ፡ ፍዳ፡ Jes. 61,2; Jes. 63,4; Jer. 28,6; ያገብእ፡ ለነ፡ ፍዳሃ፡ Gen. 50,15; ፍዳ፡ ደም፡ ንጹሕ፡ ይገብእ፡ ላዕሌክሙ፡ Jer. 33,15; በቀል፡ ወፍዳ፡ Hos. 9,5; Col. 3,24; Rom. 11,9; ἐπαγωγαί, ምሉእ፡ ፍዳሁ፡ ዲበ፡ ቤቱ፡ Sir. 23,11; Sir. 10,13; ἐκδίκησις, ፍዳሆሙ፡ ለኃጥኣን፡ ዕፄ፡ Sir. 7,17; ዕለተ፡ ፍዳከ፡ Sir. 18,24; Mich. 7,4; ἐπισκοπή Jes. 10,3; ἀντιμισθία Rom. 1,27; ይረክብ፡ ፍዳሆሙ፡ δίκην τίσουσι 2 Thess. 1,9; κρίσις Luc. 11,31 rom.; 1 Petr. 4,17; num sit ዘይትሐበየኒ፡ እምፍዳ፡ ምግባርየ፡ ዘግሩም፡ ጥቀ፡ Org.; አመ፡ አኀዝዋ፡ (feminam) ወአቅረብዋ፡ ለፍዳ፡ (judicio) Sx. Ter 5Enc.; (etiam Sx. Teq. 29Enc., ubi Lud. significationem meritum statuit, significatio poena sc. merita sufficit). c In Acc. et st. constr. usurpatur loco praepositionis pro, ἀντί Ex. 21,23; Ex. 21,24; nec non ህየንተ፡ ዘ፡ … ፍዳ፡ a poëta novatur propterea quod, ut: ህየንተ፡ ዘአፍቀርኮሙ፡ ፍዳ፤ Sx. Teq. 9 Enc. – Voc. Ae.: ፍዳ፡ ዘ፡ ብድራት፡

woorden.betekenis: currere, augescere, crescere, multiplicari, incrementum, cop
woorden.definitie: quadril. I [quod equidem non cum Ludolfo et cum Hupfeldio Exerc. Aeth. p. 27 ad فَدَّ et فَدْفَدَ currere (ፈጠነ፡), sed ad פוּץ, chald. פוּשׁ, فاض فضّ (فضل) retulerim; de עדף autem vid. ወደፈ፡] 1 augescere, crescere, multiplicari: ፈድፈዱ፡ ወበዝኁ፡ ጥቀ፡ Kuf. 46; ከማሁ፡ ይፈደፍዱ፡ Kuf. 46; ኢይፈደፍዱ፡ እንከ፡ Hos. 4,10; ፈድፍዶ፡ incrementum Org. 2 copiosiorem, uberiorem, pleniorem esse vel fieri, abundare, redundare, superabundare: ከመ፡ ኢትፈድፍድ፡ ኀጢአትየ፡ πλεονάσωσι Sir. 23,3; Rom. 6,1; 2 Thess. 1,3; περισσεύειν Rom. 5,15; 1 Thess. 4,10; Matth. 13,12; ὑπερπερισσεύειν Rom. 5,20; ὑπερπλεονάζειν 1 Tim. 1,14; seq. እምነ፡ comparative: Matth. 5,20. a numero superare, plures esse, excedere numerum: ፈድፈዱ፡ እምነ፡ … πλείους ἐγένοντο ἤ … Jos. 10,11; ወኮነ፡ ኵሉ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ትንቢቱ፡ ፳ ዓመት፡ ወዘይፈደፍድ፡ ( et quod excurrit vel et supra, et amplius ) Sx. Ter 15; ፶ ዓመት፡ ወዘይፈደፍድ፡ Sx. Sen. 20; seq. እምነ፡ Num. 3,48; Num. 3,49; ተወሰከ፡ ዘመኑ፡ (Hizkiae) ወፈድፈደ፡ እምነ፡ ኍልቁ፡ Sx. Nah. 4Enc. b redundare longitudine, longiorem esse, Ex. 26,12. c sufficere, c. Acc. Infin.: ኢፈድፈዱ፡ ነጺሐ፡ οὐχ ἡγνίσθησαν ἱκανοί 2 Par. 30,3. 3 superiorem esse vel fieri in re, excellere, praecellere, ትፈደፍዲ፡ ὑπέρκεισαι Prov. 29,47; c. እምነ፡ compar.: Sap. 7,29; Koh. 3,19 var.; c. Acc. pers.: Gen. 41,40; c. በ፡ in re: Hen. 14,16; 2 Cor. 8,7; vi superiorem esse: ቃለ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ጸንዐ፡ ወፈድፈደ፡ እምቃለ፡ ኢዮአብ፡ 1 Par. 21,4.

woorden.betekenis: adaugere, cumulare, amplificare, intendere, magis, facere, p
woorden.definitie: II adaugere, cumulare, amplificare, intendere, 1 Thess. 3,12; 1 Thess. 4,1 Platt; 1 Cor. 12,23 Platt; Eph. 3,20 Platt; ረከብነ፡ ጥበበ፡ ወአፈድፈድነ፡ προσθέμενοι Job 32,13; πλείονα ποιοῦσι Prov. 11,24; Prov. 13,11; ጻመውኩ፡ ለአፈድፍዶ፡ ፍቅረ፡ አውግስጦስ፡ ለከ፡ Jsp. p. 338; Esth. apocr. 8,13. a seq. Acc. nominis abstracti vel Infinitivi: magis facere aliquid i.e. Latine: magis seq. verbo fin.: አፈድፈዱ፡ ዓዲ፡ ጸሊኦቶ፡ (magis etiam eum oderunt) Gen. 37,8; 4 Esr. 8,56; Koh. 2,15; 3 Reg. 16,25; Matth. 27,23; Marc. 10,48; Marc. 14,31; Luc. 18,39 rom.; አፈድፈድኪ፡ ዝሙተኪ፡ (magis fornicata es) Hez. 16,15; Jer. 13,27; አፈድፈድኪ፡ ኀጢአተኪ፡ እምኔሆን፡ Hez. 16,51; ያፈደፍድ፡ ጥበበ፡ σοφώτερος ἔσται Prov. 9,9. α plus: ያፈደፍድ፡ ሎሙ፡ ውሂበ፡ Matth. 20,10 rom. β diutius: አፈድፈደ፡ ሐይወ፡ ዲበ፡ ምድር፡ እምውሉደ፡ ሰብእ፡ Kuf. 10. γ nimis, nimium: ኢታፈድፍድ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ ተናግሮ፡ Sir. 13,11. b plus habere rei alio i.e. superare aliquem, excellere aliquo in re, seq. እምነ፡ pers.: አላ፡ አፈድፈደ፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ 1 Par. 29,25 vers. alt.; c. በ፡ rei, አፈድፈደት፡ በዝሙታ፡ እምእኅታ፡ Hez. 23,11; 2 Cor. 11,23; c. Acc. rei et ዲበ፡ pers.: አፈድፈድኩ፡ ጥበበ፡ ዲበ፡ ኵሉ፡ Koh. 1,16; c. dupl. Acc.: Gen. 41,40 var. c አፈድፍዶ፡ እምዐቅም፡ excedere modum (ut in edendo, bibendo) F.M. 14,4.

woorden.betekenis: valde, laetus, jocosus, fuit, delectatus, in, deliciis, laut
woorden.definitie: I,1 et I,2 [فَكِهَ valde laetus, jocosus fuit, V delectatus fuit; אתפגג id.; etiam فنق פנק?] in deliciis vel laute vivere, vitae voluptatibus vel jucunditatibus frui, luxuriari: ይብል፡ እበልዕ፡ ወእንከሰ፡ እፈግዕ፡ ወአእከልኩ፡ Sir. 11,19; Ps. 48,19; Luc. 16,19; Luc. 16,25; Job 21,13 var.; τρυφᾶν Jac. 5,5; Herm. p. 58; ጸግቡ፡ ወሠብሑ፡ ወፈግዑ፡ በበረከትከ፡ 2 Esr. 19,25; ካልእ፡ ይፈግዕ፡ በንዋዩ፡ Sir. 14,4; ትፈግዕ፡ በአዕጻዳተ፡ ቀምሕከ፡ Hez. 28,13; σπαταλᾶν 1 Tim. 5,6; ከረያ፡ ጽጋብ፡ ወፈግዐት፡ በጽጋብ፡ Hez. 16,49; እለ፡ ይፈግዑ፡ ውስተ፡ ምስካባቲሆሙ፡ Am. 6,4; στρηνιᾶν Apoc. 18,7; በስታይ፡ ወፈጊዕ፡ κραιπάλῃ καὶ μέθῃ Luc. 21,34; Did. 4; Clem. f. 254; ይፌግዕ፡ (v. ይፈግዕ፡) በጽጋብ፡ Sir. 34,3; c. በ፡ rei, qua quis fruitur: infans ዘኢፈጸመ፡ ሕይወቶ፡ በላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወኢፈግዐ፡ በሠናያት፡ Genz. f. 130; c. ላዕለ፡ pers.: ውእቱ፡ ይነግሥ፡ ሎሙ፡ ወይፈግዕ፡ (v. ወይትፌጋዕ፡) ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ἐντρυφήσει ἐν αὐτοῖς Hab. 1,10; ὅταν καταστρηνιάσωσι τοῦ Χριστοῦ 1 Tim. 5,11.

woorden.betekenis: delectatio, oblectamentum, voluptas, vita, delicata
woorden.definitie: subst. delectatio, oblectamentum, voluptas, vita delicata; Hen. 14,13; Koh. 2,8; ፍግዓ፡ ወኀጢአት፡ Sir. 27,13 var.; ብሔረ፡ ፍሥሓ፡ ወፍግዓ፡ ወተድላ፡ Clem. f. 275; ፍግዓሁ፡ ለዝ፡ ዓለም፡ ከመ፡ ጽላሎት፡ የኀልፍ፡ Clem. f. 260.

woorden.betekenis: fidit, incepit, creavit, creare, formare, ex, animo, suo, pr
woorden.definitie: I,1 [فَطَر fidit (פטר), incepit, creavit ] Subj. ይፍጥር፡ 1 de Deo: creare, formare, κτίζειν, ποιεῖν, πλάσσειν, c. Acc.: ፈጠሮ፡ ለሰብእ፡ Sap. 2,23; Job 10,8; Job 35,10; በእንተ፡ ፈጢሮትየ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ Gen. 6,7; Deut. 4,32; Jes. 43,1; ዘእንበለ፡ እፍጥርከ፡ Jer. 1,5; Ps. 88,46; እግዚአብሔር፡ ፈጠረኒ፡ (v. ወለደኒ፡) Prov. 8,22; Sir. 24,9; oculos Ps. 93,9; draconem Ps. 103,28; mundum, terram, mare, astra al.: Job 34,13; Jes. 40,28; Jes. 45,12; Ps. 73,17; Ps. 73,18; Ps. 94,5; Eph. 3,9; Col. 1,16; ፍጥር፡ ሎሙ፡ መንፈሰ፡ ርትዕ፡ Kuf. 1; Ps. 50,11; Ps. 32,15; አነ፡ እፈጥር፡ ሰላመ፡ Jes. 45,7; እፈጥር፡ እኩየ፡ ላዕሌክሙ፡ Jer. 18,11; ኢነጸርክምም፡ ለዘፈጠራ፡ ቅድመ፡ Jes. 22,11; c. በ፡ rei ( ex ) Did. 38(vid. sub ነጠብጣብ፡); abs.: Marc. 13,19. 2 de hominibus: ex animo suo producere, excogitare, ዘፈጠረ፡ እምልቡ፡ 3 Reg. 12,33; ሰብእ፡ እምርእሶሙ፡ ፈጠርዋ፡ ለኀጢአት፡ Hen. 98,4. a fingere, ementiri, comminisci, fabricari: ነገረ፡ እበድ፡ ይፈጥሩ፡ Tit. 3,9; 1 Tim. 1,4; 1 Tim. 5,13; 2 Petr. 2,3; Hen. 104,10; 4 Reg. 17,9; ትፈጥር፡ እምልብከ፡ ψεύδῃ 2 Esr. 16,8; Jer. 14,14; Dan. 2,9. b machinari, moliri: ተዐቀብ፡ እምእኩይ፡ እስመ፡ እኩየ፡ ይፈጥር፡ Sir. 11,33; Ps. 93,20. 3 notas vel literas magicas incidere: ኢትፍጥሩ፡ ለክሙ፡ ፈጠራ፡ Lev. 19,28.

woorden.betekenis: creari, generari, gigni, natura, fieri
woorden.definitie: III,1 creari, Kuf. 3; Ex. 9,18; Lev. 18,27; Hez. 28,14; ይከውኑ፡ ከመ፡ ዘኢተፈጥሩ፡ Jes. 41,11; Asc. Jes. 4,18; Ps. 32,9; Koh. 8,9; እምአመ፡ ተፈጥረ፡ ሰብእ፡ ዲበ፡ ምድር፡ Job 20,4; Sap. 2,2; ዘእንበለ፡ ይትፈጠር፡ ዓለም፡ Sir. 42,21; 4 Esr. 8,6; 4 Esr. 9,25; Jac. 3,9; 2 Petr. 3,5; Hebr. 4,13; Hebr. 11,3; Apoc. 4,11; ተፈጢርየ፡ Job 10,19; 4 Esr. 8,69; 4 Esr. 9,21; ቦኑ፡ ቀደምከ፡ ተፈጥሮ፡ Job 15,7; Koh. 6,8; ኢተፈጥሮ፡ Koh. 4,3; c. እምነ፡ materiae: ኵሉ፡ እምነ፡ ምድር፡ ተፈጥረ፡ Sir. 41,10. a generari, gigni, natura fieri: ተፈጠርኩ፡ ውስተ፡ ከርሥ፡ ἐγενόμην Job 31,15; ዘተኀጽወ፡ በግብር፡ ወተፈጥረ፡ ምዉተ፡ ኀፍረተ፡ ዚአሁ፡ F.M. 33,1; ዕፄ፡ ኢተፈጥረ፡ በላዕሌሁ፡ Ex. 16,24. b fieri (inde ab initio rerum vel a creatore): እስመ፡ ትእዛዘ፡ ሕግ፡ ተፈጥረ፡ ሞተ፡ ትሙት፡ (ἀπ᾽ αἰῶνος) Sir. 14,17; ሰንበት፡ ተፈጥረት፡ በእንተ፡ ሰብእ፡ Marc. 2,27.

woorden.betekenis: creatio, principium, primordia, res, creata, creatura, creat
woorden.definitie: n. act. et subst., fem. et m., Pl. ፍጥረታት፡ 1 creatio, principium, primordia rerum, Kuf. 2; ፍጥረት፡ ሐዳስ፡ Kuf. 1; Kuf. 4; እምፍጥረተ፡ ዓለም፡ Rom. 1,20; 2 Petr. 3,4; ἀπ᾽ αἰῶνος Jes. 46,9; Jes. 51,9; Jes. 64,4; Sir. 44,2; πρὸ χρόνων αἰωνίων Tit. 1,2; ἀπὸ γενεῶν ἀρχῆς Jes. 41,4; ἔκπαλαι 2 Petr. 2,3; ἐξ ἀρχῆς Sir. 39,32; እምፍጥረት፡ ἀπ᾽ ἀρχῆς Jes. 43,10; Marc. 10,6; እለ፡ እምፍጥረት፡ αἰώνιοι Ps. 23,7; Ps. 23,9. 2 res creata, creatura vel creaturae: ποίημα Koh. 8,9; Koh. 12,14; ποιήματα Koh. 1,14, κτίσις Marc. 16,15; Gal. 6,15; κτίσματα Jac. 1,18; ለቀደምት፡ ፍጥረትከ፡ Sir. 36,20; አዳም፡ ቀዳሜ፡ ፍጥረት፡ Lit. 171,4; ዘይእኅዝ፡ ኵሎ፡ ፍጥረታተ፡ (v. ፍጥረተ፡) τὰ πάντα Sap. 1,7; እግዚአብሔር፡ ገባሬ፡ ኵሉ፡ ፍጥረታት፡ Haim. Ab.; Sx. Mij. 26 Enc. (vid. sub ኰሰየ፡). 3 natura: φύσις Jac. 3,7; 1 Cor. 11,14; ማይ፡ ኀብአ፡ ፍጥረተ፡ ህላዌሁ፡ Sap. 19,19; Hen. 89,26; Rom. 1,26; Rom. 11,21; Rom. 11,24; በፍጥረት፡ Hom. Mar.; በሕገ፡ ፍጥረት፡ Lit. 171,3; ገብረ፡ ሎሙ፡ ፍጥረተ፡ ሐዳሰ፡ ከመ፡ ኢየአብሱ፡ በኵሉ፡ ፍጥረቶሙ፡ Kuf. 5; ፍጥረተ፡ ልብኪ፡ πλάσμα Judith 8,29; Ps. 102,13; Jac. 1,23; ኢመፍትው፡ ለነ፡ ንላጺ፡ ጽሕመነ፡ ወኢንወልጥ፡ ፍጥረተ፡ ብእሲ፡ ውስተ፡ ካልእ፡ ግዕዝ፡ Did. 1; hominis ፍጥረት፡ እንስሳዊ፡ Phlx. 102; ዘውፁእ፡ እምፍጥረት፡ (alienus a natura vel naturae repugnans) Kedr f. 62; ኀጢአተ፡ ፍጥረት፡ (opp. eo, quod naturae repugnat) F.M. 11,2; ዘ፩ ፍጥረቱ፡ Did. 25(vid. sub ፊንክስ፡). a de Christi naturis: ክልኤ፡ ፍጥረት፡ M.M. f. 385. b elementa rerum, στοιχεῖα 2 Petr. 3,10. 4 origo, ortus, nativitas: ወይእቲ፡ ገቦ፡ ፍጥረታ፡ ለብእሲት፡ Kuf. p. 11; ምድረ፡ ፍጥረቶሙ፡ Kuf. p. 15; Kuf. p. 19; ልሳነ፡ ፍጥረት፡ Kuf. p. 51; እምትካታ፡ ወእምፍጥረታ፡ 2 Esr. 4,15; እምፍጥረትየ፡ ἀπὸ προγόνων 2 Tim. 1,3; (መጽሐፍ፡) ዘፍጥረት፡ Genesis (liber) Can. Ap. 55(alias ዘልደት፡). 5 generatio, genus, familia, γένεσις, γενέσεις Num. 3,1; Gen. 6,9; γενεά Gen. 43,7; ፍጥረት፡ ኅሩያን፡ γένος 1 Petr. 2,9 Platt. a etiam rerum: ፍጥረታተ፡ ሕምዝ፡ (genera veneni varia) Lit. 169,1. b ዘእምነ፡ ፍጥረቱ፡ αὐτόχθων indigena, Jos. 8,35; Lev. 16,29; Lev. 17,15; Lev. 19,34; plenius: ዘእምነ፡ ፍጥረቱ፡ ውስተ፡ (እስራኤል፡) Lev. 23,42. 6 res commenticia, commentum: ይፈጥሩ፡ ፍጥረተ፡ ዐቢያተ፡ Hen. 104,10. fǝṭrat C for ልሳነ፡ ፍጥረት፡ vid. ልሳን፡ (Leslau)

woorden.betekenis: creator, conditor, auctor, Deus, commentor, fictor
woorden.definitie: n. ag. 1 creator, conditor, auctor, sc. Deus 1 Petr. 4,19; 4 Esr. 8,69; Koh. 12,1; Kuf. 22; Job 20,29 (ἐπίσκοπος); ፈጣሪሁ፡ Sir. 4,6; ፈጣሪየ፡ Sir. 24,8; Jes. 27,11; ፈጣሬ፡ ሰማይ፡ ወምድር፡ Judith 13,18; Kuf. 7; ፈጣሬ፡ ኵሉ፡ Job 8,3; Sir. 24,8; Kuf. 17; Rom. 1,25; κύριος et θεός Deus Ex. 15,25 seq. (vid. annot. ad h. l.). 2 commentor, fictor: ፈጣሬ፡ ነገር፡ Kid. f. 24.

woorden.betekenis: ad, res, creatas, pertinens
woorden.definitie: adj. rel. ad res creatas pertinens, አፍቅሮ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ (amare Deum) ይኄይስ፡ እምአፍቅሮ፡ ፍጡራዊያን፡ Phlx. 3.

woorden.betekenis: currere;, currere, properare, celerem, citum, velocem, prope
woorden.definitie: I,1 [amh. id., coll. فَدَّ فَدْفَدَ currere; وَفَضَ currere, properare ] celerem, citum, velocem, properum esse: ይፈጥን፡ (v. ያፈጥን፡) መብረቅ፡ በፈቃዱ፡ Sir. 43,13; ፈጠነት፡ (v. አፍጠነት፡) ጥቀ፡ Jer. 31,16; በቃሉ፡ ይፈጥን፡ ሑረቱ፡ Sir. 43,5; ሑሰታ፡ ለጥበብ፡ ይፈጥን፡ እምኵሉ፡ ሑሰት፡ κινητικώτερον Sap. 7,24.

woorden.betekenis: celerare, festinare, properare, cito, mox, accelerare, matur
woorden.definitie: II,1 1 celerare, festinare, properare: ከመ፡ ያፍጥን፡ ዘያነብብ፡ Hab. 2,2; Jer. 31,16 var.; seq. verbo finito sive asyndeto: 1 Reg. 20,38; Luc. 15,22 rom.; Luc. 19,5; sive copula ወ፡ annexo: ያፍጥን፡ ወይሩጽ፡ ምግባሩ፡ Jes. 5,19 var.; Gen. 18,6; 1 Reg. 25,18; seq. Acc. Infin.: Luc. 19,6; Gen. 18,7; Gen. 45,13; Ps. 69,1; አፍጠነ፡ ውሂቦታ፡ ቅብአ፡ Esth. 2,9; እመ፡ ኢያፍጠነ፡ ተዐቅቦ፡ በፍርሀተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Sir. 27,3; ያፈጥን፡ ክዒወ፡ ደም፡ Sir. 28,11; Judith 10,15; Judith 13,12; vel seq. ለ፡ c. Infin.: እገሪሆሙ፡ ያፈጥና፡ ለክዒወ፡ ደም፡ Prov. 1,16; Jes. 59,7; ዘአፍጠነ፡ እዴሁ፡ ለዘቢጥ፡ Kedr f. 79; nonnumquam Latine cito, mox vertere licet: አፍጠኑ፡ ረሲዐ፡ (cito obliti sunt) Ps. 105,14; Kuf. 26; Gen. 27,20; Ex. 2,18. 2 accelerare, maturare, c. Acc.: አፍጥና፡ ለዕለቶሙ፡ Sir. 33,10; አፍጥኑ፡ ሥጣዌ፡ („maturate responsionem“) Greg. Lud.

woorden.betekenis: festinationem, adhibere, festinare, properare, accelerare, u
woorden.definitie: IV,3 (raro አስተፈጠነ፡) 1 festinationem adhibere (sich beeilen), festinare, properare, Ps. 15,3; አስተፋጠኑ፡ ወአግሐሡ፡ Judith 13,1; 4 Reg. 9,13; c. Acc. Infin.: አስተፋጠኑ፡ ገቢረ፡ ሠናይ፡ Clem. f. 262; Clem. f. 267; ይደልወነ፡ ናስተፋጥን፡ ነሢኦታ፡ (ለጥምቀት፡) F.M. 27,1; ኢናስተፋጥን፡ ሰቲየ፡ ወይን፡ Lud. ex Hom. Greg.; seq. Subj. verbi: 2 Tim. 4,9; seq. ከመ፡ c. Subj.: 4 Esr. 14,14; Hebr. 4,11; 2 Tim. 2,15; Judae 3. 2 accelerare, urgere: እለ፡ ይቀውሙ፡ ወያገብሩ፡ ወያስተፋጥኑ፡ ግብረ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ 1 Par. 23,4. 3 festinando deprehendere vel opprimere aliquem (ereilen): እግዚአብሔር፡ አስተፋጠኖ፡ በሞት፡ ለገባሬ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ግብር፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ይብጻሕ፡ ጊዜሁ፡ F.M. 11,2.

woorden.betekenis: findi, caedi, excidi
woorden.definitie: III,1 ( findi ) caedi, excidi: ኰኵሕ፡ ኢይትፈጻሕ፡ በጕድብ፡ ወበማሕጼ፡ ከመ፡ ዕፀው፡ M.M. f. 209; በከመ፡ እብነ፡ አድማስ፡ ዘኢይትፈጻሕ፡ τὰ ἀδαμάντινα σώματα οὐ πλήττεται Chrys. Ta. 22.

woorden.betekenis: abrumpere, finire, referciendo, implendo, implere, replere,
woorden.definitie: vel ፈፀመ፡ I,2 [quod cum פצם فصم componere (Ges. thes. p. 1119) et abrumpere i.e. finire interpretari solent, at significatus primus in referciendo et implendo fuisse videtur, coll. فعم (فرم) et ፈፀመ፡ – Stirpem I,1 sc. ፈጽመ፡ Marc. 4,29 et ይፈጽም፡ Rom. 5,3 exhibet quidem Platt in sua N.T. editione, at lectiones pravae videntur] 1 implere, replere, c. Acc. rei: ፈጸመ፡ ሎሙ፡ ሙሴ፡ እደዊሆሙ፡ ἐπλήρωσε Sir. 45,15; τελειοῦν Ex. 29,9; Ex. 29,29; Ex. 29,35; Lev. 16,32; መኑ፡ ዘያጠብዕ፡ ይፈጽም፡ እደዊሁ፡ πληρῶσαι 1 Par. 29,5; ፈጽሙ፡ መስፈርተ፡ Matth. 23,32; c. dupl. Acc.: ዘንተ፡ (ግበ፡) ፈጸመ፡ ቅቱላነ፡ Jer. 48,9. a complere, explere, implere, numerum Ex. 23,26; Jes. 65,20; tempus i.e. ad finem peragere, vid. sub n. 3; defectum, ἀναπληροῦν 1 Cor. 16,17; verba alicujus 3 Reg. 1,14; legem Matth. 5,17; Gal. 5,14. b explere, implere, satisfacere: ስእለተ፡ Ps. 19,6; መፍቅደ፡ Phil. 4,19; ወይፌጽሙ፡ መዐትየ፡ πληρῶσαι Jes. 13,3; ጻሕቀ፡ Sx. Ter 21 Enc.; ይፌጽሙ፡ ሕገ፡ ሥጋ፡ (honeste de exoneratione alvi) Sx. Nah. 14. c omisso Acc.: plenum modum assequi, ut: እስከ፡ ይፌጽም፡ በዕድሜሁ፡ „donec ad plenam aetatem perveniret“ Org. 4. d implere promissum, vaticinium, 3 Reg. 8,15; 3 Reg. 8,24. 2 peragere, perficere ( vollbringen, vollführen ): ነበብክሙ፡ በአፉክሙ፡ ወፈጸምክሙ፡ በእደዊክሙ፡ Jer. 51,25; ፈጸመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ መዐቶ፡ Thren. 4,11; Thren. 2,17; Hen. 5,3; Mich. 2,1; እለ፡ ይፌጽሙ፡ ኀጣውአ፡ Prov. 1,19; ይፌጽም፡ እከየ፡ Koh. 9,3 (at lectio corrupta videtur); Gen. 49,5; Matth. 3,15; Matth. 19,12; 2 Cor. 10,6; Gal. 6,2; Jac. 2,8; 2 Tim. 4,5; 2 Thess. 1,11 al. 3 consummare, finire, absolvere, ad finem perducere ( vollenden ): ብዙኀ፡ ንነግር፡ ወኢንክል፡ ፈጽሞቶ፡ Sir. 43,27; እደዊሁ፡ ይፌጽማሁ፡ Zach. 4,9; Sir. 38,30; pensum Ex. 5,14; ፈጸመት፡ ዘንተ፡ ኵሎ፡ ነገረ፡ Judith 10,1; Deut. 31,24; Hen. 41,7; Matth. 7,28; Matth. 13,53; Matth. 19,1; Luc. 12,50; Joh. 4,54; Joh. 5,36; Act. 20,24; 2 Tim. 4,7; Apoc. 11,7; Sx. Teq. 28 Enc., al. crebro; tempus, dies al.: ወፈጺማ፡ እላንተ፡ መዋዕለ፡ Kuf. 3; Kuf. 10; Gen. 29,27; Gen. 29,28; ፈጺሞሙ፡ መዋዕሊሆሙ፡ Job 21,13; Job 36,11; Sir. 26,2; Hen. 5,9. a finem facere rei agendae, desinere, perfecte, prorsus, omnino facere aliquid: seq. Acc. Infin., ut: ሶበ፡ ፈጸምከ፡ አንጽሖ፡ Hez. 43,23; ወፈጸመ፡ መጥኖ፡ ቤት፡ Hez. 42,15; Gen. 2,2; Num. 7,1; Lev. 16,20; Jud. 3,18; 3 Reg. 8,1; ወእምዝ፡ ፈጺሞ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘንተ፡ ኵሎ፡ ገቢረ፡ Jes. 10,12; ፈጸመ፡ ቀቲሎትየ፡ Job 6,9; Luc. 4,13; Rom. 9,31; Rom. 10,5; Rom. 13,8; vel seq. እንዘ፡, ut: ፈጺሞ፡ እንዘ፡ ይትናገር፡ ምስሌሁ፡ Kuf. 15; Kuf. 36; Hen. 81,10; ፈጸመ፡ እንዘ፡ ይጼሊ፡ 2 Par. 7,1. b ad perfectionem ducere, perfectum reddere aliquid: ዘብዙኀ፡ እከየ፡ ይገብር፡ ይፌጽም፡ እከየ፡ τελεσιουργεῖ Prov. 19,7; Phil. 2,2. c abs.: finem facere vel capere, Luc. 13,23; 4 Esr. 5,30.

woorden.betekenis: impleri, plenum, fieri, compleri, completum, esse, peragi, p
woorden.definitie: III,2 (passim III,1) 1 impleri, a plenum fieri, de luna Hen. 78,11; Hen. 78,13. b compleri, completum esse: ኢተፈጸመ፡ ኀጢአቶሙ፡ እስከ፡ ይእዜ፡ Kuf. 14; Gen. 15,16; 1 Thess. 2,16. c de vaticiniis: Asc. Jes. 11,38; Matth. 1,22; Matth. 2,15; Matth. 2,17; Matth. 2,23; Matth. 4,14; Matth. 8,17; Matth. 12,17 al.; Luc. 22,37; Lud. Comm. hist. p. 302 n. 4. 2 peragi, perfici: Hen. 10,12; Hen. 16,1; si adfuissem እምኢተፈጸመ፡ ሎሙዝ፡ Jsp. p. 388; Jac. 1,15; Luc. 22,37; ለእመ፡ ኢተፈጸመ፡ (zu Stand kommt) ከዊነ፡ መርዓ፡ F.N. 24,3; F.N. 32,1. 3 consummari, absolvi, finiri, ad finem perduci: Gen. 2,1; Gen. 6,16; Kuf. 2; ወተፈጸመ፡ ቤቱ፡ 1 Esr. 7,5; 2 Esr. 5,16; ወእምዝ፡ ተፈጺሞ፡ በዓል፡ Tob. 10,7; Hen. 25,4; Joh. 19,28; Joh. 19,30; Matth. 10,23; in specie de tempore: Kuf. 3; Kuf. 19; Lev. 25,30; Deut. 34,8; Tob.10,7; ተፈጺሞ፡ መዋዕል፡ Dan. 1,18; Job 1,5; Luc. 2,21; Luc. 4,2; Act. 7,23; Apoc. 20,3; Apoc. 20,5. a finem habere vel capere, desinere: ኢተፈጸመ፡ ሣህሉ፡ Thren. 3,22; 1 Cor. 13,8; ዘኢይትፌጸም፡ infinitus, Lit. Cyr. b consumi, absumi: ተፈጸመ፡ ማይ፡ እምዝቃ፡ Kuf. 17; 3 Reg. 14,10; Hen. 19,1. c suprema obire, de animatis: Apoc. 6,11; ex aëre decidit ወተፈጸመ፡ ሶቤሃ፡ ወሞተ፡ Clem. f. 254. d liber explicit, ut: ተፈጸመ፡ በዝየ፡ ጥበቢሁ፡ ለኢያሱ፡ ወልደ፡ ሲራክ፡ Sir. in subscr.; Asc. Jes. ed Laur. p. 78; Psalt. ed Lud. p. 318; Herm. p. 108, al. creberrime. e transigi, dirimi, de controversiis: ኵሉ፡ ጋእዝ፡ ዘትከውን፡ ማእከሌሆሙ፡ ትትፌጸም፡ በመሐላ፡ F.N. 43,5. f ad perfectionem perduci, perfectum fieri: Joh. 3,29; Luc. 22,16; 1 Joh. 4,17. g τελεῖσθαι initiari ab interpretibus vix intellectum ተፈጸመ፡ versum est Num. 25,3; Ps. 105,28 (quamquam videre licet sub ፈጸመ፡ n. 1 phrasin implere manus i.e. initiare).

woorden.betekenis: impletus, plenus, qui, explevit, expletus, perfectus, absolu
woorden.definitie: part. 1 impletus, plenus: Lev. 4,5; Num. 3,3; ሥርናይ፡ ፍጹም፡ πλήρης Marc. 4,28; ወርኅ፡ ፍጹመ፡ ብርሃን፡ Abush. 13. a plenus, de tempore, vid. infra sub. n. 2,e. b ፍጹመ፡ መዋዕል፡ plenus dierum i.e. qui vitae suae tempus explevit Kuf. 22. c expletus: Rom. 13,10. 2 perfectus, absolutus, plenus: a ad finem perductus, consummatus: Luc. 2,42; ወገብረ፡ ፍጹመ፡ ኪራም፡ ኵሎ፡ ቅኔ፡ (v. ፈጸመ፡) 2 Par. 4,11; Hebr. 12,23. b ( vollkommen ) τέλειος Ps. 138,21; ፍጹመ፡ ግብረ፡ ይገብር፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ምስሌከ፡ Judith 11,6; πλήρης Ruth 2,12; ከመ፡ ፍጽምተ፡ ትኩን፡ በረከትከ፡ Sir. 7,32; እስመ፡ ፍጹም፡ ውእቱ፡ ላሕይኪ፡ Hez. 16,14; ብእሲ፡ ዘሠናይ፡ ራእዩ፡ ኀያል፡ ወጽኑዕ፡ ወፍጹም፡ በራእይ፡ Clem. f. 9; ቀላይ፡ ፍጹም፡ Hen. 21,7; ፍት፡ ፍጹም፡ Jac. 1,17; ለእመ፡ ነስሐ፡ ንስሓ፡ ፍጽምተ፡ F.M. 6,13. α scientia et arte: ኬንያ፡ ፍጹም፡ 3 Reg. 7,2; ፍጹማን፡ ወምሁራን፡ ( Meister und Lehrlinge ) 1 Par. 25,8. β ethice: Cant. 5,2; ፍጹም፡ በጽድቁ፡ Kuf. 10; ፍጹም፡ በኵሉ፡ ምግባራቲሁ፡ ምስለ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ Kuf. 23; ፍጹም፡ በሃይማኖት፡ Herm. p. 48; ኖኅ፡ ተረክበ፡ ፍጹመ፡ ጻድቀ፡ (v. ጽድቅ፡) Sir. 44,17; ፍጹም፡ Kuf. 15; Gen. 6,9; 4 Esr. 1,36; Sap. 9,6; Matth. 5,48; Matth. 19,21; Col. 1,28; Col. 4,12; Jac. 1,4; Jac. 3,2; Rom. 12,2; ሥርዐተ፡ ኄራን፡ ወሥርዐተ፡ ፍጹማን፡ Phlx. 1; in malam partem: ፍጹማነ፡ አበሳ፡ Hen. 22,13. c maturus, de fetu: ብእሲት፡ ዘቀተለት፡ ሕፃነ፡ ፍጹመ፡ ዘወለደት፡ Kedr f. 78. d sanus, labis expers: ዕፀው፡ ፍጹም፡ Kuf. p. 77; በግዕ፡ ፍጹም፡ Ex. 12,5. e integer, plenus, totus: ፈለሰ፡ ፍጹመ፡ ፍልሰተ፡ Jer. 13,19 var.; ይነጽሕ፡ ንጽሐ፡ ፍጹመ፡ Prov. 25,4; Deut. 31,30; በልብ፡ ፍጹም፡ 1 Par. 28,9; Joh. 15,11; 1 Joh. 1,4; 1 Joh. 2,5; in specie de temporis spatiis: Ps. 72,10; Jos. 10,13; ዓመት፡ ፍጹም፡ Kuf. 6; ፴ ዓመት፡ ፍጽምት፡ Clem. f. 250; ዓመተ፡ ፍጹመ፡ F.M. 6,14. f solidus vel probus, de metallis: ወርቅ፡ ፍጹም፡ 3 Reg. 6,19; ብሩር፡ ፍጹም፡ Kuf. 19. g germanus: አኀው፡ ፍጹማን፡ F.N. 42,6. 3 Accipitur pro subst.: perfectio, Phlx. 88; ትሕትና፡ ውእቱ፡ ፍጹመ፡ ጽድቅ፡ Phlx. 152. 4 Adv. ፍጹመ፡ a plene, perfecte: ኢተከሥተ፡ ሕግ፡ ፍጹመ፡ Kuf. 33; 4 Esr. 12,13; 1 Thess. 5,23; ይትጋደል፡ ፍጹመ፡ Sx. Hed. 13 Enc.; „exacte“ Lud. ex Sx. Mag. 27 Enc. b prorsus, plane, Sx. Genb. 3 Enc.; ፍጹመ፡ ኢ፡ omnino non: Lud. e Lit. Mss.; ወማየሰ፡ ፍጹመ፡ ኢይሰቲ፡ Gad. T.H. c jam, ἤδη Herm. p. 8.

woorden.betekenis: consummatio, finis
woorden.definitie: subst. consummatio, finis, በፍጽም፡ ἐν συντελείᾳ Nah. 1,3; cfr. Marc. 4,29 rom.

woorden.betekenis: expletio, plenitudo, modus, justus, ac, plenus, completio, j
woorden.definitie: subst. 1 expletio a plenitudo, modus justus ac plenus: ፍጻሜ፡ መጠነ፡ አካል፡ ዘዕደው፡ ፳ ዓመት፡ ወእመአኮ፡ ፳ወ፭ ዓመት፡ ወለአንስት፡ ፲ወ፪ ዓመት፡ ወእመአኮ፡ ፲ወ፭ ዓመት፡ F.N. 24,3. b completio i.e. justa observatio legis Rom. 11,12. c initiatio, τελείωσις (vid. ፈጸመ፡ n. 1 et ተፈጸመ፡ n. 3,g), Ex. 29,27; Lev. 7,37; Lev. 8,22; Lev. 8,31; Lev. 8,33. 2 consummatio, finis, περασμός Koh. 4,8; Koh. 4,16; Koh. 12,12; τέλος Ps. in tit., vid. Lud. annot. ad Ps. 4,1; ፍጻሜ፡ ዘይመጽእ፡ Hen. 10,2; በፍጻሜ፡ ራብዑ፡ ኢዮቤልው፡ Kuf. 4; እምቅድመ፡ ፍጻሜ፡ ዓመት፡ F.N. 24,5; ከመ፡ ለፍጻሜ፡ ያብጽሕ፡ ወይግበር፡ ኵሎ፡ ሰርጐ፡ ቤትከ፡ 1 Par. 29,19. a finis propositus: 1 Petr. 1,9; ፍጻሜ፡ ነፍስነ፡ Lit. 168,2. b extremum (tempore et gradu): ፍጻሜሁ፡ ለበቀል፡ Sap. 12,27. c terminus: ኵሎ፡ ፍጻሜ፡ ማኅበራ፡ ለቤተ፡ ክርስቲያን፡ (omnium finium ecclesiae – miserere), Lit. Orth. 3 perfectio, absolutio: እስመ፡ ኀልዮ፡ ኪያሃ፡ ፍጻሜ፡ አእምሮ፡ τελειότης Sap. 6,16; Hebr. 6,1; sec. Lud. etiam Adv. prorsus, plane, ut: ፍጻሜ፡ ንቱግ፡ „plane evacuatum“.

woorden.betekenis: perfectio, integritas
woorden.definitie: subst. perfectio vel integritas animi et vitae: Phlx. 26; ሶበ፡ ርእየ፡ ቅድስናሁ፡ ወፍጽምናሁ፡ Sx. Jac. 11; Dei, Cod. Bodl. X ab init.; Cod. Mus. Brit. VIII ab init.

woorden.betekenis: plenitudo, perfectio, initiatio, absolutio, consummatio, fin
woorden.definitie: subst. 1 plenitudo, πλήρωμα, passim in Cyr. ut: እምተፍጻሜተ፡ ዚአሁ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ውሁብ፡ Cyr. f. 86. a perfectio, τελειότης Col. 3,14. b initiatio, τελείωσις (vid. ፍጻሜ፡ n. 1,c): Ex. 29,26; Ex. 29,31; Ex. 29,34. 2 absolutio, consummatio, finis, ultimum, negotii Ssal. Req.; aedificationis Chron. Ax. f. 89; ተፍጻሜቱ፡ ለዝ፡ ዓለም፡ Asc. Jes. 11,37; Vit. Mar.; Hen. 18,14; በተፍጻሜተ፡ ዓመት፡ Kuf. 4; አልብከ፡ ጥንተ፡ ወአንተ፡ ትሁብ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ተፍጻሜተ፡ Lit. Joh.; እስከ፡ ተፍጻሜቱ፡ μέχρι τέλους Koh. 3,11; Hen. 2,2; Lit. 161, al.; ውእቱ፡ ተፍጻሜተ፡ ሰማዕት፡ is est ultimus martyrum, Sx. Hed. 29.

woorden.betekenis: concussit, horrore, affecit, febris, febri, corripi, febrici

woorden.betekenis: sawā, sewā, śəwā, drink fermented from corn or barley, the g
woorden.definitie: sawā subst. ‘Il termino usato per birra è ሰዋ, un termine che non appare in autorevoli lessici gəʼəz come il Dillmann (è stato però registrato da 520a). I maestri ammettono di aver appreso il lemma ሰዋ durante la loro formazione linguistica del gəʼəz e aggiungono che ሰዋ veniva tradotto dai loro precettori con la voce təgrəña ጌሶ (cf. 584). Il concetto di birra non è comunque estraneo alla lingua gəʼəz. C’è infatti la parola ምዝር, che Dillmann rende con “cerevisia”, 1302. Si può quindi presumere che il passaggio morfematico sia avvenuto da ጽዋዕ a ሰዋ.’ 41 (153) n. 67; ʻ«Sawa» {ሰዋ} o «suʿa» {ሱዐ}, secondo lʼinsolita grafia adottata in questo testo, è il nome tigrino della popolare bevanda che in amarico è chiamata «ṭallā» {ጠላ}, ottenuta dalla fermentazione di una graminacea detta in entrambe le lingue «dāgussā» {ዳጉሳ}; cf. 192 n. 30.ʼ 66 n. 40 L sawā ሰዋ, sewā ሴዋ, śəwā ሥዋ drink fermented from corn or barley, the gešo-plant used for fermenting beer 520a

woorden.betekenis: bǝrānnā, parchment, I am going to the copyists carrying this
woorden.definitie: bǝrānnā subst. parchment ኀበ፡ ጸሐፍት፡ አሐውር፡ ጸዊርየ፡ ዘንተ፡ ብራና፡ ከመ፡ ይጽሐፉ፡ ቦቱ፡ ተአምሪሃ፡ ለእግዝእትነ፡ ማርያም። ‘ I am going to the copyists carrying this parchment so that they may copy on it the miracles of Our Lady Mary ’ 3 l. 17–19 (ed.), 3 l. 6–8 (tr.); ወለአቡነሂ፡ ሚናስ፡ ዘወሀበ፡ ብራና፡ ለጽሒፈ፡ ገድሉ፡ ለአቡነ፡ ተወልደ፡ መድኅን፡ ‘ E anche al nostro padre Minas che ha dato la pergamena per scrivere il Gädl di Abba Täwäldä-Mädǝḫn ’ 68 (148) l. 29, 70 (150) l. 1 (ed.), 69 (149) l. 33, 77 (151) l. 1 (tr.) (‘Di attestazione apparentemente più tarda è berhānnā dell’etiopico, berānnā del­l’a­ma­ri­co e del tigrino, per il quale si sono fatte due proposte etimologiche: (1) dal greco μεμβράνα e in tal caso berhānnā etiopico è forma pseudo-etimologica per un originario berānnā; o (2) dalla radice *brh, ‘essere luminoso, essere chiaro’ ( berhān, ‘luce’), riferito alla bianchezza della pergamena. A suffragare la prima, pur allettante ipotesi, mancherebbe la documentazione antica che un prestito dal greco in etiopico presuppone. In realtà, pur non segnalato nei lessici, il termine è stato in uso in epoca più antica di quanto si sia finora accertato, e secondo la grafia berānnā che indicherebbe a maggior ragione origine antica dal greco μεμβράνα: in tale forma compare infatti, con il significato contestuale di ‘foglio, pagina’, in una nota (forse del XV, certamente non posteriore al XVI sec.), a margine di un passo della Traditio apostolica, in un codice del Sinodos etiopico non posteriore al XV sec; ancora più preziosa è la menzione certamente risalente al 1437/38 d.C. di sarāḥta berānnā, ‘pergamentarii, addetti alla produzione della pergamena’, chiaramente distinti dal copista, nel colofone del ms. Pistoia, Biblioteca Forteguerriana, Martini etiop. 5.’ 522; see there for footnotes), vid. also ብርሃና፡

woorden.definitie: wabbāt subst., defender who spontaneously sides with the wronged party 1537a; difensore che spontaneamente prende le parti di un oppresso 587, ቦአ፡ ወባት፡ go over to the enemy ወበዕለተ፡ ወጠኑ፡ ተቃጥሎ፡ ቦኡ፡ ወባት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ንጉሥ፡ መሲሐዊ፡ መጠነ፡ ፴መስተፅዕናነ፡ አፍራስ። ‘ Le jour où commença à se battre, trente cavaliers (ennemis désertérent et) vinrent à l’aide du roi chrétien ’ 49 l. 15-17 (ed.), 57 l. 23-24 (tr.), ወእምዝ፡ ወጠኑ፡ ወባት፡ በዊአ፡ በበ፪ወበበ፡ ፫መስተጽዕናነ፡ አፍራስ፡ እምወዓልተ፡ ይስሐቅ፡ እስከነ፡ አስገዶም፡ እኁሁ፡ ‘ Alors des cavaliers de Yesḥaq et des fantassins commencèrent à venir se rendre par deux ou trois, et même Asgadom, son frère ’ 73 l. 18-20 (ed.), 84 l. 25-26 (tr.); ለእሉ፡ እለ፡ መጽኡ፡ በከዊነ፡ ወባት፡ ተቀበልዎሙ፡ ኃያላነ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ንጉሥ። ‘ Les gens d’armes du roi reçurent ceux qui vanaient se rendre ’ 73 l. 23-24 (ed.), 84 l. 30-31 (tr.)

woorden.betekenis: mangǝś, tribute, Yesḥaq envoya comme tribut au Ḥaṣē une gran
woorden.definitie: mangǝś subst. a tribute ፈነወ፡ ይስሐቅ፡ መንግሠ፡ ለሐፄ፡ ብዙኃ፡ ቁማሽ ‘ Yesḥaq envoya comme tribut au Ḥaṣē une grande quantité d’habillements ’ 39 l. 33-34, 40 l. 1 (ed.), 46 l. 19-20 (tr.) ወአዘዘ፡ በህየ፡ ከመ፡ ያምጽኡ፡ መንግሠ፡ ጐጃም፡ ነጋሽ፡ አንበሳ፡ ዳዊት። ‘ It fit donner l’ordre au Nagash du Guadjâm, Anbasâ Dâwit, de venir lui payer son tribut ’ 160 l. 3-5 (ed.); 160 l. 4-5 b the same as vid. መንግሥት፡ C for መንግሥ፡ ቤት vid. ቤት፡

woorden.betekenis: ʾabrosifāryon, Gälawdewos Abrosifaryon the majestic king
woorden.definitie: ʾabrosifāryon n. pr. (epithet) ገላውዴዎስ፡ አብሮሲፋርዮን፡ ንጉሥ፡ ግሩም። ‘ Gälawdewos Abrosifaryon the majestic king ’ 75 § 148 (ed.), 44 § 148 (tr.)

woorden.betekenis: (?) covering
woorden.definitie: (?) covering page 404 (fol. 20rb); the reading is not certain

woorden.betekenis: mǝʿro, un meʿero de beurre
woorden.definitie: mǝʿro subst. meaning unknown, perhaps a type of container and, by extension, a unit of measurement ምዕሮ፡ ቅብዕ፡ ‘ un meʿero de beurre ’ 9 l. 2 (ed.), ND 9 l. 6 (tr.)

woorden.betekenis: ʾad, village, country, region, Le Ḥawastā et le Ḥambarā doiv
woorden.definitie: ʾad subst. village, country, region ሐወስታ። ወሐምብራ፡ በበ፡ አድ፡ ከማሁ፡ ፫፡ ፈርጅ፡ ወሕዳድ፡ በበ፡ አድ፡ ከማሁ፡‘ Le Ḥawastā et le Ḥambarā doivent 3 farǧ chaque pays, et un ḥedād (?) chaque pays, égalament ’ 9 l. 9-11 (ed.), 9 l 16-17 (tr.)

woorden.betekenis: ʿāqāṣen, ʾaqāṣǝn, ʿāqāṣǝn, ʾaqaḍan, Les autres chefs, tels q
woorden.definitie: ʿāqāṣen, አቃጽን፡ ʾaqāṣǝn, ዓቃጽን፡ ʿāqāṣǝn, አቀፀን፡ ʾaqaḍan, subst. (title) a governor of Sarāwe ካልአንሰ፡ ሰየምት፡ እለ፡ ከመ፡ ሰራዌ፡ አቀፀን፡ ወካንቲባ፡ ሐማሴን፡ ወእለ፡ ከማሁ፡ ብዙኃን፡ ሰየምት፡ ተቀትሉ። ‘ Les autres chefs, tels que le aqaṣan du Sarāwē, le Kāntibā du Ḥamāsēn, et d’autres comme eux, furent tués en grand nombre ’ 128 l. 25–26 (ed.), 146 l. 6–8 (tr.); ወአቃጽንሂ፡ ይሠይም፡ ንቡረ፡ እድ፡ እምደብተራ፡ ‘ Le ʾaqāṣen élira le nebura ed en le choisissant parmi les dabtarā ’ 9 l. 21–22 (ed.), 9 l. 30–31 (tr.); መለከኛ፡ ወዓቃጽን፡ ‘ le chef (malakañā) ou le ʿāqāṣen ’ 29 l. 2 (ed.), 33 l. 9–10 (tr.); እመሂ፡ ሰራዌ፡ ዓቃጽን፡ ወእመሂ፡ ባሕረ፡ ነጋሢ፡ ዘሄዶ፡ ወዘተዓገሎ፡ ውጉዘ፡ ለይኩን፡ በአፈ፡ ነቢያት፡ ‘ Si quelqun’un, ʿāqāṣen du Sarāwē ou bāḥr nagāsi, viole ou transgresse cet [acte], maudit soit-il par la bouche des Prophètes, ’ 42 l. 1–2 (ed.), 49 l. 22–24 (tr.)

woorden.betekenis: masbakiyā, masbakyā, un masbakyā en or
woorden.definitie: masbakiyā, መስበክያ masbakyā subst. 1 means of, place or time for preaching 2 kind of a praying stick ? ወርቅ፡ መስበክያ፡ ፩። ‘ un masbakyā en or ’ 70 l. 25 (ed.), 85 l. 6 (tr.) (Conti Rossini suggests that warq masbakyā can be an object similar to vid. ሰንደቅ፡ 86 n. 2) C for መስበክያ፡ መስቀል vid. መስቀል፡ (TraCES) E from Amharic መስበክያ masbakyā, መስበኪያ masbakiyā instr. ‘means of, place or time for preaching’

woorden.betekenis: ǧǝwāni, ǧawāni, 1 couverture ǧewāni. –– Du daǧ azmāč Adāwo,
woorden.definitie: ǧǝwāni, ጀዋኒ፡ ǧawāni a kind of cloth 203, ፩፡ ጅዋኒ፡ ሰርፍ። ዘደጅ፡ አዝማች፡ አዳዎ፡ ‘ 1 couverture ǧewāni. –– Du daǧ azmāč Adāwo ’ 13 l. 23 (ed.), 14 l. 18-19 (tr.) E ‘perhaps from Arabic ǧawāni, pl. of ǧūniyya “sack, bag”’ 37, from Amharic ǧawāni 203, ǧāwānyā 1148

woorden.betekenis: mas, mead, hydromel, 1 capuchon jaune mas, mäs, mäš, mes
woorden.definitie: mas subst. mead hydromel ፩፡ ራዎት፡ ብጫ፡ መስ፡ ‘ 1 capuchon jaune mas ’ 13 l. 23–24 (ed.), 14 l. 19 (tr.) E Tigrinya መስ mäs or መሽ mäš hydromel variation of ሜስ mes 380a

woorden.betekenis: rāwot, large waterskin or waterbottle of leather, 1 capuchon
woorden.definitie: rāwot subst. ‘ large waterskin or waterbottle of leather ’ 403a ፩፡ ራዎት፡ ብጫ፡ መስ፡ ‘ 1 capuchon jaune mas ’ 13 23-24 (ed.), 14 l. 19 (tr.) (The translation provided by CR ‘capuchon’ is incorrect. There is a separate word rāwot which indeed means a ‘hood’. 131a, 1138a) E from Arabic rāwiyya, Amharic ረዋት räwat ራዎት rawot ራወት rawät ራዋት rawat 239, 104, 403a

woorden.betekenis: taftā, 1 aube taftā, avec 12 crochets en ergent
woorden.definitie: taftā adj. meaning unknown ተፍታ፡ ቀሚስ፡ ዘቦቱ፡ ቍልፍ፡ ዘብሩር፡ ፩፡ ወ፪። ‘ 1 aube taftā, avec 12 crochets en ergent ’ 14 l. 1–2 (ed.), 14 l. 27–28 (tr.)

woorden.betekenis: nafāḥ, one that blows, blower, nafāḥ gantā, trumpeter, et pe
woorden.definitie: nafāḥ n. ag. one that blows blower; ነፋሕ፡ ገንታ፡ nafāḥ gantā trumpeter ወእንዘ፡ ነፋሕ፡ ገንታ፡ ጰንጠሌዎን፡ ‘ et pendant que le sonneur de la trompette était Panṭalewon ’ 27 l. 2 (ed.), 30 l. 23–24 (tr.), vid. ገንታ፡

woorden.betekenis: marāḫt
woorden.definitie: marāḫt subst. meaning unknown C for ሊቀ፡ መራኅት፡ vid. ሊቅ፡ (TraCES)

woorden.betekenis: qallatā, aid, help, gift, Dans le Ṣerāʿ, nous avons défendu
woorden.definitie: qallatā subst. ‘ aid, help, gift ’ 1070b (see also the comment below) ወበጽራዕሂ፡ ሥዩማኒሆሙ፡ ወዘታሕቴሆሙ፡ ኅዱግ፡ ወአፈ፡ ሹም፡ በስምዕ፡ ወበአንበሳ፡ ወበመዓር፡ ወበቀለታ፡ ወበሕዳድ፡ አሕረምነ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይባኡ፡፡ ‘ Dans le Ṣerāʿ, nous avons défendu d’y entrer aux chefs des pays et à leurs subordonnés, les vicaires et les porte-parole des chefs, pour la cire, le lion, le miel, pour l’aumône et le ḥedād ’ 40 l. 11–13 (ed.), 47 l. 23–26 (tr.) (‘Je traduis qalatā «aumône», d’après l’amharique qallata «faire l’aumône à une personne tombée en misère par un accident imprévu, tel qu’un incendie, une incursion de bandits, ect.»’ 48 n. 2)

woorden.betekenis: dabanā, dǝbanā, dabana, royal tent, e o capacete real, que é
woorden.definitie: dabanā, ድበና፡ dǝbanā, ደበነ፡ dabana subst. royal tent 774b ወጌራ፡ መንግሥትኒ፡ ዘውእቱ፡ ዘውድ፡ አግበረ፡ ሎቱ፡ እምወርቅ፡ ጽሩይ። ደበናሂ፡ ምስለ፡ መንጠዋልዕ፡ አስፈየ። ‘ e o capacete real, que é a corôa, Ihe mandou fazer de ouro puro; e ainda mandou coser uma dabana com cortinas ’ 60 l. 86–87 (ed.), 47 l. 25–27 (tr.); ወምህርካሂ፡ ብዙኅ፡ ተረከበ፡ ወደበናሂ፡ ተሰልበ። ‘ E encontrou-se muita presa, e tambem foi tomada uma dabana ’ 80 l. 52–53 (ed.), 62 l. 33–34 (tr.); ወንጉሥኒ፡ ወረደ፡ እምነ፡ ዓቀብ፡ መንገለ፡ መትሕት፡ ወአትከለ፡ ደበና። ‘ e tambem o Rei desecu da encosta para baixo, e mandou armar a dabana ’ 117 l. 48–49 (ed.), 91 l. 26–28 (tr.) C for ዓቄት፡ ደበና፡ vid. ዓቄት፡

woorden.betekenis: ǝmmǝyya, pendant que la reine était ma mère Admās Mogasā
woorden.definitie: ǝmmǝyya subst. lit. ‘my mother’ እንዘ፡ ንግሥት፡ እምየ፡ አድማሰ፡ ሞገሳ፡ ‘ pendant que la reine était ma mère Admās Mogasā ’ 46 l. 10–11 (ed.), 55 l. 18–19 (tr.)

woorden.betekenis: fāqquze, fāqqʷǝze, un fāquezē, un drap fāquezē pour couvrir
woorden.definitie: fāqquze, ፋቍዜ፡ fāqqʷǝze ‘kind of cloth used for covering the tabot’ 2300a after 261 ፋቍዜ፡ ፩። ‘un fāquezē’ 71 l. 13 (ed.), 85 l. 27 (tr.); ፋቍዜ፡ ማኅፈድ፡ ፪። ‘un drap fāquezē pour couvrir le tabernacle’ {In the text there are two pieces, not one as in the translation.} 71 l. 22 (ed.), 86 l. 3–4 (tr.)

woorden.betekenis: sarḥ, 124 sarḥ warq (pièces de drap d’or travaillées?)
woorden.definitie: sarḥ meaning unknown; 55, referring to 86 l. 5 (tr.) provides ሰርፍ፡ ወርቅ፡ instead of ሰርሕ፡ ወርቅ፡ and translates the compound as ‘(drappo)’ i.e. ‘cloth’; ሰርሕ፡ ወርቅ፡ ፻፳፬። ‘ 124 sarḥ warq (pièces de drap d’or travaillées?) ’ 71 l. 22–23 (ed.), ND 86 l. 5 (tr.)

woorden.betekenis: zabo, warq zabo, warqa zabo, une aube avec de l’or, une chap
woorden.definitie: zabo (the) one which is, (the) one which has; ወርቅ፡ ዘቦ፡ warq zabo, ወርቀ፡ ዘቦ፡ warqa zabo 463a, 838, lit. (the) one which is (with) gold, (the) one which has gold, ‘golden embroidery’ 463a, ‘brocade, cloth interwoven with gold thread, available in pieces of about 30 m. in green, yellow, red, purple and blue’ 838 ፩፡ ወርቅ፡ ዘቦ፡ ቀሚስ። ‘ une aube avec de l’or ’ 50 l. 3 (ed.), 60 l. 3–4 (tr.); ወርቅ፡ ዘቦ፡ ካፓ፡ ‘ une chape brodeé en or ’ 65 l. 18 (ed.), 79 l. 4 (tr.); ፩፡ ግምዣ፡ ወርቅ፡ ዘቦ፡ ‘ un drap de velours brodé en or ’ 65 l. 19–20 (ed.), 79 l. 5–6 (tr.), vid. ወርቅ፡

woorden.betekenis: mari
woorden.definitie: mari one who leads C for መሪ፡ ጌታ፡ vid. ጌታ፡ E from Amharic መሪ mari n. ag. ‘one who leads’

woorden.betekenis: torāt
woorden.definitie: torāt n. pr. (place name) area in Tigray, north-west of Aksum C for ሥዩመ፡ ቶራት፡ vid. ሥዩም፡ (TraCES)

woorden.betekenis: takal
woorden.definitie: takal derived from the Gǝʿǝz verb ‘takala’, i.e. ‘plant, establish’ C for ዣን፡ ተከል፡ vid. ዣን፡

woorden.betekenis: fuṭat, sash, 19 stole che sono rimaste a me, io Musē, peccat
woorden.definitie: fuṭat subst. sash (see also the comment below) ፲ወ፱ሞጠሕት፡ ዘጸነሀኒ፡ [sic] አነ፡ ሙሴ፡ ኃጥዕ፡ ዶቲ፡ ምስለ፡ ፉጠቱ፡ ወምስለ፡ ማኅበሱ፡ ‘ 19 stole che sono rimaste a me, io Musē, peccatore, doti con la sua fascia ed il suo māḥbas 10 ’ 41 IV 1–2 (ed.), 30 IV 1–2 (tr.); ፉጠት፡ ዘሓሪር፡ ፭ ውራድ፡ [a margine illeggibile] ፲፭ ልብሰ፡ አርዋ፡ ፩ ዘነቦ፡ ፬ ‘ 5 fasce di seta, 15 werad, 1 veste di tessuto di seta, 4 zanabo, ’ 43 VI l. 20–21 (ed.), 36 l. 17–18 (tr.); ፲ወ፭ቀሚስ፡ ፭ፉጠት፡ ‘ 15 tuniche, 5 fasce, ’ 44 VII l. 2 (ed.), 38 VII l. 2 (tr.); ፉጠት፡ ዘሐሪር፡ ፬። ወቀሚስ፡ ውራድ፡ ፱[፡] ‘ 4 fasce di seta, 9 tuniche werād, ’ 64 l. 6 (ed.), 53 l. 12 (tr.) (‘Forse da accostare al tigrino fuṭā (1016).’ 47a) E Amharic ፉጠት fuṭat ‘wrapping a hamelät {i.e. headcloth} or a towel around the head’ 2343a after 1389b; Tigrinya ፉጣ fuṭā ‘striscia di tela, ordinariamente colorata, colla quale si cingono i fianchi, e tengono invece dei calzoni gli abitanti della costa’ 1016

woorden.betekenis: bǝrkʷǝmmā, stool, portatrice di sgabello
woorden.definitie: bǝrkʷǝmmā subst. stool ጸዋሪተ፡ ብርኵማ፡ ‘ portatrice di sgabello ’ 61 Didascalie (‘O «appoggiatesta in legno». Berkwemmā è registrato nei dizionari di amarico come «specie di stampella cortissima o sgabelletto» o anche «piccolo cuscino di legno coperto» (325 e 886b). Non si tratta dunque genericamente di «goods» come indica 533.’ 60 n. 168) E Amharic ብርኵማ bǝrkʷǝmmā ‘wooden headrest; bridge of a bägäna-harp; wooden handrest used by cripples with atrophied legs for walking across the ground’ 886b

woorden.betekenis: mabrāht, lamp, 7 lampade su piedistallo, 2 lampade di vetro,
woorden.definitie: mabrāht subst. lamp መብራህተ፡ ቀዋሚ፡ ፯[፡] ወመብራህት፡ ዘማህው፡ ፪[፡] ‘ 7 lampade su piedistallo, 2 lampade di vetro, ’ 64 l. 13–14 (ed.), 53 l. 20–21 (tr.) a መብራህተ፡ ቀዋሚ፡ mabrāhta qawāmi standing lamp ተቅዋመ፡ ማኅቶት፡ ፪ መብራህተ፡ ቀዋሚ፡ ፫ ‘ 2 piedistalli per lampade, 3 lampade su piedistallo, ’ 43 VI l. 30–31 (ed.), 36 l. 30–31 (tr.); መብራህተ፡ ቀዋሚ፡ ፯[፡] ወመብራህት፡ ዘማህው፡ ፪[፡] ‘ 7 lampade su piedistallo, 2 lampade di vetro, ’ 64 l. 13–14 (ed.), 53 l. 20–21 (tr.) (‘Il primo termine dovrebbe valere come sostantivo (in 104a è attestato solo come aggettivo, ma si veda l’amarico mabrāt)’. 47a) E Amharic መብራት mabrāt

woorden.betekenis: qʷǝrṣatā, E mentre prima non si onoravano sue festività se n
woorden.definitie: qʷǝrṣatā subst. ወእንዘ፡ ቀዲሙ፡ ኢይትከበር፡ በዓላቲሃ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ፬[፡] ዕለት፡ ለለ፡ ዓመት፡ ወ[eraso]እ[sic]ቡ[sopra ነ]ሰ፡ አዘዘነ፡ ከመ፡ ናክብር፡ ለለ፡ ወርኁ፡ ኵሎ፡ በዓላቲሃ፡ ወዓዲ፡ ወሰከ፡ ዲቤሆን፡ ፬[፡] ዕለታት፡ ክቡራን፡ በዓላቲሃ፡ ዘውእቶን፡ ቍጽረታ፡ ወደብረ፡ ቍስቋም፡ በአታ። ‘E mentre prima non si onoravano sue festività se non 4 giorni all’anno, nostro padre ci ordinò che onorassimo ogni mese tutte le sue festività, e inoltre aggiunse a esse 4 giorni onorati, che sono la Concezione, l’Ingresso a Dabra Qʷesqʷām,’ 64 L. 29–32 (ed.), 54 l. 15–18 (tr.) G ቍጽረታ qʷǝrṣatā (et non ቍጽረት፡) Conception de Marie. Ici le mot ቍጽረት፡ est synonyme de ፅንሰት፡ (conception). A rapprocher des sens: enserré, enroulé, noué, attaché, donné par au verbe vid. ቈጸረ።. Texte et référence: አመ፡ ፯፡ ቍጽረታ፡ ለእግዝእትነ፡ ማርያም። Le 7: conception de Notre-Dame-Marie 20, 22. 455 L ቍጽረታ qʷǝrṣatā 455 conception by the Virgin Mary lit. ‘her conception’, (originally, ‘her holding the fruit as a knot in her womb’) 451a

woorden.betekenis: hallǝwo, existence, présence, essence, nature, substance, l’
woorden.definitie: hallǝwo Infin. nom. G ሀልዎ hallǝwo (Infin. nom.), présente dans la langue théologique souvent les mêmes sens que les noms abstraits {vid.} ህላዌ፡ et {vid.} ህሉና፡, existence, présence, essence, nature, substance, φύσις, οὐσία, ὑπόστασις. L’expression théologique fréquemment usitée ኅቡረ፡ ህላዌ፡ (ὁμούσιος) se substitue parfois à l’expression ኅቡረ፡ ሀልዎ፡. ሀልዎ፡ « existence, l’être » –– መኖር፡, Ms. Paris, BnF, d’Abbadie 217, fol. 9r. ሀልዎ፡ « persona » –– መኖር፡, Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 1. ሀልዎ፡ l’existence, en opposition à ኢሀልዎ፡ le néant. እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘገብረ፡ ኵሎ፡ እምኀበ፡ ኢሀልዎ፡ ኀበ፡ ሀልዎ፡ በሥልጣነ፡ መለኮቱ፡ ጽኑዕ፡ በኵሉ፡ ግብር። 159. ሀልዎት፡ hallǝwot existence, (synonyme de ሀልዎ፡). ነገር፡ በእንተ፡ ምሥጢረ፡ መለኮት፡ ኢሀሎ፡ አብ፡ እምቅድመ፡ ወልድ፡ ወኢሀሎ፡ ወልድ፡ እምቅድመ፡ አብ፡ ወኢሀሎ፡ መንፈስ፡ ቅዱስ፡ ቅድመ፡ አብ፡ ወወልድ። ሀልዎቶሙ፡ እምቅድመ፡ ፍጥረተ፡ ዓለም። ወአሐዱ፡ ውእቱ፡ ሀልዎቶሙ፡ እምድኅረ፡ ፍጥረተ፡ ዓለም። ፫ስመ፡ ሠለስቲሆሙ፡ ብሂል፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዕሩይ፡ መለኮቶሙ፡ ወ፩ውእቱ፡ ሀልዎቶሙ፡ እምቅድመ፡ ሰማይ፡ ወምድር። አልቦ፡ ማኅለቅተ፡ ለሀልዎቶሙ። 2 ሀልዎት፡ « praesentia » –– Ms. Roma, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Roma, Orientale 134, p. 1. 3 C vid. also ሀለወ፡ esp. 1f)
